"Sealing method: Do not wipe away the dirty blood covering the front end of the gold coin. Once you wipe it away, you need to use the blood of a Beyonder from the Judgment pathway to apply it to the portrait again within a day."
"Description: It looks like a gold coin. The left half of the gold coin is slightly dark, while the right half is golden. The background patterns on both sides are completely different, giving people an uncomfortable feeling. The front center of the gold coin is covered with dark red bloodstains. After wiping away the bloodstains, you can see the left half smiling and the right half angry.
"This item came from a Fourth Epoch gold coin corroded by the Beyonder characteristic of a Sequence 7 Lucky One. This Lucky One was suspected to have been killed by a Disciplinary Paladin when he was alive, and he was tainted with some power of order."
"After analysis, I learned that this gold coin has a low sense of existence. It has anti-detection and anti-divination abilities. As long as you wipe away the bloodstains on the gold coin, you can obtain a day of good luck. The degree of good luck cannot be controlled, and it's considered passive. Furthermore, this luck isn't fixed. It fluctuates between high and low levels. Sometimes, it's especially powerful. Sometimes, it's like an ordinary person, so it's very difficult to rely on it completely.
"Beyonders with divination powers can use gold coins to cleanse the bloodstains to achieve a better divination effect.
"This item can be used, but on the second day after it's used, it has to be smeared with the blood of a Beyonder from the Judgment pathway. Otherwise, based on the luck of the previous day, it will give the user an equal amount of bad luck. Under bad luck, the user will either be injured or lose his life. Once the user dies, the surface of the gold coin will produce blood stains again. If the user doesn't obtain the blood seal for a long period of time, the user's bad luck will increase day by day until he dies."
...
After returning to his cabin, Ebner played with the ancient gold coins he had just collected and reviewed the analysis report of the Eye of Pure White.
Looking at this antithetical appearance, I can tell that it's a product from the Solomon Empire... The lucky one died at the hands of a Disciplinary Paladin? Could it be the Black Emperor's solid ally, the subordinate of the True Creator? After all, the potion formula of the Wheel of Fortune pathway, other than the Life School of Thought of the small snake and the organization that can't be named, only the huge snake that's absolutely loyal to the True Creator has it...
"Furthermore, the mural behind the door on the island that Mr. Skade mentioned might very well be related to the Angel of Fate."
Thinking of this, Ebner looked helplessly at the gold coin in his hand and pondered.
The effects of this gold coin aren't bad, but every time I use it, I need to seal it with the blood of a Beyonder from the Judgment pathway... Could it be that I have to constantly seek Xio for blood? This... It's really difficult to ask.
...
Tingen City, Blackthorn Security Company.
In the well-ventilated but silent underground, the yellow gas lamps were protected by the glass, steadily illuminating the deserted and peaceful aisle.
Klein sat in the duty room and casually flipped through the stacks of newspapers, magazines, and books in front of him. He also diverted a portion of his attention to the outside to prevent anyone from entering Chanis Gate.
The rich aroma of coffee emanated as Klein couldn't help but take a sip and pinch his temples to resist the heaviness in his head and the fatigue in his body.
He casually picked up the novel left behind by the Captain or other Nighthawks.
"Stormwind Mountain Villa, author, Fors Wall." Klein read the main content of the cover.
It was a peaceful night with a faint yellow glow. A book with a cover reminded him of the days when he rented a book to read when he was young. Hence, he read it with nostalgia.
The novel, Stormwind Mountain Villa, tells the story of the 1.65-meter-tall Ms. Szee, who weighs 98 pounds, entering Flius Mountain as a home tutor.
One pound is equivalent to one kilogram... Is this a simplified version of love from another world? Klein stroked the comfortable piece of paper with his fingers and guessed at the subsequent content.
However, just as he thought that it was a romance novel, a hateful "evil spirit" who liked to show off his knowledge but refused to finish his sentence appeared.
This description of the evil spirit is very realistic. Just like Mr. Tower, it makes one wish to capture it and tell it everything...
While Klein was ranting about the story character and thinking that it might be a supernatural novel, the female lead, Miss Cecelia, revealed the true identity of the "evil spirit" with a gorgeous inference. She was just a detective who wanted to interfere with the female lead's investigation.
Following that, Klein believed that it was a detective novel, but the male protagonist's head quickly suffered a heavy blow and lost his memories. He began a tear-jerking plot.
... In the end, it's still a romance novel. Klein closed the book and took a sip of coffee with a headache.
Dong!
Dong! Dong! Dong!
Intense knocking sounds suddenly sounded, echoing in the dim and quiet corridor and underground where there was almost no one else.
Klein was shocked and tensed up. He grabbed his revolver and looked at the source of the voice, Chanis Gate.
At that moment, he heard an ear-piercing grinding sound. He saw Chanis Gate crack open heavily!
Thud!
Amidst a voice so raw that it made one's teeth ache, Klein's nearly frozen eyes saw a toy doll. It was about the height of an adult man's forearm. It was wearing a black, elegant, and slightly retractable regal dress. The skirt had obvious stains.
It had a rather delicate face, dark eyes, and tightly pursed lips.
This was 3-0265, Misfortune Cloth Puppet! A dangerous Sealed Artifact that could bring misfortune or even death to others!
The moment he recognized it, Klein subconsciously raised his gun and aimed at it.
However, the doll in the black regal dress clung tightly to the open Chanis Gate and unfolded the piece of paper in its hand.
On the piece of paper were numerous secret symbols. There were some that Klein recognized and some that he hadn't grasped. They formed a vertical eye!
Before Klein could figure out what was happening, the court doll was suddenly pulled back behind Chanis Gate by an invisible force!
Having experienced such a terrifying incident, Klein didn't dare delay. He hurriedly rang the internal alarm and called the other Nighthawks over. After a series of investigations, he confirmed that nothing terrifying had happened to him.
After a night, Klein, who had finally returned home, didn't rest. He took four steps counterclockwise, chanted the incantation silently, resisted the chaotic screams, and went above the gray fog.
Following that, through divination, he confirmed that the vertical eye pattern was the key to the treasure left behind by the Antigonus family!
Due to the death of Ray Bieber, the descendants of the Antigonus family have been severed. Therefore, that notebook views me, a Seer who has come into contact with it and is still alive, as its successor?
It affects 3-0625 and leaves behind the key to the treasure, allowing the other party to show it to me during my shift at Chanis Gate?
"There's nothing wrong with this logic, but it still can't convince me."
"After all, I'm a completely unrelated person... Wait..."
With this in mind, Klein's heart suddenly stirred as he recalled what Mr. Tower had unintentionally revealed.
"Antigonus family... The Half-Fool..."
"And I'm currently acting as The Fool above the gray fog..."
"This mysterious gray fog space and Seer Sequence are related to the Antigonus family?"
...
On Saturday morning, Ebner, who had been separated from Backlund for a month, finally stepped foot on the land of the Capital of Capitals once again. After waving goodbye to Reporter Mike and Apothecary Darkwill, who he was more familiar with on the ship, he picked up his cello and called for a rental carriage before heading straight for his teacher's office in Hillston Borough.
When he arrived at the entrance of the law firm, he realized that there was a carriage with the Church of Evernight's Sacred Emblem parked outside the somewhat old villa.
Ebner frowned and asked the footman, who had already gone out to greet him when he returned, "Does the teacher have another commission?"
"Detective Stanton seems to be meeting a distinguished guest. He had long instructed me to bring you directly to your previous office when you return," the valet answered truthfully.
Ebner nodded and walked straight into the lobby of the law firm.
But at that moment, Detective Isengard's office suddenly opened. A man in his thirties in a black trench coat and white shirt walked out accompanied by his teacher.
Ebner glanced casually around and saw that the man had very short golden-brown hair and dark green eyes that looked like a moonless lake in the middle of the night. The collar of his shirt and trench coat stood up high, hiding his entire chin in the shadows.
What was even more eye-catching was that there was a silver-white metal box on his back that looked like a violin case.
This style was very similar to Ebner who was carrying a cello case.
When Detective Isengard saw Ebner, he immediately introduced him to the man beside him with a smile. "Your Excellency Cesimir, this is my student, Ebner Bryan. You should have heard of him."
Crestet Cesimir stared at the piano box behind Ebner a few times before smiling. "As a young detective, you've done very well to be able to find out about the criminal trafficking case with that bounty hunter lady."
"Thank you for your praise. I was just lucky." Although Ebner had yet to recall who this person was, he knew from his teacher's attitude that he was likely an official figure. Furthermore, he was likely from the Church of Evernight.
Cesimir nodded slightly, then turned to Detective Isengard and said, "Today's transaction is complete. Then I should take my leave."
Detective Isengard smiled and said, "I didn't expect an important figure like you to come in person. Please forgive me for my lack of hospitality."
After exchanging some pleasantries, the man named Cesimir carried the zither box and left.
It was not until his carriage was very far away that Ebner heaved a sigh of relief. He asked curiously, "Teacher, who is this gentleman?"
"It's the Sword of the Goddess, Crestet Cesimir, one of the nine high-ranking deacons of the Church of Evernight's Nighthawks!" Upon saying this, Detective Isengard exhaled a smoke ring and continued,
"You came back at such a bad time."

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Conversation
chapters.content:
Chapter 77 - Conversation
"Sword of the Goddess? What is he doing here?" Ebner asked after putting his luggage away.
Detective Isengard took a puff and replied playfully, "This actually has something to do with you."
"What does it have to do with me?" Ebner's heart tightened. He had been watched by too many high-level existences recently, and he did not want another one.
"Do you still remember that you sold the Seer Sequence potion formula at my Beyonder gathering?" Detective Isengard asked with a smile.
"That was the first time I went to your gathering... Remember when I sold the Sequence 9 Seer formula and Sequence 8 Clown formula." Ebner nodded. It had only been two months since the incident, and his memory wasn't that bad.
"The person who bought the formula from you is the lady known as Poison Rose. She sold me a Clown Beyonder characteristic at the last gathering!" Detective Isengard said meaningfully.
This... It can't be that the lady nurtured Clown to sell it, right? That's not right either. The Clown's Beyonder characteristic is worth at most six to seven hundred pounds. Doing this would definitely be a loss...
Ebner was taken aback at first, then thought rather comically.
Detective Isengard glanced at him and roughly guessed that his student was letting his thoughts run wild again. He ignored him and continued, "I'm guessing that the Clown nurtured by Ma'am Poison Rose betrayed her. At that gathering, her body was clearly somewhat unwell, and she was suspected to have suffered serious injuries."
"But what does this have to do with His Excellency's visit?" Ebner asked in puzzlement.
"As the Church of Evernight has always been secretly collecting items related to the Seer Sequence, Beyonder characteristics are naturally no exception," Detective Isengard explained with a smile.
"In other words, you sold that characteristic to the Nighthawks?" Ebner asked thoughtfully. However, he quickly discovered something amiss. This was because how could such a transaction alarm a Holy Artifact Contractor who had a demigod-level combat ability?
He looked at his teacher suspiciously, feeling that there was definitely something else going on.
How could Detective Isengard not tell what his student was thinking? He shook his head and said, "I don't know why His Excellency, the Sword of the Goddess, would come here personally... But I'm guessing that it has something to do with a Beyonder matter he's dealing with."
"You mean... Divination?" Ebner said in enlightenment. Although he had gained some experience from this trip, compared to old scoundrels like his teacher... No, an experienced Beyonder, he still lacked experience.
"That's right. The Nighthawks have the Sequence potions of the Seer and Mystery Pryer Sequence, and they have no lack of divination abilities. They must've seen something related to me or you in the divination interpretation of a particular case. That's why His Excellency, the Sword of the Goddess, came personally." Detective Isengard nodded in gratification. He was very satisfied with his student's reaction and sighed.
"With your current deduction ability, it won't be long before you finish digesting the 'deduction student' potion!"
Ebner was dumbfounded when he heard that. He puffed up his chest and bragged to Detective Isengard, "Teacher, I'm already a Knowledge Keeper."
Detective Isengard was stunned when he heard that. He sized up his student in disbelief and asked hesitantly, "Is what you said true?"
"Of course!" As Ebner replied, he used his aura extraction ability in front of his teacher and took away most of the remaining aura in the room.
Although this skill didn't have any external manifestations, how could Detective Isengard, who could also sense and extract auras, not notice that a large portion of the aura in the room was missing? He immediately understood what Ebner had just done.
"I didn't expect you to complete my journey of more than ten years in just a month..."
Detective Isengard didn't know what to say. There was envy, relief, remorse, indignation. All in all, it was complicated.
After a long while, he composed himself and took a deep puff of the cigarette before asking, "What exactly did you experience in this mission?"
Ebner thought for a moment. After eliminating the content that involved the Dream Maze Tower, the Tarot Club, Queen Mystic, the Sanguine Duke, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, he recounted the rest of his experiences.
But even so, it left Detective Isengard somewhat alarmed. He believed that he might not be able to handle matters better than his student in certain situations. For example, at the cave sinking ship, he felt that he wouldn't be able to find a way to restrict Sealed Artifacts so quickly. He didn't know that his student actually had a cheat.
"I never expected your trip to be so exciting... It's no wonder you advanced to Sequence 7." After hearing the ins and outs of the matter, Detective Isengard had accepted the fact that Ebner was rapidly advancing.
"Teacher, how are the two Demonesses?" Ebner couldn't help but ask when he recalled the "report" teaching before he left Backlund.
"That Ma'am Ray came once after that, and I gave her the information about the single male aristocrat... However, she seems to be somewhat disappointed that she didn't see you." Detective Isengard reined in his emotions and teased with a faint smile.
"Teacher, stop joking..." Ebner was a little helpless. He did not want the Demoness to think about him at all.
"About two weeks after Ms. Ray took away the information, I designed the Mandated Punishers to discover the 'Witch' Lena who wasn't careful enough. Heh, the Mandated Punishers mainly rely on the Knowledge Keeper they nurtured. It's quite easy to guide them," Detective Isengard said smugly.
He never hid his displeasure and schadenfreude towards the Church of Storms.
A Mandated Punisher? His teacher had made the Church of Storms take the blame again... At the same time, he had also removed himself from the blame. After all, as the secret agent of the Church of Knowledge in Backlund, how could he have the guts to report it to the Church of Storms...
Ebner was secretly impressed by his teacher's cunningness... No, Moe was wise. Then, he asked in anticipation, "So, the two witches have been captured by the Mandated Punishers?"
Upon hearing that, Detective Isengard shook his head and said, "The Mandated Punishers are still as unreliable as ever... Even after using a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, they still allowed the two Demonesses to escape. However, don't worry. The Church of Storms has already reported their looks to the Church of Evernight and the Church of Steam. Even if they come out again, they won't dare to be as unbridled as before. They won't have the time to find trouble with you and Miss Xio."
How could they escape? Could it be that the military or the royal family had protected them?
Although he had obtained his teacher's guarantee, and now Ebner was confident that he could survive in the hands of a Mid-Sequence Demoness, he still felt uneasy. For the first time, he had the thought of taking the initiative to eliminate them.
...
Backlund, Empress Borough.
Audrey Hall sat on a hanging chair in a corner in the shade. She looked at the flowers blooming under the sunlight and thought about Fors Wall's request for help.
According to Viscount Glaint's verification, there really was a girl named Xio Derecha who was investigated by MI9's intelligence department.
The reason for investigating her was to threaten a decent gentleman through illegal means and make him admit many groundless crimes such as trafficking.
With regards to this, Fors's explanation was that the gentleman wasn't a good person. He was a gang leader in Backlund's East Borough. He lived on loan sharks and even sold bankrupt civilian family members as payment.
The cause of the matter was that a particular borrower had discovered that the interest was several times higher than he had expected. Even if he failed to repay the loan after going bankrupt, he had sought out the nearby famous Arbiter, Xio Derecha, despite having failed to negotiate with the gentleman. He hoped that she could convince him to waive the unreasonable portion.
The gentleman had sent someone to threaten Xio Derecha when he first found out about the investigation. He had even gotten into a conflict with Xio Derecha, and there was evidence from the police station. However, in the end, he admitted his crime and disbanded the gang under Xio's "ruling."
As for MI9, they used this as an excuse to investigate Xio.
Viscount Glaint investigated the matter and confirmed that Fors Wall's description was true. He also confirmed that the gang leader had indeed committed many crimes.
Furthermore, he also found out who was behind this investigation against Xio Derecha.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Ball
chapters.content:
Chapter 78 - Ball
Berner Callaway was a lieutenant. He was the acting department director of MI9's "National Security and Counter-Enterrorism Team '' and Viscount Stratford's former secretary.
Audrey read the series of titles and despised Lieutenant Callaway. She felt that he must have taken a bribe from the gang to investigate a bounty hunter who upheld justice for the poor.
However, after thinking about it for a while, she decided not to use her connections to call for help. Instead, she would use her friends who worked at MI9 to end the investigation. After all, this investigation order was problematic and couldn't withstand scrutiny.
To her, the most important thing now was not to have any relationship with Fors Wall and Xio Derecha. After the incident with the Tarot Club, Audrey no longer felt like an innocent and ignorant girl.
Glaint also wishes to resolve it using normal methods, so he plans on holding a ball one day and inviting Kance over... Yes, it's quite normal for Kance to lead the investigation of MI9's internal department. That's a good idea! Audrey muttered to herself, leaning towards her friend's opinion.
Kance was Viscount Learson's youngest son, and his family had a rather good relationship with the Hall family. According to Audrey's understanding, Kance had entered MI9 after graduating from Tingen University. As he was a noble, he currently held an important position in the Internal Inspection Team.
However, it's too deliberate for Glaint to organize the ball. If someone were to connect the dots, they might think of me... Yes, I remember that there's a ball at Earl Wolf's house tomorrow night. Kance will probably be there as well. When the time comes, I'll get Glaint to mention that an officer needs to be investigated for accepting bribes. Audrey nodded slightly and made a decision.
Right at this moment, she suddenly saw her golden retriever, Susie, sneak behind the flowers in the garden in a sneaky manner and slip to a place that only gardeners could reach.
"Susie... What is it doing?" Audrey was stunned.
The golden retriever seemed to have lost its sense of smell due to the fragrance of the flowers and did not notice its owner behind it. It opened its mouth and let out a hoarse "Ahhhh".
Right on the heels of that, it caused the surrounding air to vibrate, producing words that were lacking in fluency.
"Hi."
"How are you?"
Audrey's mouth opened bit by bit, completely forgetting the etiquette that an elegant lady should have. She suddenly stood up and blurted out, "Susie, can you speak? When did you speak?"
The golden retriever jumped up in fright and turned to face its owner.
It frantically wagged its tail and opened and closed its mouth several times before shaking the surrounding air.
"I..."
"I don't know how to explain... I'm just a dog."
...
West Borough, in a bedroom of a garden villa on Williams Street, a fair-skinned lady with black hair was slowly wearing clothes. Her actions were like a beautiful painting, and her every move was charming and alluring.
Her blue eyes were filled with passion as she looked at a burly man who was panting heavily on the bed.
As expected of the Demoness of Pleasure, she deserves the name of Pleasure. She's indeed powerful! The man panted for a long time before recovering some of his stamina. When he saw the beautiful scenery in front of him, he nearly lost control. Thankfully, he was also a Beyonder, so he forced himself to enter a Cogitation state to maintain his clarity.
"Lieutenant Berner, you're very impressive too. I almost couldn't help but beg for mercy just now." The charming lady glanced at him flirtatiously and smiled. "How is it? Are you satisfied with this gift of repaying my life?"
"I'm satisfied, very satisfied... However, Miss Ray, it would be even better if you could call Lena along!" The man named Berner said with a wretched smile.
"Can't I satisfy you? And you should know that Lena doesn't have any experience in this area. She's still very inexperienced." Ray paused with his buttoned hand and rolled his eyes.
"Being inexperienced has its own pleasures! Besides, she was the one who caused the trouble of the Mandated Punishers. She should compensate for it, shouldn't she?" Berner clearly didn't plan on giving up.
Ray tilted her head and thought for a while. Then she got out of bed and tied her dark hair up in a bun. She looked at Berner and said, "It's not impossible for you to have Lena... but you have to promise to do something for me."
"What is it? Tell me about it first." Even though he was blinded by lust, Berner still maintained a certain level of caution. After all, the person in front of him was a Demoness.
"It's not a very dangerous matter... I want you to help me investigate the details of the Mandated Punishers in Backlund. That includes the members, their Sequences, and Sealed Artifacts below Grade 2. Yes, it would be even better if you had a personality or specific family information." Ray picked up the black tea on the table that had long been cooled and took a sip before saying.
She said it in a relaxed manner, but her words clearly gave Berner a fright. He couldn't care less about his pants that hadn't been worn properly as he jumped to his feet and said in disbelief, "Are you crazy?! Do you still want to take revenge on the Church of Storms?! Revenge on the Mandated Punishers?! Ignoring His Excellency God's Songster, even the captain of the Mandated Punishers is a powerhouse who has contracted a holy relic."
"The thing in this black tea is not bad, but it's a pity it doesn't have any effect on the Demoness of Pleasure." Ray put down the teacup and first commented, then said unhurriedly, "Don't be agitated. This is actually a requirement of the 'mission'. Revenge is just a matter of convenience. Although the God of Songs is powerful, there will naturally be someone to restrain him. As for the captain of the Mandated Punishers team, he has not contracted a sacred item for long. That item is currently just a burden to him."
Upon hearing that it was part of the "mission," Berner's expression softened a little. He hesitated for a while before making up his mind. "With my authority, I can only find out about the situation of ordinary members. If you want to know more, go find Lockhart. His current location is more well-informed."
"Lockhart Siakam? Duke Negan's secretary?" Ray had been traveling among various noblemen for the past month and had a good understanding of the upper-class society.
"Yes, he's also someone sent by MI9 to Duke. He's my subordinate... As for how I came into contact with him, I think it's not difficult for you." Berner nodded. Then, her expression turned ambiguous again. She smiled and asked, "Then, about Lena?"
"After you give me the information, I will send her over... It is indeed time for her to accept this. Hehe, speaking of which, although the things in your black tea don't have much effect on me, they are very useful to her."
With that said, Ray turned around and left the bedroom without caring how Berner responded. Then, he went down to the second floor and returned to his guest room.
"I must obtain the special Grade 2 Sealed Artifact that the Mandated Punishers have that can create mirror spaces!"
While thinking this, Ray sealed the room with his spirituality. Then, after taking out all kinds of utensils, she carefully took out the materials she had obtained from his previous missions and placed them in the glass bottle in order.
...
Hillston Borough, Isengard Detective Agency.
Although he had the intention to search for the whereabouts of the two Demonesses, Ebner had no clues at the moment, nor did he have any leads. He also didn't have any original plot that he could use as a reference. Therefore, he could only set it aside for the time being and tell his teacher that he was prepared to officially become a detective and accept the commission to act.
"Although I can't tell you the acting principles I've concluded because of the oath, I can say that there's nothing wrong with your train of thought," Detective Isengard said vaguely.
But this was enough for Ebner. He had only been a Beyonder for less than two months, and it was time for him to settle down. This period of time was perfect for him to summarize his principles.
"How about this? Tomorrow is Sunday. At night, I'll hold a ball at a nearby public dance hall. I'll get my colleagues from Backlund, as well as my friends from the police station and newspaper to gather here, and I'll also introduce you to them. Heh heh, don't think that just because you're from the same industry, you're definitely a competitor. When you encounter complicated requests, we actually work together more. By the way, you can also invite your friends over." Detective Isengard was clearly very knowledgeable about the ways of the world.
This was the legendary socializing at a ball? Ebner was not opposed to this. In his previous life, when he was teaching in university, he was not a homebody. He still maintained basic social interactions, but at that time, he was only limited to eating skewers with friends, going to bars, karaoke, traveling together, and so on. He had indeed never seen such high-end stuff like a ball.
It's just an invitation to a friend... Xio hasn't returned yet. Her only friend in Backlund is Fors, right? Would that salted fish accept an invitation to a ball? However, it's hard to say. In the novel, she's actually quite hardworking in writing material. I'll ask Xio when I send her a message later.
As for the other general acquaintances... Perhaps I can get Reporter Mike and Darkwill over? Hmm, Reporter Mike can try inviting them. Darkwill can forget about it. I don't want the ball my teacher is preparing to crash on his mouth.
After making up his mind, Ebner took a short nap in the lounge before heading out for the bridge again.
Ebner didn't know where Fors lived. Xio was very tight-lipped about her friend's privacy and wouldn't reveal it casually. Without Fors's permission, even if it was Ebner, she wouldn't tell her the exact address.
However, they had previously agreed on a telegram at Enmat Harbor. If there wasn't anything special, Fors would have dinner at Morris Restaurant in the bridge area every night.
As he had always stayed in the best inns during his travels with Xio, slept in the best cabins, and ate the best delicacies from all over the world, Ebner felt a little dazed as he sat in this restaurant with average renovations and taste. He then realized that this was where he should be at the moment. Previously, he had been spending too much because he had come too quickly...
After a while, as the door to the restaurant was pushed open, Fors's figure finally appeared in front of Ebner.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Giant
chapters.content:
Chapter 79 - Giant
Fors didn't wear her favorite beige dress with lotus leaf fringes. Instead, she wore a blue female riding suit with beautiful patterns embroidered on it. The collar was tied with a beige lace scarf, giving her a valiant look.
Unfortunately, there was no energy in her light blue eyes. It was as if she could fall asleep at any moment. Her temperament was also slightly dispirited, destroying the valiant feeling she had as a whole.
As soon as she entered, she scanned the shop out of habit. When she found Ebner, she was immediately surprised. She slowly walked to the seat opposite him and sat down. After exchanging pleasantries, she couldn't help but ask, "Where's Xio? Where did she go?"
"Xio is still settling her family in East Chester County. I'm afraid she will return to Backlund in a few days... She asked me to apologize to you because she didn't return as promised." Although Ebner was somewhat curious about Salted Fish's new attire, he still handed her Xio's message as promised.
"So that's how it is... I only saw you but didn't see Xio. According to the plot in my novel, I might've heard something bad..." Fors heaved a sigh of relief as her tense expression eased. There was a familiar teasing look in her eyes.
"That's why the plot of your novel is problematic, especially the setting of a certain evil spirit." Although Ebner and Salted Fish weren't as familiar with Xio, they were still able to crack jokes at this level.
"You actually know?" Fors was first surprised before she came to a realization. "By the way, Xio should have brought you a sample back then."
"According to what I know, Stormwind Mountain Villa has been selling very well in the entire Loen for the past month. You're already a famous female author, Miss Wall." Although Ebner was full of complaints about the plot of the book, it didn't stop him from feeling that the stories inside were indeed very interesting. Furthermore, best-selling novels and whatnot had to be read. What if the later levels of the Dream Maze Tower turned these novels into dream scenes? With that tower's "real-time updates" of information from the outside world, it wasn't impossible.
"By the way, why are you dressed like this? And why do you look tired?" Seeing that Fors wasn't interested in her fame, Ebner changed the topic.
"I'm accompanying Viscount Glaint to hunt in the suburbs today... Why are the nobles so passionate about such boring and meaningless activities?" Fors complained weakly as she thought about the animals that had been driven to the front by the servants and hounds before being shot to death.
As hunting is a pleasure for men, the ladies and madams watching by the side will naturally suffer... After complaining inwardly about the hunting activities of this era, Ebner turned his attention to Viscount Glaint and asked thoughtfully, "It looks like you've successfully befriended an upper noble?"
"That's right. I met Earl Hall's daughter the day before yesterday, Miss Audrey." Since Ebner was the one who proposed the plan to approach the children of nobles, Fors didn't hide anything from him.
"You didn't directly ask her to investigate Father Xio's murder case, right?" Ebner asked worriedly. If he asked directly, Audrey might not be willing to help him with such a huge matter since they weren't that close. She might even alienate them.
"Am I that unreliable in your eyes?" Fors was somewhat indignant.
If you knew that Xio thought you might starve to death at home, you would know that I trust you quite a bit... Ebner lampooned, but seeing Fors's reaction, he knew what was going on. He asked, "From the looks of it, you used MI9's investigation of Xio as an excuse for our first contact?"
"That's right. As expected of a detective. Your inference is indeed impressive!" Fors looked at Ebner in admiration and continued, "Although this is an excuse, Xio and I really want to know who's behind this."
Actually, I also want to know... because this person is most likely related to the Demoness, Ebner thought.
"I participated in Viscount Glaint's hunt today to take the opportunity to understand the outcome of this matter..." When Fors said this, her stomach suddenly growled. Even with her personality, she felt her face turn red.
Ebner shook his head and laughed. He quickly asked the waiter to order some dishes that were not too troublesome and could be served immediately before returning to the topic.
"Viscount Glaint said that it was an order from a lieutenant named Berner Callaway, but the viscount didn't give me any specific information about this person. He only told me that Xio's investigation order would be withdrawn in three to four days," Fors said as she ate elegantly and quickly.
"Berner Callaway..." Ebner muttered the name, searching quickly through the original novel in his memory. He was disappointed when he found nothing.
It seemed like he had to check the teacher's relevant files...
After dinner with Fors, Ebner recalled that his teacher was holding a banquet tomorrow night, so he invited her.
However, Fors had little interest in this matter. She had recently attended too many banquets, balls, and reading parties. She only wanted to lie in bed quietly on Sunday, so she rejected them cleanly.
Ebner, who knew her temperament well, was not disappointed. After paying the bill for one soli and four pence, he bade her farewell.
After leaving the restaurant, Ebner followed the address on Mike's name card to a terrace villa in South Side. He placed the invitation letter he had written in the office in his mailbox in front of the villa.
By this time, it was completely dark. Ebner walked through the dark streets where only a few gas lamps were still working. He hurried to the subway station, hoping to catch the last shift before it stopped.
Suddenly, his spirituality seemed to stir as he quickly cast his gaze at a corner not far away. There seemed to be a tall figure hidden there.
In the apartments on both sides of the street, there were some candlelight that scattered down. It intertwined with the crimson moonlight that penetrated the clouds with great difficulty, barely forming the outline of the figure.
It was a tall man in his forties or fifties wearing a brown priest's uniform. He was currently sitting on the ground, his aura extremely unstable. His face was sometimes ferocious, sometimes kind as if he was about to lose control.
Just sitting there is like a small mountain... This is a descendant of a giant? Wait, this is South Borough... A giant, or is he dressed like a priest? Could he be Father Utravsky?
That was what Ebner thought, but his hands weren't slow. He quickly picked up the revolver in his holster and activated the Eye of Pure White, hoping to figure out what was happening to the suspected Giant Bishop.
"Child, don't come any closer. It's very difficult for me to control my actions now. I might hurt you! You'd better stay away from here and go to the police station to call the police." Seeing that Ebner seemed to have the intention of going forward to check, the giant sitting in the corner spoke.
From his tone, it seems like there's still hope... Ebner heaved a sigh of relief when he heard that. After a few seconds, the Eye of Pure White had already analyzed the source of the giant's terrible situation.
To put it simply, he was hit by a mental curse in black magic, which triggered his old mental illness, causing him to have the tendency to lose control.
Seeing that this priest was still thinking about not harming others when he was about to lose control, Ebner felt some compassion. After thinking for a moment, he asked, "Father, I can simulate the Holy Light of the Sun domain. I wonder if it can relieve your condition?"
When the giant priest heard this, his eyes that were hidden under his bonnet clearly lit up. His light and sparse brows raised as he said in a deep voice,
"I can give it a try!"

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Mask
chapters.content:
Chapter 80 - Mask
The Holy Light of the Sun Domain. Ebner had seen Mr. Gaston use Beyonder items more than once when he was fighting against monsters on Damir Island. Therefore, the analysis of the White Eye was relatively complete. The simulation now had at least 80% of the original's effects.
A bright and pure warm light descended from the sky and landed on the giant priest's head. A scream was heard as golden flames formed a human figure on the priest's head!
The illusory figure and the golden light seemed to be locked in a stalemate for a moment before they were quickly defeated.
Then, in the warm and bright light, all the coldness, evil, and dark shadows quickly dissipated.
Looking at the holy light he summoned, Ebner nodded in satisfaction. He didn't know if it was a coincidence, but he felt that his simulation of the abilities of the other four pathways of Omniscience and Omnipotence far exceeded the other Beyonder pathways.
For example, Xio's "might." Even if it was only a Sequence 9 ability, he could only simulate about fifty to sixty percent of it. As for the abilities related to Wind-blessed and Solar High Priest, even if they were very difficult, the effects of the simulation were better.
If I could prepare a ritual in advance when simulating the Holy Light and pray to the Eternal Blazing Sun for help, the effect of exorcism wouldn't be inferior to the original Solar High Priest... Of course, this is just a thought. A Blessed of Knowledge like me praying to the Eternal Blazing Sun? "He" might have given me an Unshadowed Spear on the spot!
After making a few self-deprecating remarks in his heart, Ebner cast his gaze at the nearby giant priest. By now, the signs of him losing control had vanished, and his wrinkled face had regained its calm. He was closing his eyes tightly, crossing his hands and pressing them against his chin, as though he was making the most pious confession.
After a while, he opened his eyes, revealing a light blue color. He smiled at Ebner and said, "Child, thank you. I'm fine now."
It seemed like he had temporarily suppressed the former him that had been split out? That made sense. This giant priest's situation wasn't that bad, to begin with. If he hadn't been cursed with black magic, he wouldn't have nearly lost control.
From this point of view, although Dawn Paladins had the ability to exorcise evil spirits, there was still a gap between them and the Sun Domain.
As these thoughts passed through his mind, Ebner did not withdraw his revolver, nor did he continue to approach. Instead, he cautiously asked, "Father, is there anything else you need my help with?" His meaning was that if there was nothing else, I would leave first.
"My name is Ivanov Ilyich Utravsky. You can call me Father Utravsky. I sincerely thank you, child." In his calm but emotional voice, Bishop Utravsky stood up. He was over 2.2 meters tall and muscular. His priest uniform was tight as if the legendary giant had reappeared in the Northern Continent.
Compared to calling him by his name, it's actually easier to call him Father! Ebner inwardly lampooned the format of the Feysac Empire's name, but on the surface, he asked with concern, "Father, why are you cursed by an evil spirit?"
"I was caught off guard and was ambushed while tracking a thief..." Father Utravsky explained vaguely before sincerely saying to Ebner,
"Child, you saved me. I will repay you. However, it's already very late today. I believe you are worried about following me back... How about this? You can come to the Harvest Church on Rose Street tomorrow morning. I will prepare a thank you gift for you."
With regards to this, Ebner did not refuse hypocritically. Although saving the priest was just a matter of convenience, since he had already been paid attention to by Lilith, it was natural to earn some wool from "Her" subordinates.
As for completely curing the priest's schizophrenia? That would be left to Klein, who sought the Magician's performance in the future. He had no intention of risking his life for a stranger. Even the Tarot Club members who had a good impression of him, other than Xio, Ebner's current thoughts were to provide limited help without exposing himself.
After watching Father Utravsky's vigorous footsteps disappear into the night, Ebner narrowed his eyes and analyzed his previous answer.
"In the novels, this priest has always told Klein everything he knows when he barged into the Harvest Church. Why is he so vague when it comes to me? That's not right. He told Klein about his own matters, which is why he's so magnanimous... In that case, it's very likely that this matter involves the Church of Earth Mother."
"He was ambushed while chasing after the thief... With the priest's powerful frontal combat ability, it was clearly premeditated by the enemy to plot against him... Furthermore, using black magic to curse is very similar to the work of a Demoness..."
"If it really was done by the Demoness, I wonder what she stole from Father Utravsky."
After thinking for a while, Ebner didn't waste any more time. He hurried to the subway station and took the last subway back to the Hillston District teacher's house.
After a short rest, according to the usual practice before leaving Backlund, Ebner borrowed 2-081 to analyze it for a while before reading the books in his teacher's study. Finally, he returned to his room and fell asleep.
The next day, early on July 22, Ebner had a simple breakfast and was about to head out to the Harvest Church in South Borough to see what sort of thank-you gift Father Utravsky had prepared for him when Detective Isengard Stanton walked over with a stack of newspapers and placed them on the table.
Ebner glanced down and saw that the top sheet was the Daily Observer, which Mike was serving as a reporter.
"You solved a murder case on the liner you came back from? You didn't mention this when you recounted your experiences," Detective Isengard asked with a chuckle.
As that matter might involve the Snake of Mercury, it's best if you, a Sequence 7, don't know... Alright, although I'm also a Sequence 7, I already have many eyes on me. I don't feel like I'm being bitten by lice anymore.
Ebner made a few self-deprecating remarks and then briefly explained to his teacher how the child had been killed by the acorn. He did not even mention the gold coin from the Solomon Empire.
"Why does it feel like it's too much of a coincidence..." Detective Isengard was indeed a wily old fox. He immediately sensed something amiss from his student's words, but seeing that Ebner had no intention of explaining, he didn't probe further. Instead, he said, "That Reporter Mike is quite a friend. He actually published this matter on the second page. It looks like you'll be able to gain quite a reputation very soon."
Although the Daily Observer wasn't the best newspaper, it had a rather large circulation. It was only slightly inferior to the Tussock Times, Backlund Daily News, and other newspapers that covered the entire Loen Kingdom.
To be able to appear in such a newspaper, even if it was only a small piece, it was enough to increase Ebner's reputation.
"So I invited him to the ball tonight, too," Ebner replied with a smile after swallowing the last of his ham.
...
The Harvest Church was one of the few churches the Church of Earth Mother had in the Loen Kingdom. It was also the only cathedral in Backlund that believed in Earth Mother.
This golden cathedral had a rather striking spire and the Sacred Emblem of Life engraved on the outer wall. It was a simple baby surrounded by symbols like wheat ears, flowers, and spring water. It was completely different from the surrounding buildings.
Ebner pushed through the tall front door and peered into the church hall. Rows of seats were neatly arranged, with the huge Sacred Emblem of Life at the top and candles lit on both sides. Though clean and bright, there didn't seem to be a single believer.
On the front seat, Father Utravsky, who was like a small mountain, was praying with his eyes closed. When he heard someone enter, he opened his eyes and turned around.
Upon seeing that it was Ebner, the forty to fifty-year-old priest smiled gently and said,
"There you are, child."
"Once again, I sincerely thank you for saving me."
"Also, I've already prepared the thank you gift."
As he spoke, he took out a mask of unknown material from the pocket of his brown priest uniform. The mask was painted with exaggerated colors and strange patterns, looking like a clown.
"This is actually the spoils of war from yesterday's ambush battle. I don't know its name, so I only call it the Clown Mask. After my appraisal and experiments, I can change its appearance to another person after wearing it... Yes, it's just its appearance... But once you specify its appearance after changing, it can't be easily changed. It will take at least a month or two to change it. Currently, its designated appearance is that of a beautiful lady. You can wait for a period of time before using it again. In addition, after wearing it, your strength, speed, balance, and other aspects will be greatly enhanced." Bishop Utravsky pointed at the item in his hand.
This is a clown mask? It is currently a big boss mask for women! And you even tried it... I wonder what a 2.2-meter tall muscular giant with a small pretty face looks like...
The image of a certain comedic animation flashed across his mind. Ebner hurriedly shook his head and cut off the terrifying connection. He took a deep breath and asked,
"What about its restrictions and hidden dangers?"
Father Utravsky looked at the mask with strange patterns and gave a detailed introduction.
"It might have the characteristic of being 'alive'... because it will look forward to your performance after you wear the mask. It's best that you create a character for the person you pretend to be before wearing it and create a stage that corresponds to the performance. Otherwise, once it's unsatisfied, it will take the initiative to control your body to perform the performance it wants!"
"In addition to that, it has another problem. Once you wear it for more than two hours, you may be replaced by the personality you've developed, and your mind may split."
Ebner was quietly relieved to hear this negative effect. The 'living' characteristic might be troublesome for others, but it was easier to deal with for those with gold fingers.
Even if his Eye of Pure White couldn't suppress the mask, it was obvious that it was a Seer Sequence item. Wouldn't it be more honest if it was placed above the gray fog? It could also increase Mr. Fool's sense of mystery in front of the Tarot Club.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Creating a Diary
chapters.content:
Chapter 81 - Creating a Diary
Ebner was quite satisfied with the mask on the whole. Although he had no use for it, for the time being, the importance of this item would be evident in the future if there was a need for a vest.
As for the characteristics and other side effects of "living," even if I don't have a high-level status to suppress it from rebelling, once I become a Sequence 6, I can completely analyze this low-matched Faceless Transformation ability. Although the effects of the simulation will probably be low-matched, it's better than this Sealed Artifact with ill intentions.
With this thought in mind, Ebner took the Clown Mask that didn't seem to require any special sealing method and placed it in the bag that the priest had prepared for him.
"It's good that you like it. I originally had another Beyonder item for you to choose from, but unfortunately, it was stolen last night." Seeing that Ebner was satisfied with the thanks, Bishop Utravsky nodded slightly and said casually. Then, he turned around and walked to Earth Mother's Sacred Emblem of Life.
He extended his arms and chanted in a deep voice,
"Thank you, the source of life!"
"Praise you, Mother of All Things!"
Ebner did not know what to say when he saw this, because he was actually not sure if his previous encounter with the priest was a coincidence or a coincidence arranged by Lilith.
Perhaps both.
On the subway ride back, Ebner rubbed his hand over the mask in the bag as he recalled the details of what had happened in the church and thought.
"In the novel, after Klein helped Father Utravsky completely resolve the problem in his heart, the payment Father provided him was to choose one of the Sealed Artifacts formed by the Master Key, another syringe, and a container."
The Master Key shouldn't be in the hands of a priest yet, because it was left behind by Emlyn when he got lost at the end of August or early September. Ignoring the fact that Emlyn is still infatuated with the figurine, even the Abraham family youth before the Master Key might not be dead.
But the Sealed Artifact, which is made of a 'syringe' and a 'container', is nowhere to be seen. Has it not fallen into Father Utravsky's hands? Or is it the thing that Father said was stolen last night?
"I previously guessed that the ambush on the priest was done by a Demoness. Then, can I guess that a Demoness has designs on that Beyonder item?"
"The Sealed Artifact in my memory, which is made up of syringes and containers, has the effect of extracting a tube of one's blood first. At the critical moment, it can be infused back. This way, it can eliminate fatigue, reduce illnesses and injuries, and temporarily increase strength, speed, balance, and other aspects."
"Healing auxiliary abilities... What use does this have for the Demoness?"
Until he got back to Detective Isengard's firm, there was no progress in Ebner's thinking, so it was put on hold.
Looking at the time, he realized that it was already past two in the afternoon. It was not far from the ball at night. He decided to relax his mind and begin editing the fake diary that would be handed to Mr. Fool at the Tarot Club tomorrow.
First, I'll write a piece of gossip... Hmm, there's no need to go into too much detail. I just need to feel that a particular madam is very passionate. It's impossible for Mr. Fool to specially investigate if that madam is truly passionate... Even if he want to investigate, he'll have to wait until he becomes a Scholar of Yore.
Secondly, by using Emperor Roselle's tone, I can mention a few stories of the Dragon of Nightmare's love to weave true nightmares in reality... This knowledge will flow out of his mouth soon after The Sun joins in. It shouldn't be a problem for me to bring it out in advance... Yes, just to be safe, I can't clearly write the name of the Dragon of Nightmare as Alzuhod... No, it's best not to mention the Dragon of Nightmare, but say that he's the son of the Dragon King. Sigh, I hope this can let Klein understand his situation.
"Finally, do you want to talk about the Forsaken Land of the Gods? If the plot hasn't changed, Alger will be asking questions regarding the Forsaken Land of the Gods at the Tarot Club tomorrow. Should I help Mr. Fool prepare the answers first?"
Forget it... It would be too strange if two of the three pages are important. Besides, Alger might very well ask me directly this time... Therefore, the third page should include what I saw in the library. The emperor went to the Southern Continent to have a good time with the descendants of the Balam Empire's royal family. I'll write it up as a joke. I wonder what will happen if Klein uses this to ask Mr. Azik... Yes, it should be fine. The descendants of the Balam Empire's royal family might not be from Mr. Azik's faction.
After scribbling down three pages of the diary in Chinese, Ebner worked hard to transcribe them in an enlarged pen and drawing pattern before taking notes. For a person of the Reader Sequence, memory was no challenge.
When he was done, Ebner lit all the papers and burned them. Then he looked at his pocket watch again and saw that it was almost six o'clock. Although the ball was organized by his teacher, he, as the actual protagonist, could not arrive too late.
...
At seven in the evening, Ebner followed behind the teacher, dressed neatly. He waited in the foyer of the public dance hall to welcome the guests.
There were quite a number of detectives who had come. Most of them had never seen Ebner before, but there were a few whose names were rather familiar. They were all figures who had been mentioned in the past, such as Detective Stuart, Detective Kaslana, and Detective Zreal, who had been eaten up by rats the moment he appeared.
Towards the last Feysac spy, he found him somewhat familiar, as though he had seen him somewhere before.
But he didn't think too much about it because in next to no time, he saw a familiar face walk in.
Sergeant Fassin!
The director of Cherwood Borough's police department held his wife's arm as they walked through the main door.
Such a careful... pregnant woman? Ebner was stunned. He thought to himself, Does she think that her main account is useless and intends to start a new one?
As a polite gentleman, Ebner obviously wouldn't stare at someone else's wife. Furthermore, Detective Isengard had already walked up to her and said,
"Good evening, Sheriff. Hehe, Madam, you're still as radiant as ever."
Sergeant Fassin greeted him briefly before helping his wife find a seat. He then returned and handed her a gift with a polite smile.
"I'm sorry, but my wife is pregnant, and it's been less than a month. It's still more dangerous."
"It looks like you're going to be a father again. Congratulations." Detective Isengard caught the gift and asked, "Is there still no news of Aetris?"
"I received a letter from a relative in Enmat Harbor. He said that he has already made a name for himself at sea... Sigh, I wonder if he can come back to see the birth of his brother or sister..." Officer Faxin sighed.
Ebner's heart skipped a beat as he listened. He wanted to talk to them about what had happened to Aetris, but after thinking about it, he decided that there was no point in doing so. He even worried Sergeant Fassin for no reason. In the end, he gave up.
After a few more pleasantries, Detective Isengard handed the gift to the valet and asked him to place it in the lounge he had prepared beforehand.
Not long after, another familiar guest entered Ebner's line of sight. It was Sergeant Fiona Ravenwood and her daughter.
Due to the Church of Evernight, there were quite a number of female police officers in the Loen police system. However, due to the influence of the other faiths, societal trends, and other aspects, they still suffered a certain degree of discrimination when it came to promotions and positions. Most of them were internal clerks, and there was an invisible ceiling in their rise.
The reason why Ebner was familiar with them was because the daughter of this heroic female sergeant was his public school classmate, Susan. She was the girl with freckles that he had met outside Grant's clothing store after the incident at Jane's house. Before Ebner had transmigrated over, she had also funded the original owner with pocket money like Jane. That was how the original owner hadn't ended up on the streets.
Seeing the familiar senior, Susan, who was just 17 years old, was naturally very happy. She walked up and said, "Ebner, I saw the Daily Observer's report about you. I didn't expect you to become a detective in such a short time. Roman and Castor couldn't believe it when they saw it!"
Ebner smiled and dug out the basic information about the two of them from his memory. "How are they now? What are they busy with?"
"Kast graduated like you, but he got into Tingen's Hoy University."
"As for Roman, he joined Ms. Kapusky's club. He's mysterious every day. I wonder what he's busy with!"

chapters.title: Chapter 82: The Tarot Club Begins Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 82 - The Tarot Club Begins Again
Kapusky? I would have forgotten about him if Susan hadn't told me... Ebner thought for a moment and decided to intervene in this matter. Although Roman didn't know him very well, he was still a friend of the original owner. He didn't mind doing something that could be easily resolved.
Ebner organized his words and told Susan again what he had said to frighten Jane. Finally he said sternly, "Anyway, whether Mr. Kapusky intended it or not, his actions are likely to be illegal. You can't let Roman fool around with him again."
"So what do I do?" Susan asked, flustered by Ebner's tone.
"Just repeat what I just said to your mother. I believe Sergeant Fiona can handle this," Ebner replied with a smile. It was more reliable to report this to the police.
Susan nodded thoughtfully, feeling deeply that after Ebner Senior became a detective, whether it was his bearing or his way of thinking and handling things, he had changed a lot from before... In comparison, whether it was her, Roman, or even Custer, who had been admitted to college, they all seemed rather childish.
Later, Reporter Mike arrived as well. Ebner went forward to greet him and expressed his gratitude.
Reporter Mike waved his hand and said, "This is something that we agreed on long ago, there's no need to be so polite. Maybe I'll need your help when I go to some special places for an interview."
After the two of them chatted for a while, it was almost eight o'clock. Detective Isengard stopped waiting in the foyer and pulled Ebner to the second floor of the public dance hall. He stood behind the railing facing the door and signaled for the band to stop playing.
After all the guests looked over, the best detective in Backlund said loudly,
"I'm very happy that everyone can attend this ball. Thank you for coming..."
"I have prepared some music and food for everyone with Desi characteristics. I hope you guys will like it..."
Having said that, he made Ebner take a step forward and continued,
"In addition, I hereby formally introduce my student, Ebner Bryan, to everyone. He is already a detective who can hold his own. The case he cracked has even been published in the second edition of the Daily Observer..."
"He's still very young and needs the help of friends and peers..."
After Ebner also gave a simple speech, they went down the stairs to the dance floor on the first floor and prepared to invite the ladies for the opening dance.
Since Ebner had been pushed to the front of the stage, he was now the main character of the ball. Naturally, the opening dance had to be started by him.
Normally speaking, during the opening dance, the married master would definitely look for his spouse. Unmarried men and women would either dance with their relatives of the opposite sex or invite the person they liked. It was a different kind of blind date.
But Ebner had neither a suitable target, nor any relatives present, and it was a little awkward in this matter.
Fortunately, Ms. Fiona, the female sheriff of the North District, had gotten him out of the situation in time. As the mother of one of Ebner's classmates, she could be considered an elder. It would be appropriate for her to dance the opening dance with him. As for why not Susan? She wasn't at the age for formal socializing. She couldn't dance on such occasions.
The two of them entered the dance floor and began to dance to country music. When they were nearing the end of the opening dance, Fiona suddenly said in a low voice,
"Susan has already told me everything... You're very sensitive to these kinds of illegal events and handle them very well. You're indeed a detective who can make it into the mainstream newspapers at such a young age. I'm very assured that Susan is keeping in touch with you."
Why does this sound wrong? It's as if I have something going on with your daughter... Ebner complained in his heart, but he pretended to be humble. "You flatter me."
After the opening dance, Ebner followed behind the teacher and visited the invited detectives one by one. When he walked to Detective Zreal, the Feysac spy suddenly smiled and said to Ebner, "Young man, I have a commission in my hands. As it's very cumbersome, I don't have enough manpower. Are you willing to share some of the burdens with me? I'm willing to pay five pounds. If the employer is satisfied, I'll pay you another five pounds."
"Hello, Detective Zreal." Ebner greeted first, then asked warily, "What kind of request is it?"
This detective's five-pound request wasn't easy to accept. After all, one of his assistants had hired Klein for five pounds. In the end, because of those five pounds, Klein had no choice but to plot to kill an ambassador.
Furthermore, at this moment, Ebner had already recalled why he found Mr. Zreal familiar. Back when he had just advanced to Reader, it was this gentleman who had used a Disguise Spell to follow beside Kaspars as a backup plan for dealing with Beyonders who might lose control.
"This commission actually comes from the Church of Storms. They request to use the bridge district as the center to investigate who has suddenly gone mad or suddenly become demented in the past month or two. They also want to investigate who died from an accident due to the previous two reasons." Detective Zreal glanced at Detective Isengard before explaining with a smile to Ebner.
"Doesn't the population of these districts add up to a million? It's indeed a tedious job." After Detective Isengard said that, he shot a glance at his student. He roughly guessed what the Church of Storms, or rather, what the Mandated Punishers were looking for. However, he didn't like such a crude method of investigation. If it weren't for the situation being wrong, he would definitely have mocked them.
Suddenly going crazy... Dementia... This is a symptom of being contaminated by a Beyonder, right? In the past month or two... With this in mind, Ebner had a vague guess. The Beyonder characteristic of the "deduction student" that the original Klein had picked up couldn't have been taken from a certain death Mandated Punisher, right? The Mandated Punishers couldn't find the lost characteristic and were busy with other cases, so they hired people to investigate it? Unfortunately, the direction was wrong.
At this moment, after hearing Detective Isengard's words, Mr. Zreal smiled and said, "Therefore, regardless of whether the list of people the Church of Storms is looking for is on the list we have found, they will pay 100 pounds. If they find the person they are looking for, they will pay an additional 100 pounds." With that said, he looked at Ebner and continued,
"Don't think that I only gave you five pounds for the commission. After all, I only need you to help me investigate the bridge area. It has a much lower population compared to the other places."
Ebner thought for a while and decided to accept the commission. After all, it was very likely that he was investigating himself. Instead of passively expecting the Mandated Punishers to be exploring in the wrong direction, he might as well take the initiative to join in. Perhaps he could even mislead them at the appropriate time.
...
At the same time, in the dark bedroom of a condominium in West Borough, two figures were entangled with each other. Drunken moans drifted in the room.
Just as the man below was about to reach their peak, the lady riding on top took out a glass bottle from somewhere. Inside the bottle was a dark and sticky liquid.
The lady looked at the man with a twisted expression and took a deep breath before pouring the liquid into her mouth.
Right on the heels of that, a terrifying change began to happen to the lady's beautiful body. Countless pustules and black sores surged on her skin, and her beautiful face turned terrifyingly hideous.
But at that moment, the man beneath him suddenly began to twitch. An unknown force left his body and entered his body through the connection with the lady, constantly repairing the terrifying pus.
As a result, the lady regained some of her consciousness. She took out a syringe with a container from a mirror with great difficulty and poured the blood in the container into her blood vessels.
...
July 23, Monday.
In the morning, because he had accepted Detective Zreal's assignment to check the bridge area, Ebner left the house after lunch.
He was not in a hurry to investigate immediately. After all, if he really wanted the results, he could just hand himself over...
He wanted to take this opportunity to read some dossiers from the police stations in the bridge district to see if there were any traces of the Demoness. Due to the commission, the Church of Storms had already made contact with the various police stations in advance, making it as convenient for the detectives who had accepted the commission as possible.
Hence, Ebner, who had been reading the dossiers all morning, only arrived at his rented apartment in East Borough at two in the afternoon. There were quite a number of people at his teacher's house for the commission, so it wasn't convenient for him to participate in the Tarot Club without being disturbed.
At three o'clock sharp, above the gray fog.
Ebner, who had just regained his vision, saw the magnificent temple once again. He saw Mr. Fool sitting upright in the seat of honor, shrouded in thick grayish-white fog. He saw Justice and The Hanged Man, who were still blurry, appear in their fixed seats.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Tower’s Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 83 - Tower's Request
Ebner looked at Miss Justice, who was sitting on the other side of the ancient mottled bronze table, waiting for her to greet Mr. Fool first.
However, after a few seconds, the lady still did not speak. Ebner was slightly surprised. Then, he recalled that she was probably troubled by Susie's ability to speak. Was that why her emotions were unstable?
Sitting in the seat of honor, Klein also clearly noticed this problem. Just as he was about to ask, he saw Miss Justice suddenly sit up straight and ask,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, knowledgeable Mr. Tower, Mr. Hanged Man, who always helps me, I have a question to ask. What can a pet with Beyonder powers do to help its owner? To put it simply, what use can it have?"
As soon as she said that, she realized that Mr. Fool and The Hanged Man had fallen silent at the same time. Mr. Tower, who was beside her, chuckled softly and said with certainty, "Miss Justice, it looks like your close pet didn't lose control after drinking the potion. Instead, it gave you a huge surprise."
Klein and Alger had also guessed the general situation from Miss Justice's tone and question. However, one of them was acting as a deity, so it wasn't convenient for them to speak at this moment. The other, due to his cautious personality, didn't directly point it out, allowing Ebner to take the lead.
All hit! Mr. Tower's inference is amazing! Audrey sighed inwardly before looking expectantly at Mr. Tower and Mr. Hanged Man, hoping to receive some revelations.
Unfortunately, Ebner had no intention of answering. He had set up a persona in the Tarot Club because he liked to show off his high-end mysticism knowledge. As for such general knowledge or experience questions, they were actually not his forte.
He could rely on Justice to answer a few questions, but he might not be able to answer any more questions in the future. Therefore, he decided to ignore such questions from the very beginning, in case he became timid in the future.
Seeing that Tower had no intention of speaking, Alger Wilson replied with a strange tone,
"An animal of the Spectator pathway is still very useful. It can help you observe and listen in on certain occasions. As you know, people will be wary of their own kind, but it's unlikely that they will suspect a pet of eavesdropping, even if this pet is squatting by his feet."
That makes sense! Most of the time, when Father discussed important matters with the other nobles, councilors, and ministers, he would avoid me and lock the door of the study. But as long as Susie can avoid the initial elimination, she won't be chased away... Also, those ladies and madams like to communicate in private...
Audrey's eyes lit up when she heard that, but she suddenly discovered a detail in The Hanged Man's words. Why was he so certain that it was an animal from the Spectator pathway?
Looking around at Mr. Fool, Mr. Tower, and Mr. Hanged Man, Audrey's expression changed as she thought,
Could it be that all of you have guessed the situation at that time?
She smiled awkwardly. Thankfully, she was shrouded in fog and wasn't discovered. Audrey took a deep breath and sat up straight again. She said with a faint smile,
"Mr. Fool, I found another page of Emperor Roselle's diary."
"Very good. You have paid off all your debts," Klein replied in a good mood.
At this moment, Ebner looked up and said respectfully, "Mr. Fool, I also have three diary pages to offer to you."
He only said "diary" and didn't mention Roselle. He deeply understood the true meaning of Roselle's famous words, "Speak the truth, only the truth, speak the whole truth."
The moment he said that, he attracted Alger's attention. This gentleman wasn't surprised that Ebner had brought three pages of Roselle's diary every week. However, this made him believe even more firmly in his theory that the Tower had a very deep background.
A new Roselle diary? Klein perked up when he heard that, but he recalled the principle of "equivalent exchange" he had previously set up. He asked with a nervous smile,
"Mr. Tower, what do you need?" It's best if it's something I can do. Otherwise, I can only drag it out.
Ebner had already considered this. He organized his words and said in a sincere tone, "Mr. Fool, I recently obtained a new Sealed Artifact. It possesses the characteristic of being 'alive', but it's not very willing to communicate with me. I pray that you can make it not resist being used. Don't make any excessive requests..."
Sealed Artifact? A Sealed Artifact with the characteristic of "living" can reduce the negative effects in such a manner? Through communication? Why didn't it directly bite you to death?
When Alger and Klein heard this, they were dumbfounded. One of them was a Nighthawk, while the other was from the Church of Storms. When had they not been careful when using and handling Sealed Artifacts? Especially Sealed Artifacts that had the characteristic of being alive, their danger level was several times higher than their own! But from Mr. Tower's tone, it sounded like the Sealed Artifact was a disobedient child that needed a beating before it would behave?
Although Audrey was somewhat surprised when she heard that, she didn't have a clear concept of the dangers of Sealed Artifacts, so she was the first to snap back to her senses. She asked curiously,
"Mr. Tower, can Sealed Artifacts reduce the negative effects through communication?"
Good question, Miss Justice! Ebner smiled and gave Audrey an appreciative look before saying,
"If it were handed over to someone else or other high-level existences, it might not be easy to communicate with them. However, Mr. Fool is the pinnacle of the Sealed Artifact pathway I recently obtained. It has no chance of resisting."
The reason why he said this was to reveal a little of the meaning of The Fool and this space to Klein, so that he could quickly use Sefirah Castle to develop more tricks. After all, it was already late July, and time waited for no one.
The Fool is the apex of a particular pathway? When Alger heard this, he looked deeply at Ebner and said with certainty, Mr. Tower also has a great understanding of Mr. Fool. It's no wonder he wasn't nervous when he first joined the Tarot Club last week... Apex, could it be that Mr. Fool is really a resurrected ancient god?
After hearing Ebner's explanation, Audrey simply felt proud of Mr. Fool's strength.
Such a powerful Mr. Fool. Mr. Fool who can make Sealed Artifacts obedient is the abbot of our Tarot Club!
With this thought in mind, Audrey wanted to hold a grand ball to announce this news. Of course, it was only a thought.
As for Mr. Fool himself, he was so embarrassed that he nearly jumped forward to cover Tower's mouth!
After learning more about the meaning of The Fool, he was originally rather happy, but this bit of "happiness" couldn't resolve the substantial problem of how to communicate with Sealed Artifacts.
What should I do? By the way, Mr. Azik had already admitted that he was a Beyonder in the morning, and he might be very powerful. Perhaps he might know of a similar method... But what excuse should I use to delay the Tower's request?
Why don't we just say that we can't let them bring items up to the gray fog? Yes, I really don't have the ability to get them to bring things up now.
With this in mind, Klein deliberated over the appropriate wording for The Fool's reply to "Tower." Just as he was about to use his finger to knock on the table, Ebner respectfully asked him for instructions again, "As I need to bring that Sealed Artifact within the gray fog, so... Mr. Fool, please allow me to hold a sacrificial ritual for you!"
At this point, Ebner revealed the true goal of his series of actions. It was to let the Tarot Club's exclusive "delivery" service come online ahead of time.
Back then, Klein had obtained the model of the sacrificial ritual from The Sun. Later, he consulted many people before finally making the attempt.
However, Ebner didn't wish to wait that long. Without the express delivery service, he wouldn't be able to sell items and knowledge in the Tarot Club due to the lack of a safe payment channel. As for the Sequence 6 main ingredients, they were expensive, and there was still a huge gap in money.
Upon hearing this, Klein's fingers paused as many thoughts flashed through his mind. He wanted to know what use the sacrificial ritual had and how it should be used, but he couldn't think of a suitable excuse to ask for details. He was momentarily stumped.
How could Ebner not know what level Mr. Fool was at? He once again asked The Fool to help him materialize paper, pen, and text. Then, he wrote down the entire ritual process of "sacrifice" and "bestowment" as well as the relevant knowledge in detail. After handing it to Mr. Fool, he said respectfully, "This is the ritual process that I am modifying according to your honorific name and symbol item. I wonder if there are any mistakes. Please take a look."
He was purely finding an excuse. As a Beyonder of the Reader pathway, he was born a ritualistic magic expert. How could such a simple application fail?
After Mr. Fool received the stack of goatskin parchment, although his heart was filled with excitement, he looked at it calmly and replied indifferently, "This still requires some time to try."
At present, Klein couldn't determine if the knowledge handed over by the "Tower" was effective or not. He planned on studying it in private or asking Mr. Azik later...
However, this matter gave him a better excuse for delaying because he had to "attempt" it first. Only by "attempting" the sacrificial ritual could he help "Tower" suppress the Sealed Artifact.
I hope that when the time comes, I can find a way! Klein temporarily heaved a sigh of relief.
As for Ebner, he knew that with Klein's carefulness, the matter of the sacrificial ritual could only be decided after one or two Tarot Gatherings. However, it was much earlier than before.
So Ebner happily bowed his head. "Your will is my will."
The Fool and Tower each took what they needed, and they were in a good mood. However, Alger, who had been listening to the entire process, felt his hair stand on end.
As orthodox deities rarely responded to similar rituals, the word "sacrifice" had often been used since the Fifth Epoch to describe evil gods and devils!
Thinking that it might result in some terrifying outcome, The Hanged Man felt as though he was walking on the edge of an abyss. If he wasn't careful, he would fall down, corroded, and devoured.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Conversation at the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 84 - Conversation at the Tarot Club
What does Tower want? He had previously shown his understanding of The Fool... Could it be that he wants to help Mr. Fool return to the real world step by step? What benefits does this bring him?
Alger looked at the Tower beside him and felt that every word he said had a deeper meaning. He decided to try his best to memorize it and figure it out when he returned.
Audrey's current mysticism knowledge wasn't enough for her to accurately understand the meaning behind the sacrificial ritual. She only felt that it sounded very impressive.
As for Klein, he didn't divert his attention to observe the reactions of the members. He first picked up the diary that Miss Justice had handed over and looked down.
No oil? Was it because he couldn't find it for some reason, or was there really no oil? It had been more than 150 years since Emperor Roselle was assassinated, but there were still no signs of oil appearing...
Patriotic Health Campaign? It turned out that the health conditions in the cities of the emperor's era were so poor...
Finally, Great Emperor, what is the name of the ancient, secretive organization that you mentioned as a way out? Is it something I don't know? Why didn't you write it out?
After reading the diary page, Klein lampooned for a while before thinking, The content of this diary page should be located after he became the Consul of the Intis Republic.
