He might even call himself Caesar the Great. I have to go back and flip through the book to see when Intis's "Capital Sewer and Public Toilet Improvement Plan" appeared.
With this in mind, he picked up the diary that Mr. Tower had conjured. When he took a glance at it, the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch.
"On the second day of July I met Mrs. Ossess at the ball. She's such a stunner."
Due to the complexity of the Chinese characters and the deliberate actions of Ebner, the volume of each character was greatly magnified. Therefore, there was only one sentence on this page.
I'm going to help "Tower" communicate with a dangerous Sealed Artifact just because of that sentence? I hope the items behind are valuable.
Klein took a deep breath, stabilized his emotions, and flipped to the second page.
"4th March. In the books of the Sauron family, I read a story about the son of the Dragon King. It was written as if it was real. It said that it could weave a true nightmare in reality, allowing many living beings to unknowingly join in, and then give the cruelest and most horrifying ending..."
This page was much more standardized and the content was complete. Compared to the previous page, it was worth something... However, a mythical dragon story was of no use to me.
Klein shook his head in disappointment and picked up the third page.
"The wild beauty I slept with last week was actually a descendant of the former Balam Empire's royal family?"
This... There isn't even a date. I don't even know which day it was taken from the diary... But Emperor, isn't the scope of your "friendship" too wide? You even went to the Southern Continent...
Klein held back his urge to continue lampooning. After more than ten seconds of silence, he reined in his chaotic thoughts and made the diary in his hand disappear.
"You can communicate now."
Audrey had already recovered her Spectator state as she said with a faint smile,
"I want to know if there's a Sequence potion named Arbiter. In addition, what kind of Beyonder can directly open the door on the wall?"
I know that... Klein, who was shrouded in the grayish-white fog, was about to speak when The Hanged Man interrupted him.
"I need you to help me investigate something in exchange for an answer."
"What is it?" Audrey asked with interest and puzzlement.
Alger glanced at The Fool before looking at Tower beside him. Seeing that he didn't react to his first answer, he muttered,
"I want to know if the king has any intention of taking revenge on the Feysac Empire within this year or before June next year to start a new war on the eastern coast of Balam."
Is he afraid that I'll give Miss Justice knowledge for free again and cut off his path to wealth, so he can't wait to answer? Or is he testing my attitude again? Or is he even testing my nationality and position through this commission for Miss Justice?
Ebner analyzed the implications behind The Hanged Man's actions and felt that it should be both. However, he originally didn't plan on answering the question, because Miss Justice was clearly asking about Xio and Fors's potion Sequence. As for them, especially Xio, they were friends that he approved of. Even if they weren't important, even if they didn't mind, Ebner didn't wish to sell such information without obtaining their agreement.
This was a form of respect for a friend, just like how Xio had never told him about Fors's residence.
After Miss Justice agreed to the request and successfully returned the price to The Hanged Man, Alger replied, "The Beyonder who can open the door anywhere should be a Sequence 9 Apprentice. Mr. Tower had previously stated that the secret organization, Theosophy Order, possesses this formula. However, there's a possibility of obtaining it from another pathway, such as the ancient tomb of the Fourth Epoch."
Theosophy Order, the organization of the Demoness Sect that Mr. Tower mentioned? Klein rubbed his chin leisurely as he thought of something.
Seeing that Mr. Fool and Mr. Tower didn't retort, Audrey couldn't help but sigh.
"If I had the Apprentice formula, I might not have chosen Spectator."
Alger ignored Miss Justice's words and continued,
"There are indeed Sequence potions whose names are similar to Arbiters. I believe you aren't unfamiliar with them because this is the beginning of the Sequence pathway that the Augustus family and the Castiya family of the Feynapotter Kingdom have. Of course, low Sequence formulas have been rewarded in ancient times. Some nobles might have obtained them before."
The Augustus family was a royal family of the Loen Kingdom, while the Castia family was a royal family of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
So the Augustus family started off as Arbiters... It's no wonder I always subconsciously obey their arrangements... Audrey suddenly came to a realization as she felt that she had resolved the question that had puzzled her for a long time.
Then, she nodded slowly, leaned back slightly, and said elegantly, "I have no more questions."
At this moment, Ebner looked at Audrey and asked, "Is there any news about the Tree of Elders' tree's core?"
Audrey changed her sitting posture again. She leaned forward and placed her hands together on the long table. She shook her head apologetically and said, "Sorry, Mr. Tower. I didn't find out anything about it."
"It's alright, Miss Justice. It always hides itself well." Ebner was somewhat disappointed, but he wasn't depressed.
He remembered that whether it was the fruit of the Tree of Elders required by the Spectator pathway or the crystallization of the Tree of Elders needed by the Sun pathway, it was ultimately provided by Emlyn.
In other words, the Sanguine should have the ingredients related to the Tree of Elders... With this in mind, Ebner decided to find a suitable opportunity to interact with Emlyn when he returned and see if he could find a channel from him.
Sigh, why didn't the vampire duke who stopped me in East Chester County leave a communication method?
Seeing that Tower had finished communicating, Alger thought for a moment and turned to look at Ebner beside him.
"Erudite Mr. Tower, I want to ask you something. Is the True Creator's Holy Place that the Aurora Order promotes the legendary Forsaken Land of the Gods?"
As expected, he's asking me... From the looks of it, the sacrifice had given Alger a great deal of fear. It made him not dare to test Mr. Fool again, so he wants to indirectly attack me?
Ebner had already expected this. He smiled and replied, "Mr. Hanged Man, your question is very dangerous!"
Alger's heart skipped a beat when he heard that. The last time he saw Mr. Tower speak so cautiously about knowledge was when he was talking about the Primordial Demoness... Could it be that the True Creator was really a true god at the same level as the seven gods?
"Although the True Creator is corrupted, he is also a true god. In the battle of the four emperors, 'He' stood on the side of the Black Emperor..." Ebner said from the side before exhorting, "After leaving Mr. Fool's line of sight, it's best that you don't say such things again."
Although the sentence was short, the information it revealed made Klein and Alger's hearts stir.
'Tower' meant that... the Black Emperor lost the battle of the Four Emperors, so the True Creator was forced to move the sanctuary away from the Northern Continent?
After a long while, Alger cast his gaze at Mr. Fool, hoping that "He" could comment on Mr. Tower's words.
Klein naturally saw through The Hanged Man's intentions, but he didn't know much about the Forsaken Land of the Gods and the True Creator. He had only read a few words from the Nighthawks' information and Roselle's diary. Therefore, after a few seconds of consideration, he calmly replied,
"This is not something you should know now."
Alger's heart tightened as he immediately lowered his head and said, "Please forgive my slight misconduct."
Following that, Audrey, who had discovered the subtle atmosphere, took the initiative to ask Mr. Fool if she could join another organization, such as the Psychology Alchemists. When the time came, she would need to pay a price for protection.
Klein had long thought through this matter over the past week. Hence, he chuckled and said, "No problem. My only request is that I don't divulge the existence of the Tarot Club. And to obtain the corresponding blessings, you have to collect more of Roselle's diary pages for me." As for how much you can collect, it depends on when I have the ability to provide protection...
After Audrey asked, Ebner recalled Xio's dream about the unknown ancient dragon. He hesitated for a moment before asking Mr. Fool, "If we discover a suitable gentleman or lady for the Tarot Club, can we guide them to join? How should we guide them? What are the requirements for the subsequent members of our gathering? How should we judge?"
Klein remained silent for a few seconds before saying,
"If you think it's suitable, you can tell me here. I'll decide if you want him to join. Before that, you can't make any suggestive actions. It will result in the secret of the Tarot Club's existence being leaked. You have to remember that to non-gathering members..."
"Without my permission, you are not allowed to recite my name."
This act is a little impressive... Ebner sighed. Then, he began thinking about how to get Xio to join Klein's line of sight. After all, the gift that the ancient dragon had given her was a hidden danger. He was still worried if he didn't kill the poison in Sefirah Castle.
...
After severing the connection with all the members of the gathering, Klein, who was sitting silently at the head of the ancient bronze table, seriously recalled what had happened at the gathering.
"Isn't the act of 'Tower' offering a sacrificial ritual too risky for him? Does he really trust me that much?"
Or could it be that this is actually a test? After all, only deities can accept sacrifices and bestowments. Is he testing if I'm really The Fool?
"This is completely different from The Hanged Man's probing. The Hanged Man is probing with a careful look, while Tower is pretending to be my believer and coming openly? Is this more embodiment of confidence?"
"I suspect that he hid his true emotions the first time he came to the gray fog... No wonder I always felt that his emotions were overly lively..."
"Forget it, this is a normal reaction. There's no need to investigate further... Now, let me see what this sacrificial ritual is like."
"What?! Does the ritual actually use spiritual materials?! How can I afford that..."

chapters.title: Chapter 85: The Doctor Who Left Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 85 - The Doctor Who Left Home
In a house in East Borough, Ebner, who was lying in bed, opened his eyes. He first habitually checked if the wall of spirituality had been touched before lowering his head in thought.
"My actions of offering a sacrificial ritual will definitely arouse Klein's suspicion. He will likely think that I'm testing him."
"But it doesn't matter. After all, I have no intention of harming him. Instead, I've been helping him. As long as you sincerely help Klein, he will do his best to repay you. He won't stop just because he suspects you."
"Sigh, speaking of which, I chose to help him within my capabilities. Firstly, it's because he's a character that I like, and I'm willing to help him along the way. Secondly, it's also to build a good relationship with the future pillar and leave me a way out..."
Thinking of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom and the Sanguine Ancestor who seemed to have laid a trap on him, Ebner felt a headache coming on. He wanted to figure out what their plans were, but he didn't dare to really probe. This feeling was terrible for a Knowledge Keeper of the Reader pathway.
Shaking his head to clear his thoughts, Ebner took out the box containing the Clown Mask from his bag.
In his teacher's office, there were servants who came in and out, as well as clients who came from time to time. Ebner simply used the White Eye to analyze the power of the Clown Mask, but he didn't actually wear it for experiments.
It would be hard to explain if someone happened to see the face of the woman on top.
And at this moment, he was in a private house in East Borough. He didn't have any qualms about giving it a try.
To be cautious, Ebner first activated the Eye of Pure White before covering his face with the mask.
Immediately, he felt a cool sensation on his face. Following that, a simple thought was transmitted to his mind, urging him to do something somewhere.
This thought wasn't strong at first, but Ebner could clearly sense that it would become stronger over time. If it were to drag on for an hour or two, ordinary Beyonders might not be able to withstand its control.
Even with the suppression of the Eye of Pure White, it could only prevent Ebner from actually being controlled. However, the enticement that was like maggots in one's bones remained, and it grew stronger.
I can safely wear this mask for a few more hours when I activate the Eye of Pure White and use it with the Machine Mind, but in essence, there's not much difference... Although this mask has the characteristic of being alive, its intelligence is far inferior to the Sword of Dawn. It's not sensitive to suppression from a high-level entity.
Ebner muttered to himself before casting his gaze at the half-body mirror on the wall. Then, he saw a female face that wasn't considered outstanding but was very charming.
She was not outstanding because her facial features were average. She could not be said to be very beautiful, but she was very good-looking. She was the kind of face that could be easily overlooked by a rough glance, but if one looked at her seriously, they would have some impression of her.
It was said that she was very charming because her face had a pair of bright and indifferent eyes, giving people a sense of wisdom and elegance.
Ebner carefully looked at the face he had disguised as a woman and secretly nodded. He felt that as long as he put on some makeup, he would not be able to tell that it was a woman's face... However, he did not know what bad things the previous owner of the mask had done with this face. If the victim recognized him, wouldn't he be the scapegoat?
Then he tried the power, speed, and balance the mask brought. Satisfied, Ebner plucked it off and put it back in the box.
...
At 17 Rotans Street, Cherwood Borough, Sergeant Faxin helped his wife out of the carriage and to a house with a garden attached to it. He knocked on the door.
Soon, a valet opened the door and saw Fassin. He immediately said guiltily,
"I'm sorry, Sergeant Faxin, but Dr. Leonardo isn't here at the moment."
Sergeant Fassin started, then looked offended. "As I recall, I had an appointment at this time of day."
"I'm sorry, Sheriff. But the doctor is out and hasn't returned. Many patients who made appointments yesterday and today haven't been able to see him," said the valet helplessly.
Sheriff Faxin frowned. Out of professional habit, he asked another question. "Mr. Leonardo is a very punctual gentleman... Did he tell you when he was coming back before he went out?"
The valet hesitated for a moment, but he was also worried about his employer's abnormality. In the end, he replied, "The doctor left in a hurry. I only saw him get into a carriage with an unfamiliar badge. However, he sent me a letter today and told me not to worry. He still has to spend some time outside and asked me to cancel all his appointments."
Sergeant Faxin was relieved to hear that, but he still asked warily, "Are you sure that the letter was written by Dr. Leonardo himself?"
"Yes, Mr. Sheriff. I've been with the doctor for more than ten years. I can't mistake his handwriting," the valet promised earnestly.
"Alright... In that case, do you know if there's any surplus of the pregnancy potion that Dr. Leonardo concocted for my wife? My wife's pregnancy reaction is very strong, and she's not young anymore. She needs the help of that potion very much." Feeling helpless, Sergeant Faxin had no choice but to settle for the next best thing.
"Yes, the doctor actually prepared it before he left. He even specially instructed me to bring you the medicine. Hmm, please wait a moment."
...
Tingen City, Howes Street, inside the Divination Club's meeting room.
Due to Angelica's recommendation, Klein, who had a fortune of 8 pence in divination, had good business today. There were several people who came to him for "consultation." One of them was divining for a child who had just turned 1. Klein directly drew the astrolabe, making the other party convinced and satisfied.
The other was to search for items. Klein had used tarot divination and dream divination to lock onto his general range. This surprised him because he had never seen a fortune-teller who gave him such precise information.
Perhaps I can gather enough money to buy all the spiritual materials for the sacrificial ritual with just divination? Alright, I know that's impossible... But what should I say to Mr. Tower at the next Tarot Club? Is Mr. Fool unable to attempt it because he doesn't have the materials? Klein, who had given him a tip, put on his hat, held his cane, and walked to the club's entrance as he thought.
"Or I can seek advice from Old Neil and ask him what reason he needs to reimburse the additional materials?"
"Speaking of which, the last time Tower reminded us that Mystery Pryers are easily corrupted by the Hidden Sage's knowledge, I even went to Old Neil's house as a guest. I didn't discover anything. Yes, I'll find an excuse to visit Old Neil tomorrow when I consult him. If there's no problem, it means that the 'eye' behind Old Neil was just an accident."
At this moment, he saw Ma'am Christina, who had sought his divination, return with a young lady in a lotus leaf hat.
When Christina saw Klein, she immediately came over and asked in a low voice,
"Mr. Moretti, you previously said that if you have anything related to Lanevus, you can attempt to divine his whereabouts?"
"That's right." Klein nodded.
Christina took a deep breath and asked,
"Does his child count as something related?"
...
July 24, Tuesday.
At the Isengard Detective Agency in Hillston Borough, Ebner had just had his breakfast and was about to head to the police station in Bridge Borough to collect the police files when Sergeant Faxin walked in.
When Ebner saw him, he greeted him and said apologetically, "Sheriff, you came at a bad time. The teacher went out early in the morning. There seems to be a big case that requires his help."
"I know. It's likely that a swindler who cheated a large sum of money has entered Backlund. All the police stations have received a wanted order from that person... As the bounty is very high, many police stations are privately hiring detectives to investigate. However, I'm not here to look for your teacher."
At this point, Sergeant Faxin looked at Ebner and smiled. "After the ball the day before yesterday, your fame rose quickly in the police system. Everyone saw you as a future famous detective."
At this point, Ebner had already seen through the sheriff's intentions. He said thoughtfully, "So, Sheriff Faxin, what is the purpose of your visit today? You didn't use your identity as a police officer to formally request assistance... then, is it your personal matter?"
"Impressive deduction. As expected of a future famous detective at such a young age." Sergeant Faxin clapped his hands and said solemnly, "You're right. I want you to help me investigate the whereabouts of a doctor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Backtrack and Blood Moon
chapters.content:
Chapter 86 - Backtrack and Blood Moon
"Dr. Leonardo has been in Backlund for more than ten years. He's a private doctor with excellent medical skills. He's very accomplished in medicine and surgery and has treated many illnesses. He's very famous in Cherwood Borough, Hillston Borough, and even West Borough. He has deep ties with many merchants, government employees, and nobles."
"In the past year or so, Doctor Leonardo has made a breakthrough in his medical skills in gynecology. He has treated many cases of infertility. My wife and I visited him before, and only then did my wife successfully get pregnant again."
"My wife may have been forcibly pregnant. She was clearly only a month pregnant, but her various reactions were violent. I had to consult Dr. Leonardo again. He recommended a drug to me, and my wife's symptoms quickly disappeared after she took it."
"But that drug can only last for a short period of time. Once the drug wears off, my wife's various reactions will appear again... Yesterday, I brought my wife to the door again to seek treatment, only to find that Dr. Leonardo wasn't home."
"That doctor is a gentleman who keeps his promises. He has never gone back on his word before. This is the first time."
"According to his valet, the Doctor boarded an unfamiliar carriage and left home at least two days ago. During that time, he sent a letter back. The letter said that it would take a few more days for him to return, so he got the valet to cancel all the patients' appointments."
"I suspect that the doctor is in trouble. The letter he sent might have been written under coercion. But because his family didn't report the case, the police couldn't intervene..."
"But I didn't get much medicine. If Dr. Leonardo still doesn't come back before I'm done, then my wife's condition could be even more dangerous."
"Therefore, Mr. Bryan, I wish to entrust you with finding the doctor's whereabouts. Even if he might not want to get up in some mistress's bed, please tell me his exact location. For this, I'm willing to pay fifty pounds."
...
Sitting in the public carriage heading for Rotans Street in Cherwood Borough, Ebner recalled the content of Sergeant Faxin's request and gradually had an idea. Although Sergeant Faxin didn't say it explicitly, he should know very well that Dr. Leonardo wasn't an ordinary person. He also hinted that this case involved Beyonders. Otherwise, he wouldn't have offered 50 pounds just to find a person.
Previously, he was good at treatment, and in the past year, he suddenly became proficient in gynecology... Could it be that a Physician from the Planter pathway's Sequence 8 has advanced to Sequence 7 Harvest Sacrifice? The latter does have the ability to promote fertility...
In his impression, Klein had obtained a Sealed Artifact from the City of Silver when he was disguised as the tycoon, Dwayne. Back then, he had even complained that if the fertility rate in the entire block increased, his reputation as a Dwayne vest would be completely ruined.
At this thought, Ebner stopped making wild guesses and started thinking about how to conduct the investigation. A moment later, he gradually had an idea. He just had to wait for the clues to be found.
Speaking of which, the reason why Ebner had accepted Sergeant Faxin's request was first that he was a friend of his teacher, and it wasn't good to reject a favor. Secondly, he felt that the other party only wanted to find out the whereabouts of the doctor. Even if it involved Beyonders, the danger wouldn't be too high. With his combat strength that was close to Sequence 6, he should be able to handle it. Thirdly, and most importantly, he needed to act as a Detective!
Wasn't the reason why he was so passionate about his reputation after returning to Backlund so that he could successfully receive more requests? Now that he had an opportunity to act, he had no reason to reject it.
Since Sergeant Faxin still had work to do, Ebner was the only one who arrived at 17 Rotans Street.
Looking at the overly exuberant plants in the garden of this beautiful house, Ebner felt that he might have guessed correctly.
He didn't knock on the door because he wasn't a police officer. He didn't have the authority to make the other party cooperate with his investigation. If he rashly went to the door, not only would he expose the fact that Sergeant Faxin had hired a detective to investigate, but he would also alert potential criminals.
Therefore, after directly activating the Eye of Pure White and simulating a smokescreen, Ebner secretly arrived under one of the windows in the house. He then simulated the apprentice's ability to open the door and passed through the tightly shut window into the activity room.
This ability came from a spell model that had been analyzed in 2-081. In the process of analyzing 2-081, the Eye of Pure White had also "learned" this "Open Door ability.
After arriving inside the house, Ebner used Shadow Stealth again. He avoided the servants and nurses in the house and headed straight for the bedroom on the third floor of Dr. Leonardo's room. This skill also came from 2-081.
According to the information given to him by Sergeant Faxin, the first and second floors were covered with a long-range of activity for servants and nurses. Dr. Leonardo wouldn't be in these areas even if he did some secret business. And the rooms on the third floor were only accessible to the valet when he was allowed to come up. That was where Ebner needed to investigate.
After "Open the door" entered the bedroom, Ebner first searched around. In the end, apart from some burnt paper in the trash can at the foot of the desk, there was only a bottle of lady's perfume in his cabinet that was more suspicious.
From the information given by Sergeant Faxin, this doctor has been in Backlund for more than ten years. Although his income isn't bad and he looks decent, he hasn't married or had any children... Then, why is there a bottle of female perfume in his cabinet? Is it because he has a strange fetish or is it prepared for his mistress?
Ebner muttered to himself silently before using "Aura Extraction" to search for traces of the aura left in the bedroom.
There's so little. There's so little aura... Even as a bedroom in a private space, there shouldn't be so little aura... This is someone who regularly cleansed it, specifically targeting a Detective! If not for the augmentation of the White Eye, I probably wouldn't be able to find anything with the Knowledge Keeper's aura extraction ability.
With a sigh, Ebner analyzed the aura he had extracted one by one. Then, he used Scene Backtrack with great difficulty.
In the picture, two figures were kissing in the dimly lit bedroom. One of them was clear, and it was Dr. Leonardo. The other party could only vaguely tell that it was a woman. Apart from that, her appearance, hair color, and age were all blurred, making it impossible to tell. However, she had an extremely prominent feature, and there was a complicated red tattoo on her bareback.
Right on the heels of that, another scene appeared. It was a night with the crimson moon. Dr. Leonardo solemnly took out a bottle of perfume, dripped a drop of it on his glabella, and reached out to point out the symbol of Earth Mother in front of his chest. However, in the end, the direction he paid his respects to wasn't the Sacred Emblem of the Mother Goddess, but the moon hanging high outside the window!
Just as Ebner's gaze was about to follow the doctor's gaze to Scarlet, a fair and smooth finger suddenly reached into the scene. With a gentle twist, the entire scene shattered.
"That was..." Ebner's eyes widened when he came back to himself. Then, he activated the Eye of Pure White to analyze himself.
After a full minute, he finally exited the Eye of Pure White with sweat all over his forehead. His face was filled with fear.
Although he didn't remember the knowledge that had been blocked, nor did he know what he had nearly seen in the scene, the delayed warning of spirituality allowed him to roughly guess something.
I wonder who saved me in the end... That looks like a female finger... Earth Mother or Goddess? Hmm, from the looks of it, the former is more likely.
With this in mind, Ebner revealed a bitter smile as he thought to himself, A 50-pound investigation mission actually involves such a high-level existence... The key is that I haven't found the doctor's exact location. I can only say that I have a clue.
However, at this moment, Ebner was already considering if he should continue investigating. After all, there were quite a few problems with Dr. Leonardo. If he continued investigating, there might be greater danger. As a Sequence 7, even if he had a cheat code, should he really take such a risk?
After weighing the pros and cons, Ebner finally decided to transfer the case to Bishop Utravsky of the Harvest Church.
From the scene just now, Dr. Leonardo should be a believer of Earth Mother, but the target of his prayers had deviated... It's better to get the members of the church to clean up this matter. Just tell me the final result so that I can report to Sergeant Faxin.
Furthermore, it was very likely that Earth Mother had interfered just now. Her gaze should still be lingering nearby, and it would be safer to head to the Church of Earth Mother now.
With this thought in mind, Ebner looked at the ordinary bottle of Ladies' Fragrance Water beside him. He felt a little fearful, but after some hesitation, he sealed it with his spirituality and placed it in the box.
It was better to bring such a dangerous item to the Harvest Church and get professionals to destroy it. If it was left here and misused by ordinary people, who knew what disastrous consequences it would bring.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Lucky
chapters.content:
Chapter 87 - Lucky
After Ebner put away the bottle of perfume, he wasn't in a hurry to leave. Instead, he used his "Aura Extraction" ability to clean up the aura he had left here.
As a "detective" who was good at finding clues, he was naturally an expert in erasing clues.
After doing all of this, Ebner returned along the original route and cleaned up the traces he left behind while taking out the gold coin from the Solomon Empire period.
He rubbed the gold coin that looked uncomfortable no matter how he looked at it. Then, he exerted force with his thumb and wiped away the blood on the gold coin's front profile picture.
Due to such a terrifying encounter in a simple investigation case, Ebner deeply felt that his luck today was somewhat terrible. In order to avoid any accidents on the way to the Harvest Church, he decided to remove the seal on the gold coin to make himself luckier.
Of course, the reason why he didn't hesitate to unseal the Sealed Artifact was also because he had received a telegram from Xio from East Chester County before setting off in the morning. Xio had already set off, and as it was faster to take a steam locomotive, he could arrive in the afternoon.
Holding the gold coin of varying colors, Ebner carefully left Dr. Leonardo's house. He walked through two streets before stopping a rental carriage and letting it take him to the Harvest Church in the south of the bridge.
Due to the dangerous perfume in his arms, Ebner didn't dare take the crowded subway.
Rotans Street, where the doctor's house was located, was located in the south of Cherwood Borough. It was not too far away from West Borough and the south side of the Bridge. There was a main road that connected the border of Borough 3, so the traffic was relatively convenient.
However, at this moment, the carriage was not heading towards the road that intersected the third district. Instead, it was heading towards the bridge in the east.
Ebner, who had transmigrated for quite some time, was already familiar with Backlund's roads. When he saw that the route wasn't right, he was somewhat surprised and wary as he asked the carriage driver, "Why aren't you taking Duke Negan's Avenue?" Could it be that you want to take a detour to scam money?
The main road connecting District Three was built by Duke Negan, so it was named after him.
"Sir, I just came back from Duke Avenue. There was a very serious traffic accident there. It was said that a steam locomotive that a noble master had privately invented malfunctioned. It suddenly lost control and knocked over seven or eight carriages. It even destroyed a gas meter by the roadside... In short, it's still under martial law over there. There are many cars blocking the road, so it's impossible to pass through," the coachman explained.
Was it such a coincidence? If I didn't have the effect of unsealing the gold coins, would I have met the noble who experimented with steaming cars? Then, I would have been knocked over and smashed into pieces by the terrifying perfume?
Ebner let his imagination run wild for a while, then held the perfume more firmly.
...
On Duke Negan Avenue, the police officers who heard the news and rushed over to maintain order worked together to collect the spilled copper pennies back into the gas meter. Only then did the martial law ease and allow the cars to pass through.
A young police officer who was responsible for counting copper pence pressed down on his sore arm and complained to the inspector beside him, "What's the point of counting so many? Who knows how much has been lost... According to me, let the noble who caused the accident take full responsibility and compensate in full."
"The insurance company thinks so too, Shoko. But you should understand that if we can't provide strong evidence of financial losses, that viscount's lawyer won't let go of this opportunity to cause trouble." The inspector beside him chuckled.
Right at this moment, a carriage that was originally parked by the roadside slowly drove past them.
The young police officer named Shoko subconsciously glanced at her. Then, he saw a lady through the carriage window... a lady that he couldn't take his eyes off.
The lady had silky eyes, fair skin, and black hair. She was wearing a purple low-cut gown that revealed her shoulders. Although her face was covered by a veil, making it impossible to see her full appearance, it still made Officer Shoko, who was full of vigor, feel a throbbing sensation. He wanted to jump into the car and kiss her fingers.
Just as Shoko's eyes bugged out and a strange smile curved his lips, the inspector next to him patted him on the shoulder, snapping him out of his fantasy.
"Alright, stop looking. That's not a lady that you can climb up to." The inspector shook his head and reminded his junior with a smile.
"Inspector, how do you know that I won't be able to climb up? That carriage looks quite ordinary..." Although Shoko's thoughts were no longer running wild, his eyes still followed the departing carriage as he spoke perfunctorily.
"Hehe, kid, you really don't want to give up... Do you see that badge on the back of the carriage?" The inspector patted him again in disappointment and pointed at the carriage.
"What's that badge?" Shoko carefully identified it and asked in confusion, "I don't think I've ever seen a noble use this badge..."
"It's good that you haven't seen it before! The background of that badge is a palace, and it represents the royal court. This is the emblem of a court martial officer's house. The lady or young miss from before should be the family of a court martial officer, so you naturally can't afford it."
"I see... Achoo!" Officer Shoko retracted his gaze in disappointment. Then, he suddenly sneezed continuously for a long time before gradually recovering. Only then did he realize that the inspector beside him was actually lying on the ground, panting heavily as if his asthma had suddenly acted up.
...
Holding the Solomon gold coin tightly, Ebner safely arrived outside the Harvest Church on Rose Street in the South Borough of the Bridge.
The moment he got off the carriage, he saw the tall, giant-like Bishop Utravsky walk out of the cathedral.
"Mother has foreseen your arrival. Follow me." Bishop Utravsky glanced at Ebner and smiled warmly.
The Earth Mother had indeed paid attention to me. It seemed like the Blood Duke wasn't lying... Sigh, aren't the deities blocking the astral plane to prevent unknown existences from invading? Why would they pay so much attention to a nobody like me? Is my identity as a transmigrator that special?
Even though Ebner knew that it was impossible for the gods to keep an eye on him all the time, at most, they would pull him when he was in danger of encountering a high-level entity, just like the finger just now... However, the current level of observation was already very frightening.
Forget it. I'll think about it from a different perspective. Although I may have to pay an unknown price to receive this attention and care in the future, isn't it beneficial for me at this stage? Without that person's help, my future might only be left with the path of 'reproduction'.
After consoling himself, Ebner adjusted his mindset and followed Bishop Utravsky into the cathedral.
The moment he entered, Ebner saw all kinds of Beyonder ingredients placed in four corners of the hall. In the middle was a simple baby symbol surrounded by wheat ears, flowers, and spring water.
"The ritual is ready. Give me that item." Bishop Utravsky stopped smiling and said solemnly.
"All right." Ebner didn't hesitate. He immediately handed her the perfume bottle.
Utravsky carefully took the perfume bottle and placed it on the altar. After lowering his head and praying for a while, he began to chant loudly.
"Earth Mother, who brings fertility and life to the world.
"You are the source of life.
"You are the mother of all things.
...
"I pray for your strength,
"I pray for your blessings.
"I pray that you purify the evil filth in this bottle of liquid and give it the nobility of life again. The greatness of fertility."
After he finished chanting, Ebner felt as though a distorted baby's cry was coming from the bottle of perfume. The voice seemed very pleasant, but it also seemed to be very ear-piercing. In short, it was filled with contradictions and strangeness. Ebner even felt that if it wasn't for the Earth Mother's power enveloping them, just hearing the voice would make him and the giant bishop in front of him lose control.
Fortunately, after crying for a while, the voice gradually became low and completely disappeared.
"I actually brought such a dangerous thing with me just now?" Even though Ebner knew that there was nothing wrong with what he had handled, he was still a little scared. He then wanted to open the pure white eye so that he could analyze himself and confirm if he had been corrupted.
But at this moment, Bishop Utravsky, who had ended the ritual, seemed to know what he was thinking. He walked over and said gently, "Under the protection of the Mother Goddess, child, you are safe and sound."
Ebner nodded upon hearing this, but still prepared to go back and confirm it. As for how to confirm it? Apart from the White Eye analyzing itself, he thought of a simpler method. That was to pray to Mr. Fool.
He could pray and say anything.
If Klein gives a response, it means that he didn't see any problems through Sefirah Castle's Eye of Truth. I can also relax.
If Klein didn't respond after a long time, it was very likely that he was frightened by the abnormality on my body! It meant that I was really corrupted.
Despite having such thoughts in his mind, Ebner still expressed his approval of the other party's advice and took the initiative to tell Bishop Utravsky about Dr. Leonardo in detail.
"Leonardo is in trouble..."
"That night, I received news from him and went out. That was why someone took the opportunity to steal the Sealed Artifact. Following that, I was ambushed..."

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Demoness of Afflictions
chapters.content:
Chapter 88 - Demoness of Afflictions
"What happened... that night? What did Leonardo have to do with you, Father?"
Ebner wasn't too interested in the incident of Bishop Utravsky being ambushed that night, but since this matter was connected to Dr. Leonardo, he had to figure it out.
Although he had cleaned up the traces when he left the doctor's house, who knew if the other party had more powerful reconnaissance or divination methods? This matter involved a high-level existence, so he couldn't help but be cautious.
Not to mention, Sheriff Fassin knew about the investigation at Dr. Leonardo's house. If someone really wanted to investigate, they would find out sooner or later.
Upon hearing this, Bishop Utravsky sighed and slowly said,
"Sigh, Leonardo is a believer of the Mother Goddess. More than ten years ago, when the previous Backlund diocese bishop was still around, he devoutly believed in the Mother Goddess."
"He's a Sequence 8 Doctor. After I came to Backlund, he helped me a lot. He even used his influence here to introduce me to many potential believers."
"More than a year ago, he said that he bought the potion formula for Harvest Sacrifice at a Beyonder gathering and successfully advanced to Sequence 7."
"At that time, my mental state wasn't very stable, so I didn't delve too deeply into what he said. Now that I think about it, there were signs then..."
"Last Saturday, he suddenly sent me a letter. He said that his devotion had finally moved Mother, that he had listened to the teachings and received divine revelation. The formula he received a year ago was actually a reward."
"At that time, I felt that something was wrong and wanted to go to his door to stop him. But on the way, I realized that some of the defensive rituals I had set up in the church were triggered."
"I hurriedly returned and found a figure sneaking out from the shadows of the cathedral. I hurriedly chased after him, but I stepped into the trap that he had carefully prepared.
"The other party knew my symptoms very well. He had prearranged a black magic ritual that affected my psyche and led me to degenerate... You know what happened after that. I did my best to break the trap and snatch away the other party's Sealed Artifact mask. However, due to the remnant powers of degeneration, my psyche worsened. Finally, with the blessings of Mother Goddess, I met you who happened to pass by."
After listening to the priest, Ebner nodded thoughtfully and asked, "Father, was it a Demoness who set up a trap to ambush you?"
"Demoness of Pleasure," Bishop Utravsky said with certainty.
"Did you see her true appearance?" Ebner frowned as a strange thought suddenly arose in his mind. This giant priest seemed to be very familiar with the Demoness?
Bishop Utravsky was prepared for Ebner's question. He handed him a sketch of a person that had been drawn with a ritual.
"Ma'am Ray... It's really her." After receiving it, Ebner immediately recognized the Demoness of Pleasure, who had previously planned on finding trouble with Xio.
"What Sealed Artifact did she steal? Is it convenient to tell me?" Ebner pressed again. Although he had some guesses previously, he still needed to confirm them.
"It's a Sealed Artifact formed from a syringe and container. When I obtained it, I didn't know its name, nor did I think of naming it after it. It can allow the user to draw out a tube of his blood first, and at the critical moment, it can be infused back. This way, the fatigue will disappear, and the illness and injuries will be reduced. The strength, speed, balance, and other aspects will be temporarily enhanced." Bishop Utravsky didn't hide anything as he answered in detail.
As expected, it's this Sealed Artifact... Ebner nodded secretly. Then, after some thought, he looked up at Bishop Utravsky and said, "Do you think this Sealed Artifact is needed for the Demoness of Afflictions advancement ritual? Pain... I guess I have to experience pain myself before giving others pain and illness."
Upon hearing this, Bishop Utravsky thought for a moment before shaking his head. "The Sealed Artifact's effects aren't enough..."
That's not enough... Father, why are you so familiar with the advancement ritual of a Demoness Sequence 5?! Has this ever happened before?
Ebner lampooned and suddenly had an idea. He thought of the lady with the complicated tattoo on her back and Mr. Leonardo kissing her. He asked again,
"Then, what about a Harvest Priest that has been corrupted by a high-level existence and has mutated vitality and strange powers?"
Upon hearing this, Bishop Utravsky, who had his eyes lowered, widened his dark blue eyes, and his expression turned serious. After a long while, he said, "It should meet the requirements of the ritual... However, there might be some problems with the advancement of the Demoness of Agony... I have to report this to the Holy Cathedral."
How many Demonesses were normal? There was probably something wrong with every one of them! Even Vice Admiral Ailment... Tracy, who was still a Young Lady Ailment, was only slightly more human.
As for corruption, that was even less of an issue. Although he couldn't recall the source of the corruption, such indirect corruption was likely similar to the Rose School of Thought's indulgent faction. It was just that their beliefs and personalities were distorted.
Compared to the priest's nervousness, Ebner heaved a sigh of relief. This was because there was at most a newly promoted Demoness of Afflictions behind this matter. This Demoness of Agony was very likely to be Ma'am Ray whom he wanted to deal with.
Thanks to Teacher's arrangements and guidance, this Demoness currently doesn't have any help other than relying on some members of MI9. Furthermore, she's currently on the wanted list of the three Churches, especially the Church of the Lord of Storms. She doesn't dare to easily reveal herself, so she won't be able to quickly find out what I previously investigated...
At the same time, Ebner was once again determined to get rid of this demoness. If she were allowed to continue growing, she would definitely find out what her teacher and herself had done to harm the world, not to mention how corrupted and twisted her personality would be.
After Ebner regained his senses, he saw that Bishop Utravsky was already busy contacting the Holy Cathedral in a special way, so he tactfully bade farewell and left.
As for the matter of outsourcing this case to the Church of Earth Mother, there was actually a tacit understanding. Ebner had read the original novel and knew that the Church of Earth Mother had a complete set of processing mechanisms for the so-called "divine revelation". Since the priest had already reported it to the Holy Cathedral, even if that Dr. Leonardo was still alive, his future fate was most likely to be imprisoned under the cathedral.
But as Ebner started out the door, something occurred to him and he turned back inside the church.
Bishop Utravsky, who had just contacted the Holy Cathedral, didn't show any surprise when he saw him return. He calmly asked, "Child, is there anything else?"
"I'm trying to ask if those pregnant women who are pregnant because of Leonardo... and the baby they're carrying will have any problems?" Ebner thought about how nervous Sergeant Fassin was about having a second child and wished he had a good answer.
Perhaps because he had unsealed the gold coin and was rather lucky, Bishop Utravsky replied calmly, "Most of it doesn't matter. That's the power of the Mother Goddess's normal domain. Only pregnant women who are pregnant because of that bottle of perfume are more difficult. After the perfume is purified by the Mother Goddess, it will lose the augmentation of the strange power, and it might result in miscarriage. It will require the help of a physician or apothecary to have a chance of preserving the fetus."
I heard that Sergeant Fassin's wife was in a bad condition. It could be because of that bottle of perfume... Ebner thought for a moment and thought that he might be able to introduce the sergeant to Darkwill... Of course, he had to get the chubby Apothecary's approval first.
After receiving the answer he wanted, Ebner bade the priest farewell once again and left the Harvest Church in satisfaction.
He quickly took the subway back to the rented apartment in East Borough. Then, he sealed the room with his spirituality, preparing to pray to Mr. Fool.
...
Tingen City, inside a terrace house at 2 Daffodil Street.
Klein, who had just returned home from combat training, felt sore all over. He sat on the sofa in a very inelegant manner and casually picked up today's newspaper.
Then, he immediately saw Lanevus's wanted poster.
"He actually swindled more than ten thousand pounds... How detestable!" Klein condemned angrily before seriously memorizing the appearance of the great swindler who was wanted by the three Churches.
He had a full forehead, black hair, and brown eyes. He wore glasses that were almost round, and the corners of his mouth were slightly raised. He seemed to be mocking everyone...
Apart from the pair of glasses, Lanevus didn't have any obvious characteristics. He was very ordinary. Klein lampooned inwardly. Just as he was about to flip open the second page of the newspaper, his spirituality suddenly stirred as though he heard an illusory voice.
Someone is praying to me? Who is it? The Tower or The Hanged Man? Is he preparing to take leave on Tuesday?
Klein walked into the bathroom with a belly full of question marks. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and boarded the gray fog amidst his screams and murmurs.
The moment he entered the towering temple, Klein saw a familiar crimson star contracting and expanding. It wasn't large, but it was persistent.
"Is it Tower praying?" Klein pondered for a moment before carefully spreading his spirituality towards the dark red.
The moment the two came into contact, his mind buzzed as he saw a blurry and distorted scene. He heard an illusory and overlapping prayer:
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"You are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog;
"You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
"I pray for your help."
"I pray for your blessing."
"I beg you to listen to my description of the Sealed Artifact, Clown Mask..."
Klein watched this scene with his mouth agape as he muttered to himself, "What's going on? Is this promotion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Xio Return
chapters.content:
Chapter 89 - Xio Return
Although he was surprised, Klein quickly snapped to his senses. He lowered his head in thought and began analyzing the motive behind Tower's prayer.
On the surface, he's introducing the Sealed Artifact that requires communication to reduce the negative effects to The Fool... In fact, he's secretly asking me about the progress of the sacrificial ritual, right?
"This should be part of the previous test. It's still using a pious attitude to openly test Mr. Fool's strength..."
Thinking that he had guessed Tower's thoughts, Klein sighed and leaned back against the back of the ancient chair. He thought helplessly,
"But all the spiritual materials he gave for the sacrificial ritual add up to more than 15 pounds... Even if some of the materials to please The Fool can be simplified, it will still take at least 10 pounds to buy them all in the black market."
From the looks of it, I have to seek Mr. Azik's knowledge of 'sacrifice' without the need for expensive ingredients. If I don't make any progress for too long, not only the Tower, even The Hanged Man might have ideas... Sigh, the Tarot Club has gained a knowledgeable member. As The Fool, I'm under immense pressure...
However, there are quite a few benefits... Clown Mask? Tower said that the apex of the Sealed Artifact's pathway is The Fool. Furthermore, from the name, it should be related to the name of the Sequence 8 potion I know of, Clown... Yes, when I ask Mr. Azik, I should mention Tower's description of the mask's powers. Perhaps Mr. Azik will remember something.
The ability to change my appearance... I wonder if I'll have this ability after advancing to Clown? I'm really looking forward to it.
After looking forward to the future for a moment, Klein sat up straight and cast his gaze at the crimson star representing the Tower again. He transmitted the answer he had outlined in his mind through the subtle connection.
"I understand."
...
In an independent house in Backlund's East Borough, Ebner, who was still in a praying posture, suddenly sensed layers of gray fog appear in front of him. A distorted and blurry figure stood in the deepest part of it.
And in the empty world around him, a deep and solemn voice constantly echoed.
"I understand."
A moment later, Ebner's vision returned to normal. He stood up with a relaxed smile.
Since Mr. Fool had responded so quickly, it meant that there was indeed no problem.
He took out his pocket watch and looked at the time. It was already 4: 30 pm.
Xio's steam locomotive will arrive at the station at around five o'clock. I should be able to rush over to pick it up in time... Yes, I'll also have to discuss the matter of extracting blood with her...
With that thought in mind, Ebner's hands didn't slow down. He quickly packed up the various items for the prayer ceremony, then adjusted his appearance in the mirror before leaving again.
...
It was also four-thirty in the afternoon. Fors struggled to get out of bed. For some reason, the blood moon had suddenly appeared in the sky last night, causing her to be tortured by the ravings. She only managed to recover after a day of rest.
Xio is coming back. I can't let her notice my abnormality... She will be worried. Fors hurriedly tidied up the hair that covered the ground before heaving a sigh of relief.
She looked at the time and saw that it was already close to five. She hurriedly left the house and rushed to the nearest train station. As she walked, she pondered and said,
The ravings during the full moon are getting more intense... Thankfully, it's still within an acceptable range... Sigh, Ebner once said that the source of the ravings is related to the Abraham family, but I've recently checked all the books and even asked Viscount Glaint about it, but there's no news of this family.
However, she then smiled helplessly and said self-deprecatingly, "Forget it. So what if I really found them? According to Ebner, that family is just as helpless against the curse of the full moon as I am. They might even be exterminated... Could it be that after I find them, I'll share with them the experience of scratching my hair under the ravings?"
At this moment, as she was still in a daze, she bumped into a lady who had just come out of an alley and was also distracted.
"Ouch!" The lady cried out in shock. The lunchbox in her hand fell out of her hand. Not only did the food and drinks in the lunchbox spill all over the floor, but the two of them were also covered in them.
Thankfully, I'm not wearing my favorite dress... This thought flashed through Fors's mind as soon as she snapped back to her senses. Then, she looked down at the large patch of butter on her clothes and couldn't help but sigh. She felt that she probably wouldn't be able to take the job today.
"I'm very sorry, Ma'am! I... I'll compensate you." The lady who bumped into Fors was first stunned. When she recovered from her shock, she hurriedly apologized because she had indeed been distracted while walking.
Fors looked at the flustered lady in front of her. She was about twenty years old, and she wore a lusterless black funeral dress. She had a good figure and a pretty face, but she was also covered in grease stains. Even her hair was dripping with soup, making her look wet and extremely disheveled.
"It's fine. It's not your fault alone. I didn't notice it just now." Although Fors felt that her luck today was terrible, she wouldn't vent her anger on others. All she did was wave her hand.
"Thank you for your understanding, ma'am. My name is Chelly, and I'm a clerk at the Black River Security Company across the street. You can come to me anytime. I'll compensate you for your clothes..." As the lady named Chelly said this, the soup on her hair suddenly dripped into her mouth. She was stunned for a moment before she awkwardly apologized and took out a handkerchief to wipe her hair.
This rash look was about the same as Xio's. If the two of them could get to know each other, they might become friends. Fors lampooned before looking at her watch and realizing that it was already past five. She finally gave up struggling and decided to head back to change before waiting for Xio to return.
"There's no need to go through so much trouble, Ma'am Chelly. I'll go wash myself. Then, goodbye." Fors didn't wish to waste any more time with this rash lady as she turned and walked towards her rented apartment.
Chelly watched as Fors's figure disappeared into the distance. She smacked her forehead and muttered to herself, "I've spilled the food I brought to Madam Daly and the other Nighthawks... I have to buy another one."
...
At five o'clock in the Backlund steam train station, Ebner stood on the platform and looked around for a while. He found it odd that he didn't see Fors.
Did she oversleep and forget when Xio was coming back? That's not right. She has always taken Xio's matter seriously... Did something happen?
Just as he was letting his imagination run wild, the sound of the steam whistle echoed in every corner of the station. The monstrous steam locomotive slowly came to a stop, dragging more than twenty carriages behind it.
Under the guidance of the train attendant, the passengers disembarked in an orderly manner. Soon, Ebner saw an extremely eye-catching Miss Xio among the people who alighted.
She was striking not because of her messy blonde hair or her height of less than 1.5 meters, but because there were no passengers around her, making her stand out in the small space.
Seeing this, Ebner hurriedly went over and took the luggage. He then pulled her towards a place with fewer people... At least this way, it wouldn't seem so conspicuous.
Xio also knew that her situation was a little inappropriate. She obediently followed Ebner to a secluded spot before taking the initiative to say, "I've just advanced to Sequence 8 Sheriff. I still can't control the power of the potion."
"Why are you in such a hurry?" Wouldn't it be safer to drink the potion after returning to Backlund? Ebner didn't ask the latter half of the sentence, but he believed that Xio would understand what he meant.
Xio looked around and whispered, "Something happened again... This isn't the place to talk. Let's find a quiet place to talk later."
Ebner nodded at that and led her out of the station.
During this period, Xio asked curiously, "Why isn't Fors here? Did something happen?"
Ebner spread his hands, indicating that he did not know.
Xio looked at him steadily and suddenly heaved a sigh of relief. "So there's something you don't know... That's good too. Once you 'know' it, it means that it's very dangerous..."
Hey, Miss. What kind of image do you have of me? Ebner choked when he heard that. He deeply felt that this future Miss Judgment might have learned "bad" from him... At least, she was complaining about this aspect.
Initially, Ebner wanted to have a welcome feast, but Xio was worried about Fors's situation and decided to return to Fors's rented apartment to take a look. This made it inconvenient for Ebner to follow. After all, Xio hadn't obtained Fors's permission, so it wasn't convenient for her to reveal it.
Seeing that Xio was about to stop the public carriage, Ebner hesitated before gritting his teeth and saying,
"Xio, can I ask you something?"
"What's the matter?" Xio turned her head and asked in surprise. It had been a long time since they had been so polite.
"It's just... Can you give me some blood?"

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Ebner in Xio’s Instinct
chapters.content:
Chapter 90 - Ebner in Xio's Instinct
Ebner also knew that his request was a little too much. After all, in mysticism, the blood of a Beyonder was a rather important and critical matter. It was best not to hand it over easily to others, or they wouldn't even know how they died. And sometimes, death wasn't the most terrifying outcome.
Xio looked at Ebner seriously and didn't reject him directly. Instead, she asked, "What urgent need do you have for my blood?"
Ebner nodded and led her to a small alley by the side of the road. Then, he took out the gold coin from the Solomon Empire era and briefly explained its functions and sealing methods. He only described the Judgment pathway in the White Eye analysis report as the Arbiter pathway. Finally, he said sincerely, "You are the only Beyonder from the Arbiter pathway among my friends. I can only ask for your help."
Xio frowned, not because of her blood, but because of something else. "What did you provoke again? You actually unsealed that gold coin without my return..."
After a month of traveling together, she understood Ebner's character very well. She knew that if he hadn't encountered trouble, he wouldn't have been in such a hurry to use the effects of "luck."
Although Ebner was somewhat surprised by Xio's keen senses, he still replied with a wry smile, "Heh, I did encounter some trouble... It's not very convenient here. I'll tell you when we reach a safe place." He didn't plan on hiding it from Xio. After all, it was something the two of them had in common to deal with the Demoness in the future.
Of course, he would definitely temporarily hide the parts that involved unknown corruption and Earth Mother.
"Actually, it's about the same for me... My luck is equally terrible. The things I encounter might be even more dangerous than the ones you encounter..." Xio sighed as she looked at Ebner with a look of understanding... Yes, it was like they were brothers in distress.
Ebner recalled Xio's abnormality when she suddenly advanced to Sequence 8, and he didn't know what to say. All he could think was: Was Xio's bad luck infecting him? Or was Xio so unlucky because of his appearance...
On the other hand, after figuring out Ebner's intentions, Xio didn't hesitate to use the dagger she carried with her to cut her finger and drip a drop of blood onto the frontal portrait of the Solomon gold coin.
Ebner was very touched when he saw this because he knew that Xio had given him her blood so easily. She had truly treated him as a friend who could entrust her life to him!
...
North Borough, Converton Street, Fors's latest rented apartment.
Xio found her keys in a hidden corner of the garden. Then, as soon as she opened the door, she saw her friend curled up on the sofa in her pajamas.
While heaving a sigh of relief, she couldn't help but feel vexed. She felt that Fors had become even lazier after not returning for a month.
Upon hearing the door open, Fors immediately jumped off the sofa. Looking at her friend's puffed up cheeks, she hurriedly explained, "I originally wanted to pick you up, but Chelly bumped into me on the way and dirtied my clothes. That's why I had to go home first."
"Chelly?" Xio asked warily when she heard this familiar name.
"It's the passerby girl who bumped into me," Fors replied nonchalantly.
Xio nodded thoughtfully and didn't probe further.
Seeing that her friend's expression had finally eased, Fors hurriedly pulled her back and asked her about her traveling experience. She had already tolerated it for a long time. She didn't even ask during her meal with Ebner a few days ago. All she did was wait for Xio to come back and tell her.
After some thought, she slowly recounted some of the experiences that she had discussed with Ebner and didn't involve any secrets. Fors listened with relish.
At the end of her speech, Xio mentioned that she had given Ebner a drop of her blood to seal a Sealed Artifact. Only then did Fors stand up in shock and anxiously say,
"The blood of Beyonders is a medium for many curses and similar spells... You gave it to him just like that? Aren't you afraid that he will harm you?"
It wasn't that Fors had a bad impression of Ebner, but she felt that her friend's actions were too rash.
"I trust Ebner. He won't do that!" Xio shook her head, disapproving of Fors's worries.
After all, in her eyes, Ebner "knew" a lot of things. If he told her anything, it would probably lead to a disaster. There was no need to make an issue out of mere blood.
"Emperor Roselle once said, 'The person you think is familiar might not be as familiar as you imagine'... How can you be sure of Ebner's true thoughts? No matter how you look at it, he's a person with heavy thoughts." Fors still didn't agree. Of course, this was also because she didn't know Ebner well enough. Many of her impressions of him came directly from Xio's description.
"A heavy heart? Perhaps..." Xio paused and looked at her friend beside her. She said with uncertainty, "However, Fors, I keep having the feeling that you are the same type of person as him."
"I'm the same type of person as him?" Fors widened her eyes and repeated in confusion. She didn't think she had anything in common with Ebner.
"I think that you and his heart are actually very empty and at a loss... Neither of you have any clear goals." Xio paused and organized her words before continuing, "To be precise, be it you or him, both of you have a sense of alienation towards everything around you... Of course, both of you are much better now. Both of you are more real than when I first met you."
I'm alienated... For a person who no longer has any family, no hatred, and only wants to live like this, yet suffers pain every full moon, not knowing how long he can live, he is indeed empty and lost... However, I still have a goal. I want to solve the curse of the full moon, but this is obviously beyond my ability...
Fors was amazed by her friend's intuition, but she deliberately smiled on the surface. "What emptiness? I'm a famous best-selling author in Loen."
"Although writing novels is a hobby of yours, I know that it's also a way to relieve the emptiness in your heart. Yes, smoking and drinking are the same." Xio shook her head and said affirmatively.
Fors didn't wish to argue with her friend on this matter, so she changed the topic. "What about Ebner? According to what he said, there should be a cult and military involved in his mother's disappearance. Doesn't he want revenge? Why would he be empty if he has enemies?"
"Ebner isn't passionate about revenge... I even have the illusion that he actually knows who his enemy is waiting for him to perish," Xio said with a strange expression.
"That's... hard to say. He does know a lot." Fors thought for a moment and nodded in agreement.
"Furthermore, he seemed to have a strange sense of mission towards me at the beginning. This sense of dissonance only disappeared when we really became friends. I guess he also sensed the alienation between himself and his surroundings, so he used me to make himself more real." Xio's tone was even more hesitant when she said this because it was purely her intuition. And in reality, even though Ebner was a little special, he didn't make her feel that special.
Fors smiled and teased, "You make it sound like you're his destined female lead. Heh, my inspiration came."
Xio snapped to her senses when she heard that. Looking at the teasing look in her friend's eyes, she retorted, "Since I'm back, I'll keep an eye on you every day to write down your inspiration."
"Xio, you've changed..." You weren't so sharp before.
...
After a few days, Ebner wasn't in a rush to go to the Harvest Church to ask about Dr. Leonardo's outcome. Instead, he first went to the police station in the bridge district to continue flipping through the dossiers, trying his best to create the impression that he was actively completing the Church of Storms's mission.
Although the investigation of people who were suddenly deranged or demented was perfunctory, Ebner had read through the case files carefully in hopes of finding traces of Beyonders.
"There have been many burglaries on Wayner Street, Iska Street, and the other six streets near South Borough in the past two days. And the result of the investigation was that there were no signs of the door being pried open?"
"There was a murder on Westcott Street. The victim was a waitress. No witnesses saw the killer."
"Most of the tramps gathered at Southampton Street have gone missing. No corpses have been found..."
Ebner dug out a few cases that seemed to have Beyonder involvement but didn't seem high-end. He planned on taking the initiative to investigate and solve the case if they weren't entrusted to him.
"After all, it's a need for acting."
After Ebner sighed inwardly, he looked at the time and saw that it was almost noon. He had no choice but to pack his files and leave the police station. After some thought, he rushed to the contact address that Darkwill had given him.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Azik and the Mask
chapters.content:
Chapter 91 - Azik and the Mask
The address Darkwill had previously left for Ebner was on Leighton Street, near the Tussock River in Cherwood Borough. It wasn't too far from the bridge police station, so Ebner didn't take the carriage. He headed there on foot.
Along the way, he bought two Desi pies for lunch.
Ten minutes later, after finishing the delicious Loen cuisine that was filled with the rich aroma of meat, Ebner happened to walk to the address.
It was a two-story house facing the street. It was obvious that it had just been renovated. The signboard had the words "Folk Herb Store" written on it.
Ebner pushed the door open and walked in. As he smelled the various herbs, he also saw Darkwill with short black hair and a round face.
He was still wearing the attire of a village witch doctor. His robe was black and embroidered with all kinds of strange symbols.
The chubby Apothecary revealed a look of surprise when he saw Ebner enter. Then, he swept his dark blue eyes across him and smirked.
"You don't look sick. Why are you here?"
With that said, he pretended to come to a realization as he chuckled strangely. He suppressed his voice and said,
"Did you also hear about my mummy powder? It has indeed become very famous in the past two days. Many nobles came to buy such things, putting them in tea or making soup... There was even an earl who wanted to exchange his precious Fourth Epoch antique mask with me!"
"But aren't you too young?"
Just as Ebner was about to greet the apothecary, his words were stuck in his throat. The corners of his eyes twitched, and he felt that it was a miracle that the apothecary before him had not been beaten to death.
Seeing that the other party was still promoting the mummy powder, Ebner had no choice but to interrupt. "Darkwill, I'm here to introduce business to you today. I wonder if you have the ability to accept it."
Darkwill then stopped his endless stream of advertising slogans. He glanced at Ebner and asked suspiciously, "What business?" He's clearly just an ordinary friend on the ship, yet he's introducing me to a business? Is there a problem?
"I have a friend. His wife got pregnant through unconventional means, so the fetus might have some problems... Do you have any medicine that can deal with such a situation?" Ebner said vaguely. After all, in his eyes, he didn't know that he was a Sequence 9 Apothecary.
Darkwill sized up Ebner warily before asking with a smile, "Is that friend you mentioned yourself? Or is that unconventional method actually you?"
Do you believe that I'll report you right now? After all, you aren't the only Apothecary in Backlund. Emlyn's parents are excellent candidates!
Ebner cursed in his heart, but on the surface, he smiled and said, "Looks like you don't have the ability. What a pity for that big client..."
"Who said I can't do anything? But you have to get her to come and let me take a look. Otherwise, how would I know which 'unconventional' method caused the pregnancy?" As Darkwill opened a new store and bought and cultivated herbs, he didn't have much savings. He couldn't be reserved when it came to big clients.
Of course, most importantly, he had some connections in Backlund. He hadn't done anything illegal, so he wasn't afraid of the official Beyonders of the various Churches coming to him.
"Then it's settled. I'll bring them over tomorrow." Ebner nodded and looked around. After settling the business, he had the time to examine the shop's goods.
Sleeping Flower, Dragon's Blood Grass, Crimson Sandalwood, mint, lavender... The variety was very comprehensive. In the future, the herbs needed for the ritual could come to him. He would no longer have to go to so many shops...
While Ebner was thinking, he heard Darkwill say in a wary tone, "What are you looking at? Let me make it clear first, I won't pay the intermediary fee!"
Alright, in order not to hear this person, I would rather go to a few more shops to buy materials...
With that thought in mind, Ebner realized that his self-restraint was improving.
...
During the summer vacation, Huo Yi University was filled with lush greenery, flowers, and birds, peaceful and quiet.
After walking along the river for a while, Klein turned into a path that led to the History department. He found an old three-story gray stone building and the common room where Mr. Azik was.
He knocked on the door and entered. He saw Azik, who seemed to be sitting there waiting for him.
This was a gentleman with bronze skin, medium build, black hair, brown eyes, and gentle facial features. His eyes always had an indescribable sense of vicissitude, and beneath his right ear was a tiny mole that couldn't be discovered without careful observation.
"Why are you here today? Did you discover something and wish to tell me?" Seeing Klein walk in, Mr. Azik looked up and asked in a gentle tone.
"Mr. Azik, can I have a chat with you?" Klein looked at the other faculty members in the common room and asked sincerely.
Upon hearing his student's words, the brown-eyed gentleman organized his books and said,
"No problem. Let's take a walk by the Hoi River like last time."
"Alright." Klein held his cane and followed him out of the three-story gray stone building.
Along the way, both of them remained silent and neither of them spoke.
When the flowing river came into view, and when there were no more teachers and students around, Azik stopped in his tracks, turned around, and said to Klein,
"Well, it's quiet enough here to talk."
Klein pondered for a moment, organized his words, and said, "Mr. Azik, I recently heard of a Sealed Artifact. It has the characteristic of being alive. Perhaps its description can help you recall something."
"Sealed Artifact?" Azik was a little dazed when he heard that term. After a moment, he returned to his senses and asked, "What kind of Sealed Artifact is it?"
Klein saw that he seemed to really recall something, and he felt excited. He hurriedly followed the prayer content he received from Tower yesterday and continued, "That's a mask. It can allow the wearer to change into a preset appearance. It can enhance strength, balance, and other abilities. Its negative effects are..."
After repeating Tower's prayer, Klein saw that Azik seemed to have fallen into a strange state. His eyes were deep and unfocused at times, as though he was constantly wandering between dreams and reality.
"Mr. Azik, w-what's wrong?" Klein asked carefully as he gripped his cane and activated his Spirit Vision.
Long before he came to Hoy University to look for Mr. Azik, he had used the pendulum for quick divination. The results of the divination showed that there was almost no danger.
However, through the Clown who used his life to teach him, he already knew that divination wasn't omnipotent. He needed to constantly be on guard against his misinterpretation or the problem with the organization of the divination statement. In addition, Azik was a mysterious Beyonder. No one knew who he was in the past, nor did they know how he would react if he was provoked. Caution, wariness, and worry became Klein's normal emotions.
Azik didn't immediately answer. He reached out and pinched his glabella. After a long while, he said in a dreamy tone,
"I once had a mask like that. It could make me anyone."
"But it seems to have been lost..."
"Or maybe I lost it myself..."
Take the initiative to lose it? Why? Could it also have a very strong negative effect? Perhaps Mr. Azik lost his memory because of that mask... I originally wanted to consult him about communication skills with Sealed Artifacts...
Many thoughts flashed through Klein's mind. Before he could ask anything, he saw that Mr. Azik had already recovered. He smiled at him and said, "Klein, thank you for bringing me this news. It reminds me of something."
"I'm also very happy to be able to help you... Yes, I'll continue collecting similar information in the future," Klein replied with a smile.
Azik nodded slightly to express his gratitude before asking,
"Other than telling me about the Sealed Artifact, did you come here today for something else?"
Klein nodded when he heard that. Then, without hiding anything, he frankly asked about the relevant knowledge regarding "sacrifice," as well as how to communicate with Sealed Artifacts.
Azik gave him a deep look and replied, "I'm not sure about the knowledge regarding 'sacrifice', or perhaps I haven't thought of it. However, from my current memory, I can infer that it's very dangerous because you don't know what attitude the recipient of the sacrifice has towards you..."
No, I know, because I'm the recipient of the sacrifice. Klein mocked himself inwardly as he heard Mr. Azik continue,
"As for the method to communicate with Sealed Artifacts... Yes, take the mask you mentioned as an example. As long as you use its fearful aura or place it beside a dangerous item that can destroy it, it will be easy to communicate with it."
"In addition, every Sealed Artifact is very easy to obey the superior existences of its pathway. It's just like the Puppet Sealed Artifact that you mentioned the last time. Even after so many years, it's still searching for its original owner's aura."
Klein nodded thoughtfully when he heard that. He recalled his title as The Fool, as well as the close connection between the gray fog and the Seer pathway. He could roughly guess why Tower was certain that he could communicate with the Clown Mask.
In that case, if that Sealed Artifact is in the gray fog, it should be more 'honest', right? Klein thought to himself.
After the discussion, Azik, who had recalled some of the past, took the initiative to bid farewell. Klein knew that Azik's mind was in chaos, so he didn't try to persuade him to stay. He watched Azik return to the gray stone building.
After that, Klein, who was walking out of the university campus, suddenly felt his stomach growl. He took out his pocket watch and realized that it was already three in the afternoon. Only then did he hurriedly get on the public carriage and return to his home at 2 Daffodil Street to prepare the food. At the same time, he muttered,
"Mr. Azik actually didn't treat me to lunch..."

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Xio’s Encounter
chapters.content:
Chapter 92 - Xio's Encounter
After leaving Darkwill's herb store, Ebner went to the Harvest Church in South Borough again. He asked Bishop Utravsky about the progress of Dr. Leonardo's incident, but all he got was the result of the doctor's still unknown whereabouts.
"There's no need to be in such a rush, child. The elite of the Holy Cathedral, the Forsaken One, still needs a few days to arrive in Backlund. Before that, it's not suitable for the Church's personnel to expose too much. After all, from the intelligence of many aspects, perhaps the Loen military is also involved in this matter," Bishop Utravsky explained with a smile.
As a bishop of Earth Mother, don't you think you've said too much to a heretic like me? Don't you think I'm an outsider now?
Ebner grumbled to himself, but on the surface, he was intrigued by an unfamiliar term. "The Forsaken?" Whether it was in the original novel or in his experience since his transmigration, he had never heard the term before.
