"The Forsaken are the Mother Goddess's loyal guards in the mortal world, similar to the Nighthawks of the Church of Evernight and the Mandated Punishers of the Church of Storms," Bishop Utravsky explained.
Ebner immediately understood. He compared the Nighthawks who had appeared the most in his mind and guessed that the so-called elite "Barrens" should be a special official team similar to the Red Gloves.
Since there was no news, for the time being, Ebner didn't delay in the Harvest Church. He took the subway to the rented house in East Borough.
He had arranged to meet Xio here when they parted yesterday.
Ebner rested in his room for about half an hour before there was a knock on the door. He opened the door and saw Xio with her messy hair.
Ebner looked at her shoulder-length yellow hair, which was obviously very clean, and deliberately ruffled until it was messy. He smiled and teased, "Why didn't you take care of it? Must you do this?"
Xio glanced at him and replied, "There's no need... I've already set up my own jurisdiction in the East Borough. It's actually very inconvenient to dress up too well."
The Sheriff's powers were always linked to they "jurisdiction." The more familiar a place was, the more effective it was. Once it exceeded the range, one could only rely on Beyonder powers.
Ebner knew this very well, so he didn't continue on the topic. Instead, he turned around and walked to the center of the house, holding a ritual that had been prepared there. He used it to construct a wall of spirituality to seal the entire room.
From Xio's words yesterday, he could guess how troublesome the matter she encountered in East Chester was. And his own situation involved too many secrets. Under such circumstances, he naturally had to build a safe environment for them to converse.
Xio quietly watched Ebner finish the ritual before saying, "Actually, the day after you left, I settled down with my mother and brother, but when I returned to Storn to purchase the steam locomotive ticket, I happened to encounter Mr. Vernal."
"Vernal?" Ebner recalled who Xio was referring to and asked, "Mr. Vernal on the White Agate?"
"That's right, it's him." Xio nodded and continued, "At that time, he, his wife, Katrina, and their two daughters were hunted down..."
"So you were embroiled in a very terrifying incident?" Ebner knew very well that with Xio's sense of justice, she definitely wouldn't stand idly by when a child was being hunted down. Otherwise, she wouldn't have become the famous Arbiter of East Borough who stood up for the poor before learning of the "acting method."
"Yes... It was on the outskirts of the city. Their family was pursued by a monster formed from white fog. Their son, Lott, was devoured by the smoke because he ran a little slower. He disappeared without a trace... And the smoke gave me a very bad feeling. It's as though I couldn't control my powers just by looking at it." Even though it had been a few days, Xio still felt frightened when she recalled the smoke.
She was definitely not a timid girl, but this "fear" seemed to originate from her soul.
"White smoke..." Although Ebner couldn't recall something he had confirmed back in Sefirah Castle, he still deduced based on the clues he had. "I remember Mr. Vernal once said that he was an archaeologist. He returned to East Chester this time because his student dug up an ancient ruin in the Hornacis mountain range... Did his student bring that smoke out from the ruins?"
"Your guess is very correct... It's precisely because Mr. Vernal's student was originally an ordinary person that even though he was contaminated by the very high-level smoke, his means were still very limited. I was able to help them temporarily escape the assault of the smoke monsters." Xio hesitated for a moment before finally saying, "Of course, it's also thanks to the thing that the dragon I encountered in my dream left on me..."
She hesitated not because she wanted to hide it, but because the matter had already been resolved and she did not want to say it out loud to make her friends worry.
"What is it?" Ebner asked with a frown. He even felt that it was more troublesome than the white mist.
"I don't know." Xio shook her head and continued her story. "Although I managed to escape calamity with Vernal and his family, for the time being, I was surrounded by the fog in a village. Due to the lack of means and something on me, the smoke monster couldn't deal with me. However, I didn't have the ability to break out with a few ordinary people... Therefore, I had no choice but to consume the potion ahead of time and advance to Sheriff, hoping to rely on my new Beyonder powers to sense the weak point of the smoke seal..."
"It looks like you didn't get your wish," Ebner said with certainty. After all, the smoke was dug out from the Fourth Epoch ruins. How could a mere Sequence 8 sense its weakness?
Xio was already accustomed to Ebner's powers of "reasoning". He could immediately "understand" matters without any clues, much less give him so many details. Therefore, she wasn't surprised by his "prophecy." She nodded and said,
"We were saved by a powerful lady."
"Lady? An official Beyonder?" Ebner asked after some thought.
"I'm not sure. That lady... She's just as irascible and repulsive as your Solomon gold coin." Xio frowned when she said this, as though she couldn't accept such aesthetic taste just from recalling it.
"Asymmetrical as my gold coin?" Ebner instantly raised his opinion of the lady who had saved Xio. If she was really a remnant of the Solomon Empire, she was at least a powerful demigod.
"Yes! That lady is very beautiful herself. She's... very tall, but she's wearing a long dress that's split into two. One side is complicated, the other is simple. The other side is filled with many colors, while the other side is pure black. The boots on her feet are the same. One of the front ends is pointed and curled, while the other is similar to the current popular round-headed boots. They seem to belong to two people..." Xio described with an awkward expression.
This was really the style of the Solomon Empire... Could it be that this lady was also dug out from the ruins by Vernal's students?
While Ebner was deep in thought, Xio continued, "After the lady retracted all the fog into a bottle, she came to me and used some unknown method to take a ball of light from my forehead... I don't know what it is, but my intuition tells me that it's something the ancient dragon left on me."
"Perhaps... the ancient dragon wanted to borrow your hand to pass something to this lady..." Ebner had seen many tools and had some experience. He had some understanding of the methods of some big shots.
"You guessed it again... That lady said she wouldn't let me hand over the item for nothing... Therefore, she gave me the potion formula for Sequence 7 Interrogator. By the way, I'll need Detective Stanton's help to appraise it." As Xio spoke, she took out a piece of goatskin parchment with different colors and styles. On it were written in ancient Hermes and dragon characters.
This must be the late stages of obsessive-compulsive disorder... Ebner felt that this style alone wouldn't be fake. Who would make such a crazy fake?
After grumbling in his heart, Ebner thought for a moment and asked again, "Did you ask Mr. Vernal what's buried in the ruins of the ruins dug out by the Hornacis mountain range?"
"Of course, but Mr. Vernal actually doesn't know much... He only heard a name when he was being pursued by the white fog."
"That name is..."
"Tamara!"

chapters.title: Chapter 93: New Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 93 - New Mission
"Tamara..." Ebner was alarmed when he heard the name. Unlike the declining Abraham, although Tamara didn't appear much in the original novels, all signs indicated that this family still maintained a high-grade Beyonder characteristic passed down from their ancestors.
"Is there anything special about this name?" Xio's knowledge of mysticism was still lacking, and she didn't know much about the history of the Fourth Epoch, even if Ebner often gave her some information.
Upon hearing this, Ebner snapped to his senses and answered after some deliberation, "The Tamara family is an angel family that supported the Blood Emperor in the War of the Four Emperors. This family originally had the Arbiter pathway. Later, after a marriage alliance with the Abraham family, they obtained the Apprentice potion formula from them. And among the Spirit Knowledge Council we encountered, there should be a portion of the Tamara family members."
Xio didn't expect the Tamara family to be so powerful, and she was momentarily stunned. After a long while, she sighed and said, "I've formed a connection with the Demoness Sect again..."
Ebner also felt that it was a little strange that he kept encountering Demonesses. Could it be that he had chosen the "Tower" card in the Tarot Club, representing destruction and restartment, so he kept encountering Demonesses and hunters?
However, despite his random thoughts, Ebner still consoled Xio. "It might not necessarily be related to the Demoness Sect... According to what I know, the Tamara family has long been divided. The Arbiter faction and the Apprentice faction are opposing each other. If the lady who saved you is really a member of the Tamara family, then from the way she gave you the Interrogator formula, she should be from the Arbiter pathway."
Although Ebner can't remember the plot related to the outside god, he still remembers the relevant information about the Tamara family.
"Then... Is this the end of this incident?" Xio thought about it and asked expectantly. Neither Ancient Dragon nor that powerful lady is the existence she should provoke. Although Xio was a bit reckless, she didn't want to get involved in such a high-end layout at all.
"Since you have delivered Ancient Dragon Stuff', it should be over..." Ebner comforted her again, but his tone was a little unconfident. At the same time, he secretly decided in his heart that next time the Tarot meeting will forge a few more pages of Roselle's diary to give to the Fool, in exchange for his 'favor' to Xio.
After talking about Xio, Ebner talked about his own experience in the past few days. Except for the part involving the gods, he did not make any reservations. He told Xio everything to let her know that the follow-up of the incident has been from the Mother Earth Church. The "Forgotten" came to deal with it.
"What happened to you is much easier than mine..." Xio was relieved when she heard this.
Easy? That's not necessarily! Although I can't remember and there is no evidence, I think the blood color I saw during the "scene backtracking" should be more intense than the "white smoke".
Ebner was thinking about it, when he heard the opposite Xio speak a little embarrassedly:
"Can you lend me the Solomon Empire gold coin in your hand for a few days?"
"I...I want to change my Luck too!"
...
On Thursday morning, Ebner was about to go out to the bridge area to do an "investigation", but was stopped by Detective Isengard.
"Teacher, what do you want?" Ebner is a little strange. The teacher is helping the police station to find the fraudster these days. He often goes out early and returns late, so he is very busy.
Detective Isengard knocked his pipe and smiled and asked, "Tonight, there is an extraordinary party at the Brave Bar. Would you like to come?"
Yes, after leaving for more than a month, I almost forgot about the teacher organizing a beyonder gathering.
Ebner suddenly thought of the "Heart of the Elder Tree" that has not been found so far, he moved in his heart and nodded and said, "Teacher, I will go tonight."
Detective Isengard seemed to see through his mind. After smoking a mouthful of cigarettes, he smiled nonchalantly: "If you just want to try your luck at the party and buy the 'Heart of the Elder Tree', then you don't need to go. ."
"Is the meeting specifications not enough?" Ebner thought for a while and found that most of the transactions organized by the teacher only involved low-sequence items. In rare cases, medium-sequence items would flow out.
"That's only one aspect. The most important thing is that your teacher and I are also asking for the 'Heart of the Elder Tree'..." Detective Isengard glanced at his student. This kind of material involves promotion, if it is true He will not give way to the appearance of.
Ebner was speechless. Before he set off to Damir Island, he informed the teacher of one of the main talents of the "Polymath" he had analyzed. He originally thought he could easily get it with the teacher's contacts. Even if I can't buy it, I will find a way to find a teacher.
It's a pity that his thoughts are only his thoughts after all. Since this road is blocked, he feels that he really has to find a way to get in touch with the blood race. But don't worry too much, his "Knowledge Keeper" rules for acting have not been sorted out yet.
"So, do you want to come to the party?" Detective Isengard asked again.
Ebner thought for a while and felt that even if he couldn't buy the materials, he would sell some charms he made in his spare time. It would be good to return the funds, so he still said to Detective Isengard: "I'm going to participate, teacher."
After getting the answer, Detective Isengard did not delay anymore and hurried out to the police station.
On the other side, Ebner returned to his room and just packed his belongings, and was about to go out, when he heard the door knock.
Ebner frowned, opened the door, and saw the male servant standing respectfully outside. Suddenly guessing his intentions, he asked, "Kenny, is there a client?"
Kenny, the servant, nodded, and replied, "Here comes a gentleman who is about fifty years old, he is very well-dressed and looks like a servant of a great nobleman."
Noble servant? Came to see the teacher?
Although the teacher is not in the office, as the official student of Detective Isengard and already famous, since Ebner is there, he has to receive him, otherwise he will appear very rude.
Ebner put down the sorted charms and other extraordinary items, combed in the mirror, and then was led by Kenny to the living room.
What catches the eye is a gentleman with neatly combed light blonde hair. He is wearing a decent deacon's attire, with a few wrinkles hidden at the corners of his eyes and mouth. It is not too obvious, his complexion is healthy, and his temperament is masculine. The type of hunting and even fighting against the enemy.
Ebner pretended to greet the other party enthusiastically, and learned that the other party's name was Macy, and then went straight to the topic, asking: "Mr. Macy, I wonder if you have any entrustment for my a teacher?"
Mr. Macy smiled formulaically and said decently: "I heard that Detective Isengard is investigating a relatively serious criminal case. Time is very tight. The matter I want to entrust is not urgent, so I won't bother him... Mr. Bryan, although you are young, you have a great reputation. I believe that you can handle my entrustment well."
"You're flattering me..." Ebner felt a little hairy in his heart when he was praised. He felt that this person might have come to him, and he didn't know what it was.
Seeing that Ebner was still humble, without the arrogance of youth and ambition, Mr. Macy flashed a trace of satisfaction in his eyes, and finally said to the commission: "I would like to ask you to investigate Mr. Walter, the deacon and housekeeper of Viscount Conard. Including his hobbies, range of friends, family situation and character behavior...Although it is very cumbersome, the real employer is willing to pay a commission fee of 100 pounds for this."
Walter from Viscount Conard? This... Is this the housekeeper of the future rich man, Mr. Dwayne, right? Why should you investigate him?
A trace of surprise flashed in Ebner's eyes, and he lowered his head and thought for a while, and gradually got a thought:
I remember that Walter was in charge of taking care of the Viscount's children at Viscount Conard's house and got acquainted with Prince Edessak in the process, and he was appreciated by him...
Is this the person around the prince who is afraid of being replaced in the private investigation? Or was the butler in Viscount Conard's family who had conflicts with Walter wanting to find out about the black material?
Calmly glanced at Mr. Macy in front of him, Ebner preferred the former, after all, even the housekeeper of the Viscount would not be generous enough to pay 100 pounds if he wanted to check the black material.
"Do you have any specific requirements for the results of the investigation?" Ebner asked tentatively, in a very vague tone.
Macy smiled sincerely when he heard the words and said in a vague way: "You must be as detailed as possible, as truthful as possible, and as objective as possible. However, you can't just write the good side of the report, and consider the flaws. The Great Rosselle said, 'People will make mistakes.'"
"I see." Ebner nodded and decided to accept this order. In addition to 100 gold pounds is really a lot, he felt that it would not be a bad thing for Walter to stay away from Prince Edessak.
...
At the same time, Xio, who had just arrived in her own "jurisdiction", was stopped by a man in a black tuxedo outside a bar.
The man wore a golden mask on his face, exposing his eyes, nostrils, mouth and cheeks, making it impossible to imagine his original appearance.
The light brown eyes behind the golden mask turned, and the man smiled and said:
"I guess you don't know why I am looking for you."
His voice is deliberately dumb, but it is not extra special.
To his surprise, Xio did not show any expression of surprise and alertness. She raised her chest looked back at the masked man without losing weight, and asked: "Military Intelligence Department 9?"

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Prince
chapters.content:
Chapter 94 - Prince
After Ebner took Mr. Macy's commission, the man generously paid ten pounds in advance for the preliminary investigation and left his address.
However, for some special reasons, the other party didn't sign the contract and only made a verbal agreement.
After this gentleman, who appeared gentle on the surface, but was actually a little arrogant on the inside, left, Ebner put this assignment aside. He didn't want to waste time personally completing such a complicated investigation. It was better to learn how to transfer the Church of Storms mission to his Detective Zreal and outsource it to a cheaper detective.
Ebner pinched his chin and smiled. Then, he packed his Beyonder items and left.
To his surprise, he had just walked out of the block where the Stanton Detective Agency was located when he was politely stopped by a young gentleman.
Ebner sized him up and realized that he was a young man with curly brown hair like him. He was wearing a white shirt and a light yellow vest. The cufflinks, collar needles, badges, and other accessories were not eye-catching, but it was obvious that he had some family background.
"Detective Bryan, can I borrow your precious time?" The brown curly-haired man pointed at the cafe on the street and invited politely.
"Sir, I don't know you. If you want to carry out the commission, please go to the law firm first." Ebner did not agree immediately. Although this person was much more polite than Mr. Macy just now, there must be something troublesome if he stopped him so hastily.
"It's not a commission, Mr. Bryan. I want to talk to you about Walter." The brown-haired man seemed to recall something as he continued, "By the way, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Talim Dumont, and I'm an equestrian coach."
Was it also for Walter? Furthermore, Talim... Wasn't this the unlucky fellow who had died from Trissy's unconscious curse?
Ebner gave the man a pitying look, but it was hidden by the copper-framed glasses, and the man did not see it.
However, after hearing Talim report his origins, Ebner gave him a chance and followed him into the cafe on the street.
After asking the waiter for dessert and coffee, Talim said, "Detective Bryan, I know that Mr. Macy has entrusted you with investigating Walter. I hope you won't give the investigation results as he requested."
"Oh? Why?" Ebner asked. He could roughly guess who sent Talim to look for him. After all, he was just a declining aristocrat and equestrian coach. How could he know Macy's movements?
"First of all, Macy and the person behind him don't have a good character. Even if he promises you a very high reward, he might not fulfill it in the future."
"Secondly, Walter is truly an upright and trustworthy person. I don't ask for your investigations to be biased towards him. I just want it to be objective."
"Finally, this matter involves a major figure's resistance to the family's arrangements. If your investigation results are truly biased, it might be difficult to develop in Backlund..."
Talim sincerely said the words that he had prepared long ago. Not only did he slander his opponent, but he also gained moral sympathy. In the end, he even pointed out the danger that Ebner might encounter after the incident. It could be said that he was empathetic and moved with reason.
However, what Ebner was thinking was: I just want to cheat some funds and act along the way. Why are there so many problems?!
He shook his head. Although he did not want to deal with the so-called nobles' squabbles, he had just accepted the commission, and it was not appropriate for him to quit immediately. He could only casually ask, "If I do as you say, won't the people behind Macy also deal with me afterward?" Although he was not afraid of this.
"Don't worry. That big shot will help you block Macy and the people behind him. Before I came, he said that he can use his reputation to guarantee this matter," Talim replied with a smile.
Although the prince's character was passable, he was still a pawn in the other party's hands... What was the use of his promise?
Seeing that Ebner was silent and seemed to be moved, Talim took out a stack of documents from his bag and handed it over. He said, "This is the intelligence report of the royal family secretly investigating Walter... As long as your investigation results aren't too different from this, it's fine."
He emphasized the word "royal" to increase his persuasive power and the seriousness of the problem.
Even though Ebner had already guessed most of it, he still cooperated and exclaimed, "The royal family..." Then, he pretended to hesitate for a while and said hesitantly, "I'll accept this material, but out of professional ethics, I'll still investigate... It's just that it's too cumbersome, so it might take longer."
Talim thought for a moment and nodded. "Alright. This can also give the prince... a buffer time. Well, you can slowly investigate and submit the information. There's no hurry."
When Ebner heard this, he laughed in his heart. Since you've agreed, then let's drag it out on both sides. It's the end of July now. Once the December meteor falls, we won't have to investigate anymore...
Furthermore, it probably wouldn't take that long. Once 0-08 entered Backlund and began arranging the subsequent matters, Trissy would also become the prince's hirer. The people around the prince probably wouldn't have the time to bother with an ordinary Walter.
The two of them chatted for a while more before Talim bade farewell and left. As for Ebner, he finished the dessert he had just ordered based on the principle that he would not waste it. Only then did he receive Walter's information into his bag.
But just as he picked up the stack of documents, he saw a few ten-pound notes fall out of the documents. Ebner was taken aback before he carefully flipped through them. Only then did he realize that there was a full 100 pounds in the stack of documents!
"What a generous prince! He's willing to sacrifice so much for the people around him. No wonder a normal person like Walter still wants to avenge him after he dies..."
Ebner sighed inwardly as he put away the 100 pounds. Unless he had no choice, he did not plan on spending the money. He planned on donating it to Walter when he planned to avenge the prince.
As for preventing the prince's death? That's very sorry. Ebner felt that he was unrelated to him. At most, he felt some pity. It was impossible for him to face a true god, several angels, and a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact for him.
...
Talim left the cafe and walked two streets before arriving beside a low-profile carriage. After getting permission, he opened the door and got in.
Sitting in the car was a young man who looked rather similar to the printed portrait on the banknotes. He also had a round face and a pair of long and narrow eyes. He was none other than the third prince of the Loen Kingdom, Earl Rustin, Edessak Augustus.
"Talim, my friend, tell me, has the newly promoted detective accepted it?" Prince Edessak asked with a smile.
"Your Highness, that detective is a smart person. The plan he gave is to delay Walter as much as possible," Talim bowed and replied respectfully.
"Delay..." Prince Edessak thought for a moment and said with a smile, "He's indeed a smart person. Even with so little information and clues, he can roughly guess where the crux of this small battle lies."
"That's right. I almost didn't react when he mentioned delaying. The time is on your side, Prince. As long as they can't produce Walter's unfavorable materials in a short period of time, you can easily appoint him," Talim said with a smile.
"But why would they send Macy to find such a young detective who has just become famous? Isn't it very suspicious?" Prince Edessak's mind raced as he asked.
Talim was momentarily at a loss for words. He hesitantly replied, "Perhaps it's because this detective is both inconspicuous and capable?"
"I think they want me to think so..." Prince Edessak sighed.
"You mean that the request that Maxi gave this Detective Bryan was just a smokescreen? A bait?" Talim reacted and asked in surprise.
"I'm afraid that's the case... Recently, the control over my life has become more excessive. Previously, they only forced me to pursue Earl Hall's daughter, but now, they've even begun interfering with who I want to use. I definitely can't let them succeed this time," Prince Edessak said with a gloomy expression.
"Miss Audrey is the most dazzling gem in Backlund. It's said that she has a very gentle personality. You should be very happy to pursue such a lady," Talim teased when he saw the heavy atmosphere.
Prince Edessak regained his composure and controlled his emotions. He smiled and said, "But she's not my type."
Right at this moment, the carriage suddenly swayed as if it had been struck by something.
Prince Edessak frowned and asked, "What happened?"
"Your Highness, it was a girl who was chased here and knocked into the carriage... There seems to be something wrong with her," the warden outside the carriage quickly answered.
"Girl? What's wrong?" the prince asked curiously.
"She seems to have been drugged... the one chasing hseems to be an officer. However, after seeing the badge on the horse carriage, that person retreated on his own," the deacon replied.
The prince glanced out of the window and was stunned. After a long while, he regained his senses and ordered, "It's a gentleman's virtue to save a girl in danger. Lu Fu, bring this lady back to the manor in the carriage at the back and ask a doctor to treat her."
"Yes, Your Highness."
...
After the prince's carriage and entourage disappeared down the street, a graceful figure jumped out from the mirror of a nearby house. She looked at the departing carriage and frowned. She said angrily,
"That trash let Lena escape?"

chapters.title: Chapter 95: The Prince and the Witch
chapters.content:
Chapter 95 - The Prince and the Witch
After Ebner came out of the cafe, he first went to the police station in Cherwood Borough and informed Sergeant Faxin that Dr. Leonardo was involved in a Beyonder incident that had been handed over to professionals.
The sheriff frowned and looked worried. He was not worried about the doctor's safety, but his wife and the unborn child.
Fortunately, Ebner's visit had brought him a solution.
After hearing that an apothecary might be able to help him, Sergeant Faxin was overjoyed and thanked him profusely.
Ebner hesitated for a moment before exhorting, "It's just that... that apothecary's words don't sound good... You have to be more forgiving." Don't catch him in a fit of anger.
"Not nice?" Sergeant Faxin asked curiously.
"You should know how Aetris usually talks to people, right? This apothecary is twice as much as he is!" Ebner commented, unable to bear to look back.
Hearing this, Sergeant Faxin was so shocked that he opened his mouth. How could he not know his son's character? Every word of his could drive him to his grave... Now, this apothecary sounded even more outrageous than his son... Would it be dangerous for Martha to go there for treatment?
However, the sheriff had no other choice. After thanking Ebner again for his reminder, he also gave him a pass with a handwritten letter. With the pass, he could access the files of the Cherwood Borough police department that were not confidential, and he could also use the police department's underground shooting range for free.
Ebner was rather happy about this. After bidding farewell to the sheriff, he went straight to the police department's archive room to look up information.
From the various dossiers, the security in Cherwood Borough was much better than in the bridge area. They were all regular cases.
Ebner watched all morning and found that there was only one thing that was slightly worthy of his attention:
The Grant clothing store had been bought by a company in the factory district and was undergoing renovation. Many workers were digging deep into the foundation of the store. The noise was loud and disturbed the neighbors around them, so they called the police.
This seemed like a normal event, but Ebner had a feeling something was wrong.
It was not like he had never been to the Grant family's clothing store before. It was already a three-story building. Even if it was renovated, there was no need to dig deep into the foundation unless they wanted to build a big building... However, building a tall building surrounded by one or two-story residences... was very difficult to approve.
After all, it was already very difficult to see the sun in Backlund. If the residential area was covered by tall buildings, wouldn't the nearby residents protest? Most of the people who lived in Cherwood Borough were middle-class, so they had quite a lot of power when united.
I'm afraid he's using construction as a cover. He wants to find something underground in the Grant family, right? This might be one of the reasons why the Grant family is valued by so many big shots... While Ebner was guessing, he was wondering if he should check it out after the party. However, he thought of another possibility.
"The aura of a demigod was triggered in Grant's clothing store last month, and Jane's whereabouts are unknown. Logically speaking, she should still be under the surveillance of the Church of Storms, right? In that case, the person who dug up the items was either sent by the Church of Storms or the Mandated Punishers were waiting for the results to come out before closing the net..."
At this thought, Ebner turned his attention to the name of the factory district company that had bought Grant's clothing store: Winston's Labor and Services Company.
Secretly checking on Grant's clothing store might be noticed by the Church of Storms, but secretly checking on this company shouldn't be a problem. After all, it was a labor and service company. From the name, he knew that there should be quite a number of customers and employees. Most of them had gang connections, making it difficult for them to be completely monitored... Furthermore, be it partners or competitors, they could secretly investigate its background. His actions weren't abrupt.
After some deliberation, Ebner felt that as long as he acted cautiously, there shouldn't be any danger. He secretly decided to get Xio to help him gather information about this company tomorrow. She had connections in East Borough, the dock area, and the factory district. It shouldn't be a problem for her to obtain some superficial information.
"I hope that this investigation will allow me to find some principles that the Knowledge Keeper plays... I also hope that there are no coveted secrets on Jane..."
...
"No!" Lina let out a shrill cry, awakening from her nightmare.
She looked confused at first, but then she remembered that she had been bluffing with the disgusting Lieutenant Belner after she had sensed that she had been drugged. She had been looking for an opportunity to escape.
In the end, she took advantage of the moment when the other party was so pleased with herself that she jumped out of the window and walked away. On the way, she bumped into a carriage... and she recognized the emblem on the carriage.
It was a vertical sword with a red crown on its handle.
"The 'Sword of Judgment' of the Augustus family. I was actually saved by a member of the royal family?" Lina thought back to the last scene she saw before she lost consciousness.
She got off the bed and looked around. Suddenly, she realized that this room was a little familiar, so she quickly walked to the French window and looked out.
She was greeted by the sight of a vast expanse of lawn and exquisite statues standing around the lawn. In the distance, there was a river that skirted around the hills that were covered in all types of vegetation and converged into a rather large man-made lake.
A gentle breeze blew across the water, sending ripples across the surface. It also brought back memories of Lina.
"Red Rose Manor..." She muttered to herself.
Right at this moment, there was a knock on the door. Recovering herself, Lina habitually said, "Please come in." Then, she saw a familiar figure walk in with the butler and guards.
"Edessak?" Lina looked at the young and energetic face and subconsciously asked.
Prince Edessak raised his brows when he heard that before nodding with a smile. "Ma'am, you do know me."
Lina looked at the prince with a troubled expression, unsure how to begin.
Prince Edessak was puzzled when he saw the strange expression on her face. However, after a moment of hesitation, he asked, "Ma'am, if I may be so bold as to ask, are you the illegitimate daughter of Earl Lorena?"
Then, seeing her eyes widen in surprise, he quickly explained, "Ma'am, don't misunderstand. I don't mean to dig into your identity. It's just that you look a lot like my old friend Leland. Even his two sisters look more like him."
"Leland mysteriously disappeared three years ago. I sent many people to search for him, but they couldn't find him... And Earl Lorena's attitude towards his disappearance was very strange, as if he didn't exist... So when I saw you previously, I felt that you might have clues about this matter, and perhaps I could use this to find my friend's whereabouts."
The prince spoke calmly, but the worry in his tone was genuine. Lina's body trembled as she listened. Hesitation, fear, struggle, hatred, and many other emotions appeared on her face. Finally, she sighed and seemed to be more relaxed.
She calmed herself down and looked at the prince who had been waiting for her. She said with mixed feelings, "Edessak... I didn't expect you to think about me and worry about me when my father and brother had already given up on me... Hehe, of course you think I look like Leland now... Because I'm Leland Lorena!"
Prince Edessak had seen the change in Lina's expression and thought that this girl would tell him some secrets regarding Earl Lorena. Who would have thought that he would hear such an even more explosive news?
He stared at Lina in shock for a long time before saying, "That's impossible... A doctor and a maid examined you before. You're a real girl!"
Lina smiled sadly and lowered her head. "That's because I drank the Assassin potion under my father's arrangements, and this potion Sequence is the pathway of a Demoness!" With that said, she began talking about the past that only she and the prince knew to gain his trust.
"Demoness... What do you mean?" Prince Edessak was even more shocked and said in disbelief.
"It's just as you think. This Sequence 7 is called Witch. It will make a person really become a woman." Lina turned her head, not wanting to see the contempt and disgust in her friend's eyes.
However, Prince Edessak didn't have any negative thoughts about Lina. He frowned and asked in puzzlement, "Why did Earl Lorena make you a Demoness?"
"I'm not too sure about the details... But you should be able to guess that Father is a Palace Earl and is absolutely loyal to the royal family. As for the Demoness, she's almost under the control of the Demoness Sect... I'm probably just a means for them to test each other before they come into contact with each other. Of course, it might also be a bargaining chip that involves some transactions." Lina walked to the window and looked at the picturesque scenery outside as she replied.
"I see..." Prince Edessak's pupils constricted when he heard that. He circled the room with a solemn expression before his brows gradually relaxed, as though he had figured something out.
However, the prince did not continue this sensitive and dangerous topic. Instead, he asked, "Woman... No, Leland, what happened to you today? Why were you drugged?"
This question made Lina feel a little embarrassed and angry. She said angrily, "What else could it be? My superior from Demoness Sect, a Demoness of Afflictions who has just advanced. She wants to give me to MI9's Lieutenant Berner... Although I can accept becoming a woman, I have no intention of doing that with a man!"
"MI9... From the looks of it, there's a portion of the military involved as well." Prince Edessak had just sighed when he suddenly thought of something. His expression changed as he anxiously said, "That lieutenant should've seen you get on my carriage, and you're also a Demoness... Leland, it's not safe for you to stay here. I'm afraid the military's Beyonders will come knocking soon!"
Lina also realized what was going on. As a former noble, she naturally knew that although the prince had a noble status, he had no autonomy in many matters. As such, her expression became determined. "I'll leave now!"
Prince Edessak thought for a moment and got his maid to bring a few clothes that weren't too eye-catching to Lina. He said, "I'll get someone to arrange for you to leave through the manor's secret passage. There's probably someone watching outside."
"Thank you... Edessak." Lina was very touched. She really didn't expect her former friend to treat her this way after knowing the truth.
"You're welcome, Leland. We used to be good friends!" Prince Edessak sighed when he said this. They were originally best friends, but what were they now? Her best friend?
After simply changing her clothes, Lina was about to leave under the lead of a servant when she suddenly turned her head and said seriously to Prince Edessak,
"Edessak, I'll give you a few pieces of advice before we leave."
"Firstly, all Witches have bloody hands. No matter how pure and cute they look, their hearts have long been corrupted."
"Secondly, the Demonesses of the Demoness Sect... Other than a few exceptions, they are all men before they become witches!"

chapters.title: Chapter 96: The Long Gone Beyonder Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 96 - The Long Gone Beyonder Gathering
At eight in the evening, Ebner wore a hooded coat and an iron mask as he entered the apartment where Detective Isengard usually organized gatherings.
As he arrived late, the room was already filled with people.
Ebner took a few glances and realized that Ma'am Poison Rose, Ma'am Artisan Proxy, Black Snake, and Spider were all present. There were also some unfamiliar people. At the very least, he hadn't seen them in the few gatherings he had attended before he left Backlund.
Detective Isengard, who was disguised as Eye of Wisdom, looked at the clock in the room. Seeing that it was about time, he smiled and said, "Everyone is here today. You can begin."
The moment he said that the Artisan representative stood up and said,
"I'm selling a Beyonder item. Its name is' Confession ', and it's a revolver. It can add frost and black flames to the bullets that are shot out. When it's not used normally, this revolver can still remain autonomous. The negative effect is that every time it's used, it will be cursed by it. The starting effect is very mild, and it's almost undetectable. However, if we don't hold a purification ritual, as we continue using this revolver, the curse will deepen, and eventually, it will accumulate until it's difficult to return."
"It can also be used for two years. It's priced at 550 pounds, or it can be exchanged for the Barbarian potion formula."
Confession? From the looks of it, it's a Demoness's confession, right? Just the thought of it is terrifying. Ebner mumbled inwardly before thinking, "This Artisan agent's items are almost all time-effective, which means that they aren't made with Beyonder characteristics or Beyonder ingredients. It's more like she has the means to provide many Beyonder aura ingredients before getting the Artisan to use these ingredients that contain Beyonder auras to create items."
"What's the effect of the curse? Look at the name of this gun. Could it be that it's cursing me to 'fall in love' with it?" Just as Ebner was letting his imagination run wild, a somewhat familiar voice sounded from not far away.
Ebner looked toward the sound and saw a chubby-faced man raising his hand.
From his tone... Darkwill? Did he manage to sneak into the teacher's gathering so quickly?
Due to the obvious characteristics, Ebner recognized the chubby Apothecary he had met yesterday at a glance. He didn't dare to take a second look, lest someone noticed that he knew him. He turned his attention back to the Artisan agent lady.
"You're right. The curse's effect is to make you more inseparable from this revolver. When the curse erupts, the cursed person will devote all his heart and soul to it, and he will drink a gun and commit suicide. If you use it frequently, I suggest that you do a purification every month. It's best if someone supervises you because it will affect your judgment and make you not want to purify at all." The lady confirmed the Apothecary's words.
"Ah? Really? I... I was just spouting nonsense." The Apothecary was dumbfounded.
"560 pounds."
"580 pounds."
"590 pounds!"
...
As this revolver was indeed powerful and could save on demon hunting bullets, there were many people who participated in the bidding. In the end, it was bought by Black Snake for 625 pounds.
Following that, there were people seeking to purchase items, and there were people selling information. Although there were requests and needs, there weren't many deals that could be made. Even Eye of Wisdom, who was disguised as a teacher, offered a premium of 500 pounds to purchase the Hearts of Elder Tree. No one answered. Clearly, at a gathering of this level, Sequence 6 materials were still too rare.
Soon, it was Black Snake's turn to buy the confession revolver. He said in a deep voice, "I have a request. Someone in the dock area is inciting the workers to go on strike. I need someone to finish off the five representatives of the workers without alerting the official Beyonders. For this, I'm willing to pay 100 pounds. Mr. Eye of Wisdom will bear witness."
Detective Isengard frowned. He didn't wish to witness a murder, but just as he was about to refuse, he heard someone ask.
"Are those five representatives Beyonders?"
"No, those are just five ordinary people." Black Snake shook his head.
"A hundred pounds for killing five ordinary people? Are you really not pulling my leg?" The man scoffed.
"Perhaps you have misunderstood something. The 'solution' I'm talking about isn't killing those five people, but making them change their minds' naturally '. If it's just killing them, can't I do it myself?" Black Snake replied, emphasizing on' nature '.
If that's all, there's no harm in witnessing it... Upon hearing this, Detective Isengard swallowed his rejection.
"If it's to make a few ordinary people change their minds, I can do it," said Madam Poison Rose, who was sitting in the corner.
Ebner also took the opportunity to look at the lady who had previously bought his Seer formula and sold a Clown Beyonder characteristic to his teacher. He realized that she was panting slightly as she spoke, as though she was very tired.
The teacher did mention before that she seemed to be injured... but after more than a week, she still hadn't recovered? This injury was probably not simple.
Ebner glanced at Poison Rose thoughtfully. Seeing that she had signed a contract with Black Snake under his teacher's notary, he felt that if he didn't have other matters to investigate, he would've definitely gone to the dock area to watch. And there were probably many Beyonders present who would have such thoughts.
Ma'am Poison Rose doesn't seem to be afraid at all. I wonder which pathway she is from and what Sequence she is.
After the matter with Black Snake, the Apothecary suspected to be Darkwill stood up. He opened his hood, revealing his face that wore an iron-black mask. However, the mask only covered the area above the bridge of his nose, allowing the fat on his cheeks to clearly appear as though it was trembling.
"I have four bottles of precious medicine to sell. Two of them can effectively stop bleeding and promote the healing of wounds. Believe me, this is better than going to the clinic for suturing surgery. It will be effective for six months." The Apothecary took out a few bottles filled with liquid and introduced them.
"The other two bottles will have an effective period of one and a half months. It will allow a man to regain the impulse he had when he was seventeen or eighteen years old and become a Beyonder in bed. Hehe, you know what I mean. Even if it exceeds the effective period, it will still produce an effect. However, it will expand from there to his entire body. The user will become abnormally violent, and his strength, speed, and agility will greatly increase. Uh, he will fall into weakness half an hour later."
After he finished speaking, the entire room fell into momentary silence. It was not until half a minute later that Madam Poison Rose said, "I want those two bottles of Healing Potion. Name a price."
"Don't you want these two bottles of Berserk Potion? If you buy them together, I'll give you a discount!" Apothecary asked with a smile.
"No! If you continue talking nonsense, I won't even buy those two bottles of Healing Potion." Lady Poison Rose snorted.
"Alright, alright. Twenty pounds a bottle," the Apothecary said helplessly.
Following that, after a few more deals, it was finally Ebner's turn. He took out three low-level charms, namely the Slumber Charm, the underwater breathing charm, and the Courage Charm. This gave him a total of 60 pounds.
Speaking of which, these three charms weren't made by praying to deities. Instead, they were made by praying to the "Unknown Lands" and praying to the Eye of Pure White for their powers. The difference was that doing so had almost no cost because there was no need to sacrifice the corresponding spiritual materials to please the deities.
Of course, the shortcomings were also very obvious. Firstly, the ability to bestow the charm had to be completely analyzed by the Eye of Pure White. Secondly, the power of the charm was also quite different from the charm made by praying to the corresponding deity. It could only be considered a low-level version. Among the abilities that Ebner had analyzed so far, the power of the skills from the Sun and Tyrant path was slightly reduced, while the rest were far inferior.
Finally, the higher the level of ability, the shorter the time it could be preserved after being bestowed with a charm. For example, a Sequence 6 Notary could only last for less than an hour. There was no way to sell it, so Ebner only sold three Sequence 9 charms. At the very least, they could last for about two months.
This time, he had only sold the charms to test the waters, but the result wasn't satisfactory for Ebner. Although he had sold them all, he could clearly sense that the Beyonders at the gathering despised the lack of effective time. If it weren't for the fact that someone was about to use them in the near future, he would probably have gone on a spree.
From the looks of it, I still have to sell charms made from prayers to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom in the short term...
...
Turn the sky, July 27.
Ebner met Xio again at his East Borough home, but the moment he saw her, he was shocked. Xio's face was pale, without any color!
"How did this happen?" Ebner asked, both surprised and concerned.
Xio handed over the gold coin from the Solomon Empire period and said with lingering fear, "Don't continuously use its' lucky 'effect! It only needs one drop of blood on the first day..."
"But the second day... was too scary!"

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 97 - Investigation
So that's how it is... Indeed, Sealed Artifacts have very strong side effects. Unless one can use Sefirah Castle to intimidate others like Klein, one shouldn't easily find loopholes.
Ebner looked at Xio's pale face. "How are you feeling?" he asked with concern. "I know an apothecary. If you not feeling well, maybe we can get him to concoct a medicine."
Xio waved her hand and said, "It's alright. I'll recover soon."
"Is it really alright?" Ebner was still a little worried. He secretly activated his Spirit Vision and looked at her Ether Body. He realized that the color that she represented health was very normal. She was just a little tired, so he felt relieved.
"It's really fine," Xio repeated with certainty before deliberately changing the topic. She mentioned how she had been stopped by MI9 and finally said,
"That person should be my father's former subordinate that Detective Stanton mentioned. I can sense that he has good intentions towards me."
"He invited you to join MI9 as a spy? Did you agree?" Ebner asked curiously.
"I haven't agreed yet... I want to hear your opinion. Yes, I've asked Fors as well. The suggestion she gave me is also to ask you." Xio looked at Ebner, her eyes filled with anticipation.
Ebner knew what she was looking forward to. The lady wanted to infer from his attitude whether joining MI9 would be helpful in investigating her father's case.
"You can join. The identity of MI9's secret agent will not only provide you with the opportunity to investigate the truth, but it's also the key to improving your strength. After all, acting in the Arbiter pathway requires official cooperation." Ebner thought for a moment before giving an affirmative answer.
"Alright, then I'll give that 'golden mask' an answer when I return today." Xio nodded, her tone somewhat excited. She felt that she was one step closer to being wronged by her father.
Seeing that she was happy, Ebner was also infected as a smile hung on his lips. Following that, he also mentioned his matters to Xio and asked her to help him gather some information regarding the "Winston's Labor and Services Company".
When Xio heard the company's name, she pondered for a moment and said, "What a coincidence... Yesterday, I received a request from a working family in the East Borough. Their eldest son mysteriously disappeared while working for that company, and his whereabouts are still unknown..."
"What is the background of this company? Did the client provide any concrete information?" Ebner frowned, raising the danger level of this company.
Xio shook her head and explained, "I don't know yet. This commission was handed to me by the middleman. I plan on personally making a trip to the client's house later."
"Then I'll go with you and join your first case as a Sheriff. Is that okay?" Ebner asked with a smile after some thought.
"I'm honored." Xio raised her eyebrows and answered bluntly.
...
On the steam locomotive heading to Backlund, a beautiful girl who looked to be about seventeen or eighteen years old returned to her seat with three cups of iced tea she had bought from the train attendant.
She casually distributed the extra iced sweet tea to her two companions and then tucked her long brown hair behind her head. She then complained, "Who said the north is colder? The weather is even hotter than Via."
Hearing this, a handsome man with black hair and red eyes sitting opposite her chuckled and said, "Judy, you have to know that the climate in the coastal cities is different from that of inland cities, and they feel completely different when they're hot."
"Cullen, I really envy your physique. That way, you won't have to worry about the summer heat." The girl named Judy took a sip of the sweet ice tea and smiled. "However, it's a rare and beautiful experience to have a cold drink in such a hot summer."
At that moment, a burly man who looked to be in his thirties and was more than two meters tall, sitting beside Cullen, opened his eyes. He glanced at the man and woman who had just spoken and reminded them, "Be careful when you speak in public. Besides, this is Loen. Try to stay alert."
Judy and Cullem looked at each other, nodded obediently, and whispered back, "Yes, Captain."
Only then did the tall captain reveal a smile. He nodded and asked, "How long until we reach Backlund?"
"The train is already past East Tucker County. It should arrive at six in the evening," Judy replied as she glanced at the time on the train door.
"Then let's take a nap first to recover our energy. Perhaps we'll be able to find that person tonight..." The team leader said vaguely, but he believed that his two team members could understand his meaning.
After listening to her, Judy finished the cold drink in her hand and then began to close her eyes to rest. Only the man named Cullen was left staring with his eyes wide open, bored, and on guard. After all, for him, the night was the time when he had the most energy, and there was no need for him to rest during the day.
...
In the afternoon, Ebner followed Xio to a bar called Machinery and Inferno at the intersection of East Borough and the factory district.
They were not here to meet the client, but to find a middleman called Williams.
As it was not yet the working hours of most factories and docks, there were not many people in the bar. Xio immediately saw the drunk young man she was looking for.
Ebner also looked over and saw that the person was in his twenties. His face was thin and long like a horse, his eyebrows were messy and fierce, but his facial features were relatively gentle.
Xio walked near the person and knocked hard on the table in front of him. She frowned and said,
"Williams, can't you quit drinking? Save up your money and marry a nice lady. There will be hot water, dishes, and warm greetings every day when you come home. You can share with her all the various things you've seen while she tells you about the trivial things that happened at home. There will also be cute children kissing your cheeks and playing around with you. Isn't such warmth good?"
Back then when she first arrived in Backlund, she was able to quickly establish herself in East Borough thanks to Williams's help. Therefore, she had always hoped that he would lead a better life.
"Warmth?" Williams was first taken aback, but when he saw that it was Xio, he scoffed. "That's built on the money I bring back. I've long seen through it. If I can bring home 20 soli a week, then I'm sure my family will be warm. It's what you described. But if it doesn't work, Lord, the screams and insults of women and children will drive me crazy!"
"My mother is a role model. Every time my old man comes home, he's always accompanied by beatings, scoldings, and quarrels. Since that's the case, I might as well exchange the soli and pennies I have on me for drinks. Here, no one cares how much I earn. Everyone drinks and chats. The atmosphere is very great. If you miss women, there are those cute street girls outside. They won't quarrel with you."
Xio's lips twitched as she said, "You really are an incurable believer of the Lord of Storms. One day, you will die from alcohol and some strange diseases."
"At least I've already enjoyed it," Williams replied without care. Then, he looked at Ebner beside Xio and asked in puzzlement, "How do I address you?"
"Ebner, a detective." Ebner nodded at him and continued. "We're here to ask you to show us the way to meet our client."
"Ebner? Oh, it's that kid who often eats breakfast with Xio. I've heard of him." Williams came to a realization when he heard that. Then, he revealed a teasing smile and said, "A detective and an arbitrator. This profession is very compatible!"
"Don't waste time, Williams," Xio said as she took out a five soli note and handed it to him. She said, "This is the introduction fee for you, as well as the alcohol."
"Xio, how can you be so generous? Isn't the introduction fee usually paid by the client?" Williams was somewhat surprised, but he didn't think too much about it. He took out a pen and paper from his pocket and quickly wrote an address before handing it to Xio. "This is the address of the Kelly family. She and her husband work at night, and they usually work after eight in the evening. It's perfect for you to go now."
Ebner looked at his pocket watch. It was already three o'clock, so he didn't linger at Williams's. He left the house and hurried to the address on the note.
None of the public carriages dared to enter East Borough because they were afraid of being robbed.
When the two of them followed the address on the note to the shabby apartment that Kelly's family had rented, they realized that a fight had just taken place.
The rolling baskets, torn clothes, and fresh blood on the wall all indicated that a group of uninvited guests had entered.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Chase
chapters.content:
Chapter 98 - Chase
Such a scene clearly indicated that something had happened to the client's family. Ebner and Xio looked at each other and tacitly split up.
Right now, the earlier they figured out the situation, the more likely they would be able to save him.
Xio took two or three steps to the door of a nearby house and forcefully knocked on the tightly shut door. She used her "dignity" to make most of the East Borough residents who didn't wish to get into trouble reluctantly narrate what they had seen and heard.
Ebner checked the clues and traces in the Kelly family's old apartment, extracting their auras before using his "Scene Retrack" ability to recreate the scene.
He saw eight strong men with Southern Continent characteristics aggressively barging into this old apartment. Behind them was a middle-aged man dressed in formal attire and wearing a top hat. As this person had the least aura left, his appearance was somewhat blurry.
Kelly's family didn't resist either. The client's husband and son were clearly trained in combat. They each picked up an iron rod and charged forward.
The two of them had quite a bit of strength, and their coordination was very meticulous. Their attacks were also extremely ruthless.
Although the eight strong men with Southern Continent features had the advantage in numbers, they could not take them down immediately.
However, at this moment, the middle-aged man who had been standing behind them seemed to be getting impatient.
After he tapped his cane on the ground, a look of horror appeared on Kelly's husband and son's faces, and they immediately swung their metal rods at each other, both of them falling to the ground with severe injuries.
The eight strong men took the opportunity to rush forward and tie up the father, son, and Kelly, who had been hiding in the house.
Finally, they pushed the family of three towards the south.
The scene ended there, but Ebner's expression was even more serious. According to the information he had obtained from his investigation, the man in formal attire leading the group was clearly a Beyonder.
However, what Beyonder powers did he use to make the father and son kill each other in an instant... an illusion or mental control ability?
Ebner thought for a moment before opening the Eye of Pure White to analyze the aura left behind by the middle-aged man in formal attire using Beyonder powers.
The last time, he had nearly faced a terrifying existence because of his "Backtrack." Ebner had actually been a little apprehensive about using the White Eye to analyze the Beyonder aura of unknown origins. But now that he thought about it, he couldn't be overly worried and stop eating because of a small probability event. After all, this was a "golden finger" that he could rely on. He still had to use it at critical moments.
The main body was the illusion power of a Swindler, and it was mixed with Provoke... It should've used a Beyonder item. It was no wonder that the father and son had killed each other so quickly. However, such an ability was very ineffective against me. Under the suppression of the high-level White Eye, similar mental and illusion powers were almost useless.
Just as Ebner had this thought, he saw Xio hurriedly return. He took the initiative to welcome her and shared the information he had learned. "There are a total of nine people. Leading them is a Beyonder. The Beyonder pathway is unknown for the time being, but they have a Beyonder item that can use illusions and provocation powers."
Xio nodded and said, "The residents nearby recognize the people who came to arrest Kelly's family. They should all belong to the Black Skeleton Gang and often come here to collect protection fees."
Black Skeleton Gang? Isn't this a gang formed by the Everlasting Society and the East Balam Reestablishment Club? I remember that Klein lit a match and sent them all to meet Death...
Wait a minute. The Everlasting Society seems to be a branch of the Numinous Episcopate. If they were behind the scenes, instigating Winston's Labor and Services Company to dig things out of Jane's house, it would make sense... After all, the Everlasting Society should also be a subordinate of the Artificial Death faction. They have a long-term mission of finding Death-related items.
As for the Grant family, they might be closely related to Death. Otherwise, they wouldn't have been valued by a demigod.
While Ebner was deep in thought, Xio continued, "They've only left for fifteen minutes. They're still in a hurry!"
Ebner could hear the determination in her voice. "Are you sure you want to rescue them immediately and not follow them to their lair?" he asked deliberately. "The latter might give us more clues."
Hearing Ebner's words, Xio seriously considered it for a moment before shaking her head and saying firmly, "I'm a Sheriff, and this is my jurisdiction. Saving people is the duty of a Sheriff."
Although I don't know the exact principles, I feel that a Sheriff should be played this way... Although this is mostly from Xio's heart.
Ebner thought so, but on the surface, he smiled and motioned for Xio to come closer. He grabbed his arm, then took out a charm and whispered a word of "Storm" in ancient Hermes.
Right on the heels of that, a strong gust of wind rose beneath his feet, quickly lifting him and Xio into the air as they flew towards the southern factory district.
This was the "flight" ability of a Sequence 6 Wind-blessed.
As Ebner was unable to simulate this level of skill, for the time being, he could only pray to the Unknown Lands and give the charm the ability to "fly" after the analysis of the White Eye. However, the effective period was only two hours.
This charm was just made by Ebner before he left in the afternoon. It would be useless in another ten minutes, so it was perfect for this purpose.
During Xio's time on Damir Island, she was often sent flying by Ebner's Sea Breeze Hat, so she skillfully grabbed his arm and flew into the air with him.
In order to avoid being seen and attracting the attention of the official Beyonders, Ebner activated the Eye of Pure White the moment he rose into the air, giving Xio and himself another "invisibility" ability. Although this ability was only a low-level version, it wouldn't lose its effect as long as they didn't make any big movements. It was barely enough to cover their bodies during flight.
As for where this power came from? Of course, it was from last night's Beyonder gathering. When the confession revolver was sent to his teacher for appraisal, his teacher had privately used 2-081 to secretly analyze it and learned the invisibility ability on the gun.
Since "2-081" had learned it, Ebner, who was analyzing it every night, naturally knew it too.
Returning to the present, Ebner and Xio only chased for less than five minutes before they saw the figures of the gang members of the Black Skeleton Gang and the Kelly family.
"I'll deal with the leading Beyonder. You come and rescue the hostage." After lowering the altitude, Ebner lowered his voice and said to Xio.
"Understood." Xio nodded slightly and held the triangular blade in her hand. After all, this was a city district. Even if she had become a secret agent of MI9, she had to pay attention to her influence.
A middle-aged man in a suit and a top hat was thinking about something while he looked back at the gangsters behind him.
However, his eyes suddenly focused as a shadow that did not belong to him appeared beneath the feet of one of the thugs. However, there was nothing above his head.
Not good! Although the middle-aged man's Sequence wasn't high, he had seen quite a number of Beyonder powers. He knew that an enemy was approaching, so he didn't hesitate to take out a pistol from his holster and shoot at the man above and below him.
But before he could do anything, he heard a word in ancient Hermes, "Crimson."
"A charm?" Before the middle-aged man could react, a deep and serene feeling instantly filled him. He tried his best not to fall asleep, but unfortunately, at that moment, he heard the sound of chanting again.
"Heh, an insomniac's sun! A melancholic star!
"The past." The past was flashing.
But its weak light was not hot at all.
Sadness was reflected in the light of the night sky.
It is clear but distant. It is brilliant, but it is so cold! "
The middle-aged man could no longer resist his sleepiness and soon fell into a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: The Other Side of the Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 99 - The Other Side of the Stage
Seeing that the middle-aged man was finally asleep, Ebner heaved a sigh of relief and appeared.
The power of the Midnight Poet's Slumber Poem was much weaker than the original version. Therefore, he had wasted an additional Slumber Charm as a supplement, allowing him to succeed in one strike.
However, he was still a Beyonder and could wake up at any moment...
With this thought in mind, Ebner took a few steps forward to the middle-aged man's side and caught his limp body, preventing him from waking up due to the pain. Then, he took out another charm and activated it, consolidating the effects of the coma.
After doing this, Ebner diverted a portion of his attention to Xio's side. Then, he realized that her battle had ended.
Those eight gangsters couldn't even take down two well-trained ordinary people, so how could they be a match for a Sheriff? Xio only relied on her agile skills to pass through the eight of them once before using the triangular pricks to slice through their skin.
As her triangular blade had been imbued with non-lethal potions that could make people lose their mobility, they were all sprawled on the ground, unable to even move a single step.
Seeing that Xio was already walking towards the Kelly family to remove their restraints, Ebner turned his attention back to the sleeping middle-aged man. He had to find out where the Beyonder items on him were.
Due to the previous scene of "backtracking," Ebner first cast his gaze on the cane, but after taking a closer look, he realized that it was just an ordinary ironwood cane. Apart from being a secondary weapon, it had no other effect.
Ebner was not disappointed. He followed the direction of the cane and soon found a strange gem ring on the man's finger.
It was strange because the gemstones embedded in the ring were actually made of two small pieces of red and black gemstones. In the middle, there was a metal hoop that was unknown. On the surface of the two pieces of gemstones were tiny but exquisite runes.
"This should be it." Ebner activated the Eye of Pure White and looked at the ring for a few seconds. He felt a little more confident. Then, he carefully removed the ring and placed it in the tin box he carried with him. Following that, he sealed it with his spirituality.
The current situation was not suitable for further analysis. He would wait until they reached a safe environment.
After putting away the tin box, Ebner looked at Xio on the other side. She had already done a simple interrogation of the gangsters.
Under Xio's "authority," these villains who usually wreaked havoc in East Borough honestly confessed their evil deeds. Unfortunately, this wasn't something they could ignore. She had no choice but to take the initiative to ask, "Why did you kidnap the Kelly family?"
"We don't know, miss. Morella called us."
"Yes, yes, it's all Morella. We're just thugs. Miss, please let us go..."
"Morella is the person lying there right now. He was the one who ordered us to do all the work! Miss, can you give me the antidote first? I don't think I'll have the strength to speak if this drags on."
Upon hearing Xio's question, a few thugs scrambled to answer, and everyone unanimously pushed the responsibility to the middle-aged man, Morella.
Their voices were very loud, and Ebner, who was not far away, naturally heard them. He cast his gaze at Xio, who nodded at him, indicating that these people were not lying.
Ebner thought to himself, The battle just now caused quite a stir. Although this path is remote, it's not like there are no witnesses... I have to move this Beyonder as soon as possible. I'll get Xio to hand the rest to the police.
Although the police station in East Borough was rather passive, they would at least send someone to investigate.
With this in mind, Ebner exchanged looks with Xio before dragging the unconscious middle-aged man to a hidden alley.
...
West Borough, Williams Street, in Lieutenant Berner's apartment.
Demoness Ray, with black hair like a waterfall and fair skin, was sitting leisurely on the sofa. She was holding a flower pot with an unknown species of flower inside. The flower was still in its skeletal state and had not bloomed.
Step, step, step...
With a series of footsteps, Lieutenant Berner appeared at the door of the room. He glanced at the Demoness, who had become much quieter since becoming a Sequence 5, and said,
"My subordinates at MI9 didn't find Lena. It's likely that Prince Edessak is protecting her."
"Due to the forceful search, I have already been solemnly complained by the prince. In addition, Viscount Learson's youngest son has been investigating my abuse of power. Even Viscount Stratford would find it difficult to resist... I have already been suspended."
When Ray heard his words, she sneered. "If you can't even look after a drugged girl, who can you blame?"
"Demoness, you have to know who's protecting you from being captured by the Church of Storms!" Lieutenant Berner flew into a rage out of humiliation and threatened, "If you dare speak to me like that again, do you believe that I'll take the initiative to expose you to His Excellency, the Spellsinger of Gods?"
Ray fiddled with the leaves of the flowers in the flower pot, then turned to Lieutenant Berner with a half-smile.
The latter looked at her confusedly at first, but soon his eyes widened and his expression gradually turned ferocious. Then, he could not help but cover his head and open his mouth to shout to vent his pain, but he could not make a single sound!
This continued for five to six seconds before Lieutenant Berner's expression eased a little. He immediately lay on the ground, large amounts of sweat dripping down his forehead, and the clothes on his back were completely soaked.
"How is it? Does it taste good?" Ray asked teasingly.
"You... I'm sure you didn't use your powers just now... What's going on?" Lieutenant Berner asked with a trembling voice.
"If you had bad thoughts about me, you would naturally suffer. Heh heh, you have to be glad that you didn't really want to harm me. Otherwise, it wouldn't have only hurt for a while," Ray said with a pitying expression.
"This is... a curse? When did you put a curse on me? I clearly hold a purification ritual every time after the deed is done." Lieutenant Berner seemed to have recovered some strength as he looked at the Demoness in disbelief.
"If you think it's a curse, then it is." Ray's lips curved into an inscrutable smile. Then she carried the pot of flowers to Lieutenant Berner, who was lying prone on the floor, and said condescendingly:
"I can't relax about Lina. She knows many of my secrets. I can't let her fall into the hands of another faction... If necessary, I can kill her."
"Yes..." Although Lieutenant Berner felt indignant, he really didn't want to experience that terrifying pain again. He could only listen to the Demoness's instructions.
Seeing that he seemed to finally give in, Ray nodded in satisfaction and asked again, "Also, did you get the fake news that someone I told to spread out in the bridge area suddenly mutated into a monster?"
"Such news is actually quite common. After all, there are many cases of Beyonders losing control. Basically, they can be dealt with by the officials. A piece of news that doesn't know if it's true or false can't garner much attention." Lieutenant Berner braced himself and explained because he had never thought of helping the Demoness before.
Ray glanced at him, and though he knew the man was making excuses, he approved of what he was saying. So he went to his desk, took a metal box from a drawer, and handed it to Lieutenant Berner. "This is the Reader's Beyonder characteristic. Send someone to take it to the bridge area or the south side of the Bridge to corrupt more ordinary people."
Lieutenant Berner took the box with a blank expression and couldn't help but ask, "What exactly do you want to do?"
Ray smiled at the question but didn't say anything. She continued to cuddle the flowerpot.
But at this moment, a thought flashed in Lieutenant Berner's mind. Combined with what the Demoness had asked him about previously, he said in disbelief, "You... Don't tell me you still have designs on the Mandated Punisher team's captain? You released this Beyonder characteristic to transfer the other members of the team away?"
"Hmph, don't ask what you shouldn't ask." Ray's expression changed and she snorted.
Then, she skipped the topic and asked, "Did the service company send her to the warehouse today?"
"The ones from today have been delivered... But there seems to be an oversight on their side, allowing a worker to discover some clues, so they had no choice but to silence them... However, that worker's family contacted Arbiter Xio Derecha from East Borough because of his son's disappearance." Berner had previously advocated investigating Xio's background due to the Demoness's request, so he was very familiar with this name.
"That fair young lady again? Heh, there's probably her little detective boyfriend as well... I couldn't be bothered to continue looking for them after they escaped Backlund the last time, but this time, they came to find trouble for me..." Ray sneered and muttered to himself. She asked, "Then what happened after that?"
"I don't know yet. There's a gang backing that service company. They'll probably handle it," Lieutenant Berner replied.
"Forget it. Since it's exposed to that little detective, with his teacher's help, I'm afraid it'll be difficult to hide it anymore... Let your people immediately cut ties with that company," Ray instructed after thinking for a moment.
"Directly clear the slate? Why don't you get rid of that Arbiter?" Bernat asked in puzzlement.
"That detective brat and his teacher are likely from the Church of Knowledge. If I rashly attack them, it might interfere with my plans... You don't have to worry about them for now. I'll settle the score in the future." Ray fiddled with the flower bud, and the coldness on her face immediately disappeared, returning to the charm of a demoness.
...
East Borough, in a safe house provided by Xio, Ebner unscrewed the lid of a small metal bottle. A slightly stimulating but uplifting smell immediately escaped from the bottle.
This was the Holy Night Powder concocted by Sleeping Flower, Dragon Blood Grass, Crimson Sandalwood, and mint. The reason why he took it out was to create a serene and holy ritual environment.
Yes, after learning from the testimony of the eight thugs that the still unconscious Morella was a complete villain, Ebner had planned on setting up a ritual to make him reveal some secrets through "mediumship."
Although Spirit Channeling was the specialty of a Sequence 7 Spirit Medium of the Death pathway, other pathways that were good at using ritualistic magic could also use rituals to "Spirit Channeling." Of course, the effects were definitely not as good as professional ones.
Although using the level of the White Eye to suppress the spirit of a living person without any protection would definitely damage the other party's psyche, who would pity a villain whose hands were full of blood?

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Psychic and Backtrack
chapters.content:
Chapter 100 - Psychic and Backtrack
To put it simply, mediumship was to use one's spirituality to intrude into the other party's spirituality world, then forcefully read the other party's memories or use other means to communicate with the other party's Body of Heart and Mind in a relatively gentle manner to obtain information.
To a professional Spirit Medium, they wouldn't lack the means to protect themselves and communicate in such a state. However, Beyonders from other pathways didn't have this convenience.
In the novel, Klein, due to the augmentation of Sefirah Castle, he could maintain his lucidity while in a mediumship state. Therefore, he often combined mediumship and dream divination to obtain information.
That inspired Ebner to try to develop another operation.
After using the level suppression of the White Eye to forcefully break through the spiritual resistance of the villain named Morey, most of the other party's mental world had already been exposed to Ebner.
Directly using spirituality to read memories might bring about danger due to mental corruption, but this mind world could also be used as a necessary clue and prerequisite for "Backtrack".
Therefore, after using the Eye of Pure White to quickly analyze and filter out the fragments of information he wanted, Ebner quickly exited the spirit channeling and used Scene Retrack. Immediately following that, scenes appeared before his eyes.
Morey picked up a bottle of black liquid, and after a long struggle in his heart, he finally drank it down. Then, his expression twisted, and the veins on his forehead popped out. It took him a while to recover.
