At that moment, a man with brown skin and short black curly hair who was clearly a Southern Continent native patted him on the shoulder and said with a smile, "Morey, congratulations on becoming a lawyer. In the future, I'll leave the company and the Loen officials to you."
The scene came to an abrupt stop as a new scene appeared.
In the dim room, a man with a low hat seemed to have the intention of exposing the lower half of his round face. He easily restrained Morey and smiled. "Morey, right? I need you to do something for me."
"What is it?" Morey knelt on the ground, not even daring to look into the other party's eyes. It was as if a terrifying thing would happen at a glance.
"I want you to incite the workers in the dock area to organize a strike. The bigger the matter, the better. It's best if there's a murder case and the officials take it seriously," the man said with a smile.
"But... but I don't have the ability," Morey said fearfully, afraid that the other party would not be satisfied with his answer.
The man took out a ring embedded with red and black gems and tossed it to him. "Take this. It will help you complete it. You'd better do your job well, or else..." At this point, a mocking smile appeared on his face.
At this moment, the scene changed again, and another scene slowly appeared.
In the office, an assistant reported to Morey, "Manager, we've confirmed that the item in the thief's hand is the relic of God! He told us that the relic came from the underground of Grant's clothing store. There might be a relic of God there."
"Grant... the family that was robbed and killed?" Morey asked after a moment of recollection.
"You have a good memory. Sir, it's that family." The assistant nodded.
Morey thought for a moment and said, "That's Cherwood Borough. It's not like East Borough or the dock area... How about this? We'll buy that clothing store directly and then excavate the ruins under the name of renovation."
The scene returned to the dim room. A thug nervously reported to Morey:
"Boss, the police have noticed us kidnapping homeless people and homeless people in the bridge area. They seem to have started an investigation."
"Idiots, can't you go somewhere else? If you keep working in the same area, of course you'll be investigated!" Morey rubbed his temples and cursed.
After being scolded, the thug didn't dare to speak for a long time. In the end, he mustered his courage and said, "Boss, there's one more thing. When we sent the person we kidnapped to that big client, a worker found something..."
At this moment, the scene suddenly changed and they arrived at a large warehouse.
Morey used his foot to step on a young man who was sprawled on the ground, his life or death unknown. He asked the thugs around him, "Is this the kid who discovered the company's secret?"
"Yes, Boss Morey. This kid's father is a veteran, so he learned some reconnaissance skills. If he hadn't tried to rescue a kidnapped girl, he wouldn't have been exposed," one of the thugs replied nervously.
"They're all trash!" Morey cursed and stomped on the young man a few more times before asking, "Who knows how long he's been discovered? Did he reveal anything?"
"He probably discovered it the day before yesterday when he came here with the cargo box. In addition, this batch of workers hasn't gone on leave yet. They have been under the company's surveillance... However, he seems to have asked someone to bring a letter to his family. Although our people have checked the contents of the letter, we don't know if he wrote any secret messages. Also, his family is asking someone to contact the bounty hunters in East Borough," an assistant from the company walked over and answered.
Morey's expression darkened as he thought for a moment before instructing, "Get a few people to come with me to this brat's house for a checkup. Our client has a powerful background, and he's paid a lot of money for the goods. We can't let this pest ruin the company's business."
At this moment, the screen suddenly zoomed out, revealing the entire warehouse. It was a terrace factory near the train exhaust chimney, and further away, one could faintly see a river flowing past.
...
When it was all over, Ebner shot a glance at Morey, whose face was pale from having been forced into his mind. Without hesitation, he plunged a knife into his heart and ended his sinful life.
Earlier, because it was only a confession from the thugs, Ebner hadn't made a move. However, through spirit channeling and retracing his actions, he had already deeply recognized what kind of a villain this gentleman-like gentleman was. Therefore, killing him didn't bring any discomfort to Ebner. Instead, it gave him a sense of satisfaction to vent his hatred.
Following that, while waiting for the Beyonder characteristic to appear, Ebner also seriously considered the scenes he had seen previously.
This Morey is actually a "lawyer"? That's right. Without Beyonders of similar pathways, companies like them with the background of gangs and mysterious organizations wouldn't be able to start their businesses so easily...
The second scene should be the origins of the gemstone ring... However, that strange man only requested for the workers to represent the organization to go on strike and gave him a precious Beyonder item?
By the way, at the teacher's gathering previously, Black Snake was looking for someone to reverse the idea of the workers representing the strike... And I remember that Black Snake was likely a member of the Aurora Order...
With this in mind, Ebner was almost certain of the true identity of the man with the contradictory behavior.
So it was Lanevus who was up to no good... He probably hadn't been monitored too strictly by the Aurora Order, which was why he had taken the opportunity to threaten Morey. Heh heh, it looked like he hadn't realized that he was transforming into that existence and was mentally affected. Otherwise, with his intelligence as a great swindler, he wouldn't have used such inferior means.
Ebner shook his head. He didn't want to get involved in Lanevus's messy affairs, nor did he want to report him. After all, the swindler had wanted to help him escape with the help of the officials. Wouldn't it be better to report him?
Without Mr. Fool's interference, he might really be able to slip away under the eyes of the officials. It would not be easy to find him then.
For Ebner, because of his original identity, he really liked Klein's role and was willing to help him as much as possible. However, in this real world, the help he could provide to Klein was limited to providing him with information on Sefirah Castle or providing him with aid on certain items in the future.
As for risking his life against other Beyonders for the sake of the protagonist? That was not within Ebner's consideration.
Putting aside these jumbled thoughts, Ebner continued to examine the retrospective images he had seen.
There was a Death Ruin beneath the Grant family? What a joke. Back then, when the aura of a demigod erupted, the Spellsinger of God had personally descended. If there were really some Mandated Punishers, would they not know? Would thieves steal important things from below?
Heh heh, I wonder which organization is scheming to harm the Eternal Life Society and the East Balam Reestablishment Association. The latter doesn't know that Grant's clothing store is being monitored by the Church of Storms. They are walking into a trap.
So, why did the person or organization behind this do this? Did they have a feud with the Eternal Life Society? Did they deliberately find something to attract the attention of the Mandated Punishers? Or was there some deeper conspiracy?
Due to the lack of information, Ebner could not guess what the person behind it wanted to do. He could only temporarily ignore it and continue analyzing the subsequent scenes.
The homeless disappearance case I saw in the dossier of the bridge police station was also done by this group of people... Furthermore, they have a huge client buying these people... Is it the Aurora Order, the Demoness Sect, or the Loen military?
Ebner thought to himself as he tapped his fingers on the table. After a while, he stopped and decided to find the location of the warehouse and report it to the authorities.
This wasn't only because he wanted to act as a detective, but also because he wanted to take revenge for those innocent people who had died tragically. Furthermore, his and Xio's actions today had already offended the Everlasting Society and the East Balam Reestablishment Association. If he didn't give them some trouble, wouldn't they be thinking about how to take revenge when they were free?
Although he wasn't afraid of the organization that Klein destroyed with a single match,
At this moment, Morey's Beyonder characteristic had been completely extracted. Ebner carefully stored the fist-like object into the metal box he carried with him and sealed it with his spirituality.
After doing all of this, there was a sudden knock on the door. There were two long and short intervals. This was the secret signal he had promised Xio.
Ebner checked the time first and saw that it was already past eight in the evening. He walked over to open the door and saw Xio standing at the door with the packed food.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: The Rule of Acting as a Knowledge Keeper
chapters.content:
Chapter 101 - The Rule of Acting as a Knowledge Keeper
After dealing with Morey's corpse, Ebner returned to the safe house. As he ate the food Xio had brought, he communicated with her about the information they had obtained after separating today.
"After I handed those gangsters to the police, I revealed my identity as MI9, so I didn't suffer any difficulties." Xio only gave the golden-masked man an answer at noon and became a secret agent under MI9. She never expected to use this identity in the afternoon.
"Those thugs weren't talking nonsense, were they?" Ebner asked.
Xio shook her head and said, "Those thugs are very experienced in dealing with the police. They know what to say and what not to say. Furthermore, they can tell that I seem to be related to the police department, so they only pushed the responsibility of kidnapping civilians onto the person named Morey, but they didn't mention a word about us capturing Morey."
"Hehe, they are indeed 'experienced'... However, this should also have something to do with Morey and them not being the same type of people." Ebner laughed.
"Not the same type of person?" Xio repeated in puzzlement before coming to a realization. "You mean... looks?"
"Yes, they should all be members of the East Balam Reestablishment Association. Almost all of them are from the Southern Continent. However, although Morey is also a mixed-blood, his looks are inclined towards Loen. That's why he was chosen as the manager of a company in front of the station. He was also given the Lawyer potion by the Eternal Life Society because his looks make it easier for him to deal with Loenese," Ebner explained as he picked up the bacon with a piece of bread.
"East Balam Re Establishment Club? Eternal Life Society? What's that? Isn't this service company controlled by the Black Skeleton Gang?" Xio was somewhat puzzled as she asked directly.
"The Black Skeleton Gang is controlled by the East Balam Reestablishment Association. One can guess what this organization is based on its name. And the Eternal Life Society is a subsidiary of the Numinous Episcopate. It's a secret organization that has Beyonders. Many of the upper echelons of the East Balam Reestablishment Association have joined the Eternal Life Society to gather related items related to Death for the latter and send them back to the Southern Continent."
After Ebner said that, he finished the last piece of bread in two or three bites. Then, he recounted the results and inferences he had obtained from his spirit channeling. Apart from the related matters regarding Lanevus, he told Xio everything.
Xio nodded thoughtfully after hearing that. She was about to say something when she suddenly realized that Ebner was in a daze. Hence, she asked in puzzlement, "What's wrong?"
Ebner recovered himself at these words, and there was a look of delight on his face as he replied, "Nothing. I've just finally figured out the meaning of the Knowledge Keeper."
Xio also knew that Ebner had been summarizing the acting principles during this period of time, so she asked curiously, "What is it? How did you figure it out?" She didn't know if she could borrow the information, but she also wanted to digest the Sheriff as soon as possible.
"After I finished telling you my theory based on the results of the investigation, I felt that the Knowledge Keeper potion was finally showing signs of digestion..." When Ebner said this, he organized his words and continued,
"Back then, I was wondering why telling you these things would result in facilitating the digestion of the potion. Doesn't 'Knowledge Conservation' protect knowledge?"
Xio thought for a moment and realized that she had no clue. All she could do was ask seriously, "Yes, why?"
"It suddenly occurred to me that the best way to protect knowledge is not to hide it or keep it a secret. That way, the knowledge will be lost and cut off. The best way is to spread the knowledge to those who need to know and use it!" Ebner said excitedly.
Xio was infected by Ebner's emotions and also felt a little excited, but she suddenly thought of something and asked, "But you often did this before... Why are you only beginning to digest it now? Is it because you haven't accumulated enough?"
"I've considered that as well. I'm guessing that the so-called Knowledge Keeper should be 'Knowledge' before 'Guard.' In other words, there's a process of exploring knowledge before spreading the hard-earned 'knowledge' to the person who needs it. This is a true act. Yes, this also suits the job of a Detective. It's no wonder it has this nickname," Ebner explained with a smile.
"In other words... Most of the knowledge you previously spread wasn't obtained through your own exploration, but something you heard or read elsewhere?" Xio fell into deep thought as she had a new idea about her role as a Sheriff.
"Something like that..." Ebner replied vaguely. He guessed that the knowledge obtained through reading or learning should be considered the process of exploring knowledge. However, he wasn't in this world when he read many related knowledge. Or rather, although the knowledge he had previously told others was correct in this world, it was essentially knowledge obtained from another world.
As for why he said so much at the Tarot Club without any signs of digesting it? That was even simpler. Firstly, many of the things he said were still not something he had discovered by himself. Secondly, Origin Castle had a secret authority that even deities couldn't pry into. How could spreading knowledge there be considered spreading?
Next, the two discussed the acting method for a while before returning to the main topic.
"What happened to the Kelly family? Did they have any clues?" Ebner asked as he recalled the scene of the Kelly family's son writing a letter home.
"No, their family actually doesn't know anything... and those thugs are also insisting that they don't know where their son is."
Recalling the scene that Ebner had described, Xio knew that Kelly's son had probably been murdered, and she felt a little sad. However, she quickly adjusted herself and asked, "Ebner, can you describe the exact appearance of that warehouse in detail? I'll send an informant to find out its exact location tomorrow."
Ebner knew Xio's sense of justice was acting up again. He wanted revenge for Kelly's son, but that didn't sit well with his thoughts. "There's no need for all that trouble," he said with a smile. "I pray that the gods will paint the exterior of that factory."
...
South of the Bridge, Harvest Church.
As it was already very late, a girl with long brown hair and a blue dress politely knocked on the cathedral's door. Behind her was a two-meter-tall "giant" and a feminine-looking, red-haired man.
With heavy footsteps approaching, the door of the church opened, and Bishop Utravsky, who was 2.2 meters tall, appeared in front of them.
The brown-haired girl looked at the giant bishop in front of her and then turned back to look at her captain. She could not help but feel lucky that she was 1.6 meters tall.
However, the feminine man behind her, Cullen, seemed to have seen through her thoughts. He smiled and teased, "Judy, stop looking. When you advance to become a Druid, you can transform into a giant bear. You will definitely be taller and stronger than them!"
The girl named Judy shot a glance at the man and retorted, "I heard that vampires are all very elegant gentlemen. Why is there such an exception like you?"
"Alternative? At least I'm not obsessed with dolls," Cullen replied with a grin, not at all angry.
"A doll? What does that mean?" Judy asked, confused.
The Giant Captain could no longer stand it and interrupted, "Alright, be serious. Don't let the Bishop laugh at you."
Bishop Utravsky smiled warmly and said, "Welcome, Forsaken Ones. Unfortunately, this is Backlund. Although you have obtained the permission of the Church of Storms and the Church of Steam, i can't openly hold a banquet to welcome you."
"Bishop, you're too polite." The captain, who was also a Giant, waved his hand and continued, "We came here to complete the mission. We don't need those... Please tell us the details of the believer who went astray."
"I see. Then come into the church, all of you. We'll talk slowly."
"In addition, there's also a Blessed of the Mother Goddess who has personally experienced this matter... I think we should invite him over as well."

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Forsaken One
chapters.content:
Chapter 102 - Forsaken One
In Hillston Borough, Detective Isengard Stanton had finished a day of hard work and was reading Stormwind Mountain Villa, which he had borrowed from his students, for some leisure.
When he read that an evil spirit wearing a pair of copper-framed glasses had appeared, he couldn't help but smile. He had thoughts of befriending Miss Xio's friend.
But at that moment, his spirituality was suddenly stirred.
Detective Isengard frowned and put down the novel. As he wore 2-081 on his finger, he activated his Spirit Vision.
Following that, he saw a silver-white illusory bird drop a letter on the table in front of him.
This bird was only the size of a sparrow, and its walnut-sized head had a pair of red moon-like eyes embedded in it. The silver illusory feathers on its body made it appear extremely long and slender, not as bloated as a sparrow.
After putting down the letter, the bird tilted its head and surveyed its surroundings. Then, it flapped its wings in disappointment and disappeared into the void.
"Messenger? Whose?" The experienced Detective Isengard already knew what the spirit world creature was here for.
He pouted his mouth and did not pick up the envelope on the table rashly. Instead, he rubbed the gemstone on the surface of 2-081 and used it to analyze the envelope.
Moments later, Detective Isengard, who didn't discover any problems, carefully picked up the envelope. Then, he saw that the name of the recipient was written on it.
A letter to Ebner? How did it get to me?
Detective Isengard was somewhat puzzled. Typically, messengers could accurately find the recipient unless they didn't record the recipient's aura.
...
In the Harvest Church, Bishop Utravsky was telling the three Forsaken Ones about the ambush, the perfume incident, and Ebner's guess regarding the Demoness's advancement ritual.
At this moment, the black-haired, crimson-eyed Cullen's heart stirred, and he stretched out his palm. Immediately after, a small silver illusory bird landed on his fair and tender finger.
The bird shook its wings, then turned its tiny head toward Cullen and chirped.
Cullen listened for a moment before chuckling. He stroked its head lovingly and took out some powder ground from spiritual materials and fed it.
"What is it saying?" Judy, the brown-haired girl, asked curiously in a low voice.
"She's complaining that the recipient is very stingy and refuses to give the hard-working messenger any supper," Cullen explained with a smile as he translated for Birdie.
"I really envy you for directly taming a spirit world creature... I still don't dare to easily attempt the ritual of summoning a messenger." Judy clearly had a good relationship with Cullen and didn't hide her envy at all.
"Silika was not a creature of the spirit world from the very beginning. About 500 years ago, she turned into a specter in a crisis, and only then did she have the ability to travel through the spirit world." Cullen's gaze was deep as if he was recalling an unpleasant past.
However, he quickly snapped to his senses and said to the two "giants" who had finished their discussion and were casting their gazes over,
"That Mr. Ebner Bryan isn't at the detective agency at the moment. The letter has been handed over to his teacher."
The captain of the Giant nodded and said to his two team members, "Since Mr. Bryan won't be here for a while, we will investigate before dawn."
"Yes, Captain," the two team members answered in unison. Then, the more lively Judy asked worriedly, "Captain, where should we investigate first? We aren't familiar with Backlund at all... Will we really not get lost without a guide?"
Captain Giant carried a wooden chest that was much larger than a normal coffin. He first nodded at Bishop Utravsky before saying to Judy, "Since the heretic's perfume was first discovered at the home of that deviant believer, we'll first go there to check on the situation." With that said, he looked at Cullen, who was still teasing the silver-feathered bird and continued, "As for the guide, I remember that Cullen said that he had lived in Backlund for a long time. Let him lead the way."
Upon hearing this, Cullen, who was chatting with the little bird Silika, suddenly raised his head and said in surprise,
"Captain, are you serious? The last time I came to Backlund, Emperor Roselle had just invented the steam engine!"
...
At 11 pm, Ebner handed Xio the pictures of the factory he had drawn and arranged a time and place for their next meeting before dragging his exhausted body back to his teacher's office.
As soon as he entered the lobby on the first floor, Ebner found Detective Isengard sitting on the sofa reading a book.
Teacher is usually resting at this time... Is he waiting for me?
Ebner thought so and asked the same question.
Detective Isengard put down the book, picked up an envelope from the coffee table beside him, and handed it to him. "Here's a letter from you."
"A letter? Who sent it? Is it Jane?" Ebner guessed smoothly as he took the letter. He had almost no friends in the Outlands except Jane. Only Mr. Gaston, Miss Gwen, and Beatrice were more familiar with each other, but the chances of them writing to him were slim.
"I don't think so. This letter was sent by a messenger. That Miss Jian hasn't been a Beyonder for long, so she probably can't control a messenger," Detective Isengard said after lighting his pipe and taking a puff.
"Messenger?" Ebner's hand paused on the envelope.
"Don't worry. I've already checked. There aren't any traps or curses on this letter." Detective Isengard guessed his student's thoughts and smiled.
Ebner heaved a sigh of relief, but he still secretly opened the envelope after analyzing it with the Eye of Pure White.
The letter was in Bishop Utravsky's handwriting. The general content was to tell him that the Forsaken had arrived and to make a trip to the Harvest Church as soon as possible.
Ebner examined it a few times but did not find anything amiss. He decided to visit the Harvest Church the next morning.
When he looked up and saw his teacher's curious and probing gaze, Ebner thought for a moment and felt that there was nothing to hide. After all, he had previously told his teacher about sending a dangerous item to the Church of Earth Mother. Hence, he chose his words carefully and said,
"It's from Bishop Utravsky of the Harvest Church. He wishes for me to go over tomorrow."
Detective Isengard first nodded when he heard that before muttering to himself in puzzlement, "Since when did that giant bishop have the ability to summon a Messenger? People from the Warrior pathway shouldn't be good at this... Even Bishop Ural from the Planter pathway who worked before him doesn't have a Messenger."
Ebner was somewhat surprised when he heard that. He said in surprise, "Teacher, you even know the former bishop of the Church of Earth Mother in Backlund?" This makes a lot of friends. Apart from the Church of Storms, everyone else is your friend?
Detective Isengard smiled as he took a puff of his cigarette. His face was filled with pride as he said, "Of course I do. Otherwise, where do you think the healing powers in 2-081 came from?"
...
On Saturday morning, Ebner immediately took the subway to the Harvest Church on Blossom Street south of the Bridge after making a few short effects charms during the ceremony.
As soon as he stepped into the hall of the golden cathedral, he saw a girl in a blue dress complaining to the feminine man beside her in Feynapotter.
"Cullen, if it weren't for Silika leading the way last night, we would probably have lost our way to the Cathedral of Serenity and been imprisoned underground by the Nighthawks."
"That won't happen, Judy. Even without Silika, I... I can still divine..." Cullen replied in an unconfident tone.
Since Feynapotter and Loen were of the same origin and only differed in terms of individual words and grammar, Ebner could barely understand what they were saying.
However, in order to facilitate communication, he softly chanted Blue Star in ancient Hermes and activated the Language Proficiency charm he had just created.
Seeing Ebner enter, Bishop Utravsky, who had sparse eyebrows, light blue eyes, and a few obvious wrinkles, stood up and nodded at him with a smile. "Child, you came at the right time. The Forsaken have also just returned."
Just in time to come back... and combined with what the girl had just said, Ebner was sure they had gone out to investigate the night before, although the operation might not have been too successful...
"This is Mr. Ebner Bryan, a famous private detective. He was also the first to discover the evidence of Leonardo becoming a heretic." Bishop Utravsky first introduced Ebner to the three Forsaken Ones, then pointed to the girl who had just complained. He said to Ebner,
"This is Judy Loreto, a Sequence 6 Biologist."
Ebner was a little surprised when he heard that. He thought to himself, "Isn't the introduction usually just a name? Why does he even tell me the sequence? Does he trust me that much?"
On the other side, the brown-haired girl, Judy, saw that Ebner had a strange look on his face, but she misunderstood him. She was a natural friend, so she explained with a smile, "Are you frightened by the fact that I'm a Sequence 6 at such a young age? Actually, it's nothing. This is because my parents are saints of the Church. I was born a Sequence 7 Harvest Priest, and I only advanced to a Biologist after 18 years. I think it's very slow."
Speaking of her parents, she didn't seem to mind at all.
No, Ma'am, I'm not frightened by this. After all, with Klein being a demigod for a year, you can only be considered average.
While Ebner was grumbling in his heart, he exchanged a few words with Madam Judy. Then, he heard Bishop Utravsky point at a black-haired, red-eyed, handsome man beside Judy. "This is Cullen Tia, a Sanguine Viscount, a Sequence 5 Scarlet Scholar."
Sanguine... I wonder if he has any information about the Tree of Elders. I'll ask him when I'm familiar with it...
Having failed to find a suitable doll and had no excuse to come into contact with Emlyn, Ebner's heart stirred. He felt that he might be able to reach out to the Sanguine's treasure through this viscount... No, establish a friendly relationship with the Sanguine.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Official Act
chapters.content:
Chapter 103 - Official Act
"This is the captain of the Desolate Party, Sequence 5 Guardian Lech Arsenov," Bishop Utravsky said as he pointed at the tall figure who was praying piously in front of the mother's holy emblem.
Upon hearing that he was introduced, Captain Giant stood up and lowered his head to nod at Ebner. He smiled and said, "Nice to meet you, Mr. Bryan."
"It's an honor to meet you as well, Your Excellency Asenov." Ebner took off his hat and bowed. Since Bishop Utravsky addressed him as "Your Excellency," this person should be a high-ranking deacon of the Church of Earth Mother. His title in Nighthawks was probably equivalent to the Sword of the Goddess. The huge chest behind him might even be a holy relic that matched him.
Yes, a Sequence 5 Warrior pathway who had contracted a Holy Artifact. A Sanguine Viscount who had probably lived for hundreds of years and accumulated an unknown amount of mysticism knowledge. A Sequence 5 Scarlet Scholar. The son of two Saints, a Sequence 6 Biologist who had many good things on him...
The standard of this team is so high! Does the Church of Earth Mother think so highly of that corrupted believer?
Thinking of this, Ebner was somewhat speechless. It had to be known that when the Church of Evernight dealt with Lanevus, who had the True Creator's godhood, the lineup they sent out was probably inferior.
However, he quickly turned his gaze to Miss Judy Loreto. He felt that the reason why such a high-level team had come was probably because of the team that this young lady was in.
After all, she was the daughter of a church saint. It was reasonable for her to join a stronger team.
While Ebner was smiling and letting his imagination run wild, Giant Captain Arsenov asked, "Mr. Bryan, did you discover anything else in Leonardo's house? How did you determine that he might have become a Demoness' advancement ritual?"
Ebner thought for a moment and felt that it wasn't a secret, so he replied, "When I was 'recalling' the scene in his bedroom, I saw a woman who was suspected to be a Demoness making out with him. In addition, Bishop Utravsky is very familiar with the advancement ritual of the Demoness of Afflictions, so I had a guess."
"Is that so..." Captain Arsenov nodded slightly before looking at his team member, Cullen. The latter immediately understood. After a moment of silence, he asked Ebner, "Then, do you know where many people have gone missing in Backlund recently?"
"There are countless missing person cases in Backlund..." This was because the king was personally involved in the kidnapping of his own people.
Of course, Ebner didn't say the latter half of the sentence. He only asked in confusion, "Why are you asking about this?"
"Since that heretic became the Demoness's advancement ritual, he most likely won't be able to survive. And because of the corruption, he might very well mutate into a terrifying monster or Sealed Artifact." Before Viscount Cullen could speak, the brown-haired girl, Judy, spoke first.
"Furthermore, I'm guessing that the monsters produced by the mutation will definitely require a large amount of flesh and blood... However, the various Churches have yet to report this situation. This means that someone is secretly raising it! Yes, it's very likely that it's that Demoness." Following the girl's answer, Cullen added.
"I see. No wonder you're asking where there's been a missing population lately... Wait." At this point, Ebner suddenly remembered the psychic results he'd had on Morella last night. It was as if the service company had been trading populations with some important person.
Previously, he had subconsciously thought that this was also part of George III's apotheosis ritual or a smokescreen, but he had overlooked one point. Compared to other human trafficking, this transaction had only begun recently. Furthermore, it had begun very close to the time when Dr. Leonardo disappeared.
Seeing that Ebner was deep in thought, Captain Asenov asked gently, "Mr. Bryan, have you thought of any new clues?"
Ebner snapped to attention at that, organized his words, and recounted the results of last night's psychic and retroactively to the Forsaken present. In the end, he said, "I'm guessing that the human trafficking done by this company controlled by the Eternal life Society may have something to do with the Demoness. She seems to have seduced an officer and is fully capable of doing so."
Captain Arsenov closed his eyes in thought for a moment, then finally nodded, acknowledging Ebner's deduction. "Mr. Bryan," he asked, "could you take us to that warehouse to investigate? If it really is the Enchantress feeding on the contaminated monsters, something will surely remain there."
Ebner also did not know the location of the warehouse, so he replied, "My companions have already sent people to investigate the location of that warehouse. There should be news in a day or two."
Captain Arsenov frowned when he heard this reply. He suddenly asked, "Is the company controlled by the Eternal life Society in the dock area?"
"That's right." Ebner didn't understand what the other party meant, so he could only nod in agreement.
"Then there's no problem." Asenov heaved a sigh of relief and said to his team members, "Judy, Cullen, go with this Mr. Bryan... My size is not suitable for action during the day."
"Yes, Captain," the two replied briskly.
They wanted to arrest him and force him to confess...
It was only then that Ebner roughly guessed what the other party intended to do. He could not help but be dumbfounded by the actions of the official team.
"The dock area is the territory of the Lord of Storms and the God of Steam and Machinery. And before we entered Backlund, we reported it to these two Churches. As long as we don't cause too much of a commotion, the Mandated Punishers and the Machinery Hivemind won't interfere with our law enforcement." Seeing Ebner's surprise, Judy explained with a smile.
After hearing her words, Ebner had to admit that although this method was simple and crude, it was effective and efficient. However, it was limited to the government and some insane organizations that were not afraid of investigation.
The reason why he and Xio hadn't thought of doing so and even got someone to do the screening was because even if they infiltrated that company and captured the leader, it would be very difficult for them to silence the entire Everlasting Society, much less eliminate their memories. If they were to be exposed later, their act of invading a legitimate enterprise with Beyonder powers would be subject to the scrutiny of the official Beyonders. It wasn't worth it.
Furthermore, even if they were all silenced, it would probably be even more troublesome when the time came. The officials wouldn't let them off just because he and Xio were upholding justice.
As for why it was fine to kill Morey? That was because the other party had committed a crime first. To kill a hostage, Xio's identity as a secret agent of MI9 could be concealed.
...
The headquarters of Winston's Labor and Services Company located at the dock area was a three-story building. It didn't look obvious on the outside, but the interior was very well renovated. It wasn't much worse than some high-end clubs in Cherwood Borough.
Cullen glanced at the sign in front of the building, then pushed open the door and walked in unhurriedly.
Ebner, on the other hand, was stunned. He thought to himself, This is called infiltration? Is there such an arrogant infiltration?
However, before he could figure it out, he suddenly felt dizzy, as if he could faint at any moment.
Right at this time, he smelled an extremely stimulating smell again. Only then did he shiver and completely wake up. However, that stimulating smell still didn't dissipate, circling around his nose.
Ebner looked down subconsciously and saw Judy holding up a small bag of herbs to his nose, smiling at him.
"This is... Sleeping Potion?" Ebner shook his head and asked with a headache.
"Before Cullen became a Scarlet Scholar, he had been a Potion Professor for more than a hundred years. Who knows what kind of strange potion he developed? If I weren't a Biologist and also had the ability to concoct similar functional herbs, the two of us would probably have to sleep until he returns to wake up." Judy was extremely familiar with her companion's behavior, so she was already prepared.
If you didn't have a solution, I'm afraid he wouldn't have handled things so roughly...
Ebner was just grumbling to himself when he saw Cullen walkout, frowning.
"How's it going?" Judy asked worriedly when she saw that Callum didn't look well.
"That witch is very cautious. Not only did all the relevant personnel have their memories tampered with, but that warehouse has also been completely wiped out... The only good news is that the last batch of commoners kidnapped by this service company hasn't been transferred to the warehouse yet. They are still locked in the basement of the company." Cullen became serious for once. He felt that the opponent of this mission should not be simple, so after thinking for a while, he said to the brown-haired girl,
"Judy, contact the Machinery Hivemind and get them to help in the rescue. I have to return as soon as possible to talk to Captain about that Demoness. She's so cautious, but she's still staying in Backlund despite having mutated monsters. Clearly, she has bigger plans. As for the credit for finding these kidnappers..."
At this point, he cast his gaze at Ebner. The seriousness on his face was gone as he smiled and said, "I'll leave the credit to you, Detective Bryan! A young detective barging into a tiger's den alone, a brave hero rescuing many young girls... Isn't this a great title?"
Ah? This title was too "Roselle"!
Ebner, however, listened with an embarrassed expression, not knowing what to say.
...
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed. The headlines that Cullen had joked about had really been picked up by the major newspapers in Backlund. The Daily Observer had even taken out an entire page to report this legendary story. Now, people on the streets were either spurning the despicable and shameless Southern Continent citizens or praising Ebner's bravery and fearlessness.
This made Ebner not dare to leave the house for two days. He stayed at home analyzing his teacher's 2-081 until Miss Mid-Day came knocking on his door.
"You are now famous. Even Miss Audrey saw the report and even asked about you from Fors." Xio smiled.
Because Ebner had previously informed her that she did not need to continue searching for the warehouse, she knew the whole story on the day of the incident. She even knew that the so-called "heroic deed" was actually placed on Ebner by the Forsaken One.
"I've attracted enough hatred. In the future, not only that Demoness, but I'm afraid even the Numinous Episcopate will find trouble with me." At this point, Ebner glanced at the tree branch outside the window. There was a silver-feathered bird that was invisible to ordinary people.
Xio and Ebner chatted for a while before asking, "By the way, have you heard of Emperor Roselle ?"
Ebner froze at the question. He'd been about to forge a page for the afternoon Tarot Club but Xio had asked first.
"I do. Are you asking what Emperor Roselle wants to do?" Ebner asked calmly.
"Miss Audrey likes to collect Roselle's manuscripts. Let Fors and I take note... I'm asking if you have any here," Xio replied casually.
Is Audrey trying to buy a diary from Fors and Xio for Mr. Fool? This... This might be an opportunity. I can write a few notes for Xio in the future and let her earn some pocket money from Audrey.
And most importantly, some important information can't always be leaked from the "diary" in my hands. Giving some to Audrey would also make Klein accept it.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Testing "Sacrifice"
chapters.content:
Chapter 104 - Testing "Sacrifice"
In a row of houses at 2 Daffodil Street in Tingen City, Klein opened a thick envelope. Inside was a letter from Mr. Azik.
"The matter you asked me about the last time, I've recalled some things over the past few days. It seems to have left a deep impression on me. Perhaps, in one of my lives, or rather, in my earliest life, I often did such things."
"Although I said it last time, I have to remind you again. I warn you that you have to be careful when using this ritual. You can't entrust your safety to 'Their' consciences. 'They' don't have such things."
Mr. Azik had written it very vaguely. He didn't mention the words "sacrifice" at all... That's right. Although I don't know why this letter suddenly appeared in my room, it wouldn't be good if Melissa or someone else opened it privately and saw some words that shouldn't be seen. Even if most people couldn't understand Hermes.
With this in mind, Klein skipped over the things Mr. Azik emphasized and directly read the rest of the ritual.
"Firstly, the environment used for the sacrificial ritual is to engrave the corresponding symbols and use herbs and ores that belong to 'His' domain. Of course, it can also be used to make holy oil, ointment, incense, etc."
This part was similar to the information provided by Tower. It was part of pleasing the gods. Yes, it could be saved.
As for symbols, Klein already had an idea.
The "vertical eye" symbol that the puppet gave him when he was on duty at Chanis Gate should be the symbol of the upper echelons of the Antigonus family. It might even be the symbol of The Half-Fool that Tower mentioned.
And the symbol of The Fool that doesn't belong to this era is probably the complicated symbol behind the high-back chair at the end of the long bronze table. It's the complicated symbol formed from the Pupil-less Eye which represents concealment and the partial symbol of change, the Line of Distortion.
Or should I say, my symbol above the gray fog... The domain is very simple. Concealment, change, good luck... But I can't be sure. I can only try to do it... Yes, even if the symbol is wrong, under the premise that the honorific name is correct, the sacrificial target won't point to another existence. At most, it will cause the ritual to fail. I can be sure of this... Klein rubbed the surface of the paper thoughtfully as he came up with a plan.
His gaze regained its focus as he looked at the subsequent parts.
"Secondly, do it according to the normal ritual until you finish chanting the honorific name and prayer sentence."
"You have to remember that you have to use Jotun, Dragonese, Elvish, or ancient Hermes to communicate with the corresponding existence through the direct connection between them and the powers of nature. You can design the exact words yourself, but you have to have a few keywords—'pray', 'watch', 'offer', 'kingdom', 'door', 'open'."
The information provided by this part of the "Tower" was even more detailed. It even explained some of the principles, allowing me to modify it more easily... Did he think that I was an ancient god who had revived and might not understand modern sacrificial rituals, afraid that I would ask for blood like in ancient times, so he deliberately explained it so clearly?
As Klein guessed at Tower's thoughts, he continued reading the content below. It was also what he was most concerned about.
"Finally, use materials with spirituality and combine them with the vibrations caused by the incantation to create an initial passageway that connects to the corresponding door of the kingdom. If that person is interested, your ritual can be completed."
As expected, I still need materials with spirituality... I wonder if just reciting the incantation will allow me to open a sacrificial passage similar to the Door of Summoning. Will I be able to use some of the powers of the mysterious space above the gray fog... Yes, I'll give it a try first. If it doesn't work, I'll have to be extravagant... After all, the Tarot Club is in the afternoon. The Tower and The Hanged Man are definitely waiting for my results.
Klein put down the letter and quickly took action. He locked the wooden door, took out the silver ritual dagger, and sealed the entire room with a wall of spirituality. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and boarded the gray fog.
Although Tower and Mr. Azik had no reason to harm him, he had to first confirm that the ritual wasn't dangerous.
The grayish-white fog remained unchanged as the crimson illusory stars hung in the distance. Klein sat in the grand palace that resembled a giant's residence as he silently looked at the familiar scene before him.
After a few seconds, he retracted his gaze and made a yellowish-brown goatskin appear in front of him. Then, he picked up his pen and wrote down the incantation that had been changed according to the information provided by Tower.
"Light a candle to symbolize yourself."
"Use the wall of spirituality to create a holy environment;
"Recite the following incantations:
"Me!"
"I summon in my name:
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era, The Mysterious Ruler above the gray fog, The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
...
After carefully examining it three times, Klein wrote a divination statement at the bottom:
"It's dangerous to carry out these rituals outside."
Phew. He exhaled, put down the pen, and removed the silver chain from his sleeve. He held it with his left hand.
When the topaz pendant quietly floated above the goatskin and almost touched the divination statement, he reined in his thoughts and entered a state of Cogitation.
"It's dangerous to carry out these rituals outside."
"It's dangerous to carry out these rituals outside."
...
After reciting it seven times, Klein opened his nearly black eyes and saw the topaz pendant turning counterclockwise.
This meant that there was no danger!
"I can give it a try." Klein quickly made the item he conjured in front of him disappear. He extended his spirituality to envelop himself and simulate the feeling of plummeting.
After returning to his bedroom, Klein had already sealed the entire room with a wall of spirituality. He immediately cleaned his desk and erected the altar to pray to himself.
Taking two steps back, Klein looked at the candle that symbolized him and shouted in Jotun,
"Me!"
Following that, he switched to Hermes.
"I summon in my name:
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog, the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
Just as he finished his sentence, he immediately felt his spirituality being frantically extracted. However, he endured the discomfort and finished reciting the subsequent incantations.
However, when he finished reciting the incantation, the surroundings suddenly fell silent. Nothing happened.
I didn't summon anything... Ah right, perhaps I need to respond above the gray fog... It's really troublesome to summon myself... Klein pinched his aching forehead and muttered silently.
He slowed down for more than ten seconds before taking four steps counterclockwise. When he arrived above the gray fog again, he saw circular patterns of light at the end of the ancient long table.
This came from the strange symbol behind the corresponding high-back chair. It was a strange symbol formed by the Pupil-less Eye, which symbolized concealment, and the part that symbolizes change, the Line of Distortion.
Klein only made a gesture of reaching out his hand to touch it when he heard "I! I summon in my name", "The Fool that doesn't belong to this era", "The mysterious ruler above the gray fog" and other incantations. He saw the surging spirituality mixed with the rippling light patterns, forming an illusory, incomplete door.
The door wobbled as it tried to open. Klein immediately had an inspiration and gave a strong will to push it open.
Almost instantly, the boundless gray fog and the magnificent palace were drawn in, producing invisible ripples.
The ripples came one after another, surging towards the illusory and incomplete door.
However, no matter how Klein pushed, the door couldn't be opened. All the commotion eventually returned to silence.
Is it because the Door of Summoning hasn't fully formed? Klein retracted his thoughts and frowned as he analyzed the reason for his failure.
Yes, it's because my spirituality is lacking and I'm unable to construct a complete Door of Summoning... When I advance to Sequence 8 and become a Clown, I'll be able to pass the initial dangerous stage. I can give it another try. Perhaps there won't be any problems then... Klein nodded gently as he roughly understood what was going on.
However, he immediately revealed a bitter smile and muttered to himself, "This also means that I really have to use spiritual materials to support the oscillation before I can open the sacrificial channel..."
...
At noon, Ebner, who had sent Xio away, didn't have the mood to make up some storylines for Klein because he was also plagued by the news. He chose a page from Roselle's original diary that was easier to obtain and enlarged it in his mind, trying his best to think of it as a picture.
In fact, if it wasn't because he wanted to help Xio seek an opportunity to be "favored" by Mr. Fool, he didn't even think of giving Klein Roselle's diary this week.
After all, he had already reminded most of what he should have warned. If he gave too much and Mr. Fool could not give him equal returns, it would be difficult for him to do so.
"Actually, I'm quite looking forward to today's Tarot Club. This is because the original Tarot Club didn't have a specific description for this week or the next two weeks. All it did was say, 'I didn't obtain the diary' before it was revealed. I'm also curious about what happened during this period and wish to investigate."
"It's just that I don't know the contents of the gathering, so I can't prepare in advance. I hope my erudite Mr. Tower can maintain his character setting."
Finally, I wonder if Klein has finished studying the sacrificial ritual?
As Ebner outlined the text and thought about how to deal with the problems that might arise during the Tarot Club, time passed bit by bit. Soon, it was three in the afternoon.
...
Above the gray fog, in the majestic temple that resembled the residence of the Giant King.
Dark red bloomed on both sides of the long bronze table, and the three blurry figures' positions were unchanged from the previous time.
The tall, blonde Audrey instinctively looked up and saw a figure sitting backward in the thick gray fog. One of her hands was flat as she touched the edge of the table, while the other hand held her chin.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~!" Audrey shouted briskly.
Then, she turned her head and looked across her. She said in the same tone,
"Good afternoon, Mr. Hanged Man!"
"Good afternoon, Mr. Tower!"
Upon hearing her cheerful voice, Klein was also infected by her joy and happiness. The corners of his mouth curled up, and even the pain from experimenting with the sacrificial ritual with spiritual materials was relieved.
That was a spiritual material that he had managed to gather with the excuse of needing funds to develop the Psychology Alchemists informant...
However, it was still a success. This way, it could also make the "Tower" and even The Hanged Man behave a little and stop trying to test me, The Fool.
After returning the greeting with Miss Justice, Ebner sensed The Fool's gaze on him. He misunderstood and hurriedly said, "Honorable Mr. Fool, I brought another diary page."
I've also brought the diary again. Mr. Tower should have a powerful background, which is why he has such powerful information channels... No, you can't think of it that way. This is also because Mr. Tower is capable. As a lady, you can't belittle him just because you're jealous. Audrey, do your best. You have your own channels and abilities. You will definitely be able to obtain more Roselle diary pages in the future.
At first, Miss Justice revealed an envious expression, but she quickly adjusted it with her Spectator powers. She has filled with fighting spirit again.
On the other side, The Hanged Man fell silent for a moment before saying, "Sorry, Mr. Fool. I'm still at sea."
Klein nodded casually and leisurely took the diary that the Tower had conjured. However, he nearly laughed out loud after taking a glance at it.
"6th March. Damn, the food here is making me constipated!"
"17th March. Are all the wives of Intis so open? Did I sleep with her or did she sleep with me? It feels a little weird."

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Delivery Business Is Coming Online
chapters.content:
Chapter 105 - Delivery Business Is Coming Online
... It's indeed very romantic... Romantic constipation... This should be the diary of Emperor Roselle's early transmigration. There's no valuable information... Klein retracted his gaze and secretly clicked his tongue.
However, even if it's useless, as The Fool, I can't say it directly... I still have to ask Tower what he wants. I hope it won't be so difficult this time... No, it's fine if it's difficult, just don't waste gold pounds.
With this in mind, Klein waved his hand, dissipating the conjured pages. Then, he calmly asked Ebner,
"What do you want?"
That was what Ebner had been waiting for. He deliberated for a few seconds, then said,
"Mr. Fool, I've discovered a lady who's suitable for our Tarot Club. She's a Low-Sequence Beyonder and has quite a bit of power and resources in Backlund. Furthermore, she's sufficiently secretive and has a good character. Are you willing to let her join the gathering?"
He didn't mention that Xio might be noticed by the ancient dragons and valued by Tamara's High-Sequence Beyonders, so as to prevent Klein from being frightened into rejecting her.
However, his words revealed an important piece of information: Backlund.
So Mr. Tower also lives in Backlund. That's great. Could it be someone I know? This was what Miss Audrey was thinking.
Living in Backlund? No, it's also possible that he deliberately released fake news to mislead the public. Just because his friends are in Backlund doesn't mean that he's here! Alger thought repeatedly.
Only Klein didn't have many thoughts for the time being, because his request for the "tower" was somewhat difficult. He had previously imagined that the members of the Tarot Club wouldn't know each other. Then, they would develop a certain number of subordinates and form a relatively strict organizational structure...
Furthermore, the most important thing was that he was about to learn Jotun. He planned on pulling the praying person who was in a strange place into the gathering. And once he did that, he probably wouldn't have the strength to pull people into the gray fog before becoming a Clown.
In order to maintain his image, Klein didn't think too much and used a stalling method.
He said calmly,
"This requires a certain amount of examination."
"Mr. Tower, you used a concealed and undisguised method to let her know my name and be interested in it."
Upon hearing Klein's words, Ebner secretly heaved a sigh of relief. Even though he knew that Xio was stalling, it didn't matter. He had never planned on letting Xio enter the Tarot Club in one go. It was enough to obtain Klein's verbal permission.
As long as Xio recited The Fool's name, Klein wouldn't be unable to discover if there was a problem with her. And once he discovered it, with Klein's character, he would either resolve it directly or secretly remind me and ask me the source of the problem.
"Yes, Mr. Fool!" Ebner replied respectfully.
Seeing that he had finally dealt with Mr. Tower, Klein nodded in satisfaction. He surveyed the other two before leaning back and smiling. "You can begin your discussion."
At this moment, The Hanged Man stole a glance at Mr. Fool in the seat of honor. After some hesitation, he asked, "Do any of you know the formula for the Wind-blessed potion?"
As the acting method's effects were unexpectedly good, Alger felt that he could digest a Seafarer within a few months. Therefore, he planned on preparing for his next advancement.
However, he didn't have much hope. After all, Sequence 6 was already considered a Mid-Sequence Beyonder. The Wind-blessed formula was almost monopolized by the Church of Storms, and very few outsiders knew about it. He asked this to test Mr. Fool's reaction.
However, just as he finished speaking, he heard Tower laugh beside him. "I know what the main ingredient of the Wind-blessed is... But this isn't ordinary information. You should know its value."
Alger was stunned when he heard that. He looked at Ebner in shock as his evaluation of him increased once again. Furthermore, he was almost certain that he wasn't from the Church of Storms. If he was from the Church, how could he sell his own Sequence 6 formula?
I heard that the Church of Knowledge and the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun also have some potion formulas of the Sailor pathway... Tower is from one of these two factions?
Just as Alger was so shocked that he forgot to answer, Klein's heart stirred. He thought to himself, "Tower" really seems to know a little about everything... Besides, since he knows the Wind-blessed formula, does that mean that the subsequent potions from my pathway also know about it? What excuse should I use to ask?
However, just as he thought of this, he heard Mr. Hanged Man calmly say, "The complete formula of the Wind-blessed is worth less than 2,000 pounds, but due to the difficulty of obtaining it, it often has a very high premium... I can give you 2,000 pounds to exchange for the main ingredient information of the formula, but it will take a few weeks to gather it."
Upon hearing the price of 2,000 pounds, Mr. Fool immediately stopped his inquiry. He deeply felt that he wasn't even a Clown yet, so there was no need to consider the long term.
"I'd rather use it to exchange for the Tree of Elders Heart. It's about the same price. If there's a difference, I can make up for it," Ebner replied with a smile.
"I'll keep an eye out for you," Alger said solemnly.
At that moment, Audrey, who had been calmly watching the Spectator, couldn't help but interrupt. "Mr. Tower, do you know the Telepathist potion formula? I can buy it at a high price."
Previously, she had only thought of asking the Psychology Alchemists, but she never expected to learn of it from Mr. Tower. She couldn't help but feel vexed.
Ebner thought for a moment and felt that his performance in the formulas today was sufficient. If he could immediately produce any formulas, it wouldn't be "erudite" but a charlatan. Therefore, after some thought, he replied, "Miss Justice, I can help you ask. The next time, the Tarot Club will tell you the results."
In another week, Klein's delivery service might be open, right? Even if I were to tell you now, I can't immediately receive payment.
"Alright..." Audrey was a little disappointed when she heard that, but she quickly regained her composure. After all, Mr. Tower didn't finish his sentence, and he looked very confident.
Seeing that Miss Justice's question had ended, Alger turned his head to look at Tower beside him and suddenly asked, "If I obtain the Tree of Elders' Heart, how should I give it to you?"
Are you trying to test my background again? Are you trying to guess which faction I'm from based on my contact information? From the looks of it, he didn't completely believe me when I deliberately pointed out Backlund.
With regards to this, Ebner had long had a plan. He was just about to ask Mr. Fool about the previous "sacrifice" to change the topic, but before he could say a word, he heard the sound of someone knocking on the ancient long table.
Instantly, all three of them focused their gazes on Mr. Fool, who had retracted his finger. They were already used to this mysterious expert knocking on the table whenever he wanted to announce something.
"Ladies and gentlemen, are you willing to cooperate with me on this matter?"
Attempt? Audrey was excited as she nodded in a reserved and elegant manner.
"I'd be happy to cooperate."
As a Spectator, she clearly remembered that Mr. Fool had only used "attempts" on two matters. The first was when he pulled her and The Hanged Man into this mysterious space, and the second was when he gave an honorific name to make the two of them attempt to pray. And the results were sufficiently successful, revealing "His" true nature.
What kind of attempt will it be this time? Will it be related to Mr. Tower's request last week? I'm really looking forward to it! Audrey restrained her impatience and tried her best to be a qualified Spectator.
Attempt... Alger suddenly tensed up. Similarly, he recalled that Tower had requested The Fool for a sacrificial ritual last week, so he was very wary of The Fool's suggestion.
As for Ebner, he felt energized as he thought to himself, Is the delivery really coming online? Klein has just finished digesting the Seer, right? His spirituality can push open the Door of Summoning? By the way, the information I gave last week contained a lot of knowledge about using spirituality materials and incantations to help open passageways...
Wait a minute. Those supplementary spirituality ingredients don't seem to be cheap. Klein's weekly salary is only 4.5 pounds, right? With his cautiousness, it's impossible for him not to experiment... But can he really afford to experiment? Tsk tsk, could Mr. Fool have done something that can scare the believers crazy again...

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Sharing "Story"
chapters.content:
Chapter 106 - Sharing "Story"
Klein looked at the members of the Tarot Club who had different emotions under his Spirit Vision and smiled.
"This attempt will make your transaction simple and safe, and it will be sufficiently confidential."
He turned his head slightly to look at the Tower and said unhurriedly,
"Mr. Tower, last week, when you used Roselle's diary in exchange for reducing the negative effects of Sealed Artifacts, you asked me for a sacrifice, right?"
Klein had deliberately mentioned this matter to show his magnanimity, making it difficult for the members of the Tarot Club to realize that the sacrificial ritual he was about to attempt came from the information provided by the Tower. It was difficult for them to imagine that he didn't know anything about sacrificial offerings.
"Yes, Mr. Fool. I wish to send the Sealed Artifact to your divine kingdom through 'sacrifice,'" Ebner suppressed his excitement and answered honestly.
Klein followed his predetermined explanation and nodded slightly.
"I made some new attempts according to the current sacrificial ritual you gave me. This way, just receiving your Sealed Artifact as a 'sacrifice' would be a waste. Therefore, my idea is that each of you can sacrifice Beyonder ingredients or other items to me through the ritual. I'll then bestow them to the members you wish to trade with... Such a method is beneficial to all of you."
It can even be done this way? Audrey was instantly dumbfounded. She felt that this was beyond her imagination.
However, she quickly came to a realization. She understood the advantages of such a method and the hidden essence of a deity under the seemingly simple operation!
Mr. Fool is awesome! Our Tarot Club is indeed different from other secret organizations! We use the methods of deities to exchange for resources and materials! Audrey nearly habitually praised the Goddess in her heart, but after the lesson she learned at the last gathering, she finally changed it to praise Mr. Fool.
Alger became increasingly wary as he entered a state of calm contemplation.
"Honorable Mr. Fool, what do I need to do?"
He attempted to analyze The Fool's true goal from the sacrificial ritual.
Klein pressed lightly with his right hand and said,
"Don't worry. The ritual is very simple. It doesn't involve anything bloody or cruel."
With that said, Klein secretly glanced at Ebner. Seeing that he was unmoved, he couldn't help but sigh and say, "Good acting." Then, he continued,
"First, prepare an altar. It doesn't have to be too complicated and can be very simple. The only requirement is to engrave or draw this symbol."
As he spoke, a screen of light appeared in front of him. It was none other than the mysterious pattern formed by the Pupil-less Eye, which symbolized concealment, and the twisted thread that represented change. It was the pattern behind The Fool's high-back chair.
As The Hanged Man, Justice, and Tower attempted to memorize the symbol, Klein chuckled and said,
"If you forget, you can pray to me. Then, you can 'recall' it."
"Alright!" Audrey replied briskly.
With Mr. Fool, the rituals aren't tiring or troublesome anymore! She thought happily.
Seeing The Hanged Man nod, Klein continued describing,
"Secondly, do it according to the normal procedure, but there's no need to burn any additional herbs or smear it with holy oil. There's no need to choose a specific time. Just recite my name."
"Remember, recite it in ancient Hermes or Jotun, and use the following prayer phrases:
"Your loyal servant prays for your attention;
"I pray that you will accept his offerings."
"I beg you to open the door to the kingdom."
"After reciting, combine the vibration of the spiritual materials and the power of nature caused by the incantation and await my response."
At this point, Klein listed quite a number of materials for the ritual that Ebner had previously provided him. This wasn't the simplified material he had used during his experiments, but the original version in the information. After all, in his impression, whether it was Justice, The Hanged Man, or The Tower, they didn't lack the ten pounds.
Alger listened quietly and felt that his previous guess was very close to the truth.
The Fool is an ancient god, and "He" is in a certain predicament!
"He" gave an attempt that contained induction, an attempt that went deeper step by step. "He" wanted to use "Him," Justice, "and" Tower "to slowly break free. In the end," He "might descend into the real world!
This was also the true reason "He" had pulled people into this mysterious space and agreed to establish the Tarot Club!
Even without his previous guesses, Alger believed that he would come to the same conclusion after hearing that this simple sacrificial ritual could be compared to his previous attempts.
The only thing he didn't understand was that "Tower" seemed to have long known about The Fool's condition, but "He" had deliberately cooperated with "Him" to help "Him" escape from "His" predicament. What kind of benefits were there for a knowledgeable Beyonder like "Tower" to scheme against?
Could it be that Tower wants to use this opportunity to become Mr. Fool's Blessed?
There must be a secret that I'm still unaware of and have no way of guessing... Alger momentarily let his imagination run wild.
Upon hearing The Fool's recount of the various matters regarding the sacrificial ritual, Ebner, who had long planned on sending the "delivery" online, was the first to express his stance.
"After the gathering ends, I'll sacrifice the Clown Mask to you. In addition, I'll sacrifice two additional charms for Miss Justice and Mr. Hanged Man to attempt the bestowment ritual."
Giving away two charms just like that, how rich! Although Klein lampooned inwardly, he was very satisfied with the Tower's cooperation. Hence, he looked at Justice and The Hanged Man and thought for a moment.
"When Mr. Tower's sacrifice attempt succeeds, I'll tell you the bestowment ritual."
Upon hearing Mr. Fool's words, Justice and The Hanged Man reacted and immediately replied, "Alright, we will follow your instructions."
Audrey's lips curled up as she recalled the scene when she received the bestowment. Then, she recalled Mr. Tower's words and couldn't help but ask curiously, "Mr. Tower, what kind of charm did you sacrifice?"
Ebner chuckled when he heard that. Instead of answering, he asked, "Miss Justice, what kind of charm do you want?" As he could use the Eye of White to create low-level charms at a low cost, he had quite a number of charms in his possession. However, the effective time was too short. Only Sequence 9 charms could be preserved for a longer period of time.
"Can I've still choose?" Audrey was immediately interested. She wanted to ask what kind of gifts they had, but before she could speak, she suddenly changed her mind. She smiled and said, "Ma'am always looks forward to a surprise gift. There's no fun in knowing it ahead of time."
Choosing one of the many varieties is too cruel for me. I'll definitely think of buying them all... But that would be too disrespectful to Mr. Fool, Audrey thought to herself.
At that moment, Alger, who had been silent for a long time, suddenly said, "If it's convenient, can you give me a Courage charm?"
What the heck, he's still doing it? He's really taking advantage of every opportunity to probe me. Unfortunately, who said that people who aren't from the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun can't create Sun domain charms?
Ebner smiled to himself and nodded. "Sure."
Seeing that the topic of sacrifice and bestowment had come to an end, the Tarot Club also entered the segment of sharing information. Audrey thought for a moment and took the lead to say,
"A few days ago in Backlund, there was a large case of population kidnapping. A company secretly controlled by the East Balam Restoration Association abducted people in the dock area, East Borough, and the bridge area, killing them wantonly. Finally, this case was discovered and solved by a heroic and upright detective."
"According to my intelligence, the detective was involved in this case because the son of a family in East Borough had gone missing. He then sensed the company's problems, so he infiltrated the company alone and discovered a cell underground."
"Although the newspapers have been praising Mr. Detective for saving many beautiful girls from the dungeon, I know that it's just an exaggeration and interpretation of the newspapers. In fact, the detective was very calm. He wasn't discovered by the company's security. Instead, he carefully withdrew and found the Church of Steam. Only then did he remove the company and the gang behind it."
Klein had been experimenting with the sacrificial ritual for the past two days. He hadn't bought any newspapers from Backlund, so he didn't know about it. Now that he heard Miss Justice mention it, he agreed with the detective's bravery and rationality.
After Alger heard that, he asked thoughtfully, "They reported it to the Church of Steam, but they didn't report it to the police... That company has Beyonders backing it?"
Miss Justice was taken aback as she said, "I'm not too sure either..." Fors didn't mention if there were any Beyonders when she told me the inside story.
"That detective isn't an ordinary person either," Alger said with certainty. With that said, he looked at the Tower beside him, hoping to get some inside information on the matter from him.
However, at this moment, Mr. Tower was imitating Mr. Fool as he sat "mysteriously" in his seat. He didn't express any opinion on this matter and didn't seem interested.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Sacrifice and Bestowment
chapters.content:
Chapter 107 - Sacrifice and Bestowment
He never expected this matter to spread to the Tarot Club. Thankfully, they didn't know that Mr. Tower was that detective...
Ebner was filled with relief and prayed the subject would pass quickly.
Perhaps the gods had truly blessed him, Alger quickly mentioned something else.
"For some reason, Admiral of Blood has been pursuing Vice Admiral Dusk with all his might, eliminating two of the latter's fleets. A head-on clash between them is probably inevitable."
Admiral of Blood Senor had indeed had a baffling conflict with Vice Admiral Dusk. In the end, both sides suffered...
With this in mind, Ebner suddenly recalled that at Enmat Harbor, Xio had come back to tell him after attending Mr. Z's gathering. Mr. Z seemed to be selling an important secret of Vice Admiral Dusk... Could the conflict between Admiral of Blood and Vice Admiral Dusk be related to this?
Why would the Aurora Order start a fight between two pirate admirals?
However, Ebner didn't think for long before he gave up thinking about it. How could an ordinary person figure out the thoughts of an Aurora Order Oracle?
"In addition, Admiral of Stars 'Future' appeared in the south of the Rorsted Archipelago, but its whereabouts are unknown," Alger continued.
The Future... South of the Rorsted Archipelago... Will Jane be there? I wonder if Queen Mystic's mission is easy.
As Ebner was thinking, Audrey, who was listening with relish, blinked and asked curiously,
"Mr. Hanged Man, can you introduce Admiral of Blood, Vice Admiral Dusk, and Admiral of Stars in detail? I've only heard of their names and nicknames, but I'm not sure what Beyonder powers they have."
Alger looked around and saw that The Fool didn't stop him, nor did Tower have any intention of speaking. Only then did he nod slightly and say,
"No problem."
"Admiral of Stars Cattleya once followed Queen Mystic, but the two sides nearly fell out a long time ago. Regarding this matter, the rumors at sea are that she joined a secret organization and angered Queen Mystic. And according to the information I received, this secret organization is the Moses Ascetic Order."
"Vice Admiral Dusk Blatov Ivan spends most of his time in the North Sea. He only occasionally comes to the Rorsted Archipelago. He's a Beyonder of the Warrior pathway. Many people speculate that he has the Church of the God of Combat backing him."
"Admiral of Blood Senor has a mysterious background, and he's also suspected to be an evil spirit. He doesn't look like a living person. Furthermore, his pirate fleet is extremely ferocious. Once merchant ships encounter them, very few will survive, so there isn't much information."
"Thank you for sharing. I'm beginning to yearn for the sea," Audrey said in anticipation. "I wonder when I'll be able to truly travel."
"No, Miss Justice, this is definitely not as good as you imagine. From my point of view, this is a combination of blood, chaos, killing, desire, and fear." Alger calmly splashed cold water on her.
Ebner nodded slightly when he heard that. The fact that Vice Admiral Dusk had the background of the Church of the God of Combat matched his previous speculation.
At this moment, the three people present heard the sound of a table being gently knocked.
Klein, who was in the thick gray fog, concealed the fatigue caused by his lack of spirituality as he chuckled.
"Let the gathering end here."
"Your will is our will." Audrey immediately stood up, lifted her skirt, and bowed. Alger and Ebner also answered in a similar language.
Klein waved his hand and severed the connection. He quietly watched as Miss Justice and company's blurry figures dissipated.
...
In Detective Isengard's office, Ebner opened his eyes. He activated his Spirit Vision and looked at the tree outside the window, but he didn't see the little bird with only silver illusory feathers.
However, this was within Ebner's expectations. After a few days of observation, he had figured out the movements of the small bird.
It was probably a specter and could only move freely at night. It could barely maintain itself by hiding under the shade of the trees in the morning, but it would return to the spirit world at noon and only come out when the sunset.
After activating the Eye of Pure White and carefully checking to ensure that there were no other surveillance cameras, Ebner came to his desk and found a piece of paper and a pen. He leaned over and traced the complicated and mysterious symbol given by The Fool.
With the excellent memory of a Reader, Ebner quickly completed the first step of the sacrificial ritual.
Right on the heels of that, he pulled open a drawer and took out a candle. He set it up according to the Second Elemental Technique. One was placed on the symbol formed by the combination of the Pupil-less Eye and the Twisted Threads. The other was placed in the middle, indicating the person who was offering it.
Then, he took out the spiritual materials he had prepared and placed them around him.
After doing all of this, Ebner used his spirituality to light the two candles. He took a few steps back under the dim yellow light before chanting in ancient Hermes,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"You are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog;
"You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
"Your loyal servant prays for your attention;
"I pray that you will accept his offerings."
"I beg you to open the door to the kingdom."
...
The ancient incantation echoed within the wall of spirituality, stirring up a strong wind that stirred up the vibrations of natural forces.
It was the oldest sacrificial language created by human Beyonders. It contained many mysteries, but it lacked sufficient protection for the user.
The intense vibrations quickly swept the spiritual materials around it, turning them into a part of the whirlwind.
Wu!
The violent winds grew more violent, but they weren't ferocious any longer. They were respectively dyed silver, dark black, crimson red, orange yellow, and indigo blue.
As they constantly collided and fused, the different colors of the wind were thrown into the candle flame that symbolized The Fool. It expanded and tore open an illusory door of normal size. The symbol engraved on its surface was the one that Ebner had just drawn.
At that moment, Klein, who was above the gray fog, saw the hazy door that he had seen appear behind the high-back chair. He also felt the spirituality's power rippling out, stimulating the mysterious space.
It really succeeded... Klein suddenly had a premonition as he immediately spread out his spirituality and added shock and stimulation.
Clang!
Amidst the surreal sounds, the blurry door slowly opened!
Ebner, who was in his room, suddenly saw the illusory door made of wind and light open. Behind it was deep darkness, countless indescribable, nearly invisible shadows. They were bright lights that contained immense knowledge, a thick gray fog above them, and an ancient palace that overlooked the real world.
The delivery experiment was finally successful!
Ebner held back his excitement as he handed the Clown Mask and two brass charms that he had long prepared to the illusory door.
At this moment, he heard The Fool's deep voice ringing in his ears.
"Well done."
"It would be my pleasure," Ebner replied with a smirk.
He looked ahead again and saw that the illusory door had disappeared. The fierce wind had stopped, and the candle flame had returned to its original state.
...
In the magnificent palace above the gray fog, Klein was playing with the Clown Mask that Ebner had sacrificed.
Although he had yet to communicate with the Sealed Artifact, Klein could vaguely sense that the mask was trying to "please" him. This made him subconsciously smile.
Putting down the mask, Klein divined the effects of the two charms. After confirming that there was no danger, he shook his head and sighed. "Mr. Tower didn't give me any instructions on how to use them. I still have to make it up for him." With that said, he extended his spirituality and transmitted his thoughts to the two crimson stars that represented Miss Justice and Mr. Hanged Man.
...
Backlund. After Audrey returned from the gray fog, she was no longer able to sit quietly by the bed. She would occasionally flip through the book beside her pillow, and at other times, her gaze would be unfocused as she observed her reflection in her glasses.
