She was looking forward to the completion of the sacrificial ritual of the Tower, but she was also worried that the outcome of the attempt wasn't ideal.
After an unknown period of time, a thick gray fog suddenly appeared in front of her eyes. And deep in the gray fog, there was a high chair.
The Fool sat there and smiled.
"Miss Justice, the attempt has succeeded. Have you prepared the materials that contain spirituality?"
Great! As expected of Mr. Fool! Audrey held back her excitement and said,
"Yes, I've always had similar materials around me."
Even before joining the Tarot Club, Audrey was the same, but back then, she didn't know which ingredients were considered to have spirituality. All she did was carry them from her family's treasury according to the various smoked essential oil formulas she had collected.
Klein nodded slightly and said,
"When do you want to hold the ceremony?"
"The premise is to confirm that there are no Beyonders around."
Does a Beyonder dog count... Audrey looked guiltily at the closed door.
"I can do it now."
Klein tersely acknowledged.
"The ritual's process is the same as what I described previously. I just need to change the prayer sentence to:
"Your loyal servant prays for your attention;
"I pray that you will open the door to the kingdom."
"I pray for your power."
"In addition, use the binary ritual method."
Audrey recalled and resisted the urge to nod as she began preparing the ritual.
When the illusory door opened and the scene that was even more dreamy than the cosmos appeared, Audrey felt her body and heart intoxicated.
This is the mysterious world that I've always been pursuing. This is the feeling I've always wanted! She sincerely praised Mr. Fool.
Faith to the Goddess, worship Mr. Fool... Audrey silently defended herself.
Right on the heels of that, she was surprised to see an item appear on the altar. It was a beautiful brass card with complicated mysterious patterns engraved on it.
"A charm!" Audrey was delighted as her eyes lit up. She was about to take it from him.
However, her etiquette habit immediately restrained her. Audrey once again sincerely praised Mr. Fool.
After ending the ritual, she eagerly walked forward and carefully observed the brass charm several times.
Our Tarot Club is one level higher than all the secret organizations... Audrey secretly felt smug, but she immediately had a new question. How do I use this charm? What's the effect?
However, when she truly held the brass charm in her hand, she heard Mr. Fool's voice again.
"Activate the incantation, Fool. Recite it in ancient Hermes. Effect: You can freely traverse places with doors."

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Ball Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 108 - Ball Invitation
In the captain's cabin of the Blue Avenger, after the bestowment ritual ended, Alger looked at the additional brass charm on the altar and sat down with a complicated expression. He silently muttered to himself,
In the beginning, I could only pull people into the world above the gray fog... After a while, I can listen to prayers and respond... Now, I can receive sacrifices and bestowments... Mr. Fool is getting out of his predicament step by step and slowly delving deeper into the real world?
This guess made Alger feel afraid and worried, but at the same time, he felt a little relieved.
At least I'm a member of the Tarot Club, the earliest member... He sighed.
Perhaps... I should learn Tower's attitude towards The Fool?
...
In the magnificent palace above the gray fog, Klein sat at the end of the ancient long table. He used the method taught by Mr. Azik to gather the gray fog around the Clown mask before spreading his spirituality over to try communicating with it.
After a while, Klein retracted his spirituality with a strange expression and pondered.
"It's even smoother than I imagined... Not only did he agree not to interfere with the user's psyche, but he even shortened the time interval between changing his appearance to 20 days... And the condition is that he can only stay in the gray fog for a while a week? Perhaps Tower's judgment was right. This space is really the peak of the Clown mask pathway."
With this in mind, Klein suddenly felt quite interested in this plane. He had the idea of divining its origins. Therefore, he conjured a yellowish-brown goatskin parchment and a black fountain pen.
After some thought, he wrote the divination statement.
"The source of Clown Mask."
After reciting it seven times, he took the goatskin and clown mask, leaned back, and entered a dream.
In the gray illusory world, Klein saw a black dragon being surrounded by a dozen or so experts dressed in simple clothes that looked like savages. Soon, its head was beheaded by a red-haired man who led the group. The yellowish-brown tissue in its head was dug out.
This yellowish-brown blob constantly changed its appearance in the red-haired man's hands. At times, it was grayish-white and had wrinkles. At other times, it was dark brown and extremely smooth. At other times, there were two colors mixed together, forming a "face" without any facial features.
At this moment, an old man dressed as a wizard with colorful paint on his face put the dug-up tissue and a mask with strange patterns on it together. He then used a simple yet effective method to combine them into one.
When Klein saw this, the dream quickly faded away and he woke up.
"It looks like the creation of humans in an era of obscurity... How can this mask be preserved for so long? Hehe, but that might not be the case. It seems like the Southern Continent and some of the native tribes on the islands are still living like this."
What's that dragon? It seems to be much weaker than the legendary dragon... The organization in its head is a Beyonder ingredient? A main ingredient for potions? I wonder what Sequence it is...
...
At the detective agency in Hillston Borough, after Ebner held another bestowment ritual, he took back the clown mask that was much more honest. From Mr. Fool's description, he learned that he needed to board the gray fog once a week before continuing to be "honest."
The cost of sacrificing and receiving the bestowment ritual added up to more than 30 pounds. If he were to do it once a week... it would cost at least 120 pounds a month. That's quite a high cost... Thankfully, Klein would become a Clown in another month. When the time came, he could use his own strength to push open the summoning door, so there was no need to waste it.
As he calculated, Ebner tidied up the other materials for the ritual before removing the wall of spirituality and walking out of the room.
As soon as he stepped outside, he saw his teacher's footman, Kenny, approaching.
Upon seeing him, Ebner immediately said helplessly, "Are there reporters coming again?" Ever since he was labeled a hero by the Forsaken One, he had been harassed by various tabloid reporters. As for the reporters from the big newspapers? Of course, he was happy to be interviewed.
"Mr. Bryan, this is an invitation from your friend, Reporter Mike. He invited you to the ball held at the headquarters building of the Daily Observer on Friday night." Kenny respectfully handed over the invitation.
He originally respected Ebner only because he was Detective Isengard's student, but because of Ebner's fame, this respect had become real.
Reporter Mike? I still have to give him face... Yes, the Daily Observer is one of the best newspapers in Backlund. The standard of the ball isn't low. There should be quite a number of excellent clients participating, Ebner muttered to himself after receiving the invitation, committing the matter to memory.
After Kenny left, Ebner went to his office and reviewed the various materials that his teacher had previously collected.
How should I tell Xio The Fool's honorific name without exposing myself?
...
At night, Xio had just concluded a robbery. As the suspect wasn't at his wits' end, but rather wanted more money to buy cigarettes and alcohol before entering the house to rob, Xio judged that he had disturbed the order of her "jurisdiction" and was guilty. She also ordered the robber to repay the victim's family's losses within seven days, or he would be sent to MI9's black prison.
Of course, the last sentence was just a threat. MI9 did not have the time to care about such trivial matters. If the other party really refused to do it, they would probably try to persuade him through "physics".
After sending off the grateful victim's family, Xio walked to a nearby bar. An informant she had developed left her a message saying that he had an interesting discovery to tell her.
"Hey, Xio... you're just in time. Let's have a few drinks together." The drunk William grinned when he saw the girl coming toward him.
"Drinking isn't good." Xio first shook her head before looking at the drunkard in front of her. She asked seriously, "Why are you looking for me?"
Frightened by that authority, William's smile froze, and for a moment all that was left was the idea of nodding his head. He tried to recall it carefully with his alcohol-dazed brain before organizing his words.
"Old Thor seemed to have a stroke yesterday. He was in a daze and was found drowned in the Tussock River this morning!"
"The thief, Sanji, who was active on Disaster Street, seemed to have become an idiot the day before yesterday. He only knew how to giggle and eventually fell off the bridge and died."
"Aunt Tasso's eight-year-old granddaughter also suffered from hysteria the morning before yesterday. She kept talking nonsense, and many doctors failed to treat her. In the end, this afternoon, her granddaughter suddenly went crazy while she was away at work and stabbed herself with a pair of scissors."
...
William talked about seven or eight cases in one go, all of which were real tragedies or accidents that happened in East Borough in the past two or three days.
Xio didn't think much of it at first because there were too many similar incidents in East Borough that she couldn't manage. But when she heard the fourth similar case, she was certain that it wasn't an accident, so her expression turned solemn.
"These dead people... seem to be of all ages and genders..." Xio thought for a moment before asking William, "Do they have anything in common? What did the police report?"
Even if it was East Borough, with so many people dying for similar reasons, it was impossible for the police to not investigate.
"The police? The police only said that it was an accident caused by a sudden illness." William scoffed before looking around. Seeing that no one was paying attention to him, he whispered to Xio, "There's indeed something in common... That is, they are all believers of the Lord of Storms! Therefore, there are already rumors that the heretic cult believers cursed the believers in order to take revenge on the Lord of Storms."
With such an obvious target for the believers of the Lord of Storms, the Mandated Punishers should've already stepped in to investigate... The police's explanation is most likely just a perfunctory excuse to cover up the truth. Xio thought to herself.
After paying William 5 soli for the information, it was already late. Xio didn't delay any further as she returned to the apartment she shared with Fors in North Borough. She took the letter from the mailbox at the door before opening the door with her key.
The moment she entered, she saw her good friend in her morning clothes sitting on the sofa, stuffing snacks into her mouth while reading a magazine.
"Why are you like this every time I enter?" Xio held her forehead with her hand, looking helpless.
Come to think of it, he had learned this move from Ebner during his travels.
"Then it must be because you opened the door in the wrong way! On this point, an apprentice has more say than an arbitrator." Fors wiped the food residue from the corner of her mouth and argued.
"I can't out-talk you... But forget it. Although it's not a healthy habit, it's better than smoking and drinking." Xio shook her head and handed a huge stack of mail to Fors. She then said, "It should be from your readers. I just checked it with my powers, but I didn't find any dangerous items."
"Why do you think my readers will send me dangerous items?" Fors grumbled speechlessly after receiving the letter.
Xio didn't say a word as she silently looked at her.
Fors looked away guiltily before flipping through the email. She casually said, "By the way, I received an invitation at the literature salon today. It invited me to attend a ball on Friday night. I can bring a companion with me. Do you want to go?"
"Friday night... It's a ball held by the Daily Observer?" Xio asked in surprise.
"Yes... How did you know?" Fors was somewhat surprised when she heard that. Xio had never been interested in such activities.
"Due to the fact that there would be an important figure participating in the ball and giving a speech, I was arranged to have security work done at the ball by the Golden Mask."
...
West Borough, in a garden villa on Williams Street.
Ray was hugging a pot of flowers that had yet to bloom. She was sitting on the bed in her bedroom wearing only pajamas. Her fair and slender thighs were exposed, making Lieutenant Berner, who had made up his mind never to touch the Demoness again, unable to look away.
"In other words, His Highness, Prince Edessak, will personally attend the ball on Friday night? Heh heh, why would an important figure like him participate in such a ball?"
However, Lena seems to have received the protection of Prince Edessak. I wonder if she will be joining this ball... Yes, in that case, I should take a look.
"Berner, can you get an invitation?"

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Forsaken One’s Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 109 - Forsaken One's Request
On Tuesday morning, as the news of a lone hero charging into a tiger's den to save a life gradually died down and was replaced by some new and appalling news, Ebner finally left the law firm without being surrounded by tabloid reporters.
After arriving at the police station in the bridge district, there were quite a few police officers who greeted him when they saw him. This made Ebner feel a little overwhelmed, and he truly experienced the feeling of being a celebrity.
However, after he read through the latest case file at the police station, he no longer looked relaxed. From last Friday until today, in just two or three days, there were 16 deaths caused by sudden dementia or sudden stroke.
Furthermore, all the involved parties are believers of the Lord of Storms... Is someone provoking the Mandated Punishers?
While Ebner was thinking, there was a sudden knock on the door outside the file room. Shortly after, Sergeant Eli of the Bridge District Police Department walked in with an elderly gentleman who looked to be in his sixties or seventies.
"Detective Bryan, this is Inspector Reed from the 13th Unit of the Special Operations Division of the Police Department. He has something to ask you." Seeing Ebner stand up, Sergeant Eli introduced him with a smile.
Ebner stole a glance at the old man in front of him and saw that he had a high nose bridge, deep eye sockets, blue eyes, and a beard. His body was full of wrinkles as if he had not taken care of it for many days. He did not look like an inspector at all.
Furthermore, the Special Operations Department? This is the alias of the official Beyonder team, right? A Mandated Punisher or a Nighthawk?
Ebner was secretly on guard. On the surface, he shook Inspector Reed's hand warmly and said politely, "It is an honor to meet you, Inspector Reed."
"I'm also very happy to meet you, Mr. Hero of Backlund," Inspector Reed replied with a faint smile.
I'll take it as a provocation... Others might not know what's going on, but as an official Beyonder, they definitely obtained detailed information from the Forsaken Land. After all, they had to report their cross-border law enforcement to the Church of Storms and the Church of Steam.
After the two of them exchanged a few polite words, Reed stated his intentions. He wanted to look up the case files that had suddenly turned into dementia or insanity in the past few days.
Fortunately, he had just sorted out the information. Otherwise, it would be bad if his employer found out that he was being a salary thief. Ebner secretly rejoiced when he handed the case he had picked out to Inspector Reed.
Although this Reed didn't reveal his identity, his identity as a special operation team, together with his concern for these cases against the Lord of Storms believers, made Ebner certain that he was a member of the Mandated Punishers.
Like Ebner, after quickly perusing the file, Inspector Reed lost his smile and left the police station with a grave expression.
And when Ebner saw that the Mandated Punishers had taken over the case, he decided to stay out of it. He looked at his watch and saw that it was almost noon. He excused himself from Sergeant Eli, wanting to go to a nearby restaurant for lunch.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he stepped out, he saw Miss Judy, who was wearing a blue dress, walking over with a cup of sweet iced tea. When she saw Ebner, she even waved at him from afar.
Seeing that she seemed to be here for him, Ebner asked in surprise, "How did you know I was here?" Obviously, the dead bird with the silver feathers hadn't followed.
Judy pointed to the vegetation on the side of the road and smiled. "I went to the detective agency. Because I couldn't find you, I had to rely on my companions to find my way here."
Ma'am, you can actually ask my teacher's valet. He probably won't hide my whereabouts... Ebner glanced at the young lady who was born a Beyonder and wisely chose not to say those words.
"Oh, right, I almost forgot about the important matter. Cullen found some crucial information and asked me to come back to discuss it with you... Do you have time now?" Judy said after taking a sip of sweet iced tea.
Looking at your relaxed attitude, I know you're not in a hurry... Ebner thought to himself. He looked at his pocket watch and said, "I have time... but can you let me buy two Desi pies first?"
"Of course."
...
South of the Bridge, on Rose Street, Ebner pulled down his top hat. As he left the rental carriage and walked towards the Harvest Church, he heard Madam Judy mutter,
"Desi pie isn't as good as Servia's crispy pie—"
"Ebner, when you come to Feynapotter in the future, I will definitely treat you to a taste."
As it wasn't a Sunday, the church was still exceptionally quiet. Ebner saw two "giants" praying in front of the Sacred Emblem as soon as he opened the door, while vampire viscount Cullen was sitting in the first row of seats reading a novel.
"Captain, Father, Cullen, I brought Ebner back." After greeting, Judy ran straight to Cullen's side and sat down. Then she took out a few flowers of different colors from her pocket and handed them to him. "These are the night vanilla, slumber flower, and chamomile you wanted. I almost fought with the owner of the herb store today because of them."
"Thanks, Judy. Silika loves the taste of 'Amantha extract' the most. Now, the ingredients for the concoction are finally complete." Cullen first thanked her with a smile before asking curiously, "With your personality, you can actually quarrel with people? How rare."
"You don't know how infuriating the shop owner's words are! I only exchanged a few words with him, and he called me 'silly girl'." Judy was still a little angry when she thought about it.
"So you punished him?" Cullen asked with a smile and a sympathetic smile.
"He won't be able to speak for at least three days! Hmph, the medicine I drugged isn't something an Apothecary like him can cure." Judy snorted with a wicked smile.
Don't tell me the herb store owner you're talking about is Darkwill? Hmm, if Judy went all the way from the detective agency to the bridge police station, she happened to pass by the chubby Apothecary's shop... Ebner was stunned when he heard that. He felt that he had guessed correctly.
At this moment, Bishop Utravsky and Captain Arsenov stood up. The shadows of the two giants shrouded Judy and Cullen in the first row, making them shut their mouths at the same time.
Captain Asenov waited for the bishop to exchange greetings with Ebner before sincerely saying to him,
"Mr. Bryan, I'm sorry for disturbing your normal life, but we have a difficult matter that requires your help..."
"What is it?" Ebner asked cautiously, not immediately agreeing. He wanted to catch the Enchantress as soon as possible, but he definitely wouldn't agree if it was too dangerous.
Captain Asenov now looked at Cullen in the first row and said, "My Loen grammar is not good. Most of the descriptions are too raw. I think it would be best if you would introduce the situation to Mr. Breen."
"Alright, Captain." Cullen nodded before turning to face Ebner with an elegant smile.
"Mr. Bryan, let me explain it to you."
"Please go ahead," Ebner said politely.
Cullen said in a rich, beautiful voice,
"As the company's warehouse has been completely destroyed, Leonardo's family doesn't have any more clues. Our investigation has reached an impasse. We can only passively wait for the Demoness who raised the Mutation Monster to appear."
"Therefore, Captain and I decided to change our investigation direction. We planned to figure out where the heretic perfume came from first."
"Through my connections with the local Sanguine, I investigated Dr. Leonardo's interpersonal relationships before he became a Harvest Priest... After a series of investigations, I locked onto a suspicious lady."
"Her name is Windsor Behring. She's the wife of a coal merchant and also Viscount Lavrans's mistress."
"We found out that Leonardo was very close to her in the past. Viscount Lavrans even warned him. Even after Leonardo became the Harvest Priest, he didn't stop dating her... I have a Sanguine junior who saw the two of them attending a gathering in the secret circle last month."
"In conclusion, we plan on controlling this Ms. Windsor Behring and obtain some important information from her."
"Windsor Behring... This name sounds a little familiar..." Ebner frowned and recalled the original content seriously. Usually, he had never seen or heard of such people before.
Yes, Windsor Behring was the first Primordial Moon believer that Emlyn had killed when he participated in the Sanguine's Hunting Competition! So the one I nearly saw back then was the Primordial Moon...
Although Ebner didn't remember the knowledge of the Outer Deities, as an Outer Deity vest, the Primordial Moon was widely known among the low and mid-level Beyonders, so he could still remember the relevant storylines.
After recalling Windsor's origins, Ebner had a new question. He thought to himself, "Aren't official Beyonders always rash when handling matters? Why don't you just capture him and interrogate him? Also, what does this have to do with me?"
As if reading the question in Ebner's mind, Cullen explained:
"Be it Windsor Behring's husband or her lover, they appear to be believers of the Evernight Goddess on the surface. Their residence isn't far from Saint Samuel Cathedral... It's impossible for us to enter and enforce the law in such a place... It will attract the interference of the Nighthawks."
"And that Lady Windsor is also a recluse. She doesn't leave the North Borough easily. And even if she does, she has been following Viscount Lavrans. It's very difficult to make a move."
That's right. Although Earth Mother and the Evernight Goddess were secretly allies, she still had to show hostility on the surface. Otherwise, the God of Combat might see through her...
But what does this have to do with me? Can you ask me to lure that lady out? Ebner cursed silently and asked, "Please say it. What do you need me to do?"
"We heard that Windsor is attending the ball of the Daily Observer with Viscount Lavrans this Friday night..."
"We hope that you can get me or Judy an opportunity to enter the ball through Detective Isengard's connections."

chapters.title: Chapter 110: First Mission After Becoming Famous
chapters.content:
Chapter 110 - First Mission After Becoming Famous
"We hope that you can get me or Judy an opportunity to enter the ball through Detective Isengard's connections."
"You don't have to take risks for the rest. We will handle it properly and not bring you any danger."
At this, Cullen smiled at Ebner, waiting for his reply.
What a coincidence. I just received an invitation not long ago...
Upon hearing this request, Ebner was stunned for a moment before asking after a moment of silence, "Viscount Cullen, why don't you use your vampire connections to get an invitation? Moreover, with your abilities, you should be able to sneak into an ordinary ball without an invitation, right?"
Cullen shook his head with a smile and explained, "This isn't an ordinary ball. When the time comes, it's said that an important figure will be present to give a speech. The examination at the venue will definitely be very strict. If we use our relationship with the Sanguine, we will definitely be heavily scrutinized by MI9."
"A big shot? Which big shot?" Ebner asked curiously. Mike didn't mention this on his invitation.
"I don't know who it is exactly... but it should be a member of the royal family." At this point, Cullen looked at Ebner, who was obviously a little moved, and added, "Of course, we won't let you help us for nothing. If we can obtain the qualification to enter, I'll give you a copy of a set of mysticism books from the Blood Clan."
Ebner's eyes lit up upon hearing this. After pondering for a moment, he said, "Actually, I've been invited to this ball as well. I was allowed to bring a companion, so I don't have to trouble Teacher. However..."
"If you have any requests, feel free to ask." Viscount Cullen smiled and promised.
"I wish to purchase a Beyonder ingredient from the Sanguine. I need your help to pass it on," Ebner said with anticipation.
"What material?" Cullen didn't think it was too troublesome to be the middleman, and he could even earn a difference in price, so why not?
"The heart of the Elder Tree." Ebner exhaled, revealing his goal.
Cullen glanced at him and said meaningfully, "So you really are a 'detective'..." Then he changed the topic and said with certainty, "Sure, I'll help you ask about this. I remember that this material should be in the treasury."
"That's great! Thank you, Viscount Cullen." After Ebner thanked him from the bottom of his heart, he recalled that the identities of these Forsaken Saints seemed to be unable to withstand investigation. He could not help but ask,
"Although I can bring a companion in since there are important people here, I'm afraid the inspection will not be lax. What identity do you want to enter with me?"
It was definitely impossible for him to be a Forsaken One. Although he was an official member of the Orthodox Churches, he was also a foreigner.
At this moment, Judy, who had been quietly listening to their conversation, suddenly interjected, "I have a Beyonder item. It records the transformation ability of a Faceless. When the time comes, I can disguise myself as a clean, capable local and enter with you."
"What identity? If it's someone who has nothing to do with me, I'm afraid he will be suspected by MI9's security, right? If you are being watched, it will be very difficult for you to get close to Madam Windsor." Although Ebner didn't know how the Forsaken Ones planned to deal with Windsor, once they were stared at, it would be difficult to use any powerful means.
"That's true... In the next one or two days, I'll use a disguised identity to get to know you and pretend to have a good chat with you. This way, it won't seem too abrupt for us to attend the ball together." Judy thought for a moment and immediately gave a solution.
"That's a good idea... But did you use the Faceless powers recorded in your Beyonder items for that long?"
"Don't worry. This ability has been recorded more than twenty times, and it can last for at least six hours each time. It won't be a problem even if it takes another week," Judy replied confidently.
But why did you record so many Faceless? Was it because you changed your face every time you caused trouble?
Ebner grumbled under his breath but kept a smile on his face. What he didn't expect was that the insult was actually close to the truth.
At this moment, Captain Asenov, who had been silent all this while, decided.
"Alright, let's do as we discussed. You guys go and prepare yourselves. Don't make things difficult for Mr. Bryan."
"Yes, Captain!"
...
August 1st, Wednesday...
After breakfast, Ebner glanced at the date on the Backlund Morning Post that his teacher had subscribed to. He couldn't help but sigh. It's already August. Time sure flies... This is also the last month of peace. From now on, the Loen Kingdom and even the entire world will experience one major event after another.
It was not until the distant bell of the Holy Wind Cathedral rang seven times that Ebner snapped out of his reverie. He slowly stood up and went to his cupboard to take out his clothes.
He wore a black vest, a suit of the same color, copper-framed glasses, a half top hat, and a faint scholarly aura. After looking at himself in the mirror in satisfaction, Ebner greeted his teacher's servant and left.
But at that moment, two girls walked in together. Their eyes lit up when they saw Ebner and they quickly walked over.
The girl walking in front was wearing a beige dress and a small lady's hat. There were faint freckles on her face. She was Ebner's junior in public school, the daughter of Sergeant Fiona in the North District, Susan.
Ebner also recognized the girl behind Susan. She was also the classmate of the original owner of the body, Roman, who had joined the Kapusky teacher club at the last ball.
"Great detective, why aren't you saying anything? Have you forgotten your old classmate and old friend now that you're famous?" Susan walked up to him and joked with Ebner.
"Why would I? I'm just a little surprised to see you guys... Is there something you want to talk to me about?" Ebner was indeed a little surprised. As far as he knew, Susan had been receiving some ladylike etiquette education recently, so she probably didn't have time to come out and play.
"Can't I visit you if I have nothing to do? When we were in the club, apart from Jane, we had the best relationship!" The girl first argued with dissatisfaction, then she pulled Roman behind her and continued, "But you guessed right, we do have a commission... No, to be precise, Roman has a commission for you."
"What commission? About Mr. Kapusky?" Ebner asked curiously.
"Because my mother found quite a number of parents to work together to put pressure on Mr. Kapusky, who has already been expelled by the school. He seems to have gone to Tingen to apply for a new position, and he's currently not in Backlund." Susan rejected Ebner's guess, then tugged at the dejected Roman and said helplessly for her,
"We're here for Roman's matter... Her engagement partner seems to have a lover in the dark. We want you to find out what their relationship is... If it's really that kind of relationship, we hope you can take a few photos as evidence."
Does that mean my first assignment after I became famous was to catch adulterers? Ebner grumbled to himself before turning to Roman, who kept her head down. For some reason, he felt something was wrong with Roman. And she didn't seem as sad as she seemed.
"Roman, what's your fiance's name? Where does he live? And how did you know he has a lover?" It wasn't as if Ebner hadn't been involved in catching adulterers when he was a "Student of Ratiocination", so he was naturally familiar with this.
Hearing Ebner's question, before Roman could say anything, Susan was the first to cheer up. "That's great, Ebner," she exclaimed. "You agreed to the commission? I thought you'd disdained such cases after becoming a famous detective."
Ebner laughed at that but said nothing. He only turned his attention to Roman. He was beginning to think something was wrong with this classmate of his. Mind you, in the Host's memory, she was far more lively than Susan. Even if she had suffered a blow, she should not have been so silent.
"I want to talk to Ebner alone about this..." Roman finally mustered up the courage to say this after a long while. Then, she turned to Susan and asked hopefully, "Can I?"
Susan was a little surprised to hear this, but she soon felt that this involved the privacy of her good friend and that she really wasn't suited to hear it. So she nodded in understanding and said, "Then I'll wait for you here."
Ebner also wanted to know what this student was up to, so he brought her into his office. However, the moment he entered, he discovered that the entire room had been sealed by a wall of spirituality!
Ebner was shocked. He quickly activated the White Eye and took the revolver from his holster.
"Ebner, don't be so nervous. It's me!" At this moment, Roman suddenly changed her voice behind him, and her fluent Loenese accent became slightly southern.
"Judy?" Ebner was slightly relieved, but he still did not let down his guard. He asked in confusion, "Why did you come here in the image of my classmate?"
"It's me... Your classmate suffered a huge blow because of her fiancé. She jumped off the Tussock River last night and only survived after I saved her... She's currently recuperating in the Harvest Church and is under Cullen's care. You can visit her at any time." Afraid that Ebner would misunderstand, Judy explained everything in one go.
"After learning from her that you're her classmate, I felt that her identity was much better than the one I had prepared earlier. After all, you two are classmates. Even if you attend the ball together, you won't arouse much suspicion."
"I see..." Ebner nodded, then asked, "And how did Susan get involved?"
"Sigh, don't mention it. Not long after I disguised myself as Roman and moved into her house, this Miss Susan came to me on her own accord. She seemed to have been tortured by etiquette for too long and kept chatting with me... I had no choice but to change the topic about her fiance's betrayal. Who knew that I would be dragged here by the indignant her..." Judy sighed and continued, "Originally, I wanted to help Roman investigate the possible problems with the person she was engaged to and use it as compensation for temporarily occupying her identity."
"But now, I can only rely on you."

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Roman’s Fiance
chapters.content:
Chapter 111 - Roman's Fiance
"But now it's up to you." Judy spread her hands. Since Susan had dragged her to find Ebner and the man had agreed to start the investigation, she didn't have to do anything more to prevent the character she was playing from revealing the truth.
"You said that there might be a problem. What exactly happened?" Ebner asked with a frown.
Speaking of which, Ebner, who was Roman's engagement partner, recognized him. Although he was not very familiar with him and had never reported his name, they had met each other during gatherings.
In the original owner's memory, because he was born in a noble family, his parents still held quite a lot of shares in several steam machinery factories. Roman's engagement partner was a rather proud person, but his temperament was not bad. He was also very polite to Roman and her friends, so his reputation was not bad. Many female students were envious of Roman.
"Actually, the story is very simple. Your classmate, Roman, has noticed the estrangement of her fiancé, Alec, and has been very worried about it. One time, they met by chance, and she saw Mr. Alec fawning over a lady, so she couldn't help but step forward to reason with him.
"Who would have thought that not only did she not receive the apology she deserved, she was even reprimanded by her fiancé.
"Miss Roman was reprimanded by her father because of the school club incident, and now, she's being reprimanded by someone she likes. She jumped into the river because she couldn't take it anymore...
"Although it's normal to fall in love with someone else, from Miss Roman's description of her fiancé, I can tell that Mr. Alec used to be very self-disciplined and very good at controlling his emotions. He was clearly arrogant, but he was polite to everyone.
"Such a person, even if he especially likes his lover, shouldn't embarrass his fiancée in public.
"A person's transformation is so drastic that I have to wonder what's behind it."
After listening to Judy's analysis, Ebner nodded thoughtfully and added, following her words:
"Therefore, it's either that Alec is plotting something on the lady or that there's something wrong with the lady, affecting Alec."
"I think so too... And according to my experience in handling cases, such situations often have problems on both sides!" After Judy seriously reminded him, she smiled again and said playfully, "Okay, that's all I know. The rest will depend on your ability, Mr. Detective."
I feel like you people who know the inside story are mocking me by saying words like "famous detective" or "hero"...
Ebner grumbled inwardly, but his expression was solemn. He asked solemnly, "Then, Madam, I'll confirm one last time. Are you really willing to entrust me with finding out the truth behind the Alec incident?"
Those who obtain the knowledge that he painstakingly explored must also have the desire to obtain it.
This was the "Knowledge Keeper" principle that he had come up with after dealing with a few servants' minor problems in the past few days while hiding from reporters.
In other words, someone had to first express their desire to obtain a certain "knowledge". Then, he would inform the person of the corresponding "knowledge" he obtained through exploration, allowing this "knowledge" to be spread and used. It would no longer be easily lost or severed. This was a relatively complete acting of a Knowledge Keeper.
Although Judy didn't understand the deeper meaning behind this, she saw that Ebner's expression was serious, so she stopped smiling and said seriously, "I do have the desire to learn the truth."
"Then, I'll accept this mission. I'll bring the truth to you and Roman as soon as possible." As Ebner said this, he suddenly saw the girl in front of him pull out a few strands of withered, straw-like hair from her head and pass it to him. Confused, he asked, "What are you doing?"
"This is the prepaid reward for you. Don't underestimate them. Every single one of them can poison an adult curly-haired baboon to death within seconds," Judy explained with a grin.
Upon hearing this, Ebner's fingers that were about to touch his hair suddenly stopped.
"Haha, don't worry. They can only produce toxicity when mixed with alcohol. They're usually very safe. If you want to plot against someone, grind them into powder and mix them into beer. I guarantee that they're colorless and odorless. Even a demigod would find it difficult to detect them... Yes, my father has been tricked by me a few times," Judy said happily as if recalling something interesting.
Then being your father is really a high-risk profession... At least it's more toxic than a curly-haired baboon...
Ebner lampooned in his heart and secretly analyzed the few strands of hair with the Eye of Pure White. After gaining a rough understanding of their uses, he took it and carefully put it away.
"By the way, they were created by me using my Beyonder powers after all. After leaving me, their powers will gradually dissipate... In short, the toxicity effects will slowly decrease in three months, and they will completely lose their effects in half a year," Judy added when she saw Ebner put away his hair.
"I understand." Ebner nodded. He already knew this when he analyzed it earlier.
After talking about the commission, Ebner asked Judy about his former classmate.
"Sigh, although the bishop patiently persuaded her to calm down, I can still sense the pain and negativity in her heart. This is also why she agreed to my request to live in her place for a few days without any hesitation... She's avoiding reality," Judy sighed.
It seemed that Roman had deep feelings for her fiancé... No matter what reason Alec had, it was too much to treat his fiancée like this!
As Ebner thought this, he heard Judy say,
"I hope Miss Roman can walk out of this relationship. His fiancé might have the qualifications to become a successful businessman or politician, but he's definitely not a good match for a lady."
Ebner did not want to dwell on this topic. After all, he did not have much emotional experience, so he really did not have the right to speak. Hence, he changed the topic. "After using Roman's identity, have you thought about how to deal with the aftermath? Will it bring her trouble?"
"She's innocent, isn't she? The officials won't do anything to the innocent." Judy blinked and continued, "Besides, according to our arrangements, we won't let Roman's identity be exposed. After all, I disguised myself as Roman because of your connections. If I'm suspected, you won't be able to get away with it."
I asked because I was worried about this... Since you guys have already made arrangements, I can be a little more at ease... However, I still have to plan my escape plan in advance, in case there really is no backup plan when something goes wrong.
Ebner had a certain level of trust in Bishop Utravsky and the Forsaken Ones, but this trust couldn't reach the level of not holding back much with Xio. Therefore, the necessary preparations were still needed.
The other party was the same. Otherwise, they wouldn't have not told him the specific plan... Of course, this could also be to protect him. After all, the less he knew, the easier it would be for him to get away with it.
After that, the two of them released the spirituality seal and deliberately chatted in the tone of classmates. They deepened their "very good relationship" appearance, paving the way for "Roman" to participate in the ball on Friday.
Although no one had seen their performance at the moment, if there was a "detective" to "retrace" their actions afterward, it could be misleading.
After the two of them left the room, Susan walked up to them and asked, "When did you two become so close?"
"Roman was in a bad mood. I told her a joke to make her happy..." Ebner explained after thinking for a while.
"What joke? I tried to comfort Roman for a long time but failed. Ebner, you're really capable," Susan asked curiously, her eyes sparkling.
"That's a curly-haired baboon's story... One day, a baboon's child picked up its curly hair and ground it to pieces, then mixed it into a fruit and fed it..."
Ebner couldn't think of any funny joke, so he made it up.
Meanwhile, Judy was at a loss. Why did this story sound so familiar?
...
In the Folk Herb Store on Layton Street in Cherwood Borough, Alec, who was dressed like a successful person, watched as the village witch doctor in front of him added a few strange herbal powders into a glass bottle before dripping a few drops of rooster blood. The corners of his mouth twitched as his black eyes were filled with suspicion.
After stirring the mixture evenly and heating it up to boil, the Apothecary turned around to look at the big client who was introduced to him by someone. He took a pen and wrote on a piece of paper. "Get the patient to drink it as soon as possible. According to the situation you described, as well as the toxic specimens provided, the medicine this time should be able to restore the patient to about 30%."
Then, he seemed to want to write something else, but he felt that it was inconvenient to use a pen, so he could only sigh and give up.
"Is this really useful?" Alec still did not believe it, but since it was the lady's order, he did not question it directly. However, could an apothecary who could not even cure his vocal cords really concoct medicine that was useful to that powerful lady?
Of course, regardless of whether he believed it or not, he still painfully took out 20 pounds in cash and handed it to the Apothecary in front of him. Then, he carefully picked up the glass bottle, walked out of the shop, and boarded the rental carriage that had been waiting by the roadside.
After he sat down, the coachman drove the carriage slowly.
In the car, Alec held the glass bottle and subconsciously looked at the pedestrian scenery outside through the window. Suddenly, his spirituality stirred as he saw an ordinary-looking "man" walk over from the other side of the road and meet his gaze.
"Judging from the shape of her face... she should be a girl in a male outfit..." Alec judged out of habit before ignoring her.
In this era, there were plenty of women who disguised themselves as men to work. Furthermore, if some rich ladies secretly came out to play, they would mostly be dressed in this kind of unsuccessful disguise. This was not rare.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Follow and Fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 112 - Follow and Fight
Cherwood Borough, Leighton Street.
Ebner turned his head and looked at the rental carriage that brushed past him, as well as the somewhat familiar figure on the carriage. He couldn't help but squint his eyes and smile.
That's right. The girl who looked like a failed crossdresser at Alec was Ebner, who wore a clown mask and wore an ordinary woman's face.
The reason why he chose to change his appearance to carry out this commission mission was that Roman's fiancé, Alec, recognized him. The news about him has been so hot these few days. If he revealed his true appearance and was recognized by Alec, it would inevitably cause the other party to be alerted and would be detrimental to follow-up investigations.
The reason why they met on the road was because...
"The luck effect of this gold coin is really awesome."
Ebner muttered silently to himself. He toyed with the Solomon Empire gold coin, which had been wiped clean of blood, and put it back in his pocket.
Before he left the house to investigate, he asked Judy and Susan about Alec's address and the places he frequented. Worried that he would not be wasted, Ebner blessed himself with the Solomon Empire gold coins.
Who would have thought that as soon as he left the law firm and entered Cherwood Borough, he would coincidentally brush past Alec's carriage and "extract" a wisp of his aura the moment he recognized him as Roman's fiancé?
Alec has actually become a Beyonder? From the looks of it, he must have just advanced not too long ago. Furthermore, he lacks knowledge about Beyonder domains. Otherwise, he wouldn't have any reaction when I extracted his aura in front of him...
"Is it the potion that his suspected lover gave him? Yes, I heard that Alec really likes mysticism knowledge. Roman joined Kapusky's club precisely because he wanted to cater to his interests.
From the looks of it, his so-called lover should be a Beyonder... And a Beyonder who can casually give potion formulas...
With this in mind, Ebner didn't immediately catch up to the carriage. Instead, he took off his mask and returned to the office. He used a ritual to make a batch of short-acting charms and wore them. Then, he carried the zither box containing the Sword of Dawn. Only then did he secretly put on his mask again after leaving the office and stopped a rental carriage.
The coachman looked at Ebner's clothes and mask and pretended not to see that it was a lady. He asked, "Sir, where are you going?"
Ebner boarded the carriage, sat down, and said to the coachman,
"Follow my instructions. We'll reach the end of this street first."
"Alright." The carriage driver didn't ask why.
In the carriage, Ebner took out the Solomon Empire gold coin and began to divine.
As a Beyonder of the Reader Sequence, he wasn't very good at divination, but he held the aura he had extracted from Alec's body in his hand. Furthermore, the Solomon Empire gold coin had an additional effect on divination, and he was wearing the Clown Mask of the Seer Sequence. With all these factors added together, the effects of his divination at this moment wouldn't be much worse than a Sequence 9 Seer's.
"The whereabouts of the owner of this aura in my hand."
After chanting a few times, Ebner threw the gold coin up and let it fall freely. After spinning in the air for a few seconds, the mixed Solomon gold coin landed upright on the carriage seat.
"Straight ahead!" Seeing that the carriage had reached the end of the street, Ebner hurriedly instructed the coachman.
The front side represented a left turn, while the reverse side represented a right turn. If one wanted to stand upright, they naturally had to go straight.
As they continued on their way, Ebner constantly asked the coachman to adjust their direction. Finally, they arrived at a street front house in the St. George Borough. When they walked around earlier, he noticed that there was a warehouse behind the factory. It was obviously the door of a factory.
He tossed the gold coin again, but it kept spinning on the ground, refusing to fall or stand up...
Seeing this scene, Ebner knew that the person he was looking for should be in the factory, so he paid 4 soli for the carriage driver and jumped off the carriage with the piano box on his back.
Ebner didn't linger long in front of the main entrance where there were security guards standing guard. Instead, he walked along the factory wall until he reached the corner.
He looked around. Seeing that no one was paying attention to him, he took out a paintbrush from his pocket and drew a square door frame on the wall.
Following that, Ebner activated the Eye of Pure White and simulated the ability of an Apprentice to open the door. He directly walked into the factory from the door frame.
After entering the factory area, Ebner simulated his "invisibility" ability to hide his body while constantly "extracting" and "turning back" to search for Alec's whereabouts.
Due to the fact that Roman's fiancé might really have just become a Beyonder, he lacked the necessary common sense. Therefore, he had left behind too many traces. Soon, Ebner grabbed his "tail" and followed him to an old warehouse.
...
On the other hand, after Alec obtained the chubby Apothecary's medicine, he took a carriage to his factory and quickly entered an old warehouse on the southeast side of the factory.
Although it was still sunny outside, the interior of the warehouse was extremely dark due to the poor lighting. Alec lit the gas lamp that he had prepared long ago and could barely see things clearly.
"Ma'am, I've brought the potion back" Alec shouted a few times, but there was still no movement in the warehouse. Just as he was about to shout again, a clear female voice sounded behind him.
"Shut up! I'm checking if you've been marked."
Upon hearing this voice, Alec turned his head happily. As expected, he saw a beautiful girl with an innocent look pointing a ring at him. The blue gem on the ring emitted a few light rays that swept across his body.
"No problem... It seems that no one noticed you." The girl heaved a sigh of relief and took the glass bottle from Alec. After examining it for a while, she opened the bottle and drank it in one gulp.
Alec wanted to stop her, but before he could say anything, he saw the girl drink the potion. He had no choice but to persuade her tactfully. "Ma'am, that folk herbal store doesn't seem to abide by the rules. You should visit a more formal hospital."
The young girl could guess what he was thinking, so she shook her head and said with a smile, "Although the apothecary at the Folk Herb Store looks unreliable, his ability is still very good... He just doesn't know how to speak human language."
"Not very good at speaking human language? That's true. He's a mute, so he naturally doesn't speak human language... I didn't expect you to make such a joke, Ma'am," Alec said in surprise.
"Mute? You didn't go to the wrong shop, did you?" This time, it was the young girl's turn to be shocked. She quickly asked Alec about his previous experience.
After Alec repeated all the details of the herb store, the young girl muttered to herself thoughtfully, "Looks like someone finally couldn't stand him and made him mute..."
As though seeing that the girl was in a good mood today and wasn't as aloof as before, Alec seized the opportunity to ask, "Ma'am, I've already completed the mission you assigned me. Can you give me the Sequence 8 potion formula?"
The young girl looked at him with a faint smile and said, "You just drank the Seer potion for two days, right? You haven't even mastered Cogitation, and you're already thinking of the next potion formula? Heh heh, I can tell you clearly that if you advance to Sequence 8 in your current state, you will definitely lose control and become a monster."
Alec was somewhat depressed when he heard that. He grumbled, "I wasn't in a rush, to begin with, but this Seer Sequence's ability is far inferior to my expectations of Beyonders... It doesn't have the ability to fight head-on, nor does it have any treacherous means. I can only activate my Spirit Vision to see the so-called Spirit Body. At most, I can sense spirituality when others look at me..."
"Wait!" Before Alec could finish his sentence, he was interrupted by the young lady. Her expression was no longer as relaxed as before. She asked Alec sternly, "You said 'you have spiritual perception when others look at you'? When did this happen?"
Alec was frightened by the girl's aura, but he could not help but be attracted by her face. Under the combination of fear and excitement, he stuttered, "It happened on the way back... I met eyes with a girl walking towards me..."
"Idiot... that is a spiritual warning. You have been targeted by her!" As the young woman spoke, she secretly placed an abnormally cold claw on her hand.
"Warning? But I don't feel any danger..." Alec said in confusion.
However, at this moment, the young girl was no longer in the mood to pay attention to him because she sensed that an uninvited guest had sneaked into the warehouse.
The rune traps and alert rituals that I set up were not triggered... Only the 'Sharp Nose' brought by the 'Ice Claw' allowed me to vaguely smell the scent of a stranger... The person who came is an expert in ritualistic magic?
At the thought of this, the girl's innocent eyes were tainted with a layer of darkness, and more than ten black flames surrounded her. She decided to act first and force the person out in the future. Otherwise, when the other party calmly set up the ritual in the dark, it would probably be difficult for her to escape.
Alec, who was watching from the side, was stunned. Envy rose in his heart because such a scene was the Beyonder of his dreams!
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Black flames shot toward the dark corners of the warehouse like bullets.
Most of the black flames landed on the goods in the warehouse, but they did not burn. This was because the black flames could only affect things with life or spirituality.
However, when a black flame shot to a corner on the left side, a figure appeared out of thin air. Following that, this figure appeared in front of the young girl in the blink of an eye, pushed by a gale that came out of nowhere.
The figure raised a large sword and slashed down at the girl's head.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Intense Battle and Conversation
chapters.content:
Chapter 113 - Intense Battle and Conversation
Ebner actually didn't plan on showing himself. After using the analysis ability of the White Eye to bypass the few defensive rituals in the warehouse, he determined that the Beyonder who had given the Alish potion formula was at least at Sequence 7, or even higher.
He originally planned to leave quietly after eavesdropping on a little more information, and then find Cullen or Judy among the Forsaken Ones to come and take her down.
Unfortunately, he had made a mistake somewhere and his whereabouts had been discovered by the Demoness. In the end, he had no choice but to show himself and accept the challenge.
Yes, Demoness. After those black flames surrounded the girl, Ebner knew that he had encountered Demoness again.
Therefore, at the same time that he decisively pulled out the Sword of Dawn, he threw out two charms. One created a "gale" that pushed him to quickly appear in front of the Demoness, while the other created an illusory "shackle" in the shadow beneath the Demoness's feet, restricting her movements.
This was the most powerful technique he could use at the moment, and it could be said that he was going all out. There was no need for him to hold back against the Demoness.
If not for the fact that the Sword of Dawn could only use "Light Storm" once a day, which had a wide range and could wipe out the Alec, he would probably have to start with AOE.
Crack!
As the large sword slashed onto the girl's body, her figure first split open, then turned into fragments, turning into coarse silver mirror fragments!
Mirror Substitution Technique!
Ebner was well aware of what the Demoness was capable of, and he had never thought that he would be able to kill her with a single stroke of his sword. He had only used two precious talismans to seize the initiative.
However, just as he thought that the Demoness would enter stealth mode and constantly move about, waiting for an opportunity to deliver a fatal blow to him, she actually raised a claw that flickered with cold light and attacked from the front.
This caught Ebner off guard, who was prepared to simulate the Fire of Light to break her "invisibility".
Seeing that the terrifying claw was about to reach him, Ebner could not block it. He raised his sword again and slashed at the Demoness' neck.
Crack!
With the shattering of the mirror, the Demoness' figure suddenly appeared beside Ebner, and her cold claws were already close to his kidney.
Right after that, there was a loud clang. The claw failed to penetrate Ebner's body. Instead, it was blocked by an armor that suddenly appeared on his body.
This was one of the abilities of the Sword of Dawn. It could condense a weightless Dawn Armor on the user's body.
The strike didn't work, and the Demoness frowned slightly. Without waiting for Ebner's broadsword to slash down, she was about to retreat. She had already used the Mirror Substitution twice, but the broadsword seemed to have the ability to weaken supernatural powers. If she was struck a few more times, her "Substitution Technique" might completely fail.
But how could Ebner give her a chance to retreat now?
"Filthy!"
Accompanying the incantation chanted in ancient Hermes, a charm that Ebner had long held in his hand with evil patterns was instantly activated. It was one of the five Language of Foulness charms made from the demon aura on Damir Island.
With the activation of the charm, a demonic word filled with filth and stench echoed in the space.
"Slow down!"
The Demoness movements became extremely slow as if the surrounding space had become viscous. A look of terror slowly appeared on her face.
But at this moment, the sapphire ring on her finger suddenly flashed with light, and she regained her mobility.
The Demoness held back her joy. Before Ebner's broadsword slashed down, she activated another Beyonder item. Her body suddenly vanished, and she appeared in front of Alex, who was holding the gas lamp and staring blankly at the intense battle.
Flaming Jump? She actually has a Beyonder item with the Magician powers.
Upon seeing this ability appear, Ebner, who had missed the attack, had already given up on killing or capturing the Demoness in front of him. After all, the Demoness had a very strong survival ability. In addition to the Magician's survival skills, if she wanted to escape, he definitely wouldn't be able to catch up to her.
He was just a little depressed. Why was it that with the Solomon gold coin augmenting him with Luck, his whereabouts were easily discovered... His final trump card, the Language of Foulness charm, was also coincidentally countered by his opponent's trump card.
Little did he know that the Demoness was actually even more depressed than him. She had clearly released a large amount of "luck" accumulated in her ring, but when the Ice Claw struck her armor, it did not trigger the "Freeze" effect. Otherwise, just the "Dawn Armor" alone would definitely not be able to withstand that strike.
However, the Demoness also had no intention to continue attacking. After the previous attack and defense probing, she had already confirmed that the other party was an extremely difficult Beyonder. Not only did he have many abilities, but he also had quite a number of mid-level charms. It was not a wise choice to continue fighting like this.
Most importantly, she had already vaguely guessed his background, so continuing the battle was meaningless.
"Actually, we don't have any enmity between us. There's no need for us to fight to the death, is there?" Seeing that Ebner didn't continue to attack, the Demoness spoke in a clear voice.
"Hehe, you were the one who attacked first." Ebner did not let his guard down just because the other party had stopped. While he was talking, he secretly held the cursed badge that had been repaired by the demonic aura in his hand, planning to activate it once something went wrong.
The Demoness didn't relax either. She seemed to have put away her Frost Claw, which she relied on the most, but in fact, she had been holding onto the rod that could activate Flaming Jump.
"Then please allow me to apologize, Sir." The Demoness bowed slightly before looking at Ebner, who was tensed up. She smiled and asked, "Sir, you are from the Church of Earth Mother, right? A Forsaken One?"
Ebner was slightly shocked. He did not expect this witch to guess the Forsaken Land's identity. Although he was not one if Susan had not suddenly gone to find Judy who had changed into Roman, the one who would appear here at this moment might really be a Forsaken Land.
Narrowing his eyes, Ebner asked calmly, "Why do you say I'm from the Church of Earth Mother?"
"Heh heh, there's no need for you to deny it... This is because I recognize the face you're currently disguising. She originally belonged to Ray. She was a Demoness of Afflictions!" At this point, Demoness looked at Ebner with a faint smile and continued, "And in order to steal a Sealed Artifact from the Church of Earth Mother, Ray lost a Sealed Artifact that could be disguised as this face in the hands of a giant bishop."
Witch Lena!
After hearing the Demoness' words, the name that had once given him and Xio quite a headache appeared in Ebner's mind. After all, Ray was wanted by the three Churches. Apart from Witch Leena who appeared with her, the other Demonesses probably wouldn't know what she had done recently.
Lena was here... Could Ray be nearby? At the thought of this, Ebner immediately thought of turning around and fleeing.
"Don't worry, Ray isn't here... I broke up with her and am also avoiding her." The Demoness seemed to have guessed Ebner's thoughts and explained with a smile.
However, Ebner did not believe her words. He frowned and secretly looked around. He wanted to find a chance to leave. It would not be too late to talk after he found helpers.
"Do you want to know what Ray is planning? I can tell you."
However, just as Ebner was about to leave, the Demoness's words made him stop in his tracks.
He looked at the Demoness before him with a grave expression. After a long while, he asked, "Why do you have to tell me?"
"I know that in order to advance to Pain, not only did Ray steal a Sealed Artifact from the Church of Earth Mother, She also caused the death of one of the important believers... And since the Forsaken One has appeared here, it means that you are still doing something." When Demoness said this, she suddenly waved her hand. With a fragrant breeze, she knocked out Alec, who was eavesdropping with her ears pricked up, before continuing,
"And I am not telling you all this important information for free... what I want is a transaction."
"What deal? What do you want?" Ebner didn't have time to beat around the bush with the Demoness as he asked bluntly.
"The last time I escaped from Ray's pursuit, she planted a mutated malignant disease in me. Even the Beyonder powers of Apothecary and Physician can only alleviate it, but not completely remove it... I need the Church of Earth Mother to help me remove this latent danger," the Demoness said after a moment of silence.
Ebner did not have the right to answer her request, so he said after thinking for a moment, "I need to ask... Can you leave a contact method?"
"Hehe, is it convenient for you to capture me by leaving behind the contact method?" The Demoness laughed coquettishly at first, but then she changed the topic and directly reported a person's name. "Talim Dumont."
"You can find Talim Dumont and tell him that you wish to meet Witch Lena... When the time comes, an important figure will arrange for us to meet," the Demoness said.
Looking for Talim? Then, could that important figure be Prince Edessak? Holy sh * t, he's colluding with a Demoness before Trissy even came to Backlund?

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Feast of Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 114 - Feast of Blood
South of the Bridge, Harvest Church.
After making simple contact with the witch, Lena, Ebner quickly left the factory. Then, relying on the underwater breathing charm, he directly jumped into the Tussock River and drifted to the eastern suburbs outside St. George Borough. Only then did he go ashore and rush to the nearest subway station. He took the subway to the south side of the bridge.
As for Alec? He had already guessed the whole story from what he had eavesdropped on. He could confirm it with her after the deal with the Demoness.
The church was still deserted. Even Roman, who was temporarily staying here, was not in the hall in front. There were only two giants praying piously to the Earth Mother's Sacred Emblem.
After hearing Ebner's recount of the encounter at the St. George Borough factory, Captain Lech Arsenov frowned and asked Bishop Utravsky beside him,
"Do you know who Talim Dumont is?"
Bishop Utravsky thought carefully for a moment and replied hesitantly, "He seems to be a horse trainer from a declining noble family."
"The equestrian coach... then who is he working for?" Captain Asenov asked again.
Bishop Utravsky shook his head, indicating that he didn't know. At this moment, Ebner interjected,
"This equestrian coach came to me before and stopped me from investigating a butler's assistant... As he wasn't tight-lipped, he revealed that he was working for a prince."
"Prince? A malicious investigation of the butler's assistant? Heh heh, I'm guessing you're talking about Prince Edessak," Bishop Utravsky said with a smile when he heard that.
"Father, you're also concerned about the kingdom's political news?" Ebner asked in surprise. He always felt that Lilith's Blessed was only focused on praying and developing believers.
"Although I've only been in Loen for a short period of time, there are still some families of the upper nobles who have changed their faith in Mother," Bishop Utravsky replied gently.
Captain Arsenov said regretfully, "With a prince protecting that witch, we can't take the most direct and effective action."
As expected of a Beyonder passing by the Twilight Giant, all he could think of was to charge forward! Ebner secretly lampooned before asking the giant captain, "What do you think about the Demoness' transaction request?"
"In principle, I agree... After we agree on a meeting place, let Judy go with you. Heh heh, if she can't cure that Demoness, then I'm afraid the Saint will have to do it himself," Captain Asenov said after thinking for a moment.
At this moment, Viscount Cullen of the Blood Race walked out from the room behind the church. After exchanging greetings with the three of them, he handed a copybook to Ebner and said with a smile,
"There are no results regarding the Tree of Elders... However, I've already paid you in advance. This is the mysterious book written by a duke from the Blood Race, 'Blood Feast'. There are many interesting ritualistic magic and mysterious stories recorded in it... Of course, I've only given you the first half."
Ebner happily received the book. His first thought was... to arrange for Xio to recite Mr. Fool's honorific name.
...
Tingen, 2 Daffodil Street's row villa, in the Moretti family's restaurant.
Looking at the plate with only the bottom of the soup left, Benson raised his hand to cover his mouth and burped in satisfaction.
"Klein, your culinary skills seem to have improved by leaps and bounds again. I feel that the sourness and sweetness of the tomatoes are perfectly combined with the elasticity of the beef tail and the extremely unique freshness. This taste is even better than the last time you cooked! Klein, although I've already said this once, I have to reiterate: It's a pity that the Blackthorn Security Company caused Tingen City to lose an outstanding chef."
Melissa hugged her bloated stomach and nodded silently.
"This is only because you haven't seen real culinary skills." While Klein was being humble and polite to his siblings, he was thinking, Perhaps I can get Tower and Justice to sacrifice some of Backlund's delicacies to me in the future... Yes, The Hanged Man has been at sea all year round and has been to more places. Bayam, Pasu, Nas, and the other island's specialty foods are also said to be pretty good. What excuse should I use to get them to offer me sacrifices?
However, even if you sacrifice it to me, you have to become a Clown before you can obtain it... I can't spend ten pounds for a meal to hold a bestowment ritual...
Melissa saw that her brother was distracted and thought that he was recalling the delicacies in the restaurant. She immediately said, "I prefer what you make."
Benson chuckled and said, "Melissa, I heard that a senior lecturer from Backlund recently came to your technical school?"
"Yes, that person's name is Kapusky Reed, and he's a professor of ancient Feysac. He's very popular among his classmates, but I don't really like him..." Melissa muttered, looking somewhat depressed.
"What happened?" The two brothers noticed that something was amiss with Melissa and asked with concern.
"Nothing... It's just that I don't quite agree with some of his ideas, so I ended up arguing with him..." Melissa said in a low voice. One of the people who quarreled with her was her previous friend, and that was the main reason why she was unhappy.
Klein pinched his glabella and secretly activated his Spirit Vision. He looked at the color of his sister's aura and heaved a sigh of relief when he realized that there was no problem.
On the other side, Benson said with a serious expression, "I heard that this senior instructor came to Tingen because he complained in Backlund. From the looks of it, he still needs a righteous complaint here... so that he can return to Backlund."
"I can help you with this matter. As you know, the Blackthorn Security Company is related to the police station." Klein nodded in agreement.
"You... You don't have to do this." Melissa saw that her two brothers had expressed their concern for her in such a manner. The depression in her heart dissipated, and she felt warm all over.
...
Backlund East Borough, in Ebner's rented house.
Xio's face turned pale for no reason when she saw her good friend take out the Solomon Empire gold coin in embarrassment.
However, after pursing her lips, she still dripped her blood into Gold Coin's avatar.
Xio immediately heaved a sigh of relief when she saw that she only needed a single drop of gold coins.
Seeing that the gold coins had been sealed again, Ebner took out a book with the words "Feast of Blood" written on the cover and handed it to her. He said with a smile, "Your mysticism knowledge has always been lacking, so I specially brought this book for you... This book is owned by a duke of the Sanguine, and it contains rich mysticism knowledge..."

chapters.title: Chapter 115: All Sides
chapters.content:
Chapter 115 - All Sides
"A book on mysticism written by a Sanguine Duke?" Xio's interest was piqued when she heard that. She took the book and found that it felt very thin, as though there were only a few pages.
After flipping it open and roughly reading it, Xio realized that the first few pages only contained the ordinary knowledge of some dukes when they were in the Mid-Sequence Beyonders. She couldn't help but ask in puzzlement, "Why are there only these few pages? And... from the handwriting, it looks like you copied them?"
"Yes... I've only read a few pages of that book so far. I only copied it down for you after making sure it's fine." Ebner smiled and nodded as he explained.
He knew very well that Xio was now very different from her original self, especially after becoming a tool for the ancient dragons in East Chester County. This Miss Judgment had become sufficiently cautious. Although her habit of chanting silently remained, it was almost impossible to use Rosellewen as bait to induce her to recite The Fool's honorific name.
Therefore, Ebner planned to copy the contents of the Feast of Blood bit by bit and give it to her, gradually lowering her vigilance towards the book. Finally, he would create an opportunity for her to get the copy of Viscount Cullen's book. The honorific name of The Fool was hidden in this final step, and she would discover it herself.
Speaking of which, although the "Feast of Blood" that Cullen had given him was a copy, it was still quite far away from the current age. It definitely had a history of at least one or two hundred years. This could be seen from the style of the book.
And this sense of the times could be used to tamper with it.
In this world, some knowledge itself was dangerous. For example, the Sights in the Spirit World in Fors's hands was like that. Xio, who understood this, felt that Ebner was taking the risk for her by doing so. Therefore, she pursed her lips and looked at Ebner intently. Without saying anything, she said seriously, "Thank you, Ebner."
Upon hearing Xio's gratitude and feeling her deep emotions, Ebner sighed and felt ashamed. After all, although he had done this to help Xio, he was still using the trust between friends...
In fact, if Klein hadn't forbidden her from casually revealing his name, Ebner really wanted to tell Xio The Fool's honorific name. He believed that with their current relationship, Xio would likely choose to believe him and recite The Fool's honorific name.
Unfortunately, doing so would violate The Fool's decree. Although Klein couldn't do anything to him at the moment, he would definitely plant a seed of distrust. This way, Xio and even Fors would find it even more difficult to join the Tarot Club.
After Xio put away the handwritten portion of the Feast of Blood, she chatted with Ebner about the new information she had received in East Borough, which was a series of sudden "deaths" regarding the Lord of Storms believers.
"Is there such a thing in East Borough? It looks like the person behind this plan doesn't want the Mandated Punishers to have too much free time..." Ebner sighed and put this matter aside. After all, what did the trouble of the Church of Storms have to do with a Blessed of Knowledge? It was already very kind of him not to gloat.
...
Under the Holy Wind Cathedral.
Spellsinger of God Ace Snake, who was wearing a black bonnet, swept his silver eyes and said to his Mandated Punishers,
"You should know very well that the death of the believers of the Lord in East Borough, Bridge Borough, and the dock area is a disgrace to all of us Mandated Punishers.
"Your next mission is to investigate the mastermind and capture him.
"After the report, you have the right to use a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. You have to find out who's targeting us!"
Standing at the front, a middle-aged man wearing a modified captain's hat immediately led everyone and punched his chest with his fist. "Yes, Your Excellency!"
He was thin and didn't have any special features, but he had an anchor-shaped bluish-black tattoo on his neck. He was the captain of the Mandated Punishers in Backlund.
...
West Borough, in the garden villa on Williams Street.
Ray stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window with the flower pot in her arms, allowing the crimson moonlight to shine on her body. The expression on her face was gentle and kind. In addition to her witch-like charm, it produced a different kind of beauty.
Moreover, her figure was even more well-rounded than before, not as slender as when she was enjoying herself.
Berner stared at her in a daze for a long time before coming back to his senses. His expression suddenly turned extremely ugly as he said fiercely, "Ray, what curse did you put on me? Why do I find it harder to resist your charm?!"
' Why not? Heh heh, isn't that nice?' Ray turned back and smiled flirtatiously.
Berner knew that she wasn't willing to reveal the truth, but he didn't dare to continue questioning her. He didn't even dare to look at her again. All he could do was turn his head and say, "Some of the subordinates I sent to corrupt ordinary people with Beyonder characteristics have already fallen into the hands of the Church of Storms. Although the captured don't know who they are working for, they will be exposed sooner or later."
"Alright, there's no need to complain. Retract your people. They have already shown their value... Heh heh, I'm afraid you still don't know. Because of their efforts, not only did they drag the members of the Mandated Punishers into investigating the complicated matters of the dead, they also made the God of Mask decide to use a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact at the appropriate time," Ray said slowly as he used his fair fingers to stroke the flower bud.
However, her words completely frightened Lieutenant Berner. He immediately widened his eyes and said, "Are you crazy? What do you plan on doing? If you provoke the Church of Storms's Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, we will be doomed sooner or later. The organization won't go against such a dangerous thing just to save us."
Ray listened to Berner's hysterical shouting with interest. After he finished venting, she smiled and said, "Have you calmed down? Heh heh, speaking of which, you've done very well with the things I handed you previously, so I've decided to give you some more rewards..."
As she spoke, she removed her clothes and the thin veil from her body as she carried the flower pot towards Lieutenant Berner.
"What... What are you doing?" This time, Berna wasn't fooled by the "beautiful scenery" in front of him. This was because his spirituality was already frantically warning him, as though the people opposite him were about to become some terrifying monster.
"Of course... I'll reward you with a chance to transform and make you a part of my little fellow."
Ray's voice was still so crisp and pleasant. Her tone was still so alluring and charming, but at this moment, Berner felt that she was even scarier than the devil's voice!
Seeing Ray approach step by step, Berner no longer hesitated. He rubbed the Sun domain mystical item on his finger and was about to take the initiative to attack.
This was the Ring of Light ring he had bought at a Beyonder gathering. It could make the wearer an envoy of light, a servant of the Sun, immune to many diseases, and was very effective against Demoness of Agony. It could also control divine powers, allowing the wearer to summon dazzling beams of light and use most of the Sun domain spells.
Unfortunately, just as he had this thought, he felt a sharp pain in his head! The pain was so intense that he couldn't even stand straight, much less use a mystical item.
As for the Ring of Light's immunity to diseases, it had no effect on the headache.
