At this moment, Ray had already leisurely walked in front of Berner in a naked manner. She looked down at the lieutenant who was lying on the ground in pain and said with a smile, "I remember telling you that it's neither a Beyonder power nor a curse... An item from the Sun domain? Heh heh, the price shouldn't be low, but it's not very useful."
With that, she turned around and faced Berner with her smooth back.
Berner no longer had the energy to answer her. He raised his head with all his might, but the last thing he saw in his life was an extremely strange scene.
The crimson moonlight seemed to have a life of its own as it extended itself to the complicated patterns on Ray's back. The tattoos began to slowly wriggle under the moonlight and then came to life, turning into a beautiful blooming flower.
At the same time, the flower bud in the flower pot that Ray had been carrying suddenly opened up, turning into a flower that was extremely similar to the living tattoo. However, it was as tall as two people and extremely huge!
Right on the heels of that, the flower in the flower pot flew towards Lieutenant Berner like a ferocious beast in the blink of an eye. It opened its huge petals and enveloped him before swallowing him.
When it was all over, Ray put on her gauze pajamas again and looked at the flower bud that was still tightly closed in her hand. She said to herself,
"Berner, I didn't plan on touching you so early, but do you think you can hide it from me by deliberately sacrificing the petty tricks of a large number of low-level personnel?
However, since the Church of Storms has decided to use a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact... Then, I can lure those few people into the trap.
"Heh heh, Berner's methods are still somewhat effective. At the very least, he made the Demoness Sect and MI9's upper echelons suspect me... But so what? Without you, I can still find helpers to complete the plan."

chapters.title: Chapter 116: The Strange Encounter of a Ordinary Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 116 - The Strange Encounter of a Ordinary Person
On Thursday morning, due to Detective Zreal's prior investigation at the ball being fully taken over by the Mandated Punishers, Ebner's work was considered 'complete'. However, the subsequent investigation fees could not be obtained.
Because of this, Detective Zreal had even personally come to the door last night to explain the situation. Unfortunately, Ebner and Xio had been reading in the East Borough house at the time and hadn't seen each other. In the end, the teacher had attended to them on their behalf.
Ebner also put aside the investigation of Walter commissioned by the unknown Mr. Massey. He only sent over the selection of information that Prince Totalim handed to him every Sunday to stall for time.
Thus, Ebner, who had nothing else to do, had a rare moment of leisure. He sat in his office drinking coffee and reading the newspaper.
As for meeting with "Witch" Lena? That was a deal with the Forsaken Land, and it didn't have much to do with him. He just needed to know the result.
"Crimson Ghost Tannick, a bandit with a bounty of 3,000 pounds, has been captured. His true identity is actually an Intis spy? Intis ambassador, Mr. Bakerland, denied this matter."
Ebner looked at the headlines of Backlund Morning Class and couldn't help but sink into thought. "I remember that Red Ghost Tanick was sent by the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun to Loen. His identity is about the same as Teacher's... The Church of the Lord of Storms couldn't find the mastermind, so they first investigated the most suspicious members of the enemy church?"
Just as he thought of this, he saw Detective Isengard walk in. He couldn't help but jump in fright as he hurriedly asked, "Teacher, why are you back so early today?"
Detective Isengard had been leaving early and returning late recently. It was very tiring. At first glance, Ebner thought that he had also been discovered by the Church of Storms, so he had come back to pack his things and prepare to escape.
Detective Isengard noticed the odd expression on his student's face. With just a cursory glance at the newspaper on the table, he could roughly guess what Ebner was thinking. He couldn't help but laugh and scold him. "Your teacher isn't a fool like Tannick who only knows how to praise the Sun... Besides, I have deep connections in Backlund. Even if the Mandated Punishers discover me, the Church of Steam and the Church of Evernight will step forward to protect me."
"Teacher, I didn't mean that..." Ebner smiled awkwardly and tried to change the topic. "Why are you back so soon today?"
Detective Isengard's smile disappeared when he heard that. He sighed and said, "When I was helping Sivellaus Yard investigate the case, I heard Inspector Wayne's obituary from the West District Police Department... Today is his farewell ceremony. I came back to change my clothes before rushing to Green Cemetery for the funeral..."
"Inspector Wayne? I remember that he was invited to the public dance hall more than ten days ago... How could it be so sudden?" Ebner recalled for a moment and remembered the amiable old man he had met at the ball.
"I heard it's an old asthma relapse... He stayed in the hospital for a week without getting better... Sigh, Old Wayne is a pretty good person. He's kind and likes to help juniors... What a pity." Detective Isengard shook his head and sighed.
"After all, I've met this inspector before. Anyway, I don't have anything else to do today, so I'll bid farewell to him with you," Ebner said after thinking for a while. Although they didn't have much of a relationship, he couldn't let his teacher go alone on such an occasion.
"That's good too. Help me get a black tie," Detective Isengard instructed.
...
In a corner of Grimm Cemetery, many policemen in black suits and black ties gathered in front of a new tombstone. On it was a black-and-white photo of a benevolent old man.
Standing at the front of the grave was a lady in her thirties. Her eyes were unfocused, and she seemed to have no strength to lean on a gentleman beside her. They were Inspector Wayne's daughter and son-in-law.
Wayne's youngest son, Bruce, and the other subordinates of the police department carried the coffin over and placed it in the grave.
After the priest's eulogy and prayers, the soil began to be buried, and the black coffin was slowly covered.
Ebner and Detective Isengard stood at the back of the crowd, watching the scene with solemn expressions as they silently read the epitaph on the tombstone. But at that moment, a young man suddenly ran over from afar. He opened his mouth as if he was about to say something loudly.
However, he did not complete his actions. A few police officers who seemed to have been prepared in advance stood in front of the young man and pressed him to the ground.
Seeing this scene, Ebner frowned, but he did not interfere.
After the grave was filled up and the slate was covered, and the people attending the funeral gradually left, Ebner was about to go out and call for a rental carriage when the young man who had been pressed down finally broke free. He stumbled to the front and began to quarrel loudly with the priest and Wayne's family.
Detective Isengard frowned in displeasure and asked a familiar police officer, "Darcy, what happened? Do you need our help?"
When the police officer named Darcy saw that it was Detective Isengard who was asking, he hurriedly stopped in his tracks. After taking a few heavy breaths, he replied, "Detective Stanton, Detective Bryan, hello... There's no need for your help. That kid is from the West District Police Department. He previously claimed that Inspector Wayne's asthma was artificially caused, and he even advocated investigating the women of a royal family... But clearly, his words aren't as convincing as the doctor's."
"Do you have any evidence... of what he said?" As a detective, Isengard pursued the matter. From what he knew, if he hadn't determined his thoughts, the young police officer wouldn't have come to Old Wayne's funeral to cause a scene.
"If there's really evidence, would the sheriff and the others not investigate it? You have to know that most of the people in the police station have received Wayne's advice and help." Darcy looked around before whispering,
"Shoko clung to his ridiculous conclusion because he believed that after the accident on Duke Negan Avenue last week, a lady in a royal carriage passed by him and Wayne, and after that, both of them had different degrees of physical discomfort. The difference was that he soon got through, and Inspector Wayne went into the hospital.
"He suspected that the lady was spreading an unknown poison."
Last week... Duke Negan Avenue... Car accident... Isn't this what happened that day when I went to Doctor Leonardo's house to investigate? I remember that if I hadn't used Solomon Gold Coin to increase my luck and coincidentally boarded a rental carriage that had just passed by the scene of the accident, I'm afraid I would have been stuck in a traffic jam on Duke Negan Avenue... Then, would I have also suffered from a disease and knocked over that bottle of perfume?
At the thought of this, the image of an entire street's worth of people praising the Primordial Moon appeared in Ebner's mind. He couldn't help but shiver in the hot weather.
After Officer Darcy left, Detective Isengard pondered for a moment before asking his student, "Demoness of Afflictions?"
Although he was busy with work and didn't know what Ebner was busy with recently, he could guess that he was investigating the Demoness.
"Very likely... According to what I know, there was indeed a Demoness of Afflictions who successfully advanced around last Tuesday. If she hadn't been able to control the power of the potion back then, it would be perfectly normal for the Beyonder powers that overflowed to affect ordinary people," Ebner replied after some thought.
"I'll get the director of the West Borough Police Department to get the style of the royal badge that the young man named Shoko mentioned. I'll give it to you later." Detective Isengard drew a match, lit his pipe, and took a deep breath before saying.
"Thank you, Teacher." Ebner's eyes lit up when he heard this. This way, he would at least know which military person was working with Ray.
"I just don't want Old Wayne to die without knowing why..." Detective Isengard sighed and said solemnly, "I'll leave this matter to you."
"I'll do my best."
...
Shoko was only released after being escorted out of the cemetery by the police officers.
One of his colleagues, who was usually on better terms with him, hesitated for a moment before persuading him, "Shoko, I know that Inspector Wayne takes very good care of you. You can't accept his death... But after so many doctors' consultations, Wayne really died from a relapse of his old ailment, not those ridiculous reasons you made up."
"I'm not making anything up, that's the truth!" Shoko's eyes were red as he yelled.
The rest of the police officers sneered and said to their colleague, "Why are you telling him this? I think he's gone mad. He might not have recovered from the car accident and only became mentally ill."
Shoko glared at the officers and turned to leave. He was completely disappointed in the police station. He had to find out the truth himself.
However, after he calmed down, he realized that he had no idea where to start. He had no idea how to take the first step...
Shoko sat alone on a bench in the park by the side of the street, clutching his hair in distress. He was frustrated by his lack of learning and incompetence in the past, and he regretted his incompetence... Unknowingly, he, who was extremely exhausted, just sat there and slept. Then, he had a strange dream.
In his dream, there seemed to be an ordinary-looking old man who handed him something and repeated a few words...
A gentle breeze blew past, and Shoko jolted awake. He mumbled words over again.
Dakota Street. Number 14. Lena...
Shoko shook his neck and gave a self-deprecating smile. He wondered why he was still talking in his sleep after waking up. Could it be that his colleague was telling the truth?
However, just as he was about to stand up, he suddenly froze because there was something in his hand that did not belong to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Before the Ball
chapters.content:
Chapter 117 - Before the Ball
Cherwood Borough, in a house near the Tussock River.
Wraith Steve's figure jumped out of a mirror. He first condensed into a corporeal body before straightening his clothes. He then said respectfully to the empty room, "Your Excellency Zatwen, I received an important piece of information from a Demoness."
Just as he finished speaking, a figure quickly appeared on the piano bench not far behind him.
The figure was dressed in a black clergyman's robe, and he wore a black glove on his left hand. His face was thin, and his skin was brown. His eyes were sunken like a mummy's. The roots of his beard were black and white, extending from his mouth to his ears. However, they weren't thick, and they were rather short, making them appear like stars.
This man named Zatwen's eyes were close to his skin color and belonged to light brown. He clearly had the bearing of a priest, but he gave off a cold and terrifying feeling, as though he would be perverted in silence. He looked coldly at Steve and asked,
"What news? About Sharron and Maric?"
Despite being a wraith, Steve still felt his body turn cold. Thankfully, he managed to control himself with great difficulty and carefully replied, "It's news from the Church of Storms. They might use that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact in the near future."
The corners of Zatwen's mouth curled up when he heard that. He said with a sneer, "Heh, it's just a little trick of the Demoness. She wants me to hold back the Saint of the Church of Storms so that she can do whatever she wants."
"Then should we reject her?" Although Steve asked this, he didn't feel that the saint in front of him would reject him because the Sealed Artifact was something he could only come across by chance.
As expected, Steve soon heard Zatwen say with a sinister smile, "Why should I reject it? If that Sealed Artifact really appears, I will naturally snatch it, but I won't hold back the Tyrant's demigod as she wishes."
"However, that Sealed Artifact... Or rather, the Cursed Artifact should have very strong divination and anti-divination powers. That Demoness might not be able to plot against it..." Steve reminded.
"I'm much more familiar with the cursed item than you are. There's no need for you to remind me. It's indeed very powerful, but the price to use it isn't small either! A Grade 1 Sealed Artifact? If I were to use all of its powers, the price I would have to pay would probably directly set it at Grade 0. Therefore, the Mandated Punishers definitely wouldn't dare to remove all the seals. That Demoness at least has a chance."
Zatwen stopped there, as if reluctant to reveal more to Steve.
"This matter isn't urgent. That Demoness won't act rashly for the time being... The most important thing now is to pursue Sharron and Maric. Have you found their whereabouts?" Zatwen changed the topic and asked.
"There seems to be a demigod proficient in prophecy hiding their whereabouts behind Sharron and company. We can only search for them bit by bit through investigation," Steve replied awkwardly.
"A demigod skilled in prophecy..." Zatwen pondered for a moment before saying solemnly, "I allow you to pray to the Mother Tree during the ritual. I believe it will bring you a revelation."
"Yes, sir," replied Steve, looking delighted.
...
August 3, Friday.
Ebner had just woken up and had yet to get up when his spirituality was suddenly stirred.
He took out two charms from under his pillow and held them in his hand. At the same time, he activated his Spirit Vision and looked out. He saw a silver-white, illusory bird with a letter in its mouth standing on the windowsill. It tilted its head and sized him up with its red eyes.
Ebner breathed a sigh of relief because he recognized the bird. It was the messenger of Viscount Cullen.
"Silica." Ebner waved at it and took out a bottle of Amantha extract, which he had previously concocted, from the bedside cabinet. He unscrewed the cap of the bottle, and an alluring fragrance immediately wafted out.
He remembered Viscount Cullen mentioning that his messenger, Silika, liked this taste the most.
The moment the bottle cap was opened, the little bird made a move. It flapped its wings and immediately appeared above the "Amantha extract". Immediately after, the fragrance that filled the air suddenly disappeared and gathered around the little bird.
Ebner ignored the messenger's enjoyment as he took the letter. After confirming that there were no traps with the White Eye, he opened the envelope and read it.
There wasn't much in the letter, which was to inform him that Judy had already met Talim and that she would pass on the request to meet with 'Witch' Leena to the important person behind her. The two parties had already agreed to meet in a hunting ground in the northern suburbs on Sunday afternoon. Finally, Cullen asked him if he wanted to come along when the time came.
Ebner put down the letter and lowered his head in thought for a moment before deciding not to go. Although Prince Edessak was rather upright behind Talim, there was no guarantee that he wouldn't be lustful enough to help the Demoness set up an ambush...
It was better to let the Forsaken One take this risk. He could just wait for the news...
With that in mind, Ebner took out a pen and paper and wrote a letter back to Cullen. After writing that he had something on Sunday and couldn't go, he described what he had seen at the funeral yesterday in detail.
After he folded the letter and put it into a new envelope, the little bird, Silica, happened to jump down from the bottle of Amantha extract. It first nodded happily at Ebner, indicating that it was satisfied. Then it picked up the letter with its beak, flapped its illusory silver wings, and disappeared.
...
North Borough, Xio and Fors's rented apartment.
Xio looked at her good friend wearing the cream-colored long dress with lotus leaves. She couldn't help but stroke her forehead and say,
"Fors, you plan on wearing this to attend the Daily Observer's ball? You need at least a gown!"
As a former noble lady, Xio knew much more about the etiquette of various occasions than Fors.
Fors looked down at herself and said in puzzlement, "There's nothing wrong with that, right? I've attended a few balls in the past, and I didn't find anything wrong with it."
"But this time, there will be an important figure attending the ball. If you do that, you will probably be strictly interrogated by MI9's security personnel... I guess you don't want to be the center of attention at the ball because of the scrutiny," Xio said as she pointed at her security uniform.
What should I do? It's too late to buy it now... Why don't I just not go? Hmm, that's a good idea. Fors frowned before her eyes lit up.
"I really don't know what to do with you..." Xio shook her head helplessly before turning to return to her room. She took out a blue and white dress with intricate lace trim from the box.
"Try this one?" Xio handed the gown to Fors.
Fors tried it on and found that although it was a little tight, it was still quite fitting. She couldn't help but ask curiously, "Why do you have a gown that matches my size?"
Xio gave her friend a complicated look and said, "That was originally a gift my father prepared for my coming-of-age ceremony when I was young..." Unfortunately, I didn't grow to the height my father expected.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: "Imagination"
chapters.content:
Chapter 118 - "Imagination"
At four o'clock in the afternoon, Ebner picked up Miss Judy, who was disguised as Roman and got into the carriage to hurry to the headquarters building of the Daily Observer.
On the way, since the carriage had been borrowed from the vampires, and the coachman had been personally made guest by Cullen, Judy had no qualms about telling Ebner about her meeting with Talim the night before.
"I used my 'Recorded Steps of Consciousness' ability to directly enter Talim's sea of consciousness. After confirming that he was fine, I got Cullen to meet him. Finally, I confirmed the meeting time with the prince behind him overnight."
Ebner was slightly surprised to hear Judy say this.
He wasn't wondering why Judy could "Record" her Beyonder powers. Ever since she revealed her Faceless powers, Ebner had guessed that she had a Beyonder item that could be from the Door pathway. Furthermore, her level shouldn't be low. Otherwise, it was impossible for her to record so many abilities that could change one's appearance.
What he was more concerned about was the Stroll of Consciousness revealed by Judy... If he didn't remember wrongly, this ability should be the core ability of a Sequence 4 Manipulator of the Spectator pathway. Based on the difficulty of recording a demigod's powers with Leymano's Travels from the Abraham family, it was likely that Judy had a demigod of the Spectator pathway or a corresponding Sealed Artifact behind her...
"What are you thinking?" Judy asked curiously, noticing that Ebner's eyes were wandering.
"I'm thinking that your plan tonight wouldn't be to use the Manipulator's Manipulation powers to directly tamper with the subconscious of Windsor Behring, who is suspected to be a Primordial Moon believer, and make her voluntarily walk into your trap after the ball, right?" Ebner snapped to his senses and guessed.
"I didn't expect your deduction to be so impressive! You guessed part of our plan from just a few words of mine... You're indeed a detective!" Judy did not hide her surprise, and her bright eyes were full of admiration.
Part of it... Which meant there were other plans? That made sense. How could an old vampire-like Cullen who had lived for hundreds of years not prepare a few backup plans...
Although he had such thoughts, Ebner deliberately said humbly, "No way. Your means are better... I heard that it's very difficult to 'record' a demigod's powers. That Beyonder item of yours is very precious."
Judy glanced at Ebner with a grin at that. "It's really hard," she said, seemingly casually. "My mother demonstrated it dozens of times to make my record successful."
From her tone, it seemed like she could tell that I was testing her? Then why did she tell me on purpose... Could it be that some big shot was using her mouth to send me a message?
With this thought in mind, Ebner, who had been reminded of his experience by a toolman who had traveled thousands of kilometers, immediately activated the Eye of Pure White. Using his logical ability that had been enhanced, he combined it with some of the original content and seriously analyzed it.
Speaking of which, the Church of Earth Mother actually has a demigod of the Spectator pathway... And I remember that Sloth, one of the councilors of the Psychology Alchemists, is in charge of Feynapotter, and she's a lady... It can't be that coincidental, right?
By the way, although the Psychology Alchemists was a subordinate organization that could not be nominated, most people in this organization did not know. Even the members of the Highest Council only knew "His" name after "He" became a god.
Could it be that Earth Mother is reminding me that the King of Angels might be paying attention to this place? But why didn't "She" directly say it?
Furthermore, most importantly, why is that person's gaze stopping in Backlund... Has "He" discovered something wrong? The butterfly effect caused by my arrival hasn't interfered with the historical process, right?
Wait a minute. On careful thought, the biggest butterfly effects I've caused in Backlund since I transmigrated are Xio and "Roy" and "Leena."
Without me, Xio wouldn't have investigated the gang that originally belonged to Lawson, and she wouldn't have attracted Roy's attention because she caught a member of the Knowledge Society and provoked Witch Leena.
After that, there would not be any reports from teachers that forced Roy and Lina to avoid the Church of Storms's arrest.
If Roy had not been forced to be too ruthless, he would not have hastily prepared the ritual to advance to the Demoness of Agony. He would not have been corrupted by the Primordial Moon believers, and he would not have been investigated by the Church of Earth Mother for stealing the Sealed Artifact...
I'm not very sure about Witch Leena, but I don't think it's simple. I don't know how she hooked up with the prince... Maybe she's the one who made the predetermined history happen.
In short, it was probably the two Demonesses who attracted the attention of that person...
And my previous requests and actions had more or less interacted with these two Demonesses, causing the effects to intertwine... Is this really a coincidence?
This is probably an existence deliberately stirring the water, causing the effects of my arrival to be concealed by Ray's performance on stage, pushing her "abnormality" in front of that person...
And now, it was very likely that Ray had crossed paths with the Primordial Moon. In that person's eyes, it was reasonable for it to affect "His" script.
Due to the lack of information, Ebner could only speculate to this point for the time being. Even so, cold sweat broke out on his forehead. Although he might be scaring himself, several similar "wild guesses" gradually became facts. He did not dare to underestimate the result of "wild guesses" enhanced by the pure White Eye's logic.
Then, the next question is... who helped me mix the water and arranged a series of coincidences?
The name of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom appeared in Ebner's mind. Excluding the evil interests of those "writers", the only one who had the ability to do such a thing was probably the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. After all, "He" might be able to directly simulate the abilities of a "writer" and arrange some coincidences. "He" might even be able to learn the abilities of a Scholar of Yore before pulling out the Dragon of Nightmare, Alzuhod, from the "Historical Projection" to help "Him work...
At this moment, a new thought surfaced in Ebner's mind. Could the mind dragon Xio had encountered in East Chester County really be the work of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom?
Yes, since "He" could pull out the historical projection of Alzuhod, and the Groselle's Travels was in the hands of "His" believers, this could completely allow the Dragon King, Ankewelt, to revive ahead of time... And Ankewelt was a very good tool dragon that attracted that person's attention. It was a perfect "scapegoat." Even the abnormal coincidences in Backlund could be blamed on "Him."
Furthermore, since the Dragon King, Ankewelt, had revived ahead of time, it was very likely that Old Master Hermes, who had been searching for "Him", knew the true identity of that person. Then, that old man's attitude might have changed...
Hmm, it was very difficult for the mysterious woman of the Tamara family to be related to the Dragon King who had long perished... However, Hermes was a true antique who had lived from the Dark Epoch until now. If he was the bridge that allowed the mysterious woman of Tamara to have a tacit understanding with the Dragon King, it would make sense...
Just as he thought of this, he felt a sharp pain in his brain, and the Eye of Pure White was shut off early.
His spirituality was about to dry up so quickly? Ebner subconsciously looked at his pocket watch and realized that only two minutes had passed. Furthermore, he had already reached the limit of 20 minutes due to the potion's digestion.
Ten times the usual expenditure? That was indeed not an ordinary "wild guess". It was more like a possible route that could be used under current conditions... What was this? A prophecy?
...
When the carriage arrived at the headquarters of the Daily Observer, the area around the five-story building had already been cordoned off. Groups of uniformed security guards guarded the perimeter and set up road cards to check on the attendees.
Most of the guests had received the news that a big shot would be present to speak, so they were not against it—at least on the surface, they did not dare to oppose it and cooperated with the security personnel's inspection.
As for MI9, who was disguised as a security guard, in order not to cause too much disgust to the guests, they also tried their best to select members with good looks to send over.
Hence, Miss Xio, who wasn't tall and didn't bring too much pressure, and who had a cute appearance, was naturally sent to the frontlines. Her mission was to register the guest's identity and use her Beyonder powers to sense if there were any auras related to evil, chaos, and madness among the guests.
As it was still early and most of the guests were still on the road, Xio was feeling a little bored when a low-key carriage stopped in front of the road card. Following that, a figure she was very familiar with and a lady alighted from the carriage.
Xio's gaze paused on the lady's arm that was wrapped around Ebner for a second before she walked forward and said expressionlessly,
"Please register your identity."

chapters.title: Chapter 119: "Thief"
chapters.content:
Chapter 119 - "Thief"
Ebner had previously mentioned to Xio that he would bring the Forsaken One to attend the Daily Observer's ball. Seeing her businesslike manner, he didn't think much of it and walked forward with Judy to register their identities.
Xio looked at Judy's signature and silently said "Roman." Then, she handed the two of them to a colleague behind her to lead them into the headquarters of the Daily Observer.
This building had a total of five floors, and the ball venue was set up in the hall on the first floor. Thus, the two of them saw rows of neatly arranged seats as soon as they entered, as well as the distinguished guests who had already arrived.
Among them, women were mainly dressed in two types. One type of dress was either gorgeous or dark, but both were bold and open. One could see a large patch of white on the chest and the arms on the sides. The other type of dress was fresh and rather conservative. Even the chain bones could be vaguely seen and were even covered.
In the Loen Kingdom, this meant the difference between a married and unmarried woman. A widow and a divorced woman could choose both types of clothing, but the former would try to have a darker color.
Apart from these, Ebner also saw glittering necklaces, exquisite earrings, and all sorts of precious accessories on the ladies. Compared to the ball held by his teacher and himself in the public dance hall, the guests here were clearly more imposing.
After entering the hall, Judy greeted Ebner and left alone to find the mission target.
Ebner, on the other hand, looked around and realized that there were very few people he knew. He only had a slight impression of the senior inspectors of the Police Department. He had seen them when he was a student of deduction working with his teacher, so he was not familiar with them.
At this moment, a voice came from the entrance. Many guests looked over and smiled as they walked over.
Ebner looked over curiously. Then he saw a middle-aged gentleman in an olive-green army officer's uniform with an orange-red ribbon and a few medals on his chest walk in with his wife.
In the Loen Kingdom, active or retired officers liked to wear military uniforms at balls.
And besides, that lady was a girl in a sky-blue dress. Her eyes were rather arrogant, and there was a hint of annoyance between her brows.
Ebner didn't recognize who it was. He only vaguely heard the people who went over say "Mr. Senator".
"That's Member of Parliament Macht. He used to serve the military and joined politics after retiring from the military. He started from Backlund and became a member of the kingdom's House of Commons. He's a believer of the Evernight Goddess and a member of the New Party. He supports the improvement of the atmosphere. Beside him is his wife, Riana. She comes from a family of lawyers and provides her husband with plenty of resources. She's also a believer of the Evernight Goddess."
At this moment, Reporter Mike walked over from behind Ebner. Seeing his confusion, he introduced him happily.
Ebner and this old friend of his who had bragged about how a famous detective had gone deep into the tiger's den to rescue a teenage girl greeted him before looking at the door again.
Member of Parliament Macht? The unlucky person whose entire family had been made into a Monocle Monster by Amon, scaring their daughter to the point of nearly losing her mind?
Then, that arrogant girl is Hazel, who was accepted as a student by the Jacob family's rat demigod?
Thinking of this, Ebner could not help but look at the young lady with dark green wavy hair and bright brown eyes. But at this moment, the young lady suspected to be Hai Rou Er suddenly turned her head back to the door and frowned slightly.
Ebner looked in the direction of her gaze and saw Fors, who was dressed in an exquisite blue and white gown with intricate lace borders, walk-in.
She was first shocked by the crowd that was blocking the door to welcome Macht. Only when she realized that these people weren't here to rush her manuscript did she heave a sigh of relief. Following that, she looked around for a while and found a long table with food before walking over briskly.
During this period, Hazel's gaze remained fixed on Fors, never leaving her.
Upon seeing this, Ebner frowned. He remembered that Hazel had a Beyonder item that could help her sense and steal something "valuable." Could she be paying so much attention to Fors because she had her eyes on the bracelet that could "travel?"
Perhaps it was because Ebner had been staring at Hazel for a long time, but this made Reporter Mike misunderstand. He smiled and patted Ebner on the shoulder. He said with a smile, "That's Member of Parliament Macht's daughter, Miss Hazel. She's a girl with high standards. Many confident gentlemen have encountered obstacles in her life. If you wish to pursue her, you have to be mentally prepared."
Ebner recovered from his shock and replied with a smile, "I can't match up to the daughter of a member of the House of Commons. Reporter Mike, you sure know how to joke."
"You can't have such a mentality. Young people need to be motivated. How can you not even dare to pursue her? Besides, you are Backlund's hero. How can you not have the courage to pursue a girl you like?" Reporter Mike was already very familiar with Ebner and could joke around, so he encouraged him with a smile.
Keep your voice down. I don't want to be in the headlines of the tabloids because of gossip... Ebner lampooned inwardly, but on the surface, he deliberately looked at Fors, who had already walked to the food area. He said to Reporter Mike beside him, "I think I have a new goal. Excuse me, Mike."
...
Fors came to a long table and reached out for her favorite desserts. However, due to the complicated structure of her gown, she tripped over the corner of her skirt...
"It's over..." Fors tried her best to adjust her center of gravity, but it was as though she had lost her balance and failed.
Seeing that she was about to collapse on the long table filled with food, Fors felt vexed. It was a small matter if she embarrassed herself, but if she ruined the gown Father Xio had left for her, it would truly be a sin. When the time came, although Xio wouldn't say anything on the surface, she would definitely feel terrible.
At this critical moment, Fors suddenly felt a strong arm wrap around her. She hurriedly used this external force to adjust her center of gravity and regain her footing.
"Thank you," Fors thanked sincerely before looking up at the person. To her surprise, she realized that Ebner had pulled her back to prevent her from embarrassing herself.
At this moment, Miss Hazel, who wasn't far away, pouted in disappointment. She stopped in her tracks.
"Ebner, why are you here?" Fors asked with widened eyes.
"Because I became a Hero, I've recently become a popular figure in the Daily Observer. Isn't it normal for me to be invited? Why didn't Xio tell you?" Ebner appeared to be joking, but he secretly signaled Fors with his eyes to let her follow him.
Fors immediately understood. Her eyes darted around as she revealed a smile. "Xio won't reveal any information about her friend unless she obtains her friend's approval."
Next, she deliberately chatted with Ebner for a while, and then they walked together to a remote corner of the hall.
Hazel, who had been paying attention to Fors, wanted to chase after the two when she saw them disappear from her sight, but her mother happened to ask her to greet other guests...
Helpless, Hazel could only brush them off. She secretly decided that when the ball began, she would invite the man to dance. No... she should wait for the man to invite her to dance without rejecting him. Then, she would casually ask him about the girl's identity.
...
On the other side, Fors, who had come to a corner, didn't have the chance to ask Ebner what urgent matters he had to discuss at the ball when she heard him say,
"Fors, you've been targeted by a thief... It's best if you switch houses with Xio when you return, lest you encounter a thief at night."

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Seed
chapters.content:
Chapter 120 - Seed
"Thief?" Upon hearing Ebner's words, although Fors was somewhat puzzled, she wasn't the kind of girl who wouldn't listen to advice. She knew very well that he wouldn't say such words for no reason.
However, after she nodded slightly to indicate that she would move away after returning, she looked at Ebner teasingly and said with a smile, "In my novel, I usually suggest girls to move to the male protagonist's house. In the end, they would move to the male protagonist's house, and then a series of interesting stories would happen... I say, Ebner, don't tell me you have the same idea?"
The premise is that I have a home. I'm still living with my teacher... As for East Borough's house... Ahem, why would I seriously consider this? It's all Fors's fault for leading me astray.
After thinking for a moment, Ebner covered his forehead and said helplessly, "That's why I said there was something wrong with the plot of your novel."
"Your actions and tone are becoming more like Xio's..." Fors covered her mouth and laughed.
Just as the two were chatting, another guest walked in from the entrance of the hall.
It was a young lady. She wore a green gown with a simple style. Other than the ring on her left hand, there were no other accessories. However, this lady had long, smooth black hair. She had a voluptuous figure and beautiful curves. Her skin that was exposed was fair and tender. It was very attractive.
However, when the men in the surroundings looked at her face, they were slightly disappointed because it was an extremely ordinary face. It couldn't be said to be ugly, but it definitely wouldn't be associated with beauty, causing many interested gazes to instantly withdraw.
However, there was still a gaze on the lady, and the source of the wooden gaze was Hazel.
Hazel never expected that she would encounter guests with "treasures" one after another at an ordinary ball. However, she didn't act rashly this time. She wanted to wait until the ball began before acting.
The lady in simple clothes didn't seem to notice Hazel's magnanimity. She calmly circled around Macht and company and headed for the bathroom on the right side of the hall. Only when Hazel retracted her gaze did she reveal a teasing smile.
...
Outside the Daily Observer building, Xio had just registered the information for a guest when she saw a carriage with a black exterior and a curtain inside the window drive over. There was a coat of arms at a prominent spot in the carriage. The coat of arms was made of a vertical sword with a red crown at the hilt.
This... Sword of Judgment... The Sword of Judgment represents the royal family's Augustus family? As a former noble lady, heraldry was an essential course, so Xio immediately recognized what the badge represented.
So the important figure here is actually a member of the Augustus family... I wonder which prince or princess it is. As Xio thought this, she wanted to stop the carriage with her colleagues for inspection.
However, her actions were stopped by her superior, who allowed the carriage to pass by the road card.
"We're doing security here because we have to protect him... him. Naturally, there's no need to check."
...
Prince Edessak stepped from the carriage under the guard of his steward, Finkl. He studied the headquarters building of the Daily Observer with interest, thinking that this new building was indeed different in structure from his old-fashioned estate.
Then, just as he was about to greet the shareholders who had been waiting for him, he saw a middle-aged man wearing a modified captain's hat walk over.
Finkel, the butler, immediately stepped forward and stopped the visitor. Then he took off his hat and pressed it to his chest. He bowed in the most standard manner and asked, "Captain Kuhn, what would you like to do?"
"I'm sorry, Your Highness... but I have something to ask of you."
The person who came was none other than Captain Kuhn of the Backlund Mandated Punishers. His expression was very solemn, and although his words were humble, his tone was very unyielding.
"Captain Kuhn, His Highness is about to attend the ball. How about I make an appointment for you to meet him after it's over?" Butler Finkl smiled politely.
"What I'm about to say is related to the ball!" Captain Kuhn didn't seem to be in the mood to argue with the butler as he looked directly at Prince Edessak.
The prince frowned, but then relaxed and said with a smile, "Let him come over, Finkle. As a believer of the Lord, I believe in the Mandated Punishers who promote the Lord's power in the mortal world."
"As you wish, Your Highness." Finkler turned and bowed before stepping aside to allow Captain Kuhn to step forward.
"Thank you for giving me a chance to speak, Your Highness." Kuhn first bowed and then went straight to the point.
"The Church had previously used a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact to divine that the mastermind behind the repeated attacks on the Lord in East Borough, Bridge Borough, and the dock area will also appear at this ball. We believe that the villain's target might be you... Therefore, I request that you allow me and my team members to hide among your followers. If there's any danger, we can deal with it in time."
Upon hearing this, Butler Feinkel immediately interrupted, "Your Highness, since there's danger, I think it's better to leave this place immediately... You have a noble status, so there's no need to put yourself in danger."
The captain of the Mandated Punishers, Kuhn, frowned and wondered if the villain would not come if the prince left. However, he could not interfere with the prince's decision. He could only wait and see.
Prince Edessak's eyes flashed. After a long while, he shook his head and said, "No, since I've made a promise to Mr. Pierre and Mr. Lalu, I can't go back on my words. Otherwise, the Daily Observer's ball today will become a joke in the industry. I can't embarrass my friends like this."
He paused and looked at Captain Kuhn. "And I believe that the Mandated Punishers of the Lord will ensure my safety."
"Don't worry, Your Highness... Although it was sudden, we were prepared," Captain Kuhn said confidently.
At the same time, the coachman, Cullen, who had parked the carriage two streets away, looked at the headquarters of the Daily Observer from afar and frowned slightly.
"This atmosphere doesn't feel right..." The more he looked, the more depressed he felt. He took out a mirror and prayed to the Ancestor to perform mirror divination.
Then, Cullen's expression changed slightly. He hurriedly summoned his messenger, Silica, and hurriedly wrote two letters before handing them to her. He said solemnly, "Silica, hand this one to the captain, and send the other to my parents at the vampire encampment. Try to be quick."
Silika nodded and picked up the letter. She flapped her silver illusory wings and disappeared.
...
In the ball hall, as the most distinguished guests entered, everyone, including Macht, turned to face the youth who was slowly walking over under the butler's lead. They bowed respectfully and said,
"Good evening, Prince Edessak."
Edessak? The important personage that the Forsaken Ones mentioned to attend the ball is actually the third prince... Speaking of which, several of the things I've encountered recently have something to do with this prince. Is it a coincidence? Or is he involved with some Demoness again?
Sigh, ever since I "let my imagination run wild" in the carriage, I always feel like everything is "arranged"...
Ebner shook his head and stopped thinking about such trivial matters. As he enjoyed the delicacies on the long table with Fors, he listened to the prince's speech.
"Thank you for coming..." Prince Edessak, who was standing on the second floor and looking down, first said a few polite words before saying, "The sales of our ball stemmed from the Daily Observer surpassing the Tussock Times in all aspects last week, becoming the third-largest newspaper in the kingdom's sales volume. Let us cheer for this impressive result and toast to this impressive achievement...
"I hereby announce that in my personal name, I will invest 3,000 pounds in the Daily Observer..."
So the prince was here to invest... What was this? Control a media company and prepare a voice channel for himself?
Ebner only pondered for a moment before putting this matter aside. It was none of his business anyway.
After the ball officially began, Ebner and Fors, who were almost full, invited each other to the first dance to digest their food.
This left Hazel, who had been paying attention to them, somewhat peeved. Seeing that the two of them had no intention of stopping, she looked around before her eyes lit up. This was because she saw that the lady who she had previously sensed was sitting alone in a corner beside the bathroom. No man had invited her to dance.
Hazel's eyes darted around as she requested her mother to make a trip to the bathroom before walking towards the lady.
...
The so-called ordinary lady in a simple dress was none other than Demoness of Afflictions, Ray. After changing her appearance, she used the identity and invitation that Berna had prepared for her when she was alive to sneak into the ball venue. Then, she discovered many interesting things.
"Mother's believer is also here... However, her condition doesn't seem right. My little fellow told me that she seems to have some mental problems... I shouldn't rashly greet her, lest I attract trouble.
The Mandated Punishers are actually here... Heh heh, that Captain is also here. From the looks of it, they have indeed used that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact! After using it a few more times, the accumulated negative effects won't be easily sealed. When that happens, it will attract those who are coveting it, and it will be time for me to take action.
There's also Miss Thief who has designs on me... Heh heh, perhaps I can use her today.
With this in mind, Ray looked at Hazel, who was walking towards him, and a brilliant smile appeared on his face. Even though this face was very ordinary, it still stunned Hazel, who had just walked up to him.
However, Hazel quickly recovered herself and pretended to trip as she fell into Ray's arms.
Ray's eyes narrowed and he reached out to steady her.
"Sorry, Ma'am." Hazel pretended to panic as she got up and apologized 'sincerely'.
"It's okay, young lady." Ray smiled and nodded.
Hazel didn't dare stay any longer as she pretended to hide in the bathroom in embarrassment.
Then, she stretched out her palm and focused.
It was an emerald green seed.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Response
chapters.content:
Chapter 121 - Response
"Just a seed?" Hazel held the stolen seed in her hand and repeatedly checked it, but she didn't find anything special about it. All she could do was put it in her pocket and ask her teacher when she returned.
Patting her face in the bathroom mirror, Hazel's excitement over her successful theft gradually faded. While feeling somewhat ashamed, she cheered herself on.
"Hazel, you have to work hard. In order to act better, you have to abandon the shame of stealing items... Stealing someone else's item isn't something a lady should do... But Teacher said that Beyonder items are more dangerous in the hands of ordinary people. It's very likely to cause the wielder to lose his life... What I'm doing is considered saving someone."
After mentally preparing herself, Hazel walked out of the bathroom and realized that the lady who had been sitting nearby was gone. She didn't mind it either, thinking that the lady had been invited to a dance by a man.
When Hazel returned to her parents, she recalled the couple she had just paid attention to. Hence, she began looking around the venue... She realized that the two had returned to the long table after leaving the dance floor. They continued eating and chatting. The man had even gone to get two plates of ice cream. He had no intention of inviting her to dance.
Hazel waited for a while, but when she saw that he still didn't move, she couldn't help but feel puzzled. That person had clearly looked at her for a while before the ball. Could it be that he didn't even dare to try and retreat? That was too cowardly.
With this in mind, Hazel couldn't hold it in any longer. She greeted her mother again and made an excuse that she was going to eat something. After obtaining permission, she walked along the long table to get food while walking towards Ebner and Fors.
On the other side, although Ebner had been chatting with Fors, his attention was actually focused on Hazel. Previously, he had secretly heaved a sigh of relief when he saw her get up to head to the bathroom. Now, he realized that she was coming for the two of them. Knowing that he couldn't avoid her, he secretly pointed at Hazel and said to Fors, "The 'thief' who has her eyes on you is coming."
"Thief?" Upon hearing that, Fors curiously looked in the direction Ebner was pointing in. Following that, she saw a girl in a sky-blue dress walking over with a plate of desserts.
"Ebner, are you sure this is a thief? Why do I feel like she's richer than me?" Fors turned her head and asked in puzzlement.
"Beyonder Sequences have nothing to do with one's identity... What she likes is the treasure on you." Ebner didn't mention the bracelet. After all, this wasn't a safe place.
However, Fors quickly understood what Ebner meant. Her heart palpitated as she immediately became extremely wary.
Just as Hazel pretended to be searching for her favorite dessert and was getting closer to the two of them, the Eye of Pure White suddenly activated on its own and transmitted some information to Ebner.
The last time this uncontrollable activation had happened was when Klein had relied on Sefirah Castle to divine him. Therefore, Ebner placed great importance on this and instantly received the information.
The aura of the Primordial Moon... So the last time I was in Backtrack, I was extremely afraid of the moonlight in that scene. Therefore, the Unknown Lands connected to the White Eye had the corresponding information of the Primordial Moon. Only after encountering it would they warn me...
Hazel actually has the Primordial Moon's aura on her. Isn't she a student of the Jacob family's demigod? Why is she related to the Primordial Moon... Could it be that she stole from that big shot?
Ebnerton had a headache, but he didn't have the time to explain. He pulled Fors up and turned to leave. He even jogged after Fors gradually caught up.
Hazel stared blankly at the two fleeing Ebner with her plate in hand. She couldn't believe her eyes. When had she become so unattractive and unpopular? She'd actually run away at the sight of her? That was ungentlemanly, wasn't it?
The other guests also frowned at Ebner's jogging behavior at the ball venue, but when they saw that he was dragging a beautiful lady with him, they were relieved. They thought that the two of them had taken a liking to each other and were busy discussing life and dreams in private places.
Ebner couldn't care less. After pulling Fors away from Hazel, the two of them had almost reached the entrance of the hall.
Ebner looked a little conflicted. This was because he guessed that the Primordial Moon's aura wouldn't appear for no reason. There was a high chance that something would go wrong with this ball, and as long as he left now, he should be able to avoid this crisis.
But Ebner looked at the many guests in the venue and remembered that his friend Mike was still inside and Miss Judy had not left. Even Hugh was on duty outside the building. She could also be in danger...
At the thought of this, Ebner made up his mind and came up with a preliminary plan. He felt that although it might be dangerous, it should still be within his control.
He took a deep breath and said to Fors, who was still in a daze, "Leave this place as soon as possible. The further the better! If you encounter Xio at Luke's side, get her to find an excuse to leave this building."
Fors snapped to her senses when she heard that. Seeing how serious Ebner was, she couldn't help but ask worriedly, "Aren't you leaving? After finding Xio, I can 'Travel' to bring the two of you far away from here."
Because I have a feeling that if I leave now, the hidden danger in the ball will immediately erupt. At that time, not only will it be even more dangerous, but my friends might not even survive...
This feeling should be a "prophecy." It doesn't come from me or the White Eye's "prophecy." It's more like the feeling I had before my teacher took me in as a student... This is an "interference" from the upper echelons of the Reader Sequence... Perhaps this "interference" will leave some traces behind. Even as a deity, I don't wish to use it too much to prevent other "omniscient" from noticing it.
From the looks of it, it's really the God of Knowledge and Wisdom making "arrangements"...What's the reason this time? Yes, if the Primordial Moon really corrupts this place, then Prince Edessak definitely won't be able to escape. When the time comes, George III will probably have to choose someone else to take the blame. But that way, the Church of the Three Gods might not be satisfied after the Great Smog...
Such an outcome had indeed slightly interfered with the plan of the other party. Although it had nothing to do with the overall situation, it was enough for "Him" to spare a portion of "His" energy to check what the problem was.
And the corruption of the Primordial Moon should've come from the Demoness of Pain... The God of Knowledge and Wisdom's "arrangement" might very well be to blame the Demoness and the Primordial Moon for disturbing the progress of history, allowing that person to obtain a relatively reasonable answer. This would reduce the intensity of his observation of Backlund and even Loen. Only then would "He" be able to hide "His" little actions and also conceal my existence.
Of course, this was just my guess. As for what the gods were planning, I still couldn't guess.
As these thoughts raced through his mind, Ebner sighed and said to the worried Fors, "I still have some things to do. If only I could prevent a tragedy from happening."
"Alright..." Seeing that his tone was firm, Fors stopped persuading him and only said, "The 'heroes' in your story will return triumphantly. I believe you can do the same."
Triumph and return well. Fortunately, I didn't go back to my hometown to get married... Ebner secretly complained about Salted Fish's flag insertion, but he still nodded on the surface, indicating that he was definitely fine.
Since the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had invested in me for so long and took the risk to give me a "prophecy" just now, there was no reason for him to "clear the warehouse" so quickly... Therefore, the danger this time should be "controllable".
Furthermore, even if I encounter corruption, I still have a backup plan to pray to The Fool!
After figuring out some of the inner connections, Ebner was even more determined. After sending Fors out the door, he himself returned to the dance hall, trying his best to avoid Hazel. He found Miss Judy, who had been alone since before the ball began, and invited her to dance.
"Roman, something went wrong at the ball. I discovered the Primordial Moon's aura... I suspect that the Demoness has been here before," Ebner whispered to Judy in between dances.
Judy jumped at the sound, and her feet gave way, and she almost stepped on Ebner's foot with her high heels.
However, she was, after all, an elite Forsaken One who had handled many cases. Even though she was still young and ruthless, she quickly adjusted herself. After some thought, she understood Ebner's thoughts and asked, "You wish to report this to Prince Edessak? In the name of the Mother Goddess's believers?"
"That's right. As a Forsaken, you didn't report this arresting operation. You even used a fake identity to sneak into the ball venue. Now, the one who reported is related to the Primordial Moon, so it's not suitable for you to appear... So I'm the only one who went," Ebner said with a sigh. In fact, he didn't want to appear himself either, but he was the one who brought Judy in. Even if he got Judy to expose her, she would eventually find out about him... In that case, it was better to take the initiative to reduce suspicion.
"But... won't the God of Knowledge and Wisdom have a problem with that?" Judy looked as if she knew all about Ebner and was a little shocked at his" blasphemy" behavior.
"It should be... fine, right?" Ebner said after a moment of hesitation. At least he had never been warned.
"Alright, when I contacted Prince Edessak about the meeting location yesterday, I was talking to his butler... In a while, I'll use my recorded 'Mind Steps' ability to communicate with him in advance... After all, it's not easy for you to meet the prince," Judy said after some thought.
After the song ended, Ebner and Judy left the dance floor. The latter sat down on a nearby chair and closed her eyes as if she was resting.
After a moment Jean opened his eyes slowly and nodded to Ebner, who had been waiting nearby.
Ebner then took a deep breath and walked towards the second-floor stairwell guarded by numerous bodyguards.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Seal
chapters.content:
Chapter 122 - Seal
Seeing Ebner arrive at the stairwell, the security guard was just about to step forward to interrogate him when a meticulously dressed middle-aged gentleman happened to walk down from the second floor... He was Prince Edessak's butler, Mr. Funkel.
"This Mr. Bryan is a guest of His Highness's. You may ask him to come here." Funkel stood at the top of the stairs and glanced at Ebner before instructing the security guard.
Hearing that, the security guard made way for Ebner to enter the stairwell.
Ebner stole a glance at the butler and saw that he was wearing a snow-white shirt with a thick grayish-blue vest on the outside. His long tailcoat was well-defined and flawless.
He looked like a professional butler, but Ebner had no intention of underestimating him.
Back then, although there was no description of this butler taking action, Trissy, who held a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact and was at least a Demoness of Pleasure, was extremely afraid of him before the Great Smog happened. She even described him as "terrifying."
After the old butler forced Prince Edessak to commit suicide, he was personally wiped off by the Evernight Goddess's God's Descent Vessel. From this, it could be seen that his strength was extraordinary.
And in the aftermath of the Church of Steam's investigation, he was listed alongside the name of 'Desperate Nightingale' Panatiya!
This was very likely a demigod! Even if he wasn't, he was at least a very powerful Sequence 5... It was unknown which pathway he was from.
Ebner pondered as he followed the butler to a living room on the second floor.
After another body search, Ebner finally saw the prince in a white gown.
Prince Edessak had a round face and a pair of narrow eyes, but he wasn't solemn at all. Instead, he wore a smile the entire time. He looked at Ebner, who was led in by the butler, and said with a smile,
"Finally seeing you, Detective Bryan."
"Hello, Your Highness. I didn't know that you were the one who asked Talim to look for me." Ebner bowed.
"I also didn't expect you to become a 'hero' of Backlund... Heh heh, speaking of which, the sales of the Daily Observer exploded last week because of your interview." Prince Edessak teased with a smile before he restrained his expression and continued, "Of course, what I didn't expect was that Detective Bryan was actually related to the Church of Earth Mother."
As soon as he said that, a middle-aged man wearing a modified captain's hat standing behind the prince suddenly looked serious and scrutinized Ebner. He had originally thought that the prince had only wanted to summon a "famous detective" at the last minute, but he did not expect the other party to have such a background.
Ebner naturally felt this gaze as well... To be precise, he had noticed this man who did not look like he was here for the ball.
From his clothes, he should be a Mandated Punisher... Thankfully, I'm representing the Church of Earth Mother to make a report. If I were still wearing the identity of the Church of Knowledge, I might've been taken down on the spot.
Despite feeling relieved, Ebner didn't look at the man on the surface. Instead, he said to Prince Edessak with a serious expression, "Your Highness, I came to see you because I discovered a terrifying matter at the ball... If it isn't handled properly, it might result in major casualties!"
Prince Edessak raised his eyebrows. Before he could ask what was going on, the middle-aged man behind him asked, "What did you discover?"
Ebner did not answer directly. He turned his attention to the prince.
Prince Edessak frowned and felt a little displeased, but he quickly adjusted his expression and smiled. "This is the Mandated Punisher of the Lord, Captain Kuhn. Detective Bryan, you don't have to worry."
Yes, of course, I won't have any concerns. It's better to tell the Mandated Punishers than to tell you. After all, once you understand the severity of the problem, you might just run away with your people, but the Mandated Punishers won't... because they are guardians.
"I discovered that Member of Parliament Macht's daughter, Miss Hazel, has a very strong Primordial Moon aura... If we don't handle it quickly, there might be an unforeseen event at the ball." Ebner briefly described the matter. He believed that with the Mandated Punishers' expertise, they wouldn't be unaware of the seriousness of the Primordial Moon.
"Primordial Moon... Are you sure?" Captain Kuhn's expression changed as he hurriedly asked.
"I'm very sure that it's the Primordial Moon! Besides, Miss Hazel should've been used. There must be another mastermind behind this matter..." Following that, Ebner didn't hide anything and revealed all the information he could, including the possibility that Hazel was a Beyonder of the Marauder pathway.
Captain Kuhn nodded and said, "I believe that the Church of Earth Mother is very professional in dealing with the Primordial Moon..."
With that said, he turned his head to look at Prince Edessak, who still had a blank look on his face. He pleaded, "The Primordial Moon is a dangerous evil god. Since 'He' brought 'His' aura to this ball, 'He' must have some ulterior motive... Your Highness, although the Sealed Artifact we brought can split space, its effects are unable to completely isolate the influence of an evil god... I implore you to get Mr. Finkel to take action and protect most of the ordinary people below."
Although Prince Edessak didn't know what the Primordial Moon was, seeing how serious the captain of the Mandated Punishers was, he knew the seriousness of the matter. He first said, "I understand." Then, he asked his butler, "Finkle, many of the people below are my friends and partners. I don't wish for anything to happen to them."
"My first task is to protect you, Your Highness," the old butler replied clearly, but when he saw that the prince was also looking at him with a determined expression, he hesitated for a moment and continued, "If I still have time, I'll take care of the guests."
Only then did Prince Edessak smile. He first whispered a few words to Kuhn before looking at Ebner and saying sincerely,
"Mr. Bryan, while the news you bring is not pleasant, it is timely. Perhaps tonight you will be a 'hero' again."
"I'd rather not be a 'hero'. I'll just treat it as attending an ordinary ball..." Ebner said with a wry smile.
...
In the ballroom, Hazel was stunned for a moment by Ebner's sudden escape. Then she angrily threw down her food plate and returned to her parents.
At that moment, a gentleman who had been courting her for quite some time came over to invite her to dance. However, Hazel, who was in a bad mood, rejected him flatly. Her words were so direct that they hurt him, making him lose face.
This made Mrs. Macht, who had always valued family upbringing, very angry. She called her daughter to the side and reprimanded her in a low voice.
Hazel, who was already upset, became even angrier at the reprimand. She decided that she would definitely find out the identity of the man who fled the moment she saw him. Then she would teach him a lesson.
But at that moment, Hazel suddenly felt her heart palpitate before she became clear-headed and rational. All her frustration vanished.
At this moment, she clearly knew that she was no longer in the real world!
She looked around in a daze and realized that the gentleman in the tuxedo on the left was still inviting an impatient lady to dance. He had two daughters, and a declining noble lady in a light blue dress was doing her best to introduce her daughter to a rich businessman. Beside her, someone was holding a tray and eating the ice cream provided by the ball... Everything was no different from before.
However, Hazel was even more afraid of this scene. She secretly activated her Spirit Vision and realized that none of the passengers emitted the corresponding aura colors or emotions!
They did not have Ether Bodies!
They were clearly talking, inviting dancers, and eating ice cream, but there was no sign of them being alive!
Is this an illusion, or have they suddenly died? The more Hazel thought about it, the more horrified she became. She hurriedly turned her head to look at her parents, only to discover that they were identical to the others she had seen. They didn't look like living people at all!
Hazel was at a loss as she ran around the ball, hoping to discover something. However, she was still too inexperienced and didn't understand what had happened to her.
At that moment, her heart stirred and she took out the emerald green seed from her pocket.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Opening
chapters.content:
Chapter 123 - Opening
"McConnell, go to the exit and wait there... You should know where it is. No matter what, you have to guard the only exit. You can't let the Primordial Moon's aura leak out.
"Matthew, Robert, lies an ambush near Miss Hazel later. Once there's an anomaly, activate the Lightning Charm in your hands immediately. Don't be stingy."
...
On the second floor of the venue, Captain Kuhn of the Mandated Punishers finished giving out tasks to his team members in an orderly manner. He took a deep breath and took out a small metal box with many inscriptions engraved on it.
Ebner glanced at it from a distance and saw that the box had at least the inscriptions of the Sun and Tyrant domain on it.
Using the power of the domain related to The Sun to seal it... This Sealed Artifact is probably one of the more sinister ones...
Ebner had just thought of this when he saw Kuhn take a black eyeball the size of a goose egg from the box, its surface gleaming with a mysterious light.
This eyeball had no pupils. It was pitch-black like a moonless night, carrying an indescribable heaviness and pressure.
If not for the fact that there were a few illusory "eyelashes" flapping in the air above the eyeball, Ebner would have regarded it as a special black gem.
Wait? Flapping eyelashes? Is this eyeball alive?
Ebner stirred. He was about to observe more to confirm his theory when he realized Captain Kuhn had closed his eyes. Then he placed the black eyeball between his eyebrows.
As this action was completed, the first two levels of the ball venue were suddenly isolated from the outside world, forming an independent and strange space. Although the people and items on these two levels had been completely preserved, Ebner could clearly feel that they were just illusions and counterfeit items. Those who truly entered this space were people or objects with extraordinary spirituality.
The isolated space here seems to have the ability to absorb all kinds of extreme emotions... My current state is comparable to using the Mechanical Mind...
Standing in the corridor on the second floor and looking down from above, Ebner saw several Beyonders among the guests. They first looked around in surprise before quickly pretending not to notice anything. As they continued to cooperate with the phantom, they slowly moved towards the entrance of the venue.
Amongst them, only Miss Hazel's actions were like the light in the night, extremely eye-catching. Her flustered appearance made her look like a standard rookie, causing a nearby Beyonder who was pretending to be an illusion to conceal herself so as to avoid being implicated by her.
This was clearly a problem. Even if she was extremely afraid, in this space, her "fear" emotions would probably be immediately sucked away. She should've long recovered her calm... Could the Primordial Moon's aura help her resist the effects of the Sealed Artifact?
Ebner could imagine that the Mandated Punishers who had used this Sealed Artifact countless times naturally knew better. At this point, Kuhn had completely believed in Ebner's previous report... This Miss Hazel was indeed very suspicious.
Just as the two members of the Mandated Punishers stealthily moved towards Hazel, preparing to restrain her, the lady suddenly took out an emerald-green seed from her pocket.
The moment the seed appeared, Ebner, Kuhn, and the other Mandated Punishers felt their spirituality frantically warning them, as though the seed itself was extremely dangerous.
And Hazel, who was holding the seed, was the same. The moment she sensed the spirituality warning, she was completely dumbfounded, as though she couldn't believe that she had brought such a dangerous item with her.
At that moment, a "wind blade" appeared out of thin air, directly severing Hazel's arm that was holding the "seed." Almost at the same time, a monster made of mud suddenly appeared from beneath Hazel's feet. It hugged her body and quickly retreated to the right corner of the dance hall.
The person who used the Wind Blade was naturally Ebner. With the support of the White Eye's level, he was the first to recover from the horror of the spirituality warning. He immediately severed the direct connection between the "seed" and Hazel.
Although he didn't know if Hazel could still be saved, if she were to keep holding onto the seed, there was probably no chance of saving her.
The mud monster that followed was the Earth Fiend Statue summoned by Judy. It was the work of an Ancient Alchemist, and it was probably something her father had given her to defend herself.
Come to think of it, Ebner hadn't been able to locate Miss Judy until now. Apparently, she'd used some kind of record high-level ability to hide herself completely.
"Earth Fiend Statue? It looks like Detective Bryan's status in the Church of Earth Mother isn't low. You actually obtained a defensive item bestowed by a demigod," a young Mandated Punisher standing beside Ebner said sourly when he saw this scene.
This Mandated Punisher's name was Evan. He was one of the people Captain Kuhn had arranged to "protect" Ebner... Although Ebner didn't feel that he needed the protection of a Sequence 7 Seafarer.
Is this a misunderstanding? Heh, looks like in the eyes of others in the future, I also have a backer? Although Ebner was complaining in his heart, he had no intention of explaining. Judy was not suitable to be exposed now, so he could only take the blame.
And at this moment, an anomaly happened again. After the arm holding the "seed" landed on the ground, it quickly turned into a ball of blood and was absorbed by the seed.
Then, the emerald green seed actually completed the whole process of sprouting, growing, blooming, and bearing fruit within a second!
As a crimson fruit that looked like a crimson moon fell to the ground, a cry was heard by everyone present. The two Mandated Punishers, who were about to throw out their charms, suddenly fell to the ground, hugging their heads and rolling around.
As for Hazel, who had lost a lot of blood due to her arm being severed, she grunted and fainted.
Ebner could still tolerate it because of the White Eye, so he saw something that made his scalp tingle.
A human head grew out of the fruit! It was only a skull at first, then it filled with flesh and blood. Then, it grew hair and gradually formed facial features...
Although the entire process seemed to be the evolution of life, the evilness in it made people shudder. This was because Ebner could clearly see that the so-called bones, flesh, hair, and face were all formed by the red blood spurting out from the fruit!
When the head that grew out of the fruit finally took shape, everyone looked at his face. Evan, who was beside Ebner, had just gotten rid of the influence of the cry when he exclaimed, "Lieutenant Berner?! How could that be?"
Lieutenant Berner? This seems to be the MI9 official who advocated investigating Xio... Why is he here? And in this form? Could it be Ray's work again?
Ebner narrowed his eyes and looked at Captain Kuhn, who had his eyes closed the whole time, thinking, "The Mandated Punishers are outstanding in frontal combat, but it seems that they don't have enough means to deal with such matters..."
Just as he was thinking this, he saw the two members of the Mandated Punishers downstairs finally activate their charms. Tiny electric snakes instantly formed and leaped towards the fruit that had just grown a head. In the blink of an eye, they climbed up the mouth and nose of the head.
Crack! Crack!
With a series of clicks, Lieutenant Berner's hair stood on end, and the facial features on his head seemed to be distorted in pain.
"All of you are going to die!" Lieutenant Berner seemed to have regained some consciousness from being electrocuted. He actually spoke strangely.
When the two experienced Mandated Punishers heard this, they knew that it wasn't good. They immediately used Wind-Blessed's "flying" ability and flew backward at high speed.
Almost at the same time, the flower that grew out of the seed revealed a hideous mouthpart that was full of teeth and bit the spot where the two Mandated Punishers were standing.
It was as if a thousand-kilogram hammer had smashed into the ground, shaking the entire space.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 124: A Crazy and Chaotic World
chapters.content:
Chapter 124 - A Crazy and Chaotic World
When the blooming blood flower hit the ground, the entire space shook. A drop of blood flowed out from the "corner of" eye "on Captain Kuhn's forehead. Its color was exactly the same as the fruit...
The drop of blood only appeared for an instant before vanishing. If Ebner hadn't activated the Eye of Pure White to observe the entire situation, he wouldn't have noticed it at all.
Ebner frowned and was about to remind them, but at that moment, the flowers and fruits with Lieutenant Bellner's face in the hall on the first floor went completely mad because they hadn't killed the two Wind-blessed.
It controlled the stem of the flower to sweep everywhere, not even sparing the illusory guests. This made some of the Beyonders who were pretending to be illusory suffer immediately.
After being struck by the flower stem, not only would his body suffer heavy injuries, but even his mind would feel as though there were electric currents running through it, forming a barbed whip that constantly lashed at his soul. This was a result of Lieutenant Bellner's powers as an Interrogator. He had also been corrupted and mutated by the Primordial Moon's aura.
The two Wind-blessed who were flying in midair naturally wouldn't stand by idly when they saw this. One of them took out a mirror and released "Fire of Light" in an attempt to burn the blood-colored flower.
The other wore a red glove with crystal lenses. Immediately after, he condensed a blazing white flame spear in his palm and threw it at Berner.
Berner and the flower, who were almost unable to move, were immediately struck. Golden illusory flames that emitted the majestic aura of the sunburned their bodies to their hearts' content. As the flaming spear approached them, crimson flames suddenly appeared.
The golden and red flames complemented each other, forcing the giant blood-red flower to swing its stem violently in an attempt to extinguish the flames. The fruit with Belna's head rolled on the ground, looking rather comical.
However, although they looked like they were in pain from the burning, and Berner was screaming non-stop... In fact, the effects of the flames and holy aura were not ideal. Their auras did not weaken much.
However, the attacks of the two Wind-blessed had given the Beyonder guests who had been swept into the battlefield a chance to catch their breath. They immediately endured the pain and ran to the edge of the hall as fast as they could. Two of them were too heavily injured and had lost their mobility. With the help of Judy's Earth Demon Statue, they moved to the vicinity of Hazel.
...
Outside the headquarters of the Daily Observer, Xio stood beside the road card and turned to look at the five-story building not far away. Through the glass window, although she could still see the lights and shadows inside, her eyes were filled with worry.
The words that Fors had relayed to Ebner when she came out, together with the martial law order that MI9 had just issued, made her understand that something had definitely happened at the ball.
Just as she was about to find someone to beat up, she suddenly felt the light around her dim. The rare bright crimson moonlight had disappeared.
Xio couldn't help but look up, and her eyes widened in shock. This was because a huge shadow had appeared above the building, covering the moon like a curtain.
...
In the isolated space, Captain Kuhn saw that the effects of the Fire of Light were gradually fading, and the Wind-blessed's attacks didn't hurt Belna at all. Although Captain Kuhn's face was still calm, he had made up his mind.
He decided to use the Holy Artifact he had contracted. Even if it was because the contract time was too short and he didn't have a "tacit understanding" with the Holy Artifact of the Church, using it now would definitely result in a greater mental corruption...
"The Primordial Moon's aura has weakened!" A deliberate cry of surprise reached his ears. It was the voice of the detective related to the Church of Earth Mother.
