When Kuhn heard this, he suddenly stopped what he was about to do. He carefully sensed through the black eyeball on his forehead and found that Berna's aura was indeed much weaker than before. Even the wound that was burned by the last bit of Light Fire did not recover.
Although he didn't know why the other party suddenly acted like this, since the opportunity had appeared, he had to seize it.
Without his reminder, the two experienced Wind-blessed immediately activated the Sealed Artifacts in their hands after hearing Ebner's words.
A bright pillar of light wrapped in holy flames and crimson fire ravens descended from midair, enveloping the huge flower beside him and Berner.
For the Mandated Punishers, such a large target with no mobility was the best fixed target. If it were not for its strong survival and recovery abilities, they would not have been so passive.
Under the illumination of the fire crows and the holy light beam, the flowers and fruits that had lost the support of external forces quickly disintegrated, as if they had encountered snow that burned red iron balls.
Amidst an indescribable buzzing sound, Berner's distorted face turned even more hideous, appearing abnormally painful.
He drove the fruit around with difficulty, jumping up and down, his expression gradually becoming frightened and confused. Then, these emotions were quickly sucked away by space, allowing him to regain his calmness.
It was only at this moment that he finally realized that his condition was not right.
"Where is this..." Lieutenant Berner's voice trembled slightly. He struggled to raise his eyes to look ahead, but he only saw two cold-faced Wind-blessed.
The one named Robert among the two Wind-blessed likely knew Berner, so he stopped his actions of activating the Sealed Artifact. He only sighed and asked calmly,
"Berner, why do you believe in the Primordial Moon?"
From his point of view, the other party came from a good background and was also an officer of MI9. He definitely had to be wary of dangerous knowledge. To be in his present state, it was either because he was involved in a cult or because of some dangerous item that had colluded with an existence that couldn't be looked at directly. Regardless of which one it was, he was definitely the one who initiated the trouble.
At this moment, Berner vaguely recalled something. With only his head left, he suddenly widened his eyes and said,
"Yes, it's the Demoness of Affliction. It's a flower formed from moonlight...
"This is not the choice of the times... I don't want to die, I don't want to die!
"Lord! Save me! Save me!"
As he spoke, his voice gradually fell, and his consciousness became unclear once more.
Sure enough, the Demoness of Affliction was behind this... but what was she planning? The monster placed in the ball venue was terrifying, but its weakness was too obvious. It could not be moved, and it lacked strange means. Apart from its terrifying appearance, which could cause a riot, it had no value... Ebner's expression did not change when he heard Lieutenant Berner's last words, but his eyes were filled with doubt.
The Wind-blessed named Robert fell silent for a few seconds before pointing the mirror at him again. He said in a deep voice,
"I hope that the benevolent Lord will forgive your separation."
Another bright and pure beam of light descended. The remains of Bellner's head and flower melted at a speed visible to the naked eye, disappearing and obtaining the final purification.
Ebner watched the scene calmly. For a long time, there was no change in expression or movement.
Then, he cast his gaze on the unconscious Hazel and the other injured Beyonder guests. The corners of his mouth curled up as he let out a bitter chuckle.
"I previously warned Jane about the danger of Beyonders...
I've also warned her about the dangers and terrors of the sea...
"But after traveling for so long... I only realized it now...
"This crazy and chaotic world..."
...
In a dark room not far from the Daily Observer building, Ray, who had recovered her charming face, held a flower pot and looked at the huge shadow that blocked the moonlight in the sky. He frowned and muttered to himself,
The Church of Earth Mother's wish came so quickly? From the looks of it, it was done by a Shaman King... This way, I can't delay the progress between the Captain and the Holy Artifact...
Thankfully, I've already achieved the most basic goal. I used a portion of the branch that the baby split off to secretly contaminate the Sealed Artifact... Yes, the Captain's mind should be affected as well. It's impossible for him to have such a tacit understanding with a Holy Artifact in a short period of time.
"The PellSinger of God is probably arriving soon. I have to leave as soon as possible."
After she finished speaking, her body did not melt into the shadows. Instead, she turned into a wisp of crimson moonlight and disappeared in a flash.
...
The shadow above the building dissipated, and the crimson light sprinkled on the ground again. On a carriage two streets away, Cullen, who was pretending to be the coachman, said helplessly,
"Mother, since you're already here, there's no need to hide, right?"
"It seems you've grown quite a bit recently. You can actually sense my arrival." A pleasant voice sounded in the air, but Cullen still didn't see the figure he was hoping to see.
"The SpellSinger of God is about to arrive. Although I was forced to join the orthodox Churches, Earth Mother isn't an orthodox deity that Loen reveres. If I encounter him, it will still be somewhat troublesome." The voice paused for a moment before continuing, "By the way, there's news about the Tree of Elders' heart. If you're willing to pay 2,000 pounds or something of equal value, we can make an exchange."
After that, Cullen asked a few more questions, but there was no reply. Only then did he confirm that his mother had left. He sighed and grumbled, "Didn't you just fail to help me find the Shaman King's Beyonder characteristic and not fulfill your promise? Why did you hide from me for nearly a century and refuse to meet me?"
"Maybe it's because Ms. Hellen doesn't know how to face you? I heard that a hundred years ago, you seemed to have a younger sister..." At this time, Judy, who came out of nowhere, added with a smile.
Cullen was shocked by her sudden appearance. When he saw who it was, he changed the topic.
"Is it over there? Did you get it?"
"It's over, but our plan has gone awry... That Primordial Moon believer named Windsor Behring has been arrested by the Mandated Punisher..."

chapters.title: Chapter 125: The Coming "Headlines"
chapters.content:
Chapter 125 - The Coming "Headlines"
In the office on the top floor of the headquarters of the Daily Observer, Spellsinger of God Ace Snake sat behind a desk and listened to Captain Kuhn's report.
There was no expression on his face, but the way he leaned forward indicated his seriousness.
Captain Kuhn flipped open his notebook and described the events of the night in detail. He then repeated the results of the interrogation of the relevant personnel. Finally, he said,
"Yesterday morning, I used Sealed Artifact 1-025 to divine the true culprit behind the attack on the Lord's believers. The final outcome pointed to this ball.
"Miss Hazel's testimony after she woke up also indicated that she stole the treasure of a charming lady at the ball, which is the seed that caused a disaster.
"The Primordial Moon aura that Detective Ebner Bryan sensed at the ball originated from that seed.
"The reason why the Forsaken One entered Backlund and reported to the Church was to find believers who were tempted by the Primordial Moon. And according to the latest information they provided, the tempted believer became a Demoness of Pleasure's advancement to Affliction.
"Finally, we just obtained the Beyonder circle that Lieutenant Berner had previously inquired about how to resist the Demoness of Afflictions. We even spent 8,000 pounds to buy a Beyonder item from the Sun domain...
"In summary, we have confirmed that the mastermind behind the assassination of the believers and the Mandated Punishers is this Demoness of Afflictions."
Having reported to this point, Captain Kuhn, who was wearing a modified captain's hat, closed the notebook in his hand and waited for His Excellency Spellsinger of God's to ask about the details.
The Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake, thought for a moment, as though he was digesting the Captain's report. After a long while, he said in a magnetic voice, "Logically speaking, there's no problem. I basically agree with your point of view... However, do you have any idea why the Demoness of Agony treats us so well?"
"There's one thing. In the previous operation of the Mandated Punishers," He "heavily injured a Demoness of Pleasure... She might very well be the same person as this Demoness of Afflictions," Kuhn immediately replied, clearly prepared.
"Spellsinger of God's" shook his head slightly and said, "She wouldn't go around in circles just for revenge... In fact, even the attack this time only looked dangerous. Even if no one saw through it in advance, something happened to His Highness and those ordinary people. In reality, it would only embarrass the Church. In the end, I would most likely be demoted and transferred... My intuition tells me that her goal isn't that simple. She definitely has a bigger plan."
"Your Excellency, your deduction is very reasonable... It's just that we can't guess that witch's thoughts at the moment." Captain Kuhn smiled bitterly. He didn't think that if something really happened, it would only be "rather embarrassing". After all, it was the lives of innocents! It was something he swore to protect when he became a Mandated Punisher.
"Demonesses are always scheming. Furthermore, this one has been corrupted by the Primordial Moon. She's probably even more unpredictable... Yes, I approve of you using 1-025 to divine Demonesses again. You have to capture her as soon as possible, " Ace Snake said with a smile.
"Yes, Your Excellency." Captain Kuhn nodded.
Next, the two of them talked about how to handle the aftermath and how to deal with the people involved.
"As the instigator of this incident, Miss Hazel should've been imprisoned under the Holy Wind Cathedral as an experimenter... However, her father is a Member of Parliament of the House of Commons, and she has a wide network of friends. She's also related to the military, and her family is a devout believer of the Evernight Goddess... Therefore, to avoid some trouble, we decided to hand her over to the Church of Earth Mother. After all, she might've been contaminated by the Primordial Moon, and the Church of Earth Mother has more experience with such pollution than us."
Captain Kuhn didn't have a good impression of the troublemaker. He only didn't punish her too severely because he was worried about her influence and because she was only being used.
"Not a bad punishment... Earth Mother is biased towards the God of Combat, and she doesn't have a good relationship with the Church of Evernight. By handing that lady over to the Church of Earth Mother, I believe she will be taught a proper lesson. Furthermore, the reason for handing her over is very good." The Spellsinger of God praised with a smile before asking, "How did Miss Hazel become a Beyonder? Have you investigated clearly?"
Speaking of this, Kuhn became serious again as he replied, "She refused to tell us in the beginning, but through some means, we made her reveal some truth... It turns out that she met a teacher by coincidence. That teacher led her onto an extraordinary path... However, according to her description, we have come to the conclusion that this so-called teacher should be a Parasite, and she has ill intentions towards her teachings."
Upon hearing that, the Spellsinger of God leaned back in his chair and thought for a moment before saying, "Recently, we have a lot of matters to attend to, and we are severely lacking in manpower... Her teacher is also in the North Borough... It's best to inform the Church of Evernight and get the Nighthawks to deal with the Parasite."
"Yes, Your Excellency." Kuhn had just nodded in response when the hat on his head suddenly trembled. He hurriedly apologized to the Spellsinger of God and listened to the voice coming from the hat.
Half a minute later, Kuhn straightened his modified captain's hat, slightly organized his words, and asked, "Your Excellency, we just received news that when we were investigating the Beyonders among the guests at the ball, we discovered another believer of the Primordial Moon... And she seems to be the Forsaken One's target. She requested to share the results of the interrogation with us... What do you think?"
Ace Snake pondered for a moment and did not answer directly. Instead, he asked something else. "Most of the ordinary people in the ball haven't been released, right?"
"Yes, Your Excellency. Although there's spatial isolation created by 2-001, we can't confirm if the Primordial Moon's corruption will leak..." Captain Kuhn replied.
"It's not good to detain these ordinary people, and we aren't good at detecting such pollution, so it's better to find someone more professional to help! Agree to the Forsaken One's request, but in exchange, we need them to send people to help us complete our investigation." Speaking up to this point, Ace Snake looked at Kuhn and said with a smile, "Speaking of which, you were able to successfully eliminate the monster Berner transformed into today, and you have to thank the saints of the Church of Earth Mother for their support. If it weren't for her help, I'm afraid you would have to persist until I arrive to truly kill it."
"The Church of Earth Mother actually sent out a Saint?!" Captain Kuhn was shocked when he heard that, but he immediately thought of something and said, "It should be for Detective Ebner Bryan. He really is highly valued by the Church of Earth Mother! Although he didn't do much during the battle with the mutated monsters, he used the Earth Demon statue to save many people."
"Oh? Driving the Earth Demon Statue? This Detective Bryan is the person who reported to you that Hazel has the aura of the Primordial Moon on her? Do you have any information about him?" After hearing Captain Kuhn's words, Ace Snake was slightly interested in Ebner.
"Detective Bryan is a student of the famous Detective Isengard Stanton who has been famous for many years. Previously, he was famous for solving a kidnapping and trafficking case committed by a subordinate company of the Dock District's Eternal Life Society. However, according to the information obtained from the Church of Steam, this matter was actually done by the Forsaken One, and Detective Bryan had only helped.
"Isengard Stanton came to Backlund ten years ago and quickly became famous. As he has a close relationship with MI9, we always thought he was a member of the military... But now, his student is so highly valued by the Church of Earth Mother. We believe that he's very likely a spy buried in Backlund by the Church of Earth Mother. Furthermore, they should've made connections with Prince Edessak long ago."
Captain Kuhn recounted the information he had on Ebner and sighed. "However, it's all thanks to this detective's warning today. Otherwise, I'm afraid it wouldn't have been easy to deal with... And this detective could have left to report to the Church of Earth Mother. That way, he wouldn't have been involved in such a dangerous matter."
The Spellsinger of God nodded and didn't say anything else. Then, he waved his hand and signaled Kuhn to carry out the plan that they had discussed.
At this moment, Evan, the Mandated Punisher who had been by Ebner's side to protect him, knocked on the door and walked in. He first greeted the two of them before saying, "Your Excellency, Captain. The guests at the ball are asking us why we detained them... Matthew and Robert haven't replied, for the time being, so they asked me to ask for instructions on what excuse to use."
"Heh, that's simple. Tell them that someone wants to assassinate His Highness. We detained them to investigate the possible accomplices among them." The Spellsinger of God laughed and continued, "I'll personally inform His Highness. I believe he'll cooperate..."
"Yes, Your Excellency," Evan replied respectfully before turning to leave.
But at that moment, the Spellsinger of God stopped him again and added, "In addition, tell the guests that Detective Bryan discovered that the assassin had used a bomb to assassinate him. That's why he didn't really cause a disaster... He's the hero who saved everyone."
"This..." Evan was dumbfounded, but he immediately stood up and said, "Yes."
After Evan left, Captain Kuhn asked with a frown, "Sir, are you thinking of using Detective Bryan as bait?"
"Heh heh, it might not be useful. It's just an idle step... There's no need to send someone to follow him. Since he obtained the Church of Earth Mother Favor, he naturally has the protection of the Forsaken One! Heh heh, I want to see if that Demoness is really that vengeful or if she has other plans!"

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Becoming Famous Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 126 - Becoming Famous Again
When Ebner walked out of the Daily Observer building, it was almost two in the morning.
Initially, he had nothing to do with it. However, he did not know what the Mandated Punishers were thinking, but they added the story of "a hero who was quick-witted enough to see through a murderer's scheme and dismantle a bomb at the last moment". Even His Highness expressed his gratitude to him in public... Then, he was interviewed by the enthusiastic reporters of the Daily Observer...
"What's the use of verbal gratitude... Why don't you give me something practical?" Ebner shook his head and muttered to himself. He also understood that the Mandated Punishers were looking for an excuse to detain the guests and wait for the professionals of the Church of Earth Mother. He knew this when he saw Father Utravsky arrive with the Forsaken Ones, but he still felt that it was unnecessary to push him out as a "hero."
Although he was rather unhappy with the methods of the Mandated Punishers, Ebner still informed Evan, who was responsible for "protecting" him, about the bleeding of the black eyeball that he had observed before leaving. As for whether he believed it or not, it was none of his business.
Just as they walked out of the building, Ebner saw two familiar figures standing inside and outside the road. They were Xio and Fors.
Xio seriously sized up Ebner and heaved a sigh of relief when she noticed that he wasn't injured. She asked vaguely, "Is it over?"
Ebner shot a glance at the other MI9 security personnel not far away and nodded slightly. "It's over. There's no danger for now." As a "hero" who had just eliminated the threat of the "bomb," revealing this level of information wasn't a problem.
Xio also knew that this wasn't the place to talk. After some thought, she asked softly, "Is... is it something you can tell me?"
Her tone was a little unstable as she once again felt how weak she was... If she had the strength of a Mid-Sequence Beyonder, she definitely wouldn't have waited here for the outcome after Fors told her that something might happen at the ball. Instead, she would have entered the building to help!
Unfortunately, she was only a Sequence 8. If she rashly entered, not only would she be of no help, she might even become a burden.
Ebner could tell that Xio wasn't in a good mood, and he could roughly guess what she was thinking. But this wasn't a good place to comfort anyone, so he said, "You should be busy later. We'll talk more about it when we meet in East Borough on Sunday night."
He felt that other than the possible "arrangements" involving the King of Angels and the suspected God of Knowledge and Wisdom, it shouldn't be a problem to tell Xio the rest. This could increase Xio's knowledge and also make her more wary of Demonesses.
Xio nodded at that and said no more to Ebner. After routinely checking his registration information, he let Luke off the hook.
Fors, who was standing outside, felt relieved when she saw him. She also teased him, "The Hero has returned triumphantly. It looks like my script is pretty good."
"Hero? Did you already hear something?" Ebner asked subconsciously.
"What?" Fors was at a loss when she heard that, unsure of what he meant.
"Nothing... I'm just a little allergic to that word recently," Ebner said with a smile as he rubbed his forehead.
...
After sending Fors home, Ebner finally returned to his teacher's house before four o'clock.
After dismissing the servant who had woken up to open the door for him, he returned to his room and sealed the entire room with a wall of spirituality. Then, he set up a ritual and began praying to Mr. Fool.
Even when he was in the headquarters building of the Daily Observer, Judy and Cullen had already examined him and confirmed that he was not contaminated, but he still felt that it was safer to let Mr. Fool take a look.
...
In a terrace house at 2 Daffodil Street in Tingen, Klein, who was sleeping soundly, was suddenly woken up by illusory pleas.
He rubbed his dry eyes and lit the candle on the table. He took out his pocket watch in a daze and looked at it repeatedly to confirm that it was three in the morning.
Who is this? Is there something wrong with his head? Why is he praying in the middle of the night? Does he even allow people to sleep? Although Klein was a little grumpy when he woke up, he was worried that his Tarot Club members really had something urgent to attend to. Therefore, he got up and set up a wall of spirituality. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and chanted incantations before coming above the gray fog.
In the towering palace that resembled a giant's residence, his figure suddenly appeared at the end of the long bronze table. His eyes reflected a crimson star that was constantly shrinking and expanding.
That star belonged to the Tower.
It was him again... What was it this time...
Klein raised his right hand and spread his spirituality to touch the star that represented the Tower.
With a boom, he saw a distorted and blurry scene. He saw Mr. Tower sitting on a chair in a dark corner, dressed in a well-tailored dark blue gown. His hands were clasped together as he held his buried forehead.
At the same time, his calm voice sounded illusory as it echoed,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"You are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog.
"You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.
"I pray for your attention.
"I pray for your approval.
...
"I received a book on mysticism written by the Sanguine Duke, the Feast of Blood. I pray that you can tell me if there are any curses or traps in this book."
Klein listened attentively and carefully observed. Finally, he understood what Mr. Tower had described.
Was he so happy that he couldn't sleep after obtaining a mysticism book that he came overnight to make me a firewall?
However, books with mysticism knowledge are exactly what I need right now... However, what Sequence is the Sanguine Duke? From the name, he should be a high-level Beyonder...
After some deliberation, Klein decided to help The Tower take a look. This way, it would be easier for The Fool to ask him some questions about the debt that The Tower owed him. Of course, the most important thing was that the gray fog was sufficiently safe. Even if there was a problem with the book, it would be very difficult to threaten him on the gray fog.
But even so, Klein first conjured a fountain pen and goatskin parchment and wrote:
"Bringing the 'Feast of Blood' mentioned by Tower with the gray fog won't bring me any danger."
Holding the silver chain, Klein nearly made contact with the words on the goatskin with the topaz pendant. He half-closed his eyes and recited the divination statement.
"Bringing the 'Feast of Blood' mentioned by Tower with the gray fog won't bring me any danger."
"Bringing the 'Feast of Blood' mentioned by Tower with the gray fog won't bring me any danger."
...
After repeating it seven times, he opened his eyes and looked at the pendulum. He nodded slightly.
The topaz pendant was rotating clockwise, which meant there was no danger.
Therefore, Klein no longer hesitated and began responding to the Tower's plea.
...
In Detective Isengard's bedroom.
Ebner prayed several times before finally stopping. He held the Feast of Blood in his hand and waited for Mr. Fool's response.
He knew that Klein was probably "touring" the old city in his sleep. He might even be "watching" Captain Dunn eat the food he made in "fear." Therefore, there was an 80% chance that he wouldn't respond so quickly.
As time passed, Ebner took a deep breath and constantly consoled himself not to worry about personal gains and losses. Since the Forsaken didn't see any problems, it shouldn't be a big deal. Confirming to the Fool was just an additional layer of insurance.
At that moment, his vision suddenly blurred as he realized that an illusory fog was spreading out from his surroundings.
In the middle of the thick grayish-white fog was an ancient high-back chair. Sitting on the high-back chair was a mysterious existence whose appearance and figure was indiscernible. It was a mysterious existence that overlooked everything.
He finally responded. It seemed like he was fine! Ebner almost blurted out in surprise.
Following that, he heard a familiar deep voice.
"Got it. Give me the book 'Sacrifice'."
As his voice echoed, the gray fog vanished, and Ebner returned to his room.
The uneasiness in his heart suddenly disappeared. He subconsciously straightened his back and walked to the altar that had been set up a long time ago. He placed the Feast of Blood on it.
...
After the illusory door disappeared, the strong wind raised by the incantation stopped, and the candle flame returned to its original state, Ebner simply tidied up the room and arranged all the materials. Then, he lay down on the bed and returned to his dreamland with exhaustion.
When it was almost noon the next day, Ebner yawned and crawled out of bed. After washing up, he went to the living room on the first floor.
At this moment, Kenny came over with a look of delight and congratulated him. "Mr. Bryan, you are truly famous this time! Even the newspapers under the control of the Church of Storms are praising your wit and courage. And this morning, more than ten reporters from newspapers came to request an interview. However, they were all rejected by Detective Stanton with the excuse that you were too tired and were still resting."
As he spoke, he unfolded several newspapers to the first page and handed them to Ebner.
Ebner took the newspaper and glanced at it.
"The attacker is crazy, the real hero has good eyes and knows what's good for him."—This was a more serious title.
"The prince was in danger, the famous detective stepped forward to save him, but Sivellaus Yard let the criminal go because of his incompetence?"—this was purely to draw hatred for me.
"In the face of danger, the hero appears again. Several ladies fell in love at first sight—I've seen and heard of the Pen's Ball."—I'm afraid there was no love at first sight, but after I cut off a certain lady's arm with a wind blade, she was deeply etched in my memory.
...
Ebner put down the tabloids and picked up the Daily Observer, which had just been published. The report was rather detailed, and even details such as "discovering that a certain lady's expression was not right and the ritual was used" were written vividly.
However, Ebner narrowed his eyes when he read the description. It was only then that he understood the Mandated Punishers' intention of promoting him...

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Unexpected Digestion
chapters.content:
Chapter 127 - Unexpected Digestion
"You want to use me as bait? Heh heh, the Mandated Punishers don't seem to know that I've actually foiled the Demoness of Afflictions plans. I'm likely already on her blacklist.
Since she hasn't made a move on me up until now, it means that she has something more important to accomplish in her heart and doesn't wish to complicate matters...
"I'm afraid the Mandated Punishers are going to give up."
Ebner put down the newspaper and stopped thinking about it. After all, even if he knew that the Mandated Punishers were using him, he had no way of objecting. He might as well make use of the opportunity to gain more benefits... At the very least, he could take the opportunity to increase his commission fees.
After mocking himself in his misery, Ebner didn't choose to leave. Instead, he stayed at Detective Isengard's house and began learning the Sequence 6 ability analyzed by the Eye of White.
He had been a Knowledge Keeper for more than twenty days. Through this period of hard work, he wasn't far from learning the first Sequence 6 ability...
At four in the afternoon, Ebner, who had closed the Eye of Pure White, was taking a nap to recover his energy when he was suddenly woken up by a knock on the door.
He frowned, thinking that the person knocking on the door at this time could only be the solicitor's valet, Kenny... Is there a new commission?
As Ebner speculated, he opened the door to his room and saw Kenny standing respectfully outside.
"Detective Bryan, there's a guest who wishes to visit you," Kenny said after bowing.
"Who is it?" Ebner had long instructed them not to accept any visits unless the other party had a special identity.
"It's Mr. Maury Macht and his wife, Ma'am Riana... They said they were here to thank you for saving them last night." Kenny lowered his head out of habit.
Member of Parliament Macht? Are you sure he's here to thank me and not denounce me? I chopped off one of his daughter's arms yesterday... Of course, it's only right for him to thank me since the coconut saved her life.
With that thought in mind, Ebner grunted in agreement and followed Kenny down the stairs. He met his two visitors in the living room on the first floor.
Maury Macht was a typical Loen gentleman, in his late forties, with dark hair and brown eyes. His features were chiseled, his hairline was higher, and his face was lean and long. He still wore the olive-green army officer's uniform he'd worn at the ball last night, and it was clear he hadn't gone home to change.
His wife, Riana, wore a coat over her yellow non-collar dress from last night, hiding her fair neck and half her shoulders.
The two of them looked haggard, especially Ma'am Riana. There were tears on her face, and even her makeup couldn't completely cover it.
Seeing Ebner walk into the living room, Macht stood up and walked in front of him in two to three steps. He said in a very inviting manner,
"Detective Bryan, nice to meet you!"
Ebner was slightly taken aback by his behavior. He thought to himself, 'As the saying goes, one must ask for something when bowing to others. I wonder what this gentleman wants from him.'
However, despite having such thoughts, Ebner's face also revealed a polite smile, just like his teacher's. He said with equal enthusiasm, "Mr. Senator, I'm also very happy to meet you. In Emperor Roselle's words, it's truly an honor."
With that said, he looked at Ma'am Riana and complimented her with a smile. "Ma'am, welcome. Your presence has brightened up this firm."
If it were any other day, Lady Riana would have happily accepted such flattery. However, her daughter had been involved in the assassination of the prince for no reason and was still detained. This made her in no mood to exchange pleasantries. She could only politely smile at Ebner and say nothing more.
Ebner thought nothing of it. He turned around and shook hands with Macht before sitting down on the sofa.
Following that, the two exchanged a few words of flattery before Macht took out an envelope from his pocket and placed it on the coffee table in front of the sofa.
As the envelope was not sealed, Ebner immediately saw a stack of ten-pound notes neatly placed inside.
From the thickness of this envelope... It's at least 200 pounds... What is Member of Parliament Macht up to? Ebner wondered.
"Detective Bryan, due to your outstanding contribution last night, which saved my wife and me from a disaster, these are some of my thoughts. I hope you will accept them." As Macht spoke, he pushed the envelope in Ebner's direction.
Ebner didn't reach out for the money. He stared at Macht's sincere face for a while before saying, "What do you want to know? Or what do you want me to do? Speak."
"I knew I couldn't hide it from you, Detective Bryan..." Macht's expression changed slightly as he let out a long sigh. "However, this money is indeed to thank you for saving our family... I heard that the situation was critical back then. Was it you who made the prompt decision to save Hazel?"
So that's how it is. This senator is here to find out what happened... Does he want to know what level of mistake his daughter made in this matter? He actually came to find me... That means that the Mandated Punishers aren't very fond of this senator who believes in the Goddess.
Ebner nodded thoughtfully before saying with a smile, "Mr. Senator, there's no need to probe. If you wish to know something, I'll inform you of it... However, before I answer, I have to ask if you know of the existence of Beyonders?"
He only retired after working hard in the army until he became a major. Furthermore, he was in a godforsaken place like East Balam. He wouldn't know about Beyonders, right?
"Yes, I know... Because I didn't notice anything abnormal at the ball, and Hazel suddenly disappeared right under my nose... Therefore, I've already guessed that this is a Beyonder event," Macht said after exhaling.
"Then it's easy..." Ebner nodded. Then, he stood up and set up a wall of spirituality around the two of them in front of Mr. and Mrs. Macht so that the servants wouldn't hear what they shouldn't hear.
"Simply put, a heretic cult believer used Miss Hazel to bring a dangerous item that could kill everyone in the hall on the first floor to the ball. I discovered this dangerous item and reported it to His Highness and the Mandated Punishers."
"A dangerous item that can kill so many people..." Macht's heart sank as he gained a new understanding of the seriousness of the matter. He exhaled once again and asked with a wry smile, "Why is it Hazel?"
"That's because Miss Hazel is also a Beyonder. She's also a Beyonder who doesn't have much common sense regarding Beyonder matters! People like her are the easiest to be used by cultists." Ebner knew that she was still being kept in the dark, so he directly exposed her.
Hazel is a Beyonder? Why didn't I know? Where did she get the potion formula from? Macht immediately stood up in shock and anger when he heard that. When he served in East Balam, he knew the actions of the orthodox Churches' Beyonder teams. If ordinary people were embroiled in Beyonder matters, they would likely be very tolerant...
But it's different for Beyonders to be involved in a case... He felt that Hazel wasn't directly used as a test subject by the Church of Storms because of him.
"It seems like Hazel secretly acknowledged a teacher... But you don't have to worry, because your family is in the North Borough. The Mandated Punishers have already reported this matter to the Church of Evernight, so naturally, someone will handle it," Ebner answered after some thought. This information was given to him by Evan, who was in charge of "protecting" him.
Macht was an experienced politician after all. At this point, he had more or less figured out what had happened. He even guessed the reason why the Mandated Punishers had handed Hazel over to the Church of Earth Mother.
After pondering for a moment, he took out an envelope from his chest and handed it to Ebner. "I heard that you have a good relationship with Bishop Utravsky of the Church of Earth Mother... Can you invite the bishop to my house as a guest on my behalf?"
Even though Ebner didn't think the giant bishop would refuse, he didn't agree immediately. He only replied, "Mr. Macht, you understand that I have no right to agree on behalf of the bishop. I have to seek his opinion."
Seeing that Ebner didn't reject him directly, Macht heaved a sigh of relief and said with a smile, "Of course. I'll visit you in a few days!"
With that, he stuffed the envelope into Ebner's hands without any hesitation before bidding farewell to Madam.
After they left, Ebner stared blankly at the two envelopes on the coffee table. He wasn't thinking about the money, but because his description of Macht had allowed him to digest a portion of his potion!

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Summarizing the Rules of the Knowledge Keeper
chapters.content:
Chapter 128 - Summarizing the Rules of the Knowledge Keeper
The effects of digestion are so obvious... What's the difference between this "acting" and the previous one?
After some serious thought, Ebner glanced at the two bulging envelopes on the coffee table and made some connections.
Could it be because of the remuneration? Hmm... It can't be that superficial. This should only be the surface!
I previously speculated that the core of "knowledge" was to spread knowledge to those who urgently needed it... And "knowledge" itself was valuable. The higher the price the person needed it to pay, the more they would value it. They would make full use of it and not let it be easily lost or severed. This should conform to the true essence of "knowledge".
Well, in essence, it was still a matter of asking for the difference in how much the intellectual valued this knowledge. Mr. Macht was very worried about Miss Hazel's situation, so he was extremely eager and determined to obtain the information. He was also willing to pay an extremely high price to understand the truth. After that, he would definitely use this information to achieve his goal... This was probably the reason why his digestion had made clear progress.
At the thought of this, Ebner basically sorted out his thoughts. However, he immediately thought of another problem. The information he had given Mr. Macht was incomplete, and the core secrets were almost never revealed. Even so, it was still considered a successful "acting"...
In other words, I don't need to tell the person who is seeking knowledge everything... I should even have a choice!
After all, the knowledge of this world itself represented danger. If he were to tell someone knowledge that exceeded the limit of the person's endurance, it might very well bring him danger and death... And once he died or because he was afraid of sealing the relevant knowledge, then the knowledge obtained from this request would be meaningless and not conform to the true meaning of "knowledge preservation."
However, it was impossible to say that it was too little. Firstly, it would cause the value of the knowledge to decrease, and it would not be valued by the person seeking it. Secondly, it might arouse the suspicion of the person seeking the knowledge, instead of putting it into practice or using it...
In short, he had to grasp a certain degree! According to the old saying in his previous life, he had to "know the white and protect the black". He had to let those who thirsted for knowledge know the knowledge that he could bear. The other secrets of the exploration would be carried by himself until someone who could bear this knowledge came to seek it and spread it...
It's no wonder Vice Admiral Iceberg would first ask about Gehrman's academic qualifications, knowledge, and grasp of mysticism knowledge before answering the question. This is either a habit she kept when she was a Knowledge Keeper, or it's the acting rules of the Reader Sequence.
Ebner muttered to himself. Based on his intuition, he believed that he had already concluded most of the guidelines for acting as a Knowledge Keeper. The remaining details were better. It didn't matter if he didn't have them. It wouldn't affect his digestion too much.
According to the digestive effects from before, my daily acting together with a few explorations and informations like this incident is enough for me to digest the Knowledge Keeper potion in two to three months. If the secret of another exploration in between is rather large, and the client is able to withstand the relevant knowledge, then my progress should be faster...
At the thought of this, Ebner laughed self-deprecatingly... More secrets? He was afraid that he would not be able to "defend" himself!
Shaking his head to rid himself of these impractical thoughts, Ebner took out the notes from the two envelopes and counted them seriously. Then, he used the Eye of Pure White to analyze the authenticity before nodding in satisfaction. He muttered to himself,
There's a total of three hundred pounds. Mr. Macht is very willing to spend money for his daughter... And from the looks of it, when I really invite Father Utravsky to his house as a guest, I'm afraid I'll have to pay an introduction fee...
After putting away the money, Ebner looked at the sky and realized that the sun was about to set. It was already late to go to the Harvest Church in the south of the Bridge.
I'll go tomorrow afternoon... Tomorrow is also the day that Judy and the others will meet with Witch Lena. I can go and hear the results of the meeting. I can also invite Father Utravsky on behalf of Macht.
Following that, Ebner had a hasty dinner and continued "learning" the Sequence 6 ability that had been analyzed by the Eye of Pure White until a gust of wind suddenly rose from his feet and carried him into the air.
Yes, the first Sequence 6 ability that Ebner learned was the Flight of the Wind-blessed.
...
On Sunday afternoon, Ebner, who had successfully escaped the paparazzi's encirclement with his "clown mask", took the subway all the way to Rose Street on the south side of the Bridge.
Pushing open the door to the church, Ebner was surprised to see Father Utravsky and Miss Hazel, who had lost her right arm, one in front of the other, sitting in a chair, one tall and one short. Their fingers were intertwined, their palms empty, placed in front of their mouths and noses.
This was a special prayer position belonging to the Church of Earth Mother.
He had turned this lady into a believer so quickly? She wasn't imprisoned underground... It seemed like the pollution on her body wasn't serious and had already been cleared by Earth Mother... He didn't let her go home just to let her accept the punishment she deserved, right?
With this in mind, he randomly found a seat and sat down. After the prayer ended, he walked in front of Father Utravsky and asked with a smile,
"Father, are Miss Judy and Mr. Cullen back?"
Father Utravsky nodded warmly and smiled. "They would have returned. They were in the room behind the hall."
"Is it convenient for me to see them now?" Ebner glanced at the closed door on the other side of the hall and asked again.
"Go ahead. I think they need some insight from you, too," Father Utravsky said with a smile.
Ebner thanked the priest and nodded to Miss Hazel before heading to the other side of the church hall.
Hazel looked at Ebner's back with a complicated expression. She had already heard everything from the Mandated Punishers and the Forsaken Ones in the past two days. She knew how big of a mistake she had made... She also knew that it was this detective in front of her who had severed her arm to save her life...
She bit her lip and made up her mind. She caught up with Ebner in two or three steps and whispered "thank you" before he realized what she was doing. Then she quickly turned back to the Sacred Emblem and resumed her praying posture.
Ebner was taken aback by her actions, and then he burst into laughter. He thought to himself, "It's not easy for this arrogant lady to say 'thank you' to the person who cut off her arm... Has she improved?"
...
At 14 Dakota Street, Witch Lena arrived at the temporary residence that Prince Edessak had arranged for her after meeting with the Forsaken Ones.
Feeling the strength that filled her body once again, she, who had not coughed for a long time, could not help but sigh. "In terms of 'treatment' and 'healing', the Church of Earth Mother is indeed powerful... The medicine that the young lady concocts is much stronger than the chubby Apothecary on Lexington Street! Unfortunately, they still don't trust me and refuse to remove the root of the illness that Ray left behind..."
However, the moment Lena pushed open the door to her bedroom, she realized something was wrong. Apart from the smell left behind by the servants and maids, there was the smell of a stranger.
Lena took Ice Claw and carefully inspected it. Soon, she found a spot in the corner of the room that wasn't very harmonious.
"His breathing quickened after seeing me, but he didn't give me any sense of danger. Is he not targeting me? Could he be a thief?"
Just as Lena thought this, a figure suddenly appeared in the corner. He looked at Leena awkwardly and stuttered, "Miss... Miss Lena, I... I don't mean any harm. I'm here to give you something!"
"Give me something?" Lena's heart stirred, but she didn't let down her guard. Frowning, she asked repeatedly, "Who are you? Who are you working for? And what are you giving me?"
"Ma'am, my... my name is Shoko. I was originally a police officer... I met an old man in my dream. He asked me to give you this invisible necklace..." Shoko moved his gaze away from Lina's face and spoke normally.
At the same time, he recalled the woman in the carriage he met on Duke Avenue. The feeling she gave him was very similar to the woman in front of him.
Upon hearing the old man who had appeared in her dream, Lina's eyes narrowed and suddenly sharpened. She urgently asked, "What else did the old man say?"
"He said that although the ring he gave you last time allowed you to 'luckily' avoid being pursued several times, you still couldn't escape the Demoness'senses... And this necklace can temporarily shield you from the 'mark' she left on your body." Shoko had already heard these words many times in his dreams, so there wasn't the slightest bit of sluggishness in his words.
...
In the room behind the Harvest Church, Ebner and the Forsaken One had greeted each other. Just as they were about to ask about the outcome of their meeting with the Demoness, they heard Viscount Cullen say with a smile, "I've already contacted the Tree of Elders' Heart. It's worth 2,100 pounds!"
Ebner was delighted to hear that. He did not care about anything else and quickly calculated his assets.
Back when he was in Darvill, he already had about 800 pounds. In the past few days, he had sold quite a number of charms and Beyonder characteristics. Together with the money, he received from the commission... Well, after deducting the expenses from buying various ingredients in the past month, he currently had about 1,500 pounds in cash.
The gap is 500 pounds... Where should I get the money?
Hmm... I remember that in the novel, Danitz made it very clear where his assets were when he was giving his last words... Should I borrow some first?

chapters.title: Chapter 129: The Witch’s Purpose
chapters.content:
Chapter 129 - The Witch's Purpose
Of course, Ebner was only thinking about it. After all, most of Danitz's wealth had been exchanged for property. Not only was it difficult to take action, but it was all in Bayam... Before he learned how to "travel," it wasn't easy to go out to sea.
The gap is 600 pounds... By the way, Miss Justice asked me for the Telepathist potion formula last time! Yes, since Mr. Fool's delivery business is already online, I can sell the formula at the Tarot Club tomorrow... If I ask for 500 pounds, Miss Justice probably won't reject it... As for the remaining 100 pounds, I can earn it by selling whatever I have.
After making some calculations in his heart, Ebner gradually came to a conclusion. He then nodded at Viscount Cullen and said, "I need some time to raise funds... Can we do the transaction tomorrow night?"
To raise 2,100 pounds in a day?... Cullen silently muttered to himself, feeling that he had underestimated the wealth of this detective in front of him.
However, Viscount Cullen soon returned to his senses and said with a nod, "Sure, I'll make a trip to the vampire treasury later."
At this moment, Ebner suddenly thought of something and asked, "How many Hearts of the Tree of Elders do you have in total?" If there were more, I could sell them to my teacher and perhaps earn some intermediary fees from him.
"There's only one... Why do you ask?" Viscount Cullen asked curiously.
"Nothing..." Ebner shook his head in disappointment. Then, he stopped harping on the topic and turned to ask Judy about her meeting with Witch Lena today.
Seeing the question, Judy put away the silly smile on her face and said solemnly, "I've already confirmed that the disease on the witch, Lena, comes from indirect contamination of the godhood of the Primordial Moon!"
"Indirect contamination of godhood?" In his shock, Ebner immediately racked his brains and quickly understood the meaning behind Judy's words. Lena was a disease planted by the Demoness of Afflictions, and this disease came from indirect contamination of godhood... Doesn't that mean that Demoness Ray has a bit of godhood from the Primordial Moon?
As though she had seen through Ebner's thoughts, Judy shook her head slightly and said, "The godhood shouldn't be attached to Ray. Although she has been corrupted by the Primordial Moon, she hasn't lost her rationality... Besides, since the Church of Storms's Grade 1 Sealed Artifact can divine part of her actions, it means that she hasn't fused with godhood."
"So... it's the monster that Dr. Leonardo turned into?" Ebner quickly had a new theory.
"That's what Cullen and I think as well... In addition, according to the Mandated Punisher's description of the captured Primordial Moon believer, Windsor Behring, she had previously helped Leonardo hold a secret deed ritual! The latter might've undergone some abnormal changes during this ritual." Judy also felt that things were a little tricky. Having godhood meant that she had at least a demigod's level. Although the items on her could also activate demigod-level powers, she was still lacking in level augmentation.
As for finding their parents if they couldn't defeat them... This was, after all, a mission for their team. It wasn't like the previous night, where the safety of the Blessed was at stake. Perhaps the Church's demigods wouldn't easily take action again.
"Don't worry too much. We expected this, didn't we? That's why the Holy Church sent me here." At this moment, Captain Arsenov suddenly opened his eyes and said.
"But Captain, the holy relic is still too much of a burden for you..." Judy glanced at the huge square box behind her captain, her voice full of worry.
Captain Arsenov smiled and shook his head. "No problem if it doesn't take more than ten minutes."
Those words sounded like a flag being inserted... Ebner complained in his heart. However, they had not even found the whereabouts of the Demoness, so it was still too early to consider how to kill her.
"Don't worry too much, Judy. If necessary, I still have some means." Cullen smiled and comforted her. Then, he looked at Ebner and smiled. "Besides, we have the help of Bishop Utravsky and Mr. Detective."
Bishop Utravsky might be able to become your strong ally, but I can at most provide some intelligence support... Ebner thought, but on the surface, he asked again, "By the way, Miss Judy, did that 'witch' mention Demoness Ray's motive?"
"Just call me Judy... Well, actually, that witch doesn't know too many details... I can only confirm that Ray has been plotting against the Mandated Punisher team's Captain, Kuhn!" At this moment, Judy had already adjusted her emotions, and a smile appeared on her face again.
"Planning on Captain Kuhn? What does she want? To snatch the Church of Storms's holy item?" Ebner was somewhat puzzled. After all, Captain Kuhn was a Sequence 5 Ocean Songster. The holy item that matched him was definitely something that a Sailor would pass through. It was completely useless for a Demoness.
"It can't be a plot to snatch the Holy Artifact. If the Demoness really dares to do so, the Lord of Storms will definitely send down lightning." Cullen used his hand as a comb. After tidying his hair, he denied it.
The sacred relic of the church was not that easy to obtain.
If she's not after the Holy Artifact, then she must be after something else... Ebner asked thoughtfully, "Do any of you know what the ritual for the Demoness of Afflictions to advance to the Demoness of Despair is?"
What Beyonders wanted were nothing more than formulas, ingredients, mystical items, and ritual items.
Judy and Cullen looked at each other and slowly shook their heads. Even though the latter had lived for hundreds of years and could be said to be very knowledgeable, he had not touched upon the knowledge of the Demoness' advancement ritual.
At this moment, Captain Arsenov, who had been sitting motionless all this while, spoke again. "To the Demoness, she will first experience the threat of the Sequence's ability after drinking the potion! Therefore, the ritual is usually used to reduce this threat."
In other words, the Demoness of Despair would first experience "despair"? Hmm... wait, no matter which "despair" it was, it was actually an extreme emotion, right? Previously, Captain Kuhn had used the isolation space created by the black eyeball in the Daily Observer's headquarters building to absorb human emotions...
And I saw a drop of blood dripping from the "corner of the eye" of the pitch-black eye...
With the two combined, Ebner gradually had an idea of the Demoness's plan. He guessed that she might want to snatch this Grade 2 Sealed Artifact.
After informing the few Forsaken Saints of his speculation, Cullen seriously thought for a moment and shook his head. "That Sealed Artifact is similarly difficult to obtain. After all, it is controlled by Captain Kuhn himself. And Kuhn is also a high-ranking deacon who contracted a sacred object. Even if the Demoness has a monster with godhood, she won't be able to defeat him for a while.
"This is Backlund. The Church of Storms might have demigod reinforcements at any time."
On the side, Judy had a different opinion. She felt that since the Demoness dared to set her eyes on Kuhn, she must have some confidence. She suggested reporting this speculation to the Mandated Punishers and ask them to be more careful.
The two of them argued for a while, but they couldn't convince each other. In the end, it was Captain Arsenov who made the decision. As he reported Ebner's conjecture to the Church of Storms, he continued his investigation according to Windsor Behring's confession. He thoroughly investigated who else was related to Leonardo's becoming a heretic, and who introduced the Demoness to Leonardo. He hoped to use this opportunity to find the Demoness' whereabouts.
After they reached a consensus, Ebner offered to take his leave. When he returned to the cathedral's hall and realized that Hazel had returned to her room to rest, he took the opportunity to mention Member of Parliament Macht's invitation to Bishop Utravsky.
As Ebner expected, the giant bishop readily agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Parasite
chapters.content:
Chapter 130 - Parasite
That night, Ebner and Xio met at the place they had agreed to meet and told her what had happened in the past two days with a choice.
Xio was somewhat depressed after hearing that because she still couldn't help.
Ebner didn't comfort her either, because he felt the same way... It was difficult for him to deal with a Witch, let alone a Demoness of Afflictions who had a deity as her helper.
Following that, seeing that it was getting late, Ebner handed the second copy of the Feast of Blood to Xio before bidding her farewell and taking a public carriage back to Detective Isengard's house.
As soon as he entered, he was called to the office by the teacher.
"I found out which court noble the badge on that carriage belonged to," Detective Isengard Stanton took a puff and said slowly.
Ebner almost failed to react when he heard this. However, he recalled that at Inspector Wayne's funeral, a troublemaker had said that the inspector had been killed by a woman in a carriage using poison, and the badge on the carriage belonged to a royal.
"That's because almost all the nobles in the palace are loyal to the Loen royal family. They aren't very passionate about socializing, making them appear rather mysterious. Therefore, I spent a few days to figure out the origins of that badge." With that said, Detective Isengard flicked the ashes in his pipe before continuing, "It belongs to the Court Count Lorena family."
"Lorena House?" Ebner searched his memory to make sure the name hadn't appeared in the original. And he hadn't seen it in the firm's dossier.
"The ancestor of the Lorena family was once a servant of William I, the 'founder' and 'protector'. He was conferred the title because he saved the lives of the royal family members on the battlefield. He has always been loyal to the Augustus family," Detective Isengard explained simply to his student.
The Loen royal family and the Demoness Sect had a secret deal, so it was reasonable for a Demoness to borrow a palace earl's carriage...
However, I don't have the means to investigate a palace earl... Should I ask Prince Edessak? Yes, I might be able to tell the Forsaken One. That would be a good direction to investigate.
In addition, he could commission an investigation from Miss Justice at the Tarot Club tomorrow.
With this in mind, Ebner gradually came up with a plan. He nodded at his teacher and said, "I'll investigate it." He still remembered the solemn expression on Detective Isengard's face when he wanted him to investigate the truth behind Inspector Wayne's death.
...
Monday morning
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
"Why are you visiting so early?" Audrey looked at the sky outside before looking at Viscount Glaint.
Glaint looked around and only saw a golden retriever squatting beside him. He lowered his voice and said,
"I was going to the racecourse, but I met Kance on the way. He told me something very interesting. Really interesting. I thought I'd pass by here, so I came to share it with you."
"What is it?" Audrey asked with interest.
Glaint replied without paying attention to the words,
"You know about the assassination attempt at the headquarters of the Daily Observer on Friday night, right? It was the case that Detective Bryan discovered and successfully stopped... There's more to that case!"
Of course I do. According to Mr. Hanged Man's guess, that detective might very well be a Beyonder. If it wasn't inconvenient, I really wanted to get to know him! Audrey's eyes lit up as she pressed in a reserved manner,
"What follow-up?"
"I'm not too sure about the details. Kance refused to tell me. He only told me that Member of Parliament Macht's daughter was involved in this case and was imprisoned by the Church... It seems like she took on an evil Beyonder as her teacher." Glaint spread his right palm.
An evil teacher... Was Kance telling this to Glaint? Audrey nodded indiscernibly and asked without hiding her curiosity,
"Has the evil Beyonder been captured?"
"No, that Beyonder escaped." Glaint paused for a moment and said, "This is what I'm talking about. Back then, everyone who participated in the capture forgot what they were doing—be it MI9, the Nighthawks of the Church of Evernight, or even a high-ranking deacon of the Red Gloves who carried a holy relic... Just like that, they returned to their 'homes'... Imagine that scene..."
This... just hearing it made one's hair stand on end! What kind of ability could do this?
Yes, I'll ask at the Tarot Club in the afternoon. Mr. Tower and Mr. Hanged Man should know.
This matter is so strange. Perhaps Mr. Fool will be interested...
Many thoughts flashed through her mind as Audrey couldn't help but smile. This was the Beyonder world she yearned for.
"What are you thinking about?" Viscount Glaint, who was sitting opposite him, couldn't help but ask in puzzlement.
Audrey suddenly snapped out of her daze, tilted her head slightly, and smiled.
"Didn't you make me imagine the Nighthawks forgetting their original intentions and returning to the cathedral?"
"Haha." Glaint laughed awkwardly before sighing. "I wonder which pathway's high-level Beyonder that heretic is from. It really matches my imagination of such matters. It's too, too cool! When Hazel is released, I'll definitely ask her."
"Hazel?" Audrey asked curiously when she heard the unfamiliar name.
"That's Member of Parliament Macht's daughter! I heard she's also a Beyonder. Even though she was only used, she's still being imprisoned by the Church." Upon saying that, Glaint looked at Audrey excitedly. "Rush Fors and ask her when I can find my Apothecary formula?"
Audrey widened her eyes slightly and surveyed the area. She suppressed her voice and said,
"Quiet, whisper."
"How can you talk about the potion formula here?"
Glaint smiled without much concern. "Don't worry, it's nothing. I just confirmed that there's only one dog here besides you and me."
Susie subconsciously changed her sitting posture.
...
Backlund North Borough, in a room under Saint Samuel Cathedral.
Daly, who was wearing a black hooded robe and had blue eyeshadow and blush on her face, gave off a strange and cold beauty. She randomly found a seat and picked up the documents on the table.
She swept her gaze over it and her brows relaxed. She asked with a faint smile,
"Parasite?"
"So you guys are being played around like curly-haired baboons in a zoo?"
Sitting at the head of the table, Crestet Cesimir, who had hidden his chin and lips back into his vertical collar, said in a deep voice,
"We don't know enough about the Parasite's powers... I never expected him... No, it should be that she can even steal a person's thoughts.
"Everyone, including MI9 agents, forgot what they were going to do."
"So why are you looking for me?" Madam Daly changed her sitting posture. She was currently a member of the Backlund Nighthawks, and she wasn't affiliated with the Red Gloves. Typically, if there was nothing, she wouldn't seek her help.
"We need more clues... Therefore, I would like you to mediumship Miss Hazel... Although the Mandated Punishers have used similar means on her, I still trust your abilities more," Cesimir said after some deliberation.
"Heh, but I remember that the lady is still imprisoned in the Church of Earth Mother... I don't wish to experience the strength of a giant bishop." Madam Daly laughed and asked, "Have you communicated beforehand?"
"I have a good relationship with Detective Isengard Stanton... According to the intelligence, his student should be someone secretly nurtured by the Church of Earth Mother... Perhaps we can think of a solution through this relationship." As she spoke, Cesimir handed a document to Daly.
Daly took the information and scanned it briefly. Her eyes stopped on one of Ebner's half-body portraits.
"I think I've seen this person somewhere before..."
...
At three in the afternoon, above the endless gray fog, the magnificent palace stood silently.
Ebner, who had come here once again, had just regained his vision when he saw Miss Justice looking at the end of the long mottled table. She greeted him in a light tone,
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~"
Following that, Audrey turned to Ebner and Elger and greeted them.
"Good afternoon, Miss Justice," Ebner replied with a smile.
At this moment, Audrey, who had turned back to look up, suddenly saw an ancient-looking book on the table to The Fool's right.
It lay there quietly, casually, like an ordinary object.
What book is that? To be placed by Mr. Fool's hand, it must be something extraordinary! Perhaps it contains the secrets of a deity? Audrey guessed curiously.
Although Klein couldn't see Audrey's expression, he could still guess her thoughts from the changes in her emotions. He felt that it wasn't in vain that he had kept the book for a few more days and didn't immediately return it to the Tower after checking it...
However, the knowledge in this book was indeed very helpful to him.
Seeing that Mr. Fool had no intention of explaining, Audrey subconsciously glanced at The Hanged Man and Tower and realized that they had also noticed the ancient-looking book.
Mr. Hanged Man's eyes and actions revealed his puzzlement and surprise, as well as his inevitable guesses. After all, a book placed by the mysterious and lofty Mr. Fool definitely wasn't an ordinary item...
Eh? Mr. Tower's reaction is a little strange. He seems quite happy... happy? But not curious... Could it be that he recognizes the book?
Ebner was actually somewhat speechless. He had roughly guessed that Klein was planning on using this as an excuse. As he chuckled inwardly, he spoke first.
"Honorable Mr. Fool, there's no new Roselle diary this time."
He planned on delaying a few times before giving the diary. After all, Mr. Fool's current ability to pay was limited. If he took out too many diary pages, he might not be able to maintain his character profile of "equivalent exchange."
"I don't have to be so worried anymore..."
Upon hearing that, Klein was somewhat disappointed as he exhaled in relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Continuous Transactions
chapters.content:
Chapter 131 - Continuous Transactions
Seeing that Tower didn't take out the diary this time, Klein looked at Justice and The Hanged Man.
"Mr. Fool, I still need one to two weeks before I can return to the continent," Alger said respectfully with his head lowered.
After experiencing the sacrificial and bestowment rituals, he no longer dared to rashly test Mr. Fool.
Klein acutely sensed the slight change in his attitude, and he felt relieved. It looked like his 10 pounds experiment fee wasn't wasted... The effect was very obvious. It was just that he had been a little tight on funds for the past week.
"I'm sorry, Mr. Fool. I didn't manage to gather any new Roselle diary pages." Miss Justice felt a little guilty. She believed that she would definitely find Fors when she returned and get her to gather a few more diary pages as soon as possible.
When The Fool Klein saw that there was indeed no new diary, he didn't say anything. He leaned back in his chair and said,
"You can begin the exchange."
With that said, Audrey immediately looked at Tower Ebner who was diagonally across the long bronze table, and asked,
"Mr. Tower, is there any news about the Telepathist potion formula?"
Ebner was already prepared to raise money, so he nodded and replied with a smile, "I've already obtained the formula. You can know its content with 500 pounds.
"The transaction will be witnessed by Mr. Fool. You don't have to worry that it's fake."
He obtained the Telepathist formula in just a week? Mr. Tower's ability to find the formula is indeed very strong... Does he have extensive and reliable resources and connections in this field?
Audrey was somewhat surprised, but she quickly nodded and replied, "No problem. I'll be able to 'sacrifice' the money to Mr. Fool when I return."
She trusted The Fool very much and never doubted that she would obtain the fake formula.
Seeing that she had readily agreed, Ebner applied for a pen and paper from The Fool. He silently wrote down the Telepathist formula and handed it to Justice, who sat opposite the long table.
Audrey took it and looked at it expectantly.
"Main ingredients: Complete pituitary gland of the adult Rainbow Salamander, 10 ml of spinal fluid from the Falsman Rabbit."
"Supplementary ingredients: Chestnut Spore 5 grams, Dragon Tooth Grass Powder 8 grams, White Sprite Flower 3 petals, 100 milliliters of pure water."
"Excellent!" Audrey praised as she carefully memorized the formula. She decided that after "sacrificing" the gold pounds to Mr. Fool, she would head to her treasure vault to search for it.
After the transaction of the formula ended, Ebner looked at the silent The Hanged Man and Justice, who was in high spirits, and said again, "I'm selling a mystical item. Which of you is interested?"
Upon hearing this, Audrey immediately cast her gaze over. Even her Spectator powers couldn't hide the intense "interest" in her eyes.
When Alger heard that he turned to look at Ebner and asked in a deep voice, "What kind of mystical item?"
Ebner looked up at Klein and asked "respectfully," Honorable Mr. Fool, can you help me conjure the image of a mystical item? "
Klein was similarly curious about the mystical item mentioned by Tower. After some thought, he felt that it shouldn't be a problem to conjure an image. Hence, he smiled and said, "Sure."
After obtaining permission, Ebner immediately conjured a ring embedded with red and black gems. It came from the Eternal life Society's Morella, who was the boss behind the service company that made Ebner become a Hero for the first time.
He had already appraised this ring a long time ago. It wasn't forged from a Beyonder characteristic, but the piece of gem that had been pieced together had been stained with the blood of two Beyonders. It had also been processed by an Artisan, giving it the powers of a Swindler and Provost.
And this portion of the ability was only at Sequence 8. He had long finished analyzing it and could simulate it. There was no need for it.
"I call this ring 'Fake Rage.'
"The person wearing it can create illusions on targets above one person and below five, and incite the target's anger in the illusions, causing them to kill each other.
Of course, I can also create illusions without using my ability to incite anger. However, if the target is rational and calm, they will quickly see through this illusion. The effects will be much worse.
"This mystical item doesn't have any negative effects. If I wear it for a long period of time, I'll feel a little frustrated, but I can use Cogitation or Beyonder powers to suppress it. Furthermore, as long as I take it off, it will quickly recover.
"In the end, it will only be effective for a year. After a year, it will become an ordinary gemstone ring."
After hearing Ebner's introduction, Audrey looked at the ring with sparkling eyes, not hiding her fondness at all.
Putting aside the ability, the key was that the red and black gemstone was very beautiful. It aroused Miss Justice's desire to buy it.
"Mr. Tower, how much does it cost?"
Ebner thought for a moment and gave a false high price. "400 pounds!"
Normally speaking, if a similar item appeared at a teacher's gathering, the transaction price would be around 300.
"Alright, I'll take it! I'll sacrifice it to Mr. Fool along with the Telepathist's fee later," Audrey said without any hesitation, afraid that The Hanged Man would come out to intercept her.
Klein sat in the seat of honor and secretly sighed. Miss Justice sure is rich. Including the formula from before, she spent 900 pounds in just a short period of time... The total value of 2 Daffodil Street is only 850 pounds...
Alger was actually somewhat interested in the ring. He originally wanted to say something, but he knew that he couldn't beat Justice in terms of wealth. In the end, he would only benefit the Tower for nothing, so he could only give up.
At this moment, Ebner, who had made two deals in a row, didn't stop. He said again, "I also want to sell a Beyonder characteristic, Lawyer's Beyonder characteristic."
According to the progress of the analysis, another main material of the 'erudite scholar' would be analyzed in a few days. Ebner planned to save more money.
Is Tower selling so much because he killed a Lawyer? The Hanged Man immediately made the connection when he heard that.
As for Klein and Audrey, although they were somewhat wistful about the Tower's activity, they were mostly puzzled.
"Beyonder characteristic? What's that?" Audrey asked the question that Klein wanted to ask.
At that moment, Ebner recalled that other than Alger, the other two likely didn't know what a Beyonder characteristic was. Hence, after some deliberation, he explained,
"There is a law in mysticism... This law is called the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility.
"The Beyonder characteristic will not be destroyed or reduced. It will only shift from one object to another."
It won't be destroyed, nor will it decrease. It will only shift from one object to another... Audrey ruminated over Mr. Tower's description and felt that this simple sentence contained too many meanings.
Her emerald-green eyes turned, and when she saw that The Hanged Man didn't show any signs of surprise or contemplation, she immediately understood that this Tarot Club member had long known of this law.
I'm the only one who doesn't know... she thought with some grievance.
And Mr. Fool seemed to see through her thoughts from the color of her emotions. He silently added inwardly, "And me. I don't know either."
However, he quickly recalled the grayish-white object left behind after the Nighthawks killed the monster that had lost control of Ray Bieber. It was the grayish-white object that had been stored away by Nighthawk Aiur Harson in Backlund.
Perhaps Beyonders who lose control will leave behind Sealed Artifacts, mystical items, or main ingredients for potions?
Just as Klein thought that he heard Tower add,
"Therefore, after a Beyonder who loses control dies, they will leave behind an item that condenses a Beyonder characteristic. It might be the main ingredient of a potion, or it might be a mystical item that needs to be sealed. It's the same for normal Beyonders after they die. However, it will be equivalent to the corresponding potion without any supplementary ingredients. Of course, it also possesses a certain amount of Beyonder powers and can be used as a half-completed mystical item."
A little equivalent to a potion... A little equivalent to a potion! Klein's pupils constricted as a bolt of lightning seemed to strike his mind, illuminating the endless darkness.
He suddenly understood many things. He understood why Beyonder pathways wouldn't be severed when the materials were cut off.
Apart from substitutes, one could also rely on the remains of Beyonders!
As for Audrey, she was similarly stunned. She thought of eating people and felt like she was having a nightmare!
How can it be so cruel? How can it be so dark? Audrey had always yearned for the mysterious world in the past, and her fantasies of it were biased towards romance and cool... But this time, she realized that the mysterious world was filled with gray and black.
Ebner stopped here, waiting for Miss Justice to regain her composure, but he thought,
As for Beyonder characteristics, it was fine as long as he explained the true general knowledge. As for the other laws of Beyonder characteristics, it was best left for The Fool to use in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 132 - Mission
Alger had long known that Beyonder characteristics would be revealed after Beyonders died, so he wasn't surprised by Tower's explanation. Seeing that Miss Justice didn't seem interested in this characteristic, he asked, "How much do you plan on selling the Lawyer characteristic for?"
Although he didn't need this item, he could use it to nurture and reward his trusted subordinates. Furthermore, he knew an Artisan. If he were to turn the characteristic into a Beyonder item, he could earn quite a bit from it.
In short, he would not lose anything.
"400 pounds." Ebner didn't ask for much. He knew that Alger wasn't Audrey. Unless necessary, he wouldn't buy things at a premium. And the target customer of this characteristic was Alger.
"A very fair price... I want this characteristic." Alger nodded. As he needed to purchase the Wind-blessed formula in Ebner's hands, he had been raising money recently, so it wasn't a problem for him to take out 400 pounds in cash.
Seeing that the characteristics of the "lawyer" had been sold, Ebner stopped his "clearance" behavior.
Although he still had quite a number of good items on hand, such as the charms that could activate the Language of Foulness, considering that he was still bait released by the Mandated Punishers, he could encounter Demoness of Agony at any time.
Therefore, he decided to keep it for self-defense.
At that moment, Audrey had just enlightened herself and her mood eased slightly.
When she saw that The Hanged Man and Tower had completed their transaction, she seemed to recall something as she asked with a smile, "Mr. Tower, do you have anything else to sell? For example, those charms you made?"
Eh? That's right. I can sell those low-cost charms too... Although the price definitely won't be high, I can sell them at a low price!
But on second thought, a charm with Sequence 9 powers would only cost two to three pounds even if it was premium. How much would he have to sell to make up for the money needed for the other main ingredient?
And even if the cost of creating charms with the powers granted to him by the White Eye was very low, it still required time... It was truly not worth it.
Ebner thought for a moment before giving up on the idea of selling charms to make a fortune. Instead, he had another thought. Hence, he smiled and asked, "Miss Justice, it looks like you have a good impression of the charm I gave you?"
"Thank you for your gift, allowing me to experience the powers of an Apprentice." Audrey felt that Tower was truly a gentle gentleman. She had only expressed her yearning for the powers of an Apprentice at the Tarot Club, and he had specially given her a charm that could open the door.
"I do have many similar charms. Miss Justice, do you need them?" Ebner asked with a smile.
Justice originally wanted to say a hundred, but considering how it was impossible for Mr. Tower to create so many, and how "sacrificing" so many things at once was disrespectful to Mr. Fool, Audrey finally said reservedly, "I want ten charms with different effects. It's fine as long as the level is similar to the previous one... Yes, Mr. Tower, what do you think of 50 pounds?"
This is twice as much as I imagined. Miss Justice is really generous!
Despite her thoughts, Ebner still reminded her, "This charm can't be used directly in battle. Ten of it is only worth 30 pounds at most." He didn't want her to feel that he had cheated her of her money when she learned the true price in the future.
"It's alright, Mr. Tower. Didn't you not charge any fees for explaining the law of Beyonder characteristics? Besides, I previously promised you to pay attention to the Tree of Elders' Tree of Hearts, but I haven't made any progress... Therefore, this premium will be my compensation," Audrey said with a smile.
20 pounds as an apology gift... Miss Justice sure is rich! Sitting in the seat of honor, Mr. Fool sighed inwardly once again. His weekly salary was only 4.5 pounds. 20 pounds was his salary for more than a month.
Ebner shook his head with a smile. Be it 30 pounds or 50 pounds, he had no intention of accepting the money because he actually wanted to use the charms as payment for a commission. Hence, under Justice's expectant gaze, he said,
"Miss Justice, actually, I wish to entrust you with something... Ten charms will be the advance payment for the commission. If the follow-up information is of value, I'll also give you a payment that will definitely satisfy you... How about it?"
"What commission?" Audrey was taken aback as she asked cautiously.
"I wish for you to investigate Earl Lorena of the Loen Kingdom... I need his detailed information," Ebner said as he deliberated over his words.
