"Earl Lorena? He seems to be a palace noble..." Audrey muttered to herself before looking at Ebner seriously and asking, "Mr. Tower, what do you want to do?"
She did not want to harm others because of her, so she had to ask for the reason before giving the information.
"I suspect that Earl Lorena is related to the Demoness Sect. There might even be a Demoness in one of his properties... Miss Justice, I'm guessing that they might do something to harm Backlund. That's why I asked you to investigate Earl Lorena."
Ebner knew Justice's concerns, so he'd nailed the court earl and the Demoness together as soon as he'd opened his mouth, giving his commission a justification.
As expected, after hearing Ebner's words, Miss Justice, who already had some understanding of the Demoness Sect, was immediately filled with a sense of "mission" and "responsibility." She immediately nodded solemnly and said, "Alright, Mr. Tower, I will quickly investigate Earl Lorena."
And when Alger heard the Demoness Sect's name, his heart stirred slightly. He asked without batting an eyelid, "Which Sequence Demoness is it?"
Ebner glanced at him and knew that he was testing him again. He was probably using the level of the Demoness he was investigating to reverse engineer his Sequence. However, he didn't mind it and only replied solemnly, "It's a Sequence 5 Demoness of Afflictions!"
"Sequence 5..." Alger was alarmed when he heard that. After all, a Sequence 5 could already be considered a powerhouse. In Alger's eyes, the few pirate admirals at sea were only at that level! And for Tower to be tracking such a dangerous figure... It meant that his strength wasn't simple. It was no wonder he knew so much.
As for Mr. Fool, who was sitting in the seat of honor, although he was also in awe of Sequence 5, to him, existences above Sequence 7 were very strong. They were existences that could beat him, The Fool. There was no difference.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Communication
chapters.content:
Chapter 133 - Communication
After Ebner's request, the transaction segment came to an end, and the meeting automatically entered the free exchange segment.
As soon as this segment began, Alger, who had a change in attitude towards The Fool and the Tarot Club, took the initiative to mention,
"Admiral of Stars Cattleya's Future discovered a secret sea route in the Berserk Sea south of the Rorsted Archipelago. It might even have found a treasure trove... There's news that the Future is being pursued by Admiral Hell's Black Tulip because of this treasure trove."
Audrey clearly yearned for the sea, so she asked in excitement, "What kind of treasure is it?"
"I don't know..." Alger shook his head slightly before explaining, "This news comes from a privateer ship captain who witnessed Admiral of Stars and Admiral Hell's battle. Although he's also a Mid-Sequence Beyonder, he doesn't dare to get too close to the battle zone between two experts."
Upon hearing this news, Ebner's heart stirred as he thought to himself, Could this so-called "treasure" be the mission handed to Jane by Queen Mystic? After all, it's very likely that Jane left the sea on the Future.
Thinking of this, he could not help but pretend to be curious and ask, "How did the battle between the two pirate admirals end?"
"In the end, the Future used the starlight to jump to a faraway sea. The Black Tulip failed to catch up." Alger never expected that Tower would be interested in this, but he still shared what he knew.
Borrowing starlight to make ships jump through space? That sounds really 'cool'! Audrey's yearning was written all over her face. She couldn't help but use a term that Emperor Roselle had invented that wasn't too ladylike.
Ebner secretly heaved a sigh of relief. Following that, he thought for a moment and felt that he should deepen Miss Audrey's sense of "mission." Therefore, he shared an intelligence:
"A Demoness of Agony believes in the evil god, the Primordial Moon. She might even have obtained a bit of godhood from the Primordial Moon... She's currently lurking in Backlund."
Deity?! Primordial Moon? Alger was alarmed as he once again raised his evaluation of the Tower. The person he was tracking was more dangerous than he imagined.
Audrey was also given a fright. Although she didn't know what the Primordial Moon was, just hearing the word "godhood" made her understand the seriousness of the matter. She asked with a solemn expression, "Mr. Tower, is the Demoness you mentioned the one that Earl Lorena might be colluding with?"
"That's right." Ebner gave an affirmative answer.
Upon hearing this, Audrey couldn't help but value Mr. Tower's request even more. At the same time, she felt a strong sense of immersion, participation, and mission.
However, she still asked hesitantly, "Then what's the Primordial Moon?"
Upon hearing this question, Ebner was about to give a simple explanation when he heard a light knock on the table.
He, Justice, and The Hanged Man turned their heads at the same time and looked at Mr. Fool, who was sitting at the seat of honor. They saw the mysterious figure shrouded in gray fog gently tapping the table with his finger.
Ebner couldn't help but be surprised, but he immediately recalled that the Feast of Blood he had "uploaded" seemed to have a Chapter regarding the Primordial Moon. So Mr. Fool was trying to show his presence?
Klein indeed wanted to show his presence. If he didn't even participate in topics involving evil gods and deities, it would make him, a mysterious existence who had revived, appear too strange and easily arouse suspicion...
Thankfully, the Feast of Blood mentioned this terrifying existence, and Miss Justice's question was just right.
As Klein thought this, he said leisurely,
"Apart from the Evernight Goddess, there are two other deities who wield the authority related to the Moon. One of them is the Sanguine's Ancestor, Lilith. Although it's rumored that 'She' has long perished, 'She' often gives authentic Sanguine responses.
"As for the other one, 'He' is an existence known as the Primordial Moon. 'He' only appeared in the Southern Continent after the Pale Era at the end of the Fourth Epoch. 'He' was worshipped by many secret organizations in the Southern Continent.
"And most of the people who pray to 'Him' will change bit by bit. They will become cruel, crazy, and filled with the desire to reproduce. As for the rest, there's a high chance that they will lose control on the spot and become true monsters.
"There was once a Sanguine Viscount who attempted to pray due to the danger, but in the end, she became a piece of meat that only knew how to mate and reproduce. She and the cows, sheep, horses, rats, and even plants and rocks gave birth to strange descendants. Each one of them was equivalent to creating a new monster race. Fortunately, she was quickly eliminated, and so were her descendants."
The Primordial Moon is that dangerous? Audrey's heart raced from Mr. Fool's description. This made her deeply realize that the secret existence other than the seven deities wasn't that trustworthy... Yes, the benevolent and gentle Mr. Fool was an exception.
Alger was filled with joy, glad that Mr. Fool was a god who could communicate and was even willing to communicate. He wasn't as crazy and unreasonable as the Primordial Moon.
"Thank you for your answer, Mr. Fool." After Audrey snapped back to her senses, she stood up, lifted her skirt, and bowed to Klein.
"There's no need to stand on ceremony, Miss Justice. This is still an advance payment," Klein said with a chuckle.
"I'll do my best to gather Roselle's diary for you!" Audrey promised again. Then, she turned to look at Ebner and asked, "Mr. Tower, can I secretly report this Demoness to the Church of Evernight?"
Ebner smiled when he heard that. "Actually, the Church of Storms and the Church of Earth Mother already know of this news. Perhaps they have already informed the Church of Evernight."
Audrey was speechless. She felt that since the Church knew, it didn't matter if she was involved in this matter... However, after some thought, she thought of her advantage and nodded. "I'll investigate Earl Lorena through my connections. If there's any progress, I'll pray to Mr. Fool and tell you..."
With that said, she belatedly realized that she had taken the liberty of being the Lord of The Fool. She hurriedly apologized to the mysterious existence at the front. "Sorry, Mr. Fool... This is just a personal request of mine... I hope you can agree to it."
"It's fine. I agree," Klein said with a warm smile. He wouldn't reject such a trivial matter. Besides, he wasn't very fond of evil gods and Demonesses.
Only then did Audrey heave a sigh of relief and return to her seat. She thought for a moment before sharing the news that Glaint had brought this morning. Finally, she asked, "Does anyone know which pathway's ability this is?"
The demigods of the Jacob family had fled? Were the Nighthawks that unreliable?
Ebner was first taken aback when he heard that, but on second thought, he felt that there was nothing wrong with it. After all, the demigods of the Error pathway were about to be eaten up by Amon. The official Beyonders of the various Churches had probably not encountered a demigod of this pathway for a very long time. Without any experience, it was normal to be caught off guard.
Yes, after Leonard joins the Red Gloves, the situation will improve.
With this in mind, Ebner realized that Alger didn't seem to be familiar with the powers of the Error pathway. Hence, after organizing his words, he said,
"According to what I know, there are two demigods from two pathways who can do what you say."
"Which two?" Upon hearing Tower speak, Audrey jolted and looked over.
Klein and Alger similarly focused their attention on Ebner.
"If the Spectator pathway reaches Sequence 4 and becomes a Manipulator, it can allow the Body of Heart and Mind to enter someone's mind island through the sea of collective subconscious. It can directly tamper with their subconscious and silently control them to do all kinds of things."
At this point, Ebner glanced at Audrey. Indeed, he realized that this lady had once again broken through the state of a Spectator. Even the gray fog on her face couldn't conceal her excitement.
I never expected a Spectator to be so powerful at the High-Sequence Beyonder level! The ability I fantasized about the entire morning could actually be my means in the future? This is great! Audrey suppressed the little pride in her heart and happily fantasized.
As for Alger and Klein, they felt great fear for the Psychology Alchemists at the same time. After all, no one wanted to be controlled unknowingly.
Ebner ignored the three of them and continued, "A Sequence 5 Dream Stealer of the Marauder pathway can also do something similar because they can 'steal' the other party's thoughts of putting it into practice... However, since even a high-ranking deacon of the Nighthawks has been tricked, it's only possible that he's a demigod."
After hearing this, Audrey nodded thoughtfully before politely saying, "Thank you for your answer, Mr. Tower. I have no further questions."
Seeing that the exchange was coming to an end and that no one had any intention of speaking, Klein knocked on the edge of the ancient table again. He looked at Ebner and said, "Tower, the content of the book you sacrificed doesn't have any hidden dangers or traps."
This was confirmed through divination and many other means. Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to open it.
So this book was given to Mr. Fool by Mr. Tower as a sacrifice. It's no wonder he wasn't curious... Audrey came to a realization. However, to be held by The Fool, it must be a very powerful book. She didn't know what price she had to pay to read it.
As for Alger, he had discovered something else from The Fool's words. It was that if he encountered something that might be dangerous, he could first "sacrifice" it to confirm it with Mr. Fool? Mr. Fool can do that? Uh, no, Mr. Fool can accept such a request? It's no wonder that "He" was willing to help "Him" escape despite "His" deep understanding of The Fool... Is this the benefit he hoped for?

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Banquet Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 134 - Banquet Invitation
"Thank you for your help." Ebner stood up and bowed to the figure shrouded in thick gray fog at the end of the long bronze table.
Then, he heard Mr. Fool continue in a calm tone,
"However, the contents of a few pages contain knowledge that exceeds your current level... I'll first dismantle it and safeguard it for you. What do you think?"
The Feast of Blood was a thread-bound book that could be freely dismantled. This method of storing books also came from Emperor Roselle.
Ebner was a little confused. He had read the first half of the Feast of Blood a long time ago. How could there be knowledge that exceeded his limit?
But after some thought, he understood Klein's plan.
Those pages of knowledge that exceed the limits of my tolerance, could it be those pages that record the Primordial Moon? Are they afraid that I will see through the essence of The Fool?
Ebner cursed silently but pretended to be respectful as he replied, "Thank you again, Mr. Fool. I have no problem with it. I can rest assured with those pages in your hands."
Klein heaved a sigh of relief when he heard Ebner's reply. After all, the book was from the Tower. He had to seek the other party's opinion before he could leave those pages behind... If it was the true book of the Feast of Blood, he might not dare destroy it. However, through divination, he knew that it was a copy. Although it was quite old, there was nothing special about it.
And he had just repeated the contents of those pages. Strictly speaking, "Tower" didn't suffer any losses.
"After the gathering ends, I'll return the Feast of Blood to you." Klein smiled at Ebner.
Ebner thought for a moment and knew that according to the so-called "equivalent exchange" principle set by The Fool, he probably owed a favor this time. Hence, he took the initiative to ask, "I wonder what other payment you need other than Roselle's diary?"
Klein, who was waiting for a similar response, smiled again.
"Information regarding the Antigonus family or the Secret Order."
As expected, I want to ask this... Ebner thought to himself, but after a moment of thought, he replied, "I'll gather some information about them and give it to you at the next gathering. Is that alright, Mr. Fool?" I have to spend some time thinking about what I can tell and what I can't say.
Klein was somewhat disappointed, but he still nodded slightly.
"No problem.
"If the information you gather exceeds the value of this appraisal book request, I will compensate you further."
As for what kind of situation exceeds the value of a request, of course, it will be decided by the respected Mr. Fool. If he has the ability to pay additional compensation, then so be it. If he doesn't have the ability, then so be it... Klein added inwardly.
With that said, Klein leaned back in his chair and surveyed The Hanged Man and Justice. "This condition is equally effective for you."
As for the information that The Fool wanted from the Secret Order and the Antigonus family, Alger didn't have any doubts. Ignoring the fact that The Fool had mentioned similar requests at previous gatherings, it wasn't strange for a suspected deity to be interested in ancient family clans and secret organizations.
And more importantly, after many gatherings, he was gradually certain that Mr. Fool's state wasn't perfect in the beginning. "He" might still be in a certain predicament even now. "He" had made all kinds of attempts to free "Him" from "His" restraints and no longer be restricted.
This might even involve the huge secret of the seven deities not descending into the real world after the Fourth Epoch... Alger's thoughts flashed as he trembled. He felt as though he had entered the domain of the gods.
Ignoring Alger's imagination, Audrey's eyes lit up when she heard The Fool's words.
"Mr. Fool, I'll also ask someone."
I wonder if Fors understands these ancient families and organizations, Audrey thought to herself.
After that, seeing that no one was sharing it again, Klein swept his gaze across The Hanged Man, Justice, and the Tower. He said with a smile,
"If there's nothing else to share, let's end today's gathering here."
He still needed to retain some of his spirituality for the "transaction" later.
"By your will," said Ebner and the other two, rising.
...
After returning to his room, Ebner didn't remove the wall of spirituality. Instead, he placed the Pseudo Rage ring, Lawyer Beyonder characteristic, and ten low-level charms on the altar that he had prepared long ago.
Following that, he recited in ancient Hermes,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"You are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog;
"You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
...
Above the gray fog, Klein looked at the items offered by Tower and sighed. He began to divine them one by one. Since he had agreed to be a witness, he had to do something for his members.
After confirming that there was nothing wrong with the tower, he spread his spirituality to the crimson star representing The Hanged Man and Justice, making them prepare for the bestowment ritual.
After all the transactions were completed, Klein looked at the 1,300 pound note floating in the gray fog and secretly swallowed a mouthful of saliva. Then, with great willpower, he moved his gaze away and extended his spirituality to the red star representing "Tower."
...
Upon seeing the cash drop from the Door of Summoning onto the altar, Ebner first secretly praised Mr. Fool's delivery service before using the Eye of Pure White to inspect it one by one before keeping it close to him.
This way, my total liquidity will increase to 2,800 pounds. If I exclude the 2,100 pounds I spent on buying ingredients tonight, I'll still have 700 pounds left...
As for the other main ingredient of the Polymath, although I still don't know what it is, it shouldn't be less than 1,000 pounds. It might even be more expensive than the Tree of Elders' core... There's still a huge gap in funds.
After making some calculations in his heart, Ebner immediately felt that he still did not have enough money to spend, and working hard to earn money was probably his main mission in the next stage other than acting.
Thankfully, Little Sun will join the Tarot Club in another two weeks. Perhaps the materials needed can be exchanged from him...
At this moment, Ebner sensed that the wall of spirituality he had set up had been touched. He knew that it was Kenny knocking on the door.
Upon seeing this, he hurriedly tidied up the traces of the ritual before removing his spirituality. He sat back behind his desk and said, "Come in."
"Is there another client?" Ebner asked with a smile as Kenny pushed the door open.
"Detective Bryan, it's Member of Parliament Macht."
Ebner was not surprised by his visit. After all, the other party had spent money. How could he not come and confirm the results?
He tidied his clothes and led Kenny to the living room on the first floor. He saw Macht in formal attire.
He did not bring his wife, Riana, with him this time. He was smoking a cigarette in the smoking area in the corner of the living room. When he saw Ebner coming down the stairs, he immediately stubbed out his cigarette and came up to him in three steps. He said warmly, "Detective Bryan, it's nice to see you again."
"I'm just as pleased, Senator," Ebner returned with a polite nod.
After the two sat on the sofa and exchanged a few pleasantries, Macht couldn't help but ask, "Detective Bryan, do you know where Bishop Utravsky is?"
"I've already asked on your behalf. The bishop has already agreed. He would be happy to visit your house." Ebner nodded.
"It's truly my honor!" The slight fatigue on Macht's face vanished. He looked at Ebner with a burning gaze and asked with a smile, "I'll hold a banquet at home on Wednesday night. I hope you and Mr. Bishop can attend."
"I think there's no problem." This time, Ebner agreed on Bishop Utravsky's behalf. After all, he had already considered such a situation when he asked yesterday, and the giant bishop didn't object.
"I'll hand the official invitation to you and His Eminence tomorrow." Macht had been working on his daughter's matter for a few days, and now that there was finally an outcome, he couldn't help but heave a sigh of relief.
...
At seven in the evening, Ebner, who had 2,800 pounds in his pocket, didn't dare to squeeze into the subway. Instead, he took a rental carriage to the Harvest Church on Rose Street in the South Borough of the Bridge.

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Deal
chapters.content:
Chapter 135 - Deal
The rental carriage slowly stopped outside the rather eye-catching Harvest Church. Ebner, who was carrying a huge sum of money, surveyed the area before entering the hall.
Viscount Cullen was currently sitting in the first row on the right. He was playing with the undead bird named "Silika" while talking to Judy.
The first thing that attracted Ebner's attention was a black suitcase beside Cullen's feet. Its surface seemed to be covered with a wall of spirituality.
Sensing that Ebner had walked in, Cullen casually greeted him, while Judy welcomed him with a smile. "Your classmate, Roman, has already thought things through and doesn't intend to continue entangling with Alex... Although I see that she still has some insincere words in her subconscious, at least she won't take things too hard."
Ebner was stunned for a moment before he remembered who Alex was. "How did you persuade Roman?"
"I only used a Beyonder item to strengthen her subconscious that Alex doesn't have any true feelings for her... Yes, I also added some memories to her. Now, she doesn't remember that she actually spent a week at the Harvest Church..." She only remembers attending a beautiful ball with you...
After hiding her last words, Judy glanced guiltily at Ebner, then changed the subject.
"By the way, that Alex became Prince Edessak's advisor through the recommendation of 'Witch' Lena... His family also feels that his social status is extraordinary because of this. They are already considering breaking off the engagement with Roman."
Become Prince Edessak's advisor? That might not be a good thing. After all, His Highness was a tragedy of a "main account". Not many people around him would have a good ending in the future.
Ebner grumbled under his breath for a while before turning his attention away from these trivial matters. Right now, what he was most concerned about was the matter of trading materials. As a result, he did not notice Judy's wandering gaze. All his attention was focused on Cullen, who was using "Amantha extract" to tease the little bird.
Sensing that Ebner was looking at him, Viscount Cullen stopped what he was doing. Amidst the discontented chirping of "Silika", he turned around and asked with a smile, "I've already brought the items. Have you gathered all your money?"
Ebner nodded and smiled. "Can you let me verify if it's the material I need?"
Cullen casually sprinkled some powder ground from spirituality materials. After the satisfied "Silika" returned to the spirit world, he said apologetically, "Sorry to keep you waiting." As he spoke, he lifted the suitcase to his chest and undid the hidden button with a snap.
The wall of spirituality on it shattered, turning into a breeze that passed through the prayer hall.
Ebner, who had long activated his Spirit Vision, immediately saw bursts of strange and resplendent light. It was a spiritual luster that could only be emitted by an extraordinary main material.
There was a 20-centimeter square box inside the suitcase. It was made of tin and had many patterns. It was simple and heavy.
Cullen held the black leather case in one hand and opened the silver but slightly dull tin box. The item inside looked like a heart carved from wood. It was dark green in color and had veins like branches coiled around it, crisscrossing it like a chain mail.
As the candlelight in the cathedral flickered, it constantly shrank and expanded like a real heart. There were invisible auras being sucked in from below and expelled from above.
Upon seeing it, Ebner felt that the potion's power that he had digested was somewhat agitated, like a magnet encountering an anomaly.
Ebner was no stranger to this feeling. Every night, when he used the Eye of Pure White to analyze 2-081, he would occasionally sense something similar.
It stemmed from the convergence effect of a Beyonder characteristic, which was that High-Sequence items of the same pathway would intermittently attract Low- and Mid-Sequence Beyonders to its vicinity, and they had the tendency to gather together...
So the experienced Ebner easily suppressed the feeling of attraction between them.
However, even without analyzing it, he already knew that the strange heart in front of him was the real Tree of Elders' heart. Otherwise, there would not be a convergence effect.
Cullen displayed it for a moment. Seeing the detective in front of him nod in satisfaction, he smiled and asked, "Any other questions?"
Ebner shook his head gently, but he still secretly activated the Eye of Pure White to analyze the heart of the tree. Then, he took out a stack of notes from his closest pocket. They were all 10 pounds, a total of 60 notes. Following that, he took out a Backlund Bank receipt.
"A total of 2,100 pounds." Ebner placed the deposit slip on the stack of cash and pushed it in front of Cullen.
Cullen first closed the box containing the heart of the tree and placed it into the suitcase. Then, he picked up the receipt and took a closer look. As a vampire who had lived for hundreds of years, he had sufficient means to determine the authenticity of a receipt.
Then, he put down the receipt in satisfaction and picked up the stack of bills to check.
After confirming that there were no fake coins, he only made a few points before handing the suitcase to Ebner. He smiled and said, "I'll give you the suitcase and box."
Ebner took the suitcase, opened it, and confirmed it with the analysis of the Eye of Pure White. Only then did he put it away in satisfaction.
"You should go to the room at the back to trade materials in the future... If a believer happened to come in just now, wouldn't they immediately call the police?" Judy, who had witnessed the entire transaction process, could not help but complain.
"I don't really care, but if we're not in a public place like this, I'm afraid Detective Bryan has some concerns." Viscount Cullen glanced at Judy and shook his head.
Ebner ignored the daily bickering between the two Forsaken Ones and only sighed on the side. "You guys are really free. Is this attitude really for a mission?"
"Heh heh, because this is Loen, most of our actions can only be carried out after someone else sleeps at night. That's why we seem to be idling around... After you leave, Judy and I will be going to the related personnel's dreams to investigate the case." Viscount Cullen tucked the bills into his pocket and explained slightly.
At this point, Ebner remembered that his teacher had found out that he had not yet spoken to the Forsaken Ones about Earl Lorena, so he organized his words and recounted his experiences at Inspector Wayne's funeral, as well as his subsequent speculations to Cullen and Judy.
"Earl Lorena... Court aristocrat... Unfortunately, we can't touch this clue. Otherwise, we might be immediately expelled..." Cullen sighed after hearing that. In the Loen Kingdom, handling cases was always difficult. This made their team very uncomfortable.
"What about informing the Church of Storms?" Ebner asked.
"We don't have any concrete evidence, and our identities are special. I'm afraid it will be very difficult for the Mandated Punishers to fully trust us. At most, we will be on guard and secretly investigate..." Cullen had seen many similar matters in his long life, so he knew very well how the officials would react and handle them.
"Evidence..." Ebner muttered before looking in the direction of Empress Borough. He thought to himself, I can only believe Miss Justice's abilities.
...
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's mansion.
Audrey stood on the stairs and looked at her father, who was about to walk out of the mansion to welcome the guests. She whispered to the golden retriever beside her,
"Susie, slip into the living room and hide. Remember what Dad and the others said. Tell me when you get back."
Susie quickly wagged her tail as though she was confused by Audrey's choice of words. All she could do was open her mouth to reply with one word:
"Woof!"

chapters.title: Chapter 136: "Upload" Materials
chapters.content:
Chapter 136 - "Upload" Materials
At ten in the evening, Susie sneaked out of the door of the living room and sneaked back to Audrey's room. The latter hurriedly found an excuse to make the maidservants leave for the time being before locking the door. She turned her head to look at Susie, who wasn't sure if she was still a pet.
"Did you hear, uh, or did something happen?"
The golden retriever, Susie, squatted there calmly and howled, shaking the surrounding air.
"Yes, I heard the earl and a few nobles discussing something in the study. One of them, Marquis Sosna, started the conversation and talked about which lady was more charming..."
Seeing that Susie's words were so surprising, Audrey immediately felt extremely embarrassed. She fell silent for a few seconds before interrupting. "Susie, just ignore this marquis and repeat the rest of their conversation."
Later, she would have to disclose Marquis Sosna's words to her mother and persuade her father to cut ties with Marquis.
"Alright ~" Susie replied happily. "They discussed the prince's assassination at the headquarters of the Daily Observer. They said that the murderer's target might not be His Highness, but the Church of Storms and the Mandated Punishers."
"Is that so?" Audrey asked in surprise.
In the past two days, she had seen the heroic deeds of the "brave and resourceful detective" at the headquarters of the Daily Observer. Were they all fake?
No, that's not right. The detective's story should be true. I guess it was also his quick wit that allowed him to see through the murderer's plan and save the ordinary people in the building at the time.
"However, I'm afraid that even the detective himself doesn't know that there is a deeper reason behind this... but I do.
Just as Audrey was feeling satisfied with herself, Susie answered very honestly, "I can't give you a definite answer. This is just what I heard. I heard from the Viscount who was discussing this matter that it was said by Prince Edessak himself. By the way, that Viscount also said that Prince Edessak seems to have become enemies with Earl Lorena recently."
"Earl Lorena..." Audrey didn't expect to hear this name. Thinking of Tower's request and the Demoness that the earl might be colluding with, she hurriedly asked, "Susie, who's the viscount that's discussing this matter?"
Now that she knew the name, she wanted to find out more about it while waiting for the ball.
"Audrey, I don't know so many people. I only knew that person was a viscount after hearing the earl address me that way... After all, I'm just a dog that has just started learning." Susie shook her tail and lowered her head.
"..." Audrey was momentarily stunned before she beamed. "Susie, you've already done very well! This is your reward!"
She took out a bag from a beautifully decorated cabinet, pulled the seal, and placed it in front of Susie.
This was a dog biscuit made by Backlund's Pet Company with flour, vegetables, meat, and water. It was Susie's favorite snack.
Susie, who was sitting upright, sniffed and waved one of her claws, as if she was considering how to eat to suit her current identity.
A few seconds later, it gave up thinking and followed its instincts. It suddenly pounced forward and rushed towards the door with the bag of rations in its mouth.
It straightened its body, opened the door with one paw, and walked out. It hid in the shadows and began to enjoy its snacks.
...
After receiving the Tree of Elders' Heart, Ebner communicated with Bishop Utravsky about Member of Parliament Macht's banquet. The latter didn't reject and said that he would arrive on time after receiving the invitation.
After discussing this matter, Ebner was just about to bid farewell when he realized that the giant bishop was holding a manuscript in his hand. The handwriting on the manuscript was elegant, clearly written by a girl.
Ebner had thought that the archbishop had some romantic story, but upon closer inspection, he realized that the manuscript was actually written in Chinese! Although the structure of the Chinese interface was extremely awkward, it was very neat and could be considered a rather good type of transcription.
"Roselle text?" Ebner pretended to be surprised as he asked. Then, he carefully read the text and realized that it was indeed a Roselle diary entry.
"22nd September. Today, I received information regarding Stiano's Golden Armor Spell. This is truly an impressive technique. Stiano lives up to being one of the founders of the Moses Ascetic Order. This spell is actually comparable to a Guardian's core ability! Yes, I've decided. I'm going to modify this spell into Roselle's Golden Armor Spell again. It needs to have twelve different styles."
Alright, Emperor... It seems like you really intend to create the Golden Holy Garment? I wonder if the final transformation of this technique is successful.
Just as Ebner was grumbling to himself, Bishop Utravsky saw that he was interested. The smiling man said,
"This is the manuscript that Miss Hazel copied from Roselle... She seems to like copying manuscripts, so I gave her a few of my personal collection for reference."
Is he trying to cultivate her character? Speaking of which, why does the Church of Earth Mother's style seem a little off... Isn't copying scriptures the style of a certain Western Continent sect? Ebner lampooned silently, but on the surface, he sighed. "I never expected Miss Hazel to be interested in Roselle's text."
"She's interested in the basics of mysticism... Although she didn't say it, I can sense that the more she learns, the more ashamed she is of her ignorance." Bishop Utravsky shook his head.
"Where is Miss Hazel?"
"She still needs to be imprisoned underground most of the time... Only when praying to Mother will she be allowed to come up."
After that, Ebner didn't chat with the giant bishop. After bidding farewell to the people in the hall, he left the Harvest Church in a carriage.
However, he didn't immediately return to his teacher's house. Instead, he headed for his residence in East Borough.
After all, the Tree of Elders' Heart was also what his teacher needed. Ebner did not want to use it to test his humanity. Even if his teacher treated him very well, he would not steal his student's items.
Moreover, the teacher's house could be said to be both commercial and residential. People came and went. He was indeed worried about leaving such a precious thing there.
After entering his room, Ebner took out the spare materials that he had kept here and began to set up the ritual and altar.
A main ingredient worth 2,100 pounds naturally couldn't be placed in a house in East Borough. It was safer in Sefirah Castle.
However, I can't let The Fool help for nothing. Although it's unlikely that he will reject it, I can't be too casual with my attitude... It's better to be respectful, or I might scare him away.
With this in mind, Ebner took out a pen and paper and silently wrote Roselle's diary that he had seen at the Harvest Church. With his excellent memory, he even imitated Hazel's handwriting.
After doing this, he placed the diary and the leather box containing the Tree of Elders on the altar before sitting down. He leaned forward and placed his hands in a praying position against his forehead.
Then, she chanted in ancient Hermes,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era...
"You are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog.
"You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
...
At 10 p.m., it happened to be Klein's turn to patrol the cemetery. Just as he returned to 2 Daffodil Street, he heard illusory pleas before he could take off his hat.
It can't be Mr. Tower again, right? I just held the Tarot Club today, and there's already something I need to pray to The Fool? Klein thought as he prepared to enter the living room and head to his room on the second floor.
At that moment, he heard the bathroom door open again. He hurriedly turned around to check, only to see his sister, Melissa, walk out.
"You're back..." Melissa seemed very sleepy as she rubbed her eyes.
Klein pretended to cover his mouth and yawned.
"Yes, I need a beautiful dream. I have to go to work tomorrow morning."
He was supposed to take turns on Monday, but because of the cemetery mission assigned by Captain, his holiday was deducted by one point...
He did not know if he could apply for a special allowance because of this.
Melissa tersely acknowledged as she suddenly thought of something.
"Elizabeth went to the town of Lamud for a vacation. Her family owns an estate there."
Lamud Town seems to be in the suburbs... But where she goes has nothing to do with me? Klein thought in puzzlement.
However, these scattered thoughts flashed through his mind as he looked at Melissa. He forced a smile and nodded.
"Then I hope she has a good time. I just want to get some sleep as soon as possible."
Crossing to Melissa, he entered his bedroom and locked the door behind him.
Following that, he took out the ritual silver dagger and created a sealed wall of spirituality.
Then, Klein took four steps counterclockwise and silently chanted the incantation. He resisted the chaotic screams and went above the gray fog.
In this illusory and boundless world, sitting at the head of the ancient mottled bronze table, he casually looked at it and realized that the prayer had indeed come from Mr. Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Kaspars’ Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 137 - Kaspars' Invitation
"...Mr. Fool, I just found a page of Roselle's diary. I'm requesting to hold a sacrificial ritual and offer it to you in exchange for the Tree of Elders' Heart to temporarily stay in your divine kingdom."
It sounded nice, but in reality, after the "logistics" and "danger inspection", it was "valuables stored" again, right?
The corners of Klein's mouth twitched as he couldn't help but lampoon.
However, he didn't reject such requests that could show Mr. Fool's nature as a deity. Furthermore, he had a page of Roselle's diary as payment.
After some maneuvering, Klein looked at the emerald-green wooden heart in the suitcase and muttered to himself, "This is the main ingredient of a Mid-Sequence potion? Just looking at it makes me feel that it's very powerful... So the reason why Mr. Tower was so active in promoting it was to raise money to buy it...
"Tower really trusts me. Isn't he afraid that I'll sell something that's worth at least 2,000 pounds?
"But in his eyes, I'm an ancient god. I don't need money..."
Klein laughed self-deprecatingly before picking up the page of Roselle's diary.
Is Roselle trying to build the Twelve Palaces of the Orient? And which Sequence is Guardian? It sounds very powerful... In addition, one of the founders of the Moses Ascetic Order is named Stiano. I wonder what relationship he has with the Hidden Sage...
In addition, Old Neil's condition seems to be rather stable. It doesn't seem like he has been corrupted by the knowledge of a superior existence...
"This makes me want to report to Captain several times, but I don't have a suitable excuse."
...
In a one-bedroom room in East Borough, Ebner saw the suitcase and diary disappear into the Door of Illusion. Only then did he stand up after praising The Fool. He packed up the related items for the ritual and placed them in the only cabinet in the room.
After doing this, he left East Borough and took a rental carriage back to his teacher's house.
The next day, Ebner received an invitation from Macht early in the morning, inviting him to visit Elk Manor in the northwestern suburbs of Backlund at seven o'clock on Wednesday night.
When Detective Isengard Stanton saw this, he smiled and said to him, "It looks like you won't be able to attend the Beyonder gathering I organize tomorrow night."
"It doesn't matter. I don't have anything I want to buy at the moment anyway..." Of course, the most important thing was that he had just spent a large sum of money, and it was the time when he was short on money. Moreover, the level of the teacher's gathering wasn't high, and there were very few things that he was interested in.
Detective Isengard nodded and was about to leave when he suddenly recalled something. He turned to his student and said, "By the way, Kaspars from the Bravehearts Bar contacted me previously. He said that he needs your help."
"Kaspars? What could be the matter with him... Could it be that the gang needs me to hold down the fort for them to snatch territory?" Ebner asked with a strange expression. He seemed to have made such a promise when he first became a Beyonder.
"Probably not... There are many Beyonders behind Kaspars. Otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to run the black market there," Detective Isengard answered after some thought. After all, he was actually one of Kaspars' backers. If it was really for territory, there was no reason for him to only look for Ebner.
I know that, a Zombie and a Wraith. This configuration is enough to dominate a gang. Ebner lampooned before nodding. "I'll take some time to go take a look today." Of course, I have to investigate before going. What if I'm sold?
Seeing that his student knew what to do, Detective Isengard didn't nag further. He turned around and got into the carriage.
As there was no commission, for the time being, Ebner wasn't in a rush to head out. Instead, he continued learning the other Sequence 6 ability of the Wind-blessed, Gliding. After learning "Flight," "Gliding" became much simpler. He only needed another week to learn it.
And although "gliding" seemed to be less effective than "flying," it was not restricted by the rules of flight. On certain occasions, it was more advantageous.
Afternoon, Ebner picked up the Clown Mask and left the detective agency. He took a carriage to the Bravehearts Bar in the Bridge District.
After arriving at Iron Gate Street, he put on his mask and familiarly entered the bar. He passed through the drinkers who were cheering beside the boxing ring and walked around the surrounding card houses and gaming rooms to gather information before walking to the bar.
Then, he saw Kaspars sitting there drinking.
The old man asked for a glass of Lanti Proof. As he savored the fragrance of the malt and the burning sensation in his throat, he narrowed his eyes in satisfaction.
Ebner took the opportunity to sit in front of the bar and said to the bartender, "Half and half."
"Half and half" was the most popular alcoholic beverage in East Borough. It was concocted from malt beer and wine that enhanced alcohol. As there were two ingredients and the ratio was about the same, it was nicknamed "Half".
The bartender looked up at the indistinguishable man and woman in front of him. After a moment's hesitation, he said, "Four and a half pence."
Ebner paid and watched as the bartender mixed the drinks. He secretly activated the Eye of Pure White and extracted Kaspars's aura before "Backtracking."
Then, scenes of the bar appeared before his eyes.
Ebner skipped most of the useless scenes and focused on the two sections.
One of the segments showed a young man who had clearly never been to a bar asking Kaspars about the Beyonder gathering.
The content seemed normal, and there were similar scenes in other scenes. However, Ebner recognized the young man who came to inquire about the gathering. He was the police officer Shoko who had caused a scene at Inspector Wayne's funeral.
Find out more about the Beyonder gathering? What does this police officer want... He feels that the police station isn't reliable, so he came to investigate Beyonders? Or has he become a Beyonder himself? Then... where did he get his potion formula from?
Ebner though only briefly, then turned his attention to another scene.
It was a pitch-black card house. A man in a white shirt and black vest was playing poker with a dozen people. Kaspars walked in nervously and asked, "Mr. Maric, why are you looking for me?"
The man named Maric put down the poker card and looked at the elder in front of him. There seemed to be deep malice in his eyes, but he asked calmly, "Kaspars, I remember you know the recently famous Hero Detective Bryan?"
"Yes, Sir." Kaspars didn't dare meet Maric's eyes as he lowered his head and answered.
"Can you invite him over? I have something I want to entrust him with... Don't worry, my payment has always been fair. I won't harm others for no reason. You know that." Maric raised his chin.
...
The retracing of the scene ended here. Ebner frowned. He never expected that it was someone from the Rose School of Thought temperance faction who wanted to find him. After all, he had nothing to do with them other than the matter regarding Jane.
Glancing at the drunk Kaspars next to him, Ebner drained the "half" in his hand and left the Bravehearts Bar.
He decided to see what Maric wanted him to do, but he had to wait until he was fully prepared.
Yes, the Sword of Dawn had to be carried, and the Solomon gold coin had to be taken... It would be even better if he could trick Judy or Cullen over...

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 138 - Meeting
South of the Bridge, Rose Street, Harvest Church.
Ebner mentioned to Cullen and Judy that a Beyonder had asked to meet him. He didn't reveal Maric's exact Sequence and only said that it might be Sequence 6.
"So you want me or Judy to go with you? So we can look out for each other?" Cullen was hundreds of years old and naturally experienced. He saw through Ebner's thoughts in an instant.
Judy twirled her long brown hair with her fingers, looking curious. She had never been to a bar in Backlund, so she naturally had the idea of seeing it.
"Maybe there's some unexpected information..." Anyway, you guys have nothing to do now and can only act in the middle of the night.
Ebner wasn't embarrassed about being exposed. He hadn't thought he could hide it from Callum.
"Are there any drinks with unique flavors in Backlund's bar? If there are, I'll come with you!" Judy said with a smile. Although it was just an excuse, it was her true thoughts.
She and Ebner had become familiar with each other, and she didn't think that such a level of help would do any good. Besides, she was still feeling a little guilty about what had happened with Roman, so she was more than happy to help out with Ebner's request.
Ebner expressed his gratitude to her and introduced some local products such as Southville beer and dessert beer.
Seeing how eager she was to listen, this future "Druid" should be an old drunkard.
Just as Judy was fantasizing about the different flavors of the alcohol, Viscount Cullen pinched his chin and thought for a moment before saying, "Based on my observations of you, if the other party is only a Sequence 6, he might not be able to make you so cautious..." At this point, he looked at Ebner with a faint smile before continuing, "Therefore, this matter has to be considered according to how many Mid-Sequence Beyonders he has, or if he has a powerful Sequence 5... Of course, as there might not be any conflict, it's not very dangerous..."
As expected of a wise old man... Ebner silently cursed. He knew that the other party was deliberately exaggerating the difficulty before setting the price. Hence, he exhaled and said, "Viscount Cullen, I really want to ask for your help... Just say it directly. What do I have to do to agree?"
' It better be a friendship price, or I won't need you to come along... With Judy around, there should be quite a bit of security.'
"Don't worry, we are friends... It's just that after we return safely from the bar, in exchange, I hope you can do me a small favor." The black-haired, red-eyed viscount with a lack of masculine aura smiled and said his request.
"What can I do for you?" Ebner asked warily.
"Don't worry, it's not a complicated problem, nor is there any danger... It's just that it's not convenient for me to tell you now. I'll tell you after I accompany you to the Bravehearts Bar." Viscount Cullen glanced at the brown-haired girl beside him and changed the topic. "When night comes, you and Judy will be in the open, and you can go directly to the appointment. And I'll be in the dark. This way, even if something unexpected really happens, I'll have a backup plan."
Ebner saw that he really didn't want to talk about the "help" topic right now, so he let it go. In any case, if there really was danger, he wouldn't take it. He would just compensate Viscount Cullen in other ways.
After the three of them finished discussing, Ebner carried the cello case and boarded the public carriage with Judy, who had changed into a male outfit, to Iron Gate Street in the bridge area.
Walking into the Bravehearts Bar, Ebner skillfully bought a glass of beer and handed it to Judy, who was eager to try. Then, under the guidance of the bartender, he went to Card Room 2 and found Kaspars.
Kaspars was playing "Fighting Evil" while betting on a particular boxer outside. He was having a rather pleasant time.
Upon seeing Ebner appear at the door, Kaspars covered the cards and cursed at the others who were unhappy. He then stood up and walked to the door.
He carefully sized up Ebner, whose temperament had changed again, and then looked at Judy beside him. He smiled and said, "Another one... A handsome young man is really capable."
Ebner was speechless. He couldn't say anything bad about this old "gangster" who had helped him before, so he changed the topic. "I heard you were looking for me?"
Kaspars led Ebner to a hidden door outside the kitchen and said in a low voice, "A powerful fellow is looking for you. He seems to want to entrust you with a request... Do you still remember the matter of me finding a new backer?"
Judy, on the other hand, was consciously a few steps behind. As she drank South Wales in her hand, she looked around curiously like a little girl who had come to such an occasion for the first time and vaguely discovered something.
"I heard you mention that the person seems to be called Maric?" Ebner pretended to recall before saying.
"Yes, it's Maric! He's the most terrifying person I know. He's not even afraid of bullets! You have to know that there are many Beyonders who have cooperated with me, but he's the only one who can do this." Kaspars seemed to be sighing, but in fact, he had used this method to reveal Maric's background to Ebner, although Ebner was already aware of Maric's origins.
"I understand." Ebner nodded, accepting the favor.
"I'm just sending a message... Now you know how dangerous this person is. Although he doesn't have any evil deeds, if you don't wish to see him, I can help you pass it on." Kaspars frowned slightly and said in a slightly hinting tone.
Ebner deliberately adjusted his position and took the opportunity to sneak a glance at Judy. Seeing her nod slightly, he smiled at Kaspars and said, "It's okay. Since I'm here, it's better to meet this Mr. Maric... And I haven't thanked him after what happened with Jane."
Kaspars looked at him deeply before clenching his right fist and striking his left chest.
"May the storm be with you."
Then I'm doomed... Who doesn't know that the Church of Storms cleaned up the battlefield afterward...
After cursing silently, Ebner asked, "I want to go see Maric with Judy... the girl who was drinking beer in the back. Is that okay?"
Kaspars looked at Judy in surprise. Seeing that she had raised her cup and returned a sweet smile, he retracted his gaze and deliberated. "I have to ask. Wait here."
He didn't ask Ebner why he wanted to bring Judy with him. A nosy person wouldn't live long in this line of work. Even if Ebner was the son of his friend, he was already a Beyonder who had grown up and was no longer the same as before.
Seeing Kaspars exit through the hidden door at the back of the kitchen, Ebner pretended to look over his shoulder and asked Judy, who had taken a long swig of beer, "How's it going?"
"This beer tastes good. It's refreshing. It's just that the malt used to make wine isn't an expensive breed," Judy said seriously.
Ebner supported his forehead with his hand and said helplessly, "I'm asking if there are any problems with this place..."
Judy put down her glass, then pointed vaguely with her finger at several people who had stopped at different places in the bar. "The man has arranged for puppets to keep an eye on this bar... and I don't think those puppets are alive."
Zombies, I know.
Just as Ebner thought this, he heard Judy continue, "And I just seemed to feel prying from the spirit world. I don't know if it was an illusion or if there really was something—"
Could it be that Miss Sharron was here as well? A thought struck Ebner, and he actively reduced the conversation.
About ten minutes later, Kaspars returned to the kitchen.
"You guys can go together. He agreed," Kaspars said in a deep voice.
Those two from the temperance faction should know Judy's strength... Ebner smiled and nodded.
Next, he and Judy followed behind Kaspars, who was walking with difficulty, through the hidden door of the back kitchen and into a dark alley behind the bar.
There were high walls on both sides of the alley, and behind the walls were individual manors.
After walking along the alley for about three to four minutes, Kaspars suddenly stopped and lightly knocked on a door that was disguised as a wall by the side of the road. After obtaining permission, he then led Ebner and Judy in.
It was a small house that was sandwiched in the middle of a row of houses. If one didn't look carefully, they wouldn't notice it at all.
Seeing the trio enter, the man in the white shirt and black vest slowly stood up. It was Maric.
And sitting in front of him was a woman wearing a black gothic regal dress and a small bonnet of the same color. Her face was pale, but her pale blonde hair and exquisite appearance complemented each other's strengths.
"Detective Bryan, I have something to entrust you with."

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Sharron and Maric
chapters.content:
Chapter 139 - Sharron and Maric
"Detective Bryan, I have something to entrust you with," Maric said in a hoarse and deep voice as he looked over with his eyes that were filled with malice.
So direct? Don't they even need to make small talk or introduce themselves? Ebner was first taken aback before he felt relieved. Maric was a member of the temperance faction after all. Most of his attention was focused on resisting madness and desires. He probably didn't pay much attention to small matters.
As Ebner thought this, he turned to look at Kaspars. The latter immediately came to a realization and quickly left the house after bowing.
Seeing that the only ordinary person had left, Ebner heaved a sigh of relief. He then looked at the temperance faction duo in front of him seriously and asked, "Shouldn't you introduce them first?"
Even if he was being commissioned, he had to take the initiative and not be led away. After all, he was not weaker than the two people in front of him.
The pale but exquisite-looking lady looked at him and then at Judy who was fiddling with her hair. With a calm expression, she said,
"Sharron."
Maric also said simply, "Maric... I think you heard my name from Kaspars."
What's the difference between this introduction and not introducing? If I hadn't read the novel, I would have thought that you had used a fake name. Ebner grumbled, but on the surface, he asked, "Miss Sharron, Mr. Maric. Since you came to me, you should know me... I wonder what you want me to do?"
Maric saw that he couldn't suppress the other party in terms of aura. He wasn't good at controlling the pace of the conversation, so when he heard Ebner's question, he could only scratch his slightly messy hair and say,
"We heard some news and believe that you have some connections with the Church of Earth Mother... Therefore, our initial request was for you to introduce a Forsaken One or a bishop..."
Having said that, he saw the girl who was playing with her long brown hair stop. She continued,
"But now we've changed our minds."
The only factions that guess that I might be related to the Church of Earth Mother are the Mandated Punishers, the Machinery Hivemind, and Prince Edessak... Hmm, perhaps the Nighthawks and MI9 will also receive some news... Where did it leak to Sharron?
Yes, there was a high chance that the church's official team was fine. It was likely that the prince or MI9 had leaked the news...
Various thoughts raced through Ebner's mind, but he kept his composure and asked, "Why?"
"Because this lady and the Sanguine Viscount lying in ambush outside the house are both Forsaken Ones." Without waiting for Maric to reply, the blonde-haired, black regal dress Sharron answered with an ethereal voice.
Mr. Cullen, you have lived for so long in vain, yet you were discovered by someone directly! Ebner's calm face stiffened, but he immediately recovered. But before he could say anything, a group of black bats passed through the living room window and entered the room. They quickly pieced together and formed Cullen's figure.
He came out just like that... Was he that impatient? What happened to the light and darkness?
Ebner was dumbfounded. He felt that things were going out of control.
However, Cullen didn't have a smile on his face as usual. On the contrary, he looked at Sharron with an extremely serious expression and asked, "Why do you have her keepsake on you?"
Sharron, who was wearing a black regal dress, calmly replied, "Maric and I were nearly discovered by the Rose School of Thought demigods. She helped us."
Cullen nodded upon hearing this. His expression eased slightly, but he still said in disbelief, "She actually handed that thing to you? She clearly valued it very much in the past and refused to let it go easily."
"I don't know why either, but the premonition I got from the spirit world is that holding this thing won't do me any harm." Sharron fell silent for a moment before her illusory voice sounded again.
Ebner was confused by this conversation. He did not understand what they were talking about at all. He could not help but turn around to look at Judy, only to find that this girl was looking at Cullen with a gossipy expression as if she was imagining some touching plot.
Ebner didn't want to pry into Cullen's privacy. He pressed a hand to his forehead, determined to steer the question back to the right path, so he cleared his throat and said, "Ahem, excuse me, Miss Sharron. It's getting late, and I think we'd better get back to business... What exactly do you want to entrust me with?"
When Sharron heard that, she turned her head to look at Maric beside her. The latter immediately understood and ruffled her messy brown hair again. She said, "Sharron had previously followed Wraith Steve from the Rose School of Thought's indulgence faction. She discovered that he has made contact with a Demoness of Agony who believes in the Primordial Moon..."
He didn't specially explain what the Rose School of Thought was. After all, everyone present was a member of the Church of Earth Mother, so they shouldn't be unfamiliar with the Rose School of Thought.
Hearing this, Ebner and Judy looked at each other in surprise. They hadn't expected the clue they'd been looking for to show up here.
"The Rose School of Thought also has believers of the Primordial Moon, so Steve doesn't reject that Demoness of Afflictions... We aren't sure what they are plotting, but according to our investigations after the matter, Sharron and I are certain of one thing. That is, the Demoness of Agony wants to use the Indulgence Faction's demigod, Zatwen, to do something." Maric clasped his hands and tried his best to suppress his madness as he said,
"Regardless of what the Demoness' plan is, if she wants Zatwen to take action, then the bait she released must be real."
"And anything that might make Zatwen stronger must be destroyed!" Sharron opened her lips and added with an illusory voice.
So that's how it is. Their original plan was to get me to contact the Forsaken, then use the hands of the Forsaken to destroy the Demoness's plan, preventing the Rose School of Thought's demigod from becoming stronger...
But because I didn't act according to the plan and directly brought the Forsaken One to their doorsteps, they changed their strategy at the right time. Instead of calling it a commission, it was better to say that they were deliberately revealing information. Anyway, they were very certain that the Forsaken One wouldn't ignore the Primordial Moon believers...
Wait a minute... That's not right. If that's the case, wouldn't the commission be in vain? Not only did they not have to pay me the commission fee, but I even got a favor from Judy and Cullen... What a loss.
While Ebner was letting his imagination run wild, Viscount Cullen asked directly, "So, you just want to tell us about this matter and not actually have a commission?"
"We never expected Detective Bryan to have such a close relationship with the Forsaken One's..." Maric said as he clenched his teeth.
"Although there's no need for a commission, we will still pay for it!
"A gang controlled by Steve is helping him and Jason abduct living people to satisfy their desires.
"We will destroy this gang and rescue the survivors. Then, we can give the credit to Detective Bryan."

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Sword of the Goddess
chapters.content:
Chapter 140 - Sword of the Goddess
"No, I don't need it at all! Thank you..." Ebner was now very reluctant to be famous, especially when Maric mentioned that the mafia involved the Rose School of Thought's indulgence faction. Originally, even ordinary people like Kaspars, who weren't deeply involved, had been killed to vent their anger, much less him. He was 100% certain that he would receive revenge.
"In that case, forget it... I thought you were preparing some ritual." With that said, Maric clearly frowned and asked in a slightly hoarse voice, "Then, what reward do you want? Let me make it clear first. If it's too much, we might not agree."
The reason why he and Sharron were willing to pay Ebner a certain amount of referral fee was because they wanted to build a good relationship with the Forsaken Ones. However, if they paid too much, it wouldn't be worth it.
What do I want? Ebner looked at Maric, whose face was abnormally pale, and his heart stirred. He said, "I want you to demonstrate the ability of a Zombie for me. I wonder if that's possible?"
"A demonstration ability?" Maric didn't nod immediately. He looked at Ebner with his brown eyes and asked, "What do you want to do?"
He didn't find it strange that the other party knew that he was a Zombie. The last Sanguine Viscount who appeared seemed to have received news from her in advance.
"I'm just curious about the powers of a Zombie... When I encounter similar enemies in the future, I'll be better prepared," Ebner said casually. As for whether the other party believed him or not, it was none of his business.
Maric fell silent for a second before looking at Sharron beside him. Seeing that she didn't object, he pinched his glabella and said, "Alright. In a while, I'll find a place to demonstrate the powers of a Zombie in front of you."
Ebner nodded in satisfaction and said no more, returning the conversational dominance to Viscount Cullen.
Cullen thought for a moment and asked, "There's no need for you to beat around the bush... Just get Wraith to throw the information to Ebner or stick it to the entrance of the Harvest Church to resolve the problem. Why must you make it so complicated and meet us... Is there something else?"
Maric immediately turned irritated when he heard that. He almost couldn't suppress the malice in his eyes. This Sanguine seemed to have seen through him and Sharron completely. Every word he said seemed to have the upper hand.
However, he still forced himself to control the malice that had appeared out of nowhere. He took a deep breath and said, "Yes, we wish to make a deal with you."
"What deal?" Cullen's crimson eyes narrowed as he asked lazily.
"I wish to buy a batch of sedatives to suppress my desires from you... Of course, I want some special ones. I've injected too many in the past, and I've changed many varieties. Ordinary sedatives have no effect on me." Maric pinched his brows again.
"I see... However, there's a Potions Professor who has been teaching here for more than a hundred years, and a Biologist who was born to be a Harvest Priest. Your request shouldn't be difficult to fulfill..." Cullen nodded, but he did not finish his sentence. However, his meaning was very clear. He was asking what they were willing to exchange for.
Discrimination also has a half-assed "doctor"...Ebner added in his heart. After becoming familiar with Judy, he had learned a lot of abilities from her. Currently, he could already simulate skills to treat some less serious injuries and illnesses.
"Sharron and I can provide you with some information that you can't investigate..." Maric said in a hoarse voice.
This was also the reason why he and Sharron didn't report to other official Beyonders. Although Earth Mother was an orthodox deity, "Her" Church wasn't in an ideal situation in Loen. There were too many restrictions. And this gave them the foundation to cooperate.
Cullen knew what the two of them were thinking, but he had no intention of rejecting them. Furthermore, with that person's item, he had a basic trust in Miss Wraith in front of him. Hence, he nodded and said, "It just so happens that there's something I need to investigate. If you can find any clues, I'll make 20 different types of special sedatives for you."
"What do you want to investigate?" Maric was a little surprised. He never expected to receive a mission the moment they agreed to cooperate.
"Investigate a palace earl and find out if he's secretly protecting a Demoness." Cullen then gave a brief introduction of Earl Lorena's situation before handing the investigation that made the Forsaken Desolate to Maric and Sharron.
Maric subconsciously looked at Sharron, who said concisely, "Sure, I agree."
After the discussion, Maric didn't make any small talk. Or rather, he and Sharron weren't good at socializing. Instead, he directly brought Ebner and company to the basement of the house, where there was an empty space that looked like it had been dug out barehanded.
"This is where I usually train... I'll show you the power of zombies here," Maric said as he took off his black vest.
Ebner nodded and secretly activated the Eye of Pure White, preparing to analyze it. Although he wouldn't be able to learn most of the abilities of a Zombie in a short period of time, it was still good to store it as knowledge.
Maric first demonstrated the strength of his body. Bullets, fire, and lightning strikes were all useless. Even if he used a revolver to shoot at his head, he would at most experience dizziness. Physical attacks were like this, and most of the magic effects were the same. Ebner threw out two Wind Blade charms, but they only left small wounds on his body.
However, the effects of analyzing such physical abilities weren't very good, much less learning them... Ebner estimated that he would have to wait until he was a Sequence 5 or demigod before he could simulate the ability to strengthen his physique.
Then, Maric demonstrated some of the death-type spells he knew. Ebner quickly analyzed them, and he even learned ten to twenty percent of them after Maric used them two or three times.
...
Just as Ebner was watching Maric's demonstration, Crestet Cesimir, who was holding a silver suitcase, walked down from the public carriage with a lady in a medium's black robe. They looked up at the old house by the roadside, where Isengard Stanton Detective Agency was.
As a high-ranking deacon of the Church of Evernight's Nighthawks team, one of the twenty-two powerful figures in the upper echelons of the Church, and a member of the three giants of the Red Gloves, Crestet Cesimir wasn't someone who cared about ostentation. He liked to travel alone and take the transportation of commoners, acting as an ordinary member of the Church.
As for the lady beside him, there was no need to mention them. Daly was born a commoner, so she didn't care about such things.
"Why doesn't a famous detective who earns at least a thousand pounds a year renovate his house? Isn't that very suspicious?" Daly retracted her gaze and asked curiously. As a Nighthawk, this was also a professional habit.
"I once asked Detective Stanton this question, and his answer was: There's no need. Because the house is built too well, not many guests would dare to come in and entrust it. He doesn't want to only do missions for the rich and powerful." Cesimir tidied his golden-brown sideburns and replied with a smile.
Daly nodded thoughtfully. Then she saw Cesimir ring the bell at the door. Soon a footman opened the door.
The valet clearly recognized Cesimir and knew that he was a guest that all masters had to treat seriously. Hence, the two of them hurriedly invited the two of them into the living room.
Detective Isengard happened to be at home. After hearing the servant's report, he immediately left the office and went to the living room.
"Detective Stanton, sorry to disturb you... This is my colleague, Madam Daly." Cesimir stood up and shook hands with Isengard before introducing Daly to him.
Detective Isengard looked at Daly, who was wearing blue eye shadow and blush. He smiled and said, "Nice to meet you, beautiful lady."
"It's good to see you too, Detective Stanton." Daly stood up and returned the greeting. Although she liked to add jokes in her words, she wasn't someone who couldn't be differentiated. She was still polite to the elder whom she had met for the first time.
After exchanging pleasantries, Cesimir got straight to the point and asked, "I wonder if your student, Detective Ebner Bryan, is around? We have some matters to consult him about."
He's here to look for that kid again? He sure has been causing trouble recently... Detective Isengard sighed inwardly, but he shook his head and said, "He hasn't returned. I wonder why you're looking for him?"
Hearing this, Cesimir was slightly disappointed, but he still stated his intentions. "I heard that Detective Bryan has a very good relationship with Bishop Utravsky. I wish to entrust him to introduce my colleague to the bishop..."
You guys are also here for this matter... Detective Isengard was taken aback when he heard that. Although he didn't know what had happened at the Daily Observer's headquarters last Friday night, he had roughly restored the scene from that day through his student's words and the information from his own channels. He just didn't know which faction the attacker came from.
And later on, he had also heard the news that the Church of Evernight had raided a sewer and returned empty-handed.
Detective Isengard lit his pipe, took a deep breath, and said, "Last Saturday, Member of Parliament Macht came to entrust Ebner with the same matter. He offered a price of 300 pounds."
After saying that, he glanced at Cesimir, knowing that the other party would definitely not be able to reimburse him for this price.
Indeed, His Excellency Cesimir, who was used to taking public transport, stiffened. He repeated, "300 pounds?" It wasn't that he couldn't afford it, but he felt that it wasn't necessary for him to spend so much money just to introduce him.
"Did Member of Parliament Macht send Miss Hazel's dowry ahead of time?" Daly teased with a smile. At the same time, she reminded Cesimir that Member of Parliament Macht was willing to pay for his daughter, so there was no need for them to compare.
Cesimir came back to his senses and looked at Detective Isengard. "For the sake of an old friend, can you help?"
Detective Isengard flicked his pipe and smiled. "It's not impossible, but you have to answer a question of mine."
"What question?" Cesimir asked in surprise.
"When I sold the Clown Beyonder characteristic the last time, why did you come personally to retrieve it?" This question had troubled Detective Isengard for quite some time. He originally believed that the Nighthawks had a case that involved his law firm, which was why the Sword of the Goddess had come personally to investigate. But after so many days, there was no news.
Cesimir hesitated for a moment before replying, "It's nothing. I just happened to be free that day... You know, I've never minded doing things personally."
Liar. That day, you came in a carriage from the Church of Evernight. It's obvious how serious you are... Although Detective Isengard had such thoughts, he didn't expose him. He looked at Cesimir, who remained calm, and chuckled. "So that's how it is. I thought something had happened to me."
As he spoke, he took another puff and said to Cesimir,
"Macht will hold a banquet tomorrow at a manor in the suburbs to invite Bishop Utravsky.
"And as a loyal believer of the Goddess, when the congressman invites the bishops of other Churches, he will definitely invite a bishop of the same level as the Church of Evernight. Otherwise, it will attract criticism."
With that said, he looked at Daly who was sitting beside him, and continued with a smile,
"And inviting a female bishop here would probably make it less likely to cause any conflict."

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Audrey’s Clues
chapters.content:
Chapter 141 - Audrey's Clues
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
Audrey, who had just returned from her treasury, sent the maidservant away. Then, she sighed and squatted down to the golden retriever, Susie, beside her. "Sigh, the main ingredient of a Telepathist is only the spinal fluid of a Farsman Rabbit. I'm still lacking the pituitary gland of an adult Rainbow Salamander..."
Susie wagged her tail in puzzlement but didn't say a word. She just stared at Audrey.
Forget it. There's no need to be too anxious... Audrey consoled herself. Then, she sorted out the information she could get on the surface about Earl Lorena and made a book.
Following that, she got Susie to guard the door while she used her spirituality to seal the room and quickly set up the ritual and altar.
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era..."
The girl's sweet voice soon sounded in the room.
...
Tingen City, inside a terrace house at 2 Daffodil Street.
Klein was discussing the assassination at the Daily Observer with Benson and Melissa.
Melissa insisted that Detective Bryan's discovery of the explosives wasn't reasonable. His reasoning was likely fabricated, and the real reason was that the detective had accidentally seen the criminal's crime. Then, in order to gain the trust of others, he had deduced the existence of the bomb.
"Although this detective's actions can still be considered a hero, he might not be a capable person," Melissa said.
Benson laughed and said, "Melissa, you have to know that 'luck' is also a type of ability when it comes to working. If this Hero detective can maintain such luck, then he has outstanding abilities."
"Benson, that's not right..." Melissa pouted indignantly.
As for Klein, he listened thoughtfully. He remembered that Mr. Hanged Man had once determined that Detective Bryan was a Beyonder.
If he's a Beyonder, it wouldn't be difficult to understand the process of discovering danger first and then reverse it. After all, I often do this... Could it be that the detective is also a Seer? Is the metaphysical detective alright?
Just as Klein lampooned inwardly, he suddenly heard a buzzing whisper. His head went dizzy for a few seconds.
Someone is praying to me... He placed his right hand behind his back and chuckled at his brother and sister.
"Emperor Roselle once said that the more truth is explained, the clearer it becomes. Continue. I'll go back to my bedroom to get a report." As for whether Roselle had said it or not, it wasn't important.
"I'm also imparting social knowledge to Melissa..." Benson laughed before continuing the discussion with Melissa.
Klein went up to the second floor, locked the bedroom door, and sealed the entire room with a wall of spirituality. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and recited the incantation before arriving above the gray fog.
In the towering palace that resembled a giant's residence, his figure suddenly appeared at the end of the long bronze table. His eyes reflected a crimson star that was constantly shrinking and expanding.
Klein raised his right hand and spread his spirituality to touch the star that symbolized Justice.
With a boom, he saw a distorted and blurry scene. He saw Miss Justice wearing a beige dress, sitting on a chair in the bedroom, her hands clasped together as she prayed softly.
...
Klein listened for a while and roughly understood that Miss Justice was talking about the request she received at the Tarot Club yesterday.
Do you get the relevant information so quickly? Miss Justice is very efficient... Sigh, it's a pity that my attempt to open a smurf failed. Otherwise, I could've used this kind of commission to investigate some matters.
Klein sighed for a few seconds before responding to Justice's plea.
After some maneuvering, Klein looked at the prepared information in front of him and began to consider how to pass this matter to Tower. After all, Miss Justice had not only sacrificed the information, but she had also mentioned her own guesses. This required him to consider how to pass it on.
It's definitely impossible for me to repeat it myself. It's beneath my status... How can there be a mysterious existence personally acting as the messenger! He deliberated for nearly a minute before he suddenly had an idea. He conjured the scene and voice of Miss Justice's prayer, turning it into a mosaic-like movie scene.
With a tap of his finger, Klein cast the light screen that he had repeatedly replayed into the crimson star that symbolized the Tower.
...
After watching Maric's demonstration, it was already very late, so Ebner decided to return to his teacher's house to rest.
As for the promise he owed Cullen, he could only ask about it later. After all, he didn't seem to be in a hurry.
Hillston Borough, Isengard Detective Agency. As soon as Ebner entered, he was stopped by his teacher.
"Don't be in a hurry to rest. I have something to tell you." Detective Isengard beckoned him to come to his office.
"Teacher, what's the matter?" Ebner asked curiously after following him in.
"Just now, the Sword of the Goddess brought a lady named Daly over for a visit. She wishes to entrust you to introduce Bishop Utravsky..." Detective Isengard sat back behind his desk and said as he took a document.
"The Sword of the Goddess? Madam Daly? Why are they entrusting this matter?" Ebner was somewhat speechless. It had only been a few days? It had already been three times.
"That Ma'am Daly's dressing gives me the feeling that she's a Spirit Medium... I'm guessing that after their previous operation failed, they wanted to find new clues from Hazel, who was imprisoned in the Harvest Church." As Isengard spoke, he handed over a document and continued, "This is the payment the Sword of the Goddess originally planned on giving you..."
