Teacher, your intuition is very accurate. With such talent, you might really become a Prophet in the future... However, Madam Daly should be a Necromancer now.
With that thought in mind, Ebner took the document and opened it. It was a certificate of legal possession.
Unfortunately, I don't really need it anymore... As Ebner looked at the proof, he felt a little wistful. Ever since he advanced to Sequence 7 and could use the White Eye to imitate a Polymath, he rarely used firearms.
Putting the gun permit aside, he casually asked, "Is it the matter where the Nighthawks collectively forgot the mission content and circled the sewers before returning to the cathedral?"
"You are very well-informed... That's right, it should be that incident. However, it's not just the ordinary Nighthawks. Even the demigod deacons of the Church of Evernight might have been tricked," Detective Isengard said with a smile.
"A demigod-level deacon?" Ebner was somewhat surprised. After all, Audrey hadn't mentioned a demigod when she mentioned this in Sefirah Castle. "But why did I hear that the high-ranking deacon sent by the Church is the Sword of the Goddess?"
According to the information I received, it's very likely that they're arresting a demigod from the Marauder pathway! To deal with a demigod, there naturally has to be a demigod... However, I'm guessing that the saint hiding in the shadows from the Church has also been tricked. Detective Isengard clearly knew the actions of the orthodox Churches better than Ebner. Even with just a tiny clue, he could guess the cause and effect.
"..." Ebner glanced at Detective Isengard and said thoughtfully, "Teacher, are you also 'acting' as a Knowledge Keeper?"
Detective Isengard's hand that was about to light a cigarette paused. He looked at his student in surprise and said in surprise, "You've summarized the acting principles of the Knowledge Keeper so quickly?"
"Judging from your reaction, there shouldn't be any problems..."
Just as Ebner was about to discuss this topic with his teacher, he suddenly discovered that his vision had turned illusory, producing a thick grayish-white fog.
In the depths of the endless fog, there was a high-back chair that seemed to forever exist there. On the high-back chair sat a faint figure.
Mr. Fool... Is Klein looking for me? Or does someone want to send me a message? Just as this thought appeared in Ebner's mind, he saw a blurry figure wearing a beige dress appear in the hazy gray fog.
She maintained her praying posture and kept saying,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, I've already gathered some information regarding Earl Lorena."
"Among these superficial documents, the only suspicious part is that his youngest son, Leland, disappeared three years ago, and he didn't deliberately search for it...
Instead, it's Prince Edessak, Leland's friend, who has been searching for his whereabouts. It didn't stop until the end of last month... And at the same time, Prince Edessak and Earl Lorena have publicly become enemies.
"Of course, this is all my personal speculation. I hope it will be of help to Mr. Tower.
"Here, I request to 'sacrifice' you. Please pass this information to Mr. Tower."
...
Ebner was shocked at first, but then he lowered his head and hid his surprise. He only said silently to himself,
"Praise you, Mr. Fool!"
Then, everything he heard and saw disappeared as if it had never appeared.
"Prince Edessak and Earl Lorena are enemies?"
"Also, although the image just now was fleeting, why does the young man in the photo at the top of the document look familiar?"

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Prelude
chapters.content:
Chapter 142 - Prelude
Although Ebner found the photograph that flashed past somewhat familiar, before he could seriously recall it, he heard Detective Isengard return to the previous topic.
"I told them about Member of Parliament Macht's banquet tomorrow night. I believe you will meet Madam Daly."
Upon hearing this, Ebner snapped back to his senses. He estimated in his heart that with Madam Daly's character, she probably wouldn't clash with Bishop Utravsky. Only then did he nod and say, "I understand, Teacher."
Later, after talking to Detective Isengard about what had happened tonight at the Bravehearts Bar, Ebner returned to his room.
After sealing the spirituality, setting up the altar, and holding the ritual, Ebner saw the information gathered by Miss Justice on the altar.
After habitually praising Mr. Fool, Ebner flipped open the book and began reading it seriously.
He picked up the photo of Earl Lorena's youngest son and studied it for a moment. Soon, he understood the source of the familiarity.
Leland looks a lot like Witch Lena... Lena, maybe Leland? That's why she had an affair with Prince Edessak because they were originally good friends! And Prince Edessak suddenly stopped searching for Leland's whereabouts at the end of last month, and then became enemies with Earl Lorena... From the looks of it, it might not have been his wish for Lena to become an Assassin...
"In that case, maybe we should ask Lena about the whereabouts of the Demoness of Afflictions. After all, she should know a thing or two about where her father can hide people."
With this in mind, Ebner wrote his theory on a piece of paper and set up the ritual again. Then, he took a step back and said in ancient Hermes,
"Me!
"I summon in my name:
"A spirit that wanders between life and death, a friendly friend that can be driven, a messenger that belongs solely to Cullen Tia."
Wu!
Wind surged within the wall of spirituality as the candle flames used for the ritual rapidly expanded. Soon, a tiny bird with silver-white illusory wings flew out.
After dripping several drops of "Amantha" extract that had been prepared long ago to the little bird, Ebner gave it the note he had written and the book of information.
The bird first inhaled the scent of the extract in its mouth in enjoyment, then tilted its head and studied the pile of information that was taller than its body. Then, it flapped its illusory wings, and the information was lifted up by a gust of cold wind.
The bird chirped at Ebner as if to say goodbye then flapped its wings again and disappeared with the information.
...
South of the Bridge, Harvest Church.
After resting for a while, Cullen and Judy were about to set off again to investigate the suspect's dream when they saw the little bird, Silika, appear in front of them with the information.
Cullen smiled and rewarded her with some spiritual material powder before flipping through the information.
After a moment, Cullen looked up and handed over the information. "Judy, go to Talim's dream again tonight and contact him. Tell him we need to meet with Witch Lena again as soon as possible."
"Understood." Judy nodded solemnly. She had always been serious when it came to serious matters and never argued with Cullen under such circumstances.
...
Empress Borough, Earl Lorena's residence.
The Earl of Lorena of this generation was named Herich. He was about fifty years old, tall and thin. His black hair was nearly half white, but his eyes were sharp.
Just as he was about to go to bed, he suddenly realized that his bedroom had been sealed by someone's spirituality. The two bodyguards outside the door hadn't even noticed it.
The earl was alarmed, but he didn't panic. Apart from his calm attitude, he was also a Mid-Sequence Beyonder.
"Who's there? Come out!" The earl deliberately shouted with a spiritual voice, hoping to attract the attention of the bodyguards and guards in the mansion.
However, even after shouting a few times, he still didn't obtain the result he wanted. It was clear that the other party's sealing technique was much more brilliant than the ordinary wall of spirituality.
"Pa! Pa! Pa!"
Following a round of applause, a clear and melodious female voice came from the window. "Hehe, as expected of the Earl. You can still maintain your composure under such circumstances."
"Who is it?!" The count took out his revolver and aimed it at the window. Then, he focused his gaze and saw a beautiful girl who was at most seventeen or eighteen years old sitting on the window sill. Her head was slightly lowered, and her long fringe covered her eyes. However, the corners of her mouth curled up into a mocking smile.
"Who are you?" The earl asked for the third time. He instinctively felt that the girl was familiar, but he could not recall where he had added her.
"Hehe, looks like you've completely forgotten... Father!" At this point, the girl suddenly raised her head, revealing her delicate and cute face to the count.
"You call me father? You... you're Leland?" The earl's eyes widened at the words, but he quickly reined in his emotions and said coldly, "What are you doing back here? Are you trying to get back at me?"
At this point, he suddenly thought of something and continued, "It seems that you were the one who instigated Prince Edessak to target me? Heh, Leland, you've really grown capable. You actually seduced the prince to deal with Father."
Upon hearing her father's ridicule, Lena didn't show any anger on her face. She still had a smile on her face as she shook her head and said, "In the beginning, I hated you, but I've long since gotten over it, and I've never thought of taking revenge on you..."
"Then what are you doing here?" The earl was relieved that she did not attack immediately.
Lena ignored her father's question and continued, "When I was an Assassin, I came into contact with all aspects of the kingdom's bottom echelons. Compared to those poor people who were in dire straits, who might have caused their entire family to starve or even die because of a disease, my childhood was just too blissful!
"I understood then that it was precisely because I once had this happiness that I paid the price for it. Since I enjoyed the wonderful life of the Earl's youngest son, I had to bear the responsibility of this identity...
"So from then on, I stopped hating you. I just treated it as me repaying the happy childhood you gave me."
As she spoke, there was a hint of sadness in her eyes. Coupled with her pure and charming eyes, it made one's heartache.
"So, why are you telling me this?" The earl took a deep breath and warned himself not to be bewitched by the Demoness.
"I originally thought that our grudges had been settled and that I no longer owed you anything. I thought that you were just a passerby..." At this point, Lina's gaze suddenly turned sharp, just like her father's. She continued, "But I didn't expect you to help another witch deal with me!"
"What? Help another Demoness? How is that possible..." The Earl frowned. Although he did not care about his youngest son, he had never thought of dealing with him.
"Last week, when I was being pursued by the Demoness of Afflictions, I escaped into a safe house in my family... You should know that only the direct descendants of the Lorena family have the right to know of such places!"
Having said that, Leena gave her father a meaningful look.
"Also, a former police officer told me that the Demoness of Afflictions once rode a carriage with a royal noble's badge... And I'm extremely familiar with that badge!"
The earl frowned again, but he soon understood what was going on. He took a deep breath and said tiredly, "I understand... I'll give you an explanation."
He didn't get angry or deny it again? Leena raised her eyebrows. She could tell something was wrong from her father's tone. She thought for a moment and suddenly realized something. "It's not you... So, it's Marcello?"
Marcello was Lena's eldest brother, the earl's eldest son, and heir.
"I said that I'll give you a satisfactory explanation! You don't have to worry about this anymore." The count didn't reply but instead spoke forcefully.
"I understand..." Leena nodded thoughtfully, then snickered. "But you don't have the right to order me around now."
As soon as she finished speaking, her figure disappeared in front of the window sill like a bubble, and the seal in the bedroom was removed at the same time.
The spirituality fluctuation that had been released from the lockdown alarmed the bodyguards outside. They quickly pushed the door open and rushed in. Seeing that the Earl was staring out of the window in a daze without being injured, they heaved a sigh of relief and asked worriedly, "Earl, what happened?"
The earl shook his head slightly and told his bodyguards that he was fine. He thought to himself, "Your Majesty... What do you want? Isn't it enough that I sacrificed a son..."
Without the tacit approval of the royal family or the king, how could his successor be undetected after meeting the Demoness for so long? He was a palace count, a military officer in charge of the royal family's safety!
At that moment, a petite figure in a black Gothic regal dress suddenly appeared in the full-body mirror on the side of the wardrobe in the bedroom. She held her cheek with her hand and thought for a moment before raising her skirt slightly and bowing before disappearing.
The worried Earl and the confused bodyguards did not notice anything.
...
In an inconspicuous house in Empress Borough.
Not long after Mr. A's Beyonder gathering ended, a black-haired, blue-eyed man with a handsome face and faint traces of beard slowly transformed into a blond, beardless man. However, before he took a few steps, he realized that someone had locked onto him with spirituality.
He closed his eyes and was about to use his Beyonder powers to find the person behind the scenes when he was suddenly stunned by a terrifying aura. He couldn't help but stop his actions and turn around to look at the place with the strongest aura.
It was a beauty with black hair like a waterfall. She was holding an unopened flower in her hands and was smiling at him.
Although he looked like an ordinary person who posed no threat, the man did not underestimate him at all. He quietly looked around, trying to find a suitable place to escape.
At this moment, the beauty opened her lips and said with a charming smile, "Don't be afraid. I just want to ask you if you need a Wind-blessed?"

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Start
chapters.content:
Chapter 143 - Start
Only when the beauty with the flower in her arms left did the man, who had just finished attending Mr. A's gathering, heave a sigh of relief. He didn't dare to stay any longer as he transformed into a new appearance. After circling the surrounding streets a few times to ensure that no one was following him, he used the spots of light from the gas lamps on both sides of the street to constantly flash his figure, heading towards the Intis embassy in West Borough.
After returning to the embassy, the man who had changed back to his original appearance was led back to his room by an attendant.
The waiter was about to leave when he was stopped by the man. Although the waiter was surprised, he still asked respectfully, "Mr. Rosago, is there anything else you need?"
This was the first time Mr. Rosago had ever spoken to an attendant.
"Organize a copy of the recent actions of Backlund's Mandated Punishers for me... This is a trivial matter, so there's no need to alarm Mr. Ambassador. Do you understand?" As Rosago spoke, he controlled a marionette that had been using Psychological Invisibility to influence the attendant.
"Yes, sir," the attendant replied without any hesitation.
"Very good. After you deliver the information to me, go back to sleep. When you wake up, you will forget to talk to me." Rosago nodded in satisfaction.
After the attendant opened the door and left, Rosago recalled what the beautiful woman had said to him. He thought and said,
"If there's really a chance to obtain a Wind-blessed, it's worth taking a risk..."
As he thought this, he took out some tools from his drawer and began to divine.
...
On Wednesday morning, Ebner received a long list of "normal" commissions. The client was Mrs. Bingley, the owner of a nearby café. Her son had recently fallen in love with the daughter of a lumber merchant and was dating her.
However, due to the wood merchant's large business and the disparity between their families, Mrs. Bingley was worried that he was just playing around, so she came to Ebner to investigate the lady's character.
It's not like we're talking about marriage. Why is your son so nervous about getting a girlfriend? I'm afraid you'll go bankrupt just from the investigation fees in the future... Ebner complained in his heart, but on the surface, he accepted the request. After all, this kind of harmless acting opportunity was rare for him.
He spent the morning sneaking into the wood merchant's house and then extracted the scent of many strange men from the bedroom of the lady named Irene...
Even without looking back, Ebner could guess that the lady's private life was probably very rich. However, in order to complete the mission, he still used his Beyonder powers to faithfully record the scenes he saw.
One, two, three, four... That was amazing. There were no less than ten people in this house alone, and that included Mrs. Bingley's son...
As he watched, Ebner suddenly discovered a familiar face. It was none other than the Feysac spy, Detective Zreal.
He frowned and activated the Eye of Pure White to obtain a more complete "Backtrack Scene." He wanted to hear what the detective had said to Miss Irene.
Soon, a picture of a bed appeared before Ebner's eyes. In the picture, Irene, who had a beautiful face and elegant temperament, panted heavily as she said coquettishly to Zreal, "Great detective, I got some news that you're concerned about... What gift are you going to buy me?"
Detective Zreal, who was originally a little dispirited, immediately perked up when he heard that. He smiled and said, "Darling, I heard that the famous fashion designer, Mrs. Genia, is selling a dress that she's proud of. It's said to be the same dress as the one designed for Earl Hall... Of course, that noble lady has already worn that dress once in public. She won't wear it again in the future."
"That's great, my dear. Serena and Anna will be so envious of you if you can wear a dress designed by Mrs. Genia at the ball!" Irene kissed Detective Zreal happily and said, "A friend of mine once talked about the differential machine you asked about... I heard from him that someone sold information at a party called Mr. A, but no one was willing to buy it."
...
Upon seeing this, Ebner closed the Eye of Pure White. He could roughly guess what was going on.
This is the trigger for Klein to kill the ambassador with five pounds! But it's none of my business...
Ebner shook his head, wiped away the presence he'd been there, and quietly withdrew.
Following that, he tidied up the information of the other men he had seen in the Backtrack Scene. He then returned to the coffee shop near the office and handed it to his client, Mrs. Bingley.
Mrs. Bingley took only a few rough looks and was so excited that her hands shook. She gritted her teeth and said, "Very good... Detective Bryan, you are indeed very capable. I didn't find the wrong person."
Ebner ignored the other party's praise. After receiving the two pounds for the investigation, he felt that the Knowledge Keeper potion had indeed digested a little. He couldn't help but nod inwardly.
It was already 3 pm in the afternoon. As the manor in the northwest suburb was on the other side of the Tussock River, if they wanted to reach it, they had to take a detour to the bridge area to cross the river. It would take at least three hours by carriage, so there wasn't much time.
So Ebner hurried back to the law firm to change into his most appropriate suit. Then, he looked at his Beyonder items, hesitated for a moment, and took everything with him except the Sword of Dawn. He had offended many people now, so it was always better to be prepared.
After tidying his clothes, Ebner called for a relatively comfortable rental carriage. After paying a price of two soli, he finally got the coachman to agree to take him to the northwest suburbs.
Along the way, he received a letter from the little bird, Silika. Cullen told him in the letter that he and Judy had already met with "Witch" Lena in the morning. The other party said that she had gone to her father last night to confirm the news, and learned that the one who really hid the witch was her elder brother. This news was confirmed by Miss Sharron.
Lena gave the address where her brother might be hiding his mistress. They were in South Borough, West Borough, and Northwest suburbs. The Forsaken Ones had already set out to investigate them one by one.
"The northwestern suburbs? What a coincidence..." Ebner muttered to himself. He was slightly lost in thought and had a premonition that something was about to happen.
...
On the terrace of a manor in the northwestern suburbs, Ray solemnly set up the altar with a lot of bloody materials. Then, according to the binary ritual law, she placed a candle to represent herself and placed the pot of flowers in the corresponding position to symbolize God.
Taking a deep breath and putting on a charming smile, Ray took out the items needed for the ritual one by one. After doing all of this, she skillfully used the ritual silver dagger to guide her spirituality to flow around the altar, creating an invisible and sealed wall.
Then, she extended her right hand and used her spirituality to ignite the candle that represented her.
In the flickering, yellow light, Ray picked up a small bottle. The liquid inside was very similar to the perfume Ebner had found in Dr. Leonardo's house. Carefully, she unscrewed the bottle cap and dripped a drop into the candle flame.
With a leap, illusory fog spread out, bringing with it the strangeness of the blood-colored moon.
Ray couldn't help but take a step back and recite in ancient Hermes,
"The unique crimson moon, the symbol of life and beauty, the mother of all spiritual powers."
"I pray that you will bestow upon me the power to interfere with divination and backlash it."
...
After reciting the incantation, Ray closed her eyes and repeated it seven times in her head. Seeing that there was nothing unusual about the altar, she took out the silver pocket watch she always carried and looked at the time. Then her lips curled up slightly as she muttered to herself, "Almost..."
...
Under the Holy Wind Cathedral, Captain Kuhn of the Mandated Punishers and Robert of the Wind-blessed took out a humanoid puppet the size of a palm from the storage room that had powerful sealing powers.

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Progressive
chapters.content:
Chapter 144 - Progressive
Sealed Artifact 1-025 was also known as a Possession Puppet. It looked like an ugly puppet the size of a palm and wore clothes in the Southern Continent's style. It came from a Silent Disciple who had been killed in the colonial war. With most of its powers sealed by the Holy Cathedral, it could be used in limited ways.
Usage Method: After unlocking the first seal of the nine seals, one can possess the equipment used to assist in divination, such as the silver mirror, tarot cards, gold coins, and so on. Then, one can use the equipment used to possess the body for divination. The symbol of intention obtained from the divination this time is relatively clear. The interpretation is relatively simple and has an extremely strong resistance to interference.
Note: After each "divination", it must be sealed again within three minutes and can only be used again every three days. If it is used more than ten times consecutively, it must be placed underground for a year.
Remember not to let it see the moon during this period.
Recalling the use report of the Sealed Artifact in his hand, Captain Kuhn said solemnly to Evan, another member of the team who had long taken out various related items and was ready for divination, "I'll unlock the first seal of 1-025 later and let it possess the divination astrolabe. Remember, you only have three minutes. After three minutes, I have to seal it again. Evan, Old Reed isn't around today. We can only rely on you."
"Don't worry, Captain. Old Reed has told me the details." Evan took a deep breath and said firmly.
"Alright, I'll unlock the first seal now." Captain Kuhn nodded, then turned to the Wind-blessed behind him and said, "Robert, take 2-063 and prepare to provide support at any time to prevent any accidents."
2-063 was the round golden mirror that was used to cast Fire of Light in the headquarters building of the Daily Observer.
"Yes, Captain!" Robert, the Wind-blessed, also replied solemnly. He understood what the Captain meant. If there really was an accident, he would do his best to keep Evan alive.
As for facing himself, he naturally had to immediately seal 1-025 when the time came. Otherwise, no one present would survive.
After giving the instructions, Kuhn composed himself and took off a badge made of wind, waves, and lightning symbols from the Possession Puppet.
The moment the badge was removed, the puppet underwent a visible change. It gave off the feeling that it was "alive".
Kuhn had already seen the changes, so he was not surprised. He immediately placed the puppet's body on the prepared astrolabe. Then, "10025" slowly merged into the astrolabe like a projection.
Evan, on the other hand, picked up his pen and quickly sketched out the Demoness's relevant events on the astrolabe according to the date and time he had already grasped. The process was as if God had helped.
Soon, the astrolabe, planet, and palace elements fell into the corresponding palace according to the constellation...
However, just as he was about to complete the last part, something unexpected happened!
Evan, who was drawing, screamed and threw down his pen. He held his head and fell to the ground in pain... Next, 1-025 abruptly separated from the astrolabe. The other badges on his body also collapsed one after another...
When only three of the eight badges were left, the puppet's body suddenly grew bigger, becoming as tall as a person. The originally stiff puppet wore a strange smile. At the same time, an ominous aura filled the entire Holy Wind Cathedral.
Captain Kuhn was the first to recover. Without hesitation, he took out an exquisite box.
He violently tore open the seal runes on the exterior of the box, and a blue pocket watch with twelve black diamonds on it appeared in his hand. It was the Church's "sacred item" he had contracted—"Timeless Calamity."
' Click.' Captain Kuhn pulled up the top button and turned the second hand back to a tick before pressing it again.
A second later, as the color of the black diamonds on the surface became lighter, silver bolts of lightning shot out with an intense, violent aura of destruction, densely attacking the puppet and trapping it in the electric net.
As for Wind-blessed Robert, he had already used the golden-framed mirror to activate the Sun Halo to purify the evil anomalies in Evan's body while creating a gale to sweep Evan away from 1-025.
At this moment, the rapidly spinning hurricane tore open the ground above him, and a figure flew down from above.
It was an elder wearing a black bonnet with abnormally solemn silver eyes. He wore a black robe embroidered with the symbol of the storm. He was none other than the cardinal of the Church of Storms, the archbishop of the Backlund diocese, Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake.
Spellsinger of God scanned the scene and immediately understood what had happened. He raised his hand and added a terrifying hurricane that was visible to the naked eye outside the lightning net that trapped the puppet. Then, he looked at Captain Kuhn, who was a little pale, and asked with a frown, "What happened?"
"The divination backfired... The Demoness must have made sufficient preparations. The nine seals that the Holy Cathedral cast on 1-025 have destroyed six," Captain Kuhn reported concisely.
"Why didn't you forcefully terminate the ritual and cut off the connection?" Snake looked at Evan, who had been fed holy water by Robert, and asked solemnly.
The Church of Storms had used 1-025 for so long, so they naturally had contingency plans for similar accidents.
"Old Reed used dream divination last time, and his spirituality was too exhausted. He hasn't recovered yet... Evan is inexperienced, so..." Captain Kuhn didn't finish his sentence, but his meaning was clear.
"Forget it. Now isn't the time to pursue the matter. We have to deal with 1-025 as soon as possible." Spellsinger of God sighed and looked at Kuhn with abnormally serious silver eyes. He continued, "The emergency seal might be very intense, and it's impossible for this puppet to not resist... Cherwood Borough, or rather, there are too many ordinary people in the city. Once something goes wrong, there will be a lot of casualties! We have to bring him to a sparsely populated place as soon as possible."
"Near Backlund, there are only a few people in the forests on the outskirts of the northwest. That area is mostly a hunting ground or plantation for nobles and wealthy families," Kuhn said after some thought.
"I'll immediately take 1-025 to the northwestern suburbs. You and your teammates will follow me to prevent any accidents from happening again." Spellsinger of God nodded and agreed with Captain Kuhn.
However, he glanced at the members of the Mandated Punishers and asked in puzzlement, "Why are there only the three of you? Where are the other members?"
"Matthew was seriously injured during the surprise attack when Old Reed divined that the Demoness had fallen behind on Sunday. He hasn't fully recovered yet... McConnell has led his men to guard the Grant Clothing Store. Although the company at the dock area has been destroyed by the Forsaken, the Everlasting Society still hasn't given up on excavating that store. Perhaps there really is something... Sara has led the other members to investigate recent disappearances in order to find the Demoness's whereabouts from other directions..."
Recently, there had been a lot of incidents, and Captain Kuhn also felt that there was a severe shortage of manpower.
"Forget it. The low-Sequence Beyonders won't be of much help... You and Robert can follow me." The TheSpellsinger of God frowned again. His past experience told him that something wasn't right, but before he could think about it, the puppet surrounded by lightning and storms began to stir. It opened its mouth, which had been sewn with golden threads, and was about to let out a sharp whistle.
Upon seeing this, the Spellsinger of God opened his hair against the laws of nature. Following that, a bolt of lightning shot into the puppet's mouth, blocking its roar.
"We can't wait any longer... Let's set off immediately!" The Spellsinger of God raised his hand again, and an intense airflow appeared out of thin air. It spun rapidly, and an unstoppable hurricane suddenly broke through the ground and the buildings above, sweeping the puppet into midair.
Captain Kuhn and Robert, the Wind-blessed, looked at each other. After handing Evan over to the clerical staff of the Church to take care of, they quickly rose into the air and chased after him.
...
Cherwood Borough, in a house near the Tussock River.
When the ominous aura from the Possession Puppet broke through the seal, a figure quickly outlined itself in the originally empty room.
The Rose School of Thought demigod, Zatwen, quickly climbed up the roof and looked in the direction of the Holy Wind Cathedral. He laughed out loud and said, "Haha, the cursed item actually broke through the seal? Heh heh, with the official church, they definitely wouldn't seal it again in the city... Then, the northwest suburbs?
"That witch should be plotting something, but it has nothing to do with me. If it's really that easy to obtain, then helping her once isn't a big deal!"
With that said, his figure disappeared into the night again.
...
At the Intis embassy, Rosago, who was drinking black tea, suddenly sensed the hurricane near the Holy Wind Cathedral. He suddenly stood up with a look of surprise in his eyes as he muttered to himself, "Has something really happened to the Mandated Punishers?"
...
In a villa in the northwestern suburbs, Demoness of Afflictions, Ray, picked up the flower that had yet to bloom again. She smiled as she looked at the bloodstains on the ground behind him and touched the flower. "Are you full? It's time to help me."
...
In the northwest suburbs, Ebner arrived at Member of Parliament Macht's manor in a carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Three Battlefields
chapters.content:
Chapter 145 - Three Battlefields
In the northwestern suburbs of Backlund, Captain Kuhn and Robert of the Mandated Punishers flew over a vineyard on a gust of wind.
Achoo! Achoo! Achoo!
Suddenly Robert's nose itched and he sneezed a few times.
He didn't pay much attention to it, but immediately after, he felt his head begin to hurt. His head heated up as he sneezed continuously. In just a few seconds, he had reached the point where he couldn't maintain his "flying" ability.
At the same time, Captain Kuhn, who realized that something was wrong, also stopped. Although his symptoms were milder than Robert's, he could still feel that his throat was dry and his nose was starting to feel stuffy.
Was he sick? Was he infected? Captain Kuhn was just beginning to understand when he felt countless invisible threads sweep over from the ground, trying to wrap themselves and Robert completely.
He was no stranger to similar experiences. The previous few exchanges made him realize that this was the Beyonder power of a Demoness.
"The Demoness ambushed us here? Isn't she afraid that His Excellency Snake will return?" Captain Kuhn quickly responded despite his doubts.
He reached out to catch his companions, who were unable to fly because of their violent coughs, as he swept up a storm around them, interrupting the threads that reached for them.
However, Captain Kuhn knew that he couldn't escape the Demoness' attack range by "flying" alone, so he could only bring Robert to the vineyard.
At this moment, Robert managed to stop coughing. He took out the gold-framed mirror in his pocket and activated the Fire of Light and Holy Water.
The former could ignite all the invisible threads in the surroundings, while the latter could improve one's physique and increase one's resistance to diseases.
As the golden illusory flames that emitted the majestic aura of the sun appeared out of thin air, the "spider webs" around the two of them were ignited, as though they had turned into a giant torch.
Captain Kuhn took the opportunity to take out two bottles of potions. He drank one himself and threw the other to the Wind-blessed Robert.
The Mandated Punishers had already clashed with the Demoness of Afflictions several times, so how could they not be prepared for ailments?
And at this moment, under the illumination of the Fire of Light, Demoness of Afflictions Ray's invisibility also lost its effect, revealing her voluptuous but curvy figure.
"Captain Kuhn, long time no see. Why are you treating me so roughly the moment we meet?" Ray hugged the flower and rebuked in a tone that sounded like a lover greeting her.
However, Captain Kuhn wasn't in the mood to talk nonsense with the other party. Although he had used potions to suppress the 'illness' in his body, as time went on, it would become even more violent. If he didn't take advantage of this time to repel the other party, the longer it took, the more difficult it would be.
With a zi sound, his hair suddenly parted in violation of the laws of nature. Each strand was distinct and wrapped in lightning. It surged out and gathered into an arrow of lightning that shot towards the Demoness.
Boom!
Dark clouds overlapped in midair as a thick bolt of lightning struck down, stacking on the lightning arrow.
The arrow became even more silvery-white and hit Ray in the forehead at an impossible speed.
Clang! Crack! A sound of glass shattering rang out, and Ray's body quickly split apart under the lightning arrow. Immediately after, it shattered on the ground, turning into coarse silver mirror fragments!
Ray, who had used the Mirror Substitution Technique, appeared before Captain Kuhn unscathed. She smiled and said, "Captain Kuhn, your greeting is really passionate..."
However, before she could finish speaking, several wind blades appeared in front of her again. However, Ray was not flustered. She opened her mouth slightly and let out an invisible scream.
Along with this scream, a blue illusory halo surged out from her body. Wherever it passed, frost would condense and overlap.
In less than a second, she was inside the frozen world, surrounded by thick transparent ice.
As for those wind blades, all of them struck the ice, sinking into the center of the ice and quickly dissipating.
Seeing that his attack was blocked again, Captain Kuhn did not dare to give the Demoness a chance to retaliate. He immediately opened his mouth, wanting to continue attacking through the Ocean Songster's "singing" ability.
However, right at this moment, his throat suddenly felt extremely dry and painful. He was unable to make another sound.
"Because of Mother's grace, my 'illness' has mutated. The mutation's effect is especially targeted at Ocean Songster... Captain Kuhn, how does it feel to not be able to sing?" Seeing this, Ray did not take the opportunity to attack, but instead calmly teased, as if victory was already in his grasp.
Kuhn frowned, not understanding what the Enchantress was plotting, or what she was waiting for. It was important to know that he was at a disadvantage on the surface. Shouldn't she take advantage of the situation?
However, at this moment, he suddenly thought of a problem that he had overlooked. From the beginning of the fight until now, Robert hadn't helped at all!
With the tacit understanding of the Mandated Punishers, Robert should've used the Fire of Light to burn through the ice after his Wind Blade was released!
As he thought of this, he turned to look at his companion, only to find that he was standing motionless on the spot. Although his expression was calm, tears of pain flowed from the corners of his eyes because he wanted to cough but could not move...
"There are other enemies nearby!" Captain Kuhn immediately came to a conclusion. He no longer thought of hiding anything and took out the navy blue pocket watch with twelve black diamonds. It was the sacred item he had contracted—"Timeless Calamity".
With a click, Captain Kuhn pulled the button on the top of his pocket watch, adjusted the second hand's speed to a certain degree, and pressed it again. A second later, silver bolts of lightning shot out with a strong destructive aura, densely attacking the Wind-blessed Robert.
He didn't know where the enemy was, but his intuition told him that a Beyonder who was good at controlling abilities wouldn't be too far away. Therefore, he chose to launch an area-of-effect attack. Although it might accidentally injure Robert, it was better to be injured than lose his life.
"Ah!" With a scream, a man in worker's clothing appeared under the attack of the lightning snake. His chest was directly penetrated by the lightning, and large amounts of blood spurted out. He was about to die.
But at that moment, the man reached out and touched his chest. The terrifying penetrative wound disappeared and was replaced by the man's ankle.
This person was none other than Marionettist Rosago, who had been bewitched by the Demoness. He had previously seen Captain Kuhn unable to divert his attention in the battle with Ray, so he wanted to take advantage of the situation and secretly control Robert's Spirit Body Threads that were plagued by illnesses to make him into a marionette.
It was a pity that he had almost been defeated by the Captain's AOE Thunder Strike.
...
In the northwest of Backlund, in a charred forest that seemed to have been repeatedly plowed by lightning and strong winds, Ace Snake, the Spellsinger of God, heaved a sigh of relief because he had finally sealed 1-025 temporarily.
Although the level of the seal was only comparable to the previous six seals, it was considered safe for a demigod like him.
He looked up at the sky and saw that the crimson moon was only about to leave. He couldn't help but rejoice. "Fortunately, I sealed it before the moon came out. Otherwise, it would have been even more troublesome."
All of a sudden, Spellsinger of God's expression changed as he looked towards the southwest. He could feel the destructive aura of the 'punctual calamity'.
Kuhn was attacked? He even used a Holy Artifact? Snake frowned. Without any further delay, he picked up the palm-sized 1-025 and was about to fly over to rescue him.
But at that moment, Snake saw a hand, a black-gloved hand, appear on an undamaged tree not far away. It grabbed at him.
Right on the heels of that, Snake realized that the bent Puppet in his hand had instantly disappeared and reappeared in front of the palm!
With this action, the person hiding in the dark finally revealed himself. The figure wore a hooded black robe, and his face was covered by a golden mask with red and black stripes. He didn't look fat or thin, but he was definitely not short. He was at least 1.8 meters tall.
This was none other than the Rose School of Thought's demigod, Zatwen.
As he didn't have a good way to seal the cursed item again, he waited for Snake to complete the seal before taking action.
After Zatwen used the Marauder pathway's Sealed Artifact to steal 1-025 in front of him, his body immediately faded and turned transparent. He extended countless thin ropes that resembled tentacles to tie up the struggling puppet, hoping to bring it into the spirit world.
At this moment, the Rose School of Thought demigod suddenly heard a violent gust of wind. It collided with the air and produced an explosive sound.
Boom!
The Possession Puppet was sent flying and landed on the ground. As for the transparent "string" that bound it previously, it collapsed and returned to its human form.
At first, Zatwen couldn't help but drift upward at an angle. Then he transformed into a wraith. No, an evil spirit's form. He allowed the wind to blow through his body, no longer moving with it.
He saw the airflow turn rapidly as an unrestrained tornado suddenly rose up, sweeping the rocks, soil, leaves, and tree trunks into the air.
Zatwen didn't pay much attention to the strong winds. His eyes were focused on the puppet that had been sent flying. As an evil spirit, he wasn't affected by the tornado.
However, he soon realized that his judgment was wrong. The wind blades and other rocks in the tornado had actually hurt him!
The powers of the Lawyer pathway... The Spellsinger of God had previously used a mystical item to exert the ability of Bribe on a Possession Puppet, distorting or weakening my evil spirit body...
Zatwen had an epiphany, but there was no time for him to dwell on it, for God's Singer had opened his mouth to sing.
Heh, he accepted the "bribe" and also established a connection! As this thought flashed through Zatwen's mind, the body of the "evil spirit" suddenly transformed into a hideous puppet. The puppet grabbed its neck with its short arms, but it was the first to let out a shrill cry.
Not far away, the Songster of God was about to show his singing voice when his neck was suddenly grabbed by an invisible hand. His singing stopped abruptly.
As the hand on his neck became more forceful, the Spellsinger of God had no choice but to strike himself with lightning. Only then did he forcefully pull away the cursed hand that was pinching his throat.
But taking advantage of this opportunity, Zatwen, who had transformed back into an evil spirit, had already flashed in front of 1-025.
When Snake saw this, he exerted strength with his feet, causing the ground around 1-025 to instantly crack open. Red magma spewed out, blocking the Wraith's approach!
...
In the Backlund North Borough, Steve, who had received Zatwen's message and was rushing to the northwestern woods with Mirror Jump, suddenly stopped.
This was because he saw a figure appear from a window not far away. It was a figure formed from light golden hair, blue eyes, a pale face, and a dark black Gothic regal dress!

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Intense
chapters.content:
Chapter 146 - Intense
In Moose Manor, in Member of Parliament Macht's meticulously decorated dining room, a huge crystal chandelier hung down from the dome. It shimmered with countless candlelight, illuminating the entire room as though it was daytime.
In the corner on the right, the band members wearing vests and bow ties played a brisk melody. On the left was a long table with delicious dishes such as roasted chicken, pan-fried foie gras, lamb stew, Backlund-style roast goose, and cream cheese-baked Oravi lobster.
Even though they were very far away, Ebner seemed to smell the fragrance they emitted. He did not stand on ceremony with the senator and immediately went to get a plate to fill with food.
At that moment, Madam Daly walked over with a glass of wine. When she saw Ebner's actions, she teased in a slightly ethereal voice,
"Shouldn't one hold a glass of wine and wait for the host to give a speech at such an occasion? From the looks of it, Backlund's Hero Detective is also a carefree and uninhibited person. It's no wonder he was liked by so many young ladies."
"What young lady likes me?" Ebner felt that the title of "Hero Detective" was embarrassing enough. Why were there rumors now?
"You don't know? Some newspapers say that you're quite popular in this area. Many rich ladies are eager to have a beautiful encounter with you." Madam Daly swirled her wine glass and smiled at Ebner with her green eyes.
"That's a tabloid's nonsense. You can't take it seriously!" Ebner, who knew Daly's linguistic arts very well, did not dare to speak too casually in front of her. If she really joked about this topic, the one who would end up blushing in embarrassment would definitely be him and not this lady.
Seeing that Ebner wasn't willing to continue the conversation, Daly didn't continue teasing him. Instead, she said, "There's fog champagne, Aurmir wine, and Southville red wine here. They're all expensive and rare famous wines. We can drink a little, but not too much. We don't know what's going on over there yet. We have to stay sober."
Previously, after Sword of the Goddess left, Ebner immediately returned to the manor's main residence to ask Daly. The latter said that she did not know the exact situation. Cesimir had only told her through Nature Spirit to stay here before leaving. She was not qualified to participate in the battle there.
Of course, while Daly remained behind, she had already used the Messenger to inform the Holy Cathedral.
And these words also made Ebner give up the thought of immediately running back to Backlund. The situation outside was unknown. What if they encountered danger along the way? It was better to stay in the Elk Manor for the time being. After all, with Daly and Bishop Utravsky here, and him, their combat strength wasn't too bad.
Thinking back, Ebner smiled at Daly. "Ma'am, I don't really know how to drink. After all, drinking isn't good."
Daly looked at him with a smile and said thoughtfully, "This wording... is something that a young lady told you?"
...
As the sky darkened completely, the red moon that was slightly more than a semicircle appeared clearly.
And its outline rapidly expanded. In just a second or two, it turned into a full moon, a blood-red full moon!
Blood Moon! Ray looked up at the crimson hanging in the sky and smiled. "Finally."
With that, she unbuttoned her shirt and removed all her clothes, revealing her beautiful body to the three men present.
Unfortunately, Robert had just been struck by the "electric snake" indiscriminately, and he had already suffered heavy injuries. He could only barely maintain his consciousness, and he was still blaming himself for wasting the opportunity to use the Holy Artifact.
At the instant Marionettist Rosago transferred the damage, he had used Flaming Jump to leave the battlefield. He was already nowhere to be found.
Captain Kuhn, on the other hand, was only deeply afraid of the Demoness's actions. He wanted to kill her immediately, so why would he care if she wore clothes or not?
Of course, Ray didn't look forward to the gazes of the men. Instead, she kept staring at the blood moon in the sky as though she wanted to show her beauty to the moon. At the same time, she opened her arms and hugged Scarlet as she chanted piously,
"The unique crimson moon, the symbol of life and beauty, the mother of all spiritual powers."
As Captain Kuhn had just used "Timed Disaster", he could not bear the backlash of the pointer, for the time being, so he could only condense a wind blade again and prepare to interrupt Ray's obviously unusual action.
But at this moment, an invisible wave suddenly hit Kuhn, making him feel as if he had been struck by lightning. He suddenly felt fear in his heart and was so afraid that he wanted to abandon his teammates and fly away immediately.
As for the Wind-blessed Robert, although he was also affected, he wasn't the main target of that force. Even though he was still afraid, he gritted his teeth and drove his damaged body, activating the Sun Halo from the golden-framed mirror.
The Sun Halo could increase the courage of his companions within a twenty-meter radius and purify the evil powers in their bodies!
A dark golden light flashed, and Captain Kuhn suddenly felt like he was bathing in warm sunlight. His emotions suddenly stabilized, and he was no longer as nervous and afraid.
"Psychiatrist... Dragon's Might! Could there be other enemies?" Captain Kuhn, who seemed to have found his courage, instantly regained his ability to think. He already had the intention to retreat, but with so many enemies surrounding him, even if he turned around and ran, it would be very difficult!
"At the very least, I have to severely injure the Demoness. Otherwise, I won't be able to run very far before I get entangled by her again."
Thinking up to this point, Captain Kuhn made a decision. He wanted to wait until the "Timed Disaster" could be used, then immediately release its maximum output to create an opportunity for himself and Robert to escape.
In fact, it had only been four to five seconds since Kuhn decided to use the wind blade and Robert activated the Sun Halo.
And in those four or five seconds, Ray's tribute to the moon had been completed. The complicated tattoo on her back had "come to life" again in the light of the moon, faintly linked to the pot of unopened flowers.
Soon after, an extremely evil aura rose. The flower suddenly grew to more than three meters tall. The blooming flower was covered in disgusting blood, and there was a mouthpiece filled with sharp teeth at the stamen.
Apart from that, the flower had escaped the restrictions of the flower pot and used many branches as its limbs. It was like the evolved version of the flower in the Daily Observer headquarters.
What the hell is this? Rosago, who was controlling his marionette in the distance, couldn't help but widen his eyes when he saw this scene. If not for the Wind-blessed having a chance of succeeding, he would've already "leaped" away.
However, Kune was not surprised by the flower's existence. What surprised him was the aura of the flower! After all, he did not feel such pressure when facing His Excellency God's Songster.
"Alright, the game has officially begun. My little friend wants to eat more."
Ray laughed charmingly, then pointed with her delicate hand. The flower waved the note excitedly and lunged at Kuhn.
Kune was not going to wait for death. He spread his hair again, and silver lightning gathered in an instant, forming an arrow of lightning that directly hit the mouthpiece of the stamen.
The flower stopped in its tracks after being hit, but all of its petals turned even redder. It suddenly swung its dozens of branches in the direction of the two.
The lightning strike that could severely injure any Beyonder below the level of a demigod was useless apart from making the flower furious.
Seeing this, Kuhn hurriedly rushed to Robert's side. After pulling him up, he immediately "flew" into the air to avoid the whipping branches.
However, at this moment, Robert suddenly lost control of his emotions without any warning. He bawled loudly as he continuously wrestled with Kuhn, who was holding onto him with one hand. He screamed, "Let me go! Let me go! I don't want to be a burden! Let me die!"
Psychiatrist's Frenzy!
Robert, who had been surrounded by self-reproach, almost collapsed after being attacked like this. He temporarily lost his rationality.
Captain Kuhn's "flying" trajectory slightly deviated due to the unexpected twist and turn, and was immediately hit by a branch.
The two Mandated Punishers crashed heavily to the ground. Robert didn't mention it, but Kuhn had his ribs broken and stabbed into his stomach. He couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood.
The flower did not give him a chance to "heal", and directly tied him up with a branch. This was extremely violent, causing the already injured Kuhn's body to tremble in pain. Even the "Timed Disaster" slipped out of his hand and fell to the ground.
Captain Kuhn endured the pain and wanted to summon the wind and gather lightning, but he realized that the slime on the branch seemed to contain an unknown poison, so much so that he would fall into the edge of "madness" the moment he used his spirituality. He could not activate his ability at all.
For the first time, despair flashed in Kuhn's eyes. He watched helplessly as the branch sent him to Demoness Ray.
"That's much better." Ray reached out a finger and lifted Kuhn's chin, smiling as he continued, "You know what, Captain Kuhn? If you didn't have that thing on you, I would have raided the empty Holy Wind Cathedral today."
"So your target is really 2-001..." There was a flash of regret in Kuhn's eyes. Back when Detective Bryan and the Forsaken Ones had reminded him, he hadn't paid much attention to it. After all, in his eyes, the Demoness was just a rat in the sewers. She couldn't be seen in the light at all, let alone plot against the Church of Storms...
"Are you regretting it? Did anyone remind you? Oh..." The Demoness was first taken aback before she came to a realization. She smiled sweetly and said, "So it's that little detective. Heh heh, after this incident, I'll personally go play a game with that detective and his little girlfriend."
Then, without waiting for Kahn to speak, she went back to the previous topic. "When I was at the headquarters of the Daily Observer, I spent a lot of effort to pollute that thing so that I could know its location at any time..."
At this point, Ray leaned closer to Kuhn and stuck his whole arm into his clothes to feel around. After a while, he took out a small metal box with many inscriptions on it.
Opening the small box, Ray took out a black eyeball the size of a goose egg with a mysterious luster on its surface. She played with it for a while before putting it back in the box and holding it in her hand.
At the same time, Robert, who was not far away, stood up unsteadily once again. However, there was no spirit in his eyes. Clearly, he had become Rosago's marionette.
Rosago was even more afraid of the Demoness of Pain who had bewitched him. After obtaining his marionette, he didn't stay any longer and quickly got the Wind-blessed to fly him away from the battlefield.
When Kuhn, who was bound by the branches, saw this, his face showed obvious sorrow. It was for Robert, but also for his dying self... No, perhaps dying normally was already an extravagant hope...
Ray ignored Rosago's escape. He had shown considerable value in the battle just now, so it was only right to give him a little reward.
"Well, it's getting late. It's about time I made you a part of the little guy."
Ray took his time and clapped his hands. The flower was immediately so excited that its petals were delicate, and it was about to send Kuhn into its mouthpiece to chew.
"It's over... forgive me for not being able to go back, Nisse." Captain Kuhn closed his eyes.
At this critical moment, illusory bats the size of a palm suddenly flashed out of the moonlight and swarmed towards Captain Kuhn's branches.

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Hatred
chapters.content:
Chapter 147 - Hatred
The illusory bats constantly attacked the branch with their claws that had mysterious symbols and patterns, tearing it apart in the blink of an eye.
Immediately after, the group of bats carried Captain Kuhn's body, which had fallen off from the branches, and cleverly avoided the other branches that were dancing around the flower, slowly landing on the ground.
Watching the bats gradually converge into a handsome man with black hair and red eyes, the originally desperate Kuhn finally heaved a sigh of relief and said gratefully, "Thank you, Forsaken."
With that, he looked at the Demoness with hatred. Since he wasn't dead, he had to avenge Robert.
The handsome man who saved Kuhn was naturally Cullen, who had quickly rushed over after noticing the eruption of the evil aura. He looked at the huge strange flower with a grave expression.
On the other side, Ray did not seem surprised by Cullen's appearance. The corner of her mouth even curled up, but it quickly disappeared.
"Kill them!" Ray pointed and ordered the giant flower.
The flower's petals turned red again, swinging dozens of branches toward Cullen and Kuhn.
However, at that moment, countless vines suddenly grew out from the ground. They quickly weaved into a net to block the whipping path of the branches. Although they were shattered, they successfully stopped the twitching branches.
Behind the large web woven with vines, Judy revealed herself. She looked at the giant flower, which was constantly using the branches to jump forward. She beckoned to the ground, and immediately after, clumps of thorns rose from the ground, drowning the giant flower from all directions, and stabbing the spikes on her body into the flower stems.
Seeing this, Ray only chuckled and ignored it, but her eyes were on an open space on the other side of the vineyard.
As expected, the thorns that pierced into the roots of the giant flower quickly turned yellow and withered, quickly turning into dust.
"Hiss... This flower's poison is even more powerful than my thorns! No, that's not poison, that's pollution!" Judy narrowed her eyes and observed for a moment before waving her hand to remove the other plants she had cultivated.
The Primordial Moon's corruption was too effective against her creation. Such contact with it was a waste.
After destroying many of the thorns, the flower seemed to become increasingly agitated. It opened its mouth and spat out countless white pollen.
"That is... Don't let the pollen touch you. It will let you passively reproduce its offspring!" With just a glance, Judy could tell the effect of the pollen and immediately reminded her.
"Leave it to me!" As a Potions Professor who had been teaching for a hundred years, Cullen was already prepared for the Primordial Moon's tricks. As he spoke, he threw out several bottles of potions.
The medicinal liquid sprinkled in the air like raindrops on the pollen, instantly combining with it. Then, with an indignant illusory roar, most of the pollen was neutralized and destroyed. Only a small portion of it landed on the ground and began to grow crazily after coming into contact with the grass or other plants.
To this, Judy simply waved her hand again and created a sharp-toothed thornbush that gnawed at the plant. She ate all of the plants that had been infected by the pollen. Finally, she had Cullen pour the potion over the thornbush and kill it.
And at the same time, behind the giant flower, a giant that was even taller than the giant flower appeared out of thin air. His entire body was covered in silver-white armor. He raised a broadsword condensed from the light of dawn with both hands and rapidly slashed forward.
Crack!
As expected, the huge flower was split in half from its stamen to its roots!
"Captain!" Cullen and Judy exclaimed in surprise when they saw this scene.
This silver-armored giant, who was nearly four meters tall, looked like Captain Asenov after he wore the contract of a Holy Artifact. Unfortunately, this state was too much of a burden for the Captain who was still a Guardian. It couldn't last long.
"Holy Artifact of the Silver Knight's ability? It seems to only be able to use the Sword of Dawn and 'borrow light to hide'? But... this isn't enough..." Seeing the giant flower beheaded, Ray was still not moved at all. She even had the leisure to comment on it, but towards the end, her voice had a tinge of regret.
Her attitude instantly put everyone on alert.
As expected, under the crimson moonlight, the giant flower rapidly recovered as though it had never been hurt by the Silver Knight.
It opened the huge mouthpiece in the stamen, roared, and waved its branches to fight the silver-armored knight that was even larger than it.
Undying bodies? But Beyonders of the Warrior pathway could weaken the mystery of their opponents. With the augmentation of a Holy Artifact, even those "undying" creatures shouldn't be able to recover...
Seeing this scene, Cullen couldn't help but frown. If they couldn't find a way to break the "regeneration" of that flower, when the Captain's burden reached its limit, the few of them would probably have to run away.
"I know what's going on! That witch! That flower's original form is actually the tattoo on the witch's back! That's why she took off her clothes because she needs moonlight to shine on her tattoo." Kuhn recalled the various actions of the witch, and his heart stirred as he blurted out.
Tattoo... Cullen carefully sized up Ray, and the latter clearly sensed his gaze but did not mind at all. She even deliberately puffed out her chest and winked at him.
So confident? Are you sure we can't do anything to her?
At the thought of this, Cullen suddenly disappeared. When he reappeared, he was already behind the Demoness.
At this moment, a silver-white revolver with a long barrel appeared in his hand.
This was the Sealed Artifact that Cullen had grasped. It was called Red Peach A, and it was forged with the Beyonder characteristic of Light Sacrifice. It could produce bullets condensed from Holy Light.
With a loud bang, a magnificent and pure beam of light shot out from the barrel and hit the ice wall around the Demoness.
Under the scorching heat of the sun, the ice on the periphery quickly melted, but the bullet condensed from Holy Light was still unable to penetrate the final layer of frost that clung to the Demoness.
Cullen fired a few shots at the same spot but was unable to achieve any results. At this moment, the Demoness seemed to have "finally" reacted. She revealed a charming smile, and immediately after, five transparent frost spears stabbed into Cullen's body.
Cullen's body rapidly turned incorporeal as it was tainted with a faint red color, turning into a hazy moonlight. The moonlight instantly shattered, turning into red scales that dissipated on the spot and rapidly reformed in the distance. This was the Moonlight Transformation ability of a Scarlet Scholar.
"No... The frost around her seems to have been strengthened by the tattoo. Attacks below the level of a saint are useless," Cullen said to Judy with a frown. He knew that Judy's Beyonder items likely still had a few demigod powers.
"Although the abilities of 'Record' are close to that of a demigod, without the augmentation of a demigod's level, they are only slightly stronger than your revolver. They might not be useful." Judy shook her head.
At this moment, Captain Kuhn, who had picked up the "Timed Disaster", said, "I can launch an attack to break the layer of ice, but it will take 10 seconds to prepare..."
"Are you crazy? I've also heard of that holy relic of yours. 10 seconds... I'm afraid your body won't be able to hold on for much longer," Cullen said in surprise.
"To me, killing her is more important than my life!" The fury in Kuhn's eyes burned, and the hatred in his voice was almost tangible.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Ending
chapters.content:
Chapter 148 - Ending
"You're not in the right mood..." Cullen looked at Kuhn's angry eyes and frowned. He then looked at the navy pocket watch in his hand and asked, "How many times have you used it today?"
Although a punctual Calamity was a sacred item of the Kuhn contract, and it wouldn't be too much of a burden to use it normally, it was ultimately a Beyonder item transformed from a high-level Beyonder characteristic.
Even if it was compatible with a contractor, overuse would result in serious mental corruption. After all, Beyonders below the demigod level had little resistance to divinity.
"I know! My spirit has been corrupted by the 'sacred relic', and I've become irrational and irritable! I know all of this, but the idea of wanting her dead definitely comes from my heart!" Kuhn was emotional, but the firmness in his words showed his determination.
"Alright, we can give it a try." Cullen stared at him for a few seconds before finally nodding.
"But... will that witch just stand there and wait to be struck by lightning?" Judy asked worriedly.
With 10 seconds of preparation time, as long as the Demoness wasn't an idiot, she wouldn't just stand there without moving.
"I think she will 'cooperate'... Of course, we can't just sit back and do nothing. We still have to put on a show." Cullen narrowed his crimson eyes as if he had seen through something.
"Acting... You mean?" Judy was stunned at first, then she said thoughtfully.
"Don't say it out loud..." Cullen shook his head. His intuition told him that if he were to say it out loud, there might be other changes.
On the side, Kuhn scratched his head in irritation—the modified captain's hat had fallen off somewhere when he was caught by the Demoness. He asked in confusion, "What are you guys doing?"
"It's nothing. Just prepare for your 'calamity.'" Cullen shook his head, not prepared to explain anything. The Captain of the Mandated Punishers in front of him was clearly not in the right state. If he were to be agitated again, he might really go crazy.
After brushing off Kuhn, Cullen looked at the silver-armored giant who was fighting the giant flower, and then his lips moved as if he was saying something.
After the giant swung the Sword of Dawn and chopped off the blood-colored flower's flower plate again, he turned his head and nodded slightly. Then, before the flower recovered, he grabbed its stem and pulled its entire body away from Demoness Ray.
Seeing that his captain was holding back the giant flower, Cullen turned his gaze to the row of grapevines not far behind the Demoness. His lips curled up slightly.
He then looked away and said to Kuhn, "You can get ready." Then he turned back to Judy and said, "Judy, you're going to join me in pinning down the Demoness with long-range attacks."
"Understood." At this moment, Judy roughly understood Cullen's intentions. Without hesitation, she took out a handful of seeds from her bag. They were all powerful Beyonder creatures refined by her father. They were considered a type of golem, but they usually existed in the form of seeds.
Kuhn nodded as well. He pulled the button on the top of his pocket watch and turned the needle back to 10 degrees! This time, the black diamonds embedded on the surface of the watch began to turn light. Dark clouds began to pile up in the sky above where Kuhn was, and silver electric snakes were shining. It was extremely terrifying.
Seeing this, Judy also quickly scattered the dozens of seeds in her hands. Those seeds grew as soon as they saw the soil, germinated, bloomed, and the result was smooth.
The last fruit that fell was a 1.8-meter tall soldier wearing golden armor and holding a long sword.
As soon as these "soldiers" landed, they formed a formation and charged towards the Demoness in an orderly manner.
Seeing this, Cullen used the darkness domain type spell, Abyss Shackles. He raised his hand slightly, and the shadows around Ray instantly gathered together as if they were alive, turning into pitch-black chains that tightly wrapped around the ice around the Demoness.
When Ray saw this, a smile appeared on her bright face, and then her body burned with quiet black flames from the inside out.
The black flames pierced through the thin ice and instantly landed on the chains formed by the shadows and silently burned them. Using their spirituality as fuel, they quickly burned the chains back to their true shadow.
But at this time, the golden-armored soldiers had already arrived. They surrounded the Demoness and raised their swords to slash at the ice around her.
With a thought, the black flames that burned the shadows turned into bullets and shot at the golden-armored soldiers.
However, when the black flames landed on the soldier's body, the golden armor actually shone with a dazzling light and quickly extinguished the black flames. In the end, only a black mark was left on the surface of the armor.
"Your defense isn't bad. Although it's not as good as a Guardian, it's not much worse than being afraid of death... However, it's still a creation of the Mother domain." After Ray sighed with interest, the tattoo on her naked back trembled slightly as though it was alive. The bullets formed from black flames were immediately dyed a dark red color.
Right on the heels of that, the golden armor of the 'soldier' silently ignited, burning to ashes in a second or two, revealing the wooden, rigid figure inside.
However, at that moment, the punctual Calamity needle finally returned to its original spot. As the ten black gems turned pale, silver bolts of lightning suddenly fell from midair.
The punctual Calamity Scourge only had twelve degrees on it, corresponding to the twelve black diamonds. Once the needle returned to the twelve degrees, it would launch an attack that truly belonged to Sea King in 12 seconds!
Unfortunately, with Kuhn's ability as a Sequence 5, 10 seconds was already the limit. Even so, this attack truly possessed the power of a demigod. Furthermore, it was a continuous attack of a demigod!
The lightning spread its "branches", enveloping a hundred-meter radius around the Demoness in the Lightning Forest. The destructive aura and destruction felt like it was corporeal!
All the plants, animals, rocks, and buildings in the area, including the soldiers whose seeds grew, were shattered and evaporated in such a silver-white expanse.
Before the violent silver storm calmed down, the second wave of tyrannical electric snakes twisted and entangled, descending once again like giant waves.
After releasing the "Lightning Storm" ten times in a row, there was no color on Kuhn's face at all. His legs went soft and he fell to the ground. The "Timed Disaster" also fell to the side, but his eyes were fixed on the center of the thunderstorm, wanting to witness the final outcome.
Before Judy could feel sorry for the soldiers, she ran to him and used the "Record" Ancient Alchemist's healing ability to heal his injuries. Cullen also took out a bottle of potion and drank it.
Kuhn paid no attention to this. He only looked at the vineyard, which was almost leveled.
Suddenly, a figure emerged from the rubble. It was none other than Demoness Ray.
At this moment, her naked body was covered in dust, and her delicate skin had been charred black piece by piece. Parts of her skin were even lacerated, and it was obvious that she had suffered severe injuries.
The flower tattoo on her back also became dim, but everyone could clearly see that the tattoo was slowly recovering under the illumination of the blood moon!
Because of this, the Witch's injuries were visibly improving.
Looking at this scene, Kuhn bit his lip and struggled to get up, wanting to pick up the "punctual Calamity" to deal another blow. However, it was already a miracle that he was still alive in his current body condition. How could he have the ability to activate the "holy relic" again?
The giant flower that was confronting the silver-armored giant had also disappeared. It was obvious that the power of the tattoo had been greatly weakened, and it could no longer be conjured.
But at this moment, under Ray's disappointed and smug expression, a pure white bone sword less than a meter long suddenly pierced through the tattoo on her back.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 149 - Arrival
The one who delivered this fatal blow was naturally one of the three giants of the Church of Evernight, the Red Gloves. The Sword of the Goddess, Crestet Cesimir.
He had already been nearby when Kuhn was preparing for the "Timed Disaster". Although Cullen had discovered him, he did not point it out. That was why he had used the "sacred relic" to stab the Demoness's "vital point" when she was caught off guard.
As the white bone sword stabbed into the tattoo on Ray's back, a large amount of blood gushed out from the flower-like patterns, far exceeding the standard of a normal person.
When Cesimir saw this scene, his expression suddenly changed. He did not even have the time to pull out his bone sword before he flew backward. As he retreated, he tapped his teeth and released the wraith sealed within.
On the other side, Captain Arsenov, who had transformed into a Silver Knight, arrived in front of Cullen, Judy, and Kuhn in a few steps. At the same time, he knelt on one knee with his back facing the demoness. The Sword of Dawn was inserted into the ground, protecting the three people under his body.
Just as he completed this action, the tide-like dark power flowing out from the white bone sword fiercely collided with the blood-colored power in the patterns. The violent shockwaves swept in all directions from the Demoness' back.
This shockwave was not as shocking as the "punctual calamity" from before, but its level was rather high.
Even after retreating for a distance, a distorted, broken, semi-transparent face appeared on every tooth. Crestet Cesimir was still shaken by the aftershock and fell to one knee with a grunt. Blood and tears flowed down his facial features.
Cullen and company weren't any better off. Although the physical impact was blocked by the silver-armored giant, the impact from the high-level status wasn't something a Guardian could withstand!
There was no need to mention it. His brain, which was already severely injured, felt as if it was hit by a huge hammer. He only felt a hum and fainted.
Cullen's body instantly turned illusory, turning into a hazy moonlight. However, after the moonlight shattered, it did not reassemble as quickly as before. Instead, it struggled to piece back Cullen's image bit by bit.
Judy's long brown hair suddenly grew to three meters long. The strands of hair wriggled on their own as if they were alive. After a long while, she regained control of her ability. Her hair that had suddenly grown longer also turned yellow and fell freely.
"That was horrible. I almost lost control," Judy said to Callum, her face pale.
Cullen first checked Kuhn's condition and found that after Judy's previous treatment, he wouldn't die for the time being. Only then did he turn back and say, "Only by destroying a trace of the Primordial Moon's godhood can there be such an impact. You should be glad."
With that said, he stopped talking and seized the opportunity to recover his spirituality. In order to deal with the impact, his Moonlight Transformation had nearly collapsed. Even though he had barely recombined it, he still suffered quite a bit of backlash.
At this moment, Captain Arsenov also took off his "holy relic"—the huge silver armor—and his body shrank to two meters. He immediately sat on the ground, panting heavily, and sweat covered his face. Clearly, the holy relic of the Silver Knight ability was still a heavy burden to him.
For a moment, the noisy thunder and explosions were gone, and the blood-colored moon returned to normal. Only silence and darkness remained in the destroyed vineyard.
A minute later, Cesimir struggled to his feet with his left palm supporting the ground. He decided to confirm the outcome again, although he didn't think the Demoness would survive such a collision.
Meanwhile, Cullen opened his eyes and "Blink" appeared beside Cesimir.
However, just as they neared the spot where Ray had been standing, Cullen was the first to notice that something was wrong.
"The Demoness isn't dead... She escaped right under our noses!" he said with certainty.
"What?" Cesimir was taken aback. Previously, he hadn't seen the Demoness' remains, and he had thought that there was nothing left of her. However, after a careful inspection, he nodded and said, "There's no Beyonder characteristic..."
"And I previously saw her snatch a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact from Kuhn. There's nothing here either," Cullen added.
Cesimir picked up his bone sword and put it back into the suitcase. He then asked in puzzlement, "That Demoness is very strange. She had the upper hand previously and clearly had many opportunities to leave calmly. There was no need for her to clash head-on with the three Holy Artifacts, but she was like a boor who flaunted her strength, giving us ample time to prepare... And now, she's leaving without any hesitation... She's like two different people."
"I'm guessing that the Demoness's plan has two goals. First, it's the Sealed Artifact of the Church of Storms..." As Cullen spoke, he squatted down and flipped open the rubble on the ground with his gloves as though he was searching for something.
"And the second goal should be to use our hands to escape the flower on her back and escape the control of the Primordial Moon.
"From her previous performance in the battle, it's not difficult to tell that another will had awakened in her body—perhaps that flower. In short, that will seemed to be subtly fusing with her... but the Demoness noticed something.
"Therefore, she deliberately created a character that was arrogant in battle and liked to toy with her opponents. In fact, she was deceiving that will, or rather, deceiving herself.
"She played this game while creating opportunities for us to attack her.
"I guess if she had done it herself, Captain Kuhn might not have been able to wait for our rescue... She wants us all to gather and help her destroy that flower!
"And during this process, Demoness cannot reveal that intention, nor can she show it too obviously. Otherwise, she won't be able to 'deceive' herself! And I didn't let Judy say it previously because I was afraid that she would find it difficult to deceive herself after hearing the 'truth'."
At this point, Cullen suddenly paused, because he had found some bloodstains on a stone. This wasn't the blood that the flower had spat out. Those things had already been completely destroyed by the white bone sword. Instead, it was the Demoness' blood that had flowed out when she was struck by lightning... her own blood.
"So that's how it is... In that case, after she was attacked by the lightning, her intentions were actually detected by that will. Otherwise, her face wouldn't have revealed two completely different expressions at the same time!" Cesimir nodded in realization. When he stabbed the bone sword into the Demoness' back, he had caught a glimpse of the expression on her face. At that time, it had been a little strange, but now he completely understood.
"However, even if she had a backup plan, she definitely wouldn't be able to withstand the impact of the godhood. She must have suffered severe injuries." Cullen dipped his finger into the blood before placing it into his mouth to suck on it. Soon, he looked towards the south and continued, "We've found her traces."
