He stood up and said to Judy, who was standing nearby, "It's not safe here. Take Captain and Kuhn to the nearby manor for help as soon as possible."
With that, Cullen looked at Cesimir and asked, "Your Excellency Cesimir, can you still move?"
Cesimir smiled bitterly. "I can only barely protect myself."
"Then why don't you help me look after Judy and the rest... I'll go after that Demoness," Cullen said with a smile.
Cesimir knew that she was giving him an out, so he nodded in agreement.
On the other side, Judy had already picked up the "punctual Cosmic Disaster" and the gold-framed mirror used by Robert from the ground beside her. Then, she summoned the earth golem to carry Kuhn, and together with Captain Arsenov, who had barely recovered some strength, they slowly walked towards the viscount's villa in her memory.
...
After everyone left for a while, a petite figure appeared in the vineyard. She also came to the pile of rubble and dug out a stone with blood on it. Soon after, black flames rose and covered the blood on the stone.
...
Demoness Ray, who was running rapidly in the dark, suddenly screamed and fell to the ground.
She struggled to her feet, muttering to herself. "Blood curse... Lena?"
With that said, she realized that she no longer had the energy to continue running. She needed the "pain" to replenish her energy...
She looked around.
Soon, she saw a manor that was holding a banquet.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Emotion
chapters.content:
Chapter 150 - Emotion
In Elk Manor, Ebner and Daly were standing on a fake mountain in the garden, looking at the dense dark clouds in the north with solemn expressions.
In Backlund, when guests attended banquets and balls, leaving the hall and entering the garden wasn't considered rude. This was because strolling under the moon and blowing on the night breeze that carried the fragrance of flowers was a very classy matter. However, it often meant a rendezvous.
Of course, Ebner and Daly were not here for a date. It was because the lightning storm triggered by the 'punctual Cosmic Disaster' was too loud. Even though they were dozens of kilometers away, they could still feel the horror brought about by the 'Cosmic Disaster'.
As he was feeling uneasy, Ebner took the initiative to request Macht to take a walk in the garden. In reality, he wanted to find an empty spot to summon Cullen's messenger and ask about the situation.
However, for some unknown reason, Daly followed him out. This made Macht's expression turn ambiguous.
As for Bishop Utravsky, he remained in the main residence. He appeared to be chatting with the senator, but in fact, he was using it to protect his family.
"The wandering natural spirits told me that there are several Beyonders fighting in the north, but they don't dare to approach. They don't know the exact situation," Daly said with a slightly ethereal voice.
Ebner nodded when he heard that. He was thinking of a reason to send Daly away so that he could set up a ritual to summon Silika.
But at that moment, he suddenly felt vexed. All kinds of emotions and desires surged out of his mind. There was confusion, horror, regret, sadness, fear, and helplessness from witnessing the changes in Jane before and after. In short, most of them weren't positive emotions.
Just as Ebner was about to be controlled by the desire to vent his emotions, the Eye of Pure White suddenly activated. Through the suppression of his level, he found some rationality and calmed down again.
Therefore, Ebner didn't hesitate to use his Machinery Hivemind. He temporarily blocked his excess emotions and desires before returning to normal.
And at this moment, the Eye of Pure White had also transmitted the "analysis" of the current situation to him.
"This is... the Church of Storms's 2-001? But isn't it able to absorb people's extreme emotions? Can it also release disturbances?"
Ebner looked at the results of the "analysis" and frowned as he muttered to himself. Then, he analyzed,
Ray has always been seeking this Sealed Artifact... And its appearance here clearly shows its malice towards the people in the manor...
"Did Ray succeed? Is she here now?!"
Thinking of this, Ebner became even more vigilant. Without hesitation, he took out the Solomon Gold Coin and wiped the blood off the portrait.
Following that, he looked at Daly who wasn't far away, hoping to seek help.
However, at this moment, the lady was not in a good state. Her consciousness was clearly not very clear. Her face revealed various expressions such as "inferiority", "fear", "self-abandonment". Even when Ebner walked over, she stared at him with empty, blank eyes for a few seconds before throwing herself onto him, as if seeking warmth.
Ebner was naturally not one to take advantage of a lady. He held Daly with his hand and then simulated the Solar High Priest's "immune fear" ability.
Daly felt a warm power enter her body as though the sun shone brightly over her head. This feeling reminded her of a man—a man who always listened to her gently, a man who always stood by her side, a man who always helped her steadily, a man who would feel embarrassed when confronted with jokes involving both sexes, a man who accepted all of his teammates' flaws with a sincere attitude, a man who would be at a loss when she teased him again, a man who liked to hide his pain and sorrow in his heart When he came across danger, he would be the first to step forward and cover his teammates behind him.
"Fear" and "anxiety" quickly faded from Madam Daly's mind as the man's image lit up her heart.
The lady's lips curved up a few seconds later, looking kind and beautiful... Her green eyes glowed brightly again as she smiled at Ebner.
"Detective Bryan, you are truly a reliable gentleman... I'm sure those tabloids aren't entirely baseless... You could have seduced me if I hadn't been so old."
She was well aware of what had occurred previously, so she made light of it with sarcastic remarks. She, of course, conveyed her gratitude in a diplomatic manner.
"This is not the time for a joke, Ma'am Daly. Also, just refer to me as Ebner." Ebner breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that she had recovered. With the suspected Demoness lurking nearby, having a Necromancer mentor would greatly increase the odds of surviving.
"What is the situation?" When Daly heard that, her smile faded and she asked solemnly.
"Let's have a conversation while we walk!" Bishop Utravsky was on Ebner's mind, and he was terrified that something might happen to him. After all, his mental issues were really significant, and he couldn't take the agony of intense emotions.
"I'm guessing that the Demoness of Agony obtained 2-001. This should be the isolation space created by the Sealed Artifact." On the way to the main residence, Ebner summarized his guess.
Although the Church of Storms hasn't informed me of the specific information regarding a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, the Nighthawks actually have some understanding of 2-001...
"Its appearance is that of a pupil-less eyeball. If the eyeball is placed between the eyebrows, it will create a unique space that can absorb extreme emotions... And if it is placed in front of the chest, it will release the emotions that it has absorbed, causing people to fall into the violent outburst of emotions, unable to extricate themselves."
Daly, who barely managed to keep up with him, did not hide anything. In a few words, she shared what she knew with Ebner.
Ebner held his chin in his right hand as he walked.
Among the Beyonders who fought in the north, one of them should be the Demoness of Agony... Even if she succeeded, she shouldn't have stopped so close... Unless she had no choice but to do so!
"Releasing extreme emotions isn't her goal. It's probably just a means... What does she want us to do with this method? Or achieve some expectations?"
Daly closed her eyes and thought for a moment. Suddenly, she said, "I'm guessing that she's trying to give us' pain '!"
At this moment, Ebner had already arrived at the gate of the main residence. Upon hearing this, he stopped in his tracks and asked, "What do you mean? Wasn't there pain in the emotions she released just now?"
"That's not the pain she 'created'... I'm guessing that she's in a very bad state and needs this method to stabilize her condition," Daly said somewhat ambiguously. At the same time, she was very glad that the person she met when she was troubled by extreme emotions was Ebner.
If... if you weren't such a gentleman just now, I'm afraid I'd have to go through another nightmare, much less face him... then the pain in my heart would be unimaginable.
Ebner naturally did not know what Daly was thinking, but he could roughly guess it. Therefore, he immediately understood what she meant.
Acting?
Stabilizing her condition through "acting"? In that case, she might be on the brink of losing control. It was no wonder she didn't do it herself. She didn't even release the most basic "illness" of the Demoness of Agony.
A realization dawned on Ebner, but he didn't voice his speculation. He wasn't ready to let the Nighthawks know that he had mastered the acting method. What if he was dragged off to touch his sword and swear?
As soon as they pushed open the door, Ebner and Daly felt a murderous aura. Looking around, they saw Bishop Utravsky standing in the middle of the hall. In his hand was a heavy and broad sword that seemed to be condensed from light.
Seeing the two of them walk in, Bishop Utravsky struggled violently, but his face soon turned ferocious, and the hand holding the sword slowly lifted.
When Daly saw this scene, she immediately opened her mouth and uttered a difficult and awkward language that no living being could understand.
This was the "Language of the Dead" of the Necromancer. It could bypass the protection of flesh and blood and target Spirit Bodies.

chapters.title: Chapter 151: The End of the Demoness
chapters.content:
Chapter 151 - The End of the Demoness
As Daly said in the Language of the Dead, a transparent layer quickly appeared on the surface of Bishop Utravsky's body. Immediately following that, a cold wind that could be described as mournful blew in the hall.
In Ebner's Spirit Vision, he saw a transparent figure about 2 meters tall with a hideous and terrifying expression. It was obviously an evil spirit.
Just as Ebner was about to simulate Holy Light to completely destroy the evil spirit, Daly, who was beside him, waved her hand at him, indicating that there was no hurry. Then, she opened her mouth again.
"Umeklo!"
As another awkward, difficult, ear-piercing, and completely incomprehensible word were recited, the transparent figure that appeared from the bishop's body suddenly quieted down. He could no longer feel the cold feeling from before. If not for the fact that he could still see it through his Spirit Vision, Ebner might have thought that it no longer existed.
After the evil spirit left Bishop Utravsky's body, the latter's face clearly softened, but the huge sword condensed from light in his hand did not dissipate.
"Do you have the ability to make people fall asleep?" Daly reached out and summoned the evil spirit to her side. After communicating with it for a while, she turned her head and asked.
Ebner glanced warily at the impish evil spirit, hesitated, then nodded. "Yes, ma'am... but will that help the bishop?"
He wasn't afraid of using the powers of multiple pathways in front of Daly. After all, it could be said that he had used a mystical item. After all, he was only a weak Sequence 7, right?
He hesitated because he didn't know if Madam Daly was aware of the bishop's mental ailment. Wouldn't there be a bigger problem if she made a mistake in her judgment because she didn't know?
"This little fellow said that there are two people in his mind. They are like lovers who are about to break up. They love and hate each other, and they are sentimental. As the third party, we can't get between them for the time being... However, we still have to restrict his actions so as to prevent the Demoness from poaching him." Daly explained patiently with an ethereal voice and terrible choice of words.
Ebner, who was in the state of 'Mechanical Mind', did not have any other thoughts about her joke segments. He only picked out the important parts and asked, "You mean to use dreams to restrict it?"
"Yes, it's both a restriction and a form of protection," Daly said with certainty.
Ebner nodded slightly before carefully approaching the giant bishop. Then, he opened his mouth and recited a peaceful poem that made one feel as though they were in the night.
"Whenever the sun sinks in the west
"The dewdrops fill the evening lapels
"She is as pale as the moon when she is bare
"Or like stars with the moon
"The moon sees grass under the nourishment of night dew
"It blooms with elegant, delicate flowers
"Avoid sunlight like a hermit."
...
The chanting echoed, and the ability of the Midnight Poet immediately made Bishop Utravsky's body sway slightly. His eyes seemed to have regained some clarity as he smiled gently at Ebner. Then, without resisting, he leaned against the pillar in the hall and fell asleep.
"Let's find the Demoness of Afflictions immediately, in case she tries anything else," Daly told Ebner as the bishop fell asleep.
"You know the location of the Demoness? Through that evil spirit?" Ebner seemed to have guessed something and asked directly.
"Yes, this little fellow was summoned by the Demoness through black magic... She wants to use it to control the bishop to attack us... She also wants the bishop to do something destined to be 'painful'!" Daly said as she followed behind the evil spirit that led the way.
Ebner followed cautiously and analyzed calmly. "From the looks of it, that Demoness has indeed lost the ability to attack. Otherwise, she wouldn't have used such a troublesome method... The black magic to summon this evil spirit is most likely a ritual aid."
However, Ray's luck today was really not very good. She clearly did not expect that I could easily escape the emotional control and help a necromancer regain his rationality. And as a backup plan, she used it to provoke the evil spirit that the bishop killed. In the end, not only was she exposed by Daly, the necromancer mentor, but she also exposed her own position...
Was "Solomon Gold Coin" so effective?
"I can't be too careless... Maybe she's just showing weakness..."
The two followed the evil spirit and soon left the main residence, arriving in the courtyard.
Under Ebner's "calm" gaze, the evil spirit jumped onto a carriage engraved with the Dark Sacred Emblem. Then, a black flame rose, and the evil spirit disappeared from the carriage before it could even scream.
Ebner and Daly looked at each other, each preparing a spell of attack.
At this moment, the carriage's curtains were lifted. A lady with black hair stuck her naked upper body out of the carriage window and said resentfully,
"I didn't expect you to come here so quickly... Can't you die in pain and despair?"
This was Ray, who'd had to escape to this place after being cursed by Lena. She had a black eyeball embedded in her chest.
Ebner didn't say a word. Instead, he used the Eye of Pure White to quickly analyze the Demoness's state. Soon, he discovered that although she appeared calm, she was also entangled by various emotions and desires. As she had been severely injured mentally and physically, she was on the brink of losing control!
This was also the reason why the other party was so fearless despite not being able to use many methods. She was certain that the two of them would not dare to attack her rashly. Otherwise, she might lose control and become a monster on the spot.
Daly had also discovered this through her own means. She frowned and said, "It's indeed very tricky. I lack the means to quickly kill her... We might as well wait for the reinforcements from the Holy Church. Time is on our side. We just need to watch her and not let her escape."
Ebner shook his head and said expressionlessly, "Bishop Utravsky might not be able to last that long. I don't know how the ordinary people outside are doing... Most importantly, the Demoness might be stalling for time because she's waiting for something else to be done."
"Does that mean you have a solution?" Daly heard the hidden meaning in his words and her eyes immediately lit up.
"I can only say that she was really unlucky today."
Ebner took out a badge from his pocket.
It was the badge that had cursed Xio at the beginning. It was the badge that had been repaired by Ebner with the aura of a devil.
The enmity between him and Demoness of Afflictions, Ray, began with this badge, and now, it was finally going to end.
This was because the curse power in this badge could trigger one's desires!
As for Demoness Ray, because she was using 2-001, he had the various extreme emotions and desires that the Sealed Artifact had been absorbing all this time!
Ebner aimed the badge at the carriage and crushed it with a cold expression.
Right on the heels of that, Ray, whose upper body was leaning against the window, suddenly had his head explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Spoils of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 152 - Spoils of War
In the woods in the northwest area of Backlund, Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake, watched helplessly as the Rose School of Thought demigod Zatwen escaped into the spirit world, but he was powerless to stop him.
Furious, he landed on the ground and released a gust of wind, sweeping the Possession Puppet on the ground not far away in front of him.
"As expected... it's already an empty shell!" With just a glance, Snake's face turned even uglier, and he smashed the puppet onto the ground.
"What's wrong?" a man with black hair and golden eyes asked after picking up the puppet.
He was a demigod from the Loen military. He had been attracted by the commotion caused by the battle at the demigod level. It was also because of his arrival that Zatwen had decisively retreated.
"1-025 broke through the seal once again. It secretly abandoned this' vessel 'that sealed it when I was too distracted. I wonder what it possessed to escape!" Seeing the military demigod's question, Sneck's expression eased as he explained slightly.
"What? A Grade 1 Sealed Artifact has been lost?" The military demigod jumped in fright when he heard that. One had to know that Grade 1 represented extreme danger. It was a terrifying existence that could destroy a city. Even with the means of the Church's seal, they could only make limited use of it. And now, it was completely out of control. What did this mean? Just the thought of it made his scalp tingle.
"I'll get someone to report the details to you later... I have to rush over to see how Kuhn is doing." After nodding at the military demigod, Snake leaped up and flew towards the spot where the Timed Disaster had activated Lightning Storm.
...
In a house in the North Borough of Backlund, Wraith Steve flashed out of a piece of glass hatefully. Due to Sharron's entanglement, he didn't have the time to rush to the location designated by Lord Zatwen. And Lord had already sent him a message, asking him to wait at this stronghold.
At that moment, Zatwen, who was wearing a black glove on his left hand, came out of the spirit world. His expression was cold and terrifying. Without needing Steve to explain, he asked, "Sharron stopped you?"
"I'm sorry, my lord. I tried my best to get rid of her, but I didn't succeed..." Steve lowered his head in fear and apologized.
"Cough, cough. There was the Blood Moon just now. How could Sharron still have the ability to hold you back?" Zatwen coughed twice as his face turned pale. Just now, the military demigod had suddenly sensed that he had given a mysterious decree that had weakened, causing him to be injured by God's Songster's Lightning Arrow.
"I'm not sure... but I saw Sharron drink a potion during the battle," Steve said after a moment's thought.
"From the looks of it, a Scarlet Scholar is helping her... Cough, cough, cough." Zatwen coughed violently again before instructing Steve, "Thankfully, the outcome isn't too bad. The cursed item has escaped the control of the Church of Storms... It shouldn't be too far away. It must still be in Backlund. In the future, find someone to ask around and see if there's any horror stories that suddenly spread in the city."
"Yes, my lord," answered Steve quickly and respectfully.
"In addition, find where Sharron and Maric are staying as soon as possible."
...
In a somewhat dilapidated manor in the northwest suburbs, Captain Asenov, Judy, and the Sword of the Goddess, Crestet Cesimir, took turns to enter a Cogitation state after setting up a simple guard to recover their exhausted spirituality.
As for Captain Kuhn? He was still unconscious.
Speaking of which, this was the manor that Ebner and Xio often came to practice guns on. It was later bought by Mr. Caron, a shareholder of Coim Company. Since Mr. Caron hadn't started repairing it, only two servants were left to guard it. And they didn't notice that an uninvited guest had come to the manor.
Cesimir's expression suddenly changed as he became vigilant. He picked up the white bone sword again... because he realized that he had been pulled into a dream.
Almost at the same time, Judy realized something was wrong.
She was the daughter of a Manipulator, and the mystical item in her hand recorded various powers like Dream Traversal. How could she not notice that she had entered a dream?
Only Captain Asenov did not understand what was going on, but seeing that his companions had reacted, he naturally silently added "protection" to them.
At this moment, an old man slowly walked in.
He was wearing a black clergyman robe with red ribbons, and he had five Dark Sacred Emblems on his chest. His face was clean, and he didn't have a beard. His eyes were deep, dark, and serene.
Upon seeing him, everyone, including Captain Asenov, was stunned. Then, they bowed respectfully to the old man and said,
"Your Excellency Saint Anthony."
This elder was Saint Anthony Stevenson, one of the thirteen archbishops of the Church of Evernight!
He was the person in charge of the Backlund diocese, a true high-ranking member of the Church of Evernight.
He first greeted the two Forsaken Ones amiably and eliminated them, mainly because of the fear in Judy's heart. As the Bishop of Terror, Saint Anthony's existence alone brought about "fear." Furthermore, the stronger one's spirituality was, the clearer one could feel it.
Then, he turned to ask Cesimir, "What happened?"
At this moment, Cesimir had already confirmed that the person was indeed the archbishop. He hurriedly reported everything that had happened, and finally added, "Earth Mother Church's Cullen has already gone to pursue that Demoness of Afflictions. I don't think she can escape."
"Being stabbed by the Sword of the Goddess will definitely result in 'misfortune.'" Saint Anthony nodded in thought.
With that said, he suddenly clapped his hands, and the dream shattered. Before Cesimir and the others woke up, they vaguely heard Saint Anthony's voice. "His Excellency Spellsinger of God's has come... He's actually even slower than me..."
...
In the courtyard of the Elk Manor, Demoness Ray's head suddenly exploded, and the headless corpse collapsed weakly on the carriage window. The black eyeball that seemed to be embedded between Ray's breasts also fell to the ground with a thud.
"Ebner, you're very rough with a lady who's plagued by lust... But I like it."
When Daly's ethereal teasing voice reached his ears, Ebner saw cracks appear in the surrounding void, shattering like glass.
Then, he felt a sense of reality. He clearly knew that he had returned to the real world.
After turning off the Machinery Hivemind, Ebner noticed that the servants in the yard had suddenly become more spirited. They were even sizing up Daly and himself frequently as if they did not understand why the two of them were circling around a carriage. Generally speaking, didn't people go on dates to admire the moon and admire the flowers?
Ebner carefully came to the carriage window and examined it with the Eye of Pure White. After confirming that there was no danger, he silently pushed Ray's corpse back into the carriage and opened the door to board it.
As for Madam Daly, she picked up the eyeball and wrapped it with her spirituality. After temporarily sealing it, she followed Ebner into the carriage and closed the door behind her.
"The smell of blood sure is pungent... I'm afraid this car can only be used after it's completely purified." Madam Daly sounded disgusted, but her expression didn't change much. As a former Corpse Collector, she was already used to dealing with various corpses.
Although Ebner also found the smell of blood pungent, his attention wasn't on it. Instead, he looked at the strange symbol painted with blood in the car, as well as an altar that was temporarily made on the seat. On the altar was an emerald-green fruit... Through the analysis of the White Eye, he knew that it was a Beyonder characteristic.
As expected, the Demoness still had a backup plan! If I hadn't decisively detonated her "desire," she might've really delayed it until the ritual was completed. This seemed to be a ritual to sacrifice to a mysterious existence... However, these symbols weren't directed at the Primordial Moon. Through the Forsaken One and the Sanguine's "Feast of Blood," Ebner gained a lot of understanding of the Primordial Moon.
However, this Beyonder characteristic seems to be Harvest Sacrifice... Could it be that Dr. Leonardo?
Ebner had some guesses in his heart, but he didn't dare to easily go back in time. Be it the Beyonder characteristic or the Demoness herself, they were certain that she was related to the Primordial Moon. He didn't dare to seek death now.
Daly had already looked over the Demoness's body. She had no place to store anything because she was naked when she died. Daly only took one ring from each of her hands as a result.
At first glance, it's clear... This is the most wild corpse I've ever seen." "The Beyonder characteristic and 2-001 will definitely be handed over to the Church," Daly said as she handed one of the rings to Ebner. These two rings are our spoils of war, though I'm not sure which church will take them. "We can divide them."
Ebner wasn't being unreasonable. He had lost a Sequence 5 trump card in order to kill the Demoness, so he had to make amends.
After receiving the ring, he used the White Eye to analyze it and knew its effects.
"Name: Ring of Light.
"Appearance: A pure gold ring with a white gem.
"Effect: It can make the wearer an envoy of light, a servant of the Sun. It is immune to many diseases and possesses the Light of Sacredness. The wearer can summon a magnificent and pure blazing beam of light. It can use most of the Sun domain spells of the Solar High Priest and Notary. It can use the Halo of Purification to purify the undead within a fifty-meter radius. It's the bane of such creatures.
"Through this ring, those who are recognized by the wearer will be raised. Those who disagree will be weakened.
"Negative effects: If the wearer frequently uses it, he will gradually become a believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun. He will slowly abide by the teachings from the bottom of his heart and praise the Sun.
"Suggestion: Use it when activating the Eye of Pure White. It can completely avoid the negative effects."
This... This is a Beyonder item with the domain power of a Sequence 5 Light Sacrifice! If Ray still had the strength to activate it just now, she could've just casually given me a Holy Light, and I would've fled.
I remember that after the incident at the headquarters of the Daily Observer, the Mandated Punisher who monitored me, named Evan, had mentioned to me that Lieutenant Berner, who had become fertilizer for the giant flower, had once mortgaged his garden house in West Borough and raised 8,000 pounds to buy a powerful item from the Sun domain in a vain attempt to escape the Demoness's control... Could it be this Ring of Light?
At that thought, Ebner slipped the ring onto his finger. Since it had entered his hand, there was no way he could return it. He was in need of a trump card for self-preservation.
"I didn't expect you to be the first one to give me a ring..." Daly could not help but smile and shake her head when she saw that he had no intention of being modest. She also wore the other ring that she had obtained from the Demoness.
And the first ring I gave was Xio... even though it was a reward for helping my teacher pass it over.
Ebner grumbled in his heart and prepared to get out of the car to return to the manor's main house. He and Daly had come out for a walk in the garden and then entered the carriage together... If they returned a little later, there was no telling what rumors would spread.
He didn't care about rumors, but even though Madam Daly didn't seem to care, Ebner knew that she actually cared about similar things being heard by Dunn again. Otherwise, she wouldn't have liked to put on her old-fashioned makeup and no longer get too close to other men. All that was left was a bit of a joke to deliberately show that she hadn't changed noticeably.
An awkward crush... Should I incite Klein to reveal Daly's crush on Dunn in advance?
While Ebner was letting his imagination run wild as he opened the car door, illusory uniforms suddenly passed through the window and quickly formed Cullen's figure on the seat.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Settling the aftermath
chapters.content:
Chapter 153 - Settling the aftermath
"Mr. Cullen, why are you here?" Ebner asked in surprise.
"I was originally chasing after this Demoness... I didn't expect her to die in your hands!" Cullen looked at Ray's headless corpse and replied with a smile.
With that said, his gaze passed the corpse and landed on Madam Daly, who had been smiling without a word since he appeared.
Seeing him look at Madam Daly, Ebner hurriedly introduced, "Mr. Cullen, this is Madam Daly of the Church of Evernight. The Demoness was actually killed by me and Madam Daly."
Cullen nodded slightly. He had exchanged names with Daly, so they knew each other.
As the Church of Evernight and the Church of Earth Mother had a very ordinary relationship, Cullen didn't exchange pleasantries with Daly. Instead, he told them about the intense battle in the vineyard. Finally, he said,
"Because Ray was stabbed by the Sword of the Goddess, I concluded that there was a high chance that an accident would happen during her escape, so I used her blood to indicate her location and chased after her."
"So the Demoness was stabbed by His Excellency Cesimir. No wonder she was so unlucky," Daly said in enlightenment.
Hearing this, Cullen's lips twitched. Although there was nothing wrong, why did it sound a little off?
At this moment, Ebner finally understood why "Solomon Gold Coin" was so effective today...
"Quickly go back and continue attending the banquet. I'm here looking at the Beyonder characteristic... I believe that the Church's people should be arriving soon." Cullen glanced at the black jelly-like substance that was seeping out of the Demoness' body and said to Ebner and Daly.
Madam Daly naturally had no objections. She trusted official Beyonders, even if they weren't part of Loen's official staff. Therefore, she got out of the car first.
"Alright," Ebner responded first, but he was not in a hurry to get out of the car. He turned back and asked, "Mr. Cullen, Bishop Utravsky doesn't seem to be in a good condition... Do you have any medicine that can help him?"
However, Cullen merely smiled and said, "Don't worry. The bishop is Blessed of God, and his will and faith are very firm. He won't be so easily harmed... He should be awake by now."
"Blessed..." Ebner repeated the term, then relaxed.
At that moment, Cullen suddenly waved his hand to chase away the nearby spirits. Then, he looked through the car window at Madam Daly, who had already walked quite a distance away. He whispered to Ebner, "Ebner, that Madam Daly has a depraved aura and isn't a suitable spouse... In comparison, Miss Xio, Miss Fors, and even Miss Susan who are closer to you are more compatible with you. They are pure girls."
As a member of the Blood Clan, he only liked pure and beautiful girls. He naturally detested women like Daly who had once indulged in debauchery.
"Although Madam Daly has been deprived for a period of time, she has already been redeemed by an upright gentleman..." Ebner first explained to Daly in a serious manner before saying unhappily, "What kind of image do I have in your eyes? You make me sound like a playboy like Emperor Roselle..."
"Roselle isn't as reserved as you when it comes to relationships. Back then, he... Forget it, why am I telling you this?" Cullen shook his head. Suddenly recalling something, he continued, "By the way, do you still owe me a promise?"
"What do you want me to do for you?" Ebner asked warily. He wasn't trying to renege on his debt. He just wanted to assess the risk of what was happening.
"There's no need to be nervous. As I said before, it's not a dangerous thing." Cullen first waved his hand, then deliberated over his words before saying, "I see that you're very well liked by girls, so you should know how little girls think... So I want you to help me choose some gifts for my sister..."
Ebner was relieved to hear this request. He was too lazy to argue with her about whether he liked girls or whether he knew how to choose what girls liked... anyway, he would buy him some gifts. As for whether Cullen's sister liked it or not, what did that have to do with him?
"How old is your sister?" Ebner asked casually.
"Um... less than a hundred years old."
...
Thursday morning, in the basement of the Holy Wind Cathedral.
As he had always been responsible for monitoring Grant's clothing store, the Wind-blessed McConnell had become the only intact Mid-Sequence member in Backlund's Mandated Punishers team, and he had also taken on the role of captain.
At this moment, he was holding a notebook and reporting the information gathered by various parties to the God of Songs, Ace Snake.
"Demoness Ray has been planning to use 2-001 as her future advancement ritual after being ambushed by us.
However, when she went from pleasure to pain, she used a ritual. She was a former Earth Mother believer who believed in the Primordial Moon. As a result, she was corrupted, and her mind showed signs of splitting... Or rather, a new personality was secretly changing her.
"Through her relationship with some of the nobles in MI9, she constantly harassed the believers of the Lord, causing trouble for us and further dispersed our forces.
"Later, through her actions at the Daily Observer's headquarters, she secretly corrupted 2-001. Then, through special means, she could sense the location of this Sealed Artifact... Back then, Detective Bryan had informed us of this through Evan. Unfortunately, we didn't take it seriously.
Demoness Ray likely learned of 1-025's existence through her connection with the nine parts of the plot. She also tried her best to lure us to use this Sealed Artifact to divine her location. And she secretly contacted the Rose School of Thought's demigod and used this Sealed Artifact as bait to restrain you...
"The Demoness's plan succeeded. She successfully used the three Holy Artifacts to escape the Primordial Moon's control and took 2-001 from the Captain.
Unfortunately, she underestimated the influence of the Sword of the Goddess. She was trapped in misfortune without realizing it, and eventually, she was killed by Detective Bryan and a Nighthawk.
"Finally, the Demoness of Afflictions Beyonder characteristic was taken away by His Excellency Saint Anthony. The Harvest Sacrifice characteristic attached to the flower was retrieved by the Church of Earth Mother, and 2-001 was returned to us."
The Wind-blessed McConnell closed his notebook, his eyes filled with heaviness. After all, the Mandated Punishers in Backlund had suffered heavy losses this time. Not only were nearly everyone below the captain seriously injured, even one of the Wind-blessed had died in battle! Furthermore, they had lost a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact.
"We owe the Church of Earth Mother and the Church of Evernight quite a big favor this time... Without their help, Kuhn probably wouldn't be able to return..." After Snake sighed in exhaustion, he said to the only Wind-blessed who could still take action, "I've already reported this matter to the Holy Cathedral. The reply I received is that we can relax the supervision of the Church of Earth Mother."
"To what extent?" Maccon asked.
"they still can't preach in public, but the Harvest Church is allowed to hold Mass once a week," Snake replied.
"Then... the Church of Evernight?"
"Send all the information we obtained from Hazel regarding the Marauder demigod. They suffered a loss last time. They must've wanted to save their face," Snake said after some thought.
Seeing that McConnell had no objections, the SpellSinger of God stood up and was about to leave when he suddenly stopped and asked with his back facing his team member, "How's Kuhn?"
"He managed to preserve his life under the treatment of the Forsaken One... However, he overexerted himself using the Holy Artifact, causing his mind to be severely corrupted. I'm afraid he won't be able to hold the position of the Holy Artifact Contractor and Captain anymore." McConner sighed as his face was filled with gloom.
"Then, after he recovers, let him guard the underground warehouse..." With that said, Mr. Snake seemed to recall something and asked, "You just said that Detective Bryan killed the Demoness... Is this Bryan the detective who revealed the demonic plot at the Daily Observer's headquarters? The one that the Church of Earth Mother values?"
"Yes, Sire," MacConner said, nodding.
"Then, let's publicize this detective's name through the newspapers we control. Consider it our repayment to the Forsaken One's."
With that said, Snake left the Mandated Punishers' headquarters and boarded a carriage to Empress Borough... He wanted to seek justice for his teammates.
...
Empress Borough, Sodrak Palace.
George III, who wore a crown and had a firm face and a mustache, sat on the throne. He looked at Viscount Stratford and smiled.
"Tell me, what happened?"
"Your Majesty, the Church of Storms, and the Church of Evernight wish for you to give an explanation for the royal nobles colluding with the Demoness." Viscount Stratford braced himself and reported.
"Explanation? Hmph, Earl Lorena and his son colluded with the Demoness of Agony and were ultimately killed by the Demoness. That's an explanation!" George III grunted.
"In addition, I remember that regardless of whether it's the Church of Evernight or the Church of Storms, the councilors they support have recently been pushing forward the topic of choosing officials for the public examination... Tell them that in principle, I've agreed to it," George III added when he saw Viscount Stratford's troubled expression.
"Yes, Your Majesty." Viscount Stratford heaved a sigh of relief and replied.
After the viscount left, George III sat there without moving for a long time. After an unknown period of time, he suddenly laughed without any warning.
...
In an unfamiliar city that was shrouded in darkness, there were gorgeous buildings that gave off a mysterious and dark feeling.
In the middle of the church was a church. The church was more than eighty meters tall and was supported by huge black pillars. Each pillar was embedded with a certain number of skulls. Some of them came from humans, while others came from different creatures. However, all of them had their empty eyes pointed downwards as though they were watching every living being that entered the church.
Every detail of the cathedral could be said to be exquisite, but what constituted them were elements of nightmares, horror, and mystery.
In the depths of the cathedral hall stood a huge cross. A grayish-white dragon statue was wrapped around the cross.
Unlike ordinary churches, there were no rows of seats for believers to pray in, nor were there any places for candlesticks. There was only a small long table placed in front of the dragon statue. There were five seats on both sides of the long table. The top and bottom were empty.
At that moment, an old-school gentleman with some wrinkles on his forehead and an abnormally pale face walked in with a man wearing a mask with widened eyes and a wide mouth. He said to the other six people sitting on both sides of the long table,
"This is Mr. Wrath. He has deep attainments in the mind domain. He will be a new member of the council."

chapters.title: Chapter 154: After the Curtain
chapters.content:
Chapter 154 - After the Curtain
"From today onwards, Mr. Wrath will be in charge of the matters in the capital city of Lenburg, Esala."
The old gentleman briefly explained the situation of the newly joined Mr. Wrath. After the members of the council got to know each other, he looked at a man sitting to the left of the long table wearing a Pride mask and asked, "Mr. Pride, how's the handling of the Demoness of Afflictions in Backlund?"
"Although it's a little complicated, the Demoness has been successfully eliminated, Mr. President." Mr. Pride nodded with a smile. The two eyes on his mask grew on his forehead, giving him a natural feeling of superiority. His tone was the same.
"How was the exact process? Did you expose yourself to the Church's officials?" asked the old gentleman who was called president.
"Mr. President, you worry too much. Why would I personally participate in the game?" Mr. Pride shook his head with a smile. Then, he organized his words and said,
"That Demoness of Afflictions, Ray, who received the attention of the Primordial Moon, is a part of the big plan. She more or less knows of the goal of our Psychology Alchemists. Therefore, I've been guiding the official factions to eliminate her, so as to prevent her from going crazy and revealing some secrets, ruining our plan.
"In the beginning, I wanted the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom to eliminate her. This way, I can prevent the Demoness from having any contact with the three Churches of Loen, increasing the possibility of her leaking the secret.
"Through some friends, I learned that the ritual prepared by Demoness of Pleasure, Ray, for her advancement was likely a Harvest Sacrifice that believed in the Primordial Moon. This should be the influence the Primordial Moon had on her, so as to further corrupt and control her.
"Therefore, I designed a sheriff's wife to go to the Harvest Priest's house to request for medicine and pregnancy. And that sheriff has a good relationship with Detective Isengard, who was sent to Backlund by the Church of Knowledge.
"After the Harvest Sacrifice was used by Ray as an advancement ritual, and he lost control and became a monster, the sheriff, who couldn't obtain any follow-up drugs, went to Detective Isengard's office to issue a commission. However, it was somewhat different from what I guessed. The sheriff had entrusted his student, Detective Bryan, who was just a little famous at the time because Isengard was too busy with detective work.
"Some accidents began from here. I originally planned on letting Detective Bryan meet the Demoness of Afflictions, who had just advanced, during an investigation. He would then be killed, which would lead to the investigation of Isengard and even the Church of Knowledge. Therefore, I carefully arranged a car accident to hold back the Demoness, preventing her from going to the Harvest Priest's house early to obtain the Primordial Moon's item. I also missed Detective Bryan, who came to investigate."
However, to my surprise, Detective Bryan quickly found clues about the Primordial Moon and the item. Then, he left the Harvest Priest's house in advance and went straight to the Harvest Church...
When the president of the Psychology Alchemists heard this, he frowned and interrupted, "What's the reason for the accident? What's so special about this Detective Bryan?"
"I only found out later that this detective is a Blessed of Earth Mother, which is why he recognized the Primordial Moon's item," Mr. Pride replied.
"I see... That makes sense." Mr. President nodded and let Pride continue.
Mr. Pride looked at Madam Sloth and said elegantly, "Thanks to Madam Sloth's help, the Church of Earth Mother quickly reacted and sent an elite team of Forsaken Ones to Backlund to carry out the mission to eliminate the Demoness."
Wearing a mask that looked like the wearer was sleeping, Miss Sloth raised her head lazily and waved her hand. She casually said, "It's rare for you to ask, so I naturally have to give you face... However, about the matter, you promised me..."
"Don't worry, I won't break my promise." Mr. Pride raised his head arrogantly, indicating that he wasn't someone who went back on his word. Then, he continued,
"The Demoness named Lena fell out with Ray and escaped. I gave her a mystical item in the dream, allowing her to 'luckily' avoid Ray's pursuit, so as to reveal Ray's information and goal to the Forsaken One who arrived in Backlund.
"But something happened to Lena again. She actually encountered Prince Edessak, who happened to be out and received protection from the prince. This clearly doesn't match the organization's predetermined future, so I wanted her to be found by Ray after she finished sharing the information. I wanted to use her hand to get rid of Lena.
"Therefore, I arranged for Detective Bryan's fiancé, a classmate named Roman, to meet with Lena. Then, I got his other classmate, Susan, who was very close to him, to bring Roman to find Detective Bryan to issue a commission so that he could meet with Lena and obtain information.
This place was originally very smooth, but strangely, after the mystical item I gave Leena suddenly lost its effects, she wasn't found by Ray... This might be because Ray had been corrupted by the Primordial Moon back then, causing her to lose a lot of vigilance and gradually go crazy.
"I didn't interfere too much in Ray's later schemes. It was Ma'am Sloth who led the Forsaken Land and Detective Bryan into it.
"I only magnified the Pride in Captain Mandated Punishers and neglected some information. Finally, I made Backlund's Mandated Punishers lose a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact that's good at divination.
And Demoness Ray was also killed by Detective Bryan due to the bad luck brought about by the Sword of the Goddess...
"The Demoness of Pain, who caused a deviation in our predetermined future, was eliminated... It didn't cause the officials to investigate the royal family, nor did it expose the existence of the organization. After that, Leena should've left the prince because her father and brother were executed by the king.
"That's the general situation. As for the details, I'll provide a document later."
Having said this, Mr. Pride sat back in his seat, looking faintly pleased with himself, apparently very pleased with his "arrangement."
After some thought, the president nodded and said, "I've also been paying attention to the developments in Backlund. In the beginning, I noticed Detective Bryan's activity and thought that he was a chess piece arranged by some existence to destroy the will of the Lord... Now, from the looks of it, although he has some problems, he shouldn't be targeting us... After all, many of his actions were actually directed by you, Pride."
Upon hearing this, Mr. Wrath, who had just joined the council and hadn't said anything, curled his lips slightly. The mask that looked like it could roar at any moment had a hint of humor, but it quickly vanished without attracting anyone's attention.
"Mr. Pride, your mission has been completed very well. I'll give you the reward you deserve later..."
With that said, Mr. President, who was dressed like an old-school gentleman, surveyed the members of the council and continued,
"The second matter to be discussed today is that many of the villages in the Loen Kingdom's East Chester County have recently encountered many mysterious matters involving dreams. And the source of the matter is likely a mind dragon.
"I need someone to confirm if this is true."
Just as he said that several councilors looked over with interest. Only Ms. Sloth and Mr. Wrath remained indifferent.
The former still looked like she was sleeping, while the comical expression on the latter's mask seemed to flash past again.
...
In an unknown space, a plain quill wrote:
"The Psychology Alchemists' Pride Hvin Rambis was overly arrogant due to the influence of the Personality Mask, so he overlooked many details. He believed that the series of events regarding Demoness of Afflictions Ray had always been under his control... This is very reasonable."
At this point, the quill suddenly turned into a ferocious and furious dragon, but before it could do anything, it suddenly turned into bubbles and disappeared into the dust of history.
...
At two o'clock on Thursday afternoon, Ebner, who still didn't know he was going to be famous again, walked out of his room looking excited.
As Ray had been killed by him, Detective Isengard, who was happy that his old friend Inspector Wayne had gotten his revenge and was no longer threatened by the Demoness, temporarily lent him 2-081.
And just now, he had finally finished analyzing the Polymath potion formula.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Hero Detective
chapters.content:
Chapter 155 - Hero Detective
"Sequence 6: Polymath
"Main ingredients: 1 core of the Tree of Elders, 1 crystal of the Thousand Spell Phantom.
"Supplementary ingredients: 5 drops of Human-Faced Golden Phoenix Flower juice, 8 grams of Blue Foxtail Flower powder, 70 ml of spring water from Sonia Island's Golden Spring."
After the excitement, Ebner looked at the formula analyzed by the Eye of Pure White and fell into deep thought.
Thousand Art Phantom? What is this? There's actually nothing related to it in Teacher's library... Perhaps I should ask Cullen or Judy. They are on the train tomorrow morning, and I can send them off tonight.
"I know about the Human-Faced Golden Phoenix Flower. It's a rare plant that grows in the south. As a Biologist, Judy should have it in her hands. She should ask about it when she goes to the Harvest Church at night.
Blue foxtail flowers aren't difficult to find either. I've seen them at Darkwill's place...
Finally, the spring water from Sonia Island's Golden Spring can be considered a commonly used item in the mysterious world. Many high-grade wines will be brewed with it. As long as one is willing to spend money, they will definitely be able to obtain it.
"In that case, it seems that only the 'Thousand Phantom's Crystal' is more troublesome."
Thinking of this, Ebner gradually had a plan in his mind. He looked up at the clock in the hall and realized that it was already 2: 30 PM. He hurriedly put "2-081" back into his teacher's treasure vault and put it away. Then, he took the copy of "Feast of Blood" and hurried out.
He had already gotten someone to inform Xio in the morning to meet her in a single apartment in East Borough.
Not far from the detective agency, Ebner saw the son of the cafe owner, Mr. Bingley, walking arm in arm with a young lady toward the Claude Grand Theatre on Tarlton Street.
The lady had a beautiful face and an elegant temperament. Her black hair was smooth and elegant, and her light brown eyes seemed to contain many words.
Ebner was no stranger to her. After all, he had watched more than ten of her "films" in the background...
Had Mr. Bingley not taken any action after receiving the documents yesterday? It made sense. Forcefully breaking them up would often backfire, easily arousing the rebellious nature of young people. As someone who had been there before, Mr. Bingley should understand this very well.
The thought spun around in Ebner's mind before he put it out of his mind. Anyway, his commission was over. What did it have to do with a detective like him how his client was going to deal with the aftermath?
Shaking his head, he stopped a public carriage by the roadside and boarded it.
At this moment, Irene, who was chatting happily with Mr. Bingley, turned around and saw Ebner getting into the car from the corner of her eye.
"Evan, look! Isn't that Detective Bryan?" Irene's eyes lit up, and she pulled Mr. Bingley's hand.
Evan Bingley also turned around. He took a quick glance and nodded unhappily. "Yes, his office is nearby. I see him often. He even went to my cafe for lunch."
"Ah, I didn't expect you to know such a famous person! Can you bring me to visit him someday? I have a lot of classmates who are his admirers." Irene looked at Mr. Bengley expectantly.
"No problem. I know him very well!"
Hearing this, Irene happily stood on her tiptoes and kissed him. Then she continued, "Then, can you invite him to the ball that I'm preparing for this weekend? I have many friends who will come that day. If they know that I've invited the Hero Detective, they'll be so jealous."
Mr. Bingley's face stiffened. He was just bragging, and he wasn't confident that he would be able to invite anyone. However, he still forced himself to ask nonchalantly, "Hero Detective? Is he very famous? We live on the same street, so we don't feel anything... Haha."
"Of course he's very famous, and his stories about solving cases are all very legendary and dramatic." Irene nodded and looked around. Suddenly, she pointed at the latest magazine displayed in a newspaper stand by the road and said excitedly, "Look, Detective Hero has solved another big case."
Evan Bingley subconsciously looked over and was attracted by a striking headline:
"Sivellaus Yard's savior, Hero Detective Bryan, assassinated the main culprit."
...
Sitting in the carriage, Ebner closed his eyes to conserve his energy. He did not care about the passing passengers around him. As he stood there, he finally heard the word "Will Street".
This was one of the streets near East Borough. As they were afraid of being robbed, no carriage dared to enter East Borough. This was already the closest spot.
After alighting from the carriage and walking into the familiar Black Palm Street, he quickly arrived at his rented one-bedroom apartment.
And Xio was already waiting.
"It's not good to be late, Ebner," Xio said, taking out her pocket watch and looking at it.
"Sorry, I was too engrossed in my work and forgot the time," Ebner explained slightly before opening the door and entering with Xio.
"Are you busy today?" Ebner asked casually, seeing the other man's impatience.
"Is it that obvious? But you guessed right again. I don't know what's going on, but that golden-masked man gave another strange mission today, but the reward was very generous." Xio tidied her messy blonde hair and sat in the only chair in the room.
"What mission?" Ebner asked curiously.
"Let us investigate the authenticity of the horror stories circulating in the market... Besides, this is a long-term mission... I think they're looking for a mystical item." Xio didn't hide anything from Ebner. She still wanted to use his Detective powers to help her complete the mission.
"What kind of horror story?" Ebner's heart stirred as he suddenly recalled what Cullen had told him yesterday. The Church of Storms had a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact that broke through the seal.
"It's a horror story about some dead things suddenly coming alive and turning people into something or an animal," Xio repeated the words of the golden-masked man.
This description... Could it be that the Church of Storms had lost a cursed item?
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that he might have guessed correctly. Ebner said to Xio seriously, "It's best you don't investigate this mission in-depth. If you discover anything, report it immediately. Don't rashly pursue it... That's too dangerous."
Xio jumped in fright when she heard that. She knew very well that the "danger" mentioned by Ebner was truly deadly, so she nodded without any hesitation. Then, she asked curiously, "What is it? Is it something I can know?"
"I can only say that the Church of Storms might have lost a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact last night." Ebner thought for a moment and felt that it was best to let Xio realize how serious the matter was.
"Grade 1 Sealed Artifact..." Xio repeated before sighing. "It's no wonder MI9 gave such a good reward... Indeed, there's nothing so cheap in this world."
"What did they promise to reward you with?" Ebner asked.
"As long as there are concrete and believable clues, any one of the main ingredients of the Interrogator will be rewarded." Xio pursed her lips and continued regretfully, "I originally wanted to borrow the Solomon gold coin from you and try my luck."
"I think if you really used Solomon Gold Coin, then your greatest luck would be that you didn't find any clues..." Ebner grumbled before taking out the gold coin that was asymmetrical and lacked blood coverage on the portrait.
Xio took only a quick glance and fell silent. Then she fixed her eyes on Ebner and asked, "What did you do again?"
With that, she skillfully pierced her finger and covered the gold coin with a drop of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Farewell
chapters.content:
Chapter 156 - Farewell
After listening to Ebner recount his previous experiences, Xio said thoughtfully, "It's no wonder that there was lightning and thunder in the northwest yesterday. Fors even complained that the strange weather affected her thoughts on writing books..."
Although Hazel had been imprisoned in the Harvest Church, Xio and Fors had still moved to the vicinity of the North Borough's Tussock River. It wasn't too far from where the Mandated Punishers and Demonesses had fought yesterday.
"That was actually an excuse for her, wasn't it...?" Ebner laughed, shaking his head.
"It is, in fact, an excuse... But I believe she's attempting to hide the pain she felt during last night's Blood Moon..." Xio let out a sigh. Xio, who had long since become a Sheriff, could sense irregularities and discern any clear indicators, unlike before. As a result, despite Fors's best efforts, she was found.
"Is there truly no way to help Fors, Ebner? Despite the fact that she Although she always survives I've always been worried, "Xio inquired, worried and anticipatory.
Ebner only shook his head and remained silent. Soon, the Feast of Blood that I brought this time would be the only handwritten copy, he only thought to himself. After two weeks of preparation, I trust you have overcome your initial apprehension about this book... I'll come up with a means to show you the original copy with The Fool's honorific name and pique your attention in a few days... When you enter, Mr. Fool's line of sight, even if something really happens to Fors, she will have a backup plan to seek help.
Xio wasn't too disappointed when she saw Ebner's reaction. She guessed that he wasn't really out of ideas, but they were both too weak to use them now.
In the end, I'm still too weak. I have no right to know the truth about my father being wronged, nor do I have the ability to help Fors. I can't even keep up with Ebner...
With this in mind, Xio grabbed her messy and soft blonde hair and blurted out, "Ebner, do you know where to find the horn of a Striped Black Snake?"
The horn of a Glimmering Black Snake? I remember that it was one of the main ingredients of the Interrogator. Xio only asked about the horn of the Glimmering Black Snake, but she didn't ask about the other main ingredient, the Powder of the Spirit of the Lake... Did she already obtain it, or did she know about the relevant information?
Ebner thought so and asked.
Xio instead asked, "Do you remember that I borrowed Solomon Gold Coin from you for two days?"
"I remember." Ebner nodded.
"After using the gold coins, I was lucky to find the trail of a smuggler who had been wanted for a long time. I followed him all the way to his lair.
"In the end, not only did this merchant bring me a bounty of 300 pounds, I also found the Powder of the Spirit of the Lake in his lair. This was originally the advancement material he prepared for himself.
Xio suddenly thought of something as she continued with a pale face,
"The effect of the gold coin then blinded me. The next day, I tried it again, but the result was considerably worse... Finally, I learned that I had pushed my luck too far. I'll have to pay 10 thousand times the price to silence it without causing a backlash..."
As a result, Xio had made at least 800 to 900 pounds from that lucky streak... It wasn't a loss. She remembered that she was a lucky girl since she had met so many individuals who genuinely cared about her... Her personality and character were, of course, the most important considerations.
"I'll ask through other channels."
...
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
Audrey looked at Susie who had opened the door and entered. She lowered her voice and said,
"What are Dad and the rest discussing?"
When she realized that Earl Hall had invited many important figures from the political scene to her house in the afternoon with abnormally solemn expressions, she immediately sent Susie in to listen.
"They talked a lot. I have to think about what to say, Audrey," Susie said, closing the door behind her.
"Don't be nervous. Take it slow, Susie," Audrey said as gently as she could, afraid that her golden retriever would forget to say anything if she was nervous. She had experienced similar situations with some important figures before becoming a Beyonder... Of course, now that she thought about it, she was probably affected by the Beyonder powers of the Arbiter Sequence.
"Hmm... The first thing is that Earl Lorena's title has been stripped away by His Majesty. As for his assets, other than some that were previously nominally managed by the royal family, they were all given to the Church of Storms." Susie thought for a moment before opening her mouth and vibrating the air.
"Ah?" Audrey was stunned, suspecting that she had heard wrongly. She never expected that the information she had just given to Mr. Tower would have an outcome so quickly.
"What did they say about this matter?" Audrey pressed.
"A duke was feeling regretful. He said that the person who colluded with the Demoness was Earl Lorena's successor, and it had little to do with him... But the Church of Storms is too domineering. They insisted on His Majesty executing Earl Lorena," Susie repeated seriously.
So that's how it is... I wonder what role Mr. Tower played in this matter... Perhaps the entire matter was exposed due to his efforts... Could it be that Mr. Tower is very influential in the Church of Storms? Who could it be? Audrey muttered silently to herself before feeling excited. After all, she had provided the information previously, so she was more or less involved in this matter.
"What else did they say?" Audrey thought for a while before coming to her senses and asking again.
"The other thing is that His Majesty has agreed to the preliminary proposal for the Government Employees Unified Examination. The gentlemen of the two Houses have already begun discussing this topic. They wish to complete the review process before October so that this matter can be approved in both the House of Lords and the House of Commons." At this point, Susie raised her head and asked with an obviously puzzled expression, "Audrey, I don't quite understand what these words mean..."
Before Audrey could gloat over her previous efforts being answered, she was stunned by Susie's question. She thought for a while before answering, "Tomorrow, I'll find books related to the organization structure of the kingdom's government for you..."
"Alright." Susie wagged her tail happily.
...
At six o'clock in the evening, in a corner of a restaurant near Lunar Flower Street near the south side of the bridge.
Apart from Bishop Utravsky, who was praying in the cathedral with Hazel, the other three official members of the Church of Earth Mother were all present. Even Captain Asenov, who was afraid of scaring others, wasn't absent.
The white tablecloth was laid out quietly on the long table. The waiters brought plates of food over. They first cut the food before delivering it to each guest.
Ebner, who had rushed over after handing over his copy of the Feast of Blood, saw the steak drenched in black pepper sauce, the bacon, the sausage with mashed potatoes, the dairy egg soup, aloe vera, the specialty cheese, and the amber champagne.
Having not eaten lunch, he instantly felt his saliva seep out and his stomach started growling.
Glancing at the unsightly Sanguine Viscount Cullen, Ebner was the first to pick up the glass of red wine in front of him. He said with a smile,
"Cheers to our meeting and friendship!"
"Cheers!" Judy said happily as she raised her glass.
Cullen was the only one who ignored him. He even said in a strange tone, "Friendship? The gift you chose for my sister... I think our friendship is over."
"Don't be so calculative, Cullen. I think it's pretty good." Captain Arsenov smiled gently at this time, but his eyes glanced at the gift box that Ebner had brought over, which contained a rather exquisite doll. He could not help but smile, obviously knowing why Cullen's face was so dark.
This doll was originally an item that Ebner had planned on using to get to know Emlyn, but unfortunately, he didn't use it. And since he had been analyzing 2-081 the entire morning, he didn't have the time to buy any gifts. All he could do was bring it out.
"Captain... If it was a hundred years ago, it would be fine... But now, dolls are the laughing stock of the entire Blood Tribe..." Cullen said weakly.
"Then why don't you let me add some condiments to its hair? This way, it won't just be a doll, but a Sealed Artifact," Judy suggested in all seriousness, but her curved eyes betrayed her.
"...My sister doesn't have such a high resistance to poison... And I don't want anything strange to grow on her either!"

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Garden Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 157 - Garden Villa
In the end, it was Ebner who expressed that he had not found a suitable gift due to the short amount of time. He would definitely make up for it when he returned. Only then did he appease Cullen's resentment and the atmosphere at the table gradually became more lively.
After the plates on the table were empty, everyone returned to the Harvest Church.
Come to think of it, Captain Asenov was the biggest of them all, but he was a terrible drinker. He closed his eyes and fell asleep after just two bottles of champagne. It was only after Cullen gave him some hangover medicine that he regained consciousness.
Judy, on the other hand, looked young, but she was actually an old drunkard. She drank more than 50% of the wine that she had called over, and she was still in high spirits and did not seem reluctant at all.
Ebner went to the first row of chairs in the church and sat down. His gaze fell on Bishop Utravsky, who was praying earnestly in front of the altar.
Seeing Hazel return underground, he asked Cullen beside him, "Do you know what 'Thousand Phantom' is?"
"'Thousand Spell Phantom'? That's a type of giant dragon, or maybe it's a pseudo-dragon. It's good at many strange spells and can simulate abilities that I've seen before. It's much smaller than ordinary dragons, and it's between reality and illusion. That's why it's called 'Thousand Spell Phantom'... I saw it once when I was a Potion Professor at Lenburg University," Cullen answered after thinking for a moment.
A kind of... Lenburg of dragons? Could it be raised by the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom? That was what Ebner thought, but he asked, "Do you have a way to get the 'Thousand Phantom's Crystal'?"
Cullen shook his head and glanced at Ebner. He said playfully, "I've never seen this alternative dragon anywhere else... I'm guessing that it's the main ingredient of Sequence 6 or 5 of the Reader. That's why it's being reared by the Church of Knowledge."
This is just as I thought. It's no wonder that apart from the Church of Knowledge, even among the Mandated Punishers, Beyonders of the Reader pathway can only advance to Sequence 7 Knowledge Keeper... I wonder if "He" will give me one if I pray to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom...
Just as Ebner was letting his imagination run wild, Cullen said with a smile, "By the way, the Church of Storms gave us a garden villa in Cherwood Borough. It was originally an asset that belonged to Earl Lorena."
The Church of Storms is that generous? Ebner quickly did a mental calculation. An ordinary single house in Cherwood Borough cost at least a thousand pounds. If it was a garden house, it would be worth at least five thousand pounds.
"That's to repay us for arriving in time and saving Captain Kuhn." After explaining with a smile, Cullen organized his words and continued,
"I only received the news not long ago. The Mandated Punishers suffered heavy losses this time. Not only did they lose a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, but they also lost a Wind-blessed... Yes, after investigations, that Wind-blessed should've been a helper summoned by the Demoness and turned into a marionette."
"Marionettist?" Ebner blurted out a question. Back then, other than Klein, there was only one marionette master who had appeared in Backlund, and that was the Intis embassy's Rosago.
Could Rosago have done it?
Just as Ebner had some guesses, he heard Cullen continue, "That's right. The Church of Storms suspects that someone from the Secret Order has infiltrated Backlund, so they are jointly investigating with the Church of Evernight."
I remember that the Secret Order's lair is in Intis? Although Rosago is working for Intis's official organization, he's most likely a member of this organization. Yes, I can tell Klein about this in the next Tarot Club. It just so happens that Mr. Fool wants information on the Secret Order.
Seeing that Ebner was deep in thought, Cullen didn't disturb him. Only after the other party snapped back to his senses did he continue. "After we reported this matter to the Holy Cathedral, the reply we received was' deal with it on your own. 'Captain Arsenov felt that this property was given to the Mother by the Church of Storms, and it wasn't suitable to be auctioned for money, so he decided to temporarily keep it."
"Why are you telling me this?" Even though Ebner had some guesses, he still asked in surprise.
"Captain, Judy, and I will be leaving Backlund tomorrow. As for Bishop Utravsky, he still has to stay in the cathedral. He really doesn't have anyone to watch over that house, so I hope you can help..." Cullen answered with a deep meaning.
"You mean you want me to stay in temporarily to watch over him?" Ebner pointed at himself and said in surprise.
Is there such a good thing? No... the maintenance of such a house is quite expensive. In addition, I must hire servants to clean the house... Do I have to pay for it?
With that thought in mind, Ebner asked without hesitation.
Cullen laughed and said, "Hehe, you don't have to pay for it. That house is very big, and I've already found two tenants for you. They'll pay for those trivial matters."
"A tenant? Who is it?" Ebner asked warily.
"Don't worry, it's someone you know. No danger," Callum replied, leaning back in his chair.
Ebner eyed him suspiciously, then nodded in agreement when he saw that he didn't want to say more. At the same time, he decided to check out the house first. If there really was a problem, he would move out immediately.
After taking the house key from Cullen and asking for the specific address, Ebner was about to go to the room behind the church to look for Judy, hoping to exchange for some Human-Faced Golden Phoenix Flowers from her.
But before he reached the corridor, he heard Cullen behind him say again, "By the way, because you killed the Demoness, it can be considered as avenging Kuhn and that dead Wind Blessed. The Church of Storms also gave you a huge gift."
Ebner turned at that, looking interested. "What great gift?" he asked.
Cullen replied with a strange expression, "Soon—tomorrow morning, you will become the headline of all the major newspapers again! It's said that this is a reward that His Excellency, God of Songs, has personally selected for you. Yes, there are actually some newspapers controlled by the Church of Storms that have published additional articles today. It's just that they don't have enough influence. The matter hasn't spread yet."
"Thank you so much!" Ebner's face fell.
He didn't object to becoming famous, but to avoid Beyonder elements, every time he became famous, he would fabricate all sorts of so-called "reasoning shows". That was too embarrassing... Especially when the "reasoning process" made up by various newspapers was different!
With a heart full of "grief and indignation," Ebner found Judy, who had taken all her strength to help the captain to bed, and made her own request.
And Judy did not let him down. Without saying anything, she found a small bottle of the juice of the Human-Faced Golden Phoenix Flower, dripped five drops into the sealed container, and handed it to him.
Ebner had planned on paying. Although it was only five drops, the Golden Phoenix Flower was a rare flower, so its value wasn't low. It would cost at least 100 pounds on the market.
But Judy waved her hand and didn't ask for her money. Instead, she hoped he would help her collect some strange plants in the future. It was a long-term commission.
...
Backlund North Borough, in a room under Saint Samuel Cathedral.
Daly, who had applied blue eye shadow and blush again, gave a bewitching and cold beauty as she handed the report she had written to Crestet Cesimir on the other side of the table. She said, "That Detective Bryan and I don't know much. We just happened to kill the Demoness."
Cesimir glanced at the ring on Daly's hand before turning his gaze away. He calmly asked, "Do you know where Detective Bryan obtained the badge that can ignite desire?"
Daly shook her head and replied, "How would I know? After all, I only spent five minutes in the carriage with him..."
At this point, she saw that Cesimir's expression was still solemn. She couldn't help but ask, "It's just a mystical item. Even if it's somewhat evil, why do you care so much?"
"Because the fifth case... there have been five cases of suspected demon murders."

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Parting
chapters.content:
Chapter 158 - Parting
At noon on Friday, Ebner arrived at the steam station before lunch to see off the Forsaken.
Speaking of which, he had returned to Detective Isengard last night. After telling his teacher the complete formula of a Polymath, he had asked him for information regarding the Thousand Phantom.
Unfortunately, although Detective Isengard had some confidence in obtaining the Crystal of Thousand Spells, he had to wait until he returned to Lenburg at the end of the year to report his work...
After that, Ebner held a ritual and prayed to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, but unfortunately, there was no response.
Looks like the God of Knowledge won't give me any direct help...
Since he was already mentally prepared, and the old dragon had to find a "tool" for information, Ebner wasn't too disappointed.
...
On the platform of the steam locomotive, an old man wearing a black suit and a half top hat walked out of the second-class carriage with a leather suitcase in his hand.
He didn't look too old. There were only some wrinkles at the corners of his eyes, but his temples were completely white.
His name was Lawrence Nord, and he was a public school teacher from Constant City, Midseashire.
As soon as Lawrence got out of the car, he casually glanced at the platform and saw a tall figure over two meters tall standing not far away. There were also several young people surrounding him.
He recognized one of the black-haired, red-eyed youths.
"Viscount Cullen..." Lawrence muttered to himself. If it weren't for this vampire viscount passing by and providing assistance during the disaster many years ago, not many in his family would have survived.
As for Lawrence, he didn't want to be surrounded by negative emotions like depression, despair, and other emotions in his family. He didn't want to face the sighing and oppressive atmosphere every day, so he found a reason to leave the Elders Guild and come to Backlund to find his other brother, Lauber, and his half-brother, Sam.
He never expected to encounter a benefactor of his family the moment he arrived in Backlund.
He wanted to go over and chat, but he saw Viscount Cullen and another beautiful girl following behind the half-giant and boarding the steam locomotive on the other side of the platform.
Only a young man with curly brown hair and copper-framed glasses remained on the platform, waving goodbye to them.
"Forget it... Maybe the viscount forgot about that small matter... At least it's a small matter for him." Lawrence mocked himself and left the station with his luggage.
...
On the steam locomotive, Captain Asenov was still as taciturn as ever. Judy was cheerful, only a little reluctant when she had said goodbye to Ebner earlier. She had long since recovered and was smiling again.
As for Viscount Cullen, in his long life, he had already gotten used to such scenes of parting.
"I think someone was watching you from the station just now?" Judy suddenly said to Callum, who was sitting across from her.
Obviously, Lawrence thought that his hidden gaze couldn't fool this "biologist."
Cullen nodded and said indifferently, "I once saved him in passing... Speaking of which, the 'drawing book' that your father gave you is related to his family."
Judy nodded thoughtfully at that. After a while, she said, "He's dying... at most three months of his life."
"I know, that's why I didn't go over... Sigh, I might as well not see him." Cullen sighed.
...
Tingen City.
After lunch, Klein put on his hat and left the Blackthorn Security Company, arriving at the Shooting Club at 3 Zouteland Street.
After pushing open the door and entering the reception hall, he didn't directly head to the shooting range belonging to the Nighthawks. Instead, he found a seat in the hall and waited patiently with his black cane in hand.
He had agreed to meet Daxter at this Zouteland Street Shooting Club!
Daxter was an informant he had developed, one of the members of the Psychology Alchemists. He was just a standard rookie. After all, his guide had gone mad.
After waiting for a while, Klein saw Daxter walk into the hall of the Shooting Club when it was two minutes to one.
He was wearing a black silk top hat and a fitted tuxedo. In his hand was a silver-inlaid cane, and on his face was a pair of gold-framed glasses.
Daxter looked around without attracting any attention. When he saw Klein nod slightly, he retracted his gaze and walked to the front desk. He applied for a shooting range and rented a gun.
After the two of them entered the same shooting range, Daxter asked in a deep voice, "Officer Moretti, why did you meet me this time?"
"I just wanted to ask if you need the Telepathist formula," Klein said frankly. He didn't hide his thoughts. After all, he was facing a Spectator, and it wasn't easy to fool him.
Ever since he obtained this formula from the "Tower" at the Tarot Club, Klein had the intention of selling it to Daxter. After all, after this period of observation, this gentleman's character wasn't bad. Furthermore, he had the backing of the Psychology Alchemists. Even if he was just a peripheral member, it was only a matter of time before he obtained this formula. If he didn't sell it now, he might not have another chance in the future.
