In addition, with this meeting with Daxter, he no longer needed to hide the potion formula. He could find a sufficient excuse to hand it over to the Captain so that he could accumulate more merit points. Yes, he might even get additional reimbursements.
It's really worth it to make two deals with a free formula... Klein thought happily.
Daxter stared into his eyes for a moment before asking, "What do you want from me?"
Of course, it's gold pounds! Klein nearly blurted it out, but after careful thought, he felt that it wasn't subtle enough. Furthermore, he had to consider the other party's wealth. Therefore, he hesitated for a moment before saying in deliberation, "I need you to observe Hood Eugen's situation closely and report to me at any time... Of course, I won't give you the formula for nothing. You have to pay 100 gold pounds in exchange... This is already very cheap."
"Officer, your words aren't sincere enough, but the price is partly true," Daxter suddenly said calmly.
...
Looking at the steam locomotive leaving into the distance, he could still hear Judy's promise to come to Feynapotter and treat him to Sylvia's crispy pie, as well as Viscount Cullen's reminder to send him the new gift as soon as possible. Ebner sighed in disappointment.
Although he'd only spent two weeks with Judy and Cullen, he'd already formed a friendship with them. Now that they were parting ways, it was hard not to feel bad for Ebner, who still wasn't used to it.
Shaking his head to get rid of these thoughts, Ebner decided to visit the garden villa that he was in charge of. If there were no problems, he would move in as soon as possible.
Ever since the various mainstream newspapers had been promoting him, the savior of Sivellaus Yard, this morning, his teacher's house was once again surrounded by reporters. Even his normal commissioning business was affected. If not for his Clown Mask, he might not have been able to come out to send off the Forsaken Ones.
Even if it was to get some peace, he had to move as soon as possible.
...
Cherwood Borough, 28 Kings Street.
It was a three-story building with a small garden. The layout was not big, but the interior was exquisitely decorated. It was obvious that his previous owner had good taste.
Ebner walked over and took off the clown mask before opening the door with a key.
Then, he saw a man and a woman walk out of the living room.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: The Skades
chapters.content:
Chapter 159 - The Skades
Upon seeing these two people, Ebner was clearly stunned. He blurted out, "Mr. and Mrs. Skade, why are you here?"
They were the people involved in the murder that Ebner had encountered when he was reincarnated in Backlund from East Chester County. The Solomon gold coin was found on their dead son.
To be honest, ever since Cullen told him that the so-called "tenants" were people he knew, he had guessed Sharron and Maric, Lena and Talim, Xio and Fors, and even Roman and Susan... But he never expected it to be these two.
Ebner remembered that this Mr. Skade was the manager of a sea trade company. He had saved a mysterious old man on his way back from the Rorsted Archipelago. Later, under the guidance of this old man, he found a small island with hidden treasures. The shareholders on the ship did not heed the advice of the old man before he left. They led Mr. Skade and the others to open a door and saw the murals inside...
After that, all of them started to be plagued by bad luck. Many of their children even suffered from all kinds of illnesses.
And the Solomon gold coin that had repeatedly helped him was also from that small island.
Mr. Skade, who was wearing a white shirt with a black vest on the outside and had neatly combed hair, first bowed to Ebner before respectfully saying, "Detective Bryan, we are now servants of the Church of Earth Mother. Mr. Cullen arranged for us to work in this villa... He instructed us to serve you."
"Wait... I remember that you're believers of the Church of Steam, right?" Ebner interrupted. He remembered very well why he, a believer of steam, had to do sea trade.
"Yes. Back then, you even suggested that we pray at Saint Hierländ Church the moment we arrived in Backlund and tell the priest about our previous encounter..."
At this point, Mr. Scard's expression became obviously complicated. He sighed and continued, "Unfortunately, the Church of Steam didn't take it seriously. Harriet and I were still plagued by bad luck. We were even caught by the gangs and almost sold to slave traders..."
"The gang you're talking about, could it be..." Ebner suddenly had a guess. He felt that the Church of Steam, or rather, the Machinery Hivemind, might have taken it seriously, but the two ordinary people did not know.
"Yes, it's Winston's Labor and Services Company, as well as the Black Skeleton Gang behind it! Here, I would like to sincerely thank you, Detective Bryan. If you hadn't infiltrated the company and cracked this case, I don't know what tragic fate Harriet and I would've met... Unfortunately, we were all unconscious at the time, and we didn't see your heroic fighting prowess with so many villains."
A look of gratitude came into Mr. Skade's eyes. Mrs. Skade, beside him, curtsied again and thanked Ebner for his rescue.
Ebner's mouth twitched. 'What the hell does he have to be so 'heroic' about? He was clearly 'hanging out' with Judy outside that company the whole time... Judy was the only one who made a move.'
To hide his embarrassment, Ebner took a deep breath and changed the topic. "Then how did you become servants of the Church of Earth? And why are you here?"
"Detective Bryan, it's like this. After we were rescued by you, we lost all our belongings and had no choice but to wander around East Borough while looking for a job... However, my luck was still very bad. I never found a job that suited me... But on the night of last weekend, just as we were walking numbly on the streets of East Borough and were about to collapse, we were finally blessed by fate and met Mr. Cullen and Miss Judy."
With that said, Mr. Skade piously drew the Earth Mother's simple Sacred Emblem on his chest and chanted in a low voice,
"Thank you, the source of life!"
"Praise you, Mother of All Things!"
...
Bishop Utravsky's ability is very strong... Ebner was very sure that Cullen and Judy did not have this infectious ability. They must have brought the Skades back to the Harvest Church.
However, they were really lucky to have met Judy and Cullen who were investigating at night...
While Ebner was lost in his thoughts, he heard Mr. Skade continue, "The Earth Mother redeemed Harriet and me, so I decided to become the Earth Mother servant and spread her loving kindness to everyone who needed it.
"Previously, Harriet and I had been helping Mr. Cullen to gather some information. We were only arranged to be here yesterday. As a valet and maid, we helped you manage this villa."
"I see..." Ebner nodded. After pondering for a moment, he asked a practical question. "Who will pay for your salaries and the daily expenses of the villa?" It can't be me, right? I thought Cullen had found two sugar daddies, but who knew that it would be two poor people...
"It will be reimbursed by the Church... Of course, the monthly budget, settlement, and settlement bills will only be handed over to Bishop Utravsky after you sign the agreement." As he spoke, Mr. Skade took a receipt with various expenses and handed it to Ebner. After all, he was a manager of a sea trade company and was quite capable in his business.
Ebner gave it a cursory glance before putting it aside. As long as he didn't have to pay, it would be fine. As for the Skades, would they take the opportunity to earn some extra money? He felt that he didn't have to worry about it at all. When the time came, he could just use the Ring of Light's "notary" ability to draw up a contract.
Next, Ebner asked Skade about the specifics of the garden villa. He learned that since many of the furniture and necessary items had been moved or destroyed before the handover, some repairs and purchases were still needed. They could not be checked in immediately. At the current rate, they would have to be ready by Monday or Tuesday at least.
Yes, after I move in next week, I'll hold a banquet at my new residence and invite all my friends over... I can design it so that Xio can find the tampered Feast of Blood.
...
In an old apartment on the south side of the bridge, Witch Lena was reading today's newspaper. The focus of her attention was undoubtedly the headlines of the "Hero Detective Capturing the Prince" assassination.
"Heh heh, this is too much. The murderer is a burly man over 1.8 meters tall. The hero detective relied on his intelligence to deal with him and finally defeated him with the environment... Tsk tsk, I wonder what Ray would think if he were still alive and read this newspaper?" Lena said happily as she read.
Sitting opposite her was former constable Shoko. He looked at the smiling Demoness and asked worriedly, "Are you really alright? Earl Lorena has already been executed, right... Why are you still smiling?"
"Witch" Lena glanced at him and said nonchalantly, "I told him before that the suffering I suffered in the Demoness Sect was equivalent to repaying his kindness... We don't owe each other anymore."
"Then why are you acting so sad and angry at Prince Edessak? As if you want to break up with him?" Shoko asked, puzzled.
Upon hearing Edessak's name, Lena's expression softened. She sighed and said, "My existence will only bring him endless trouble... Taking the opportunity to stay away from him is for his own good... After all, he's my only friend."
"Aren't I your friend too?" Shoko retorted unhappily.
"You? You can only be my future sister!" Leena looked at him with a faint smile. Then, before he could react, she changed the topic. "You've been frequently acting as a vigilante recently, assassinating many gang leaders. It's time to stop. I heard that they've already found Beyonders to ambush you."
"But what about the role of an Assassin?" Shoko wasn't aware that she had changed the topic and only raised her doubts.
"Assassins are particular about scheming before making a move. They kill in one strike! Assassins like you who interfere when they encounter injustice can only be considered lucky that you haven't died until now." Lena sighed. She looked at the present Shoko as though she was looking at her past self. She was so naive.
Despite knowing that Sequence 7 would become a Witch, he still chose this Beyonder path, all for the sake of becoming stronger and ruling his own fate.
With this in mind, she glanced at the newspaper beside her. With a thought, she smiled at Shoko and said, "The Demoness of Afflictions, Ray, should have been killed by this hero detective. Since you were taken care of by Inspector Wayne, now that he has avenged himself, shouldn't you go and thank this detective?"
Shoko was stunned for a moment before nodding in agreement, "That's right, we need to pay them a visit."
"Then when you get there, give him this 'necklace' as a thank-you gift," Lina said, pulling a box out of the drawer beside her and handing it to Shoko.
Shoko subconsciously took it and opened it. Her eyes instantly widened as she said, "Isn't this the necklace I gave you? This is an extraordinary item... You actually gave it away?"
The corners of Lena's mouth curled up slightly, but she didn't reply. She only thought to herself, No matter who's scheming behind the scenes, I can't keep this necklace. Otherwise, I'm afraid I'll fall deeper into the trap. Even if it helped me in the past... And since that Hero Detective is able to receive credit every time, it's obvious that his background isn't shallow. I should let him or the existence behind him give me a headache.
...
In the blink of an eye, it was Sunday. After two days of headlines, the popularity of Ebner's "hero" had finally dropped. Only then did he have an opening. He wore the "clown mask" and went out.
He first went to the garden villa in Cherwood Borough to check on the restoration progress before walking to the Folk Herb Store near the Tussock River.
Darkwill's chubby face quickly entered his vision.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Old Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 160 - Old Friend
In front of the streetfront house with the signboard "Folk Herb Store" hanging on it, the moment Ebner entered the outer room of the shop, he saw a man jogging out from inside. The moment he saw someone, he immediately lowered his head and quickened his pace.
Don't worry, we won't guess what potion you bought... Speaking of which, can't Darkwill do some serious business? After lampooning inwardly, Ebner swept his gaze and was suddenly stunned. Apart from Darkwill, who had a round face and a chubby body, there was actually someone he knew in the store.
It was the friend he hadn't seen in a long time, one of the members of the Hunter Squad that Anderson was preparing to form, the son of Sergeant Faxin, Aetris.
At this moment, Darkwill was promoting his best potion to the livid Aetris.
"This is a potion that will make you more outstanding in that aspect. It's the kind that adds mummy powder. Do you need it? I guarantee you will be satisfied.
"I know. You may be very strong, but as a man, you always chase after the strong."
Aetris took a few deep breaths to calm himself down, but he couldn't help but say in an unpleasant tone, "Leave your potion for yourself, although I don't think someone like you can use it." With that said, he deliberately sized up Darkwill's stomach and face.
Darkwill wasn't angry. He chuckled and said wretchedly, "It might not be useful elsewhere, but this is Backlund. There are many street girls. They appear outside the concert halls and the theater and wait in the streets and alleys. Some of them are professionals, while others are part-time maidservants. They have different styles. It's said that in certain places in the West Borough, there will occasionally be bankrupt noble ladies. It's very desirable..."
After that, he looked at Aetris provocatively and pretended to be regretful. "You haven't experienced it yet, have you? Tsk tsk, so you're a virgin. What a pity."
Aetris's head was pounding. he resisted the urge to hit him and said, "I don't have time to argue with you. I have something to ask you, Apothecary! What drug did you make for Sergeant Faxin?"
"Do you think I'm someone who enjoys helping others?" The chubby Apothecary looked at him strangely and asked.
"Of course not!" replied Aetris without any hesitation.
"Then it's settled. Why should I tell you? That's my client's privacy!" Darkwill spread his hands and said innocently.
"But you just took my money..." Aetris retorted.
"Didn't you spend money to buy medicine? The moment you came in, I could tell that your blood was surging, your desires were fluctuating, and your body was very empty... Young people need to be restrained," Darkwill said with an ambiguous smile.
Aetris widened his eyes as if she could not believe that such a shameless person existed. he was indeed weak, but it was not because of what he had done, but because he had been injured before.
Seeing that the two of them were flaming each other and completely ignoring him, Ebner could only deliberately cough to attract their attention. At the same time, he complained in his heart: The provocation level of this future "provocator" is actually inferior to the Apothecary's... Indeed, Darkwill should definitely change his approach.
Upon hearing the cough, Darkwill immediately looked at the door and said in an exaggerated tone, "Look who's here? Backlund's Hero Detective actually came to my shop. If I were to take a picture and hang it at the door, would my business flourish?"
Ebner shot him a glance when he heard that and said calmly, "It looks like you still want to remain silent for a few more weeks?" His relationship with the Church of Earth Mother was recorded in all the major factions in Backlund. He wasn't afraid of others knowing that he had a good relationship with the Forsaken Land.
Upon hearing this, Darkwill immediately swallowed the words he was about to blurt out. He carefully craned his head to look out before heaving a sigh of relief and asking, "You recognize that brown-haired girl? She didn't follow you, right? The poison that the girl inflicted was simply terrifying. I don't know how much effort it took for me to finally treat myself the day before yesterday..."
To be honest, this was a little beyond Judy's expectations. She'd thought you'd be able to concoct the antidote in three or four days at most... Was that too much of a noob?
That was what Ebner thought, but he didn't answer Darkwill's question. He just smiled at him meaningfully, then turned to Aetris. "It's been a long time."
"It's only a month. How can it be considered long?" replied Aetris, who had wanted to talk to him for a long time.
She felt that her adventures out in the sea had been fruitless, while Ebner's return to the metropolis had caused his reputation to rise in a short period of time. Therefore, he felt somewhat awkward, inferior, and unnatural.
I say, will people like you die if you don't argue? Ebner lampooned. Then he said to his friend who had always been "awkward", "I was the one who introduced Sergeant Faxin to Darkwill. You don't have to worry too much. Well, if you want to know anything, you can ask me."
Ebner could roughly guess why the other party had come here. Furthermore, the act of consulting him was essentially a "commission". It could be considered a "acting", so how could he let it go?
Upon hearing Ebner's words, Aetris heaved a sigh of relief. he trusted the character of this Hero Detective, and he felt that he wouldn't deliberately harm his parents... Although this Apothecary had a foul mouth.
Ebner saw through her thoughts and shook his head with a smile. Then, he pointed at the chubby Apothecary beside him and said, "Although Darkwill's words are asking for a beating, he's not a bad person. Although the potions recommended to you have the effect of enhancing that aspect, the main effect is still healing."
"You can tell that I'm injured?" said Aetris in surprise.
"How obvious..." Darkwill curled his lips before looking at Ebner. He asked suspiciously, "You actually know the specific effects of my potion? I remember you being a detective..."
Not to mention that he could directly "analyze" it, but he could roughly determine its use from the abilities of "physicians" and "Harvest Sacrifice" that he had learned from Judy.
Even though he was thinking, Ebner didn't explain further. He only smiled and replied, "I have a friend who's a 'biologist'."
"So you should take care of your woman and make her release less poison..." Darkwill muttered softly before pushing the bottles of potions in front of Aetris. He said, "They're enough to heal your injuries! This is equivalent to the money you just paid. If you don't believe me, you can ask our Backlund hero."
Aetris subconsciously took the potion and came back to his senses. Seeing that Ebner nodded gently, he hesitated for a moment before putting it away.
Although his original intention was only to ask his father why he bought the potion produced by a Beyonder for his mother, since Ebner knew, spending money to make himself recover faster didn't seem like a bad idea.
Seeing that the "weak" youth approved of this transaction, Darkwill turned to look at Ebner and asked, "What are you doing here today?"
He could tell that although the two people in front of him knew each other, it was just a chance encounter.
"I want some 'blue fox-tailed flower powder.'" Ebner reported the supplementary ingredients required by the 'learned man'.
"How much do you want?"
"8 grams will do."
"Alright, wait a moment." With that said, Darkwill turned and entered the inner room.
"Aetris..."
Seeing that the Apothecary seemed to need some time to prepare, Ebner prepared to chat with Aetris. However, before he could finish, he interrupted him.
"Call me Kyle. Don't call me by my old name until I have some strength."
Was he afraid that something he was doing would implicate his parents and family? Ebner nodded thoughtfully and casually asked, "Kyle? Is that the name of your former companion?"
"I didn't expect you to remember... I said before that Kehr and the others entrusted those naive dreams to me before they died... Since I inherited the dreams, I naturally have to use their names to fulfill them." Although he was a little surprised, she still answered.
Just as they chatted, Darkwill walked out with a small bottle sealed by spirituality. He placed it in front of Ebner and said, "Eight grams of Blue Fox Tail Flower Powder. Counting the bottle, I'll be indebted to you for ten pounds."
According to what Ebner knew, the market price of the blue fox-tailed flower powder should be around one pound and ten soli. It was slightly fluctuating, and the chubby Apothecary's price was quite fair. Therefore, he didn't bargain and happily took out a ten-pound note and handed it over.
After obtaining the supplementary ingredients he needed, Ebner decided not to communicate with Darkwill anymore. Otherwise, even with Judy's deterrence, Darkwill would most likely sell those strange potions.
Besides, it was obvious that she wanted to know about her family as soon as possible, so Ebner quickly excused himself from the apothecary. Then he joined Aetris... no, "Kyle" in the café on the next street.
After spending two soli ordering the shop's specialty ice cream coffee, Ebner told "Kyle" about Officer Faxin's previous encounter.
Of course, when it came to Demonesses, the Forsaken Ones and the Primordial Moon were eliminated by him. He only said that Dr. Leonardo that the Faxin couple had found was a Harvest Priest who suspected to believe in an evil god...
"The old man actually went to seek help from Beyonder powers for his child? Is he that eager?" 'Kyle' said, dumbfounded.
"It's a little strange... By right, the sheriff shouldn't be so blind..." Ebner felt that it was a little abrupt now that he thought about it. However, people had different thoughts, so he didn't pay too much attention to it. He only asked, "Don't you know? I remember that Sergeant Faxin asked someone to bring a message to Enmat Harbor?"
"I've spent most of the past month undergoing Mr. Anderson's bizarre training. I didn't have the time to contact my relatives at Enmat Harbor, so I missed them." "Kyle" couldn't help but ask, "How... are they now?"
"The last time we met was not bad. Darkwill's potion was also very effective. The child in Mrs. Faxin's stomach has already stabilized... However, ever since I was labeled as the 'savior of Sivellaus Yard' by the various newspapers, my relationship with the police system has become a little complicated... I might be the person they least welcome now!"
Ebner gave a self-deprecating laugh, but what he was thinking was: Because of this "fame", the benefits of obtaining information and using the shooting range for free would be gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Diary
chapters.content:
Chapter 161 - Diary
Aetris—or "Kyle"—was envious of
Ebner's
fame, but he was a man of some heart. He adjusted quickly and sighed. "Aye, as long as they're all right, that's good..."
"Since you've returned to Backlund, don't you plan on visiting them?" Ebner asked.
"I came back this time to finish a task," Kyle responded, shaking his head. "There will undoubtedly be some twists and turns once my father sees it. And I don't want my mother's emotions to be too unstable during her pregnancy..."
"Mission... Is this the mission Anderson assigned to you?" Ebner asked, frowning.
Kyle paused for a time before softly responding, "It's to finish a 'hunt'!" Fearing that Ebner would misinterpret, he continued, "Don't be concerned. The potential target is a real jerk. He's been convicted of a slew of maritime offences. He arrived in Backlund only after clearing his name and assuming a new identity... In Bayam, he has a bounty of up to 1,000 pounds."
A bounty of 1,000 pounds. Although it can't be compared to the officers on the pirate admirals' ships, their strength shouldn't be weak either... I'm afraid that the wound on Beatrice was left behind after fighting them.
Even though he thought so, Ebner did not intend to ask further. He only nodded and said, "Be careful."
After that, they talked about their respective experiences since leaving Enmat Harbor. Then Ebner looked at the time and realized it was almost noon. He said goodbye and left the cafe.
"Kyle" seemed to be waiting for someone and didn't leave immediately.
Ebner didn't care. He bought Desi pies again in a nearby store, then ate them as he mounted the steam metro and hurried to the south side of the Bridge.
He needed to submit his budget to Bishop Utravsky.
In addition, ever since he learned that the bishop had some collections of Roselle's diary dungeons, Ebner had made plans.
Since he already had one, there was no need for him to come up with another one.
Even though it was the weekend, the Harvest Church was as deserted as usual.
Ebner pushed open the door of the cathedral and was surprised to see Madam Daly, who had blue eyeshadow and blush on her cheeks, walking out. Beside her was a beautiful lady in her twenties, dressed in a lusterless black funeral uniform.
And this lady, Ebner, also recognized her. She was
Chelly
, whom he and
Xio
had saved in the dream of the
Dream Labyrinth Tower
. She had even stopped Xio at the steam locomotive station in Enmat Harbor.
Chelly became a Nighthawk?
Ebner was surprised, but he made way for her on the surface. He smiled and greeted her. "It's good to see you here, Madam Daly."
He wasn't surprised that Daly had appeared in the Harvest Church. After all, at Member of Parliament Macht's family's banquet, she had likely negotiated with Bishop Utravsky on the condition of channeling
Hazel
.
Daly took a few steps forward, looked up at Ebner, and smiled. "We meet again, Detective Bryan."
As she spoke, she pointed at the girl in black mourning clothes beside her and introduced, "This is
Chelly
, my assistant. Hehe, she really admires you, Detective Bryan."
"It would be my pleasure, Madam Chelly," Ebner greeted as if seeing Chelly for the first time.
Daly looked back at the half-giant bishop, who sat at the front, praying piously. Then she turned back to Ebner. "We've got things to do. We've got to go."
"If you please, ma'am." Ebner nodded and watched as Daly pulled the hood of her psychic black robe over her head and stepped out of the church.
"I'm looking forward to meeting you again, Detective Bryan." After Chelly bowed with her dress behind her, she wore a conflicted expression. It was obvious that she wanted to ask something more, but she forcefully held back. She caught up to Madam Daly and left the Harvest Church.
At this moment, Bishop Utravsky, who was dressed in a brown priest robe and a clergyman's bonnet, looked like a mountain. When he saw Ebner coming over, he stopped praying and smiled at him. "Child, you're here."
"I brought the budget to repair the house." Ebner walked forward and handed the receipt that Skade and his wife had given him to the half-giant bishop. Then, he casually glanced at the podium and indeed saw the paper with Roselle's text written in graceful handwriting.
This naturally came from
Miss Hazel
. Ever since she was imprisoned in the Harvest Church, she had nothing better to do. She liked to copy the Roselle manuscripts in Bishop Utravsky's collection.
Ebner pretended to be curious as he picked it up to take a look. Then, he realized that it was three diary entries written by
Roselle
at different times.
"On the first day of June, Florent once again extended an olive branch to me. His meaning was very obvious. He wanted me to become his subordinate. However, I still pretended to be stupid and fooled him. Heh heh, even if I want to feign civility with him, I can't agree so readily. Otherwise, how can I raise my price?
However, the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Sauron family that Floren mentioned today is very interesting. Not only is it alive, it suddenly came to life without any signs. This reminds me of the Hidden Sage. Is' He 'in a similar situation?
Floren had appeared in the original diary. I remember that he was a member of the Sauron family who was very compatible with a high-level Beyonder characteristic. After fusing with the characteristic, even his personality changed, making the emperor suspect if he had changed into another person...
Such a future upper echelon shouldn't be spouting nonsense. This Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Sauron family might really be problematic... However, from the contents of the diary, the Emperor and Floren should still be middle to low-level Beyonders. How could they have the opportunity to come into contact with information regarding a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact?
Unless someone deliberately revealed it... Or perhaps, it was the living Sealed Artifact's doing!"
Ebner looked at the journal, habitually analyzing and deducing.
However, even if there is a problem, it should be something that the emperor should be worried about a hundred years ago. It has nothing to do with me...
When Ebner came back to his senses, he mocked himself for worrying for nothing. He looked at the diary on the next page.
"15th January. A Witch of Calamity sent herself to the door. I wonder if I should give it a try? Sigh, Huang Tao, oh Huang Tao, why would you have such thoughts? Are you really not afraid of meat and vegetables anymore?"
Upon seeing this, Ebner instinctively glanced in the direction of the underground prison. If
Miss Hazel
knew what he was copying, he would like to ask her how she felt...
Furthermore, if he did not remember wrongly, the original line
"The taste of a Demoness is not bad"
came from the
"16th January"
diary... He did not know if it was from the same year.
Retracting his slightly strange gaze, Ebner turned another page.
"6th August. I met a vampire today. He called himself Cullen and said that he was willing to help me overthrow the rule of the Sauron family in his name..."

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Joint Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 162 - Joint Investigation
"The Blood Clan wants to invest in me too? Just like how they invested in the Night Emperor in the Fourth Epoch? But this amount of investment is too small. Why should they support the Night Emperor and support a beautiful queen, while I only have a rough man!"
When Ebner saw this, his lips curved again as he thought, Viscount Cullen, do you know that the Emperor despises you?
Bishop Utravsky had already put down the receipt and said with a smile, "You can tell Skade that the expenditure within this budget can be directly recorded in the Harvest Church's account."
Ebner returned to his senses and placed the diary pages back on the platform before replying, "I'll pass it on."
With that said, he looked at the manuscripts and asked the bishop, "Miss Hazel should've confirmed that there's no corruption from the Primordial Moon, right? Why is she still imprisoned?"
After the banquet ended that day, Macht secretly gave him 100 pounds as a thank-you gift for successfully introducing him to the bishop. Out of respect for the money, he helped Hazel ask.
"This isn't a good time... If we directly release Miss Hazel, the Church of Storms probably won't agree..." Bishop Utravsky shook his head and gently explained.
That's right... The Church of the Lord of Storms had suffered a huge loss previously, and it was the time for them to be unhappy. If they saw Hazel being released so easily, they would probably cause trouble.
Ebner immediately came to a realization. It was no wonder Member of Parliament Macht didn't request the bishop to let Hazel go home. As a politician, he must have seen this...
Since that was the case, Ebner did not say anything else. He left after conversing with the half-giant bishop for a while.
However, when he left the Harvest Church, he only walked out of an intersection when he saw Madam Chelly standing by the roadside in a black funeral dress.
The other party's eyes lit up when he saw him and walked straight over.
"What's the matter, Madam Chelly?" Ebner asked in puzzlement. He didn't seem to have any relationship with this lady, did he? Was she here for Xio?
"Detective Bryan, it was Madam Daly who asked me to pass this letter to you." Chelly took out a folded letter and handed it to Ebner.
Ebner took it and asked Chelly with his eyes. After getting an affirmative answer, he started reading.
There wasn't much content in the letter. The general idea was to invite him to have dinner at Shewell Restaurant on Kent Street in North Borough tomorrow night. It also meant that His Excellency Sword of the Goddess would be present...
The handwriting on the letter was not dry. Clearly, it had just been written not long ago... Was this an impromptu idea? However, could Daly make the decision for Cesimir?
With this thought in mind, Ebner asked casually, "Why isn't Madam Daly here?"
"My lady really has something urgent to attend to. That's why she asked me to wait for you here," Chelly replied.
...
In the basement of Saint Samuel Cathedral in Backlund's North Borough.
"The Mandated Punishers are sending a deacon to Tingen? They wish for me to assist them temporarily?" Daly's cold and alluring face revealed a hint of surprise.
"Yes, the Church of Storms lost a Wind-blessed in the previous incident. This incurred the wrath of the Thunder Cathedral, and they specially sent an elite who's good at tracking down traces. As they suspect that it was done by a Marionettist, the focus of the investigation is the Secret Order," Crestet Cesimir said in a deep voice.
"The last time there were clear traces of activity from the Secret Order was in Tingen, and it was discovered by Tingen's Nighthawks team. Is that why the Church of Storms is investigating there?" As she had been paying close attention to Dunn, Daly knew every case of Tingen's Nighthawks team, so she was naturally no stranger to the Secret Order's activity in Tingen.
"That's right, but it's impossible for us to get the deacons of the Church of Storms to directly go to Tingen's Nighthawks team to read the information and even interrogate the captured members of the Secret Order... Therefore, we need to use the excuse of a joint investigation," Cesimir said after some deliberation.
"And because I'm familiar with the Tingen Nighthawks, as a member of the Joint Investigation Unit, I can provide sufficient lubrication to the communication between the two parties?" Daly joked with a smile.
"If not for helping you, I really don't want you to go..." Cesimir sighed.
"Thank you," Daly said sincerely before asking, "What time is it exactly?"
"Next Wednesday or Thursday. It depends on when the deacon of the Church of Storms will arrive," Cesimir replied.
"Is that so... Thankfully, it didn't delay my date tomorrow night," Daly said with a chuckle.
...
Monday morning, as he had to attend the Tarot Club in the afternoon, Ebner was in his room organizing the information he had promised to give Mr. Fool last week.
Actually, I don't know much about the Secret Order either... However, I won't give Klein any information regarding Zaratul. I'll only reveal some information that can be obtained through connections like the headquarters in Intis... In addition, I can give Klein information about the Secret Order's Marionettist beside Ambassador Intis, so that he can be mentally prepared in the future.
Yes... The Marionettist is also mentioned. He's only said to be a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Seer pathway.
As for the Antigonus family, I can reveal more... I can only tell him that this family is an illustrious noble from the Fourth Epoch and possesses the complete Seer Sequence potion formula... That's more or less enough. Any more would involve a deeper level of historical knowledge. Even if I tell him, I'm afraid Klein won't understand.
He recited the information he had compiled a few times and memorized it in his mind. Then, he lit the fire and burnt it.
Although it was fine to give this information to Mr. Fool through "Sacrifice," The Fool still needed a "fee" to open the door to the kingdom. It wasn't worth it to expend nearly ten pounds of materials for such a tiny amount of things. It was better to note it down and materialize it on the gray fog.
...
3 p.m.
After his vision recovered from the crimson and hazy state, Ebner once again arrived above the boundless gray fog that didn't belong to reality. Following that, he saw Audrey half get up, lift her skirt, and cheerily greet him.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~
"Good afternoon, Mr. Hanged Man ~
"Good afternoon, Mr. Tower ~"
After exchanging pleasantries, Klein, who had already activated his Spirit Vision, noticed that Miss Justice seemed to be very excited. He couldn't help but wonder, Did something happy happen?
Audrey puffed up her chest and said proudly,
"Mr. Fool, I've memorized two more pages of Roselle's diary."
Ebner smiled when he heard that. He wasn't surprised that Audrey could take out the diary because he had handed it over through Xio. Because of this, Xio had made a small profit.
However, he also said, "I've also obtained another diary page, Mr. Fool."

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Multiple Transactions
chapters.content:
Chapter 163 - Multiple Transactions
A new Roselle diary? Klein's mind jolted as he gently knocked on the table. The four pages that Audrey and Ebner had finished writing suddenly vanished and appeared in The Fool's hands.
However, he didn't immediately watch it. Instead, he asked with a smile,
"Very good. Miss Justice, Mr. Tower, what do you need?"
Before Ebner could say a word, Audrey's eyes lit up as she said,
"As you know, I'm about to finish digesting the Spectator potion, and I obtained the Telepathist potion formula from Mr. Tower... However, I only found one of the main ingredients in my family's treasure vault. I wish to know the clues to the other main ingredient, the Rainbow Salamander's pituitary gland... Hmm, I know that the contents of these two pages aren't much, and it might not match the value of the clues to the Telepathist's main ingredient. I'll give you a few more pages. Yes, I'll also pay you an additional sum..."
As Xio and Fors already had clues to the other Roselle diary pages and were working hard to obtain them, Audrey didn't find it difficult to take out a few more pages.
However, before she could finish her sentence, she suddenly felt that something was wrong. She couldn't help but curse herself in her heart.
Mr. Fool was a god-level figure, how could he be interested in vulgar money!
Therefore, Audrey couldn't maintain her Spectator state as she hurriedly added with a stutter,
"That's not what I meant! Mr. Fool, what I meant was that you can specify the compensation you want. Yes, that's it!"
Ebner tried his best to maintain his emotions so that it wouldn't be noticed by Klein, who was using his Spirit Vision, despite the intense fluctuations. However, he still chuckled inwardly.
"Miss Audrey, I'm guessing that Mr. Fool must really like your suggestion. He might even be fabricating a Blessed who lacks money..."
At that moment, Klein hadn't thought that far ahead. He was more troubled because how could he know the clues to the Rainbow Salamander's pituitary gland? Could he rely on divination?
No, that was the last resort because there might not be an outcome... He had to think of an excuse to deal with it first...
But at that moment, Alger suddenly said, "I know where to find the Rainbow Salamander, but this information isn't cheap."
Audrey immediately looked over, but she quickly restrained her surprise and asked reservedly, "What do you want?"
"I want 200 gold pounds or clues to the Tree of Elders' tree's heart," Alger said in thought.
The latter naturally wanted to exchange for the Wind-blessed formula with Ebner. As Detective Isengard lacked this material, Ebner didn't take back his request at the Tarot Club.
A clue to the heart of the Tree of Elders? I know that. It's in the junk pile beside me... Unfortunately, the "tower" was stored here. If I were to take it out, I might be exposed on the spot.
Klein mocked himself in an optimistic manner.
However, he soon recalled some of the content in the Feast of Blood. It seemed to mention that there was a Tree of Elders planted on Pasu Island, Esala, and Trier...
Therefore, after some thought, Klein tapped the edge of the ancient table with his finger before Audrey could speak.
Seeing that everyone's attention was on him, he smiled and said,
"I know where the Tree of Elders is.
"I'll give Mr. Hanged Man the clues to the Tree of Elders, while Mr. Hanged Man will inform Miss Justice of the clues to the Telepathist potion's main ingredient. As for Miss Justice, she will give me the newly obtained Roselle diary in the Tarot Club once or twice. That way, the transaction will be completed."
Audrey originally thought that it wouldn't be a problem to spend 200 pounds to buy clues, but since Mr. Fool had given her a suggestion, she suppressed the urge to directly pay for it. She smiled faintly and said,
"I have no objections."
"Neither do I." Alger hesitated for a moment before nodding. However, he seemed to recall something and added, "However, I wish to communicate privately during the transaction."
With that said, he casually glanced at "Tower" beside him, thinking that if "Tower" knew the clues to the Tree of Elders, he might not need to find it...
Klein didn't refuse. He knew that Tower had already finished reading the Feast of Blood. What if he found out that he was doing the same thing? Therefore, excluding him from this three-way transaction was naturally necessary.
Only Audrey looked at Mr. Tower worriedly. She felt that Mr. Tower had always been sharing knowledge and information for free. It wasn't good for them to exclude him...
However, she saw that Mr. Fool didn't object. After some hesitation, she didn't raise any objections.
As for Ebner, who was excluded from the three-way deal, he didn't show any reaction. He could guess what Klein was trying to use to trick Alger. After all, he had seen the Feast of Blood. The locations of the Tree of Elders mentioned were all near the headquarters of the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Eternal Blazing Sun... Even if he knew, how many people could obtain it?
And knowing Alger's cunning personality, Ebner guessed that it was impossible for him to tell Audrey the exact coordinates of the island with the Rainbow Salamander. At most, he would tell her the general location... Audrey was a noble lady. So what if she knew which island had the materials she wanted? This was probably information that didn't have much practical value.
Finally, the two pages of the diary that Justice handed to Klein were actually the two pages where the Demoness took the initiative to visit and the Emperor complained that the Sanguine didn't give him a beauty. There was also very little information in them...
However, in a sense, this was really an equivalent exchange!
While Ebner was lost in his own thoughts, the other three completed the transaction in private.
Miss Audrey used her Spectator powers to try her best to hide her dissatisfaction. She felt that she might as well ask Mr. Fool for information. Mr. Hanged Man was truly dishonest.
But on second thought, since Mr. Fool has tacitly agreed to this transaction, it means that it's indeed of equal value... Perhaps, the contents of Roselle's diary that Fors received aren't important? Is that why it's only worth such imprecise information?
Thankfully, among the locations of the islands that The Hanged Man gave, there are a few places that aren't too far from where Alfred served... Perhaps I should write to him and ask? Miss Justice thought to herself.
As for The Hanged Man, he was deep in thought about the information regarding the Tree of Elders given by The Fool. He thought to himself, Why would the three deities that are hostile to each other nurture the Tree of Elders at the same time? Is there anything special about it? Or is there some deeper secret...
Klein carefully observed the two Tarot Club members. Seeing that they didn't suspect The Fool, he secretly heaved a sigh of relief.
Then he looked apprehensively at Ebner, but he deliberately leaned back in his chair and asked in a flat tone, "What do you want this time, Tower?"
"Honorable Mr. Fool, can I accumulate my contributions to you first?" Ebner thought that he might not put too many things into the gray fog in the future, so he felt that it was better to give some benefits first.
The Fool nodded gently and smiled calmly. "Sure."
Thankfully, Tower didn't give me any problems this time...
With this in mind, Klein was in a good mood. He picked up the two diary pages handed over by Miss Justice and cast his gaze over.
"15th January, a Witch of Calamity delivered herself... Could it be that you really don't care about meat anymore?"
"...What right do you have to support the Night Emperor and support a beautiful queen, while I only have a rough man!"
Klein's eyes glazed over as the corners of his mouth twitched involuntarily. He deeply felt that he had underestimated Roselle.
As for Audrey and Alger, they realized at the same time that Mr. Fool's gaze was fixed on the first diary entry. "He" was actually reading each word extremely seriously?
"Does it record something important? I really want to know... But who submitted this page? Mr. Tower? Hmm, judging from Mr. Fool's attitude towards the transaction, the two pages I submitted shouldn't have any important information... As expected of Mr. Tower!"
Audrey thought to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Communication and Share
chapters.content:
Chapter 164 - Communication and Share
However, even though Klein was stunned by Emperor Roselle's "integrity," he still noticed some useful details from the two pages.
Demoness of Despair... Is that the name of a High-Sequence Beyonder of the Demoness pathway? From the name, I can tell that acting is probably very evil! It's impossible for a Demoness to experience despair herself, right?
In addition, Emperor Roselle's real name is actually Huang Tao. He really lives up to his name!
"The Night Emperor should be the emperor of the Trunsoest Empire. He actually married a Sanguine as his queen?"
As a normal graduate of the history department, Klein naturally had some understanding of the Trunsoest Empire. However, no matter what history he read, there was no record of the Queen of the Night.
Although "Feast of Blood" was written by the Duke of the Blood Clan, there was very little information about the Blood Clan recorded in it... It shouldn't be necessary, right?
As Klein thought this, he picked up the diary page that Tower had submitted.
The Sauron family's Floren... Grade 0 Sealed Artifact... suddenly came to life... It's very similar to the Hidden Sage?
There's quite a lot of information on this page... However, from the tone of the diary, the Emperor and the Sauron family's Floren should only be Low- and Mid-Sequence Beyonders. How do they know the specific information about a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact? Is this done deliberately by someone, or is the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact doing something?
Klein's thoughts raced as he thought of many things. However, he quickly reined in his various thoughts and moved his gaze away from the diary. He looked at The Hanged Man, Justice, and Tower and smiled.
"The diary you provided is very valuable."
"It's our honor," Audrey replied respectfully, restraining her curiosity.
"You can communicate now." Klein nodded slightly before leaning back into his chair and said leisurely.
Just as he said that Ebner obtained The Fool's agreement and conjured a stack of documents. Then, he said, "Mr. Fool, this is the information regarding the Secret Order and the Antigonus family that I promised to gather for you last week. This is to repay my previous request for appraisal."
Klein was immediately interested when he heard that. However, as there was quite a lot of information, he didn't plan on reading it on the spot. He planned on slowly studying it after the Tarot Club ended.
However, he still muttered inwardly, Mr. Tower's memory is really impressive. He actually managed to produce such thick information... It looks like Miss Justice is having a hard time memorizing two pages...
Mr. Fool nodded in satisfaction and said casually, "Well done. The debt you owed from your appraisal has been erased."
"Praise your benevolence and generosity, Mr. Fool." Ebner took the opportunity to flatter him. After all, he had a premonition that he would definitely need to borrow Sefirah Castle in the future.
Seeing that Mr. Fool didn't flip open the information handed over by the Tower, Audrey thought for a moment and looked at Ebner diagonally across her. She said apologetically,
"I'm sorry, Mr. Tower. Regarding Earl Lorena, I wasn't able to gather more information, nor did I expect you to take action so quickly..."
Although she was excited about being able to participate in this major event, she knew that her role was negligible. All she did was gather some superficial information. Her contributions couldn't match up to those charms, and even the favor she owed Mr. Tower for broadening her knowledge wasn't enough.
The Tower has already taken action? Has something major happened in Backlund? I'll have to ask Miss Justice when we exchange information later. Alger's heart stirred when he heard that as he thought to himself.
Klein also frowned as he thought to himself, "The big news that came from Backlund in the past two days only has that Hero Detective making new contributions, capturing the prince's assassination... Could this matter be related to the Demoness of Afflictions? Was it done by Tower?"
"Miss Justice, the information you provided was very timely. It was very helpful," Ebner replied with a smile.
He wasn't lying. If it weren't for Justice's intelligence informing them that he, Lina, was Earl Lorena's youngest son, the Forsaken Ones wouldn't have asked Lina where the Demoness of Agony might be hiding, and they might not have been able to save Captain Kuhn in time.
However, Audrey believed that Mr. Tower was consoling her. She shook her head and said sincerely, "You don't have to comfort me... I know everything. Yes, Mr. Tower, do you have any other requests that you need me to do? I wish to make it up to you..."
She was not used to feeling indebted to others and tried her best to repay them... Of course, she would not do anything too difficult.
Ebner thought for a moment and suddenly thought of something. He smiled and said, "I happen to have something to trouble you with, Miss Justice."
"What's the matter?" Audrey perked up and asked curiously.
"Hmm... It's like this. I need to give a gift to a girl. I don't know what to choose... Miss Justice, can you give me a suggestion?" Ebner said after some deliberation.
A gift for a girl? Audrey's interest was instantly piqued. She even asked in a gossipy manner, "Is it for a lover?"
"No, it's a gift from my sistr." Ebner shook his head. The nature of the gift could not be mistaken.
"Mr. Tower, this isn't the place to discuss such matters. After the Tarot Club is over, I'll tell you after I consider it," Audrey said after some thought.
Sitting in the seat of honor, Klein watched this scene with a deadpan expression. He lampooned inwardly. Thankfully, I can directly edit your image and voice for "Tower" to see. If I, an evil god, were to directly pass it on, how bizarre would that be?
"Alright." Ebner also knew that it wasn't appropriate to talk about such trivial matters in the gray fog, so he stopped when the point was reached. He then turned to the successor and asked, "I need the 'Thousand Phantom's Crystal' and the 'Horn of the Striped Black Snake'. Do any of you have them? I can give you a price that will satisfy you."
The horn of the 'Glittering Black Snake' was naturally for Xio to purchase and could also be used to confuse others.
Upon hearing this, Audrey used her Spectator powers to maintain her smile. This was because she had never heard of these two names before. She was also certain that she didn't have these two materials in her treasure vault at home, so all she needed to do was smile...
Alger fell silent for a moment before saying, "I happen to have clues regarding the Black Striped Black Snake. If I can get its horn, how much are you willing to pay?"
"700 pounds and it can be repaid from the price of the Wind-blessed formula. Of course, if you obtain the Tree of Elders' Heart, I will compensate you with the difference," Ebner replied with a smile.
As the main ingredient of Sequence 7, the price of the horn of the Amphiptere Black Snake would normally fluctuate between 600 to 700 pounds. Ebner's price was already very fair.
"Alright, I should be able to get it on Thursday or Friday. We will do the transaction under Mr. Fool's witness." Alger agreed without any hesitation.
After the negotiation with The Hanged Man ended, no one raised any new requests or deals. The Tarot Club naturally entered the next process—sharing information.
Audrey first looked up at Mr. Fool and said respectfully,
"Mr. Fool, the method you previously described to select officials for the public examinations has been approved by the King and the Prime Minister. Currently, the Upper Academy and the House of Commons are undergoing a review process. It's estimated that it will be approved by early October... In February next year, it might enter a formal implementation phase."
"It looks like the king and the prime minister still have brains," Alger mocked out of habit.
Ebner had heard of this matter on Thursday. According to Cullen, it was one of the compromises the king had made in order to appease the Church of the Lord of Storms. Therefore, he added,
"Because that's the price His Majesty, King George III, paid."

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Susie’s Suggestion
chapters.content:
Chapter 165 - Susie's Suggestion
"The price His Majesty paid?" Audrey repeated and asked in puzzlement, "Why do you say that?"
Alger also cast his gaze over. He had a vague guess that it was related to the Demoness of Agony that Tower had previously investigated.
As for Mr. Fool, he was also filled with curiosity. Having a limited understanding of this world, he was very willing to listen to "Tower" talk about certain things... Although this fellow refused to explain everything completely, just like the evil spirit in Stormwind Mountain Villa.
Seeing that the trio's attention was focused on him, Ebner organized his words and said, "Backlund's Mandated Punishers lost a Wind-blessed in order to capture the Demoness of Afflictions. They lost a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, and more than half of the team's members were seriously injured... Under such circumstances, how can His Majesty quell the Church of Storms's anger without paying a price? After all, the person who hid the Demoness was a trusted aide of the royal family."
Audrey had previously learned from Susie that the Church of Storms had forced His Majesty to execute Earl Lorena, but she didn't know that there was such an inside story. At that moment, she couldn't help but be enlightened. "No wonder the Church of Storms seems so domineering..."
The Wind-blessed died in battle? Was it Robert, Matthew, or McConnor? Captain Kuhn was also seriously injured... He had contracted a sacred item, the Timeless Disaster! What happened in Backlund? Where's His Excellency SpellSInger of God's? How could he sit back and watch such a thing happen?
Alger's heart was in turmoil. He even felt that Tower might be spouting nonsense... However, he stole a glance at The Fool sitting at the seat of honor. Seeing that the mysterious existence didn't retort or knock on the edge of the long table, it was obvious that he had tacitly agreed that Tower's words were accurate...
After taking a deep breath and letting it out, Alger, who had regained his calm, quickly began to ponder. Just the Demoness of Afflictions alone definitely wouldn't cause the Mandated Punishers in Backlund to suffer such losses. There must be other factions involved... Considering that it was George III who made the compensation in the end... Could this be a game between the Church and the nobles of the kingdom? The Mandated Punishers and the earl are just sacrifices in the game?
For some reason, he suddenly felt a little sad.
As a Nighthawk, Klein could empathize with her. He desperately wanted to know the cause and effect, but as The Fool, he couldn't ask her... All he could do was hope that Miss Justice would once again be a qualified fall guy.
As expected, Audrey didn't disappoint Mr. Fool's expectations. She couldn't hide her curiosity as she pleaded, "Mr. Tower, can you share the entire process of the matter with me? It's very difficult for me to come into contact with the truth in my daily life. I can only understand it through you... Yes, I'll pay you. What do you want?"
"Heh heh, Miss Justice, all you need to do is help me choose that gift," Ebner replied with a smile.
He originally wanted to inform the Tarot Club about the general situation, especially Mr. Fool. After all, in half a month, Mr. Fool would be coming to Backlund. And that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact that had lost control was extremely dangerous. If he were to encounter that Sealed Artifact while unprepared, wouldn't the safe, hidden, and equal trading platform of the Tarot Club be gone?
Audrey didn't expect Mr. Tower to mention this again. She thought to herself, Mr. Tower really cares about his sister. It looks like I have to seriously choose a suitable item... Yes, it's best if I get Annie to help. She has always had the best eyesight.
Annie was her personal maid, and her family had served the Hall family for generations. When it came to treating people, she was a true professional.
"I also want to join... Tower, what do you need me to pay?" At that moment, The Hanged Man suddenly said.
In the previous three-way deal, he had excluded "Tower" because of his request. Therefore, he was afraid that the other party would mimic him and not let him understand what had happened in Backlund.
"I need you to help me take note of the Future's movements, as well as the subsequent intelligence regarding the treasure that Admiral of Stars found on the Storm Sea's new route." Ebner glanced at him and deliberated for a moment before slowly speaking.
Alger never expected that Tower would mind this matter, but he still agreed without any hesitation. "Alright, I'll gather the information I heard for you... However, I can't be sure if the information is true."
"No problem. Just give it to me." Ebner nodded and deliberated before describing,
The cause of the entire incident should be an ambush by the Mandated Punishers against Ray, who was still a Demoness of Pleasure...
Following that, he described how Ray had planned to advance to the Demoness of Afflictions, only to be corrupted by the Primordial Moon. He also described how he had planned to split up the Mandated Punishers in search of Sealed Artifact 2-001.
Of course, what he said was only what he knew. He even ignored his role in it and his guesses about the "arrangements".
But even so, it still made Audrey, Alger, and Klein tremble in fear. Especially when they heard that the Demoness had used the godhood of the Primordial Moon to fight the three Holy Artifacts, they even broke out into a sweat for the two captains and Her Excellency, the Sword of the Goddess.
However, what they did not know was that Ebner had only heard rumors about that battle. Although the outcome of the battle was not wrong, the process was fabricated by him...
So His Excellency SpellSinger of God's was held back by the Rose School of Thought's demigod... Only then did Alger come to a realization. However, he found Captain Kuhn's choice in this matter unbelievable. If it were him commanding, how could he be so passive?
Klein was very interested in the Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. He thought It can be used to enhance the accuracy of divination... Could it be a high-level item of the Seer pathway?
Audrey's attention was on something else. She said in surprise, "So the Demoness of Afflictions was really killed by that Detective Bryan? I thought he was pushed out by the Church of Storms..."
Upon hearing that, Ebner coughed and corrected him. "It was Detective Bryan who her killed together with a necromancer from the Church of Evernight."
"That's impressive too! I always felt that Detective Bryan's reputation was fake, but now that I think about it, he might be even more powerful than the rumors say." Audrey said with some yearning. She also wished to one day become a hero who protected the kingdom and the people.
Although "Tower" had described it in great detail, Klein felt that the waters behind this matter were probably very deep. There was a more terrifying truth hidden behind it...
However, since "Tower" had spent too much time explaining, his spirituality could no longer hold on. Therefore, he didn't have time to think carefully. Seeing that no one spoke, he immediately tapped the edge of the table with his finger and calmly said,
"Let's end today's gathering here."
"As you wish!" All the members, including Ebner, stood up at the same time.
After all the figures dispersed, leaving him alone in the ancient palace, Klein rubbed his glabella and picked up the information that Tower had conjured.
The Secret Order's headquarters are suspected to be in the Intis Republic? Furthermore, they do possess the potion of the Seer pathway...
However, after only reading a few pages, Klein could no longer withstand the consumption of his spirituality. He had no choice but to leave the gray fog, return to his room, and fall asleep on his bed.
...
After his vision returned to normal, Ebner removed the spirituality seal in the room. Then, he changed into decent clothes and prepared to head to the North Borough to meet Madam Daly's invitation.
"I wonder why the Sword of the Goddess is looking for me? But since we are meeting at an official restaurant, I don't think there will be any trouble."
Although Ebner had such thoughts, he still carried all the Beyonder items other than the Sword of Dawn.
Without using the Solomon gold coin, he couldn't believe his luck. After all, every time he attended banquets or balls, there would be some problems.
...
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's mansion.
Audrey reined in her excitement after learning of a major incident and walked around the house.
Following that, she turned her head and smiled at the golden retriever that had run back after removing the spirituality seal.
"Susie, if you had a sister, what would you give her?"
Susie instinctively wanted to spit out her tongue, but she stopped herself demurely.
It wagged its tail and thought carefully before replying in a cheerful tone,
"Backlund cares about the biscuits produced by the pet company... Yes, they have to be beef flavored."

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Case
chapters.content:
Chapter 166 - Case
At 5: 40 PM, at the Shewell Restaurant on Kent Street in North Borough.
'This restaurant seems to be very high-end... It's even more luxurious than some of the estates I know of...' Crestet Cesimir, who had arrived early, looked around and felt a little uncomfortable.
Although he was a high-ranking deacon of the Church of the Goddess, his life had always been very simple. He didn't have many pursuits of quality of life, so he didn't have such a luxurious restaurant in the future.
Sitting beside him, Madam Daly chuckled and pulled down the hood of her black robe. She said in an ethereal voice,
"This is actually the style of the Feysac Empire. It's quite different from ours. They like to decorate it with some ancient and huge materials, just like their height."
"Why did you put the invitation place here? Isn't the Halka Restaurant near the church good?" Cesimir asked, puzzled.
"Because I've always wanted to try the taste of this place, but my salary doesn't allow it," Daly replied with a smile. Then, her eyes moved slightly, and she pretended to be mysterious as she said, "And don't you know? That woman, Halka, doesn't have a good reputation... Recently, even Chelly won't go to her restaurant to buy lunch for the Nighthawks."
"Did something happen?" Cesimir's gaze sharpened.
"Don't be nervous. It's just that some of the ridiculous things she did previously were discovered," Daly explained with a smile.
Cesimir looked at her seriously for a while before sighing. "I'm not Dunn. You don't have to test my reaction. Even if you do, it won't be the same as Dunn. It won't be of any help to you... However, I'm certain that he won't mind too much."
Daly's smile faded when she heard that. She fell silent for a moment before saying, "I'm sorry. I went to Tingen this time because I want to be brave, but I was also afraid of losing it completely..."
"I really need to consider if you are a good candidate to join the 'Joint Investigation' team... Perhaps it's not too late to change?" Cesimir said deliberately.
Upon hearing this, Madam Daly recovered from her baffling emotions. She chuckled and said, "Isn't it just an expensive meal? You can't be that stingy, right? You can reimburse me."
Just as the two of them were chatting, they heard a waiter knocking on the door. Then, they saw Ebner walking in with a waiter behind him.
...
At the intersection of Empress Borough and West Borough, Townsend Street.
Xio stood in a dark and secluded alley. Even without looking up, she could see the layers of gorgeous palaces and towering gothic bell towers in the distance.
It was the highest area in Backlund, and also where the Loen royal family resided.
In the Northern and Southern Continents, its status in the entire world was equivalent or even slightly higher than Intis's White Maple Palace and the Feysac Empire's Aurmir Palace, but its name was neither romantic nor ancient.
It was called the Sodrak Palace. In ancient Feysac, the word meant "balance."
Xio retracted her gaze from the famous Bell of Order and looked to the other side of the alley.
A figure slowly walked out from the shadows where the gas lamps couldn't shine.
The figure wore a golden mask that revealed the lower half of his face. He was the person in charge of MI9 who had previously turned Xio into a spy.
"Did you gain anything from the previous commission?" The man in the golden mask asked according to his usual practice.
Xio shook her head and said, "No, at least East Borough and the dock area didn't have any incidents similar to the horror stories you mentioned."
Although she had listened to Ebner's advice and didn't rule it out, as a Sheriff, she still had to be aware of the happenings in her district.
She paused and pretended to be reluctant as she asked,
"Is this commission long-term?"
The masked man fell silent for a moment before saying,
"That's right. If you hear anything related, contact me immediately.
"However, I'm here today to give you a new mission."
"What mission?" Xio completely entered her bounty hunter state as she prepared to assess the risks.
The golden-masked man replied, "Investigate someone's whereabouts."
"Who?" Xio asked.
"I don't know... But he should have the dual powers of a Wind-blessed and a Hypnotist. If you encounter someone like him, come find me immediately," the golden-masked man said hesitantly.
The dual powers of the Wind-blessed and Hypnotist? Does MI9 want to find the Marionettist who helped Demoness of Afflictions? Xio quickly came to a conclusion.
She had previously heard from Ebner about the battle in the northwest suburbs. She had also learned some of the powers of a Marionettist, so she immediately guessed MI9's plans.
However, wasn't this something the Church of Storms should be worried about? Why was MI9 so proactive?
With this in mind, Xio feigned a blank look and asked, "Hypnotist's powers? What's that?"
As for the Wind-blessed, there was no need to ask. The reputation of the Mandated Punishers was not unknown even to wild Beyonders.
"You don't have to worry about that. Later, I'll give you detailed information on Hypnotist and Wind-blessed." With that said, the masked man continued in a bewitching tone, "If you really find clues about that person, I can give you a reward from the main material of the Interrogator."
Although a Marionettist is a Sequence 5 powerhouse, from what I heard from Ebner, he seems to have some guesses. Perhaps he will "know" soon... Besides, I only need to receive information and report it. I don't need to fight a Sequence 5 Beyonder.
After some consideration, Xio nodded and said, "I accept this request."
"Very good." The masked man's tone became relaxed. After looking around, he took out a stack of papers from his pocket and said, "It's best to burn them immediately after reading them."
With that said, he slowly retreated and returned to the shadows, disappearing around the corner of the alley.
Xio opened the information and flipped through it. Not only was there a description of the Hypnotist and Wind-blessed powers, but there were also photos of two people.
Xio was somewhat familiar with one of them. Thanks to the Sheriff's powers, she recalled a Mandated Punisher she had investigated when she was on duty at the Daily Observer's headquarters.
From the looks of it, MI9 was really looking for that Marionettist...
Xio rubbed her chubby cheeks and walked out of the street, preparing to take a public carriage back to North Borough.
Right at this moment, she suddenly sensed an abnormal aura passing by not far from her, but she did not see anything.
Assassin? Xio, who had seen the Psionic Knowledge Society's instigator, quickly determined the source of the "abnormalities," even if it wasn't under her jurisdiction.
After some thought, Xio secretly followed the "abnormality" she sensed.
...
In the private room of Shewell Restaurant, Ebner tasted a mouthful of Feysac's raw white whale slices and fried whale steak. After secretly complaining that it wasn't fresh enough, he smiled and asked Cesimir, "Your Excellency, you aren't really just treating me to a meal of Feysac's delicacies, are you?"
To be honest, Ebner thought that he had made a mistake when he saw the decor of the restaurant. He only walked in after confirming it repeatedly.
"Detective Bryan, I invited you here mainly to ask you about something," Cesimir slowly exhaled.
"What is it?" Ebner swirled the Sonia blood wine in his glass and asked curiously.
"He wants to know the origins of the badge you used to kill the Demoness of Afflictions... as well as the information regarding Beyonders of the Devil pathway," Ma'am Daly interjected.
So it's because of this matter... But why didn't you come to me directly to ask, and instead go through so much trouble to treat me to a meal?
Yes, there have been too many reporters around my teacher's house recently. It's indeed inconvenient for them to visit. Besides, I'm quite famous. It's not appropriate for the Nighthawks to summon me to the police station or Saint Samuel Cathedral...
With this in mind, Ebner organized his words and said without hiding anything, "That badge was successfully made after I killed a demonic creature in Damir... The Church of Storms should have records on this."
"It's the same as what we found out." Cesimir nodded slightly. Clearly, he wasn't surprised by Ebner's words. Then, he said sincerely, "From the looks of it, you aren't unfamiliar with the Beyonder powers of the Devil pathway. Can you tell me about it? I know it's a little presumptuous to ask this, and it might involve the secrets of the Church of Earth Mother, but there's a demon killing in Backlund at the moment. I need to know about him."
If he was not very familiar with it, how could he have used the materials on the monsters to create such a powerful badge, even though it might be a gift from Earth Mother?
Madam Daly spoke again and smiled. "Don't worry. I won't let you help for nothing."
Ebner thought for a moment and could guess what they were looking into. "What do you want to know?" he asked tentatively. He was inclined to help anyway.
"I want to know what Sequence Beyonders need to continuously cut open a person's abdomen and extract all their organs," Cesimir asked.
There wasn't much information regarding the Devil pathway in Saint Samuel Cathedral. After all, it had been a long time since the other party had acted so brazenly in Backlund.
If he wanted more detailed information, he could only go to the headquarters of the Holy Cathedral to read it, but that would be a waste of time, and the demon was still killing people.
Such "dangerous" information couldn't be sent via telegram or other means. It could only be read by someone with sufficient authority.
Ebner deliberated for a moment and answered as simply as possible, "This sounds like a ritual used by demons to aid in one's advancement. It often appears from Sequence 6 to Sequence 5."
"So, what's the pattern and interval of this ritual?" Cesimir pressed.
Ebner shook his head. Before he could answer, Madam Daly, who was sitting diagonally opposite him, suddenly took out a letter from the void. She opened it and took a look. Suddenly, she frowned and reported to Cesimir, "The sixth case has happened... It's the Halka we talked about previously... It's near Samuel Cathedral!"

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Ferocious Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 167 - Ferocious Beast
Upon hearing Daly's words, Crestet Cesimir immediately stood up. He pulled up the strap of the chest made of silver metal beside him and carried it on his back.
"We'll talk about it later..." he said briefly to Ebner before striding out of the restaurant.
Daly also stood up and followed closely behind the Sword of the Goddess. She only had time to nod at Ebner.
As for Ebner, he wanted to follow and have a look, but the waiter stopped him.
"Sir, please settle the bill," the waiter standing at the door of the private room said as he looked at Ebner warily.
Eh... His Excellency Cesimir didn't pay the bill? Ebner looked out of the private room and realized that Cesimir and Daly were nowhere to be seen. Instead, a few burly men who looked like bodyguards approached them under the waiter's hint.
If I were to run away now, would tomorrow's headlines become "Is it the sorrow of humanity or the loss of morality... The Hero Detective is actually eating a free meal!"?
After cursing in his heart, Ebner took a deep breath and asked the waiter who was staring at him intently, "How much?"
The waiter heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that he wasn't really thinking of escaping the bill. After making some calculations in his heart, he quickly reported the price. "Including the bottle of Sonia blood wine, it's a total of 53 pounds 4 soli."
Sonia Blood Wine was brewed from sweet wood juice, a specialty of the area around the Golden Spring. The Golden Spring of Sonia Island was also known as the Elven Spring, and its spring water was even a supplementary ingredient for Sequence 6 potions.
"..." Ebner was speechless for a moment. It was best for him to squeeze out a polite smile. "Can I develop a ticket?" He had to ask the Church of Evernight for reimbursement!
"A ticket?" The waiter was a little confused at first, but he quickly recovered and smiled. "You want the page of the bill, right? No problem."
Ebner nodded and looked back at the Feysac delicacies that he had only taken a few mouthfuls of. He asked again, "Do you provide packing services here?"
...
West Borough, Williams Street.
Xio was currently running quickly along with the shadows on both sides of the road, and not far behind her was a ferocious beast the size of a lion.
Suddenly, the ferocious beast let out a low growl from its throat, and its speed increased by 20% as it pounced towards Xio.
The image of a ferocious beast's claws piercing through her heart immediately appeared in Xio's mind, so she suddenly rolled to the left. Almost at the same time, a claw glowing with green light brushed past her.
This was the Beyonder power of a Clown provided by the Ring of Prejudice.
However, this wasn't the end of it. The ferocious beast missed its attack and nimbly turned around, flying towards Xio again.
However, at this moment, a figure flashed out from the shadows of the street. While the beast was still in the air, it used all its strength to slam into its body, knocking it five to six meters away.
When Xio saw this, her prepared actions faltered as she took out a few brass charms from her pocket. Then, as she activated the charms, she dragged the figure straight through the locked door.
By the time the beast arrived again, Xio had already passed through four or five houses. Seeing this, she let out a low growl, but didn't continue chasing. Instead, she returned to a house deep in the street.
On Xio's side, although she hadn't run too far, she was able to make use of the complicated terrain to escape the ferocious beasts' pursuit and catch her breath.
After secretly entering an empty room in a nearby house, Xio looked back at the person she was pulling. When she realized that he had reached a safe place, she relaxed and fainted.
Xio frowned. After a quick examination, she found that this person's arm had been scratched by the beast, and the wound was glowing with green light. It was obvious that he had been poisoned, and the poison was extremely strong.
If he hadn't appeared to help me knock into that lion-like beast, I would have been the one poisoned... Therefore, I should think of a way to save him.
With this in mind, Xio looked at the assassin she didn't recognize at all and silently muttered to herself, "I can only help you treat your wounds briefly. As for whether you can survive, it depends on whether I can find Ebner in time..."
With that said, she quietly left the house and headed for Isengard's Detective Agency in Hillston Borough.
...
At ten o'clock that night, Ebner had just returned to the teacher's house with his lunchbox and wine bottle. Before he had time for supper, he heard the footman come to report that Miss Xio had arrived.
Ebner was somewhat surprised and immediately went downstairs to the living room. He then realized that Xio's messy blonde hair was stained with blood.
"What happened?" As he spoke, Ebner habitually extracted Xio's aura and quickly saw a lion-sized Beyonder beast in the background.
"Werewolf? No... It should be an animal that ate the characteristics of a werewolf!" Ebner, who had carefully observed and analyzed Maric's abilities, quickly guessed the details of the beast from the aura it left behind.
"So it's a werewolf..." Xio was enlightened before quickly saying, "There's a person who needs your help. He was poisoned by the werewolf's claws."
"What's going on?" As Ebner asked, he tidied up his equipment and left with Xio.
"87 Williams Street." After Xio gave the address, she stood beside Ebner and waited for him to move.
Ebner nodded and wrapped one arm around Xio's waist before activating the White Eye. At the same time, he simulated the Wind-blessed's "flying" and the Witch's "invisibility" abilities.
With a strong gust of wind rising from beneath their feet, Ebner quickly took to the air with Xio and flew towards West Borough.
In midair, Xio recounted what had happened to Ebner in detail.
It turned out that after Xio accepted the golden-masked man's mission, she had accidentally discovered an unripe Assassin.
Due to the Consciousness Council, Xio didn't have a good impression of Assassin. She thought that he was going to do something bad, so she secretly followed him.
