In the end, she discovered that this Assassin was actually a good person. He was trying to rescue a girl who had been forcefully abducted to a villa on Williams Street.
Unfortunately, his stealth skills as an assassin weren't very good. He was easily discovered by the ferocious beasts in the villa. If Xio hadn't helped him in time, he wouldn't have been able to enter the shadows again.
The rest was simple. The beast thought that Xio was an accomplice, so it chased after her without letting her go. The assassin actually circled back after escaping, which resulted in the previous scene.
"Is it someone from the Rose School of Thought's indulgence faction that you previously mentioned?" Xio asked with a frown after recounting her encounter.
"It can't be someone from the Rose School of Thought. Otherwise, neither you nor that assassin can escape!"

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Clues
chapters.content:
Chapter 168 - Clues
West Borough, Williams Street.
Since this place was very close to Empress Borough where the nobles lived, even though Ebner had simulated his invisibility ability, he did not dare to fly over directly. Instead, he slowly descended on the nearby streets.
Under Xio's guidance, the two quickly arrived in front of the house with door number 8.
Ebner stared at the door number for a long while, his expression subtle.
This puzzled Xio. She looked around and asked warily and suspiciously, "Is there something wrong?"
Upon hearing that, Ebner snapped out of his daze and shook his head. "Nothing..." It was just that there might be a Fourth Epoch ruin under the house.
Taking a deep breath and throwing away the messy thoughts in his mind, Ebner simulated the apprentice's ability to "open the door" and led Xio into the mansion that had a lawn and garden in front of it.
The house had a total of two floors, and the furniture inside was rather messy. It must have been a long time since someone took care of it. Only the servants' room on the left side of the house had candlelight shining. That should be where the people guarding the house slept.
The two of them walked through the messy living room and down the stairs into a rather spacious basement.
There were no gas pipes here, but there were four metal candlesticks embedded in the wall. As Xio was afraid of being discovered, she hadn't lit them before, so the basement was pitch-black.
However, this wasn't a problem for Ebner. The moment he activated the Ring of Light on his finger, the surroundings lit up.
As for whether this light would be discovered by the servant guarding the door? That was even less of a problem. The servant had been forced into a "dream" the moment he entered.
Ebner didn't check on the assassin who was lying on the ground, unsure if he was dead or alive. Instead, he used the Eye of Pure White to survey the basement. After confirming that the grayish-white secret door in the corner didn't have any signs of being opened or any other aura contamination, he heaved a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Xio walked in front of the assassin and squatted down to examine him again. Originally, she did not have much hope. She had only brought Ebner here to do her best and have a clear conscience.
However, after taking a closer look, she quickly revealed a surprised expression.
"Ebner, he's alive."
Upon hearing Xio's words, Ebner was also taken aback before he quickly walked over.
Similar to Xio's previous judgment, Ebner also felt that this assassin had long been incurable. It had been more than half an hour since he had been poisoned. Logically speaking, this period of time should have been enough for him to die four or five times.
"Eh? Isn't this the same Shoko constable who made a scene at Inspector Wayne's funeral?
So he became an Assassin... It's no wonder I saw him going to the Bravehearts Bar to inquire about the Beyonder gathering when I "recalled" Kaspars' experience...
"However, the poison in his body remained within a certain range and did not spread?"
Under the illumination of the Ring of Light, Ebner could see the assassin's face clearly, as well as his current situation. The green light from the wound on his left arm was rising violently, but it seemed to be suppressed back to its original spot by some force. They were in a stalemate.
Ebner looked back at Xio, who immediately understood and said, "He was like this when he was just injured. The poison didn't spread, but it didn't weaken either."
Hearing this, Ebner looked thoughtful. Then he examined Shoko closely and was soon attracted to a necklace made of five different colored gems strung together around his neck.
"It should be this necklace that's working, which is why he survived..." Ebner nodded. He had just analyzed it with the Eye of Pure White and found that the necklace was using flesh magic to constantly restore Shoko's body that was corroded by the poison. That was why it was in a deadlock with the poison.
This way, the treatment would be much simpler.
The poison of a Werewolf wasn't difficult to remove. Even Shoko, who was wearing the necklace, could withstand it. The only problem was the evil power attached to the poison.
And to deal with evil anomalies, the Sun domain was naturally the most professional.
With this in mind, Ebner immediately created Sun Holy Water and sprinkled it on Shoko's wound. Then, he raised his left hand and aimed the Ring of Light at him.
The gemstones embedded in the ring instantly bloomed with a brilliant golden color, a golden color like sunlight!
Right on the heels of that, the streaks of golden light became purer, finally forming a seal-like projection in the holy water around Xiao Ke's wound.
"I declare that it is effective against evil anomalies!"
As Ebner's solemn voice reverberated, a dazzling golden light erupted from the holy water, instantly engulfing the strange green light around the wound.
Almost at the same time, the wound on Shoko's left arm began to move. Muscle tissue regrouped and grew, slowly but firmly healing.
"It's done. He will probably fully recover tomorrow," Ebner said to Xio with a smile when he saw this scene.
Xio nodded slightly. Then, she hesitated for a few seconds before asking hesitantly, "Ebner, should we check that side again?"
She was naturally referring to the villa that housed the Werewolf.
Ebner pinched his chin and pondered for a moment. He thought to himself, "Officer Shoko's body isn't strong, and he doesn't seem to have any Beyonder items that can increase his strength... But even so, he can actually knock the beast that's suspected to be a Werewolf five to six meters away..."
This meant that the beast might not be a real werewolf...
I've seen Maric's stamina before. Let alone Shoko, even if a carriage were to hit him, he wouldn't be able to gain an advantage!
Although werewolves weren't as physically strong as zombies, they shouldn't be that much weaker...
I remember that Maric once told Klein that Werewolves could use dark spells to control the targets that had their poison infiltrate their bodies for a period of time, and they could turn them into subordinates, turning them into monsters similar to Werewolves. And those monsters often had short lives...
From the looks of it, it was very likely that the other party was only a Sequence 7. Furthermore, it was inconvenient for him to take action personally, so he could only use spells to create monsters to fight the enemy...
However, there shouldn't be too much danger if he were to investigate it.
With this in mind, Ebner nodded and said, "I'll take a look at the villa. Take this Officer Shoko back to the detective agency and wait for me there."
"Officer Shoko?" Xio started, then caught herself. "So you recognize him."
"We met once before." Ebner first responded to Xio before solemnly exhorting, "It's best to leave this house as soon as possible and never approach it again."
Xio had already sensed that something was amiss from Ebner's attitude. She was mentally prepared, but when she heard this, she heaved a sigh of relief and nodded. "Understood."
She did not mention following Ebner because she knew that with her strength, she would only be a burden and might implicate Ebner.
After the two of them finished their discussion, Ebner left the garden villa at 8 Williams Street alone and headed towards a bigger house deep in the street.
In stealth mode, as soon as he approached the garden of the house, Ebner smelled the pungent scent of blood. His heart skipped a beat, and he didn't dare go through the front door. He drew a door on the sidewall and passed through.
He followed the smell all the way to a corner behind the house. Then, the smell of blood suddenly became stronger.
With the help of the faint moonlight that penetrated through the clouds, Ebner focused his gaze and nearly vomited.
The floor here was littered with broken leg bones, pelvis, heels, ribs, hair, and other human 'parts'. On the wall was the corpse of a lion-sized beast that had its insides completely emptied!
Large patches of red were flowing along the walls and the small path behind the house. There were even some traces of milky white.
Upon seeing this scene, Ebner's expression turned extremely ugly. He endured the discomfort and extracted the chaotic aura around him, then performed "Scene Retrack."
Soon, scenes appeared before his eyes.
The blood moon had just disappeared when a gentleman in his fifties with a lot of silver mixed in his black hair returned to the villa from outside. He didn't let the valet accompany him. Instead, he took a stroll in the garden as if he had something on his mind.
Suddenly, there was some movement in the grass in the garden. The gentleman looked over in surprise and saw a dirty puppet suddenly appear in his line of sight...
The scene suddenly came to an abrupt halt, as if it had been forcibly disrupted by some kind of power.
Ebner rubbed his temples, which were aching from the interruption of his ability. He immediately had a guess.
1-025?

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Original Story and Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 169 - Original Story and Invitation
1-025 once appeared here?
The owner of this place had obtained the Sealed Artifact and was distorted by the negative effects. That was why he committed such atrocities?
Hmm... It's also possible that he was completely controlled by 1-025!
As his thoughts raced, Ebner did not hesitate and directly simulated his "flying" ability to soar into the sky. To him, he had no obligation to investigate the matter. The reason he came was first because the enemy's strength was average, and secondly, out of sympathy for the kidnapped girl. If he could save her, he would have saved her.
However, if a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact could appear here, the situation would be completely different. If he didn't leave now, would he, a Sequence 7, stay behind to have supper with a suspected "cursed object"?
Ebner flew far away at full speed until he was almost in Hillston Borough. Only then did he slow down and heave a sigh of relief.
After returning to Detective Isengard's office, Ebner realized that he had returned a little earlier than Xio... He couldn't help but laugh. He felt that he was really timid. The first thought he had when he encountered a situation that he might not be able to handle was to escape.
If he hadn't noticed anything abnormal, he might not have stopped in Hillston Borough and flown to the Harvest Church.
Standing in the doorway of her teacher's house, Ebner let his mind wander as he waited for Xio to arrive.
At this moment, it was completely silent. The night was dark, and most of the people had already fallen asleep. He was the only one nearby, breathing in the cool air mixed with fragrances, creating some sizzling sounds.
Everything was peaceful and serene.
About ten minutes later, the arrival of a carriage broke the silence.
Xio had just jumped off the carriage when she saw Ebner waiting at the door. She couldn't help but exclaim, "So fast?"
"There was an accident..." As the carriage driver was still around, Ebner didn't talk much. Instead, he asked curiously, "You can hire a rental carriage at this late hour?"
"Bujolem is a friend of mine. He usually serves a merchant and also lives near Williams Street... Shoko hasn't woken up just now, so I had to trouble him," Xio casually explained before introducing the driver named Bujolem to Ebner.
"It's an honor to meet you, our 'hero detective.'" Bujolem smiled and greeted Ebner before continuing. "I'm glad I could help you, Miss Xio."
While Ebner was exchanging pleasantries with the coachman, Shoko, whose poison had not yet fully cleared from his body, struggled to get out of the carriage. When he saw Ebner, his face was full of gratitude and he kept thanking him.
Ebner had something else to ask him, so after saying goodbye to the coachman, he helped him into his room, and Xio joined him.
He turned on the gas lamp and heated up the Feysac cuisine that he had packed from Shewell Restaurant before placing it on a small table in the room. He made the two of them sit around the table and eat something.
Ebner then poured himself a cup of Sonia blood wine and asked Shoko, "Can you tell me how you discovered that Williams Street family was abducting girls?"
Xio glanced at a piece of cake smeared with cream in front of her. Without bothering to be polite to Ebner, she raised her hand and grabbed it.
Shoko, on the other hand, was more reserved. Although he was already very hungry, he deliberated for a moment before asking, "Detective Bryan, do you know Ma'am Leena?"
"Witch Leena? She's still in Backlund? Did you get your Assassin potion from her?" Ebner frowned. According to the news he had received, Leena had probably gone far away because of her father and brother's murder.
That news was sent to the Forsaken Land from Prince Edessak... In that case, Lina and His Highness might not have really fallen out.
As Ebner was thinking this, he heard Shoko praise him with mixed emotions.
As expected of a Hero Detective. He managed to deduce my situation with just a few words...
Anyone who knew a little about the Demoness pathway could guess it, right? This level of flattery wasn't enough.
While complaining in his heart, Ebner asked thoughtfully, "You're working for her... So, Leena instructed you to do this?"
"That's right." Shoko nodded and continued.
"Because I recently assassinated some scum from East Borough, Miss Lina was worried that I would be ambushed, so she gave me a mission to retrieve something from her at 16 Williams Street.
"Yes, 16 Williams Street was originally Lieutenant Berner's property, but a few weeks ago, the lieutenant mortgaged the house to the bank and took a large sum of money.
"Later, as you know, after the news of Lieutenant Berner's death spread, the bank immediately auctioned off the property and soon had a buyer.
"It was a gentleman who returned from East Balam with a large sum of cash in hand. He happened to buy the house.
Heh heh, I habitually gather this information. It looks very normal... But the night before I planned on taking action, I happened to discover this scum from East Balam hiring gang members to forcefully abduct a girl who was alone...
"And I recognize one of the girls... she's the fiancée of Inspector Wayne's youngest son, Miss Jennifer."
Ebner looked at the officer who had dared to make a scene at Inspector Wayne's funeral and immediately understood his motive. "So you just snuck in to save him?" he asked.
"I heard that that person would be going out to socialize tonight, and the bodyguards he hired would also be accompanying him, so... who would have thought that there would be such a ferocious beast in his house!" At this point, Shoko's expression turned ugly. It was obvious that his emotional fluctuation had affected his injuries. After a while, he asked again, "When you went to that villa previously, did you save the girl who was abducted?"
Ebner shook his head and sighed. "I didn't find anyone alive in that mansion..." It was the truth. He'd been running as fast as he could, but he really hadn't noticed the presence of a living person there.
Shoko deflated at that. "I don't know how sad Bruce will be... He's liked Jennifer since he was a kid..."
The three of them fell silent for a moment. Ebner arranged for Shoko, who was clearly in low spirits, to rest in the guest room. Then, he said to Xio, "Go and report to MI9 now. Tell them that there might be a Rose School of Thought werewolf in that villa."
"Didn't you say that..." Xio was puzzled at first, but she quickly reacted and said in enlightenment, "That's to attract MI9's attention?"
As he couldn't provide any evidence, it was impossible for Ebner to say anything about 1-025. Therefore, he could only use the Rose School of Thought as an excuse to report the case to the officials. And the Rose School of Thought had previously dispatched a demigod during the war in the northwest suburbs. It was unlikely that the military would take this matter lightly.
"That's right." Ebner nodded slightly. Although the Sealed Artifact appeared to be rather intelligent and might not reap much from the official operation, he had to give it a try.
"Alright, I'll go now." Xio had clearly thought of this as well. She immediately stood up and took another honey biscuit before leaving.
Ebner smiled and shook his head. After cleaning up the leftovers, he washed up and fell asleep on the bed.
The next morning, Ebner arrived at the garden villa in Cherwood Borough as usual.
Seeing him enter, Mrs. Skade quickly came up to him and said with a smile, "The renovation is complete, and the new furniture is ready... Yes, the books you bought over the past two days are also on the bookshelf."
"Very good." A smile appeared on Ebner's face upon hearing that. It was clear that the books he had bought at the last minute were used as cover for the Feast of Blood. Now that everything was ready, he could only wait for the actors to enter.
With that in mind, Ebner took out a pen and paper, wrote a list, and handed it to Mrs. Skade. "I'm going to hold a party here tomorrow night," he instructed. "I hope you and Mr. Skade are ready... and send the invitation to the address on this list."
Mrs. Skade nodded her assent at first, but when she took the list and looked at it, her expression became rather strange, for apart from Mr. Mac, Mr. Stanton, and a few other men at the top, it was all:
"Miss Xio Derecha,
Miss Fors Wall;
Miss Susan Ravenwood;
Miss Roman Brandon;
Daly Miss Simone.
...
"..."
Would there really be no problem? Mrs. Skade hesitated for a moment before asking tentatively, "Does... does everyone on this list really have to send an invitation?"

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Preparation
chapters.content:
Chapter 170 - Preparation
"All invited, of course." Ebner didn't think much of it. After giving Mrs. Skade another word of advice, he headed straight for the study in the mansion.
This study wasn't very big. There was only a row of bookshelves in front of the west wall. The rest of the layout was more like a living room.
When they arrived in front of the bookshelf, they were greeted with books like "Aristocrat heraldry", "History of the Intis Kingdom", "History of the Loen Kingdom's Aristocrats", and other books that Ebner had specially gotten Scard and his wife to purchase. These were the types that Xio preferred.
These books weren't cheap, and the bookshelf was filled with astonishing prices... Thankfully, the Church of Earth Mother had reimbursed them.
While he was thinking, Ebner tidied up the order of the books and placed the "Feast of Blood" that he had brought and tampered within a position that he could easily obtain.
After doing all this, he thought for a moment and decided to use the Solomon Gold Coin again at the banquet tomorrow night. Firstly, it would allow him to be a little luckier with his arrangements, and secondly, it could ensure that nothing unexpected happened during the banquet.
...
In the garden of 16 Williams Street, the bloody scene that Ebner had seen yesterday had been cleaned up. Even the lion-like beast that had been hollowed out was stored in a large box.
A handsome man in a neat suit was standing in the bedroom on the second floor of the villa. He was in his forties, mature and elegant.
He swept his golden eyes across the room and locked onto an empty cabinet.
At this moment, a man wearing a golden mask knocked on the door. After obtaining permission, he walked into the bedroom and reported to the Loen soldier in a standard posture,
"Your Excellency, this villa has been cleaned up. We have pieced together the complete remains of two women and a monster corpse that was transformed by a werewolf.
"This matches the information reported by one of our secret agents. From the looks of it, this might be a stronghold of the Rose School of Thought."
The handsome man in a well-ironed suit did not comment on this. After some thought, he asked, "Have you investigated the owner of this property?"
"Yes, Your Excellency. The owner of the house is called Quinn Seid. He's a tobacco merchant who returned from the Southern Continent and owns many tobacco plantations overseas.
"No one knows his exact experiences overseas. I only heard that his means aren't very clean... In addition, in order to compete for a business deal, he had previously deliberately instigated Tingen's desperado, Barkus, to kidnap the youngest son of a local tobacco merchant, Vickroy... This matter was ultimately resolved by Tingen's local Nighthawks team.
"And because Quinn's people only deliberately revealed some information about the tobacco merchant to Bacchus and didn't actually participate, and with a big name lawyer defending him, the matter was left unsettled. The police department didn't pursue it further."
When the handsome man heard this, he sneered and said, "How many merchants who earn big money overseas are clean? Especially when they do tobacco business... Do you have any other information about this person?"
The golden-masked MI9 member hesitated for a moment when he heard that, but he still answered, "According to the information gathered by our intelligence department, there are rumors that Mr. Quinn Said is actually working for the Sauron family, or he might even be a branch of the Sauron family... It's just that there's no concrete evidence."
"Intis' Sauron family?" the handsome man asked in surprise.
"Yes, Your Excellency. It's said that someone witnessed Quinn's appearance when he first went overseas. Back then, he didn't have black hair, but red hair," the masked MI9 man replied.
"Why would the Sauron family disguise themselves to settle down in Backlund... They even seem to have a connection with the Rose School of Thought..." The handsome man pondered for a moment before asking again, "Do you have anything else to add?"
"Yes, Your Excellency. This property was originally owned by Lieutenant Berner, who was transformed into a monster by Demoness of Afflictions Ray... We suspect that Quinn had another motive for buying this place," the man wearing a golden mask reported.
"A merchant from the Southern Continent... Could he be a believer of the Primordial Moon?" The handsome man muttered to himself before instructing, "Find out Quinn's whereabouts immediately. If necessary, inform the Nighthawks of this matter and borrow their manpower."
The MI9 member first responded before asking with uncertainty, "Don't we need to inform the Mandated Punishers? They have been searching for news of the Rose School of Thought recently."
"This is West Borough. Beyonder matters are under the jurisdiction of the Nighthawks, right? Besides, the Mandated Punishers don't have enough manpower to help us," the handsome man said with a chuckle.
After the golden-masked MI9 retreated, he cast his gaze at the cabinet he had previously noticed and muttered silently,
"Could it be 1-025?"
...
After leaving the villa in Cherwood Borough, Ebner took a public carriage to Saint Samuel Cathedral in the North Borough.
After all, dinner yesterday hadn't been reimbursed... In addition, he had to personally hand over the invitation to Madam Daly since there wasn't a specific address.
Sitting in the public carriage heading to North Borough's Phelps Street, Ebner leisurely looked at the Daily Observer he had bought before boarding the carriage. On the front page, he read:
"A kind lady was brutally murdered! After investigation, it turned out to be a serial case. It's known to be the sixth case!"
Here is a detailed description of the life of the murdered Lady Harja, from her miserable childhood to her struggle to finally own a small restaurant of her own, to the elevation of her class. This comparison reflects the wickedness of the murderer who cruelly robbed her of her new life.
Ebner didn't think much of it. From the police dossiers he had previously read, he knew that countless people mysteriously disappeared or even died in Backlund every day... In comparison, the number of casualties caused by the Devil dog was limited.
The reason why it was so highly regarded was because its methods were too cruel, and it did not avoid ordinary people, so the impact it caused was rather bad.
East Borough, the factory district, and the dock area were filled with legitimate "Devils" that ate humans. They were not lacking a Devil dog...
However, Ebner wasn't the original protagonist. He didn't have much feelings for the plight of ordinary people in this era. He might feel pity and lament over Klein's plight, but he didn't have Klein's "great love" or his determination as a Guardian. After all, he was only concerned about himself and his friends and elders...
As for the others? Unless they were the original characters that he liked, he would only take care of them if he had the ability to. He would not take the initiative to do anything.
After reading the newspaper several times, the public carriage finally stopped at Phelps Street.
There was a pure black cathedral with bell towers on both sides. It had a symmetrical beauty. It was none other than the Church of Evernight's Backlund diocese headquarters, Saint Samuel Cathedral.
Ebner stepped close to the church. Even without entering the prayer hall of the church, he still felt a sense of peace.
He wanted to ask Madam Daly about her location through the priest, but he was lucky. Before he entered, he saw Madam Daly's assistant—Miss Chelly walking out of a nearby building with a lunchbox.
Ebner hurriedly chased after her. After exchanging greetings, he stated his intentions.
After hearing his request, Chelly thought for a moment and nodded. "Follow me. I happen to be delivering lunch to Madam Daly."
Then, Ebner followed Chelly around the Saint Samuel Cathedral and came to a narrow street. Finally, they stopped at the entrance of a security company named Black River.
The girl at the front desk was obviously surprised by Chelly's action of bringing someone back. After whispering to Chelly, she looked at Ebner in surprise.
Ebner pretended not to hear the gossip between the two ladies and sat for a moment in the reception room of the company. Then he saw Ms. Daly, her face smeared with blue eye shadow and blush.
Before Ebner could take the initiative to greet her, Madam Daly teased with a faint smile,
"I'm sorry that I didn't see the headlines of today's newspaper headlines such as 'Eating a luxurious meal without paying the bill, the Hero Detective maliciously flees'."
Ma'am, so you're also aware that you tricked me yesterday.
Ebner grumbled under his breath, then handed her the attached page of last night's bill. He had no embarrassing thoughts.
Daly took it and glanced at it. She said with a smile, "You really don't pretend to be forthright... You should know that handing the bill to a lady is not a gentleman's action."
Ebner ignored her joke. The fact that she hadn't returned the bill was in itself a tacit agreement that it would be reimbursed.
"Also, this is the information His Excellency, the Sword of the Goddess, needed yesterday. I've organized it into a written document." Ebner then handed Daly the information regarding the Devil pathway that he had prepared this morning.
This time, Daly stopped smiling and accepted it with a solemn expression. However, after flipping through a few pages, she smiled again and said playfully,
"Why are 'Devils' invitations for girls? Eh? And for me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 171 - Gift
"What?" Ebner was shocked. He thought he had taken the information about the Devil wrong.
At this moment, Daly only took out the invitation card that she had given her from the information. Then, she said with a teasing smile, "I was just joking when I saw this stuck inside... I didn't expect it to touch the truth?"
"This isn't funny at all... Madam Daly," Ebner said helplessly as he touched his forehead.
"Alright, I'll accept this invitation. Heh heh, you're quite lucky. I happen to be free on Wednesday night." Daly's eyes darted around as she put away the "Devil" document and said.
In fact, because the Mandated Punisher elite from the Thunder Cathedral arrived a day later than expected, the plan to leave for Tingen on Wednesday was postponed until Thursday... However, the reason for this was not explained to Ebner.
...
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
An abnormally cruel murder happened near Saint Samuel Cathedral in North Borough. The victim's death was extremely terrifying... Audrey, who had finished her lunch, casually flipped through the Backlund Evening News in the activity room.
Upon hearing his daughter's whisper, Earl Hall shook his head and sighed.
"It's said that this is the sixth such case, but the police and official Beyonders have no clues."
Upon hearing her father's words, Audrey wished she could transform into a detective and bring Susie to capture that detestable fellow. However, she knew that it was impossible. She could only turn to ask, "Where's that Hero Detective? Doesn't he have any clues?"
Earl Hall, who had a beautiful mustache, chuckled and said, "If every tricky case is solved by a detective, how do you think the police will feel?"
"The police deliberately didn't let Detective Bryan join the investigation of this case? How could they do that? That's a bunch of lives!" Audrey immediately frowned and said angrily.
"My beautiful princess, you have to believe in the police's abilities. When they get serious, they might not be worse than that Hero Detective... Furthermore, the Goddess's guards have already joined the investigation." After Earl Hall said that, he tapped his chest four times.
"Praise the Lady." Audrey also drew a crimson moon on her chest.
After lunch, Audrey returned to her room. After finding an excuse to dismiss all the maidservants, she looked at the gifts that Annie had recommended and said to Susie worriedly,
"Susie, do you think this waist made of pure silver is better hung, or that three wreath-shaped headdress looks better?
"Or this feathered hat?
"Gosh, I think that gemstone accessory is beautiful too..."
Susie wagged her tail and answered straightforwardly, "They taste very hard when they bite."
Following that, it saw Audrey's expression collapse as she tilted her head and said, "Since you can't choose a suitable one, why don't you give it all away?"
Audrey's eyes lit up when she heard that. She thought to herself, That's right. Why should I worry about this? I'll let Mr. Tower choose it himself! It's not worth much anyway.
With this in mind, she immediately gave Susie a look. The latter had a tacit understanding and ran out to guard the door without any verbal communication.
As for Audrey, she locked the door and sat by the bed, chanting Mr. Fool's honorific name.
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"You are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog.
"You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.
"I wish to pray to you and express my request.
"I wish to hand over the items I promised Mr. Tower to him."
After waiting for a few seconds, a dark red light surged out in front of her. Following that, she saw the boundless gray fog and the majestic and mysterious figure behind it.
"I understand."
As the calm and solemn words sounded in her ears, the phenomenon in front of Audrey's eyes vanished as she returned to her room.
Mr. Fool responded so quickly! With that in mind, she quickly set up the altar and placed all the gifts into a luxurious-looking bag.
...
Above the gray fog, Klein, who was reading through the information regarding the Antigonus family, couldn't help but click his tongue when he checked the gift that Miss Justice had "sacrificed."
Although he couldn't recognize the brands, he could tell from the style that they weren't cheap. Some of the premium products were definitely worth more than 10 pounds...
And Miss Justice actually planned on giving such a precious item to Tower? How rich!
...
At Isengard Detective Agency in Hillston Borough.
Just as he returned from the North Borough, Ebner received a notice that Mr. Fool was receiving items. Therefore, he returned to his room, created a wall of spirituality, and began the "bestowment" ritual.
As the "door to the kingdom" opened, a handbag covered with a feathered hat landed in front of him.
"So many?" After ending the ceremony, Ebner opened the handbag and was dazzled by the various accessories inside.
He played with the head accessory, front accessory, and waist accessory in his hand for a while before deciding to hand over the power of choice to Cullen.
Following that, he set up the ritual again and recited in ancient Hermes,
"Me!
"I summon in my name:
"A spirit that wanders between life and death, a friendly friend that can be driven, a messenger that belongs solely to Cullen Tia."
As the surrounding temperature dropped, Ebner saw an illusory, silver-winged bird emerge from the void through his Spirit Vision.
As soon as it landed, it looked at Ebner before turning its head to look at the handbag that was only three meters tall.
Ebner immediately unscrewed the cap of the bottle of Amantha extract he had prepared and placed it in front of the little bird, Silika.
"Silika" let out a few "happy" noises and sucked the extract into her mouth. Then, she flapped her wings and expanded her illusory wings, firmly wrapping the handbag and hat inside.
When it was done, it tilted its head and chirped at Ebner a few times before wrapping itself around the handbag and disappearing.
Seeing that Silika had successfully taken away the gift, Ebner released his spirituality seal.
After tidying up the ritual items in the room, he pushed open the bedroom door and saw Shoko, who was temporarily staying at his teacher's house, walk over.
"Are you feeling better?" Ebner asked, slightly concerned.
"Thank you for your help. The toxins have been completely removed." Shoko thanked him gratefully before turning to Ebner with a solemn expression. "Detective Bryan, I have something to tell you."
Abner nodded and let him into his room. He made a cup of coffee and brought it to him. "What's the matter?"
"Lena... She wishes to deliver this necklace to you!" Shoko said as she took off the necklace with five gems embedded in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Necklace
chapters.content:
Chapter 172 - Necklace
"The necklace Lena gave you? What was she planning to do?"
Ebner did not immediately take the necklace from Shoko. Instead, he secretly activated the Eye of Pure White and analyzed it in detail.
"The main body of the necklace is made from the scales of a demigod-level five-colored gem dragon from the Reader pathway. In other words, it's the five different-colored gems embedded on the pure silver chain.
"Due to the passage of time and the constant use of this Beyonder item, a lot of its powers have been lost. From the initial use of 16 basic powers and 8 mystic arts, to now only having 8 basic powers and 2 mystic arts, more than half of the powers it contains have been lost. It's estimated that it will be completely useless in another three to five years.
"Currently, there are three Sequence 6 abilities that can be used. They are the Sun pathway's Notary, the Hanged Man pathway's Flesh Magic, and the Tyrant pathway's Deep Stealth.
"There are also three Sequence 7 abilities. They are the Sun pathway's Holy Light Summoning, the Visionary pathway's Placate, and the Hanged Man pathway's Hidden Shadow.
"Sequence 8 abilities only have one mind-reading ability. Sequence 9 abilities also have one Mirage Scale.
"As for the two secret arts, they are the core powers of this necklace. They are both at Sequence 5. They are Evans' Concealment and Vaulitt's Perfect Recovery.
"Evans' Concealment Barrier is based on analyzing Sequence 9's Mirage Scale, Sequence 8's Telepathic Heart, and Sequence 7's Shadow Hiding. It's formed from the core characteristics of these abilities. Finally, it can be strengthened through the effects of Notary. Once it's cast, it will form a phantom scale-like barrier around the body. It can hide one's figure, making one invisible in both the visual and psychological sense. It can also effectively resist detection methods like divination.
"Vaulitt's Perfect Recovery Art is a secret art formed from the combination of two Sequence 7 powers, Holy Light Summoning and Placate, as well as Flesh Magic and Deep Stealth. When used, it can form a blood cocoon around the body. In theory, as long as one isn't dead, any injuries can be quickly healed. Furthermore, due to the existence of Holy Light and Placate, even if the evil anomaly invades the body or even the symptoms of losing control, there's a ten to twenty percent chance of being rescued.
"The material of this necklace comes from the scales of a demigod-level dragon. Although it can effectively enhance the anti-divination and repulsion powers of Evans's Concealment Barrier, it also has certain corruption.
"Wearing it for a long period of time will gradually turn into greed, laziness, and lust.
"Use 'Vaulitt's Perfect Recovery' cautiously. This is because, after the Blood Cocoon recovers, one's personality will deviate slightly from the previous three states if one doesn't have strong mental protection."
Looking at the analysis report sent by the Eye of Pure White, Ebner frowned. It was not because the necklace was bad, but because it was too powerful. It was even more perfect than his trump card, the Ring of Light ring.
Although this necklace only had the ability of pure support, not to mention the eight basic skills, just the two 'secret skills' were enough for him to gain a lot.
The functions of these two 'secret arts' were secondary. The key was that their 'combination' provided an idea. This made Ebner have many new ideas. When he became a 'secret arts mentor' in the future, he might take fewer detours.
Of course, he wasn't even an erudite scholar at the moment. He was still far from being a Mysticism Magister. What was more important now was to figure out why Leena had given him such a precious Beyonder item.
Therefore, after closing the Eye of Pure White, Ebner thought for a moment before asking, "Shoko, do you and Lena know the ability of this necklace?"
Shoko had noticed that Ebner had been staring at the necklace. Although he found it strange, he had been waiting patiently. Now that he was asked, he hurriedly replied, "I know. The old man who handed this necklace to me once described its ability in detail to me..." Then, he repeated the ability of this Beyonder item as if he was familiar with it. From the process, it was obvious that he had memorized it.
Ebner was not in a hurry to interrupt him. Instead, he compared his description with his analysis report and found that other than the material of the necklace, everything else was basically the same. He did not even hide the negative effects.
After Shoko explained the function of the necklace, she looked at Ebner, who was deep in thought and added, "It was precisely because of that negative effect that I did not dare to use 'Perfect Recovery' after I was poisoned. I could only barely resist it with 'flesh magic'..."
Ebner nodded. Then he thought of a new character revealed in Shoko's earlier words and couldn't help but ask, "You said it was a 'necklace' given to you by an old man? Wasn't it Lena?"
"To be precise, I brought this necklace to Lena..." Shoko shook his head.
"What exactly happened?" Ebner frowned, feeling that this matter was getting more complicated.
Shoko replied as he recalled,
"That would have to start from Inspector Wayne's funeral... After I was chased out of the cemetery that day, I was extremely depressed due to my unwillingness and hatred for my incompetence. At the very most, due to my depressed state, I unknowingly fell asleep in a park by the street...
"In my sleep, I met an old man. He told me many things and asked me to bring something to Lena... When I woke up again, the necklace appeared in my hand."
Ebner interrupted and asked, "What did the old man look like? What did he tell you?"
I couldn't see the old man's face clearly, or perhaps I forgot after I woke up... As for what he told me, it was actually very simple. Apart from the introduction of the necklace, there was some information about Lena and how to find her.
"In the end, he asked me to tell Lena something... Because he repeatedly asked me to repeat it in my dream, I still remember it very clearly." Shoko recalled the experiences in her dream. Without waiting for Ebner to ask, she continued,
"He said that although the ring he gave you last time allowed you to 'luckily' avoid several pursuits, you ultimately couldn't escape the Demoness's senses... And this necklace can temporarily block the 'mark' she left on you."
This sounds like it's about Ray chasing after Lena... Mark? It can't be the divine corruption of the Primordial Moon that Judy mentioned, right? I remember that the last time I contacted the Witch, Judy had already helped her completely eliminate the corruption... After all, all the godhood had been destroyed by the three holy items. The corruption brought about by it naturally became rootless.
As for Lucky's ring, it can't be the ring she used to forcefully escape the effects of the Language of Foulness during my battle with Lena, right? When I received it, I also used Solomon Gold Coin... No wonder I always felt that I wasn't lucky that day... What's this? Is it the "Lucky" inner scroll?
However, who was supporting Lena from behind? To actually deliver two such precious Beyonder items in succession! Although they seemed to have timely effects and weren't forged from Beyonder characteristics, if they were to be sold at a gathering, there would definitely be people willing to pay a high price for them.
Furthermore, I suspect that the reason why Lena was able to escape from Ray and successfully hide under Prince Edessak's wings was because of this mysterious person's interference...
Hmm, this method of doing things... It can't be the Psychology Alchemists, right? Hvin Rambis? He wants to guide Lena to betray Ray and then sell the information to the Forsaken Ones? What role does Judy's mother play in this?
But that wasn't right, because if that was the case, just giving her a Lucky ring was enough. There was no need to give her such a precious necklace... After all, Lena had already revealed the information to Judy.
It was difficult for Ebner to grasp the truth of the matter, so he decided not to think too much about it. He asked Shoko again, "This thing's origins are unclear. Lena is also afraid that if she continues to hold it, it will bring about some kind of disaster, right?"
"So that's how it is..." Shoko was stunned for a moment before she came to a realization. "I thought she really wanted to help me return your favor..."
With that said, he added, "She previously told me that you killed the Demoness of Afflictions and avenged Inspector Wayne. I should express my gratitude to you and even offer this necklace as a gift."
Ebner was somewhat speechless when he heard that. He thought to himself that such an excuse would only fool a rookie Beyonder like Shoko. No one would believe it.
However, would he be able to get rid of it just by giving it away? All the gifts of fate had already been marked in secret. Since Lena had accepted the old man's help, she must have become his pawn...
Unless... giving the item to me is also part of the old man's plan or 'arrangement'.
Then, this couldn't be a setup by the Psychology Alchemists.
Perhaps, there was more than one elder who gave Lena the extraordinary item. Who said that the person who gave her the necklace was the one who gave her the ring? Was it him?
Ebner had a vague guess at this point, but he dared not dwell on it.
However, he still reached out to take the necklace. He planned on sending it to the Harvest Church in a while. He would first ask Earth Mother, who was currently the friendliest to him.
In the eyes of many people, he was already a Blessed of Earth Mother. Even if the person behind the scenes was paying attention to this matter, he wouldn't find it a problem to bring the necklace there.
As for Mr. Fool, it was best to wait until the next Tarot Club to ask. The "contributions" he had accumulated so far weren't enough. It was probably impossible for him to let Mr. Fool divine something of unknown origins.
After he divines the Eternal Blazing Sun and has a good idea of the upper limit of the gray fog's powers, he will help me appraise it without any qualms.
At that thought, Ebner straightened his thoughts and asked Shoko one last question. "What is the name of this necklace?"
"It's called Fallen Morning Star."

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Cullen’s Reply
chapters.content:
Chapter 173 - Cullen's Reply
Fallen Morning Star? The name is not bad... but why do I feel like it's familiar, but I can't recall it? Could it be that its information that I temporarily forgot because it involves a higher level?
Ebner frowned and put the matter aside for the moment. He looked at Shoko in front of him and asked something he hadn't had time to ask last night. "You said Lena wanted you to go to 16 Williams Street to retrieve something that was supposed to be hers... What was that?"
Shoko hesitated for a moment. After all, that was different from what had happened before. It was Lena's privacy. For a moment, he wondered if he should tell Ebner.
The conflicted look on his face was so obvious that Ebner could easily read his thoughts. "Then you don't need to say anything. Let me make a deduction."
Shoko heaved a sigh of relief when he heard that and nodded subconsciously. He deeply felt that Detective Bryan was really an understanding and kind person... However, unfortunately, he was still unwilling to reveal Madam Lena's privacy. This was his principle as a person.
At this moment, Ebner had already activated the Eye of Pure White and simulated the mind-reading ability he had learned from the Fallen Morning Star. He "read" part of the information in Shoko's shallow thoughts, so he said, "That's a Beyonder item that Lena often uses, right?"
Shock ran through Shoko at that. She hadn't expected the first line of Detective Bryan's reasoning to close in on the truth.
It should be a claw-shaped Beyonder item... Ice Claw? Does that mean that she lost this Sealed Artifact later? As Ebner "read" Shoko's superficial thoughts, he inferred based on his battle with Lena.
Shoko's eyes were already staring straight. He sighed and said, "As expected of a Hero Detective... It's no wonder you were able to crack so many major cases. Such reasoning ability is like seeing it with your own eyes. Could this be the deduction method mentioned by Emperor Roselle?"
Roselle had even mentioned the "acting method"? From the looks of it, it was true that he had never seen the "Sherlock Holmes" before...
Ebner grumbled to himself, then analyzed. 'Lena used Ice Claw when she fought me at the warehouse. And before the ball at the Daily Observer headquarters, Ray must have moved away from the villa at 16 Williams Street...'
I remember that I met Lena on August 1, Wednesday, while the Daily Observer ball was on Friday night...
No, Cullen had once mentioned that before the battle in the northwest suburbs, the Mandated Punishers had used that 1-025 to divine Ray. There was also an encounter near William Street, but because the Demoness was prepared, the Mandated Punishers had a Wind-blessed heavily injured...
In that case, before that encounter, Ray might still have snuck back to the house of number 16 and conveniently placed Ice Claw there.
Well, more than a week in between should have been the time Lena's "luck" failed and Ray found it and lost Ice Claw because of it.
As for Inspector Wayne's funeral, it was the second day after he helped Roman catch the adulterer. That was also the day that the old man handed the "Fallen Morning Star" to Shoko...
Indeed, the two elderly men who delivered the Beyonder items were not the same person!
The former should have given up on Lena after she connected with the Forsaken One. Although she had not told Judy about Ray's information at that time, she had most likely revealed it to Prince Edessak. Even if she was killed by Ray, this information would still fall into the hands of the Forsaken One. She had no value then, so the "lucky" ring had failed.
As for the old man who used Shoko to hand over the "Fallen Morning Star" to Lena, he probably hoped that Lena would continue to live... However, I still can't figure out what plans he has...
Ebner's mind raced, and he smiled as his mind wandered to answer Shoko's earlier question. "That's the charm of 'reasoning.'"
Although he failed to protect Ma'am Lena's privacy, Shoko wasn't depressed. After all, he wasn't the one who leaked the information. It was just that Detective Bryan was too powerful. He was able to deduce the entire process of the matter with just a few clues.
After that, Shoko bade farewell to Ebner. The latter didn't urge him to stay and only reminded him tactfully, "The Assassin pathway will undergo major changes at Sequence 7."
But seeing Shoko's unconcerned look, Ebner felt that his good intentions were wasted.
After Shoko left, Ebner looked at his pocket watch and saw that it was past three o'clock. He quickly picked up "Fallen Morning Star" and left the house. He took the subway to Moon Flower Street, which was south of the Bridge.
In the Harvest Church, Ebner, who was pushing open the door, suddenly felt his spirituality stir. He hurriedly activated his Spirit Vision and saw a chick struggling to escape from the void with a handbag.
"Silika?" Ebner asked in surprise. He did not have "Amantha" or any other spiritual material powder with him.
The little bird, Silika, put down the handbag and chirped at Ebner a few times before taking out a letter from the opening of the handbag.
Ebner took the envelope. He was embarrassed to see Silika staring at him without moving, so he simulated a little psychic aura, condensed it on his finger, and placed it in front of Birdie.
Silika approached curiously at first and lowered her body as if she was smelling it. Then, she turned her head away with an obviously disgusted expression and chirped a few more times.
At that moment, Hazel, who was praying with Bishop Utravsky, turned her head and saw this scene. She fell silent for a moment before walking over. She took out some spiritual materials and placed them on Silika's ground.
Silika then let out a few joyful cries and flapped her silver illusory wings to sweep up the spiritual materials before disappearing.
"Thank you very much." Ebner looked at Hazel and smiled. "I wouldn't know how to entertain 'Silika' without your help."
"Even if you don't give her anything, she won't do anything. At best, she'll be a little angry. Next time, she'll throw the letter right in your face," Hazel said dryly.
"There's such a thing? Are you—er—very close to her?" Ebner asked, surprised.
"After all, I've already lived here for ten days. I also know Mr. Cullen and Madam Judy... One time, Silika was in a bad mood, so she directly threw the letter at Mr. Cullen's head." Although Hazel's tone was calm, there was a hint of a smile in her voice at the end.
However, this once arrogant girl quickly restrained her expression and turned back to the Earth Mother's Sacred Emblem to continue praying.
Ebner was not surprised to see this. After all, he had seen such scenes many times before. He was in no hurry to ask the bishop about the "Fallen Morning Star". Instead, he opened Cullen's reply.
"Pure silver products... Although we Sanguine isn't afraid, we don't really like them.
Speaking of which, you really are similar to Roselle. The first gift he gave me was all pure silver...
"In addition, I think that the feathered hat is very suitable, so I chose it as a gift. You can return the rest of the jewelry.
"Your friend, Cullem."

chapters.title: Chapter 174: New Storm
chapters.content:
Chapter 174 - New Storm
Seemed like it wasn't too good to give silver accessories to the Sanguine... Besides, Roselle had done so before. Could it be that the emperor was expressing his dissatisfaction over the fact that the Sanguine didn't send a Beauty Goddess to help?
After lampooning inwardly, Ebner picked up the handbag that contained a lot of jewelry. He planned on "sacrificing" it to Klein the next time he transacted with the Tarot Club members so that he could return it to Miss Justice. This way, he could save on the cost of "sacrificing" the materials.
Bishop Utravsky ended his prayer and sent Hazel back underground before returning. He looked down at him and said gently,
"I already know why you're here. That item isn't dangerous to you, nor is it the setup of some deity. However, you have to use it as little as possible."
These words directly blocked Ebner's question. After a while, he heaved a sigh of relief and thought, "Is Lilith very free every day? Why did she send an oracle over such a small matter... Does she really think highly of me? How did I gain her favor?"
However, since the necklace wasn't dangerous, he could really get Mr. Fool to help investigate its origins...
Previously, he was still a little worried that The Fool might face a deity because of this, even though the other party would seek death this weekend to see the Eternal Blazing Sun's "appearance."
As for the scheme behind the necklace's true owner? With Earth Mother memorizing the book, he was actually no longer afraid.
Besides, once a Fallen Morning Star was caught in the gray fog, all his plans would fall through.
Bishop Utravsky, who had sparse eyebrows, light blue eyes, and a few obvious wrinkles, saw that he was much more relaxed. He smiled and said, "In the afternoon, Skade came over and talked about your ball at the villa."
Ebner snapped out of his daze and casually asked, "Is he here to send you an invitation?"
Bishop Utravsky shook his head gently and said with a smile, "He's here to seek my remedy. After all, this is his first time being a butler."
"A remedy? Did something happen to him?" Ebner asked curiously. He did not receive any reports about this when he went to the villa in the morning.
"Is it because of your invitation list... I heard that you invited many unmarried ladies?" the bishop asked with a smile.
"Yeah, what's wrong with that? I invited a lot of men too..." Ebner said after some thought.
Didn't Member of Parliament Macht also invite the unmarried Ma'am Daly? There's no taboo, right?
"If you already have a wife, or if your mother and other female seniors are around, or if you even have sisters, that's fine. But... have you ever thought about who will receive the ladies when they arrive? Your banquet lacks a hostess to entertain female guests," Bishop Utravsky said gently.
This... seems to be a problem... Ebner finally realized what was wrong.
Speaking of which, the banquet itself was a cover for Xio to come into contact with The Fool's honorific name. The reason why so many people were invited was to lower Xio's guard further, allowing her to unknowingly recite the ancient Hermes name in the atmosphere of the banquet.
As for the preparations for the banquet, he didn't care at all. He subconsciously felt that Xio or Fors could help him entertain the female guests, but now that he thought about it carefully, it was indeed inappropriate... Although they were good friends, he couldn't just treat them as mistresses.
This was not a class reunion in his previous life, but a formal social gathering in this era. He had to follow the rules.
Otherwise, there was a high chance that he would be reported in the tabloids tomorrow... However, there was a high chance that he would not have a good reputation this time.
"It's also Lady Skade's first time doing such a job, so she only realized what was wrong after sending out the invitation. She asked her husband to come to me to seek a solution," the bishop said with a chuckle.
"Have you thought of a solution?" Ebner asked diffidently.
"It's very simple. Just find an older and famous person to host the banquet on your behalf... However, this way, the main character of the banquet won't be you. Furthermore, the scale of the guests will increase. Can you accept it?" Bishop Utravsky asked while giving a solution.
"That won't be a problem..." Ebner breathed a sigh of relief, thinking: Anyway, his main goal wasn't to increase his social network.
"In that case, I'll get Member of Parliament Macht and his wife to help you host this banquet in a while... Heh heh, I believe they will agree because I'll be bringing Hazel with me when the time comes. It will be a good opportunity for them to meet." Bishop Utravsky nodded.
In fact, it's to turn my good friend gathering into your preaching banquet, right? Is this taking advantage of the fact that the Church of Storms owes the Forsaken One a favor and crazily playing the sidelines?
Ebner grumbled, but outwardly expressed gratitude to the half-giant bishop.
After that, Ebner especially looked at the preaching platform in front of him and realized that there was no new transcribed diary on it. He then bade farewell to the bishop in disappointment and left the Harvest Church.
At the same time, in the storage room behind the Harvest Church, a handsome, devilish-looking man who was standing in a corner like a statue in a red shirt and black turtleneck suddenly opened his eyes.
He raised his head and looked to the north with a hint of mockery on his lips. He thought to himself, That old dragon's luck is as bad as ever. He doesn't have any knowledge when it comes to scheming... If he didn't have the knowledge to make 'arrangements' with 'His' arrangements, 'His' previous plans would have long been discovered by that person... Even though he died once, 'He' still doesn't know that person well enough.
...
North Borough, Bellette Street.
Fors opened the invitation Xio had brought back and tsked. "Ebner has finally moved into his new residence? And it's a garden villa? When did he become so rich?"
"It seems to be a house gifted to the Church of Earth Mother by the Church of Storms. Ebner is only looking after it on behalf of the Church of Earth Mother."
"The Church of Earth Mother treats him so well? He isn't even a believer of the Earth Mother, is he?" Fors said enviously before changing the topic "indignantly." By the way, Xio, Viscount Glaint came to me today. He wishes for us to bring him to the Beyonder trading gathering held by Mr. A the day after tomorrow night. Yes, Miss Audrey might come along. "
"No problem. I'll protect them." Xio nodded solemnly. This was something she had promised, so she naturally wouldn't go back on her word.
Although she had now joined MI9 and had the hope of investigating the truth behind her father's case, Miss Audrey's line couldn't be severed. It would definitely be helpful to build a good relationship with her.
Moreover, she had a good impression of that kind lady and was willing to be friends with her.
...
Cherwood Borough, in the villa of the timber merchant, Lester.
Miss Irene and her lover, Detective Zreal, had just finished a "fierce battle." While cleaning herself, she said casually, "I've already found out the time and address of Mr. A's party through my friends... Honey, do you want to know?"
"Of course I do, my beautiful Miss Irene." Detective Zreal brightened at the suggestion. He didn't want to miss any clues about the possible second-generation difference machine.
"Well, then, dear detective, what can you bring me?" asked Miss Irene, as she straightened her clothes and smiled at the detective, who was still smoking in bed.
Detective Zreal thought for a moment and asked, "I heard that you've been asking about the Hero Detective recently? Do you want to know him?"
"Of course I do! I boasted in front of my friends that I would invite Detective Bryan to my party... But that useless Evan can't do anything!" Irene was immediately interested and scolded her current boyfriend.
"That young man from the cafe manager's house? I think he really has feelings for you..." Detective Zreal said first, then sighed and changed his words. "Forget it, I won't persuade you... Anyway, I received an invitation to Detective Bryan's banquet at his new residence. Do you want to come with me?"
"Of course, darling, you're much more reliable than the kid in the cafe!" Irene threw herself into his arms and kissed him. Then she organized her words and said, "I heard that Mr. A's party will be held this Thursday night. The specific address is in Queens... Well, I'll take you there then."
"Very good. Detective Bryan's banquet is tomorrow night, so there's no need for conflict." After Detective Zreal finished speaking, he felt that he had recovered enough strength to stand up.
...
In the Intis embassy, under the service of Robert, the Wind-blessed, who had put on makeup, Marionettist Rosago was eating supper while reading a newspaper.
When he saw the news of the acquisition, he was taken aback for a second before he silently muttered to himself,
"Mr. A's gathering is scheduled for the night after tomorrow?"

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Nighttime
chapters.content:
Chapter 175 - Nighttime
East Borough, Black Palm Street.
On summer nights, even the wind carried some heat. Wearing a full set of workers' clothes, Aetris's head was covered in sweat. He couldn't help but reminisce about his days at sea. Although it was also very hot and humid, he could easily bare his shoulders. It wasn't like Backlund, where even in East Borough, the act of completely taking off his clothes would attract attention.
After an unknown period of time, without a map, he relied on his intuition to arrive at a familiar crossroad. This was the place he had stepped on a few days ago.
There were very few street lamps here, and only one or two could be seen from afar. If it weren't for the fact that the dark clouds hadn't covered the crimson moon tonight, he believed that many roads would be so dark that he wouldn't be able to see clearly.
As he walked, he suddenly heard a curse from ahead.
"Get up! All of you, get up!
"You can't sleep here, you b* tch!
"The streets and parks are not a place for lazy dogs like you to sleep!"
Stunned for a moment, the corresponding words
"Poor Law"
popped up in his mind, and he understood what was going on. When he was a police officer in the past, he often did similar things during night patrols. Back then, he thought it was nothing and that he did it to protect the laws of the kingdom...
However, ever since he ventured out into the world outside Backlund and truly experienced the lives of the poor at the bottom—to the point of waking up to the sting of batting sticks while sleeping in the park—he began to doubt the legitimacy of his previous actions. He often thought...
Is that really correct? Why would the Senators of the two Houses formulate such an unreasonable law?
He had once asked this question to his guide in the Beyonder world, Mr.
Strongest Hunter Anderson.
Mr. Anderson sneered and replied, "Because those councilors can represent the interests of the nobles, the interests of the factory owners, the interests of the Church, and even the interests of the emerging classes. However, none of them are truly the lowest of the low. Of course, they won't speak for them."
After that, Mr. Anderson told him that theses on sociology and politics could even fill up more than ten large bookshelves at Lenburg University. However, no matter how clear the discussion was, it was useless. After all, in this world, those with power had the final say.
At that time, Aetris expressed his yearning for the University of Lenburg. Unexpectedly, Mr. Anderson laughed so hard that he couldn't stand up on the spot. Then, he threw Aetris a test paper and told him to stop dreaming if he didn't score above 85 points.
That "dream" ended completely because Aetris didn't know any of the questions on the test paper...
At the memory, Aetris shook his head to get rid of the jumbled thoughts. Then he got his bearings and headed for the right street.
The streets of this area were controlled by the Pauleys, who managed a large number of street girls who pulled in patrons at bars and the edge of the road to do unspeakable things.
This district was considered a "bustling" area in East Borough. All kinds of buildings were relatively better, and the streets weren't that dirty. The air was filled with the smell of oyster soup, fried fish, ginger beer, and other food drinks left behind by street vendors, as well as the fishy smell of fish and aquatic products.
Not in the mood to observe the place, Aetris hurried to an old apartment building. Just as he was about to enter, he suddenly saw a thirteen-year-old girl walking out of Broken Axe Lane on the other side of the street. She was wearing a dark yellow dress that had been sewn countless times, and she was holding a vocabulary book.
Behind her was a young girl who was slightly older, about 17 or 18 years old, also wearing an old dress. She chased after her younger sister, complaining that she was walking too fast and not waiting.
However, they soon saw Aetris standing in front of the apartment. The older girl's face immediately darkened as she shouted, "Why are you here again? You're not welcome here!"
At this moment, her sister tugged on her sleeve and turned to look at Aetris. "Sir, I know you're a noble gentleman, but you've brought my father's belongings back as you promised. Now that you've fulfilled your promise to him, please stop disturbing our lives, okay?"
Aetris forced a smile and said in a low voice, "I just saw that you haven't moved out of East Borough for so many days. I wanted to ask if you have any difficulties... Is it because you don't have enough money? After all, I owe Sam..."
"Sir, this is East Borough," the younger girl said, emphasizing her point.
After a moment of silence, he understood. This was East Borough, the most chaotic place in Backlund. If this family of women were to suddenly move, even a fool would know they had gotten an unexpected windfall. It was impossible for him to provide protection at all times... Perhaps the money he had given them previously would harm them instead.
"Sir, we are already very grateful to you. At least Mother doesn't have to be so tired anymore... So, don't disturb us anymore, okay? Your arrival will only make us more dangerous." The younger girl emphasized again, her voice low.
"Alright..." At last, Aetris nodded helplessly. Then, he handed her two letters and said, "If you encounter anything you can't solve, take this letter to the police department in Cherwood Borough to look for Sergeant Faxin. He'll provide some help when he sees the letter... As for the other letter, if there's something even Sergeant Faxin can't handle, take it to
Detective Hero Bryan.
I believe you've heard of his name.""Hero Detective Bryan?" The two girls didn't want to take the letter, but they changed their minds when they heard the name. They said in disbelief, "You... You know Detective Bryan?"
"Yes, I know him... You look like you admire him." Aetris was a little surprised. He felt it was better to mention a name than to explain further.
"Detective Bryan is our 'hero' from East Borough. He was the one who rescued Sister Janice from the gang-controlled company on the neighboring street," the thirteen-year-old girl replied with sparkling eyes.
"Aunt Kelly and her family were rescued by him and Miss Arbitrator. He's a true hero," the older girl said excitedly.
That fellow Ebner is really famous! I'm so envious...
While thinking this, Aetris took the opportunity to chat with the two girls. He was relieved to learn that they had just returned from the church's night school.
Even so, the two girls remained wary of him. Aetris had no choice but to regretfully leave the dilapidated apartment filled with moist water vapor and foul odors. He decided to help them when he found a suitable way to repay Sam for saving his life.
The younger girl watched him leave and sighed. "Actually, this gentleman is a good person. Mother just doesn't want to interact too much with him..."
"I know, but so what? The news he brought made my mother sad! Besides... I won't admit that that person is my father!"
...
After bidding farewell to the two girls, Aetris turned back to Black Palm Street and entered the temporary residence he had rented here. He changed into a more convenient outfit for walking in the night before heading toward another gang-controlled block.
There was his hunting target.
...
Late at night.
Click.
Ebner, who was sound asleep, suddenly heard a small voice.
He immediately jolted awake as he casually turned on the gas lamp in the room and rubbed the Ring of Light, prepared to activate it at any time.
Wu!
At that moment, a cold wind blew past without warning. The light from the gas lamp suddenly turned dark green.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Jane’s Intentions
chapters.content:
Chapter 176 - Jane's Intentions
Upon seeing this, Ebner subconsciously activated his Spirit Vision. Then, he saw a figure appear on the wall behind the gas lamp and above the desk. It was a figure formed from a dark and illusory fog that looked like a black cloak!
Who was it?! Before Ebner had time to think carefully, he wanted to activate the Ring of Light and cast Holy Light first.
But at that moment, the figure suddenly shook the air and said, "Ebner, I'm Jane. Don't attack me."
"Jane?" Ebner stopped rubbing the ring on his finger, but he did not stop. Instead, he turned the Holy Light he was about to activate into the Purification Halo that enveloped him. Due to his excellent control, the sudden appearance of the golden halo only formed a barrier of light around his body and did not affect the other uninvited guest.
"I know that this visit was too sudden, and I should've greeted you in advance... However, my body is still on the ship outside Pritz Harbor, so I can only have my Spirit Body fly over to communicate with you." As she spoke, the illusory figure made of black fog raised a hat made of the same black fog. It tried to construct a simple appearance, but it didn't succeed. It only produced facial features that were rough like a simple painting.
The black mist figure spread her hands helplessly. She looked at Ebner, who was surrounded by golden light, and continued, "I think you still remember that when we met at Enmat Harbor Cemetery, I said that I was going out to sea to help an important figure find something, right? Also, my father helped me apply a fake identity in Bayam when he was alive, so I'm now called Jane Miranda."
She said this both to gain Ebner's trust and to lay the groundwork for what she would say later.
Although her voice isn't right, and her appearance isn't too clear, this is indeed something only Jane and I know... She has already become a Spirit Medium, right? But Spirit Mediums have such powerful abilities? She can even be a part-time messenger... Ebner sighed inwardly and didn't let down his guard as he asked,
"Jane, you became a Spirit Medium? So soon?"
"Not as impressive as you. Even overseas, I've heard of Backlund's reputation as a Hero Detective!" Jane first teased with a smile before answering, "Yes, I've gained quite a lot from helping that important figure. I've already become a Spirit Medium."
"But it's only been a month..." Ebner clearly remembered that the last time he saw Jane at Enmat Harbor was in the middle of July, and now it was only August 15th. It was only a month.
Although it had only taken him a month to go from "Student of Ratiocination" to "Knowledge Keeper," he was personally sent by the God of Knowledge and Wisdom to provide intelligence to aid him in digesting the potion.
As for Klein, who was in the midst of helping... How much more suicidal was he compared to his digestion speed?
"Because I went to dig a grave... a grave that might have been my ancestor's... So the 'Gravedigger' digested very quickly..." After a moment of silence, Jane answered in a slightly ethereal voice.
"In the Berserk Sea?" Ebner asked thoughtfully.
"Eh? Ebner, how did you know?" Jane asked in surprise. Although the words formed by the vibration of the air had always seemed ethereal, Ebner could hear the difference in the tone.
"Admiral of Stars discovered the treasure in a secret sea route in the Berserk Sea. The Future was then attacked by Admiral Hell." Ebner succinctly shared the information he had obtained from Alger.
"So you deduced that I was on the Future... I'm afraid you have already guessed the identity of that important figure, right? As expected of a Hero Detective!" Jane sighed with emotion when she heard that. Although Back when she left Backlund, he had already excelled in his inference ability, she never expected him to be so powerful. He had deduced so many truths from the information he revealed during their few meetings.
"I do have some guesses..." Ebner nodded but didn't say it out loud. Although he was almost certain that the person who came to visit him in the middle of the night was indeed Jane, he still kept his basic guard up. Furthermore, it involved demigods. It was always right to be careful.
Seeing that Ebner's vigilance had slowed down slightly, Jane made the illusory face formed by the black fog reveal a "simple" smile. She said, "I relied on the effects of a mystical item to let my Spirit Body fly so far away, but it can't be delayed for too long, so let's talk about serious matters first."
"I'm listening." Ebner nodded solemnly.
Jane's black fog formed a strange smile on her face as she said, "The first thing is that I want to meet you. Yes, I also want to congratulate Detective Hero on becoming famous."
Can you not mention the name "Hero Detective" anymore? I feel so awkward every time I hear it, okay?
Ebner silently lampooned, but on the surface, he said, "Actually, I'm quite worried about you... Has your ship escaped from Admiral Hell's Black Tulip?"
"This is the second thing I want to say. I want to ask you for a favor. Help me report a piece of news to the Church of Storms." The head formed by the black fog tapped heavily and slowly.
"What news?" Ebner's expression was somewhat odd. He deeply felt that the Church of Storms was about to become a hired thug and tool again. Thinking back to the series of events after his teacher reported the Demoness, he couldn't help but worry for them.
"The Black Tulip will appear in the outer seas of Pritz Harbor at this time tomorrow," Jane replied unhurriedly.
Upon hearing that, Ebner immediately guessed what Jane or Cattleya were thinking. He thought for a moment before suggesting, "In fact, reporting it to the military might be more effective. Ever since the Pritz ironclad entered the water, it hasn't produced any outstanding results."
"Alright... However, it's not convenient for us to deal with the military... And there are quite a number of Numinous Episcopate or Black Tulip scouts onshore. A large-scale report might be immediately discovered and informed Admiral Hell." Jane had clearly received the authority of Admiral of Stars, so she had a plan for Ebner's suggestion.
"I'll get someone to report it. Don't worry." Ebner nodded, a plan forming in his mind.
"Thank you, Ebner." Jane first made a ridiculous smile appear on Black Mist's face, then took out a book with skin as black as ink from the thick cloak of fog and placed it on the small table in the bedroom.
"Here's your advance payment and thank-you gift," Jane said briskly.
Ebner looked down at the cover and saw that although there were no words on it when his eyes touched it, a line of ancient Hermes words flashed clearly in his mind: Book of the Dead.
"Book of Dead Souls?" Ebner didn't read it directly. Instead, he habitually switched to Loen language before reading out its name.
"Yes, this book is one of my discoveries in the mausoleum. It contains a lot of mysticism knowledge, as well as many ways to form necromantic ritualistic magic..." Jane introduced the book in detail. Obviously, she had read it all before.
"This book is the original?" Ebner frowned, then relaxed as if he had figured something out.
"Yes, I never expected Cattleya to agree to give you the Book of Dead Souls as a reward... Is there a problem?" Jane clearly had her doubts as she asked uneasily.
"It's nothing..." Ebner shook his head and thought to himself, It's very likely that Admiral of Stars is deliberately spreading the Death pathway's items... Heh, it shouldn't be just me. The other items from the mausoleum are likely scattered into the hands of the Moses Ascetic Order or some other faction. And the truly valuable items will definitely be left for Queen Mystic.
Yes, I'm not the only one who has reported the matter... That's right. Why would Admiral of Stars place all her hopes in one place? There must be many contingencies.
However, he didn't explain it to Jane. Firstly, it involved the law of Beyonder characteristic convergence, so explaining it would be too troublesome. Secondly, this was only his guess. What if Admiral of Stars was really that generous?
Seeing that Ebner did not want to go into details, Jane did not ask further. Instead, she observed him carefully for a while and found that he had no intention of getting angry. Then, she heaved a sigh of relief. A "happy" expression appeared in the black fog. She said, "Also, I have a gift for you... Don't decline it."
As she spoke, she shook the cloak again and took out a copper whistle.
"This whistle can summon my messenger. If you wish to find me in the future, blow it and get the messenger to bring me a letter."

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Infiltration and Rescue
chapters.content:
Chapter 177 - Infiltration and Rescue
The function of this whistle was very similar to Mr. Azik's copper whistle. It also seemed to have a negative effect of attracting the deceased...
Ebner, who had activated the Eye of Pure White, carefully examined the copper whistle before finally accepting it.
When Jane saw Ebner accept her gift, the face formed by the black mist once again showed a "happy" expression. Then she lifted the hem of her dress, bowed, and said goodbye.
"I don't have much time. I have to leave now... I wish you a good night's sleep, Ebner."
Her voice became softer as the figure formed by the black fog slowly retreated back into the wall.
"I wish you a safe journey," Ebner said, pressing his hand to his chest and smiling back.
Soon, the light from the gas lamp shone brightly, and all the dark green disappeared.
Ebner, who had been activating the Eye of Pure White, watched this change in a daze. It took him a long time to come back to his senses, but he sighed in his heart. "I didn't learn it... Apart from the mystical item Jane mentioned, I should have borrowed some kind of undead power."
