Then, after some thought, he took out the cello box with the Sword of Dawn sealed in it from his bedroom cabinet.
When the Sword of Dawn wasn't used, it needed to be sealed with the power of Death or Darkness. Therefore, every once in a while, Ebner had to hold a new ritual to reset the runes on the inside of the chest.
But now that he had the Book of Dead Souls, he could change his way of thinking...
While Ebner was thinking this, he began to engrave the inscription on the inside of the box. He placed the Book of Dead Souls in the center of the inscription and finally closed the box.
This way, the two items could restrain each other and seal each other...
After sealing the entire box with his spirituality, Ebner nodded in satisfaction.
After doing this, he wanted to pray to Mr. Fool and ask if what Jane said about the Black Tulip passing through the Pritz outer sea at dawn tomorrow was true.
It wasn't that he didn't trust Jane, but since he was going to report her, he had to verify the truth of the matter. Otherwise, wouldn't he implicate his friend who delivered the news?
However, he looked at the sky and decided to wait for a few hours until daybreak. If he disturbed Mr. Fool at this time, he might encounter a terrifying "morning sickness."
However, he couldn't disturb The Fool. He still had to do some other preparations.
Ebner dressed and packed his usual mystical items and charms. Then he opened the door and tiptoed downstairs.
It was not until this moment that he realized that Jane's arrival did not alarm his teacher. Apparently, her black mist state had a "concealment" effect!
Was it the effect of the mystical item she mentioned, or was it the special effect of the specter that helped her Spirit Body fly so far?
With this question in mind, Ebner left Detective Isengard's office and activated the Eye of Pure White to simulate the ability to "fly." He used the darkness to fly towards the bridge.
Since he needed to report it to the military, there had to be a "reasonable" source of information... And the organization that colluded with Admiral Hell was undoubtedly the Numinous Episcopate...
Of course, Ebner couldn't afford to offend the Numinous Episcopate, but the branch of the Numinous Episcopate, the Eternal life Society, could more or less be related to Admiral Hell. Naturally, it became a good target for him.
Furthermore, the Eternal life Society had previously had a feud with Ebner. His reputation as a Hero Detective had originally been built on the success of the "Black Skeleton Gang", a subordinate of the Eternal life Society—although he hadn't done so willingly.
However, the Eternal life Society clearly hated him to the core. If not for him being in the limelight and not being able to take action, Ebner would've been attacked.
And the reason why Ebner hadn't taken action to eliminate them was because he had previously sensed that the Church of Storms might be watching this organization.
However, the Mandated Punishers were either injured or dead. Those who could still move were still investigating the whereabouts of the Marionettist who had killed Robert. This made it convenient for him to act.
...
79 Durham Street, Backlund Bridge area.
Perhaps the various Churches had yet to find out the location of the Everlasting Society's stronghold, but Ebner, who had seen the original location, remembered to ask Chu for help. After all, he had a deep impression of the organization that Klein had sent to the sky with a few matches.
Standing in the shadows near the cottage that bordered the docks, Ebner reached into a hidden pocket and plucked out a handful of shimmering powder, which he sprinkled with the spell.
Right on the heels of that, he simulated the witch's "invisibility" ability. His figure disappeared inch by inch, and the outline of his body was completely erased by an eraser like it was drawn with a pencil.
This was an Assassin technique he had learned from the Cardiothoracic Department yesterday. It could effectively enhance the effects of invisibility.
After concealing himself, he quietly came to the front door of the house and used his ability to simulate the "door opening" to enter the room.
There weren't many people in the room. There were only three of them, all of whom had distinctive characteristics of the Southern Continent. However, although the three of them were very muscular, they didn't seem to be Beyonders.
Of course, Ebner could not tell. He did not have the ability to do so. Instead, he read the shallow memories of the three of them through "mind reading." That was how he came to this conclusion.
Only ordinary people were here? If that was the case, the "information" he received would not be convincing...
Just as Ebner was in a dilemma, he heard a man wearing a white singlet complaining, "The man brought back by Lord Godotpos is really tough. It's been almost 15 minutes, and he still hasn't revealed the mastermind?"
The bald man, who was sitting opposite the man in the white vest, replied with a smile, "It should be soon. I've never seen anyone who can last more than half an hour under Lord Lima and Lord Godotpos. I guess they'll come up from underground soon."
"I wonder who that Mr. Aubrey is, to be able to receive the personal protection of Lord Godotpos... If not for Lord Godotpos, he would most likely have been assassinated by that person tonight." The man in the white vest sighed.
So he was interrogating an assassin in the basement... Abner was enlightened. He was about to look for the entrance to the basement when he saw the third man who had been silent all this while standing up and walking towards the wine barrel by the kitchen.
"What are you going to do, Gordon?" asked the bald man curiously.
The man named Gordon said without looking back, "It's almost two o' clock. I have to send down three glasses of chilled Southville beer. That's what Lord Lima ordered."
The bald man responded with an "oh", and only after Gordon disappeared into the kitchen did he spit in a low voice, "Pfft, what a lackey! He thinks he's better than others just because he saved Lord Lima's thigh!"
"That's right!" the man in the white vest chimed in angrily.
Ebner ignored the two men who were obviously jealous. Instead, he crept into the kitchen and stared thoughtfully at Gordon as he poured beer into his glass.
When he went to the ice cellar to retrieve the ice, Ebner quickly went forward and took out three strands of yellow hair sealed with spirituality from his pocket. Then, he placed the strands of hair into the wine cup.
This was the hair that Judy had given him. It was said to be able to poison an adult curly-haired baboon to death in a few seconds...
The hair dissolved as soon as it was drunk, leaving no trace behind.
Upon seeing this, Ebner nodded in satisfaction as he thought, From the looks of it, what Judy said about "even demigods being difficult to detect" wasn't an exaggeration. At the very least, he, who had many means, had no other means to detect problems other than using the Eye of Pure White.
At this moment, Gordon returned to the kitchen and placed the ice cubes into the wine glass. After waiting for nearly two minutes, he used the tray to pick up three cups of Southville beer. He went to the cupboard and knocked on a wooden board beside it.
Soon, the closet was pushed open from the inside. A man with brown skin and short black curly hair appeared at the entrance of the underground tunnel.
He looked at Gordon appraisingly, then nodded. He took the tray containing the wine glasses and closed the cupboard again.
Ebner wasn't in a hurry to follow them in. Instead, he turned back and simulated his Nightmare powers, pulling the three ordinary people in the house, including Gordon, into a dream. Then he calmly ended their lives with a small knife.
These were all villains who had been identified by Klein in the future. Their hands were stained with the blood of innocents, so Ebner didn't hesitate to kill them.
After burning them to ashes with Witch's Black Flames, Ebner went to the closet and used his Door Opening ability to pass through and enter the basement.
This basement wasn't large, and it was about the same size as the house Ebner had rented in East Borough. Therefore, he immediately saw the three Beyonders lying on the ground peacefully. If not for the fact that their Beyonder characteristics had been revealed, Ebner would have thought that they were just sleeping.
And the person who was tied to the X-shaped rack, who was almost unrecognizable from the torture.
"Beatrice?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Harvest and Report
chapters.content:
Chapter 178 - Harvest and Report
"Aetris?!"
Ebner screamed in his heart. He did not expect to meet this friend here. And from the looks of it, he should be the "tough bone" that the bald man had mentioned before, who failed to assassinate and was caught instead.
At this moment, Aetris looked extremely miserable. His clothes were torn and tattered, and his entire body was covered in deep black marks. Even his limbs were broken!
Hearing the noise, Aetris raised his head with difficulty. Through his blurred vision, he barely understood what was going on in the basement. He nodded at Ebner, who had already revealed himself, and tried to squeeze out a smile. In a hoarse voice, he said, "Friend, although I don't know who you are, I'm very grateful that you saved me... I'll repay you later."
He did his best to show his worth and emphasized that he did not know the man, lest he be silenced.
You're thinking too much. I originally came here to 'create something out of nothing' and find out some information...
Ebner, who was wearing a clown mask and had a female face, cursed silently. However, he was not in a hurry to untie Aetris. Instead, he first used his "physician" ability to treat his injuries.
Although the "treatment" he simulated was much less effective than the original version, it was enough for emergency treatment. At the very least, it stabilized the other party's condition temporarily and did not worsen.
And the injuries were no longer worsening. It was enough for a strong "hunter."
"Thank you," said Aetris, relieved to see that Ebner meant no harm. If he had, he would not have been so unnecessary.
Ebner nodded and didn't say a word. Instead, he turned around and went to the three dead Beyonders. After carefully identifying them, he wanted to put away the Beyonder characteristics that they had extracted.
Corpse Collector characteristic. This was produced by the brownish-yellow-skinned man who opened the closet... I remember seeing him back when I was recalling Morella's memories. He should be called Godotpos... Yes, according to the three people, it was this Godotpos who protected the so-called Mr. Aubrey. That's how Aetris was captured? Heh heh, forget the fact that Hunter can't beat Corpse Collector, he was even captured... How embarrassing...
"Uh, alright. This Godotpos has a Beyonder item? That makes sense."
Ebner grumbled to himself as he searched Godotpos for another jet-black revolver.
After analyzing it with the Eye of Pure White, he realized that it only had the ability of Silent Shooting. Although it wasn't very powerful, it was still quite useful.
After stowing away the characteristics and revolvers, Ebner looked at the other brown-skinned man beside Godotpos.
They were both from the Southern Continent's Balam race, but this person's clothes were more exquisite, and he maintained his skin better than Godotpos. Ebner even analyzed several types of skincare products from his face...
This should be the 'Lord Lima' mentioned by those ordinary people, right? His status should be above Godotpos...
As expected, this is a Gravedigger... Tsk tsk, thankfully, a Witch's invisibility can hide from wandering spirits. Otherwise, I would've had to do more...
There's actually no Beyonder item? That's right. He doesn't seem to be a combatant, so there's no need for him to carry a dangerous Sealed Artifact with him... Yes, the Sealed Artifact of the Everlasting Society shouldn't be in this stronghold either. It probably has other places to store it.
"Eh? He has a letter on him?"
After Ebner put away the characteristic, he unfolded the letter and found only one sentence:
"It has been confirmed that Earl Wolf has a mask that he brought out from the Eggers family mausoleum."
The Eggers family's mask... This was lost by Mr. Azik, wasn't it? The Eternal Life Society is already planning on it? However, I can imitate this handwriting. When the time comes, I'll hand this letter and the forged intelligence to the military...
As his thoughts raced, Ebner turned his attention back to the last man poisoned to death.
It was an elder in his sixties. He had a big nose, grayish-blue eyes, and his facial skin was loose. He didn't have a beard, and his hair was very thin. And on his body was a dark red object that resembled jelly. It was the Beyonder characteristic of a Provoker.
"That person is Donald Aubrey. On the surface, he's the boss of a bar in East Borough, but in fact, he's a pirate who disguised himself after he came ashore! His nickname at sea is Laughter Longman, with a bounty of 1,000 pounds."
At this moment, Aetris finally regained some strength. He introduced the man to Ebner with a complicated look in his eyes.
Provoker... From the looks of it, the hunting mission Anderson gave him wasn't just to train Aetris. It also had the intention of allowing him to 'act' and obtain the ingredients for his advancement...
Unfortunately, Aetris had screwed up.
Ebner nodded slightly but had no intention of replying. It would be awkward if Aetris knew who he truly was.
He placed the Provoker characteristic into the tin box and left the basement through the hidden entrance in the closet. Upstairs, he found a large bag in the house and returned to the basement to store the so-called Grinning Man's corpse inside it.
Carrying the bag on his back, Ebner untied the ropes binding Aetris. Ignoring his words of gratitude, he silently left the stronghold of the Eternal Life Society.
However, just as he stepped out of the door at 79 Durham Street, a young man blocked his path.
The newcomer wore a white shirt, black vest, and black pants. His medium build, blond hair, and blue eyes made him unmistakably recognizable—he was the Strongest Hunter, Anderson.
Isn't he supposed to be heading to the sea near the ruins of the battle of gods? Why is he in Backlund? Could he be secretly protecting Aetris?
Ebner immediately became alert, his body tensing, ready to "fly" away at any moment.
"Don't be nervous, sir. I just want to make a deal with you." Anderson touched his earlobe and smiled.
"What do you want to trade?" Ebner asked, deliberately squeezing his throat to mask his voice, even though he already had a guess.
"The Provoker's Beyonder characteristic. I want to buy it," Anderson said seriously.
As expected... Ebner thought to himself before pretending to consider the offer. After a brief pause, he named his price. "700 pounds."
"That's a fair price, but I don't have that much cash on me. Can I use this to exchange instead?" Anderson replied as he took a small, eyeball-like item from his pocket.
Ebner carefully examined the object and immediately recognized it—it was a Gravedigger's Beyonder characteristic, identical to the one he had just stored away earlier.
After a moment of thought, Ebner, who had no desire to get further entangled with Anderson, nodded in agreement.
The two cautiously made the exchange. Once it was completed, Ebner didn't hesitate any longer. Carrying the bag, he "flew" away from the stronghold.
Anderson watched him leave before turning back toward the Eternal Life Society's stronghold. He kicked open the door and stepped inside.
When he saw Aetris still standing in the basement, he grinned and said,
"Dear Aetris, I hope this unforgettable lesson has taught you that being a Hunter requires brains, not just brawn.
"If you haven't realized that yet, don't worry—I'll assign you another mission that will leave an even deeper impression on you."
...
Since he was carrying a bag containing a corpse, Ebner didn't return to his teacher's office. Instead, he headed to the one-bedroom apartment he rented in East Borough.
After taking off the Clown Mask and returning to his original appearance, Ebner glanced at the sky. The faint glow of dawn was beginning to emerge, though it couldn't pierce the thick fog that blanketed Backlund.
It's almost five... Mr. Fool shouldn't mind waking up early, right?
With that thought, Ebner clasped his hands and brought them to his nose and mouth, as though praying. In a low voice, he sincerely recited,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era..."
...
Tingen, at a terrace house on 2 Daffodil Street.
Klein, who had been sleeping soundly, suddenly opened his eyes. He heard layers of illusory pleas echoing faintly in the air.
"Who is it this time? Tower? Or The Hanged Man?" Klein muttered as he rolled over in bed a few times before finally getting up in resignation.
He picked up his silver dagger and constructed a wall of spirituality, sealing the room. Taking four steps counterclockwise, he arrived above the gray fog. The crimson star corresponding to "Tower" expanded and contracted incessantly before his eyes.
Indeed...
Klein sat down on the high-back chair, leaned against it, and spread his spirituality, allowing Tower's voice to ring clear.
"Honorable Mr. Fool, I received some information regarding Admiral Hell Ludwell. According to it, the Black Tulip will pass through Pritz Harbor's outer sea at dawn on the sixteenth day...
"I wish to use the 'contributions' I've accumulated to confirm the authenticity of this news. If it's true, I hope you can pass it on to Mr. Hanged Man and have him report it to the Church of Storms as soon as possible.
"I understand it will place him at some risk, so I'm willing to pay a certain amount... The payment will be handed over via 'sacrifice' shortly."
In the towering palace, Klein tapped his fingers rhythmically on the edge of the long bronze table, pondering how to handle Tower's request.
The information about the Black Tulip and Admiral Hell seems detailed enough. Perhaps I can divine it?
With that thought, Klein conjured a fountain pen and wrote:
"The information that Tower obtained is accurate."
He set the fountain pen down, removed the silver chain wrapped around his wrist, and let the topaz pendant hang steadily above the divination statement.
Klein closed his eyes and calmly recited the sentence.
After repeating it seven times, he opened his eyes and saw the topaz pendant spinning clockwise.
That's a confirmation.
Nodding in satisfaction, Klein used his spirituality to inform Tower of the divination result. He added cautiously, "This is based on the current observations. It doesn't account for any future interference by other entities."
Just as he was about to contact The Hanged Man to relay the information, another prayer from Tower reached him. It was for a sacrificial ritual.
Moments later, a large, tattered bag was "sacrificed" and appeared within the gray fog.
"What's this?" Klein muttered, picking up the note attached to the bag while habitually untying the string at its mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 179 - Arrival
As the string was pulled apart, Laughter Longman's head was revealed. His eyes were closed and his expression was serene as though he had fallen asleep.
The corners of Klein's mouth couldn't help but twitch. He had already seen the note on the bag and knew that it was a corpse worth 1,000 pounds...
"Thankfully, I've seen quite a number of corpses, and this pirate died peacefully... Otherwise, I would really have to get Mr. Fool and Tower to calculate the mental damage compensation."
Klein lampooned as he spread his spirituality to the crimson star of The Hanged Man. He then threw Tower's previous prayer and the contents of the note over.
...
On the vast and boundless Sonia Sea, waves rose and fell.
The Blue Avenger advanced steadily without any signs of wobbling.
Alger Wilson sat in the captain's cabin, holding a brass sextant, but his eyes were closed.
This was because he had just received a message from Mr. Fool.
Tower wants me to report the Black Tulip? I remember that he was very involved with the Future... What's his relationship with Admiral of Stars?
Yes, I remember that Admiral of Stars probably joined the Moses Ascetic Order after falling out with Queen Mystic... And Tower knows a lot of knowledge that others don't...
Could it be that Tower is a pillar of the Moses Ascetic Order or someone related to it?
I have a mission to gather intelligence for the Church, to begin with. There's no need for me to take many risks by sending this information back...
"Laughter Longman, I remember that his bounty is indeed 1,000 pounds, and Tower has promised to split it with me 50-50... After deducting 10% of the handling fee, I can probably get about 400 pounds. That's pretty good."
Alger thought for a moment and felt that this business could be done. He immediately prayed sincerely to Mr. Fool before quickly setting up the altar.
After some maneuvering, a large bag with a note attached to it appeared in front of Alger. He opened it and identified it before nodding slightly. He pondered for a few minutes before leaving the captain's cabin. He came to the deck and said to the few crew members,
"We are about to reach Tiana Island. We will stay there for a day."
The crew cheered and shouted,
"Thank you, captain!"
...
Upon hearing the news from Mr. Fool, Ebner heaved a sigh of relief and felt a little regretful.
Unfortunately, Miss Justice's jewelry was left at his teacher's house and wasn't brought over. Otherwise, she could've been sent to the gray fog with the corpse...
Of course, these messy thoughts only lasted for a moment. Ebner quickly threw them to the back of his mind and focused on faking information regarding Admiral Hell.
"Yes, I have to reveal this matter in the tone of an immature intelligence agent.
In addition, I have to stuff some other dry goods in. This way, I can gain trust from the military and also attract attention...
By the way, I'll delete the information that the 'immortal fool' will reveal to Klein in the future and join in. This will be enough to attract attention, and it won't change the development of the era too much in the short term...
It took Ebner three hours to complete the fake intelligence. Then, he activated the Eye of Pure White and copied all the information.
This way, even if Klein were to personally divine it, he wouldn't be able to obtain an accurate outcome, much less the military...
Ebner nodded, satisfied. Then he looked at his pocket watch and saw that it was eight o'clock. He quickly gathered his things and went out the door, then headed for his headquarters in Queens in Sivellaus Yard.
Ebner didn't plan on seeking Xio's help for reporting this matter to the military. Firstly, Xio's level was too low. If he were to report it to the higher-ups, the Black Tulip would probably reach Sonia Island by the time the information reached them...
Secondly, Xio's identity actually had some latent problems. Although she was concealed by her "golden-masked" superior, reporting two important pieces of information in a short period of time might attract unnecessary attention.
Hence, he actually wanted to seek his teacher's help.
Detective Isengard had always had a rather harmonious relationship with MI9, and Lenburg and Loen were allies. It was completely reasonable for him to get some information and pass it to the Loen military.
As it was Ebner's first visit to the police headquarters on Sivellaus Street in Queens, no one recognized him, so he was spared much trouble. He found his teacher easily enough.
Detective Isengard Stanton was currently analyzing the ins and outs of the serial murder case with another famous detective in Backlund. And because the victims had different backgrounds, they were in a dilemma.
Seeing Ebner arrive, Detective Isengard, who knew very well that his student wasn't welcomed by the police department, immediately stood up. Then, he greeted another detective named Botos before bringing his student out and finding a cafe to sit down.
"What happened?" Detective Isengard asked as he took a sip of coffee.
"Teacher, I attacked the Eternal life Society's base yesterday and obtained a piece of information... I hope you can hand it over to the military as soon as possible," Ebner said with a solemn expression as he handed a document folder to his teacher.
"Oh?" Seeing how serious he was, Detective Isengard put down his cup, took out the intelligence, and read it seriously.
However, after reading a few lines, he put down the document again. He pondered for a moment and said with a smile, "You're giving me credit.
"If the military can really fight a beautiful battle in Pritz Harbor, our situation in the Loen Kingdom will improve greatly... Although it's already quite good now.
"Yes, I won't ask you how the information came about... In short, as long as it's true, and with the Everlasting Society as an excuse, no one will pursue the matter...
"Don't worry, I'll pass it on to you."
Ebner felt a little ashamed and relieved at that.
To his shame, he did not expect his teacher to know him so well that he could guess part of the truth.
Fortunately, if the intelligence was handed over by his teacher, even if the military discovered the source of the information, they would be more likely to suspect the officials or the Church of Knowledge, and they would not investigate further.
In his gratitude, Ebner's mind turned and he initiated the conversation. "Teacher, I have some ideas about the commonality of serial murders and victims."
"What idea?" Detective Isengard looked up and asked curiously.
"Teacher, have you ever read such a report before... In Backlund, one in six women between the ages of 15 to 55 are doing or have been street girls before?" Ebner deliberated over his words.
Detective Isengard was taken aback when he heard that. Following that, he rubbed his usual pipe with his thumb and said, "I see. I understand!"
Then, he raised his head and looked at his student in admiration. "Your mind is very active! I feel that even without the honor that was imposed on you, you are still an excellent detective."
"Thank you for the compliment, Teacher." Abner shamelessly accepted Detective Isengard's praise because he was still cheating.
...
Cherwood Borough, 28 Kings Street.
At four in the afternoon, a rental carriage slowly drove over and stopped at the entrance of the garden villa.
Xio and Fors each wore exquisite gowns as they got out of the car. Following that, an attendant led them into the villa.
After greeting Macht and his wife, Xio looked around before asking the attendant, "Where's Ebner? Where is he?"
"Detective Bryan is receiving Detective Zreal and Miss Irene in the activity room."

chapters.title: Chapter 180: "Arrangement"
chapters.content:
Chapter 180 - "Arrangement"
On the way to the activity room, Fors looked through the first-floor window at the garden outside as she sincerely said to Xio,
"This is my dream residence. When I have enough money, I'll buy a house like this in Backlund."
Xio followed her friend's gaze as she looked outside and whispered,
"I lived in a place like this when I was a kid—"
After saying that, she realized that she seemed to have lost her composure and quickly changed the topic. "I thought you would say that you wanted to buy a manor in the suburbs or other places with good scenery."
"No, I'll choose Backlund because the delicacies here are more convenient," Fors said seriously.
As they spoke, they had reached the door of the living room.
As the door was not closed, they could easily see what was inside through the gap.
The first thing she saw was a girl in her early twenties wearing a low-cut lace gown. She was leaning towards Ebner, pretending to be curious about something.
Xio frowned when she saw this scene and stopped.
"What's wrong?" Fors asked in surprise.
"That woman has signs of 'chaos' and 'madness'..." Xio replied as she pointed at the girl who was circling Ebner.
Fors sized up the lady and said hesitantly, "She seems to be an ordinary person..."
"Who said that ordinary people can't be 'chaotic' or 'crazy'? Many such people are actually more dangerous than Beyonders." As Xio spoke, her expression turned serious as she pushed open the half-open door and walked into the activity room.
Ebner, who had been annoyed by Miss Irene in front of him, was relieved to see Xio walk in. Then he quietly took a few steps back and said apologetically to Detective Zreal and Miss Irene, "I have a friend coming over. Excuse me."
"Go ahead," Detective Zreal replied with a chuckle.
Just as Miss Irene was about to say something, she met Xio's "dignified" gaze. Her mind instantly went blank, and her body trembled slightly, like a small animal that had encountered its natural enemy. It took her a long time to recover.
At that moment, Ebner had already left the activity room with Xio and Fors.
"It's horrible..." Irene muttered.
"Heh heh, that's Miss Xio Derecha, the very famous Arbiter in East Borough and the dock area. Many gang leaders are intimidated by her 'might,' much less you," Detective Zreal explained with a chuckle.
"Xio Derecha? Is she on good terms with Detective Bryan?" Irene had recovered by now, and she turned to look at Zreal.
"There are rumors that they are very close. It seems like it's true..." Detective Zreal nodded first, then said playfully, "Hehe, you might have provoked her just now."
"She's just a little girl. She doesn't have a body, so she probably doesn't know how to please people... When I find an opportunity to show Detective Bryan my 'inner beauty', He'll completely abandon her." Irene snorted.
...
In the stairwell leading to the third floor, Ebner, who had long witnessed Miss Irene's "inner self" in the "Backtrack" scene, was telling Xio about Irene's background.
"I see... But Ebner, you have to be careful. I can sense 'madness' from her. She's probably the kind of person who would do anything to achieve her goals... I'm afraid she's already targeting you," Xio said worriedly after hearing Ebner's description.
"There's no need to worry too much. She's just an ordinary person." Ebner wasn't very nervous about this. After all, from the scene of him "retracing" she didn't seem to have any intention of stepping into the "Beyonder" realm. Otherwise, with her vast "friendship", she would've long obtained the potion.
At that moment, Fors, who had been listening by the side for a long time, noticed the heavy atmosphere. She changed the topic. "Ebner, where are you taking us?"
"Go to the study on the third floor... I know you guys don't really like this kind of socializing, and I've set up a small library there. It's quiet and has a lot of food placed there. Before the official banquet starts, you can spend time there... This is preferential treatment for my friends." Ebner blinked and said seriously.
"That's great." Fors's eyes lit up when she heard that as her heart leaped with joy.
She could eat snacks and read books quietly, and she could also taste the delicacies after the main meal started. Was there a better banquet than this? It was perfect.
Xio wasn't against socializing, but when she saw how happy her friend was, she pursed her lips and smiled before following Ebner into the study on the third floor.
Just as Ebner said, apart from a row of bookshelves against the west wall, the rest of the tables and coffee tables were filled with fruits, desserts, and drinks.
Behind the table and coffee table were two long sofas that could fit a person. They were soft and comfortable.
Upon seeing this scene, Fors immediately forgot her reservations and lay down on the sofa. At the same time, she grabbed a piece of cake and grumbled, "Wearing high heels is really tiring."
This Miss Salted Fish was wearing a light-colored long dress that was daringly made of lace. She also wore a silk cardigan with high heels.
These was the clothes Xio had prepared for her. It would have been more fitting to wear a pair of satin shoes, but Fors was curious about the feeling of wearing high heels and wanted to give it a try... However, she only felt regret now.
If Ebner wasn't present, she would have taken off her shoes.
Xio shook her head, feeling helpless at her friend's indecent posture. She walked forward and straightened her body before sitting beside her.
Ebner saw them take their seats and was about to say something when a servant came to the study door and knocked. He reported, "Detective Bryan, your friend Mr. Darkwill has arrived."
"Go do what you need to do. Fors and I are fine here," Xio said when she saw this. She had come so early to help, but seeing how the Macht couple had arranged the banquet in an orderly manner, she dismissed the thought.
Ebner nodded and said casually before leaving, "You can read here. I bought quite a few interesting books."
With that said, he closed the door of the study and took out the Solomon gold coin, wiping the blood on the portrait.
...
In the study, just as Ebner left, Fors took off her shoes and lay down on the sofa again, completely ignoring Xio's protests.
Xio tugged at his slanted shawl and covered half of his fair shoulders before saying, "Take note of your image. What if Ebner returns?"
"What's wrong with that? Even if I take off all my shawls, it's still much less than where Miss Irene showed herself." Although Fors didn't care, she still adjusted her posture.
Xio sighed and ignored her. Instead, she walked to the row of bookshelves and quickly found two books she was interested in. They were Aristocrat heraldry and Intis Kingdom History.
Just as she was about to take it away and read it, she suddenly saw an ancient-looking book next to "Noble heraldry". It was the "Feast of Blood" she had read in batches.
"So it's here." Xio's heart stirred as she pulled it out from the bookshelf.
...
Tingen, 36 Zouteland Street.
When Klein entered the Blackthorn Security Company, Rozanne, Anna, and the company had already gotten off work. The place had turned abnormally cold and dark.
Dunn, who was wearing a black trench coat, sat on the sofa in the reception area. He didn't light the gas lamp, as though he had merged into the lightless area.
"You found a clue?" he asked in a mellow voice, startling Klein, who was looking around for the Captain.
Klein quickly turned around and looked into Dunn's gray eyes.
"Yes, we—"
Before he could finish speaking, he suddenly paused because layers of illusory pleas echoed in his ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Reciting the Honorary Name
chapters.content:
Chapter 181 - Reciting the Honorary Name
Who? Mr. Tower? Or Mr. Hanged Man?
Klein couldn't help but fall into a trance.
Dunn saw him stop halfway through his report. He frowned and asked in a deep voice, "What's wrong?"
"Ah? It's nothing. I just suddenly wanted to go to the bathroom..." Klein snapped to his senses and temporarily put aside the matter of "praying." He quickly recounted the important parts of his investigation on Lower Street with Leonard.
Dunn would interrupt from time to time to ask. When he was done, he suddenly stood up and walked towards the door.
"I nearly forgot. You can go to the bathroom now and follow me there... Heh, according to the latest information from Backlund and my judgment, the person there should be a witch. She might be holding a ritual to curse you!" Just as he was about to go downstairs, he suddenly stopped and said to Klein, who was at the door while wearing his hat,
"Alright." Klein's expression turned solemn as he nodded.
...
In the bathroom, Klein sealed the room with his spirituality. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and went above the gray fog.
However, this time, he didn't see any illusory stars expanding or contracting with a deep red glow. However, at the end of the ancient and mottled bronze table, there was a bright light rippling from the side of The Fool's seat.
A prayer that isn't from a Tarot Club member... Is this the reliable friend that The Tower mentioned before? Could it be the "woman" he was planning on giving away? Hmm, with the character of The Tower, if it's really a woman, he probably wouldn't use a friend to refer to her. Klein sat down in his seat with some guesses before spreading out his spirituality and touching the ripples of light in response to the prayer.
The scene in front of him suddenly changed, revealing a blurry long sofa. A petite figure in a green dress was curled up on it. She was leaning against the chest of a languid lady, holding an ancient-looking book.
That book looks familiar... The Feast of Blood? Mr. Tower hid The Fool's honorific name in the Feast of Blood and allowed this lady to read it by accident? Klein suddenly came to a realization and figured out the reason.
After pondering for more than ten seconds, Klein didn't really respond because the Captain was still waiting outside. He planned on taking this step after today's mission was over. Then, he would test her personality and ability through her reaction, attitude, and handling methods.
Furthermore, he had mostly learned Jotun. He planned on pulling the youth who was in a strange place into the gathering this weekend. For the time being, he didn't have the ability to pull the lady along.
...
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era..." Holding the Feast of Blood, Xio, who had just finished reciting the ancient Hermes, was stunned for a few seconds before she suddenly sat up straight.
As she had been leaning against the sofa while reading, Fors immediately cried out in pain and said unhappily, "Xio! You're pressing on the flesh on my leg. It hurts."
Xio turned a deaf ear to him because her mind was filled with a terrifying thoughts. What I just read... seems to be the honorific name of a hidden existence!
And her general knowledge of mysticism and the various stories she had heard from Ebner told her that once she recited the complete honorific name of a hidden existence, it often meant that she attracted the attention of the other party!
The consequences of such a gaze were unlikely to be pleasant or even tragic!
Many of those hidden existences were the incarnations of evil gods and devils!
And I recited it in ancient Hermes... I'm so silly. Ebner had clearly copied the non-threatening content for me to see... Why did I pick up the original?
Xio jumped to her feet and held the triangular blade in her hand. She looked around warily, afraid that an indescribable monster would suddenly appear in the quiet house.
The sofa, coffee table, bookshelves, small table, curtains, mirrors, and other items were reflected in her eyes one by one without any changes.
After about ten seconds, Xio relaxed a little and softly consoled herself.
"There's no need to be afraid, there's no need to be afraid. Perhaps it's just a meaningless incantation. After all, I've never heard Ebner mention the so-called foolishness... I can't recite that name again!
"But... but this honorific name is written in the Feast of Blood. Could the vampire duke's record be wrong?
What if this really is an evil god or devil? If 'He' becomes interested in me, 'He' will respond even if the previous ritual isn't complete, right?
I wonder if Ebner has a solution... But he's only a Sequence 7...
Thinking about it made Xio depressed again. She felt that she had made a grave mistake and that she might even implicate her friend.
Fors also snapped out of her initial daze. Seeing Xio's huge reaction and the cold sweat on her forehead, she believed that something had happened and that a terrifying enemy had arrived. Therefore, she rolled off the sofa.
She didn't bother tidying up her dress and shawl as she walked barefoot to Xio, who had her back facing her. Then, she took down a bracelet covered by her lace cuff. With one hand holding onto the dark green rough stone on the bracelet, she grabbed Xio with the other and was about to chant an incantation.
However, her decisive action gave Xio, who was already nervous, a fright. She subconsciously turned her body and struck her elbow from behind.
Pa!
Her arm hit a warm body, causing the other party to let out a familiar scream and fall to the ground.
Oh no... I think I hit Fors... Thankfully, I didn't use the triangular blade!
Xio winced, glad for a moment. Then she turned his attention to his friend, who was hugging her stomach, writhing in pain, her eyes brimming with tears.
"Fors, why did you approach me from behind?" Xio straightened her back as she attempted to push all the responsibility out.
Fors didn't answer immediately. After a while, she slowly stood up with the help of the coffee table. However, due to the collision and the intense tumbling, the strap of her light-colored dress had long snapped. The entire dress hung from her waist, revealing her bra.
"I-I wasn't looking. I saw your reaction and thought that a powerful fellow was coming to take you away. But you attacked without even seeing clearly!" Fors grumbled righteously.
Xio said awkwardly, "I'm just nervous..."
"What happened?" Fors rubbed her stomach and felt that her understanding of the situation was probably wrong. She didn't seem to have any enemies...
"Fors... I made a fatal mistake..." Xio sighed and answered honestly.
"What mistake?" Fors asked in puzzlement. There shouldn't be anything wrong with just reading a book, right?
As Fors had read the handwritten copy of the "Feast of Blood" by Ebner, she gave it some thought and recounted how she had accidentally recited the ancient Hermes incantation that was suspected to be the honorific name of hidden existence.
"W-what happened to your brain? The part that Ebner didn't copy for you was naturally something that he thought was dangerous. How did you manage to read it?" Upon saying that, Fors became a little afraid. She looked around and felt a chill for some reason.
Of course, this was because she was naked.
She walked to the sofa with her dress and picked up the "Blood Feast" book that Xio had thrown to the ground. Under Xio's guidance, she flipped to the page with the honorific name. With a glance, Fors, who had quite a bit of knowledge in mysticism, nodded slightly and said,
It's not the evil gods, devils, or secret existences that I know of...
"And nothing has happened so far, which means that the problem is not big."
Seeing Xio heave a sigh of relief, she thought for a moment before adding,
However, since it's the honorific book of a Sanguine Duke, it must be true...
"I remember Ebner has a good relationship with a Sanguine Viscount. This book was brought from the Sanguine... Why don't you ask him?"
Xio calmed down and felt that she should ask Ebner. At the very least, she needed him to simulate Holy Light and exorcise her evil...
However, just as she was about to open the door and leave, she stopped. Then, she turned around and said to the confused Fors, "Fors, you have to wear your clothes before I can get Ebner to come over..."
Fors was instantly rendered speechless. She shook the broken strap in front of Xio and said helplessly, "How am I supposed to wear this?"
...
In the hall on the first floor of the villa, Darkwill was chatting happily with Sergeant Faxin. However, the latter's smile was clearly very stiff, but he had no choice but to smile apologetically. It felt forced.
Beside him, Mrs. Faxin's face was growing darker.
However, Darkwill didn't have the self-awareness that Faxin was patronizing him. Or rather, he didn't care at all as he continued promoting his signature potion.
Fortunately, Ebner's appearance gave Sergeant Faxin a glimpse of the "light" in the "darkness."

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Tarot Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 182 - Tarot Card
At the entrance of the villa, a carriage drove over from afar. A well-dressed couple with an outstanding temperament alighted from the carriage.
The servants behind them moved a wheelchair from the carriage and helped a little boy about ten years old into the wheelchair.
Mr. Skade, who was receiving guests at the entrance of the villa, was stunned when he saw the person. However, he quickly composed himself and squeezed out a smile to greet him.
"Mr. Auceptin, Mrs. Auceptin, and Will, welcome."
Mr. Auceptin, who was wearing a handmade suit and a top hat, sized up Skade before laughing. "I didn't expect you to be a butler here... As an old friend, why didn't you tell me? If I hadn't received Member of Parliament Macht's invitation, I wouldn't have known."
What old friend? When I went to look for you when I was down and out, you weren't so enthusiastic...
Mr. Skade cursed silently but did not show it. After checking the invitation that Mr. Auceptin had handed over, he dutifully welcomed the family of three into the villa.
At this moment, quite a number of guests had arrived in the villa. Mr. Auceptin seemed to have seen an acquaintance and immediately walked forward to chat. Mrs. Auceptin also entered the activity room provided for the ladies.
As for Will, who was in a wheelchair, he seemed to have been forgotten by them.
Mr. Skade knew that the couple did not like the child, but he did not expect them to ignore him. He frowned and walked up to them. "Do you want to go somewhere? Do you want me to push you to the restaurant?"
"Just put me in a quiet room." Will seemed to be used to being forgotten. As he played with the tarot card in his hand, he gave Mr. Scard a smile.
The smile sent Mr. Skade into a trance. He felt very much like his dead son.
When he came back to his senses, he looked at Will with a more amiable gaze. Hence, he pushed the wheelchair to a small room on the left side of the first floor of the villa and placed the child whose legs were inconvenient on the sofa in the corner.
As he lifted his body, Mr. Skade realized that the child's left calf seemed thicker than his right, which was why he could not move.
As expected, it's still a strange illness... We shouldn't have opened that door and looked at the mural... Otherwise, our children wouldn't have suffered like this.
Mr. Skade sighed and looked at the child who was skillfully fiddling with the tarot cards. He exhorted,
"Will, this room is actually my lounge. You can stay here and play by yourself for a while. If there's anything, call a servant to call me... Yes, after the banquet begins, I'll personally come and fetch you."
The kid named Will put down his cards and nodded obediently. He looked up and smiled. "Go ahead, Mr. Skade. I'll take care of myself."
An optimistic and strong child... Unfortunately, Mr. Auceptin doesn't seem to like him...
Mr. Scard could not help but recall his first meeting with this child.
It was because he hadn't been in Backlund for long, and he had spent most of his money. In a desperate situation, he had no choice but to visit his former superior, Mr. Auceptin, and pray that he would give him a vague job.
However, although Mr. Auceptin had received him, he had been perfunctory the entire time... Finally, just as he was about to bid farewell, only this child took out a deck of tarot cards and smiled for him to draw one.
And back then, due to his depression and confusion, he didn't pay much attention to it. All he did was casually pull out a Justice card.
Then, the child said to himself, "Sir, you will be helped by someone important."
And not long after that, he met Mr. Cullen and Miss Judy and joined the Church of Earth Mother.
Indeed, he had received help from a benefactor.
With this in mind, Mr. Scard was deeply moved. Of course, he did not think that his luck had changed just because of a child's casual remark, but this coincidence also left a deep impression on him. Hence, before leaving the room, he smiled again and asked Will,
"Can I draw another tarot card?"
Unexpectedly, the child named Will shook his head and said solemnly, "Don't be greedy, or there will be bad luck."
Mr. Skade was stunned for a moment before he fell silent. He did not pay much attention to it and just thought that the child was engrossed in playing and had his own principles. He shook his head and the two of them opened the lounge to work.
After Mr. Skade left, Will picked up the tarot cards again and continued to cut and shuffle them, enjoying himself. But soon, his hand suddenly stopped in the midst of cutting.
Will looked up at the garden outside the window and an apartment further away. He then sighed. "How unfortunate... That silly snake must have taken away too much of my luck..."
With that said, he took out a real Sun from the group card in his hand!
...
27 Kingst Street, Cherwood Borough.
In an empty bedroom on the second floor of the villa next to the garden where the banquet was being held.
A wave of fluctuation suddenly came from the pitch-black void, vaguely revealing an invisible door covered in complicated symbols.
Soon, a hand reached out from the door.
It was an extremely pale, bloodless palm that didn't seem to belong to a living person!
Just by looking at it, one could feel incomparable malice!
However, right at that moment, the palm that was about to push open the invisible door suddenly stopped. At the same time, an almost inaudible surprised voice came from inside the door. "The aura of 1-025 has appeared?"
As the voice faded, the pale white hand retreated back into the door, and then the invisible door completely vanished.
...
28 Kingst Street, in a corner of the smoking room of the villa, Ebner took out a strand of withered yellow hair from his pocket and waved it in front of Darkwill's eyes. He asked with a faint smile,
"Do you know what this is?"
Darkwill carefully identified it before his eyelids twitched. He looked around guiltily before asking softly, "That brown-haired girl is here too? Where is she?"
"Guess?" Ebner smiled brightly. For Darkwill, Judy could be considered a top deterrent.
"Tell me, what do you want me to do?" Darkwill took a deep breath and asked in a straightforward manner.
"Mind your mouth. Just don't mess up the banquet." Ebner smiled politely.
"Just for this, you actually used such a terrifying thing to scare me?" Darkwill asked in disbelief.
"Seems like you have no self-awareness!" Ebner glanced at him and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Invitation and Exorcism
chapters.content:
Chapter 183 - Invitation and Exorcism
"Didn't I do it for the good of that sheriff? His body is severely lacking, so there's no harm in me nourishing him." Darkwill shook the fat on his face and muttered indignantly.
He was obviously taking the initiative to help, but he never said a word of thanks. Don't you think you should reflect on yourself?
Ebner lampooned but did not say anything. After all, this was Darkwill's way of doing things. He did not need anyone's praise. All he needed was his own pleasure...
Therefore, this Apothecary should really become a "hunter"?!
Using Judy's hair to "intimidate" Darkwill, Ebner hurried out of the smoking room after another conversation with him—he wasn't in any hurry, just couldn't quite handle the smell of tobacco.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he stepped outside, Ebner saw his former public schoolmates, Roman and Susan, two girls walking toward him hand in hand.
Susan, who had been looking around, also noticed Ebner at the first moment. A smile immediately appeared on her face, but she did not wave or jump to the front like before. Instead, she nodded at Ebner in a reserved manner before slowly walking over with Roman.
As for Roman, she became nervous as soon as she saw Ebner. She didn't even know where to put her hands. If it weren't for Susan, she would have become an ostrich.
It was said that this lady had been receiving the so-called "education of a lady" recently...
Ebner's thoughts flew for a second before he quickly pulled them back. When the two girls arrived, he smiled and said to them, "Ladies, your arrival has brightened this villa."
"You flatter me too much, Ebner..." Roman replied quickly, his face reddening at the compliment.
Susan blinked her eyes and pretended to complain. "Ebner, you're getting more famous now. You don't even contact us... If I didn't receive your invitation, I wouldn't have dared to visit you. I'm afraid you would have forgotten about us."
These words were half true and half false, but they instantly swept away all the feelings of alienation that had arisen from not seeing him for many days.
Ebner shook his head and explained with a smile, "I don't have as much time as you..." After all, I'm busy catching adulterers and finding people. I can also find a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact and kill a Demoness of Afflictions or something...
"Excuses!" Susan first snorted in dissatisfaction, then asked casually, "Such a great detective, are you free this Saturday and Sunday?"
Ebner thought for a moment and realized that because his "popularity" was high, he did not receive any commission, so he nodded and said, "It should be fine... Why are you asking this?"
"Because Roman and I need a 'flower guardian' this weekend! I want to invite you to be our escort," Susan replied with a smile.
Flower Guardian? Didn't this word come from Emperor Roselle?
Ebner grumbled inwardly, but on the surface, he asked curiously, "What are you going to do?"
"The club that Roman and I are in is preparing to organize a camping trip and an adventure. Although it's not a dangerous place and there are teachers leading the team, we two girls who can't protect ourselves naturally need a reliable gentleman to protect us... So, your chance came?" Susan said with a spirited smile.
Beside him, Roman looked up at Ebner expectantly.
If Klein were here, he would probably have used the excuse of going to the bathroom by now... Right, since I've already used Solomon Gold Coin, I might as well use it to enhance my divination abilities.
At this thought, Ebner asked, "Where are you camping?" This was to obtain more prerequisites.
"It's near the town of Kava in the southeastern suburbs of Backlund," Susan said after some thought.
"That's indeed not far..." Ebner nodded thoughtfully before bowing slightly apologetically. "I'm very sorry, ladies. I would like to go to the bathroom now. I'll answer you when I'm back."
I hope there won't be any rumors like Dwayne... Should I be glad that Fors is obediently reading on the third floor?
Muttering under his breath, Ebner entered the bathroom around the corner on the first floor and locked the door.
"There's a potential danger in the town of Kangwa that I can't resolve."
After reciting it seven times, Ebner tossed the Solomon gold coin high into the air and let it spin to the ground.
Opposite! It means that there is no danger that I cannot solve.
Ebner sighed when he saw this. He picked up the gold coin and was about to open the bathroom door.
But at that moment, his spiritual perception was triggered. He immediately looked at the mirror in front of him.
At some point in time, a wheelchair was reflected in the mirror. The shadow in the wheelchair was so deep that no one could see the details. All they knew was that there was an abnormal child on his left leg.
The child said in a clear voice,
"Try not to use that gold coin after you leave Backlund."
This tone, this style, this way of appearing... The future favorite ice-cream under The Fool... No, the Angel of Fate?
"I think you're thinking about something rude," the child frowned and said unhappily.
"How can that be?" Ebner quickly denied it. Considering that the man was most likely an angel, he tensed up and asked warily, "Why?"
The child in the wheelchair scoffed and said,
"Ask yourself. Can you really use such 'good luck' without any cost?
"Don't talk about the blood of an Arbiter pathway Beyonder. That's just a sealing technique."
Indeed... Even a Winner's Luck had to be accumulated before it could be released once, but this Solomon Gold Coin seemed to really have no limits... According to Xio, even if it was used continuously, the effects of "good luck" were no longer obvious. The difficulty of sealing it was just greater...
Then, what's its origins? Is it really formed from the Beyonder characteristic of a Lucky One? Why can't my White Eye analyze its abnormality in this aspect... Could it be that the analysis of the White Eye isn't complete?
Knowledge does not equal Power?
Or could it be that... The Solomon Gold Coin might've come from the Snake of Mercury in front of him? Only by approaching "Him" would it have such an effect, so it could only be used in Backlund? Then, what would happen if it was used outside Backlund? Would the collective backlash from overdrafting luck happen?
At this thought, he could not help but look at the child in the wheelchair in the mirror.
"I know where it came from, but I don't want to tell you... I only appeared here because I promised a friend to give you a reminder..." The child then disappeared into the mirror before Ebner could ask another question.
Ebner was stunned. Now, he fully understood Emperor Roselle's desire to "beat" a Seer. However, considering that the future Prophet of the Reader pathway was also of the same caliber, he had no choice but to suppress this "dangerous" thought.
After washing his hands and leaving the room, Ebner was in no hurry to find Susan and Roman. Instead, he called Mr. Skade, who was making a guest appearance as the butler, and asked casually,
"Could it be that a child whose leg is not in a good condition is attending the banquet?"
"Detective Bryan, you saw Will?" Mr. Scard exclaimed. He thought that the child had run out because he couldn't stand the loneliness. He quickly looked around but didn't find anything.
"Will?" Ebner asked, pretending to be puzzled.
"Will is the son of Mr. Auceptin, the director of my previous trading company," Mr. Skade hurriedly explained.
Will Auceptin? He's really the "infant" angel of my Lord...
Ebner nodded imperceptibly, but had no intention of meeting the man immediately.
He had a feeling this wasn't a good time to meet Will.
Furthermore, the other party was the Snake of Mercury. If he wanted to communicate with him, he would definitely give him a way to contact him. On the contrary, if the other party did not want to see him, he would not be able to see him even if he came to him.
After asking Will about it, Ebner didn't continue to disturb Mr. Skade's work. He turned back to where he'd been talking to Susan and her friend, but Hugh was there, too, as if he were talking to Susan.
Seeing Ebner approach, Xio immediately sensed it and went up to him. She said anxiously, "Ebner, I have something to tell you."
Ebner wasn't surprised that Xio had come down to look for him. After all, this was his trap, so he nodded without hesitation. "Alright, let's talk upstairs."
Then, he turned to Susan and said apologetically, "I have something to do. Please excuse me..."
"What about the weekend?" Susan asked, remembering the invitation she'd given him.
"Don't worry, I'll be a good escort," Ebner replied with a smile before turning into the stairwell with Xio.
Susan watched the two of them leave and mumbled, "Their auras are so similar... They look gentle, but they give me the feeling that whatever they say is right. We can only listen to them obediently."
Hearing this, Roman was silent for a moment. Then, he looked at his good friend and classmate and whispered, "Susan."
"What?" Susan turned around and asked.
"Do you... know about Beyonders?" Roman asked hesitantly.
"Beyonders?"
Ebner and Miss Xio should be Beyonders...
"The world they are in... is different from ours!"
...
At the door of the study on the third floor, Xio stopped in her tracks. Her face was filled with hesitation, but after struggling between embarrassment and losing her life for three seconds, she said honestly,
"Ebner, I made a mistake—"
Even though he knew better, Ebner pretended to be both confused and concerned. "What mistake?" he asked.
"I... When I was watching the Feast of Blood, I recited an honorific name..." Xio lowered her head and said guiltily, as though she was a primary school student waiting to be reprimanded by her teacher.
The Fool? Ebner maintained his usual persona in front of Xio. He quickly guessed the outcome and recited the word in Loenese.
"That's right..." Xio was even more depressed when she heard this word. Why didn't she think of translating it into Loen language first?
"Ebner, do you know which existence this honorific name recorded by the Sanguine Duke points to? Could it be that 'He' has already paid attention to me? Could there be... any terrifying consequences?"
As Xio spoke, she took another deep breath to hide her nervousness.
It was certain that he would be watched, but the scary consequences... would be more like he didn't have enough money to spend?
As for the rest, there was no need to worry. After all, that mysterious existence could not defeat you...
Although he thought so, Ebner knew that Xio was actually very worried. The reason why she could remain so calm was probably that she had previously gone overseas to train and had encountered the high-level Beyonders of the Gulong and Tamara families in East Chester County. She had some similar experiences.
After pretending to think for a moment, Ebner comforted him in a gentle tone, "You don't have to be too afraid. Since nothing terrible has happened so far, it means that this honorific name isn't very dangerous... Well, I'll write to Viscount Cullen later to ask."
Upon hearing Ebner's words and sensing that the situation wasn't too serious from his tone, Xio's expression eased a lot. She then hesitantly asked, "Then... Then can you first simulate Holy Light and perform an exorcism ritual for me? By the way, when I recited my honorific name, Fors was beside me. She had to exorcise the evil together."
Is this the future Judgment and The Magician getting Tower to exorcise The Fool?

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Banquet and Curse
chapters.content:
Chapter 184 - Banquet and Curse
As his thoughts raced, Ebner nodded and said, "Although I can't pray for power from the Eternal Blazing Sun, I can design a ritual and use the Ring of Light's powers to enhance the effects of exorcism... However, I don't have any metal or flowers from the Sun domain on hand. I have to purchase them tomorrow..."
In fact, with Ebner's present powers, holding an exorcism ritual wasn't that troublesome. However, he had to wait for Klein to respond to Xio's "prayer" and confirm her crimson star before carrying out the exorcism ritual.
Otherwise, if he really ended the connection, wouldn't he have wasted his efforts?
Xio had no objections to this. All she said was, "Then Fors and I will come to find you tomorrow at noon."
"You can stay in this villa temporarily tonight. If anything happens, I can provide help in time," Ebner suggested after thinking for a while.
As long as he was worried that Xio would overreact in fear after Klein responded to Xio at night, wouldn't it be terrible if she reported The Fool's name to the Church or MI9?
Although Klein didn't care if there were no believers, organizations, or doctrines from the Three Gods, such actions might cause Xio to lose her chance to join the Tarot Club.
Upon hearing Ebner's words, Xio began to think seriously. She didn't feel shy about moving into Ebner's house. After all, they were on the ship that was traveling to Damir. They were staying in a suite, which was much closer to the guest room than the villa...
She hesitated because she was worried that the mysterious existence would target Ebner because of this.
However, after thinking about it carefully, Ebner had been saying that he was Blessed of knowledge, and he had clearly obtained the favor of the Earth Mother. With such a background, he should not be afraid of that mysterious existence...
With this in mind, Xio tersely acknowledged and said, "I'll tell Fors."
At this moment, Ebner realized that he had been standing outside the study. He was about to open the door and enter when he was stopped by Xio, who was blocking the door.
Ebner asked curiously, "What's wrong?"
Xio pursed her lips when she heard that and replied in embarrassment, "Then... Um, Ebner, can you prepare another set of clothes? Yes, clothes that Fors can wear."
...
Because Mr. and Mrs. Macht were extremely experienced in hosting banquets and had a plan for the unexpected situations of the guests, they had prepared a few loose-fitting ladies' gowns in the villa. Although they did not fit well, as long as one's figure was not too extreme, they could still put them on.
In the banquet hall, Fors, who had changed into a beige X-shaped dress, held a plate and took a small cucumber sandwich. She took a bite and told Ebner, Xio, Roman, and Susan her true feelings in a half-joking manner,
"The style of the dessert at the banquet seems very unique. Be it carrot cake or cream muffin..."
Upon hearing this, Ebner shot a glance at Hazel, who was beside Bishop Utravsky, and explained, "It's said that Miss Hazel made it herself. Member of Parliament Macht was extremely gratified by this, so he placed these desserts on the table beside the main meal to share with everyone."
"Hazel?" Fors followed Ebner's gaze and immediately recognized the lady who had tried to steal her bracelet at the Daily Observer's headquarters dance.
So it's her... It's said that her right arm was severed by Ebner? Fors looked at the long glove on Hazel's right and nodded in thought.
As Ebner was surrounded by four young and beautiful ladies, he received quite a bit of attention. As for Portland Moment, who happened to overhear their conversation, he immediately laughed and said to Member of Parliament Macht,
"That doesn't sound like the Hazel I know."
Macht exchanged looks with his wife and said in satisfaction,
"Everyone will grow up, right?
"Hazel has really matured a lot recently. This is all thanks to Bishop Utravsky!"
Did Macht switch from a staunch believer of the Goddess to a half-giant bishop?
Ebner lampooned inwardly. Just as he was about to pick up a staple, he saw Madam Daly walking towards him with a smile without makeup.
"This is the bill for your expenses, Hero Detective." Without any further ado, Madam Daly took out an envelope and handed it over.
Ebner subconsciously took it and counted it. He discovered that there were ten notes worth ten pounds.
"Isn't... that too much?" That feast was clearly only about 50 pounds.
"The extra is the intelligence fee that Cesimir gave you. He's very satisfied with the service you provide." With that said, Daly looked at Xio and company beside Ebner. Her green eyes moved slightly before she chuckled.
"You don't seem to realize the seriousness of the situation, do you, Detective?"
"What?" Ebner said blankly.
"Including me, there are now five ladies accompanying you... Today, there are a few famous reporters. I'm afraid your reputation as a 'Hero Detective' will be published tomorrow. Yes, especially since I gave you money. I wonder what fanciful stories they will come up with," Daly said with a faint smile.
Ebner was shocked when he heard that. He turned his head and looked at Xio, Fors, Roman, Susan... He thought to himself, Daly's words might very well come true!
Should I immediately hypnotize those reporters? Although I haven't learned this ability, I can pray to "Knowledge and Wisdom" to create charms.
"Heh heh, you took it seriously! Don't worry. Only the bishop and the two girls behind you can see that I came to find you and gave you an envelope." The corners of Daly's mouth curled up as she shook her head and smiled.
"Ma'am, I have to admit that your joke almost killed me," Ebner said helplessly.
"If you really take action, you will probably have to enjoy the gentleness of the Nighthawks under Saint Samuel Cathedral tonight." Daly smiled at Ebner.
...
Tingen, West Borough.
At this time, the sky had completely darkened, and dark clouds had covered the crimson moon.
A two-story grayish-blue house on the banks of the Tussock River seemed to be hidden in this dark shadow. It was extremely quiet, and not a single sound could be heard. It was as if there were no worms or life.
Klein looked at this scene, his palms sweating as his body trembled.
He felt that there were countless terrifying things hidden there, waiting for a bloody feast.
Soon, he heard a violent gust of wind and could clearly distinguish the gunshot.
After a few minutes, he heard singing coming from the target building.
It was a folklore tune that Leonard often hummed. It was filled with vulgar words, and it was also the signal for him to meet up with Dunn and company!
But just as he took two steps, Klein suddenly paused. Then, he undid the silver chain in his sleeve and allowed the topaz pendant to fall naturally.
"The singing just now was an illusion."
...
After reciting it seven times, he opened his eyes and saw the pendant spinning counterclockwise.
"It's not an illusion..."
Klein felt relieved and quickly walked into the house.
Then, he saw Dunn putting down a puppet beside a destroyed altar. He turned around and said to himself,
"This is a terrifying curse ritual. Fortunately, we have already destroyed it... This puppet is cursing you. You can use it to communicate."
Realizing that he was no longer a burden, Klein subconsciously stuck out his chest and looked up.
"Yes, Captain."
But after he finished speaking, he came back to his senses and looked around. He realized that each puppet beside the altar had a different name and corresponding information.
"Who else was cursed other than me?" Klein subconsciously asked.
"And Leonard and me... The rest are survivors of the Alfalfa," Dunn said after a moment of silence.
The Alfalfa survivor... Was it Instigator Tris? No, according to the information provided by Tower regarding Demoness, she should be called Trissy now!
With this in mind, Klein was just about to report to the Captain when he heard the latter say in a mellow voice,
"Previously, Daly encountered a terrifying Demoness in Backlund, but she and Hero Detective killed her together... And later, Daly specially wrote to me and told me an important piece of information—the name of the Demoness pathway's Sequence 7 is Witch!"

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Recognition
chapters.content:
Chapter 185 - Recognition
At this moment, Leonard suddenly exclaimed and asked, "Witch? Captain, do you mean that the lady who escaped was Tris? He became a woman?"
With that said, he suddenly paused before coming to a realization. "So that's how it is. This can perfectly explain Instigator Tris sudden disappearance. It also matches the characteristics of the upper echelons of the Demoness Sect."
"What?" Frye blurted out in surprise, as though he didn't hear what Leonard was saying.
Klein, who was still considering how he should explain the information he had obtained from the Tarot Club in a reasonable manner, was taken aback. He then looked at Captain Dunn, wanting to hear what he had to say. If there was anything lacking, he could find an excuse to add on.
It was just like when he had wanted to answer Miss Justice's question at the Tarot Club, but had been beaten to it by the Tower or The Hanged Man.
"According to Daly, after a Beyonder of the Demoness pathway becomes a Sequence 7, they will indeed become female." Dunn first nodded, acknowledging Leonard's guess. Then, he pointed at the puppets with names written on them and said, "However, I can't confirm if it's Tris... Trissy. After all, it might be another member of the Demoness Sect."
"The potion can actually accomplish such a thing!" Frye sighed in disbelief.
"Combined with the person cursed on the puppet, I believe it should be her. After all, the three of us were the ones who foiled her plan of instigating Joyce to kill someone. It's reasonable for her to seek revenge on us," Leonard judged matter-of-factly.
"Don't jump to conclusions without concrete evidence..." Dunn criticized Leonard's frivolousness before solemnly saying to Klein, "I'll leave it to you."
Hearing the trust in the captain's tone, Klein nodded. After thinking for a moment, he quickly set up the ritual and placed a mirror that had shattered due to the witch's use of the Mirror Substitution Technique in front of him. Then, he chanted in Hermes,
"...I pray that this mirror can be restored for a short period of time. I pray that it will reflect everyone that has been reflected for the past month."
...
As the incantation was recited, the mirror began to glow with a dark light. Immediately after, a figure was reflected.
It was a young lady. She had soft black hair, a round face, and gentle and sweet temperament.
"Indeed, she's very similar to Instigator Tris. It should be her," Leonard said with a smile when he saw this scene.
Dunn nodded solemnly as well. He turned to look at Klein and said, "Try divining the target's current location."
"Alright." Klein placed his cane on the clothes Trissy hadn't destroyed in time. Then, he recalled the target's facial features and corresponding information as he recited the divination statement.
"Tris, no, Trissy whereabouts."
After repeating it seven times, the silver-inlaid black cane actually failed to topple in the midst of swaying. Instead, it remained firmly in place.
The divination was disrupted.
...
In the dark night, Klein and Leonard walked about five hundred meters before they saw the public carriage stop.
After waiting for a while, they returned to Iron Cross Street. One of them went to the nearby police station and asked the police officers to help seal off the dock and train station, while the other returned directly to his home in Daffodil Street.
After parting with Klein, Leonard looked at his colleague's back and tilted his head as though he was listening to something. He then muttered to himself,
With that badly damaged mirror as a medium, it's impossible to present the figure so clearly?
Does Klein seem to have secretly used some techniques that are passed down within the Sanguine?
"As expected, he is a 'protagonist' who hides secrets just like me!"
...
After returning to the terrace house at 2 Daffodil Street, Klein quickly ran to the second floor and entered his bedroom.
After locking the door and sealing the room with a wall of spirituality, he calmed his emotions and took four steps counterclockwise. Following that, he appeared in the towering palace above the gray fog amidst crazy ravings.
Sitting on the high-back chair belonging to The Fool, Klein prepared to respond to the reliable companion recommended by Mr. Tower and let the matter enter the examination process.
He reached out his hand and pointed at the circle of light that was constantly rippling because Xio was reciting her true name to establish a connection.
Immediately following that, the mysterious space above the gray fog trembled slightly for a few seconds.
When everything calmed down, a blurry figure appeared at the edge of the long bronze table.
Xio opened her eyes sleepily and saw the boundless gray fog, an ancient high-back chair, and a black figure looking down at her.
Klein carefully sized up Xio before severing the connection according to his plan.
The petite figure with a hazy face disappeared, but there was an illusory crimson star in the grayish-white fog.
When Klein saw this scene, he frowned slightly because he felt that the girl was strangely familiar.
Faced with an inexplicable sense of familiarity, other Sequence 9 Beyonders might try their best to recall or ignore it, but Seers were different. Klein directly conjured a pen and paper and wrote a divination statement:
"The source of that sense of familiarity."
Right on the heels of that, he held the piece of paper and leaned back, silently reciting the divination statement.
After seven times, his eyes darkened and he fell into a deep sleep.
In the blurry and distorted world, Klein saw a petite girl shoot Instigator Tris, who was about to retreat into the shadows and kill him on the spot.
Besides the girl was a young man wearing a military uniform, a triangular hat, and a pair of copper-framed glasses.
...
This is the dream I saw when I was divining Joyce's dream. Does it seem to be hiding something terrifying?
Mr. Tower's reliable friend is the girl who killed Tris in the dream?
In that case, the young man beside the girl... could he be Tower himself?
That was highly possible! To be able to take risks in such a magical place meant that they were close enough!
However, if that youth was really "Tower," then he should have disguised himself every time he participated in the Tarot Club? At the very least, he never wore glasses after coming above the gray fog...
Heh heh, the lively thoughts I observed from "Tower" were indeed faked. He didn't trust The Fool as much as he appeared!
For some reason, Klein, who had come to this conclusion, heaved a sigh of relief.
...
Cherwood Borough, in the garden villa at 28 Kingst Street.
After the banquet ended, she sat upon his bed.
She had been worried about the hidden danger of chanting The Fool's honorific name. Not long after she fell asleep, she dreamed of a mysterious space and the gray fog figure looking down at her.
This dream was so clear that it scared her once again.
She had already relaxed a lot when she felt that Ebner's attitude wasn't too serious.
Xio got up and put on her clothes. She put on the Ring of Prejudice and held the triangular blade in her hand as though it would give her courage.
Still, she thought, trembling a little.
Is it a nightmare caused by fear, or is it because of the attention of a hidden existence? Is there an evil spirit haunting me?
Could there be monsters attacking in the dark?
Hmm... Should I find Ebner to exorcise the evil right now? There's no need to wait for the ritual. I'll get him to help me simulate Holy Light first?
"But it's already so late... It doesn't seem too good..."
Xio struggled for a few seconds and looked at Fors, who was sleeping soundly beside her. She thought to herself, To be able to sleep so soundly means that I didn't see the mysterious space or the gray fog... In other words, I'm the only one being "watched"...
With this in mind, Xio heaved a sigh of relief. However, this also strengthened her resolve to find Ebner to exorcise the evil.
At the very least, she couldn't sleep with Fors tonight, or she might be implicated.
...
In the master bedroom on the third floor, the gas lamps were still lit even though it was almost midnight.
Ebner was feeling a headache over the teasing of Mike and his friends after the banquet when he suddenly felt his spirituality stir. He hurriedly activated his Spirit Vision and immediately saw an illusory monster appear from the void.
Its body was made of white bones, and its eye sockets shimmered with pitch-black flames. It was nearly four meters tall.
This was Jane's messenger, suspected to be one of the legacies inherited from her ancestor's mausoleum.
Furthermore, the messenger's appearance was very similar to the original description of Mr. Azik's messenger.
The skeleton messenger looked down at Ebner, then took out a mirror and handed it to him.
Puzzled, Ebner took the mirror, but he soon heard Jane's voice coming from inside:
"Ebner? This mirror can share my vision, but it can't be used for communication...
"Yes, the time is just right. A sea battle that might be recorded in history is about to begin."

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Exorcism and Live Broadcast
chapters.content:
Chapter 186 - Exorcism and Live Broadcast
A naval battle... what was this? Was this a live broadcast of a war movie?
The corners of Ebner's mouth twitched. Then, he habitually activated the Eye of Pure White and began analyzing the mirror.
