It turned out that it was only a part of an organization separated from a spirit world creature. Its main body was still in Jane's hands, so it was able to transmit what Jane saw and what it said to this part of the "mirror"...
This... I can't learn it.
Sighing to herself, Ebner concentrated on the image in the "mirror."
However, as it was not yet midnight, apart from the surging waves of the ocean, there was only a brief and excited commentary. There was nothing else worth paying attention to.
Dong!
Dong dong!
But at this moment, there was a sudden and forceful knock on the bedroom door.
Ebner suddenly sat up straight and placed the "mirror" on the table before walking to the door and asking in a deep voice,
"Who is it?"
"Ebner, it's me..." Xio's slightly uneasy voice sounded from outside the door.
Xio? Why are you here at this time? By the way, it's likely that Klein pulled her into the gray fog and didn't tell her anything, so she's afraid...
With a plan in mind, Ebner knocked on the door and saw Xio carefully enter the room.
"I heard a woman's voice when I was outside... I was still wondering if I should knock on the door." Xio first looked around before saying in puzzlement.
As it was close to midnight, Jane, who relied on special spirit help to observe from afar, was completely focused on maintaining the spirit from being discovered. She had no time to speak, so Xio couldn't find the source of the voice.
"That's a friend of mine speaking through a Beyonder item..." Ebner hurriedly explained. Otherwise, his reputation would really be hopeless.
With that said, he stood up the "mirror" so that Xio could see the scene inside.
"Mirror... What are you looking at?" Xio was even more puzzled after taking a few looks.
Ebner thought for a moment and felt that there was no need to hide the matter of him reporting Admiral Hell from Xio. He recounted the entire matter, especially the part about Jane.
It wasn't that he didn't want to talk to Hugh about Jane. It was just that it involved Jane's privacy, and until he got her permission, he couldn't casually reveal it.
"Jane... is that classmate of yours? I remember helping her catch her father's adultery... Well, it was later proven to be a misunderstanding," Xio said as she recalled.
"Yes, she became a Beyonder after Mr. Grant's accident," Ebner replied with a nod.
Xio suddenly sighed and said in an envious and yearning tone, "But in two months, she's already a Spirit Medium..."
Mr. Hanged Man said at the previous Tarot Gathering that he could obtain the horn of a Black Snake of Lightning on Thursday or Friday, so you aren't far from advancing.
Ebner muttered something under his breath, but on the surface, he changed the subject. "What brings you here so late?"
Xio snapped back to reality at his words. She composed herself and organized her words to tell Ebner about the mysterious space she had just seen in her dream and the gray fog figure.
"So you want to perform an exorcism right now?" Ebner immediately guessed her intentions.
"Is it because it won't work too well?" Xio pursed her lips. She could tell what Ebner was thinking from his attitude.
It's not that the effects aren't too good, but it will produce a rather good backlash... Perhaps it can even let Klein watch our live stream...
Ebner grumbled to himself, but he did not refuse to exorcise Xio.
Firstly, he didn't have an excuse to reject Xio's request. If he kept rejecting her, Xio might notice something amiss. When the time came, he could only lay his cards on the table.
Secondly, even if Holy Light strengthened the connection between Sefirah Castle and Xio, Klein probably wouldn't be able to see their faces clearly... Yes, it would be best if he spoke as little as possible later.
Thirdly, the naval battle in the "mirror" was about to begin. By strengthening his connection, he could also get Mr. Fool to watch a "gun version" movie remotely...
With this in mind, Ebner made Xio sit by the bed while he raised the Ring of Light and aimed it at her.
As the gem on the ring shone, Xio saw a pure, warm, and bright light burst from Ebner's finger.
It surged toward her like a tidal wave, drowning her completely.
This feeling was very similar to when she received the purification of the Sun Brooch from Detective Isengard. However, the light that Ebner used the Ring of Light to create was purer and stronger.
Dozens of seconds later, everything returned to normal. Xio felt warm, comfortable, and at ease. It was as though she had been soaking in a hot spring. The fear, frustration, and worry she had felt earlier had been swept away, leaving only her vigorous fighting spirit and fearless courage.
...
Tingen, 2 Daffodil Street.
Klein, who had just divined that Trissy would take the steam locomotive out of Tingen, didn't stay above the gray fog for long. He wrapped himself with his spirituality and simulated the experience of falling, successfully "returning" to his room.
Captain previously said that he would send a telegram to Backlund, to Enmat Harbor, to the main railway station, and to have Trissy wanted nationwide... I won't report the results of the divination this time, lest I be suspected... Klein quickly made a decision. This was because, regardless of his warning, Dunn was using the most correct method to set up the follow-up.
Due to the operation to capture Trissy in the evening, he had yet to have dinner. Thankfully, the considerate Melissa had especially left him dinner, and all he could think of was the greasy lamb chop.
"Praise the Goddess... It would be even better if there were some fennel and cumin."
Klein had just taken a bite when he suddenly felt a warmth on the back of his hand.
He couldn't help but look down and realize that the four black dots representing the mysterious space above the gray fog hadn't appeared.
"What's going on? Is there anything wrong with pulling that lady into the gray fog?" He muttered in puzzlement before eating the lamb chop in a few bites. Then, without washing his hands, he sealed the room with his spirituality again.
This was a change that he relied on the most, so he had to take it seriously.
He quickly took four steps counterclockwise and entered the ancient and lofty palace above the gray fog. Klein looked up to the side and discovered that the core of the newly added crimson star had been dyed with a golden color that resembled sunlight.
"Is this the source of the warmth I felt?" Klein spread out his spirituality and carefully touched it as he recalled his prayers.
Light and shadow changed as a blurry scene appeared before his eyes.
The petite girl he had attempted to pull above the gray fog was sitting on a bed in a bedroom. And in front of her, a youth wearing copper-framed glasses raised the ring on his right hand and pointed it at her.
Immediately after, warm and pure light erupted, surrounding the petite lady.
Klein immediately recognized the youth as the one he had seen in dream divination. And he had previously guessed that it was Tower himself.
At this time, they're actually in the same bedroom. Their relationship is indeed very intimate... I'm increasingly certain that the youth is 'Tower'.
However, is this lady looking for "Tower" to exorcise evil? And "Tower" really dares to do it... Is he certain that a holy light at this level can't do anything to Mr. Fool's gaze?
With this in mind, Klein nearly laughed.
And at this moment, he finally understood the reason for the situation. It wasn't that someone had penetrated the gray fog and locked onto him. It was similar to the Tarot Club members chanting their honorific names and praying. And when the gray fog received the information, it would instinctively respond to him. However, because it wasn't a prayer, the illusory stacked voices turned into a warm current.
A hint. This is a hint, not an effect or damage... Klein made a clear judgment.
At the same time, the image in front of him and the voice he heard remained. It did not disappear as quickly as it usually did.
In the past, I wasn't able to take the initiative to pry into the corresponding target of the crimson star. Only when the target makes a request can I receive the corresponding scene...
"Yes, there's another situation. When I provide feedback, I can see the scene and hear synchronized voices. However, once the response ends, I won't be able to obtain any additional information."
"But now, this scene and sound surprisingly lasted for a long time... It's like a reality show full of mosaics."
"The purifying power helped me maintain the corresponding passageway?"
At this moment, he suddenly saw the bespectacled young man sit beside the petite lady and look at a mirror on the table.
At the same time, an ethereal female voice sounded from the mirror.
"Ebner, look! The Black Tulip has appeared!"
Klein was taken aback when he heard that as he thought,
"Ebner? Is that the name of the Tower?"

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Watching the Sea War
chapters.content:
Chapter 187 - Watching the Sea War
Outside Pritz Harbor, the ocean that was free from industrial pollution was silent. Only the crimson moon hung high in the sky, mysterious and dreamy.
Suddenly, a ghastly and terrifying sailboat sailed over from the sea not far away. It was fast and silent.
It was a large, three-masted, wide-body ship. It was extremely large and nearly a hundred meters long. Its color was mainly black and suffused with a gloomy green color.
On its pale sail was a blooming black tulip.
It was none other than Admiral Hell Ludwell's flagship, Black Tulip!
He wondered where Jane had hidden the spirit that had been used for reconnaissance. Through the "mirror" that stood on the table, Ebner could clearly see a man dressed as a captain standing on the deck at the head of the ship.
He wore an exaggerated triangular hat embroidered with white skeletons and feathers. He wore a white shirt with floral borders and a complicated and gorgeous brown short coat. A thin rapier hung from the leather belt that secured his white tights.
The man's face was covered in a silver mask. His facial features and contours were hidden inside. The cold lines around the holes that represented his eyes, nose, and mouth made one feel intimidated.
This image matched perfectly with the rumored Admiral Hell Ludwell!
At this moment, the man suspected to be Ludwell turned his head and looked in the direction of the "mirror" as though he had discovered Jane's spying.
However, before he could react, some ripples suddenly appeared on the originally empty sea surface.
Those ripples rippled in the air like water and spread out at an unimaginable speed, revealing the five military warships hidden behind them.
...
Ocean Songster's Water Screen? But the effects are just too good. It even managed to fool Admiral Hell... Hmm, there should be other pathway powers mixed in. At the very least, it weakened or concealed the aura of a living person. Otherwise, Admiral Hell would've long discovered that something was amiss.
Ebner took a few leftover carrot cakes and cream muffins from the party and placed some drinks on the coffee table in front of the bed. He took a bite of the cake and commented.
These were all Hazel's works. After all, the other normal desserts were basically finished by the customers.
Xio nodded and silently grabbed a piece of cake as well. Then, she stared at the military flagship that was much larger than the Black Tulip and said with sparkling eyes, "This is the first time I've seen an ironclad... It's said that it has more than ten thousand tons of weight, and its armor is nearly half a meter thick..."
You even know this?
Ebner looked sideways but didn't respond, because he really hadn't noticed the specific parameters of the ironclad warship. It was part of his knowledge blindness.
To hide it, he had no choice but to pick up another muffin and put it in his mouth.
Above the gray fog, in the ancient palace, sitting on the high-back chair belonging to The Fool, Klein, who had watched the entire scene through the crimson star representing Xio, suddenly felt hungry again.
...
In the outer sea of Pritz Harbor, when Admiral Hell Ludwell saw the ambush that had suddenly appeared, he looked at the towering ship that was shimmering with metallic light from afar. Two pale-white flames burned silently in the eye sockets of his silver mask.
Right on the heels of that, he raised his left hand without any hesitation. The black, square-shaped ring on his index finger emitted a faint glow.
In an instant, with Ludwell at the center, illusory light suddenly erupted. It quickly spun and collapsed inward, forming a blurry bronze door.
The bronze door was covered in all sorts of mysterious patterns. It had an indescribable deepness and silence.
With a creak, the door swung open a crack.
Behind the gap was unfathomable darkness, like the deepest and heaviest night sky.
Ludwell raised his hand to his face and removed the silver mask.
A deep, pale-white light suddenly spewed out from behind the mask, causing the black, heavy ring on Ludwell's left index finger to instantly emit endless deathly silence.
The deathly silence surged into the bronze door, pushing it off the deck and into midair.
The door, which was covered in mysterious patterns, fused with an infinite deathly silence and rapidly expanded to more than thirty meters tall.
It stood there with the sea as its base as if it was connected to another world, different from the current world.
Since the Loen military had ambushed him, they must have made ample preparations... Therefore, he couldn't place his hopes on luck. Decisively retreating was the best choice.
With this in mind, Ludwell planned on pulling the Black Tulip into the bronze door and into another world.
But at that moment, a deep and dignified voice echoed across the sea.
"Wandering is prohibited here!
"Teleportation is prohibited here!
"The Spiritual Realm is forbidden here!"
Accompanied by this voice, the bronze door that was about to open completely closed and gradually dissipated into the sea.
Upon seeing this, the pale flames in Ludwell's eyes clearly wavered before shrinking to an extreme. He spat out a word,
"Law Enforcer!"
Such a level of "restrictions" could only be completed by a demigod.
...
"Isn't this a little bullying? Ludwell is only a pirate admiral, but the military actually dispatched a demigod to deal with him... Even if he wins, it won't be glorious... The navy is really well-prepared to ensure the victory of the Pritz." Ebner sighed and took a sip of sweet iced tea.
"Were those 'restrictions' made by a demigod?" Xio asked casually as she focused on the scene in the mirror.
"The spirit world door Ludwell constructed has the augmentation of that ring. How can ordinary judges be prohibited? It must've been a demigod who personally took action." When Ebner said this, he saw that the Black Tulip had no choice but to turn its body when it failed to escape. It seized the "T" to engage in battle and added,
"Without any other hidden means, Admiral Hell is in danger!"
Above the gray fog, Klein muttered to himself in thought, "So this is how Beyonders of the Arbiter pathway fight when they fight... Is it a "restrictions" to begin with?"
...
On the surface of the sea outside Pritz Harbor, the Black Tulip did not head straight for the ironclad warships that were obviously not to be trifled with. Instead, it headed for a steam-powered sail double-powered warship that was coming from the north, planning to break out of the siege from here.
As the cannon windows were pushed open one by one, the dozens of cannons on the right side of the Black Tulip fired in unison, producing a series of rumbling sounds.
Cannonballs flew towards the dual-powered warship. Before they could approach, they fell into the sea and exploded into waves. They either leaped over or fell further away.
This was a calibrated shot!
But soon, the second round of cannon fire sounded again.
And at that moment, on the warship that had been bombarded, a thin middle-aged man dressed in the Church of Storms bishop's attire suddenly soared into the sky. His hair stood up at the same time as lightning coiled around him.
Right on the heels of that, the silver bolts of lightning wrapped around his hair shot out like arrows, accurately intercepting every cannonball!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Amidst the lightning and fire, the silver and crimson colors shone, and then shrapnel flew everywhere as if dozens of fireworks had been set off.
...
Ludwell is very unlucky. He actually chose to break out of the encirclement with an Ocean Songster of the same level as him... I have to say that the Church of Storms is very professional when it comes to naval warfare. Not only do they have an advantage in terms of attack and movement, but they also have a way to defend against artillery fire... Admiral Hell is probably doomed this time.
Ebner stared intently at the scene, his expression turning solemn. He didn't care about anything else but the final destination of Ludwell's ring. After all, it concerned the place where Death had fallen.
...
Under Ebner's gaze, the Black Tulip continued its bombardment while opening the bronze door in its body again, causing translucent, illusory, and hideous creatures to appear in the sea of artillery!
Pale corpses stretched out their rotten palms as crimson or cold flames appeared, forming pairs of eyes.
Suddenly, this place seemed to become the entrance to hell. All kinds of undead creatures crowded the surface of the sea and charged at the warship like a tide.
When the Ocean Songster on the ship saw this, she immediately started singing and constantly used her "terrifying" voice to intimidate all the undead who dared to approach.
However, due to his distraction, it was inevitable that he would be hit by the Black Tulip. The ship immediately burst into flames.
Thankfully, at this moment, the Pritz rushed to the battlefield with steam power.
...
Above the gray fog, in an ancient palace.
Klein looked at the gradually dissipating golden sunlight as the corners of his mouth twitched. Finally, he said helplessly,
"I wonder if I can get the 'Tower' to use 'Holy Light' to renew the fees'? At least let me finish watching it. It's so uncomfortable to be cut off here..."

chapters.title: Chapter 188: After the War
chapters.content:
Chapter 188 - After the War
"This place prohibits ghosts and undead!"
The undead that was charging forward like a tide suddenly froze, and then they were blown up by an invisible majestic force and vanished in the blink of an eye as another voice echoed on the sea.
When the Pritz arrived on the battlefield, the situation on the Marines' side, which could only be passively beaten, quickly changed.
The sailors on the battleship where the Ocean Songster was stationed were no longer shivering in terror due to the undead's aura. Instead, they started loading shells and launching counterattacks.
In an instant, dozens of cannons on the left side of the warship roared.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Cannonballs flew out and landed around the Black Tulip, creating huge waves on the sea. The mist that was stirred up covered a large area.
However, the strange thing was that the intense bombardment failed to hit the Black Tulip. Some of the shrapnel brushed past the ship, but they seemed to have touched a projection and passed through it!
Seeing this scene, a lady standing on the Pritz frowned. She extended her right hand and pressed down again.
"The mystery of this place has weakened, and reality has strengthened!"
Just as she finished her sentence, a thick black fog suddenly rose from the surface of the Black Tulip, as though it was resisting some invisible force.
However, this resistance reduced the mystery of Specter Ship. Immediately, it was hit by several cannonballs, sending the skeletons controlling the ship flying.
At the same time, the Pritz finally entered the battle. The two main cannons on the deck in front of them were the first to take action. Almost instantly, two large holes were torn open on the Black Tulip.
The main gun of the Pritz was a 305mm heavy cannon. Fortunately, the "Black Tulip" was also a giant ship, and it still had some mysterious protection. Otherwise, those two shots would have blown off half of the ship's bow.
However, the military was obviously not satisfied with the current results. The other six rapid-fire cannons on the Pritz, twelve six-pound cannons, eighteen six-barrel machine guns, and four torpedo launchers fired at the same time. Dozens of shells and torpedoes immediately exploded on the Black Tulip, causing the Specter Ship, which had been sailing across the Five Seas for countless years, to flare up and show signs of breaking.
Admiral Hell Ludwell's masked face couldn't be seen, but he knew that he had reached the most dangerous moment. Furthermore, he hadn't received any response from the bronze door in his body to the Numinous Episcopate...
He had to make a decision!
Seeing that the second round of attack from the Pritz was about to descend once again, Ludwell looked at the Black Tulip beneath his feet with some reluctance. He thought to himself, Thankfully, only the Black Tulip came alone because of the pursuit of the Future... Furthermore, the first and second mate are scattered across the various fleets. Even if I lose my flagship this time, as long as I don't return to the Underworld, I'll still be Admiral Hell.
Taking a deep breath, Ludwell no longer hesitated. He took off the silver mask on his face again and removed most of the restraints on his Underworld.
Right on the heels of that, the illusory bronze door appeared once again. The opening produced an extremely terrifying suction force, causing the people on the nearby ships, be it ordinary sailors, soldiers, or Beyonders, to feel their Spirit Bodies float up uncontrollably, separating from their bodies bit by bit. Furthermore, they were unable to stop it!
...
"The reason why Admiral Hell Ludwell kept wearing that mask was that he had accommodated an extremely powerful Underworld creature that far exceeded his own. On the one hand, this creature was used by him, but on the other hand, it had corrupted his body and transformed him into a half-dead, half-human existence.
"And the mask's effect is to pacify the soul, allowing the Underworld creatures in Ludwell's body to remain relatively calm most of the time.
"Now that he has been forced to a dead end, he should have steeled his heart and completely released the restrictions on that Underworld creature! That's why he has such a terrifying suction force on his Spirit Body... Look, even the Imperative Mage has no choice but to focus on resisting. He can no longer maintain the previous' restrictions'."
In the master bedroom at 28 Gold Street's garden villa in Cherwood Borough, Ebner explained the current situation to Xio based on the information in the novel and the mysticism knowledge he currently possessed.
Xio nodded slightly when she heard that and said thoughtfully, "I'm afraid he will pay quite a price for this."
"That's for sure... However, now that the law of 'Spirit World Traversal' has disappeared, he has a chance of escaping, right?" Ebner took a sip of sweet iced tea and smiled.
...
It was just as Ebner had predicted. The moment the decree disappeared, Ludwell raised the square black ring on his left index finger again and aimed it at the illusory bronze door, infusing the power of death into it.
The bronze door suddenly changed. It connected to the world of death, but this time, it didn't expand to the size of the Black Tulip.
Ludwell deeply knew that the chance of escaping was only a few seconds. There would definitely be a counterattack from the Imperative Mage later, and the Black Tulip's hull was too massive. It was impossible for it to pass through the door in such a short period of time.
His gaze first swept across the lady on Pritz before landing on the Ocean Songster on the corvette. As though he wanted to remember the two enemies, he decisively stepped through the bronze door and vanished.
...
At the same time, the image in the "mirror" in the villa's bedroom suddenly stopped.
"Ebner, Mirror, you can blow the copper whistle and hand it to the messenger tomorrow morning... I still have some matters to attend to, so I'll stop here."
As Jane's voice came from the mirror, it indicated that the "live stream" was officially over.
Ebner stood up and sealed the mirror with his spirituality before storing it in a box. Only then did he smile and tease Xio, who still hadn't had enough. "I'm going to sleep after watching the naval battle. Are you staying here or going back to sleep?"
Xio rolled her eyes at him when she heard that. She knew that he was using a joke to ease her fear, so she deliberately said in all seriousness, "Alright, I don't have any objections... But have you considered the consequences of me leaving your room tomorrow morning and being seen by the servants? You were already in the limelight at the previous banquet. Don't tell me you really want to be in the headlines?"
Then why did you come to my room in the middle of the night? Klein didn't know how to make up stories about us in Sefirah Castle!
Ebner complained in his heart, but seeing that Xio was obviously joking and teasing him, he knew that she had already adjusted her mindset and was no longer as helpless as before. He was relieved.
In particular, Klein clearly had no intention of pulling him into Sefirah Castle for questioning. This meant that Xio didn't have any strange traces or limbs left behind by the ancient dragon or the high-level Beyonder of the Tamara family...
As for being noticed or 'arranged', that was unavoidable. They could only react accordingly.
After all, even he and Mr. Fool were still being "arranged"!
...
In the Sonia Sea, on a small island nearly 50 nautical miles away from Pritz Harbor, a thin-haired elder emerged from the void.
He looked at the direction of the sea outside Pritz Harbor with an ugly expression and learned the result of the naval battle from the surrounding natural spirits.
This elder was a demigod of the Numinous Episcopate. After receiving Admiral Hell's distress signal, he rushed over via Spirit World Traversal.
While he was traveling, he suddenly fell into a peach forest full of flowers.
The peach forest seemed to be a sealed off space. Its connection to the outside world was completely cut off by the mountain at the end of the forest's water source.
Left with no choice, the old man could only try to explore the outside of a small cave...
But when he finally passed through the cave and walked out of the peach forest, he realized that time had passed far faster than he had imagined.
"Who is stopping me?"
The elder thought for a while, but he couldn't figure out which pathway this power came from. And now, the military demigod seemed to have sensed his arrival. Therefore, he had no choice but to enter the spirit world again and leave this island.
...
In a cave on an island, Ludwell, who had been rendered immobile by the powerful spiritual backlash in his body, raised his head with great difficulty. He looked at a gigantic Spirit Body with pitch-black flames burning in its eye sockets not far away from him. Immediately, he felt his brain buzz before he lost consciousness.
...
Early Thursday morning, Ebner, who had just woken up and had yet to blow the copper whistle to return the "mirror", suddenly felt his spirituality stir. He hurriedly activated his Spirit Vision and saw a nearly four-meter-long skeleton messenger place a thin rapier on the table in front of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Respective
chapters.content:
Chapter 189 - Respective
Looking at the rapier placed on the table by the messenger, Ebner frowned and had various guesses.
However, he didn't see any letter from Jane except for the rapier, so he had a thought. He took out the box that was temporarily sealed last night and took out the "mirror" used for "live-streaming."
As expected, just as he removed the spirituality seal, he heard a faint voice.
"Ebner, this is Ludwell's sword. It's considered a mystical item... I'll give it to you as a gift.
"In addition, please hand the mirror directly to the messenger."
Ebner looked up at the tall messenger, who was nearly four meters tall and whose head had extended out of the roof. He complied and held the mirror high.
Upon seeing this, the skeleton messenger crouched down and received the mirror.
Ebner froze for a moment, then tipped his head back to look into the other man's eyes, which were burning with dark fire. He nodded slightly as a greeting.
Is this how Xio usually feels when he looks at others? Ebner wondered darkly as he watched the messenger disappear.
At this moment, he picked up the rapier and activated the Eye of Pure White to analyze it.
Indeed, it's not a mystical item that directly corresponds to which pathway or Sequence it is from, but a product of an irregular combination of similar characteristics...
"It only has one Beyonder power, and that is to bring absolute destruction to the object it stabs.
The results of the analysis are basically the same as the description of Ludwell's thin sword. I should be able to confirm that this is his sword...
In that case, it turns out that Jane was in such a hurry to switch off her live broadcast last night to chase after Ludwell?
Even the sword was seized. Ludwell is probably doomed... In that case, the ring left behind by Death was likely either obtained by Jane or fallen into Admiral of Stars hands...
In fact, if the plan to intercept Admiral Hell is being presided over by Admiral of Stars, that would be fine...
"If Jane really completed it on her own... then her harvest in her ancestor's mausoleum might be beyond imagination..."
After thinking for a moment, Ebner laughed self-deprecatingly. This was because even if there was anything wrong with the mausoleum, Jane had Admiral of Stars and even Queen Mystic to take care of her. It wasn't his place to interfere. Besides, with his present strength, he couldn't interfere...
I still have to raise my strength as soon as possible... This world's future will only become more dangerous. Sequence 7 isn't enough.
After sighing with emotion, Ebner placed the thin sword in his collection room and thought:
"I remember that Ludwell's weapon is called 'Harris Rapier'. It originated from an ancient prince of the Southern Continent... However, from today onwards, it will be called 'Bryan Rapier'.
After that, Ebner had a hasty breakfast and prepared to buy the relevant items for the Sun domain ritual.
He had agreed to perform another exorcism ritual for Xio yesterday, so he naturally had to keep his word.
However, after he left and arrived at the street intersection, he was about to board the public carriage when he suddenly heard the paperboy's voice.
"Extra! Extra! The Black Tulip has been sunk by the new ironclad warship. A new era is coming!"
"Extra! Extra! The Black Tulip has been sunk by the new ironclad warship. A new era is coming!"
After pausing for a moment, Ebner quickly took out a two-pence coin and bought a copy of the Daily Observer. Many passengers who wanted to take the bus made the same choice.
Opening the newspaper, Ebner immediately saw the headlines:
"The Black Tulip was sunk by the heavy cannons of the ironclad warship Pritz. Admiral Hell Ludwell jumped into the sea to escape."
...
At the same time, at Daffodil Street in Tingen City.
"Extra! Extra! Doomsday for the Pirate Admiral! The first battle of the ironclad warship has been won!"
Klein was originally covering his mouth with his hand and yawning when he suddenly felt energized when he heard the newsboy peddling.
He didn't sleep well the entire night because he kept thinking about the outcome of the naval battle. Although it had nothing to do with him, he really couldn't accept the feeling of the story coming to an abrupt end at its climax. If he hadn't remembered to maintain Mr. Fool's mystery, he would've frequently used his spirituality to touch the crimson star of the Tower, urging him to use Holy Light again to reinforce the passageway.
After spending money to buy a Tingen Morning Post, Klein quickly browsed through it.
There was not much content in the news. They only explained the time, location, characters, and results. As the saying goes, the shorter the content, the bigger the matter.
Ludwell still managed to escape in the end? With the situation last night, with a demigod personally participating in the hunt, I thought it would be difficult for Admiral Hell to escape this calamity... As expected of a pirate admiral? His strength is indeed astonishing!
However, the matter happened last night in the outer seas of Pritz Harbor. As for Tingen City, it was already revealed by the newspapers this morning. The speed of information exchange in this world isn't too slow. This is all thanks to Emperor Roselle's outstanding contribution. Thank you for inventing a telegram. If not for such a convenient way of transmitting information, even with a steam locomotive, it would have taken at least two to three days for Tingen to receive it...
Just as he thought of this, Klein suddenly froze as he frowned.
He realized that he had made a common sense mistake regarding Trissy's divination before watching the "live stream" last night!
Only Earthlings would make such a common sense mistake!
During his divination above the gray fog last night, Klein had seen Trissy take the steam locomotive into the distance. Therefore, he subconsciously determined that this was happening.
However, no one in this world had invented electric lights or similar devices. There was almost no steam locomotive after dark, and Klein, who was used to seeing green trains traveling at night, instinctively ignored it!
In other words, that wasn't what happened last night!
It was the scene of the future that he had foreseen!
With this in mind, Klein couldn't be bothered to save money to squeeze into public transportation. He immediately called for a rental carriage and quickly boarded it.
...
At the Backlund train station, Daly, who was wearing a hooded black robe, blue eye shadow, and blush, stood on the platform with her sidekick, Chelly. The latter was looking at her watch as she frequently looked at the station's entrance.
"Chelly, there's no need to rush. There's still some time before the train starts driving... Besides, even if he doesn't come, we can still wait for him in Tingen." Madam Daly's bewitching and beautiful face revealed a smile as she consoled Chelly.
"That Mr. Deacon of the Church of Storms sure isn't a gentleman. He actually made a lady wait for him," said Chelly unhappily.
"According to that Hero Detective, it's not surprising for the Church of Storms to be late..." Daly added with a smile.
At that moment, a youth in his mid-twenties walked over quickly. After hearing Daly's words, he explained, "Ma'am, I think you and that detective might have some misunderstanding about us Mandated Punishers..."
Daly looked at the person and saw that he was wearing a pair of gold-rimmed glasses. His hair was wheat-colored, his eyes were grayish-blue, and his cheekbones were high. He had the characteristics of the south, identical to the photos of the so-called "elites" she had previously seen from the Church of Storms's headquarters. Hence, she directly asked, "Stewart?"
"Yes, Ma'am Daly. I'm Stewart. Yes, I'll reiterate here. The reason I'm late is that I accidentally got engrossed in the analysis of a spell... It wasn't intentional, nor can it represent the style of the entire Church of Storms..."
After a simple self-introduction, the youth named Stewart emphasized once again. Then, he actually turned around and ran towards the ticket office... to buy tickets.
"Ma'am Daly, is this person reliable or not?" Chelly's mouth twitched when she saw this scene as she asked hesitantly.
"There should be... no problem, right? According to the information, this is a... secret arts instructor."
Daly answered with uncertainty. Her voice became softer until she could no longer hear clearly.
...
In Tingen City, under Saint Selena Cathedral, Klein closed his eyes and leaned back in his chair.
Due to his misinterpretation of Trissy's divination, he deeply realized that divination wasn't omnipotent. He also used it as an opportunity to completely digest the potion.
He felt the complete digestion of the potion and vaguely saw illusory stars one after another. Those stars had an inexplicable connection with him, as though they wanted to gather together and become one.
After an indescribable feeling of hunger and thirst subsided, Klein returned to normal and didn't have any additional insights.
At that moment, he knew that he was a true and complete Seer.
Next, I'll lay the foundation three to four times with Captain before formally requesting... At the same time, I can go to the underground market to see if there are any corresponding Beyonder ingredients... It should be very expensive...
Having digested the Seer, Klein quickly made a decision.
In the afternoon, seeing Captain Dunn and company return one after another, Klein asked about the situation and obtained the outcome of not capturing Trissy.
Klein first expressed his regret before pausing and deliberating over his words.
"Captain, I haven't heard anything I shouldn't have heard in more than a week. I've seen things I shouldn't have seen. Furthermore, this is under the condition that I often use my Spirit Vision in Cogitation."
"Oh?" Dunn frowned in puzzlement.
At the same time, there was a soft gasp at Dunn's office door.
Klein hurriedly turned his head and saw Madam Daly looking at him with a faint smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Mr. A’s Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 190 - Mr. A's Gathering
At 7: 30 PM in Backlund's Empress Borough, outside a house that seemed to belong to a particular noble.
Xio, who had changed into her traditional knight training attire, stood there with her good friend Fors, waiting for Viscount Glaint and Miss Audrey to arrive.
Fors waited in boredom as she subconsciously took out a cigarette to pass the time. However, Xio, who was beside her, sniffed and said,
"Smoking is harmful to health."
Seeing the seriousness on her face, Fors guiltily didn't argue. Instead, she changed the topic.
"Xio, you really didn't do anything last night when you went to Ebner's room?"
Xio rolled her eyes at her and replied, "If you hadn't slept so soundly, I would have dragged you along."
"What you said suddenly makes me a little afraid..." Fors pretended to look terrified, but she saw that Xio had no intention of continuing the conversation. Instead, she asked in concern, "Are you still worried about chanting that honorific name? Was the exorcism ritual held by Ebner in the afternoon ineffective?"
Xio shook her head and whispered, "That's not the case. Although I'm not sure if the evil spirit has been expelled, that ritual gave me courage... I'm not that afraid anymore."
"Then why do you look uninterested?" Fors asked in puzzlement.
"I just suddenly understood why Ebner didn't want to tell me the truth... Other than my lack of strength, it was mainly because I was too rash in my actions. If he had really told me, I'm afraid I wouldn't have been able to hold myself back from provoking someone I shouldn't have... and even implicated you and him."
Actually, I think Ebner was referring to himself when he said he wasn't strong enough. With his personality, if he felt that he was within his control, he would definitely say it...
Fors lampooned inwardly, but on the surface, she changed the topic again. She said with a smile, "Speaking of Ebner, he was the center of attention at the banquet last night... According to what I know, many tabloids were planning on making up stories about him on the front page. In the end, it was Admiral Hell and the Black Tulip that saved him. Compared to this huge matter, no one paid attention to a detective."
Xio rolled her eyes at her friend once again and ruthlessly lampooned, "You're also one of those female leads in the news, right? And the one that appears the most."
Seeing her good friend finally return to "normal," Fors heaved a sigh of relief and said indifferently, "I don't read those tabloids... The stories they fabricate aren't as good as mine."
Just as the two were bickering, a low-key carriage stopped in front of them. Following that, a man and a woman got out of the carriage. They were none other than Viscount Glaint and Miss Audrey.
Glaint wore a hooded robe and hid his face deeply in the shadow of the hood. When he saw Xio and Fors, he greeted them warmly and asked curiously, "Is this really a place for Beyonder gatherings? It looks no different from ordinary residences."
If this wasn't ordinary, should he hang a banner and brazenly post the title of the gathering? Was he afraid that the Nighthawks, Mandated Punishers, and the Machinery Hivemind had too little to do?
At some point in time, Fors had the habit of complaining, but she didn't say it out loud. Instead, she tried her best to maintain a smile as she pointed at Xio.
"Xio is an excellent persuader. She can help you get what you want."
In other words, I've even found someone to bargain for you. Do you think I'll bring you to an ordinary residence to have fun?
With a blue boat-shaped bonnet in her hood and a thin black veil hanging down to cover her face, Audrey also felt that her friend's question was lacking in standards. She might even be despised for implicating herself. In order to save her image, she smiled and called out to Fors,
"Miss Xio, can I trust you?"
"With the Goddess protecting us, you don't have to worry at all." Xio straightened her back and drew a crimson moon on her chest.
"May the Goddess bless me." Audrey nodded and tapped her chest four times.
After that, the four of them didn't say anything else. They took a few steps forward and knocked on the wooden door between three long and two short steps.
With a creak, the main door slowly opened. Audrey, who had entered her Spectator state, saw many people sitting in a mess inside. Some of them used various methods to conceal their appearances, such as relying on hoods and masks, while others didn't care at all and calmly exposed their facial features.
Almost instantly, Audrey noticed the black-robed man sitting on an armchair.
This man was also wearing a hood, hiding his appearance in the shadows.
He silently stared at the guest, giving off a feeling of looking down from above.
Very confident, but his eyes are disgusting. His gaze keeps moving over my body like two slippery tentacles trying to peel off my clothes... Audrey's senses were sharp, and she observed meticulously. She calmly made a judgment, but she nearly got goosebumps.
At this moment, Fors introduced in a low voice, "That's Mr. A, a powerful Beyonder, the convener of this secret gathering."
As for Xio, she didn't pay attention to Fors's description of the other two. Her gaze stopped on a couple who had just entered the entrance.
Although both of them wore black robes and hid their faces in their hoods, Xio easily recognized them with her Sheriff's powers. They were the people she had seen at Ebner's party last night.
"It seems to be the girl I first saw in the activity room. She had a chaotic, crazy aura around her... I remember her name was Irene? The other man should be Detective Zreal."
Xio mumbled to herself before returning her attention to protecting Audrey and Viscount Glaint.
On the other side, Detective Zreal didn't notice Xio sizing him up. His gaze was focused on a blackboard in the room.
"Tears of Babies, Flowers, 200 pounds."
"Mummy powder, 10 grams, 5 pounds."
"Fish slime. Thirty milliliters. 29 pounds."
"Sequence 8 Sheriff potion formula, 450 pounds."
"Third-generation difference machine manuscript clue, 300 pounds."
...
Detective Zreal was excited, but he didn't seem satisfied on the surface. He only secretly wrote down his request and price and handed it to the attendant beside him.
But at that moment, he suddenly heard an inaudible voice.
"The lead on the differential machine has appeared again!"
Zreal was shocked and quickly turned back to look, only to find that the one who spoke was a man with ordinary looks and only seaweed-like blue hair that was very eye-catching. He did not wear any concealment and just openly showed his face.
Perhaps the face itself is fake... As Detective Zreal speculated, he had a bad feeling that his purchase this time wouldn't go smoothly.
As expected, the note handed over by Mr. A stated that he was to wait for the free exchange phase and bid with another buyer.
Detective Zreal let out a breath and suppressed his slightly irritated thoughts. He turned to look at his companion who had brought him into this gathering, Miss Irene, who was still an ordinary person.
However, he quickly realized that the lady had been staring at the organizer of the gathering, Mr. A, and she actually looked distracted.
"What's wrong?" Detective Zreal patted her in surprise and asked. This was the first time he had seen this lady reveal such an expression.
"I saw that man's face just now... He's really good-looking!" Irene answered subconsciously.
Mr. A, who was sizing up all the ladies present, clearly sensed Irene's gaze. He raised his head slightly, so that the shadow of his hood no longer covered his face, and then gave Irene a meaningful smile.
...
Audrey was originally disgusted by Mr. A's gaze and felt disgusted as though she had eaten a fly. When she sensed that he had shifted his attention, she heaved a sigh of relief and looked at the other blackboard in the room.
"Need a pair of adult Manhal fish eyes."
"Powder left behind by wraiths, 165 pounds."
"Emperor Roselle's notebook. Three pages, twenty pounds."
Upon seeing this, Audrey left the Spectator state in shock and excitement. There was only one thought in her mind:
These prices, these prices, they were too, too cheap! The Beyonder ingredients didn't even exceed 300 pounds!
Compared to the transactions with Mr. Tower and Mr. Hanged Man at the Tarot Club that easily cost more than a thousand pounds, these were too cheap!
I really want to buy them all...

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Bidding and Interrogators
chapters.content:
Chapter 191 - Bidding and Interrogators
Audrey finally controlled herself and reservedly bought three pages of Emperor Roselle's manuscripts. She also discussed with the young man who sold the manuscript if having Roselle's words tattooed on her body would have any Beyonder effects.
And the other party swore that he had long deciphered a portion of Emperor Roselle's special runes and tattooed three of them on his body. Furthermore, he had obtained quite a good ability.
Of course, Audrey had actually asked Mr. Fool about this before, and Mr. Fool's answer was that unless some deity was suddenly interested, the words themselves didn't have much power.
Although she felt that the other party was bragging, out of curiosity, she still probed, "What did you tattoo on your body, and what did you obtain from it?"
The young man who sold Roselle's manuscript immediately rolled up his sleeves and displayed three distorted "patterns." He replied excitedly,
"I'm stronger and healthier!"
Audrey silently memorized the shapes of the three symbols and decided to consult Mr. Fool at the next Tarot Club.
Xio had also left a line of text on the blackboard. It was one of the supplementary ingredients for the Scholar potion, the Spring Water of Sonia Island's Golden Spring, which she had helped Ebner purchase.
At the same time, Detective Zreal was led to the activity room on the first floor by an attendant. He looked up and saw a long-haired lady wearing a strange iron mask waiting there.
She looked at Zreal, whose face was hidden in the hood, and said with a smile in a voice that was obviously disguised, "When all the bidders are here, I'll introduce them."
"Sure." Detective Zreal nodded slightly, having no objections.
In less than a minute, two more people were led into the room by an attendant. One of them was the man with an unmasked face and an obvious blue seaweed head.
The other person was a lady whose face was completely covered by the shadow of a hood. Only her gender could be seen from her impressive figure.
Seeing everyone present, the lady in the strange iron mask glanced at the three people in front of her and chuckled.
"Let me give a preliminary self-introduction to prevent you from doubting my abilities."
"There's no need. I believe in Mr. A," the lady with her face hidden under the hood said hoarsely.
Although Zreal and the blue-haired man didn't really trust Mr. A, they weren't stupid enough to refute him on the spot. Therefore, they only listened quietly to his statement and didn't say anything.
"I'm a Cryptologist. Half a month ago, I discovered that the Rose School of Thought and Element Dawn had a conflict in a particular area... That conflict was very secretive, and almost no one discovered it, but the level wasn't low... As a Cryptologist, I did some investigations due to my interest. Then, I discovered some clues in the dreams of an ordinary person who had worked in that area.
"Turani von Helmosuin, the greatest scientist after Emperor Roselle, a mathematician, a Mechanic, the father of the second generation difference machine... He once lived in seclusion in that area."
Having said that, the masked lady took out a piece of paper with a formula written on it and showed it to the trio. Then she continued,
"This is the manuscript that the ordinary person saw when he was hired to clean the study. I dug it out in her dream. It should be able to prove that the 'third generation difference machine manuscript' exists."
Just as she said that the blue-haired man asked solemnly, "Is Helmosuin still living there? Is the battle between the Rose School of Thought and Element Dawn still ongoing?"
The lady in the mask glanced at him and replied softly,
"Mr. Helmosuin had long taken advantage of the gap between the two factions to escape, and most of the Rose School of Thought and Element Dawn had chased him out of Backlund. Now, there aren't any factions guarding that spot...
"In addition, I have to remind you that Mr. Helmosuin hid the manuscript very well before he escaped. It's not easy to find it."
The blue-haired man sneered when he heard that and asked, "Then how do I know if the manuscript of the Differential Machine exists? After all, you were a Swindler previously, right?"
"I'm now a decrypted scholar. You have to trust the judgment of a professional. I'm certain that a manuscript was left there... Yes, regarding this, we can get Mr. A to notify you," the lady in the mask said as she spread her hands.
"I made sure her words were true."
At that moment, a hoarse voice was heard. Everyone was shocked. They quickly turned around and realized that Mr. A was already sitting on the sofa on the other side of the living room. None of them had noticed him.
However, with the expert's assurance, both the blue-haired man and Detective Zreal removed a portion of their suspicions. As for the hooded lady, she remained calm throughout, as though she trusted the Cryptologist.
"Alright, since there are no questions, let's begin the bidding. The starting price is 300 pounds. If you have the Barbarian potion formula, you can have the priority to exchange for it," the lady who called herself the Scholar of Secrets said as she clapped her hands.
"400 pounds!" The hooded lady directly quoted.
"450!" Zreal naturally did not want to be outdone. He had specially applied for special funding from his superiors for this gathering, and it was approved.
"I'll pay 500 pounds!" The blue-haired man frowned. He had only learned that this information was for sale after coming here, so he hadn't prepared a lot of money. 500 pounds was nearly the limit he could afford.
"I have a Rune Steel Sword that has the effects of purification and exorcism. It's the nemesis of water ghosts, wraiths, zombies, and other undead creatures. It can also be used for three years. It's worth more than 500 pounds. If you're interested, I can use it to exchange for it." The lady, who was using a hood to cover her face, thought for a moment before opening a box beside her and showing it.
"No, I don't need a weapon... However, if you add another 400 pounds to the foundation of this weapon, I'll be more than happy to sell it to you," said the long-haired lady after some thought.
Detective Zreal's heart sank when he saw this scene. He hurriedly shouted again, "1,000 pounds, I bid 1,000 pounds! This is even more valuable than the sum of the sword and 400 pounds."
The masked Ma'am of Secrets curled her lips when she heard that. She surveyed the area and saw that no one else was raising the price. She then nodded and said, "Deal! Don't worry. I won't sell this information in the future. It will be notarized by Mr. A."
Detective Zreal paid with some heartache. Although this was the funds he had applied for, if there was any surplus, it would actually be all his... Unfortunately, 1,000 pounds was the upper limit of his application.
Fortunately, he finally got that address.
But just as he received the note from the Cryptologist, before he could read it, he suddenly heard the blue-haired man cough violently. In just a few seconds, he had reached the point where he couldn't straighten his back, as though he was leaning on an invisible figure behind him to prevent himself from falling.
Zreal was shocked when he saw this scene because only now did he realize that there was another person in this room!
"You actually dare to play such tricks at my gathering! This is only a warning... Now, take your marionette and leave this room immediately!" Mr. A looked at the blue-haired man with a cold gaze before adding in an unquestionable tone, "In addition, after the gathering ends today, you will be the last to leave! I will keep an eye on you!"
That person felt a chill in his heart when he heard that. He then realized that his symptoms seemed to have lightened a lot, and he hurriedly left the room in a sorry state.
"What happened?" Detective Zreal and the lady who sold the information looked at each other in confusion.
"He tried to use the marionette in Psychological Invisibility to read your mind, but I interrupted him," Mr. A explained with a smile.
Detective Zreal felt a chill in his heart and decided not to wait for the party to end. He would take advantage of the fact that the man had been intimidated by Mr. A. and go home immediately.
Before he walked out of the living room, he realized that the lady with the hood covering her face had no intention of leaving. It seemed that there was another deal to be completed.
Mr. A glanced at them before returning to the trading hall.
After everyone left, the Cryptologist said coquettishly to the hooded lady, "There's no Barbarian this time. It's really difficult to obtain the formula for your Sequence."
"What can I do? Thankfully, I earned quite a bit this time... To be honest, you sure are bold. I was previously shocked by your act of raising the price without permission... Thankfully, someone was willing to pay 1,000 pounds..."
"Hehe, as a Cryptologist, my observation, intuition, and deduction abilities have greatly improved. Even without using Beyonder powers, I can guess where that person's bottom line is."
...
After Detective Zreal left the living room, he went to find Irene and asked her if she wanted to leave with him, but she was obviously not willing.
Detective Zreal couldn't be bothered with this. He even felt that he could avoid being followed if he lost a burden. He glanced at the blue-haired man who was staring at him with an unfriendly gaze and walked out of the house without looking back.
Seeing that Mr. A was sitting back on the sofa and that no one else needed him to "notarize", Irene walked over excitedly and asked in a reserved manner, "Sir, can I get to know you?"
Mr. A glanced at Irene's face and chuckled. "Sure."
...
After the gathering ended, Xio and Fors first protected Audrey and Viscount Glaint back to the viscount's ball before parting ways.
Xio also had to deliver the spring water from Sonia Island's Golden Spring to Ebner.
When she arrived at the garden villa in Cherwood Borough, Xio had yet to take out the "spring water" when she heard Ebner say to her with a smile,
"Xio, you have already obtained the horn of the Glitter Snake.
"Together with the 'Powder of the Spirit of the Lake' you previously obtained...
"You will soon become an Interrogator!"

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Meeting at Night
chapters.content:
Chapter 192 - Meeting at Night
Alger had previously mentioned that he could find the horn of a Black Striped Black Snake at the Tarot Club. He never expected this gentleman to be so efficient. He had already succeeded on Thursday.
Ebner received the message from Mr. Fool before dinner. Then, he held a "bestowment" ritual and received the ingredients.
Xio looked at the black horn that seemed to flash with electricity and pursed her lips, but she didn't reject it. Instead, she put it away and asked, "How much did you spend?"
Ebner knew Xio's character. Hee didn't pretend to be generous or take the opportunity to raise the price. Hee only replied honestly, "700 pounds."
Speaking of which, Ebner didn't hold another sacrificial ritual to send the money to Alger. Instead, he deducted Laughter Longman's bounty and part of the Wind-blessed formula's price. After all, the cost of holding a ritual wasn't low, so he could save as much as he could.
"I'll raise enough money for you as soon as possible." Xio nodded and said seriously.
"There's no need to rush..." Ebner shook his head with a smile and casually asked, "How's your Sheriff digestion?"
Xio thought for a while and replied, "I should be able to digest it in four to five days."
"That fast?" Ebner was somewhat surprised. He remembered that Xio had become a Sheriff in East Chester County. It had been a month at most...
Xio was like that, Jane was like that, only Beatrice was more normal...
"After learning of the acting method, I actively maintained the order in East Borough and successfully prevented many crimes that I believed to be crimes. As such, I received quite a bit of feedback."
So the key to acting as a Sheriff is to take the initiative to eliminate the order-breaking act that I believe in?
Ebner nodded thoughtfully.
After that, Xio recounted what she had seen at Mr. A's gathering. Finally, she said, "Prepare a room for me. I'll stay with you today."
"What?"
"It's too late. The subway has stopped running."
...
Tingen, 2 Daffodil Street.
At eleven at night, Klein bade the siblings goodnight before returning to his bedroom.
He sealed the room with his spirituality before taking four steps counterclockwise and arriving at the ancient palace above the gray fog.
Sitting in the seat belonging to The Fool, Klein used his spirituality to touch a star wrapped in golden light. It was a crimson star that symbolized Xio.
Previously, when he had helped The Hanged Man bestow the horn of the Glittering Black Snake to the Tower, he had seen the golden glow on it. He knew that the Tower had held another exorcism ritual for the girl named Xio, reinforcing the "passageway" once again. However, he didn't have the time to take a closer look at it. All he could do was watch the "recording" in the dead of the night.
Following that, he saw the petite miss Xio leave a magnificent garden villa after the exorcism ritual. Then, she headed to Backlund's East Borough to deal with the various disputes of ordinary people and track down the "criminal" who had destroyed her order. In just an afternoon, she had successfully stopped a potential evil crime and saved the lives of two families...
The "recording" lasted until she went to Empress Borough to meet a friend. Then, they waited together for a Miss named Audrey to attend a Beyonder gathering.
But just as Xio was about to reach the target building in Empress Borough, the scene suddenly stopped.
It broke again... Klein sighed helplessly. Then, he tapped his fingers on the edge of the ancient long table and thought seriously.
From this recording, Miss Xio is someone with a sense of justice, and her actions are very principled! It's no wonder Mr. Tower trusts her so much and calls her a 'reliable' person... From the looks of it, it's not just because of their close relationship.
In addition, Miss Xio has a wide network of connections in Backlund's East Borough and the dock area. Furthermore, she's deeply trusted by the people in her "jurisdiction." Be it, ordinary workers or gangsters, as long as they aren't vicious people, they are willing to let her be the arbitrator when they encounter troublesome matters...
"Finally, although this' video 'doesn't show it, this lady likely has an official background. Otherwise, many of her slightly out of line actions would've attracted the police's interference.
Yes, abiding by principles. She's kind and doesn't have a high Sequence. She has her own information and resource circle... Overall, this lady is indeed a good candidate for a Tarot Club member...
After I advance to Sequence 8, I can consider pulling her into the gray fog... Of course, the premise is that she's willing.
With this in mind, Klein conjured a new divination statement on the goatskin.
"Miss Xio joining the Tarot Club will bring me danger."
Putting down the fountain pen, he removed the spirit pendulum that was wrapped around his wrist and held it firmly with his left hand. He also made the topaz pendant hang in the position where it was about to touch the goatskin.
After reciting it seven times, his eyes darkened and the spirit pendulum in his hand began to move slightly, counterclockwise.
The answer was no, no...
Klein nodded before realizing that it was late. He hurriedly left the palace above the gray fog and "returned" to his bedroom.
He removed the spirituality seal and stood in front of his desk. Under the light of the gas lamp, he looked out the oriel window. At that moment, the nearby street was dark. There were only a few street lamps leading the way. The stars in the sky were embedded in the black curtain. Bit by bit, they weren't clear.
So it turns out that Backlund, which is known as the Land of Hope and Capital of Capitals, is also like that... I thought that only Tingen had a lower street... From Miss Xio's point of view, I can tell that the people in the East Borough of Backlund are inferior to Tingen's lower street! Klein muttered silently as he reached out to hold the curtain, preparing to pull it.
Wu!
At that moment, a gust of cold wind blew past without warning. His bedroom window opened by itself.
Klein subconsciously took a few steps back and instinctively tapped his left molar twice. At the same time, he suddenly leaned against the bed and attempted to take out the pistol under his pillow.
But at that moment, a slim lady suddenly jumped in with the help of a special Spirit Body from outside the window. She had blue eyeshadow and blush on her face, giving her a bewitching beauty.
It was Madam Daly, whom Klein had met at the Blackthorn Security Company this afternoon.
"Don't be so passionate. I can't withstand your bullets," said Madam Daly with a smile as she looked at the black muzzle.
"Ma'am Daly? Why are you here in the middle of the night?" Klein asked, dumbfounded. However, he didn't let down his guard because it was possible that someone was pretending to be Daly.
"It's me... I know that such a visit is too crude. I should give you some hints so that you can be fully prepared... However, I actually came up with it on the spur of the moment. I had no choice," Madam Daly replied with a smile.
Although I still find it unbelievable, it's indeed Madam Daly's way of speaking... Klein lampooned inwardly as he asked without lowering his gun,
"Ma'am, why are you here?"
"If I were you, I would first seal the bedroom with my spirituality. Otherwise, your family might misunderstand when they see me in your bedroom at this time." Daly glanced at the door and joked with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 193 - Behind the Scenes
"Klein, you don't have to be so wary. We met at the Nighthawks headquarters in the afternoon, didn't we?" Having said that, Daly continued in an ethereal voice, "Heh heh, are you really not going to seal the room? Personally, I don't mind being misunderstood by your brother and sister."
Klein nodded when he heard that, but he didn't approach the desk. Instead, he took out a silver ritual knife from the bedside cabinet.
After quickly constructing a wall of spirituality, he didn't hide from the lady in front of him. He held the revolver in his right hand while his left hand nimbly undid the spirit pendulum in his sleeve. Holding it with one hand, he recited the divination statement:
"The person in front of me is Nighthawk Daly Simone herself."
After seven times, he saw the topaz pendant rotating clockwise.
This meant that he was certain!
Only then did Klein put down his gun. After some deliberation, he repeated his previous question. "Ma'am, why did you come to me in the middle of the night?"
"...You really are a professional Seer," Daly first lamented. Then, without standing on ceremony, she sat on the chair in front of the desk and asked, "Do you still remember what you said in Dunn's office?"
"What I said to Captain... Ma'am, are you referring to... the Seer principles that I summarized according to the maxim of the Mystery Pryer pathway's do as you wish but do no harm '?" Klein's mind stirred as he probed.
"Yes, I heard you say that 'this effectively helps you control the potion so that 'you won't hear voices that you shouldn't hear or see scenes that you shouldn't see'..." When Madam Daly said this, she looked at him with a faint smile before saying with certainty,
"Your words can only confuse Dunn... I'm very sure that you aren't as ignorant as you make yourself out to be. Heh heh, Mr. Moretti, I believe you have already concluded the acting method!"
"Is this why you came to me?" Klein asked without affirmation or denial.
Daly already knows the "acting method" clearly... He calmly made a judgment.
"Yes." Daly nodded casually. Then, she put away her teasing smile and said solemnly,
"I think we should be honest with each other on this matter. I know that you have concluded the acting method, and you definitely know that I have mastered it. Sigh, what's unpleasant is that it took me nearly two years to clearly realize it. As for you, you have only been a Beyonder for a month and a half..."
Upon hearing Daly's words, Klein hesitated for a moment before smiling frankly.
"This is because you are my role model."
He originally wanted to say, "I'm just standing on the shoulders of a giant," but he ultimately decided not to give Emperor Roselle another chance to appear in his ears.
"Even if you gained inspiration from the maxim of a Mystery Pryer and confirmed your thoughts from my experiences and performance, it only took you slightly more than a month to clearly recognize 'acting' and summarize your own Seer principles. It's enough to prove that you have outstanding wisdom and open thinking! Compared to a certain slow-witted detective who is widely praised, I think you are even more outstanding," Daly said with a chuckle.
"Slow-witted detective? Are you talking about that Hero Detective?" Klein's heart stirred as he asked seemingly unintentionally.
"You also know about Detective Bryan? His reputation has spread to Tingen?" Daly asked in surprise.
"I previously heard Captain mention that you and Detective Bryan killed the Demoness of Afflictions together..." As Klein spoke, he briefly mentioned the battle with the Witch yesterday to Daly.
"So you encountered a Demoness... and a curse..." Daly's expression turned solemn, but she quickly composed herself. She smiled again and answered her previous question.
"Actually, I didn't help much. The Demoness of Afflictions died at Detective Bryan's hands."
Detective Bryan is actually that powerful? He can single-handedly kill a Sequence 5? He really is Mr. Tower!
However, the detective should only be his identity on the surface. He didn't know which organization he relied on to enter that dangerous place that was similar to a dream and had such profound knowledge...
As Klein was making random guesses, Madam Daly changed the topic and sighed.
"Once the Church notices that you have grasped the acting method, you have to make a promise in front of the Goddess's holy relic. You have to make an oath not to tell anyone about the acting method.
"That's why I can only chat with someone like you who also knows the acting method. Your condition has already told me the answer before you answered. That's why I dared to say that term."
"You want me to reveal the 'acting method' to Captain and the others?" Klein asked thoughtfully. He had already guessed the reason for Madam Daly's visit.
"That's right. Back when I made the oath and was informed of the exact meaning of the 'acting method', I didn't have a clear understanding of the matter, so I wasn't able to accurately remind Dunn and company."
When Madam Daly said this, there was a clear hint of conflict in her tone. After a long while, she heaved a sigh of relief and continued, "Dunn was a little evasive towards me. I didn't understand why previously and thought that he was worried about my previous actions... However, after returning to Tingen and opening my heart to him, I realized that he actually felt that he wasn't worthy of me..."
Ma'am, you don't have to tell me this. I'm not a late-night emotional show host. The corners of Klein's mouth twitched as he resisted the urge to lampoon.
"He thinks that I've become a Sequence 6 Spirit Guide at such a young age. My future is bright, and I'll meet even more outstanding men in the future... What a joke. He's clearly such a radiant person, but he actually feels inferior in front of a filthy person like me..." Madam Daly continued.
Ma'am, for you to say such words, it means that you are also feeling inferior... What is this? You are both greedy and afraid of each other's radiance, yet you don't dare to hug each other?
Although I have more or less guessed the problem... but I am really not a late-night emotional broadcaster... Please forgive me for being helpless!
The corners of Klein's mouth twitched again as he attempted to change the topic back to its original state. Hence, he solemnly promised,
"I originally planned on using the special application to remind Captain of the existence of the acting method. With your explanation, Ma'am, I don't have to worry about anything."
Since Madam Daly didn't deny the "future of light" in her words, it meant that the "acting method" wouldn't be feared or ostracized by the Church of Evernight.
Daly noticed her loss of composure and quickly adjusted her tone. She smiled and nodded. "Very good. You are really a kind young man! I believe that after Dunn advances quickly, he will no longer ignore my hints, right?"
Ma'am, could it be that what you said about opening up your heart was just a hint to the Captain?
As a keyboard warrior, Klein secretly expressed his disdain for such cowardly actions.
"I won't let you help for nothing either. If you have any problems or need any help, you can write to me. Wait for me. Heh heh, when I become an archbishop or high-ranking deacon and understand why the Church hides the secret of the 'acting method,' I'll give you some hints."
After Daly said that, she informed Klein of the method to summon her messenger. Then, seeing that it was already past two, she took the initiative to bid farewell.
After watching Daly's figure fly out of his house with a strange spirit, Klein heaved a sigh of relief. He silently muttered to himself, "The Spirit Guide is really powerful! I wonder what my Sequence 6 abilities will be in the future, and how special they will be..."
...
In a hotel on Iron Cross Street, Stewart, the Secret Spell Guide sent by the Church of Storms to investigate the Secret Order's traces, suddenly opened his eyes. His originally knitted brows relaxed as he thought,
So the Spirit Body that flew over was controlled by Ma'am Daly... Heh heh, a Nighthawk who concluded the acting method himself? His logic is indeed very strong. It's a pity that he didn't take the Reader pathway.
"But since I know about it, I'll still write it in the report. I'll submit it a day or two later... I'm really sorry."
With this in mind, he checked the feedback results of another "mystic technique" used for reconnaissance...
"Isn't it too much of a coincidence to have clues about the Secret Order so quickly?"
...
In a house with a dark red chimney on the outskirts of Tingen, a quill stopped writing on a notebook.
Under the crimson light, one could vaguely see the words on the page:
"Witch Trissy was unhappy that the Tingen Nighthawks interfered with her revenge. She set up a ritual to curse Klein Moretti, Dunn Smith, and Leonard Mitchell. As she wasn't prepared..."
(A line of text was erased)
"What's unbelievable is that Trissy failed. The three Nighthawks didn't die from the curse. Klein Moretti and Leonard Mitchell were unharmed! Only Dunn Smith was affected by the curse. His mental state, which had recovered for unknown reasons, worsened once again, to the point of losing control."
"Klein Moretti summarized the acting method and even wanted to reveal it to Dunn. Thankfully, Daly Simone and a secret arts mentor arrived and prevented him from finishing his sentence."
"Daly Simone found Klein Moretti at night, hoping that he could inform Dunn Smith of the acting method. However, this matter was found out by Stewart, who came to Tingen with Daly Simone. He decided to write it into the daily report of the joint investigation team."
"Due to the fact that Zangwill didn't wish for the joint investigation team to stay in Tingen for long, he took the initiative to release some information regarding the Secret Order. However, this action seems to have aroused Stewart's suspicion..."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 194: New Diary and Book of the Dead
chapters.content:
Chapter 194 - New Diary and Book of the Dead
On Friday night, Detective Isengard Stanton held another Beyonder gathering at the Bravehearts Bar.
Although this gathering was hardly enough to satisfy Ebner's needs, he still wanted to try his luck. In the end, he unexpectedly bought two pages of Roselle's diary, which cost him a total of 30 pounds.
Among the two transcribed manuscripts, one of the pages was a pile of meaningless Chinese characters. Someone must have randomly pieced together a bunch of sentences based on the original "symbols."
However, Ebner couldn't expose the seller's trick on the spot. Wouldn't that be equivalent to telling others that he could understand Roselle's text? Besides, the seller might not even know it himself.
Fortunately, the content on the other page was relatively normal.
After returning to the garden villa in Cherwood Borough, Ebner picked up the diary and read it seriously.
"4th March. Today, Cullen and I parted on bad terms again! I was very angry. I couldn't understand why he was so stubborn and why he was so determined to stop me from exploring the Fog Sea!
He always looks lazy and doesn't really care about many things. Furthermore, he didn't stop me when I was exploring the Berserk Sea... Could there really be some secret hidden in the Fog Sea? And this secret is related to the Sanguine?
"After careful consideration, I still decided to explore the Fog Sea in-depth. However, before that, I have to think of a way to obtain a ghost ship. I previously obtained some clues from some rumors near the Oraldec Archipelago.
"If Cullen doesn't want to follow, then forget it. I still have Edwards and Grimm."
Ebner frowned subconsciously after reading the diary. In his memory, the Emperor seemed to have been contaminated during his exploration of the Fog Sea. As for what was contaminated, he could not recall.
However, he had already experienced similar situations many times. He knew that this probably involved knowledge that he shouldn't know at the moment, so he ignored it first. A similar doubt arose in his mind as Roselle.
"Cullen is strongly against Roselle exploring the Fog Sea. Does he really know what's there?"
However, he quickly rejected this idea. After all, Cullen was only a vampire viscount. The other party wouldn't be able to withstand his dangerous knowledge.
So, is it the Sanguine or the Church of Earth Mother warning Roselle through Cullen? However, that's not enough... If it's really the Church or Sanguine interfering behind the scenes, with Roselle's strength at the Mid-Sequence level, it's impossible for him to leave the sea.
At this thought, Ebner considered summoning the little bird "Silika" and writing a letter to ask Cullen, but he could not find an excuse to know...
After all, my relationship with Cullen isn't good enough for me to easily inquire about secrets. Besides, I'm not willing to take the risk for Roselle's past.
With a sigh, Ebner dismissed the idea of writing the letter and began packing his bags for the weekend off to go camping and exploring with Susan and Roman's club.
However, who knew that on Friday night, the weather around Backlund would suddenly change. The winds would surge, and dark clouds would stack up. Then, it would rain heavily when it was almost daybreak.
Such weather was clearly unsuitable for camping, so Susan's servants came to the door on Saturday morning in the rain to inform Ebner that camping had been forced to be canceled and changed to the next Saturday's news.
The downpour lasted for two days until Sunday afternoon when Ebner took advantage of the rare moment of comfort brought by the downpour and stayed in the villa reading the Book of Dead Souls he had obtained from Jane.
Although the Book of Dead was made of rather magical material, the words written on it lacked spirituality. It was purely Hermes.
But the terrifying thing was that once those words were combined, it seemed to have the ability to influence one's thoughts, making one want to return to the Underworld...
Without activating the White Eye, Ebner only dared to read for five minutes. Once that time passed, his Spirit Body would involuntarily feel as though it was leaving his body.
This book is too dangerous for the current Klein and the other Tarot Club members. It's better to wait until Mr. World is online before using it to make a deal.
With that in mind, Ebner closed the pages of the Book of the Dead and put them back in the cellophane case so that it and the Sword of Dawn could seal each other.
After two days of reading, it was not that he did not gain anything. Not only did he master a lot of ritualistic magic in the aspect of undead, but he also obtained the refining and contracting method of a bone dragon.
Once he succeeded, not only would he immediately possess a summoning item equivalent to a demigod, but he could also control a bone dragon to traverse the spirit world.
It was a pity that the materials were too difficult. Not to mention those supplementary materials, although they were precious, as long as one was willing to spend money, they could buy them. However, the main material needed to refine the bone dragon required the complete skeleton of a semi-god rank dragon and a wisp of death aura from Calderón City.
I wonder if there's a complete dragon skeleton in the Forsaken Land of the Gods. I can ask when The Sun enters the meeting on Monday... However, even if there is, it's not something The Sun can obtain right now. It's probably impossible to obtain it in a short period of time.
