As for the death aura in Calderón City, I can wait for the future Gehrman to explore it and get some...
...
Just as Ebner was thinking about The Sun and The World, the two of them were actually conversing in Sefirah Castle.
Having been suddenly pulled into the mysterious space above the gray fog, Derrick looked at the mysterious existence seated high in front of him and recalled the principle of "equivalent exchange" that he had just mentioned. After a long while, he said firmly,
"I wish to obtain the potion formula for The Sun's initial Sequence from you."
Sequence, potion, Sun... The Sequence pathway is controlled by the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun... From the looks of it, they might really be in the same world...
And the word "Sequence" was born after the first Blasphemy Slate appeared, which was the end of the Second Epoch's Dark Epoch... In other words, if the City of Silver was really in the Forsaken Land of the Gods, it meant that this region was separated from the Northern and Southern Continents at the end of the Second Epoch...
Could this be related to the Cataclysm of the Third Epoch? Legend had it that the Evernight Goddess, Earth Mother, and the God of Combat had appeared, and together with the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, they had protected humanity through the Cataclysm...
Yes, it seems like Mr. Tower knows quite a bit about history. When he sees this youth tomorrow, he might have some guesses.
As Klein thought this, he was also stumped over how to obtain the potion formula for The Sun. Although he might be able to find Tower and The Hanged Man, wouldn't that make Mr. Fool appear redundant?
Yes, I should temporarily safeguard 3-0782 later. Perhaps I can divine something from it...
Klein maintained his posture and replied calmly,
"This deal can be left to the next two days. You'd better stay out of the house for the next two days. Try not to stay in the same room as the others."
"...Alright, I'll follow your instructions," Derrick replied with his head lowered, not raising any objections.
Klein secretly heaved a sigh of relief as he tapped the edge of the table.
"Before sending you back, let us complete the equivalent exchange. I gave you a chance to become stronger, and you have to pay the corresponding price."
Derrick thought for a moment and replied in a deep voice,
"I will describe it truthfully."
Following that, he described the City of Silver's creation myth, history, and the current basic situation to Klein in detail. He also introduced the two pathways he knew of—Warrior and Secrets Suppliant.
As Klein pondered, he tapped the edge of the long table with his fingers. Suddenly, he asked again, "Do you know the son of the Dragon King?"
"I do, Mr. Fool. King of Dragons Ankewelt is also known as the Dragon of Imagination. And his son, Alzuhod, is said to be able to envelop the sky and look down on the land and sea! He's a famous powerhouse. His title is the Dragon of Nightmare," Derrick said as he recalled the teaching materials.
The Dragon of Nightmare? This matched the contents of the previous page of Roselle's diary. With so much evidence, it seemed like the place where the youth was really belonged to this world.
Klein nodded and pointed to the surface of the long bronze table with a smile. "Now, you need to confirm your code name." A tarot card had already appeared there.
Derrick took two steps forward and flipped through the tarot cards. Without any hesitation, he said,
"Sun. I choose Sun."
...
Not long later, Klein, who was in Lamud Town, successfully divined that the source of the Mutated Sun Sacred Emblem was a drop of golden blood.
Following that, he curiously and excitedly wrote the divination statement:
"The source of this golden liquid."

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Another Tarot Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 195 - Another Tarot Gathering
Boom!
The mysterious space above the gray fog began to quake violently as the majestic palace collapsed inch by inch. The ancient and mottled bronze table was smashed into pieces with holes in it.
This terrifying change only lasted for three seconds before silence returned above the gray fog as though nothing had happened.
The golden flames that had been burning on Klein's body gradually extinguished. His charred surface rolled as he screamed until his ability to think had returned.
Following that, he propped himself up on the armrest of the high-back chair and stood up with great difficulty. He was horrified and at a loss for what had just happened. He never expected such a result.
He took a few breaths, looked up, and surveyed his surroundings. He realized that the towering palace and the ancient long table, which had never changed since ancient times, had been damaged. This was unprecedented damage to the world above the gray fog, which had never been abnormal.
Suddenly, his heart tightened as he hurriedly looked at the junk pile in the corner. Only when he saw that the 100 pounds he had earned from selling the Telepathist formula were safe did he heave a sigh of relief.
As for Mr. Tower's Tree of Elders' Heart?
Such a high-level item shouldn't be so easily broken, right? At least it doesn't seem to have changed... Klein thought uneasily.
After a while, Klein recovered a little. At the same time, he guessed that he had divined the Eternal Blazing Sun.
He pondered for a moment, and then he let the charred skin on his body fall off while summarizing the "unexpected" gains.
The manufacturing method of the high-level charm, Flaring Sun Charms, the potion formula for certain Sequences of the Sun pathway, as well as some knowledge regarding deities.
Thinking up to this point, Klein rubbed his temples. Seeing that there was no movement above the gray fog, he finally felt relieved. After confirming that the Eternal Blazing Sun didn't follow the clues and find this place, he thought again.
"The Eternal Blazing Sun's hostility towards the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom is extremely intense. Why?"
What's a pure white angel?
Mr. Tower seems to be very familiar with these three Churches. It's very likely that he knows... Yes, I can find an opportunity to mention this at the Tarot Club tomorrow and wait for Mr. Tower to freely express himself.
"Although the personality he displayed at the Tarot Club might very well be a disguise, even if it's to maintain his' persona, 'I believe he wouldn't miss the opportunity to show off."
...
Backlund, at the bottom of Saint Samuel Cathedral.
"Once we have a plan that can threaten his life, he will immediately sense it... The abilities of demons are really troublesome." Crestet Cesimir pulled up the collar of his shirt and muttered helplessly to himself.
"Yes, Your Excellency. We've set up three ambushes specifically, but they were all dodged..." A black-haired lady in her thirties said solemnly.
She had good looks. She wasn't wearing a hat and wearing clothes similar to men's clothing. She wore a black coat, a white shirt, black tight pants, and boots of the same color. However, the cold aura around her was very obvious.
"Could it be that we can only rely on luck?" The person who spoke was a cold man with sharp brown eyes like an eagle. He asked indignantly, "What about the detectives hired by the police? Did they figure out anything?"
The lady from before nodded and replied, "Detective Isengard Stanton speculates that the target of that Devil should be women who had been street girls and had the experience of 'corruption'. Currently, the police are monitoring the key people..."
"Then how can we monitor them?" The brown-eyed man sighed.
"Most importantly, we didn't even witness a single murder scene. The prerequisites were insufficient, so some divination and prophecy methods couldn't be used..."
The Nighthawks discussed for a long time without any leads. Seeing that the meeting had ended, Cesimir left Samuel Cathedral and began patrolling the streets alone.
Just now, Borgia, the man with the cold brown eyes, had said something right. When dealing with demons, sometimes one had to rely on luck.
But just as he crossed two streets and came to a secluded alley, his spirituality was suddenly stirred. He focused and saw Daly's messenger come through the opening.
"This is a brief report from the joint investigation team? It can be handed directly to the Holy Cathedral. Why would the Church of Storms send it to me?"
With doubts, Cesimir opened the letter. After reading a few lines, he frowned.
After reading it, he first burned the letter that Daly had brought with her. Then, he returned to the basement of Saint Samuel Cathedral and returned to his office.
Then, after some hesitation, he took out a pen and paper and wrote a special application form in the tone of a Nighthawk.
...
Klein endured his mental fatigue and finally waited for Corpse Collector Frye to hand over 3-0782 before running back to the inn.
After returning to his room, he locked the door with great willpower. He did not even have time to wash up before he collapsed on the bed.
In less than ten seconds, his breathing became heavy, then long and steady.
In his sleep, Klein had just finished preparing a table of delicacies with various seasonings when he realized that someone had invaded his dream.
He immediately jumped in fright, but before he could take precautions, he suddenly saw Captain Dunn push open the "door" and walk to the table in his black trench coat.
He took off his hat, nodded slightly, and sat down. Without standing on ceremony, he picked up his knife, fork, and soup. He quickly finished all the food on the table—tomato oxtail soup, fried lamb chops, mashed potatoes, and oatmeal bread.
Klein watched in a daze, unsure of what the Captain was up to. Only when the Captain was full and left with a thumbs up did he snap back to his senses...
Then, he thought in exasperation and amusement,
"Captain, you and Madam Daly are indeed a pair of two-way lovers!
"One came to my house in the middle of the night to scare me, and the other came to my dream in the middle of the night to scare me...
"One caused me to not dare to sleep in the middle of the night, and the other caused me to be unable to eat delicacies in my dreams...
Speaking of which, these dishes have been completely devoured? Is this the power of a Nightmare?
"What a nightmare... This Nightmare is really creative..."
...
August 20th, Monday...
At 2: 55 pm, Ebner sat in the main bedroom of the villa, sorting out the possible situations he might encounter during the gathering and how to deal with them.
After exiting this state, he sealed the room with a wall of spirituality. Then, he looked up at the clock and saw that the needle was pointing at three.
The familiar gray fog and the blurry figure came into view. Just as Ebner regained his vision, he heard Audrey's greeting.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~"
"Good afternoon, Mr. Hanged Man ~ " Audrey was just about to greet every member of the Tarot Club when she suddenly saw a figure sitting in front of the tower.
"This is?" Audrey looked at Mr. Fool in puzzlement and joy.
Has the Tarot Club expanded again?
Although I can't see his face clearly, I can tell that he's not too old... Is this The Sun? Ebner turned to look at the tall youth beside him and thought.
At this moment, Mr. Fool chuckled and introduced in a voice that seemed to go on forever,
"This is a new member, named Sun.
"This is Miss Justice, this is Mr. Hanged Man, and this is Mr. Tower."
Alger observed The Sun carefully as his mind raced. He secretly guessed, "He seems to be an ordinary youth... No, he must have some special traits or special background. Otherwise, he wouldn't have been chosen by an existence that resembles a god like Mr. Fool!
"God, every move must have a deeper meaning!"
Audrey also entered her Spectator state and quickly came to a conclusion.
"His body movements indicate that he is a little nervous and uneasy... but he has maintained a sufficient amount of silence, giving off the feeling that he is a lone wolf, yes, a lone wolf..."
As Audrey thought, she cast her gaze at The Fool at the end of the long bronze table and said happily,
"Mr. Fool, I found two more pages of Emperor Roselle's diary."
Klein perked up when he heard that. He pretended to be relaxed and said, "Very good. The 'debt' you owed in the previous transaction will be offset."
Upon hearing this, Audrey's originally happy mood instantly plummeted. After all, the information she had obtained from the previous three-way deal wasn't of much use. It was better to exchange Roselle's diary for some other information from Mr. Fool... For example, what the tattoo of the person at the gathering represented.
"Mr. Fool, I also found two diary pages."

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Postponement
chapters.content:
Chapter 196 - Postponement
"Mr. Fool, I also found two diary pages," Ebner said respectfully as he looked at Klein, who was sitting at the end of the long bronze table.
Tower has taken out the diary again? He really is someone who has many channels and is well-informed... I'm afraid that the Hero Detective is only his superficial identity.
Through the name Ebner had revealed during the "live broadcast" that night, as well as the true strength of the Hero Detective that he had learned from Daly, as well as the part of the matter that Tower had previously entrusted to him, there were many overlaps with the Hero Detective's actions.
Klein had already determined that Mr. Tower was the famous detective who had recently made a name for himself in Backlund.
This was not an intentional inquiry, but a conclusion he came to based on the information he obtained by chance.
However, Klein didn't believe that Tower only had the identity of a detective. There was definitely a powerful organization hidden behind it. Furthermore, from Daly's attitude towards him, it was likely that the organization was official.
As his thoughts raced, Klein "Teleported" the diary pages conjured by Justice and Tower to his side. Then, he temporarily held them down and wasn't in a rush to read them. Instead, he turned his head to look at Tower and calmly asked,
"What kind of payment do you need? Do you want to accumulate 'contributions' like last time?"
Goddess's Blessing, I hope it's not some particularly troublesome request. Otherwise, it can only be that Mr. Fool thinks that your contributions aren't enough and wants you to accumulate them first... However, from the previous few situations, Mr. Tower seems to know his limits, although there are obvious signs of probing...
As Klein thought, he silently prayed to the Goddess for good luck.
Ebner had already planned for this. He first requested Mr. Fool to help him conjure the projection of the Fallen Morning Star before giving a brief introduction of its functions. Finally, he said sincerely,
"The process of this item entering my hands is somewhat odd. I wish to figure out its origins."
Although Bishop Utravsky told him that this item didn't have the layout of the deity, he felt that it was better to confirm it through The Fool... Furthermore, it didn't involve any deities. Klein's divination on Sefirah Castle shouldn't be too dangerous. At most, it would give him a headache.
This mystical item is so powerful. It can actually use the powers of five pathways at the same time, and it can even combine into two mystic techniques! Although the two mystic techniques are only supplementary powers, they're still very powerful. They're even more powerful than all the mystical items I know of in the past! I really want to buy them... Unfortunately, Mr. Tower probably won't sell them easily...
Audrey looked at the necklace made of five gems in the video, her eyes glistening. She wished she could ask for the price on the spot. Even if it was very expensive, her father, Earl Hall, would definitely reimburse her for such an item.
As Alger stared at Fallen Morning Star, he thought of Creeping Hunger wielded by Vice Admiral Hurricane. It was also a powerful item that could use multiple pathways, but the price of using it was much crueler than this Fallen Morning Star.
Derrick only gave it a few envious looks before retracting his gaze. The City of Silver's general education told him that this wasn't something an ordinary person like him could control. Even if he barely used it, the price would be too high for him to bear.
As for Klein, who was sitting at the head of the table, his first reaction was to reject it. He had just made a suicidal divination of the Eternal Blazing Sun yesterday, and he didn't wish to do it a second time. But just as he was thinking of how to phrase it, he heard Tower say,
"I know that the value of these diary pages might not be enough for you to personally investigate them... I remember that you previously mentioned that you have a Blessed by your side... Can I ask your Blessed to help me check them? I can transfer all the 'contributions' of presenting the diary to your Blessed. If it's not enough, I can make some material compensation."
Seeing that Klein was silent and seemed to show signs of rejecting him, Ebner decisively changed his strategy and began enticing him.
Does Tower really think that my Blessed has the strength to investigate the origins of this item, or is he testing me again? Does he want to use this matter to measure the depth of Mr. Fool's Blessed?
Judging from his anxious expression, it didn't seem like he was just testing the waters. Perhaps the former was the main goal, while the latter was just a side effect...
Then should I agree to it or not? Hmm, I won't reject it directly. I'll delay it until next week before giving an answer. I'll have plenty of time to divine if there's any danger in investigating the origins of this item... Of course, I can also take the opportunity to think of how much money I should charge...
With this in mind, the scales in Mr. Fool's heart had already tipped. He deliberately leaned back, crossed his hands, and replied in a relaxed manner,
"Alright, I'll ask if they are willing to accept your request... There should be some feedback from the Tarot Club next week. Heh heh, you aren't in a rush, right?"
"Yes, I have sufficient patience for this matter, Mr. Fool." Ebner resisted the urge to lampoon as he lowered his head and said "respectfully."
Indeed, how could such a mighty existence that resembled a god not have a Blessed serving him? Furthermore, from Mr. Fool's tone, "He" probably has more than one Blessed! While Alger felt apprehensive, his attitude towards The Fool became even more reverent. Since "He" had so many Blessed, it meant that "He" had the ability to interfere with the real world.
"Very good." Seeing that he had temporarily resolved the problem of Tower, Klein nodded in satisfaction. Then, he picked up the diary that Miss Justice handed over and began reading.
But soon, he began to curse inwardly as he read:
"Alright, Countess Files, private gathering. This is very Roselle...
Eh? So some of the Sequences can be interchanged at the high Sequences? This is different from what the Church told the Nighthawks... Yes, Savant and Mystery Pryer, Sleepless, and Corpse Collector can be interchanged. I have to memorize it and verify it with the Tower later... Thank you, Emperor Roselle.
I wonder which pathway can my Seer Sequence switch with? The Apprentice and Marauder mentioned by the Thearch back then?
Upon seeing this, he realized that the two pages of the diary that Justice had transcribed seemed to be connected, but the actual content wasn't coherent. It was a record from two periods of time. Hence, he frowned and held back his depression from being interrupted as he continued reading.
"13th April. I participated in that ancient organization's gathering. I never expected them to be members of this organization. It really makes me tremble with fear.
"So the second Blasphemy Slate is in the hands of this organization. This is the first time I've seen this legendary divine item!
"As expected, it hides an unimaginable secret. Hehe, perhaps one day in the future, I will create a Blasphemy Slate that belongs to me. No, it will be a group. Every piece must contain an ultimate secret!"
Emperor, why don't you tell me the name of that ancient organization! You are making me feel worse than the seal from before! Perhaps, perhaps, Roselle had some ulterior motive. He didn't or didn't dare to write down the name of that organization, even if he was using Chinese... Klein felt itchy and puzzled.
However, from this diary page, he finally confirmed that Emperor Roselle had seen the second Blasphemy Slate. Later on, he created a deck of cards with each card corresponding to a pathway of the divine.
I wonder where those cards are hidden and who will obtain them... As Klein sighed inwardly, he picked up the two pages of the diary that Tower had handed over. However, with just a glance, he began to suspect if he was suffering from dyslexia. This was because it was filled with the following words:
"The sun is really close..."
However, Klein quickly understood what was going on and had the urge to curse the fake.
Thankfully, I didn't directly agree to Tower's request. Otherwise, it would've been too much of a loss if I had to use this random page to divine something of unknown origin.
He took a deep breath and picked up the second page. Fortunately, it was something more "serious" this time.
After reading it, Klein tapped the edge of the long bronze table with his finger and thought.
Cullen? This should be the second time I've seen him appear in Roselle's diary... I remember that in the diary entry the last time, Roselle complained about why the Sanguine didn't send him a beauty...
Besides, in the diary I previously obtained, I mentioned Roselle's expedition to the Fog Sea... It should be a month after the diary page that Tower took out, Roselle obtained the Black Throne's ghost ship.
They soon discovered an island that wasn't on the sea route. Then, Grimm, one of the so-called Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, became odd, as though he was infected by something...
Then, what about Roselle, who was at the same level as Grimm back then... Could he have been infected by something on that island?
"Is this the reason why Cullen isn't willing to follow and is even determined to stop Roselle's voyage? Is it divination or a prophecy? But why didn't he say it out loud... Was the symbol he received not accurate enough?"
Klein's thoughts raced as he thought of many things.
But he quickly reined in his thoughts and moved his gaze away from the diary. He looked at The Hanged Man, Justice, Tower, and The Sun and smiled.
"Sorry to keep you waiting. Now we can start our free discussion."
Just as he said that Alger looked at Tower and said directly, "I've already gathered enough money. You can now tell me the formula for Wind-blessed."
"So soon?"
Even if it was slightly deducted, it still required 1,800 gold pounds. That was a huge sum of money. As Ebner thought this, he requested Mr. Fool to conjure a pen and paper and began writing down the formula.
"Heh heh, I received a commendation for Admiral Hell's matter, so I barely managed to gather all of it." Alger didn't choose to hide it. Instead, he said it openly. After all, even within the Church, the number of people who knew that he was the one who had reported him could be counted on one hand. Furthermore, they were all upper echelons. It was impossible for outsiders to discover his identity.
"Admiral Hell?" Miss Justice, who was sitting opposite the long bronze table, immediately perked up.
Ludwell's Black Tulip had been sunk by the Pritz ironclad warship, and it was currently the most important matter in the kingdom. How could Audrey not know the headlines of every newspaper?
However, could it be that our Tarot Club is interfering in this matter?
With this in mind, Audrey became even more excited, completely escaping her Spectator state.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Forsaken Land of the Gods
chapters.content:
Chapter 197 - Forsaken Land of the Gods
"Mr. Hanged Man, could it be that you and Mr. Tower were involved in the Pritz's encirclement of Admiral Hell? Can you tell me the details? I can pay you." Audrey forcefully suppressed her excitement and asked Alger in a reserved manner.
Alger turned his head to glance at Tower and realized that he was focused on writing the formula without any objections. Only then did he reply,
"Thank you for your generosity, Miss Justice, but this isn't particularly useful information for the members of the Tarot Club. Payment isn't necessary."
Audrey had also recovered her Spectator state. Upon hearing Alger's words, she smiled and said,
"Mr. Hanged Man, a lady would not easily owe a gentleman a favor. Yes, I have an answer to your confirmation request from last month. For the time being, His Majesty has been persuaded by the Prime Minister not to seek revenge on the Feysac Empire on Balam's East coast. This news, I believe, is sufficient compensation."
"Thank you again for your generosity, Miss Justice." Alger first thanked Audrey before continuing after a few seconds of silence.
"To be honest, I don't know much... Mr. Tower informed me through Mr. Fool on Wednesday morning that the Black Tulip would pass through Pritz Harbor's outer sea at midnight on Thursday. He requested that I inform the Church. Through some connections, I then reported it to the Church's upper echelons... The Pritz then intercepted and sank the Black Tulip in the outer sea of Pritz Harbor late that night.
"Admiral Hell Ludwell allegedly jumped into the sea to flee and has yet to be found, according to the newspapers... Admiral Hell's various fleets have already been taken over by members of the Numinous Episcopate, but he has yet to appear... I'm guessing he was apprehended or killed by the authorities."
At this moment, Ebner finished writing the formula and retorted with a smile, "Ludwell wasn't caught by the officials. Someone else caught him." With that said, he pushed the paper with the Wind-blessed potion formula in front of The Hanged Man.
Blue Shadow Falcon's six crystal feathers, Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor's pair of eyes... Alger memorized the names of the two main ingredients with a single glance.
At the same time, Klein, who was sitting in the main seat, also memorized the two ingredients.
Derrick, who was sitting beside Ebner, was already confused. He was abnormally at a loss. He felt that he could understand nearly every word, but he didn't know what it meant when he connected them.
Admiral Hell, the Pritz naval battle, the king and prime minister, the House of Lords and the House of Commons, the east coast of Balam, the Feysac Empire, the Numinous Episcopate—he didn't know anything about them.
Feysac, the root of the term is a variant of the giants. What does it have to do with the fallen Giant King's Court?
Wind-blessed... That's the pathway that the elves have, right? It seems to be Sequence 6?
Derrick looked at Justice, then at The Hanged Man and Tower. He suddenly felt that he might not be in the same world as the three of them.
Could it be that somewhere in the cursed land, far away from the City of Silver, there exists more than one city or even a country? Derrick maintained his silence, but he thought with some reverence,
To be able to pull people from so far away together and ignore the terrifying monsters in the dark depths of the cursed land, The Fool might really be a god, an ancient god...
However, Audrey wasn't satisfied with what she heard. Although she knew a lot of things that weren't in the newspapers, Mr. Hanged Man's narration was too dry. It didn't achieve the effect she had expected... Furthermore, he didn't seem to have participated in the naval battle...
"What about the details of the naval battle?" That was what I wanted to know the most. Audrey couldn't help but ask eventually.
Alger shook his head and said regretfully, "I'm sorry. With my status, I'm not qualified to participate in this battle."
Just as Audrey was feeling depressed, she suddenly heard the sound of a long bronze table being gently knocked.
Audrey and Alger felt their spirits lift at the same time as they looked at Mr. Fool in the seat of honor. They saw the mysterious expert stop what he was doing and smile slightly. "I happen to know a little about the details of the naval battle." With that said, he glanced at Ebner, intentionally or otherwise.
Why are you looking at me? Hmm... Are you going to materialize the scene of Jane's "live stream" that night? So, is this also a way to knock me down? A subtle reminder that he knows my every move?
But why did he have to beat me up? Did I do something that made him feel like it was too much?
Ebner watched in confusion as Mr. Fool conjured the scene of Jane's "live broadcast" that night. It even included the announcement of the "Decree Mage" on Pritz, which only silenced Ebner's commentary.
However, Klein only conjured the Pritz from the water curtain. After the Black Tulip failed to shuttle through, the Imperative Mage raised his hand to "ban" it, and the Ocean Songster intercepted the cannonballs. He didn't release all of them. Firstly, he didn't know what would happen after that, so he couldn't conjure it. Secondly, if it took too long, his spirituality wouldn't be able to withstand it.
After all, I don't have the ability to watch a movie with everyone here... Klein thought after the screening ended.
So there's a demigod on the Pritz... From the looks of it, he's a demigod from the Arbiter pathway! It's no wonder the Black Tulip failed to escape. Alger couldn't help but sigh as he resolved the doubts in his heart.
As the captain of a ghost ship that sailed on the sea, he had a deep understanding of the Black Tulip's toughness and strangeness. Before this, he couldn't imagine that the ship would sink, even if the opponent was a new ironclad.
But with a half-god holding down the fort, that was a different story.
Audrey's heart surged as she watched. The terrifying black magic, the huge bronze door, the law of the gods, the lightning that shattered countless cannonballs...
This is the mysterious world I yearn for! Audrey wished she could stand up and dance to vent her excitement.
The one who was most shocked was actually The Sun Derrick. Be it the undulating seawater, the crimson sky, or the mighty and massive battleship, the strange and unpredictable ghost ship made his body tremble as though he was in a dream.
No, even in a dream, I would never dream of such a scene! They are completely beyond my imagination... Is that the sea depicted in textbooks? Is that a ship recorded in ancient literature? Also, such a beautiful scarlet... Is that the moon?
It turned out that Miss Justice, Mr. Hanged Man, and Mr. Tower really lived in another world! A normal world without monsters in the darkness or curses!
I wonder what price I have to pay to make Mr. Fool bring the City of Silver to this normal world...
Just as Derrick was surrounded by shock, Audrey had already adjusted her state of mind. However, she still said excitedly, "Thank you for letting us see the battle at sea and fulfilling my wish, Mr. Fool."
Klein replied in a relaxed and calm tone, "I hope it can help you."
Audrey calmed herself down and recalled the scene she had just seen. She said, "Does anyone know which pathway the ability to 'Prohibition' belongs to?"
I know that. I've heard Tower explain it before... Klein's heart stirred as he answered with a smile before Tower and The Hanged Man could.
"That's the ability of the Arbiter pathway. A Sequence 6 Judge can use the ability 'Prohibition' but to prevent the Black Tulip from traveling through the spirit world, it has to be at least a Sequence 4 Imperative Mage."
"I see... Arbiter? He should be a demigod from the military." Audrey nodded before standing up and curtsying. She sincerely thanked and praised, "Thank you for your answer, Mr. Fool. You are truly knowledgeable."
Alger was extremely disdainful of Justice's words.
How could an important figure like a god be described as knowledgeable?
To a certain extent, this existence was equivalent to knowledge!
Klein guiltily accepted Miss Justice's praise. After all, he was only recounting the commentary on the night of the Tower. At most, he had changed his words.
At this moment, Derrick finally recovered from his shock. He looked at the three people around him, who were clearly in the same world, and summoned up his courage to ask, "Do... Do the sun and moon exist in your world?"
Upon hearing this, Justice and The Hanged Man looked at each other. They didn't understand why The Sun would ask such a question. Only Ebner knew Derrick's background very well. He smiled and asked, "Why are you asking this?"
"I suspect that you and I aren't from the same world." Derrick directly voiced his judgment.
This child... To think I kept telling him not to speak nonsense and not to reveal his origins, but... Klein nearly reached out to cover his face.
Sigh, although The Sun looks silent, pained, and mature, he's really just a youth!
"Not in the same world? What makes your judgment based on? Is there no sun or moon in your world?" Ebner asked knowingly.
"Yes, the City of Silver I'm in was once ruled by the Giant King's Court. Ever since it was abandoned by the omnipotent and omniscient Lord, it has been surrounded by darkness..."
Derrick briefly described the situation in the City of Silver without much caution.
Audrey and Alger were so shocked by the terrifying environment he described that they forgot to think.
Only Ebner pretended to think for a moment after hearing that. He deliberated and said,
"According to what I know, in the distant Second Epoch, there was a country named the Kingdom of Silver.
"The Kingdom of Silver has a rather special status in the Giant King's Court. They don't directly believe in Giant King Aurmir, and they believe in the Queen of the Giant King's Court, Omebella.
"Since you have the historical records of the Giant King's Court, it's unlikely that we are from two different worlds...
They belong to the same world, but the environment is completely different. And the City of Silver has historical records of being abandoned by the Lord...
"Then there's only one possibility:
"The place where you are is what we call...
"Forsaken Land of the Gods!"

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Transaction and Entrustment
chapters.content:
Chapter 198 - Transaction and Entrustment
"Forsaken Land of the Gods!"
Upon hearing the special term from "Tower," Alger immediately snapped out of his shock and looked at Derrick, who was a few seats away.
In the internal information of the Church of the Lord of Storms, in the secrets that a bishop-level "Captain" like Alger could come into contact with, the Forsaken Land of the Gods would always have a name. There was no specific description, but it clearly pointed to the end of the Sonia Sea.
As far as he knew, even the grand cardinals at the core of the Church did not know what the Forsaken Land of the Gods represented. Only the leaders of the Church, the Executors of the Lord of Storms, knew something about it. They seemed to be secretly presiding over the secret operation to find the Forsaken Land of the Gods.
Alger had previously made a bold guess in the previous Tarot Club, equating the True Creator's Holy Place that the Aurora Order had promoted with the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Unfortunately, the Tower had refused to say much back then, and Mr. Fool hadn't given him an answer, preventing him from confirming it.
And now, he was shocked and stunned to discover that the Tarot Club member with the alias The Sun was actually from the Forsaken Land of the Gods!
Although this was just a deduction from "Tower," Alger could tell from his tone that he was very confident.
More importantly, the mighty existence that resembled a deity at the very top did not retort!
With this in mind, Alger looked at the figure leaning against the back of the chair at the end of the long table, shrouded in thick fog. He thought with a trembling heart,
"Mr. Fool has always known where the Forsaken Land of the Gods is, and he can pull in members from there? That's a secret place that the Bishop of Storms wishes to find but has never been able to find!"
As Audrey had no concept of the Forsaken Land of the Gods, she wasn't too shocked. All she did was sigh inwardly. The origins of The Sun were indeed extraordinary, and they were very mysterious.
Before pulling Derrick into the gray fog, Klein had guessed that the strange place he was in was the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Now, with Tower's words as evidence, he confirmed his previous guess.
"'Tower,' on the other hand, knows a lot about the secret history of the end of the Second Epoch and the start of the Third Epoch. His identity is far from simple! Is he a Blessed of a particular Church? Is he the son of a member of a certain Church's upper echelon?"
As Klein was making random guesses, Derrick barely digested the content of Ebner's words and roughly understood what he meant. Then, he asked with uncertainty, "Mr. Tower, do you mean that there are records of our City of Silver where you are? There are records of the Giant King's Court? Furthermore, you are still being favored by the Lord, so your world is' normal '? And the place where our City of Silver is is called the Forsaken Land of the Gods by you?"
Ebner nodded slightly and replied, "Nothing wrong in general, but—"
However, before he could finish his sentence, Derrick said incoherently in excitement, "Mr. Tower, can you help our City of Silver pray to the Lord, praying that 'He' will look after us again and let the sunrise again... We have struggled in the darkness for thousands of years, but we have never betrayed the Lord! Back when we were ruled by the Giant King's Court, we believed in the cruel Giant King Aurmir. It was the Lord who redeemed us. We will never betray the Lord again!"
Being ruled by the Giant King's Court... It's indeed ancient... But it doesn't seem to correspond... Alger immediately recalled the description of the Second Epoch in the hidden Chapter of the Book of Storms.
The sky, sea, and land were occupied by dragons, giants, elves, mutants, demons, phoenixes, demonic wolves, and specters. Humans were enslaved, but in the end, the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom led humans to defeat these Beyonder creatures one by one, ushering in the beginning of the Third Epoch, the Age of Glory.
Giant King Aurmir... Klein silently repeated the name.
In many myths and legends, this was a powerful existence comparable to a god. Even today, there were still remnants of worship for him. For example, the most famous and expensive wine in the Intis Republic was named "Aurmir"—it was said that this Giant King loved blood-like wine.
"Please mind your words, Mr. Sun. This is Mr. Fool's country." Audrey looked at The Sun worriedly and kindly reminded him.
Only then did Derrick come to a realization. Although Mr. Fool claimed that he wasn't a god, the ability "He" displayed was no different from a god's. His words might've angered this existence.
With this in mind, he hurriedly lowered his head and sincerely apologized. "I'm sorry, Mr. Fool. I... I was just a little agitated." In fact, he wasn't as pious as he claimed to be towards the Lord who had created everything. He even felt a hint of resentment deep down.
"There's no need to be so reserved. I've long said that I'm only The Fool who likes to exchange equal amounts. I usually wouldn't get angry over trivial matters... Unless you violate my principles or reveal my name to an outsider without my permission," Klein said with a deep and calm voice.
However, Derrick didn't dare to take it seriously. He still lowered his head and said in horror, "I understand, Mr. Fool."
Alger suddenly interjected, "Our world doesn't have the Lord who created everything you speak of. The omnipotent and omniscient God... The ones protecting us are the seven orthodox deities."
"Seven orthodox deities?" Derrick was taken aback. This news had completely exceeded his imagination. However, after what had just happened, he didn't dare continue the topic of deities. He planned on observing how others communicated and understanding the bottom line before attempting to ask.
On the other side, Alger didn't have any intention of explaining. He had discovered a huge potential value in Derrick, so he naturally had to incite his interest while holding back. Only then would he be able to obtain more at the smallest price.
As for what he could obtain from The Sun, he had yet to figure it out. In short, he had to be prepared.
I wonder if Tower can think of this level and cooperate with me... Alger glanced at Ebner and thought.
Ebner naturally knew what Alger was thinking. Wasn't it just to fleece him? This was actually his plan.
The reason why he had pointed out that he was in the Forsaken Land of the Gods was not only to take the opportunity to show off and sell his persona but also to skip the unnecessary probing stages and quickly make use of the many rare resources of the City of Silver.
Therefore, after a moment of silence, Ebner directly asked Derrick, "You previously said that there are many monsters and Beyonder creatures near the City of Silver?"
"Yes." Derrick nodded honestly.
"So do you know about the 'Thousand Spells Phantom'?" Ebner asked expectantly.
"I know. It's a type of alternative dragon. It's very small in size, and its form is between real and illusory. After death, it will turn into a crystal. The protective facilities of many important buildings in the City of Silver are set up using this crystal as the foundation," Derrick replied in a textbook manner.
"Very good... I need the crystallization of a Thousand Spell Phantom. If you can get one, I can give you the corresponding reward... Hmm, what do you need?" Ebner directly asked about The Sun's needs, not giving him a chance to hesitate and reject.
Derrick clearly hadn't experienced such rhetoric. Without much thought, he said, "I need the initial Sequence formula of the Sun pathway... However, I don't have anything that can be used to exchange for Thousand Technique Mirage Crystals... Besides, it's not equivalent to a Sequence 9 potion formula."
"Heh heh, help me ask what the seller of the Thousand Technique Mirage Crystal needs. As for the items to be exchanged, it will naturally be provided by me. As for the Bard formula, I'll do my best to help you find it. Consider it your intermediary fee. Yes, Bard is the name of the Sun pathway's initial Sequence," Ebner said with a smile.
He didn't say that he knew the formula now. That would make it seem like he was prepared.
Although Derrick had never heard of the term "intermediary fees," he finally understood what Mr. Fool meant by translating it in the same voice. Hence, he said sincerely, "You're really a good person, Mr. Tower. I'll help you ask as soon as possible..."
At this point, he suddenly thought of something and asked again, "How should I inform you after I ask what item I need to exchange? And how will you give me the item?"
"Inform me that I only need to pray to Mr. Fool... As for receiving the items, do you know how to 'sacrifice' and accept the bestowment ritual?" Ebner said with a smile.
"I know... However, Mr. Fool's symbol..." Derrick said with some difficulty.
At that moment, Klein, who was sitting at the head of the table, rapped the edge of the long bronze table and said with a smile, "Regarding the ritual's process and symbolism, you will naturally know when you pray to me when you return."
With that said, he looked at Tower and said in a calm tone, "I have the Bard formula here. I know you can find it, but it will take at least a week. And if The Sun can become a Beyonder earlier, it will be easier to negotiate with others."
With great difficulty, Klein decided to step in. This was because if he didn't say anything, wouldn't the Bard formula end up in his hands? How could he live up to the pain he had suffered from divining the Eternal Blazing Sun?
Is he asking me to pay for it? But I knew it. I just didn't want to arouse suspicion. Why did I have to pay...
Ebner felt a little conflicted, but he still acted as though he was tempted. He cautiously asked, "What do I need to pay? More of Roselle's diary?" If that was the case, it wouldn't be a problem. At most, he could spend some time fabricating some stories about the emperor.
It also made Klein understand that useless information could only be exchanged for useless information.
Mr. Fool tapped the edge of the ancient long table with his finger again and chuckled. "I wish to entrust you with a mission... This mission actually comes from one of my Blessed. Heh heh, speaking of which, he's the most likely person to accept investigating the background of that Morning Star Fallen. If you can handle this matter well, he might help you investigate the source of the item in the future.
"As for the Bard formula, I'll pay you in advance."
"May I know what the mission is about?" Ebner pretended not to know that he was a god, Blessed, and Believer.
"I need you to investigate the life story of the first Baron Lamud. The more detailed, the better... Yes, you can seek the help of the lady you recommended to join the Tarot Club. Consider it an inspection of her abilities... Although I'm quite satisfied with her situation, I still need to observe her further."

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Shepherd
chapters.content:
Chapter 199 - Shepherd
The first Baron Lamud? That's the identity Mr. Azik used in his life, right? Klein should've already explored Lamud Town at this time. Is he trying to help the spawn of Death regain more memories?
Yes, accepting this commission should be considered a relatively complete Knowledge Keeper act... And the one who wants this "knowledge" is the Death Consul. Once he really remembers something, the feedback I receive shouldn't be small...
As for Xio's inspection? Heh heh, do I not know that the Tarot Club's recruitment criteria are purely voluntary? Isn't the so-called "examination target" the same as a "tool person"?
As his thoughts raced, Ebner made a decision. He looked at Mr. Fool and said respectfully, "I'm willing to accept this mission."
"Very good." Klein nodded in satisfaction before looking at Derrick. He asked gently, "What do you think?"
In fact, this request had nothing to do with The Sun, but he was after all the party involved in this transaction. Out of respect, Klein felt that he shouldn't exclude him.
"I have no objections." Seeing that he could obtain the starting Sequence of the Sun pathway on the spot, Derrick immediately nodded without any hesitation.
Upon seeing this, The Fool Klein pressed his hand forward in a good mood. He conjured two Bard formulas and "passed them" to Tower and The Sun.
"Tower" took a casual glance and stopped paying attention.
And The Sun first frowned before relaxing.
Yes, the names of the materials in the Forsaken Land of the Gods must still be ancient... Thankfully, this formula of mine was obtained directly from the Eternal Blazing Sun. It has an ancient name and various substitutes... Klein thought with some relief.
After the transaction ended, Ebner looked at Justice Audrey across him and said apologetically, "Miss Justice, the gifts you gave last time only chose a feathered hat... I'm sorry, but I forgot to return the rest of the jewelry to you when I got busy..."
Audrey waved her hand and said with a smile, "Those accessories aren't worth much. There's no need for you to return them to me. That would be too troublesome for Mr. Fool... In that case, if you can answer a question of mine, then those accessories will be my thank you gift."
"What question?" Ebner asked with a smile. He could roughly guess what Audrey wanted to ask.
"I recently came into contact with some Beyonder circles and learned of an expert named Mr. A, Mr. Tower. Do you know his background and true identity?" Audrey asked in anticipation.
Mr. A? I only know Mr. Z... Could such a similar code name be from the Aurora Order? Klein made a guess, but he didn't answer.
He had to maintain his image and try his best not to give an answer that he wasn't too sure of. If he really faced such a situation, his description would be ambiguous, like a charlatan.
As expected, she asked tha5... Ebner thought to himself. He deliberated over his words before saying,
"The Aurora Order has five Saints and twenty-two Oracles. These Oracles use letters as their code names and call themselves Mr. A and Mr. X... They are at least Sequence 7 Beyonders, and the strongest are Sequence 5. They are quite good at concealing themselves... A dead Oracle will be replaced by a new Oracle.
"I heard that they're passionate about hosting Beyonder gatherings in big cities, such as Mr. Z from Enmat Harbor or Mr. A from Backlund.
"According to what I know, Mr. A is a Sequence 5 Shepherd. He Grazed many powerful Beyonders and has many means. He's indeed very powerful."
Just as he said that Derrick, who was listening quietly, blurted out in surprise,
"Shepherd?"
Seeing that everyone's eyes were on him, Derrick immediately panicked and hurriedly explained,
"I just didn't expect that there would be Beyonders of this Sequence in your world... This is a Sequence pathway that our City of Silver found in cities that were destroyed by the Things of Darkness. It's only a Sequence 5 Shepherd. However, after Elder Lovia became a Shepherd, she became very powerful, very strange, and very terrifying. It's said that she had once fought against an evil spirit at the level of a High-Sequence Beyonder and wasn't injured. Therefore, when there was an empty seat in the six-member council, she made an exception and became an Elder."
When Klein heard this, he sighed inwardly. The Sun, you are indeed still a child. Although this information isn't very useful to The Hanged Man and Justice, it can be packaged to exchange for something valuable. You actually said it out loud! You said it out loud...
Audrey asked out of curiosity, "Which Sequence pathway is the Shepherd from? What Sequence is it?"
"It's from the Secrets Suppliant pathway, 5." Klein seized the opportunity and clicked without leaving a trace.
Secrets Suppliant... The Aurora Order's pathway... The Sun said that the City of Silver found the potion formula for this Sequence in a city that had been destroyed by the object of darkness...
The True Creator's "sanctuary" was indeed in the Forsaken Land of the Gods, right? Even if it wasn't there, there was at least a huge connection!
Alger immediately solved a mystery in his heart and didn't say a word.
"Mr. Tower, can you give a detailed introduction of Shepherd's powers? I can pay for it." Audrey looked at Ebner, who was diagonally across the table and asked.
"There's no need for that, Miss Justice. The value of your jewelry can match this knowledge." Ebner shook his head and smiled. "Do you wish to apply for a private exchange?"
Ebner had once roughly estimated the price of those accessories. Since one of the head accessories was made by a famous designer, it could be sold for at least 200 pounds. If it was auctioned, the price would probably be even higher.
Therefore, Ebner was too embarrassed to ask Miss Justice for money.
Audrey thought for a moment and felt that there was no need to be so petty. She replied with a faint smile, "Just say it."
"The core ability of a Shepherd is Grazing. It can devour the souls of others, including wraiths and evil spirits, and use a unique method to control these souls. It's like shepherding sheep for a deity.
How much ability a Shepherd has depends on how many Beyonder souls they has devoured... Of course, this isn't without limitations.
"At the level of Sequence 5, Shepherd can only choose the three powers that can control the soul. Furthermore, it can Graze seven souls."
Audrey's face turned pale when she heard that. Although she was hidden by the gray fog and not discovered by others, she couldn't help but sigh. "This... This is too evil! Compared to the Mystic Skill Guide corresponding to the Morning Star of Corruption, it can also use powers from other pathways. The ability of a Shepherd is too evil!"
So that's what a Shepherd means... The Sequence pathway controlled by the Aurora Order is as strange as ever... It's no wonder they believe in the True Creator. No, the Fallen Creator... Klein was instantly enlightened, but he didn't nod, acting as though he had known all along.
As for Alger, he spat out a word. "Creeping Hunger!"
So Creeping Hunger was the means of a Shepherd. It was no wonder Qilangos could become a pirate admiral with it.
Thinking of this pirate admiral, Alger's heart stirred. Seeing that the others had no intention of continuing the transaction or sharing, he looked at Miss Justice and organized his words before asking, "Do you still need the Rainbow Salamander's complete pituitary gland?"
"Of course!" Audrey snapped out of her disgust for the Shepherd and nodded without hesitation.
"I might be able to get it, but you have to complete one of my requests," Alger said after some thought.
He actually wished to entrust the mission to Tower, but he had just accepted Mr. Fool's mission, so he probably didn't have the time... Besides, he didn't have anything that could move Tower at the moment.
"What commission?" Audrey asked in puzzlement.
Alger thought for a few seconds and said,
"I received news that the great pirate, Qilangos, known as Vice Admiral Hurricane, has secretly come ashore and infiltrated Backlund. I don't know what he's up to, but I hope you can help me find his whereabouts. As for the rest, there's no need for you to take the risk."
"Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos? One of... No, one of the six pirate admirals?" Audrey's eyes widened as she repeated in surprise.
"Yes, he's a Sequence 6 Wind-blessed of the Sailor pathway. At the same time, he possesses a mystical item called Creeping Hunger. I only learned that it's a Sealed Artifact with the Shepherd characteristic from Mr. Tower's introduction... In addition, Qilangos is rather cunning and cruel. Don't try to deal with him," Alger solemnly introduced.
Having said that, he suddenly turned his head and looked at Klein.
"Mr. Fool, can I request your Blessed to provide help at the critical moment? I will pay the price of your interest."
My Blessed is only myself... Klein vented his frustrations as he smiled.
"The premise is that my Blessed happens to be in Backlund."
"Alright." Alger retracted his gaze in disappointment and anticipation.
"Mr. Hanged Man, I'm willing to accept this request... Can you describe in detail the characteristics and habits of Creeping Hunger and Vice Admiral Hurricane?" Audrey appeared rather confident.
This made Ebner glance at her, and he couldn't help but guess inwardly. Miss, don't tell me the source of your confidence is Xio? She's only a Sequence 8. Is it really appropriate to give her such a dangerous mission?
"Very good. If you succeed, then the Rainbow Salamander's complete pituitary gland will be yours," Alger first promised. Then, he informed Audrey about how Creeping Hunger ate a person's soul and flesh every other day, as well as the Beyonders who might have Grazed several pathways.
Following that, with Klein's permission and help, Alger conjured Qilangos's portrait.
"Alright, I'll arrange for someone to find him," Audrey pursed her lips and replied with a smile.
After discussing the matters that needed to be discussed and sharing the information that needed to be shared, Klein saw that no one said a word, so he smiled and announced the end of today's gathering.
...
After returning to reality, Ebner immediately set up an altar and held a bestowment ritual. He obtained 1,800 pounds from The Hanged Man buying the formula.
After activating the Eye of Pure White to verify the authenticity, Ebner placed the bundle of cash into the safe in the bedroom.
After doing all of this, he retracted his spirituality seal and began to seriously consider how Mr. Fool's mission should be completed.
Although the original novel also had an introduction to Mr. Azik's life, it was very brief. It's impossible to directly report it...
"As for the era when Azik was active as the first Baron Lamud, it was probably in the final Chaotic Era at the end of the Fourth Epoch. It has been at least 1,300 years since today... After all, this year is only 1349 of the Fifth Epoch.
"Where should I start?
Perhaps there will be corresponding clues in the royal family's library... But even ordinary people can't enter that place...
"Perhaps... I can disguise myself as someone with sufficient identity?"
Thinking of this, Ebner stood up and took out a mask with complicated patterns that looked like a clown's face from his warehouse.
"The Clown Mask should be able to redesign my appearance."

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Candidate
chapters.content:
Chapter 200 - Candidate
Klein wrapped himself with his spirituality and plummeted.
After returning to his room, he removed the wall of spirituality and thought to himself,
This time, I didn't find a chance to ask Tower why the three deities are hostile, as well as what pathways can be swapped... Sigh, it's really inconvenient without a smurf. I wonder if I can resolve this problem after becoming a Clown...
Following that, Klein originally planned on slacking off for the afternoon. After all, he no longer needed to act as a Seer, nor did he need to use the Divination Club as a fixed schedule. Occasionally, he would earn some extra money and fulfill his duties as a Nighthawk.
But just as he lay down, he heard the doorbell ring. Ding, ding, ding.
Who would be at the door at this time? Could it be that Melissa had finished school early?
Klein was puzzled, but he had no choice but to get up and go downstairs. He only did a divination before opening the door to confirm that there was no danger before opening the door.
Then, he saw Madam Daly in a black robe.
"Ma'am, why are you here?" Fortunately, it was the door this time.
As Klein asked, he welcomed Daly into the living room.
However, Daly seemed to be in a bad mood. She didn't even have the intention of teasing him verbally as she said directly, "I think you have to tell Dunn and the rest about the 'acting method' as soon as possible."
"What happened?" Klein asked as he poured a cup of water for her and sat down.
As to the Acting method, he was still giving the Captain hints and laying out his plans. He intended to wait until the end of the week for a thorough showdown and submit a special application.
"An important figure will arrive in Tingen tomorrow afternoon. If nothing goes wrong, he will bring you the Clown potion," Daly sighed and said gloomily.
But I haven't applied yet... Klein was dumbfounded. In fact, he had even decided if he wanted to advance through the Church through divination before the Tarot Club.
Daly was somewhat thirsty as she picked up her cup and took a sip of water before answering, "You should know that I returned to Tingen because of the Joint Investigation Unit, and the other member of this team is a Mystic Spell Guide from the Church of Storms...
"That night, after I left your house, I happened to fly past the hotel he was staying at... In the end, he secretly stole some information from the Spirit Body I controlled through a secret technique, so I learned that you had grasped the acting method...
"Then, he wrote this matter into the joint investigation team's report..."
"What a coincidence." Klein frowned.
"It's indeed a coincidence, but I have to admit that his mystic technique is indeed powerful. If he hadn't taken the initiative to tell me about it afterward, I wouldn't have discovered it." With that said, Madam Daly took out a letter from her bag and handed it to Klein.
"Thankfully, he wasn't deliberately targeting you or me, so I saw the brief report before handing it over. Then, I got a friend from Backlund to help you make up a special request. At the very least, this matter was resolved. Otherwise, both of us would have to suffer some punishment.
"Yes, this is the application that my friend wrote for you... Of course, this is just a transcription. The original copy has been handed over to the Holy Church. Take a look, in case someone really asks, you don't even know what you 'wrote'."
Klein took the letter and read it briefly. He didn't think there was anything wrong with it, but the wording was rather simple. It didn't seem like the writing of a university-educated person.
After she finished speaking, Madam Daly stood up again and finally revealed a smile. She said to Klein, "I'm leaving Tingen City tomorrow, but I won't go back on my promise to teach you. If you have any questions, you can summon my messenger to ask me."
"You are leaving tomorrow?" Klein asked in surprise. Then, he thought of something and asked, "Is there a clue from the Secret Order?"
"Yes, Stewart—the secret arts tutor of the Church of Storms—found out the source of the Antigonus family's notebook and locked onto a person named Regis. He currently lives in Midseashire's Constant City," Daly didn't hide anything as she said generously to Klein.
"Why are you telling me this? Isn't this confidential?" Klein immediately felt horrified.
"Heh heh, Stewart hinted that I can deliberately spread the news." Daly smiled and nodded.
Klein nodded thoughtfully.
...
Backlund, South Borough, Harvest Church.
Ever since the banquet at Villa 28 Kingst Street in Cherwood Borough, Hazel had never been imprisoned in the basement again.
However, she had truly become a priest of the Church of Earth Mother, so she still came to the cathedral every day to do volunteer work and copy the Holy Bible.
In front of the podium, Father Utravsky stood there, making Miss Hazel look like a child.
He smiled and said to Hazel, who was wiping the platform,
"Recently, you have already experienced the joy and relaxation of working with dedication and gratitude. Let's end it here today. Calmly feel the pulse of life itself and the pure joy that comes from it."
"Yes, Father." Hazel drew the Earth Mother's Sacred Emblem on her chest before leaving the church.
But then she suddenly saw a young man with brown hair and copper-framed glasses walk in. It was Detective Ebner Bryan, whom she recognized.
She had mixed feelings towards Ebner. He had initially annoyed her and even cut off one of her arms... However, it was also thanks to him that she was able to escape from the evil god's hands. She should be grateful.
Under this conflicted mentality, Hazel didn't know how to face Ebner in the beginning. She wasn't even willing to interact with him.
However, after experiencing the baptism of Earth Mother's teachings and feeling the Mother Goddess's benevolence and love, her temperament gradually calmed down. She could finally face this detective who had caused a huge change in her life.
"Good evening, Bishop Utravsky.
"Good evening, Miss Hazel."
Ebner was the first to exchange greetings with the two of them. Seeing that Hazel was about to leave, he hurriedly stopped her and stated his intentions. "I would like to ask you if you have any friends who are more familiar with the history of the late Fourth Epoch and the early Fifth Epoch?"
He didn't directly mention the royal family's library, so as to prevent the news from leaking out. However, the people Hazel could come into contact with wouldn't be of too low a level. They should be qualified to enter the royal family's library... Well, at the very least, they should be qualified to enter the library that was open to the public.
"Good afternoon, Detective Bryan." Hazel first greeted him with a smile before lowering her head in thought. Finally, she replied,
"Three of the people I know fit your requirements better... but I'm not familiar with them."
She used to be very arrogant, and because she had become a Beyonder, she was even more unwilling to interact with ordinary people. She barely managed to keep herself from being impolite during her daily social interactions, so how could she have any friends?
She had heard of the three candidates before at the ball, but she wasn't sure if they would work.
"It doesn't matter. Just tell me." Ebner had expected this and didn't mind. He had no intention of making friends with these people.
"The first is Viscount Horatio's daughter, Emma. She's a student at the history department of Backlund University. She usually likes to study in the library and doesn't like to socialize... I met her at Duke Negan's ball. By the way, her mother, Madam Norma, is the Duchess's younger sister. She used to study in the history department when she was in university, so she has a good family background."
At this point, Hazel paused and said with an awkward expression, "But I heard that Miss Emma's character is very strange. She's even harder to get along with than me back then..."
Miss, I'm not here for a matchmaking session. There's no need to talk about my personality... Ebner cursed silently, but he also opened up a new train of thought.
It seemed like there might be relevant information in the Backlund University's library.

chapters.title: Chapter 201: "0-08" Text
chapters.content:
Chapter 201 - "0-08" Text
However, Miss Emma's mother was Duchess Negan's younger sister... Madam Norma?
I remember that this person is a peripheral member of the Psychology Alchemists. She was the one who introduced Audrey to the Psychology Alchemists...
Therefore, it was best to stay away from Miss Emma if there was no need. After all, he had to be careful of the Spectator.
Just as Ebner thought this, he heard Hazel continue her introduction.
"The second is one of my pursuers... Well, he was once one. His name is Sonard, and he comes from a middle-class family. However, he has outstanding abilities, and he was selected by Baron Syndras and groomed. Now, he has become a member of the House of Commons at the age of thirty. His future is very promising."
Her tone was calm. Even when she talked about her former admirer, she didn't show much emotion, as if she was talking about a stranger.
But no matter how capable this person is, he doesn't meet my requirements, though Ebner, but he politely didn't interrupt Hazel.
She continued,
"This Mr. Sonard is highly regarded by Baron Syndras because he knows history well. He knows all kinds of stories and even folklore from the Fifth Epoch... It's said that the baron often calls him over to tell him stories and learn the wisdom of the ancients from him."
I get it, this is a storyteller!
It was said that Baron Syndras was a financial investor. For the baron's title, he first bought 600,000 acres of land. Then, he donated 100,000 gold pounds to the Carlton Club, where the Conservatives congregated. He also donated 400,000 pounds to the Conservative Party's activities. After that, he donated 300,000 pounds to various charity events. Only then did he successfully receive His Majesty's conferment.
Such a person did not have the time to study history seriously. It was normal for him to bring a "mister" who knew how to talk about history around him.
Also, I remember that the members of the House of Commons are eligible to enter the royal family's public library to borrow books... Yes, this Sonard candidate.
"As for the third one... Actually, you know him as well. He's Mr. Cullen. He's very knowledgeable. When I was imprisoned underground, I only occasionally heard him talk about the past. I felt that I had gained a lot from it," Hazel continued.
Cullen? That's right. Perhaps the Sanguine have corresponding records... Hmm, I'll write to him later to ask.
Following that, Ebner, who felt that he had gained a lot, immediately expressed his gratitude to Miss Hazel. The latter smiled and replied, "You're welcome. I'm very happy to help you, Detective Bryan."
...
North Borough, in Xio and Fors's rented house.
As the weather was too hot, Fors took off her lotus-leaf collared dress the moment she entered and changed into her pajamas. Only then did she look at Xio, who was eating ice cream on the sofa. She asked in surprise,
"You actually came back so early? Could it be that all the criminals in East Borough are on vacation today?"
Xio rolled her eyes at her and "retaliated". "I'm just asking if something big happened in Backlund today... You actually left home on your own accord."
Fors didn't stand on ceremony as she snatched Xio's ice cream and took a bite. "What do you mean by taking the initiative? It was clearly Viscount Glaint who got someone to look for me, so I went out."
Xio didn't mind the ice cream as she asked curiously, "What's up with him again?"
"It's nothing more than asking about the Apothecary formula... By the way, he also said that Miss Audrey asked to meet you at Philip's Department Store in West Borough on Friday morning." After eating the ice cream, Fors felt the heat from her body dissipate a little before answering.
"Philip's Department Store... That's the most upscale department store in the kingdom, the one that only opens to nobles and wealthy people with membership?" Xio asked uncertainly.
"It's that store... Are you going?" Fors asked as she slumped on another sofa.
Xio pondered for a moment and nodded. "Miss Audrey might have entrusted me with something. She has always been generous, so I'm guessing that the commission fees won't be low... And I still owe Ebner 700 pounds for the materials. I have to raise the money as soon as possible."
"I'm guessing that Ebner definitely didn't force you to return the money." Fors tapped her foot in Xio's direction without any care for her image. She joked, "And if you really can't return it, you can still compensate him."
"Don't joke around like that..." Xio first sternly smacked Fors's foot back before saying thoughtfully, "You seem to know Ebner very well?"
"Didn't you say that I'm very similar to him? I just directly substituted myself..." Fors said confidently.
Xio shook her head helplessly. In terms of language, she was no match for her friend, despite her considerable progress.
Hence, Xio released all her "might." Just a casual glance at Fors caused the latter's smile to freeze on her face. She felt that she was under the pressure of a Spirit Body, and even her knees turned weak...
Fortunately, she was lying on the sofa at the moment. Otherwise, she would have knelt down.
It was only when Xio retracted her gaze that Fors gradually regained her composure. She asked with lingering fear, "Xio... You... Why did you become so terrifying today? I remember that your dignity didn't have such a strong effect?"
"Didn't you ask me why I came back so early? It's not that the criminals in East Borough are resting today, but... I'm no longer a Sheriff," Xio said in a good mood. Then, after some thought, she added, "I didn't mean to scare you just now... I just became an Interrogator, so I'm still unfamiliar with controlling my powers."
"You became a Sequence 7 just like that? So fast..." Fors widened her eyes and muttered to herself.
"Very soon..." Xio suddenly sighed and continued, "But it's far from enough..."
...
Tingen, in a hotel on Iron Cross Street.
Stewart looked at the telegram in his hand and frowned.
I've already spread the news that the joint investigation team is preparing to rush to Constant to capture an important member of the Secret Order. The surveillance personnel at Constant also reported that Regis fled to Backlund overnight after hearing the news, exposing several of the Secret Order's strongholds during his escape...
This reaction is normal, but it doesn't match my expectations...
If the information I obtained previously wasn't a coincidence, then it should've led my investigation in the wrong direction... But from Regence's reaction, it doesn't seem like a trap, nor does it look like an abandonment... He's really an important member of the Secret Order!
Perhaps there's a third-party organization in Tingen. This organization deliberately revealed information about the Secret Order to me...
"What are they plotting? Is it just a grudge against the Secret Order?
Or... does someone not want me to stay in Tingen?
With this in mind, Stewart originally wanted to pray to the Lord of Storms to receive a revelation... But he quickly changed his mind. He felt that praying to the Lord for help over such a trivial matter was making a mountain out of a molehill.
Furthermore, his main mission was to investigate the Secret Order. Since he had a clear lead, he had to return to Backlund to continue investigating.
...
In a manor with a dark red chimney, a pale hand suddenly held a quill pen and wrote on a new page:
"As it has nothing to do with the mission, Stewart decided to ignore some of the hidden problems in Tingen City and return to Backlund to continue pursuing the upper echelons of the Secret Order behind Riggins. He will find the marionette master who blasphemed the loyal guards of the Lord of Storms and bring him back to the Holy Cathedral for trial."
After writing this sentence, the owner of the pale-white palm picked up the notebook and flipped through it, as if he was checking something. Finally, Tiger the Tiger closed the notebook again and left.
Not long after the person left, the notebook opened again. The classic quill didn't take up any ink as it wrote on its own.
Although Stewart is about to leave Tingen, he still can't let go of all the coincidences he encountered. Therefore, he decided to secretly return to Tingen when he has the time and secretly investigate the truth... This is very reasonable.
...
At nine in the evening, Ebner, who had returned to his bedroom, suddenly felt his spirituality stir. He hurriedly activated his Spirit Vision and saw the illusory silver-winged bird, Silika, fly out of the void.
He had written a letter to Cullen on the spot at the Harvest Church, so Ebner knew that it was a reply.
He unscrewed the lid of the Amantha extract that had been made ready and pushed it in front of Silica. Then Ebner opened the card envelope and began to read seriously:
"Regarding the first Baron Lamud, the Sanguine wouldn't record a lowly noble in the Loen Kingdom.
"However, I happen to know a little about this family... Ever since Lamud obtained his title as the first baron, every generation's baron was rather brave, but the outcome was often not good. It was only when the oath-breaking battle broke out that the last successor of this family died in battle with Feysac and completely declined.
"Speaking of which, I met Silika in an ancient castle of the Lamud family.
"As for more, I don't know much about it. I hope that the content will help you.
"Your friend, Callum."
After folding the letter, Ebner glanced at the little bird, who was sucking on the Amantha extract with an intoxicated expression. He thought I wonder what this little bird has to do with Mr. Azik's family. If I encounter the Death Consul in the future, I might be able to summon Silika...
"Silika" had already finished enjoying the taste of the extract. Seeing that Ebner did not reply, she hopped and chirped a few times before shaking her illusory wings and disappearing.
After she left, Ebner also packed up his "equipment." Then, he activated the White Eye and simulated "flight" and "invisibility" powers as he flew all the way to Backlund University.
The university's library usually wasn't guarded by Beyonders. He wanted to take advantage of the night to look for the information he needed.
Unexpectedly, just as Ebner entered the library with his "open door" ability, he found an oil lamp lit in a corner on the second floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 202 - Ruins
Lights? There's someone else in the library at this hour? Is it the administrator, or... someone who came here to "borrow" books like me?
Ebner was slightly surprised. He thought for a moment, then maintained his "invisibility" and quietly approached the light on the second floor.
He needed to find out who was here and when they were planning to leave... If the people in the library did not leave, then he should consider forcing them to sleep for the night.
However, he had only taken a few steps before he was forced to stop. This was because there were many hidden warning runes placed on the stairway.
Is it a Beyonder who lit a lamp on the second floor and read a book? Ebner frowned as he became even more vigilant. He carefully bypassed the "obvious" traps in his eyes and stepped onto the wooden steps as though he had no weight.
Unexpectedly, just as he quietly ascended to the second floor, he heard a girl's excited exclamation:
"Fanni, I found the records of the ruins..."
Before she could finish speaking, she stopped abruptly as though someone had covered her mouth. Following that, a deep female voice sounded. "Lower your voice. Do you want to call everyone from Backlund University? Also, don't say my name."
"Don't worry. Not only did I set up many traps on the first floor, but I also set up some small tricks to confuse senses. The sound and light here can't be heard or seen from five meters away," the girl from before said proudly.
At these words, Ebner seriously estimated the distance between himself and them.
About ten meters... Was that girl talking nonsense?
No, it should be because I'm rather special... Yes, I've always activated the Eye of Pure White, so her so-called trick didn't work at all. It's just like Detective Zreal's "diversionary tactic."
With that thought in mind, Ebner moved a little closer. He stopped when he was almost within five meters of the so-called area.
The "invisibility" ability of the witch he had simulated was not perfect. At least, being unable to hide his shadow was a huge flaw, so he did not get too close.
At this distance, however, Ebner could not only make out the faces of the two girls, but also the words on the books in their hands.
The two ladies didn't look old. The one named Fanni was around 20 years old. She had beautiful chestnut-colored hair that reached her shoulders, and her facial features could only be described as very elegant. However, her figure was extremely outstanding, and even the loose black robe she wore couldn't hide it.
The other, more vivacious girl looked to be about Ebner's age. She had long black hair that fell to her waist, and her eyebrows were long and straight. Her blue eyes were extremely bright, and her lips were slightly curved as if she had been maintaining a teasing smile.
The books in their hands were ancient and looked very dated. However, from Ebner's point of view, he could only see a small portion of the content, as well as the book's name, "Saint Augustine—The Battle of the Violated Oath".
Before Ebner could criticize the name, he heard the lady named Fanni ask in a puzzled tone, "You are clearly a student of Backlund University. You could have come to the library in broad daylight. Why did you have to drag me here in the middle of the night?"
"I borrowed a book during the day to record it. This will definitely leave a trace. If someone tracks it down, wouldn't I be exposed?" The girl with long black hair answered seriously as she flipped through the book.
"Is this what you learned when you were a Swindler?" Miss Fanni put down the book in her hand and deliberately teased.
"It wasn't so troublesome when I was a Swindler. Didn't those men send themselves up to deceive me?" the girl who was reading the book said without raising her head.
"That's why you gave me a 'weird personality' evaluation... Hehe, if it weren't for your family background, I'm afraid the label on your head would be even worse." Fanni stretched her back and then leaned on the table in front of her as she joked.
