"A label... I don't like Emperor Roselle's words, nor do I like people like him. I hope you can use more Loenese words. Thank you." The girl wrinkled her nose unhappily before opening the bookstall in her hand on the table. She pointed at a record on it and said to Fanni,
"Look, there are detailed records here. After the Battle of the Violated Oath, a baron once built a manor there. However, due to the natural disaster, a mudslide drowned the manor and the surrounding villages..."
"I'm from Intis to begin with. Why do I need to use the Loenese way of phrasing it?" Miss Fanni muttered softly before leaning over to take a closer look. She pinched her chin and said, "So you think that the ruin I accidentally discovered was left behind by this baron?"
"That's right. There's a high chance that a military noble of the 'Battle of the Violated Oath' is a Beyonder! Also, due to the sudden descent of the Cosmic Disaster, the Beyonder items and other valuable items he has collected will definitely not be taken away in time. They might still be inside." The girl was beaming with joy and appeared very excited.
"But it's also very likely to be dangerous... After all, we don't know the baron's strength. Furthermore, the sudden arrival of a natural disaster... This is too suspicious." Fanni frowned.
"Isn't it better if there's danger, or even a mysterious incident? As a Cryptologist, it would be disappointing if it's really just an ordinary person's house." Speaking up to this point, the girl flipped the book a few pages forward and said meaningfully, "Besides, look here. It simply recounts the battles that the baron participated in... Did you notice? His opponents seem to be all arrogant and conceited people with low minds!"
"You mean... Briber?" Fanni's eyes immediately lit up with joy.
"That's right. Perhaps the Barbarian formula you need will fall into this expedition," said the girl who called herself a decryption scholar with a smile.
"I'll go make preparations now." Fanni stood up in a hurry.
"There's no need to be in such a hurry. The remains haven't been discovered by others yet... Also, you know that it's not easy for me to go out. Even if I'm staying in a university dormitory... I have to find a suitable reason," said the black-haired girl helplessly as she pulled her companion, who seemed to want to leave immediately.
Since they found the necessary information, the two ladies did not stay for long. They picked up the book that they found, "Saint Augustine—The Battle of the Violated Oath", and quickly left the library.
As for the black-haired girl who claimed to be a Cryptologist, she had also cleared the rune traps she had set up when she went down to the first floor.
They did not notice Ebner who was watching from the side.
A Cryptologist and a lawyer?
And that "lawyer" named Fanni gives me a very familiar feeling. She looks very much like the Artisan's representative at the teacher's gathering.
He did not know where they found the remains...
After thinking for a while, Ebner put this matter to the back of his mind and began to seriously search for information about the Lamud Family in the library.
Although he was actually quite interested in the ruins mentioned by the two ladies, firstly, they did not mention the location of the ruins, and secondly, he had business to attend to. He did not have the time to follow and investigate the identities of the two ladies, so he could only give up.
...
Tingen City, Blackthorn Security Company.
Dunn Smith sat in his office, sipping his coffee and looking down at his documents.
It was already late at night. At that moment, other than Leonard, who was on duty at Chanis Gate, he was the only one in the company who was still lighting up.
At that moment, Dunn's deep gray eyes widened, and the document in his hand fell to the ground... This was because he felt a body filled with heat hugging him from behind.
The fragrance in his nose allowed him to identify the person behind him.
Moments later, Leonard, who was outside Chanis Gate, frowned. He seemed to hear a faint sound.
Just as he was hesitating whether to ring the bell, an old voice sounded in his ear.
"I advise you not to be nosy."

chapters.title: Chapter 203: Information and Clown
chapters.content:
Chapter 203 - Information and Clown
On Tuesday morning, Klein thought about how he should reveal the "acting method" to the Captain more naturally as he walked into the Blackthorn Security Company.
"Good morning, Klein!" The clerk at the front desk, Rozanne, greeted him with a bright smile. Then, she blinked her light brown eyes and whispered mysteriously,
"You know what? There's something wrong with Captain today."
Upon hearing this, Klein immediately became alert. Ever since the incident with Witch Trissy, the Captain's mind seemed to have returned to its previous state. He often forgot some things, so he was extremely sensitive to the "abnormality" that Rozanne mentioned. He immediately lowered his voice and asked solemnly, "What happened?"
Rozanne was shocked by his attitude and hurriedly waved her hand. "It's not what you think... Actually, I think Captain encountered something good."
"Something good? What happened?" Klein was somewhat dumbfounded as he asked in puzzlement.
"Yes, when I went to deliver today's newspaper, I saw Captain in a daze. From time to time, he would reveal a smile that was so gentle that it could drown someone... I called out to him twice before he answered me." Rozanne's eyes lit up as she nodded.
This... Could it be that Madam Daly has confessed to Captain again? Could it be that Captain didn't back down this time... Then, do I still need to tell him about the acting method?
As his thoughts ran wild, Klein walked to the partition and knocked on the Captain's office door.
One, two, three...
After more than ten knocks, Dunn's deep voice sounded from the partition.
"Please come in."
However, at that moment, Klein felt uneasy. He first put down the spirit pendulum and divined if there was any danger before pushing the door open and entering. Then, he saw the Captain instinctively sit up straight, making his gray eyes turn deep as though he was trying his best to remain calm...
This looks like I was secretly playing with my phone in my dorm when I was in school. When I saw the teacher checking on my room, I quickly hid my phone and sat properly...
After lampooning inwardly, Klein cleared his throat and sat down with his hat and cane. "Captain, I have something to report."
"What is it?" Dunn clasped his hands together and asked in a deep voice.
Klein looked at the serious Dunn Smith and suddenly smiled.
"Captain, I thought of something yesterday."
"What's the matter?" Dunn repeated the question. He leaned back slightly in his chair and loosened his clasped hands.
Klein recalled the draft he had prepared and described in detail how he had done the acting process. Although he didn't mention the word "acting," he said everything he could.
After Dunn quietly listened to Klein's description, his gray eyes turned even deeper.
He fell silent for more than ten seconds before reaching out to rub his temples. Then, he picked up his pipe and was just about to take a whiff when he suddenly recalled something. He put it down and sighed. "It's no wonder Daly said that there will be a high-ranking deacon from the Church coming to inspect you in the afternoon... Heh heh, you previously submitted the Spectator and Telepathist potion formulas. You have already contributed enough. I believe you will soon become a Clown."
Although that was true... the word "clown" was still too sad!
As Klein lampooned, he noticed that Captain Dunn seemed to be in a trance again. He hurriedly raised his voice and asked, "Captain, are you alright?"
"I'm fine. Don't worry." Dunn focused his gaze again. He only thought to himself, "I just... didn't know if it's real or... just a dream..."
Seeing how abnormal Captain was today, Klein planned on asking Leonard, who was on duty last night. Hence, he took out his pocket watch and pretended to look at the time.
"Captain, I have to find Old Neil. Today's mysticism lessons are about to begin."
"Alright." Dunn held his pipe and watched Klein leave before falling into a daze again.
...
At noon, due to him spending most of the night reading in the Backlund University's library, Ebner only woke up at this time.
After a simple lunch, he took out a pen and paper and began to organize the information he had read through the Eye of Pure White last night.
"The first Baron Lamud, also known as Mr. Azik, obtained the title of nobility due to military achievements in the last Chaotic Era brought about by the Pale Disaster at the end of the Fourth Epoch.
Second Baron Lamud, Mr. Azik's son. Due to some unknown reason, he became enemies with an earl in the kingdom... There are no records of who this earl is in the library. He only mentioned the conflict between the two nobles over the years, but the second Baron Lamud suddenly disappeared...
"And it was mentioned before that the Nighthawks discovered the headless corpse of Mr. Azik's son. They confirmed that he was poisoned to death when he was alive. They even set up ritualistic magic around his coffin to suppress him out of fear that he would become an evil spirit after death.
"This is very likely done by the Earl who has a feud with him!
"After that, the Lamud family's title was inherited by the branch family... But even so, they were still suppressed. Almost every Baron Lamud died young for various reasons, like a curse.
"During the 'Battle of the Violated Oath,' the last baron was sent to the front line to stop the Feysac Empire. In the end, he died on the battlefield... And Lamud's bloodline ended there."
Looking at the content he wrote on the paper, Ebner felt that as long as he found out who the earl who had been suppressing Mr. Azik's descendants was, he should be able to report to Klein.
As for where to look for it? It was naturally the royal library that was originally planned.
From the looks of it, he still had to find the storyteller, Mr. Sonard, that Miss Hazel had recommended.
And the first step in disguising himself was naturally to understand it first. Therefore, Ebner quickly found Sonard's house based on the information he had obtained. He planned on using "Invisibility" to observe him at a close distance. It was also better to use the Clown mask to "pinch" his face.
However, he soon received a piece of news that caught him off guard:
That was, Mr. Sonard had followed Baron Syndras to Desi Bay early this morning. He wouldn't be back until next Wednesday.
What a coincidence... If I can't disguise myself as Sonard, am I really going to pretend to be Emma?
However, even if I'm willing to disguise myself, the Clown mask doesn't have that ability... If I can't change my body, wouldn't I be exposed at a glance?
With a small sigh, Ebner had to change his strategy, wondering if he could entrust someone else to do the job for him.
Miss Justice's identity is definitely sufficient, but she knows of the mission Mr. Fool gave me. If I were to go over and entrust it to her, I might be exposed. Besides, this is very disadvantageous to the usual mysterious and erudite image of Tower... It's easy for his persona to collapse.
It wasn't a problem for Hazel in the past, but after she was corrupted by the Primordial Moon, she was more ostracized by the upper-class society. Many important figures wouldn't send her an invitation to a ball as proof...
And once she entered the royal family's library, the Beyonders of the royal family would definitely pay more attention to her, and they would definitely suspect her motives for investigating the information of the first Baron Lamud... This might lead to trouble.
Ebner went through all the people he knew in Backlund in his mind, only to discover that there wasn't a suitable candidate.
Either their status was too high and could not be used, or their relationship was generally untrustworthy. In short, they each had their own problems.
At the thought of this, Ebner had to admit that the task of entering the royal library in the short term was very difficult to complete. He had to take his time to think about this.
...
In the alchemy lab of the Blackthorn Security Company in Tingen City.
Klein watched nervously as the Sword of the Goddess, Crestet Cesimir, bent down to pick up the silver-white box by his feet. At the same time, his dark green eyes instantly turned dark.
Then, Cesimir opened the chest, revealing a pure white bone sword inside. He whispered,
"Swear on the sacred relic."
With that said, he took out a tin box. After opening it, a fist-sized grayish-white object was revealed.
Klein's pupils constricted when he saw this because he had seen it before. It was something he had seen when he was divining how to obtain the Clown potion above the gray fog.
Back then, he didn't know what it was... But now, through Tower's description, he knew that it was the Clown Beyonder characteristic!

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Transaction and Expelling Evil Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 204 - Transaction and Expelling Evil Again
At five in the afternoon, in a terrace house at 2 Tingen Daffodil Street.
Klein, who had become a Clown during the day, looked at the ritual on the table and shouted in Jotun,
"Me!"
After a slight pause, he switched to Hermes and said,
"I summon in my name:
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog, the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
Right on the heels of that, he took four steps counterclockwise and arrived above the gray fog. Soon, he heard the summoning incantation he had just chanted. He saw the surging spirituality and ripples of light fuse together to form an illusory door.
He allowed the "door" suction force to suck him in before using a special Spirit Body to descend into the real world.
"It really works... The summoning ritual on 'Feast of Blood' seems to be tailor-made for me..."
Klein sighed before attempting to control his Spirit Body to fly in a circle in midair. Only then did he control his emotions and stop floating in midair.
Following that, he attempted to grab the charms and ordinary notes he had made before ending the summoning and returning above the gray fog.
I actually succeeded! This means that I don't need a sacrificial and bestowment ritual to put or take out items from the gray fog...
When the Tarot Club members conduct transactions in the future, they likely won't need such precious supplementary ingredients to open the Door of Summoning... However, there's no need to inform them about such matters. Expensive ingredients will help them maintain their reverence for Mr. Fool.
Looking at the money and charms in his hand, Klein muttered to himself thoughtfully.
Following that, after testing the other uses of the special Spirit Body, Klein, who was somewhat exhausted, was about to "return" to reality when he suddenly saw the crimson star representing The Sun expand and contract.
...
In the garden villa on 28 Kingst Street in Cherwood Borough, Ebner was sitting at his desk, reading the relevant information on how to obtain access to the royal library.
Since disguising and entrusting didn't work, he might as well change his way of thinking and obtain the qualifications himself.
The rest of the annual fees and donations are fine, but it's more troublesome to need the guarantee of a true noble heir...
"If something really happens, the vouchers will be held responsible. Unless they know everything, it's impossible for them to take such a huge risk... Especially someone like me who took the initiative to look for them.
"Perhaps those fallen nobles will vouch for the money, but the price probably won't be low. I have to be prepared to receive a large sum of money... And Mr. Fool won't reimburse me."
Just as Ebner thought of this, he suddenly saw a boundless gray fog. He saw a blurry tall figure in an empty room in a praying posture.
Following that, words entered his ears.
"...Please inform Mr. Tower that I've already found someone willing to sell the Thousand Technique Mirage Crystal. He wishes to use it to exchange for a powerful Sequence 6 armor or Beyonder item that can protect him. Yes, it's best if it can be used steadily for more than two years..."
This is The Sun, right? His efficiency is quite high. Did he manage to contact the seller in just a day? However, it's not easy to buy a Sequence 6 Beyonder item, much less one with so many conditions...
With this in mind, Ebner also "respectfully" lowered his head and chanted Mr. Fool's honorific name.
"...Please inform Mr. Sun to stabilize the seller for a few days. I'll find a suitable Beyonder item as soon as possible."
After handing over the matter of asking The Sun for help, Ebner took the initiative to mention the results of his investigation that day. He asked Mr. Fool if he needed to find out which earl had framed and constantly suppressed Baron Lamud.
Soon, he received an affirmative answer.
After doing all of this, Ebner had completely abandoned the idea of bribing a declining noble to vouch for him. He didn't have much gold pounds in his hands, so he couldn't waste it on meaningless things.
As for the Sequence 6 defensive item that the seller of the City of Silver needed, Ebner planned on searching for it at various secret gatherings in Backlund. If he couldn't buy it before next week's Tarot Gathering, he would sacrifice his Sword of Dawn.
The Sword of Dawn appeared to be a Beyonder weapon, but it could also condense a Sequence 6 Dawn Armor to protect the user. Although it was very likely to turn the user into armor, it could be considered a weapon that was both offensive and defensive.
However, even though the Sword of Dawn had very serious negative effects, its value was still much higher than the Crystal of Thousand Spells. If they really wanted to trade, the other party had to make up for the difference in price.
...
Above the gray fog, Klein habitually knocked on the long bronze table after hearing Tower's report. After a while, he made up his mind and simulated the feeling of "falling". He "returned" to his bedroom and tidied up a little before heading downstairs.
Melissa, who was busy in the kitchen, poked her head out and saw Klein. Her eyes lit up as she said,
"I bought the ingredients. There's chicken, potatoes, onions, fish, turnips, and peas. I also bought a small jar of honey."
Sister, have you gotten used to the occasional luxury? Klein chuckled.
"I need you to prepare dinner today. There's no need to consider my portion. I have something to do outside, so I might need to return at dawn. Yes, I need to do a favor for Instructor Azik. He's a faculty member of the Khoy University's History department."
Melissa pursed her lips and said,
"Okay."
After bidding farewell to his sister, Klein stopped a carriage at the door and rushed to Mr. Azik's house.
Two hours later, Klein led Mr. Azik to the abandoned castle.
...
At midnight, Ebner, who was about to fall asleep, suddenly heard a knock on the glass. He turned his head and saw a petite figure lying outside the window on the third floor. It was Xio with a head of messy yellow hair.
Ebner quickly opened the window and let her in. "Why are you here at this time? Also, why didn't you knock?"
Xio pursed her lips and said in all seriousness, "It's too strange to visit at this time... It's better to go through the window and look for you directly. It'll avoid a lot of trouble."
If someone found out that you were in my room in the middle of the night, wouldn't it be even more troublesome?
Ebner complained in his heart, but he asked curiously, "Why are you here so late?"
"I want to carry out another exorcism ritual..." Xio said bluntly, but her expression was a little unnatural.
"Exorcism ritual? Why? Did you dream of The Fool again?" As Ebner asked, he activated his Spirit Vision and discovered that Xio's aura had indeed been tainted with a layer of dark green. Although the aura wasn't strong, it could at most cause an ordinary person to fall ill.
The signs of being haunted by ghosts and wraiths... Ebner calmly made a judgment and directly asked,
"Where did you go?"
Xio sighed and replied, "After I became an Interrogator, I was assigned a new mission by my superior, the Golden Mask... It's to interrogate some prisoners in MI9's dungeon..."
MI9's dungeon... was indeed not a good place...
"They didn't prepare a protective ritual or item for you to go to a place like that?" Ebner asked curiously.
Xio shook his head. "Because I'm not an official—"
Ebner understood, so he didn't ask any more questions. Instead, he set up the ritual and began "exorcising" Xio.
At the same time, he thought to himself in amusement, Mr. Fool will probably be able to watch another "live stream"...Although it's not appropriate to directly "sacrifice" the Book of Dead Souls to him, it's not a problem to convey some related rituals and magic through me... It's also a good opportunity to teach Xio some tricks to prevent her from being troubled by the undead in the future...
Well, after the exorcism, he would go to the kitchen to get some snacks.
...
After busying himself for half the night, Klein, who had finally obtained Mr. Azik's sincere friendship and became an "ally" with him, returned to 2 Daffodil Street feeling tired, sleepy, and hungry.
Not long after he entered the house, he felt a warmth on the back of his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Camping in the suburbs
chapters.content:
Chapter 205 - Camping in the suburbs
Listening to Ebner describe the various characteristics of the undead, Xio, who was sitting by the bed, nodded repeatedly as she took a bite of the golden croissant.
After becoming an Interrogator, the "Spirit Penetration" ability she could use was actually very effective on Spirit Bodies. It was just that she wasn't familiar with specters before, which gave her an opportunity.
Now that she had heard Ebner's explanation, she felt that she would not fall for it so easily...
On the other side, after introducing the characteristics of various specters, Ebner explained a few more commonly used necromantic ritualistic magic arrangements. Unfortunately, Beyonders of the Arbiter pathway weren't good at this. Xio nearly fell asleep listening to him.
Seeing this, Ebner had no choice but to stop teaching.
Above the gray fog, Klein tapped the edge of the ancient table and muttered to himself,
So Miss Xio, whom Tower recommended to me, is a spy from MI9. It's no wonder that some of her law enforcement actions in Backlund's East Borough weren't obstructed by the police...
However, Mr. Tower would always teach and eat with girls he's close to in the middle of the night. Is this the real reason why Madam Daly calls him a slow-witted detective?
After he couldn't help but lampoon, Klein suddenly felt that the spirituality seal outside the room in the real world had been activated. Hence, he hurriedly simulated the feeling of "falling" and returned to his bedroom.
After removing the wall of spirituality and opening the door, he saw his sister, Melissa, standing outside with a plate of roasted chicken.
"This was specially left for you by Benson and me. You only left at that time, so I guessed that you might not have had dinner." Melissa handed the plate to Klein before yawning as she returned to her room.
Klein held the roasted chicken and felt very touched. After all, he was really hungry. Furthermore, he had watched the couple eat and drink for nearly half an hour in order to learn the knowledge of wights. He had reached his limit.
"Sister, you are the most considerate." Klein sighed as he ate the roasted chicken.
After having his fill and washing the cutlery, Klein even took the time to take a "combat shower" before returning to his bedroom and falling onto his bed.
As he was mentally exhausted, he fell asleep the moment he wrapped the blanket around himself.
In his hazy and fragmented dream, Klein suddenly woke up and realized that he was sitting in the living room at home, holding the plate of roasted chicken his sister had given him.
... Is Captain here again? He was stunned at first, then he looked out of the oriel window, angry and amused.
With a creak, the door opened. Dunn, who was wearing a black trench coat over his knees, walked in slowly with his cane and pipe.
He looked around, then expressionlessly took the roasted chicken from Klein's hand. After a moment of hesitation, he still ate it.
Klein watched this scene in a daze as he thought sadly, Above the gray fog, Mr. Tower made me watch him and a girl enjoys delicacies in the middle of the night, and in the dream, the captain came to snatch my dinner... I can't live like this anymore. It's really a "nightmare"!
...
On Friday afternoon, Xio lay on her sofa and carefully studied the sketch of Vice Admiral Qilangos that she had received from Audrey that morning.
In her eyes, this was a living, walking gold pound.
After memorizing the appearance of the great pirate Qilangos, she read the additional description:
"Brown hair, dark green eyes."
"Portraits are only used as a reference because the target has the ability to transform into another person's appearance. The duration is unknown."
Portraits are only for reference... A target can transform into another person... Only for reference, transforming into another person... Then why do I need to memorize the content so seriously... Xio's expression froze as though she had sensed the world's malice.
She looked up in a daze and looked at Fors who was lazily lying on the sofa. She muttered to herself,
"There's no way to find them. I don't know what they look like. All I know is that they're foreigners. The number of foreigners who come to Backlund every day is uncountable."
Fors tried to sit up, but she failed three times.
"I'm just an apprentice, not an arbitrator..." she mumbled as she reached out to press on the back of the sofa, successfully turning from lying down to sitting down.
"That lady might think we're prophets?" Fors joked.
Xio was about to answer when she suddenly recalled something. She asked Fors, "Did you tell Miss Audrey that we know Ebner?"
Fors nodded guiltily and said in all seriousness,
"Miss Audrey isn't as innocent and naive as the rumors say. She has a meticulous heart and calm observation skills. Previously, through a simple question, she confirmed that I know Hero Detective ."
"Is that so?" Xio asked doubtfully. Then, she muttered softly, "Perhaps the person she really wants to entrust the job to is Ebner." Then, she suggested, "I'll be in charge of gathering information. You can summarize that pile of gold pounds. No, that pirate admiral's hobbies and characteristics?"
Fors widened her eyes as she shook the iron box containing the cigar in her hand.
"How can you bear to do that? How can you bear to let a slender and sensitive writer do such things as summarize and analyze reasoning?"
Xio shot a glance at her friend and subconsciously revealed a convincing dignity.
"In your 'Stormwind Mountain Villa', there's a very exciting piece of reasoning. That Miss Ceci even managed to subdue an evil spirit with Ebner as its prototype."
Fors hunched her shoulders and lowered her head. She looked at the coffee table and mumbled,
"Why can't you get past Ebner?"
Xio ignored her complaints and lowered her voice, making her childish voice deepen as she asked,
"Do you have any other way to solve this problem?"
Then, as if remembering something, she added, "Except to ask Ebner for help."
Fors was stunned for a few seconds before she suddenly looked up and asked,
"Why don't you look for him? You have to spend money to consult other detectives..."
"Because he and his classmate went camping in the southeastern suburbs. He won't be back until Sunday," Xio said with a pout.
"You can do the early stages of gathering information first. When he returns, you can seek his deduction." Fors took the opportunity when Xio's "dignity" disappeared to temporarily take back the initiative.
...
Ebner had been actively participating in all kinds of Beyonder gatherings since Wednesday, seeking to purchase guardian-type Beyonder items.
Unfortunately, Sequence 6 items were rare to begin with. Furthermore, his requirements weren't low, so he wasn't able to find one that met the requirements.
However, he did not care too much. Anyway, with the Sword of Dawn, he was not afraid of not having anything to exchange for Thousand Technique Mirage Crystals.
On Friday afternoon, at the invitation of his classmates, Susan and Roman, Ebner accompanied them to the town of Kowa in the southeastern suburbs of Backlund in the evening.
Arriving at the Old John Inn in the town, which was also the gathering point for this camping activity, Ebner saw a middle-aged man with a balding head from afar. He was currently inviting the three men and two women beside him into the restaurant for dinner.
The balding man's name was Blake, a public school equestrian teacher whom Ebner had attended when he was studying there.
When Blake saw Ebner and company alight from the rental carriage, he immediately walked forward warmly and greeted them with a smile. "Ebner, it's really great to see you here! I never expected you to become a famous Hero Detective in Backlund."
"Hello, Mr. Blake."
But Ebner clearly wasn't impressed by his enthusiasm. After only a few pleasantries, he turned his attention to the two pretty girls behind Blake.
This was not because he was lecherous, but because he recognized those two girls!
They were the two Beyonders that Ebner had seen in the Backlund Library on Monday night.
Why are they here? Aren't they looking for the ruins of a baron? Could it be that the so-called ruins are near the town of Kangwa?
By the way, this camping trip was originally supposed to take place last week... But due to a huge storm, it was delayed...
Could it be that the heavy rain accidentally exposed the entrance to the ruins and was discovered by a lady named Fanni?
"But now that I think about it... the storm last week wasn't normal either..."
As his thoughts raced, Ebner had the sudden urge to turn and run.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Strange Hotel
chapters.content:
Chapter 206 - Strange Hotel
Of course, although he was impulsive, he didn't really escape.
After all, although he once again had "random thoughts" that resembled a prophecy, he didn't feel any strong warnings.
This meant that, even though there was something wrong with the storm last week, the matter should have ended long ago. At this moment in the town of Conva, there is a high probability that there is no danger beyond his ability.
And this was the same result as the divination result of him using the Solomon gold coin.
Seeing that Ebner's attention seemed to be focused on the two ladies behind him, Blake, was puzzled at first, but then he thought of the rumors in a small newspaper, so he revealed a knowing smile and said,
"Ebner, Susan, Roman, let me introduce you. These two beautiful ladies are Miss Emma and Miss Fani. They accepted the Adol's invitation and joined our camp temporarily."
Adol was one of the three male students present. Ebner was not too familiar with him, only that his family seemed to be in the jewelry business.
Then, Blake introduced the three of Ebner to Emma and Fani. The two ladies didn't pay much attention to it at first, but they nodded in a reserved manner to maintain basic courtesy.
But when she heard that Ebner was the recently famous "hero detective", the black-haired Miss Ema's eyes lit up as she revealed a look of interest.
Detective Bryan has quite a number of legendary stories, and every story seems to involve Beyonders... As a Cryptologist, it's only natural that Emma would be interested in his experiences.
However, just as she was about to say something, she was pulled by her sleeves by Fani. This lady with an excellent figure shook her head indiscernibly, indicating that she shouldn't complicate matters.
After all, this "hero detective" was known in the major newspapers as a top deduction master who could restore the full picture of the incident with just a few details.
Talking up with him, if you accidentally reveal something, wouldn't it expose their true purpose in coming to Conva Town?
Thanks to her Beyonder powers as a Cryptologist, she instantly understood what her friend meant. She immediately restrained her bubbly personality and skillfully acted arrogantly.
But what they didn't know was that Ebner had already known their purpose.
There was no need to mention the well-built Ma'am Fani. Ebner had long determined that she was the Artisan's representative at the teacher's gathering who had been seeking to purchase the Barbarian potion formula.
As for Emma, when he didn't know her name before, Ebner just thought she was a wild "Cryptologist". At most, she had joined the Hermits of Fate.
But after learning her name, Ebner instantly linked her to the daughter of Viscount Horatio, whom Miss Hazel mentioned.
After all, the names were the same. Both were students at Backlund University, both had a reputation for being "eccentric", and both came from extraordinary backgrounds, With so many conditions combined, it's almost certain that they're the same person.
After exchanging a few more words with the three boys, Mr. Blake led them into the dining room of the Old John Inn for dinner.
Ebner had thought that the hotel in the country town would be relatively simple, which was evident from the casual name "Old John" and the exterior decoration of the hotel.
But to his surprise, he suddenly felt a sense of novelty after entering the hotel.
This is because the exterior of the house doesn't seem big, but it's not the same inside... Most of the rooms and facilities in the hotel are underground!
Moreover, the decoration of the underground part obviously has the architectural style of the Fourth Epoch. It wasn't a style that was just like the old ones, but one that was truly ancient.
At least, even Ebner, who already knew a lot about the Fourth Epoch, didn't see anything wrong.
The only thing that makes him feel uncomfortable is that this place seems to have some architectural traits of the tomb ... For example, there were many Hermes decorations engraved on the dining room wall.
One had to know that, apart from using Hermes in mysticism, it was mostly used for tomb sacrifices.
As a "Cryptologist" Emma obviously also see this, She pondered for a moment, then she suddenly asked the boy beside her who had nominally invited her to a camping trip, "Do you know which master designed this restaurant? I think it's excellent."
How could Adol know this? He hurriedly excused himself and ran to the front desk of the hotel. It took him quite a while before he returned. He said in a standard reciting tone,
"This restaurant has a long history, rumored to have existed in the Fourth Epoch. Back then, it was built by a priest who was good at cooking.
Of course, that original building had long been destroyed in the flames of war. The current hotel building was rebuilt about a hundred years ago... As the priest had always kept his design manuscript, it was restored to such a perfect state.
"As for why it's called 'Old John,' that's because the person who rebuilt it had the name."
When Emma heard this, she nodded thoughtfully.
Ebner on the other side, after putting a piece of the chicken pie in his mouth, he became increasingly puzzled about the layout of the hotel.
This was because, after entering the restaurant, he increasingly felt that the interior of the hotel wasn't designed for living people. Apart from not having many mysticism symbols, the overall layout of the hotel was like a tomb...
Furthermore, some of the details of the decorations are somewhat similar to the rituals recorded in the Book of Dead...
Which god's priest was the one who built the hotel in the Fourth Epoch? Could it be Death?
Why did he come to Backlund to build a hotel similar to a cemetery?
Could it be the hidden hand that Death buried in the Northern Continent during the War of the Four Emperors?
While guessing in his heart, he wasn't worried. After all, no matter what schemes there were, it was more than a thousand years ago. This was just a "fake" that was built according to the blueprints.
This wasn't something he easily believed, but a fact that had already been verified with the White Eye.
...
After dinner, the group of young people gathered in the lobby of the hotel for a while before returning to the rooms Mr. Blake had arranged for them.
In the basement, in the room closest to the stairs.
Emma looked at the gas lamps that illuminated the entire suite, and she joked with her friend who was organizing her equipment, "That Detective Bryan's gaze was on you the entire time."
Upon hearing that, Fanni loaded her revolver as she retorted, "A Hero Detective is paying attention to you because you're a thief after all, while I'm a bright Lawyer."
Emma glanced at her friend and continued teasing, "I don't think you understand what I mean..."
However, before she could finish her sentence, she saw Fanni turn her gun around. She had no choice but to change the topic. "When do we leave?"
"That ruin isn't far from here. We'll leave when everyone else is asleep in the middle of the night... Yes, we'll try to return before daybreak," said Fani as he put his revolver into his holster.
...
In the middle of the night, Ebner, who heard the light footsteps in the corridor, suddenly opened his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Ruins Exploration
chapters.content:
Chapter 207 - Ruins Exploration
In Delaire Forest south of the town of Conva, a river ran from afar and circled around a small mountain not far away.
One side of the mountain cliff was bare, revealing pure black stones. Under the illumination of the crimson moon, it gave off a sinister and terrifying feeling.
In the bay at the foot of the mountain, two girls wearing white shirts and black trousers surrounded a hidden underground entrance. They were none other than Emma and Fani who had secretly left the inn in the middle of the night.
"Fani, was this entrance dug up by you?" Looking at the passage beyond the disguise, she couldn't help but frown and ask her friend beside her.
Fani fiddled with the mechanical device in her hand as though she was examining something. After a while, she replied, "Look at the marble wall in the passage. Even if you use your brain, you'll know that I didn't dig it out."
"According to the records in the book, wasn't the baron's castle buried by a landslide? How could there be an entrance... Could it be that a storm last week changed the terrain and exposed a passage to the castle?" Emma asked in puzzlement.
"Why don't you do a divination?" Fani teased as she took out three metal boxes the size of shoe boxes from her backpack.
Upon hearing that, Emma rolled her eyes and chided, "You clearly know that I'm not good at divination..."
"So, let's not talk about demoralizing things... At this point, can you resist the urge to return without any explorations?"
With that said, Fani threw out the three metal cubes.
The metal blocks began to transform in midair as several tentacle-like metal tubes extended out from both sides of the square.
When they landed on the ground, the cubes turned into mechanical dolls that seemed to have many arms and could walk upright.
At that moment, Fani drew a triangular Sacred Emblem on her chest and added,
"With them scouting the way, there shouldn't be much danger... God will protect us."
When Miss Emma saw this, she quickly coiled her long black hair on her head and muttered, "Your grandfather treated you really well. These mechanical dolls seem to have very strong firepower."
Fani knew that her friend was actually nervous. After all, she was a noble lady who seldom had any adventuring experiences. Therefore, she explained,
"Each of the Annihilator mechanical dolls is equipped with four high-pressure steam rifles that can shoot demon hunting bullets, as well as a silver cannonball that comes with the Fire of Light. In terms of destructive power, each of them exceeds a Sequence 7 Beyonder.
Upon hearing that, Emma heaved a sigh of relief. Then, she stretched out her right hand, clenched her fist, and placed it on her chest. "May the Storm be with you."
...
Seeing the two Beyonder ladies walk down the passage, the invisible Ebner, who had followed behind, circled around the warning rune that Emma had set up and entered the passage as well.
The reason why he followed the two girls here wasn't only because he was curious about the ruins, but more importantly, it was obvious that these two girls were novices and hadn't made sufficient preparations for the expedition. If no one was watching, and if something terrifying was released, wouldn't the nearby Conva Town suffer?
With him following them, not only could they save their lives at critical moments, but they could also stop them from courting death.
The black marble staircase had been scuffed for more than a thousand years, but it still maintained its hardness without any signs of corrosion.
The two ladies followed behind the square doll and walked down the stairs to the basement. Following that, they saw the decorations and patterns that were characteristic of the Fourth Epoch.
"This... seems familiar?" Miss Fani looked around with the light from the mechanical dolls and said in surprise.
"Of course they look familiar. We've seen these patterns before at the Old John Inn!" Emma narrowed her eyes and quickly identified the source of the familiarity.
And in the back, Ebner immediately determined that not only were there decorative patterns, but even the layout of the room he was in was exactly the same as the dining room at Old John's Hotel!
I wonder if this is the "inn" that the priest from the Fourth Epoch built?
With this in mind, Ebner used the White Eye to analyze the furniture and items around him before denying his previous guess.
That's not right. The style of the furniture is unique to the Fifth Epoch, and some of the building materials aren't old enough... It shouldn't be a building from the Fourth Epoch... Could it be that it was replicated like the Old John Hotel?
But why did it have to be this style?
Just as Ebner was in deep thought, as a Cryptologist, Miss Emma naturally sensed that the layout of the ruins was almost identical to Old John's Hotel.
As she didn't discover any danger for the time being, she carefully rummaged around with her friend.
"Almost all the valuables have been damaged or rotted... There are no traces of Beyonder items for the time being."
"This is indeed the former residence of Baron Conrad. I found his emblem here. Although it has been severely corrupted, it's exactly as described in the 'Battle of the Violated Oath' in the City of Hope."
"Eh? The bookcase in the underground study is actually so well-preserved. The books inside don't seem to have suffered any serious weathering."
After the two girls probed the basement, they immediately made a new discovery.
As for Ebner, he was on high alert because he discovered something that the two ladies had missed—footprints!
It was a footprint that didn't belong to him, Emma, or Fani. It was unfamiliar yet extremely fresh!
The unfamiliar footprint seemed to follow the staircase from above before disappearing into a huge, heavy, double black stone door at the end of the underground corridor.
That was also the only place in the ruins that was different from the Old John Hotel.
That door... It seems to have been pushed open from the inside... From afar, Ebner looked at the opening of the stone door, but even with his night vision, he could only see darkness.
The stone door had already cracked open, allowing them to enter side by side. It was dark inside.
At this moment, Emma's voice came from the study.
"They're all books on biography. Many of them are collections at home... Only this handwritten notebook might have some value... But I can't understand what he's writing..."
"There are also words that a Cryptologist can't understand?" Fani, who was standing guard, asked in surprise.
"I recognize ancient Hermes, Dragonese, Jotun, and Elvish, but I'm certain that the words in this notebook aren't any of those! These are completely different languages," Emma said with certainty.
"Then bring this notebook with you. We'll find someone to identify it after we finish exploring this ruin," said Fani after some thought.
"That's all I can do..."
Although Ebner was also a little interested in the notebook, it wasn't appropriate for him to show himself. All he could do was give up.
I'll find an opportunity to show my "erudite" side in front of them after the expedition and guide them to hand over the notebook to me for interpretation...
Just as he thought of this, he saw the two ladies leave the study and arrive outside the huge black stone door.
The lights of the three mechanical dolls shone in through the cracks, but they could only illuminate a tiny area behind the door, unable to let them see it clearly.
Just as Fani was about to instruct the mechanical doll to enter, she was stopped by Emma. The latter said with a certain tone, "There's danger down there!"
Fane clearly trusted her friend. She nodded with a serious expression and said, "Then, I'll do the preliminary cleaning!"
Clean up? Before Ebner could react to what she meant, he saw a golden cannon about half a meter long extend out from the heads of the three mechanical dolls.
Right on the heels of that, the cannon barrel quickly lit up, outlining blazing patterns and imprints.
Boom!
Three golden fireballs that resembled miniature suns flew out from the "cannon barrel" and into the darkness.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The ground trembled slightly as intense light emitted from the cracks.
Invisibility in the vicinity wavered as his feet trembled, nearly causing his invisibility to fail.
At this moment, a monster the size of a calf with golden flames burning all over its body darted out from the crack in the stone door at an extremely fast speed.
That aura... Is it another monster that the Werewolf created with its poison?!

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Strange Baron
chapters.content:
Chapter 208 - Strange Baron
He was very familiar with the monsters created by the Werewolf. After all, Xio had been attacked by something similar before, so he recognized her at a glance.
The owner of this ruin is a Werewolf? The Beyonder characteristic he left behind after his death became a Sealed Artifact, so he created many monsters?
As he made this guess, he didn't hesitate to extract the monster's aura and use "Scene Retrack."
Soon, scenes appeared in front of him.
In the pitch-black basement, a stone coffin that was obviously sealed by ritualistic magic suddenly exploded. Soon after, a man more than two meters tall, covered in black spots, stood up.
His actions were a little slow and stiff at first, but they quickly became much smoother. However, what was unsettling was that the man was actually walking backward towards the stone door.
Then, the man extended his arm and pushed open the stone door with the back of his hand. Then, he took a step back and entered the corridor, heading for the stairs. On the way, he left a row of new footprints.
Typically speaking, although walking backward wasn't normal, it wasn't anything surprising. The reason why he said "disturbing" was because the man walked so naturally and fluidly. It felt like "a person should walk like this"!
Upon seeing this, Ebner immediately determined that not only had the baron's corpse not rotted due to the strange black spots, but he had also been possessed by something unknown...
Yes, the way he walked was definitely not human, nor was it a Beyonder existence that was slowly advancing through the potion.
At that moment, Ebner already had a rough guess.
"1-025!"
The reason why he had such a guess was that he had already seen the origins of those monsters. They were originally small animals that lived in the underground ruins. They had suddenly changed after being tainted by the aura left behind by the man, turning into massive monsters.
Just the dissipating aura is enough to achieve the same effects as a Werewolf's poison. The thing possessing the Baron of Black Spot is at least at the demigod level. In addition, it might not even be human...
In that case, overall, 1-025 was undoubtedly the most suspicious!
The only good news was that the baronet possessed by 1-025 had likely left the ruins long ago. It was precisely because he had dug up a tunnel that led to the ground that Miss Fani had chanced upon the entrance.
From the looks of it, the storm last Friday night that lasted for two days might've been caused by a few factions vying for the Sealed Artifact... After all, a demigod conflict could completely change the weather!
And 1-025 had probably abandoned its host during the chaotic battle between the demigods and secretly possessed the baron's corpse in the underground ruins.
Ebner had originally wanted to use the man's dispersed aura to trace back more scenes, but as more monsters were flying out from behind the door, the two ladies were already in dire straits. If he didn't take action, he might have to collect their corpses.
Although he didn't have much of a relationship with them, just as he had analyzed his personality, he didn't have much love and wouldn't deliberately rescue strangers. However, if he happened to encounter someone in trouble and had the ability to handle it himself, he didn't mind helping them.
...
Seeing more monsters rush out from behind the stone door, Fani controlled the three mechanical dolls to shoot while also feeling a deep sense of regret.
Why did I blindly throw out the Fire of Light cannonball which could be used as a trump card on the mechanical dolls?
I should've used one as bait to lure the monsters together and bombard them with cannonballs. This is a good way to eliminate them effectively...
Why was I so arrogant back then, believing that anything behind the door would be destroyed under the bombardment of the mechanical dolls?
Depression and regret instantly surrounded her, distracting her slightly.
But before she could adjust her emotions, a monster that seemed to be a mutation of snakes took the opportunity to break through the crossfire of the three mechanical dolls and opened its mouth to bite Fani's neck.
Just as it was about to reach her, Fani suddenly disappeared. In the blink of an eye, she appeared in front of Miss Emma who had extended her back. At that moment, the latter was brandishing her dagger to force back a rat-like monster's sneak attack.
At the same time, the necklace around Fani's neck suddenly turned to dust, dissipating into the dust that was floating around her.
Although she had escaped with her life, her precious life-preservation item had been used up.
Boom!
Following that, there was a loud boom.
As he temporarily lost control, one of the three mechanical dolls was immediately torn apart by a monster's sharp claws. However, the explosion before it was destroyed blew up this monster that was like a calf into pieces. It was also the only result of the battle.
However, the loss of a mechanical doll was even more disadvantageous for Fani and Emma. In the blink of an eye, three or four monsters tore through the bombardment and pounced on them.
Although Fani had already raised her revolver to shoot, her demon hunting bullets seemed to be ineffective against the monsters. They were almost unable to break through the monsters' hide. In terms of damage, they were inferior to the dagger in her friend's hand.
Seeing a monster pounce at her, and seeing how she could do nothing despite using all her means, she could only close her eyes and wait for her death. At the same time, she thought with regret,
"Grandpa, farewell...
"Emma, my arrogance implicated you..."
However, despite waiting, she didn't feel any pain. Instead, the monsters that were roaring seemed to be wailing in pain.
What happened?
Fani opened her eyes and was surprised to see dozens of golden and black flames suspended in midair. They bombarded the monsters in the corridor like cannonballs.
And beneath the flames stood a man wearing a pair of copper-framed glasses. He was none other than the famous Hero Detective.
This is... being saved? Fani muttered to herself in pleasant surprise.
"We're saved!" When Emma saw this scene, she echoed and took back the thing her mother had secretly given her.
At this moment, while controlling the flames to attack, Ebner turned his head to say to Fani, "Did you take something from the ruins?"
Fani was a little confused by the question, but she also knew that the question was definitely very important. After some thought, she took out a notebook.
This was the notebook that she had put away in the study and was about to return to get someone to interpret it.
"Throw it away first! You were Bribed. That's why your choice was so arrogant and reckless. That's why your attack was ineffective."

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The Enthusiastic Fani
chapters.content:
Chapter 209 - The Enthusiastic Fani
When she heard the word "Bribe" from Ebner, she froze for a moment before recalling the information she had read in the Backlund University Library.
"Baron Conva's opponents are all arrogant and weak-minded people!"
This is the effect of the Briber's powers, and I actually fell for it without realizing it... It's no wonder my choice was so arrogant...
Fani felt frustrated once again. She was frustrated that she hadn't made any preparations despite knowing the relevant information. She regretted thinking that the Baron had long died and that he would no longer use his powers as a Briber.
Looking at the lady in front of her who was in a state of self-reproach, the corners of her mouth couldn't help but twitch. Although she knew in her heart that the other party was most likely affected by her Bribe powers, she still had a complicated feeling that "everyone around her is a pig teammate."
Especially when compared to the tacit understanding Xio had when she fought alongside him, this lady's performance was even worse than a burden.
"Miss Fani, hurry up and throw that notebook away!" As he used the simulated Black Flames and Fire of Light to stop the monsters, he repeated what he had previously said loudly.
However, Miss Fani didn't seem to hear it as she lowered her head in self-pity.
Fortunately, Miss Emma had figured out why they had been "hit." She quickly went forward and shook her friend's shoulder.
Then, the violent shock in her chest jolted Miss Fani out of her emotional world.
Fani's vision gradually returned to focus. She was stunned for two seconds before remembering what Ebner had said.
Then, she raised her arm and ruthlessly threw the notebook far away.
I told you to throw the notebook away, but I didn't ask you to throw it that far... Forget it, as long as she has this action and intention, it will be easy!
Upon seeing this scene, Ebner once again had the urge to facepalm. However, he focused and raised his left hand, aiming the Ring of Light at the notebook that was tumbling in midair.
Then, he opened his mouth and solemnly said in ancient Hermes,
"I declare that the connection is severed. Bribe is ineffective."
Just as he said that the remaining two machine puppets fired bullets, causing blood to splatter across the nearby monsters.
The monsters originally didn't pay much attention to bullets that couldn't even tear through their fur. As a result, they didn't dodge at all, instantly killing several of them.
The other monsters, who weren't hit in their vital spots, roared in pain and had no choice but to dodge the bullets... However, this way, their limited room to dodge was once again compressed.
Upon seeing this, Ebner immediately condensed several "Fire of Light" that were much brighter than before and scattered them on the remaining monsters.
This time, he had borrowed the powers of the Ring of Light, so its might was naturally much stronger than what he had simulated.
Boom!
The fireball condensed from Fire of Light smashed into the monsters like a cannonball. The golden flames instantly charred their fur and skin, producing hideous and terrifying wounds.
Right on the heels of that, black flames accurately followed the wounds and entered their blood vessels and organs, burning them within!
Ebner knew very well that these so-called monsters mutated because they were tainted with the aura of the cursed item.
Everything about them was abnormal. All the strangeness stemmed from the aura that unknowingly emanated from Baron 1-025's possession.
If he didn't get rid of those auras, even if he killed the monsters, he didn't know if there would be even more terrifying changes.
Thankfully, the essence of the aura was actually a special type of spirituality. As for the black flames of a Demoness, they were fuel for her spirituality, so it couldn't be any better to use them to eliminate the aura.
In the blink of an eye, the offensive and defensive situation in the corridor was reversed.
As more monsters were burned to nothingness by the two flames, the rest seemed to become afraid and turned to run back to the room behind the stone door.
But how could Ebner let them do as they wished? He immediately simulated the Whip of Pain and ruthlessly lashed at the escaping monster's Soul Body.
The monsters trembled as they ran, then their limbs went limp as they collapsed to the ground.
Whip of Pain was one of the powers of an Interrogator. That night, after Xio came to "exorcise" the evil spirit, Ebner had gotten her to demonstrate it several times. He had also experienced what it felt like to have an electric current surge through his mind, as though a barbed whip was constantly lashing at his soul.
However, he couldn't simulate the might of Xio's original Whip of Pain. In a situation where she was resisting, the effects weren't ideal.
That was why he waited until the monsters ran away in panic before using it. This was because their mental resistance was the weakest.
Although they didn't know what method the detective in front of them had used, seeing that the remaining monsters were motionless on the ground, the two ladies quickly attacked with various means.
Especially the former. Due to the disappearance of the Bribe effect, this Lawyer had already recovered her usual ability to think.
At the thought that her performance had been worse than average, she wished she could burrow underground.
It's fine being arrogant, but to abandon himself to despair after encountering danger, to the point of closing his eyes and waiting for death... Just thinking about it makes me feel embarrassed...
In her displeasure, she naturally vented her anger on the monsters. The two mechanical puppets immediately unleashed their full strength, creating bloody holes in the monsters that couldn't stand up.
As for the black flames, they drilled into the monster's body through the bloody holes, burning wantonly.
...
After all the roaring sounds came to a halt, Ebner used the White Eye to confirm each and every one of them before removing all the black flames and golden flames. He turned back to the two ladies and said,
"There shouldn't be any enemies left."
At least all the monsters I "retroactively" found were lying here.
Upon hearing his words, Miss Emma finally heaved a sigh of relief and withdrew her dagger back into her sleeve. She then revealed a brilliant smile and said, "Thank you very much, Detective Bryan. You really are a 'hero.' Without you, it would've been difficult for Fani and me to escape."
Her tone was very sincere because what she said was the truth. Even if she used the thing her mother gave her, there was no guarantee that it would be effective. When the time came, there was a high chance that only she could escape, and the price she had to pay in the future might be even more terrifying.
However, Fani was still a little nervous. She first blocked the mechanical puppet at the stone door, then she straightened her clothes, planning to kiss him to express her gratitude.
As an Intis lady, she didn't appear reserved.
However, Ebner jumped in fright at her sudden approach, thinking that she had yet to escape the influence of Bribe and was trying to harm him. He quickly took a few steps back and became alert again.
Fani was taken aback when she saw this. She recalled that she was in Loen. This kingdom needed to be reserved when expressing their feelings. Only then did she stop in regret and solemnly bow.
"Detective Bryan, you are my savior... I'm very grateful. I will do my best to repay you."
Ebner realized that he had apparently misunderstood her. Although it was a little awkward, he had long mastered the ability to control all kinds of "embarrassment" and "surprise" in Sefirah Castle. Therefore, he said without a change in expression,
"There's no need to stand on ceremony. Since you've encountered me, I naturally wouldn't sit back and do nothing..."
"Stand by and do nothing? Do you also like Emperor Roselle's classics?" Fani's eyes lit up as she blurted out.
No, I don't want to talk about how much I'm annoyed with him now... Just as he was lampooning inwardly, he heard Miss Emma ask curiously, "Detective Bryan, how did you happen to be here?"
Is this lady trying to sound me out? Heh heh, a seemingly innocent and lively girl is actually more cautious, while the other one looks older and more experienced, but she's a little straightforward?
That's right. After all, she's already a Cryptologist. She must've played the role of a Swindler before, so how could she be naive?
As for the future Barbarian... There's nothing wrong with being a little straightforward.
While he lampooned inwardly, he replied with a smile, "The two of you are out of place with your public school classmates, but you insisted on joining this camping trip. This is already suspicious.
"Besides, you went out in the middle of the night and caused too much noise. You woke me up, so you came over to take a look."
He didn't mention a word about his eavesdropping at the Backlund University Library.
"So I was suspected by you the moment we met? As expected of the famous 'Hero Detective.' Indeed, not a single clue can escape your eyes!" Upon hearing that, Emma came to a realization and sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Behind the Stone Gate
chapters.content:
Chapter 210 - Behind the Stone Gate
"As expected of a detective. I thought we hid it well..." Fani restrained her enthusiasm and echoed in a reserved manner.
Ebner wasn't pleased with the two ladies' flattery. After all, it wasn't a result of his inference.
On careful thought, ever since I became a "detective," my reasoning seems to be all about cheating through manipulation such as prophetic, retroactively, mind-reading, and eavesdropping...
However, the speed at which I digest my potion isn't too slow... Could it be that acquiring knowledge and information by any means is one of the principles of Knowledge keeper?
As his thoughts raced, he didn't continue the conversation. Instead, he asked with a smile,
"Do you still plan on exploring the room behind the stone door?"
When Miss Fani heard that, she was a little hesitant. Having come this far, she naturally didn't want to give up. However, she had her reservations about the possible danger behind the door, so she didn't dare to make a rash decision. She subconsciously looked at Ema beside her.
As she pondered, she habitually wanted to smooth her long hair, but she didn't touch it when she reached out her hand. Only then did she remember that she had coiled her hair up before entering the ruins...
Hence, under the surprised gaze of her friend and the hero detective, she awkwardly adjusted her lace collar and coughed before asking,
"Detective Bryan, as a Cryptologist, I don't want to give up on the exploration of the mysterious ruins... But our abilities are limited, and we can't protect ourselves... So, can you protect us in completing this exploration?"
At this point, she was afraid that Ebner would misunderstand that she was an insatiable person, so she quickly added, "Of course, the items obtained from the exploration will be yours. After all, without your protection, Fani and I might've already been killed by those monsters... I only hope that I can solve the mystery here... In addition, I'll personally prepare a gift to repay you for saving my life."
Fane nodded in agreement when she heard that. "My thoughts are the same as that of Emma... Hmm, if the room below has the potion formula of Barbarian, I only ask for a copy... I wonder if that's possible?"
After pretending to think for a moment, Ebner said with a smile, "I agree... But there's no need for any gifts. Perhaps I'll ask you for some help in the future... Just don't reject it."
In fact, according to the scenes he had "traced" back through the monsters, there shouldn't be any other danger behind the stone door.
"What help? As long as I can do it, anything is fine," Miss Fane replied without hesitation.
By the side, Miss Emma was a little helpless about her friend's straightforwardness. According to her original intentions, she would rather pay a large sum of money than help her friend with something she didn't know. Therefore, she could only bite the bullet and ask, "What do you want me to do, Detective Bryan?"
"This isn't a good place to talk about such topics. Let's talk about it when we get back." Ebner avoided the topic. It wasn't because he was keeping them in the dark, but it was indeed inappropriate.
If he had raised his request on the spot, it would probably make people suspect that it was premeditated.
It was safer to let this request settle down.
Neither of them had any doubts about what Ebner had said. After all, they were in the ruins and could be in danger at any time. It was indeed not a good time to communicate.
The three of them reached a tacit understanding, and then they arrived before the black stone door together.
Following that, Fani controlled a mechanical doll without any ammunition to pass through the gap. In just two seconds, the three heard a series of clanging sounds... It was the sound of metal rolling down and hitting the ground.
Clearly, on the other side of the stone door was a flight of stairs, and this model of mechanical dolls didn't have the ability to go downstairs.
Fani smiled awkwardly, then twisted a mechanical device on her ear before saying to the two of them, "There's no danger for now..."
Ebner nodded and rubbed his finger against the Band of Light ring and activated the Light of Purification. Following that, rings of golden light enveloped him and the two ladies.
This way, even if there were wraiths, dead souls, or other dark creatures launching a sneak attack, there was no need to worry.
With this in mind, Ebner signaled to the two ladies behind him with his eyes and walked through the stone door first.
Feeling the courage and warmth brought by The Sun, Fani and Ema looked at each other, then followed closely behind Ebner and stepped through the gap in the stone door.
The staircase behind the door wasn't long. It was about 100 steps, about 15 meters tall.
The three of them carefully arrived at the bottom of the stairs. With the light from the halo, they looked up, only to realize that there were no magnificent sculptures or columns, nor were there any murals or collections of masters' glory.
The only pieces of furniture were already rotten, and a large portion of them had been destroyed by Fane's bombardment...
This is just an ordinary basement that isn't even 300 square meters...
The only thing that had anything to do with mysticism was the cracked coffin in the middle of the room.
"This... This place doesn't match that thick stone door at all! It's not even worthy of the hundred stairs!"
The stark contrast made Miss Emma find it unacceptable as she couldn't help but grumble.
However, when he saw the layout of the basement, he pinched his chin thoughtfully.
Although many details were severely damaged due to the prolonged period of time, the general layout of the basement was obviously set up according to a ritual in the Book of Dead... Although it was only a small part of the ritual.
This place was probably built based on the blueprints left behind by the priest from the Fourth Epoch. However, something unexpected must've happened midway, so it was only dug up for such a small basement...
"Detective Bryan, what do you think we should do now?" At that moment, Fani's voice suddenly sounded, interrupting his thoughts.
She had learned a deep lesson previously, so she didn't dare to search for anything.
"First, find and store the Sealed Artifact with the powers of a Briber... Otherwise, it might continue to influence the retrieval of the item," Ebner said after some thought.
Upon hearing that, Emma merely swept her gaze across the items scattered in the basement before casting her gaze on the central shattered stone coffin. This was her intuition as a Cryptologist.
At this moment, Ebner had already analyzed the interior and exterior of the stone coffin through the White Eye. He couldn't help but sigh. "That Baron Conva from centuries ago is really a powerful ritualistic magic master. He actually connected the Briber Sealed Artifact to the entire ruin. It's used to seal his body, and it's also used to deal with any intruders... This line of thought is worth borrowing."
Having said that, he walked straight to the coffin and took out a pitch-black chain gauntlet from the bottom of the shattered coffin.
If not for the stone coffin being destroyed and the ritual losing most of its powers, I wouldn't have succeeded so easily!
At this moment, the confused Miss Emma couldn't help but ask, "Seal himself? Why did the baron seal himself?"

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Exchange of Information
chapters.content:
Chapter 211 - Exchange of Information
"Name: Hand of Wisdom
When your enemy loses their minds because of arrogance, you are intelligent.
"Appearance: pitch-black chain gauntlet.
"Functional description: After wearing a glove, the user can obtain terrifying strength and a strong physique for a short period of time. By giving the target a Bribe in actual or symbolic terms, it can 'weaken' them and make them 'arrogant.'
"Negative effects: Wearing it for more than ten minutes will throw one's mind into chaos and do something incomprehensible. It will increase the risk of degeneration and losing control.
"Suggestion: Use it when activating the White Eye. It can effectively reduce the risk of mental corruption."
Looking at the analysis report of the White Eye, Ebner nodded secretly. He felt that, although the corresponding Sequence of this mystical item wasn't high, its powers were very useful. Otherwise, it wouldn't have been used by Baron Conva as one of the items used to seal himself.
Yes, the Hand of Wisdom was only one of the core components of the stone coffin's sealing ritual. According to Ebner's conjectures, the armor on the baron's body and the weapon in his hand were likely Beyonder items. They were also core components of the seal...
Unfortunately, they were taken away by the baron's corpse that was possessed by 1-025. They weren't left here.
But then again, if the seal of the ruin was still intact, the two ladies, Emma and Fani, who had rashly barged in, probably wouldn't have survived until the stone door was opened.
As for why the baron, who Miss Emma had just asked, wanted to seal himself, he wasn't very sure either. It was just a result of reverse-engineering the damaged ritual's layout.
Therefore, after putting away the Hand of Wisdom chain glove, he replied with a smile, "I'm afraid the reason why the baron sealed himself has to be provided by the notebook that Miss Fani threw away just now."
He guessed that since the baron had specially dealt with the bookcase, he definitely wanted to use this opportunity to leave some information for future generations.
"That notebook... Can you pick it up now?" Fani asked nervously.
"No problem. Also, you can search the basement without worries and see if there's anything of value."
After saying that, Ebner seriously studied the shattered stone coffin.
Ignoring the fact that the material of the stone coffin was very special, just the remaining "ritualistic symbols" on it had benefited him greatly.
Upon hearing Ebner's words, Jenny immediately returned to the upper level to search for the notebook she had thrown somewhere.
As for Miss Emma, she only looked around casually before walking straight to Ebna's side.
As a Cryptologist, her "intuition" told her that the only thing in the basement that had any research value was the shattered stone coffin.
Did the owner of the stone coffin force himself out from inside? He was also the one who dug up the exit of the ruin? Did Fanijust happen to discover the exit? After Miss Emma analyzed the scene with her powers as a Cryptologist, she also came to the same conclusion as Ebner.
However, she immediately thought of something and blurted out, "Could it be that 1-025 ran here and possessed the baron's corpse before escaping?"
Upon hearing that, Ebner looked up and said in surprise, "You know of 1-025?" Even he could only barely guess at the general gist of it by using "retroactively."
"It looks like you had already expected it, Detective Bryan... That's right. The storm last Friday night was so abnormal. As a Hero Detective, you must've had some doubts... I believe that you came to the town of Conva to investigate the whole story, right?"
Having said that, she chuckled and said in a self-deprecating manner,
I should've long thought of it... Why would a famous detective appear in a public school's camp for no reason? Sigh, I actually found it quite normal back then...
I'm not that curious. I'm purely here to camp... If I had known that there was something wrong with the storm, I wouldn't have rushed over to investigate... Even if I really want to know, wouldn't it be better to get Mr. Fool to help me divine?
Despite lampooning inwardly, he said cautiously on the surface, "Miss Emma, there's no need to praise me so much. Go ahead and speak your mind."
This lady appeared lively and innocent, but Ebner knew that she was not a simpleton. Even though she lacked experience, she was not as straightforward as Miss Fani.
She took the initiative to tell him this for a reason.
"Actually, I just wanted to exchange information with you... I guess you don't know the exact details of the battle last Friday night, and I happened to know something through some channels...
"I want to use this information in exchange for your understanding of the situation of this ruin... Especially why the layout of this place is so similar to the hotel in Conva Town."
Seeing that Ebner had read her mind, Miss Emma didn't feel embarrassed. Instead, she said her plan with a smile.
She had some guesses about the ritual that the baron had set up.
This girl is indeed a thief! However, she likely doesn't have any nefarious thoughts. She's just too obsessed with "decrypting."
After pondering for a moment, Ebner felt that an exchange with the other party wasn't a loss. Hence, he nodded and said,
"Sure, go ahead."
Seeing that Ebner had agreed, she secretly heaved a sigh of relief and said with her eyebrows arched,
"According to what I know, the Rose School of Thought and the Church of Storms saint had a fierce battle deep in Delaire Forest in the south last Friday night. The goal was to vie for 1-025...
Later, two other factions joined in. Together with the military that arrived last, there were five demigods attacking at the same time... This resulted in a heavy storm that lasted for days.
"But in the end, 1-025 actually escaped under the noses of a group of demigods, leaving behind a Beyonder item known as the Claw of Frost. As for the tobacco merchant it possessed, it was completely dead."
The Claw of Frost which Rina had lost had indeed been taken away by the tobacco merchant who was possessed by 1-025... It's no wonder that Shanko was pursued by monsters when he was searching for the Beyonder item.
Ebner nodded in thought and pressed, "Which two factions joined in the struggle?"
"I can't be sure... but I heard that it should be the Element Dawn and the Numinous Episcopate," Miss Emma said with uncertainty after some thought.
Element Dawn and the Numinous Episcopate? The former's motives are unclear. Perhaps it's to stop the Rose School of Thought's indulgence faction... And the latter is most likely to seek revenge on the Church of Storms and the military for attacking Ludwell.
Yes, Miss Sharron and Maric seem to be related to the Element Dawn. I can go to the Bravehearts Bar to ask around later. In addition, I can write to Jane and ask her...
With this in mind, Ebner snapped to his senses and organized his words. He was about to share what he knew with Miss Emma.
But at that moment...
Tap.
Tap.
Tak...
The sound of leather boots stepping on the stone stairs could be heard from above. Miss Fani had found her notebook before walking down again.
"Detective Bryan, it's better if you tell me the information after we leave this place." When Miss Emma heard the voice, she immediately cut off the words that were about to escape her mouth.
"You're welcome. Just call me Ebner." Ebner paused before casually replying.
However, he was a little surprised. The two ladies seemed to be on very good terms, but Miss Emma didn't seem inclined to share information about the ruins?
"Alright, Ebner. You can also call me Emma." Miss Emma did as she was told. Then, before Miss Fani came close, she explained softly,
I don't want Fani to know the secrets that involve mysticism. I have to help her... She's a little rash, and knowing too much might bring her danger.
Upon hearing that, Ebner came to a realization, but he secretly lampooned, Calling others rash, but as a believer of the Lord of Storms, you aren't any better, right? Otherwise, you wouldn't have nearly fallen into a hopeless situation in the previous battle.
At this moment, Miss Fani had already approached. Seeing that her friend was whispering to Detective Bryan, she frowned slightly before quickly easing her brows. Then, she opened the notebook she picked up and placed it in front of Ebner. She asked in anticipation,
"Detective Bryan, do you recognize the words here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Translation
chapters.content:
Chapter 212 - Translation
Ebner picked up the notebook and, relying on the powerful analytical powers of the White Eye, flipped through a few pages and came to a realization.
"This notebook was written in secret text," he said with certainty.
"Secrets?" Miss Fani repeated in confusion.
"The lettering that forms the words in this notebook is very simple. It doesn't look like mature text that has undergone evolution. Instead, it looks more like a symbol that was temporarily designed... I just did a count. The type of symbol is roughly the same as the number of words in ancient Feysac." Ebner pointed at the words on one of the pages and explained with a smile.
Upon hearing that, Miss Fani leaned over to Ebner and looked in the direction of his finger. She then said thoughtfully, "In other words... each symbol represents one or a few letters in ancient Feysac?"
"That's right!" Ebner nodded, but he shot a glance at Emma. He wasn't surprised to find that the lady had long known that the words in the notebook were in secret.
That's right. How could a Cryptologist not be able to see through such a simple trick? She didn't mention it before because she wanted to help Miss Fani out?
As he thought this, he quickly deciphered the alphabet that represented some of the symbols using the "Poor Election."
Then, he frowned.
