This was because the words formed by the deciphered alphabet were actually a series of numbers!
This is the second level's encryption? What extraordinary content is recorded in the notebook... It has to be so confidential?
However, since it's a digit, it probably requires a corresponding "codebook" to complete the translation... I wonder which book the baron used as a "codebook."
At this thought, Ebner sighed and showed his results to the two ladies beside him.
Upon seeing this, Fani said in an exaggerated tone, "Detective Bryan, you're amazing! You managed to crack it in such a short period of time."
Her face was filled with amazement.
Miss Emma felt mixed emotions. She knew that she couldn't decipher the meaning of the cryptic text in such a short period of time, so while feeling depressed, she sighed from the bottom of her heart. "As expected of Backlund's famous Hero Detective!"
After sighing, she also thought of the question that Ebner had previously thought about. She deliberated and said, "Ebner, these combination of numbers might very well represent the words corresponding to the position in a book?"
"That's right. Perhaps it's a book from the study above." Ebner nodded slightly and agreed with what Emma said.
"Ebner..." Miss Fani muttered softly. Then, she took out her pocket watch and looked at it. It was already four o'clock, so she reminded him, "It's almost dawn. We have to rush back to the town hotel as soon as possible. We don't have time to determine which book those numbers correspond to."
"Then let's pack it together. We can slowly search for it when we get back." Emma laughed and said meaningfully.
"How?" Ebner asked in surprise.
Although he didn't count them carefully, there were at least twenty to thirty books in the bookcase in the study. It wasn't easy to move them away. It was the same even if he had the strength of a curly-haired baboon after wearing Hand of Wisdom.
"Leave it to me." Fani puffed out her chest and said confidently.
Seeing that she seemed rather confident, Ebner didn't speak further. After carefully searching the basement with the two ladies, he went up the stairs to the study on the upper floor.
Following that, he learned the reason for Miss Fani's confidence.
One by one, the books were placed into Fani's backpack. It was as if they were placed into a bottomless pit, without any signs of being filled.
This backpack is a mystical item? Could it be the ability of a Secrets Sorcerer to create an interspatial pocket?
Hmm... Probably not. For Low-Sequence Beyonders to use items at the demigod level, the negative effects would probably be staggering... Furthermore, for an item at this level to be in the hands of a Sequence 9, it would only bring her trouble.
But even so, it must be a priceless treasure... Are they that at ease with me? Aren't they afraid that I'll have malicious intentions?
Miss Fani is one thing... But looking at Miss Emma, she seems to be already used to it? Don't they realize the true value of this item?
Just as Ebner was filled with suspicion, Fani had already packed all her books into her backpack. She turned around and smiled. "That's enough. Let's head back to the inn first."
Ebner nodded, but he still said wistfully and warningly, "This is the first time I'm seeing a mystical item that possesses Space."
However, Fani clearly read between the lines. Her eyes softened as she said with a smile, "Thank you for the warning, Detective Bryan. But I believe in your character."
You believe me so easily? Lady, isn't it too easy to gain your trust?
Ebner lampooned, but seeing that she seemed to know her limits, he stopped persuading her.
...
The three of them walked all the way back to the Old John Inn, and Fani and Emma returned to their rooms.
After using her spirituality to seal the room, Fani took off her shirt and trousers, walked into the bathroom, and soaked herself in the bathtub to wash away the dust. Only then did she say to her friend in fear,
This expedition was really dangerous. If I hadn't met Detective Bryan, I probably would've died...
Emma also nodded solemnly and said, "The effects of Bribe in the ruins are truly terrifying. Both of us had picked up that notebook, and our mental state should've been lowered back then... And you were greatly demoted... You even forgot your trump card back then and really closed your eyes to await your death."
At that moment, Fanihad already recovered from the comfort of the bath. As she rubbed the soil on her body with a towel, she said with a smile, "But we were lucky to get to know Detective Bryan as a result."
"Why? Did you really fall in love with him at first sight?" Emma teased with squinted eyes as she lay beside the bathtub.
"It's not love at first sight, but I have a good impression of him. It's true that I'm willing to develop a friendship with him... Don't you think that he's very good at combat, knowledge, and reasoning? Our Beyonder path requires such a powerful companion!" Fani said solemnly as she released the mischievous hand of Aimar.
"So... that's why you used 'backpack' to test his character?" Emma asked with a smile.
"Wasn't that a plan you came up with long ago?" Fani glanced at her friend and mimicked her voice. "When you meet a suitable companion, use it as a test. If the person being tested shows any malicious intent, they will definitely suffer the consequences and be devoured by the backpack."
"I was indeed the one who said it... It's just that your performance was too deliberate. I think Ebner has already seen through it..." Emma sighed.
"I wanted to ask you why you called him Ebner. What did you talk about in the basement?" Fani asked suspiciously.
"'Ebner' was specially permitted by the 'heroic detective' to address me as' Emma, '" she said smugly.
And the only response she got was a handful of water that Fani poured out...
...
After returning to the guest room, Ebner still didn't know that he had become the topic of conversation between the two girls while they laughed.
As the sky was about to brighten, he didn't rest. Instead, he flipped open an obviously old book and began comparing the numbers in his mind in an attempt to decipher the hidden meaning behind the second level.
As for the book, he had specially asked for it before he parted with the two ladies.
However, even when he compared all five books, he didn't find the correct passcodes.
Just now, when I was selecting books from Fane's backpack, I deliberately chose the five most likely books... But none of them were...
"Then, will the codebook really be hidden in the other books in the hands of those two ladies?"
Worried, Ebner subconsciously paced around the room. Suddenly, he swept his gaze across the Hermes relief sculptures on the hotel's wall. His heart skipped a beat as he suddenly had a new idea.
That baron was clearly building a house according to a ritual before sealing himself... Or should I say, a mausoleum!
What he recorded in the notebook with two levels of encryption might very well be related to this matter...
And that ritual is recorded in the Book of Dead!
Could it be that... the real codebook is the Book of Dead?
With this in mind, he casually flipped to a page in the notebook and compared the first line of numbers with the Book of Dead from his memories.
Soon, he figured out the contents of the diary page.
"12th September. I chanced upon an abandoned ancient castle in the middle of Delaire Forest. As the situation was unclear, I didn't approach it and planned to explore it after making preparations.
"14th September. According to my observations, there seems to be a vampire secretly guarding the ancient abandoned castle, but he's only a Sequence 7. It's very easy to enter the ancient castle without his knowledge.
"I decided to head in with her to investigate the moment she arrives."
Looking at the words he had deciphered, Ebner recalled the scene of the baron's black-spotted corpse and felt his scalp tingle.
As he had seen it before, he knew how terrifying the ancient castle in Delaire Forest was!

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Baron’s Diary
chapters.content:
Chapter 213 - Baron's Diary
I remember that Emlyn had once asked a Sanguine duke about the ancient castle, but the answer he received was that the ancient castle was older than the duke. Furthermore, any creature that approached it would be in danger of being corrupted by the corruptive powers of Chaos Sea!
Even a Devil was corrupted after being thrown into the ancient castle, turning from cold and cruel to crazy and chaotic.
If Baron Conva had really explored the depths of the ancient castle centuries ago, it would make sense that he hadn't finished building the mausoleum and had sealed himself underground...
With this in mind, Ebner was in no hurry to translate the rest of the content. Instead, he flipped to the first page of the notebook and compared it to the Book of Dead in his memory. He started from the beginning.
"2 May 745.
"Today, I—Benjamin Conva Grant—became a Gatekeeper. This is a day worth remembering because I finally have the right to build a mausoleum and prepare the ritual to awaken my ancestor.
"As the diary entries from today might involve some secrets, I decided to change my notebook and use a hidden passage to record them... This way, unless someone had read the Ancestor's Book of Dead, it would be hard to decipher...
Ebner looked at the translated words "Benjamin Conva Granta" and "Book of Dead Souls" and fell into deep thought.
Jane's last name is Grant... And according to her, the fake identity she had taken on in Bayam was named "Jane Milantha"...It was definitely not a coincidence!
And the original book of the Book of Dead was dug up by Jane in her ancestor's mausoleum...
Then, who was Jane's ancestor? At first, I thought that it might be an identity that Mr. Azik had used in one of his lives... But now, it seems unlikely.
After all, Mr. Azik didn't need the so-called "awakening" ritual. From the looks of it, he hadn't instructed anyone to build a specific mausoleum for him...
Furthermore, according to the knowledge I obtained from the Book of Dead, building a special mausoleum isn't to "awaken"...
The effect of the ritual was to use some special connection between the real world and the Underworld, allowing the built mausoleum to temporarily overlap with the real mausoleum in the Underworld, forming a "door" that led to the real mausoleum.
And Jane had said that she had found her ancestor's mausoleum in a ruin in the Berserk Sea, and she had obtained many treasures and gifts, including the Book of Dead...
Jane, could it be that she entered her ancestor's true mausoleum through that ruin?
Hmm... Queen Mystic seems to always know of the ruins in the Berserk Sea, but she just doesn't have the right to enter... That's why she nurtured Jane who's related to the ruins and personally taught her?
And Queen Mystic's goal is likely to find something left behind by Emperor Roselle when he was alive... In that case, the emperor must've forcefully entered the mausoleum...
Perhaps this is how the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Pale Death, in Queen Mystic's hands came about...
Then the question returns to the past. Who was Jane's ancestor... or the ancestor of the Grant family?
Why did the messenger he left behind look so similar to the messenger that Mr. Azik controlled?
Is it another descendant of the Eggers family? Or is it the other resurrection contingencies of Death?
After pondering for a long while without any clues, Ebner didn't think further. He picked up a pen and paper and continued his translation work.
"3rd May. I plan on summoning my subjects to build a castle for me in the name of the feudal lord. I'll use this to cover up the commotion of me using my Spirit Body to dig underground mausoleums to prevent myself from being discovered by the three Churches."
"4th May. The progress of the construction wasn't ideal. The Spirit Body I controlled was terrible. Even the simple carvings were slanted... Ancestor, I don't wish to find an artist's Spirit Body, but at least bless me with the spirit of a stonesmith...
...
"25th May. As it was the busy farming season, I had no choice but to stop my recruitment. The progress of the mausoleum and castle construction was forced to be suspended... Thankfully, the best time to hold the awakening ritual is next April. I still have plenty of time to prepare."
...
The rest of the content was filled with daily trivialities. After taking a few glances, he swept it away and paused his gaze on a page of the June 23rd notebook.
After secretly bearing a child, Mrs. Aston is still as beautiful and enchanting as ever. Unfortunately, this is Loen, who's very conservative. She's unwilling to end her marriage with that old man and marry me... Even if we secretly have a child together...
"Heh heh, speaking of which, that little fellow was reared in Backlund by Aston's servants, but that old man from the Augustus family knew nothing. I even imagined that she had gone on vacation.
"Aston gave the little guy a name, John Grant, but I didn't like it much."
Lady Aston... Don't tell me it's the one in the later diary who he plans to bring to the ancient castle for an expedition?
Upon seeing this, Ebner sighed because it was destined to be a tragedy.
"26th June. The farming work has finally come to an end. After letting the subjects rest for a few days, I issued another conscription order. My castle and my mausoleum have finally begun working again..."
...
"6th July. I once again came to Backlund to meet Aston. And this time, I met that little fellow. However, his body was very cold. He likely inherited some Beyonder characteristics and was born half a Corpse Collector.
"For this, I wore a mystical item that had been passed down in my family for years on him, so as to hide his physical abnormality. And that item also contains some of the knowledge of the Corpse Collector pathway. Even if something happens to me in the future, the little guy can use it to become a Beyonder.
"Although he's an illegitimate child, he's my only child after all."
...
"1th September. It's almost time for autumn planting. I have no choice but to stop the recruitment process... The advancement of Aston requires the cursed item of an ancient wraith. I have to help her seek out relevant information in the Beyonder circles..."
...
"5th September. At tonight's Beyonder gathering, someone told me that there seems to be an ancient wraith in the depths of Delaire Forest... My territory is at the periphery of Delaire Forest. There were no rumors of wraiths in the past... However, the host of the gathering didn't confirm that what he said was the truth... Perhaps, I should personally explore it?"
What happened next was something that Ebner already knew from the previously translated diary entries. This baronet had called for Lady Aston and entered the sealed castle which had underground corruption!
As for the last few pages of the diary, the handwriting seemed to be different from before, as though it was written by another person... Therefore, Ebner didn't dare to translate it.
That might very well be what Baron Conva wrote while being corrupted. Who knows what terrible things he might write?
Yes, there shouldn't be any problems when the Tarot Gathering happens next Monday.
However... Baron Conva likely still retained some of his rationality. Otherwise, he wouldn't have sealed himself up.
And it was most likely arranged by him that the landslide destroyed that Irma had read about in the library was to completely seal himself inside...
Unfortunately, he was still found by a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact... Sigh, I wonder if 1-025 has already been corrupted? If so, it would be even more terrifying.
...
Backlund, in a factory at the dock area.
More than ten people were gathered around a long table in a hidden basement, discussing something.
And not far away from them, a young man wearing a pair of gold-rimmed glasses, with wheat-colored hair, grayish-blue eyes, and high cheekbones was quietly listening to their conversation.
Strangely, no one noticed his existence.
This young man was none other than the deacon of the Church of Storms, Mysticism Magister Stuart.
He wanted to hear more of the conversation of the Secret Order members, but at that moment, the door to his room suddenly opened. However, no one appeared at the door.
Stewart first frowned, then guessed inwardly, Psychological Invisibility?

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Camping
chapters.content:
Chapter 214 - Camping
Psychological Invisibility?
Although Stewart had only sensed some disharmony in the psyche and didn't really see the person, it was enough for him to make the correct judgment.
According to Captain Cook's information, the Marionettist who killed the Wind-blessed of the Church in the northwestern outskirts had a Hypnotist marionette!
With this in mind, Stewart didn't hesitate to extend his right hand and point his palm in the direction of the door. Then, he used the Prometheus "Theft."
At this level of "Theft," he could temporarily steal the Beyonder powers of others for his own use. Furthermore, the more he understood the target, the easier it was to steal the power he wanted...
As a Mysticism Magister, there was no reason for Stuart to fail, as he had also completely analyzed and learned Psychological Invisibility.
Suddenly, Stewart felt a blob of fog-like objects condense at the door before merging into his right palm.
A middle-aged man with a dazed expression appeared at the originally empty basement.
At this moment, Stewart also appeared. He ignored the looks of shock, fear, anger, and hatred from the Secret Order members around him. He opened his mouth and sang in ancient Hermes,
"Lightning brings destruction,
The might of a deity shocked everyone.
"Storm, give birth to hope.
After the disaster is new life. "
As ancient Hermes had the power of nature, coupled with the singing ability that Stuart had simulated, even though the lyrics were extremely simple, it still made everyone around him feel as if they were hearing thunder. They were so intimidated that they lost the ability to move.
His opponent might very well be a Marionettist, so Stewart naturally wouldn't let his guard down. The reason why he had used the Ocean Songster's powers to intimidate his opponent was also to make it difficult for him to focus on controlling the Spirit Body Threads.
After doing all of this, he simulated the Binding of Wind again, binding the Hypnotist marionette and the Secret Order members in the basement. Then, Stewart snapped his fingers and used his secret technique, Blink, to vanish from the basement. He instantly arrived at the factory's first floor.
Before he tied up the marionette, he had used the "aura" left on it to "trace" back. "He" saw that the marionette's owner had been controlling it here.
Stewart's actions were fluid, and it couldn't be said that he wasn't fast. Unfortunately, when he appeared on the ground, he failed to discover any traces of the Marionettist... He was still a step too late.
Flaming Jump? He was actually able to recover so quickly under the influence of Singing... A Beyonder item, or does he have a marionette other than the Wind-blessed?
As Strat thought, he extracted the remnant "aura" in the workshops. Following that, he simulated his "flight" ability and soared into the sky, chasing west.
However, Stuart eventually lost sight of his target, because he had used Flaming Jump to enter the residence of a great noble, blending into the crowd that was holding the ball.
Is he trying to use the mixed aura to hide his remains? From the looks of it, this Marionettist isn't unfamiliar with Beyonders of the Reader pathway...
With the aura mixed in, I really can't "extract" anymore... Furthermore, he must've changed his appearance. There's no target even if I want to search for him...
Thinking of this, Stewart sighed regretfully. He could only inform the nearby Mandated Punishers through his developed "messaging" to keep an eye on the guests who came out of this noble house...
Although he knew that it might not be of much use—after all, if a Marionettist was hell-bent on escaping, they had too many tricks up their sleeves... With him losing clues, even he didn't have the confidence of capturing him.
Not only did I fail to capture him, I even made him wary... Next time, I might not be able to catch his tail so easily...
Now, I can only try to see if I can find a breakthrough point from that marionette...
Stewart muttered to himself before taking to the air again and flying in the direction of the dock area's factory.
But when he returned to the factory, he was surprised to find that not only had the Hypnotist marionette and all the members of the Secret Order vanished, even the Mandated Punisher who had been lying in ambush to receive him had vanished.
Upon seeing this, he had an ominous feeling. He hurriedly raised his aura and prepared to "Retrack" see what had happened.
However, his "Retrack" failed immediately. Not only did it fail to produce any scenes, even he suffered a serious backlash. He nearly lost control from the mental shock.
Stewart "Placated" himself a few times before barely recovering. As he was in low spirits, he couldn't control his emotions and muttered to himself in horror,
The aura here... Is there a high-level power interfering? Furthermore, its level far exceeds that of ordinary demigods!
Although I didn't "retroactively" discover anything... my intuition tells me that there's shocking malice and degeneration left behind...
"Is it the Saint of the Rose School of Thought? Or is it... an angel?"
...
On Saturday morning, Ebner yawned as he walked out of his hotel room. After exchanging a few words with his classmates, who had already finished dressing up, he went to the dining room to have breakfast.
Here, he saw Emma, who had already put down her long black hair.
As for Miss Fani, she was nowhere to be seen. She was probably catching up on her sleep.
When Emma saw Ebner enter, she only nodded slightly in greeting and gave basic courtesy without showing any familiarity with him.
Ebner knew that she was putting on an act, so he returned the bow cooperatively. Then, he enjoyed breakfast with his two classmates while chatting and laughing.
Although many things had happened the night before, such as exploration, combat, decryption, and the shock of news of underground corruption, Ebner hadn't forgotten the reason for coming to the town of Conva.
He was here for a camping trip, and he was here to be the "escort" for the two ladies, Susan and Rose.
Why would a Flower Protector experience so many other trivial matters...
After lampooning inwardly, Ebner continued his important work of filling his stomach.
After eating and drinking to their heart's content, the four men and four women, who had participated in the camping trip, followed the trail in the woods to Delaire Forest on the south side of the town.
After carefully distinguishing the direction in which he was going, he was relieved to find that he wasn't heading towards the center of the forest.
If Mr. Black really wanted to take them to the abandoned castle for the night, he would have to find a way to forcefully change his plans.
Teacher Black clearly knew that the young masters and ladies behind him weren't here to challenge the limits, so the paths he chose were relatively flat and smooth, with few obstacles and little danger.
But even so, two hours after they set off, Adol, who had the worst stamina, couldn't hold on any longer. He didn't care if he would embarrass himself in front of the girl he had been longing for. Panting, he asked, "B... Mr. Black, how far to camp?"
As the only son of a jewelry businessman, he always rode on carriages when he traveled. When had he ever traveled that much?
"Heh heh, just a dozen more meters and we'll reach it by turning this hill." Seeing this, Mr. Black shook his head, turned around, and helped him up as they walked through the final stretch.
After circling around the small hill, everyone's vision suddenly opened up.
This was a patch of grass near a stream. The surrounding area was open, and there was a water source. It was indeed a good place to camp.
Following that, the ordinary people, such as susan, romantic, and Adol, had no choice but to stay in their spots to rest due to their physical exertion. They also set up tents and other camping items.
As for Ebner and Irma, they volunteered to take the hunting and timber-gathering mission and walked into the forest.
Ms. Black wasn't very agreeable at first, but after witnessing some of the fighting skills that the two of them had deliberately shown, she wisely kept silent.
After leaving everyone's line of sight, Emma was the first to stop. Then, she used a Beyonder item to jump onto a thick branch of a tree. She patted the other side of the branch with her hand, signaling for Abner to sit down.
Whether it was to gather wood or hunt, it was a trivial matter for Beyonders. The two of them could even fly to a nearby town to buy it directly. Therefore, while they were alone, they might as well explore what they hadn't finished the night before.
Ebner naturally knew what she wanted to do. After a moment's thought, he "flew" onto the branch and sat on another branch not far away.
When Emma saw this, she blinked. Then, after using her spirituality to seal the surrounding space, she said to Ebner with a smile,
"Let's talk about serious matters... Ebner, what do you need me to do with Fani? You have to say this first, I won't agree to anything that's too overboard..."

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Request and Summary
chapters.content:
Chapter 215 - Request and Summary
As for what he needed the help of the two ladies, Emna had long made plans. Therefore, he smiled and said,
"There are two things that require your help... Yes, don't worry. It's not too much trouble, nor will it be overboard."
"What exactly is it?" Emma first pressed, then a hint of ridicule flashed in her eyes. She tensed up her face and pretended to be serious as she said, "Even if I have to propose to Fani, I'll try my best to help you."
What the hell... Ebner's face was blank, and he almost fell from the tree. After a long while, he said helplessly, "Miss Emma, stop joking."
Not only was this lady scheming, but she also seemed to be a little scheming and liked to tease people.
"Isn't that the case? Some of the Backlund newspapers have tried hard to describe the romance of the Hero Detective!" Emma fiddled with a mechanical device by her ear before covering her mouth and laughing.
If I really am as amorous as the papers say, would you and Miss Fani still wish to return to the hotel last night?
Ebner retorted inwardly, but on the surface, he didn't continue with the topic. He forcefully changed the topic and said,
"First, I need a protective Beyonder item at Sequence 6. It can be used for at least two years, and the smaller the negative effects, the better... Of course, I'll pay for it. All you have to do is provide suitable items."
Upon hearing this request, Ema wiped away her smile and said thoughtfully, "Was it the 'mechanical doll' from last night that allowed you to infer that there was an Artisan backing Fani?"
Not only that, she had sold many Beyonder weapons at her teacher's gathering. She was long known as an Artisan proxy; otherwise, I wouldn't have taken the opportunity to make this request.
Despite having such thoughts, Ebner wasn't foolish enough to say what was on his mind. He only nodded and said, "Not only the mechanical dolls but there's also her backpack... I even feel that she might have an archbishop of the Church of Steam backing her."
"Ebner, your reasoning skills are indeed impressive. This is very close to the truth..."
Emma first sighed with emotion, then she pressed her fingers against the mechanical device by her ear, as if she was listening to something. Then, she continued with a smile, "Fani has already agreed. She said that she would help you find an item that meets the requirements as soon as possible... And you don't have to pay for it. This is to repay her for saving my life."
How embarrassed would that be? Although that was on his mind, he appeared amiable on the surface. He nodded without any reservations and smiled. "I'll wait for her good news then."
Emma was stunned for a moment, then she laughed and said, "Ebner, you really are different... Well, at least you're different from most gentlemen. If it were anyone else, even if they were willing, they would've hypocritically declined a few times, right?"
However, she wasn't disgusted by the ungentlemanly behavior of Ebner... To be precise, she was also such a person, out of place with the other noble ladies like her.
That's because you don't know Mr. Fool...
Ebner lampooned inwardly before mentioning his second request.
"The second thing is that I would like to trouble Miss Emma to help me read some information in the royal family's library..."
Upon hearing that, Emma frowned and asked, "Ebner, how can you be so sure that I'm qualified to enter the royal library? Do you know my identity?"
"I know a little... I'm friends with Miss Hazel," Ebner said in a rather vague manner.
"A friend who cut off her arm?" Miss Emma couldn't help but lampoon. Then, she said in disbelief, "Hazel actually mentioned me in front of you? I guess there must be nothing nice about it."
Lady, you sure are well-informed... Although it's not a secret that I severed Hazel's arm, there probably aren't many people who know the inside story...
Where did your information come from? The Psychology Alchemists? Or the Hermits of Fate?
However, from her personality and habits, she doesn't seem like a member of the Psychology Alchemists... And most importantly, she's not a Spectator.
Just as Ebner was making a guess, Miss Emma saw that he didn't reply and asked,
"What do you want me to read in the royal library?"
"Help me investigate the Lamud family's historical documents, as well as the secrets sealed by the royal family... Yes, this family obtained their aristocratic title through battle achievements at the end of the Fourth Epoch. They completely declined during the Battle of the Violated Oath." As Ebner spoke, he mentioned some of the information he had previously found to Ema, leaving only Mr. Azik's part in the conversation.
However, Emma's eyes grew brighter as she listened. When Ebner was done, she said in excitement, "Just listening to your description makes me feel that this family might be hiding some secrets. I can't wait to find out... In short, I agree with your request. I'm very interested in this matter now!"
After discussing the matter of repaying the debt, the topic naturally shifted to the transaction they hadn't completed the night before.
After some thought, Ebner felt that it wouldn't be a big problem telling the baronet the reason for building the mausoleum. After all, apart from the specific building and time needed for the so-called "awakening" ritual, the most important factor was still the descendants of the baronet. It would be useless even if the lady in front of him wanted to imitate her.
After hearing Ebner's recount, Miss Emma said in enlightenment, "So that's how it is. It's no wonder that someone would keep following a blueprint of a building for more than a thousand years... They should be the descendants of some existence... Is this a contingency plan of that existence's resurrection?"
Revival? That doesn't seem like it either. After all, the ritual was only a "door" that led to the Underworld. It didn't have the ability to revive...
Furthermore, there's a high chance that Jane has already entered that real mausoleum... No, Roselle might've entered earlier, but I haven't heard of any high-level existences of the Death pathway being resurrected as a result...
Of course, Ebner wouldn't tell Emma about this. He just added, "That baron must've encountered something unexpected while constructing the underground mausoleum. That's why he sealed himself up..."
Emma nodded thoughtfully and guessed, "It's very likely that there's something wrong with the ritual itself, making him hear or see information about high-level existences. Then, he's on the verge of losing control, so he has no choice but to seal himself."
And the truth is much more serious than you can imagine!
Just as Ebner was sighing to himself, he suddenly felt that the speed at which the Knowledge Keeper potion was being digested had greatly improved.
Is this knowledge I provided to Emma very helpful to her? Is this why the feedback I received speeding up her digestion?
As he thought of this, he stole a glance at Miss Emma who was on a tree branch opposite him. He realized that her face was filled with an obvious pleasant surprise.
Pleasant surprise? Did my words bring her a pleasant surprise? Could it be that her Cryptologist potion has also been partially digested as a result?
According to my previous analysis, "conservation" should be to tell suitable knowledge to someone who needs it, and to keep the "inappropriate" knowledge from them.
Emma has clearly "decrypted" my unconfirmed words and obtained some of the truth, so she has "digested" it...
And because of this knowledge, I received feedback from her?
Although I can't be sure, it's very likely... From the looks of it, not only are the Knowledge Keeper and Cryptologist similar in abilities, but they might also be able to work together when it comes to digesting potions...
After letting his imagination run wild, Ebner looked at the time and realized that it was already getting late. He ended his conversation with Miss Emma and jumped down from the tree.
No matter what, he had to take some time to get some prey back to complete his mission.
...
In a factory in the dock area, Mysticism Magister Stuart was describing to an old man with a black bonnet and abnormally stern silver eyes what he felt when he "retraced" the scene.
The elder was wearing a long robe embroidered with the symbol of Storm. He was none other than the Cardinal of the Church of Storms, the Archbishop of the Backlund diocese, Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake.
"Corruption... Full of malice..." Snake ruminated over the words described by Stuart and frowned.
It's normal for 1-025 to have malicious intent, but the aura of "degeneration"? Could it be that the cursed item believes in some evil god? Or was it corrupted by some evil god?
At this moment, an illusory door suddenly tore open in the air outside the factory. It was covered in complicated symbols.
The door opened silently, and a handsome man in a starched suit walked out. He was in his forties, mature and elegant.
He used his golden eyes to scan the hole in the top floor of the workshop before landing on the ground. He asked, "Did 1-025 appear here previously? Or did Mahmosi still not return to the Southern Continent?"
"Why are you here?" Snake asked in a deep voice.
"This is Backlund. A Grade 1 Sealed Artifact can even destroy most of the city. How can I not come? Besides, I think you need our military's help," the handsome man said with a smile.
Ace Snake didn't say a word when he heard that. He turned his gaze back to the outside of the workshop.
This was because an elder wearing a white priest robe and a clerical cap had walked in. His face was unusually kind, and his expression was calm and gentle.
And behind the elder were several members of the Machinery Hivemind. One of the men with a cut face held a silver mirror with ancient patterns.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Mirror Question and Answer
chapters.content:
Chapter 216 - Mirror Question and Answer
Ace Snake looked at the kind old man who led the Machinery Hivemind members into the workshop and asked with a frown,
"Horamick, why are you also here to join in the fun? Are you here to laugh at us Mandated Punishers?"
Horamick Haydn wasn't only the head of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery's Backlund diocese, but he was also a member of the Divine Council. He was also a very famous scientist in the Northern Continent, and an honorary professor of physics at Backlund University.
From his tone, one can tell that Spellsinger of God is very familiar with this archbishop of the Church of Steam. They have a good relationship.
Upon hearing Ace's unfriendly tone, Horamick calmly smiled and said, "Strictly speaking, this is the area under the Machinery Hivemind's jurisdiction. It's also our duty to investigate..." Having said that, he glanced at the handsome military man on the other side and continued, "Don't worry, we're only here to provide some help, not to vie for 1-025."
When Ace Snake heard that, his expression softened. He thought for a moment and probed, "Did the Machinery Hivemind get any new clues?"
"Not at the moment... But we brought a Sealed Artifact that can provide clues." With that said, Horamick's hands naturally hung low as he turned around and said to the man behind him, "Ikanser, bring 2-111 over."
"Yes, Your Grace," the man named Ikanser answered respectfully before walking forward with a silver mirror in his arms.
The others immediately focused their gazes on the mirror.
On both sides of the mirror, there was an eye-like accessory. It was built on a black gem, looking deep and charming.
"It's only a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact?" Ace Snake was clearly disappointed.
Horamick smiled without saying a word, motioning for Ikanser to show its abilities.
With a head of frizzled, messy, and stubborn brown hair, Ikanser gritted his teeth and stroked the surface of the silver mirror with his right hand. After repeating it three times, he took a deep breath and said in a deep voice,
"Honorable Arrodes, my question is, what exactly happened in the basement of this workshop last night?"
As he said that, the surrounding space suddenly became dense, and aqueous light appeared on the surface of the silver mirror.
Soon, a scene appeared in the silver mirror.
More than a dozen hooded suspicious people were sitting around a long table, arguing fiercely about something, oblivious to the fact that on the other side of the table, a young man wearing gold-framed eyes was quietly watching their performance.
At this moment, a middle-aged man with lifeless eyes appeared at the door of the basement. Just as he pushed open the door, the young man who no one noticed previously extended his right hand and opened his mouth to recite a poem...
Then, the young man threw out ropes formed from hurricanes, binding everyone in the basement before he disappeared.
With a flash of water, the scene changed. A man in a black overcoat, scarf and heavy hat walked into the basement. He surveyed the area and walked straight to a member of the Secret Order. He took out a small box from his pocket.
Then, without him moving, everyone in the basement turned into lifelike dolls.
The man waved his hand, and one by one, the cloth dolls flew up and entered the illusory bronze door that had condensed in front of him.
Finally, the aqueous light in the mirror froze on the scene of the man looking up slightly, revealing a face covered in black spots.
The black spots were so terrifying that even the silver mirror's "reenactment" of the scene still left everyone present in shock.
Ikanser exhaled. Just as he was about to silently leave the demigods, a few lines of ancient Feysac appeared on the silver mirror.
"Based on the principle of reciprocity, it's my turn to ask."
"If you answer wrong or lie, you will be punished."
The word "punished" was blood-red, as though it was dripping with liquid!
The expression on Ikanser's face twisted for a moment before turning abnormally serious.
Following that, aqueous light flashed on the silver mirror as a new line appeared:
"What was the true name of the Giant King's Court's queen in the Third Epoch?"
Ikanser's throat bobbed up and down as sweat gradually appeared on his forehead.
After a brief silence, he casually said,
"Constant!"
"Wrong." The blood-red words on the mirror changed again. "Mission or penalty?"
There was an obvious struggle on Ikanser's face. Finally, he exhaled and said,
"Penalty."
Just as he said that a silver bolt of lightning appeared out of thin air and struck his head.
Sizzle. Ikanser's hair stood on end, and his body collapsed with a thud, spewing out some black smoke.
As for the mirror, it didn't fall to the ground with him. Instead, it floated up and landed on a machine's console beside him.
When Stuart, who had been watching the development of the situation, saw this scene, he immediately walked forward, squatted down, and pressed his right hand on Ikanser's back, simulating the power of "healing."
After two seconds, Ikanser stood up, trembling as he panted. After a long while, he nodded at Stuart and said in a hoarse voice, "Friend, thank you."
"You're welcome..." Stewart stood up and looked at the silver mirror on the operating table. He asked thoughtfully, "It seems to have the powers of the Reader and Sailor pathway's High-Sequence Beyonders. Is it really only a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact?"
Ikanser nodded.
"Yes, it's not very dangerous."
As he said that, he suddenly sounded like he was gritting his teeth.
"In other words, all other aspects have reached the standards of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact?" Stuart said in enlightenment.
At this moment, the three saints present began discussing what they had seen.
"Could the man who appeared in the basement be 1-025? His methods are very similar, and he dressed like that in the summer. I can't think of any normal person who would choose to dress like that," Ace Snake said after some thought.
"Although it makes sense, that person clearly came for the item on that member of the Secret Order. The others were just implicated... Besides, that person gives me a different feeling from 1-025... He seems to be even more terrifying." When the handsome military man said this, he looked at Horamick with his golden eyes.
His meaning was clear. Since there was such an easily usable Sealed Artifact, why was he making random guesses?
"So, we need to know the exact background of that man, as well as what he took away?" Horamick nodded in agreement. Then, he looked at the weak Ikanser and turned to the other Machinery Hivemind members.
"Which one of you is going to use 2-111?"
To his surprise, before the deacons and members of the Machinery Hivemind could respond, Stuart, who was beside Ikanser, eagerly interjected, "Your Excellency Horamick, can I use 2-111? I have full confidence in my knowledge. I should be able to answer its questions."
Horamick looked at him seriously and then replied with a smile, "Sure, let you use it."
After receiving permission, Stuart picked up the silver mirror on the operating table in excitement. When he turned around and was about to ask Ikanser about the things to take note of when he discovered that the high-ranking deacon of the Church of Steam and the Machinery Hivemind members behind him were all looking at him with pity.
Compassion? Why? Do they think I'll be punished? Are they so sure that I can't answer 2-111?
With a hint of confusion, Stuart stroked the surface of the mirror three times with his right hand before asking,
"Honorable Arrodes, my question is the origins of the man who turned everyone in the basement into dolls and took them away."
The interior of the workshop darkened once again as if dark clouds had just passed by.
The surface of the silver mirror swirled with aqueous light as a blurry image quickly condensed.
It was an underground mausoleum. A man covered in black spots sealed himself in a stone coffin with scarlet armor, a silver broadsword, and a pitch-black glove.
Following that, the scene changed. The decorations in the mausoleum visibly rotted, clearly having been there for a long time.
At this moment, a transparent figure passed through the ritual passed through the stone coffin and possessed the man's body.
The scene came to an abrupt halt.
"It really is 1-025!" Ace Snake glanced at the handsome military man and said proudly.
The military man ignored him. Instead, he pinched his chin and muttered to himself, "What exactly happened to that man? Why did he seal himself?"
"In the scene that flashed past, that person's family emblem appeared. I think we should be able to find it in the royal family's library," Horamick said with a smile after listening quietly.
"Leave this to me. I'll get it done as soon as possible," the handsome military man said with a nod.
At this moment, the silver mirror named Arrodes had already dissipated the scene, turning into words.
It required Stuart to answer a question, and if he lied or refused to answer, he would be severely punished.
Strat felt an inexplicable sense of anticipation and anxiety, but he found the words of the mirror a little strange.
Answer a question is like an exam. Knowing means knowing, and not knowing means not knowing. Why does it think that I would lie or be unwilling to answer?
Puzzled, Stuart looked at the mirror and quietly waited for the question.
A few seconds later, he saw the blood-like words change as they formed one after another.
"The first time you resolved the biological problems of an adult, which bishop or deacon's wife surfaced in your mind?"
Stewart froze, feeling everyone's gaze fall on him, especially one of the high-ranking deacons of the Church of Storms who was on duty outside.
...
Saturday afternoon. As the weather had changed again, heavy dark clouds covered half the sky, so the public-school camping trip was forced to be suspended.
Under Mr. Black's lead, the group of young men and women quickly returned to the small town of Conva.
However, just as he returned to the hotel, he discovered that the atmosphere in the town was a little off. It seemed like there were many new faces.
He couldn't help but look at the nearby Emma. The latter nodded with a serious expression, clearly sensing this.
At that moment, a voice came from behind them.
"Miss Emma? Why are you here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Subsequent and Commission
chapters.content:
Chapter 217 - Subsequent and Commission
When Emma suddenly heard someone call out her full name, she was alarmed. She quickly turned back to look at the source of the voice and realized that it was Viscount Leerhsen's youngest son, Kance.
They were both children of noble families, and they were about the same age. She had interacted with them at various balls and banquets, so she naturally knew them.
However, according to what Emma knew, Kance had entered MI9 after graduating from Tingen University. He had become more mysterious ever since...
Wait? MI9? Since Kance is here, the abnormal atmosphere in the town is because of the military's intelligence organization?
As she thought this, she turned her gaze and smiled. She said with some annoyance, "Kance, you gave me a fright."
"I'm very sorry, Miss Emma." The thin and tall young gentleman, Kance, first apologized politely before repeating his previous question. "How did you come to this remote town?"
Such an attitude makes it seem like he's interrogating me... Although his choice of words is very polite...
Could it be that the military has also discovered the matter regarding Baron Conva... Or could it be that 1-025 has caused some trouble in Backlund after possessing the baron?
Tsk, it's a good thing that I secretly went to search for Baron Kanga's information at night and didn't leave any records on the surface... Besides, the entrance was very hidden. After that, Ibna buried it and cleaned up the traces.
Without knowing its exact location, even MI9 would find it difficult to find it within a short period of time...
As her thoughts raced, she deliberately revealed a dissatisfied expression. Her long, straight eyebrows furrowed together as she harrumphed. "Hmph, I was invited by Detective Bryan to attend a public school camping trip... Why? Does MI9 even need to bother with such matters?"
She didn't say that it was Adol who had invited her. After all, he was only the son of a jewelry businessman. Even though she had the label of having a strange personality plastered over her head, to suddenly agree to an ordinary person's invitation was too strange.
But Detective Bryan was different. He had been very famous recently, and his experiences were legendary enough. He was the topic of conversation for many young noble ladies.
When he heard that Detective Bryan would be participating in the camping trip, he accepted the invitation out of curiosity and longing.
Even if MI9 found out that it was actually Adol who had invited him, he wouldn't suspect anything. He would only think that he had been used.
"Detective Bryan? Ebner Bryan? Hero Detective?" Kance was taken aback when he heard that. Then, he cast his gaze at the few gentlemen present and quickly locked onto Ebner.
Seeing that the person had mentioned him, Ebner took off his cap and bowed slightly as a form of a bow. He smiled and said, "I'm Ebner Bryan... Nice to meet you. How may I address you?"
"Kance Leerhsen... Hello, Detective Bryan." Kance nodded and returned the greeting.
After figuring out the purpose of the group of people who came to the town of Conva, Kance didn't pester them further. He let them return to the inn and secretly lowered his voice to warn Emma,
"you have to be careful of this Hero Detective. His reputation doesn't seem too good... Besides, there are rumors that he's close to a famous bounty hunter in East Borough."
Upon hearing that, Ema secretly chuckled. Then, she pretended to not believe him and said half-truthfully, "That's just gossip. Ebner isn't such a person."
The reason he said "true" was because, after more than a day of contact, Emma had long noticed that he wasn't a playboy. Instead, he was an unexpected gentleman. Furthermore, he was very respectful towards women. This respect wasn't superficial but came from the bottom of his heart. He truly treated them as equals.
She said, "fake," because she felt that perhaps the "tabloids" weren't completely nonsense. From the attitude of his two female classmates, she knew that he was actually very likable... And he didn't seem to be able to keep a distance from the ladies, which resulted in some misunderstandings...
Yes, perhaps it was because he placed women on equal footing that he missed out on the details of etiquette.
Just as Emma's thoughts were wandering, Kance sighed and stopped persuading her. He didn't have a deep relationship with her. Since she didn't believe him, he could forget it.
However, I still have to investigate the cause of this camping trip...
Seeing Kance turn to leave, the group didn't delay any further. After a simple dinner, they returned to their rooms.
...
At night, in a relatively exquisite villa outside the town.
Kance handed the tidied documents to a man wearing a golden mask and reported,
"Your Excellency, I've already checked the people who visited Kance Town recently, but I didn't find anyone suspicious."
The masked man nodded noncommittally, then he picked up a page of information and seriously read it. After a long while, he pointed at the content on one of the pages and asked, "What's going on with this public school camping trip?"
Kance had long guessed that his superior would ask this, so he explained, having prepared for it,
"Detective Bryan was a student who had just graduated from this public school, and Miss Emma and Miss Fani had joined the camp out of curiosity about the Hero Detective.
Besides, their camping trip wasn't a last-minute decision. It was already prepared a week or two ago. It was only delayed because of last weekend's heavy rain... And by then, 1-025 likely hadn't been possessed.
"So, I think there's nothing wrong with their camping trip."
The masked man lowered his head in thought for a moment before nodding slightly. "Indeed... We can remove the surveillance on them. Our manpower is limited, and we can't waste it on unrelated people. Our top priority now is to find the castle ruins of Baron Kangwa."
"Yes, Your Excellency." Kance first responded before saying hesitantly, "But, we only have a few pictures of the interior of the ruins... We can't determine its exact location..."
"Heh heh, I know what you're thinking, but these 'internal scenes' were obtained by a deacon of the Church of Storms who sacrificed himself... Therefore, it's temporarily impossible for us to have any more information." The masked man recalled the 'tragic' scene that had happened in the factory's workshops. Even someone as determined as him couldn't help but feel a lingering fear.
However, Kance felt a deep sense of respect when he heard that. He sighed and said, "Sacrificing myself to obtain important information... What a respectable Guardian... If I were to be in dire straits in the future, I hope that my sacrifice will be worth it."
The masked man looked up at him and asked, "Are you sure?"
"I can swear on it!" Kance replied without hesitation.
...
On Sunday morning, the group of people who had ended their camping trip due to the weather returned to Backlund via carriage.
Both of them were a little upset because they had never had the chance to speak to Ebner alone.
This was especially so for susan. After hearing about Beyonders from the Romans, she had wanted to ask about Ebner, but she had failed to do so.
At noon, Ebner returned to his gardened villa on Gunsted Street in Cherwood Borough. Before he could catch up on his sleep, Mr. Skade, who was acting as a butler, knocked on the door and reported that Xio and Fors had come to visit. They were already waiting in the living room.
Xio actually used the front door this time? Oh right, she still has Fors with her. There's no way she can go straight up to the third floor...
Ebner lampooned inwardly before calmly changing his clothes and heading downstairs to the living room.
"Ebner, we need your help with something." Xio didn't stand on ceremony with Ebner as she directly mentioned her request.
"What is it?" Although Ebner had some guesses, he pretended to ask curiously.
At this moment, Fors deliberately took out a page of information from the dossier in her hand and handed the rest to Ebner. She said with a crafty smile,
"We hope that you can find the patterns of the target's actions in Backlund from the information."
Ebner gave her a deep look, took the envelope, and pulled out the documents inside.
After a few glances, Ebner chuckled and pretended to be surprised.
"Qilangos is in Backlund?"
"How did you know?" This time, it was Fors's turn to be surprised, because the page she pulled out was filled with Qilangos's actual introduction and portrait.
How would I know? I was there when The Hanged Man entrusted Miss Justice with this mission!

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Deduction and Guess
chapters.content:
Chapter 218 - Deduction and Guess
It was obviously impossible for Ebner to tell Fors the truth behind this; therefore, he picked up the documents and "inferred" based on the contents.
"That's because the traits are too obvious... Look here, the target has an obsession with the wind, and he's also a senior sailor. This is clearly telling me that the person you're looking for is a Beyonder from the Sailor pathway and that his Sequence can't be too low. Otherwise, you and Xio wouldn't appear so serious!
"Look at this line again. 'The target is a psychotic serial killer with the need to kill a living person every other day'... This also indicates that the Beyonder of the Sailor pathway might have a Beyonder item that requires living human sacrifices to suppress the negative effects.
"Finally, on the page, you especially took away, I guess it's about the person you're looking for. There's even a portrait of him... I don't know why you didn't show me that page, but it's obvious that you think I would immediately recognize him if I saw him.
In conclusion, this person is a Mid- or High-Sequence Beyonder of the Sailor pathway. He has a powerful Sealed Artifact that requires the sacrifice of a living person. He likely hasn't been in Backlund for long, and he has quite a reputation...
"And although there are many people who meet these conditions, I only know one person who needs to hide his identity—Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos."
When Fors heard this reasoning, her face immediately revealed a look of admiration. She clapped her hands and marveled, "Ebner, your reasoning skills are amazing! I even planned on changing the paragraph you just said into a novel!"
However, Xio said in a deadpan manner, "That wasn't what you said before you left... You said that the reputation of Ebner's Hero Detective was mostly a coincidence. I don't know what his actual level of reasoning is, so I'll have to test him first."
Fors spread her hands innocently and replied, "Didn't you also tacitly agree?"
So you deliberately didn't give me that page to test my reasoning skills... Heh, luckily I can cheat.
Ebner secretly gave a self-deprecating comment before deliberately teasing her. "You flatter me. My Deduction skills are only at the level of the evil spirit you penned. I can't even compare to the 1.65-meter-tall Lady Sissi who weighs ninety-eight pounds, much less you who created her."
Fors was rendered speechless by what he said. She only felt that the present Ebner was very petty.
In fact, he hadn't slept the night before yesterday, and because he was worried that MI9 would investigate the truth in his dream, he had been on guard the entire night. Therefore, he was rather exhausted.
Furthermore, he was more relaxed in front of Xio and Fors, so he wasn't on guard. This made it difficult for him to hide his personality.
Xio sighed at the childish behavior of her two friends. She once again felt that her friends were only reliable on serious matters and were the same type of people in private.
In order to get back to the topic at hand, she had no choice but to show her authority, making her two friends turn serious once again. Only then did she say,
"Ebner, did you deduce where Qilangos would be living in Backlund?"
Ebner nodded. The information provided by Xio and Fors was already very detailed. He didn't even need to recall the details to guess where Qilangos would choose to stay.
"This pirate admiral isn't lacking in money, so he definitely wouldn't mistreat himself. He definitely lives in Empress Borough, West Borough, Hillston Borough, Cherwood Borough, or the outskirts of North Borough.
"However, as a Sailor, he wouldn't be too far from the Tussock River. He would likely choose a house near the bank.
Furthermore, the Beyonder item he has is named Creeping Hunger. It has the corresponding powers of the Shepherd pathway, but it will eat a person every other day... Therefore, the place he stays in is definitely close to the East Borough or the bridge area where people disappear without garnering much attention.
Just as he said that Fors thoughtfully added, "So it's very likely that he lives on both banks of the Tussock River in West Borough or Cherwood Borough? Because it's closer to the bridge?"
"That's right!" Ebner nodded. Then, he looked at the two excited ladies and deliberated over his words.
"I don't know who got you to search for Qilangos, but I hope that you don't participate in it personally. Otherwise, you'll have a hard time escaping if you really encounter Vice Admiral Qilangos."
Xio wiped away her smile when she heard that. She had always had great trust in Ebner. Seeing how serious he was, she couldn't help but ask, "Is Qilangos really that terrifying? He seems to only be a Sequence 6 Wind-blessed..."
"A great pirate with a bounty of 10,000 pounds, what do you think?" Ebner first shook his head before saying with a serious expression,
"You've also witnessed Admiral Hell Ludwell's strength. Although Qilangos is inferior to him, he's a pirate admiral who's equal to him for extended periods of time. How could he be a simple Wind-blessed?"
Upon hearing this, Xio immediately recalled the sea battle she had watched that night and nodded solemnly.
Ludwell, that's a pirate admiral who wasn't even able to retain a demigod! Ebner was right. Even if Qilangos is slightly weaker, he's not someone Xio can deal with.
"So... are we going to ignore Miss Audrey's request?" Fors interjected.
She didn't mind mentioning the "most dazzling jewel of Backlund" in front of Ebner. After all, it was Ebner who had suggested that she and Xio get to know the lady.
Xio was also a little hesitant. She still owed Ebner the money for the Interrogator's materials, and Miss Audrey had been very generous. She didn't wish to give up on this request.
After all, although Qilangos was powerful, she wasn't going to capture or kill him. She was only going to search for his traces. The risk was still within acceptable limits.
Looking at Xio's conflicted expression, Ebner could roughly guess what she was thinking. He sighed and said in a suggestive manner,
"I mean there's no need for you to investigate on your own. I'm not asking you to give up on that lady's request."
Fors's heart stirred when she heard that as she asked, "Why do you say that?"
"Qilangos wanted to feed Creeping Hunger, so his target was most likely homeless in East Borough. After all, even the police didn't know how many tramps existed in Backlund...
And East Borough is Xio's previous area of jurisdiction. This should've been reported in MI9...
When Xio heard this, she said in enlightenment, "You mean to report some clues and use MI9's powers to investigate Qilangos?"
"That's right." Ebner nodded and continued, "Since you're a spy under MI9, it's completely reasonable for you to report it after discovering the powers of degeneration and evil."
Most importantly, it wouldn't attract the suspicion of the organization that couldn't be named.
Furthermore, MI9 should be focused on searching for the whereabouts of 1-025. As for the Baron that the Sealed Artifact had possessed, it had suffered underground corruption and was also filled with degeneration...
Then, would the military not investigate carefully when they received news that the aura of degeneration had appeared in East Borough?
If the military really doesn't do anything about it... Heh heh, when the time comes, who's part of that organization would be a little clearer, right?
I have a nagging feeling that someone is scheming behind this. After all, it's too much of a coincidence that 1-025 managed to escape by "possessing" it.
I guess even if Xio doesn't report it, someone will definitely send the relevant information to MI9.
...
At ten o'clock on Monday morning, Ebner, who had a rare nap, rubbed his still-dazed head and got up with great difficulty.
It wasn't that he didn't want to continue sleeping, but that Mr. Scard had already woken him up once and brought him the news that Miss Fanney was about to visit.
Sending someone to notify them before a formal visit was also part of social etiquette.
After washing up, Ebner put on his decent clothes and waited for about ten minutes before Miss Fani's carriage slowly drove into the villa's garden.
After ushering the lady with the suitcase into the living room, the two dismissed their servants. Only then did Ebner look at Fani, who was sitting opposite him, and ask,
"Miss Fani, is there any news regarding that defensive Beyonder item?"
Miss Fani nodded with a smile. She lifted the suitcase by her feet and placed it on her long thighs, then she undid the buckle.
After the lady opened the suitcase and turned the side of the suitcase to look at Ebner, he saw what was inside.
It was a set of cold leather armor.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Leather Armor and New Commission
chapters.content:
Chapter 219 - Leather Armor and New Commission
"This leather armor has just been made, and it doesn't have a specific name, but I call it 'Wolf Armor,'" Miss Fani said with a smile as she showed it.
"Wolf armor?" Ebner stirred in his heart as he recalled that this lady had previously sold a Claw of Frost at his teacher's gathering. He immediately guessed something.
"Yes, its main ingredient was a Werewolf's hide. Only its vital spots were fused with the skin of a Zombie... Together with some other Beyonder ingredients, we formed this Werewolf Armor." As Miss Fani spoke, she stood up, took out the armor from her suitcase, and wore it.
Indeed... I heard that Miss Sharron and the others had once seduced the Church of Storms and ambushed Jane before they clashed with the Rose School of Thought's indulgence faction... Could it be that the ingredients of the Werewolf and Zombie she killed had fallen into the hands of the Artisan backing Miss Fani?
As he pondered, he watched the young lady clumsily hang up the ice-cold wolf armor.
Surprisingly, the leather vest looked very flat when folded in the suitcase, but it was surprisingly well-tailored when worn by Miss Fani. Even her excellent figure was outlined, as if she was wearing a lady's armor from some online game in his previous life.
As an Intis lady, Fani didn't feel embarrassed at all. Instead, she openly circled around and said with a smile, "As you can see, this leather armor can automatically adjust its size and shape according to the wearer's figure... It's just too tight, so it's best not to put anything sharp in the clothes inside..."
It's the material on a werewolf from the indulgence faction... It's not strange to have this problem...
Ebner lampooned inwardly as he shifted his gaze away and asked, "What Beyonder powers does it have?"
"When wearing this leather armor, one can obtain super strong self-recovery abilities. When running at full speed, one can forcefully raise their speed to the level of a steam locomotive at its peak. However, each activation of these two abilities will shorten the lifespan of the Wolf Armor. As for how much it will cost, it will depend on the actual situation.
"In addition, it's not afraid of fire or drowning. It can weaken or even be immune to many kinds of magic, especially ice-type spells. It's almost useless against it.
"Finally, its defensive strength against vital spots is extremely strong. Even the direct bombardment of bullets and cannonballs can't affect it... Yes, it will take at least five strikes to break its defensive strength against vital spots."
At this point, Miss Fani took out a gun and aimed it at her heart to demonstrate.
Upon seeing this, Ebner, who was sitting on the sofa, immediately stood up and extended his hand to stop her.
"I believe you wouldn't lie to me about something like this... So, forget the demonstration."
As Ebner took the revolver and placed it on the coffee table, he tried his best to speak sincerely.
What a joke. If she were to really shoot, not to mention how much of a misunderstanding it would bring to the servant next door, as well as Mr. Skade and the others, if there was a problem with the quality of this "wolf armor," and the young lady in front of him were to get into trouble at his place, it would be hard to explain.
As for what the function of the Wolf Armor was like, he could use the White Eye to analyze and confirm it later.
Fani didn't stop Ebner's actions. She released the gun's handle and added, "That's the negative effect... Wearing it often makes one impulsive. Without any external interference, one often does whatever one thinks of doing."
Lust... The word flashed through Ebner's mind once again. He could think of anything he wanted, and it was also a manifestation of his "Lust."
However, at this level of "indulgence," he should be able to balance himself with a sedative or a spell that stabilized his mind without affecting his usage of it.
"It was recently forged. In theory, it can exist for more than three years... However, if you use the powers of 'self-recovery' and 'acceleration' frequently, you might become an ordinary leather armor in a few months."
With that said, Miss Fani untied the "string" made of spiritual materials around the edge of her leather armor and took it off.
Then, she folded the "wolf armor" and placed it back into the suitcase. She pushed it onto the table in front of Ebner and asked with a smile, "Detective Bryan, how's the gift I prepared?"
"It was very useful to me. Thank you for the trouble, Miss Fani."
Ebner was indeed very satisfied. This Beyonder item might have a time limit, but it had powerful defensive capabilities. It also had excellent healing powers and escaping abilities. It was definitely a life-saving weapon.
If it were to be sold for auctions, the price of such an item would be at least 1,500 pounds. If one were to encounter someone who desperately needed it, it was not impossible for the price to exceed 2,000 pounds.
"You're welcome... as long as you like it. After all, I'm doing it to thank you for saving my life," Fani said happily when she saw Ebner accept the leather armor.
Ebner thought for a moment and asked Miss Fani to wait while he returned to his office to write a document. Then, feeling that it wasn't serious enough, he found an envelope and sealed it. He then returned to the living room and handed the envelope to her.
"I have something else that I'd like to entrust you with, Miss Fani... This is my advance payment."
"Just call me Fani Detective Bryan, if you have anything to say, just say the word. I don't have to pay for it." Franny didn't take the envelope as she waved her hand.
I'm trying to maintain our relationship. I might have to trouble you in the future if I need to create Beyonder items. Are you going to help me for free every time?
As his thoughts raced, Ebner stuffed the envelope into Miss Fani's hands and said with a smile, "Don't refuse. There's something you need here. In addition, my commission is a long-term one, so it might be very troublesome... Also, just call me, Ebner, like Emma."
Fani didn't refuse this time. After receiving the envelope, she asked thoughtfully, "What do you want from me, Ebner?"
"There are two things... First, I hope that you can help me take note of the information regarding 1-025. Yes, it's best if you help me organize it every few days."
Although Ebner had never directly encountered the cursed item, he had indirectly interacted with it several times. He had a vague feeling that his "fate" with it wouldn't be so easily severed. Perhaps he might really encounter it one day... Therefore, it was very necessary to figure out its whereabouts in advance.
"Sure." After a moment's thought, Fani agreed. She didn't ask why Abna believed that she had the ability to obtain information on a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. After all, even without using her connections, she could more or less obtain some information just by relying on Emma.
"The second is that I hope you can help me collect some of Roselle's notebook and manuscripts. I've recently been interested in those Roselle characters." Seeing that she had agreed, he immediately made a second request.
If he could get the real Roselle diary, there was naturally no need for him to fabricate anything. This was especially so for Klein, who had matured very quickly. He wasn't as easily fooled as before. If he missed anything, it might incur his suspicion.
"That's easy. Previously, in order to 'decrypt,' Emma had also searched for Roselle's notebook, but unfortunately, she was unable to decipher it... I'll get a few pages from her in a few days." Fani didn't pay much attention to this request and agreed very easily.
After that, the two of them talked about mysticism. As it was almost noon, Miss Fani seemed to have other social events to attend. Only then did she reluctantly leave.
Only when she got into her own carriage did she recall the letter that Ebner had handed her. She took out the envelope from her exquisite pouch and carefully opened it.
When she saw the contents of the letter, Miss Fani was stunned. A look of surprise and joy flashed in her eyes!
This was because the piece of paper was the Barbarian potion formula that she had been longing for!
"Ebner, what a gentle person."
...
Ebner, who only wanted to maintain their relationship so that he could "fleece" her for a long period of time, didn't know of Miss Fani's evaluation of him. He returned to his room after lunch and took a nap to replenish his energy while waiting for three.
Meanwhile, in a particular basement of Pritz Harbor.
Alger sat in his chair, looking coldly at the struggling man as he listened to his testimony.
"H-he's here to complete a mission, but I'm not sure what it is exactly." The struggling pirate lost all will to resist, and he answered honestly, "I only know that he might benefit from it. Qilangos once boasted in front of us that if this matter goes smoothly, he'll get an item he's been dreaming of getting for a long time. The Four Pirate Kings will also become the Five Pirate Kings."
An item that he had been dreaming of? What could it be? Could it be that the mysterious employer behind him could give him a demigod Beyonder characteristic?
Alger frowned and slipped into deep thought.
...
At three in the afternoon, Klein looked at The Sun, who he had pulled up ahead of time. Then, he established a connection with the crimson stars representing Justice, The Hanged Man, and The Tower. He pulled the three members back into the magnificent palace that looked like a giant's residence.
As soon as Audrey saw the scene in front of her, she immediately greeted with a brisk tone,
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool. I've memorized another page of Emperor Roselle's diary."
With that said, she greeted the three men in front of her. She only thought to herself that it was time to develop a few other female Tarot Club members.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Miss Justice’s Question
chapters.content:
Chapter 220 - Miss Justice's Question
Miss Justice is always able to maintain her cheerful mood. How enviable. I hope I can do the same... Upon hearing the brisk greeting, Klein couldn't help but sigh.
But then he thought about how she had given away a bag of jewelry so easily. He suddenly felt that it was very difficult to maintain his cheerful mood like Miss Justice...
As his thoughts raced, Klein took the page of Roselle's diary that Miss Justice had conjured. However, he wasn't in a hurry to read it. Instead, he looked at the lively and cheerful lady and calmly asked,
"What do you wish to obtain?"
As she had already received Alfred's reply and had received clear information about the Rainbow Salamander, Audrey didn't choose to ask for more clues about the material. Instead, after some thought, she said in deliberation,
"At a Beyonder trade fair, I met a person who claimed to be very knowledgeable in Roselle's language. He tattooed three symbols in Roselle's language on his arm and declared that these symbols possessed 'power,' making him stronger and healthier..."
Having said that, Audrey conjured the picture of the three words after receiving Mr. Fool's permission. Then, she looked up respectfully and requested,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, I wish to know the meaning of these three symbols... Also, do they really possess powers?"
Upon hearing that, Ebner didn't dare to look at the words immediately, afraid that he would laugh out loud if they were strange words.
After a few seconds of mental preparation, he stole a glance at the words conjured in front of Miss Justice.
Uh, this is... a young lady?
Perhaps it was because of the "tattoo" in Audrey's memory, the structure of the word appeared extremely distorted. It took Ebner quite a while to recognize it.
Young lady... To think that it's really a combination of three words. I thought it would be three completely unrelated words or even a cross-section of words like 'division leader.'
He probably "dug" it out from some diary page, right?
However, can tattooing a "young lady" make one healthier and stronger? In his previous life, even the evil spirits who relied on copulation to advance didn't dare to think of such a good thing.
Just as Ebner was lampooning inwardly, Klein, who was sitting in The Fool's seat, couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth when he saw the words.
He thought about it seriously and felt that even if it was for the sake of Mr. Fool's dignity, he couldn't reveal Roselle's method of interpretation. Otherwise, if the members of the Tarot Club knew that Mr. Fool often read descriptions like "young ladies" and "madams," that persona would completely crumble...
Of course, it was more likely that they would be scared to death by their own "sacrilegious" actions.
However, I can't ignore Miss Justice's request... What should I do...
Klein was just about to make a perfunctory comment when he caught sight of the yellowish-brown goatskin parchment conjured by Miss Justice. He discovered that the first line wrote:
"2nd August. The waters are deeper than I imagined. History really is a lady who dresses up at will."
Looking at this slightly distorted and menacing Chinese sentence, Klein came to a realization. Perhaps Miss Justice's diary was bought from the gentleman who had the words "young lady" tattooed on it... And this sentence was likely the origin of the "tattoo."
However, this sentence gave him new inspiration. Hence, after some thought, he said in the tone of The Fool,
"I should've said that Rosellewen doesn't possess any mysterious powers.
"As for these three patterns... you can understand them as having the meaning of 'weak,' 'unable to resist,' and 'being at the mercy of the strong.'"
Did just three symbols contain that much meaning? However, the gentleman had indeed fooled himself. How could such a symbol bring about health and strength?
A series of thoughts flashed through Audrey's mind. She looked at the figure shrouded in gray fog, stood up, curtsied, and said sincerely, "Thank you for your answer, Honorable Mr. Fool."
Klein leaned back in his chair and replied calmly, "It's just an equivalent exchange."
Alger also forced himself to memorize the three symbols and patterns in his mind. At the same time, he kept guessing inwardly: This term must've come from Emperor Roselle. What kind of setback did he encounter back then to write such pessimistic words? Could it be when he fell out with the Church of Steam? Or was it before he was ultimately assassinated?
Derrick had no idea who Roselle was. Although he was also a little curious, he remembered that Mr. Fool had exhorted him not to ask about the secrets of others. Therefore, he only silently kept some information to himself.
Only Ebner was most understanding of Mr. Fool's "painstaking efforts." He could roughly guess what Klein was trying to do to explain himself, but he couldn't help but lampoon inwardly.
To explain the words "young lady" in such a profound manner, what if one day a Tarot Club member tattooed it on his body to motivate him?
"I don't want to be manipulated, so I want to become strong!" The person who shouted this carved the words "young lady" on his arm.
Such a scene flashed through his mind as he took a deep breath, thankful that The Star and The Moon hadn't joined the Tarot Club.
Although The Sun was also very "hot-blooded," he didn't know much about Roselle's status and influence. He likely wouldn't do such a thing.
Seeing that he had fooled the four people present, Klein smiled and cast his gaze at Roselle's diary in front of him. He then continued reading.
'When members of the seven Churches advance in the Low- and Mid-Sequences, not only will they provide potion ingredients and the specific formulas, but they will also personally demonstrate the concoction process... And at the High-Sequences, they only provide finished potions?
This... High-Sequence Beyonders should directly give Beyonder characteristics, right? That's why they didn't inform me of the formula.'
"The industrial revolution and the Age of Steam and Machinery will become the hotbed for the descent of the evil gods? Why?"
Klein frowned slightly as he tapped the edge of the ancient table with his index finger.
