Did Mr. Fool encounter a difficult problem? Anything that can put him in a difficult position definitely involves a very high level... Audrey looked at the figure shrouded in gray fog and interpreted his current state through his body language.
While Klein was reading the diary, Ebner took the opportunity to read the last few pages of Baron Conva's diary.
That was something he didn't dare interpret in the real world.
"Aston is dead! Died! Killed by me! Right in front of me! No! That's not her! It's not her!"
He didn't even remember the date... Furthermore, he recorded it in a completely incoherent manner. It was like he was raving... To think that he could still remember to encrypt two levels in such a state...
After translating that sentence, Ebner frowned. This was because the chaos in the words had already reflected the baron's mental state. He was likely half-crazy by then.
"Haha! It's Aston's spirit! She really isn't dead! She really isn't dead! I sealed her in the 'door' in my body and made her my spirit! We will be together forever!
"22nd September. The decision to seal Aston in my body was indeed correct. My mind felt much better as a result. At the very least, I could calm down and think about certain things... For example, is there really nothing wrong with our condition? The results of my own inspection were that everything was normal... But if there really was nothing wrong, why would every servant who saw me suddenly disappear?"
When Ebner read this, he couldn't help but shudder. He couldn't help but have a few questions arise in his mind. Was the spirit sealed in the baron's body really Madam Aston? After he sealed the spirit, was the so-called "normal" that he had recovered really "normal?"
These questions lingered in his mind as he couldn't help but translate the rest of the content:
"I obtained a lot of knowledge from behind the ancient castle's door that can overturn my understanding of mysticism... This knowledge tells me that in order to resolve the problems in Aston and me, I need to use an item called Sefirah Castle... But that knowledge also tells me that Sefirah Castle doesn't belong to this era.
"Therefore, I decided to use the few Beyonder items in my hand to seal myself with the knowledge obtained from behind the ancient castle's door. I'll sleep until the era of Sefirah Castle before waking up.
"I have a strange plan. I won't miss that era."

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Ebner’s Guess
chapters.content:
Chapter 221 - Ebner's Guess
Sefirah Castle... What exactly happened to Baron Conva in the ancient castle?
I remember that the underground corruption stems from the Chaos Sea. It's a sefirah corresponding to the five pathways of omnipotence and omniscience...
Therefore, the baron was corrupted by the sefirah and obtained a lot of knowledge?
However, the mere indirect contact between Xio and Fors nearly caused him to die. How could Baron Conva not go completely mad after obtaining immense knowledge?
What's so special about him? Could it be that his ancestor who was sleeping in the Underworld helped him? Or did he encounter something special at the door of the ancient castle?
Apart from the ancient sun god and Amon, the only existence I know that stems from the Chaos Sea is Arrodes...
Could it be that Baron Conva met Arrodes's former self through that door?
I remember that the Licking Dog Mirror once told Klein that he only gained true consciousness after turning into a mirror on the ground. He had zero memories of what happened before.
What kind of state was his previous self in, and how did he leave the Chaos Sea? There was no mention of it at all... Then, could it be that the baron brought him out from behind the door?
Hmm... I'll have to find out when the Church of Steam obtained 2-111...
If the baron really is as I imagined, it would be understandable if he encountered Arrodes's former self through the underground door of the ancient castle. Then, the knowledge that he obtained includes Sefirah Castle...
Just as he thought of this, he saw Klein stop rapping the edge of the ancient table. He surveyed the members of the Tarot Club and said with a smile,
"The contents of this diary page has brought me some new ideas... Sorry for the wait."
Audrey thought of Mr. Fool's explanation of the three words and said with envy and anticipation,
"I can understand that. I look forward to the day when I can exchange information about how to read Emperor Roselle's diary."
"That will require a huge price." Klein smiled as he glanced at Justice. He then swept his gaze across The Hanged Man who remained silent and looked at the "tower" sitting at his seat of honor.
Mr. Tower doesn't seem to be in the right mood? He wasn't that nervous just now... Did he suddenly think of something?
Although he was a little curious, Klein didn't intend to probe the secrets of the Tarot Club members. Therefore, he leaned back more comfortably and said with a relaxed tone,
"You can speak freely now."
Alger immediately said,
"Mr. Fool, Mr. Tower, Miss Justice, I received a new piece of information. Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos infiltrated Backlund to complete a difficult mission. He might stay there for a long period of time and create an appalling tragedy. In addition, I know that this matter involves a very important item, an item that can help Qilangos quickly become a High-Sequence Beyonder."
"Quickly become a High-Sequence Beyonder? Isn't he afraid of losing control?" Audrey asked in puzzlement, taking on the role of a Spectator.
Qilangos was a Sequence 6 Wind-blessed, one Sequence away from Sequence 5.
Alger had long expected such a question as he answered frankly,
"That's why that item is extremely important."
With that said, he glanced at the seemingly distracted "Tower" and asked,
"Mr. Tower, what kind of item do you think it is?"
Upon hearing that, Ebner snapped out of his daze and looked at Alger in surprise. He didn't understand why this fellow was asking him this... According to what had happened, shouldn't he deliberately exaggerate the value of the item in an attempt to entice Mr. Fool's Blessed to take action?
At this moment, Ebner had already adjusted his state of mind. After all, the Baron possessed by 1-025 was still far from his daily life. No matter how serious the problem was, it should be MI9 or the Mandated Punishers who were having a headache.
However, even though he couldn't figure it out, he still answered Alger's question.
It's impossible for there to be items that can rapidly raise one's Sequence... Even if one strictly adheres to the "acting principles," it will still take quite some time to digest them. Furthermore, Sequence 5 and Sequence 4 advancements require a corresponding ritual...
"Some rituals have very strict requirements. They aren't that easy to complete... And forcefully drinking the potion will only lead to losing control!
"Therefore, I guess that the so-called item is either a Sealed Artifact that can allow him to match a demigod for a short period of time, or it can enhance Creeping Hunger and allow it to Graze a demigod-level beyonder."
After hearing Abner's analysis, The Hanged Man, Justice, and Mr. Fool nodded silently, finding it very reasonable... At the same time, thoughts began to form in their minds.
So it turns out that from Sequence 5 onwards, consuming potions requires a ritual?
So mystical items that have already taken form can also increase the effects of one's abilities?
So Shepherd can also Graze demigods?
As they were deep in thought, they heard Tower continue,
Of course, I can't rule out the possibility that the so-called rapid advancement was just Qilangos's own misunderstanding. The item promised by the mastermind might not have the ability to do so...
"Yes, I guess Qilangos might've heard of that item before, but he had never seen it before. That's why he misunderstood."
The first part of the analysis was just nonsense. Only the last part was true.
Ebner added silently inwardly.
"Therefore, regardless of the situation that Mr. Tower is guessing, it's a very important and very mystical item." At this moment, Alger emphasized his words in response to Ebner as he looked at The Fool who sat high in the thick gray fog.
Although he said it in a tactful manner, his meaning was very clear. Mr. Fool, are you not tempted by such a valuable item? Do your Blessed have no thoughts about it?
At that moment, Ebner came to a realization. Alger had deliberately asked me this question in order to use my authority in "erudite" to make the theory that "that item is very important" more convincing... As such, it might attract Mr. Fool's interest...
However, Alger clearly misjudged... After all, it's not that Mr. Fool isn't interested, but that he doesn't dare to be interested...
Klein obviously understood what The Hanged Man was trying to convey, but just as Ebner had thought, as an evil god in the entrepreneurial stage, the power didn't support his involvement in the matter. Furthermore, as a Nighthawk, he couldn't leave Tingen without permission...
As for the Blessed? The Trinity?
Klein inwardly gave a self-deprecating comment while feigning indifference.
"Got it."
Seeing that The Fool remained unfazed by the matter regarding Qilangos, Alger sighed and looked at Tower. The reason why he had taken the initiative to ask was not only to use his judgment to strengthen his persuasiveness but also to attract Mr. Tower's attention.
After all, the "Tower" was a powerhouse capable of pursuing the Demoness of Affliction! In fact, if the Tarot Club had mentioned that Ludwell hadn't been caught by the officials and that someone else had caught him, then perhaps Ludwell had also been taken down by him. If such a powerhouse became interested, Qilangos would probably have a hard time escaping.
However, "Tower" doesn't seem to have any interest at all... Could it be that he doesn't even lack demigod-level means?
As his thoughts raced, Alger reined in his disappointment and began discussing the results of his investigation with Miss Justice.
Audrey first gave a simple description of the "inference" that Abner had given Xio and Fors over the weekend. Then, with the attitude that she was doing something serious, she said,
"We need more information. What's most important is Qilangos's hobbies and habits."
Then, Alger recalled Qilangos's habits of liking fish, drinking liquor, finding women to relieve himself, using cold weapons, and going swimming every day. Clearly, he was very familiar with him.
Audrey memorized each and every one of them, forming the character named Qilangos in her mind.
Then, she smiles faintly and says, "I hope it will be a success. It's a pleasure working with you." Although I have some progress with my Rainbow Salamander's complete pituitary gland, I don't mind getting another set for Susie.
Seeing that The Hanged Man was done, Abner looked at The Sun Derrick, who was a few seats away from him and said with a smile, "I've already obtained a Sequence 6 defensive Beyonder item. You can go and make a deal with the seller of the Thousand Spells Phantom Crystal."
As Derrick was previously unable to understand the various nouns Alger mentioned, he was a little distracted. When he heard Mr. Tower's question, he was stunned for a moment before saying in surprise,
"That fast?"
According to his expectations, it would be pretty good if Mr. Tower could obtain similar items after two or three Tarot Gatherings. After all, the supply of defensive Beyonder items in the City of Silver had always exceeded the supply.
Klein and Alger were equally surprised. The former didn't expect that, apart from finding the formula and Roselle's diary, he had the means to obtain Beyonder items.
As for the latter, he was surprised at the efficiency of the "Tower" on the resources of the Forsaken Land of the Gods... He had yet to figure out how to exchange for benefits from The Sun, but the "Tower" was about to exchange for an important material.
Derrick quickly calmed down. After some thought, he felt that he had to figure out if the item met the seller's requirements. If he were to directly take it out and the seller wasn't satisfied, wouldn't he be breaking his promise to Mr. Tower?
As a youth who cared deeply about his reputation, Derrick deliberated and asked, "Mr. Tower, can you tell me what kind of item it is?"
"Sure." Ebner nodded slightly. Then, he conjured the image of the Wolf Armor and explained its abilities in detail.
Completely intimate, to the point of even outlining her body's curves? This leather armor is so embarrassing. If it were me, I definitely wouldn't want it... Audrey felt a little embarrassed after hearing this, but her Spectator powers allowed her to maintain her calm.
Alger nodded slightly, believing that it was a pretty good defensive item. If it wasn't for the fact that he couldn't refuse the materials from The Sun, he would've bought it himself.
As for Mr. Fool, all he felt was envy.
He also wanted something that could save his life.
Derrick felt the same longing.
In the past few days, he had tidied up the inheritance his parents had left him. Apart from the house, furniture, and a few items he used to reminisce about his parents, he had brought the rest of the valuable items to the "black market" in the City of Silver in exchange for the ingredients of the Bard potion and the opportunity to meet the seller. At present, he was only relying on food rationing.
However, he believed that this situation wouldn't last long. Once he passed the combat examination, he would join the team that cleared the Things of the Dark in the vicinity and receive a sizable reward.
When that happens, I can also buy similar items from Mr. Tower...
As Derrick thought with hidden hope, he turned his head to look at the knowledgeable Mr. Tower and said seriously,
"This' wolf armor 'matches the seller's requirements very well. After the gathering is over, I'll go get the crystallized Thousand Phantom."
"Alright, after the gathering ends, I'll request Mr. Fool to hand over the Wolf Armor to you." With regards to this, Ebner was very happy as well. After all, this way, he would have all the ingredients needed for the Polymath potion. He was just short of digesting the Knowledge Keeper potion and advancing to Sequence 6.

chapters.title: Chapter 222: The New Pirate Admiral
chapters.content:
Chapter 222 - The New Pirate Admiral
After closing the deal for the Thousand Spells Mirage Crystal, Ebner turned his gaze to Mr. Fool at the seat of honor. He hadn't forgotten the mission Mr. Fool had given him last week, as well as the request he had made. Hence, he said,
"Mr. Fool, the investigation of Baron Lamud will take a few days to complete... I wonder if your Blessed is satisfied with the information I previously provided?"
Although Miss Ema had agreed to go to the royal family's library to read the relevant information, she had to arrange the time according to her habits. Otherwise, it would be bad if she incurred the suspicion of others, especially when she had been investigated by MI9 before.
The "Tower" is very efficient. As expected of the famous" Hero Detective!" However, the reason he's mentioning this now is to ask my Blessed if he's willing to accept the commission of investigating the "Fallen Morning Star", right?
Klein sighed inwardly, but he was already prepared for the question about "Tower." He chuckled and replied in a normal tone,
"My Blessed is very satisfied with this, so he expressed his willingness to accept a commission to investigate the origins of the Fallen Morning Star... Yes, due to some of his uniqueness, you need to provide him with some compensation."
Klein tried his best to avoid saying terms like "gold pounds" and "money" from The Fool's mouth. He only used compensation as a substitute. He even deliberately emphasized the uniqueness of a Blessed, making the members of the Tarot Club focus on this and ignore the essence of his lack of money.
As for what exactly is "special"...The Blessed and the deity are the same person, and they're also very poor and weak... That's "special" enough, right?
As he lampooned inwardly, Klein carefully observed the Tarot Club members present. He discovered that Miss Justice and Mr. Hanged Man were indeed looking pensive. It was unknown what they were thinking about. The Sun didn't even think about it, as though he was daydreaming. Only Mr. Tower frowned as though he was thinking about something.
...
From the looks of it, Klein had divined the commission for the investigation of the Fallen Morning Star... It shouldn't be too dangerous; otherwise, he wouldn't have agreed so readily...
As for the reward... I'll pay a little of my blood. After all, when The Sun's Thousand Spells Mirage Crystal is sacrificed, I'll have to deposit it in Sefirah Castle... I'll just treat it as payment for safekeeping...
With this in mind, Ebner deliberated and said, "What do you think about a compensation of 200... No, 300 pounds?"
As the spoils of war that he had obtained from the Eternal Life Society's base were rather valuable, along with the 1,800 pounds that Mr. Hanged Man had spent on buying the formula last week, he was rather well-off and didn't lack the money. Therefore, he appeared rather generous.
300 pounds? Up to this day, I've only seen that much money from Sir Deweyville... Klein sighed and pretended to be uninterested in the money as he nodded.
"A reasonable deal."
He originally wanted to add on, "Although the compensation he receives isn't because of the money itself," to enhance his image, but on second thought, he felt that it was a little unnecessary. What if "Tower" also added, "In that case, just give me a penny as a symbol"...Wouldn't that just make it worse? Hence, he could only give up.
With that said, the Tarot Club naturally entered the stage of "sharing information." Alger thought for a moment and said,
"Admiral Hell Ludwell hasn't appeared again. His fleet has been subdued, and a new pirate admiral has been born."
Audrey was rather interested in the pirate admiral and asked,
"What's his name? There hasn't been any news about him in Backlund."
Alger nodded slowly and said,
"She's a lady named Mary. She wasn't famous in the past, and she's likely a powerhouse sent by the Numinous Episcopate to replace Ludwell.
"However, last week, she consecutively subdued Ludwell's original first mate, second mate, and third mate, revealing her strength at the pirate admiral level. She also brought a ghost ship, the Pale Saintess, that's comparable to the Black Tulip."
"Then what's her title?" Audrey asked curiously.
"She calls herself Admiral Pale... But because she has a terrifying sword-shaped mystical item known as Pale Justice, and her sword techniques are rather superb, many people call her the Saintess of Swords or Admiral of Swords," Alger answered directly.
Saintess of Swords? Ma'am, did you come to the wrong set...
Furthermore, Pale Justice? This should also be Emperor Roselle's work, right?
Both of them lampooned inwardly.
"However, this new pirate admiral offered a reward for Ludwell's whereabouts the moment he subdued the fleet... It's worth 10,000 pounds!" Alger added seemingly unintentionally.
Giving 10,000 pounds just by informing them of the location? From the looks of it, there's something important that Ludwell needs to be retrieved... Is it that Death ring?
However, did The Hanged Man specially mention it to see my reaction? He suspects that I killed Admiral Hell?
Ebner looked thoughtfully at Alger, but he made no comment.
Alger sighed in disappointment when he saw that Tower wasn't answering. He didn't say anything else.
Seeing that Mr. Hanged Man had finished sharing, Audrey also talked about the changes in Backlund over the past week. She mainly talked about the progress of the two Houses of Honor's investigation.
After she said that, she glanced at The Sun Derrick, who was sitting there in a daze. Her heart stirred as she asked,
"Mr. Sun, I wonder if you can share the situation of the City of Silver and the Forsaken Land of the Gods? I can pay for it. What do you need?"
Derrick was taken aback at first before he said incoherently,
"I haven't had anything I desperately need recently... I should be able to digest the Bard potion soon. I can accumulate my compensation there. Yes... But actually, I don't know what's important to you, so I don't know what to say."
Audrey acutely noticed the word "digest." She deliberated and asked,
"Mr. Sun, you grasp the 'acting method'?"
Derrick looked at Miss Justice in confusion and answered frankly,
"This isn't something strange... The general knowledge class in the City of Silver teaches the 'acting method.'"
The 'acting method' is taught in general education classes... Audrey glanced at The Hanged Man and realized that he was also looking at her. Both of them suddenly fell silent.
So it turns out that only the two of them didn't know of this method.
At this moment, Alger seemed to think of something as he probed, "Mr. Sun, have you mentioned anything about taking note of the 'acting method'?"
"Yes." Derrick nodded without hesitation. "Our general knowledge class clearly stated that there is only one key point for the 'acting method.' 'Remember, you're only acting.'"
Just as I expected... We're using an ingenious method to bypass the obstruction and completely disintegrate the remnant mental influence of the potion, and not submit to it... Sun, you really are a naive youth. You managed to trick me into giving you important information just like that...
Klein resisted the urge to facepalm as he thought to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Jane’s Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 223 - Jane's Decision
"Just as Mr. Tower guessed at the last gathering, our City of Silver's former self, the Kingdom of Silver, was once ruled by the Giant King's Court. Therefore, the Beyonder chain we grasp is the Giant pathway. We also call it the Divine Blood Warrior pathway... We have the complete 9 to 4 potion formulas of this pathway, and three of the six-member council are Sequence 4 Demon Hunters of this pathway.
"Also, when we killed certain monsters and explored those destroyed cities, we obtained some potion formulas of other Sequences. However, the chains weren't complete and were more or less incomplete.
"For example, I mentioned Elder Lovia last time. The Shepherd she was in was a Sequence pathway found in those destroyed cities, but it only reached Sequence 5."
"In addition, as you know, giants and dragons are archenemies. Therefore, the City of Silver also has the Dragon Sequence 9, 8, and 7."
...
Due to the previous Tarot Gatherings where everyone was discussing the potion formula the most, Derrick, who didn't know what to say, gave a simple introduction of the City of Silver's formulas. He felt that this was what Miss Justice wanted to hear.
Furthermore, from the conversation I heard, I can tell that the lady opposite me is a Beyonder of the Dragon pathway... Derrick glanced at Miss Justice and thought silently.
"Dragon pathway?" Audrey asked in puzzlement.
"Telepathist is the Dragon pathway's Sequence 8. Behind it is Psyche Analyst." Seeing Miss Justice puzzled, Derrick thought that the way they addressed each other might be different, so he explained slightly.
So the Spectator Sequence originated from the dragons... Audrey was enlightened.
Just as she was about to ask about the other situations in the Forsaken Land of the Gods, she heard Mr. Fool, who was sitting at the seat of honor, rap his fingers on the edge of the ancient bronze table.
With regard to this, Audrey could only restrain her curiosity and look at the mysterious figure shrouded in gray fog.
Seeing everyone look over, Mr. Fool smiled and said,
"Let's end it here for today."
As the City of Silver was very unfamiliar with Justice and company in every aspect, it might take a very long time for The Sun to describe it again. Worried that he lacked spirituality, Klein had no choice but to forcefully end the gathering.
It was better to end it now than to be forced to end it midway through The Sun's story. Furthermore, he still needed to leave enough spirituality to activate the Door of Summoning.
"By your will." Upon hearing that, the three of them stood up in unison.
After severing the connection with the four members, Klein waited above the gray fog for a while. Then, he saw two Beyonder items and a neat stack of bills being sacrificed.
He didn't care about the suitcase with the wolf armor and the jewelry box containing the Fallen Morning Star Necklace. Instead, he held the gold pound that belonged to him and used the opportunity to verify its authenticity. Then, he nodded in satisfaction and cast his gaze on the other two items.
Using divination, he confirmed the negative effects and powers of the Wolf Armor. After confirming that it wasn't too different from Mr. Tower's description, he used his spirituality to trigger the Sun star and threw the suitcase containing the Wolf Armor along the quickly opened Door of Summoning.
Then, Klein picked up the jewelry box containing the Morning Star of Depravity and opened it. The necklace with five beautiful gems of different colors appeared in front of him.
The real thing looks even better than the display... According to Mr. Tower, these gems are actually scales of some kind of dragon? That dragon must be very rich...
Klein played with the necklace for a while, but he didn't immediately divine its origins.
Although he had learned through spirit dowsing that the root of the necklace wasn't too dangerous, he still decided to "court death" after his spirituality was completely restored.
With this in mind, Klein put down his necklace and quickly plummeted into the gray fog, leaving the mysterious space.
...
After sacrificing the gold pounds and two Beyonder items to the gray fog, Ebner tidied up the altar, but he was in no hurry to remove the wall of spirituality.
The last part of BaronConva's diary that he translated above the gray fog left him a little uneasy. After activating the White Eye, he even had a vague feeling that he might have some interactions with him. If he didn't make sufficient preparations, it would be difficult for him to escape unscathed even if he had The Fool backing him.
After some serious thought, Ebner decided to first write a letter to Jane and ask her what exactly had happened to her ancestor's tomb. Since the baron was also a descendant of that existence who slumbered in the depths of the Underworld, there was no harm in knowing more.
After writing the letter, Ebner took out the copper whistle that Jane had previously delivered, brought it to his mouth, and blew hard.
A huge, terrifying, illusory skeleton messenger quickly appeared, still standing on the floor of the bedroom, completely unfazed by the fact that its head had drilled into the ceiling.
Ebner had no choice but to raise his head again and throw the envelope at the messenger.
After the summoning ended, Ebner played with the copper whistle and muttered to himself,
"I wonder if Jane will tell me..." It was her secret after all.
After that, he removed the spirituality seal, changed his clothes, and stopped a rental carriage.
After giving the carriage driver one soli, the carriage drove him to Rose Street south of the Bridge.
...
On the Future which was slowly cruising through the waters of the Rorsted Archipelago.
Jane, who had long hair, was sitting in a dark cabin with a black hood. In front of her was an item with the words "crystal ball," "mirror," "tarot card," and opposite the table was a rather boorish-looking pirate, but he had already fallen asleep.
After a while, the pirate slowly woke up with a confused expression.
"Your problem has been resolved, Heath. Remember to stay away from Frank's laboratory when you're drunk... If it wasn't for the fact that he didn't use a more troublesome Spirit Body for the suturing experiments that day, you probably would've had to ask Captain for help to lessen the pain of your death," Jane said in an ethereal voice.
"Thank you, Madam Lydia," the pirate named Tess returned to his senses and said with a look of gratitude. He found the pain from before terrifying just thinking about it.
After the pirate man retreated, Jane pulled down her hood. Just as she was about to do her research, she suddenly had a thought. She looked at the deck in front of her where bones were already spewing out like a fountain. A huge messenger nearly four meters tall quickly took form.
When the messenger saw Jane, it knelt respectfully and bowed its head, handing a letter to her with both hands.
Seeing the letter, Jane's mood immediately brightened, but after reading the contents, she frowned deeply and said to herself,
"Did he encounter some trouble? Otherwise, he wouldn't have written to ask about this..."
With this in mind, Jane hurriedly wrote a reply and handed it to the messenger to bring back to Abner. Then, she left the cabin and walked down the corridor and down the stairs to the captain's cabin at the highest level.
After knocking on the door and receiving permission, Jane walked in and saw a black-haired lady in a classic robe. She was none other than Admiral of Stars Cattleya.
"Jane, ever since you opened the spirit channeling room on the ship, the mess caused by those worrying fellows hasn't been reported to me for a long time... It's been hard on you."
Cattleya first let out a poignant sigh before using her eyes that had a hint of mystery to carefully size up Jane. She asked in puzzlement, "Why are you looking for me at this time?"
"Captain, I'd like to return to Backlund in the near future. I have some things to take care of... Well, it won't take long. I'll be back soon, even if it's my vacation for this month... What do you think?" Jane asked, deliberating over her words.
"Do you need help?" Cattleya asked after a moment of silence.
"I don't know yet... If I really need it, I'll ask you for help," Jane replied after some thought.
"In three days, the Future will dock in the waters about 200 kilometers south of Pritz Harbor, Quela. It will set sail on Sunday night at the same time. During this period, you can move freely." Cattleya nodded slightly and didn't ask why as she said it directly.
"Thank you, Captain."
...
Backlund, South of the Bridge, Harvest Church.
After the sermon, in the eyes of ordinary people, Bishop Utravsky, who was already half the height of a giant, put down the Holy Bible in his hand, looked around at the people in the prayer hall who were gradually leaving, and said in relief,
"Finally, a believer is willing to listen to the teachings of the benevolent mother."
Then, he turned to Miss Hazel who was wiping the candle stand, and said with a smile,
"It's all thanks to you."
"No, Father, your efforts have moved them." Hazel didn't stop what she was doing, but her tone was rather serious.
Although her father had introduced some people who were willing to listen to the teachings of the Mother Goddess, they wouldn't have really changed faiths if they hadn't felt Bishop Utravsky's charm.
Seeing that the believers had left, Bishop Utravsky looked down at the busy lady and chuckled.
"Your good nature is also an important factor that moved them... I know that you had privately helped them resolve some problems."
Upon hearing that, Miss Hazel immediately panicked. She didn't even dare to look up at the priest as she stammered, "I... I just never knew... I didn't know that there would be such shameless relatives... That's why I helped Lady Norma..."
"There's no need to be nervous, child. A friendly 'theft' doesn't violate the teachings of Earth Mother, not to mention that those things don't belong to that family, to begin with... And the appropriate 'acting' does help your mental state," Bishop Utravsky said kindly.
Hazel was just about to say something when she suddenly heard a creak at the door. Turning her head, she saw Detective Bryan, who she had mixed feelings about, push open the door and enter.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Divining "Fallen Morning Star"
chapters.content:
Chapter 224 - Divining "Fallen Morning Star"
"Father, good evening.
"Good evening, Miss Hazel."
When Ebner walked into the Harvest Church, he greeted Miss Hazel and the half-giant bishop who was standing near the preaching platform.
"Good evening, Detective Bryan... However, you should call me Priest Macht at the cathedral," Miss Hazel corrected him after returning the greeting.
After exchanging some pleasantries, Bishop Utravsky looked at Ebner benevolently and asked gently,
"Child, why did you come to the Harvest Church?"
Eh? Why didn't you say "I know the purpose of your visit" as usual today? Could it be that Earth Mother doesn't care about 1-025 at all? Or has "She" finally recalled something important and stopped paying attention to a puny transmigrator like me?
As his thoughts raced, he said with a smile, "I have something to ask you."
"What is it? Please speak," Bishop Utravsky said with a smile.
Ebner subconsciously glanced at Hazel, who immediately understood. She pursed her lips in displeasure, but she said tactfully,
"Father, I'll be copying the teachings of Earth Mother."
"Alright, child." Bishop Utravsky nodded with a smile. After Hazel left, he sealed the surroundings with his spirituality and said to Ebner, "You can speak."
"Do you know of the abandoned castle in the middle of Delaire Forest?" Ebner asked probingly after some thought.
Upon hearing this, Bishop Utravsky nodded and shook his head. With a solemn expression, he said, "I've read some records about that ancient castle... But within the Church, I'm not allowed to know too much about it.
According to the information I read, only that ancient castle was built in the Fourth Epoch. It was once guarded by an elite knight squad while the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire was in power... Unfortunately, ever since the War of the Four Emperors began, that ancient castle has been abandoned.
"Before I was sent to Backlund to be a bishop, the archbishop of the Holy Cathedral personally instructed me not to go near it."
The reason why the bishop wasn't allowed to know the secrets of the castle was because he would be corrupted if he did?
In that case, there are people who are permitted to know about the Church of Earth Mother? Hmm... There's a high chance that only members of the Mother and Moon pathway are permitted. Although I've forgotten why I vaguely feel that the Beyonders of these two pathways aren't too afraid of the underground corruption...
Perhaps I should write to Cullen and ask him?
This thought flashed through Ebner's mind, but he immediately rejected it. This was because it was impossible for Cullen to write such knowledge on a letter and get Silika to bring it over.
But I don't have any ties with the local Sanguine...
I can get to know Emlyn ahead of time, but he probably doesn't know as much as I do... Besides, before joining the Tarot Club, this future Mr. Moon wasn't important to the Sanguine. There was no way he could obtain any useful information.
Just as he thought of this, his spirituality was suddenly stirred. He hurriedly activated his Spirit Vision and saw the nearly four-meter-tall messenger take form. It lowered its head and looked at him with its eye sockets burning with pitch-black flames. It then placed a letter on a chair in the prayer hall.
Then, he disappeared.
Ebner picked up the letter and opened it to read. Then, a look of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Jane said that she would be returning to Backlund in the near future... Was this arranged by her, or did she only decide to return after receiving my letter?
"Could it be that her ancestor's mausoleum really has some secret that can't be said in the letter?"
After silently muttering to himself, Ebner put away the letter and bade Bishop Utravsky farewell.
Apart from asking Bishop Utravsky for information, he came to the Harvest Church mainly to use this Blessed to tell Earth Mother about the possibility of him suffering "underground corruption," so as to probe the attitude of this deity who had been paying attention to him.
Since he had already achieved his goal, there was no reason for him to stay.
But just as he walked out of the Harvest Church's door, he heard an ethereal, real, and feminine voice:
"Solomon's gold coin."
This is... Earth Mother giving me a hint? A thought flashed through his mind as he suddenly turned around, only to realize that there was no one in the cathedral other than the half-giant bishop and Hazel.
He frowned and stood at the door of the cathedral, habitually analyzing.
Solomon's gold coin? Is Earth Mother trying to tell me that if I were to encounter 1-025, I would be able to turn the misfortune into a blessing?
But the snake from before had warned me not to abuse that gold coin, especially after I left Backlund...
Wait, little snake... Does Earth Mother mean that I should ask "Her"?
Yes, this is an idea. I can give it a try.
At this thought, Ebner's brows gradually relaxed.
At this moment, Miss Hazel saw Ebner standing at the door. She hesitated for a moment before finally stomping her feet and walking over.
Seeing the lady walk towards him, Ebner snapped back to his senses and asked in surprise, "Is there something, Miss Priest?"
"Are you satisfied with the person I recommended the last time?" Hazel asked after some deliberation.
"Yes, that information is very useful to me." Ebner nodded and acknowledged the man's help. After all, he wouldn't have gone to the Backlund University Library without him, and he wouldn't have easily gotten to know the two ladies, Ema and Fani, on his subsequent expeditions.
"As long as it's useful... Then, can I ask you for a favor?" Miss Hazel asked with a perturbed tone.
"What is it?"
"Do you know where there are safer Beyonder gatherings? Can you take me there? I need to buy some materials."
...
Above the gray fog, Klein, who had already recovered his spirituality, took a deep breath and wrote a divination statement:
"Its origins."
Right on the heels of that, he held the Morning Star of Depravity necklace to prevent the pronoun "it" from pointing to an error.
Leaning back in his chair, Klein recited the divination statement and gradually fell asleep.
In the gray, illusory world, he saw a laboratory with many steampunk-styled facilities.
There were iron hammers driven by steam, boilers that kept emitting white smoke, and various mechanical arms.
In the center was a power well that seemed to be a laboratory. The gas lamps inside were abnormally bright.
A man in a white shirt and black trousers was sitting on a luxurious sofa in the laboratory. His eyes were filled with curiosity as he looked at the five gems of different colors.
The man had long chestnut-colored curly hair, blue eyes, a high nose bridge, thin lips, and a beautifully manicured mustache.
He seemed to be sizing up the five gems as he spoke to his side.
But strangely, there was only a test bench beside him. There was no sign of anyone or anything.
Right on the heels of that, with the help of the mechanical arm, the man made the five gems and many expensive spiritual materials into a beautiful necklace.
After the dream ended, Klein opened his eyes and said in surprise,
"Roselle?"

chapters.title: Chapter 225: The Results of the Divination
chapters.content:
Chapter 225 - The Results of the Divination
"Roselle?"
Klein was filled with surprise. It wasn't that he hadn't tried to divine about this fellow countryman of his, but it wasn't that he couldn't receive any revelations due to the lack of prerequisites, or that he had been interfered with, preventing him from achieving the desired effect.
He had never seen him so clearly before!
I never expected to see Roselle when I was divining the Fallen Morning Star ...
So this necklace was made by him. It's no wonder Mr. Tower felt that its origins weren't simple...
However, in the divination scene just now, the Emperor seemed to be talking to some invisible existence...
I can't see... What does it represent? Hmm... It should be some unknown existence to me.
"It's because I've never known such an 'unknown,' so the result of divination doesn't have any revelations or symbols..."
After a few minutes of consideration, Klein conjured another goatskin and wrote a new divination statement:
"The origins of the gems on this necklace."
After reciting the divination statement seven times, Klein held the goatskin and held the Morning Star necklace before leaning back in his chair.
Since he had accepted Mr. Tower's money, he had to figure out the origins of the necklace.
In seconds, Klein's eyes turned from brown to black as he entered a Cogitation state.
His eyelids drooped down as he "saw" the illusory and blurry dream.
In the gray and shattered world, a dragon suddenly appeared!
The dragon was dozens of meters long, and the scales on its body were made up of five-colored gems. Overall, it looked less ferocious than the lizards that Klein knew. It was more beautiful.
However, it wasn't in a good state. Its huge body was constantly rolling on the ground, and its face was extremely distorted. Even Klein could tell what it was afraid of.
"Ariehogg!" The gem dragon finally fell silent after shouting that name. Then, the gem scales on its body peeled off and disappeared.
Following that, the scene changed. On a hazy land, there was a huge stone pillar that was tens of meters tall. And above it was a tall dragon.
The dragon crouched at the top of the stone pillar like a tiny mountain. Its body was covered in huge grayish-white stone scales, and its eyes were pale gold and vertical.
With a whoosh, the two wings of the mind dragon spread open, almost covering the entire sky.
Following that, scales that looked like gems fell under its wings.
At this point, the scene shattered as Klein opened his eyes.
So that gem dragon was hunted by another dragon... And from the hazy scene at the back, it seems like a dream... So that's a mind dragon?
However, what does the gem dragon mean by "Ariehogg" before it died? Is it its own name, or the name of the dragon that killed it? Or does it mean something else? Sigh, that seems to be Dragonese. Unfortunately, I haven't learned it...
Klein couldn't help but sigh as he placed the Morning Star necklace back into the junk pile.
Yes, ever since he became a Clown and could bring items into the gray fog without expending any energy, a corner of the ancient palace had formed a junk pile.
Right now, there was a suitcase containing the Tree of Elders' core, the Telepathist formula he sold, as well as a stack of gold pounds he received from accepting the request. There was also some spare clothes and spiritual materials that hadn't been expended from the recent "sacrifice."
Now, there was another necklace of Beyonders.
Klein didn't plan on returning the Fallen Morning Star to the "tower" that quickly. After all, he had previously mentioned that his Blessed had been entrusted to investigate its origins. It was impossible for him to be that efficient.
Furthermore, the results were obtained in less than a day. Mr. Tower might have some doubts about it... After all, the more difficult it was, the more precious it was!
Therefore, it was more reasonable to return it to Mr. Tower in a week or two and inform him of the divination result.
Besides, I've also made progress in my investigation of the house with the red chimney. If I were to really meet the mastermind behind Mr. Azik's interference in my fate, this item might be of some help... Although it doesn't have any offensive means, it has all sorts of supportive abilities and recovery abilities.
As for the offensive means... I still have to create Flaring Sun Charms as soon as possible. Its power might even exceed that of Sequence 7 or 6...
Yes, tomorrow... I should be able to receive the report of Mr. Azik's paranormal activity tomorrow!
With this in mind, the expectant Klein prepared to leave the world above the gray fog. But at that moment, the illusory star that symbolized The Sun began to expand and contract. Derrick was requesting a sacrificial ritual.
The Sun has exchanged for the ingredients Mr. Tower needs? That was quick!
...
Backlund, at the entrance of the Harvest Church on Rose Street.
Looking at the perturbed young lady who was making a request, he asked thoughtfully,
"Are you going to buy the potion ingredients of Swindler?"
Hazel heaved a sigh of relief when she saw that he didn't directly reject her offer. She didn't harp on the topic as she nodded and said, "I've already digested the Marauder potion. I naturally have to seek to advance to Sequence 8."
"From the looks of it, you haven't given up on the path to becoming a Beyonder..." Ebner said after glancing at Hazel.
From the looks of it, this lady wasn't frightened by the horror of the Beyonder incident. She's a lot more determined than in her original book... Is it because the Primordial Moon didn't hurt her family?
Or was he influenced by Bishop Utravsky and learned some of the qualities of his body?
Despite looking weak, the rather stubborn Hazel didn't hesitate to say, "Of course, although I'm ashamed and frustrated over my ignorance, I don't wish to give up on this path... Besides, the more I know, the more I can sense the danger of this world...
"Only by becoming powerful... as powerful as you, Detective Bryan, can I protect my parents and my family."
Me? Powerful? Heh heh, I'm only a weak chicken, okay! If you suddenly put on a monocle one day, you can instantly squash me to death...
In that case, go to the Bravehearts Bar on Iron Gate Street at seven on Friday night and find Kaspars. Say that it was introduced by Ebner. He will take you to the Beyonder gathering.
Hazel hesitated for a moment when she heard that. Finally, she said in embarrassment, "Detective Bryan, can you... Can you pick me up here on Friday night? I... I don't know the way..."
I'm only familiar with North Borough and Empress Borough in Backlund. Even the area south of the Bridge only knows Rose Street.
And participating in Beyonder gatherings is a secret from my family. I can't order my carriage driver around.
Although Ebner was surprised by this request, he didn't find it troublesome. He nodded and agreed.
"Alright."
...
After returning to the villa on Kingst Street in Cherwood Borough, Ebner was just about to ask Mr. Skade about Will Auceptin's address when he saw the gentleman walk over and report,
"Detective Bryan, a guest came after you left."
"Oh? Is he the client? Has he left?" Abner didn't take it to heart. After all, he was a famous detective, so it was normal for someone to come to him for a job.
"He calls himself Irvin Binkley, a neighbor of yours from the neighborhood where you used to live," Mr. Skade answered meticulously.
Through this period of time, he was becoming more like a qualified butler.
Irvin Bengley? He should be the son of the coffee shop's owner, Mrs. Bengley, right? I remember that the lady had entrusted me with investigating Miss Ailin...
What was he looking for?
With this in mind, Abner asked.
But Mr. Skade shook his head and replied, "I'm sorry, Detective Bryan. He didn't say... but he said he would come again tomorrow afternoon."
"Got it." Ebner nodded slightly and left the matter at that. He then asked for Will Auceptin's address.
"It's 66 Dalton Street in North Borough," Mr. Skade answered after a moment's hesitation. Although he was puzzled by the question, he didn't ask anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Meeting and Date
chapters.content:
Chapter 226 - Meeting and Date
"66 Dalton Street in North Borough." Ebner nodded slightly. In fact, he knew the address. Back when Dr. R Aaron was plagued by bad luck, he had once brought Klein there to find Will Auceptin. Unfortunately, they were late, and the snake had already rebooted.
The reason why he asked Mr. Skade was only to confirm it again. After all, the butterfly effect he had created was already quite significant, so it was normal for any changes to happen.
After returning to his room, just as he was about to take out the Book of Dead to study it carefully, his vision suddenly blurred. He saw an endless grayish-white fog.
Then, he saw Derrick praying for a sacrifice in a simple room. On the altar was a green hexagonal crystal the size of a goose egg.
Crystal of a Thousand Spell Illusion? The Sun has already been exchanged? Great, now all the ingredients for a Polymath will be gathered!
However, I advanced to Knowledge Keeper less than two months ago. I haven't finished digesting the potion yet...
With this in mind, Ebner decisively followed his plan and bowed his head in prayer.
"Honorable Mr. Fool, I hope that the crystallized Thousand Spells will temporarily stay in your kingdom. For this, I'm willing to pay two pages of Roselle's diary to hand it to you at the Tarot Gathering next week."
Since Miss Fane said that she could get Roselle's manuscript from Ema, she should be able to hand it to me within the week...
But even if she didn't get it, it didn't matter. At most, she could fake another two pages.
Two to three seconds later, he heard a deep and majestic voice:
"Sure."
"Thank you very sincerely, Mr. Fool." The corners of Ebner's mouth curled up as he tapped his chest a few times. After all, he didn't know what the gesture corresponded to Mr. Fool. He couldn't just draw the crimson moon.
...
Tuesday morning. After eating breakfast, Ebner wore his Clown mask and took the subway to North Borough.
As it was very likely that the Auceptin family would be investigated by the Nighthawks in the future, he didn't use his true appearance.
Speaking of which, ever since the Clown mask could be used to reconstruct a face, Ebner had given himself the face of Iron Man Tony from his previous life. Of course, due to his lack of "skill," he was only eighty to ninety percent similar.
When they arrived at the villa at 66 Dalton Street, Ebner didn't choose to pull the doorbell. Instead, he entered the house by mimicking "invisibility" and "opening the door."
Strangely, he searched the entire villa, but he didn't see the wheelchair-bound figure.
Will isn't here? "He" doesn't want to see me? Ebner frowned and walked to the door of the house. He "extracted" His "aura and used" Scene Retrack. "
Scenes flashed past, and Ebner quickly found what he wanted to know.
He saw a maid in a black and white dress pushing a wheelchair out of the activity room. On the wheelchair was a little boy who wasn't even ten years old.
"Young Master, you will be admitted into the hospital from today onwards... Y-you have to take good care of yourself." The maidservant began to sob as she spoke.
"Don't cry, Sarah. Draw a card." The child didn't look depressed at all. Instead, he smiled and comforted her. Then, he skillfully shuffled the cards and cut them before handing them to the maid.
The maidservant pursed her lips and obediently took out one of them.
"What about the proper Wheel of Fortune? From the looks of it, you'll be able to seize the opportunity to get a new job, and your new employer will treat you very well," the boy said with a smile.
With that said, the little boy suddenly looked in the direction of the door, then he said in a suggestive manner, "This proper Wheel of Fortune is enough. There's no need to visit me at the hospital."
"What?" the maid asked blankly.
"Nothing. I'm just bidding farewell to my future friends," the little boy said with a smile.
...
At this point in "retroactively," Ebner was certain that Will's last few words were directed at him. "He" must've seen me retroactively coming from Fate, so "He" added a few more sentences.
This time was likely the last moment before Will's "Reboot." It was most likely during the most intense battle between "Him" and Ouroboros in a domain he didn't know about...
Therefore, "He" doesn't wish for me to meet "Him" at this time?
Sigh, the battle between the Snakes of Mercury isn't something I can intervene in now, so it's better to listen to advice...
Sighing silently, Ebner focused his attention on the Wheel of Fortune.
The actual Wheel of Fortune symbolizes good luck, the arrival of a good opportunity, being neither rich nor noble, being good at improvisation, having a chance of being promoted, being fated to meet, love at first sight, happiness in marriage...
This sounds good, but is my chances of getting a promotion referring to my reputation as a Hero Detective getting even better?
And the destined meeting... Is it referring to my destined encounter with 1-025?
That's considered good luck?
Ebner secretly lampooned, even though he knew that his guess was actually unreliable.
...
Meanwhile, in the Backlund hospital, a tall, thin, and cold doctor wearing gold-rimmed glasses was patrolling the ward.
He was the famous surgeon, Aaron Ceres.
Aaron walked into a single ward and saw the little boy playing tarot cards on the bed. His cold expression gradually softened.
He walked forward and forced a smile. "Will, how are you feeling today?"
The child named Will looked up at him and suddenly sighed. "Doctor, I'm really not nervous about the operation."
Aaron looked at the awkward child and secretly shook his head. He then said, "It's boring playing tarot cards alone. Take me along."
Will stopped what he was doing and looked at the doctor. "Are you sure?"
Seeing Dr. Aaron nod, Will spread out the tarot cards in his hand and said, "Draw one."
To relax Will, Dr. Aaron cooperatively flipped a card.
"It's the inverted Wheel of Fortune."
Will looked at him and said with a pure and innocent smile,
"Doctor, your luck will get worse."
...
It was already one in the afternoon by the time Ebner returned to his gardened villa on Kingst Street in Cherwood Borough. In consideration of the possibility of the arrival of Mr. Irvin Binkley in the afternoon, he didn't leave the house again. Instead, he focused on studying the Book of Dead, hoping to find some clues.
Although he had Earth Mother's hint and the Snake of Mercury giving him "good luck," he didn't feel that he could "win" by himself... Furthermore, the bestowment of fate had always been in place. There was no harm in making more preparations and relying less on others.
However, the afternoon passed, and Mr. Binkley didn't visit again. It was unknown if he had been delayed or if the problem had been resolved.
However, he didn't take it to heart because he had more important things to do.
In the afternoon, Miss Fani sent someone to invite him to an Intis-styled restaurant for dinner.
Ebner knew that the other party had likely obtained Roselle's manuscript, so he gladly went.
...
At seven in the evening, at the Siena Restaurant in Hillston Borough.
Ebner took a sip of the white wine that was said to come from Intis but was actually produced from Masin in the analysis of the White Eye. He smiled at Miss Fani and said,
"Thank you for your hospitality. Why did you ask me to come out?"
"Can't I ask you out for a meal if there's nothing else?" Fani teased at first. Then, she took out five sheets of paper with words imprinted on them from her purse and handed them to Ebner. "These are Roselle's manuscripts you wanted. Before, Emma only collected this much because she was momentarily interested."
Ebner took the manuscript, but he didn't read it immediately. After all, he didn't want to expose the fact that he could read such words.
"By the way, Emma will be going to the royal library tomorrow morning to read the documents. She should be able to find the information you need when the time comes... So, she has arranged to meet you at the Backlund University Library tomorrow night," Fani added.
"At night? Backlund University Library?" Ebner subconsciously repeated. He was fine with that, but...
Why do all the ladies I know enjoy discussing matters in the middle of the night?

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Various Parties
chapters.content:
Chapter 227 - Various Parties
East Borough, in a terrace house in a narrow alley.
The gang leader, Darkholme, who controlled many beggars and thieves, was throwing darts at a target on the wall in boredom as he waited for his servant to serve dinner.
The door creaked open.
Darkholme looked in the direction of the sound, and just as he was about to reprimand his servant for being too slow and causing him to starve, he realized that the person who had walked in from the bedroom's door wasn't his beautiful maid, but an unfamiliar man with a unique wide chin and dark green eyes.
"Who are you?" Darkholme asked, about to take out his revolver from his holster.
But before he could finish his actions, he suddenly felt an unimaginable pressure. He felt as if an electric current was running through his mind, forming a barbed whip that constantly lashed at his soul.
This "feel" was painful and numbing, as though it came from deep within the brain, making it impossible to resist. All he could do was tremble as his knees buckled.
Therefore, Darkholme immediately knelt down.
At that moment, he felt that facing this man was like facing the increasingly powerful Arbiter, Xio Derecha...
No, he's much more terrifying than Xio! At the very least, Xio wouldn't kill anyone. As for the person in front of me... I have a nagging feeling that he's going to eat me up...
As his thoughts raced, the gang leader, who always had an amiable smile on his chubby face, immediately lowered his eyes and said in a sycophant manner, "Lord, is there anything you need of me? Just instruct me."
In the dark environment, the man aimed the black, digestive glove on his left hand at Darkholme and slowly asked,
"Who got you to investigate the missing tramp?"
Darkholme heaved a sigh of relief and replied without hesitation,
"It's a bounty hunter named Arbiter, Xio Derecha."
"Bounty hunter? Why would a bounty hunter care about a tramp from East Borough?" The man snorted and walked towards Darkholme. The feeling of being beaten in the soul descended once again.
"I don't know... She gave me 10 pounds for the investigation fee... I was just doing something with the money..." Darkholme didn't dare to lie, and he quickly revealed all the missions Xio had assigned him.
The man fell silent for a moment before pressing with a hoarse voice,
"Tell me in detail about the bounty hunter and her residence."
Darkholme had no intention of hiding the truth for Xio. He answered honestly,
Xio Derecha is a very famous Arbiter in East Borough, the dock area, and the factory district. She's trusted by everyone from the poor to the factory owners. Even when many gangs have disputes, they would hire her to be Arbiter...
In addition, she has a close relationship with Backlund's Hero Detective, Ebner Bryan. They often have breakfast together...
"Also, there are rumors that she has already become an official secret agent... But this is just gossip, and I can't guarantee that it's true. As for where she lives... I really don't know... Perhaps she's living with that Hero Detective?"
"Hero Detective... Secret Agent? Is it MI9?" the man muttered to himself. Then, with his black-gloved left hand, he patted Dwayholme's body and said emotionlessly, "Very good, very honest."
Darkholme heaved a sigh of relief, believing that he had just been saved by being sensible.
At least he managed to survive this time.
But at that moment, he suddenly saw the man spread open the fingers of his left glove. A mouth had opened up in the middle!
Darkholme's thoughts froze, and his body instantly turned into a lump of flesh as he threw himself into the mouth.
After a while, the maid who had fallen asleep for some baffling reason served the newly heated dinner in fear.
She thought she would be severely punished, but when she pushed open the door, she didn't see the owner. There was only a pile of clothes scattered on the floor.
...
Tingen City.
At half past seven in the evening, Klein, who had successfully borrowed the Mutated Sun Sacred Emblem and made two Flaring Sun Charms, finally arrived at Zouteland Street and handed over Sealed Artifact 3-0782.
After confirming that the Captain didn't notice anything unusual, Klein left the Blackthorn Security Company in a good mood and returned home before eight.
He took out his keys and opened the door to see an unfamiliar figure.
It was obviously a young girl who wasn't even in her twenties. She was wearing an old gray dress and was wiping the dining hall with all her might.
She had black hair and brown eyes. Her eyes were small, her nose wasn't sharp enough, and her facial features were very ordinary.
Who is it? Klein was taken aback at first before he realized that she might be a maidservant who was here to try out her chores.
At this moment, Benson lowered his newspaper and looked at his brother. He said with a smile,
"A company that doesn't allow employees to leave work on time is annoying."
"But the salary it pays will heal this injury," Klein replied with a smile.
After receiving the 300 pounds that Mr. Tower had sacrificed, Klein felt a lot more confident. He leaned his cane, took off his top hat, and walked to the living room. Then, he looked around and asked curiously,
"Where's Melissa?"
"She has a gathering tonight. Just now, Miss Elizabeth and Miss Selena sent someone to pick her up... Don't worry, I've already confirmed that it's fine. Besides, she won't be back too late. You have to leave some space for your sister to socialize," Benson replied with a chuckle.
Is it a girls' gathering... Klein nodded slightly, but he was still a little worried. Hence, he took off the silver chain inside his left sleeve as an excuse to head to the bathroom. He let the topaz pendant hang steadily and silently.
"Melissa is currently in danger."
...
After seven times, he opened his half-closed eyes and saw the topaz pendant spinning counterclockwise.
There's no danger... Klein immediately heaved a sigh of relief.
Following that, he removed the wall of spirituality and walked out of the bathroom in a relaxed mood for dinner.
Benson watched as his brother forked a piece of mashed potatoes, pork, and sausages with a fork. He said thoughtfully, "Klein, you've been going to the washroom quite frequently recently... I suggest you go to the hospital to take a look...
Klein nearly threw his fork away when he heard that. After a moment of silence, he raised his voice and emphasized, "Benson, I'm very healthy."
"I heard from a friend that the powder sold at a folk herb store on Vlad Street is quite effective... If you don't want to go to the hospital, you can try it there." Benson ignored his brother's emphasis and continued suggesting.
Vlad Street? Isn't that a herb store suspected to be run by Beyonders? But the last time I checked, the store had already changed hands... Could it be that the person who took it is also a Beyonder? Yes, I'll check it another day.
Despite having such thoughts, Klein said perfunctorily, "The original owner of that herb store is no longer around."
"So you've already been there." Benson was enlightened.
Klein suddenly felt that he couldn't explain himself, so he could only change the topic. "Why did Melissa and the rest gather?"
"It seems like a new teacher came to the public school where Miss Elizabeth and Miss Selena studied. Oh, it's a lady... They were welcoming the teacher, and Melissa was invited as a friend.
"Heh heh, I heard that this lady is also from Backlund, but she's different from the person named Kapusky from Melissa's school. It's said that this teacher is very skilled, and she won the affection of most of the girls in public schools in less than a day," Benson replied after some thought.
So that's how it is... Klein nodded slightly and then put the mashed potatoes and pork sausages to his mouth and took a bite.
At the same time, in a restaurant on Tingen Howes Street, a group of young girls raised their cups and said in unison,
"Welcome to Tingen, Teacher Lena."
"I hope Teacher Lena will forever be young and beautiful."
"Ms. Lena, cheers."
A beautiful, scholarly lady sitting at the head of the table watched this scene with a smile. She raised her cup in greeting before downing the beverage.
...
Backlund. After having a meal with Miss Fani, Ebner returned home with the stack of Roselle's manuscripts at Cherwood Borough's Kingst Street.
When he returned to his bedroom, he first got Mrs. Skade to prepare some beverages and dessert before he settled himself comfortably on the sofa.
Then, he pulled out a page from the stack of diary pages, took a sip of his beverage, and began reading.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: "Scum" Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 228 - "Scum" Law
"2nd April. Due to the recent chaos in the kingdom and the various revolts, spies from the Trier countries and mysterious organizations have been rampant. I've decided to reorganize the kingdom's intelligence organization and pull out a number of elites to form a new department to include my direct superior...
Yes, this new department has to have a nice-sounding name. It sounds domineering... I've decided. I'll call it the "Man in Black" organization.
"Finally, I have to thank the Savant potion. Without it, I definitely wouldn't have thought of the word 'rampant.' Who knows, I might even have to use pinyin in Chinese."
"3rd April. I met Floren and told him about using the kingdom's intelligence department to form my own team. That fool indeed believed me and gave me the authority.
"This fellow keeps flaunting how similar he is to his great grandfather. Could it be that his great grandfather, the former High-Sequence Beyonder, would be as silly as him?"
After reading this diary page, Ebner took a sip of black tea and lampooned inwardly Man Black? This name isn't auspicious at all... Why isn't it called the Avenger or the Guardian of the Galaxy?
From Roselle's gradual grasp of the Intis intelligence department, as well as some of the information I know, this is likely a diary entry from more than a hundred years ago, before the famous incident in Intis.
The results were clearly recorded in history textbooks. In the end, Roselle's status as a colonel quelled the rebellion, and he took advantage of the political changes to change the Intis Kingdom to a republic, a self-appointed consul.
In the following 19 years, he reformed the codex, encouraged inventions, and protected the industrial revolution. He greatly increased his country's strength and fought wars both north and south. He included Lenburg, Masin, Segar, and other countries under his protection, making the three powerful Northern Continent countries, the Feysac Empire, the Loen Kingdom, and the Feynapotter Kingdom bow their heads.
At the end of 1192, when he was about to serve twenty years as consul, Roselle changed the Republic into an Empire and called himself Caesar.
Less than six years later, he perished in the White Maple Palace, ending the Fifth Epoch's most legendary piece of history to date.
As Ebner recalled the history he had read in the library as a Reader, he picked up the second diary page.
Then, he saw a sentence he was very familiar with:
"6th March. Dammit, I'm almost constipated from eating the food here!
"17th March. Are the madams of Intis this open? Did I sleep with her, or did she sleep with me? Why do I feel a little weird?"
This paragraph... I've copied this paragraph before. I remember that it should've been exhibited at Roselle's exhibition hall...
Miss Emma or Miss Fani had seen that exhibition in other cities?
However, since it's a repeat, it's not appropriate to show it to Klein... What a pity...
With this in mind, Ebner put the diary page aside and picked up the third page.
After a simple glance, Ebner became serious. As the handwriting on this page was small and neat, it was likely that Miss Emma had copied it herself, so there was a lot of content.
"11th November. On this holiday that originally belonged to single people, I suddenly confirmed a piece of news that I had previously learned.
That's... Bruna. She's actually a descendant of the former Balam Empire's royal family. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call her a princess!
However, that's not the main point. After all, this isn't the first time I've been tainting an abject princess... However, there's actually quite a bit of power backing Bruna. They sealed off the harbor and actually wanted me to stay behind to truly become her husband.
"How is that possible? I'm a man who's going to become a Pirate King. Why would I stay for a woman? Besides, I have Matilda and all the charming madams in Trier.
"That's why I secretly informed Edwards through Cullen's messenger, telling him to secretly sail to the outer seas of Behrens tomorrow morning. Once I leave, I'll immediately pull up the anchor and set sail!"
"12th November. Bruna is such a pure and upright lady. She believed in my lies... Although I couldn't bear to, I still used her to break through the seal and return to the ship.
Before I left, I left the mystical item I forged, Pale Justice, to Bruna as a memento... Although I think it's best if she forgets me.
The Emperor sure is a scum! Ebner couldn't help but curse when he read this. He then recalled the diary page that the Emperor had fabricated after seeing the rumors about the Southern Continent.
I only made up a sentence: "The wild beauty who slept with me last week was actually a descendant of the former Balam Empire's royal family?" I didn't even write the date... Hmm, it doesn't have much of a conflict with the contents of this "true" diary page... So, handing this page to Klein probably wouldn't be a problem?
With this in mind, he looked at the words "Pale Justice" in the diary and thought,
At the Tarot Gathering yesterday, Alger had just mentioned that there was a new Admiral of Paleness at sea, and the weapon in his hand was also known as Pale Justice...
This shouldn't be a coincidence... The background of Admiral Pale Maria is the Numinous Episcopate, and apart from the Artificial Death faction, the strongest faction in the Numinous Episcopate is the royal family faction. Princess Bruna that Roselle mentioned is probably a member of the royal family faction... Is that why Maria inherited the Pale Justice?
Wait, could Roselle really have left behind a son in the Southern Continent?
After some idle gossip, Ebner ate a small piece of velvet cake and picked up the fourth diary page.
The content on this page was all about Roselle's sexual history. After a few glances, he placed it aside, prepared to "present" it to Mr. Fool to earn the remaining value.
Although there wasn't much content on the fifth page, which was the last page, it mentioned something that surprised Ebner because it wasn't mentioned at all.
"1st October. This is really a good day. Not only am I about to obtain what I've been plotting all this time, but I've also officially obtained the support of the two Churches!
"2nd October. Today, I learned something that left me very shocked. Not only were there foreign powers involved in the various revolts in Intis, but there was also the influence of that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Sauron family that suddenly came alive! No, to be precise, it's the true mastermind behind all of this!"
Putting down the diary, Ebner rubbed his temples and frowned.
A Grade 0 Sealed Artifact that suddenly came to "life" in the Sauron family... I remember that Roselle's diary in the Harvest Church had mentioned it before...
Is it the culprit behind the Intis mess? But how did it do it?
Even if it suddenly "came alive," even if it wanted to escape the control of the Sauron family, since an angel family had already discovered it, it would definitely be properly sealed...
Unless some high-level existence is helping it... Who could it be? And why would it do so?
And where did the Sealed Artifact end up... Did it fall into the hands of the Emperor?
Questions flashed through his mind as he finally sighed and packed up the five diary pages.
There was too little information to provide any effective inference.
...
Wednesday morning, at Zouteland Street, Tingen City.
Klein entered the Blackthorn Security Company in a good mood.
"Good morning." Rozanne looked around and said, "Old Neil is sick. Shall we visit him at noon?"
"Old Neil is sick?" Klein asked in surprise.
Rozanne nodded and said,
"Yes, he got someone to ask Captain for leave."
Klein nodded slightly and said, "Then let's visit him at noon. Sigh, Old Neil sure is pitiful. His wife passed away early, and his child is busy in some city. When he's sick, he can only lie at home alone and helpless."
Upon hearing Klein's sigh, Rozanne widened her eyes and asked in surprise,
"When did Old Neil get married?
"I clearly remember asking him why he wanted to remain single. His answer was that he didn't meet the lady he wanted to marry..."
Upon hearing Rozanne's words, Klein was alarmed as he had an ominous feeling.
After hearing at the Tarot Club that the Mystery Pryer pathway might be corrupted by the knowledge of the Hidden Sage, Klein had always paid close attention to Old Neil's physical condition. However, there had been no problems with him all this time. It made him subconsciously relax and not be that nervous...
Taking a deep breath, Klein deliberated and quickly decided on a divination statement.
"There's something wrong with Old Neil's current situation."
...
As he silently chanted, his eyes quickly darkened as he entered a state of Cogitation.
Ding!
He flicked his thumb, sending the brass coin into the air, constantly tumbling and spinning.
Pak! The coin fell right into Klein's open palm.
This time, George III's portrait was facing up.
The portrait indicated that it was correct and positive.
This meant that there was something wrong with Old Neil's current situation!
Could the "eye" on his back really be the Hidden Sage? Klein held the coin and suddenly recalled what had happened when he first advanced.
After barely consoling Rozanne who was clearly worried, Klein gradually calmed down. He didn't inform the Captain immediately. Instead, he entered the bathroom and took four steps counterclockwise to head above the gray fog.
The Fallen Morning Star Necklace contained the secret technique, "Ovalt's Perfect Recovery."
This secret technique had a chance of recovering people from the brink of losing control!
As long as it's useful, even a little risk is worth it...
Captain... He probably wouldn't probe deeper either!

chapters.title: Chapter 229: The Black Hand Behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 229 - The Black Hand Behind the Scenes
After "bestowing" himself the Morning Star necklace, Klein descended from the gray fog, returned to the real world, and placed it in his pocket.
Then, he dispelled the wall of spirituality and walked out of the bathroom. He quickly walked to the Captain's office and pushed open the door.
Dunn Smith was drinking his coffee when he nearly choked on his coffee.
"What happened?" He didn't blame Klein. Instead, his expression turned solemn. The abnormality of his teammates often indicated the seriousness of the matter.
Klein answered simply without hiding anything,
"Captain, I divined that there was something wrong with Old Neil.
"Last month, Old Neil told me that his deceased wife loved music, but today, Rozanne said that he has always been single.
"Besides, on the day I became a Beyonder, I saw a pair of strange, illusory eyes watching everything from behind Old Neil's back. There was also an almost transparent figure peeking from the door. He told me that it was a characteristic of ritualistic magic.
"I felt that something was amiss, so I tried to divine.
Dunn listened with a solemn expression. He stood up immediately and walked to the clothes rack. He asked curiously,
"Why didn't you directly divine if Old Neil had lost control?"
"I've been observing Old Neil's physical condition for the past month. At the very least, he was fine until last weekend... He's just a little old, so I think he's on the brink of losing control. There are signs of him losing control, and there's still room for redemption." Klein expressed his point of view in one breath.
Dunn put on his black top hat and trench coat before nodding.
"A very reasonable deduction... Let's visit Old Neil now. Yes, we should try to avoid agitating him.
"I'll go to Chanis Gate to get Sealed Artifact 3-0611. It should be able to stabilize Old Neil's condition and prevent his condition from worsening.
"Find Royale in the recreation room."
Sealed Artifact 3-0611... When Klein heard the name, he immediately felt energized. Previously, he had only thought that the secret technique on the Fallen Morning Star could stabilize the state of losing control, but because he was too flustered, too uneasy, and too worried, he had forgotten that there was a Sealed Artifact with similar effects behind Chanis Gate.
"Number: 3-0611.
"Name: Peaceful Hair Strands.
"Sealing Method: Do not make direct contact with living creatures.
"Description: This is a simple accessory formed from many strands of black hair.
"As long as one comes into contact with it without any protection, all living beings will lose all their desires and emotions, including but not limited to hunger, anger, sorrow, pain, envy, hatred, joy, satisfaction, and greed.
"It has been confirmed that the affected creatures will even lose their desire to leave contact with 3-0611. They will quietly stay in their spots until the end of their lives.
"If an external force is used to break contact between the person and 0611, then the person will gradually recover. However, experimental data suggest that the prerequisite for this is that the person has not been in contact with it for more than two hours.
"Once the contact lasts for more than two hours, the victim will remain silent forever.
"You can use gloves to avoid direct contact."
"These strands of hair do not possess any living characteristics. They do not have any inclinations of escaping the seal."
As his thoughts raced, Klein didn't delay any further. He immediately went to the recreation room and called out Sleepless Royale Reideen.
The lady with black smooth hair asked calmly, "What's the mission?"
"To visit Old Neil," Klein replied heavily.
"Old Neil..." Royale, who had always had a cold expression, exclaimed before falling silent.
A few minutes later, Dunn came out from underground. The three gathered together and took a carriage to Old Neil's house.
On the way, Dunn recounted Old Neil's past. Only then did Klein learn that Old Neil had a couple he was about to get engaged with when he was young. He died of a serious illness... Before he died, Old Neil had even taken the risk of exposing the secrets of a Beyonder to save him with ritualistic magic. Unfortunately, he didn't succeed.
At that moment, Klein's heart sank as he once again had an ominous feeling.
...
In the outskirts of Tingen, in a house with a dark red chimney.
A classic quill wrote:
"As Neil kept attempting the Alchemical Life bestowed by the Hidden Sage, he exacerbated the corruption he suffered. His body and mind were on the brink of losing control.
...
"Through divination, Klein Moretti determined that Neil's condition was abnormal. Hence, he took out the Morning Star necklace.
"The Fallen Morning Star Necklace contains two powerful secret techniques. They are the 'Ives's Concealment Barrier' and the 'Valette's Perfect Recovery Art.' The latter can effectively control a state that's about to lose control, so Klein Moretti wanted to save Neil.
At the same time, Dunn Smith felt his mental state recover a little thanks to Daly Simone's nourishment. After he heard Klein Moretti's report, he immediately determined that Sealed Artifact 3-0611 could help him recover. Hence, he went behind Chanis Gate to retrieve it.
