Dunn Smith, Klein Moretti, and Royale Reideen rode a carriage to Neil's house. Neil hadn't completely lost control yet. If they arrived in time, they might still have a chance with the help of the Fallen Morning Star and 3-0611...
Just as the quill wrote this, it was grabbed by a pale hand.
The palm came from a man, a man wearing a black double-breasted frock coat. He was obviously blind in one eye, and his dark blue eyes were nearly black.
The man picked up the brown-covered notebook and read it carefully. Then, he picked up his quill and wrote on the newest page without dipping it in ink:
"Neil recalled that the moment Klein Moretti rapidly advanced, the Holy Cathedral immediately sent people to examine him, as though they were stopping Klein Moretti from sharing the method of quickly grasping the potion. The indignation in his heart and his suspicion of the Church of Evernight made him attempt to pray to the Hidden Sage once again while his body was at its limit. This was in line with logic.
"On the brink of losing control, he was once again corrupted by high-level knowledge. Neil's outcome was sealed. He completely lost control and became a disgusting monster.
"Following that, Dunn Smith, Klein Moretti, and Royale Reideen arrived at Neil's residence. They acutely noticed that Neil had lost control. As for Neil, he attempted to use words to move Dunn and company to let him go.
As Dunn Smith reeled in sorrow, he attempted to use his Nightmare powers to pull Neil into a dream.
But his attempt was seen through by Neil, and he used his connection with the Hidden Sage to escape Dunn Smith's dream.
Dunn Smith's psyche was damaged by the backlash, and he was even contaminated by the aura of a high-level existence.
At this point, the blind man closed his notebook and looked out the window. He said to himself,
"Fallen Morning Star... The Concealment Barrier of Evins? It's no wonder he can always escape death..."
...
In a bungalow with a garden in the outskirts of Tingen North Borough.
Neil, who had completely lost control, used his four cold, lashless eyes to shine with a dark light. He locked onto Dunn, and his expression turned cold.
"You are pulling me into a dream!
"No, it's useless! My eyes can see through everything!"
At the same time, the sticky blood that covered the ceiling, floor, and walls began to squirm, like a giant opening its mouth in an attempt to swallow Klein and company.
Klein didn't draw his revolver in a fluster. Instead, he reached into his pocket, intending to use Holy Light Summoning from the Fallen Morning Star.
Suddenly, he saw everything calm down again. The sticky, bloody liquid with dense black hair was as serene as a still lake.
Neil lost his coldness, hatred, desire, and other expressions. He became peaceful and quiet.
At some point in time, Dunn had already thrown Sealed Artifact 3-0611 into the sticky blood.
Any living creature that made contact with the Peaceful Hair Strands would turn silent and lose all motivation until the end of their lives!
Dunn, Klein, and Royale drew their guns and aimed at the man's head.
At that moment, Old Neil revealed an expression of extreme fear as he struggled. His strong desire to live had slightly overcome the effects of Sealed Artifact 3-0611.
The four additional eyes disappeared. The wrinkles at the corners of his eyes and mouth were deep, his hair was white, and his dark red eyes were turbid, just like the first time Klein saw him.
"Dunn, do you remember the time when I saved you..."
"Royale, do you remember how I helped you save your family's lives..."
"Klein, do you remember how I taught you mysticism every day? Do you remember how we talked about reimbursement? Do you remember how I made you hand-ground coffee? Do you remember how we dealt with the Mandated Punishers who lost control?"
...
Klein hesitated for a moment before hearing—
Bang! Bang! Two sounds.
Two silver demon hunting bullets flew out, stabbing into Old Neil's head one after another.
Dunn and Royale lowered their guns and fell silent.
"We are guardians, but also a bunch of miserable wretches that are constantly fighting against threats and madness."
After a long while, the hunched Dunn looked at Old Neil's mangled corpse and muttered to himself in a daze.
...
Backlund, Cherwood Borough, in the garden villa on Kingst Street.
As it had been drizzling since the morning, Ebner didn't leave the house and instead stayed home to experiment with the effects of various ritualistic magic.
However, Xio's sudden visit broke his reverie.
"Darkholme disappeared last night," Xio said after entering the living room.
After carefully recalling for a while, Ebner remembered who Darkholme was. Hence, he asked, "The gang leader who controlled quite a number of people? The one who gave you the information about Dual-faced Lawson?"
"That's right." Xio nodded and said with a heavy expression, "I previously entrusted him to pay attention to the vagrants in East Borough... So I suspect that his disappearance might have something to do with Qilangos."
"You didn't disguise yourself when you entrusted Darkholme with the mission?" Ebner asked.
"Of course." Xio nodded, somewhat puzzled. Would disguising her traits work? Even if she was tall, the gang leaders would've recognized her.
"Then, I'm afraid Qilangos is already aware of your general situation..." Ebner immediately made a judgment.
"I thought of that too, so I'll be moving when I get back... But many people know that you're my friend, and your place isn't a secret... I'm worried that Qilangos will attack you," Xio said worriedly.
At this moment, Ebner suddenly sensed something and immediately activated the White Eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Give Up and Questions
chapters.content:
Chapter 230 - Give Up and Questions
After activating the White Eye, Ebner first checked Xio. After confirming that she wasn't a fake with the Faceless powers, he heaved a sigh of relief.
That's right. Xio wasn't raising herself up. She was only 1.5 meters tall... Even Klein was helpless at this height, much less Qilangos who was slightly taller than Klein...
While lampooning in his heart, Ebner quickly walked into his storage room and took out the Book of Dead. He wanted to use the book's special aura to hold a ritual and forcefully simulate the abilities of a Spirit Medium to communicate with the nearby spirits.
After setting up the items, he directly chanted in ancient Hermes,
"The undead wandering around the neighborhood,
"Weak creatures that can be controlled by others,
"Those who were attracted by the aura of the Book of Dead,
"I command you in my name to bring back the aura of the suspicious person near the house."
On the other side, Xio was a little confused by what Ebner was doing, but then she seemed to realize something as she quietly watched him hold the ritual.
Soon, the ritual was completed. Wisps of aura gathered around Ebner as he "extracted" them one by one, then "analyzed" and "retroactively."
A minute later, Ebner closed the White Eye and sighed. He said to Xio, "As expected, you were followed... There were five different people passing by on the street outside, but their auras were the same."
"The powers of a Faceless... The Creeping Hunger you mentioned before? Qilangos?" Although Xio had some guesses, she couldn't hide her surprise. At the same time, she blamed herself and felt lucky.
She blamed herself because she had brought the danger to Ebner... And she was glad because she hadn't returned home. At least Fors was safe.
However, why didn't Qilangos take me down immediately?
With this in mind, Xio asked, "Since he has already discovered me... Why did he only choose to tail me?"
Ebner wasn't too worried about Qilangos's possible surprise attack. If he were outside, he really wasn't Vice Admiral Hurricane's match. Any slight carelessness might result in him being taken away by Creeping Hunger's combo attacks...
However, this villa had many of his arrangements. Once he was attacked, he could activate many prepared ritualistic magic in a very short period of time!
The magic's lethality is ordinary, but it's very effective when used to stop enemies and trap enemies... This way, even if I can't defeat them, it's enough to delay them until the official Beyonders arrive.
Therefore, after taking his time to consider it, he asked, "Does Darkholme know of your identity as a MI9 spy?"
Xio thought for a moment and answered after some deliberation, "He might have some guesses... After all, many of the cases I did as a Sheriff were done with the help of the military, so I didn't get into trouble with the police... These ordinary people might not notice it, but the gang leaders definitely know it...
"The most obvious thing is that they were very cooperative with the 'order' I set up in the future."
Ebner nodded without feeling surprised. He said with a smile, "Then, Darkholme might've informed Qilangos of this judgment. The latter didn't attack you because it's still daytime, and it's not convenient to use his powers... Besides, he's afraid that MI9 will increase the intensity of their search on him after something happens to you."
Of course, Qilangos might still be worried about me... After all, I'm a well-known Hero Detective, and I'm suspected to have quite a powerful background... If something happens to Xio, as her friend, I'll definitely investigate. This would be extremely disadvantageous for Qilangos, who had to complete an assassination mission.
However, he didn't say those narcissistic words.
Xio said thoughtfully, "Then, he followed me... Was he trying to figure out my interpersonal relationships?"
"That's right. I guess he's trying to figure out your background before deciding if he should attack you or not."
After saying that, he held another ritual. Then, he looked at the clock in the living room and said to Xio with a smile, "It's been more than half an hour since any stranger passed by the streets around the villa... It seems like Qilangos has given up on dealing with you for the time being."
"Then I'll immediately return and move. Then, I won't appear in East Borough or your place for the time being." Xio heaved a sigh of relief and immediately made a decision.
"Hmm, just to be safe, I'll fly you out from the roof with me. This way, even if Qilangos doesn't give up, there's no way for him to tail us," Ebner suggested after pondering for a moment.
After all, although Qilangos was a Wind-blessed, he didn't know how to hide himself. He didn't dare to show off in the day.
"Alright!"
...
Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos, who had transformed into an ordinary-looking gentleman with a high hairline, walked into a coffee shop by the side of the street at the corner of Gutman Street.
After entering the store, he surveyed his surroundings before sitting in the furthest corner. He then called for the waiter to order a cup of coffee and two plates of dessert.
Qilangos took a sip of the Fermo coffee which was said to be very delicious. He frowned and held back his urge to vomit. He put down his coffee cup and picked up the dessert.
Soon after, a blond man dressed in an experienced attire pushed open the coffee shop's door and walked in. He sized up the person before walking towards the innermost seat and sat opposite Qilangos.
"Have you completed the mission given by the boss?" Qilangos put down his fork and knife when he saw the blond man.
"Half of it was done, and the other half was handed over to four people. However, those four only completed half of the assigned mission," the blond man replied meticulously.
Who thought of this signal? He's not even as skilled as us pirates! Qilangos cursed silently and looked at the blond man in front of him. He suggested in a serious manner, "Can we meet at a bar next time?" After all, coffee is too awful!
"It's not appropriate for me to go to a bar with my identity..." As he spoke, the blond man took out a stack of documents from his briefcase and pushed it in front of Qilangos. He said in a serious tone, "This is the information you wanted... You'll have to rely on yourself in the future. We won't provide you with any help."
Qilangos didn't flip through the documents immediately. Instead, he asked in a deep voice, "Any results on the matter I reported last night?"
"That's just a coincidence. You're overthinking things! According to what I know, the spy from MI9 is investigating another case involving a high-level Sealed Artifact. He's not targeting you at all." The blond man didn't say anything. Instead, he wrote the words on a piece of paper. After Qilangos read it, he immediately tore it up and put it in his pocket.
Qilangos heaved a sigh of relief. Since he didn't expose his identity, there was no need for him to take the risk of killing Miss Arbiter, who was at least a Sequence 7...
Furthermore, the lady had a close relationship with the Hero Detective. If he really touched her, he would probably get himself into quite a bit of trouble. If he were to delay his mission, it would be a loss if he didn't obtain the item.
With that in mind, Qilangos flipped through the documents. Then, the names of the nobles such as Lord Natos, Viscount Kancelek, Baron Gramir, and Baron New Glasgow appeared before his eyes.
...
At night, Ebner, who had helped Xio and Fors move home, rested for a few hours before flying all the way to the Backlund University Library.
Emma had previously arranged to meet him here through Vane.
Having already been here once, Aibner skilfully circled around the many spell traps that Irma had set up and walked to the light on the second floor.
However, he didn't use "invisibility" this time.
Emma, who was engrossed in a book, looked up when she heard the commotion. She then happily waved at him and asked a question that left Ebner extremely surprised,
"Ebner, do you know that in the Fourth Epoch, there was an Amon family known as Blasphemers?"

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Conversation with Emma
chapters.content:
Chapter 231 - Conversation with Emma
Amon? Miss, as a Beyonder of the Marauder pathway, you're actually interested in Amon... Where did you get the urge to become a part of Amon?
After lampooning inwardly, Ebner wasn't too worried. Firstly, he had already used the Eye of White to check the area a few times before entering the library. He was certain that there weren't any other living people apart from Miss Emma... Secondly, Amon didn't dare let "His" avatars enter Backlund at this time.
Unless Amon steals the memory of the problem he discovered, there's no need to be overly suspicious... However, with the level of the White Eye, it's unlikely that Amon's avatar can do it... Therefore, there's no need to worry about it.
As his thoughts raced, he took a deep look at Miss Emma and confirmed that she wasn't a member of the Hermits of Fate. She had likely obtained the Marauder Sequence potion by chance, or else she would've been informed of certain taboos.
"What's wrong?" Miss Emma's hair stood on end from the way he looked at her. Her long, straight eyebrows furrowed as she asked uncomfortably, "Why are you looking at me like that?"
"Emma, I don't know why you mentioned the name 'Amon,' but regardless, it's best not to probe further... This is because, even in the Fourth Epoch, where there were many High-Sequence Beyonders, this family's last name was taboo!" Ebner warned solemnly.
"It's that serious?" Upon hearing that, Emma was shocked at first. Then, when she saw Ebner's stern expression, she said in depression, "Among the five major families of the Tudor Dynasty, the Amon family is the most mysterious one. It has the least history left behind. It seems to have been distorted and concealed by some power... I thought I could unravel a portion of the family's secrets and completely expend the Cryptologist's potion..."
Upon hearing this, Ebner's heart stirred as he immediately thought of something. He probed, "Don't tell me that you discovered the tomb of the Amon family in some book?"
How do you know that? You can figure that out? Emma's eyes widened. Although she didn't say it out loud, the expression on her face made it clear.
"It's really him... I was just making a guess!" Ebner pretended to look surprised, but he sighed inwardly.
So you were the one who discovered the mausoleum at the bend of the Stratford River in White Cliff Town? In that case, Miss, your original ending wasn't very good...
"As expected of a Hero Detective. You really are sharp!" Emma clicked her tongue in wonder. After sighing, she said to Ebner, "That's right... I previously found some records in an ancient book and determined that there was an ancient tomb near White Cliff Town... And the tomb's owner is most likely an important member of the Amon family.
"But as you know, I don't have much freedom. I had to sneak around at night even when I wanted to meet you... Therefore, I couldn't personally confirm the existence of the ancient tomb. As for Fani, she's only a Sequence 9, and a Lawyer isn't proficient in all kinds of ritualistic magic. Even if she has an extremely powerful mechanical creation, I wouldn't let her take the risk..."
Ebner could naturally tell what she was implying. She didn't wish for Fani to take the risk, so she deliberately brought up the topic of Amon to me the moment they met in order to garner my interest... But she didn't expect me to be so afraid of Amon, so she had no choice but to explain things clearly...
Even the Church of Steam's saint-level archbishop nearly died there. How could a Sequence 7 like me dare to join in the fun?
Ebner lampooned before persuading again, "Based on my experience, that place must be very dangerous. Even if Low- and Mid-Sequence Beyonders manage to escape by chance, they might suffer some unknown disaster in the future. I repeat, 'Amon' is taboo. Even demigods have deep reservations about this name."
"But, I've already gotten Fanito leak some information at a relatively high-level Beyonder gathering yesterday... I-I didn't expect it to be that dangerous," Emma said uneasily. Her original intention was only to attract some powerful adventurers to explore the exact location of the mausoleum. Although she knew that it was dangerous, she never thought of deliberately harming others.
Then whoever goes will be unlucky... There was nothing that could be done about it. The other Beyonders weren't like Ema. Even if she told them that there was danger, they probably wouldn't care...
After all, for unaffiliated Beyonders, how could there be no danger if they wanted to obtain something? However, the danger this time was beyond their imagination.
Even if it was Emma, she definitely had her suspicions. If not for the deep impression that she had left on her during the expedition to the ruins, giving her a certain degree of trust and understanding, she might've thought that she was just exaggerating.
Although Emma was indeed hesitant, although she had a rash side to her personality, she was happy to listen to the opinions of others. Especially through her spiritual intuition as a Cryptologist and her observation skills, she determined that what Ebner said came from the bottom of his heart. He was really thinking for her, so she decided not to probe into Amon for the time being.
After I advance to become a demigod and become a powerhouse like Hazel's teacher who can fool the Church of Evernight, I'll head to Amon's mausoleum to explore...
After carefully observing Ema's expression and confirming that she had really given up on exploring Amon, he heaved a sigh of relief.
He didn't want his friend to wear a monocle one day...
Then, after comforting Emma, he asked,
"Have you found anything about Baron Lamud's family?"
Upon hearing that, Emma nodded and composed herself. She handed a notebook to Ebner and said with a smile, "I found the relevant records in the royal family's library. This is some of the content that I copied... I have to say, the story of the first Baron Lamud is romantic and inspirational. It's not as legendary as his son's."
"It's filled with the word 'legendary'?" Ebner ruminated over the word and flipped through the notebook.
The first part of the story was nothing special. It was about the first Baron Lamud, who was also Baron Azik's life story. It recorded his low birth, his meritorious exploits, and how he married his former mistress after obtaining an aristocratic title.
This was indeed inspirational and romantic, enough to be treated like a novel.
After silently making some comments in his heart, Ebner once again read the life story of the second-generation baron that Irma had copied.
The second generation Baron Lamud's name was Tana. When he first came to Backlund, he was Earl Wolfe's knight squire.
Relying on the Sequence potions he had inherited, as well as his relatively powerful strength, he quickly stood out among the attendants. He also became good friends with Baron Kilgor, who was also an attendant back then.
Due to his outstanding handling skills and dazzling battle achievements, the second generation Baron Lamud was appreciated by William I. He then left Earl Wolfe and became the king's confidant with his good friend, Baron Kilgor.
In the years that followed, these two friends made plenty of contributions to the kingdom. They had both competed and cooperated with each other, and they had a good relationship.
During this period of time, Emma had copied a few examples of battles after the enemy. The process was indeed legendary, allowing the king to not only allow Tana to attack the baron, but he also made Baron Lamud his hereditary.
Until a secret mission came... The details of the mission didn't seem to be found by her. She only wrote that the security clearance level was extremely high and that she didn't have enough clearance.
This mission was jointly completed by the two Barons, Lamud and Kilgor. However, the two later became enemies, and Kilgor had even poisoned Lamud to death.
And the king's attitude towards this was simply to punish them for losing some of their property.
Upon reading this, Ebner pondered for a moment and asked Emma, "Was the person who kept suppressing Baron Lamud also Kilgor?"
Emma nodded slightly and replied, "It's no secret. After all, we've already become sworn enemies, so I naturally won't go easy on you."
"It seems like the crux of the problem lies in that secret mission... What is it? Besides, Baron Kilgor sounds familiar..." Ebner muttered to himself in thought.
"The Kilgor family's aristocratic title was abolished more than a hundred years ago..." mEma added.
"More than a hundred years ago... Back when Roselle was in power?" Ebner seemed to recall something as he asked.
"It does seem to be the case..." Emma was taken aback as she recalled before nodding.
Kilgor... The former military Brigadier General, a high-ranking member of MI9, Qonas Kilgor, had such a surname.
I wonder if it's related...

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Ebner’s Deduction
chapters.content:
Chapter 232 - Ebner's Deduction
After pondering for a while, Ebner cast his gaze on the examples of Baron Lamud, the second generation Baron Lamud who had been plagiarized by Miss Ema. In other words, the ones that were deemed rather legendary by her.
From the looks of it, they were nothing special. These classic examples only made people feel that the two Barons, Lamud and Kilgor, were indeed extraordinary. Many nearly impossible missions had been successfully completed by them. It could be said that they were legends...
But on careful thought, there was a huge problem! How could the requirements for each mission be so harsh? In fact, the few times they survived could be attributed to good luck...
Such a mission was more like a designed test... Perhaps the king was training them!
Then here comes the question. What's so special about them that they're worth the effort of a country's rulers to nurture them?
I'm not sure about Kilgor, but Lamud's greatest uniqueness is that he's a descendant of Death, the son of the Death Consul.
This uniqueness likely couldn't be hidden from the Founder, Protector William I, who had observed him up close... After all, he was a Sequence 1 Hand of Order.
Therefore, a reasonable deduction would be that the king wanted to use the descendants of Death to obtain something somewhere, so he had customized those so-called missions to deliberately train him? It was just like how Queen Mystic was nurturing Jane.
However, Loen's king clearly isn't as kind as Queen Mystic. He probably plans on killing the donkey the moment it's finished, silencing it... And Lamud must've discovered something during that so-called mysterious mission. He even tried to attract the Church's attention in order to protect himself. That's why he was poisoned to death by the king with the help of his friend... Otherwise, there's no need for this.
In order to not arouse the Church's suspicion, the king didn't even take back Lamud's aristocratic title. Instead, he promoted a new baron and ordered Kilgor to continue suppressing him... He wanted to make this matter a private grudge and divert attention.
Then, what was it that was worth it for an angel family to nurture someone to obtain it, but was also afraid that the Church would learn of it?
Thinking of this, I connected it to the Augustus family's vision of being manipulated by the gods to become a chess player... Ebner suddenly had an idea.
Emperor Roselle once said to make a bold hypothesis and carefully verify it. I can first assume that Augustus had a plan to nurture his family members to become gods at the end of the Fourth Epoch and the beginning of the Fifth Epoch... Then, they had three choices.
Learn from Solomon to become the Black Emperor, learn from the Night Emperor to become a judge, and learn from the Blood Emperor to take the risk to become a Red Priest.
And at the beginning of the Fifth Epoch, apart from the three Sequence 1s and the Uniqueness that might've followed Trunsoest's Specter Empire, the other Sequences had a clear owner.
And Death had little to do with Trunsoest. The possibility of Kilgor and Lamud being used to seek out this Sequence 1 was very slim... And even if they needed to seek it, Augustus wouldn't nurture any outsiders.
There were no clear descriptions of the three Sequence 1s of the Black Emperor after Solomon's death, but some of them were lost, while others fell into the hands of some orthodox deity or evil god.
I remember that Qonas Kilgor was a demigod of the Black Emperor pathway, but that wasn't a reference. After all, I didn't know if he was a Beyonder characteristic passed down from his family's ancestors, or if it was bestowed by the kingdom later.
However, if the Kilgor family was special and had some special connection with the Black Emperor, then it would make sense that William I had nurtured the first Baron Kilgor.
They might very well have used Kilgor to find the whereabouts of a particular characteristic, but it would be difficult to obtain it for the time being. That was why they kept the family alive.
All the way until Roselle became the Black Emperor, those characteristics all had the surname "Yellow." The Kilgor family lost its value, so it was stripped of its aristocratic title due to some mistakes.
As for the final Red Priest, it should only be a contingency plan for Augustus, or a tool used to exchange for other Sequence 1s...
Back then, the Loen royal family might've used the Conqueror characteristic to exchange for the Prince of Abolition characteristic from the Demoness Sect... After all, a Sequence 1 was only exchanged for some help from the Demoness Sect. It wasn't of equal value.
And at the end of the Fourth Epoch, at the beginning of the Fifth Epoch, it was not long after the death of Death and Red Priest...
Perhaps the Augustus family nurtured Death's descendants precisely for the Red Priest's characteristic or Uniqueness left behind by the Emperor of the Underworld. Yes, from the results, the Conqueror characteristic is more likely to be the case.
Furthermore, there's a high chance that they succeeded...
Baron Lamud, the second generation, must've sensed that he might be silenced, so he left a contingency to inform the Church.
This contingency might've garnered the attention of the Church, but it wasn't taken seriously. As such, the kingdom had changed the way they executed him, reducing the possibility of the Church discovered something amiss.
...
Although this hypothesis was based on Ebner's hypothesis, it made sense logically. As long as there was concrete evidence at a few key points, it could be determined that his reasoning was valid.
As for how he could verify it? There was no need for him to complete it since he already had an idea. He could hand it over to Klein and let him rack his brains. After all, this was Mr. Azik's matter. It was only right that he put in more effort.
Of course, the reports submitted to Klein didn't include high-end knowledge like Red Priest or Black Emperor. Ebner planned on only telling him the conclusion. As for the process of reasoning for coming to a conclusion, he would save as much as he could. Anything that couldn't be omitted would be replaced with vague terms.
After organizing his thoughts, Ebner put away Emma's notebook and was about to leave.
Upon seeing this, Emma pouted in dissatisfaction before calming down.
From her observations, Ebner must've deduced some incredible secret after reading her notebook, but he wasn't willing to tell her a single thing... How petty! He was clearly very generous to her, and he even gave her the Barbarian potion formula that she had always been begging for, but had never been able to obtain... Why was he treating her differently?
However, in the end, Ema had hidden such matters from Vane before. She was rather experienced in such matters, and she quickly guessed what was on Abna's mind. She understood that he felt that it was not time for her to know those secrets.
Therefore, Emma couldn't help but ask when Ebner's figure was almost at the staircase, "Ebner, can you tell me what conditions I need to meet to be qualified to explore Amon's tomb?"
Upon hearing that, Ebner's feet wobbled, and he nearly stepped into the spell trap that Irma had set up. He thought in a speechless manner, So this lady hasn't completely given up on investigating Amon? The courage to pursue a monocle is truly worthy of praise and tears...
Despite lampooning, Ebner turned back and said in a joking tone, "When your thoughts suddenly become chaotic one day, you realize that you're doing or have already done something very stupid... After that, you can think of Amon as you wish."
With that said, he simulated his "flight" ability and "opened" the door from the roof before leaving the library.
"That tone of a charlatan... Those who don't know better will definitely think that you've already advanced to Prophet!" Emma was stunned for a moment before cursing bitterly. Following that, she knitted her beautiful eyebrows and habitually "decrypted" it. "What does' chaotic thoughts' mean? What does' foolish matters' mean?
"I don't feel like I have any clue at all. Is Ebner just fooling me?"
...
At nine o'clock on Thursday morning, at the moon, at the Raphael Cemetery.
Klein stood silently in a corner of the cemetery in his pure black formal suit and shirt, holding a silver-inlaid cane.
He listened to Rozanne's sorrowful sobbing as he watched Captain, Frye, Leonard, and Kenley carry the black coffin containing Old Neil's "corpse" to the tombstone. Then, he silently lowered it into the grave.
Finally, his gaze stopped at the epitaph engraved at the bottom of the tombstone's photograph. It came from Old Neil's recent diary entry:
"If I can't save her, then I'll accompany her."
The Hidden Sage! Klein silently engraved the name in his mind... There were some things he couldn't do right now, but he would definitely do it in the future!
At this moment, he suddenly heard resounding prayers.
Seeing that Old Neil's funeral was over, the Nighthawks were making their final farewell and were about to return to the company.
Klein walked in front of the silent Captain and said in a heavy tone, "I'll get a public carriage."
The company's carriage couldn't accommodate that many people.
"Go ahead... There's no rush. They should still have something to say to Old Neil..." Dunn said after a moment of silence.
"Alright!" Klein nodded and quickly left the cemetery. He followed the Captain's instructions and was in no hurry to get a carriage. Instead, he turned into the public bathroom of the cemetery.
A wall of spirituality sealed off the space and took four steps counterclockwise to the gray fog palace. Klein sat in the seat belonging to The Fool and emanated his spirituality to touch a constantly expanding and contracting crimson star.
It was the crimson star representing the "Tower."
After listening to the other party's request, Klein quickly responded. He then received the information provided by the "Tower" sacrifice through the surging spirituality and rippling light.
It was a notebook and a piece of paper filled with words.
Klein flipped open the notebook and saw neat, neat handwriting. It was obviously written by a lady.
"This isn't Miss Xio's handwriting. Although I've only watched a few live streams, Miss Xio's handwriting is a little cruder.
It's also not like the Roselle diary that was handed over to the 'Tower.' It's the handwriting of the lady who copied Roselle's writing. Although it's an imitation, one can tell that the handwriting is slightly nascent...
Another lady who's helping The Tower... From the looks of it, Mr. Tower has many friends...
After Klein quipped a few times, he immediately felt a lot better as the corners of his mouth curled up.

chapters.title: Chapter 233: The Combined Truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 233 - The Combined Truth
As he still needed to hire a rental carriage, Klein didn't spend too much time above the gray fog. He only took a few glances at the conclusion from the "tower" before returning to reality.
After taking a carriage and a group of Nighthawks back to the company, Klein finally finished reading the notebook after using the opportunity to head to the bathroom several times in the afternoon.
Mr. Tower guessed that the Lamud family is related to the Death of the Fourth Epoch, and the other Baron Kilgor is related to the Solomon royal family. He was used by the Loen brass to conspire for a high-level item of the Lawyer pathway... Only when the emperor reached the peak of the Lawyer pathway was he forced to give up...
So the Solomon royal family's Beyonder pathway began with Lawyer, but the emperor of this dynasty is collectively called Black Emperor. Is this hinting that Lawyers are good at manipulating the rules? That's not right. There was probably no Lawyer in that era... I wonder what its ancient name is.
But isn't the Emperor a Beyonder of the Savant pathway? Could it be that Savant and Lawyer can be interchanged at high levels? The Emperor later switched to the Lawyer pathway? Sigh, I hope Roselle's diary will mention this in the future.
Yes, although Mr. Tower is only making assumptions, I have to say that he lives up to his reputation as a famous detective! Let's not talk about Kilgor. Baron Lamud, or should I say, Mr. Azik might really be related to Death!
"Tuesday at Morse Town, I tried to divine the origins of the haunting created by Mr. Azik, and I ended up seeing an inverted pyramid that extended underground. This is undoubtedly a symbol of Death, an honor that only his descendants can receive.
Crouching on the toilet in the bathroom, Klein thought about Mr. Tower's inference as he muttered to himself.
Until the bathroom door was knocked.
"Klein, it's time to get off work!" Rozanne's voice came from outside. "I know you're very sad about Old Neil's death, but don't be too sad..."
What does she mean? Does she think I'm secretly crying in the bathroom? Klein was speechless. He packed his clothes and walked out the door. When he saw Rozanne looking worried, he forced a smile and said, "I'm fine... I just had a stomachache yesterday..."
"Klein, I know all about it... Actually, it's the same for me," Rozanne said with a hoarse voice, as though her nostrils were blocked.
She was clearly still very down.
...
After leaving the Blackthorn Security Company, Klein went home and told his sister to remember to leave dinner for him. Then, he took a trackless public carriage to Azik's house.
Ding dong, ding dong.
Amidst the crisp bell chimes, Azik opened the door in his white shirt and black vest.
After exchanging pleasantries, Klein entered the foyer, put down his cane, took off his hat, and followed Azik to his activity room.
The activity room was decorated with a fireplace, rocking chair, sofa, and coffee table. Klein sat in his usual spot.
Azik lit the cigar and took a cigar to warm it up. At the same time, he asked,
"Have you settled the matter at Morse Town?"
"I have to thank you for that," Klein said sincerely.
While he was fiddling with the cigar, he took the initiative to say,
"Mr. Azik, I got my friend to find a set of information regarding Baron Lamud. Oh, and that friend's inference regarding the information."
"You've put in a lot of effort. I have to thank you for your kind intentions, for remembering my matters all this time." Azik looked up and sized up Klein for a moment before nodding.
"It's my friend who's very concerned about this matter." Klein didn't take credit for it as he passed the copied information and the relevant conclusions to Mr. Azik.
As for the original item, it was naturally still above the gray fog. No matter how much trust he had in Mr. Azik's character, he wouldn't hand him the item of a Tarot Club member.
Mr. Azik didn't say a word as he solemnly received the documents. Then, he read them with a serious expression.
The living room was so silent that it was almost frozen. Time ticked by.
About half an hour later, Mr. Azik put down the documents and closed his eyes as though he was trying to squeeze out his memories.
After a few seconds, he opened his eyes and said in an emotionless tone,
"Upon seeing this, I recalled something... I remember that in the later stages of Baron Lamud's life, I had investigated Tana's death...
"And the results of my investigations back then can be used as evidence for your friend's inference."
Having said that, Azik lit his previous cigar once again and pointed at the cigar case on the coffee table.
"Do you want one?"
"No." Klein shook his head firmly.
Meanwhile, he silently lampooned,
Mr. Azik, before you lost your memories, you must've left quite a bit of wealth for yourself. Otherwise, how could a teacher who isn't even an associate professor enjoy cigars so frequently?
Mr. Azik took a puff on his cigar and continued,
There's only one point. The last piece of information that Tana left wasn't for the Church, but for me... From the beginning to the end, he had never thought of betraying the kingdom he was loyal to... But the Loen royal family clearly didn't believe him. They thought that the Church had received some news, so they did something unnecessary!
When Klein heard this, combined with Mr. Tower's inference, he felt his heart turn ice-cold. His impression of William I, who had been imprinted with 10 pounds, instantly dropped significantly.
"At that time, Tana didn't know that I could really see his message, so he didn't make it very clear... But there are still two things that can testify to your friend's inference.
First, before the 'secret mission' mentioned in the information, that little fellow, Kilgor, had actually explored another ruin with a member of the Augustus family named Grue...
"I don't know the exact process, but ever since then, Tana accidentally discovered that Kilgor was no longer Kilgor... And after that mission, the Kilgor family was bestowed with a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, Concerto of Light and Shadow."
This is... because the first Baron Kilgor found an item he couldn't get his hands on, so he was silenced and replaced? After all, the royal family only needed to control Kilgor's bloodline, and the baron himself, who knew some of the truth, naturally couldn't keep it. Otherwise, it would increase the risk of exposing the secret.
As for the Concerto of Light and Shadow, could it be formed from the true Baron Kilgor's Beyonder characteristic?
Just as Klein thought of this, he heard Mr. Azik continue,
Second, the location of Tana's last mission should be somewhere dangerous in the Underworld. According to his guess, it should be the ruins of Death.
Heh heh, it was precisely in such an environment that Tana was able to leave some 'messages' for me... Unfortunately, Augustus, who was monitoring him, misunderstood.
"That child was actually determined to return to the Underworld to complete his last mission."
With that said, Mr. Azik stood up and sucked at his cigar at the activity room's window. Only when Klein finished digesting what he had said did he say,
"By the way, I'll be leaving Tingen soon."
"Why?" Klein asked in surprise.
Didn't you say that you were going to find the mastermind who affected my fate and stole your child's skull?
Azik held his cigar and explained with a sigh,
"The target might've noticed my attention and investigation. There hasn't been any movement recently, leaving me with zero clues. Therefore, I plan to leave Tingen for Backlund for the time being. On the one hand, the information from before touched me quite a bit. Perhaps I should use this clue to find traces of my memory loss. On the other hand, it will lower the target's guard.
That's right. Mr. Azik's last memory loss was near Backlund University... Unfortunately, you can't find a red chimney house for me... Klein nodded solemnly and said,
"I will pay close attention to this matter. Once the target takes action and exposes himself, I will inform you immediately."
"Well, Mr. Azik, how can I inform you in time?"
In Klein's opinion, if Azik was a descendant of Death, or if he had some connection with Death, his strength should be close to that of the Corpse Collector Sequence. He definitely had the means to create something similar to Daly's messenger.
In other words, this could prove whether Azik was related to Death, or if he was "His" descendant.
Azik took a puff of his cigar and thought for more than ten seconds. He took out an accessory from his left sleeve.
It was an exquisite, ancient copper whistle. There were many strange patterns that filled it with a mysterious charm.
"This is an item I carried with me when I woke up in Backlund. As long as you blow it, you can summon a messenger that belongs to me."
...
The Tussock River ran through Backlund, leaving behind many docks.
Jane Grant, or should I say, the present Jane, was wearing a black hooded robe as she slowly walked down the inner river liner.
She saw people coming and going at the harbor. Countless workers were sweating as the scene was bustling and noisy.
Just as she was about to sigh, she heard a deep sigh from behind her, revealing her inner thoughts.
"Long time no see, Backlund."
Jane couldn't help but look back. It was a man with a head of blue seaweed and a bishop's robe of the Church of Storms.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Sensation
chapters.content:
Chapter 234 - Sensation
Bishop of the Church of Storms? From the airfield, he should be a sailor who has been drifting out at sea for extended periods of time... The captain of an official private ship?
With her foresight from more than a month of experience on the Future, Jane made a judgment.
However, she didn't pay too much attention to it. She quickly retracted her gaze, got her bearings, and left the harbor.
As for the bishop, he didn't seem to notice her sizing him up, as though she didn't exist at all.
At this moment, Backlund, which had no sun, was once again covered in dark clouds and drizzling.
Out of the harbor, Jane frowned and took out an umbrella from her luggage. Then, she quickly circled to a nearby street, and her body turned corporeal from its previous nearly transparent state.
Then, she stopped a rental carriage and admired the Backlund Street scenery in the drizzle as she headed for the Bravehearts Bar in the Bridge area.
She was still wanted by the Church of the Lord of Storms, so it wasn't suitable for her to visit Ebner openly.
Furthermore, she had agreed to help Nina and Frank buy some materials when she returned, but her understanding of the Backlund Beyonder circle was limited to Maric and Sharron. That was why she came to them first.
It was already eight in the evening by the time they entered the noisy bar. With a Spirit Medium's sensitivity towards the undead, Jane was able to acutely notice several zombies with just a few glances.
Upon seeing this, she didn't head to the bar counter to order some drinks. Instead, she pulled down her hood to reveal her true face. Following that, she circled the boxing ring and prepared to leave. She waited for Miss Sharron or Maric to appear on the carriage outside.
At this moment, the door to the billiard room creaked open. Kaspars, who was wearing a linen shirt, limped out with a newspaper in hand.
His turbid eyes glanced over when he suddenly saw a familiar figure. He subconsciously rubbed his eyes as though he couldn't believe it. Following that, he exhaled and asked,
"Miss, how may I help you?"
"There's no need for that for the time being. I'm only here to meet an old friend," Jane said with a warm smile. She naturally recognized the old man. Back when she had just become a Beyonder, she had entrusted him to call her over to Ebner.
As she spoke, she saw that the newspaper she was holding was News at Sea. On it was a rather eye-catching title:
"Shocking! Admiral Pale killed the kingdom's navy admiral and has a bounty raised to 20,000 pounds! He's officially listed as a pirate admiral!"
Admiral Pale... I heard from Captain that she seems to be an upright and stubborn lady who seldom kills... How did that navy admiral provoke her?
Jane was surprised, but she didn't show it. She just nodded at Kaspars, walked around the crowd, and pushed open the door to leave the Bravehearts Bar.
Kaspars looked at her back and rubbed his temples. He couldn't help but mutter to himself,
That fellow, Ebner, became a famous detective in Backlund in a short period of time. The girls he knows aren't simple either...
"Miss Xio's reputation as an Arbiter is very famous in East Borough, the dock area, and the bridge area. It's said that she's very powerful.
The lady who disguised herself as a man last time even made Maric very afraid...
"As for this Miss Jane, I remember that she was only a weak young lady two months ago... But just now, just a casual look at me made me feel out of breath..."
...
After leaving the house, Jane boarded the rental carriage from before and cast her gaze out the window, waiting for Miss Sharron to appear.
Of course, she had already conveyed her desire to meet through the zombies. She believed that they would respond regardless of their willingness.
Silently, Jane's spiritual perception was triggered as she turned her head to look at the window. On the glass that could reflect the night, a young lady wearing a small black bonnet and a gothic regal dress clearly appeared.
Turning back, Jane saw Miss Sharron sitting opposite her. Her pale blonde hair, blue eyes, and pale face looked no different from before.
"Good evening, Miss Sharron," Jane greeted her. She had received a few days of her education, so she was rather familiar with her.
Sharron bowed in return and said simply,
"I sense danger from you."
So Maric didn't dare to come over to meet? Jane immediately understood what Sharron meant. She vaguely explained, "I had some fortuitous encounters after I went out to sea."
Sharron nodded slightly and didn't ask further. She asked in an illusory voice, "Why did you come?"
"I need the items on this list. It's best if they can be prepared within two days. I can pay an additional ten to twenty percent." Jane didn't beat around the bush as she took out a piece of paper and handed it to Miss Sharron.
Sharron took it and looked at it carefully before saying, "Eight hundred pounds. One hundred pounds is the handling fee... In addition, you have to pay an advance of one hundred pounds."
"Deal!" Without bargaining, Jane handed over the money. After all, this wasn't for her to buy things for herself.
Sharron put away the gold pounds and looked quietly at Jane with her blue eyes. "In two or three months, Maric and I will launch a counterattack against the indulgence faction..."
"Pyromaniac!" Before she could finish her sentence, Jane interrupted her. She asked in a cold voice, "Will that werewolf be here too?"
"Tyre was definitely there!" Sharron said with certainty.
"Then, you must inform me before you take action! I'll give you the method to summon my messenger later," Jane said in an emotionless tone.
The werewolf had torn apart her mother and destroyed her family, forcing her father to sacrifice his life in exchange for a chance of survival...
The scene of that night was still fresh in her mind. If not for the indulgence faction having a demigod protecting them in Backlund, she would've long killed the Werewolf with her own hands.
"Alright!" Miss Sharron looked at Jane quietly, her blue eyes void of emotion.
...
In the villa at Cherwood Borough's Kingst Street, after having dinner, he had wanted to return to his study to read, but at that moment, the gray fog appeared before his eyes once again.
A moment later, Ebner, who received Mr. Fool's reply, fell into deep thought.
The final destination of the second Baron Lamud was some ruin in the Underworld? It's no wonder the Augustus family went through the effort to nurture a descendant of Death. After all, in that place, only a descendant of Death can succeed...
Baron Kilgor died during the previous mission? Was he replaced later? It's no wonder that the second Baron Lamud would fall out with his good friend...
"Concerto of Light and Shadow. I remember that this item appeared in the original. It was bestowed to Brigadier General Qonas Kilgor by the king...
Could it really be forged from the Beyonder characteristic of Kilgor's ancestor? However, I remember that the item also has the Beyonder characteristic of the Arbiter pathway mixed in...
Could it be that Kilgor finally saw through the kingdom's intention of silencing him, and he perished together with the person in charge of monitoring him? That resulted in the formation of this item with two pathway characteristics?
After making random guesses, Ebner discovered that the Knowledge Keeper potion showed no signs of digesting. Clearly, his "acting" had failed.
Sefirah Castle is indeed a "hidden" place. There's no feedback from "guarding" it... Perhaps I can find a chance to talk to Mr. Azik in person?
With a sigh, Ebner put away his regret and began his fixed studies every night. As a Beyonder of the Reader pathway, "studying" was a daily occurrence.
...
Just as Ebner received the news from Mr. Fool, a man covered in black spots in an old warehouse in the factory district suddenly stirred and stood up.
An ancient gem pendant hung from his sleeve. He had previously obtained it from a member of the Secret Order.
The gem pendant naturally swayed before pointing in the direction of Cherwood Borough.
"Sefirah Castle..."
The man let out a hoarse whisper, his tone filled with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Prelude
chapters.content:
Chapter 235 - Prelude
"Sefirah Castle!"
After saying this word, the black spots on the man's face miraculously peeled off, revealing a handsome face.
After a few seconds, the man's brown eyes became lively and no longer as rigid as before.
Sefirah Castle is indeed the nemesis of my corruption... Just using some of the remnant aura on this pendant to stir the power emitted by Sefirah Castle has allowed me to temporarily regain my lucidity...
The man, who still had some dark spots on his cheeks, muttered to himself before checking his condition. He then said thoughtfully,
That cursed item that possesses me seems to have been corrupted by something of an extremely high level. It actually reached a strange balance with the underground corruption in my body... That's why I have the chance to control my body...
"Aston, my decision back then was correct. After sleeping together in this era, we finally have the possibility of escaping the corruption..."
After ranting for quite a while, the man looked in the direction of Cherwood Borough once again and said with some regret, "Unfortunately, Sefirah Castle disappeared after an instant. We didn't manage to pinpoint its exact location...
But it doesn't matter. The direction is correct...
"Aston, you can't wait to meet me again, right?"
...
Backlund, in a villa at the harbor.
The Machinery Hivemind and MI9's high-ranking members sat on both sides of a long table in the hall, quietly waiting.
And at the seat of honor, there were three chairs, and now two of them were occupied. They were the Church of Steam's archbishop, Horamick Haydn, and a Saint wearing a golden mask from MI9.
A few minutes later, Deacon Ikanser walked in from the outside. He took off his hat, pressed down his fluffy but not soft hair, and sat in the first seat on the left. His hands were already occupied by the members of the Machinery Hivemind.
Opposite him, diagonally across him were MI9 high-ranking officers. They had all been summoned by the Backlund archbishop, Horamick Haydn, and the military saint for a meeting.
The archbishop, who was dressed in a white priest robe, looked like an ordinary old man. He glanced at the empty seat beside him and asked the military saint, "Why hasn't His Excellency Snake arrived yet?"
"The Church of Storms seems to be searching for Vice Admiral Hurricane's whereabouts recently. Perhaps they've been held back by something," the golden-masked military demigod said with a chuckle.
Archbishop Horamick looked at his watch again and nodded. "It's time. Since His Excellency Snake hasn't arrived yet, let's not wait for him. We can report the results to the Mandated Punishers after the meeting."
With that said, he looked around and gently said,
"Let's start with Ikanser. Tell me in sequence about the investigation over the past few days."
Ikanser Bernard pulled at his hair, took out the ancient silver mirror, Arrodes, from a special pocket in his clothes, and placed it in front of him.
Upon seeing this mirror, the members of MI9, who had experienced the previous incident at the dock area's workshops, subconsciously swallowed a mouthful of saliva. Only Kance Leerhsen, who was seated for the first time by the military saint, sized up the silver mirror in puzzlement. He didn't understand why his colleagues would reveal such serious expressions.
As Ikanser flipped through the thick documents, he succinctly reported,
"Your Grace, Your Excellency, we are in charge of the missing members of the Secret Order and the dock area. After a thorough investigation and with the help of the corresponding Beyonder methods, we have confirmed that 1-025's target is a person named Regence from the Secret Order... To be precise, he bought an antique from Constant City. As for the other members of the Secret Order, they were only implicated.
According to the information provided by the Church of Storms's high-ranking deacon, Mr. Stuart, that antique was even exchanged from the Antigonus family's notebook... Although Regence regretted it greatly afterward and even sent someone to Tingen to retrieve the lost notebook, he didn't succeed.
However, even if it was just a spur of the moment, it also means that the antique isn't simple. Otherwise, how could a high-ranking member of the Secret Order stationed in Loen so easily make such a decision?
At the mention of Stuart, Ikanser suddenly sighed. This gentleman was actually quite a nice person. Back when he was punished by Arrodes's lightning, it was the other party who had treated him... Unfortunately, he hadn't reminded him out of some psychological reason, which completely destroyed his reputation among the two Churches and the military.
Regardless, Mr. Stuart's "sacrifice" pointed us in the direction of our investigation. Otherwise, we wouldn't know what 1-025 really cares about... Ikanser slowly exhaled and continued his report.
"As for the investigation of the dock area and the factory district, the situation isn't ideal. As the personnel flow is too high, we are unable to accurately know who disappeared recently..."
Horamick listened quietly and muttered to himself, "It can't always be like this in the dock area and the factory district. It seems like the necessary reforms are necessary."
"That's something that requires the Cabinet and parliamentary gentlemen to consider." The military saint shrugged. Then, he signaled to Kance with his eyes to report on the progress of his side.
Upon seeing this, Kance stood up and bowed. Then, he solemnly reported,
"We have also obtained preliminary results from our investigations of the identity of the target of 1-025's possession. As 1-025 was lost in Delaire Forest, the target of its possession should be around there. And the black spots on its body, as well as the characteristics of a Gatekeeper, we guess that it's the result of a Beyonder from the Corpse Collector pathway losing control... Therefore, it's very likely that it possesses a demigod corpse of the Corpse Collector pathway in an ancient tomb.
"After further investigation, we narrowed down the target to three.
"First, more than a hundred years ago, a Beyonder named John once lived in the town of Conva. The hotel in the town was built according to his specific style... According to our investigations, although there are no Beyonder traces, this building has an extremely strong ritualistic style.
"As for this man named John, his whereabouts were unknown, and he might've died near the town of Conva.
"Second, it was Baron Conva before and after the Battle of the Violated Oath. This baron's fief was around there, and he died in an extremely bizarre manner. His castle and fief were buried by a landslide... However, this baron only had the strength of a Mid-Sequence Beyonder when he was alive, so it's unlikely that he affected 1-025. Therefore, we don't think it's very likely."
"The third is the captain of Duke West's guard, who was at the same time as Baron Conrad. The records say that the duke's wife went missing, and the duke sent his captain to search for her, but she also disappeared in Delaire Forest."
After hearing him, Archbishop Horamick pondered for a moment, looked around at the members of the gathering, and concluded,
"...From the looks of it, we haven't fully grasped the situation. There are three things that cannot be confirmed. First, 2-111 previously indicated that 1-025 possesses a very high level of intelligence. Therefore, is the one controlling that body 1-025 or the body's consciousness? Second, what is the antique that the Secret Order member bought? What's so special about it? Third, what is its goal! Since it has intelligence, it can't be doing things based on instinct like before."
2-111 referred to the magic mirror, Arrodes.
Everyone fell silent as they considered the archbishop's question.
At this moment, the golden-masked military demigod suddenly said,
"Kance, ask 2-111 who's controlling that body?"
Is it finally my turn to perform? Your Excellency previously asked me if I was willing to sacrifice myself because you need me to use a Sealed Artifact?
So that's how it is. From the looks of it, the negative effects of this Sealed Artifact can be very painful... That's why my colleagues were so afraid just now.
Looking at his superior and then at his colleagues, Kance's blood boiled. He stood up straight and replied,
"Yes, sir."

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Approaching
chapters.content:
Chapter 236 - Approaching
"What a good lad..." the golden-masked military saint praised approvingly. Then, he looked at Archbishop Horamick and asked with a smile, "Your Grace, what do you think?"
Although they had communicated beforehand, this was, after all, a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact. He had to ask a symbolic question to show his respect.
Horamick Haydn subconsciously drew a triangular Sacred Emblem on his chest and said benevolently, "The Lord will bless you, child."
With that, he looked at Ikanser, signaling him to briefly explain how 2-111 was used.
After receiving the hint, Ikanser looked at Kance with pity and forced a smile.
"As an MI9 officer, you should've heard of Sealed Artifacts and know that they have certain negative effects.
"The side effect of Arrodes is that it will raise a question to you in an equivalent manner after answering your question... If you can't answer it, you will be punished by it... Of course, it sometimes asks you to do certain things... But believe me, directly accepting the punishment is the best choice."
So that's how it is. From the looks of it, the question posed by this mirror is very high-end, to the point that most people can't answer it. That's why they're afraid of its punishment...
However, since I've already made up my mind, I'm not afraid of the pain that punishment will bring me. Those questions don't mean much to me.
With this in mind, Kance's gaze became even firmer. He walked around the long table, took two steps forward, and carefully observed the silver mirror out of curiosity. He discovered that, apart from the strange patterns and the two-eyed attire, there was nothing special about the Sealed Artifact... So, he retracted his gaze and asked solemnly, "Your Eminence, please tell me how to use it."
"There's nothing special about it. All you have to do is touch its surface three times and respectfully ask him questions... In addition, the entire process has to be watched by others... If it's just you, it won't answer any questions," Ikanser answered without elaborating.
"I see." Kance nodded, but he was mumbling inwardly. Why does someone have to be watching? What's wrong with him? Does this mirror enjoy excitement?
For some reason, he suddenly had a bad feeling...
However, the arrow was already on the bowstring, so he didn't have the time to think too deeply about it. He took a deep breath, picked up the ancient silver mirror, and gently stroked it three times with his right hand.
"Honorable Arrodes, my question is, who is in charge of 1-025's possession?" Kance asked according to his superior's instructions.
The surface of the silver mirror shimmered slightly, quickly outlining the scene of a man with black spots covering his face lowering a simple gemstone pendant.
Then, Ikanser, the nearby deacon of the Machinery Hivemind, and the MI9 officers saw the black spots on the man's face gradually peel off, revealing a handsome and mature face. And in the void behind him, there were three colors—blood, black, and gray.
At this moment, under the influence of the blueprint, all the members of the Machinery Hivemind and MI9 inexplicably guessed the truth—
The man in this scene was restrained by the power of three different colors and regained control of his body.
At this moment, the scene in the mirror jumped and presented an external scene. It was a scene of a factory building in a drizzle, as well as the Tussock River which was potholed by the rain as it silently flowed past the factory district.
At this point, the scene changed once again. On the banks of the slightly turbid Tussock River, several tramps hiding under the bridge under the heavy rain suddenly turned into dolls before being sucked into the illusory "door."
Right on the heels of that, the scene changed once again. This time, the lights of a bar that operated at night suddenly went out. Then, the "door" opened once again, and several black figures entered. The bar fell completely silent...
"...That factory seemed to be a factory district? 1-025... No, that possessed man is actually still in the factory district?" Ikanser frowned slightly. "Unfortunately, I can't recognize which factory it is. Otherwise, I could've gone to capture it now... However, the three colors that Arrodes displayed should represent three different powers. And with the three powers balanced against each other, the one leading the body might very well be the original personality of the possessed corpse."
He quickly analyzed it with a standardized sentence, but he thought in surprise,
Arrodes seems to be in a good mood today... It actually gave so many details... No! I can't let my guard down. The more it gives, the more terrifying the questions it raises in the future.
On the other side, Kance said in surprise, "That person's appearance after the black spots peeled off... Is he Baron Conva from 700 years ago? I saw his portrait when I was reading the documents!"
"Baron Conva? From the looks of it, the so-called mudflow that buried the castle was very problematic. He must have quite a secret!" the golden-masked military saint said thoughtfully.
At this moment, Archbishop Horamick Haydn suddenly said, "I just compared those scenes... I discovered something. The first and second scenes might very well be what happened now or just now... And the latter two should be things that have yet to happen!"
What didn't happen? That's right! It's the rain in the scene! In the past few days, it's only drizzling tonight... And in the last two paintings, the tramp on the bridge was clearly hiding from the heavy rain. Then, this scene might very well be the scene in the latter half of the night or the next few nights!
And there aren't many people in the bar for the final portrait. It should be almost dawn...
"If Arrodes really gave the scene in the order of time... then I'll boldly guess that the latter two paintings most likely happened between dawn."
Ikanser, who was most familiar with Arrodes, instantly made a guess and judgment.
Everyone in the hall, including the two saints, nodded slightly when they heard this. Archbishop Horamick stood up and said in a rare serious tone,
"If that's really the case, then it's obvious that Baron Conva is constantly moving west from the factory district! He might be looking for something... But he clearly has the corruption of a high-ranking existence. We can't let him go no matter what! The bridge area and the Cherwood and West Borough are currently in danger!"
The golden-masked military saint nodded. Just as he was about to issue an order, Arrodes grew impatient from waiting. Bloody words appeared on the mirror's surface.
With a skip of his heartbeat, Ikanser immediately felt that the mirror might be angry. He once again looked at Kance in pity and lowered his head in guilt.
At that moment, Kance also understood that he was about to face a "problem." He pulled himself together and looked at the mirror.
The blood-like words squirmed and quickly formed a question:
"Why were you dressed in female clothes the day before your sixteenth birthday?"
With a hum, the color in Kance's face drained as it flushed red.
...
At nine o'clock at night, in the gardened villa in Cherwood Borough, Ebner was verifying a type of ritualistic magic according to the description of the Book of Dead. But suddenly, the wall of spirituality he had set up was touched, so he could only stop and open the door to the study.
Standing outside the door was Mr. Skade. He said apologetically, "Detective Bryan, I'm sorry to disturb you... However, it's your friend, Miss Fani, who is visiting..."
"Fani? At this time?" Ebner looked at his watch, feeling extremely surprised. However, since the other party had braved the rain so late at night, it was obvious that he had something urgent to tend to.
As expected, once they reached the first floor, Ebner saw Miss Fani, who had been drenched by the rain and wore an anxious look on her face, quickly walk up and say,
"Ebner, something happened."
"Don't worry. Take your time. Urging won't solve the problem..." Ebner comforted her before asking in a deep voice, "What happened?"
"Emma told me about a tomb of a great noble from the Fourth Epoch... She wanted me to leak some information..." Fani said incoherently.
"Did someone discover the tomb, only to disappear shortly after returning?" Ebner asked calmly. He didn't panic, because such an outcome was "normal."
"Yes... You can even deduce that?" Fani composed herself and looked at Ebner with surprise and admiration.
That's because there's no need to make any deductions... Ebner sighed and comforted her once again, "Don't blame yourself too much. They should've thought of the risks before exploring the tomb..."
"I'm not blaming myself... It's just that just a moment ago, the bar where the gathering was held was jointly sealed off by the Machinery Hivemind and MI9! I-I'm worried..." Miss Fani said uneasily.
A joint seal? For the first time, Ebner frowned.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: All Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 237 - All Here
Joint Seal? Just a few Beyonders disappeared after investigating the mausoleum. Logically speaking, the officials shouldn't have had such an intense reaction...
Furthermore, if the officials were really investigating the matter regarding Amon's mausoleum, this lady in front of him wouldn't have had the chance to appear...
After working with Cullen, Judi, and the other Barrens, Ebner knew what the official Beyonder teams were like. If they really wanted to obtain information, they wouldn't stand on ceremony with the low-level Beyonders at the gathering. After all, as long as they were caught, there was always a way to get them to speak.
After pondering for a moment, Ebner deliberated over his words and asked, "Fani, were you at a gathering? Which bar? How did you get out?"
Fani took a sip of the black tea that Ebner had specially gotten his servant to prepare. After stabilizing her panic, she replied,
"After I received the Barbarian potion formula you gave me, I've been attending various Beyonder gatherings over the past few days in a bid to purchase the core horn crystal of the Earth Rhinoceros...
That gathering was held at the Dragon Tooth Bar, 22 Tucker Street near the bridge area... The level of this gathering isn't low, and it's even possible for high-level Beyonders to participate. Therefore, we received the news before MI9 and the Machinery Hivemind arrived, allowing us to leave in time...
Yes, my carriage encountered a team from the Machinery Hivemind and MI9 before it left that street... I recognized two of the members, so I confirmed their identities.
Upon hearing this, Ebner interrupted, "You weren't stopped or questioned?"
"No..." Fani shook her head. She had just realized that something was amiss, so she hesitantly guessed, "My carriage was borrowed from a friend... Perhaps it's because they know the emblem on the carriage?"
Although I don't know exactly what Miss Fane's identity is, I think it has something to do with the officials. The friend she mentioned shouldn't be someone of low status. It might even be about the same as Miss Emma...
However, this isn't the reason why the officials don't conduct inspections or stop us from interrogating them... For them to so easily allow the Beyonders of the gathering to leave, it means that the officials aren't here for them at all, but for that bar... Or perhaps there's something near the bar that they're more concerned about!
1-025? Devil dog? Or Qilangos? No, Qilangos doesn't have that much face. The investigation of the Devil dog was mainly done by the Nighthawks and the police...
Could it be that the official "prophecy" or "divination" had found traces of 1-025, so they had set up the surveillance in advance? Arrodes was used?
Of course, it might also be some other case that I'm not sure about...
With this in mind, Ebner briefly shared his thoughts with Fane. He only left out his guess about the official target.
Fani was already very convinced by Ebner's reasoning skills, so she was immediately relieved when she heard him.
But after relaxing, the lady quickly felt that her clothes weren't very comfortable. When she looked down, she realized that the cloth had clung tightly to her body due to the rain. It was rather uncomfortable.
She pursed her lips and pretended to be embarrassed. "Ebner, can I take a shower and hang the clothes here to dry... and stay the night?"
Ebner traced her gaze and looked away. He didn't feel embarrassed. After all, he had already admired this lady's figure when she was trying on the wolf armor...
However, when he heard Fani's request, he finally realized what was going on. He hadn't noticed it the entire time, but now he had a vague feeling that he might have been tricked by her.
Since Fani could recognize the members of the official team, there was a high chance that the other party could recognize her! Even if the officials had matters to tend to and didn't have the time to bother with her, it was very likely that they would find out why the young lady had traveled by carriage at night...
That's why she came to me, and not to look for her more trusted Emma, right? Is she using me as a scapegoat? When the investigation is done, there's an eighty percent chance that she would say that she's meeting me privately, right?
Of course, I can't eliminate the possibility that this lady was hot-headed and found someone familiar without any hesitation...
Although he was a little speechless, he wasn't a petty person. Furthermore, with his special status, the officials wouldn't cause him any trouble over such a trivial matter. Therefore, he tacitly accepted Fani's request and nodded. "I'll get Mrs. Skade to prepare some clothes and a guest room for you."
Furthermore, the rain outside was getting heavier, and he could hear sounds inside the house. It was indeed unsuitable for him to continue heading out.
Then, he pondered for a moment and added, "Don't do it again."
Regardless of whether the young lady understood him or not, Ebner got up and greeted Madam Skade. Under her surprised gaze, he briefly told her about Miss Fani's stay and asked her to prepare it.
"Thank you for taking me in, Ebner." Miss Fani got up and curtsied with her illusory dress before following Mrs. Skade to the guest room.
After settling the uninvited guests, Ebner returned to the study on the third floor, intending to sleep after reading some more books.
However, the moment he entered the study, he acutely noticed something disharmonious. His heart skipped a beat. One had to know that the study was connected to his secret storage room. Some mystical items, extra charms, and Beyonder ingredients were sealed there. He had set up many ritualistic magic and curse traps.
And for someone to bypass his arrangements without being discovered by him meant that something was amiss. Therefore, he immediately became extremely wary. Not only did he activate the Eye of White, but he also wore the Ring of Light and Hand of Wisdom glove.
At that moment, a black fog suddenly filled the study. Then, a beautiful figure slowly appeared at the source of the fog. It was none other than his classmate, Jane Grant.
"Ebner, it's me... Heh heh, why do we get so nervous every time we meet?" Jane looked at the wary Ebner and joked.
That's your problem... Who asked you to appear in the same way as the female ghost every time you come, always in the middle of the night...
Ebner lampooned inwardly as he carefully sized up Jane. He discovered that this lady had changed quite a bit from when they met at Enmat Harbor more than a month ago.
Her hair has grown longer, and the color has become even darker. It's almost out of the "golden" category... However, her temperament has softened, and she's no longer as cold as before. It's a good change.
Seeing that the other party was only looking at her and not saying anything, Jane deliberately circled around and asked in a teasing tone, "Which one of us is more beautiful?"
You're prettier, but Fanihas a better figure.
After this thought popped up in his mind, Ebner shook his head without answering the question. Instead, he asked, "Jane, when did you come back?"
Jane didn't press further. She had asked in order to eliminate the unfamiliarity that she hadn't seen in a long time. She closed the distance and replied with a smile, "I just arrived in Backlund today and came to see you.
"I originally wanted to suddenly appear to scare you, but I never expected that I would be so well-hidden that even I was detected... You really are very powerful."
After learning that the visitor was Jane, Ebner no longer felt puzzled that his ritual had been so easily seen through.
After all, he had set up the Book of Dead at the core of the study, the book with special powers. And Jane was clearly more familiar with the book, so she was able to easily bypass the traps.
However, Ebner was even more curious about Jane's method of hiding herself. After all, even his White Eye hadn't been able to see through her hiding method.
Since he didn't see it, there was no way to "analyze" it, so he didn't learn it.
"Did you drive some invisible spirit just now?" Ebner asked, unwilling to give up.
"It's a spirit with an extremely weak presence. I borrowed some of its powers... and it's here now." Jane covered her mouth and chuckled.
Upon hearing this, Ebner carefully checked it a few times, but he failed to find anything. All he could do was give up.
The White Eye's efficiency at analyzing Spirit Bodies was indeed very low.
After a silent sigh, Ebner and Jane talked about their experiences over the past few days.
"You actually went through so much in a month... It's no wonder you were given the title of 'Hero Detective,' even though it sounds a little fake now..."
Ebner's experience made Jane worry at times, sometimes holding her stomach, sometimes angry, sometimes sad. Finally, she sighed.
Ebner held his forehead and said in a speechless manner, "Since you know the details, stop mentioning that title."
"Although those weren't your intentions, from the outcome, and from the perspective of the victims, you can live up to the word 'hero.'" Jane first gave an affirmative answer before changing the subject.
"Ebner, did you write to ask me about the Ancestor's tomb because of Baron Conva who was possessed by 1-025, as well as the very unique internal structure of the Old John Inn in Conva Town?"
"That's right... It's mainly because I feel that I seem to have some special fate with 1-025. I might encounter it one day, so I want to know more about the person it possesses," Ebner nodded and said seriously.
After pondering for a moment, Jane deliberated and said, "Regarding the exact situation of the adventure, I can't tell you because I signed a contract with that important figure... I can only tell you the following...
First, the ancestor's mausoleum isn't in the Underworld, but deep within Calderón City in the spirit world! The effects of the ruins in the Berserk Sea are similar to the ritual building built by the Baron of Conva Town. It's just that after Emperor Roselle's renovations, the passage there is more stable and two-way.
Heh heh, even if that Baron Conva, who might be my ancestor, successfully completes the ritual, allowing the mausoleum to temporarily overlap with Calderón City's tomb, it's still possible to enter and not exit...
Roselle? He really did enter Ancestor Jane's mausoleum! In that case, the Death card might very well be there... I wonder if it's in Jane's hands or Bernadette's... Yes, it might very well be the latter. One of the reasons why she sent Jane to explore that ruin was probably because of that Card of Blasphemy.
However, "He" is sleeping deep in Calderón City? Could it be another contingency of Death? I remember that when I was talking to Klein, it was said that Death might have other hidden trump cards...
Just as he thought of this, he heard Jane continue,
