"Second, I guess that Mr. John, who built Old John's inn more than a hundred years ago, might've succeeded... This is because I found his corpse and spirit in my ancestor's mausoleum... Heh heh, that Book of Dead actually originates from him. Along with that book are his diary entries. The content recorded in the diary matches what you said about Old John.
"I guess that the inn originally had more underground buildings. That was the main body of the ritual, but after a brief overlap with the ancestor's mausoleum, it self-destructed.
"Third, I ultimately failed to enter the main hall of the Ancestor's mausoleum, so I don't know the exact situation inside... I don't know exactly who 'He' is either..."
I remember that the baron's diary mentioned that the illegitimate child he gave himself and Lady Aston had been named "John." Could it be that the illegitimate child had lived for centuries and had finally waited for the best opportunity more than a hundred years ago to successfully enter the mausoleum... In the end, he died there because he couldn't come out?
Not necessarily. There were many generations of Loen father and son who shared the same name. It was also possible that they were the descendants of the illegitimate son, John.
As her thoughts raced, Ebner sensed Jane calling her ancestor, so he repeated solemnly, "'Him'?"
"Yes! 'He'! That's the only thing I can confirm." Jane nodded heavily.
Ebner fell silent for a moment and didn't ask further. He looked at the clock and saw that it was almost noon. Thinking that Jane no longer had a home in Backlund, he said with a smile,
"It's late today, let's talk tomorrow... Hmm, I can only trouble you to stay in the study for the night..."
Jane was still wanted by the Church of Storms, and her identity couldn't be exposed, so it wasn't appropriate for her to implicate the ordinary couple. There was no way to arrange a guest room.
"It's fine. This sofa in the study is very comfortable." Jane didn't mind. The conditions at sea were much worse than here.
After that, he secretly brought some food and beverages from the kitchen to the study before bidding Jane goodnight and returning to his bedroom to get some rest.
However, it seemed like many things were destined to happen tonight. Just as Ebner was changing into his pajamas and preparing to go to bed, there was a sudden knock on the glass of the bedroom. Xio's wet figure was pressed against the window from the heavy rain.
What's going on today? Could it be that there are still girls meeting at night in the true meaning of the Wheel of Fortune?
Ebner couldn't help but lampoon. Then, having no choice but to resign himself to his fate, he got up from the bed, opened the window, and let Xio in.
"Ebner, I was urgently summoned by MI9! But I have a bad feeling."

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Layers of Preparations
chapters.content:
Chapter 238 - Layers of Preparations
"Urgent recruitment?" As Ebner asked, he handed a pillowcase to Xio, allowing her to wipe the rain that kept dripping down her hair.
"After becoming a Sequence 7 Interrogator, MI9 gave me another badge for emergency contact..." Xio received the pillowcase and didn't mind it. She randomly wiped her messy blonde hair and wiped away the excess water. Only then did she take out a cracked badge and showed it to Ebner. Then, she continued, "It was destroyed after receiving the conscription order."
"It should be a one-time use Beyonder item for communication... Using such an item to send out emergency conscription... It might be very dangerous!" After using the White Eye to analyze it simply, he said with a serious expression.
At the same time, he thought of how the Dragon Tooth Bar at the Fani Gathering had been sealed off by MI9 and the Machinery Hivemind. There had to be a connection between the two.
Could it be that the two official organizations failed to capture the target despite using so many hands and ended up letting the target escape, so they summoned a large number of people to perform a search?
That's not right. From the urgency of the conscription... Perhaps something unexpected happened...
Xio pursed her lips and nodded. She said seriously, "I also have a bad feeling... So when I passed by your house, I thought of coming up to borrow the Solomon gold coin."
Xio and Fors's new rental apartment was also in Cherwood Borough, not far from the gardened villa on Kingst Street.
Didn't you think of pretending that you didn't hear the conscription? What a silly girl with a sense of responsibility and justice...
Ebner secretly sighed, but he quickly did a mental calculation.
If MI9's target was really Baron Conva who was possessed by 1-025, then Xio's trip would probably be very dangerous!
Ignoring the terror of the cursed item itself, just the underground corruption from the baron's body alone is something Xio can't withstand if some of it leaks...
Yes, MI9 might've summoned so many external staff to prevent the corruption from spreading!
If I, unfortunately, guessed it right... What should I do to help Xio?
It's unrealistic to follow them personally. Ignoring the fact that this is a secret mission of the official organizations, my appearance as an outsider will definitely attract attention.
The Demoness's invisibility could fool Low- and Mid-Sequence Beyonders, but it couldn't fool a demigod powerhouse...
Even if I were to really obtain the tacit approval of the military and the Church of Steam, I wouldn't have the ability to resist a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact and underground corruption...
Originally, Xio and Fors had explored the ancient castle, and after being corrupted, they had relied on Mr. Fool to use Sefirah Castle to kill the poison...
Eh? That's right! I can't do it, but that doesn't mean that Klein can't! Besides, if I remember correctly, the Feast of Blood records the secret deed ritual. Mr. Fool should've learned how to use it to stir the power of Sefirah Castle ahead of time...
With this in mind, he confirmed with Xio once again, "Was the gathering place in the conscription notice you received near the Dragon Tooth Bar on Tucker Street?"
"It's indeed not too far away," Xio replied after some thought.
Following that, she saw the solemn look on Ebner's face. She couldn't help but ask, "Ebner, do you 'know' something again?"
Ebner nodded and without hiding anything, told Xio all the information he knew about 1-025 and Baron Kanga. Finally, he couldn't help but persuade her,
"If you head over now, you might very well encounter 1-025. It's very dangerous! It's best you don't go!"
Xio pursed her lips, clearly hesitant. However, her eyes quickly turned firm as she looked straight into Ebner's eyes and said,
"Ebner, thank you for the warning and advice...
"But that golden-masked superior of mine has not treated me shabbily. I can't run away because of the danger when he needs my help.
"Besides, I have many friends living in the bridge area. I can't forgive myself if I throw them into a hopeless situation because of my fear of danger...
Also, if I had to retreat from the possibility of danger, how could I have the courage to continue exploring the truth of my father's grievance? My father in the Goddess's divine kingdom wouldn't agree either...
Finally, once I go against the order, I'll probably be severely punished by MI9. I might even have to flee again... That way, not only will it be difficult to know the truth of my father's injustice, but even my mother and brother might be implicated as a result.
Upon hearing Xio's decisive confession, Ebner suddenly recalled what Klein had said to Danitz before he saved her at Bansy Harbor...
They're all people who use "light"! As expected of the future Miss Judgment! However, Xio seems to be much more mature than her former self. I wonder if she's good or bad...
After feeling poignant inwardly, Ebner didn't try to persuade her otherwise, because he sensed Xio's determination.
Therefore, he directly took out the Solomon gold coin and the revolver he had obtained from the Everlasting Life Society, which could shoot silently, and handed it to Xio.
"Take these with you. Don't be stingy when it's necessary."
With that said, Ebner quickly set up a ritual in the bedroom. He took off the Ring of Light ring he always wore and placed it in the corresponding spot.
"What are they doing?" Xio asked in confusion as she looked at Ebner's actions.
As Ebner continued setting up the ritual, he replied, "I'm preparing the Holy Blessing ritual. It can augment you with a Sun domain's purifying halo that can exist for a long period of time. If you really encounter evil entities, you can rely on the halo to avoid their attacks."
Of course, the most important thing was to maintain the "livestream" channel on Sefirah Castle for a long period of time.
As he thought this, he set up the ritual items and made Xio stand in the corresponding spot.
As a series of incantations were recited in Hermes, Xio's surroundings were dyed gold. Layers spread outwards, but they quickly converged, leaving only a thin layer clinging to her body.
Seeing that the ritual had succeeded, Ebner hurriedly wore the Band of Light ring on Xio's finger and said with a smile, "This way, as long as you wear it, you can maintain the halo of purification. You don't have to worry about the side effects of the ring before the ritual's effects wear off."
Xio looked at the Band of Light on her fingers and pursed her lips again. After a long while, she looked up and said solemnly, "Thank you, Ebner. I'll definitely bring them back safely."
Don't flag me, how inauspicious would that be? At this moment, should I say something child-like?
When he saw Xio about to leave through the window, he hesitated for a moment before calling her back. He asked with a stern expression, "Xio, do you trust me?"
"Of course," Xio replied without any hesitation before asking curiously, "Why do you ask?"
"Do you still remember the honorific name recorded in the Feast of Blood?" Ebner asked instead of answering.
"Yes." Xio was taken aback as she nodded.
"If... I mean if you are in a hopeless situation, then recite 'His' name!" Ebner emphasized, implying something.
Xio's eyes widened when she heard that, but they were already very close to the final moment of the gathering. She didn't have the time to ask in detail. All she did was nod heavily and say, "Got it!" before jumping out the window.
Seeing her disappear into the night rain, Ebner looked away.
Then, he sat down and leaned forward, his hands clasped in a praying position as he held them to his forehead.
He chanted softly in Hermes,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era, you are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog. You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.
"I pray for your attention; I pray for you to listen;
"I pray for you to protect Xio Derecha and protect her from completing tonight's mission..."
...
After the prayer, Ebner packed up his ritual items and removed the wall of spirituality. Then, he opened the bedroom door and walked towards the study in the corner of the third story.
Even though he had received Mr. Fool's response, he was still worried about Xio. He planned on following her personally just in case.
However, as it might be detected by the military and the Church of Steam, he decided to seek Jane's help after some thought.
Back when Jane was live streaming the sea battle outside Pritz Harbor, she had successfully used a special spirit to avoid the demigod's senses.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Urgency
chapters.content:
Chapter 239 - Urgency
Tingen, 2 Daffodil Street. In the bedroom that was completely shrouded in the night.
Klein, who had been tossing and turning for a long time before barely falling asleep, suddenly heard a buzzing sound in his ears. He opened his eyes in a daze despite his already light sleep, and his muddled mind turned dizzy for a few seconds.
Someone is praying to me... Hmm, there's a warm feeling coming from the back of his hand... At this moment, this familiar feeling... Could it be that "Tower" is exorcising Miss Xio again?
Klein stared blankly at the clock in front of his bed for a long time before realizing what was happening. Then, he got up and stretched his back in an unglamorous manner.
Please don't tell me to "come online" and watch the broadcast... Although I can learn quite a bit of mysticism knowledge every time, I have to warn "Tower" to let him know that Mr. Fool isn't that happy about this.
Although he was cursing inwardly, Klein still stood up to confirm if the bedroom door was locked. Following that, he sealed the room with a wall of spirituality. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and recited the incantation before arriving above the gray fog.
In the towering palace that looked like a giant's residence, his figure suddenly appeared at the very end of the long bronze table. The first thing that appeared in his eyes was a pulsing crimson star.
Klein raised his right hand and emanated his spirituality, touching the star that symbolized the "Tower."
With a boom, he saw a distorted and blurry scene. He saw Mr. Tower in his pajamas, sitting on the edge of the bed that seemed to be drenched by the rain. His hands were clasped as he held his forehead.
This bedroom looks very familiar! Indeed, Mr. Tower is the man who was always with Miss Xio in the middle of the night... That man might very well be Detective Ebner Bryan.
Klein found evidence once again to confirm his theories. He pumped himself up and listened carefully for a while, quickly figuring out the matter that Mr. Tower had requested of him.
A Grade 1 Sealed Artifact?
The "newly unearthed" baron from 700 years ago who was corrupted by an unknown existence?
The Machinery Hivemind and MI9 joint operation...
Miss Xio is actually going to face these terrifying things? It's no wonder Mr. Tower was worried and even asked me to protect her at the cost of ten Roselle diary pages...
It wouldn't be a big problem if it's just to help take a look, but if Miss Xio really encounters danger, how am I to save her? Write to Mr. Azik? But how am I to explain this to Mr. Azik?
As his thoughts raced, Klein used his spirituality to touch the crimson star that symbolized Miss Xio.
Light and shadows changed as a scene quickly appeared in front of him.
It was Mr. Tower presiding over Miss Xio's ritual!
Eh? This ritual doesn't seem to be solely to maintain the purifying halo. It seems to be hinting at a mysterious existence... Wait, could that mysterious existence be me?
Just as Klein thought of this, he saw Mr. Tower call out to Miss Xio before she left, hinting at the honorific name hidden in the "Feast of Blood."
I understand! Mr. Tower had secretly set up a delayed "secret deed" during the operation just now. And once Miss Xio recited The Fool's honorific name, she would immediately point the target of the secret deed to me and complete the ritual!
Was he afraid that I wouldn't respond to his request, so he made additional preparations, allowing Miss Xio to gradually bond with me through a secret deed while in dire straits and then provide her with help?
What a brilliant method. Tower really is a master of ritualistic magic.
As Klein reflected on the matter, he also had some ideas about how to protect Miss Xio. He recalled the contents of the secret deed ritual recorded in the "Feast of Blood," and he reached out to take out the Morning Star necklace from the junk pile.
The gem on the necklace came from a dragon at the demigod level. Although the power it could use was only at Sequence 5, its level allowed it to borrow the power of the gray fog.
Retracting his gaze from the five-colored gem, Klein thought for more than ten seconds before answering the "tower" prayer.
"Got it."
After vaguely giving an answer, Klein once again spread his spirituality to Miss Xio's star. As he watched the livestream, he also observed her physical condition and Spirit Body.
It looks like I won't be able to sleep the entire night... If this goes on, my hairline will have to rush to work.
...
Backlund,
After Xio arrived at the gathering point at Tucker Street, she was arranged by a woman in a golden mask to meet her at a house on the corner of the street.
At this moment, the golden-masked woman said to the secret agents in a clear voice,
"A very terrifying monster was trapped in Sealed Artifact 1-010 by His Excellency and the archbishop of the Church of Steam. However, although 1-010 can seal space, it has many entrances and exits like a maze... This house is one of the exits.
"That terrifying monster has the ability to create Blesseds. Once its Blesseds break out of the encirclement formed by the Machinery Hivemind and MI9, escaping the blockade of 1-010 and possess the residents of the surrounding streets, there's a chance that the monster will escape!
"Therefore, your mission is to guard this exit and kill everything that escapes!
"Don't be stingy with your Beyonder weapons. The military will reimburse you for everything you spend tonight."
A detective asked with a serious expression, "Ma'am, what kind of monsters are the enemy?"
"Anything is possible. Perhaps it's a person, a cat, a goat, or even a puppet, kitchenware, and so on. Of course, most of them are dead spirits and zombies," the lady with the golden mask said in a deep voice.
The five secret agents, apart from Xio, wore nasty expressions when they heard that. This was because their Sequences weren't very high, and they had never encountered anything that dangerous before.
The woman in the golden mask took in their expressions and attitudes as she nodded to herself. She thought to herself that these people were indeed powerful detectives in the periphery. Although they were afraid, they weren't flustered... Especially the lady named Xio Derecha. She was the calmest and wasn't tall, but she had pretty good guts.
After secretly making an assessment, the lady in the golden mask surveyed the crowd and said,
"You don't have to worry too much, because I'm the main force here. All you need to do is hold back the other monsters when I'm free.
"Besides, you only need to stay here for an hour. The reinforcements will arrive in an hour."
The moment she said that, the few detectives heaved a sigh of relief.
And at this moment, several mutated "monsters" stormed out of the house covered in blood.
...
Inside the sealed Dragon Tooth Bar, the archbishop of the Church of Steam and Machinery's Backlund diocese, Horamick Haydn, looked at a member of the Machinery Hivemind who was running over to report while panting. He asked in a serious tone,
"How's the situation?"
"The first batch of MI9 reinforcements have arrived. They've temporarily stabilized the situation... However, Your Grace, 1-025 seems to be able to turn any item into rabbits, cows, pigs, and other animals without any restrictions. It can also make these animals rapidly reproduce before making them degenerate and mutate into monsters... And after those monsters are killed, they will become zombies or dead spirits, still under their control... This can't go on!" the Machinery Hivemind member wiped the blood from his face and hurriedly reported.
Horamick Haydn frowned when he heard that. He looked at the military demigod beside him and deliberated before saying, "Your Excellency, are we still unable to find the exact location of the baron who was possessed?"
"I can only confirm that he's trapped in these two sealed streets! But as for where he is, even if I controlled 1-010, I wouldn't be able to sense it," the military saint said regretfully as he shook his head.
"Then I'll give you another half an hour. If your subordinates don't discover her location in half an hour, I'll report this matter to the Mandated Punishers and Nighthawks and get them to reinforce her," Horamick said after a moment of thought.
"Half an hour? Sure!" The golden-masked military saint hesitated for a moment, but he still nodded.
...
At the same time, just as I flew out of the house with Jane, Ebner suddenly saw a lady in a beige ruffled dress rush over to the gardened villa on Kingst Street in the heavy rain.
"Fors?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Intense
chapters.content:
Chapter 240 - Intense
Fors was rushing towards Gunsted Street in a hurry, but to her surprise, someone called her name. She looked around hurriedly, but she didn't see anyone.
But at that moment, a figure suddenly descended from the sky and appeared in front of her.
This unexpected development frightened Fors so much that she took a few steps back and nearly fell to the ground.
Only when she placed her hand on her forehead and barely covered the rain in front of her did she realize that the figure was the person she was looking for, Ebner.
Upon seeing this, Fors's face revealed a look of pleasant surprise. Ignoring her sorry state, she went forward and grabbed Ebner. "Xio left in a hurry. The more I think about it, the more I feel that something might've happened to her! That's why I came to you for help..."
Before she could finish her sentence, she was interrupted by Ebner. "I know, I'm going to find her now!"
"You know?" Fors was taken aback at first, but she quickly reacted. After wiping the rain from her face, she pleaded, "Take me with you! You know that with me around, there's always a safe way out."
With that said, she even waved the bracelet that only had three stones left.
Ebner looked at her and did some mental calculations. Finally, he nodded and said, "Follow us then."
"All of you?" Fors blinked in confusion, wondering if she had heard wrongly.
It was only when she was lifted into the air by a strange spirit did she realize that there was a woman whose face she couldn't see clearly beside her.
...
In front of a house on Tucker Street, as several monsters rushed out, the lady in the golden mask pushed out her right palm as though she had sensed something. She said in ancient Hermes,
"Imprison!"
In the blink of an eye, the monsters that were about to charge at her, Xio, and the other spies froze on the spot. Surrounding them were layers of transparent walls.
"Attack!" the lady ordered the five detectives in a cold and indisputable tone.
By then, Xio had already reacted. She held the revolver that could shoot silently in her hand.
The others were the same.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
The five of them opened fire one after another, accurately hitting the monsters in the head.
Their skulls were torn open by the bullets as blood and milky-white blood splattered in every direction. Their bodies rapidly degenerated into blobs of disgusting flesh and blood.
The other four detectives heaved a sigh of relief and smiled. For the first time, they felt that this mission might not be as difficult as they had imagined.
Only Xio widened her eyes and suddenly retreated.
Due to her ability of the Ring of Judgment, the image of the blob of flesh suddenly exploding appeared in her mind.
And the truth was the same. Just as she retreated, the blobs of flesh expanded at a shocking speed. They even broke through the golden-masked lady's "Imprison" and attempted to jump towards the crowd.
When the lady saw this scene, she frowned and thought in puzzlement, Flesh bomb? Why would a Blessed created by 1-025 use the means of a Rose Bishop? Could it be that someone from the Aurora Order is secretly involved?
I have to inform the admiral of this information as soon as possible!
With this in mind, she didn't hesitate any further. She extended her right hand again and pointed in the direction of the house. She said in ancient Hermes,
"Exile!"
The expanding flesh and blood immediately encountered a majestic and invisible force as they were blown away, smashing into the building's interior.
Right on the heels of that, the blobs of flesh that had expanded to their limits exploded. Balls of flesh and blood transformed into a storm that swept the surroundings, quickly eroding the walls and other areas into deep, black marks.
When the four detectives saw this, they felt a sense of fear and shame. They were afraid that if the lady from MI9 hadn't taken action, they would've probably perished from the explosion.
The shame was that they, who claimed to be knowledgeable, had actually committed such a low-level mistake. They were so pleased with themselves that they forgot their bearings before confirming that the enemy was completely dead.
As for Xio, seeing that her "prediction" didn't really happen, she wasn't disappointed either. She carried her revolver and returned to her previous spot. After observing for a few seconds, she said, "It's not over!"
Xio clearly remembered the relevant knowledge of the undead that Ebner had briefed her on that night. And the surrounding atmosphere and feelings were very similar to the scene of the birth of the undead as described by Ebner!
Furthermore, the lady leading them had previously mentioned that their enemies included zombies and dead spirits!
Indeed, after the flesh exploded, illusory and ethereal figures surged out from the house again. Instantly, they gathered into a five-meter-long Spirit Body that looked like a combination of cows and sheep. It also had a pair of wings on its back.
The Spirit Body seemed to be very afraid of the lady in the golden mask. The moment it took form, it flapped its wings, wanting to soar into the air and open up a distance from the Beyonders in front of it to ensure its safety.
Unfortunately, the lady was already prepared for this. She pushed out her right palm and declared in ancient Hermes,
"Flying is prohibited here!"
Suddenly, the gigantic Spirit Body's wings seemed to be bound by something invisible. It began flapping with great difficulty, unable to move its body any further. It only flew less than half a meter before landing on the ground.
In its anger, the bull-horned monster that had just taken form immediately let out a Shriek, but just as it opened its mouth, a ball of Fire of Light accurately poured into its "throat," instantly blocking the Shriek.
It was a demon hunting bullet that contained the Fire of Light that Xio had shot.
— as an accessory to the revolver, provided by Ebner out of friendship.
The masked woman gave Xio an approving look. Then, while the Spirit Body was screaming from the fire of light, she solemnly said,
"Evil spirits are prohibited here!"
The evil spirit's body immediately trembled when it heard that, as though it was being attacked by an invisible force.
However, although it wasn't strong, the level of its Spirit Body might be relatively high. This kind of influence that directly targeted an existence was quickly suppressed by it.
At this moment, the golden-masked lady's expression turned extremely solemn as she said a sentence formed in ancient Hermes,
"Violators should be punished!"
Then, she pushed out her right palm and waved it down. She said with a cold tone,
"Psychic Piercing!"
Just as she said that the Interrogator's Psychic Piercing powers seemed to receive an unknown boost. It immediately made the goat-headed undead's thoughts turn sluggish before turning extremely confused. It was difficult to use Beyonder means.
No matter how powerful a Spirit Body that couldn't use Beyonder powers was, it was only a target. Soon, it dissipated under the barrage of MI9's myriad of demon hunting bullets.
...
In the ancient palace above the gray fog, Klein, who was sitting at the end of the long, mottled table, watched Xio use her revolver to shoot a demon hunting bullet that was equivalent to a Sequence 7. He couldn't help but sigh.
How extravagant! Such demon hunting bullets are much better than the ordinary demon hunting bullets the company gives out... I wonder if Mr. Tower prepared them for Miss Xio...
If that's the case, can I ask him to buy some spare ones in the future?
However, I'll have to wait until I successfully open a smurf account at the Tarot Club... After all, Mr. Fool doesn't need those things.
After a few "sour" words in his heart, Klein cast his gaze on Miss Xio's Spirit Body through the crimson star.
This was because he had just discovered that at the instant the goat-headed evil spirit was destroyed, Miss Xio's Spirit Body seemed to be corrupted by something black!
As for the others present, including the female powerhouse from MI9, none of them seemed to be so targeted...
Miss Xio... Is there anything special about her?
Klein stroked his chin and slipped into deep thought.
...
In the street sealed by 1-010, a figure wearing full-body armor and holding a sword suddenly appeared on the roof of a house.
He was none other than Baron Conva who had been jointly hunted by the Church of Steam and MI9.
"The aura of Sefirah Castle!"
After muttering to himself, the baron steered a massive Spirit Body and flew towards the exit where Xio was.
...
Meanwhile, in the Dragon Tooth Bar, the military saint suddenly stood up and said to Archbishop Horamick in pleasant surprise,
"1-025 has finally appeared!"

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Sparring and Separating
chapters.content:
Chapter 241 - Sparring and Separating
"1-025 has finally appeared!
"It's flying towards the exit that symbolizes the Blue Planet."
Although the military saint was rather surprised, he didn't act rashly. Instead, he looked at the archbishop of the Church of Steam, as though he was seeking his opinion.
Horamick narrowed his eyes after hearing his words as if he was thinking about something.
After a few seconds of silence, he opened his eyes and said unhurriedly,
"It might also be a deliberate attempt to attract our attention... According to what I know, although there are many exits in the independent space sealed by 1-010, other than the Moon we are at, the other entrances and exits can't accommodate the powers of a demigod. There's no way to let it pass."
The military saint nodded and said in a suggestive manner, "That's right. That's why I want you to intercept it while I stay here."
Horamick glanced at him and said with a gentle smile, "It seems like you think it's more likely to come here? Is rushing to the Blue Planet only an illusion?"
In front of this experienced archbishop, the military saint didn't intend to hide his intentions. He simply said, "This is the only correct exit."
"From the looks of it, your military is hell-bent on getting 1-025? For this, you actually didn't hesitate to offend the Church of Storms..." Horamick gave him a profound look, but he didn't refuse. To him, the most important thing was to eliminate the threat that 1-025 posed to ordinary people.
"We need to use it to do something," the military saint replied vaguely and said no more.
Horamick nodded. Soon after, the skin on his legs automatically opened, revealing the abnormally complicated mechanical structure inside. Then, after a series of transformations, it formed a device similar to an airship's thruster.
Then, he soared into the air and flew out of the hole in the bar's roof.
...
Baron Conva, who was more than two meters tall and wearing thick armor, was surrounded by several evil spirits as he flew at an adequate speed.
Suddenly, his heart stirred. He chanted the words that seemed like an incantation, and then his body disappeared in midair.
Almost at the same time, the light of the Sun, which far exceeded normal standards, suddenly lit up. All the nearby Spirit Bodies that had yet to react didn't even have the chance to scream before they were obliterated by the energy of the Sun.
Baron Conva, who had appeared on the ground, frowned at this scene and muttered,
"Light of Holiness from the Priest of Light? That's not right. It lacks that holy and pure feeling. It's more like a simple release of energy... It should be the solar flare released by an Astromancer!"
"Astrologer? What an ancient title. We're all called astronomers now." At this moment, Horamick's figure appeared in midair. He looked down at the baron from above and wasn't in a rush to attack. Instead, he calmly said, "It looks like you're very clear-headed. Even if you've gone mad, you're still a clear-headed lunatic... How do I address you?"
He had previously learned the identity of the person possessed by 1-025 through Arrodes. Now, he was only asking to confirm and buy time.
The baron looked up and replied without a change in expression, "Benjamin Conva Grant... Just call me Baron Conva, His Grace the Archbishop of the Church of Craftsmanship."
"Lord Baron, do you know me?" Horamick asked with interest.
"The clothes of the Church of Craftsmanship haven't changed in 700 years... Hmm, the badge seems to be different from before," the baron explained simply. Then, he retracted his gaze and calmly said, "I have something important to do. If you want to stop me, please do it... For example, those things you hide in the clouds."
"I was discovered... As expected of a war hero who obtained an aristocratic title in the Battle of the Violated Oath," Archbishop Horamick said with a smile.
As soon as he finished speaking, a five-meter-long cannon suddenly extended out from the clouds. It was surrounded by electromagnetic waves as if it was preparing for a terrifying attack.
Boom!
An orange-red "beam" shot out from the cannon's mouth, instantly striking the baron who didn't seem to react at all.
The huge impact caused the ground to quake, and the surrounding houses collapsed, raising up a large cloud of dust.
After a long while, when the smoke and dust cleared a little, a paper figurine that had almost been burnt out returned to its human form in the crater.
However, the humanoid creature's armor was tattered, and most of the flesh on its body had been charred. Only with the protection of its face was it possible to tell that it was Baron Kangwa who had been attacked head-on.
"What kind of attack is that? Cough! Cough! Cough! Why haven't I seen it before?" The baron coughed violently as foul blood gushed out of his mouth. It was obvious that the attack just now had dealt him immense damage.
"That's the 'Super Electromagnetic Cannon' invented by Roselle. However, its technology has yet to be spread to ordinary people, and it's still under wraps... Of course, the saints can already restore Roselle's original idea."
At this moment, Horamick's leaking voice came from the other side.
The baron was stunned when he heard that. He hurriedly turned his head and saw that the archbishop of the Church of Steam was in a terrible state. Not only were the joints of his legs distorted, but even most of the mechanical structure of his head had also been destroyed. However, there didn't seem to be any problems with the main installation, and it was still operating normally.
Machinery dolls? When did the Church of Craftsmanship come up with such a method? Who's Roselle? The baron's pupils contracted when he saw this, as though he had encountered something unbelievable.
In his era, the Beyonder methods of the Church of Craftsmanship weren't that varied or terrifying.
Just now, he had connected the paper figurine that he had transformed into with the Cursed Artifact and suffered equal damage. He originally believed that with his outstanding survivability, he could easily let the other party kill him. But in reality, no matter how strong his physical body was, he couldn't beat the machine. After all, the other party could change parts on the spot.
"Speaking of Roselle, he's an impressive figure... Heh heh, if His Grace is interested, he can come to the Church as a guest. I'll talk to you about his deeds in detail." As Horamick invited him, he raised his right hand and unhurriedly fiddled with the exposed gear.
The baron fell silent for a moment. He took off his damaged armor and threw away his broken sword. Then, he stood up and said, "You don't look well, and I still have the ability to move."
However, before he could finish his sentence, he saw Horamick grip his left hand with his newly repaired right palm and suddenly twist it.
With a creaking sound, his left hand was bent at the wrist, but no bones pierced through his skin, bringing out flesh and blood.
There was a heavy, black metal tube embedded in his left wrist!
His entire left arm was a small-caliber mystical cannon!
Seeing that the cannon that didn't seem simple was pointing at him, the baron fell silent once again. He felt that he couldn't catch up to the times, so he didn't speak further. He directly summoned the bronze door in his body.
Unlike the other Gatekeepers, he didn't have any additional spirits in his body. All he sealed was his beloved—Lady Aston.
Although Horamick didn't know the exact details of the baron, his intuition told him that he couldn't let the baron complete his summoning. Therefore, he suddenly opened fire with the heavy metal tube in his left arm.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom...
Instantly, balls of flames engulfed the baron's body, shattering the door that was about to open.
However, Archbishop Horamick didn't let his guard down. Although the Baronet Conva in front of him was only a Sequence 5, the strange corruption on him, together with the help of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, made ordinary saints not as difficult to deal with as him.
As expected, just as Archbishop Horamick warily went forward to take a look, two streams of light suddenly shot out from the dust and smoke caused by the explosion and flew in two different directions.
One of them was the puppet formed by 1-025. At that moment, it seemed to have left the baron's body and was preparing to tear open the void and enter the spirit world. Unfortunately, due to the failure of 1-010's seal, it could only flee towards the Dragon Tooth Bar in a panic.
As for the other, it was a voluptuous female phantom. She hugged a head with some black spots on her cheeks and flew towards the exit of the Blue Planet.
...
Outside a house on Tucker Street, Xio and the other detectives, who had stood guard for nearly half an hour, repelled several waves of monster attacks. They were all panting from exhaustion, and the only thing worth rejoicing about was that no one was injured.
The lady in the golden mask was also covered in rain and sweat. Her spirituality could no longer withstand the battle.
Fortunately, the reinforcements from the military had arrived.
However, just as both sides finished their handover, Xio and company exhaled and prepared to leave, a female Spirit Body suddenly rushed out from the house's exit!

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Escaping Danger
chapters.content:
Chapter 242 - Escaping Danger
The newly arrived reinforcement team didn't panic when they saw this. The captain of the team who had replaced the golden-masked lady was also a Disciplinary Paladin. He raised his right hand and pointed at the Spirit Body hugging its head, about to chant the words "Imprison" in ancient Hermes.
But at that moment, the voluptuous female Spirit Body was the first to open her mouth and sing in the Language of the Dead!
Yes, it wasn't the commonly used means like Shriek, but a Singing of the Sea Songster.
In an instant, awkward, incomprehensible, jarring words that were completely incomprehensible came out of the female evil spirit's mouth in a strange rhythm.
Although they couldn't understand what she was singing, everyone present couldn't help but freeze on the spot. Even a transparent layer quickly surfaced on their bodies.
Everyone's souls were being pulled by an illusory power!
At that critical moment, the Band of Light on Xio's finger flashed with a blinding light. The purifying halo that originally clung to her body began to spread outwards layer after layer. White holy light warmed the surrounding MI9 detectives and also purified the evil forces in their bodies, giving them immense courage.
The two Sequence 5 Disciplinary Paladins present snapped to their senses immediately. Almost at the same time, they brandished their right hands and declared in ancient Hermes,
"The Language of the Dead is prohibited here!"
"Singing are prohibited here!"
After the announcement, the golden-masked lady, whose spirituality was nearly drained, almost lost her balance. She only managed to stabilize herself by holding onto the street lamp by the side of the road.
She took off her mask, revealing a young, handsome face. She then took out a bottle of medicine, unscrewed the cap, and downed it.
Elsewhere, after Xio's purifying halo had dispelled the effects of Singing, the baron's head in the female evil spirit's embrace suddenly opened its eyes. It stared straight at Xio as though it had locked onto something.
But at this moment, the reinforcements from MI9 had already begun attacking them.
Faced with the barrage of demon hunting bullets and Beyonder powers, the baron's face was once again covered in black spots that extended outwards. It was like black, cold armor that wrapped around his Spirit Body and Aston's.
Despite the attacks landing on them, they were unable to break through their defenses.
At the same time, the team members who were attacking, including the Disciplinary Paladin captain, suddenly realized that he had been bound by something without realizing it.
They looked down with great difficulty and discovered that the ones binding their bodies were actually their shadows!
"Commandeering Shadow? Black Knight? How is that possible..." the captain cried out in shock. But before he could finish his sentence, his shadow covered his mouth!
It wasn't his fault for making a fuss. After all, this exit could only accommodate a Sequence 5 existence, while the Black Knight was a genuine demigod.
No! It can't be a Black Knight! If the other party is really a demigod, there's no need to use such means to deal with us... But even if he's not a real demigod, such means aren't something we can resist!
The captain forced himself to calm down and think of countermeasures, but clearly, Baron Conrad and Lady Aston wouldn't give him the time.
After binding the team members with his shadow, a half-closed bronze door suddenly appeared above the baron's head.
Behind the open gap was endless darkness, like the deepest and heaviest night sky.
Indescribable pairs of eyes were hidden in the deep darkness, densely packed and everywhere, but they were unable to discern their actual appearance.
Skinless, bloody arms reached out as greenish-black vines with baby faces extended out. Palms with mouths filled with teeth grabbed everything outside as they screamed, laughed, sobbed, and yelled.
After releasing Lady Aston and leaving the seal of 1-010, the "door" in the baron's body once again sensed the entrance to the Underworld!
The bound captain and team members were powerless to resist. All they could do was watch helplessly as they were grabbed by the arms, entangled by the slippery, illusory tentacles, and bound by the greenish-black vines with baby faces!
Following that, they were dragged behind the door by these strange creatures within a second or two!
All of this happened too quickly. One second, the team was still attacking in unison, and the next second, they were bound by shadows and dragged through the door... Therefore, even the heroic lady and Xio didn't have the time to react.
Not to mention the other four detectives who were further away.
"Run! Run! This is not a monster we can fight against right now!" After the woman snapped back to her senses, she decisively issued an order. Following that, she endured her headache and forcefully released "Exile" on the baron and Lady Aston. Then, she activated a charm on her and quickly flew away.
The other four secret agents didn't dare delay when they saw this. They used their life-preservation items and fled in all directions.
The baron ignored them. His remaining head stared straight at Xio, and with the help of Lady Aston, he rapidly approached her.
A look of horror appeared in Xio's eyes. She thought that the purifying halo she had previously activated had angered the headless monster, which was why she had targeted it.
At that moment, a scene suddenly appeared in her mind.
The monster's head fell directly from above, instantly digesting her head and seizing her body!
Xio, who had been surprised many times, knew that this was a "foresight" scene given to her by the Ring of Prejudice. Hence, she used this ring to bring about her outstanding agility and speed as a Clown as she pounced to the back in an unimaginable manner.
"Eh?" Just as Xio rolled on the ground, the baron's head let out a soft exclamation. This was because he had just controlled her shadow, but he had failed to break through the protection of the Light of Purification she had augmented herself with.
That layer of Light of Purification seems to be related to some existence of a very high level... Is it Sefirah Castle? Is it?!
The baron's calm eyes gradually became fervent and crazy. He was determined to obtain the young lady's body.
Hence, before Xio could get up, she once again "predicted" danger. This time, the evil spirit had bound her with "wind," and the monster's head had taken her by the shoulder.
Upon seeing this scene, she didn't have the luxury of time to think. She immediately activated the Light of Holiness on the Band of Light ring. At the same time, she didn't get up and continued rolling backward with the help of the Clown's coordination.
Escaping wasn't an option. To avoid being bound by the wind, he could only attack the evil spirit and interrupt her casting of her powers.
The terrifying "black spots" appeared once again, blocking the hastily released Light of Holiness. However, due to another failure, the madness in the baron's eyes became even more obvious. It was unknown what he was chanting, but on the other side, Xio felt something indescribable explode in her soul. She immediately lost all her strength as two streams of blood flowed out of her nose.
At the same time, Mr. Fool, who was sitting in the hall of the gray fog, suddenly stood up. This was because he could clearly see that the black spot that had been corrupted in Miss Xio's spirit was rapidly spreading. In the blink of an eye, it had covered half of her head!
"Say that name! Miss Xio, hurry up and recite that name!"
Klein anxiously muttered to himself. He couldn't help but pull Miss Xio above the gray fog.
However, he didn't do so after calming down. Firstly, he didn't know if he could purify the area through the "secret deed." He didn't know what the outcome would be if he directly pulled someone up. If this place was corrupted and invaded, then he would lose his last hope.
Secondly, by touching Mr. Tower's crimson star, he discovered that the detective had already arrived near Miss Xio. Without a safe environment, Miss Xio would still be in danger even after the "tacit" ritual... It was better to "cleanse" the corruption after Tower saved her.
"There should still be time!" Klein, who was familiar with the deeds of the Hero Detective, relaxed a little and returned to his seat belonging to The Fool.
However, he was holding tightly onto the Morning Star of Depravity necklace and Azik's copper whistle, prepared to "rescue" them at any moment.
...
Just as Xio's thoughts slowed down and she felt that she was about to be finished, an illusory broadsword made of light suddenly stabbed into the ground in front of her, turning into a Hurricane of Light that swept outwards.
The baron's head, which had originally wanted to seize Xio's body, was forced to use "black spots" again by the storm formed from "dawn."
However, this time, the effects of the "black spot" seemed to be much weaker. It failed to completely block the might of the Hurricane of Light.
He was injured!
Upon seeing this, Lady Aston was just about to take action when she suddenly saw a black-robed lady aim a pitch-black ring at her with her right hand and command her with the Language of the Dead.
However, she was unwilling to follow orders to harm Benjamin, nor did she dare disobey the lady's orders. She could only fall into a dilemma and not move.
The person who had spoken the Language of the Dead was none other than Jane. She frowned when she saw this and said to Ebner, who was carrying Xio, "That spirit doesn't seem to be of a low level. My orders have been resisted, and I'm afraid I can't delay her for long."
Ebner knew that Xio was in desperate need for treatment and purification, and he couldn't afford any delays. All he could do was look at Fors who had rushed over with the two of them.
The latter immediately understood what he meant. Then, with a snap, he pulled a dark green stone from his bracelet. Then, he grabbed onto Ebner's hand and shouted in ancient Hermes,
"Door!"
The stone immediately emitted an illusory light blue glow.
Seeing this, Jane immediately understood what was going on. She quickly went forward and held onto Ebner's arm. The four figures turned blurry and almost invisible.
They saw forms that were difficult to describe. They even saw transparent objects that didn't seem to exist. They saw different colors, and lustrous splendors that contained immense knowledge.
This was the spirit world!
After three breaths, they left the transparent and illusory state and returned to reality.
Ebner looked around and realized that this was his bedroom.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Xio and The Fool
chapters.content:
Chapter 243 - Xio and The Fool
Outside a house on Tucker Street, Baron Conva watched helplessly as his target "Teleported" away.
After all, with only his head left, he didn't have the ability to move. At this moment, Mrs. Aston was still affected by Jane's orders and unable to move.
As for the residents of the nearby streets, they had long been evacuated by MI9 in various ways. He couldn't find anyone suitable to reconstruct his body.
About a minute later, Lady Aston shook off Jane's orders. She immediately picked up the baron's head, carefully hid her body, and flew towards the East Borough.
Not long after they left, an ordinary-looking, grizzled elder slowly walked out of the house that had been mostly destroyed as the exit of the sealed space.
He stared in the direction of the baron and Lady Aston as he muttered to himself thoughtfully, "It didn't cause any reaction... Could it really not be him?"
As he spoke, he cast his gaze towards the independent space created by 1-010. It was as though the Grade 1 Sealed Artifact's seal was useless against him.
The military obtained 1-025... Whose plan was this? That Tyrant actually tacitly allowed it...
Just as the elder was pondering over the matter, the MI9 elite team, who had rushed over after receiving the call for help, walked out of the exit.
They covered each other and advanced in turn, appearing very wary... But strangely, the elder was leisurely standing not far from them, but they ignored him as though he didn't exist.
...
In an unknown space, a mummy wrapped in yellow bandages was pierced by countless brown tree branches and suspended in midair.
Its stomach bulged, and from time to time, some parts bulged and shriveled, as though it was giving birth to new life.
The mummy's mouth was open as it kept screaming in extreme pain.
However, when 1-025, which was contaminated by the Primordial Moon, underground corruption, and the aura of Sefirah Castle, was sealed in a special puppet by the military saint,
Although the mummy continued to scream, its painful cries seemed to contain an additional, indescribable feeling.
...
In the bedroom of the villa on Kingst Street, after discovering that they had "Traveled" back to their bedroom, he placed Xio on the bed.
At this moment, Xio's condition was already very serious. The black spots rapidly spread at a discernible pace, covering her neck, shoulders, arms, and chest.
"Ah!" Fors subconsciously cried out when she saw this scene. She then thought of something and hurriedly took out a bottle of restorative medicine from her sling bag.
"It's of no use..." Ebner shook his head when he saw her actions. Then, he said to the two ladies behind him solemnly, "I'm going to hold a ritual for Xio to purify those black spots... Oh, please leave for a moment."
Time was of the essence, so he didn't care how suspicious his explanation was.
Jane guessed that there might be some secret that was inconvenient for her to reveal to them, so she glanced at him and didn't ask further. She only nodded and said, "Okay, call me if you need any help."
With that, she opened the bedroom door and walked out.
Fors came to her senses and looked at the black spots that were still spreading on Xio's body. She couldn't think of a solution as her lips quivered. Biting her teeth, she suddenly turned around and left the bedroom with Jane.
It wasn't that she didn't trust Ebner, but the situation reminded her of a similar plot she had once written in her novel. There were always tragic outcomes, the kind that she couldn't even see the last time...
Therefore, she was very worried and afraid.
"Believe in Ebner. He seems to have a high chance." Jane looked at Fors, who was in a daze and patted her shoulder in consolation.
After a short battle, the two of them had some ties.
"Thank you..." Fors barely composed herself and looked at the mysterious hooded lady in front of her. She politely said, "My name is Fors. Fors Wall... Ma'am, how may I address you?"
"Just call me Jane," Jane introduced vaguely, then changed the subject. "Miss Wall, are you the author of Stormwind Mountain Villa?"
Fors didn't hide the truth as she nodded generously. "Yes, have you read my book?"
"That's my favorite novel to read," Jane said excitedly. "Can you give me an additional character?"
"Huh?" Fors wore a blank look, puzzled as to why the mysterious and powerful Miss Jane would suddenly become so friendly.
Just as they were chatting, a female voice suddenly sounded from the stairs. "Who are you? Why are you here?"
Fors and Jane were alarmed as they looked in the direction of the sound. They saw a girl in pajamas with an excellent figure walking over with a lamp in one hand and a revolver in the other.
It was Fani who had been woken up by the conversation.
...
In the bedroom, after using his spirituality to seal the room, he leaned toward the bed and pressed Xio's shoulder. He quickly said,
"Do you remember what I said before?
"Quickly use ancient Hermes to recite that honorific name!
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era..."
Xio flipped her eyelids that were pressed down by the black spots, unable to move. Her mind raced with great difficulty, and she only reacted two to three seconds later. Following that, she chanted in a low voice without any hesitation,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"The mysterious ruler above the gray fog;
"The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck..."
Just as she said that Xio was surprised to see crimson starlight surge out of the void and sweep towards her.
Above the gray fog, in the towering palace that looked like a giant's residence.
Seeing Miss Xio finally recite her honorific name and activate the "secret deed" ritual that Mr. Tower had secretly prepared, Klein suddenly felt the entire mysterious space tremble. The motionless grayish-white fog began to flow!
The crimson star representing Miss Xio emitted a tidal-like illusory glow.
Countless beams of light condensed, turning into the blurry figure of Miss Xio. This figure seemed to be bonding with a great existence, allowing her to gain a wonderful Soul Body experience.
However, there were black spots tightly circling the illusory Miss Xio, making her look extremely uneasy.
As the "secret deed" ritual was about to be completed, Klein felt agitated by the "black spots." The grayish-white fog and the mysterious space above it clearly began to ripple with power!
Klein was temporarily unable to combine these powers with his own spirituality to create Beyonder effects that could exorcise evil spirits, but according to the mysticism knowledge recorded in the "Feast of Blood," he had long prepared another method.
Lowering his gaze, Klein's gaze landed on the Fallen Morning Star necklace in his hand.
Following that, he used his spirituality as a whirlpool to draw over the pried power from the mysterious space and directed it towards the necklace like a tidal wave.
The slight tremble above the gray fog became obvious. Specks of pure light intertwined and swept towards Klein, blending with his spirituality.
"Placate!"
"Summoning Holy Light!"
At the same time, Klein activated the two powers contained in the Morning Star of Depravity and transmitted them to Miss Xio through a secret deed.
With the augmentation of the high-level powers, the two powers were essentially close to God's Bestowment.
A few seconds later, he saw the "black spots" on Miss Xio's body and Spirit Body rapidly fade away. However, there were still some ominous marks. Klein hesitated for a moment before finally deciding to pull Miss Xio's Soul Body into the gray fog to perform a thorough "sterilization".
However, before he pulled her up, Klein carefully did a divination.
...
As indescribable beams of light surrounded her, Xio, who was about to lose consciousness, suddenly felt her thoughts turn much clearer. However, before she could think further, she heard a roar.
A second or two later, the terrifying roar vanished. She then saw herself in an ancient and majestic palace, sitting beside a mottled green table. Beneath her feet was an endless grayish-white fog, and in front of her was a towering figure looking down at her.
This scene was both unfamiliar and familiar to her. She had seen it once in a "dream," but it had never appeared again after she found Ebner to exorcise the evil spirit.
That purification was actually useless... He probably knew long ago... He had always believed in this mysterious existence? That's why he didn't feel that nervous when he heard that I had chanted that honorific name...
Or even... That might've been set up by him... I'm so silly. How could I have placed such a precious book of mysticism in my study? I never even suspected that...
So that's how it is. It's no wonder he suddenly knows so much despite being an ordinary public school graduate. It's as if he knows everything! He obtained knowledge here!
However, the Church of Earth Mother seems to think highly of him... Could it be that this mysterious existence known as The Fool is related to Earth Mother?
I wonder if there's a chance of figuring out my father's grievance?
Thoughts suddenly popped up in Xio's mind, but this was clearly not a good time to think. She pursed her lips, stood up, and bowed at the figure shrouded in gray fog.
"Are you... the great King of Yellow and Black?"
"You can directly call me Mr. Fool. Have a seat," Klein smiled and replied calmly.
Xio bowed again and sat down, confirming that she had escaped the state of nearly losing control.
She secretly glanced up and thought.
"Honorable Mr. Fool, what was that black spot?"
How would I know what that is? You're so close to "Tower," so shouldn't you ask him? Although there's no basis, I feel that he definitely knows.
As he lampooned inwardly, Klein said in a calm tone,
"Your spirit and body have been corrupted by some force.
"There's no problem now."
Xio stood up and bowed when she heard that. "Thank you for your help, Honorable Mr. Fool."
"There's no need to thank me. I'm The Fool who likes fair and equal exchange. The Tower has already paid the corresponding price for this," Klein said leisurely.
"Tower? Are you referring to Ebner?" As Xio asked, she was very touched. She couldn't imagine the price that Ebner had paid. After all, the target of the transaction might very well be a deity.
Is it really Detective Ebner Bryan? I've finally confirmed it!
Shrouded in the gray fog, The Fool laughed and nodded gently.
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Tower and Judgment
chapters.content:
Chapter 244 - Tower and Judgment
"Tower" is Ebner's code name, and the owner here is The Fool... Could it be a secret organization that uses the tarot card as its code name? And the leader of the organization is a god?
Xio counted the number of seats on both sides of the long table. After two seconds of silence, she said,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, can I join like him?"
Thankfully, I became a Clown... Sequence 8. Otherwise, I really wouldn't be able to afford the cost of you joining...
Klein secretly rejoiced as he leisurely chuckled.
"This is a gathering they organized themselves. It's organized by me.
"There are still seats available at the moment. You can join."
As he spoke, Klein smiled and pointed at the cards that suddenly appeared on the surface of the long bronze table. "They've decided to use the names of the tarot cards as their code names. You can choose one of them. The ones below already have an owner, so you can't choose..."
He had chosen Miss Xio to join the Tarot Club after some consideration. Firstly, through a few "live-streams" and "Recording" observations, he was certain that Xio was a kind, upright, and principle-oriented lady. Apart from often causing unnecessary trouble for Mr. Fool in the middle of the night, her character was trustworthy.
Second, Miss Xio is a spy from MI9, and she's very famous in Backlund's East Borough and the dock area. By joining, she can expand the intelligence support and resources of the Tarot Club. If he were to leave Tingen one day and head to Backlund, Miss Xio would be of great help to him.
Third, and most importantly, joining the Tarot Club was Miss Xio's own wish, and she wasn't forced. As an "evil god" during her entrepreneurship, she naturally had no reason to refuse.
After receiving the tarot cards that had been conjured, Xio didn't ask or speak further. She immediately took one out and flipped it over.
Her card depicted an angel with a trumpet and the deceased awaiting redemption.
The Judgment card!
Looking at the Judgment card in her hand, Xio was taken aback.
"This is in line with my expectations."
Shrouded in the gray fog, The Fool Klein nodded slightly and calmly said,
"Backlund time, gather here at three in the afternoon on Mondays. Make preparations in advance.
"At the gathering, you can exchange information, ingredients, formulas, and knowledge. You can also pay a certain price to entrust missions to other members."
Xio thought back to Ebner's work and rest and said in enlightenment,
"Yes, Mr. Fool."
"Alright, you can go back now." Klein felt the fatigue brought about by his lack of spirituality, so he didn't speak further.
Xio immediately stood up and bowed according to the descriptions in the religious rituals.
"Your wish is my wish."
Just as she said that, dark redness soared in front of her. By the time everything dissipated, she had already returned to the real world and was lying in bed with Ebner.
Subconsciously looking at her arm, she realized that the black spots had vanished. Xio sat up and saw that Ebner was sitting on a chair in front of her desk, smiling at her.
Xio looked around and realized that the room had been sealed by spirituality. Hence, she pursed her lips and didn't beat around the bush. She went straight to the point. "Ebner, are you Mr. Tower from that gathering?"
"Yes, that's the Tarot Gathering organized by Mr. Fool." Ebner nodded and explained. Then, he looked at Xio, who seemed to have thought of something, and he said with a smile, "I guess you also received your code name. Is it Judgment?"
"You guessed it again..." Xio sighed when she heard that. She asked with a complicated expression, "So, you were the one who arranged the Feast of Blood in the study during the banquet?"
"That's right. I recommended you to Mr. Fool, but some of the necessary tests are indispensable. Therefore, you need to establish a connection with Mr. Fool... Don't worry. That existence isn't an evil god. Instead, it's very benevolent and just. Besides, the Tarot Club is indeed a very good gathering. Your Interrogator main ingredient was bought from Mr. Hanged Man."
Since he had joined the Tarot Club, there was no need for him to hide this from Xio. After discussing what had happened at the Tarot Club, he finally concluded in a profound manner, "In short, with Mr. Fool's help, there's hope for the matter you wish to complete!"
Upon hearing this, Xio's eyes widened as she said in surprise, "According to your description, Mr. Fool is an important figure that's almost like a god. But having the support of such an existence is only hope?"
Ebner nodded solemnly and said, "That's also why I haven't told you the whole story."
"Do I have the right to know something only after becoming a demigod?" Xio recalled what Ebner had said when they were traveling together. She muttered to herself, "Father actually got embroiled in such a terrifying matter?!"
"Although he didn't delve deep into it, the level of the matter he discovered is indeed very high," Ebner said with certainty.
Xio exhaled and reined in her emotions. She then asked worriedly, "You... What price did you pay to get Mr. Fool to save me? I can help you share some of the burden."
"It's nothing. I just promised to collect ten pages of Roselle's diary for free for Mr. Fool in the next few Tarot Gatherings," Ebner replied with a smile. There was no hint of embarrassment in his tone.
For a mere ten pages of Roselle's diary, if he were to give up his integrity and randomly piece together some random code, it wouldn't take more than half an hour.
"Roselle's diary? Those Roselle manuscripts? Those are diary pages? Mr. Fool is collecting them? Wait..." Xio suddenly thought of Miss Audrey's penchant for Roselle's manuscripts. She suddenly looked at Ebner and asked hesitantly, "Could Miss Audrey also be...?"
Ebner replied with a smile, "When you told me that the lady was also collecting Roselle's manuscript, I guessed that she was Justice from the Tarot Club..."
"I remember that you sold the two pages to Miss Audrey through me... Could it be that you were testing me? Did you finally confirm it?" Xio asked thoughtfully.
Although that makes sense, I really didn't have any intention of testing Justice's identity back then...
After muttering to himself, Ebner said in all seriousness, "Justice did hand over two pages of the diary at that Tarot Gathering... However, I can confirm that her identity is actually a commission for the investigation of Vice-Admiral Hurricane."
The commission to investigate Qilangos also came from the Tarot Club? Xio quickly reacted. She never expected that she would unknowingly be deeply involved with the Tarot Club. Could this be Mr. Fool's observation and test of her?
"That's the investigation Mr. Hanged Man entrusted to Miss Justice..." Ebner simply recounted the details of the request to Xio.
"So, you were just fooling us with your reasoning about Qilangos's identity the other day? After that incident, Fors would always say that she was struck down by you and lost her spiritual perception, even though I know that it was just an excuse for her to delay writing..." Xio couldn't help but lampoon. After some thought, she asked Abna,
"Then, does Miss Audrey know of your identity?"
Ebner thought for a moment and felt that he should've been completely exposed to Klein, but Audrey and Alger were temporarily unable to associate themselves as detectives with the knowledgeable Mr. Tower. Hence, he replied, "She likely doesn't know."
"Then... when heading to Mr. Fool's palace, can you... disguise your height?" Xio asked with a conflicted expression.
After all, if I were to be recognized, it would probably be difficult for you to hide your identity.
After a moment's thought, he guessed what Xio was worried about. Hence, he said with a smile, "It's likely only our Soul Bodies that have stepped into Mr. Fool's kingdom... Yes, more accurately, it's our Astral Projection. Therefore, our image comes from our understanding of ourselves. It's about what clothes you wear in real life, and what clothes you wear in the hall above the gray fog."
This is proven by how everyone wears their clothes during every meeting. If it's just a pure mental image, I'm afraid we'll be seeing each other naked...
"That makes things easier..." Xio heaved a sigh of relief.
As he looked at her relaxed expression, he kindly reminded her, "Miss Audrey is already a Spectator. To fool her, you'll probably have to put in a lot more effort."
Miss Audrey was actually a Beyonder long ago? That's right. With the mysterious Tarot Club gathering as her backer, how could she lack formulas and ingredients... She had previously gotten Fors and me to bring her into the various Beyonder circles, probably to find a suitable excuse for herself to become a Beyonder.
Despite having such thoughts, Xio wasn't too worried. She was very confident in her disguise skills. As long as her height wasn't exposed, she felt that Miss Audrey, who she had only met a few times, wouldn't be able to recognize her.
Seeing how confident she was, Ebner couldn't help but think mischievously,
According to the past few Tarot Gatherings, Audrey seemed to be the same as before, trying to pull Xio and Fors into the Tarot Club...
Then here comes the question: What kind of mood does Miss Audrey have when she realizes her "arrangement" one day?
What kind of expression would Miss Audrey have when she eventually learned the truth?
Thinking about it makes me look forward to it...
Just as Ebner was lost in his fantasies and Xio was deep in thought, the wall of spirituality that sealed the room was suddenly stirred.
After regaining his senses and sensing for a moment, he realized that it was Jane who was knocking on the door. Only then did he remove the seal...
Then, he saw three ladies enter.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Dealing With The Aftermath
chapters.content:
Chapter 245 - Dealing With The Aftermath
It was only when the three ladies entered the bedroom that Ebner realized that Fani was there as well. After a moment's thought, he guessed that she had sensed the commotion on the third floor and had come up to take a look.
However, Ebner didn't request her to leave. After all, the monster that attacked Xio might very well have been Baron Conva from 700 years ago. As for Miss Fani, who had gone to dig up Xio's mausoleum with him, she could barely be considered someone involved. There was no need to deliberately hide it from her.
Furthermore, if this lady hadn't run over to mention what had happened at the Dragon Tooth Bar, he wouldn't have paid so much attention to Xio's emergency mission.
Elsewhere, Fors arrived beside Xio in a few steps. She pulled her up and sized her up a few times. Only when she confirmed that she was fine did she heave a sigh of relief. She couldn't help but hug Xio. Then, she pressed down on her shoulder and said with a stern expression,
"Xio, how can you directly carry out such a dangerous mission without telling me anything!
"You clearly told me that if I were to join you, there would be a safe way out."
Xio blinked and said, "Aren't I fine... However, Fors, your body is very cold!"
As Xio said that, she seemed to realize something. She turned her head to the side and changed the topic. "Ebner, can you help us find some clean clothes?"
Ebner froze for a moment before coming to his senses.
They didn't notice it in the pressing situation just now, but now that the situation has stabilized, they see that, apart from Fani, the other three ladies are in a sorry state... Especially Xio. Not only was her clothes drenched by the rain again, but she was also stained with dirt because she had been rolling on the ground while dodging the attacks...
They do need to change their clothes. It would be terrible if they catch a cold and fall sick... But at this time... How am I supposed to tell Mrs. Skade...
At that moment, Ebner realized that he didn't have enough powers to "learn." It would be much easier if he had powers like Hypnosis, weaving memories, and stealing memories.
After struggling for two seconds, Ebner nodded in resignation. Then, he went downstairs and knocked on the Skade couple's door.
Then, under the couple's incredulous gazes, he revealed his intentions for coming.
...
In the East Borough, in an independent house of a slave merchant, Baron Conrad shook his neck to get used to his new body.
And behind him, the illusory Lady Aston floated in midair, circling the baron a few times as though she was expressing something.
"Aston, I know what you mean. Although this body is weak, it doesn't stop me from using my powers..."
Lady Aston flew up and then abruptly landed.
"Are you telling me why I didn't divine the young lady's whereabouts? Heh heh, it's not that I didn't divine it, but I had already used the connection of the black spots to spy on her location fifteen minutes ago... Unfortunately, the black spots on her body have already been completely removed! That should be the power of Sefirah Castle!"
At this point, the baron's eyes once again revealed a fervent look, but he quickly suppressed it and regained his calm.
Lady Aston stared straight at the baron, her upper body swaying from side to side.
"What are we doing now? Heh, I'll be heading to the library after daybreak... I have to figure out what a Beyonder Electromagnetic Cannon is and who that so-called Roselle is!" the baron said through gritted teeth.
Mrs. Aston tilted her head when she heard that, but she didn't do anything else.
...
Bridge Borough, Tucker Street, Dragon Tooth Bar.
As the military put away Sealed Artifact 1-010, the street returned to normal. The houses that were originally destroyed by the monsters and evil spirits instantly returned to normal. It was impossible to tell how tragic the situation was like being bombarded with cannon fire.
The military saint was in a good mood as he placed a sealed puppet into a metal box and stored it in his suitcase.
At this moment, a stream of light flashed, and the Church of Steam's Archbishop Horamick descended from the sky while stepping on bright flames.
"You look a lot more 'new' than before..." The military saint sized him up and quipped with a smile.
He clearly knew the person in charge of the Backlund diocese of the Church of Steam.
"Previously, the damage to my body had already exceeded 60%. It's very difficult to repair... I could only use a spare one... This body was refined when I was still an Alchemist more than twenty years ago. My appearance was also the same as before, so I naturally appeared a little younger." Horamick didn't think much of it when he heard that, and he even explained a little.
"The mechanical dolls created by Alchemists are indeed magical..." The military saint praised before changing the subject. He asked curiously, "I wonder which of the dolls made from the Church of Earth Mother's Ancient Alchemist is more useful."
"Oh, I can only say that they have their unique traits. Ancient Alchemists are more inclined toward Alchemical Life, and they like to create golems and other creations. As for us..."
Just as Horamick said that he suddenly stopped and looked up at the west sky.
The military saint also sensed something at the same time and turned to look over.
Soon, strong winds blew towards the Dragon Tooth Bar from afar. The Cardinal of the Church of Storms, the Archbishop of Backlund, Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake, and a few Mandated Punishers flew over.
The saint from the military, "His Excellency Snake," nodded at the visitor without panicking at all and greeted him. Then, he heard Spellsinger of God's charming voice.
"Admiral, why didn't you inform me about the three-party operation?"
When the military saint heard the question, he replied unhurriedly, "That's because our military and the Machinery Hivemind discovered the whereabouts of 1-025 through 3-111 at the previous meeting... And you, the Mandated Punishers, were absent from that meeting."
"We were caught up with something..." For a moment, there was nothing he could say. His aura weakened a little, and it took him a while to explain.
But he immediately diverted the topic and asked again, "Did you get 1-025?"
At this point, Spellsinger of God felt that his tone was a little stiff. He added, "If you've already sealed it, I hope that you can return it as soon as possible... The Church of Storms will remember this friendship, and it will definitely repay you."
As soon as he said that, he swept his gaze between the Church of Steam's archbishop and the military saint. Finally, he stopped at the suitcase that appeared rather out of place.
Archbishop Horamick chuckled and replied gently, "I'm very sorry Your Excellency Snake. I wasn't able to stop 1-025... As for the admiral, I'm not sure. After all, I just returned."
The military saint held his suitcase and denied firmly, "I didn't see the Puppet either."
Ace Snake stared at him for a long while before nodding. "I hope you don't regret your decision today."
With that said, he walked out of the bar with the Mandated Punishers behind him. He helped the Machinery Hivemind team and MI9 evacuate the residents who had previously been evacuated to deal with the aftermath.
Despite being angry, he had to do something serious.
At this moment, Stuart, who had deliberately left bruises on his face without any treatment, came over and asked doubtfully,
"Your Excellency, we didn't attend the meeting previously. It's obvious that the military is behind it. I even found some evidence... Why didn't you show it just now?"
Spellsinger of God glanced at the elite deacon who had spoken, but he didn't say anything. All he thought was:
"Punk, I also know that I'm very suspicious, but... that's a revelation!"
Seeing that the Cardinal was avoiding the matter, Stewart frowned and decided to write to the Council of Cardinals.
...
In the bedroom of the villa on Kingst Street, under Mrs. Skade's seemingly veiled look of contempt, Ebner received the dessert and beverage she brought and placed it on the coffee table.
A few ladies who had just taken a hot bath and changed into their pajamas happily picked up their cakes and muffins after thanking her. As they ate, they talked about what had happened.
Of course, it was mainly Xio and Ebner talking while the others were listening.
As she listened, she became surprised. She suddenly said, "Ebner, could that monster with only his head left be Baron Conva?
"You managed to decipher the diary of the Baron? Why didn't you tell Emma and me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Susie’s Growth
chapters.content:
Chapter 246 - Susie's Growth
As soon as she said that, Fani noticed Xio and Jane looking at her. She blinked and suddenly realized that she had been questioned. She hurriedly explained,
"Ah, I don't mean to be dissatisfied, I'm just a little surprised... You should know that during the past few days, I've been going through all the books that I brought back from the tomb, but I haven't found any suitable passcodes..."
Hey, Miss. The descendant of the grave you dug up is sitting here. Although she had dug up her ancestor's mausoleum herself, she might not necessarily be willing to let others do the same...
After lampooning in his heart and seemingly pondering for a moment, he said to Fani, "I have indeed translated the baron's diary, but there's some knowledge that's very dangerous, and I can't tell you directly... How about this, forward what I've said to Ema. If she still wants to hear it after knowing, I'll find some time to tell her something less dangerous..."
Why did she say it to Emma instead of telling me? Fani wanted to ask, but then she thought of something and shut her mouth, reluctantly nodding.
Ebner could tell at a glance what she was thinking, but he didn't change his mind. Although Miss Emma was a believer of Storms and was reckless at times, she was much stronger than Miss Fani, who was often brainless.
Following that, everyone chatted for a while. Seeing that the sky had already brightened and that the rain had stopped, Fani and Fors bade farewell and went home to catch up on their sleep.
Xio had planned on seeking out MI9's superior to claim the demon hunting bullets she had spent the night before, but she was stopped by Ebner.
