"You want me to go with you to the Harvest Church? Why?" Xio asked in puzzlement when she heard Ebner's request.
"Although the matter of you being corrupted by the black spots last night seems to only be known by Jane, Fors, Mr. Fool, and me, there's no guarantee that the officials will use any means to restore what happened last night... Therefore, to be safe, let's go to the Harvest Church. This way, even if the officials pursue the matter, they will think that Earth Mother has bestowed God with grace to remove the corruption."
Ebner answered after some deliberation.
After Xio heard this, she stared at Ebner for a long while before asking hesitantly, "Ebner, wouldn't the half-giant bishop be angry that you used the Church of Earth Mother in such a manner? Also, what would Mr. Fool think?"
"Mr. Fool is a benevolent god. As long as it doesn't violate the rules set by "Him" there's no need to worry... As for the Church of Earth Mother, I believe Bishop Utravsky will help with this." Ebner wasn't too worried. With the attention and acceptance Earth Mother had given him, this problem wasn't a problem at all...
In fact, if not for the fact that he felt that he was courting death, he even had the intention of testing the bottom line of tolerance Earth Mother had for him.
Seeing how confident Ebner was, Xio didn't speak further and rode with him to the south side of the bridge.
On the way, Ebner spent two pence to buy a copy of the Daily Observer. Then, he saw the news about last night's bridge on the headlines:
"Shocking! The criminal planted many bombs in the Dragon Tooth Bar. The military is evacuating the nearby residents."
...
After arriving at the Harvest Church, there was no need to go into detail about the negotiations with Father Utravsky. The tolerant half-giant bishop readily agreed to Ebner's and Xio's request without even asking why.
It was worth mentioning that due to the actions of the military and the Machinery Hivemind last night, most of the Beyonder gatherings in the bridge area had been delayed. It was no exception for Isengard's, even if the Bravehearts Bar was on the other side of the bridge area near East Borough.
As a result, Miss Hazel, who had been looking forward to the gathering for days and had arrived early at the Harvest Church, was very disappointed. However, there was nothing she could do. All she could do was instruct Ebner to notify her when the gathering was scheduled.
After leaving the Harvest Church, Xio bade Ebner farewell. She planned on seeking out MI9's superior for reimbursement before rushing to Empress Borough to hand over the information regarding Qilangos to Miss Audrey.
Although she already knew that the lady was Justice of the Tarot Club, Xio still decided to complete the mission.
However, Xio also knew that her investigation results weren't of much use... Although she had reverse-investigated Qilangos's previous activity range and residence through the "missing" Darkholme, he definitely wouldn't stay in his original spot with the help of Creeping Hunger. There was even a high chance that he would change his appearance and become another person.
I hope Miss Audrey can deduce the purpose of Qilangos's visit to Backlund through this information... Xio couldn't help but sigh.
"In fact, it's more likely that Miss Justice will share the information you gave her at the next Tarot Gathering and get us to help her analyze it together..." Ebner said with an odd expression.
Xio fell silent. She mimicked Ebner's habit of stroking her forehead before weakly asking, "Did you figure out anything?"
Although I know the answer, I really haven't thought of how to analyze it... Besides, this matter was instigated by an organization that can't say its name. I don't dare to interfere.
With this in mind, Ebner shook his head and said, "When contacting Miss Audrey, take note of the golden retriever she rears... Don't mention the Tarot Club or Mr. Fool's name in front of it just because it's an animal..."
"Susie?" Xio frowned and said thoughtfully, "Is it really a magical creature?"
"Miss Justice once asked what would happen if a pet drinks the potion at the Tarot Club... And the suggestion we gave was to use its easily neglected traits to eavesdrop on some information," Ebner explained with a smile.
"I understand." Xio nodded solemnly.
However, she recalled the last time she met Susie. When she confirmed that, other than being a little reserved when she saw that the satchel on her was the work of the fashion designer, Mr. Sades, she didn't do anything ridiculous, she heaved a sigh of relief.
...
In the Hall family's luxurious villa.
Audrey was sitting on the sofa in her activity room, holding a letter opener and attempting to open the letter in front of her.
It was from her second elder brother, Alfred.
At that moment, she saw Susie push open the unlatched door and run in.
Susie sat on the carpet in front of Audrey and used her claws to take off her leather pouch. With great familiarity, she pulled open the zipper and threw out the documents inside.
"You really are an excellent messenger!" Audrey wasn't stingy with her praise.
Susie looked back at the door and vibrated the air before whispering,
"Your friend is very serious. When I saw her, I thought of the past... Yes, but she bought me some biscuits today. It suits my palate... Unfortunately, I didn't dare to eat it."
Susie, your Loenese is becoming more fluent... Audrey sighed inwardly, but on the surface, she praised her, "Very good. As a lady, you can't just eat the food that others give you."
Susie wagged her tail happily when she heard that.
Audrey wasn't in a rush to read the investigation report that Xio had submitted. Instead, she first opened the letter from her brother and began reading it with a smile.
After a while, Audrey put down the letter and happily said to Susie, who was guarding the door,
"The pituitary gland of an adult Rainbow Salamander is finally here."
"Woof?" Susie cocked her head in puzzlement.
...
Late at night, in a library in the North Borough, Baron Conva sat in the darkness, constantly scribbling as he compared himself to a book.
In front of him, the evil spirit, Mrs. Aston, seemed to be bored as it kept flying around.
Baron Conva looked up at her and comforted her, "Don't worry. After I verify Roselle's theory, I'll find someone to investigate the young lady's whereabouts."
When Mrs. Aston heard this, she paced around on the spot a few times.
"I promise this will be the last time... It's mainly because some of the theorems Roselle raised require new mathematical algorithms. I have to learn them again..."
After hearing the door that directly flew back into the baron's body, Lady Aston fell asleep.
...
Saturday morning, Tingen.
After dealing with the new case and learning the cause of John Maynard's death through mediumship, Klein informed Inspector Tolle the results.
The latter quickly passed on the information to the Member of Parliament's wife and sister, as well as the person involved in the matter, Madam Sharon.
The moment Klein, who had been permitted to leave, walked out of the room, he saw a woman being protected by a few gentlemen.
The lady was wearing a long black dress, and her skin was fair and smooth. Her brown hair was like a waterfall, and her brown eyes were as pitiful as a fawn's. It made one want to protect her involuntarily.
Madam Sharon... Klein suddenly recalled the porno that she had starred in. He hurriedly raised his right hand to cover his mouth and coughed dryly.
Following that, he cast his gaze to the side where three ladies stood.
One of them was a voluptuous, fair middle-aged lady. She wore a trendy regal dress, and she was none other than the wife of a deceased member of parliament. She was glaring at Madam Sharon angrily.
Beside her stood a young, relatively thin girl. The girl's face was covered in tears. At that moment, she was leaning against a beautiful woman with a scholarly air as though she was seeking comfort.
Seeing Klein look at the three ladies, the superintendent introduced them,
"That's Maynard's wife and sister... as well as his sister's public school teacher...
"Ma'am Leena."

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Jane and Xio
chapters.content:
Chapter 247 - Jane and Xio
Leena? It seems like Melissa was invited to a gathering by Elizabeth a few days ago. The reason is to welcome this female public school's new teacher...
I even divined if there was any danger because of this...
I heard that she came from Backlund?
Klein thought for a moment before recalling who this beautiful lady was. He habitually tapped his left molars twice and used Spirit Vision to observe the people present.
The color of Mrs. Maynard's emotions clearly shows her anger and her hatred... It's very similar to her external appearance...
Maynard's sister's emotions were a deep gray. Yes, she was very sad, but not very angry... Perhaps she had yet to react?
The colors of Leena's emotions were orange mixed with some red and blue. In other words, there was a hint of excitement and thought amidst the warmth.
Excited? Why so? Is there some personal grudge between her and Maynard? That's not right. Although she seems to be trying her best to comfort her student, her attention seems to be focused on Madam Sharon...
She must have had some sort of grudge against Madam Sharon, so she was excited to see her being insulted by Madam Maynard?
Finally, it's Madam Sharon... Hmm, the color of her emotions is blue, representing rational thought and calmness... This is the complete opposite of her flustered and nervous appearance... Indeed, a socialite is definitely not some innocent bunny...
After the inspection, Klein was about to retract his gaze when he suddenly saw Madam Sharon raise her head and glance in his direction. Then, she lowered her head again, looking scared and trembling.
If I couldn't see your emotional colors directly, I might've been fooled by your behavior... You should consider working as an actor... After lampooning, Klein didn't stay any longer and walked out of Maynard's house with Inspector Tolle.
When he opened the door and was about to step out of the foyer, Leena glanced at his back and thought to herself, Nighthawks? That's right. Maynard's death was too sudden, so it's hard to avoid suspicion... That Demoness of Pleasure was a little too anxious...
As she thought of this, she looked at Madam Sharon, who couldn't even lift her head after being scolded by Mrs. Maynard. She thought to herself, Perhaps I can make use of them...
...
Dock area, Backlund Shipyard.
After bidding farewell to Ebner, Jane carried a small suitcase into her predetermined cabin.
She looked out the window and observed the sky that was filled with thin fog. She estimated the time.
After a while, when she felt that Ebner had likely left the harbor, she picked up the suitcase again. At the same time, her body turned illusory as though she no longer existed in this world.
At this moment, the riverboat had already traveled quite a distance. She opened the window and flew out with some sort of flying Spirit Body.
...
Bridge Borough, Iron Gate Street.
Due to the military's actions, the Bravehearts Bar's business wasn't good. The usually noisy boxing ring was empty, and only one or two of the card rooms had their lights on.
In one of the tightly shut doors, in the pitch-black billiard room, a slightly illusory Jane sat silently beside a billiard table in the darkness, as though she was waiting for someone to arrive.
At this moment, a figure suddenly appeared in the half-body mirror placed at the side of the billiard room. She had a pale face and exquisite looks. She wore a black bonnet and a Gothic regal dress. It was none other than Wraith Sharron.
The two ladies who looked like "female ghosts" looked at each other for a while. Finally, Jane couldn't help but ask, "Have you prepared what I wanted previously?"
"Most of them have been sent to the address you requested... Only that ordinary milk cow with the mystical creature's bloodline has no clue..." Sharron replied without much emotion.
"There's no rush..." As Jane spoke, she summoned a Spirit Body in the shape of a "mouth" without any reservations. As she listened to the Spirit Body's "words," she lampooned, "I wonder why Frank wants such an oddity!
After a while, Jane nodded in satisfaction and smiled at Miss Sharron. "I'll pay you the rest of the money now."
"Leave it to Kaspars." As soon as she finished speaking, Miss Sharron's figure faded and disappeared.
A Wraith sure is convenient... she lamented bitterly. Then, the door to the billiard room was pushed open, and a fifty-year-old man with a big nose and a linen shirt limped in with a lamp in his hand.
Holy Lord of Storms, why would a young and beautiful lady like such a terrifying environment?!
It was none other than Kaspars. The person in charge of the black market was filled with complaints, but he had no choice but to muster his courage to walk forward. He forced a smile and said, "Hello, Miss Jane... Miss Sharron asked me to come over."
Jane had a good impression of the old man. After exchanging a few pleasantries, she handed over the gold pounds she had prepared.
With the help of the light to confirm that there were no mistakes, Kaspars put the notes into his suitcase, then asked Jane hesitantly, "The lady you were waiting for is already here... Should we meet somewhere else?"
After all, not every lady was that curious.
"There's no need. Just leave the gas lamp behind." Jane smiled and shook her head.
That's good too. At least some light would be normal... The red-nosed elder heaved a sigh of relief as the hideous wound on his face seemed to tremble.
Not long after he left, Xio Derecha walked in from the billiard room with a stern expression.
Under the dim light, Xio's shadow was elongated. Her 1.5-meter-tall figure exuded the aura of a giant.
"Have a seat." Seeing Xio enter, Jane greeted her with a smile.
Xio didn't stand on ceremony as she sat on a chair on the other side of the billiard table. Staring at Jane, she asked in puzzlement, "Didn't you leave Backlund today? Why did you ask to meet me here? If it wasn't for the fact that I could sense from your aura that it was really you, I wouldn't have come here."
As she asked the question, Xio subconsciously used her Interrogator mental pressure.
"This place has become your 'area of jurisdiction,' isn't it?" Jane answered without answering his question. Then, she wiped away her smile and said seriously, "There's no need to do such meaningless tests. Let's have an honest talk."
Seeing that the mental pressure didn't seem to have much effect on Jane, Xio stopped her ability and asked probingly, "What do you want to talk about?"
"Although I don't know what's so special about you, the last thing that appeared on Thursday night was actually you, right?" Jane asked.
Ebner had analyzed this point with me later. Although he didn't know what his basis was, he determined that Baron Convawas apparently sought Mr. Fool's aura... And I happened to be noticed by Mr. Fool that day, so I was targeted.
As this thought flashed through her mind, Xio nodded and said, "That's right... Perhaps I had injured him with the purifying halo?"
Jane shook her head and said, "It's not that simple. I noticed that the monster looked at you with a fervent look... He must've wanted to get something from you."
She actually guessed this step... This Miss Jane is also very impressive.
Xio sighed inwardly as she asked without batting an eyelid, "So what do you want to say? Or do?"
"Ebner's life in Backlund is too comfortable... I'm not saying that it's not good. I even yearn for this life... But he also lacks vigilance as a result.
"Since that monster desires you so much, it will definitely investigate your identity so as to find you.
"And your address is always changing, and your whereabouts are never fixed... Therefore, the target of the other party might very well be directed at the person you're very close to, Ebner!
After all, Ebner is very famous, and it's not difficult to find his address...
"I guess Ebner thought of that as well, but he might very well choose to make preparations and wait for the other party to arrive... I don't know what his confidence is, but it's too passive.
"Therefore, what I need to do is to help him eliminate this danger in advance!"
At this point, Jane looked at Xio's face which was illuminated by the light, and said solemnly,
"And I need you to be the bait."

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Two Letters
chapters.content:
Chapter 248 - Two Letters
"Bait?"
Xio didn't comment on the suggestion. She hadn't known Jane for long, and they couldn't even be considered friends. She didn't trust her in a plan that involved her life and death.
"Yes, bait." Jane nodded. She clearly knew what Xio was worried about, so she continued,
"I don't need you to participate in the battle with that monster. All you need to do is lure him out.
"In addition, I will entrust a friend to watch over you in secret. Once that monster appears, she will immediately take you out of the battlefield.
"Of course, if you're worried about my arrangements, you can also do it with that friend of yours who has the powers of Teleportation... Yes, it's Fors, right? Let's do it together... But don't worry, I'll still let that friend watch over you. I won't let you really encounter any danger."
At this point, Jane stared into Xio's eyes and said in a sincere tone, "I don't think you're willing to put Ebner in danger for your own sake, right?"
Xio fell silent for a moment when she heard that. Clearly, Jane's last sentence had moved her... Or perhaps, she had had similar considerations in the past. Unfortunately, she wasn't strong enough, and reporting it to the officials might expose Mr. Fool's secret, so she didn't take any action.
"Are you really confident? According to what I know, you're only a Sequence 7 Spirit Medium, right? That baron had previously eliminated an entire MI9 team, including a Disciplinary Paladin," Xio asked after a while.
However, raising this question itself meant that Xio was inclined to join Jane's plan.
Jane had obviously thought of this as well. A smile appeared on her face as she replied, prepared, "I have a powerful Beyonder item that can allow me to temporarily control the power of a Sequence 5... Furthermore, I'll get a powerhouse to help me.
"In short, with the strength displayed by that monster, I have a seventy percent chance of eliminating him."
Through her Interrogator senses, Xio determined that Jane wasn't lying. Hence, she nodded slightly. After some deliberation, she asked again, "When do you plan on beginning this plan?"
"Next Monday or Tuesday, after the expert I mentioned arrives," Jane estimated the time and replied.
"I agreed to join your plan..." Xio nodded at first, then she looked at Jane and said bluntly, "But I don't trust you... So, I need to sign a Notary Certificate before I take on the role of bait."
"Reasonable suggestion." Jane had already expected this, and she said happily, "Before the operation officially begins next week, I'll think of a way to get a Notary Certificate."
As she spoke, she paused and asked, "What other questions do you have? Speak them all out."
Upon seeing this question, Xio clearly hesitated for a moment, but she still deliberated over her words. "According to Ebner's inference, that Baron Convais actually your ancestor, right... Can you really do it?"
After hearing this, Jane subconsciously moved her long hair that was originally hanging in front of her chest to her back. Her eyes were a little adrift as she said, "Ignoring how many generations I was away from that ancestor of mine, we didn't have any feelings for each other... Even if I really cared about family ties, I should've personally ended his pain when he was corrupted by the black spots and sent him back to the Underworld and to God, right?"
It's no wonder you've been using the word "monster" as a pronoun to refer to Baron Conva... Xio immediately came to a realization and didn't ask further.
...
After Xio left the Bravehearts Bar, Jane sat quietly for a while before sighing. Then, she took out a pen and paper and bent over a nearby table to write.
When the letter was finished, Jane put the letter in an envelope but didn't send it immediately. Instead, she walked out of the bar and strolled into a warehouse at the dock area in the night.
The moment she entered the warehouse, a strange Spirit Body flew over and circled her twice, as though it was trying to claim credit before vanishing.
This was where she and Miss Sharron had agreed to store their transaction items.
After checking the materials and items she had purchased and confirming that there were no mistakes, Jane set up a ritual and summoned the huge humanoid skeleton whose eye sockets were burning with black flames.
After handing the letter to the skeleton messenger, Jane pointed at the materials in the warehouse and instructed,
"Pass the letter to Captain first. You should still remember her, right?
"In addition, ship these materials to the Future in batches..."
After the skeleton messenger reverently received the letter, it quickly vanished.
Seeing the messenger leave, Jane ignored the items in the warehouse and sat on a chair. As she thought, she muttered to herself,
The next step is to convince Miss Sharron to visit Xio for a day...
Yes, there's no need for her to fight for it. It's just to leave the battlefield with Xio when the monsters appear... In that case, some news I heard in the Rorsted Archipelago might garner her interest, making her willing to help...
...
Cherwood Borough, in the gardened villa on Kingst Street.
At this moment, Ebner was sitting at a desk in the study, writing a letter.
With regards to the possibility of a threat from Baron Conva , Jane and Xio could imagine it, so he naturally didn't ignore it.
However, compared to the two ladies, Ebner had a deeper understanding of the baron's strength.
After all, the other party had suffered underground corruption!
And the essence of underground corruption was a sefirah!
Furthermore, compared to the baron who could occasionally maintain his lucidity and suppress his madness, Ebner's intuition told him that the lady named Lady Aston was more terrifying.
Because of the baron's diary, Ebner suspected that the so-called "Lady Auceptin" wasn't the "Auceptin" that the baron believed to be. Instead, it was some kind of terrifying thing sealed behind the underground door of the ancient castle...
Even the large amount of knowledge the baron obtained from behind the door didn't come from corruption but from her.
After all, Sefirah Castle's orientation was too obvious. It didn't seem like knowledge obtained by coincidence.
Due to this, Ebner believed that if he wanted to resolve this problem, he would probably need demigod-level powers.
And awkwardly, other than the Sanguine Duke who stopped him in East Chester County, he didn't know any demigods... much less anyone who was willing to help him...
Furthermore, he had already been to the Church of Earth Mother, and he hadn't received any additional hints, so he probably wouldn't receive any additional help.
As for the God of Knowledge and Wisdom... there's no need to mention it.
However, as he was thinking of countermeasures, he suddenly recalled the true Wheel of Fortune card he had obtained from the snake.
Lucky, good timing, not rich or noble, good at improvisation, promising promotion, a chance encounter, love at first sight, happiness in marriage...
Let's not talk about the last few events. Where do luck and good timing come from?
Is there any suitable opportunity to resolve the problem at hand?
Following this train of thought, Ebner quickly thought of a person, a person who might've just arrived in Backlund—Mr. Azik.
Baron Conva was a Sequence 5 Gatekeeper of the Death pathway, and no matter what Madam Aston's essence was, she existed in the form of an undead.
As a Death Consul, Mr. Azik was probably able to suppress them greatly.
Even if the two of them were corrupted by the sefirot and might have a certain level of resistance, they would definitely be greatly weakened.
Therefore, Mr. Azik's arrival does match the principle of a good opportunity in the Wheel of Fortune...
But it's still the same problem. Ebner doesn't know him...
As he thought about it, he suddenly recalled that Cullen had once mentioned in his letter that the first time Silika was in Baron Lamud's ancient castle... Perhaps it had something to do with Mr. Azik.
Thus, with the intention of getting to know Mr. Azik through Silika, Ebner wrote a letter to Cullen, hoping to get his permission.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Miss Judgment’s First Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 249 - Miss Judgment's First Appearance
Not long after, ripples appeared in the space as the tiny bird, Silika, emerged from the spirit world with a letter in its beak.
Ebner first used Amantha extract as a reward for Silika who had painstakingly delivered the letter. Then, he opened the envelope and began reading seriously.
"...I'm very happy to receive your letter. However, you shouldn't be asking me this question. Instead, you should be asking Silika directly.
"If she's willing to help you, I have no objections... This is because I also wish to understand her relationship with the first Baron Lamud.
"It should be known that the era in which Silika was born was nearly a thousand years after the era when the first Baron Lamud was active. She shouldn't have had any interactions with him... But the reality is that she had been searching for everything about the baron ever since she was alive. Even after she turned into an undead and lost most of her memories, she was still stuck in that ancient castle for a long time, unwilling to leave..."
After putting down the letter, Ebner cast his gaze to the side of the glass bottle, where she was happily drinking the scent of Amantha extract. He began to calculate inwardly.
Perhaps my guess isn't wrong. Silika might very well be closely related to Mr. Azik...
But how should I move her to help me?
Yes, perhaps I can try it with the Book of Dead...
With this in mind, Ebner went to the storage room and took out the black-covered book that seemed to suck out a person's soul.
What was worth mentioning was that, as he had activated Hurricane of Light the night before yesterday, in order to save Xio, he had watched the sunrise with the Sword of Dawn for two days. Then, ignoring its "protest," he sealed it with the strange black-skinned book.
On the other side, Silika had just finished absorbing the Amantha extract in the bottle. She looked wistfully at the cabinet where Ebner had taken out the bottle before retracting her gaze. She planned to flap her illusory wings and return to the spirit world.
But at that moment, she suddenly smelled an aura that made her feathers tremble slightly. That aura made her yearn for it, but it also made her fear it... This was because that aura belonged to a true Mythical Creature.
After Ebner carried the black-bound book back to the study, he saw Silika retract her wings like a quail, but her eyes were fixed on the Book of Dead.
Without waiting for Ebner to speak, Silika tilted her head and controlled the black fog around her to form a simple sentence in the air.
"Can I help you keep the book?"
Could it be that your constant chatter in the past was because you didn't really want to communicate with me...
Upon seeing this scene, Ebner was instantly rendered speechless. To think that he had been considering how to ask the man...
But to hand it to you for safekeeping? Are you sure you won't steal it?
With that in mind, Ebner smiled and said, "Thank you for your goodwill, Silika... I won't trouble you any further... But if you can do me a favor, I can allow you to 'watch' it for two hours a day."
Silika tilted her head, and the fog in the air changed once again, forming a line of Loenese text. "I'm helping you by watching over you? Wouldn't I be at a disadvantage then?"
Don't you know if you'll suffer a loss or not? I didn't expect this little guy to be so smart and have so many tricks up his sleeve...
After lampooning a few times, Ebner rolled his eyes and pretended to put away the Book of Dead. He then said regretfully, "Then forget it... I'll find a spirit who's willing to help..."
Before he finished his sentence, the fog above the bird's head quickly formed a single word. "Deal!"
Right on the heels of that, the fog changed again, changing into a line of Jotun. "Bullying little birds is shameful."
Don't think that I can't understand it just because you changed the language...
The corners of Ebner's eyes twitched as he pretended not to know the giant language. He said without a change in expression, "Next Wednesday night, I need you to lure a gentleman to my location...
"I'll tell you the details in the future. However, you can come to me at night for the next few days and help me watch the Book of Dead."
Silika tilted her head as though she was thinking or divining something. After a while, she nodded and looked at the black book. After chirping a few times, she flapped her wings and disappeared.
What does he mean? Come again in the evening? Why can't he be bothered to communicate?
Ebner rubbed his forehead and sealed the Book of Dead. Then, he continued thinking.
If nothing unexpected happened, Mr. Azik would appear near Duke Negan's manor next Wednesday night to kill Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos.
When that happens, all I need to do is get Silika to follow Qilangos and I'll be able to successfully meet the Death Consul.
However, to be safe, I'd better think of a way to sneak into that ball to prevent any unforeseen circumstances from happening...
Although it's very likely that I'm the biggest accident... After all, I've attended balls and banquets, so it's rare for nothing to happen.
After lampooning a few times, Ebner reined in his thoughts and felt that he could think of a solution with Father Utravsky.
Due to Member of Parliament Macht's repeated introductions, the half-giant bishop had produced excellent results over the past month. He had already established friendly ties with many of the upper-class aristocrats.
...
In the blink of an eye, it was Monday.
At noon, after eating, Ebner was at home selecting suitable diary pages for the Tarot Gathering. At this moment, Xio suddenly carried a suitcase and went up to the door.
After the two came to the study, Xio took out a huge pile of bottles, wigs, and clothes from the suitcase.
"Is this... a disguise tool?" Ebner asked with uncertainty as he watched Xio fiddle with the items.
"Of course, I have to ensure that I'm not recognized by Audrey... Yes, it's Miss Justice. She recognized me!" Xio arranged the items in categories before looking at Ebner. "Wait outside. I need some makeup and clothes..."
Does she think it's hard to explain that Fors is at her place, so she came to me? But what is she going to disguise herself as?
With this thought in mind, Ebner opened the door and left the study.
After waiting in the corridor for nearly an hour, Xio's voice sounded from the study. "Come in."
Ebner found the voice a little strange, but he didn't think too much about it. He opened the door in passing, but he was immediately stunned. He almost asked, "Miss, who are you?"
It turned out that there was a blonde-haired beauty in a classic regal dress and feathered hat standing in the study. She was slightly taller than 1.6 meters.
If it wasn't for Xio's appearance, Ebner wouldn't have dared to recognize her.
And perhaps it was because of her makeup, Xio's face, which had some baby fat, no longer looked that obvious... If she went out with this appearance, perhaps only someone very familiar with her would recognize her.
This is comparable to the "Asian heretic magic" from my previous life...
Despite lampooning inwardly, he couldn't help but laugh. "In Mr. Fool's kingdom, the members of the Tarot Club can't see each other's faces. There's no need for you to wear makeup."
"This is actually a psychological cue... I disguised myself as this, so I naturally had to simulate this personality," Xio replied slowly. Her tone was like that of an educated noble lady, but her choice of words was still the Xio he was familiar with.
However, Xio seemed to have received a similar education when she was young... Is this a reenactment of her childhood dreams? Ebner silently thought to himself, but on the surface, he reminded her, "You still have to watch your words."
Xio nodded in thought and replied, "Let's leave it at that for now. I'll try to keep quiet at the Tarot Club."
However, she had decided to secretly study with a noble lady, treating it as helping Fors gather material.
...
Three in the afternoon.
Xio, whose vision had recovered from the crimson and blurry state, once again saw the boundless gray fog that didn't belong to reality. She saw the palace that looked like a giant's residence, as well as the three men sitting opposite her.
According to the information that Ebner had told her, they were followed by The Hanged Man, The Tower, and The Sun.
And the "Tower" was none other than Ebner!
In the blink of an eye, Xio's tense and worried emotions eased. All of this matched what Ebner had said, which meant that what he had previously described was likely true, and not just a figment of his imagination after he was bewitched by the evil god...
Of course, it's also possible that I've gone mad...
Just as Xio was secretly spying on the other members, Miss Justice Audrey had proudly straightened her back, tipped her chin, and happily greeted,
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~
"Good afternoon, Mr. Hanged Man ~
"Good afternoon, Mr. Tower ~
"Good afternoon, Mr. Sun!
"Good afternoon, uh..."
At this moment, Audrey suddenly saw a lady appear beside her.
New member? I was only thinking about Qilangos, and I didn't realize it... That's really not right!
After some self-reflection, Audrey cast her gaze at Mr. Fool, awaiting the introduction of the mysterious existence.
But how would he know that Klein was also staring at Xio with his mouth agape under the cover of the gray fog? He sighed inwardly just like what he had before,
"Miss, who are you?
"Did I pull the wrong person?"

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Alger’s Envy
chapters.content:
Chapter 250 - Alger's Envy
Klein activated his Spirit Vision and observed her a few times. Through his familiar aura, he confirmed that this Miss Judgment was Xio Derecha, who he had previously pulled into the gray fog.
Furthermore, Mr. Tower didn't show any signs of surprise or shock. He likely knew that Miss Xio would dress up like that...
That's right. They were so close that even if Miss Xio disguised herself, she wouldn't hide it from Mr. Tower.
However, this disguise that didn't look anything like the original was ridiculous. Should I say that he was indeed a spy from MI9? He was indeed professional!
After lampooning inwardly, The Fool Klein casually pointed in Xio's direction and said with a smile, "This is the newly joined Miss Judgment."
When Judgment Xio saw Mr. Fool, who resembled a god, mention her, she immediately stood up elegantly, displaying her height of 1.6 meters. Then, she curtsied and simply greeted everyone as a way of getting to know each other.
The way she phrased her words was very unique to Backlund. her actions were elegant and standard, and she should've received a good education as a noble...
However, the regal dress she's wearing probably wasn't made by a famous artist. She doesn't have much jewelry, and the style isn't fashionable...
In conclusion, Miss Judgment should've come from a family of abject nobles or a family of merchants who had just been promoted...
But it's not absolute, because it might be a deliberate disguise by Miss Judgment. After all, if she really wore the style designed by a master, her identity might be easily identified...
Even I, apart from coming to this ancient palace without any preparations the first time, have been wearing ordinary home clothes for the subsequent Tarot Gatherings.
As Audrey observed Judgment's actions, she used her Spectator Beyonder powers to analyze and make a judgment.
Alger's attention was focused on something else. The tone in which "Tower" responded to Miss Judgment's greeting was very casual and even somewhat familiar. It didn't seem like it was their first meeting...
Could it be that Miss Judgment is one of the members that Tower recommended to Mr. Fool? She passed the test?
Why did "He" so eagerly raise his faction within the Tarot Club?
Alger glanced at Tower beside him and slipped into deep thought.
As for The Sun, he looked curiously at Judgment, as though he was guessing if she came from the City of Silver region where he was, or from the normal world where Mr. Tower and Mr. Hanged Man were.
From her clothes, she should come from the normal world... After all, how was she supposed to fight in such clothes?
At this moment, seeing that Xio had already exchanged greetings with the crowd, Abna was the first to stand up and bow to Mr. Fool. "Honorable Mr. Fool, thank you for your help. I brought three pages of Roselle's diary this time, but I've also found the rest of the diary. I'll make up for it later."
Upon seeing this, Xio hurriedly got up and said sincerely, "Thank you for your help, Mr. Fool... I will help Mr. Tower gather the diary pages together."
This was something that Ebner had discussed with Xio in advance. After all, it was difficult for them to hide the fact that they knew each other well. Even if they could hide it from each other at one or two Tarot Gatherings, it was only a matter of time before they exposed themselves. Therefore, it was better to directly point it out. After all, other than Mr. Fool, even if others knew, there was no way to confirm their identities.
Mr. Fool saved Mr. Tower? No, it's more likely that he saved Miss Judgment! This lady might very well be the one who Mr. Tower recommended and had accepted the mission of investigating the first Baron Lamud!
Was it because of that investigation that put Miss Judgment in a life-and-death situation, so Mr. Fool displayed his might in reality for the first time? And Miss Judgment also joined the Tarot Club because of this?
I really want to see Mr. Fool take action with my own eyes! That would definitely be very, very exciting... I wonder if I can get Miss Judgment to repeat it?
No, Audrey, stop your dangerous thoughts... To discuss it in person is being disrespectful to Mr. Fool!
Many thoughts flashed through Audrey's mind. Finally, a look of envy and yearning appeared on her face, but she quickly recovered her Spectator state.
Alger said to himself, "as expected." Then, he was surprised that "Tower" could actually get Mr. Fool to save him!
Even though he had paid the price, the fact that Mr. Fool was willing to take action implied how much this god doted on Tower!
The series of actions that "Tower" had done to help The Fool escape was indeed for a purpose! This was likely his goal!
Mr. Fool is actually so generous to his believers and Blesseds!
With this in mind, Alger, who had discovered Mr. Fool's new usage method, couldn't help but feel a sense of envy... He was the one who joined the Tarot Club first...
Hence, Alger glanced at The Fool and suddenly said,
"Mr. Fool, I'm about to receive a batch of Emperor Roselle's diary pages. I believe that I'll be able to present them to you the next time, or at the next gathering."
According to the arrangement of the Church of the Lord of Storms, Pritz Harbor was under the jurisdiction of the Backlund diocese. Therefore, Alger could enter the capital by reporting on his previous voyage and wait for Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos to reveal himself.
Backlund had been the headquarters of the Church of the Lord of Storms until the end of the last epoch, when the Loen Kingdom was established. Only then did they move their holy altar to Pasu Island. Therefore, regardless of the angle, the Backlund diocese of the Lord of Storms was second only to the headquarters of the seven major Churches. The richness of the information was imaginable.
Under such circumstances, Alger was very confident that he could gather Roselle's diary which was half-open for the Church's Beyonders to study.
Upon hearing that, Klein deliberately let his tone carry some joy as he nodded.
"Very good."
His true emotions were a mixture of joy and worry. He was delighted that he would soon be able to see many pages of Roselle's diary. There might be a lot of useful information on them, but he was also worried about what he should use to exchange for them with The Hanged Man. After all, no one knew if there was anything in those diary pages that would garner The Hanged Man's interest, or if there was anything valuable in those pages.
There's no need to worry about the tower for now. The Hanged Man is going to put me in a difficult position again... Even a Seer has its limits... Klein sighed silently.
At this moment, Ebner had already conjured the three pages of Roselle's diary, waiting for Klein to Teleport them to his hand.
In the three pages he handed in this time, two of them were given to him by Fani last time. In other words, it recorded that Roselle had set up the Black Suits organization, as well as a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Sauron family suddenly coming to life and becoming the mastermind behind the Intis internal strife.
As for the page of "Roselle used the former Balam Empire's princess, Bruna, to escape Behrens, and" Pale Justice," it was temporarily suppressed by Ebner. After all, the contents of this page overlapped with the content of the diary he had previously fabricated. Although it wasn't contradictory, it was better to avoid it as much as possible.
Therefore, the third page he handed in was actually a completely incomprehensible "messaging" that lacked a drawing.
Soon, three pages of the diary appeared in Klein's hands.
Ebner, Audrey, and company began to wait in silence, accustomed to such matters.
Only Xio was participating in it for the first time. Although she had already heard Ebner's description, she was still surprised that The Fool could really read Roselle's words.
At this moment, Klein, who was sitting at The Fool's seat, looked down and read the first page.
... I've decided. I'll just call it the Man in Black organization...
"...I have to thank the Savant potion. Without it, I definitely wouldn't have thought of the word 'rampant'..."
Man in Black? That sounds like Roselle. Does he treat spies and members of secret organizations as "alien"? Hmm... In a sense, the people here are indeed "alien" to transmigrators like Roselle and me!
In addition, alright... I admit that even if I were to read "rampant" once, I wouldn't be able to write it even if I turned around. I'll probably have to use dream divination to recall it...
As Klein lampooned, he made a self-deprecating comment. Soon, he turned the page and cast his gaze on the second page.
... There's actually the influence of that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact from the Sauron family that suddenly came alive! No, to be precise, it's the true mastermind behind the scenes!
This... I remember mentioning a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact in the previous diary page...
From what the Emperor said, it was the mastermind behind the Sauron Dynasty's upheavals. The Emperor was just trying to coincide?
What's its goal? To gain freedom? Why do I have a nagging feeling that there's a huge conspiracy behind this...
Could the last page contain the Emperor's detailed introduction of the Sealed Artifact?
With this in mind, Klein picked up the last page in anticipation. With just a glance, he wished he could burn the diary page.
Thankfully, his Clown powers allowed him to conceal his emotions very well. With the gray fog's obstruction, even Miss Justice and Miss Judgment, who were secretly observing him, didn't notice anything amiss.
Putting down the diary, Klein looked up and surveyed the area. Seeing that Justice Audrey was about to speak, he gestured for her to wait before conjuring a few goatskin parchments.
"This is the meaning of a portion of Roselle's secret symbols. It's considered free knowledge, so that you can better collect the diary pages."
It included numbers and dates.
Just the dates alone can eliminate most counterfeits... Klein secretly sighed. He could no longer tolerate such counterfeits.
Audrey and company were abnormally surprised. They never expected Mr. Fool to really teach them the corresponding meaning of Roselle's text. Although they had already discovered that the secret symbols on the goatskin were the simplest ones, they all believed that this was a good beginning. With a first time, there would be a second time, and a third time!
Only Ebner pretended to be delighted as he secretly sighed. It seemed like using random code to make up the numbers wouldn't work in the future...

chapters.title: Chapter 251: Exchange
chapters.content:
Chapter 251 - Exchange
Seeing that everyone had memorized the corresponding numbers and dates, Klein nodded at Miss Justice, indicating that she could speak.
"Mr. Fool... Similar to Mr. Tower, I've also found two ladies who are suitable for our Tarot Club. They're Beyonders and have their own circles and resources in Backlund. They're also able to keep secrets and have good character. Are you willing to let them join the gathering?" Audrey deliberated for a few seconds and resisted the urge to immediately talk about Qilangos. She first asked the question she had always wanted to ask.
Seeing Mr. Tower successfully pull his friend into the gathering, she couldn't help but wish to imitate him.
Xio immediately looked at Justice Audrey with an odd expression. She thought, This description... Could she be referring to me and Fors?
Could it be that even if I hadn't been set up by Ebner, I would've been set up by Miss Audrey?
Derrick was also very interested in this as he looked sideways at Mr. Fool, awaiting "His" answer.
Alger sighed secretly. He didn't have anyone he could recommend.
Why are all of you trying to pull people into the Tarot Club? However, there's no hope for a short period of time... As a Sequence 7 Beyonder, Miss Xio has already placed a huge burden on me. I probably have to wait until the Clown potion is further digested before I can pull in another member.
Klein lampooned as he chuckled.
"It's still the same as before. First, secretly reveal my name to them, and then I'll give them a certain test."
As for the test, I'll think about it after I've decided...
"That's great!" Audrey was relieved. As she considered how she could reveal Mr. Fool's honorific name to Xio and Fors, she looked across the table and said, "Mr. Hanged Man, there's been progress regarding Qilangos."
Alger sat up straight and couldn't hide his joy as he asked,
"Where is he?"
"Unfortunately, he noticed our investigation the moment we found traces of him. It's even possible that he killed someone related to him. If it wasn't for the person I entrusted my services to have a friend of special status, Qilangos would've probably been attacked as well, afraid of attracting trouble." Audrey recounted the important points of the investigation report that Xio and Fors had submitted.
In the report, Xio hoped to pressurize Qilangos through the officials, especially the Church of Storms, so that he would commit mistakes and reveal his motives in Backlund. Audrey didn't go into detail, believing that with Mr. Hanged Man's intelligence, he would definitely be able to think of this.
As for the possibility that someone in MI9 might be colluding with Qilangos, the report Xio had submitted to the military wasn't given much attention. Audrey herself didn't know about it, because Xio hadn't written anything in her investigation results.
Furthermore, Audrey still didn't know that Xio had become a spy in MI9. She only believed that she was a rather famous bounty hunter.
Sitting a spot away from Audrey, Xio's expression turned even odder. Thankfully, the gray fog prevented anyone from seeing her.
As the person who was "almost" attacked by Qilangos, she couldn't help but have a strange feeling when she heard his investigation report being brought to such a "Divine Council" for discussion.
Elsewhere, Alger pondered for a moment and nodded slightly.
"I will pay close attention."
With that said, he turned to look at the end of the long bronze table and respectfully said,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, once I figure out Qilangos's true motives and the very important and mystical item he's trying to obtain, I'll recite your name and inform you through a ritual... I wonder if you're willing to listen to these trivial matters of the mortal world?"
He didn't repeat his request for The Fool's Blessed to provide him with help. Since he had already mentioned it and The Fool had given an answer, there was no need for him to harp on it. Otherwise, he would anger the deity.
Therefore, Alger only expressed his desire to "report."
If the final temptation was sufficient, he believed that Mr. Fool's Blessed would definitely appear.
That's not a problem, as long as you don't report it in the middle of the night... What if Mr. Fool goes bald one day due to a lack of sleep... After lampooning a few times, Klein leaned back in his chair and nodded gently. He replied in a deep voice,
"Sure."
Upon hearing The Fool's reply, Alger heaved a sigh of relief. He lowered his head and said humbly,
"Please allow me to praise you in advance."
Mr. Hanged Man seems to be a lot more respectful and proactive towards me, The Fool, today... What triggered him?
Klein was secretly surprised, but he didn't show it. All he did was smile and maintain his unfathomable posture.
As for the hidden meaning in his words, Klein naturally understood it as well. However, Mr. Fool didn't personally promise it. Who made the rule that he would provide help once he heard it?
However, compared to before, he now had more confidence because his real ally, the mysterious Mr. Azik, was in Backlund.
Seeing that the exchange between The Hanged Man and Mr. Fool had come to an end, Judgment Xio thought of Darkholme, who was nowhere to be found and likely dead. Although he was a complete thug, he had died because of her request. If possible, she was willing to seek revenge for him.
Xio hesitated before asking,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, perhaps I might be able to help with Mr. Hanged Man's matter... If I obtain very useful and timely information, can I recite your name and inform you and Mr. Hanged Man through a ritual?"
As for the technique of fleecing Mr. Fool, Ebner was afraid that it would scare Xio. He hadn't mentioned it when he introduced the Tarot Club to her, so Xio wasn't aware.
Look, Miss Judgment is so polite! She even knew to ask if I could help her pass on the message... She's not like the others who have already been led astray by the Tower!
I hope Miss Judgment can keep doing this... But with her relationship with Mr. Tower, it might be very difficult...
Recalling the previous "late-night livestreams," Klein lampooned inwardly as he said with a deep voice through the thick gray fog,
"Sure."
Audrey, Alger, and Derrick didn't have any additional thoughts on this matter. They had previously communicated and traded with each other through Mr. Fool, and they were already used to it. They only felt that this was a normal perk that Mr. Fool had bestowed upon the Tarot Club members.
In the previous exchange, Ebner didn't interject. Although he knew Qilangos's motives, there wasn't enough evidence to verify his "inference." Secondly, he wanted to use Mr. Azik's "plot" to intercept Qilangos to find the Death Consul, but he didn't wish to expose Admiral Hurricane.
After seeing that the matter regarding Qilangos had come to an end, and considering how he had handed in the Fallen Morning Star last week, he couldn't help but look up at Klein. He then stood up and bowed, asking indirectly,
"Honorable Mr. Fool, I wonder if your Blessed has received the gold pounds I sacrificed?"
Yes, I've confirmed it over again. There's a total of 300 pounds. They're all real money. They're lying in the junk pile beside me...
Klein muttered to himself in delight, quickly realizing what Mr. Tower was asking.
However, he had already decided to drag it out for a week before telling her the results of the divination to show how difficult it was for his Blessed to investigate, as well as how valuable the information was.
After all, Mr. Tower also had a grudge against the mystical item, and he had no plans on using it anytime soon.
Therefore, The Fool Klein leaned back in his chair, half-closed his eyes, and said in a deep voice,
"I'm not too concerned about such trivial matters... However, the birth of a Fallen Morning Star might involve a secret existence. My Blessed is still investigating."
That Flower-Faced Fox who was doing a dream divination is talking to Emperor Roselle, but there's no sign of him. That should be enough of a secret, right? I'm not lying either... Klein added inwardly.
This... Don't tell me you're bragging? Ebner tried hard to hide his suspicious eyes and emotions, but he quickly analyzed inwardly.
Klein wouldn't use pure lies to fool the Tarot Club members. He mostly used vague words to fool others... In that case, the revelation he divined likely had a hidden existence.
Who could it be? Concealment... Could it be the Goddess? Hmm, probably not. If it's the Goddess, Klein probably wouldn't even be able to come up with the conclusion that it involves a secret existence...
Sigh, the reason why Klein didn't tell me directly is most likely because he still has uses for the Fallen Morning Star. Besides, if that so-called Blessed of his only took less than a week to find information involving a secret existence, I'm afraid it wouldn't be convincing enough...
From the looks of it, I'll have to wait a week... No, I won't know the outcome until two weeks later... Thankfully, I'm not in a hurry to know this. Its potential threat is the smallest around me.
With this in mind, Ebner snapped to his senses and bowed at Mr. Fool once again before sitting down.
When Justice and The Hanged Man heard the conversation between him and Mr. Fool, the former exclaimed inwardly, 'Just any Beyonder item in your hand involves a secret existence. Mr. Tower is indeed very mysterious and powerful.'
As for The Hanged Man, he found it a matter of course. As someone who could hunt down the Demoness of Affliction and kill Admiral Hell, he had to hand over the item to Mr. Fool for inspection due to his reservations. It definitely had a special background.
I wonder who the hidden existence involved is...
Xio had long heard from Ebner about his suspicion of the item, so she wasn't surprised. However, she had a better understanding of Mr. Fool's "easy-going" attitude.
He could even entrust a dangerous item identification to "His" Blessed? All he paid was a little gold pound?
What Ebner said previously was right. Mr. Fool was truly a "amiable" god.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Omnipotent and Omniscient
chapters.content:
Chapter 252 - Omnipotent and Omniscient
Seeing Tower sit back in his seat, Alger looked around and made his request.
"I need a pair of Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor eyes. I will pay the corresponding price."
Although he had yet to digest the Seafarer potion, he had to make some preparations in advance.
And during the last Tarot Gathering, he had bought the Wind-blessed potion formula from the "Tower." He already had an idea of the whereabouts of the Blue Shadow Falcon, but it was difficult to find the Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor, so he could only try his luck here.
However, the people on both sides of the long bronze table showed no reaction.
Needless to say, Mr. Fool didn't possess such an expensive item. He had never even heard of such a material before Mr. Tower wrote the formula.
Although Miss Justice's vault was quite large, there weren't many items at the Sequence 6 level. She was certain that she had never seen it in the catalog.
Miss Judgment is still in debt to this day. Although she should be able to pay off the reimbursement and reward money she received from the special recruitment, she would still have quite a bit of spare cash... Up to now, she's still in debt.
The Sun said honestly, "There's no sea around the City of Silver..." In between the lines, he was implying that there was no Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor.
Alger wasn't disappointed either. He didn't expect to buy it immediately, and he hadn't saved enough money... Therefore, he only requested, "I hope you can help me keep an eye out," and let it go.
Justice, Judgment, and The Sun nodded and agreed to his request.
As for Ebner, he did know where the Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor eyeballs could be found, but Miss Justice hadn't joined the Psychology Alchemists at the moment, so there was no way she could get them even if she said it out loud...
In the end, Ebner remained silent.
Following that, the topic entered the stage of sharing information. Audrey recalled the topic she hadn't finished at the last Tarot Gathering. She asked Derrick, "Mr. Sun, can you tell me in detail about the City of Silver you're in?"
After a few Tarot Gatherings, Derrick roughly understood what "equivalent exchange" meant by Mr. Fool. Furthermore, through the previous transactions with Mr. Tower, he more or less understood some of the "resources" he could use.
However, Derrick didn't pay much attention to such basic general knowledge. Therefore, when he heard Miss Justice's question, he thought for a moment and replied,
Ever since the Lord that created everything, the omnipotent and omniscient God, abandoned this land, the City of Silver has existed... No, just as Mr. Tower mentioned, it existed before that. However, it was called the Kingdom of Silver back then...
The difference is that, in the records of the City of Silver, our ancestors should've believed in Giant King Aurmir, and not the Giant Queen Omebella that Mr. Tower mentioned...
"This was specially checked after I returned last time."
At this point, Derrick was afraid that Mr. Tower would misunderstand, so he hurriedly explained,
Of course, with my status, I won't be able to come into contact with high-end information... This is only what I saw in the books that were opened to all the residents of the City of Silver...
Upon hearing that, Ebner only smiled without saying a word. At the same time, he extended his right palm, signaling him to continue.
Seeing that Mr. Tower didn't seem to be angry, Derrick heaved a sigh of relief. He admired this knowledgeable "powerhouse" who had determined the location of the City of Silver with just his words.
However, the focus of the rest of the people present wasn't on who The Sun's ancestor believed in, but the words "Omnipotent and Omniscient God."
They were no strangers to the "Lord that created everything." The Creator mentioned in the legends of the deities like the Book of Storms and The Revelation of Evernight had similar titles. The True Creator that the Aurora Order and other secret organizations believed in was also given the same title.
However, this was the first time that everyone had heard of the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" in this world. Be it the Evernight Goddess, the Lord of Storms, or the God of Steam and Machinery, none of them claimed to be omniscient or omnipotent.
Apart from Klein, who had heard The Sun's description alone, and who knew what was going on inside, the other three fell into deep thought.
Elsewhere, Derrick didn't notice the pensive looks on Justice and company's faces. He composed himself and continued,
"In the first few decades after being forsaken by the Lord, plants couldn't grow, and the City of Silver was severely lacking in food. We could only hunt dark monsters with physical bodies and some mutated animals to relieve our hunger. The population began to drop uncontrollably. Fortunately, we later found Black-Faced Grass. It could survive in such an environment, and it became our reliable and stable food source.
"It was believed to be the final blessing left behind by the great God, allowing the City of Silver to persist for generations. It lasted for 2582 years in the Dark Ages.
"This is the time recorded by past Chiefs. The other residents of the City of Silver use relatively more lightning as day, and when the lightning subsides, it becomes night. One takes a day... As this is often chaotic, we are unable to grasp the exact number of days."
Derrick stopped after briefly explaining the few memorable incidents in the history of the City of Silver. He clearly realized that it was inevitable that he would divulge valuable information if he kept talking. And this information could be used to exchange for his resources for advancement.
After secretly sighing for the City of Silver's harsh living environment, Audrey snapped back to her senses and sighed. "Thankfully, you found the Black-Faced Grass and stubbornly survived."
"Yes... This might be the final blessing of the Lord..." Derrick lowered his head, his voice revealing a hint of pain.
"What's the title of the Lord you believe in, 'He' is Omnipotent and Omniscient?" Alger asked.
"I don't know... It's sacrilegious to randomly guess the Lord's title..." Derrick replied, stumped.
Although entering The Fool's kingdom is the greatest form of blasphemy against the Lord... He really doesn't know the meaning behind it, nor has he read about it in books.
"Is that so..." Alger nodded before glancing at the silent "Tower" beside him. He asked seemingly casually, "Regarding this, Mr. Tower, do you know anything? Can you tell us?"
After all, "Tower" was someone who could deduce the Forsaken Land of the Sun with just a few words. He definitely had a deep understanding of that place.
Nice question! Klein's mind stirred when he heard that. In fact, he had long wanted to ask Tower such a question. Unfortunately, as The Fool, it wasn't appropriate for him to ask.
Ebner could naturally tell what Alger was thinking, but he couldn't be bothered to nitpick. He hesitated for a moment before deciding to divulge some information. Hence, he deliberated over his words and said,
"Speaking of 'Omnipotent and Omniscient,' I do know a little... Do you think that among the twenty-two Beyonder pathways, which of them can represent 'Omniscient' and which of them can represent 'Omnipotent?'"

chapters.title: Chapter 253: All Kinds of Imagination
chapters.content:
Chapter 253 - All Kinds of Imagination
Upon hearing the question, the Tarot Club members fell silent for a moment. Finally, Judgment Xio was the first to answer,
"If it represents Omniscient, I think the three pathways—Reader, Mystery Pryer, and Savant—are most likely..."
She had always been able to learn some general knowledge about the abilities of various pathways from Ebner, so her knowledge wasn't too limited.
Alger also said, "The pathway that represents Omnipotent. I can only think of Secrets Suppliant. After all, you clearly explained the traits of a Shepherd to The Sun at the last gathering."
Sitting at the seat of honor, Klein secretly nodded when he heard that. What Judgment and The Hanged Man said was in line with his thoughts.
I wonder if Mr. Tower will have any different ideas...
With this in mind, Klein saw Mr. Tower first look at Miss Judgment and explain with a smile,
"Mystery Pryer and Savant correspond to knowledge itself. They are split into two aspects. One is more about mystery, while the other is more about reality. However, they do not represent Omniscient."
Having said that, he nodded at Alger and said with certainty, "Secrets Suppliant does represent 'Omnipotent ' in the aspect of Beyonder powers."
So the Mystery Pryer and Savant represent knowledge itself. It's no wonder the emperor's diary said that they can switch pathways at high levels. To think that their internal connections are like this... Then, since the Reader and Secrets Suppliant represent omnipotent and omniscient parts, can they also be interchanged?
Wait, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom should have the highest authority of the Reader pathway. And "He" is at odds with the Eternal Blazing Sun and the Lord of Storms, but at the same time, "They" view the True Creator, who wields the highest authority of the Secrets Suppliant, with extreme animosity... Could there be some connection between the two?
Could it be that Sailor and Bard are also considered to be omnipotent and omniscient? They can also be interchanged?
Klein thought back to the diary pages he had read in the past.
"So, the so-called Omnipotent and Omniscient is actually referring to the two pathways of Reader and Secrets Suppliant?" At this moment, Audrey maintained her Spectator state and calmly interrupted.
Ebner didn't answer her directly. Instead, he continued introducing the traits of the few pathways.
The name of the Reader pathway's Sequence 1 is Eye of Omniscient. The Beyonders of this pathway believe in constantly being rich in knowledge. By climbing up the stairs, one can reach the depths of the cosmos...
"Furthermore, Omniscient also means Omnipotent. Therefore, the Reader pathway can learn and simulate the Beyonder powers of other pathways from Sequence 6 Polymath. Although it's not as powerful as the original, it has many means. It's almost omnipotent.
"I previously introduced Secrets Suppliant. Its Sequence 5 Shepherd can Graze Beyonders of other pathways and obtain their powers. In a sense, it's also a type of Omnipotent.
"I believe everyone is very familiar with the Sailor pathway. From my point of view, it actually represents the sea, land, and air, which are also the Omnipotent of the material world.
"Similarly, the Spectator pathway is also known as the Dragon pathway. It's a pathway that the mind dragons grasp. It should represent the Omnipotent of the mind, the mind, and other non-material worlds.
Finally, the Bard pathway... This pathway also possesses the authority of Omniscient. The evidence is that its Sequence 6 is called Notary. It can be used to 'notarize' almost anything. Without the authority of Omniscient, it's very difficult to do this...
"In short, the Reader, Sailor, Bard, Secrets Suppliant, and Spectator pathways are collectively known as the Five Pathways of Omnipotent and Omniscient. This is a portion of what I know about so-called Omnipotent and Omniscient."
Of course, if you want to know more, you'll have to pay extra.
Omnipotent and Omniscient Five Pathways?! Justice, The Hanged Man, and the others muttered this term in their hearts. At the same time, they looked at Mr. Fool at the seat of honor, hoping that this mysterious existence would judge and add on to what The Tower had said.
Why are all of you looking at me? This is the first time I've heard of this term... Klein knew that although not saying anything would make the members have doubts, it would at least diminish Mr. Fool's dignity.
After all, the word "omnipotent and omniscient" sounds very lofty. With The Fool's usual persona, it's only normal to give a comment or two...
As his thoughts raced, Klein had an idea. He leaned back in his chair in a seemingly relaxed manner and chuckled. "Heh heh, the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Eternal Blazing Sun are at odds with each other, and the three deities are at odds with the Fallen Creator."
This is a fact that everyone knows. As for how you imagine it, it's up to you. Anyway, even if you guess wrong, you can't blame Mr. Fool.
This... Mr. Fool is implying that the three deities and the True Creator are at odds because they share the same pathway of Omnipotent and Omniscient? Could this be a secret that only deities know?
Alger quivered when he heard that as thoughts flashed through his mind. He came to a realization of the relationship between the various Churches.
This made him feel a rather special sense of superiority and joy, as though he had seen the essence of the matter, exceeding the level of most Beyonders in the Church of Storms.
Furthermore, since these five pathways have the concept of "Omnipotent and Omniscient," "tower," are the other pathways similar?
Yes, the Savant and Mystery Pryer mentioned by Tower just now could be classified as knowledge itself...
Furthermore, the Church of the God of Combat and the Church of Evernight are as incompatible as the three deities. Then, are Sleepless and Warrior also in the same "spectrum" that we don't know of?
Just as The Hanged Man was letting his imagination run wild, Klein actually made similar connections and went one step further.
The Emperor once regretted not choosing Apprentice and Seer in his diary. And his transmigration might very well be similar to mine, having something to do with the space above the gray fog...
Could I make a bold guess that the palace above the gray fog is actually part of the "scope" of Seer and Apprentice? The emperor's final regret was that he couldn't come here because he had chosen another pathway?
At this moment, Xio was surprised at Ebner's "unrestrained" behavior. Although she had long known that her friend often had the desire to pour her heart out and always wanted to "flaunt" her knowledge, other than when they first met, he had already restrained himself. He always said to keep half, or Fors wouldn't have added the annoying Mr. Evil Spirit character in Stormwind Mountain Villa.
That's right. The reason why he usually doesn't dare to speak is that he's afraid of attracting danger... And this is the Divine Council. With Mr. Fool present, he doesn't have many reservations...
It's no wonder he thinks so highly of The Fool. Apart from the unimaginable benevolence, tolerance, generosity, and amiable attitude displayed by this existence, it's also because he finally has a place to speak his mind...
Perhaps, the reason why he was able to restrain his desire to "flaunt" and "pour out" was also because he had joined the Tarot Club and had a place to vent...
With this in mind, Xio even thought of using the opportunity to ask Ebner about things he usually didn't wish to divulge, but she ultimately decided not to launch a sudden attack. She would discuss with him what knowledge she could ask for when she returned.
Miss Justice's attention was focused on the saying that the Spectator pathway represented the Omnipotent of the mind and psyche domain. She was very excited about it and wanted to immediately ask The Sun what powers the mind dragon had.
However, the timing was clearly not right, and he could only hold back for the time being.
Derrick muttered to himself, "When the Lord first awakened, 'He' took back 'His' authority from the ancient gods... Could it be that 'His' authority was scattered and lost after 'He' fell asleep?"
Perhaps, I should exchange information about the legends and deities of the normal world with Miss Justice and the others?
Ebner looked around at the people who were either deep in thought, excited, solemn, or curious. To ease the mood, he joked,
"Speaking of which, it's also a coincidence. Apart from Miss Judgment who just joined, the rest of us happen to be Beyonders of the Omnipotent and Omniscient pathway."
The Hanged Man was taken aback when he heard that. He thought to himself that The Tower was indeed a Beyonder of the Reader pathway. Then, he suddenly snapped to his senses and suddenly looked at Mr. Fool who was sitting at the seat of honor in a leisurely manner. There was only one thought in his mind: This is definitely not a coincidence!
There must be a deeper meaning to the actions of the gods! Miss Judgment is an exception because she was recommended by Tower, and not personally chosen by Mr. Fool.
Apart from the Secrets Suppliant pathway, the other pathways that "He" had personally selected were all "omnipotent and omniscient."
Furthermore, Mr. Fool is clearly hostile towards the True Creator. He even belittled it by calling it the Fallen Creator!
Could it be that "He" is also coveting the "omnipotent and omniscient" authority? Is this the path to becoming a god?
At that moment, Alger felt that he had finally figured out the deeper purpose of Mr. Fool's gathering.
Klein guessed what The Hanged Man was thinking from the changes in the colors of his emotions. He immediately felt speechless. Could he really say that it was a coincidence?
By mentioning it so directly, Mr. Tower must've been imagining something, right? Is he using this opportunity to test me? These two sure are worrisome. Just look at Miss Justice, Mr. Sun, and Miss Judgment. They don't have that many thoughts...
Forget it, explaining would only make things worse. They probably wouldn't believe it either... That's good too. It will increase their sense of awe and lessen my troubles...

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Cattleya’s Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 254 - Cattleya's Arrival
Alger reined in his emotions and took a deep breath before saying to Ebner,
"Thank you for your answer, Mr. Tower."
He didn't say exactly what he had figured out, afraid that he would be punished by Mr. Fool.
Do not pry into the mystery of God! Alger repeated this inwardly a few times before finally calming down. To hide his loss of composure, he deliberately changed topics.
"At the dawn of Friday, the military sealed 1-025 which originally belonged to the Church of Storms again. They didn't return it to the Church of Storms, as though they had other uses for it."
1-025? Early in the morning on Friday? Indeed... Back then, Baron Conva broke out of the encirclement after escaping 1-025. It's no wonder he only had his head left. From the looks of it, he was beaten up very badly.
Ebner nodded in thought. He had already guessed it. After all, if the Grade 1 seal was still on the baron, it wouldn't be easy for them to escape, even with Fors's bracelet helping them.
Klein, who was sitting at the seat of honor, couldn't help but look at "Tower" and "Judgment" when he heard that. He thought to himself, So there was such a terrifying thing that night? Thankfully, I wasn't there and only watched the livestream...
On the other hand, Audrey was delighted that the Grade 1 that she had lost was finally under control. She didn't wish for Backlund, which she was living in, to suffer any major losses due to the loss of the Sealed Artifact. She had been on tenterhooks ever since she heard about it, and she was finally relieved.
As for who eventually obtained the Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, she didn't care.
At this moment, Xio wanted to mention that Baron Conva was pursuing Mr. Fool's aura, but on second thought, she felt that it was purely a guess of his without any basis... Besides, Ebner himself didn't report it to Mr. Fool... More importantly, with Mr. Fool's godlike powers, he probably knew of this long ago...
Therefore, she opened her mouth but ultimately didn't say it out loud.
At this moment, Klein's spirituality was almost exhausted. Seeing that no one was sharing it, he decisively ended the gathering.
He watched as Justice, The Hanged Man, The Tower, Judgment, and The Sun disappeared before his eyes.
Klein didn't stay any longer. He used his spirituality to envelop himself and simulate the sensation of descending rapidly. All that was left was the towering palace, the ancient table, and the twenty-two high-back chairs silently standing above the gray fog.
Having "returned" to the real world, Klein dispelled the wall of spirituality and was just about to head out to buy some spiritual materials for rituals
As he had become a Clown, his weekly salary had increased to 10 pounds, reaching the level of a senior Nighthawk. Together with the 300 pounds that Mr. Tower had sacrificed from the junk pile above the gray fog and the 100 pounds he had earned from selling the formula, he was very confident.
But just as he reached the living room on the first floor, he suddenly felt something touch his arm.
Apart from him, something in the living room touched his arm!
His hair stood on end as Klein retracted his arm. He turned his head and saw five thin, pale fingers growing on the tip of a red tongue. Beneath them were irregular sharp teeth!
Klein first reached into his pocket where the Slumber and Requiem Charms were. Following that, he saw the five baby-like fingers holding onto a neatly folded piece of paper.
A letter...
Messenger!
Klein heaved a sigh of relief.
At this moment, the five pale fingers holding onto the paper touched his arm again.
Klein took a deep breath and grabbed the letter with his left hand. Then, from the corner of his eye, he saw the pale fingers, red tongue, and irregular sharp teeth dim and disappear.
With a thought, Klein tapped his left molar and secretly activated his Spirit Vision.
He saw the five abnormally thin fingers again. He saw the long red tongue embedded with sharp white teeth. He saw them retract into the transparent face on the ground.
A second later, the face burrowed underground as though it had never been there.
It seems like when Spirit Body creatures are willing to be seen and have the corresponding powers, even ordinary people can discover them...
As Klein thought, he unfolded the letter and read the letter from Spirit Guide Daly.
"The Mysticism Magister from the joint investigation team, Stuart, will take the afternoon steam locomotive back to Tingen. He might come to ask you about something...
"There's no need to be nervous. Just answer honestly.
"Also, this person doesn't seem to have a good reputation when it comes to relationships. Try not to let him interact with Dunn.
"Of course, if they really talk about something, remember to write to me...
"I will pay you something you look forward to."
Klein's lips twitched as he read the letter. He confirmed that it was Daly herself.
Mysticism Magister Stuart... Why did he return? Doesn't Tingen City no longer have Secret Order members?
Is he suspecting something about me?
With this in mind, Klein decided not to meet the deacon of the Church of Storms alone, lest he used a mystical technique to dig out some secrets from him. When that happened, he might not even be able to silence him.
Following that, after burning the letter, Klein changed his clothes and went out, heading straight for the underground market of the Evil Dragon Bar.
On the way, he suddenly heard the paperboy shout out the addition of the Tingen City Honest Paper.
Additional issue? Special issue? Did something major happen? Klein's heart stirred as he took out a penny to buy a newspaper.
Then he saw the title of the additional magazine:
"The steam locomotive from Backlund to Tingen derailed due to extreme weather. The exact number of casualties is unknown."
The train derailed? May the Goddess bless us. I hope the passengers are fine... Klein subconsciously drew the crimson moon on his chest, but he didn't pay too much attention to it. He got on the public carriage and headed for the harbor.
...
About 60 kilometers away from Tingen, in Maple Leaf Town, Stuart helped rescue the passengers from the train carriage. When he saw that the sun had already set, he couldn't help but sigh.
I only have a day or so of vacation. I won't be able to go to Tingen in time... After a night's rest in Maple Leaf Town, I'll have to return to Backlund tomorrow... I can only wait until Monday to investigate what's hidden there.
Sigh, my luck seems to be terrible recently...
"Does this imply something?"
...
In the evening, Xio, who had taken off her disguise and cleaned up her makeup, ate and drank at Ebner's house.
Ebner watched her stuff a piece of pie into her mouth in a few mouthfuls as he quipped with a smile, "Miss Justice would never have imagined that the proper Miss Judgment would be like this in private."
"* * * good * * *?" Xio puffed her cheeks and said indistinctly.
