Although he didn't understand, he subconsciously felt that it wasn't something nice, so he didn't press further. Instead, he asked,
"How does it feel to participate in the Tarot Club for the first time?"
Xio had already swallowed the pie. After some thought, she replied, "Mr. Fool is much milder than I imagined. Miss Justice is also more approachable than when I was interacting with her..."
"That's because she doesn't have any augmentation from her status in the Tarot Club. You are all equal members, so it's naturally easier for you to come into contact with her," Ebner analyzed with a smile.
Xio thought for a moment and felt that it was indeed the case, so she didn't think too much about it. After discussing the traits of The Sun and The Hanged Man, she asked Ebner in a serious manner, "Can you tell me something that you couldn't tell me at the Tarot Club?"
"Partially, but the ins and outs of your father's matter are too dangerous. The timing isn't right, and our strengths are lacking. Even if I were to tell you at the Tarot Gathering, if you can't forget it, leaving Mr. Fool's kingdom will still result in danger," Ebner said after some thought.
The most troublesome thing about this matter was that it was arranged by the King of Angels who couldn't say its name. The more he knew, the easier it was to be detected.
Xio wasn't like him who had an extremely high-level cheat code, nor did she have a deity backing her up to conceal her tracks...
And Mr. Fool, who was viewed as his pillar of support, was still a "good-for-nothing."
"As expected," Xio said with a sigh. She had long guessed this outcome and wasn't disappointed.
...
In a warehouse in the Backlund dock area, Jane calmly flipped through a novel in the darkness. As though she was happy to see something, her eyebrows arched up.
At that moment, the color in her eyes instantly turned black, dotted with countless resplendent lights.
It was like the cosmos was reflected in his eyes.
Soon, the "gravel" formed from stars quickly spun. In a daze, it seemed to gather into a black-haired lady wearing a classic robe.
"Captain!" Jane put down her novel, stood up, and greeted her happily.
It was none other than Admiral of Stars Cattleya. This beautiful lady in a white shirt and tailcoat adjusted her glasses and frowned. "Why are you here?"
"A Spirit Medium has to maintain some level of mystery," Jane explained with a smile.
"Spirit Medium..." Cattleya immediately fell silent. It took her quite a while before she said, "There's someone who can channel spirits in such a place?"
"Th-they went into a pitch-black warehouse by mistake while drunk and met the mysterious and beautiful Spirit Medium. Through spirit channeling, they resolved the problem that had been plaguing them all this time. When everything was over, they realized that they couldn't find the warehouse they were at when they were drunk... Isn't this script great?" Jane said in excitement.
"I remember that there was a similar plot in Stormwind Mountain Villa," Cattleya exposed.
"Ahem..." Jane coughed dryly and changed the topic. "Captain, I invited you here for official business."
"Oh, you mentioned in your letter that you want me to help you kill a Sequence 5 Gatekeeper? Although I have already agreed to help you gather the ingredients for the Spirit Guide potion, isn't it too early to consider the Gatekeeper characteristic?" Cattleya narrowed her eyes and asked cautiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Tuesday
chapters.content:
Chapter 255 - Tuesday
"Although I just became a Spirit Medium not long ago, and I'm still far from digesting it completely, there's no harm in making preparations early..." Jane replied after some deliberation.
Cattleya looked at her subordinate, who had been assigned to her ship by Queen Mystic, and knew that she wasn't telling the whole truth. All she could do was think, I thought I finally had someone to worry about, but I never expected that I'll end up like the fellows on the ship, always causing trouble for me...
However, despite feeling exhausted, Cattleya asked after some thought, "Who is that Sequence 5 Gatekeeper? Tell me in detail."
Jane didn't dare to hide anything on this matter; otherwise, it was very likely that she would harm her captain, as well as herself and Xio. Therefore, she recounted in detail the information that Ebner had previously told her, as well as his battle achievements when fighting MI9. Finally, she concluded,
"Overall, that Gatekeeper is equivalent to a powerful Sequence 5 Beyonder who possesses a demigod-level Sealed Artifact. As for his strange spiritual strength, it's unknown. But from his previous performance, he's likely only a Sequence 5 or 6."
A Baron from more than seven hundred years ago... Corrupted by a high-level existence... A Gatekeeper who can use the powers of a Black Knight... This isn't including that strange Spirit Body...
Although Cattleya had expected this, she never expected the person Jane was dealing with to be so difficult to deal with. After a moment of surprise, she said in exasperation,
"For such a person, even if you use the Sealed Artifact you obtained from the mausoleum and can temporarily control Ludwell and me to cooperate, it will only defeat him at best. It will be difficult to retain him... I advise you to give up."
"What if there are still Wraiths and Zombies helping to block his escape? Although they won't join the attack, they will help restrict his mobility." Jane had already communicated with Miss Sharron and made a deal.
"That's worth a try..." Cattleya pondered for a moment before nodding slightly. Then, she said to Jane in a profound manner, "I won't ask why you insisted on killing that Gatekeeper. It's just that, regardless of the outcome, the favor I owe you before the ruins are repaid."
"Of course." Jane nodded without hesitation.
"In that case, tell me your plan." Cattleya nudged her thick glasses and asked.
"Alright, Captain." Jane went with the flow and then explained her plan of using Xio as bait to fish out the baron.
"The plan is alright. The only loophole is that the baron's whereabouts are unknown. The 'bait' you prepared might not be able to encounter him." Having said that, Cattleya habitually nudged her glasses and asked, "Do you have a backup plan?"
"Unfortunately, there's no such thing..." Jane sighed. Her only social connection in Backlund was Ebner. She had formulated a plan without alerting him. It was already very good that she could perfect it so perfectly. There was no way she could have any backup plans.
"In that case, I'll need two days to prepare. I'll begin taking action on Wednesday night... In addition, I'll stay in Backlund until Friday at most. If the other party doesn't fall for it, I'll give up on this operation," Cattleya said after nearly twenty seconds of silence.
"Sure, I have no objections." Jane thought for a moment and exhaled.
...
That night, after Xio placed all her disguises and makeup tools in the storeroom at Ebner, she bade farewell and returned to her rented apartment.
She and Fors had already moved from North Borough to Cherwood Borough, and their residence wasn't far from Kingster Street, so there was no need for them to stay the night like before.
On the way, Xio's spiritual perception was suddenly triggered. However, before she could activate her Spirit Vision, a letter was stuffed into her hand.
Xio opened the letter warily and read it before muttering to herself with a serious expression, "Wednesday night?"
Then, she came to the park by the street, lit the letter, burned it to ashes, and scattered it in the grass.
...
Tuesday morning, Klein knocked on the Captain's office door with great familiarity.
After receiving permission, he turned the doorknob and pushed open the door. He saw the Captain enjoying his breakfast. To his right was a cup of coffee emitting a rich aroma. On the plate in front of him was white bread, toast, and bacon.
"What's the matter?" Dunn took out a piece of tissue and wiped the corners of his mouth.
"Mr. Stuart hasn't arrived yet?" Klein had already circled the office previously, but since he didn't find the deacon of the Church of Storms, he wanted to visit the Captain and report something.
"Mr. Stuart had an affair on the train. He had already sent a telegram last night, saying that he would visit again next week." Dunn handed a telegram to Klein.
Klein took it and scanned through it. Thinking of the "Honest Paper" he bought yesterday afternoon, he subconsciously blurted out, "What a coincidence."
As he spoke, he glanced at the Captain through the corner of his eye. Apart from some electric characters, there was an open magazine in front of the Captain.
"It's indeed a coincidence, but it should be written in the telegram. The Mysticism Magister has confirmed that the accident was purely accidental and that there were no signs of it being done by someone else. When it comes to investigating cases, we should trust the professionalism of a Mysticism Magister who was once a detective," Dunn said as he leaned back in his chair.
When Klein heard that, he nodded and skipped the topic. He began talking about the main purpose of his visit.
"I've met Daxter Guderian, the doctor from the mental asylum and a member of the Psychology Alchemists."
At that moment, he noticed the title of the magazine in front of the Captain through the corner of his eye.
"The Donningsman Tree Sap in the Southern Continent's rainforests has an obvious effect of boosting hair growth."
This... Could it be that he wants to take note of his image after making progress with Madam Daly?
In fact, Beyonders didn't have to go through that much trouble. If Old Neil was still around, he would most likely suggest designing ritualistic magic for hair regrowth. He could then pray to the Goddess for help. As for whether he would eventually grow fur and become a curly-haired baboon, that would be a whole other matter...
Cough, perhaps Mr. Tower, who has a deeper understanding of ritualistic magic, can design safer and more reliable methods...
Wait, why am I thinking about this? I'm not bald! Could it be that the past few late-night live streams have given me a sense of danger?
What the... spirituality warning?
The self-deprecation in his heart immediately dyed Klein's happiness with sorrow. The sorrow was filled with a comical feeling, just like a Clown.
Dunn leaned forward again and clasped his hands. He asked, "What information did the doctor provide?"
Klein snapped back to his senses and threw away the ridiculous thoughts in his mind. He briefly described, "He told me that before Hood Eugen went mad, someone had visited him frequently. That person's name was Lanevus."
"Lanevus..." Dunn rubbed his temples. "I seem to have heard of it somewhere..."
"The cheat who swindled at least 10,000 pounds," Klein reminded him.
At the same time, he couldn't help but lampoon, Captain, you're not sensitive at all to money!
Dunn thought for a moment with a serious expression before shaking his head, indicating that he had no recollection of it.
Upon seeing this, Klein had no choice but to recount the main points related to Lanevus. Then, he applied to channel Hood Eugen's spirit in a bid to obtain clues.
Dunn finally agreed to Klein's plan. After some thought, he decided.
"...We'll go at dawn and secretly sneak in.
"I'll stay by the side to prevent any accidents from happening."
...
Backlund, South of the Bridge, Rose Street.
A rental carriage stopped at the entrance of the Harvest Church. After taking a glance at the grayish-white fog in midair, he pressed down on his silk top hat and unhurriedly walked out of the carriage and passed through the door.
The moment he entered, he saw Miss Hazel in her priest attire carefully wiping the candle stands with a cloth and a bucket of water.
And Father Utravsky, who seemed to have grown a little taller, was preaching in the morning.
He randomly found a seat and waited. After the priest finished his final toast, he walked forward and greeted Bishop Utravsky with a smile before asking,
"Father, is there any news of Wednesday's ball?"
Bishop Utravsky smiled warmly and said, "My identity isn't suitable for such an occasion, but I helped you get an invitation."
As he spoke, he took out an exquisitely printed card and handed it to Ebner.
"Thank you very much, Father." Ebner received the card and thanked him with a sincere nod.
"Heh heh, the person you should thank the most is Member of Parliament Macht. It was because of his help that everything went so smoothly. Yes, their family will likely be attending the ball. You can just follow the Member of Parliament." Bishop Utravsky chuckled.
Together with Member of Parliament Macht... Perhaps I can get a ride on the carriage? While his thoughts wandered, he found it inappropriate to leave immediately. He picked up a piece of cloth and helped Hazel wipe the tables and chairs in the cathedral.
But just as he was wiping the handrail of the basement stairs, he discovered that the Sacred Emblem of Life engraved with spiritual materials on the heavy stone door that had once imprisoned Hazel had lit up once again. Together with many mysterious symbols, it formed a complete seal.
"Who are they holding this time?
Wait, counting the time... Could it be some vampire who got lost and came to me?

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Sending a Message
chapters.content:
Chapter 256 - Sending a Message
Wait... Could it be some vampire who got lost and came to me?
Ebner mumbled inwardly, but he didn't ask further. After all, Emlyn had joined the Church of Earth Mother as the right god. There was no need for him to interfere.
However, when Bishop Utravsky saw the peculiar look on his face, he explained with a smile, "It's a special Sealed Artifact. It's in... Well, in the words of Emperor Roselle, it's in the maintenance of the power of faith."
A Sealed Artifact that can be regularly protected with the power of faith? Could it be something like the Earth Mother's divine descent vessel? Is there such a terrifying thing in the Harvest Church?
It's no wonder the bishop wasn't worried that her demigod teacher would come knocking after receiving Hazel...
However, if there really was such a powerful Sealed Artifact, how did Ray successfully steal the mystical item from the Harvest Church? Was it before the Sealed Artifact arrived, or did he deliberately let it go?
As his thoughts raced, he tactfully ignored the topic. After wiping the tables and chairs in the prayer hall, he bade farewell to Bishop Utravsky and Miss Hazel.
The latter hesitated for a moment before saying, "My carriage will pass by Cherwood Borough's Golden Street around four in the afternoon tomorrow. You can just wait there."
Ebner was taken aback, never expecting to be given a ride. He then said with a smile, "Alright... Hazel, please thank Member of Parliament Macht on my behalf."
Hazel nodded slightly before she fell silent. She silently began her routine prayer.
...
Outside an abandoned manor on the outskirts of Enmat Harbor, the first mate of the Future, Frank Lee, carefully followed his captain's instructions and used different strengths and intervals to knock on the manor's door.
The first mate was wearing dungarees and a white shirt. He was in his thirties and looked healthy. He had thick hair, making his exposed forearm look like it was covered in a brown sweater.
However, the place he was in was so strange that his spirituality had already wildly issued a "warning." Frank only felt that the "sweater" on him didn't give him any warmth or security. If he didn't trust his captain very much, he would've long fled.
With great difficulty, he knocked on the door according to his captain's instructions. Frank waited silently. Even though he didn't see any abnormalities, he still felt that the manor was like a monster that was about to open its mouth, ready to swallow him at any moment.
Suddenly, green pea vines drooped down from the sky, interweaving into a lush forest.
The "forest" didn't have a peak as the vines formed different paths. They either intersected or spiraled, extending high into the sky.
Frank was taken aback for a second before he came to a realization. Then, he casually found a pea vine to circle around him as he walked down the hanging trail.
The appearance of these special plants soothed Frank's horror. As he walked, he used his powers as a Biologist to instinctively analyze their composition.
If it wasn't for the fact that these plants were seemingly illusory, and how he felt that deliberately destroying them would result in terrible outcomes, Frank would've taken the peas back to study them.
"These beans grow so quickly. If I were to graft it to a cow and let every vine produce milk, wouldn't it be better than simply planting 'cows'?"
After silently muttering to himself, Frank quickly saw the green plants form a hammock that gently swayed from high above.
He couldn't see what was on the chair. All he saw was a pair of black leather boots hanging down. At the same time, a gentle but emotionless voice entered Frank's ears.
"Why did she get you here?"
It seems to be a lady... Is she someone Captain knows? I wonder if you can give me a few of those peas for Captain's sake... As Frank let his thoughts wander, he took out a letter and a small box and handed it to her.
He didn't know who he was meeting, and he was only following his captain's instructions.
A slender palm reached out from the chair to receive the letter and box, but the owner of the palm didn't intend to immediately read it. Instead, he fell silent for a moment before muttering to himself, "She didn't choose to use the messenger... Does she think that the spirit world isn't safe... Or does she think that the information she passes on isn't urgent?"
With that said, she first opened the letter and briefly read it. After pondering for a moment, she said to Frank, "Go back... Tell her that I know what she said. Also, get away from that abandoned manor as soon as possible."
Frank nodded in confusion before he didn't dare delay any further. He planned on retracing his steps.
But at this moment, the pea vines suddenly shrank upwards and gradually faded away. The green forest quickly disappeared.
Frank immediately landed at the entrance of the abandoned manor. There was no one around, other than the manor that resembled a "monster." It looked no different from before.
The fairytale-like scene from before seemed like an illusion.
Frank recalled the mysterious lady's exhortations and his heart palpitated. He quickly ran towards the harbor.
At the same time, on the top floor of the abandoned manor, a lady wearing a white Intis-styled shirt and a dark-black jacket, with a thin rapier by her waist, dressed like a standard sea captain, was brandishing resplendent starlight as she descended onto a monster formed from shadows.
Right on the heels of that, the starlight instantly condensed, creating a huge transparent amber that firmly enveloped the shadow "monster."
After doing all of this, the lady opened the box with complicated patterns and took out a card.
It really is a Card of Blasphemy... This should be the Death card, and it has been activated... It's no wonder Cattleya doesn't dare to hand it to the messenger...
But what's so special about that person named Frank? He actually brought this card to me safely... Only when it was handed to me did this card attract the "monsters" of the spirit world and Underworld...
"How did Cattleya know of his uniqueness?"
As she muttered to herself, the lady picked up the letter and seriously read it a few times before frowning. Then, her blue eyes that resembled the sea turned extremely deep, like the surface of the sea before a storm.
Under such circumstances, she clearly lost her focus as her eyes turned blurry.
She was prying into the secrets of the River of Fate and making a prophecy of Cattleya's and Jane's subsequent actions.
In the next second, the lady raised her right hand.
Her skin immediately turned as white as snow, and her lips turned as red as blood. Her hair turned as black as ebony.
An illusory, ancient mirror appeared in her hand.
Silently, she "saw" a scene:
Black sticky spots surged out of the body of a man who had been possessed by an evil spirit.
Bang!
The transparent Eyes of Mystery Prying suddenly shattered.
The lady rubbed her temples to ease the pain from the backlash and muttered to herself in puzzlement,
What are Cattleya and Jane up to?
...
On Wednesday afternoon, Ebner boarded Member of Parliament Macht's carriage at his doorstep and headed for Duke Negan's mansion in Backlund's Empress Borough.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Ball
chapters.content:
Chapter 257 - Ball
Hillston Borough, in a house with a stable and garden.
Qilangos, who had a unique broad chin and dark green eyes, looked at the unconscious Baron Gramir. He took off his clothes and changed into his own clothes.
Right on the heels of that, he leisurely walked in front of the dressing mirror and watched the black glove on his left hand squirm as though it was digesting something. He saw many distorted lines appear on its back.
A few seconds later, Qilangos saw himself in the mirror with a strong nose and thin eyebrows. Even his cheeks were drooping, and his eyes had turned pale blue. He looked exactly like the unconscious Baron Gramir, be it his height, looks, or temperament.
After examining the baron a few times and matching his habits, Qilangos bent down and broke the baron's neck. He dragged him to the side and stuffed him into the wardrobe.
"What a hypocritical and foolish noble, making me waste so much time to learn the strange pronunciation and so-called noble accent of certain words..."
Qilangos sneered in disdain. Then, he dripped a few drops of amber-colored liquid onto his wrist and wiped them on different parts of his body. He then thought impatiently,
I wonder who collected the information, to actually record how long this idiot knew how to use perfume before attending the banquet... Could the partner over there have bribed one of his mistresses or head maid?
However, I seem to have missed the notice of time in the information... It doesn't matter. Who would be so bored as to care how long it takes for someone to spray perfume before participating in a banquet? After all, they're both brands and smells.
With that thought in mind, Qilangos instructed his servants not to enter his bedroom without permission. Then, he maintained his baron's demeanor and boarded the carriage with his butler accompanying him.
...
At seven in the evening, in Duke Negan's mansion, a grand ball was being held.
The place was divided into two parts. One was the dancing hall at the bottom level, which was paved with glamorous stone slabs engraved with complicated patterns. In the corner was an excellent band belonging to the duke. Up the stairs of the hall was a winding corridor that circled the second floor. The guests held wine glasses and stood in front of the railing, overlooking the dancing below. It was as if they were watching a fencing match from the stands. From time to time, a gentleman would walk in front of a lady or madam and invite them to dance. If permission was given, both parties would walk down the stairs hand in hand and enter the hall.
On the other side of the winding corridor that was not close to the hall, there were doors after doors. Behind them was the guest lounge.
But behind the double door was a corridor, and on both sides of the corridor were different plaster statues of the ancestors of the Negan family.
At the end of the hall was another part of the ball. It was also a hall with long tables filled with all sorts of delicacies and wine. Another band belonging to the duke was playing relaxing melodies for the guests.
In the hall, the guests were gathered in groups of three or five, either sitting or standing as they conversed about various matters. Those who wished to avoid the din for a short period of time entered the attached balconies to take in the garden's scenery and the crimson moon in the sky.
At that moment, Ebner was holding a cup of Aurmir red wine that had been deciphered by the White Eye. He stood beside the two-story staircase in the dancing hall, carefully and furtively observing the guests.
Although this cup of wine wasn't a collector's version of 1286, it was still a high-end product produced in 1330. The entire bottle was worth about 130 pounds.
Usually, Ebner would never buy such expensive red wine, but since someone was treating him, he naturally took the opportunity to enjoy it.
At this moment, he saw a blonde, soft-haired girl walk up the stairs after the opening dance.
Her green eyes were as beautiful as gems, but they also seemed like the surface of the sea that hid maelstroms, making it impossible for anyone to shift their gaze away.
However, what caught Aibner's attention was a ring that she had accidentally revealed.
The ring was embedded with red and black gems. It was in a unique and dazzling manner. It was none other than the "fake anger" he had previously sold at the Tarot Club.
This girl is Miss Justice? As expected of the most dazzling jewel in Backlund!
Ebner secretly marveled before retracting his gaze. He didn't come here today to meet the "netizens" offline, but to ensure that the "plot" played out normally. Therefore, he didn't plan on interacting with Miss Justice, who was a very important "actress" in this matter, to prevent any accidents from happening to the "butterfly."
On the other side, Audrey didn't notice that Ebner was "sizing her up." This was because there were many gentlemen sizing her up. Many of them were already itching to dance.
How boring, but it's not like I can't participate... Sigh, can't they just let me quietly observe? I have to say, some people have rich expressions when dancing. They remind me of animals seeking mates...
After sighing helplessly, Audrey suddenly had an idea. She took two quick steps before the gentlemen invited her and stepped onto the corridor that led to the dining hall.
At the same time, in a corner of the winding corridor on the second floor, two unpopular ladies were leaning against the railings and chatting.
One of them was Miss Hazel who had come with Ebner. She had been ostracized by the gentlemen of high society after the incident at the Daily Observer's headquarters. After such a long period of time, she was already used to it. She even felt that it was a little quieter, so she remained very calm.
As for the other person, she was the youngest daughter of Viscount Horrorhawks. As she had done quite a number of outrageous things during her time as a Swindler, she was hated by many. Even though she had a strong background, she still had the reputation of being "eccentric." Now, she was naturally left in the corner.
However, the two ladies weren't in the mood to be depressed. Holding their drinks, they pouted in the direction of Ebner and said, "Look, Ebner seems to be attracted by the 'most dazzling jewel of Backlund.'"
Hazel glanced at her and said coldly, "What does his attraction have to do with me?"
"Aren't the two of you on very good terms? I heard that you even revealed some of my matters to him." Emma rolled her eyes and asked indirectly.
"He cut off my arm... How can such a relationship be good?" Hazel puffed her cheeks in an inelegant manner before retorting, "Your topic has always been revolving around him. Your relationship with him is really good, right? Otherwise, he wouldn't have sold me out."
So you really mentioned me to Ebner... I thought it was just an excuse he made up...
Although she was deep in thought, she didn't seem embarrassed at all. She smiled and admitted, "I do have a good relationship with him..."
Hazel frowned when she heard that. She thought to herself that Detective Bryan really didn't know Emma two weeks ago. How long had it been, and they were already so familiar with each other? Could it be that the rumors about Detective Bryan were true? He was a playboy and very good at getting girls to like him?
But he didn't show this side of him at the Harvest Church...
With her acumen as a Cryptologist, she easily guessed what Hazel was thinking. She found her naivety amusing as she found her adorable. She was even more knowledgeable than Jenny. She had really chosen the wrong pathway.
...
After being discussed by the two ladies, Ebner tensed up when Audrey walked into the corridor that led to the dining hall. This meant that Vice Admiral Hurricane's disguise was about to be seen through, and the "plot" was about to begin.
He looked at the huge crystal chandelier hanging from the roof and then at the defenseless guests in the dancing hall on the first floor.
If everything remained the same, Qilangos would use Wind Blades to cut the metal chain of the chandelier and create chaos...
With such a heavy chandelier hanging down, the people below would probably suffer heavy casualties...
Since he had encountered it, he had to try his best to save it.
The principles that he had previously set for himself flashed through his mind, and he made up his mind.
Although he needed to ensure that the "plot" happened tonight, saving the people in the dance hall wouldn't affect the "plot."
After a brief deliberation, Ebner carried his wine cup to a corner of the corridor and came before the two ladies, Emma and Hazel.
"Ebner, do you want to invite me for a dance?" Seeing him approach, Ema asked with a smile.
However, Ebner only greeted her politely before turning to face Hazel. He bowed in a standard manner and said, "Miss Hazel, may I invite you for a dance?"
Hazel glanced at him and fell silent for a few seconds.
"It's my honor."
She then extended her metal palm.
Ebner politely held her hand as they walked up the stairs to the first floor and entered the dance floor. Following the melody, they began a brisk and lively dance.
At this moment, Emma, who had been left on the winding corridor on the second floor, frowned. She could tell that there was something wrong with Ebner's attitude. Although he didn't give any clear indication, he had secretly waved at her when he turned around.
Ever since I've come into contact with that detective, he's rarely been this serious... Is something serious going to happen? Well, regardless, I'll go and hide for now... It should be safer at the restaurant at this time!
After making up her mind, she ignored the gazes of others and left the corner angrily, following the long corridor towards the restaurant.
On the dance floor, directly under the dome chandelier.
Ebner looked at Hazel's beautiful but expressionless face and asked solemnly,
"How heavy is this arm made from ancient alchemy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Saving People
chapters.content:
Chapter 258 - Saving People
"The greatest burden?" Hazel looked up and swept her gaze. "Could there be an accident at this ball?"
The major change in her life stemmed from a ball, and at that time, the detective in front of her was the first to discover the problem... Therefore, when she heard the question, she immediately made the connection.
"I found a person among the guests who made me feel that he was very dangerous... Although I don't know who he is, nor can I determine his motives, I guess that no matter what he wants to do, he will first cause chaos," Ebner explained to Hazel in a measured tone.
Hazel thought for a moment when she heard that. Using the opportunity of spinning during the dance, she looked up at the huge crystal chandelier on the roof and said in enlightenment, "You believe the other party will sever the chandelier's chains?"
Ebner nodded and took a step diagonally with her in his arms. He said with a smile, "My intuition tells me so... As you know, my intuition has always been very accurate."
Very accurate. That's why she ran away the moment he saw me approach at the ball in the Daily Observer... Hazel's mouth subconsciously gaped before closing it again. After nearly ten seconds, she said,
"My metallic arm is actually a steel golem created by Miss Judi's father. It only transformed into an arm and is attached to my body for my use...
I know that. I also know that I installing it for you in the beginning was to prevent your demigod teacher from doing so. It's to create a temporary protective and positioning function, allowing the Church's powerhouses to quickly descend...
However, due to the excessive amount of resources provided by Member of Parliament Macht, the Church of Earth had likely changed its attitude, changing the Golem's "clearance," allowing it to be kept by you for extended periods of time, allowing you to use most of its abilities."
As he thought this, he heard Hazel continue,
"In its normal state, it can easily pick up an item weighing about 100 kilograms. It can resist high temperatures and low temperatures, and it's even immune to some magic and curses... Once the seal is completely removed and the spirit inside awakens, it can restore it to the form of a steel golem... I'm not sure of its exact strength, but Miss Judi had once commented that, although it can't compare to a Guardian, it's not much weaker...
"However, she also warned me that once the 'spirit' within it awakens, I have to bring it back to the Harvest Church to seal it again. Otherwise, the 'spirit' will gradually go mad and lose control..."
After some thought, he asked sincerely, "If the chandelier really crashes down, I will try my best to slow it down. Can you hold on for a few seconds to give the guests around you a chance to escape?"
Although he wanted to save her, he had no intention of forcing her.
Hazel looked up silently and said two seconds later, "Why didn't you report it to Duke Negan?"
"I don't have any evidence. Do I want others to believe my intuition?" Ebner was already prepared for this as he feigned exasperation.
Hazel nodded in agreement before solemnly saying, "If your intuition is correct, I'll do my best."
She originally had a sense of justice. Otherwise, she wouldn't have helped Dwayne capture the intruder in the middle of the night.
And after joining the Church of Earth Mother, she was infected by Bishop Utravsky's actions, and she was now "reborn."
With that said, Hazel didn't continue on the topic. She focused her attention back on the dance as though she was immersed in the music.
Ebner also fell silent. As he was immersed in the beautiful melody with the girl, his attention was focused on a gentleman on the second floor who was holding a cup of red wine, as though he was admiring a beautifully dressed lady and madams.
...
At the same time, Audrey noticed that something was wrong with the smell of the Amber perfume on Baron Gramir. She began to suspect his identity.
After reporting her discovery to her father, Earl Hall, Audrey left the dining hall and entered a corridor. She familiarly found Duke Negan's small prayer room.
She pushed open the door and locked it behind her. She then found a dark corner and sat down. She leaned forward and clasped her hands together in a praying position, holding them to her forehead.
Then, she chanted softly in Hermes,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era, you are the mysterious ruler above the gray fog. You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
...
In a simple room in the Holy Wind Cathedral, Alger was organizing the Roselle text notebook he had borrowed from the dossier. But at that moment, he suddenly saw his vision turn illusory as a thick grayish-white fog appeared.
Moments later, Alger pressed his hand to his chest in surprise and joy, praising Mr. Fool before taking his items and leaving.
He was going to find one of the Cardinals of the Church of Storms, the Archbishop of the Backlund diocese, Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake!
For Alger Wilson, personally killing Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos was the best course of action, but if he couldn't do it, it was still acceptable to confirm that he was dead!
However, he was soon informed by Backlund's acting captain of the Mandated Punisher team, that Mr. Snake had gone for a stroll by the Tussock River...
Taking a stroll... At this time? If not for his mental fortitude, Alger would've grimaced.
He took a deep breath to calm himself. After asking where Mr. Snake might be, he didn't hesitate to rush over.
When Stuart, who happened to come over to handle some matters, saw this scene, he frowned deeply.
...
On the second floor of Duke Negan's mansion, Qilangos glanced at the huge crystal chandelier hanging from the ceiling and decided not to wait any longer.
He pressed his right hand forward slightly.
Woo!
A sudden gust of wind swept the area above the dance floor, extinguishing the candles on the crystal chandelier.
As the light and darkness intertwined, and just as everyone's attention was drawn, a few wind blades struck the same spot on the metal chain that hung the crystal chandelier under the cover of the strong winds.
Creak!
Amidst a jarring shattering sound, the huge crystal chandelier fell straight down.
At this moment, it happened to be the end of a dance tune. There were definitely many men and women on the dance floor. If they were really smashed, even if they survived by chance, they would suffer some unspeakable damage.
The constantly paying attention to the developments of the situation was naturally the first thing he noticed. Without any hesitation, he activated the White Eye and simulated a Glide around the falling chandelier.
However, as the huge lamp was too heavy, it far exceeded the weight limit of Ebner's low-profile powers. Therefore, it could only slow down its descent slightly to buy time for the others to react.
It really smashed down... Upon seeing this, Hazel first glanced at Ebner, secretly expressing her admiration for his intuition.
In fact, she didn't believe in the so-called "intuition" that Ebner mentioned at all. She felt that it was definitely the result of his inference based on some clues, just like how he discovered that she had been corrupted by an evil god...
But this might very well involve his secret, so he was unwilling to say it...
As her thoughts raced, Hazel took the initiative to remove a portion of the seal on the metal arm. She instantly felt the "spirit" inside awaken.
After a simple communication with it, an illusory hand extended from the metal arm. It spread its fingers and caught the gigantic chandelier that was falling at a much slower speed.
However, even though the chandelier didn't crash onto the dance floor, the terrifying scene that they saw before their eyes sank into the darkness still caused screams to sound out one after another. Many gentlemen and ladies were flustered as they shoved each other in the darkness, looking like they were about to lead to a tragedy of being trampled upon.
After "simulating" the Midnight Poet's vision of the darkness, Ebner signaled Hazel to place the chandelier on the ground. Then, he jumped onto the lamp and activated the Fire of Light on the Ring of Light. He then rekindled most of the candles on the chandelier.
At the same time, the effects of the Sun domain's "Immunity to Horror" spread out with him at its center. Light and the courage that suddenly rose in their chests made the people in panic gradually regain their senses.
"It's Detective Hero! He caught the chandelier and saved us! We're fine now!" Under the warm power, the people who had regained their calm looked in the direction of the chandelier and immediately deduced a portion of the truth. Some even recognized Ebner.
The word "hero" was usually used for casual conversation, but in times of danger, it was a powerful "force" that could inspire people.
Therefore, even though the situation remained unclear, most of the people on the dance floor heaved a sigh of relief and quickly gathered around Ebner.
At this moment, Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos failed to kill Duke Negan despite his repeated attacks. Furthermore, the number of Beyonders present had exceeded his imagination. He realized that he might've revealed something and was thus ambushed!
Although he didn't want to believe his own judgment, Qilangos calmly responded.
He first used Creeping Hunger to release Dragon Might, intimidating the nearby Beyonders and ordinary people. Then, he took the opportunity to swirl a hurricane around him and ran at high speeds, breaking through a lounge door and the oriel window.
With a clang, he leaped out of the house and flew out of Duke Negan's mansion with the aid of the wind.
Just as he was about to smash through the window and take off, the illusory wings on a tree outside the manor suddenly flapped. She flew up and followed behind Qilangos at a leisurely pace.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Azik and Silika
chapters.content:
Chapter 259 - Azik and Silika
With the blessings of the wind, Qilangos relied on his "flight" ability to shake off his pursuers.
He looked around, intending to pretend that he had sneaked into the Tussock River and fled, before turning to run into the financial center of Backlund, the Hillston Borough.
At that moment, his vision suddenly blurred. He realized that he had stopped and was floating in midair. Beneath his feet was a dark water surface that was constantly rising. Under the water were pale-white palms that were grabbing outwards.
Right on the heels of that, a huge humanoid skeleton suddenly appeared. This Skeleton was four meters tall, and its eye sockets were burning with pitch-black flames. Its bones were illusory and blurry.
When Qilangos saw this, the corners of his mouth curled up into a sneer. Then, the glove on his left palm bloomed with a brilliant light, as if it was made of pure gold.
A streak of pure, blazing brilliance suddenly descended from the sky, enveloping the huge skeleton. The pale-white hands under the dark water evaporated one after another.
This was the Priest of Light's Light of Holiness.
The radiant pillar of light dissipated, and the pitch-black flames in the huge skeleton's eye sockets were extinguished. Then, it turned transparent and dissipated in the air.
But before Qilangos could heave a sigh of relief, similar skeletal monsters appeared around him one after another. One, two, three... There were more than a hundred of them!
More than a hundred pairs of eyes burning with pitch-black flames cast their gaze at him.
Qilangos's expression froze when he saw this.
When everything was over, there was a figure with a unique wide jaw and brown ancient warrior's hair bun.
However, at that moment, the figure's dark green, cold eyes appeared extremely empty... The glove he wore on his left hand had vanished.
...
In a hotel in Backlund's Cherwood Borough.
Azik, with his bronze skin and mole beside his ear, sat under the gas lamp and stared at a glove placed in front of him.
He looked at it for a while before revealing a painful and twisted expression. He muttered to himself,
"I-I think I've cooperated with them before..."
Before he finished his sentence, he suddenly stood up and shouted in a cold tone, "Who is it? Come out!"
As an invisible force descended, a bird holding onto a bottle staggered out of the void. She stared at the pained expression on Mr. Azik's face as a look of concern appeared in her eyes. She then flew in front of him and even threw the beloved bottle aside.
However, when she came close, many questions surfaced in her tiny, round head. She didn't seem to understand why she was so close to the person she had just met.
Mr. Azik seemed to have a similar feeling in his heart as his expression subconsciously eased. Seeing Silika's tiny body pounce over, he hurriedly extended his right hand and allowed it to land on his fingers.
The bird, Silika, didn't recover from her confusion until she stood on Mr. Azik's fingers. She tilted her head and chirped.
Mr. Azik seemed to be able to understand what she was saying. After listening quietly, he smiled and said,
"Is that so? You think I'm very close too? Heh heh, I feel the same way too..."
With that said, he raised his finger and placed it in front of his eyes. He seriously sized up the bird with silver illusory feathers and asked with a gentle smile, "What's your name?"
The silver-feathered bird didn't cry this time. Instead, a line of Loenese words condensed above its head: "Silika."
This line of text had an obvious personal style to it, so much so that even Mr. Azik couldn't help but feel dazed when he saw it.
"This is my handwriting!" Mr. Azik said to himself with great certainty.
The bird, Silika, cocked its head once again and chirped.
"Is that so? This line of text is your only memory after awakening in the Underworld? So you used it as a name?"
Mr. Azik nodded thoughtfully and closed his eyes. He kept muttering the names "Silika," as though he was trying to recall something.
Soon, the image of a black-haired young lady hugging his arm and wheedling appeared in his mind. However, when he tried to recall more, his head began to ache once again...
Seeing the gentleman in front of her, who she felt extremely close to, reveal a pained expression, she couldn't help but fly up and grab the bottle of Amantha extract that had fallen to the ground. She then brought it to the man's nose.
She knew that this medicine not only tasted good, but it could also quickly restore peace and serenity.
A refreshing fragrance entered his nostrils, and Mr. Azik quickly extricated himself from the maze of memories. He looked down at the concerned look on the bird's face, and his eyes softened. He emphasized, "Thank you, Silika."
Seeing that he was fine, Silika stuffed the bottle's lid back into place and carefully protected it under her illusory wings.
This was an apology gift from the bad guy who had bullied the little bird. It was unknown what materials and techniques he used to concoct it, but the taste was much better than what Cullen had concocted.
When Mr. Azik saw her actions, he couldn't help but smile. "When I'm free, I'll make some for you as a gift."
Upon hearing that, Silika nodded happily before flapping her illusory wings and chirping.
"He asked me if I thought of something? Heh heh, I did get something, but I can't be sure..." Mr. Azik chuckled and answered vaguely. Then, he asked Silika, "By the way, how did you find me?"
Silika's eyes darted around as a line of Loenese text appeared above her head again. "I'm helping someone track down the Wind-blessed."
Even though she felt that Mr. Azik was very close to her, she didn't forget the "mission" that was given to her by Ebner. After all, the book and the medicine were too tempting.
"Tracking Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos... Is your friend an official Beyonder?" Mr. Azik asked in surprise.
Silika shook her head and used the fog to conjure the name of Ebner.
She wasn't acting on her own accord. Instead, she was acting according to one of the plans that Ebner had previously exhorted her to do.
"Ebner Bryan... Hero Detective?" Mr. Azik pondered for a moment and finally made up his mind. He requested to Silika, "Can you take me to see your friend? You know that I'm searching for my memories. Perhaps he can help me remember something."
Upon hearing that, Silika immediately took off and chirped a few times, signaling the other party to follow.
Mr. Azik didn't expect her to agree so readily. He was stunned for a moment before he shook his head with a chortle. Then, he followed behind Silika and entered the spirit world.
...
In the lounge of Duke Negan's mansion, Audrey was discussing the assassination attempt with her mother, the other noble ladies, and the heroic act of Detective Bryan stepping forward to save the people on the dance floor at the critical moment.
"Speaking of which, I think I saw the Hero Detective leave the duke's mansion? Did he follow Qilangos?" Emma, who was following her mother, asked seemingly unintentionally.
She was actually a little depressed. The assassination of the duke was such a huge event, and yet, as a Cryptologist, she didn't notice it at all... And it was very likely that Ebner had long seen through Qilangos's disguise and warned the duke. That was why the duke had made preparations in advance.
Could a Detective really be that much better at observation than a Cryptologist?
Just as Emma was secretly sighing, a noble lady who didn't like her happened to see her leave the second floor of the ball in a rage. She covered her face with her fan and chuckled.
"It was Miss Macht who was dancing with Detective Bryan at the time of the incident. She seemed to be in shock, and the detective chose to send her home. This was approved by the duke and His Grace, Spellsinger of God."
"What a gentle gentleman."
I envy Miss Macht for personally escorting such a hero... Why wasn't I the one dancing with Detective Bryan?
...
Upon hearing the words of the young ladies, Audrey smiled and thought worriedly,
I heard that the detective has a very close relationship with Miss Xio... But he seems to be a bit of a playboy... Should I persuade Miss Xio to maintain a certain distance when dating him?
Yes, I can directly persuade them that I'm trying to sow discord... The next time I meet Xio and Fors, I can pretend that I accidentally told them the story of the ball...
At this moment, Audrey, who had just made up her mind, suddenly saw her father with his beautiful mustache appear at the door. She found a reason to leave the lounge and went to the balcony of the hall outside.
Then, she learned from her father about Qilangos's death and the person who killed him.
Audrey instantly guessed that it was done by Mr. Fool's Blessed, and she became excited.
When Earl Hall saw his daughter's expression, he couldn't help but give her some serious advice. He also instructed her not to be too curious about secret organizations.
After receiving Audrey's obedient promise, the earl informed his daughter in a good mood. Due to her contribution, she was about to receive a total of 30,000 pounds as well as a vacation manor in Desi Bay that was privately gifted to her by Duke Negan.
Amidst her joy, Audrey suddenly thought that if she were to really take the bounty, she would probably be recognized by the other members of the Tarot Club. Hence, she acted pitifully and begged her father not to divulge any information about her, lest she attracts danger.
Earl Hall felt that what his daughter said made sense. After some thought, he said with a smile,
"I'll inform Duke Negan to hide this matter and get him to get someone else to collect the bounty, and then I'll compensate you in private... As for why the duke noticed it ahead of time... I'll get someone to hint to the reporter to push the hero detective out... What do you think?
"I guess Duke Negan will agree. After all, the detective helped him save many of his guests' lives. It's only right to compensate him for his reputation."

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Meeting Azik
chapters.content:
Chapter 260 - Meeting Azik
In Duke Negan's mansion, in a private study.
The fat and tall Duke sat in a high-back chair behind a table, smoking a cigar as he looked at Spellsinger of God and Prime Minister Aguesid and the others opposite him.
After discussing the possible origins of the powerhouse who killed Qilangos, they unanimously believed that he was likely a High-Sequence Beyonder with an unknown motive. It was even possible that he came from a new secret organization.
Prime Minister Aguesid, who was also Duke Negan's younger brother, said solemnly,
"We have to find out the identity of the High-Sequence Beyonder as soon as possible. We have to find out why he came to Backlund. We have to know if he was simply pursuing Qilangos and why he killed Qilangos."
The late Spellsinger of God, Ace Snake, stood up immediately and said,
"I'll immediately make arrangements and contact the Church of Evernight and the Church of Steam. I'll get them to assist in our investigations."
"His Majesty will also get the military and the intelligence agencies to cooperate," Prime Minister Aguesid said with a nod.
After Spellsinger of God and the others left, Duke Negan held his cigar and asked his secretary, "Are any of the guests at the ball injured? If there are any, arrange a schedule. I'll visit them one by one and compensate them."
His secretary was a thin blond young man with delicate features. He looked refined and reserved, but his biggest flaw was that his hairline had deteriorated to the point of exceeding his age.
Upon hearing the duke's question, the young man flipped open the notebook in his hand and meticulously read, "According to the doctors in the mansion, only Baron Ralph, Lord Wright, and Miss Beti suffered some superficial wounds..."
"It's much better than I expected... This is all thanks to the timely assistance of that Detective Bryan," Duke Negan said wistfully before asking cautiously, "By the way, how did he catch the heavy chandelier?"
"He used the statue of Earth Mother from the Church of Earth Mother. It's precisely because of this that he left the mansion in a hurry. This is because the statue has to be sealed once it's activated," the blond secretary reported.
"A statue... I remember that this detective had previously used a statue to save someone during the incident at the headquarters of the Daily Observer?" Duke Negan recalled the information he had read in the past and asked casually.
"Yes, Duke. Ebner Bryan is suspected to be a Blessed of Earth Mother, and the Church of Earth takes very good care of him. That statue should be used to protect him," the blond secretary answered with certainty. At the same time, he took out the information regarding Ebner and placed it on the Duke's desk.
Duke Negan was very satisfied with his secretary's efficiency. He picked up the documents and casually took a few glances. Then, he said with a chuckle, "It seems our hero detective is quite unlucky. There will always be problems at the balls and banquets he attends."
With his breadth of mind, he naturally wouldn't blame it on an uninvolved person. Furthermore, Ebner had just helped him recover quite a bit of his losses—a loss of reputation.
He was only joking, but when he saw his secretary's deadpan expression, he immediately felt bored. He continued, "Earl Hall just came over and told me that he could claim the credit for seeing through Qilangos's disguise for this detective. I'll just treat it as a reward for his reputation...
Heh heh, the Earl is thinking for his daughter!
Since that young detective had really helped me, a little compensation in terms of reputation makes me appear too petty...
At this point, the duke paused and looked at his secretary. He asked, "Lockhart, how do you think I should reward the detective?"
The blond young man named Lockhart seemed to be prepared. Without any hesitation, he replied seriously, "Detective Bryan came from a merchant's family. His family went bankrupt three months ago due to the Grain Act, and his house was repatriated... If you can redeem his old residence and return it to him, the detective will be very grateful to you."
Duke Negan nodded in approbation and smiled. "Very good, I'll leave this matter to you."
Lockhart responded respectfully, then asked seemingly unintentionally, "Duke, about Miss Hall?"
"Heh heh, that most dazzling jewel of Backlund saved my life... Get someone to retrieve the bounty offered by the various countries for Qilangos and hand it over to that lady as soon as possible! Well, you can do it yourself." Duke Negan waved his hand.
"As you command, my duke," Lockhart responded again.
Then, seeing that the duke didn't have any other instructions, he bowed and left. When the door to the study was closed, he suddenly frowned and thought to himself, Could Miss Hall be related to the high-level Beyonder who killed Qilangos? Well, if she really is related, then the bounty of thirty thousand pounds might very well be handed over to that powerhouse... Now that I can handle it personally, I can monitor the flow of the money!
...
At nine in the evening, after escorting Hazel and her family to the Harvest Church, he took a carriage back to his villa on Kingst Street.
Speaking of which, he had no intention of taking the credit for the chandelier, but be it Hazel or Member of Parliament Macht and his wife, none of them wanted her to take the lead. Therefore, he had no choice but to bite the bullet and accept the role as the hero detective.
As for why Hazel's family isn't willing to be in the limelight... If the news of a frail girl catching a chandelier weighing hundreds of pounds with one hand were to get published, Hazel would probably be in an even more difficult position on social circles.
Thankfully, the rescue operation had been initiated by Ebner, and he had played a large role in it. Therefore, it wasn't as awkward as when he claimed credit in the past.
Isn't this a form of improvement? Is there a chance for a promotion in the name of the Wheel of Fortune?
As he lampooned in his heart, he walked into the villa, went up to the third story, and pushed open the door to the study.
Then, he saw a man with bronze skin and soft facial features. Beneath his right ear was a small mole. He was standing beside a desk and looking at a stack of documents.
As for Silika, she stood on the gentleman's shoulder, her head turned to the side as she looked eagerly at the storage room on the side of the study.
This appearance... and the ritual trap I set up in the Death domain didn't activate... This person should be Mr. Azik, right? Heh, Silika sure is reliable!
Upon seeing the intruder, even though he already had a guess in his mind, he still entered a state of alertness. He asked softly, "Who are you?"
"My friend, don't be nervous. My name is Azik. Azik Eggers. I mean no harm... Yes, Silika can testify," Mr. Azik put down the stack of documents and said gently.
It really is Mr. Azik! After letting down his guard, he pretended to shout, "Silika?"
Upon hearing this, Silika immediately cried out in joy as she shot glances at the storage room.
What a glutton! Ebner lampooned, but he still took out a bottle of Amantha extract he named from a nearby cabinet and placed it on the table.
This was a new formula he had learned from the Book of Dead, but it wasn't actually very useful. This was because the effects of this medicine were almost the same as ordinary Amantha potions, but the ingredients used were at least ten times more expensive than ordinary Amantha potions... The only benefit was that the taste was better. At the moment, other than using it to bribe Silika, it was useless.
He even suspected that Jane's ancestor who wrote this book had developed this medicine because of Death's fall and the lack of a backer. He wanted to please the Goddess...
However, for a Beyonder of the Death pathway, to have such high standards for developing medicine was rather ridiculous.
Just as Ebner was letting his imagination run wild, Silika had already flown over to grab the bottle, opened the lid, and happily took in the smell.
"It looks like she wasn't forced by you." Ebner seemed to finally heave a sigh of relief.
In fact, he just didn't want Mr. Azik to know that he had long known of him and was waiting for him to arrive.
"Detective Bryan, I'm sorry that I came uninvited... I even took the liberty of reading your information." Mr. Azik first apologized before pointing at the stack of documents. "However, I couldn't help but read it because I saw something that caught my interest."
The stack of information was actually the investigation report that had been handed to Klein under the prerequisite of Ebner, but he had added a few more personal items.
Upon hearing Mr. Azik's explanation, Ebner sized him up seriously before saying in a fake enlightened manner, "That was an investigation I did for a friend... If your face wasn't disguised, I think you might be the person in the investigation report, right?"
"Yes... It looks like you've already recognized him..." Mr. Azik admitted generously. Then, he sighed and said, "The world sure is small. I think I already know who the friend you entrusted you with is... Heh heh, after all, I received a similar set of information from him, but I didn't have the complete information..."
At this point, Mr. Azik straightened his face and solemnly said to Ebner, "Detective Bryan, I'm very grateful for your investigation. It reminded me of certain things and also pointed out the way for me to investigate my background."
When Ebner heard this, he was about to say something polite, but he suddenly froze.
This was because, at this moment, the Knowledge Keeper potion in his body had been completely digested.
...
In a warehouse at the dock area, a black-robed Jane gloomily observed the nearby police who were constantly searching the area. She said to Admiral of Stars who was already prepared, "I wonder what happened... Why are there so many official inspectors tonight?"
Cattleya shook her head and said with a deadpan expression, "An accident is inevitable... Such a situation isn't suitable for action. Inform the 'bait' you prepared to prevent her from setting off today.
"Whether we take action tomorrow night remains to be seen."
Jane sighed and said helplessly, "That's all we can do..."
...
At the same time, their target, Baron Conva was still sitting in the dark library, staring at a mathematical theorem as he rapidly wrote down his calculations.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Azik’s Gratitude
chapters.content:
Chapter 261 - Azik's Gratitude
In the study of the villa on Kingst Street, Ebner personally brewed a cup of Southville black tea and handed it to Mr. Azik before sitting opposite him.
Speaking of which, ever since Xio and Jane developed the bad habit of coming to visit in the middle of the night, there had been some snacks and edible beverages in Ebner's study and bedroom.
Of course, this wasn't an instruction from Ebner, but Madam Skade's own decision...
Back to the topic at hand, Mr. Azik, who was essentially an angel, had personally admitted that the information had helped him greatly. This brought about great feedback, allowing the Knowledge Keeper potion that he had drunk to finally be completely digested.
Therefore, in a good mood, the bronze-skinned gentleman opposite him asked, "Mr. Azik... Or should I say, Baron Lamud, is there a reason why you and Silika came looking for me?"
Although letting Silika lure Azik over was his established strategy, and although he had deliberately placed the stack of documents on the table, he couldn't let her know about it, lest he arouse unnecessary suspicion.
Thankfully, Silika was rather cooperative and didn't inform him of his plans. Otherwise, he would have to activate Plan B.
Just as Ebner was rejoicing and deciding to add a few more bottles of medicine for a "feast," Azik habitually touched the inconspicuous mole below his right ear and asked after some deliberation,
"Aren't you surprised that a person from more than a thousand years ago would sit in front of you?"
Seeing that he was in no hurry to answer the question, Ebner poured himself a cup of black tea and took a sip before saying with a smile,
"This isn't anything strange... Based on the information I found, I can confirm that you're a Beyonder of the Corpse Collector pathway.
"And this pathway's Sequence 4 is called Undying. They die once every sixty years, revive once, and forget most of their past memories. They need to be slowly recovered, just like the beginning of a new life..."
Azik's mind went adrift as he muttered the words "Corpse Collector" and "Undying."
After a while, he said in a slightly deep voice,
"The knowledge you're describing gives me a familiar feeling. It reminds me of something... However, although I don't have any memories, I still feel that I should've passed the Undying stage... But some of my symptoms match the Undying after my resurrection...
"After the Undying stage, are you still constantly dying and reviving?" Ebner pretended to think for a moment before saying in an apologetic tone, "I'm very sorry. If there weren't any more clues, I probably wouldn't have been able to deduce anything."
"You don't have to apologize at all, Detective Bryan... It wasn't something you had to do in the first place..." Mr. Azik waved his hand, then he shook his head and smiled bitterly. "Besides, if it was very easy to figure out my identity, I think I would've long found a way to escape my destiny.
"In short, what you just said has already benefited me greatly. I'm very grateful for that."
"It's already a reward for a detective for you to be able to get something out of it," Ebner said politely in a Loen-styled manner, but he was thinking to himself, It's good to be grateful... I'll only ask for your help in the future if I have any gratitude.
At that moment, Mr. Azik finally recalled the purpose of his visit. He said, "The reason I took the liberty of visiting you this time is to figure out what happened to Silika... Yes, including her when she was alive and after she died."
On the other side of the table, Silika, who was carrying a bottle, turned her head curiously when she heard her name. Her ears pricked up as well.
"Silika?" Ebner pretended to think for a moment, then replied after three or four seconds, "I don't know much about Silika either. I only know that she had apparently gone to Lamud Town's ancient castle to explore it when she was alive, and she even met Mr. Cullen there... And after she turned into a dead spirit, she was also unwilling to leave the ancient castle for some time.
"As for more detailed information, I'm afraid you'll have to ask Mr. Cullen."
Mr. Azik looked at Silika with a look of tenderness before asking seriously, "Mr. Cullen? Who is he?"
"Mr. Cullen is a Sanguine Viscount, and Silika is his messenger," Ebner answered simply.
This wasn't considered betraying Cullen. After all, he had already obtained his permission when he wrote the letter.
"Messenger?" Mr. Azik frowned when he heard that.
The memories that flashed past his mind made him almost certain that Silika was the daughter of one of his lives.
And now, his daughter was being used as a messenger for someone else to command... Although it was obvious that the contract she signed was very relaxed based on her free and casual attitude, it still left Mr. Azik uncomfortable. He was eager to talk to Mr. Cullen.
When Silika heard the conversation about herself and Cullen, she chirped a few times in excitement. Although Ebner didn't understand her, he could tell from her appearance that she was talking about some interesting matters between her and Cullen.
Hence, Mr. Azik's expression turned even friendlier.
He thought for a moment, then he took out a glove that was so thin that it looked like it was made of human skin. He handed it to Ebner and said, "Detective Bryan, I would like Silika to lead the way and meet Mr. Cullen as soon as possible... This glove will be an apology for my intrusion.
"It's a relic of the pirate Vice Admiral you were tracking. I made some simple seals to prevent it from starving usually, but every time it's used, you have to feed it with the flesh and soul of a human. Otherwise, it will devour you."
This is Creeping Hunger... Mr. Fool's future cashier! Although Gehrman seems to have hunted many famous pirates, most of the Beyonder characteristics and formulas he sold were thanks to it.
Ebner looked at it curiously, but he didn't take the glove. Instead, he looked at Mr. Azik's surprised eyes and shook his head.
"It's fine if you want to apologize. Actually, I happen to need the help of a high-level Corpse Collector pathway Beyonder..."
Having said that, he looked at the illusory bird that had sucked the fragrance of the Amantha extract clean. He joked,
"Besides, I don't think Silika wants to leave yet!"
After all, she hadn't fulfilled her promise to the Book of Dead Souls, "Incense."
...
In Tingen City, in a bungalow surrounded by gardens and lawns in the Golden Indus borough.
A young, scrawny girl in a black dress and hat finished reading the police report. Tears streamed down her face as she gritted her teeth and said, "She suddenly died of excessive drinking and continuous indulgence in sexual pleasure? What a laughable conclusion! Her lovers must've given the police some pressure to come up with such a joke!"
She spoke with a sobbing tone as though she was talking to a beautiful lady beside her.
The girl was the sister of the deceased Member of Parliament Maynard, and the beautiful lady beside her was the public school teacher who had been by her side consoling her.
Seeing that her student was crying sadly, Leena consoled her a little before pointing out, "Since the police department can't be counted on, perhaps we can spend money to hire professionals to find evidence."
"Professional? Is there such a professional in Tingen?" When the scrawny girl heard this, she stopped crying and looked expectantly at the teacher she felt very close to.
"Definitely," Leena answered with certainty. Which city didn't have a few official Beyonder teams?
At that moment, Mrs. Maynard happened to hear their conversation from upstairs. She immediately took over the conversation excitedly. "Aisa, your teacher is right! I've heard of such professionals... The tobacco merchant, Vickroy's youngest son, Elliott, was kidnapped a month ago. The mercenaries he hired only took half a day to find him! I think we can find those mercenaries too."
Having said that, Mrs. Maynard calmed down a little. She looked at Leena and said solemnly, "Ma'am Leena, thank you for accompanying Aisa for the past few days, and thank you for your good advice! If things go well, I'll definitely pay you handsomely."
Leona bowed slightly and said calmly, "It's my greatest honor to help you."
With that said, she lowered her head and appeared bashful, but the corners of her mouth curled up slightly.
...
On Thursday morning, Ebner took back the Book of Dead under Silika's reluctant gaze and sealed it again.
Beside him, Mr. Azik, who had been staying there the entire time, pondered for a moment before saying, "The aura on this book is very special. Although it's beneficial for Silika, it's best not to let her come into contact with it for more than three hours every day."
You're thinking too much. If you weren't here, it would be pretty good if I let her "rub against" me for an hour every day.
After lampooning silently, Ebner read between the lines and asked,
"Do you find this book familiar?"
Mr. Azik shook his head and said with certainty, "This isn't a book I made or written. It doesn't seem familiar at all..."
Having said that, he continued, "However, I have a vague feeling that the remnant powers seem to be very similar to mine..."
Similar but unfamiliar... Could Jane's ancestor really be another resurrection contingency of the Emperor of the Underworld in the Fourth Epoch?

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Sudden Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 262 - Sudden Attack
"The great pirate Qilangos was killed by the Duke's bodyguard in Backlund!"
"Standing alone with a hundred-pound chandelier, the great detective, Bryan, is once again a hero."
"A detective and a pirate, the fine disguises are no match for a detective's keen eyes."
...
On Thursday morning, Fors and Xio walked along the streets in their veiled hats, preparing to head to the nearest branch of the Varvat Bank.
Fors's new royalties for Stormwind Mountain Villa, as well as the bonuses and reimbursements for Xio's previous operation, had finally been disbursed.
He heard the paperboy's clear voice.
Ah? What? Qilangos is dead? He even fought against Ebner? A chandelier weighing hundreds of pounds... Ebner doesn't seem capable of that.
Xio and Fors looked at each other in confusion.
Only when the paperboy approached them from afar and repeated a few times did they suddenly realize what was happening.
The two of them had moved house because they were afraid that Qilangos would find them. Now, they were surprised to hear the news of his death.
"Do you have any inside information?" Fors asked Xio.
Xio shook her head and said, "I haven't been to find Ebner in the past few days... nor have I received any missions from MI9..."
At the same time, she came to a realization. It was no wonder the officials created such a huge commotion last night. It was because of Qilangos.
Seeing that her friend had no clue, Fors walked to the paperboy and bought a copy of the Tussock Times.
This was one of the three most distributed newspapers in the Loen Kingdom.
"Hmm... Qilangos is indeed dead. He was killed by Duke Negan's bodyguards... He disguised himself as Baron Gramir before the assassination, but Ebner saw through his disguise, so the duke was prepared." Xio scanned the papers and summarized the contents.
Fors held the second page of the newspaper and tsked. She smiled at her friend and said,
This entire page depicts how Ebner caught the chandelier, how he lit up the lights again, and how he inspired the masses. This prevented a huge mess from happening at the ball...
"After this incident, his reputation has grown! No, let's go to Kingster Street now. We have to get him to treat us."
"If we go over now, are you trying to provide material to the tabloids to increase the amount of gossip about Ebner?" Xio lampooned before continuing, "Instead of getting Ebner to treat you, why don't you look forward to how much Miss Audrey will pay us... To her, a few hundred pounds isn't a lot, but we haven't actually completed our mission..."
Be it Miss Justice or Mr. Hanged Man's request, I wasn't able to participate...
"If I don't go now, am I to climb up the wall and climb through the bedroom window like you did in the middle of the night?" Fors muttered softly before consoling herself.
"At the very least, Qilangos appeared on his own accord so quickly. He was in such a hurry to take action and fall into an ambush because of you and me... Besides, the person who saw through him is our friend! With Miss Audrey's generosity, she would've paid at least half of the reward even if she hadn't paid him."
I hope so... Xio snapped back to her senses and took a deep breath. She sighed inwardly. So this is the Tarot Club! To let a powerful pirate admiral die for no reason... How terrifying!
I wonder if I'll be able to issue a request through the police station after Ebner tells me the truth, or if I can solve the problem with Mr. Fool bearing witness...
On the other hand, Fors reminded the bouncers who might receive a reward worth tens of thousands of pounds, "Xio, let's not look for Miss Audrey for the time being. Wait for her to contact us. There are too many details about Qilangos's death that we don't know about. If we rashly look for Miss Audrey, we might end up in danger."
Of course, if there's really something urgent, I can inform him through Mr. Fool... But that would expose my identity.
With this in mind, Xio nodded in agreement with Fors. She originally wanted to say something, but at this moment, she suddenly saw a figure appear in the glass of the stores by the side of the road. It was a figure wearing a complicated black regal dress and a small bonnet.
The figure disappeared in a flash, but as an Interrogator, Xio was able to memorize the person's appearance once she saw him. She could even sense him at a supernatural level.
Therefore, she instantly recognized that it was Miss Sharron who had protected her last night until Jane informed her that the operation had been canceled.
Miss Sharron deliberately exposed herself to me... Is there something?
Xio's heart stirred. After some thought, she said to Fors, "I saw the signal left behind by MI9... Head back first. I'll go see that golden mask."
Ever since Xio became a spy in MI9, similar situations had happened many times. Fors didn't think too much about it as she exhorted her before taking out the royalties and walking towards her rented apartment.
But halfway there, Fors realized that something was amiss. This was because Xio's MI9 superior seldom chose to meet in the morning even if he had left a secret signal. It usually happened after dark... Unless it was very urgent!
But Xio didn't look nervous when she spoke. Instead, she looked like she was pretending to be calm...
Could it be that... she's hiding something dangerous from me again?
With this in mind, Fors hurriedly returned to the spot where they had parted, but she didn't see Xio.
She searched the surroundings for a while, but she still found nothing.
Xio might not really be doing anything dangerous. Perhaps it's just my imagination... Hmm, maybe I should ask Ebner...
Fors took a deep breath and forced herself to calm down. Following that, she got her bearings and walked towards Gunsted Street.
Just like the rainy night last week.
...
Elsewhere, Xio followed the figures that kept flashing through the glass on both sides of the street. They arrived at a restaurant that looked simple but was actually very stylish.
As there weren't many people in the restaurant at this time, she immediately saw Jane sitting in the middle.
And at that moment, sitting beside Jane was a woman in a black robe with a "glasses." However, Xio couldn't see her face because of the hood of the robe.
Although the operation yesterday had been canceled, the main members of the team had met each other once. Xio didn't know who the lady was, but she was certain that she was a powerful helper that Jane had hired.
Xio sat opposite Jane and greeted her simply before asking, "Have there been new changes?"
"Yes, an important figure has decided to provide us with some help. This has allowed us to confirm the baron's location, and we plan on launching a surprise attack immediately... However, we still need you to lure him to a specific location." Jane didn't make any small talk. She directly told Xio and Sharron, who was listening in the mirror, about her modified plan.
"Immediately launch a surprise attack? In the day?" Xio jumped in fright when she heard that, but she quickly reacted and calmly asked, "That important figure provided a concealed space for the battlefield? That's why he needed me to lure him over?"
"That's right." Jane looked approvingly at Xio, thinking that it was no wonder that Ebner valued her. This Miss Xio was indeed very intelligent.
Xio thought for a moment and felt that she wasn't in much danger. After all, Miss Sharron could take her away at any time...
But she still looked at Jane and said seriously, "I need to redo the 'Notary' contract."
"No problem. It's only right." Jane happily took out a goatskin parchment that emitted the luster of the Sun domain.
...
After signing the agreement, they didn't delay any further and took a carriage to a library near North Borough.
On the way, Xio secretly wrote down Mr. Fool's honorific name in ancient Hermes.
This is the best "insurance" she can think of... Since the baron has been pursuing Mr. Fool's aura, the mysterious existence that's like a deity might be interested.
...
In Tingen City, Klein, who had just finished reading the Tingen Morning Post and learned of Qilangos's death, lampooned himself.
As the boss behind the scenes, I actually only learned of the outcome from the newspapers...

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Prelude
chapters.content:
Chapter 263 - Prelude
The news regarding Qilangos wasn't long, and it only stated the time, location, characters, and outcome. Instead, Detective Bryan's heroic deeds took up several pages of the story... Was the officials trying to simplify the incident?
I didn't expect Mr. Tower to be present at the ball yesterday as well... However, if even Miss Justice can see through it, it's impossible for him not to. He must've seen through Qilangos's disguise ahead of time, just as the newspapers said.
