However, Mr. Tower didn't report to me like Miss Justice... Yes, from his attitude during the Tarot Gathering, I can tell that Mr. Tower doesn't pay much attention to Qilangos. He wasn't even interested in the very important item he was trying to obtain...
This meant that Mr. Tower was likely a powerhouse whose strength was even higher than Vice-Admiral Hurricane. That was why he didn't need The Fool's help because he was confident that he could resolve the threat posed by Qilangos!
However, after I advanced to Sequence 8 and deepened my connection with the space above the gray fog, I could already determine that Tower's Sequence was only at Sequence 7...
Then, from this, I can deduce that he must have a very powerful mystical item on him. It might even be a sacred contract item! That's why he didn't care about the item Qilangos desired because he didn't need it...
However, Mr. Tower probably didn't fight Qilangos directly yesterday. Otherwise, there would be news about it...
And since Qilangos's death was described concisely, it could only mean that the person who killed him wasn't suitable to expose it to the media... Therefore, there was a high chance that Mr. Azik was behind it.
As Klein's thoughts wandered, he felt a little more at ease.
Since Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos is dead, that means Mr. Azik won! Even if he's injured, it shouldn't be too serious...
If it were more serious, he would definitely be caught by the Mandated Punishers or Duke Negan's Beyonder bodyguards. And in such an emergency situation, Miss Justice, Mr. Hanged Man, and even Mr. Tower would definitely try their best to report to me. The latter not happening is enough to prove that things are under control...
Yes, if Mr. Azik hasn't replied to me by tonight, or if Miss Justice and Mr. Hanged Man haven't prayed to me, I'll blow the copper whistle again and summon the messenger to send a letter of inquiry...
Relaxing, Klein shifted his attention away from the newspaper, preparing to secretly hear the views of the other passengers on the public carriage.
But at that moment, he suddenly heard stacked layers of faint prayers.
Sounds like a lady... Is it Miss Justice, or Miss Judgment? Or are they the two Beyonders that Miss Justice is planning to recommend to the Tarot Club?
As he thought, Klein looked around the carriage. Finally, he sighed helplessly and thought, There's no bathroom on the carriage...
...
Backlund. Inside the villa at 28 Kingst Street.
Last night, Ebner hadn't accepted Mr. Azik's gift of Creeping Hunger. Instead, he had requested to help deal with Baron Conva.
As for Mr. Azik, he was equally interested in the ancestor of Baron Conva, who was also the powerhouse who was sleeping deep in Calderón City and had powers similar to his. Hence, he agreed.
Through the baron's diary, Ebner knew that he was actually seeking the power of Sefirah Castle. Therefore, his original plan was very simple. It was to hold an exorcism ritual on himself and do a "livestream" for Klein. He could temporarily "catch" the scent of Sefirah Castle and attract the baron over before letting Mr. Azik deal with him.
Of course, in order to prevent Mr. Azik from discovering that he believed in an evil god, he planned on completing the ritual at the Harvest Church.
This way, even if Mr. Azik could tell that he had a high-level aura, he would associate it with Earth Mother...
As for whether it would be inappropriate to pray to Mr. Fool at the Harvest Church, Ebner didn't think it was a big problem. After all, it was obvious from how the Sanguine Duke had stopped him from entering Tingen. Lilith definitely had a certain understanding of Tingen's story.
However, her plans couldn't keep up with the changes. Before Ebner could set off for the Harvest Church, Fors went up to the door in a fluster, completely unconcerned that she might be caught by a reporter hiding nearby.
After hearing Xio's abnormal behavior, Aibner frowned. He thought for a moment and didn't delay any further. He said to Fors, "I'll use the washroom." Then, he turned to leave the living room, leaving the dazed Fors sitting alone.
Mr. Azik was in the study on the third floor, praying to Mr. Fool elsewhere. Even if he constructed a wall of spirituality, it was impossible to hide from him.
But with that gentleman's bearing, he wouldn't deliberately eavesdrop, right? After all, this was Mr. Fool's divine kingdom of the living. It came with the attribute of Concealment!
After lampooning inwardly, he locked the bathroom's door and sealed the surroundings with his spirituality. Then, he took on a praying posture and respectfully prayed,
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"The mysterious ruler above the gray fog;
"The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.
"I pray for your help.
"I pray for your permission to communicate privately with Miss Judgment above the gray fog."
...
In Tingen City, Klein got off the carriage and rushed to a nearby restaurant. Using the washroom, he took four steps counterclockwise and went above the gray fog.
Inside the ancient and towering palace, Klein sat in the seat belonging to Mr. Fool. He looked at the constantly shrinking and expanding crimson star beside him.
The prayer comes from Miss Judgment... But the voice seems to be very soft... Is it inconvenient for her to recite my honorific name in the environment that Miss Judgment is in? Is she asking for help?
With this in mind, Klein's heart tightened. He didn't wish for anything to happen to any of the Tarot Club members. Hence, with a heavy heart, he emanated his spirituality to listen to her.
After carefully listening to Miss Judgment's nearly inaudible prayer, Klein heaved a sigh of relief. However, he still frowned and leaned back in his chair. Without opening his mouth, he silently said to himself,
Miss Judgment is forming a team with a bunch of people she's not familiar with to deal with the monsters from that night?
From what she said, she didn't discuss it with Mr. Tower... This lady is a little rash.
Besides, that monster might be pursuing my aura? Why? Could it be from the Secret Order or the Antigonus family?
Just as Klein was about to pull Miss Judgment into the gray fog and ask her in detail, an illusory male voice suddenly echoed in the ancient palace.
At the same time, another crimson star rapidly expanded and contracted.
Klein glanced at it and confirmed that the prayer came from the "Tower."
The two of them sure have a tacit understanding... The good news is that it's finally not midnight this time...
After lampooning inwardly, he extended his right hand and emanated his spirituality to touch the crimson star.
Suddenly, the plea became clear and layered. Klein quickly understood what the "Tower" was praying for.
Is he trying to 'develop' the 'video call' function again? The Tower is really a genius!
The corners of Klein's mouth twitched. After some serious thought, he decided to satisfy this request of his. After all, he also wanted to hear what Mr. Tower and Miss Judgment would talk about.
Following that, he emanated his spirituality and touched the crimson star representing "Tower" and "Judgment." Then, he completely disappeared into the gray fog.
...
In a small library on the outskirts of North Borough, while Baron Conva was scribbling on a piece of paper, Lady Aston's Spirit Body suddenly flew out of his body and circled around him.
"Stop fooling around... Oh? You said that you discovered a hint of Sefirah Castle's aura nearby? Alright, alright. We'll head over after I finish my calculations," the baron said perfunctorily without even looking up.
Upon hearing his words, the illusory face of "Aston" gradually distorted. She spun a few times, as though she had made a difficult decision.
Following that, black mist appeared out of thin air from her body. In the blink of an eye, it dyed her Spirit Body in a highly terrifying manner, no longer as dignified and beautiful as before.
Then, she pounced onto Baron Conva's back.
"Aston, you..." The baron finally realized that something was wrong, but before he could respond, terrifying black spots crawled onto his body. He could no longer maintain his calm as he instantly went "mad."

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Interlude
chapters.content:
Chapter 264 - Interlude
Above the gray fog, in the ancient palace.
As Klein touched the crimson star, two figures whose faces were concealed by the gray fog instantly appeared from the explosive light. They were Mr. Tower and Miss Judgment.
Among them, there weren't many changes to Ebner. He could only vaguely see a pair of copper-framed glasses on his nose bridge.
However, Miss Xio was completely different from her image at the Tarot Club. Not only was her waist-length blonde hair gone, but even her height had also shrunk to 150cm.
Hidden in the shadows, Klein secretly nodded. This was the Miss Judgment he had seen when she was "exorcising" the evil spirit, and not the "packaged" one from the previous Tarot Gathering.
As expected of a military detective, he's indeed good at disguises.
Just as Klein let out another sigh, Ebner had already recovered his vision and met Xio, who was still in a daze.
Xio was stunned for a few seconds before realizing where she was. She looked around, but she didn't see Mr. Fool.
At this moment, Ebner sighed and asked directly, "Where are you and Jane now? Have you found Baron Conva?"
Xio was alarmed as she blurted out, "How do you know of my and Jane's plan?"
It really is...
Upon hearing Xio's words, Ebner immediately confirmed his guess.
Previously, after hearing Fors mention Xio's abnormality, he had roughly guessed something.
Since Xio had chosen to hide the matter from Fors after receiving the letter, it was definitely dangerous.
She didn't come to me either, which means that she has some confidence in resolving the matter and doesn't want to involve me...
The only person who might pose a threat to me in the near future is the escaped Baron Conva. Xio has a high chance of dealing with him.
That night, she had witnessed Baron Conva strength, but she still felt that she had the confidence to defeat him. There must be some external force involved... Furthermore, this external force might very well have come to her on its own accord!
The goal was likely to need her as "bait."
There was only one person who had the reason to do so, and he also knew about the incident that night, and he was also familiar with the rough strength of Baron Conva, and that was Jane...
And behind Jane was Admiral of Stars. This was probably the source of their confidence!
However, as he guessed their general plan, he also understood their motives for taking action behind his back: They wanted to help him eliminate the threat from the baronet.
Therefore, be it Xio or Jane, Ebner had no right to blame them. He could only sigh and repeat his previous question. "Where are you now?"
At this moment, Xio also sensed that she had been deceived by Ebner. In consideration of his "reasoning" powers, she knew that there was no need to hide it any further. Therefore, she said very straightforwardly, "We've already confirmed the baron's location near the North Borough's Yafana Library."
At this point, to prevent Ebner from worrying, she added, "An important figure provided me with help by setting up a secret space near the library."
An important figure? Hidden space? Don't tell me Bernadette is here too? Peach Blossom Source?
Ebner heart stirred, but he secretly heaved a sigh of relief.
No matter how strange the baron was, no matter how terrifying the spirit in his body was, he was no match for Queen Mystic, who possessed several Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts and had mastered many mysterious spells.
With her around, at least Xio and Jane's safety was guaranteed.
"I'll be there soon. Be safe... Also, if there's a chance, warn that important figure to be careful of the 'spirit' on the baron!
"The corruption on them might very well come from underground."
Ebner nodded slightly and gave a solemn reminder before praying to Mr. Fool to end the "communication."
Soon, he and Xio vanished from the ancient palace above the gray fog.
Klein, who had been hiding behind the gray fog, appeared. He frowned slightly and muttered to himself,
"Underground corruption? What's that? Abyss? Devil? Speaking of which, when I was cleansing the black spots on Miss Judgment, I did feel the power of degeneration."
...
In the villa at 28 Kingst Street, Ebner, who had returned from above the gray fog, removed the wall of spirituality. After coming out of the bathroom, he first found Fors and told her not to worry. He had already confirmed Xio's location and was about to rush over to make her wait here for the time being.
Fors wasn't willing to wait as she looked at Ebner and requested, "Take me with you. I'm here at the critical moment, so there's still a safe way out."
Ebner shook his head and declined politely, "Don't worry, it's not that dangerous this time... Besides, if you use that bracelet again, I'm afraid you won't be able to bear the corresponding price."
Although he could seek Klein's help, he was afraid that his chest would be pierced this weekend. He hadn't been in the service area for several days, so it was better to avoid courting death.
Fors was instantly at a loss for words. Before she could think of an excuse, she heard Ebner say, "Besides, I have the ability to traverse the spirit world this time. I don't need you to sacrifice yourself... So just wait here in peace."
With that, Ebner didn't explain further. He went straight up to the study and said to Mr. Azik, who was gently chatting with Silika,
"Mr. Azik, I'll have to trouble you with the North Borough's Yafana Library."
He believed that he understood what he meant.
Mr. Azik gently patted Silika's head before turning around to joke, "I thought I was a carriage driver after hearing what you said..."
Although it was a joke, Mr. Azik's actions weren't slow at all. Ebner felt his vision suddenly change. The reds were redder, the yellows were yellower, and the whites were whiter. All sorts of colors saturated as he drew a strange oil painting!
As for Mr. Azik, he grabbed his arm and walked deep into the saturated, stacked oil paintings!
...
North Borough, in a carriage near the Yefana Library. Xio, who had just met Ebner, lowered her head in thought for a few seconds. Then, she took out a mirror she carried with her and seemingly muttered to herself,
"I just recalled something. The baron and the spirit in his body might've been corrupted by some unknown entity from underground."
With that said, she didn't speak further. Instead, she rubbed the Ring of Prejudice on her hand and prepared for any possible attacks.
At that moment, she suddenly heard an ethereal voice. "That person said, 'Got it.'"
Xio instantly felt her hair stand on end. When she saw who was sitting in front of her, she heaved a sigh of relief and said with a helpless smile,
"Miss Sharron, why did you suddenly appear?"
The ring of prediction didn't provide any images... Could it be that she doesn't harbor any animosity?
Sharron, who was wearing a gothic regal dress and a small black bonnet, was sitting quietly on the other side of the carriage, her face as pale as always.
"That man suddenly acted abnormally. I'll take you away," Sharron said without emotion before grabbing Xio's arm.
Before Xio could react, she felt herself moving involuntarily under a huge force. She could also hear the sound of the wind!
When she snapped back to her senses, she found herself in a forest filled with peach blossoms.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: The Warrior and the Chessboard
chapters.content:
Chapter 265 - The Warrior and the Chessboard
Completely covered by the "black spots," Baron Conva looked like he was wearing a set of pitch-black armor. When he discovered the aura of Sefirah Castle flash nearby, he immediately hid in the shadows and chased after it.
To his surprise, just as he turned a corner, he seemed to accidentally enter a peach forest. The way he came was gone.
Looking at the different scenery that suddenly appeared in front of him, the baron's remaining bit of rationality told him that he was in a sealed space that had been man-made. Just like when he was trapped by MI9 and the Church of Steam and Machinery, if he wanted to leave, he had to either break through it with brute force or find the exit.
He first tried the first method. He condensed a huge, gloomy sword in his hand and ruthlessly slashed around.
This was the Black Knight's "Blade of Spiritual Flesh." Not only could it corrode flesh and obliterate souls, but it could also tear through barriers, causing any creature with degenerate thoughts to lose their defenses. It was the core Beyonder power of the Black Knight, stemming from the "Degeneration" domain.
Unfortunately, this artificial space wasn't something "alive," and its potency far exceeded the baron's imagination. Previously, even the Numinous Episcopate's true demigod was unable to break through it, much less a fake Black Knight who could barely use his demigod powers thanks to the underground corruption.
Hence, the baron, who had been cleaving the air with his broadsword for half a day, became crazier. Even the black spots couldn't hide his warped expression.
However, he ultimately stopped his meaningless actions and followed the trail in the woods towards the foot of the mountain.
Soon, the baron arrived at a small village at the foot of the mountain.
The people in the village came and went in the fields, farming and working. The elders and children were all at ease, chatting and playing.
However, on careful inspection, these people weren't real living people. Instead, they were dolls with exquisite craftsmanship.
The baron, who had fallen into madness, had no intention of communicating with the dolls in the village. He pulled out their shadows and wrapped them up with his own shadows, breaking their limbs and necks.
A beautiful doll girl who was dancing immediately screamed and collapsed to the ground when she saw this terrifying scene.
And the baron had no intention of showing mercy to a doll. Nor would he show mercy to a doll, not to mention that Lady Aston was still attached to him.
Hence, he gave a cruel smile and raised the Blade of Spiritual Flesh to cleave the doll girl in half.
But at that moment, a toy soldier with one leg suddenly rushed out from a nearby house. He wore a well-ironed military uniform as he stood in front of the lady and raised his rifle to shoot at the baron.
The gun was only a toy, and the bullet it fired was only a small lead ball. However, such an attack caused the baronet, who was covered in black spots, to stagger. He had no choice but to stop his slashing actions.
Although the bullet was ordinary, it contained a firm "protective" belief, as well as the courage and tenacious will of a soldier.
These were the nemesis of degeneration!
The baron, who was shrouded in the shadow of "Degeneration," was extremely disgusted by these qualities. Therefore, he became even crazier and condensed a wind blade, slicing off the soldier's head.
However, after a soldier died, new soldiers quickly walked out of the house with guns. They were equally determined and fearless. They were also the nemesis of "degeneration."
"As long as the faith to protect is there, then we will fight to the death, never giving up.
"This is the fairy tale magic, 'Firm tin soldier.'"
On a small mountain deep in the peach blossom forest, Queen Mystic Bernadette, who had long chestnut hair and wore a shirt with lace flowers and a bow tie, stood beside a natural swing formed from green plants. She seemed to be talking to herself and explaining.
She looked deeply at Miss Sharron, who was circling the edge of the peach forest with Xio, as well as the man covered in black spots who had already entered the hamlet at the foot of the mountain.
At this moment, Jane was standing quietly beside her, looking very obedient.
As for Cattleya... she had vanished.
"I originally didn't want to interfere with your 'hunt,' but this person has clearly exceeded the limits of your abilities. Even approaching him might be dangerous."
As Bernadette spoke, she pointed at the increasingly impatient baron. Jane looked over and saw him scatter some of his "black spots" onto the soldier, instantly corrupting his "will to protect" and causing his body to split into a "degenerate" will and shadow, forming an independent existence that looked like a soldier but had a distorted face.
When the "fallen" soldier's shadow saw the sobbing doll girl, he couldn't stop his evil thoughts. He wanted to go forward, but he was stopped by the soldier. After a short but intense battle, they perished together.
And this time, the soldier wasn't able to be reborn... His "determined heart" was no longer that pure.
Jane frowned when she saw this. For the first time, she felt the terror of the "black spots."
Previously, although Xio had been corrupted by the "black spots," she had seen how easily Abner had used ritualistic magic to remove them. Therefore, she had the misconception that the black spots weren't difficult to deal with and that they could be resisted as long as she was prepared...
But now, a soldier who was determined and purer than the Priest of Light and Guardian was so easily "corrupted"...
Although it was only a creature created by magic, it was precisely because of this that he was even purer. He wasn't like a real person who had different thoughts and evil thoughts.
But even so, he still "degenerated" in front of the black spots!
If it were me or Captain, I might not end up any better than the soldiers...
While feeling a lingering sense of fear, Jane also felt puzzled. What method did Ebner use to remove the corruption on Xio so completely?
However, this thought only flashed through her mind for a moment. After all, it was a secret that belonged to Abner, so there was no need for her to delve deeper into it.
Coming back to her senses, Jane saw that, after the baron "killed" the toy soldiers and doll girls, he seemed to vent his madness and began a massacre in the village. Momentarily, broken wood and torn cotton flew in all directions. Although the scene wasn't bloody, it was still a mess.
Jane looked at the originally exquisite dolls in pity, turned back, and respectfully asked Queen Mystic for advice, "What should we do now?"
"Let's play some chess first... It's impossible for him to maintain that state for too long. Even if it's a high-level corruption, it can't be produced out of thin air without the source being lost." Queen Mystic Bernadette pointed at the nineteen chess boards and the black-and-white chess pieces in front of her as she said with a gentle but emotionless voice.
Chess? At this time?
Although she was mumbling inwardly, Jane obediently sat opposite Queen Mystic.
However, when she picked up the stone-like chess piece, she looked blankly at the nineteen lines of chess. After a long while, she asked in embarrassment, "How... should I play this?"
She had never seen such a move before!
Upon hearing that, Bernadette nodded slightly and said in her gentle voice,
"My father taught me that it's actually very simple. Regardless of the direction, as long as you connect five chess pieces, it's considered a win..."

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Gradually Advancing
chapters.content:
Chapter 266 - Gradually Advancing
As the rules weren't complicated, Jane quickly played it well. However, Queen Mystic was clearly very good at such games. Furthermore, she was especially serious about such games and refused to go easy on them. Therefore, Jane lost several rounds in a row.
Just as Jane gradually figured out something and wanted to win a round, Queen Mystic Bernadette stopped her game and looked down the mountain. "It's done."
Jane snapped back to her senses when she heard that. She suddenly realized that she had been so engrossed in the game that she had even forgotten the time.
She hurriedly used her "spirit" to look into the distance, only to see that the "black spots" on Baron Conva's body were receding bit by bit, turning into a disgusting, black sticky liquid.
As for the body of the slave merchant that the baron had taken from him, it also merged into the "liquid," leaving only his head that was tightly hugged by Lady Aston's evil spirit, floating in midair.
Just as the black liquid separated from the baron, a glass bottle suddenly appeared out of thin air. The liquid temporarily left the baron's control and flew straight into the bottle.
Right on the heels of that, a fair palm held the glass bottle and stuffed a "wooden stopper" into the bottle.
The baron's head, which was being hugged by Lady Aston, seemed to regain its lucidity. He looked at Bernadette, who was sitting on a pea vine, and said with a wry smile, "Is it some kind of 'Mystical Re-enactment'? I've once used similar ritualistic magic, but unfortunately, it can only be sealed for a short period of time..."
"Any last words?" Bernadette asked in a gentle but emotionless voice.
"No... I remember everything... Auceptin died long ago when exploring that ruin... The spirit that suddenly returned was actually formed from my splintered obsession...
That's why she's so suited to the perfect Aston in my heart... That's why she's even more persistent in finding than me...
Forget it, there's no point talking about it now. I should've died a long time ago... Besides, there's no need for me to live on my own without Aston...
After hearing his words, Bernadette fell silent for a few seconds. Then, she took out a shimmering golden scroll from her gray dress's pocket and muttered a word in ancient Hermes,
"Purification!"
Silently, the scroll was engulfed by flames that resembled the sun. Following that, it emitted a warm glow that enveloped the evil spirit that was hugging its head.
Instantly, the corrupted powers of degeneration, corruption, corruption, darkness, and evil quickly dissipated.
Just as he was about to be melted by the power of purification, the baron leaned his head into the arms of the splintered Aston and said regretfully, "Unfortunately, there are still many new theorems that haven't been verified..."
Before he finished his sentence, he completely disappeared under the radiance of The Sun.
However, at this moment, Bernadette suddenly frowned. She stared intently at the spot where the baron was floating before he was purified. This was because there were no Beyonder characteristics left there!
Suddenly thinking of something, she controlled the pea vine to bring the glass bottle that sealed the black liquid in front of her. However, she realized that the black liquid from before had vanished without a trace.
Bernadette stared intently at the empty glass bottle. Her blue eyes that resembled the sea instantly turned extremely deep, as though she was observing something or making a prophecy.
Soon, she muttered a few keywords,
Dreamweaver... Three songs... Omnipotent...
Just as she said this, she felt a sharp pain in her eyes.
As someone who was used to courting death... No, a knowledgeable Clairvoyant, she immediately realized that if this continued, she would probably foresee something very dangerous. Therefore, she hurriedly stopped.
After repeating the words "prophesied" a few times, Bernadette fell silent for three seconds before sighing to herself.
"So that's how it is...
"But this way, the girls are safe."
...
In a small alley near the Yefana Library in the North Borough, the figures of the couple quickly outlined themselves at the end of the road.
Just as Ebner was about to say something, Azik's bronze-colored eyes suddenly turned dark, as though they were connected to a silent, dark world.
He grabbed at thin air with his right hand, and a familiar spirit fell into his palm.
It was the spirit that belonged to Baron Conva!
And at that moment, the baron's spirit had shrunk into a ball, silently lying in Mr. Azik's palm as though it had fallen asleep.
"It's not a complete soul... It's very strange. It's similar to a certain state in my memory, but it's also different. It's as if it's mixed with some illusory things..." Mr. Azik analyzed the spirit in his hand as he tried hard to recall something.
Upon hearing Azik's muttering, Ebner immediately had a guess. Hence, he pretended to look curiously at the spirit in Azik's hand and asked,
"Is this Baron Conva's spirit? He was stopped by you when he returned to the Underworld?"
Azik nodded and said,
"I sensed him the moment we arrived here.
"He shouldn't be the spirit of a dead Beyonder. I suspect that he was created by a particular Holy Cathedral and Dreamweaver..."
That's not all, right? The source of the underground corruption is the omnipotent and omniscient existence. Who knows what the baron really encountered under the ancient castle... While this was on his mind, he deliberated and said,
"Perhaps it's a result of the high-level corruption?"
Azik glanced at him and shook his head.
"It's unlikely to be naturally formed... This gives me the feeling that someone is using him to verify certain ideas."
"To verify certain ideas... Are you saying that... Baron Conva is a product of an experiment?" Ebner frowned as he had never thought of this before.
That ancient castle was guarded by the Sanguine... It's hard to tell if the Sanguine had deliberately let Baron Kangva in back then...
That's the vicinity of Loen's capital. It's very difficult to hide from the three orthodox deities...
And the existence that used such a terrifying thing for experiments was probably not a true god, but a King of Angels!
Ebner didn't dare to think any further because he might be listed as a suspect. Just the thought of it left his scalp tingling.
At that moment, Mr. Azik simply communicated with the spirit in his hand before grabbing onto Ebner's arm and traversing the spirit world again.
...
Just as Baron Conva was being purified by Bernadette, black liquid appeared out of thin air in the Baronet's castle ruins that had been buried by the trio. It condensed into a stone coffin in the basement.
With a smacking sound, the coffin's lid was propped up by a pale hand as Baron Conva's tall body sat up.
He first looked around blankly before muttering to himself in delight,
"Did I sleep until 700 years later? That era that belonged to Sefirah Castle?"

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Sealing
chapters.content:
Chapter 267 - Sealing
The layers of colors receded quickly, and Ebner felt as though he was quickly passing through a strange and bizarre world. Although this wasn't his first time, he still found it rather novel.
Unfortunately, even after activating the White Eye, he was still unable to completely "analyze" this ability, much less learn it. He felt that it was impossible to even think of becoming a demigod.
Soon, Ebner noticed that the thick black and overlapping shadows in front of him were beginning to look familiar. He thought for a moment and vaguely recognized that it might be near the town of Conva.
At this moment, Azik's figure came to a halt as he solemnly said,
"The spirit here tells me that there's danger."
There's danger? Even Mr. Azik finds it dangerous? Is it the ancestor of the baron who's sleeping deep in Calderón City? Or is it some underground corruption?
Upon hearing this, Ebner immediately had several guesses.
Azik half-closed his eyes for two seconds before opening them.
"The greatest danger seems to have subsided... Well, it's not a big problem. Let's go in."
Hey, hey, I remember that you said something similar to Klein in the past, only to bump into Saintess of White Katarina on the Black Death... Your "problem isn't serious," perhaps to yourself?
Although he was lampooning her inwardly, he still chose to believe in the Death Consul. After all, even though he had lost most of his memories and his combat strength had greatly decreased, he was still essentially an angel.
In the blink of an eye, Ebner realized that he had returned to the entrance of the Baron's castle ruins that he had buried a few weeks ago with Vann and Ema.
Mr. Azik held the Baron's "spirit" in his palm and communicated with it again. Then, he explained to Ebner in a gentle tone,
"If my judgment isn't wrong, another Baron Conva has woken up in this mausoleum."
Another one? Is Baron Conva some cabbage on the ground? They can always be harvested after planting it?
As Ebner lampooned, he did some mental calculations. Mr. Azik had previously mentioned that the spirit of Baron Conrad Conva is created by the combined efforts of the Trinity Templar and the Dreamweaver...
The Trinity Templar could grow a head covered in shadows on each shoulder. One was young, and the other old. Each head could take away a third of a person's body and instantly become complete through flesh and blood magic...
And a Dreamweaver could separate some of their former identities and turn them into living people. And even if these identities died, it wouldn't lead to the death of their true bodies...
After recalling the traits of the two Sequence 3 powers, Ebner had some guesses, but he didn't speak rashly because he didn't have any evidence.
Besides, for a Sequence 7 like him to know what the names of the Holy Cathedral and Dreamweaver mean is already impressive enough. It can still be explained, and it might even incur suspicion... Even if Mr. Azik might not care...
Mr. Azik clearly didn't expect Ebner to make any inferences as a result. He stared intently at the ground for a while before saying, "Well, we have two choices now.
"First, directly eliminate the newly awakened baron. This way, the problem you face should be temporarily resolved... But the clues will be cut off, as a result, making it difficult to figure out the truth behind it... Furthermore, his origins aren't here, so he might still bring you a new threat...
Second, I'll temporarily seal this place and let the awakened baron live in the castle ruins for some time. Once I recover more of my memories and figure out the form of his existence, I'll then reverse engineer his origins...
More than 90% of his origins were in the abandoned castle in the middle of Delaire Forest! It was very likely that the baron and Lady Aston had never returned!
Taking a deep breath, Ebner looked at Mr. Azik, who was staring at the ground, and asked sincerely, "What do you think is the safest solution?"
"Personally, I'm very interested in the truth behind him. It might allow me to recall more things..." Mr. Azik looked down again and slowly raised his head.
In other words, you're inclined to seal it for the time being? After muttering to himself for a while, Ebner asked, "How long can it be sealed?"
"It won't take long... With the means I can recall, I can seal this place for about a year at most," Mr. Azik said after some thought.
A year? Ebner heaved a sigh of relief.
Ignoring how far he would grow in a year, Klein was definitely a demigod. With the help of Sefirah Castle, he could spend money to entrust The World to resolve this problem.
This matter involved the Mysteries. Even if some existence was using this arrangement, they would definitely have some reservations.
Although there was no evidence, Ebner's intuition told him that the truth behind Baron Conva might be related to him. Otherwise, there was no way to explain his "fate."
The "predestined encounter" in the rotation of the Wheel of Fortune didn't refer to me or 1-025, nor was it Mr. Azik... Instead, it was referring to a particular existence behind the baron's matter.
Therefore, it's better to delay this "destiny" as much as possible. The more variables that are introduced, the better... It's easier to fish in troubled waters!
With this in mind, Ebner made up his mind. He smiled and said, "I'll choose the second plan."
Mr. Azik nodded slightly. He didn't judge his choice, but he raised his hand slightly. Instantly, with him at the center, invisible and distorted faces rose amidst black fog, forming a strange door.
The door lay on the ground with its surface half-open. It was as though a large, half-opened mouth had grown out from the ground.
Then, Mr. Azik pierced his finger with his fingernail and dripped a drop of blood on the door.
The angel's blood is a ritual seal set up using spirituality materials... That baron sure is impressive! Tsk tsk, once that door is closed, I'll probably have to use a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact to break the seal.
Sensing the powerful sealing force coming from underground, Ebner couldn't help but sigh.
At this moment, Mr. Azik took out the spirit of the baron he had previously captured, as though he wanted to throw him into it as well, but he stopped at the last moment.
"What happened?" Ebner asked curiously when he saw Mr. Azik suddenly look at him.
"This baron's spirit has requested me to bring some of Roselle's academic works in to seal them together... He was very cooperative previously, so I've decided to fulfill this wish."
"Eh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Subsequent
chapters.content:
Chapter 268 - Subsequent
North Borough, in a coffee shop on Böklund Street.
Just as Jane and Ludwell, who she controlled, pushed open the door and walked in, she saw Captain Cattleya sitting alone in the corner. She was still wearing the classic black robe that exuded a sense of mystery, but her expression was filled with an indescribable look of confusion.
For the first time, Jane was surprised to see her captain reveal such an expression, but she also felt a baffling sense of sadness.
However, she didn't have the luxury of time to think about it. She walked in front of Cattleya and whispered, "Ma'am wants us to leave Backlund as soon as possible."
Cattleya snapped to her senses when she heard that. She wasn't wearing her heavy glasses, and the dark purple hue in her eyes swirled as she looked at Jane. She asked, "Has the operation ended?"
"It's over. The baron has already been cleansed, but he didn't leave behind any Beyonder characteristics..." At this point, Jane felt a little regretful. Although most of the reason for persisting in killing the baron was to help Ebner eliminate the threat, it would be even more perfect if she could obtain his characteristic.
Although she could temporarily control Admiral Hell to do battle, strictly speaking, Ludwell was a public property of the Future, so she couldn't casually get rid of him to retrieve his characteristic.
Cattleya nodded and pursed her lips. She asked hesitantly, "Did... Did she say anything else?"
"Ma'am said that your fate isn't with her..." Jane thought and told Cattleya what Queen Mystic had said before she left... Although she didn't know what it meant either.
"That again... Is my fate not with her? Then, where will it be?" Cattleya muttered to herself in a daze.
... Th-this isn't what a valiant pirate admiral should say?! She's like a lost little girl who's abandoned by her family... Captain, your image in my heart has completely collapsed... Wait a minute, don't tell me that I've been silenced after seeing Captain's expression?
Jane froze for a moment, wondering if she had heard wrongly. Then, she lampooned inwardly. She didn't know what the relationship between her captain and the lady was, so it wasn't appropriate for her to hastily console her.
Cattleya closed her eyes and wore a pair of heavy glasses on her nose bridge. Only then did she recover her usual elegance. Then, she stood up and said, "Let's go. Her words are always right. Since she wants us to leave Backlund as soon as possible, we might encounter danger if we don't do as she says..."
"Yes, Captain." Jane didn't have any objections. Before she came to Cattleya, she had already greeted Xio and Sharron and paid them. Of course, Xio didn't take it.
"Aren't you going to bid him farewell?" Cattleya suddenly asked, seemingly hinting at something.
"We already said goodbye... And this time, I still hid it from her..." At this point, Jane immediately came to her senses and said in surprise, "Captain, how did you know?"
"My crew insisted on doing something illogical. I had to know the reason... So I asked someone in private." Cattleya nudged her heavy glasses and added, "His reputation isn't very good."
"That's a rumor created by others out of envy," Jane retorted.
Cattleya nodded in a noncommittal manner and didn't continue on the topic. Instead, she took out a scroll with star patterns from her pocket and spread it on the table.
Seeing this, Jane immediately understood and took off the exquisite lady's glove on her left hand.
Almost at the same time, the connection between the glove and the many thin, illusory black threads that couldn't be seen with the naked eye suddenly severed.
Just as Admiral Hell Ludwell was about to collapse to the ground, Cattleya recited a word in ancient Hermes,
"Retreat!"
Right on the heels of that, Ludwell's body turned illusory as he flew into the scroll. Cattleya waved her hand and swept him up before placing him into her pocket.
Faced with such a magical scene, the others in the coffee shop didn't react at all, as though they hadn't seen it.
...
About half a day after Jane and Cattleya left the coffee shop, a middle-aged man wearing a silk top hat walked in. He had a rather thin face and a somewhat cold demeanor. He looked around and frowned as he muttered to himself, "Ludwell seems to have vanished the moment he arrived..."
...
In the vicinity of the Yefana Library, which Mr. Azik had brought back, it wasn't difficult for Ebner to find Xio, who had just come out of the Peach Blossom Source.
As for Mr. Azik, he had gone to the library to search for suitable books for Baron Conva.
Xio immediately felt a little guilty when she saw Ebner, but she quickly straightened her back and said, "The operation was very successful. That important figure has already eliminated Baron Conva."
Ebner looked at the lady whose eyes darted around and sighed inwardly.
I originally thought that she had undergone a lot more training than her original trajectory and had already matured greatly... But from the looks of it, she's still the same Miss Judgment who would bravely charge forward if given the opportunity... At most, she had made adjustments to her "rash" posture because of her greater experience and knowledge...
This is probably the influence of the existence at the top of the two pathways of order. Although I don't remember what his name is or where he comes from, my intuition tells me that this kind of person who would gamble with all his chips if he has the confidence comes from him...
George III, who planned on switching pathways to forcefully ascend to God, did so, hoping that Roselle, who had been cleansed of the corruption, did so... As for Solomon and the Night Emperor, they were probably the same. Otherwise, how could a true god perish so easily?
It looks like my decision not to tell her the truth about Father Xio's death was the wisest one... Otherwise, who knows what kind of trouble this lady would cause...
As Ebner lampooned, he took out an asymmetrical gold coin from his pocket and handed it to Xio.
Faced with a strange and dangerous enemy like the baron, how could he not use "luck" before heading out?
When Xio saw this, she very consciously pricked her finger and dripped a drop of blood onto it...
After doing all of this, Ebner said to her, "Don't worry, I know what you and Jane are thinking... However, I hope you can tell me about it the next time something like this happens..."
At least he knew more inside information and could determine how dangerous it was.
Xio heaved a sigh of relief when she heard that before saying in a relaxed tone, "Alright."
"Don't celebrate too early... Fors is still waiting for you to explain yourself when you get back!" Ebner glanced at her and sneered.
"Fors? So it's her... That's how you guessed my and Jane's plan, right?" Although Xio had asked, her tone was rather certain. However, she immediately felt worried. After all, she had promised Fors that she wouldn't do anything dangerous behind her back during the last emergency mission...
Looking at Xio who had fallen into a state of "horror," Ebner didn't remind her that she could collude with him to hide the truth from Fors. He told her that it was just a "misunderstanding."
She should also be taught a lesson by Fors so that she wouldn't dare to "rashly" do anything.
As he thought of this, he silently chanted Mr. Fool's honorific name.
With his understanding of Klein, if he were to encounter something that might put the Tarot Club members in danger, he would definitely guard Sefirah Castle and be prepared to rescue them at any time. Therefore, now that the matter was over, he had to report it to him to make him feel at ease...
After all, there wasn't a livestream this time. The mysterious and powerful Mr. Fool actually couldn't see anything.
...
Above the gray fog, in the ancient and towering palace, Klein listened to the report from the "tower." Only then did he put down the Fallen Morning Star in his hand and simulated a rapid descent before returning to reality.
He had already used the bathroom of the Old Will Restaurant for more than half an hour. If he didn't leave now, someone might knock on the door and ask.
Although this restaurant had a lunch agreement with the Blackthorn Security Company, and Klein was no stranger to the employees and boss here, it was precisely because he was familiar with them that he didn't want strange rumors to spread into the company.
After leaving the restaurant, Klein ignored the cashier's hesitant expression. As he walked towards the office, he thought,
The ancient baron, who seemed to be searching for The Fool's aura, had been destroyed by the demigod behind Miss Jane who "Tower" mentioned...
However, "Tower" said that the baron hadn't completely died. He had found the location of his resurrection and sealed it...
An ancient person seeking The Fool... Resurrected from the dead... Don't tell me he really knows the origins of the space above the gray fog?
Yes, when I'm strong enough, I'll let "Tower" open the seal and ask the baron.
As he thought of this, Klein had already walked to the door of the Blackthorn Security Company. He pushed open the door and was just about to greet Rozanne when he saw two ladies sitting on the sofa. One was young and skinny, while the other was plump and fair-skinned. They were both wearing black hats and long black dresses without any additional colors.
And the Captain was sitting opposite them, talking to them.
After carefully sizing up the two ladies, Klein suddenly felt a sense of familiarity, as though he had seen them somewhere before.
Just as he was recalling, he heard the scrawny girl say,
"Our mission is to track and monitor Madam Sharon and find evidence of her crimes."
Madam Sharon... Klein suddenly felt enlightened as he remembered where the sense of familiarity came from.
The lady who didn't say a word was Maynard's wife, the daughter of the New Party's leader. And the one who was speaking with confidence was Maynard's sister, a public school student. Her teacher was the beautiful and popular Ma'am Leena...
However, the lady didn't seem to be there? That's right. This kind of investigation of "family scandal" isn't suitable for outsiders to participate in.
Heh, she actually came straight to us... I wonder where she got the information from. Klein shook his head and chuckled.
Captain Dunn was obviously puzzled by the same question.
The scrawny girl recalled her teacher's words and replied,
"It was the tobacco merchant, Vickroy, who introduced us here. You saved his kidnapped son so easily, so he complimented you as the cream of the crop in this industry, being able to complete missions that others couldn't."
Dunn nodded slightly. "I understand."
However, after signing the contract and collecting the down payment, and transferring the mission to Klein who was watching the show, Dunn hesitated and said,
"Do you remember the tobacco merchant? What was the kidnapping about?"
... So you didn't remember anything, Captain. You didn't understand anything... Why were you acting so calm and confident! Klein facepalmed.
...
In the evening, Mr. Azik, who had finished copying Roselle's books and writing them in a scholarly manner, finally completed the seal and returned to his villa at 28 Golden Street.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Sequence 6 Polymath
chapters.content:
Chapter 269 - Sequence 6 Polymath
In the study of the villa, Ebner saw Mr. Azik walk out of what seemed to be a scene of splotches of paint. He went forward and asked with a smile, "Is the seal done?"
"It's done. For at least a year, the baron will obediently study in the underground castle ruins," Mr. Azik replied with an odd expression.
Ebner was somewhat speechless. For a moment, he even felt that the baron was more suited to being a Reader than he was... He didn't know if it was because Baron Conva was such a person to begin with, or if it was a persona created by a Dreamweaver...
In addition, the spirit that can be separated from the Holy Cathedral has one young and one old. This person who loves to learn is most likely the young one... Young people have the motivation to learn and improve, making it easier to maintain their passionate love...
Just as Ebner was letting his imagination run wild, Mr. Azik skillfully placed Silika on the back of his hand and told her about what had happened today.
Silika tilted her head and looked affectionately at Mr. Azik, listening attentively.
After the man and bird finished their warm exchange, Mr. Azik turned his head and nodded at Ebner. "Although I didn't help you completely eliminate the threat, you should be fine for the time being...
"That's why I plan on heading to Feynapotter with Silika to meet Viscount Cullen... I want to express my gratitude to him and thank him for taking care of Silika over the past few centuries."
From the tone of his voice, why does it sound like he's a father-in-law visiting his son-in-law? Could it be that Cullen really has some sort of relationship with Silika? Hmm... That's hard to say. After all, the latter hadn't become a dead spirit when Cullen first met Silika...
In a hypocritical manner, Ebner worried for Cullen. Then, as if recalling something, he asked Mr. Azik, "How can I contact you if something goes wrong with the seal on Kanga?"
Mr. Azik thought for a moment and said with a smile, "You can inform me through Silika... I believe you know about the ritual to summon her... Well, if there's a change in the ritual's incantation after meeting Cullen, I'll get Silika to inform you. Heh heh, Silika loves the Amantha extract you make. I think she's very willing to help you."
This... Silika is Cullen's messenger, right? I'm using his messenger to deliver a letter to you... Is Silika expanding her business?
After lampooning inwardly for a while, he sincerely bade farewell to Mr. Azik and Silika.
The latter looked at the glass bottle on the table and reluctantly flapped its silver wings and leaped into the spirit world.
Mr. Azik nodded at Ebner once again. Then, the surrounding void rippled like water before his figure disappeared from the room.
Seeing the big shot that he had painstakingly managed to cozy up to leave, Ebner waited for half an hour before activating the Eye of White to inspect it a few times. Then, he sealed the room with his spirituality and set up an altar to receive the bestowment. He lowered his head and prayed.
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era..."
...
Tingen, in a row of houses at 2 Daffodil Street.
After receiving Leonard's guidance on tailing and monitoring skills the entire afternoon, Klein confirmed that this handsome and elegant colleague wasn't like he had imagined, who only knew how to play Feynapotter lute and recite beautiful poetry. He had seduced Madam Sharon into bed and tailed her up close to monitor her...
Alright, he still has some real skills.
As Klein lampooned, he recalled how he had followed his instructions to head to the Hound Pub to find a gang leader. He had hired his subordinates to take turns monitoring Madam Sharon and recording the 5 pounds she had spent on her daily activities. It pained his heart.
How expensive! Thankfully, this amount of money can be reimbursed...
Benson looked at his brother's taut face and asked with a smile, "Klein, what's wrong? Did you lose your money?"
Did I lose it... or did I lose it on my own accord? Klein composed himself and didn't bring his work-related matters home. Hence, he didn't continue the topic and instead invited him with a smile,
"Do you know? 'The Return of the Count' will be screened at the Tingen Theater next weekend. It has already been played dozens of times in Backlund, and every performance has been filled. I don't think we should miss this opportunity."
This was a decision he had made a few days ago, but there had been too many things to talk about at the Tarot Gathering over the past two days. He hadn't had the chance to tell Benson and Melissa.
Seeing that Benson was interested and that Melissa was still hesitant, he added with a smile,
"It's said that the most popular supporting character in 'The Return of the Count' is a genius mechanic."
"Alright. Regardless, we have to go to the theater to watch a play." Melissa pursed her lips and nodded grudgingly, but her eyes were much brighter than before.
Just as Klein was about to respond, he heard a buzzing sound. He felt dizzy for a few seconds.
Someone is praying to me again... It's a man... It can't be... It's still... the "Tower," right?
Helplessly sighing inwardly, Klein placed his right hand behind his back and chuckled.
"Then I'll patiently wait for the tickets to be reserved.
"Alright, I have to return to my bedroom to produce an appraisal for an antique."
"We have to plunge into the sea of knowledge as well. I hope we don't drown in it." Benson, who was trying his best to revise his professional knowledge, gave a self-deprecating laugh and returned to the dining room with Melissa.
Klein went up to the second floor, locked his bedroom door, and sealed the room with a wall of spirituality. Then, he took four steps counterclockwise and recited the incantation before arriving above the gray fog.
In the towering palace that looked like a giant's residence, his figure suddenly appeared at the seat of honor at the long bronze table. His eyes reflected a pulsing crimson star.
"It really is still the 'Tower'... What happened this time?"
Klein raised his right hand and emanated his spirituality, touching the star that symbolized the "Tower."
After listening to her prayers, he cast his gaze on the two precious Beyonder ingredients in the junk pile.
The core of the Tree of Elders and the crystallized Thousand Spells.
These two materials were originally stored in suitcases, but the suitcase with the Tree of Elders heart had been destroyed by the flames from the Eternal Blazing Sun when he was divining the Mutated Sun Sacred Emblem...
One of them has a suitcase, while the other doesn't have a suitcase. That's too suspicious... Hmm, I might as well give up the suitcase containing the Thousand Spells Phantom's crystal. I'll just send the two ingredients over directly... How could Tower suspect that the mysterious and powerful Mr. Fool would embezzle one of his suitcases?
After muttering to himself guiltily, Klein looked at the Door of Summoning that had already taken form under the ritual held by the "tower." He closed his eyes and threw the two materials in.
...
In the study, Ebner looked at the two shiny materials that appeared on the altar and fell into deep thought...
...
On Friday morning, after having breakfast in bed and waking up naturally, the couple returned to their bedroom after informing them not to disturb him.
He took out various ingredients and used his full mental strength to concoct the Polymath potion.
Last night, after "receiving" the ingredients, he wasn't in a hurry to concoct them. Firstly, he wanted to wait for the ingredients to "air out," so as to prevent himself from being tainted by the aura of Sefirah Castle and causing unexpected problems. Secondly, he was already mentally exhausted, and it wasn't the best time to advance.
First, I'll put in the 70 milliliters of spring water from Sonia Island's Golden Spring which Xio had bought from Mr. A's gathering. Then, I'll drop 5 drops of the Golden-Faced Phoenix Flower's juice that Miss Judy gave me. After that, I'll buy 8 grams of blue fox tail powder from Darkwill...
After mixing the supplementary ingredients evenly, Ebner took a deep breath and added the two main ingredients worth more than 4,000 pounds into the solution in the beaker.
Suddenly, the originally "silent" solution boiled. The rising mist seemed to contain countless "symbols," making one feel dizzy just by looking at it.
It was only when everything was restored back to normal that Ebner saw what the final potion looked like.
It was blue and green in color, and the surface of the solution trembled every few seconds, bringing with it countless water droplets that resembled stars before finally falling back into the solution.
It was as if there was an invisible heart beating in the potion...
Holding a beaker, Ebner sat on the edge of the bed and, with the help of Cogitation, composed himself.
After sitting upright for more than ten seconds, he raised his right hand and poured all the potion inside into his mouth.
Unlike the low-Sequence potions, which only had massive amounts of information surging into his mind, the "torrent" kept flooding his brain...
Apart from giving Ebner a splitting headache with the Polymath's potion, his heart was also undergoing a transformation of massive amounts of energy.
The energy was so violent that Ebner felt that if he didn't have the strength to use his spirituality to guide and control the energy that invaded his heart, he might've instantly destroyed his heart or mutated into a monster.
Time ticked by, and when the modifications were finally completed, the information in his mind and the energy in his heart receded at the same time. Only then did Ebner let out a long sigh of relief. Then, he thought happily, I've finally become a Sequence 6 Polymath, a true Mid-Sequence Beyonder!
He rested for a while to calm his mental fatigue before observing himself in the mirror.
This advancement seems to be going very smoothly. Only the heart is a little dangerous, but with my self-control, I'm still at ease... And the other places don't even show any signs of mutation...
Could it be that I've digested the Knowledge Keeper potion better?
Hmm... Perhaps the most dangerous part of the Polymath potion is the reconstruction of the heart... After all, the other Knowledge Keepers aren't like me who are often attacked by the information streams of the White Eye. They're already used to it and can even divert most of their attention to guide the energy in the heart...
The average person would probably only be able to resist it head-on... The chances of failure at this step would probably be very high! It's no wonder Sequence 7 Beyonders are common in the Churches. They hold the positions of captains and bishops, and at Sequence 6, the number of people begins to plummet...
With this in mind, Ebner felt a little relieved. He stopped probing and turned to study the new powers of a Polymath.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: The Ability of a Polymath
chapters.content:
Chapter 270 - The Ability of a Polymath
Based on the knowledge infused into him by the Polymath potion, Ebner simply tested his powers and had a general understanding of his Sequence 6 Beyonder powers.
Firstly, after becoming a Polymath, the core "Analysis" ability had essentially been enhanced.
Previously, the "Analysis" of the Knowledge Keeper stage was more about analysis based on existing knowledge or information. Although there were certain "Beyonder" characteristics, such as "Analyzing" a Beyonder's aura to obtain the corresponding information and so on, overall, it was more about inference, retrogression, and summarization... Of course, among ordinary people, unless one was a genius with extraordinary talent, the corresponding abilities couldn't be compared to a Knowledge Keeper.
However, as the "Analysis" function of the White Eye was abnormally powerful, Ebner had rarely used his own "Analysis."
As for the "Analysis" stage of a Polymath, with a certain level of knowledge prior to this, it was possible to analyze the principles behind the Beyonder powers used by the opponent. This was also one of the prerequisites for subsequent "learning" and "mimicking."
In addition, the enhanced "Analysis" could help the user quickly identify the Beyonder environment they were in, as well as their strengths and weaknesses.
The two abilities that came with these two abilities were actually often used when activating the White Eye. Exploring Spell Traps, analyzing the Sealed Artifact's effects, and negative effects were, strictly speaking, embodiments of these two abilities.
As for the principle of Analysis of Beyonder powers, there was no need to mention it. Ebner had used the White Eye's ability to draw skills from his friends and enemies.
In short, the "Analysis" ability of a Polymath was still overshadowed by the "Analysis" brought about by the White Eye. It didn't increase his strength much.
Secondly, the Polymath's potion changed changes his heart.
The modified heart is called the "Heart of Omnipotence" in the knowledge passed down from potions... The reason why it's called that is because it's one of the necessary conditions for the Reader pathway to go from omniscience to omnipotence.
To convert knowledge into power, one needed a certain foundation.
And the Heart of Omnipotence was the foundation of energy.
Through the knowledge infused in the potion, Ebner learned that, apart from expending his spirituality, he also had to bear the burden of the energy needed for his powers.
This was the effect of the Heart of Omnipotence.
Although a "Polymath" claimed that there was no limit to the number of simulated skills, it was actually limited by the amount of energy stored in the Heart of Omnipotence. It was similar to a "blue-path" mage in a game before the First Epoch.
However, the "simulation" I did with the White Eye doesn't seem to have such a restriction... No, actually, there is one. It's very difficult to successfully "simulate" powers involving one's physical attributes, such as the Werewolf's "Power," the Zombie's "Steel Skin," and so on... Perhaps it's due to the lack of energy!
With this in mind, Ebner immediately used the remaining power of the potion in the Heart of Omnipotence to "simulate" the powers of a Werewolf.
Speaking of which, he had long "analyzed" all of Maric's powers, but his "simulation" had never succeeded.
About three seconds later, the corners of Ebner's mouth twitched as he helplessly muttered to himself, "I did succeed, but it was just too draining... Although I just advanced, the amount of energy stored in the Omnipotent Heart isn't much..."
However, the success of the "Simulation" of the Werewolf made Ebner understand one thing. It wasn't that he didn't expend energy when using the White Eye to do the "Simulation," but that he didn't expend his own energy.
It might very well be a "simulation" that stirred the power of the outside world to complete!
That's why the ability to strengthen one's physical attributes can't be "simulated." This is because once I use it, I might not be able to afford the price...
Perhaps a simple outburst of strength can make me lie in bed for a month or two.
As this thought crossed his mind, Ebner took out the snacks prepared by Mrs. Reskard in the bedroom and ate them in a few bites. Only then did he feel a little less hungry.
So the energy stored in the Heart of Omnipotence can be replenished with food... Heh heh, that's good too. At least I don't have to worry about getting fat from eating supper in the future...
After a few self-deprecating words, Ebner composed himself and continued pondering over the other abilities of a Polymath.
The third power of a Polymath is "studying."
This "learning" ability wasn't general knowledge, but a "learning space" that was specially meant for analyzing, researching Beyonder powers, and ritualistic magic.
As long as a Polymath meditated on the form of the Thousand Technique Mirage Crystal, "His" mind could enter a space that seemed to contain countless stars.
In this space, a Polymath could "analyze" the observed powers, study the principles, and even attempt "simulation"...The efficiency was much higher than the outside world.
As for the stars, the bright stars were powers that he had already learned, while the illusory ones were powers that he had yet to fully "analyze" and was temporarily unable to replicate.
Ebner guessed that this illusory learning space was probably the embryonic form of the White Tower. The stars would sooner or later transform into "books" on the bookshelves... Together, they would form the "Mythical Form" after becoming a demigod.
Finally, it was also the trademark power of a Polymath, "Simulation," or "Imitation," so there was nothing much to say. After all, Ebner had often used this power with the White Eye, so he was very familiar with it.
Apart from these new powers, the other powers like Machine Mind, Scene Rewind, and Aura Retrieval had also been significantly improved, but there were no qualitative changes.
After familiarizing himself with the powers of a Polymath, Ebner rested for a while before activating the White Eye.
Not bad. If I have enough spirituality, I can use the Eye of White for at least one to two hours. That's enough!
In addition, I can indeed "experience" the next Sequence's powers in advance... Hmm, under the situation of activating the White Eye, I can modify a portion of my Beyonder powers to make it meet the requirements of using it...
But for now, I can only reduce the effects of my powers...
However, this isn't a bad thing. The decrease in effects often implies a decrease in the usage conditions... For example, with a Traveler's Teleportation, if the effects are reduced to a fixed point, I can design a corresponding ritual that allows Low-Sequence Beyonders to use it...
"Of course, without a ready-made template, it would probably take a long time to create such a spell, even with the help of the learning space."
After silently muttering to himself, Ebner closed the White Eye.
Then, after he packed up the apparatus for the potion, he dispelled the wall of spirituality, opened the bedroom door, and went straight to the dining room at home.
From the looks of it, I'll have to get Mrs. Skade to prepare plenty of food in the future...
Perhaps it won't be long before I have the title of Foodaholic Detective...
Unable to make it down the stairs due to his hunger, he "glided" to the first floor and greeted Xio and Fors, who had stayed the night at the villa and were chatting in the hall, with a rueful smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: Leena
chapters.content:
Chapter 271 - Leena
Friday night, Tingen, Osna Street.
After receiving information from the gang and learning that Madam Sharon would only be back very late after attending the Conservative Party's banquet, Klein felt that he hadn't wasted his five pounds. With the help of his balance and agility as a Clown, he scaled the wall and entered the bedroom on the second floor of Madam Sharon's house through the water pipe.
As soon as he entered the house, he suddenly smelled a faint fragrance that reminded him of the fragrance of a woman that made his blood vessels swell.
Klein instantly felt his mind go adrift as he even felt his body react.
He then used Cogitation to calm himself down and lampooned, "Is she using an aphrodisiac as incense?"
...
Not long after Klein entered Madam Sharon's bedroom, a slender figure suddenly appeared under a tree in the garden downstairs.
This figure belonged to Witch Leena. Ever since she secretly instigated Maynard's wife and sister to hire an official team to investigate Sharon, she had been hiding nearby. Hence, she had taken in Klein's entire operation.
However, she didn't dare to continue approaching. This was because she had tried before, but she had nearly been detected by the other party's spirituality.
Staring at Klein's back, Leena muttered to herself helplessly, "This is the quality a Clown should have... Why are the two I nurtured so incapable?"
...
At the same time, Ebner, who was in Backlund, finally fulfilled his previous promise and brought Miss Hazel to the Bravehearts Bar on Iron Gate Street to participate in the Beyonder gathering his teacher was about to hold.
As a Sequence 6, Ebner wasn't interested in gatherings at this level. Therefore, after introducing Hazel to Kaspars, he turned and entered a gloomy card room where he found Maric.
After becoming a Polymath, Ebner was no longer afraid of him. Even if he really lost control, he had the confidence to escape unscathed.
Maric, who was playing cards with his Zombie companions, heard someone push open the door. He looked up, revealing a pale face with hints of madness. He stared at Ebner for a long time before asking in surprise, "You're already a Sequence 6?"
After all, he had just advanced, and he still had some of the potion's powers left. Even though he had concealed it very well, it was still eye-catching enough for a senior Beyonder like Maric.
"Just advanced." Ebner nodded without explaining further.
"You and Miss Jane have improved really quickly..." Maric couldn't help but sigh. Then, he collected himself and looked at Ebner with brown eyes that were filled with deep malice. He asked, "Why are you here?"
"I wish to see you demonstrate the powers of a Zombie again." Without beating around the bush, Ebner directly voiced his request.
Maric clasped his hands together and didn't say a word, as though he was waiting for Ebner to give him the price.
"100 pounds." Ebner spat out a number before adding, "This price is very fair. You're only demonstrating your powers, so there's no loss, nor is there any danger."
"Maric, agree to him." At that moment, an ethereal female voice suddenly interjected.
Aiming for a closer look, he saw a figure appear behind Maric. It was a figure wearing a complicated black regal dress and a small bonnet. It was none other than the blonde Miss Sharron with blue eyes.
As the two of them often appeared in pairs, it wasn't surprising. After nodding at each other in greeting, he counted the down payment.
But at that moment, he heard Miss Sharron calmly say, "But no gold pounds."
Ebner stopped taking out his wallet and asked curiously, "Miss Sharron, what do you want?"
Miss Sharron didn't answer him directly. Instead, she asked expressionlessly, "Can you still contact Miss Judi?"
Judi? Of course... Besides, I was about to write to her about Cullen...
With this in mind, Ebner nodded and said, "Sure... Do you have something to talk to Judi about?"
"An ordinary milk cow with a mystical creature's bloodline." Miss Sharron looked at him silently with her blue eyes as she said a string of words.
"What?" Ebner suspected that he had heard wrongly. To possess the bloodline of a mystical creature, one had to be ordinary... Who would be so bored to nurture such a thing?
"I need an ordinary milk cow with a mystical creature's bloodline," Miss Sharron pursed her pale lips and repeated.
"This... I don't know if Judi can find it..." Ebner thought for a moment before saying with uncertainty.
Although, if Judi's father was willing to help, he could probably "pinch" one of them.
"Maric will demonstrate it to you first... If you can't find it, then pay," Miss Sharron said simply.
"Deal." Ebner nodded and agreed to the deal. Then, he asked a "technical" question, "If we really find it... How do we ship the ordinary milk cow with the mystical creature's bloodline from Feynapotter?"
But don't expect Silika to travel through the spirit world with a bull... Even if she was given a bucket of Amantha extract, it was impossible.
"Find a random harbor. I'll inform someone to retrieve it..." Sharron fell silent for a few seconds before saying with an illusory voice.
With the transaction coming to an end, Maric, who was one of the items that had been traded, didn't object to the outcome. He quickly brought Ebner to the underground training field.
...
In the outskirts of Tingen, in a house with a green lawn and a red chimney.
A middle-aged man with dark blond hair and one blind eye put down the ancient quill in his hand and picked up an open notebook. He examined the content that had already been written:
"In order to seek advancement, Witch Leena arrived in Tingen and became a public school teacher. She also deliberately approached the sister of the New Party's Member of Parliament Maynard and obtained his trust and reliance.
In order to make Tingen City's Conservative Party and New Party completely at odds, Madam Sharon took the risk of killing Member of Parliament John Maynard to vent the accumulated madness after her transformation.
"She didn't have enough reasons, and her motives weren't strong enough, but she still took action. Everyone has moments when they aren't clear-headed enough, and she's in that stage, and she has plenty of confidence in not being discovered. Therefore, our story isn't made up. It's reasonable.
"Witch Leena reminded Maynard's wife and sister that they could hire mercenaries to investigate Madam Sharon.
Maynard's wife found the Blackthorn Security Company through the tobacco merchant, Vickroy. They didn't fail their mission. Klein Moretti's investigations quickly discovered Madam Sharon's abnormality.
"Dunn, who had the strength close to Sequence 6, decided to take the initiative to attack. He also handed Sealed Artifact 3-0271 to Kenley.
"The two of them returned to Madam Sharon with Klein. Dunn attempted to pull her into a dream from a distance to control her.
"That's not a problem, but unfortunately, Madam Sharon happened to place the statue of the Primordial Demoness beside her."
"Hence, the Nighthawks' plan failed. In his anxiety, Kenley reflected on himself and saw himself.
Klein secretly took out the Fallen Morning Star to save his colleague, but it was too late... Madam Sharon was taken care of, and Kenley was killed as well...
The line above was scribbled away.
What's surprising is that Witch Leena, who had planned on waiting for both the Nighthawks and Madam Sharon to suffer heavy injuries before she took action to seize the Beyonder characteristic, actually joined the battle ahead of time and saved Kenley, who was about to be struck by the black flames...
With the addition of the Witch, Madam Sharon's death was certain. However, before she died, she let out a fatal curse. And the target of the curse wasn't Klein Moretti who kept stopping her from escaping, nor was it Witch Leena who wanted to seize her characteristic. It was Captain Dunn who arrived late.
Although this doesn't match her personality, nor does it reach her expectations of being cursed, her choice before her death is blind... This is a reasonable development.
Dunn was cursed, and his mental state became rather unstable, but he didn't pay much attention to it. This was because a curse of this level didn't have much of an impact on his daily life. He would be able to dispel most of it after a Mass at the cathedral on Sunday afternoon.
...
In Madam Sharon's bedroom, Klein lowered his arms and panted heavily. Madam Sharon, who only had half her head left, slumped to the ground. Her figure was still outstanding, and her skin was fair and tender.
However, he didn't let down his guard. He stared intently at the beautiful lady who was squatting in front of Madam Sharon as if she was waiting for something. He frowned and asked, "Ma'am Leena, you're also a Demoness... Why are you helping us?"
Upon hearing that, Leena chuckled. She then glanced at Kenley who was lying on the ground, his fate unknown. She replied gently, "His fiancée is a colleague of mine during this period of time. She's a very kind and warm lady who has helped me quite a bit... Such a beautiful lady's life story shouldn't have such sorrowful stories... Isn't that so?"

chapters.title: Chapter 272: The Night Before
chapters.content:
Chapter 272 - The Night Before
Klein didn't want to believe a single word of what the Demoness had said, but regardless of her motives, it was a fact that she had saved Kenley. Therefore, before she showed any animosity, he wasn't willing to attack her.
Of course, this was also related to the Captain being temporarily unconscious after being hit by Madam Sharon's curse before his death. He was the only Nighthawk left at the scene.
After remaining on guard for about a minute, it was unknown what Beyonder method Leena used to purge Madam Sharon's Demoness of Pleasure characteristic.
She appeared calm as she carefully sealed the Beyonder characteristic before standing up. She smiled at Klein and said, "The Nighthawk is alive. It's time for me to leave... We shall meet again if fate permits it."
With that, she disappeared in front of Klein. She then nimbly jumped out the window, went over the wall, and headed for the Tussock River.
Although he saw her leave, Klein didn't dare to be careless. As he kept his gun on alert, he undid the silver chain on his sleeve with one hand and let the topaz pendant fall naturally.
After carefully swapping the positions of the revolver and spirit pendulum, Klein waited until the topaz stabilized. He immediately closed his eyes and entered a state of Cogitation. He then silently chanted the divination statement:
"Leena has already left this house."
...
After seven times, he opened his eyes and saw the pendulum spinning clockwise.
"she really left..." Klein's heart calmed down. He put away his spirit pendulum and walked to Kenley's side to check on his injuries.
Previously, he had secretly used Holy Light Summoning and Placate on the Morning Star to treat Kenley before the Captain arrived. Otherwise, he would've been killed by the evil spirit in 3-0271 even if he hadn't been hit by Madam Sharon's Black Flames.
Although he suffered some mental damage, he managed to escape the evil spirit's mark... It shouldn't be a big problem... When the Mystery Pryer from the Holy Cathedral is transferred to Tingen, I can get him to design a ritual to slowly treat Kenley.
Since Kenley's life was no longer in danger, and the Captain could wake up at any time, Klein didn't intend to use the "Fallen Morning Star" again to avoid explaining himself.
After hesitating for a moment, he came before Madam Sharon, who only had half her head left. He took out all sorts of materials and quickly set up an altar to channel her spirit.
I've already wasted some time. If I wait for Captain to wake up before channeling his spirit, I might not be able to get anything.
Moments later, Klein opened his eyes after watching a huge bed film titled "Madam Sharon takes you to Tingen's Upper Circles."
Through spirit channeling in the dream, he learned a lot. For example, Maynard's death was backed by the current mayor... or the potion formula for some of the Sequences of the Demoness pathway.
However, there was also a new question. Madam Sharon's motive for killing Maynard was too hasty. It didn't seem to match her usual modus operandi.
Just as he was deep in thought, Captain Dunn suddenly sat up straight and opened his eyes. He first surveyed his surroundings with his sharp eyes. When he saw the situation clearly, he heaved a sigh of relief and pressed his glabella. His expression was somewhat pale.
Despite not being injured, he seemed to have lost a lot of blood.
"Captain, are you alright?" Klein was delighted to see him wake up.
