"It's nothing... Madam Sharon's final curse wasn't completed yet, and she didn't have the medium to curse me, so she wasn't very powerful... Well, at most, she can disrupt my mental state. When Mass is over the weekend, the Goddess's grace will be able to completely heal my injuries."
Having said that, Dunn stood up and walked slowly to Klein's side. He said in an abnormally deep voice,
"I made a mistake. I was fooled by Madam Sharon. I didn't expect her to secretly leave the dream long ago... If it wasn't for another Demoness, we probably wouldn't have been able to keep her here..."
If it wasn't for my uniqueness, I would've died along with Kenley about ten seconds after the battle began... Klein turned his head to look at Kenley who was silently lying on the ground and exhaled.
"Captain, Kenley..."
"I know..." Dunn replied hoarsely. "But you have to get used to it. It's normal for Nighthawks to die during missions. Perhaps I'll be next."
"No, Captain... I mean, Kenley isn't dead yet... Back then, it was Leena who saved him." Although Klein was very wary of Leena, she had saved Kenley no matter what, so he didn't want her to be wanted by the Nighthawks, so he directly mentioned her contribution.
Dunn was taken aback when he heard that. Then, his pale face revealed a gentle and relaxed smile. "Is that so? That's great!"
As he spoke, he couldn't help but draw a crimson moon on his chest. At the same time, he said, "Goddess, bless me!"
Klein could understand the Captain's feelings. Whenever he thought about how Kenley would die tonight, how he would face his family, how his parents would look at him with grief, and how his fiancée would look like she had lost her soul... Klein felt fear from the bottom of his heart... He was afraid of hearing the sobbing!
At that moment, he actually agreed with what Leena said. He just needed to change it.
In the stories of the guardians, there shouldn't be any sorrow!
Amidst his joy, Dunn subconsciously wanted to take out his cigarette case and smoke. However, he remembered that he hadn't brought his cigarette with him for some time, so he gave up. However, he suddenly thought of something and asked, "Leena? Do you know that Witch?"
Captain, is your brain thinking too much, or has your forgetfulness worsened? I thought I didn't need to use the excuse I prepared just now.
After lampooning inwardly, Klein shared what he knew about Leena with Dunn. Finally, he added, "Most of this was told to me by Madam Daly during our last casual chat. You were there as well."
Dunn thought about it seriously before nodding in enlightenment. "From the looks of it, Maynard's wife and sister were the ones who instigated them to find us... Her goal is Beyonder... It's the remains that Madam Sharon left behind."
Captain, I already know what a Beyonder characteristic is. You didn't even hide it from me when you came to concoct the Clown potion with Her Excellency's Sword of the Goddess... You don't have to be so careful.
After lampooning, Klein told Dunn everything he learned from the spirit channeling. Then, he expressed his doubts about Madam Sharon's murder of Maynard.
"Pleasure really doesn't need to kill someone of a higher status... Hmm, we have to find out where Madam Sharon has been all these years and find out her true background... Of course, we have to report this to the Holy Cathedral and let them arrange it. We can't leave Tingen as we wish." Dunn nodded slightly. When he mentioned reporting this to the Holy Cathedral, he deliberately didn't mention the matter of "Leena."
Then, he looked around and said, "Clean up the scene and then get someone from the nearest police station to come over. Oh, and make a trip back to Zouteland Street and get Frye to help."
"Yes, Captain."
...
Outside a village downstream of the Tussock River, a moist figure emerged from the river and disappeared in the blink of an eye. It was like a water ghost from folklore. The drunkard who happened to see this scene jolted awake from his fright and ran back to the village in a panic.
It was none other than Leena. She stared at the drunkard's back and sighed after a long while. She muttered to herself, "Forget it... He didn't see my face... Besides, no one will believe it even if I tell them... Killing him might attract attention."
Following that, she got her bearings and ran towards a small mountain southeast of the village.
As wild animals were almost extinct, there was an abandoned hunter's hut halfway up the mountain. It was a safe house that Leina had prepared long ago.
After entering the cabin, Leena quickly took off her drenched clothes and changed into a male hunting suit she had hidden in the moonlight. Only then did she sit down. As she took out the food she had prepared, she thought with a serious expression,
The Fallen Morning Star is actually on that Nighthawk of the Seer pathway... Didn't I get Shook to hand it over to Detective Bryan? Why would it be in Tingen? Did Detective Bryan sell the necklace to the Nighthawks?
"If... If I hadn't transferred it to The Fallen Morning Star back then, it would most likely be me bringing it to Tingen, right?
Was it really my own judgment when I heard about Madam Sharon's style at Backlund's gathering and deduced that she might be a Demoness of Pleasure? Or could it be that someone is behind it...
Could it be that the mastermind's goal is only to have the Fallen Morning Star arrive in Tingen?
No... It's not that simple. I'm afraid something major will happen in Tingen...
I happened to become Maynard's sister's teacher, and Madam Sharon killed Maynard...
The Nighthawks who instigated Ma'am Maynard to hire an official Beyonder team chanced upon the Nighthawks who possessed the Morning Star of Fallen...
There are too many coincidences... I never noticed it before!
No, I have to leave as soon as possible! The further the better!
Having made up her mind, Leena rested for a few hours. At dawn, she immediately got up and rushed to a nearby town with a steam locomotive station.
...
In the Tingen suburbs, in a house with a red chimney.
The middle-aged man with dark golden hair and one blind eye looked at the latest content written by the quill.
"After receiving the Beyonder characteristic, Witch Leena sensed the hidden danger in Tingen and decided to leave this city."
He pondered for a moment and didn't make any additional changes. This Witch was also very strange. She had previously changed the story she had written. It would be a change if she could leave.
However, there were too many variables in Tingen!
The middle-aged man glanced at the words "Klein Moretti," and his expression turned nasty. He flipped another page of the notebook and pointed at the word "Stuart." Then, he walked around the room and muttered to himself,
I can't delay any further. The Church of Storms's Mysticism Magister will likely come to investigate next Monday. If something were to happen to him midway, it will probably be difficult to push it to an accident. He will definitely suspect that there's been some sort of interference and subsequently lock onto me and 0-08...
Therefore, on Sunday... I have to take action before Mass!
At this moment, he seemed to come to a decision. He stopped in front of the table, picked up his quill, and wrote on his notebook:
"Leonard and Klein found a letter left behind by Lanevus during a search."
Megose was summoned for some baffling reason. She came to Zouteland Street and entered the Blackthorn Security Company. The baby in her stomach was in a critical period and couldn't stop her urges.
Dunn made a detailed arrangement, the correct arrangement, but he made one mistake. If he had made up his mind to take care of Megose immediately, it would be best to lure her behind Chanis Gate and use the advantage of the environment and items to engage in combat. If he was waiting for help, he definitely couldn't take out Saint Selena's ashes.
"Unfortunately, Dunn, who was in a daze due to the repeated curses and corruption, didn't think of the most important point. The son of a deity could sense the threat of the Saint's ashes. Hence, the latter was triggered and began to absorb the power of his mother's body in an attempt to be born ahead of time, even if it wasn't fully matured.
At this point, the man recalled the history teacher who had spoiled his plans several times. He added,
Azik isn't in Loen. Even if he recalls the Spirit World Traversal, it will be difficult for himto rush back in a short period of time.
After reevaluating the content he had written, the middle-aged man placed the notebook and quill into his pocket and left the house.
...
On Sunday morning, just as I was about to enter the learning space after breakfast to analyze and learn the abilities related to Zombie, Ebner was suddenly stopped by Mr. Skade, and a telegram was stuffed into his hand.
Bishop Utravsky is looking for me? He wants me to go to the Harvest Church...

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Light and Darkness
chapters.content:
Chapter 273 - Light and Darkness
After reading the telegram, Ebner didn't think too much about it. He planned on heading to the Harvest Church immediately.
Bishop Utravsky had helped him so much, and now that he had something to ask of him, as long as it was within his capabilities, there was no reason to refuse.
But just as he was about to get a rental carriage, the gray fog suddenly appeared in front of him... Following that, he received the news that the Tarot Gathering would be temporarily canceled tomorrow.
The Tarot Gathering has been canceled... In that case, Mr. Fool is going to die today? It has already come to this day...
Klein's comfort zone was coming to an end.
Ebner sighed. He didn't know if the information he divulged to Klein had any effect, but even if he was a little wary, there wouldn't be much of a change... After all, 0-08's powers were too terrifying. It wasn't something Klein could resist at this stage.
It wasn't that he hadn't thought of telling Klein that Tingen was under 0-08's "arrangement," but other than forcing Ince Zangwill to take action in advance and push the matter into an uncontrollable state, there weren't any benefits.
Captain Dunn might still die, but if Klein couldn't be resurrected due to an accident, that would be a huge problem.
As his thoughts raced, he suddenly thought of another problem. Bishop Utravsky had summoned him on this special day... Was the purpose related to Tingen's story?
...
Tingen City, morning.
As it was Klein's turn to be on duty at Chanis Gate last night, he didn't check on Miss Justice and the other members who were praying one after another. Only when he left the company in the morning and got on his rental carriage did he have the time to head to the gray fog hall to listen to their "messages."
There's actually no "Tower"? That's rare. Sitting in the seat belonging to The Fool, Klein glanced at the few pulsing crimson stars and couldn't help but lampoon.
The "messages" came from Justice, The Hanged Man, and Judgment respectively. Although they used different choices of words when praying, their main meaning was the same: to ask for leave.
Yes, Miss Justice is being protected by her father's men because of the tip-off. It's indeed inconvenient for her to participate in the gathering. Mr. Hanged Man is currently beside His Excellency, Spellsinger of God, and he similarly doesn't have any conditions. Miss Judgment seems to be attending an internal MI9 meeting, and she doesn't seem to have the time...
This way, only me, Mr. Tower, and The Sun are left... I might as well pause it for a moment.
With this in mind, Klein separately replied to Miss Justice and the company's prayers,
"Got it."
Right on the heels of that, he sent a message to the crimson star that corresponded to Tower and The Sun.
"The upcoming gathering shall be temporarily canceled."
After doing all of this, Klein simulated the feeling of falling and returned to the real world. He discovered that the carriage had already arrived at Daffodil Street, so he quickly paid for it and got off.
Just as he took out his keys to open the door to his house, Klein saw Bella wiping the dining table. His sister, Melissa, and his brother, Benson, came down the stairs in their respective outdoor clothes.
"Isn't today's Mass held in the afternoon?" Klein asked curiously.
Benson smiled and said,
"I can understand the memories of someone who hasn't slept the entire night."
"Huh?" Klein was even more confused.
"Today is the first day that 'The Return of the Count' will be releasing tickets," Melissa explained.
Klein smacked his forehead and took off his hat.
"I've been so busy recently that I forgot about it."
Especially in the past three days... he added with a sigh.
Melissa looked at him with concern and said,
"Your breakfast is in the kitchen. Eat it and go to bed. Benson and I are lining up in the morning to buy tickets. In the afternoon, we'll head to Saint Selena Cathedral for Mass."
"Alright." Klein waved goodbye to his siblings and had a simple breakfast before returning to his bedroom and falling asleep.
But not long after he fell asleep, Dunn appeared in his dream in his black trench coat.
Klein immediately snapped to his senses and followed his normal dream-like reaction. He slowly summoned,
"Good morning... Captain..."
Dunn nodded slightly and said,
"While Leonard was investigating the Lanevus case, he discovered a clue that requires your help at 62 Howes Street.
"The Mystery Pryer sent by the Holy Cathedral won't arrive until tomorrow morning because of a train fault."
Only after the Captain left did Klein open his eyes. He couldn't help but mumble to himself, The steam locomotive malfunctioned... Aren't the train accidents between Backlund and Tingen a little too frequent?
Besides, Howes Street... Isn't that the area where the Divination Club, my classmate Welch, and the member of the Aurora Order were located? There sure are many things happening recently. One by one, they seem to be brewing something...
As he thought, Klein quickly got up, dressed, and went out to stop a rental carriage.
...
Backlund, South of the Bridge, Rose Street.
When Ebner pushed open the door to the Harvest Church, he immediately saw Bishop Utravsky preaching in front of the prayer hall... After all, with his height, it was difficult to ignore him.
He looked around, but he didn't see Miss Hazel. He couldn't help but find it odd.
It was Sunday, and as a priest of Earth Mother, Hazel should've come early in the morning.
With a sense of puzzlement, he sat in a pew by the aisle for a while. Only when the sermon ended and the few believers left the cathedral in twos and threes did he get up to walk to the two-meter-tall half-giant bishop.
After politely exchanging greetings with Bishop Utravsky, Ebner asked in passing, "Where's Priest Macht?"
"Heh heh, I gave her a day off today." Bishop Utravsky looked down at him and replied with a gentle expression. Then, he added in a suggestive manner, "Besides, some things aren't up to her yet."
Hazel isn't even qualified to know? Then, an outsider like me, who isn't even a believer of Earth Mother, is qualified?
After lampooning silently, Ebner adjusted his expression and asked solemnly, "Why did you send me a telegram to ask me to come over?"
"I don't know exactly what it is either..." Bishop Utravsky first shook his head, then he turned to look at the door at the basement's entrance, which was still sealed by various rituals and symbols. He smiled gently and said, "You came a little early... Wait a moment, 'He' will personally meet you later."
"'Him'?!" Ebner jumped in fright when he heard that. His mind raced as he recalled the information that Father "accidentally" revealed when he saw the sealed basement a few days ago, as well as his own conjectures.
"A special Sealed Artifact...
"It needs to be regularly protected by faith...
"It's suspected to be a deity's descent vessel!"
Lilith!
The true name of this deity flashed through his mind, and he subconsciously swallowed a mouthful of saliva. If his inference wasn't wrong, then he might be meeting a deity later? Although it was only the manifestation of a deity...
Isn't this a little overboard? I'm just a weak and pitiful Sequence 6.
At that moment, the tiny bit of pride that had been generated from his advancement to the Mid-Sequence Beyonder was gone.
...
Tingen City, 62 Howes Street.
After a series of divinations and searches, Klein and Leonard finally found the letter left behind by Lanevus.
In the letter, the other party told the official Beyonders who might have found the letter in a crazy tone. He had planted a bomb in Tingen that would grow stronger with time! A bomb that could turn the entire Tingen City into ruins if it exploded!
"9th August. The events of the past two days have made me feel a little down. I started the industrial revolution with my own hands and personally ushered in the Age of Steam and Machinery. Will it become the hotbed for the descent of an evil god?"
The sentence Emperor Roselle wrote in his diary flashed through his mind. Klein almost immediately guessed that the child laborers on Lower Street who died before their time were factory workers who seldom lived more than ten years due to their working conditions. The female workers who took the risk of severe illnesses and only received a meager salary were the source of power that constantly grew in Lanevus's bomb.
Hence, he and Leonard immediately returned to the Blackthorn Security Company on Zouteland Street.
The moment he entered, Klein saw two familiar faces. One was voluptuous, while the other was thin. They were Maynard's wife and sister.
As Madam Sharon's matter had been exposed, the current mayor had no choice but to resign. Therefore, they came to express their gratitude and settle the final payment.
But Klein didn't have the time to bother with them. He nodded slightly in greeting before briskly walking to the Captain's office to report.
After Dunn heard that, his expression turned serious. He immediately sent a report to the Holy Cathedral and requested them to send a mysticism expert over to assist him.
While the Captain was sending the telegram, Klein returned to the reception area to read the newspapers to pass time.
But at that moment, a beautiful woman with a bloated stomach walked in. She was apparently more than seven months pregnant.
Klein was taken aback as he felt that he had seen the young pregnant lady before.
Suddenly, he heard Leonard exclaim,
"Miss Megose?"
...
Backlund, at the basement door of the Harvest Church, the Sacred Emblem of Life engraved with spiritual materials and the many mysterious symbols gradually dimmed and completely lost their effects.
Bishop Utravsky easily pushed open the door and motioned for Ebner to enter.
Only an idiot would enter such a situation if he didn't know your character...
Ebner took a deep breath and walked down the stairs into the house.
As soon as he stepped into the basement, he felt a strange force envelop the space around him. The air was also filled with a faint blood color.
Such a scene made Ebner feel a strange sense of familiarity. It was as if he had seen the Sanguine Duke who had stopped him from entering Tingen back in East Chester County...
Soon, his thoughts were confirmed because a handsome, devilish man in a red shirt and black coat appeared before him.
"We meet again." The devilish man stroked his elegant silver hair and said with a smile.
"Your Eminence, I wonder if you're...?" Ebner couldn't help but ask. This was related to what kind of etiquette and attitude he should adopt towards the other party.
"You've already guessed it, haven't you?" The devilish man raised his brows and asked with a smile.
"As expected..." Ebner said to himself. Then, he solemnly drew the Earth Mother's Sacred Emblem on his chest and chanted, "...You are the source of life; you are the mother of all things."
"There's no need to be so reserved. I'm not meeting you as a Snake Spirit." The silver-haired man shook his head.
I feel that Lilith has a lot of humanity in her... Ebner stole a glance at her and lowered his head. He asked respectfully, "May I know what instructions you have for summoning me here?"
Although the other party said that he wasn't meeting him as a deity, he didn't dare to take it seriously.
"There's a mission for you..."
...
In the Blackthorn Security Company, with the activation of the Flaring Sun Charms, Megose completely melted under the bright white light. The semi-illusory and terrifying object in her body no longer had the support of reality. Unable to complete the final step of the transformation, it turned into black gas unwillingly and angrily, melting into the light and flames.
Klein managed to stabilize himself and opened his eyes a few seconds later. He saw Captain Dunn in his black trench coat still standing in his original spot. He saw that the heart in Saint Selena's urn was still beating slowly.
He couldn't help but feel overjoyed. Just as he was about to take out the Morning Star Necklace, he activated the secret technique on it without any regard for anything else. It was the perfect Recovery Art of Ovalt which was said to be able to restore anyone as long as they were still breathing.
Dunn Smith turned his head and looked at Klein. His voice was as mellow as always.
"We saved Tingen."
"We are miserable wretches and guardians."
With that, Dunn fell back and released his hands.
Upon seeing this, Klein, whose expression had frozen, didn't dare delay any further. He took out the Morning Star necklace and put it on the Captain's neck.
But suddenly, he felt a pain in his chest. His pupils constricted as he froze on the spot.
He lowered his head and was stunned to see a slightly pale palm tear through his left chest. It was covered in blood.
Right on the heels of that, the palm was retracted. Following that, it first took away the Fallen Morning Star from Klein's hand before picking up Saint Selena's urn.
But Klein could no longer see anything.
...
In the basement of the Harvest Church, Ebner looked at the vessel of Earth Mother's descent and asked cautiously, "What's the mission?"
"I need you to place this gem on the corpse of the former Captain Dunn Smith of the Tingen Nighthawks... and bring him to the Harvest Church at Enmat Harbor."
With that said, the silver-haired man took out a pitch-black gem from his pocket.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Ebner’s Plans
chapters.content:
Chapter 274 - Ebner's Plans
On the outskirts of Tingen, in a house with a green lawn.
It had a garden that had begun to wither in early September and a dark red chimney.
A middle-aged man with dark blond hair and nearly black eyes walked into the bedroom. He took out a quill and an ordinary notebook and placed them on the table.
He quickly flipped to the last few pages and examined the lines of words written by the quill.
Megose became a monster, and the battle began. With the help of the Saint's ashes, Blood Vessel Thief, and the strange appearance of the high-level charm, Megose died. The deity's spawn was exorcised, and Dunn Smith was pushed to the brink of death. The power of Saint Selena's ashes was also severely damaged. This perfectly matched Ince Zangwill's thoughts.
"Klein Moretti wanted to use the Fallen Morning Star to save Dunn Smith, but that wasn't permitted by Ince Zangwill.
"He killed Klein Moretti, the fellow who always caused problems to his plans, and he took away Saint Selena's ashes and the Fallen Morning Star.
"Ince Zangwill set up a ritual with the remaining descendants of Death and consumed Saint Selena's ashes, successfully advancing from Sequence 5 Gatekeeper of the Death pathway to Sequence 4 Nightwatcher of the Evernight pathway. As such, he obtained godhood and became a demigod powerhouse.
"The sun continues to illuminate the land. Almost no one in Tingen City noticed that they were lucky enough to avoid a huge disaster. Monster Ademisaul would be very confused about this.
When the man named Ince Zangwill read this, he didn't find it problematic. Hence, he used his slightly pale hand to solemnly pick up the quill. Without dipping it in ink, he clearly wrote a sentence at the end of the notebook:
"That's the end of Tingen City's story."
The pages flipped quickly and the manuscript closed.
After putting the brown-covered notebook back into his pocket, Ince Zangwill held the necklace formed from five different-colored gems in his hand. After seriously examining it for a moment, he silently said,
This is the legendary "Fallen Morning Star"... As expected, the" Concealment Barrier of Evans" is still here... With it, I don't have to worry about the Church's pursuit. I might even be able to hunt the higher-ups of the Church...
"Heh heh, I will prove how foolish the Church of Evernight was to abandon me!"
...
In front of an unknown, grayish-white grand palace that was more than two hundred meters tall, there were a few thick stone pillars that were slightly shorter than it was, as though they were a squadron of soldiers standing straight.
A long lizard-like monster was squatting at the top of a stone pillar in the middle, like a small mountain. Its body was covered in huge grayish-white stone scales, and its eyes were pale gold and vertical.
This was a mind dragon that seemed to come from a myth.
At that moment, there was a hint of excitement in "His" pale golden eyes as "He" said a word in Dragonese with a humming voice, "Alzuhod!"
However, that hint of excitement was quickly wiped away as the dragon returned to its silence. Its pale golden vertical eyes turned cold once again as it muttered to itself in a buzzing voice,
"That wasn't my arrangement... Who helped me?
"Hermes? No, even I didn't observe the process of 'arrangement.' It's enough to fool that person... It can't be 'His' means...
That could only be my original subsidiary god... So "He" has also figured out that person's true identity? That's right, with "His" caution, how could "He" not have any suspicions!
In that case... there's no rush... That person who has been planning for thousands of years must have the means to deal with any accidents... I have to wait for the best opportunity...
"I believe that my subsidiary god will create an opportunity...
Yes, in addition, I have to be careful of Hermes... Although "He" has awoken me and has seemingly formed an alliance with me, "He" might still be plotting something.
At this point, the dragon paused and closed its mouth. It kept asking inwardly,
Why did he say it out loud? Although the environment here is very safe...
The problem of Ariehogg affected me? That's not right. It's clearly me. I'm "Him"...
So, do I have such a habit?
The dragon fell into deep thought.
...
Backlund, South of the Bridge, in the basement of the Harvest Church.
After receiving the black gem, he couldn't help but activate the White Eye to analyze it. He discovered that it was a rather special Stone of Life.
The reason why it was special was that the knowledge used to refine this Stone of Life had exceeded the limits of what Ebner knew. Even the White Eye was unable to completely analyze it in a short period of time.
"This is to activate what I set up on Dunn's body..." the devilish and handsome man, who was the vessel of Earth Mother's descent, explained with a smile.
Lilith went to Tingen? That's right. Thinking back to what "She" said when "She" stopped me in East Chester, "She" clearly knows something about Tingen's uniqueness. Perhaps she had a deal with the Goddess, so she went to observe...
Therefore, "She" did all of this to befriend the future Lord of the Mysteries, Klein?
Although he was making random guesses, he didn't dare to ask. He only promised, "I will complete this mission."
Ignoring the fact that he had the intention to save Dunn to make up for his regret, just Lilith's help from before was enough to make him unable to refuse...
And more importantly, how could he have the guts to shirk a request from a deity?
"Very good." The devilish man nodded in satisfaction. Then, he took out a blue crystal pendant from his sleeve and handed it to Ebner. "This is an advance reward for you."
Eh? There's a reward? The mission you assigned me isn't that troublesome. How embarrassing...
Despite having such thoughts, Ebner didn't stand on ceremony as he took the pendant and hung it on his sleeve, intending to study its function when he returned.
It was not enough to reject a gift from an elder, much less something personally bestowed by a deity.
"Let's end it here for today. I can't stay in the real world for too long. We'll meet again if there's a chance." The handsome man didn't say anything further when he saw Ebner accept the pendant. He waved his hand and dispelled the blood-colored space that sealed the basement.
His figure disappeared as the sealed space was removed.
Holding the Stone of Life that resembled a black gem, he thought for a moment before turning to walk up the stairs and return to the prayer hall of the Harvest Church.
Upon seeing him come up, Bishop Utravsky didn't ask further. He only smiled and said gently, "Earth Mother's decree is for me to help you as best as I can."
I'll most likely have to head to Tingen Cemetery to dig up the grave this time... Do you think it's impossible to be discovered by a two-meter-tall half-giant like you?
After lampooning inwardly, Ebner thanked the half-giant bishop for his goodwill and requested him to organize the latest information on Tingen. Only then did he leave the cathedral and take a carriage back to his villa at 28 Kingst Street.
If the plot doesn't change much, Dunn and Klein should be dead by now...
The Church of Evernight's reinforcements should've arrived in Tingen by now. It's very difficult to come into contact with Dunn's corpse now. It's very easy to be discovered...
Therefore, it's safer to dig up their graves after they're buried on Saturday...
Yes, I'll take action on Sunday night. I'll skip the time when Klein "broke out" from the soil to prevent any misunderstandings from happening when I meet him...
It's best if I can use this opportunity to 'imitate' the Clown Mask's ability to change appearances!
After making up his mind, Ebner snapped back to his senses and took the blue crystal pendant from his sleeve. He activated the White Eye and began studying it seriously.
...
Inside the Blackthorn Security Company which had been reduced to ruins and was covered in burn marks and debris.
Benson and Melissa walked in together with Leonard.
Looking at this warlike scene, Benson's face was filled with disbelief. He couldn't understand why such a terrifying attack would happen in Tingen City which was peaceful and serene.
And this accident had taken his brother's life.
Melissa looked straight at the figure lying not far away. She took a few steps forward and came close.
She looked at Klein's corpse, which had been cleaned up by the Nighthawks, and bit her lip with her teeth. After a long while, she cursed softly, "Idiot!"
When Leonard saw this scene, he felt his heart wince. He also admired this girl's resilience. He knew that she hadn't cried after the grievous news. Her silence was heart-wrenching.
At this moment, upon hearing the news that something had happened in Tingen, Stuart, who had rushed over on a train, entered the company. Just as he was about to ask something, he was stopped by Frye. He pointed at the family members in the company and shook his head.
Stewart immediately understood and turned towards the Tingen Mandated Punishers who had rushed over to reinforce them.
Not far behind him, Madam Daly, who had rushed over on the same train, closed her eyes and went straight to Leonard, signaling him to follow her.
After a while, Madam Daly suppressed something and said,
"Lanevus!
"Ince Zangwill!
"Very good! Don't die so soon! Those cold little fellows of mine yearn to enter and exit every place on your body!"
...
At 138 Rose Street, Backlund Bridge area, Detective Zreal was sitting in his study, listening to the report of a fifteen-year-old boy in a round hat.
"Ian, does this mean that you've already found clues to Helmosuin's manuscript?"

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Audrey’s Arrangement
chapters.content:
Chapter 275 - Audrey's Arrangement
The boy named Ian was thin and had delicate facial features, but his eyes were extremely intelligent. When he saw the question, he hurriedly nodded and described the clues he had received. Finally, he said, "However, Mr. Detective... That place is a little strange. I couldn't open the secret door no matter how many times I tried."
Upon hearing this, Detective Zreal immediately understood that the door that Ian mentioned was likely sealed by Beyonder means. As an ordinary child, he naturally couldn't open it.
However, since it involved something extraordinary, Detective Zreal didn't explain it to Ian. Instead, he happily handed him three one-pound notes and said with a smile, "This is a reward for you. If you can get more clues in the future, I'll pay you another two pounds."
Ian frowned when he received the money, his expression slightly twisted. He subconsciously flattened the three crumpled bills and tidied them up. Even the portraits of the kings had to be heads facing up, matching them up. There couldn't be any mistakes.
When Detective Zreal saw this scene, he was a little speechless. He thought to himself that this kid probably didn't have the life of a noble. He was quite particular after suffering from a noble's disease.
At that moment, Ian took out a thick stack of bills from his pocket. They seemed to be strictly stacked in order of face value. Then, he inserted the three bills given by Zreal into the first stack.
"Thank you for your generosity." After neatly putting the notes back into his pocket, Ian thanked him sincerely. For an orphan like him, three pounds was a huge sum of money.
Watching the boy, who was much more mature than his actual age, leave, Detective Zreal stroked his chin and muttered to himself in thought,
Even that Cryptologist lady failed to discover the secret door... Perhaps it's very dangerous! Hmm, it looks like I'll have to report this matter to the station head to resolve it...
With this in mind, he put on his coat and walked to the chimney of a park on the street as if he was taking a stroll. He then used a chalk to secretly draw a few symbols.
This was the way he had agreed to meet with his superior... As for the answer, it was hidden in the advertisements in the Backlund Secrets News that he would air.
Speaking of which, the Backlund Secrets News was a small newspaper filled with all sorts of fake news. However, due to its high editorial standards, many of the articles were written with great interest, so the sales were pretty good. It was ranked first among all the smaller Backlund newspapers.
After doing all of this, Detective Zreal, who had been busy for more than two weeks because of Helmosuin's manuscript, finally heaved a sigh of relief. He thought for a moment and decided to find his "good friend," Miss Eileen, to relax his body and mind.
But when he arrived at the timber merchant's house, he was surprised to learn from Eileen's maid that, apart from occasionally going on dates with her real boyfriend, Mr. Binkley, she had stopped casually making "friends." Instead, she had been hanging out at high society social events with her father, as if she was trying to clear her name.
Zreal was surprised by this, but he didn't think too much about it. He only thought that perhaps Eileen had her sights set higher.
But why didn't she break up with Mr. Binkley? This question flashed through Zreal's mind, but he didn't probe deeper. After all, it had nothing to do with him.
He didn't stay for long as he stopped a rental carriage and headed for the Golden Rose.
Meanwhile, in the bedroom on the third story of the timber merchant's villa, Miss Eileen and Mr. Binkley were quietly kneeling in front of a figurine of a Hanged Giant about half a meter tall, piously praying and listening...
...
In the blink of an eye, it was Wednesday.
That morning, Ebner first received a reply from Miss Judi through the post office. In the letter, she said that she hadn't found the milk cows he mentioned, but she could help ask the other Biologist in the Church of Earth if they had any similar creatures. She would probably give them an answer in a few weeks.
At the end of the letter, she wrote in a rather mysterious tone: Cullen seems to be in a daze over the past few days, as though he's worried about something, but he refuses to tell me...
"Give me an answer in a few weeks? Miss, are you going to get someone to groom one for you?" After putting down the letter, Ebner couldn't help but lampoon.
As for Cullen, it was good as long as he was still alive. At the very least, he didn't need to modify the incantation to summon Silika.
Ebner shook his head. Just as he was about to write a letter to her to tell her that there was no need to rush things and that he could just transfer the money directly to Miss Sharron, Xio closed the door again.
This time, she brought three pages of Roselle's diary.
Ever since she found out what the price was for asking Mr. Fool to save her, she had been actively searching for relevant information. She had finally found three pages in MI9's archives.
After taking it, he glanced at it a few times and knew that it was the real thing. However, Xio was in front of him, so in order to not expose the fact that he knew Roselle's language, he didn't look at it carefully.
Xio felt a little relieved when she saw Ebner accept the diary without standing on ceremony.
She didn't mention the process of her visit, but she mentioned something else. "Miss Audrey asked Fors and me to have high tea at Viscount Glaint's place."
Upon hearing that, Ebner thought for a moment before saying with a smile, "Then, she will most likely have to pay for your previous investigations with Fors."
Xio pursed her lips and said wistfully, "I wonder how much she'll give..."
I did give you 800 pounds, but that's not necessarily the case now. After all, you didn't encounter as much danger as I did.
And in fact, Miss Audrey was as generous as ever.
When the afternoon came, Xio and Fors entered Viscount Glaint's study and received the thick envelope from Miss Audrey. They felt the weight of the money.
Xio said sincerely,
"Miss Audrey, thank you for your generosity. Your honesty makes you even more beautiful."
Audrey smiled faintly and said,
"A total of eight hundred pounds. Decide how to split it among yourselves.
"I'm very sorry that that matter caused your friend to lose his life."
Eight hundred pounds... No, there's no need to apologize... Darkholme isn't my friend at all. The death of a person like him is really a contribution to the security of Backlund!
Xio didn't count the notes in a reserved manner, even though she really wanted to do so.
Fors couldn't help but smile as she said wistfully,
This is even more than the royalties I've received for my book, Stormwind Mountain Villa...
Should I praise Miss Audrey or mock the poverty of an author? she added silently.
Viscount Glaint, who was sitting on the sofa, was also a little envious, but he wasn't envious of Xio or Fors. As a viscount with a relatively good financial situation, eight hundred pounds wasn't a large sum.
What he envied was Audrey's generosity. She didn't feel burdened at all.
"Ahem..." Viscount Glaint cleared his throat. "If you can get the Apothecary formula, I will also pay you handsomely."
"We'll do our best!" Xio replied without hesitation. Following that, she looked at Audrey and said in a fake manner, "We recently came into contact with someone suspected to be from the Psychology Alchemists. The Spectator potion you want will soon give you clues, even though I know you no longer need it."
Xio, I'm almost at Sequence 8, almost catching up to you... Audrey glanced at Xio and nodded with a smile, but she didn't say a word. Her impression of Xio was that she was a Sequence 8 Sheriff.
I know... But you're not as good as me. Xio guessed the meaning behind Audrey's smile and added silently in her heart.
With that said, the four of them chatted about the various rumors about the Beyonder circles as they sought out the books they wanted to read under Audrey's example.
During this process, Audrey casually mentioned Detective Bryan's reputation, but she was surprised to find that neither Xio nor Fors cared. It was as though he had nothing to do with them.
This puzzled Audrey. She thought, Could the rumors about Xio and Detective Bryan's close relationship be fake?
And at this moment, Xio's eyes lit up because she had discovered a hidden layer in a book named "Study of the Coat of Arms."
She quietly opened the interlayer and found an ancient piece of paper.
The front of the paper was covered with the special symbols created by Emperor Roselle, and on the back was a paragraph of ancient Hermes.
Then, she saw three lines of ancient Hermes text that left a deep impression on her.
"The Fool that doesn't belong to this era;
"The mysterious ruler above the gray fog;
"The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck."
Upon seeing this, she closed the book and asked Viscount Glaint if she could borrow it. After receiving permission, she lowered her eyelids and secretly glanced at Audrey.
As for Audrey, who had witnessed the entire process, she knew nothing about it. The corners of her mouth curled up slightly as she looked to the side in a reserved manner, pretending to be reading.
As a qualified Spectator who had advanced, she had accurately grasped Xio's and Fors's preferences in certain areas after many interactions. With that, she had made arrangements in advance that no one noticed.
Letting the one being guided feel that it was their own will was a manifestation of the powers of a Spectator.
However, she felt that her "arrangement" was somewhat disharmonious, but she didn't notice any problems...

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Diary
chapters.content:
Chapter 276 - Diary
"Name: Lilith's Tears
"Appearance: Blue Crystal pendulum
"Function description: Place the pendant at the heart for a full-body treatment. Most diseases and non-lethal injuries can be quickly treated.
"Place the pendant between your eyebrows and you can transform into a giant bear. In this state, the user's strength, speed, and defensive abilities will be greatly enhanced. Furthermore, you will grasp a portion of earth-type spells.
"If you shatter the pendulum, you can release Barren. Once this power is activated, with the user at the center, all creatures within a two-kilometer radius will wither away, entering the end of their lives. Even ordinary demigods are no exception.
"Take note: Once Barren is released, the pendulum will be completely destroyed. The user will similarly wither away."
"Negative effects: Every time you use the powers of the pendulum, you will fall into an indescribable state of grief, and it's very difficult to extricate yourself from it. You need to receive psychological treatment in time; otherwise, there's a chance of you losing control.
In the study of the villa at 28 Kingst Street, after three days, Ebner finally finished analyzing the pendant bestowed by Earth Mother...
It has to be said that this is a powerful item, especially the description of the Barrenness. It might even be the Beyonder powers of a Mother Sequence 2 Desolate Matriarch! But...
This ability is used to perish together with others, right?!
Apart from the few pathways that can be resurrected from The Fool and Death, using this power is equivalent to suicide...
Yes, perhaps there's nothing wrong with the Desolate Matriarch. The Mother pathway's Sequence 3 is called the Pallbearer. This name sounds like it involves the domain of death, and the Mother pathway might very well have authority like the Samsara of Life and Death...
It's no wonder Bishop Utravsky's style resembles those bald heads of the Western Continent...
After lampooning inwardly, Ebner put away Lilith's Tear pendant. Regardless, he finally had a powerful "trump card" in his hand. Even if he didn't really use it, it could still serve as a deterrent.
Furthermore, just because I don't dare to perish together with him doesn't mean that Mr. Fool doesn't dare to either! Desolation happens to be followed by an intact corpse...
Well, taking a step back, even if Klein didn't dare to try, wouldn't he still be able to use his marionette in the future?
As his thoughts raced, he picked up the three pages of Roselle's diary that Xio had brought. As he drank a mouthful of sweet iced tea, he changed into a more comfortable position on the sofa and began reading.
He hadn't noticed it before, but now that he looked at it carefully, he immediately realized that the three pages were continuous. Furthermore, they were describing the same thing—something he had guessed when he was investigating the first Baron Lamud.
"12th June. I secretly came to Loen. I've been in Backlund for more than a week. Although the madams and young ladies here are usually more reserved and it's not easy for them to communicate in-depth, the Tussock River is very clear. The air is also very fresh. Compared to Trier, which I've personally started the industrial age, this place is really suitable for living.
What's worth mentioning is that due to the Church of Evernight's advocacy, Backlund residents have long developed a relatively hygienic lifestyle... At the very least, there's no smell of Trier on the streets!
"Speaking of which, if my transmigration identity is that of an Intis noble, I really want to settle down here.
"13th June. I found a hidden manuscript on an old bookshelf in the Backlund University Library today. It seems to record a secret base left behind after the Solomon Empire was destroyed... Perhaps there's a treasure there? Heh heh, I'm indeed the protagonist of this era. I have fortuitous encounters everywhere.
Yes, I'll summon back Grimm, Edwards, and Cullen who are out on missions. Then, I'll form a team to search for this ruin... It should be in Loen's Sivellaus County, north of the Hornacis mountain range, somewhere south of Midseashire.
"14th June. Cullen and Edwards returned first. I mentioned the matter to them, but Edwards's eyes lit up when he heard that. He appeared very excited. As for Cullen, he seemed to lack interest. He told me that even if there were any treasures there, they had long been found.
"Indeed, these long-lived creatures are rather 'widowed.' Even though they look young, they have long lost the enthusiasm of young people. However, his opinion isn't important. After Grimm returned, we had a vote.
"Finally, without any surprises, we passed the exploration plan with three to one vote.
"15th June. Upstream along the Tussock River. Although the river isn't too fast, the ship we are on board doesn't go very fast... Unfortunately, at my current stage, I don't want to design a steam engine with higher efficiency. Otherwise, with the railway, our travels wouldn't be that slow.
"17th June. The four of us arrived at Constant City."
"18th June. The mountain roads of the Loen Kingdom are really terrible. Even though I built a shock absorption facility, the carriage ride was still so bumpy that it nearly blew up my ass... When I return this time, I'll improve the steam engine's power. I must spread steam locomotives and railways across the Northern Continent!
"20th June. After two days of searching, Cullen found the entrance to the ruins with one of his Beyonder items. Speaking of which, the entrance is very strange. It's clearly halfway up a cliff, but we can actually reach it in one step at the foot of the mountain... And if we were to go in another direction, we wouldn't be able to reach it no matter how long we walked.
"Cullen said that the concept of distance here has been 'Disordered,' and I didn't quite understand what he meant.
"After entering the ruins, the path becomes even more terrifying! At times, you're clearly advancing, but you suddenly realize that you've retreated to the side of a lava pool and nearly fell. At other times, you clearly wish to stop, but you realize that you're still running with inertia...
"I finally understand why there aren't any monsters here. This is because even monsters can't survive in such an environment.
"In short, after experiencing many hardships, we finally arrived at a gorgeous hall.
"However, apart from a mural in the hall, there's only a pair of knights stabbing each other's broadswords into each other's chests. The rest of the items seem to have been moved away long ago. Yes, even the Beyonder characteristics of the two powerful knights are gone.
"From the looks of it, Cullen guessed right. Indeed, someone had been here long ago. Could it be that I'm really not the main lead? No, I don't think so. Hence, I carefully studied the mural and finally discovered the mystery behind it.
So this mural indicates the true location of the treasure trove, the way to open it, and the correct time to open it...
The diary came to an abrupt halt as Ebner flipped through the back pages, only to be regretful that there was no follow-up.
The path was "Disordered." This should be the power of a High-Sequence Beyonder of the Black Emperor pathway... And although there's no evidence of those two dead knights, they're probably the good friend of the second Baron Lamud, Kilgor, and the royal family's spy, Glu...
So, that ruin only contains clues to the treasure left behind by the real Black Emperor?
But why didn't the subsequent Loen royal family members destroy the murals or bury the two knights after clearing out all the items in the hall?
I have a feeling that there's another reason behind this... And the reason why Emperor Roselle succeeded in becoming the Black Emperor was probably because of this treasure trove.
I previously speculated that the conditions for opening the treasure might very well require the bloodline of a descendant of the Solomon Empire... Therefore, the royal family had always treated the descendants of Kilgor well. It was only when Roselle became the Black Emperor that the family made a mistake and deprived him of his aristocratic title.
And Roselle later received Savigny at the White Maple Palace and recruited him—King of the Five Seas Nast's father!
And Nast had always claimed to be a descendant of the Solomon Empire.
So that's how it is...
At this thought, Ebner closed his eyes as though sensing something. Then, he shook his head in disappointment.
He wasn't disappointed in his own conjectures but rather disappointed in the progress of the potion's digestion.
Although there seem to be tiny signs of digestion, it's not obvious... From the looks of it, exploring secrets from historical events to enhance one's knowledge of different types isn't the key to the acting of a Polymath...
In fact, before he drank the Polymath potion, he had naively believed that he could digest most of the mysticism knowledge he knew.
But the reality is very different from his expectations... Then, what's the key to being a Polymath?
...
Tingen, Raphael Cemetery at night.
The bronze-skinned Azik held a bird with illusory feathers in one hand and a bouquet of white flowers in the other. He stood in front of Klein's grave for a long time without saying a word. Finally, he sighed and said to himself,
"I'm sorry I'm ten minutes late.
"But I should know who it is..."
He bent down and put down the bouquet of flowers before turning to leave the cemetery and Tingen.
There was an indescribable silence and loneliness under the illumination of the crimson moonlight.
Suddenly, the stone slab sealing the grave was flipped over as a slightly pale hand reached out from the soil.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Resurrection
chapters.content:
Chapter 277 - Resurrection
Whoosh!
The stone slab was pushed open, and the coffin lid was pushed open. Klein sat up and looked around blankly.
His memory was still fixated on the pair of hands that held Saint Selena's urn and the Fallen Morning Star. It was as if he had fallen asleep without a dream.
Instinctively, he lowered his head, unbuttoned his clothes, and looked at his left chest. He saw that the hideous wound and the missing heart were squirming as they healed. It was just like how he had seen the bullet hole in his temple rapidly heal back then. The only difference was that it was even slower and more difficult this time.
After nearly a minute, Klein buttoned his suit, pushed himself up, and stood up. He discovered that his Clown powers had yet to disappear.
The best elder brother... The best younger brother... The best colleague... Klein looked at the tombstone and read the inscription silently. His heart winced as he seemed to experience the despondent feelings Melissa and Benson had.
This might be worse than me witnessing Captain's impending death without being able to save him... He sighed and retracted his gaze. He squatted down and closed the coffin lid.
Although his thoughts were still a little scattered, Klein knew that he had to quickly deal with the scene and not be discovered by anyone.
Resurrection wasn't something ordinary people could play with!
...
At the same time, in a hotel in Tingen City's Iron Cross Street, in an attempt to simulate the powers of a Faceless, Ebner, who had changed his face, looked at the crimson light outside the window and muttered to himself, "At this time, Klein should've been resurrected, right?"
He had actually arrived in Tingen on Friday afternoon. He had even observed Klein's and Dunn's burials from a distance, but he had no intention of watching Mr. Fool lift his coffin.
Once I meet Klein, with his high spiritual perception and my connection with Sefirah Castle, it will definitely give him a sense of familiarity and even vigilance. When that happens, I'll be exposed if he casually divines it... That wouldn't be beneficial for me to dig up Dunn's corpse. It might even cause a misunderstanding.
Of course, this was also because the powers of a Faceless were learned from the Clown Mask. It was considered a low-quality combination. It could only change facial features and adjust the face shape to a certain extent. Even the hair couldn't be changed, let alone the height and aura of one's body.
How could such a disguise fool the spiritual perception of a Seer augmented by Sefirah Castle?
Retracting his gaze from the night sky, Ebner used the light from the gas lamp to read the information Bishop Utravsky had gathered for him about Tingen's Beyonder events from the past two months.
As he read the information, he recalled the original story, hoping to confirm if there had been any major changes to the "plot."
Trissy's crimes were discovered ahead of time, and she even instigated Joyce to attack his fiancée? This... This is probably the fault of Xio and me, right? Did our actions in the Dream maze tower affect the surviving members of the sea in the real world? Yes, Madam Daly's new assistant, Miss Chely, who was rescued by Xio in the dream, seems to have a baffling sense of familiarity towards Xio and me.
Ebner nodded thoughtfully and picked up the next set of documents.
Eh? Leena actually came to Tingen? She even helped Klein kill Madam Sharon... This is for the Beyonder characteristic... Could it be that this change was caused by me as well? Or could it be that someone is behind all of this... Hmm, I'll ask Shoko after I return. Perhaps he will know something.
...
In a corner of the Raphael Cemetery, Klein filled his grave with soil and covered it with a stone slab. Only then did he clap his hands and stand up again.
During the process, his spiritual perception had sensed the existence of Azik's copper whistle, so he dug it out and wiped it clean.
However, Klein didn't intend to summon the messenger immediately. He decided to first pay his respects to the Captain.
He removed the topaz pendant that was still wrapped around his wrist and did a few simple divinations before finding Dunn's grave.
Klein looked at the black-and-white photograph of the Captain. He had a gentle expression, a high hairline, and the grayness of his eyes were faintly discernible. He looked no different from his usual self.
Under the photo was Dunn's name, date of birth, date of death, and epitaph.
"A true guardian;
"The most trusted partner;
"The Captain forever."
Klein watched in a daze as his vision blurred for some reason. Tears streamed down his face as he finally shouted with a choking voice,
"Captain... I miss you too!"
After a while, Klein felt a cold wind blow past him. He wiped his eyes and sniffed.
Recovering his silence, he found a secluded spot and prepared to board the gray fog. He wanted to use divination to figure out the person who killed him that day, to figure out the true murderer behind all of this!
But at that moment, he suddenly heard a series of chaotic footsteps and a few words floating in the wind.
"Ms. Kapusky..."
"...Are we really digging..."
"...The resurrection of the dead?"
Klein immediately stopped in his tracks. Using his agility as a Clown, he quickly climbed up a nearby tree and stood in the treetop, looking at the open and flat area not far away... The voice came from there.
Kapusky... That name sounds familiar... Ah, I remember. Melissa had once mentioned that a new teacher came to her school. That's the name...
When he thought of Melissa, Klein's expression immediately softened. He recalled that night. Melissa and her friend had apparently had their differences because of this teacher, so they were very unhappy. Benson and himself had even tried to help her vent her anger...
Right, back then, Melissa said that she didn't agree with some of the teachings... I didn't ask what they were either... And he brought so many people to the cemetery in the middle of the night... Could he be a cult member?
At this thought, Klein's heart tightened. He decided to observe. If there really was something wrong with this teacher, then he had to get rid of him no matter what to get rid of this latent problem for Melissa.
At this moment, a few young boys and girls had already dug out a corpse under the command of a black-robed man and had circled around it.
Following that, the black-robed youths began to dance around the corpse, twitching slightly as they danced a strange, slightly crazy dance.
As far as Klein could see, the girl was tossing her long hair, and the boy was kneeling on the ground, reaching out his hand. These scenes had a subtle connection with the surroundings, as though they had a sense of mystery or a natural rhythm.
It really is a Spirit Dance... Ritualistic magic that even ordinary people can participate in... Klein shifted his gaze away and looked at the black-robed man who was chanting an incantation beside the corpse. It was very likely that he was Melissa's teacher.
The Spirit Dance that the young boys and girls were dancing was clearly guided by him!
He should be a member of the Numinous Episcopate, and there's a high chance that he's a Beyonder... Klein nodded indiscernibly. He planned on watching how the other party held the resurrection ritual to determine his level.
If he's only a Low-Sequence Beyonder, I'll finish him off... If I can't deal with him myself, I'll think of a way to report it to the Church... Hmm, I'll send Miss Judgment a mission when the time comes. The reward can be exchanged for the diary that Mr. Tower owes me. I believe Miss Judgment will be very willing to do so...
Wait... Mr. Tower... Fallen Morning Star! Mr. Tower's Fallen Morning Star seems to have been taken away by the mastermind! This... How should I explain this to Mr. Tower...
Just as Klein finally realized the problem he had neglected since his resurrection, the dance on the other side reached its climax. The adult black-robed man suspected to be Kapusky raised his head and took off his wig, revealing a few strange tattoos engraved on his bald head.
He raised his hands and shouted,
"Death!
"Honorable Death!
"About to return!"
After the shouting, the dance stopped. The seven or eight youths stood on either side, looking lost and expectant, excited, and fearful.
Then, the black-robed man bent down and opened the iron cage by his feet, taking out a black object.
Klein snapped back to his senses and suppressed his slightly flustered emotions. He focused his gaze and discovered that it was a green-eyed black cat.
Th-that works? He was clearly taken aback as he suddenly recalled the various folklore regarding the black cat. For example, if the black cat, which symbolized the evil emissary of hell, jumped over a corpse, the corpse would be awakened.
This was the first time Klein was seeing someone use such a method in a ritual.
The black-robed man took a step forward and stopped the black cat from struggling before tossing it towards the corpse.
Meow!
The black cat's fur stood on end as it roared and leaped over the corpse.
At that moment, Klein felt that he understood cat language. He believed that it was definitely saying one word:
"Fuck!"
As the black cat fled, the corpse actually sat up!
But before the group of youths could rejoice, it opened its mouth, as if it was going to pounce on the girl closest to it and bite her.
Thankfully, the girl's reaction was very fast and she was very agile. She dodged the attack by a hair's breadth.
As for the black-robed adult man, he seemed to be stunned by the scene before him. He tried his best to use Hermes to give some instructions, but it was to no avail.
Klein, who was watching this scene from afar, was similarly dumbfounded. He thought, Is that it? Is this Teacher Kapusky a real rookie?!
However, seeing that the corpse was about to pounce on the young boys and girls who were killed, Klein naturally couldn't sit back and do nothing. He calmly removed the spirituality seal on Azik's copper whistle and threw it far away.
The corpse immediately stopped lunging forward. Then, it shrugged its shoulders and ran in the direction of the copper whistle.
Klein took this opportunity to return to the ground, took four steps counterclockwise, and stepped into the gray fog.
He quickly took out a hooded robe from the junk pile and draped it over his body. Then, he grabbed a Slumber Charm and returned to reality.
It was a charm he had previously made and had left unused above the gray fog.
Using his agility as a Clown, he quickly caught up to the corpse. Without any hesitation, he raised the silver charm and shouted a word in ancient Hermes,
"Crimson!"
Feeling the silver sheet in his palm turn cold, Klein injected his spirituality into it and threw it out.
A dark red flame lit up his eyes as a light explosion reverberated through the forest.
A gentle power emanated out, bringing with it an irresistible fatigue. The running corpse immediately swayed a few times, closed its empty eyes, and plopped to the ground.
Klein quickly picked up Azik's copper whistle, took four steps counterclockwise, and brought it along with the gray fog.
Without Holy Night Powder by his side, he was temporarily unable to create a wall of spirituality. He could only send it to the gray fog to prevent the corpse from suffering further stimulation.
After leaving the world above the gray fog and carrying the corpse back to its original position, Klein discovered that only a few young boys and girls remained in their spots in shock. As for the black-robed adult, he had already fled.
However, Klein wasn't worried. He had left too many things here, making it easy to divine his whereabouts.
Looking at the children who were clearly about Melissa's age, Klein, who had his face hidden in his hood, asked them about the black-robed man who had escaped.
"H-he's our language teacher, Kapusky Reid..."
"He claims to have a deep understanding of death and wants to lead us in finding the mysteries of immortality."
The few youths answered in unison.
It really is him... The mystery of immortality? There's no need to pay taxes when bragging... From his performance just now, he's probably not even a Sequence 9... Is he really a member of the Numinous Episcopate? Is that all the Numinous Episcopate does?
Klein decided to confirm it with the teacher again, so he warned the children and told them to tell their parents before leaving the cemetery. Then, through dowsing, he quickly found Kapusky's location.
Eh? He didn't return to his rented apartment but came to a hotel? Iron Cross Street... It's so close to Daffodil Street...
...
Ebner, who was reading the documents in front of his desk, suddenly felt his spiritual perception trigger. He acutely noticed that the room next door seemed to be sealed by spirituality.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Digging a Grave
chapters.content:
Chapter 278 - Digging a Grave
In the hotel room, after using words to scare the teacher named Kapusky, Klein used the mysticism materials he had on him to concoct Holy Night Powder, creating a wall of spirituality.
Then, he began interrogating the ancient Feysac language teacher from Backlund.
Kapusky was actually quite frightened by what had happened tonight. His few attempts in Backlund had failed to awaken the corpse, so how could he have known that it would be so dangerous...
As for the cloaked man in front of him, he looked like a legendary professional who dealt with such Beyonder matters. Therefore, he didn't dare to hide his background and the Spirit Dance ritual he learned from Klein.
"In other words, it was taught to you by a tramp you saved... No, by the old gentleman? He even performed the act of swatting a mosquito to wake it up?" Klein asked thoughtfully.
"Yes... If it wasn't because I didn't have enough time, I even wanted to become his student.
"In those few days, he taught me the Dance of Death and a lot of knowledge. Unfortunately, this period of time was too short. Just as I entered the zone, he died..." Kapusky said with some regret.
To that old gentleman, death might not be the end... Klein thought of the wonders of Mr. Azik and couldn't help but ask, "Where did you bury him?"
"Buried in the back garden of my Backlund house... Well, the address is 4 Alka Street in North Borough," Kapusky answered honestly.
I should report this to the Captain and get him to contact the Backlund Nighthawks to check...
Just as he thought of this, Klein realized that he was no longer a Nighthawk after his resurrection. It was even more impossible for the Captain to hear his report...
His mood instantly fell, and it took him quite a while to compose himself. He then asked, "Apart from the Spirit Dance and that so-called resurrection ritual, what else did you learn?"
Kapusky looked strangely at the man in front of him, who had hidden his face in his hood, and he felt that there was a hint of flagging interest in his tone. However, he didn't think too much about it. He took out an exquisite, unadorned copper whistle from his pocket and replied,
"There's also this copper whistle. I think it's key to communicating with the world beyond the senses."
As he spoke, Kapusky raised his hand to blow at it and said wistfully, "Every time I finish blowing it, I can feel the surroundings turn cold. I feel like someone is watching me and tugging at me..."
As he spoke, Klein, who had his Spirit Vision activated, saw a skull with three dead fish eyes emerge from the ground.
Around the skull were black appendage-like tentacles.
A tentacle reached out, occasionally touching Kapusky's leg and tugged at his clothes, looking rather impatient. However, Kapusky didn't respond at all, as though he hadn't noticed it at all.
This is a messenger, right? The copper whistle summons the corresponding messenger... Why did you summon it without giving it a letter? Klein was stunned.
At this moment, Kapusky looked at him excitedly.
"Do you feel it? The surroundings have turned cold! Even the gas lamps have turned dark!
"It's real. Someone is watching me and tugging at me!"
The corners of Klein's mouth twitched as he watched, and he muttered to himself,
"I take back what I said before. He's not a rookie, but a noob!
He's not a Beyonder! Nor is he a member of the Numinous Episcopate!
I thought he was someone who had just stepped through the door of mysticism. From the looks of it, he hasn't even found the door...
After Klein secretly lampooned, he felt that his sorrow had been greatly alleviated. Hence, his heart stirred as a strange smile that looked like both crying and laughing appeared on his face under the hood. He said in an exaggerated tone, "That's because you can't see it. Now, there really is a hideous monster licking you!" As he spoke, he even described the monster's appearance.
"What?" Kapusky's hand trembled, and the whistle fell to the ground, while the skull monster burrowed back underground.
Klein bent down to pick up the whistle, took a simple look, and kindly mentioned,
"Stop blowing that copper whistle." Spirit world creatures were of no benefit to ordinary people.
"Are you saying that the copper whistle can summon monsters I can't see?" Kapusky asked in horror. He didn't doubt Klein's words, because there was no need for him to lie to him.
Without waiting for Klein's reply, he continued asking,
"C-can you help me throw this copper whistle into the Tussock River or the Khoy River?"
From the looks of it, this teacher must've been frightened by the resurrected corpse tonight... This is the kind of person that Mr. Ye is talking about!
Klein silently lampooned and agreed to the man's request. At the same time, he thought that he could divine the copper whistle after divining his murderer above the gray fog.
Following that, he scared the man again. After the man promised to leave Tingen for the time being, Klein removed the wall of spirituality and walked out of the room.
But at that moment, his spiritual perception was triggered. He felt as though someone was spying on him.
Klein didn't stop walking, but he was extremely wary. All sorts of guesses surfaced in his mind, but he had no clue. In his hand was the only Slumber Charm he had left.
Thankfully, nothing happened until he left the hotel, and the feeling of being spied on had vanished.
Which unaffiliated Beyonder discovered my act of setting up a wall of spirituality, so they want to know exactly what happened? Although he was inclined towards this guess, Klein didn't let his guard down. He quickly walked to another hotel two streets away from Iron Cross Street and spent a full ten pence to get a single bathroom. Then, he used a coin flick to confirm if anyone was watching his every move.
After receiving a negative answer, he quickly took four steps counterclockwise, recited the incantation, and went above the gray fog.
Inside the ancient and towering palace, Klein didn't bother examining his surroundings as he repeated his divination.
Seeing that the negative answer had not changed, he let out a long breath.
"My revival was already so exciting... Captain, look, my luck is as bad as ever!"
He first gave a self-deprecating laugh before he laughed in an exaggerated manner, as if he had encountered something that could amuse him for the rest of his life.
Nearly a minute later, Klein wiped the smile from his face as he divined the culprit who killed him and everything with a solemn expression... The final result was Ince Zangwill!
So it's him! After a moment's thought, Klein guessed the purpose of his actions, as well as the general powers of Sealed Artifact 0-08.
"In the Sauron family's library, I read a story about the son of the Dragon King. It was written as if it was real, saying that it could weave a true nightmare in reality, allowing many living beings to unknowingly join in. Then, it gave the cruelest and most harrowing ending..."
Thinking back to the page of Roselle's diary that he had once seen, Klein came to a realization. 0-08's powers shouldn't be used in direct combat, but rather similar to the son of the Dragon King!
I should've made the connection long ago... Perhaps 0-08 interfered with my thoughts?
With this in mind, Klein closed his eyes and then divined Ince Zangwill's location, Lanevus's location, and the hope of him becoming stronger.
The final outcome was—
The Land of Hope, the Capital of Capitals, Backlund!
Hence, Klein made a decision.
...
In the inn at Iron Cross Street, watching Klein leave in a panic despite appearing calm on the surface, Ebner removed his invisibility and returned to his room.
He was actually more flustered than Klein. He had deliberately avoided Klein, but he never expected to nearly bump into him in this tiny hotel.
As for how he could recognize that it was Klein? The aura of Sefirah Castle on him was so obvious under the White Eye that even the curly-haired baboon could recognize him.
Thankfully, Klein's means were still far from adequate. If it were the future Gehrman, he would've taken the initiative to strike when he realized that he was being watched.
Ebner sighed a few times. He wasn't actually afraid of meeting Klein in the real world, but this wasn't the right time. If he had met him in Backlund, he might've pulled him back and gotten Judgment to hold an offline gathering...
However, why would Klein be here after his resurrection? Who was living in the room beside me?
With these questions in mind, Ebner simulated the powers of a Nightmare and silently intruded into Kapusky's dream from next door and questioned him in the dream.
As for why Kapusky fell asleep so quickly? When a Nightmare enters a dream, who cares if you sleep or not?
After becoming a true Polymath, the effects of the ability to simulate Sequence 7 were nearly twenty percent better.
So that's how it is. It's actually Kapusky! This is also the butterfly effect I brought, right...
Thankfully, because of Klein's timely intervention, this guy didn't cause too much trouble, and those students probably wouldn't choose to call the police... Otherwise, the cemetery would definitely be monitored by the official teams, increasing the difficulty of digging my grave...
Ebner nodded in relief and no longer had any doubts. Seeing that it wasn't early, he forced himself to sleep through Cogitation.
...
On Sunday, Ebner secretly followed the Kapusky teacher around. He was relieved to see that he hadn't been arrested by the officials and had only been beaten up by the student's parents.
At night, the September breeze was tainted with a hint of coldness. After penetrating the cemetery, it became even colder.
Using his powers of invisibility, he silently arrived in front of Dunn Smith's grave. He looked at the photo on the tombstone with a receding hairline. After confirming that he hadn't found the wrong grave, he simulated his Nightmare powers and covered a ten-meter radius to prevent anyone from passing by.
Then, he picked up the shovel he had prepared and began digging.
The two piles of soil gradually increased in height as the tomb was exposed bit by bit.
Finally, the coffin fully presented itself before Ebner's eyes. He activated the Heart of Omnipotence and simulated the power of a Zombie for a brief moment before lifting the heavy wooden lid that had been nailed shut.
The undertaker that the Nighthawks hired was obviously of good quality. Dunn's "corpse" lay in the coffin peacefully. He didn't look like someone who had been dead for a week.
Ebner didn't immediately take action. Instead, he used the White Eye to analyze Dunn carefully. Then, combined with the special Stone of Life that Earth Mother had given him, he had a rough idea.
Then, he bent down and moved the corpse out of the coffin. Then, he closed the lid and filled it with soil. Only then did he put Dunn into a gunny sack that he had prepared. He carried him over his shoulder and left the cemetery.
He didn't dare to openly place the Stone of Life on Dunn. If he created a huge commotion and attracted the official team, it would be hard to explain.
In fact, if it wasn't for the fact that Earth Mother seemed to deliberately hide the news that Dunn wasn't completely dead, he would've "sacrificed" the sack containing Dunn to the gray fog. He could wait until he arrived at Enmat Harbor by steam locomotive before requesting Klein to "bestow" it back...

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Doctor
chapters.content:
Chapter 279 - Doctor
Ebner didn't fly far with the sack containing Dunn. He only left the city before landing on the ground. He came to a bungalow he had rented as a fake.
This house was rather far from the three Churches, and the Tussock River flowed nearby, making it very convenient to escape.
As for Ebner, he had already set up a ritual in the hall to conceal the phenomenon and sound. Therefore, the moment he entered, he placed Dunn's "corpse" on the prepared altar.
In a remote suburban house, dim crimson moonlight, flickering candlelight, sinister and mysterious symbols... and an altar with corpses on it...
Such a scene made even the host of the suspected "evil" ritual feel odd. He couldn't help but lampoon.
It's clearly a ritual of the orthodox Churches. The host is a Blessed, and the one being rescued is also a "hero" of noble character... But why does this scene look like a supervillain? Anyone who sees it will probably report it.
After easing his anxiety, he carefully took out a tin box from his pocket. He removed the spirituality seal on the tin box and took out the Black Stone of Life that Earth Mother had given him.
Ebner took a deep breath, prepared to flee at any moment. He walked forward and unbuttoned Dunn's shirt, revealing his obviously stitched chest. Then, he solemnly placed the black gem on his left chest.
The moment the Stone of Life touched Dunn's body, it melted and seeped into his chest. Then, his entire body was surrounded by red and green colors, emitting intertwining red and green beams of light.
Upon seeing this scene, Ebner heaved a sigh of relief. This was because a phenomenon of this level couldn't break through the ritual he had set up... At least he didn't have to flee.
As he relaxed, he activated the White Eye and carefully observed the changes in Dunn's body as a result of his accumulated knowledge.
Although Ebner didn't know what the complete acting method of a Polymath was, accumulating different types of knowledge was definitely one of them.
Just like that, about thirty minutes later, Dunn, who was lying on the altar, slowly opened his eyes. However, his eyes were unfocused, as though he was in a daze.
That was indeed the case. When Dunn woke up, he felt as though he was having a chaotic dream.
In the dream, he became the little Ett who broke down on the spot and cried after his first dangerous mission. He became Rozanne's mother, Adelaide who had once blocked an evil curse with her arm. He became the beautiful Dwayne who had the warm temperament of dawn... Of course, he also became Dunn Smith, who died after triggering the power of Saint Selena's ashes with his heart...
"Who are you?" At that moment, an ethereal voice seemed to reach his ears from the horizon. It carried a warm and comforting power.
"Who am I? Who am I... Who am I!" The confused Dunn's eyes seemed to focus when he heard the voice. He repeated the question over again as images flashed through his mind.
There was Adelaide who liked to read, and the scene of her reading in the solarium. There was the scene of little Ett often hunting in the forest, and Dwayne always standing by the window of her bedroom, quietly watching the pedestrians...
Finally, the scene was of him hugging Daly in the office as Dunn...
"Daly..." After reciting the name, Dunn acted like a lost ship that had finally found a harbor to dock at. He "threw" his "anchor."
"I'm Dunn Smith! Captain of the Tingen Nighthawks, as well as... Daly's lover." Dunn's eyes regained their lucidity as he recalled the scenes before he was killed.
