Although he was still unable to move, his mind was rapidly analyzing the situation. He should be dead... Why would he revive?
Did some cultist steal my corpse and attempt to control my resurrected self?
Or did Daly do something silly like Old Neil?
Just as he was feeling worried, a dusty memory suddenly appeared in his mind.
It was a Friday in the middle of July. He was originally patrolling Raphael Cemetery when he was pulled into an independent space by a silver-haired vampire in a red shirt and black high-collar coat.
The vampire had said something strange like "a favor for a friend I've never met before," and had bitten him on the neck without any explanation. He even said that it was to "ensure" himself...
And after that, there was a conversation between him and himself... Dunn felt that the conversation had a lot to do with his current situation, so he tried hard to recall it. Finally, he recalled the scene in his mind.
After the silver-haired vampire bit Dunn's neck, he released the suppression effect on Dunn. He smiled and said, "I sealed half of your soul and the portion of Beyonder characteristics that you haven't digested yet with special methods.
"Heh heh, without the burden of the excess characteristics, your mental state will gradually improve, and your forgetfulness can also be improved. However, having lost half a soul, even if I use the method of Creation to help you mend it, your resistance to mental spells, especially mental curses, will still be much weaker."
Dunn touched the spot where his neck had been bitten. Without a change in expression, he asked softly, "Why did you do that?"
Life Creation. This term sounded like a technique only high-level Beyonders had.
"Like I said, I'm only providing you with a safeguard to prevent any accidents... Let's put it this way, if you unfortunately die, half of your mind will seep out along with the Beyonder characteristics that you've digested. In the eyes of others, especially one of the pens, you really are dead!
"However, the characteristic and soul I sealed came from you after all. Once someone holds the Stone of Life I refined to remove the seal, they will automatically trigger an Alchemical Life ritual, allowing you to revive...
"However, your soul wasn't complete back then. Your soul might've been stitched with the remnant psyche from the characteristic you didn't digest...
"As for who will control your mind in the end, that will depend on you."
At this point, the devilish silver-haired vampire revealed a beautiful smile and continued, "Alright, let's end it here for today. I've tampered with your memories. In a while, you'll forget about meeting me. You'll only remember it after the seal is removed."
When he recalled this, Dunn subconsciously wanted to touch his neck, but unfortunately, he realized that he was still unable to move.
However, he immediately sensed that something was amiss because the surroundings didn't seem real to him. Instead, it felt like a scene from a "dream."
After figuring this out, as an experienced Nightmare, Dunn immediately activated his powers in a bid to escape the dream. However, the chaos in his mind assaulted him, causing his powers to fail. He nearly suffered a backlash.
At that moment, the surroundings shattered. Dunn immediately felt that he had regained control of his body. He immediately sat up and looked around. What entered his vision was a hall that looked like a cult's ritual and a young man with a thin face and a goatee.
The young man was naturally Ebner. After Dunn woke up, he was afraid that Dunn would overreact and attract the official Beyonders. Therefore, he simulated a Nightmare and pulled him into a dream, intending to communicate with him there.
But to his surprise, Dunn's mind was in such a mess that he couldn't even use his Nightmare powers. He didn't manage to see through the reality of being in the dream and instead recalled the matters between him and the vessel of Earth Mother's descent.
As for Ebner, he was naturally very interested in this, so he decided to go through a round of temptations and "watched" a "documentary" on his dream island for free.
Who is the friend that Lilith mentioned about not meeting? Klein? But combined with that conversation... It might also be directed at me... After all, before everything happened, there was someone who was willing to save Dunn. It could only be me who knew the plot, right?
Upon thinking of this, Ebner felt flattered. What did he do to deserve a deity to be his "friend!"
Of course, this might also be Lilith's nonsense. After all, "She" said that "She" was under the Ancestor's orders... "She" is clearly the Ancestor's incarnation. This Lilith... seems to have a lot of humanity in her.
Dunn, who sat up, saw that the young man who seemed to be the host of the ritual was staring at him without saying a word. He could only take the lead and ask solemnly, "Who are you?"
Upon hearing that, Ebner snapped to his senses. He thought about the prototype of the figure he had disguised himself with his Faceless powers. Then, he thought of the possible "acting" method he could use in the future and replied with a chuckle,
"You can call me... Doctor Strange."

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Rich-Lush Cathedral
chapters.content:
Chapter 280 - Rich-Lush Cathedral
"Doctor Strange?" Dunn looked at Ebner in puzzlement before nodding. "A classic character in Emperor Roselle's hero series... I have to say, your appearance is very similar to what the Emperor described..."
"Perhaps I'm someone who walked out of Roselle's novel?" Ebner smiled and teased.
Ever since he transmigrated, he had studied Roselle's various quotations and novels, so he naturally knew of the so-called hero series novels. Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to give his alternate identity the name.
One had to know that be it the Goddess or Father Son, none of them were unfamiliar with the name of a superhero. If not for Roselle's endorsement, he would've immediately been targeted by the two if he revealed his "alternate identity."
Speaking of which, although Roselle's "hero" was a series of novels, it only wrote three stories, "Doctor Strange," "Iron Man," and "The Hulk." Perhaps it was because his imagination was too ahead of time, but these three novels weren't very popular more than a hundred years ago. Their influence was far inferior to "The Return of the Count of Monte Cristo."
Instead, it was only in the last ten years or so that these three novels regained their vibrancy and were deemed classic by many... but they were still niche.
The low sales might be the reason why Roselle didn't continue writing the "hero" series... Of course, it's more likely that the Church had interfered. After all, in order to fit in with the real world, Roselle had changed many stories and added some vague Beyonder knowledge.
And the reason why Ebner used this name as an "alt" was also because he considered that the acting of a "Polymath" might have a requirement of "fame"...With the gimmick of a classic character, "fame" was relatively simpler.
If not for the fact that the reputation of a Hero Detective had nothing to do with "erudite"—more like "love-making"—and how strict the Church's management of Sequence 6 Beyonders was, he wouldn't have wanted to expose himself... Why would he need to use another alt?
Dunn ignored Ebner's joke. He carefully observed the ritual structure in the hall and confirmed that there were no "evil" elements. He heaved a sigh of relief and asked again, "Doctor Strange, are you also a blood-sucking... Sanguine?"
"I'm not a Sanguine... You don't have to go through the trouble to probe me. I can tell you that I'm under orders to 'revive' you and provide you with some guidance." Ebner shook his head and went straight to the point.
"On orders... On whose orders?" Although Dunn was wary, he didn't show it. He asked cautiously, "Is it the high-level Sanguine powerhouse who gave me 'protection'?"
In a sense, you guessed right... Although this was on his mind, he wore a smile without saying a word. Although Lilith didn't ask him to hide it, he felt that it wasn't appropriate for such information to come out of his mouth.
When Dunn saw this, he knew that it was difficult to get something out of him. He could only change the topic and asked in a deep voice, "What was the guidance you mentioned previously?"
"My mission is to bring you to the Harvest Church at Enmat Harbor... As for the rest, you'll know when you get there," Ebner replied.
Through his analysis of Dunn's body, he had a general idea of Dunn's current situation. He knew that Dunn's mind was probably still in a mess and needed "treatment" from professionals... And if he wasn't surprised, there would be a professional waiting for him in the so-called "Harvest Church."
"Harvest Church? Church of Earth Mother..." Dunn lowered his guard when he heard that. The Church of Earth Mother was an organization of orthodox gods, so they wouldn't do anything evil.
The moment he woke up, the experienced Dunn knew that it would be difficult for him to return to the Church of Evernight and become a Nighthawk again...
Even if he were to force his way back, the best outcome would be to become a Keeper of Chanis Gate. He might even be imprisoned underground for extended periods of time...
It wouldn't have mattered if he had no strings attached. He could tolerate such treatment... However, he clearly remembered that a palm had penetrated Klein's chest just before he died!
There was obviously someone behind Tingen's series of events for the past three months, and that person eventually succeeded... He didn't know how many people in the company survived... But even if it was just Klein, he wanted to take revenge himself!
This made him temporarily unable to accept the fate of being imprisoned...
Besides, once I'm imprisoned, it would probably be difficult for me to meet Daly... And that would make me even less worthy of her...
Therefore, after pondering for a moment, Dunn asked again, "I accept your arrangements... Can I get the method to advance?" Typically, mysterious organizations would use such conditions to entice Beyonders to join, right?
Ebner shook his head and said with a smile, "How you advance is up to you... However, after coming to the Harvest Church, it should be helpful to your mental problems."
"You don't need me to join?" Dunn asked in surprise. Could it be that reviving me is just a daily act of kindness?
Just by looking at Bishop Utravsky's drawing style, one can tell that the faith of Earth Mother's pull people is voluntary... Besides, even if Lilith has a good relationship with the Goddess, "She" wouldn't directly poach him, right?
After lampooning a few times, Ebner shook his head and said in a suggestive manner, "Didn't that person tell you that 'He' was only doing a friend's favor?"
Regardless of who this "friend" was referring to, Klein definitely owed her a favor... Lilith didn't suffer any losses.
"'Him'?!" Dunn couldn't hide the shock in his voice. Although he had guessed that the Sanguine was at least an earl... he never expected him to be a duke at the angel level!
An angel definitely wouldn't lie to a trivial figure like me... But who among the people I know can make an angel think so highly of them? Who exactly is worthy of an angel scheming to "owe" me a favor?
As his thoughts raced, Dunn made up his mind. He stared at Ebner with his deep gray eyes and said in a deep voice, "I will follow you to Enmat Harbor so that you can complete your mission..." Then, he added in a mellow voice, "But before we set off, I have to confirm something..."
After a moment's thought, he guessed what Dunn was thinking. He asked with certainty, "You want to know the outcome of the battle at Blackthorn Security Company last Sunday... and who the mastermind is, right?"
"You know about it?" Dunn looked at him, his gray eyes filled with solemnity. It was obvious that he was afraid of hearing unacceptable news.
"First, don't worry. You successfully saved Tingen, and the spawn of an evil god didn't descend.
"In that battle, you, Klein Moretti, and the Keeper were the ones who died in battle... In addition, Ma'am Seeka and Leonard were only slightly injured.
"As for the mastermind... It's Ince Zangwill."
Using the original plot and the information provided by Bishop Utravsky, Ebner briefly told Dunn the results.
Dunn frowned slightly when he heard that. He retracted his gaze and muttered to himself as though he was in thought, "Ince Zangwill... 0-08... Those coincidences... So that's how it is. I understand. He's here for Saint Selena's ashes. All the previous incidents were to affect my psyche, making me make the wrong decision at the critical moment..."
After more than ten seconds, he looked back at Ebner and said, "Can we go to the cemetery to see Klein before we leave... It was my mistake that killed him..."
Upon hearing this request, Ebner's expression turned odd. After all, what was there to see in an empty grave? However, seeing how cooperative Dunn was, he didn't reject the request. When he saw that the sky was beginning to brighten, he took out a random-looking mask from his pocket and handed it over.
"This is a Clown mask. Wearing it will allow you to disguise yourself as another face... I don't think you want to be recognized by your former colleagues," Ebner hid his smile and said very seriously.
Dunn took the mask without hesitation and wore it. Soon after, his face began to squirm, and his flesh and skin began to undergo strange changes like half-melted wax. Finally, they combined to form the face of "Tony Stark," which Ebner had previously conjured.
Dunn stood up when he felt the twitching on his face stop. He walked to the full-body mirror in the corner of the hall and looked at it carefully. Finally, he nodded and said, "Not bad. People who aren't very familiar with it wouldn't be able to recognize it."
Then, Dunn changed into the clothes that Ebner had prepared for him. Then, he left the house one after another.
However, when Dunn came to the garden and saw the entire house, he could not help but sigh. "So I was resurrected in this house..."
"Is there anything special about this house?" Ebner was a few steps behind Dunn as he had to clear the ritual items. He was confused by Dunn's question.
"Klein, Leonard, and I had once fought Demoness Trissy here... Heh heh, if I had followed Klein's plan and used a cannon to bombard the house, I'm afraid this house wouldn't have existed..." At this point, Dunn suddenly fell silent. Then, he muttered with a hoarse voice, "Klein..."
...
In a corner of the Raphael Cemetery, in front of Klein's grave.
Dunn looked at the black-and-white photograph that was filled with a scholarly air. After a while, he stood up and said to Ebner, "Let's go."
Klein, as Captain, I will avenge you.
...
Meanwhile, Klein, who had just spent thirty pounds advertising his detective work in some newspapers, sneezed unnaturally.
He sniffed and looked up at the misty sky. He grumbled, "The air in Backlund sure is bad."
Following that, he picked up the Backlund Secrets News which had just spent the advertisements for him, and silently lampooned, "It costs so much to advertise... And Mr. Tower clearly didn't spend a single cent, but he has so much 'news'..."
Sigh, thinking of Mr. Tower reminds me of the "Fallen Morning Star" which Ince Zangwill had taken away... What reason should I use to muddle through this matter during the afternoon gathering?
...
At noon, Ebner and Dunn walked out of Enmat Harbor's steam locomotive together. Under the strange gaze of the carriage driver, they rushed to the Harvest Church in the outskirts of the city.
At least half of Enmat Harbor believed in the Lord of Storms, and the Church of Earth Mother had almost no believers here.
Therefore, the Harvest Church was much quieter than Backlund's Harvest Church, with only two priests presiding over it.
One of the priests was a man in his fifties. He had a lot of silver in his beard and hair. He had a kind face and a temperament similar to Bishop Utravsky.
As for the other person, she was a pretty lady. She looked to be in her thirties and had beautiful brown hair. When she smiled, there was a dimples at the corners of her mouth.
When they saw the two enter, they stood up and walked over.
The woman with long brown hair sized up Dunn before looking at Ebner. She smiled and said,
"I've already brought the milk cow you got my daughter to look for here. It's in the clearing behind the cathedral."

chapters.title: Chapter 281: "Tower" Guess
chapters.content:
Chapter 281 - "Tower" Guess
Milk cows? In other words, Ma'am, you're Miss Judi's mother? You look very young... Hmm, the age of a High-Sequence Beyonder cannot be judged by their appearance...
I remember that Judi had indirectly revealed that her mother was a demigod of the Spectator pathway...
Therefore, it was impossible for her to be a priest or bishop who was permanently stationed at Enmat Harbor. She had been sent here at the last minute!
Yes, Dunn's problem is the side effects of the mental sutures. And regarding this treatment, Spectator is indeed more suitable... With the help of a Doctor from the Planter pathway, he should be able to resolve Dunn's mental confusion after some treatment.
However, I once "guessed" that Miss Judi's mother was the "Sloth" of the Psychology Alchemists, but she was still sent by Earth Mother to carry out this relatively confidential mission... Then, either my previous "guess" was wrong, or she was very trusted by Earth Mother. Perhaps joining the Psychology Alchemists was tacitly permitted by Earth Mother.
This wasn't strange either. Thinking back to how Miss Justice would so easily become Pride in the future, it wasn't unacceptable that the Psychology Alchemists would have any snitches other than the president.
As his thoughts raced, he replied with a smile, "Thank you for your help, Miss Priest... I'll get someone to bring the cows away as soon as possible."
He didn't know how to address her. With Dunn present, it wasn't convenient for them to interact much... While stumped, he suddenly recalled how Sloth had addressed herself as Miss Sloth in the Psychology Alchemists. He guessed that she might like to address him as "young," so he called her "Miss Priest."
Indeed, the woman with long brown hair revealed a lazy smile when she heard that. The dimples at the corners of her mouth appeared as she nodded. "You're welcome... Heh heh, this lad sure knows how to talk."
Dunn was puzzled when he heard them say something about "milk cows." He thought it was a code or a riddle, but since he was new here, he didn't think too much about it. It was only when he followed the two priests to the dormitory and saw a milk cow in the clearing behind the church...
After handing Dunn over to the white-haired Priest Norris and Miss Judi's mother, he bade them farewell and left.
There was less than an hour until the Tarot Gathering, so he had to make some preparations.
Speaking of which, Priest Noris was a resident of the Rich Church, a Sequence 7 Harvest Priest.
...
Backlund, Cherwood Borough, in the gardened villa at 28 Kingst Street.
Xio Derecha had already visited at noon. Her makeup and clothes were all in Ebner's study. Even if she wasn't there, she had no choice but to come.
The Skades were already familiar with Miss Xio, and Detective Bryan had given special instructions before he left. Therefore, they didn't treat her as a guest at all and allowed her to enter Ebner's study.
After spending an hour getting dressed, Xio looked at herself in the full-length mirror, hoping to remember this image.
Perhaps in one or two more times, even if I don't deliberately dress up to deepen my impression, I'll be able to conjure this image in Mr. Fool's kingdom...
Just as she thought of this, she saw the familiar, illusory crimson light surge out like a tidal wave, drowning her.
...
In the Forsaken Land of the Gods, in an area outside the City of Silver, in a half-collapsed black-gray tower.
Derrick moved to the edge of the fire, leaned against the broken wall, and faced his companions. He pretended to be asleep, waiting for Mr. Fool to summon him into the gray fog.
Ever since he discovered that the members of the six-member council and Elder Lovia were unable to discover the existence of Mr. Fool, he gradually believed that as long as he didn't carelessly expose any problems, he could secretly attend the Tarot Gathering above the gray fog even under the gaze of others.
...
Empress Borough, Earl Hall's mansion.
Audrey sat in her bedroom and let Susie guard the door while she thought with sparkling eyes, Two weeks have passed. Mr. Hanged Man must've prepared the pituitary gland of an adult Rainbow Salamander... I'm about to advance to Sequence 8!
To her, this was more exciting and worth looking forward to than the thirty thousand pound bounty and the large plantation worth at least 8,000 pounds!
...
On the ghost ship of the Blue Avenger, Alger, who had taken the initiative to leave the capital, Backlund, and return to the sea, felt the summoning of The Fool. The face of Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos suddenly surfaced in his mind—flesh and blood rapidly decaying as pieces of his face peeled off.
Alger lowered his head in awe, allowing the crimson tide to engulf him.
...
And at that moment, Klein, who was sitting in the palace that looked like a giant's residence above the gray fog, was wondering for the last time what kind of tone and posture he should use to prevent The Fool from being suspicious of the loss of the Morning Star of Depravity.
I can think of a few words and tone to respond... Goddess bless me. I hope Mr. Tower will respond according to my script... As Klein secretly prayed, he secretly drew a crimson moon.
At this moment, the five members of the Tarot Club had already appeared on both sides of the ancient table.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~"
After Miss Justice greeted The Fool who had led everyone to the seat of honor with a cheerful voice, Klein activated his Spirit Vision and observed Justice, The Hanged Man, The Tower, The Sun, and Judgment to confirm their present state.
The others didn't experience many changes. Only the surface layer of the Astral Projection deep in Mr. Tower's Ether Body changed again. The unified color was much purer. This meant that he had indeed advanced to Sequence 6.
Klein thought for a moment and took the initiative to say with a chuckle, "Congratulations on taking another step forward in the path of being a Beyonder, Mr. Tower."
"I can't do without your help and protection," Ebner replied humbly.
It was also the truth. Without the Tarot Club's logistics platform, it was impossible for him to gather all the materials needed for a Polymath so quickly.
Mr. Tower's Sequence has increased? What Sequence was he? 6 or 5? Hmm... Mr. Fool only said that he "advanced a step" and didn't congratulate him on becoming a demigod... This means that he wasn't originally a Sequence 5...
While Audrey looked at Mr. Tower enviously, she imagined what she would look like after becoming a Mid-Sequence Beyonder.
The Hanged Man also had the same misjudgment as Justice regarding Tower's strength. Therefore, he had determined that he had become a Sequence 5 with powerful combat strength that was comparable to a pirate admiral.
The Sun, on the other hand, had feelings of envy and yearning. He believed that by relying on the Tarot Club, he would one day become a powerhouse like Mr. Tower, the true Sun of the City of Silver.
Miss Judgment Xio wasn't surprised at all. She had already learned of the news during the transfer of information from Ebner's advancement. Therefore, the slightly agitated her had been actively completing the interrogation missions issued by MI9 over the past week. This resulted in the military prison having a terrifying legend of "invisible horror."
At this moment, The Hanged Man snapped back to his senses. He stood up, faced Mr. Fool, and said with abnormal respect,
"Mr. Fool, I received nineteen pages of Roselle's diary this time.
"Here, I have to thank you for sending your Blessed to help me get rid of Qilangos. These diary pages are my reward!"
19 pages? Not bad... Klein didn't talk about the Blessed as he said with a smile,
"This is the principle of equivalent exchange.
As expected of Mr. Fool... A pirate admiral with a mystical item isn't someone "He" takes to heart at all... It seems like there's no need for me to mention the bounty... I wonder how many High-Sequence Blessed Mr. Fool has... Audrey sighed wistfully.
Upon hearing The Fool's reply, Alger said humbly,
"The limit of my current memory is six pages. Please allow me to give them to you a few times."
"No problem." Klein, who was enveloped by the thick gray fog, nodded slightly.
At this moment, Ebner was conjuring the diary pages as he said apologetically, "I also obtained three diary pages this time... Well, I still owe you four pages. I can only wait for the next one... I hope you can forgive me..."
I hope you can understand that I lost your Fallen Morning Star... It's a pity that I can't say it out loud; otherwise, Mr. Fool's "awesomeness" would be completely over.
After lampooning inwardly, Klein wasn't in a hurry to flip through the nine pages of the diary. Instead, he rapped the edge of the long table and looked at Ebner. "There are already preliminary results from the investigation of the Fallen Morning Star... Do you want to share it with them, or do you want to hear it alone?"
Please choose to communicate privately... The more people who know what I'm saying, the easier it is for me to be exposed...
Although he was nervous, Klein still leaned back leisurely after asking the question, as though he didn't care about the answer.
When Ebner heard that, he was taken aback. He looked deeply at The Fool and suddenly had various guesses.
Giving me a choice might seem like a casual question, but it's not in line with Klein's habits... By asking this question, it's as if he wishes for me to choose to communicate privately...
Could it be that the secrets involving the Fallen Morning Star aren't suitable for others to know? That's not right. If that's the case, Mr. Fool would definitely say it out loud...
Or could it be that in this "secret," there's information that can be "sold for money," so Klein plans on hiding it from the others? That's not right. That way, wouldn't I be able to guess the nature of the poor god who lacks money... With Klein's caution, he wouldn't do that.
Hmm... Then, there's another possibility... Did something happen to the Fallen Morning Star itself...? Did he have to come up with some sophistry to fool me?

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Private Communication
chapters.content:
Chapter 282 - Private Communication
But regardless, it's best not to ruin Mr. Fool's reputation... He might be very nervous right now...
As his thoughts raced, he quickly made a decision and solemnly said, "I choose to communicate privately."
Phew... Klein heaved a sigh of relief. He nodded slightly and said in a normal tone, "Sure."
I really want to hear it...
Audrey, who had once heard the description of the powers of a Fallen Morning Star and was rather curious about the item, pursed her lips under the gray fog's cover, as though she wanted to pay for the right to listen in.
However, she then recalled that Mr. Tower wasn't a person who was stingy with knowledge. As a deity, Mr. Fool obviously didn't need gold pounds. The reason why they chose to communicate privately might very well be because the source of the Fallen Morning Star involves knowledge that we shouldn't know yet.
Endure it, Audrey! You have to work hard to advance to Mr. Tower's level. That way, you'll have the right to know more secrets! Audrey blinked and reluctantly retracted her gaze from the Seat of Honor.
Alger had similar guesses, but he wasn't too curious about the Fallen Morning Star, so he didn't feel much regret.
As for The Sun and Judgment... The former was muddle-headed and felt that he knew too little about the world where Mr. Tower was. Even if he shared it with her, he probably wouldn't be able to understand it. As for the latter, he was already used to it. There were too many things that he usually hid from her, so he wasn't short of one more thing...
At this moment, Klein rapped the table, isolating Justice, Judgment, The Sun, and The Hanged Man from hearing or seeing anything.
Following that, he looked at "Tower," deliberated over his tone, and said in a tone as emotionless as he could, "Firstly, regrettably, my Blessed, who accepted your request, suffered an attack from a Grade 0 seal while pursuing the Fallen Morning Star. He unfortunately perished, and your Fallen Morning Star was lost as a result."
He first brought out the worst possible outcome, letting "Tower" lower his expectations. At the same time, he emphasized the existence of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, highlighting the danger of the matter.
In short, it was to strengthen a concept: It wasn't that the Blessed of The Fool couldn't do it, but that the enemy was too powerful.
Grade 0 Sealed Artifact? The fall of a Blessed? Don't tell me that you used the "Fallen Morning Star" in the Blackthorn Security Company's "Evil God's Fallen War"...And after your death, it was picked up by Ince Zangwill or the Church of Evernight?
It's no wonder you wished to communicate privately... If The Hanged Man and the others were to know that your Blessed could also be "killed," and that the murderer is still out at sea... I'm afraid The Fool's authority would be greatly reduced...
Yes, only I, who seems to know the true meaning of The Fool, can still maintain my fear and reverence.
As Ebner thought, he tried hard to control his emotions to prevent Klein from detecting his inner lampooning.
At that moment, Mr. Fool was staring intently at the emotional colors of "Tower." Although his thoughts were active, he didn't see any additional changes in anger, fear, or surprise. After sighing silently at how well he disguised himself, he said in an unchanging tone, "However, before my Blessed perished, he obtained a portion of information regarding the Fallen Morning Star...
"First, its ingredients originate from a demigod-level ancient dragon from the Reader pathway. The one who killed it was a mind dragon named Ariehogg."
After a few weeks of tutoring, Klein had mastered a portion of the method of reading and writing Dragonese. Therefore, he had a new understanding of the scene in the dream divination. He was almost certain that the term "Ariehogg" was shouted by the ancient dragon before its death was the name of the murderer who killed it.
As Dragonese was also a language with "power," that cry could actually be considered a "curse," a curse that could let its kinsmen know of its murderer.
"Ariehogg? One of the three remaining ancient dragons, Ariehogg?" Ebner asked, half surprised, half deliberate.
At the same time, he quickly did some calculations.
Ariehogg took away the material and forged the Fallen Morning Star? No, with the aesthetics of the dragons, they shouldn't be able to create such an Intis-styled lady's necklace... Yes, it doesn't matter who "He" got to create it. In short, since it appeared in Leena's hands and was obtained by me, it's likely that this ancient dragon was behind it.
Yes, previously, because Xio had encountered an ancient dragon in East Chester County's Hartlarkh Village and had helped it deliver something to a High-Sequence Beyonder of the Tamara family, I had once guessed that the Dragon King, Ankewelt, had already awoken on Ariehogg's body...
And I also used the Fallen Morning Star to ask at the Harvest Church. The answer I received was that there was no layout of the deities...
Yes, even if the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt were to awaken, "He" would only be a Sequence 2 Discerner... And if "He" was unwilling to accept this, "He" would definitely try to advance...
Therefore... "His" target was 0-08!
Although he didn't know how "He" awakened or what connection "He" had with 0-08, the Fallen Morning Star was clearly the key to strengthening this connection!
Yes, when I was reading the Tingen Beyonder information collected by Bishop Utravsky, I had previously seen information about Leena... Heh heh, "His" original plan was to bring the Fallen Morning Star to Tingen through Leena and clash with Ince before indirectly meeting up with 0-08, right?
From the looks of it, apart from the members of the Psychology Alchemists, there was likely someone else who helped Leina escape the Demoness of Affliction's control.
However, Leina was influenced by some existence to give me the Fallen Morning Star... And because I was worried, I "sacrificed" it to Klein and got him to divine for me to take a look...
With just one hand from Sefirah Castle, the Fallen Morning Star was still in Ince's hands, but the entire process was "concealed." The original wielder was also dead. Unless one constantly paid attention to Ince, perhaps no one knew that the Fallen Morning Star had come into contact with 0-08...
Even if they knew, they would only think that he had obtained this item by chance and not "arranged" by someone...
The existence who interfered was the real deal! He made "arrangements" using someone else's "arrangement."
Ebner sighed inwardly. He had roughly guessed who had secretly "arranged" them. The only ones who had such abilities and vaguely knew of his secret were Lilith and the Two-Five Dragon! And the former didn't seem to be good at such means, so the Two-Five Dragon... No, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was the most suspicious.
On the other side, Klein ruminated over Ebner's words. One of the three remaining ancient dragons? Mr. Tower does know a lot... But who are the other two?
Of course, it wasn't the time to ask. It wasn't suitable for him to ask about The Fool's identity. Therefore, he only paused for a moment before continuing, "In addition, my Blessed also found out that the Morning Star necklace was personally made by Roselle."
He didn't mention the figure he couldn't "see" in the dream divination. After all, that was only his guess of the contents of the scene. Perhaps Roselle was just talking to himself?
Roselle personally forged it... Ebner was first taken aback as he immediately had a new guess and question.
Someone had actually set up a trap more than a hundred years ago? There was a high chance that Ankewelt hadn't woken up back then. Then, who could it be? Was it Hermes who had been constantly investigating Ankewelt's whereabouts?
Yes, it's very possible. Similarly, as a member of the unspeakable organization, "He" is very familiar with Roselle. It's not strange to commission a Beyonder item...
But what about "His" motives? Could it be that "He" was just trying to find trouble with Amon's brother?
Just as Ebner was filled with puzzlement, Klein looked at him with a staid expression, but in fact, he was a little perturbed. He thought, This way of saying things should be acceptable to Mr. Tower, right? Most people would probably pay attention to the information they received before their Blessed died as a result. As for the trivial matter of losing the item, they wouldn't delve into it, right?
He pondered for a moment before saying slowly,
"I've already sent other Blessed to investigate this matter.
"I believe they will find your Beyonder items...
"Of course, this might take some time."
Klein wasn't spouting nonsense. He had already made up his mind to seek revenge on Ince Zangwill.
Upon hearing this, the clueless Ebner snapped back to his senses. He roughly guessed Mr. Fool's thoughts and knew that he was probably feeling guilty for losing his things. Hence, he deliberated and said, "Mr. Fool, your Blessed perished because of me... I'm deeply sorry for that."
In fact, he didn't pay much attention to the Fallen Morning Star, even if its powers were very useful.
"It's just an equivalent exchange. Since he took your reward, he naturally has to complete your request. It's his own fault for dying... He didn't pay enough attention to the relevant information, and he wasn't prepared enough."
Mr. Fool said indifferently, but he didn't realize it himself. Towards the end, he felt a little self-deprecating.
"Thank you once again for your generosity," Ebner said "sincerely."
The strategy of emphasizing the death of his Blessed was indeed correct. The "tower" was more worried than concerned about the lost item...
Klein nodded slightly and rapped the long bronze table once again to announce the end of the private exchange.
Then, he picked up the conjured Roselle diary, looked down, and read the contents of the first page.

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Klein’s Scheme
chapters.content:
Chapter 283 - Klein's Scheme
"16th December. I contacted the pathetic fellow who was trapped in the storm and lost in the darkness.
He called himself Mr. Door... He wanted me to help him return to the real world... He promised to satisfy three of my requests...
"...Some of the history of the Fourth Epoch that he described is really interesting."
Mr. Door... This naming style is very similar to mine... I wonder what the real name of this pathetic fellow who's lost and trapped in the darkness amidst the storm is. What's his Sequence...
After secretly laughing in a self-deprecating manner, Klein seriously read the rest of the content. After all, as a history student, he was also very interested in the Fourth Epoch.
The so-called War of the Four Emperors is Solomon's Black Emperor, the half-crazy Blood Emperor of the Tudor Dynasty, the Night Emperor of the Trunsoest Empire, and the Emperor of the Underworld of the Southern Continent, also known as Death's War?
If this is true, it will really overturn most of the current research on the Fourth Epoch in the history world!
The Emperor of the Underworld reaped the greatest benefits during the War of the Four Emperors? Does this mean that "He" used these benefits to advance to Death? Yes, but "He" went mad...
Even a deity can go mad. How terrifying. Just thinking about the details makes me tremble from the bottom of my heart! It's no wonder the knowledgeable Emperor Roselle would use horror to describe this matter...
Could it be that the so-called evil gods are the crazy orthodox gods? Then, would there be a day when only the evil gods are left in the world... Man, does this mean that an irreversible apocalypse is coming?
That's a lot of information!
Klein couldn't help but sigh inwardly... At the same time, he raised his evaluation of the Black Emperor, Blood Emperor, and Night Emperor, believing that they were top experts close to the deities.
Perhaps the names such as Black Emperor and Blood Emperor are the corresponding pathway's potion names? Sequence 1? Hmm, in that case, having the Black Emperor live for centuries or even millennia isn't something unacceptable. I always imagined that the Black Emperor was the common title of every emperor of the Solomon Empire... Heh heh, from the looks of it, perhaps no one has changed... The Fourth Epoch really lives up to its name of the Epoch of the Gods!
With this in mind, Klein picked up the second page. The contents of this page were connected to the first page, still talking to Emperor Roselle and Mr. Door.
And here, Mr. Door mentioned two laws, which were the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility and the Law of Similar Sequence Beyonder Characteristics Conservation. The total number of Beyonder characteristics was fixed at the source without any increase or decrease.
The Law of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility and the Law of Similar Sequence Beyonder Characteristics Conservation? Yes, Mr. Tower once mentioned the former at the Tarot Club, and the latter is even more interesting... The so-called Similar Sequence pathway? Is it one of the pathways in the category that Mr. Tower concluded last time?
For example, the "omnipotent and omniscient five pathways," and "knowledge two pathways," as well as Roselle's example of how the three Dark battles can be interchanged...
Similar Sequences not only have conservation of total characteristics but they can also be interchanged... This further verifies the accuracy of the pathway's scope that Mr. Tower concluded.
There must be a huge secret behind this!
Many thoughts flashed through Klein's mind as he felt that he had delved deeper into the realm of mysticism in the Beyonder world.
He quickly flipped through the last four pages and was disappointed when he realized that it was no longer related to Mr. Door.
His Clown powers allowed him to conceal his emotions very well. With the gray fog's obstruction, even Miss Justice Audrey, who was secretly observing him, didn't notice anything amiss.
Reining in his chaotic thoughts, Klein read the third diary page.
This page was filled with Roselle's grumblings. He grumbled about how the Savant pathway lacked combat-related Beyonder powers from Sequence 9 to Sequence 6 and could only create and use items. He grumbled about how the modern name of Sequence 5 was Astronomer, and how a second-grader could become an all-rounded mad scientist.
At the same time, he enviously thought of another relatively complete pathway of the Church of Craftsmanship—the Warlock and Scroll Professor of the Mystery Pryer pathway. He only despised the existence of the Hidden Sage.
The Emperor sure has a strange talent for being funny... Upon seeing this, the recently depressed Klein couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth. He wanted to light a candle for this senior.
But in the end, he only sighed, turned to the third page of the diary, and continued his search.
The last three pages were filled with a straightforward account of the famous incident in Intis in 1173. At the last Tarot Gathering, Klein had already felt a similar atmosphere in the diary of Roselle's establishment of the Black Suits, as well as the discovery that the culprit behind the matter was a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Sauron family. Therefore, he didn't have much to reflect on.
However, the last part of the diary wrote:
"...The Secret Order's Zaratul secretly visited me very suddenly."
"...I have to send someone to investigate the Secret Order and grasp more information. I can't repeat my passiveness from before. I can't let Zaratul lead me by the nose again." Then, he came to an abrupt halt.
This made Klein have no choice but to feel an uncontrollable sense of frustration... as well as anger towards the Chapters he had lost.
So, did you find anything, Comrade Roselle? Klein couldn't find the rest of the information, so he could only force himself to calm down and wait for the next gathering when The Hanged Man would hand over the other six pages.
Taking a deep breath, Klein composed himself and picked up the three pages from the "Tower."
He didn't have much hope. After all, although the frequency at which the diary pages were handed in was very high, the quality was fluctuating. He was always in a state of mind... even though he knew that this was normal...
However, to Klein's surprise, the three pages that "Tower" handed in were continuous, and they almost told a complete story!
Yes, this is the emperor's expedition in Loen... Heh heh, Backlund's air was actually very good back then? It's really ironic compared to now!
So it turns out that the Church of Evernight placed great importance on hygiene before Roselle... That's not surprising. The Goddess likes moon flowers, night vanilla, and slumber flowers so much. She must be a deity who has a high requirement for her living environment.
The spread of railways should actually be a result of Loen's terrible road conditions? That's ridiculous...
Even the concept of distance can be "Disordered"... Which pathway's power is this?
I have a nagging feeling that the Emperor's expedition was arranged by someone...
Klein lampooned as he read, but he turned serious at the end.
He suddenly recalled a piece of evidence that the descendant of Death had given him after he passed on the information to Mr. Azik. "Before the 'secret mission' mentioned in the information, that little kid, Kilgor, had once explored another ruin with a member of the Augustus family named Grue..."
Hence, Klein couldn't help but have a guess. Could that treasure be a high-level item from the Solomon Empire which the Loen royal family was conspiring to obtain?
In the end, it was still obtained by Roselle? That's why the Kilgor family's stable aristocratic title was stripped away because of some mistakes?
And the diary just mentioned that the Emperor of the Solomon Empire had always been the Black Emperor...
Could it be that Mr. Tower wasn't wrong? Roselle had really jumped into this pathway?
This... This doesn't seem to be a neighboring building, right? Has he gone mad? Half mad? Is this the truth behind his assassination in the White Maple Palace?
Closing his eyes, Klein stopped his thoughts from wandering. He swept his gaze across the Tarot Club members, and his gaze finally landed on the "Tower." He then recalled the diary he had just read, and an idea gradually came to him.
Therefore, he rapped the edge of the ancient bronze table and said with a deep and calm smile,
"Roselle mentioned some hidden history in his diary and mentioned some simple general knowledge. The latter reminded me of something I never told you."
Audrey's mind suddenly turned adrift as she turned her body and looked at the seat of honor at the ancient table in pleasant surprise.
Mr. Fool took the initiative to mention the contents of Roselle's diary again? What would it record? Would he be teaching Roselle some words this time? She was so excited that she completely forgot that she was a Spectator.
Compared to her, Alger was much more composed, but his subconscious straightening of his back ruthlessly betrayed him.
Derrick didn't know who Emperor Roselle was, nor did he know what this name represented in the Northern Continent. Therefore, he couldn't hide his curiosity and didn't show any abnormalities.
As for Judgment Xio, she tried her best to maintain her persona as a noble lady. She looked more like a Spectator than Audrey. It was impossible to tell that she had the fierce title of "invisible horror."
Only Ebner was relatively calm. He guessed what Mr. Fool was planning to share. However, he was also a little puzzled. This was because he had already thrown out the concept of "pathway's scope." Even if Klein still mentioned the concept of a neighboring Sequence, it was impossible for him to attract Justice and The Hanged Man to "bid" to hear the subsequent knowledge.
After all, as long as it wasn't a curly-haired baboon, they would definitely be able to figure out the meaning of a neighboring Sequence from its scope...
Wait, could Klein be after me?
Was he trying to start a conversation so that he could sit back and wait for Miss Justice or The Sun to ask questions about my Sequence knowledge for free?
If that's the case, should I cooperate or not?

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Switching Pathways
chapters.content:
Chapter 284 - Switching Pathways
While Ebner was still in thought, Audrey couldn't help but ask, "Mr. Fool, what general knowledge did Emperor Roselle mention? I can pay for this information."
However, I want a private exchange! she added inwardly.
Klein chuckled and said,
"There's no need. This is simply general knowledge."
"After reading this part of the diary, as the organizer of the Tarot Club, I believe it's necessary for all of you to know this. Of course, I know very well that some of you already know this."
He was mainly referring to Tower and The Sun. The former had always been trying his best to show his "knowledgeable" side, as though there was nothing he didn't know... As for the latter, the City of Silver had two to three thousand years of history, so it was impossible for them not to discover the law of Beyonder characteristics.
Of course, with Miss Judgment's relationship with Mr. Tower, it was very likely that she had long grasped it.
Unfortunately, my Blessed also needs to show off... I can't ruin Mr. Azik's image as a powerhouse just because of some money... Especially when one of my Blesseds died because of the 300-pound investigation fee... Klein sighed silently.
"Thank you very much! Mr. Fool, you are just too generous!" Audrey replied in delight.
She felt three seconds of regret for her wish to use money to buy information.
Klein stopped tapping his fingers and said in an unperturbed tone,
"Mr. Tower had previously shared the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility. I believe you already have a basic understanding of Beyonder characteristics... And just after I finished reading Roselle's diary, I recalled that it actually has a second law, known as the Law of Similar Sequence Beyonder Characteristics Conservation."
Law of Beyonder Characteristics Conservation... The Hanged Man slightly changed his sitting posture, feeling that he understood something, but he was unable to fully understand what this law represented or what it contained.
The feelings of Justice and The Sun were similar to his, and they were unable to understand the true meaning of this law.
Judgment glanced at Tower because she had been briefed on the relevant knowledge by Ebner before they went to Damir together. She had always felt that the knowledge had little to do with her, but now that she had heard Mr. Fool mention it, she realized that this law might be very important.
As expected, Ebner thought to himself. He had roughly guessed how Mr. Fool was going to "do it," and he planned on using his limited cooperation to verify his theory.
"What's a Similar Sequence?" Alger couldn't help but ask.
However, just as he asked the question, he suddenly recalled the concept of "categories" mentioned by Mr. Tower when he explained "omnipotent and omniscient."
The same Sequence within the same "category" might very well be the "Similar Sequence" as The Fool spoke of!
With this in mind, Alger was just about to add on and ask Mr. Fool if his idea was correct when he heard the suspected deity at the very end chuckle.
"The so-called Similar Sequence refers to High-Sequence pathways that can be interchanged.
"Let me give an example. The Death pathway's Sequence 5 Gatekeeper can not only be advanced normally, but they can also choose the Warrior pathway, which is Sequence 4 Demon Hunter of the God of Combat pathway.
"This won't bring about the risk of losing control, nor will it accumulate madness. It's not the same as consuming the wrong potion.
"Of course, if it's not a similar Sequence, being half-crazy is the best outcome."
Klein's answer didn't use the concept mentioned by the "Tower." Firstly, as a very powerful and mysterious existence, it wasn't appropriate to use the concepts concluded by the members of his own gathering. Secondly, the "scope" mentioned by the "Tower" was only derived after all. Although there was plenty of evidence to support it, it might still be inaccurate... As for the interchangeability of the three pathways—Corpse Collector, Sleepless, and Warrior—Roselle, he had verified it.
On this point, Klein trusted his fellow countryman more.
So that's how it is... This information is just too valuable! As expected of Mr. Fool. The so-called simple general knowledge is enough to shock most Low- and Mid-Sequence Beyonders and benefit them greatly!
As Alger muttered silently to himself, he felt wistful.
So Sequences can be interchanged... Ebner didn't tell me... Does he think that there's no need for me to switch Sequences? Xio thought.
The Sun suddenly recalled something unbelievable that the former Chief had done—he had built a mausoleum for himself, went deep into the underground mausoleum, and then moved inside to make it his home.
Back then, everyone thought that he had gone mad and ended his own life... But combined with The Fool's description, he might very well be attempting to advance to another pathway...
Audrey was delighted that the information could be exchanged via Sequence. It wasn't that she wasn't satisfied with her Spectator pathway, but that she had a chance to choose again in the future. It was just like selecting something of interest at Philip's Department Store. It was a wonderful experience!
Amidst her excitement, Miss Justice asked in a reserved manner,
"Mr. Fool, I would like to ask if the Spectator pathway can be interchanged with the pathway in the 'omnipotent and omniscient' mentioned by Mr. Tower. In addition, apart from what you mentioned, what other pathways in the 'spectator' pathway can be interchanged?"
As expected of the Tarot Club's best fall-guy. Well asked! I'd like to know too! Klein was already prepared for Miss Justice's question. He turned to look at the "Tower" and chuckled. "Since the concept of 'scope' was summarized by the 'tower,' you have to ask him about it."
Mr. Fool is unwilling to answer directly... Does "He" think that Mr. Tower's concept of "scope" isn't accurate enough? Hmm... That might very well be the case. No matter Mr. Tower's knowledge, he's still only a Mid-Sequence Beyonder. It's possible that his conclusion regarding high-level knowledge isn't accurate enough...
But compared to me, even if it's not accurate enough, it's precious enough!
Miss Justice's heart stirred when she heard that as she immediately had a guess. She looked at the "Tower" diagonally across her and deliberated over her words before asking, "Mr. Tower, I can pay for the answer to this question. How much do you think it's better to have gold pounds?"
Alger had similar guesses. He had originally attempted to ask similar questions, but since Miss Justice had asked first, he shut his mouth. Furthermore, he was certain that the "tower" wouldn't charge him anything.
Mr. Fool has already shared his knowledge for free, so how can the "Tower" that labels himself as Mr. Fool's Blessed be charged? Does he think that the knowledge he gives is more important than what Mr. Fool gives?
On the other side, although he had already expected this situation, he still secretly sighed.
However, on the surface, he smiled and shook his head. "There's no need for that. I'm actually very happy to share my research results..."
Of course, it's only limited to the results of reading novels...
"Mr. Tower, you really are a knowledgeable and generous gentleman," Audrey praised with a brisk tone.
Upon hearing their conversation, Xio glanced at Ebner across the long table. She maintained her elegant seating posture and thought, Ebner, is indeed very easy to talk to at the Tarot Club. He usually tells me some secrets and knowledge, but he doesn't seem to be that happy. He has to think about what he can and cannot say.
"You flatter me, Miss Justice." Ebner first said politely before organizing his words and answering Justice's previous question,
"Your guess isn't wrong. A Spectator can indeed be interchanged with High-Sequence Beyonders like the Secrets Suppliant, Sailor, Bard, and Reader pathway. Furthermore, after switching paths, the original characteristic won't disappear. It can even mutate into new powers.
"As for what other 'categories' there are... I've summarized a few groups that might not be completely accurate...
Yes, apart from the two categories of omnipotence and knowledge itself, there are also categories of bizarreness, calamity, darkness, and order.
He deliberately didn't list down all the neighboring pathways, only mentioning a few common groups.
"The 'darkness' is likely referring to the three pathways of Sleepless, Corpse Collector, and Warrior that Mr. Fool previously mentioned, right? I can understand the Sleepless and Corpse Collector pathways, but what does the Warrior pathway have to do with the 'darkness?'" Alger interrupted.
"The Warrior's Sequence 6 is known as Dawn Paladin. It can use the powers of Dawn. Dawn is the power of dawn to break the light of darkness. And at the top of this pathway, it's said that one can grasp the powers of Twilight," Ebner explained with a smile, but he didn't go into detail.
So that's how it is. Dawn and dusk are almost nighttime... Alger nodded in thought.
Derrick thought further when he heard that. The City of Silver was in the darkness, and all the Chiefs were Beyonders of the Warrior pathway. Was there a deeper reason for this...
At this moment, Judgment also asked in a rather polite manner, "Mr. Tower, is the law of order referring to the two pathways of the Arbiter and Lawyer pathway?"
Upon hearing Xio suddenly speak to him in such a manner, Ebner was still a little unused to it. He nearly failed to react, but he immediately understood that Xio was "acting" her persona. Hence, he answered cooperatively, "Miss Judgment, your judgment was right. I think so too."
At this point, he paused and explained the two pathways of Calamity—Assassin, and Hunter.
"An Assassin and a Hunter can be interchanged? I remember that a Demoness can make a person become a woman... Then, what about a Hunter?" After hearing Tower's explanation, Audrey recalled her baffling excitement when she learned of the uniqueness of the Demoness pathway. She asked with piqued interest.
"Similar situations happened... The Beyonders of the Hunter pathway will become men at Sequence 4 Iron-blooded Knight!" Ebner thought for a moment before adding, "This is also the only pathway for a woman to become a man."
Indeed, there is a pathway for women to become men. Furthermore, it's in the ones I predicted... Hunter represents war, and it really is in the category of calamities. After all, a military disaster is also a type of calamity... It will cause women to change genders at Sequence 4... That's not right. The Demoness pathway is at Sequence 7 Witch, but it doesn't strictly correspond... The more Klein thought about it, the more he felt twisted and crazy. This was brought about by extreme asymmetry.
Could it be that the underlying logic of this world is chaos, distortion, madness, and asymmetry? He tried his best not to frown.
However, he quickly thought about another layer of meaning behind Tower's words. Hunter is the only way for a woman to transform into a man... Could it be that the pathway for a man to transform into a woman isn't the only one? Is there another way apart from the pit known as Assassin? Could it really be Seer?
Klein suddenly felt that the world was filled with malice. Compared to chaos, distortion, and madness, it made him feel even more uncomfortable.
"Finally, there are three pathways in the realm of bizarreness—Marauder, Apprentice, and Seer.
"The reason why it's called 'bizarreness' is that the Beyonder methods of these three pathways are very bizarre. It often causes people to fall for them without realizing it."
At this point, Ebner added inwardly, Actually, I'd prefer to call them the three pathways of "theft fraud," "opening and unlocking," and "intimidation of the mind!"
But Mr. Fool is sitting at the seat of honor, so forget it...

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Clown and Nightmare
chapters.content:
Chapter 285 - Clown and Nightmare
Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder can indeed be interchanged... Furthermore, these three pathways might very well be related to the space above the gray fog...
Upon hearing Tower's explanation, Klein nodded without batting an eyelid, but he then lampooned inwardly,
What do you mean by "strange" means? Aren't the methods of Mutants and Devils more "strange"? Why don't you just add that to the scope!
This reason is way too far-fetched, isn't it? He's afraid that no one will notice that he's being perfunctory!
Despite his lampooning, Klein seriously analyzed the motives behind his actions.
Why would the knowledgeable "Tower" be so perfunctory? Wait, could it be because of... me?
Yes, I'm The Fool. According to what Tower said, I'm at the top of the Seer pathway. He's afraid of me, so he doesn't dare to explain in detail!
Mr. Tower, I actually don't mind. Please speak more.
Alger also sensed that Tower was being perfunctory, but he came to the same conclusion before The Fool himself.
As he secretly sneered, he wanted to infer the possible connections, but on careful thought, he suddenly realized that his understanding of these three pathways was very superficial. He only had a general understanding of the powers of Sequence 9 and 8. He knew nothing more...
There seem to be very few Beyonders of these three pathways... According to Mr. Fool's explanation of the Law of Similar Sequence Conservation of Beyonder Characteristics... Does this mean that there are a lot of High-Sequence Beyonders in these three pathways and that they're very concentrated? Therefore, there are very few Low- and Mid-Sequence Beyonders?
Just as Alger was letting his thoughts wander, Miss Justice had roughly digested what Ebner had said. She nodded in a reserved and elegant manner. "Thank you for your explanation, Mr. Tower."
She didn't know much about most Beyonder pathways, so although she felt that Mr. Tower's description of "bizarreness" was too simple, it wasn't as deep as what Klein and Alger knew...
Furthermore, she only wanted to know the conclusion. As for why, there was no need for her to probe deeper.
Ebner nodded in return and said with a smile, "You're welcome, Miss Justice."
In fact, Klein was overthinking things. The reason why he was so perfunctory was solely because he didn't know how to explain it.
Could it be that these three pathways are pathways split from the Lord of the Mysteries, Space-Time Beacon, Embodiment of Sefirah Castle, Dominator of the Spirit World?
Or should I talk about the differences between Worms of Time, Worms of Spirit, and Worms of Star?
Or should I really mention the three pathways of "theft fraud," "slipping through doors to lockpick," and "detention center" in front of Klein?
It was obviously very inappropriate for such information to be leaked out early.
After a few seconds of silence, Audrey turned her head to look at Mr. Fool. Seeing that this mysterious powerhouse had no intention of adding anything, as though he was tacitly agreeing that there was nothing wrong with the knowledge mentioned by Mr. Tower, she looked at Alger with utmost anticipation.
"Mr. Hanged Man, my information allowed you to finish Vice Admiral Hurricane. Have you prepared the complete pituitary gland of an adult Rainbow Salamander?"
That's one of the reasons why I returned to the sea... Alger nodded gently and said,
"I've already obtained the Beyonder ingredient you wanted.
"After the gathering ends, I'll 'sacrifice' it to Mr. Fool."
"Alright," Audrey replied briskly.
After asking about the ingredients, Miss Justice asked Mr. Fool about the two Tarot Club "candidates" she had previously recommended in a good mood.
I didn't receive their prayers... Could it be that I didn't receive them because of The Fool's honorific name that I recited during the days of my "death"? But then, there should be a "message", right...
Klein secretly diverted his attention to search the surrounding crimson stars. After confirming that there were no "prayer" messages, he leaned back in relief and pretended to be calm. "The person you recommended didn't recite my name."
Ah... Xio and Fors didn't fall under my "guidance" or "arrangement"?
Audrey was stunned when she heard that, but she immediately felt frustrated. She felt that she had been too naive in the past.
Judgment Xio silently watched this scene. It took her a great deal of effort to maintain her posture as a noble lady without laughing out loud...
Then, she took a deep breath and couldn't help but think.
Should I find a chance to report this misunderstanding to Mr. Fool? Although with "His" godlike observational skills, he probably already knows that I'm one of the people Miss Justice recommended... However, taking the initiative to report is an attitude problem. I can't let Mr. Fool believe that I'm deliberately "fooling" Miss Audrey.
Following that, the group conversed for a while before the gathering came to an end. The Sun, The Hanged Man, The Tower, Judgment, and Justice returned respectively. Klein remained above the gray fog, awaiting the sacrifice.
...
Backlund Empress Borough, Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
Not long after Audrey held the bestowment ritual, she saw a soft object that was constantly changing colors and was filled with ridges on the altar.
"The Rainbow Salamander's pituitary gland!" Audrey was overjoyed. Her eyes lit up as she prepared to take it out.
However, her etiquette habit immediately controlled her as she sincerely praised Mr. Fool once again.
After ending the ritual, she impatiently walked forward and carefully observed the Beyonder ingredient five times.
Then, she looked warily at the door, as if afraid of Susie's sudden intrusion.
A few minutes later, there was a bottle of liquid in Audrey's hand that kept changing, as though it could shine into the depths of everyone's hearts.
She confidently drank the Telepathist potion and successfully tide through the integration stage of the Beyonder characteristic and advanced.
...
In a hotel in the North Borough of Enmat Harbor, Ebner, who had just finished attending the Tarot Gathering, opened his eyes. He seriously took in the feeling for a while before muttering to himself in satisfaction,
My spirituality has changed slightly, and the potion seems to have digested a little...
"Indeed, one of the acting principles of a Polymath is to resolve the problems of others with your own knowledge.
"But this is clearly more one-sided; otherwise, there wouldn't only be such feedback."
As for why he could receive feedback from Sefirah Castle, he had already roughly figured it out.
Polymath was, after all, different from Knowledge Keeper. The latter focused more on "preservation," with the goal of preventing knowledge from being lost. As for the former principle, even though Ebner hadn't finished concluding it, he mostly focused on solving problems with "knowledge."
Therefore, as a Knowledge Keeper, he didn't receive any feedback no matter how much he spread the knowledge in Sefirah Castle. This was because Sefirah Castle itself was a "concealed" environment. Knowledge was equivalent to not saying it out loud. It couldn't even be divined or retroactively retroactively, so there was naturally no feedback.
However, Polymath was different. Although Ebner suspected that Sefirah Castle had still blocked a portion of the "feedback," at least the "problem-solving" part could be played on Sefirah Castle.
After some thought, Ebner came up with a few "acting" methods and planned to verify them in the future. The timing wasn't right, but it wasn't suitable to act immediately.
After removing the wall of spirituality, he took a shower in the hotel to clear his discomfort from digging up the grave the night before. Then, he ordered a specialty of Enmat's and enjoyed it for dinner.
When it was completely dark, Ebner suddenly recalled something he had overlooked. He hurriedly wore his clothes and left the inn, calling for a carriage to rush to the "fertility cathedral."
It turned out that he had forgotten to retrieve the Clown mask he had lent Dunn because the Tarot Gathering was about to begin.
It wasn't that he couldn't bear to part with the mask. After advancing to Polymath and easily simulating the powers of a Sequence 6, the Clown mask was no longer of much use to him.
However, the mask had living characteristics. It could be said that it had a very nasty personality. It would only behave itself after being "taught" by Mr. Fool once or twice a week at Sefirah Castle. Otherwise, it would force the wielder to do something out of line.
And last week, Klein had died just in time. The mask hadn't had the chance to go above the gray fog to receive Mr. Fool's education. Although Sefirah Castle's "remnant might" was still present, and with the White Eye suppressing it, it had acted rather "honestly," but who could guarantee that it wouldn't attack Dunn while it was gone?
After rushing to the Harvest Church under the cover of the night, just as Ebner pushed open the door to the cathedral, he saw Dunn, who had transformed into "Thanks to you, Stark," standing in front of the sermon counter. He threw the stack of paper in his hand to the ground, then spread his arms and announced to the crowd in the prayer hall,
"I'm Iron Man!"
...
"Name: Clown Mask.
Function: Change one's appearance to the appearance of another person that had been set.
Negative Effect: It has the characteristic of being "alive." It will look forward to your performance after wearing the mask. The performance's content and venue are related to the person who is wearing it.
Take note: Make sure to put your heart into the performance; otherwise, once it's not satisfied, it will take the initiative to control your body to perform what it wants! Once you wear it for more than two hours, you might be replaced by the character you set, and your mind might fracture as a result. (Bring it to the gray fog once a week; the negative effects and things to take note of do not exist.)
...
Upon seeing this scene, the corners of Ebner's mouth twitched. He stroked his forehead and said to the lady who was suspected to be Sloth, "Miss Priest, why do I feel that his mental problems are getting worse..."
The woman with long brown hair revealed her dimples as she asked with a smile, "Do you feel frightened?"
"A little..." Ebner thought for a moment and answered honestly.
"Then there's no problem... Don't you think he plays the role of a Nightmare very well?" the woman with long brown hair said with deep meaning.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Dream
chapters.content:
Chapter 286 - Dream
The acting of a Nightmare is great... So, this is a dream? That's right, if it wasn't a dream, how could there be no empty seats in the Harvest Church? Priest Noris probably only dared to think of such a good thing in his dreams.
However, I was pulled into a dream without realizing it... When did this happen?
After carefully recalling for a moment, he immediately discovered something disharmonious.
For example, why didn't he take advantage of the night to "fly" over when the hotel he was at was only a block away from the Church of Abundance?
And that rental carriage stopped in front of him the moment he stepped out... Of course, what was even more contradictory was that the carriage driver didn't charge him any fees!
At this moment, when the woman with long brown hair saw the look of enlightenment on Ebner's face, she said with a smile, "It looks like you've already sensed it... That's right, I used a Sealed Artifact to pull everyone in the nearby streets into this dream. Heh heh, the negative effects of the mask came too suddenly. In order to not cause a huge commotion, I can only use this method to temporarily satisfy its little 'hobby.'
"Besides, this will also help the patient you brought with you... His Beyonder characteristic digestion was terrible previously... No, it can be said that he almost didn't digest it... With this environment, letting him act appropriately is very helpful in the treatment."
At this point, the woman with long brown hair glanced at Ebner and continued with a teasing tone, "I sent a carriage to invite you over to ask about the exact situation of your mask... But you seemed to have the ability to move in the dream. You actually maintained your lucidity..."
The reason why I can maintain my lucidity in the dream is most likely related to the White Eye... However, I can't compare it to Klein. Not only can he maintain his lucidity, but he can also immediately sense that he's in a dream...
Of course, this is also related to experience. If I encounter more, I can probably tell.
Ebner thought for a moment, but he didn't continue on the topic. Instead, he asked, "Even if the residents nearby are muddle-headed, having such a ridiculous dream would still leave some impression... I'm afraid that they will bear a grudge against the Church of Abundance. How will Priest Norris proselytize in the future?"
"They're all believers of the Storm. It's impossible for them to accept the teachings of Earth Mother," the brown-haired lady said as a matter of course with her eyes curved.
Are you implying that these are already "sunken" capital, so "trash" is using them?
Ebner was speechless. He felt that Miss Sloth, who was suspected to be from the Psychology Alchemists, seemed to have some warped humor...
How could such a personality be taught to such a "simple" daughter like Miss Judi?
As Ebner lampooned, he asked again, "But with so many people having the same ridiculous dream, what would they do if they were to report it to the Church of Storms?"
"You seem to be thinking about something impolite..." The woman with long brown hair narrowed her eyes. Then, she pointed at Dunn who was still giving an impromptu speech in front of the podium, and said with a smile, "That's right! If you aren't afraid, how can you show the effects of a Nightmare?
"As for reporting it to the Church of Storms? That's even more impossible. They won't remember where they were frightened."
Don't remember... So that's how it is. I nearly forgot that the lady in front of me is a demigod of the Spectator pathway. She might very well be a Sequence 4 Manipulator. "She" is good at "Alterating" the consciousness of ordinary people in dreams.
Nodding slightly, Ebner organized his words and described the negative effects of the Clown Mask in detail. Finally, he said, "I was planning on retrieving it and sealing it."
The brown-haired lady held her right elbow with her left hand and pinched her chin with her right hand. After some thought, she said after some deliberation, "If it's possible, I hope you can lend me this mask... Or perhaps, lend it to my patient for some time.
"Firstly, as you know, his current identity is a little inappropriate. He needs some disguises, and the Clown mask is suitable for him.
Secondly, when I was giving him preliminary treatment, I realized that this patient's personality is too gentle. He's unable to become a true Nightmare... The negative effects of this mask can help him. Be it a Nightmare or a Midnight Poet, it's very suitable.
As for the "side effects" of splitting a new personality, she didn't mind it. After all, to a demigod Psychiatrist, splitting a new personality was nothing.
After seriously considering her request, he felt that there was nothing wrong with agreeing to it. The mask was of little use to him now, not to mention that she had shipped over the "milk cow" he wanted from afar. He had to return the favor.
"Sure..." Ebner first nodded before exhorting solemnly, "However, you have to be careful of the mask backlash. 'It has a very nasty personality."
"Don't worry. Although I'm not as good as a High-Sequence Beyonder of the Corpse Collector pathway when it comes to communicating with a living Sealed Artifact, I have the means to slightly modify some of its ideas," the woman with long brown hair said with a smile as she covered her mouth.
Are you planning on hypnotizing the Sealed Artifact? There's actually such an operation?
Just as Ebner was dumbfounded, the brown-haired lady continued, "But I can't just borrow your things without expressing anything. Otherwise, if Judi finds out, she'll definitely blame me for being embarrassed in front of her friends."
I don't think you have the concept of "losing face" at all...
As Ebner lampooned inwardly, he heard Judi's mother say,
"Yes, I have two choices here.
"First, I heard that you're already a Polymath. You definitely need to analyze and learn some practical abilities. I can demonstrate to you all the abilities of the Spectator pathway's Sequence 9 to Sequence 4... Of course, how much you can learn will depend on your abilities."
You know that I'm a Polymath? There aren't many people who know of this information... So, Ma'am, you really are valued by Lilith... You should be the snitch she sent to the Psychology Alchemists.
With this in mind, Ebner asked without batting an eyelid, "What's the second choice?"
"Heh heh, the second choice is a complete manuscript of a secret technique. It should be helpful to you after you become a Mysticism Magister," the brown-haired lady replied with a chuckle.
"What kind of 'secret technique' is it?" Ebner asked curiously.
"Its name is Solar Eating. It comes from the Sequence 5 Astronomer of the Savant pathway, Eclipsing. It can create an environment that blots out the sun and pure darkness through a simple ritual," the brown-haired lady described the effects of a "secret technique."
Eclipses... Astronomer... I remember that this Sequence was called Astrologer in ancient times. The Emperor had once mentioned in his diary that only after becoming an Astronomer did he have Beyonder powers that came under his control...
Hmm, could this "combat-type Beyonder power" be the effects of various astronomical phenomena?
If the "solar corrosion" is to blot out the sun and create darkness, then the "lunar corrosion" is to block the crimson moon and reduce one's spirituality, right?
What about a meteor shower? Don't tell me it really summoned a fireball from the sky? Did 0-08 use the same principle to smash Klein with a meteorite in the future?
After letting his thoughts wander for a while, Ebner organized his thoughts and weighed the pros and cons for a moment before finally making a decision. "I choose to observe the abilities."
He had been eyeing the powers of a Spectator for a long time, but unfortunately, there had been no suitable person or item to "fleece" him. Now that a Spectator demigod had taken the initiative to approach him, he naturally didn't wish to miss the opportunity.
As for the manuscript of "solar eating," although it was pretty good, it wasn't very useful for the present.
"You should be on the train tomorrow afternoon, right? I'll demonstrate it to you when you come tomorrow morning." The lady with long brown hair nodded first. Then, she turned her head to look at Dunn, who had finished his speech, 'looking embarrassed. She smiled and said, "Alright, that's it for tonight. I wish everyone a good dream."
As her clear voice fell, the scene around her shattered. Ebner suddenly sat up, only to realize that he was still on the bed in the hotel room.
It's no wonder the emperor always says to be careful of the Spectator...
Heh heh, her goal of borrowing the Clown mask isn't as simple as she said...
However, since she's someone Earth Mother trusts, she wouldn't harm Dunn.
...
The next morning, Ebner arrived at the Harvest Church. He first observed the demonstrations from Judi's mother and chatted with Dunn, who seemed a little uneasy after seeing him. Then, he went to the steam locomotive station and took the first train in the afternoon to reach Tingen before the sunset.
This time, he didn't disguise himself and used his true appearance to rent a room at the hotel.
After a simple shower, Ebner was about to take a break when he suddenly felt his mind go adrift. However, he immediately woke up.
Having had the experience of forcing himself into a dream, he immediately knew who had pulled him into a dream again!

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Serial Killer
chapters.content:
Chapter 287 - Serial Killer
The method to pull someone into a dream is very crude. It's not as silent as Miss Judi's mother... It shouldn't be a High-Sequence Beyonder...
After having a general idea of what was going on, Ebner recalled the looks of the ordinary people in the Abundance Cathedral last night. He deliberately wore a blank expression and looked towards the door.
The door creaked open, and a figure in a gray trench coat walked in.
He was in his thirties, had a long, thin face, and blue eyes that had the charm of a middle-aged man.
