"But why would an Intis envoy's bodyguard just happen to wander into the South Bridge District at night? We didn't pay much attention before... But now that I think about it, was he there to support the Hero Bandit 'Black Emperor'?
"Maybe this 'Fool' has ties to the Secret Order...
"A few months ago, the Church of Storms had been retaliating against the Secret Order after one of their 'Wind-blessed' was turned into a 'Marionet'...
"And later, the assassination of the Intis ambassador—we all know that the Church of Storms wasn't responsible, but Intis might not believe that... Even though they officially accepted the claim that it was the Aurora Order's doing.
"So, I suspect that this entire incident was orchestrated by Intis... Their goal is to embarrass the Church of Storms and retaliate for the suppression they faced earlier."
Earl Hall pondered for a moment before asking, "What is His Majesty's stance?"
"Sorrowful, but without giving any specific instructions," Aguesid replied.
Upon hearing this, Earl Hall nodded thoughtfully and said carefully,
"With the current evidence provided by MI9, Intis will never admit to it... And even if we obtain key evidence, such as a confession from the military attaché disguised as Madame Panis, the most they will do is offer a scapegoat as compensation... They won't even make it public!
"After all, Feysac is already putting enough pressure on us. We can't afford to go to war with Intis over this."
"And we also need to find another mastermind behind the scenes, so the public doesn't direct too much hatred toward Intis..." Aguesid sighed, following up on Earl Hall's statement.
Earl Hall nodded and said,
"Exactly... In fact, solving this problem isn't about identifying the true mastermind but rather deciding what we want to achieve with this incident... If we want war, if we want to restart the colonial conflicts, then we simply tell the public that the mastermind behind Patrick Jason was the Feysac Empire or Intis. As long as the evidence is somewhat convincing, I doubt the public will scrutinize it too deeply."
Prime Minister Aguesid tugged at the corners of his lips in a humorless smile and said helplessly, "But we're in the middle of a series of reforms, which won't stabilize until at least the latter half of next year. We won't have the capacity to launch a war before then."
Earl Hall chuckled and said:
"The organization worshiping the 'Fool' or the Secret Order is too obscure. If we make this public as is, it will only cause greater panic—people always fear the unknown, the things they don't understand.
"So, what do you think about blaming the 'Aurora Order' instead?"
...
West Borough, Williams Street, inside the Panis family's villa.
Bianca, who was disguised as Madame Panis, was having dinner with her "husband."
Mr. Panis was a man in his forties—obese, unattractive, and prone to fits of anger. His attitude toward women was exactly what one would expect from a devoted believer of the Lord of Storms...
No wonder the real Madame Panis had an affair with the young, handsome, and charismatic Baron Larry.
Bianca scoffed internally, but as she recalled that she would have to serve this man in bed tonight, she found it difficult to even swallow her food.
Yet, for the sake of her mission and to maintain her cover, she had no choice but to endure.
However, just as she was forcing herself to eat, a sudden wave of dizziness struck her, her thoughts becoming sluggish...
"There's poison in the food!" Bianca's heart trembled in shock. Without caring about maintaining her cover, she prepared to chant an incantation to use her witchcraft and neutralize the poison.
But to her horror, she found that her tongue and throat were completely numb—forget chanting, she could barely make a sound!
Even so, Bianca did not give up. Summoning her last ounce of willpower, she reached into her clothes for a scroll.
Just as she was about to tear it open, a hand suddenly reached out and took it from her.
Bianca froze for a few seconds before turning her gaze toward the owner of the hand, only to see that it was her own "husband," Mr. Panis.
"Bianca, your body has always fascinated me... If not for the orders from above, I would be reluctant to kill you." Mr. Panis sighed with regret as he placed the scroll aside, then reached out to caress her face while chanting an incantation to remove her disguise.
You too... are undercover? But why did they order my execution? Bianca's beautiful eyes were filled with terror and confusion.
"You're truly beautiful—far more so than the real Madame Panis! I would have loved to enjoy you in your true form at least once... But alas, there's no time.
"After killing you, I still have to retrieve and place the real Panis couple's corpses here to stage their deaths as a poisoning incident."
As he spoke, Mr. Panis unbuttoned Bianca's clothes, exposing her chest, and located her heart. Under her horrified gaze, he plunged his hand inside.
But the next moment, his expression froze.
A sharp, unbearable pain suddenly shot through his own chest!
Realizing what was happening, Mr. Panis tried to withdraw his hand to heal himself, but his entire body was paralyzed—he couldn't move at all!
At that moment, Bianca stood up. She glanced down at the arm lodged in her chest without any hesitation, then chanted an incantation, unleashing a wind blade that severed his neck.
Next, she pulled his arm from her chest and sighed:
"You were truly unlucky... Of all the ways to kill me, you just had to go for my heart.
"Every 'Warlock' inherits a unique form of witchcraft from their bloodline... And mine happens to be a peculiar 'Heart Curse'—a spell that only activates when I take a fatal hit to the heart, swapping my injuries with my attacker's.
"Heh, it looks like misfortune doesn't only plague my 'master'... Anyone who's had an intimate relationship with me seems to suffer from it as well... Is this one of the negative side effects of that experiment?
"Whatever. No point dwelling on it now... The priority is to go into hiding and figure out what's really happening. Why did the envoy order my execution?"
Muttering to herself, Bianca quickly redressed and retrieved the mask that had been taken from her. After a brief disguise, she slipped into the villa's underground drainage system and made her escape—leaving all her injuries transferred onto the dead man.
About ten minutes later, a joint team of Mandated Punishers and MI9 agents entered the villa.
...
Inside the rest chamber of the Dream Labyrinth Tower, Ebner murmured to himself after listening to the preliminary "search" results from the "Magic Mirror" regarding the Desire Apostle's soul:
"The Andrelard family once used a high-ranked sealing artifact—a sigil—in their conflict with the other two major demon families... And it is said to bring misfortune?
"This artifact was entrusted to the Andrevad family by Duke Yaldabaoth...
"Yaldabaoth was Roselle's adopted son...
"Could it be the 'Seal' from Roselle's Sword-Mirror-Seal trio?"
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 629: Lack of Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 629 - Lack of Strength
After throwing the "Tower" card in front of Leonard in the sewer, Ebner controlled the "Bone Dragon" and used its "Dream Traverse" ability to leave Cherwood Borough.
—Although it was the afternoon, many Backlund workers and employees worked night shifts, while others were still asleep at this time.
He arrived at a safe house he had rented in advance in the East Borough. After securing the room, he entered the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" through the "Gate of Dreams and Reality" to study the captured Desire Apostle.
He avoided probing any memories related to the "Twilight Hermit Order" and instead interrogated him about his origins and the current state of the three major demon families of the Blood Sanctify Sect. Even within the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," it was highly likely that the Angel King's perception could not be fully blocked.
According to the Desire Apostle, the three major demon families—Nois, Beria, and Andariel—had not followed the original novel's setting, where the latter two submitted to Nois. Instead, they had entered a full-scale conflict.
Andariel had only managed to recover in the past century with the support of the Duke of Terror, Yaldabaoth, barely resisting the encroachment of the Nois family.
This shift also stirred unrest within Beria, who had already submitted to Nois.
Jason Beria, the Desire Apostle, was one such restless demon. Hoping to advance to the demigod level—or even higher—he had accepted the mission to assassinate Duke Negan.
Among all the gathered intelligence, what intrigued Ebner the most was that during the most intense clash between the Andariel and Nois families, Andariel had fully unsealed a "Seal"-type Sealed Artifact. The power it unleashed actually repelled a "Blood Archduke" of the Nois family!
"That seal is likely the 'Seal' among the three extraordinary items crafted by Roselle using three 'Angel Wraiths'—the Sword-Mirror-Seal set...
"Judging from the 'Magic Mirror,' if it was fully unsealed, then the 'Sauron Family's Angel Wraith' sealed within the artifact might have fully awakened. Whether it remains with the Andariel family is uncertain...
"But at least it's a lead..."
With this thought, Ebner commanded the "Magic Mirror" to search the memories of the various demon families' strongholds.
The final results were: Jason Beria did not know the Nois family's location, but he was aware that the Beria family resided in West Velas County of the Loen Kingdom, while the Andariel family was hidden in the Antares Mountains north of Feysac.
"The Beria family in West Velas County? Hmm... This matches the descriptions in my teacher's book, 'Demon Legends of the West Velas Region,' so it should be true.
"Additionally, the claim that Andariel hides in the Antares Mountains of Feysac also has supporting evidence... I remember when I helped Closfia in Indo Harbor by 'acting' in a nightmare as 'Doctor Strange,' I saved a young man whose nightmare was about encountering a monster in a small town within the Antares Mountains...
"And that monster was a 'Four-Armed Bone-Faced Ape.' Its bone face is one of the primary materials used by demons.
"As for Nois... Although there's no direct evidence, I have a strong intuition they're hiding in Intis... After all, the first soul 'pastured' within the 'Magic Mirror' came from the Nois family's 'Devil'!
"Unfortunately, that 'Devil's' soul seems to have been tampered with. Even under 'Pasture,' I still can't extract more information...
"Of course, if I further unseal the 'Magic Mirror,' I might be able to break through the restrictions... but that's not worth the risk."
Ebner sighed. After extracting all the knowledge possessed by the Desire Apostle, he instructed the "Magic Mirror" to release his soul and Beyonder characteristics.
As for the Beyonder characteristic, Ebner had no intention of selling it. If a demon got hold of it, they would likely start a serial killing spree to prepare for their ritual. He couldn't allow such chaos to spread, so it was better to turn it into an extraordinary item after the "Great Smog" incident was over and bring it to Bayam.
As for the soul of the Desire Apostle... before it dissipated, Ebner "sacrificed" it to "The Fool," allowing Klein to harvest some "second-hand" wool—making full use of waste materials.
Of course, he found a plausible excuse, claiming that the Desire Apostle was involved with that unnamed organization and needed "The Fool" to handle it. This prevented Klein from suspecting anything.
After finishing all this, Ebner returned to reality and took a carriage to the Church of the Earth Mother.
As for the puppet bound by ropes of solidified black flames, after some thought, he decided it would be best to return it to its former owner—the past "Chained God," now the "Spirit Angel."
...
Inside the ancient palace above the gray fog.
Staring at the brown-haired, brown-eyed, empty-gazed "Desire Apostle," Klein couldn't help but sneer:
"So, is this yet another step forward in Mr. Fool's exploitation?"What kind of new service is this?
"Destroying evidence? Not quite... It seems more like they dared not provoke some organization, so they picked a scapegoat to take the hit...
"But I just want to say, we need more of this sort of thing!"After all, every strong soul contains immensely valuable knowledge—it's all 'money'!"
With that thought, Klein silently mocked himself:"How did I suddenly start thinking of money? I'm not inherently a money-loving person—it's just a normal preference. Back in Tingen, I always encouraged Melissa to spend, always egged her and Bensen on hiring a maid, insisting that no matter what, one must never deprive oneself. Even during covert operations, safety comes first and caution is paramount, so that wealth never clouds one's mind.
"Even Sharon praised my 'moderation'...
"But for revenge, one must ascend the hierarchy, and to ascend, one has to purchase expensive extraordinary materials, plus powerful extraordinary items... I can only scrape together a penny at a time, saving every bit I can..."
After a soft sigh, Klein cast aside his chaotic thoughts and, focusing his mind through meditation, let his spirituality spread, beginning the interrogation of the "Desire Apostle."
In this mysterious space above the gray fog, he could now, like a true "Medium," directly communicate with the lingering spirits without having to pray to anyone or even require any ritual assistance—a fact he had already confirmed when channeling with the "Marionettist" Rosago.
Moments later, as he watched the spirit body of the Desire Apostle completely vanish before his eyes, Klein tapped the edge of the long table with his finger and muttered:
"It turns out that the organization whose name Mr. Tower and Roselle mentioned—but could not utter— is called the 'Twilight Hermit Order'... Sounds rather fancy!"This organization can actually produce a 'Blasphemy Card' as a reward for assassinating Duke Negan...
"'Abyss Card'... 'Tyrant Card'..."
After pondering for a while, Klein suddenly felt his real body being moved. His heart leaped in alarm; he quickly simulated the sensation of falling and left the space above the gray fog.
No sooner had he returned than he discovered that he had already left the washroom. A chill ran down his spine, and his body felt uncontrollable... Not far away on a sofa sat a member of the "Machinery Hivemind," who appeared to be saying something.
Carlson of the Machinery Hivemind had suddenly come by to check on my condition. So, according to our prior agreement, Sharon had attached my body to him, engaging in a sort of feigned compliance?Klein immediately deduced the situation, and the chill in his body began to fade. Clearly, Sharon had already noticed his return and restored control of the body to him.
Carlson, wearing thick spectacles, glanced at him. With little inspiration and not noticing that Klein's inner self had been replaced, he continued the previous conversation with praise:
"Your detective intuition and logical thinking have given us the most important help. The butler mentioned in his letter that afterwards he would discreetly give you a bounty, about 1,000 pounds."
So generous? Hmmm... I had thought that Mr. Tower got the fifty thousand from that briefcase... But it now appears that it was officially seized... Perhaps the Desire Apostle was in such a hurry that he left it at Duke Negan's mistress's villa?While he was pondering this, Carlson deliberated inviting him to become an informant for the Machinery Hivemind.
In response, Klein, with a straight face, drew a triangular holy emblem over his chest and gladly accepted.
"Beloved by Mr. Fool, dear Sherlock..."Miss Sharon, hidden in the mirror-world, silently murmured to herself.
...
In the basement of the Harvest Church, while handing the puppet over to Lilith's container and requesting it be delivered to Ebner, the "Chained God," she hesitated for a moment before asking:"Is the disaster in the East Borough truly inevitable?"
Lilith, with her silver eyes, looked at him intently. After a pause, she replied:
"Borrowing someone's words, it is the inevitable result of the times...
"This 'inevitability' isn't set by anyone; even if the 'development of the times' is envisioned by Him, it is built upon the unstoppable tide of progress...
"And add to that a king who needs to cover up his 'population' disappearances...
"Even if we can prevent it this time, a similar catastrophe will occur again next time!
"Of course, the most important point is... neither you nor the one you fancy now have the power to upend this trend..."
Hearing this answer—which Ebner had long suspected—he sighed, finally resigned, and muttered to himself:
"So, we can only do our best to remedy it?"
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 630: Monday
chapters.content:
Chapter 630 - Monday
the emotional moment, Ebner decided to act according to his original plan, no longer expecting the gods to show mercy. After all, even Lilith—the one he valued most—had expressed a refusal, and even if other deities saw through George III's tricks, they wouldn't care much.
His plan was simple: he had been residing in the East Borough lately, waiting for the Demoness of Despair to appear so he could intervene and stop her from spreading a mysterious "plague" in the field of occultism.
He couldn't stop the course of time, but he could mitigate man-made disasters!
As for why he remained in the East Borough? Due to the various "butterfly effects," he could no longer guarantee that Panatia would act on December 28th as in the original account... It might happen a few days early or a few days later.
He could only wait patiently.
Once his plan was set, Ebner thought a while and then requested Lilith's help: "I'd like to ask you for a favor..."
"What favor?" Lilith asked with a smile.
"I want you to help me prepare a false identity... During my time lying low in the East Borough, I'd like to try playing the role of a 'Mysticism Magister.'" Ebner did not specify any particular details about the identity, merely stating his need; he believed that with the Earth Mother Church's power in Loen, it shouldn't be too difficult.
After all, in the original tale, even a secret organization like the "Dawn of the Elements" could provide Klein with a false identity.
Lilith glanced at him with a wry smile, shook her head, and said, "You can just pray directly to 'Knowledge'... 'Learning' and 'Imitating' to create a forgery is His forte."
If I use that reason to approach the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, won't I incur divine punishment? Isn't this the worst scandal He's ever faced?
Ebner was momentarily speechless, but he understood that directly asking Lilith for this favor was indeed improper, hence her teasing tone...
It was all her fault—her casual tone, expressions, and posture always made me forget that she is, in essence, a deity...
After silently defending himself, Ebner then heard Lilith say, "I was just joking earlier... I'll have Closfia handle it through the 'Psychological Alchemy Society'... Even if you cause trouble with that identity, the blame will fall on the 'Psychological Alchemy Society.'"
This rich humanity of Lilith made him wonder if it was all an act... Hearing her words, Ebner sighed inwardly again.
After expressing his sincere thanks to Lilith, Ebner took his leave and ascended the stairs out of the basement.
Soon after returning to the prayer hall, he witnessed a classic scene from the original narrative:
Bearded Detective Sherlock Moriarty and the bloodline youth Emlyn White exchanged a suitcase and cash as if in a mob deal. After the transaction, Emlyn quickly moved to stand beside Father Utravsky and began verifying the bills.
Seeing this scene, Ebner's lips twitched as he recalled the moment when he and Karen had traded over the "Elder Tree's Heart"...
In contrast, he found his and Karen's actions to have been perfectly normal.
At that moment, having confirmed the condition of both items, Klein noticed Ebner coming up the stairs.
"Mr. 'Tower'..."
From the inscription
In Praise of the Humble Room
, Klein had already deduced that this unfamiliar face belonged to Mr. Tower—the very one who had just slain the "Desire Apostle"! The Mr. Tower who wielded demigod means!
—He had learned this through the description given by the Machinery Hivemind and from questioning the soul of the Desire Apostle.
Yet, he didn't intend for his current detective identity to mingle too much with Mr. Tower, to avoid revealing any weaknesses. So, in keeping with the plan, he snapped his fingers, igniting a match he had set aside in his pocket. The sudden blaze of red flames engulfed him.
When the flames subsided, he had disappeared.
Ebner, who had a rough idea of Klein's thoughts, gave a subtle smirk. But soon, his smile deepened as he received a "passive" prophecy, or rather a premonition:
The day when he would expose that person's "disguise" was not far off!
And the catalyst... turned out to be Edwina?!
Ebner pinched his chin and mused:
A simple deduction suggests that Edwina will soon locate the so-called "Key of the Northern King" from the descendant of soldier Longzel's family and, in a safe manner, invite me into "Grossel's Travels."
Hmm... To be on the safe side, I'll probably report to Mr. Fool... And if Klein has already become "Gehrman" by then, he might indeed come in person...
Of course, it might also be that I proactively invite "The World."
So, perhaps the opportunity to unmask the disguise will occur in the "Hall of Honesty"?
Sigh... Luckily, I anticipated this beforehand; I should develop a mysticism technique to consolidate thoughts... Otherwise, it might result in both sides exposing themselves...
...
Monday Morning
In front of house number 30 on Black Palm Street in the East Borough, a refined young man, though dressed rather shabbily, shook hands with his landlord and withdrew a 1-pound note from his thin wallet to pay the rent.
That was a month's rent.
"Mr. Ivins, I heard you've taken a teaching post at the free school? You truly are a gentleman of high morals." The landlord, as was his habit, offered flattery, but the rent remained non-negotiable.
The free school was established by the three major churches or certain charitable organizations as a night school, holding classes from 8 to 10 p.m. completely free of charge, even providing writing materials and some paper at no cost—primarily to combat illiteracy, with some religious instruction thrown in at most.
However, due to the meager salary, the school lacked teachers.
Freya and her younger sister Daisy had been attending that school for a long time. Even though Aetris had recommended better schools for them, they never accepted his kindness.
"You flatter me... If possible, you can just call me 'Professor', sir. I prefer that title," the young man said with a cheerful smile.
"Alright then, 'Professor', sir." The landlord gave him a strange look but ultimately obliged—after all, it didn't cost anything to call someone that.
Once the landlord left and the door was shut, the young man—Ebner—placed a hand to his forehead and couldn't help but complain inwardly:
Closfia... no, maybe Lilith. Just what kind of ridiculous persona did she design for me?
A down-on-his-luck musician who dreams of becoming a 'professor'? Someone who, after repeatedly hitting walls in Backlund, had no choice but to come teach at a free school set up by the Church on the edge of the East Borough?
And he has an inexplicable obsession with being called 'Professor'?
Why give me a persona like this?
As doubts filled his mind, Ebner recalled what Lilith had told him when she handed over his identification documents:
"This identity was inspired by a story Rhine once told me... In that story, the 'Professor' was a renowned musician favored by the Silver Moon."
...
Capital of the Rorsted Archipelago, the City of Generosity, Bayam.
Alger, having disembarked from the
Blue Avenger
, changed into a robe embroidered with storm patterns and headed straight for the Church of the Lord of Storms.
As soon as he entered the Grand Prayer Hall, he performed the Church's ritual greeting to the bishop and respectfully said, "The Storm be with you!"
"The Storm be with you!" the bishop responded with the same gesture.
Before Alger could speak, the bishop took out a telegram and said gravely:
"You came at the right time. There's something you need to know...
"Duke Negan has been assassinated. The Cardinal Council has ordered all Mandated Punishers and clerics to be alert to any events involving Tarot rituals, organizations that worship the Fool, as well as intelligence related to rogue figures like the 'Black Emperor', 'Iron Man', and 'Doctor Strange'.
"In addition, intelligence on the Secret Order must also be gathered."
"Tarot rituals? Secret Order?" Alger was shocked inside but maintained an expression of confusion on the surface.
He couldn't quite understand why Duke Negan's death would be linked to the Tarot Club—or to Mr. Fool.
And what did this have to do with the Secret Order?
The bishop nodded solemnly and explained:
"The one who assassinated Duke Negan was a Sequence 5 demon and Baron Larry. The latter vanished without a trace, but the former was killed by a Saint during his escape. He left behind a 'Tower' card... This is similar to what happened to Vice Admiral Hurricane Qilangos when his assassination attempt failed—although that time no Tarot card was left."
"Also, it's suspected that Larry may have received backing from Intis. And during the Black Emperor's operation against the Aurora Order, individuals suspected of being from the Secret Order were involved...
"So, the Cardinal Council believes that the organization worshipping the Fool might be connected to the Secret Order!"
The Tower... took out the Desire Apostle? He's become a demigod? So his three-week leave was to perform an advancement ritual...
Hmm, if it really was him, then he was probably acting on behalf of either the World or Mr. Fool... Could this have been part of a test to become Blessed?
Also, Mr. Fool must be more focused on the truth hidden behind the assassination—the real mastermind!
Could it be the Secret Order? I remember Mr. Fool attached great importance to that group, even issued a mission for its intel...
Heh, the Cardinal Council might've guessed one thing right—Mr. Fool probably does have some connection to the Secret Order... but not a close one. They might even be enemies.
A flood of thoughts raced through Alger's mind. As he lowered his eyes to read the telegram, he saw that the Church had formed a joint investigation team made up of Mandated Punishers, Machinery Hivemind, and Nighthawks to look into the assassination of Duke Negan. Each member was an elite from their respective organization.
As his eyes scanned the names—Stuart, Daly, Ikonsa—Alger hesitated for a moment, wondering if he should apply to join the team to stay updated on the investigation's progress...
But in the end, he decided to stick to his original plan and develop quietly.
...
In a rowhouse at 15 Minsk Street, Backlund, Klein finally gathered all the materials needed for Sequence 6 "Faceless Man" after receiving the "Human-Skinned Shadow's characteristic" from Sharon. He successfully advanced.
While experimenting with his new powers, he morphed into a woman's face and even shaped a pair of "A-cup" breasts on his chest. Then someone suddenly knocked on the door.
The shock nearly caused him to activate Flame Leap. Fortunately, he calmed himself in time, reverted to his bearded Sherlock look, and opened the door.
Standing outside was an elderly man dressed like a butler, there to invite Sherlock to meet an important figure.
That figure was, of course, Prince Edessak, who had sought Klein's help to investigate the whereabouts of Talim.
"Talim? According to what Mr. Tower described, he might be... 'reading by candlelight with a red-sleeved beauty' right now... Hmm, something like that. I wonder if Roselle ever copied that phrase..."
...
Aboard the
Golden Dream
, the now inexplicably-turned-pirate Talim was miserably scribbling ancient Hermetic words with pen and paper.
Beside him, Danitz was eating grilled fish while pointing out Talim's mistakes.
He really was enjoying the "red-sleeved beauty and scented candles" life...
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 631: New Diary
chapters.content:
Chapter 631 - New Diary
3 o'clock sharp.
Inside the ancient palace above the gray fog.
As the illusory crimson light surged, Audrey Hall appeared beside her seat at the long table.
She glanced around and immediately noticed that the long-absent "Tower" had finally returned to the gathering after three weeks.
When she first heard the news of Duke Negan's assassination, she had Suzie eavesdrop on her father, Earl Hall, and obtained some crucial information... for instance, the mysterious disappearance of Baron Larry; and how the one who intercepted the "Desire Apostle" was a high-sequence powerhouse riding a dragon, who even left a "Tower" card right in front of the Nighthawks...
Last night, she had confirmed this again through the Psychological Alchemy Society.
Based on all of this, she had reached the same conclusion as "The Hanged Man" Alger — Mr. Tower must have been carrying out the ritual to advance to the demigod during those three weeks!
Though she felt a little puzzled about Mr. Tower's motivation in intercepting the "Desire Apostle," she didn't think he had been the mastermind behind the duke's assassination.
As her thoughts flashed by, "Justice" Audrey stood up as usual, lifted her skirt slightly, and led the others on both sides in greeting. "Good afternoon, Mr. Fool~"
Klein, who had just been promoted to "Faceless Man" and was in a rather good mood, nodded lightly in response to the Tarot Club members' greetings.
As she sat back down and exchanged greetings with the others, Audrey relied on her abilities to capture everyone's expressions and behavior.
Mr. "Hanged Man" stole a glance at Mr. Fool with subtle curiosity, then looked toward Mr. Tower, his emotions tinged with envy... That meant, as a member of the Church of the Lord of Storms, he likely knew the full details of Duke Negan's assassination and had some guesses about Mr. Tower's current Sequence. Moreover, he must be quite eager to uncover the truth behind it...
Mr. Tower feels more and more unfathomable... He seems to naturally exude 'dragon might,' yet upon close observation, I can't detect anything... Is it just my imagination? Or are demigods inherently this terrifying?
She also noticed that his mood was still quite good.
"Sun" seemed emotionally stable, with a hint of ease — which meant he believed the surveillance from the City of Silver had already been lifted...
She still couldn't read Mr. "World" clearly, nor Miss "Temperance"...
Perhaps I'll need to reach a higher Sequence before I can sense what they're truly thinking.
Fors seemed relaxed but carried a trace of depression...
Did becoming an apprentice of the Abraham family force her into something unfavorable?
Miss "Judgment" appeared even more authoritative than before... but why had her figure changed from before?
Did she pad something beneath her clothes?
No, that's not right. The figure here is merely an astral projection — the appearance is largely based on one's self-perception... No need for physical alterations.
Huh? Mr. Tower seems to have noticed the small change in Miss Judgment's figure too... His emotions feel a little complicated... but mostly happy...
Hmm, Mr. Fool is still as mysterious, powerful, and impossible to read as ever.
As all these thoughts flashed through her mind, "Justice" Audrey looked toward the figure shrouded in gray fog and said, "Respected Mr. Fool, I've acquired four new pages of Roselle's diary."
These were copies she had obtained from the Psychological Alchemy Society. Since she had only brought it up last night, time was short — Islant had only managed to get her three pages, and the remaining one had been delivered that morning by Mr. Hilbert Alucard, who had introduced her into the Society.
"What reward do you want?" Klein asked with a smile.
Audrey thought for a moment, then cautiously asked, "I have a question... In the case of Duke Negan's assassination, was the person who intercepted the 'Desire Apostle' one of your Blessed? If so, I'd like to understand the reason behind it."
As she spoke, she glanced at Mr. Tower seated diagonally across from her.
Miss 'Justice'... no, Audrey Hall... why did she look toward Mr. Tower? Could it be that Mr. Tower was the one who killed Duke Negan? But didn't the newspapers say it was a serial killer disguised as a banker?
Hmm, Xio's been really busy lately. She'll finally be home tonight — I'll have to ask her for intel when she gets back.
Also, I should write to my teacher and ask if he has any of Roselle's diary pages... no, I'll call them 'notebooks' publicly...
"Magician" Fors, despite her confusion, now felt both longing and motivation.
"The Hanged Man" Alger also turned his gaze over at this time, clearly very interested.
The reason? It's probably that Mr. Tower was helping his teacher eliminate hidden dangers... It really isn't that complicated...
While thinking that, Klein casually shook his head and smiled. "You'll have to ask Mr. Tower about that. If he agrees, you can transfer the reward for the diary pages to him."
As expected!
both "Justice" and "The Hanged Man" thought to themselves.
With Mr. Fool's personal confirmation, their earlier speculation was undeniably verified.
"Justice" Audrey leaned forward and looked toward Tower with anticipation. "Is that okay?"
As she asked, the others also turned their attention toward him.
"Sure," Ebner replied with a relaxed smile. He then manifested two more diary pages and respectfully looked at Mr. Fool seated at the head of the table. "Together with my two pages, please count them toward my 'contribution.'"
Ever since he had used "Prophecy" to deduce that he might soon invite "World" and Edwina to explore
Groselle's Travels
, he had started saving up contributions — to make it harder for Klein to refuse.After all, if the prophecy had led to that result, it meant the exploration likely couldn't proceed without "World."
As for Roselle's diary? That was something he had purchased from "Lion" Leon while in the City of Generosity, Bayam. It consisted of twenty pages, all containing content that the latter had personally witnessed while following the Emperor.
Excluding the parts that overlapped with the pages he had already handed over to Klein, and the few pages he had given to Xio before the two Tarot Meetings he hadn't attended, he now had six pages left in his possession...
Ebner planned to submit them in batches. After all, he didn't know whether it was deliberate on the Emperor's part, but almost all of the content in those twenty pages seen by "Lion" Leon consisted of rather indecent material...
Of course, it was also possible that the Emperor simply hadn't minded the lion's presence when writing his diary after engaging in those shameful acts.
While recalling the eye-burning contents of the diary, Ebner saw that Mr. Fool nodded in approval. He then looked at "Justice" Audrey and asked:
"Would you prefer to speak privately?"
Audrey glanced around the long table and smiled. "No need. Please go ahead and speak."
Ebner took a moment to organize his thoughts before speaking at a calm and steady pace:
"The mastermind behind the assassination of Duke Negan is still that same organization I mentioned previously... the one with the motto, 'Whatever is spoken shall be known!'
"They once again used a Blasphemy Card as payment, luring the 'Desire Apostle' of the Blood Sanctify Sect into assassinating Duke Negan."
"That mysterious organization with the motto, 'Whatever is spoken shall be known'? Isn't that Intis and the Secret Order?" Audrey exclaimed in surprise.
She had previously considered that organization, especially since Mr. Tower had speculated that Zilingus's previous attempt to assassinate the Duke had likely been backed by them.
But the involvement of Baron Larry, along with the reasonable inferences drawn by the churches and the military, had caused her to shift her suspicions elsewhere.
After all, at the end of the day, she knew nothing about that organization—not even its name.
The same applied to "The Hanged Man" Alger.
"Baron Larry was merely used as a scapegoat to frame Intis. He might not have even been conscious at the time," Ebner said, shaking his head in explanation.
Had it been a few days earlier, he wouldn't have been so clear about Larry's role in the incident... But after meeting with Xio yesterday, she had conveyed to him Princess Vera's evasive remarks. That made him realize that this affair might also involve internal struggles within the Twilight Hermit Order...
And that Princess Vera had taken the opportunity to make her move!
After helping him with the fake identity, Closfia also mentioned that "Pride" had suffered a setback at the hands of the Princess, and that Larry had been taken away by her as well.
"Framed? Who did the framing? Is there a third-party organization involved in the scheme? Or could it be that the 'Whatever is spoken shall be known' group is trying to provoke a war between Intis and Loen?"
Audrey found this organization far too terrifying—because it was impossible to predict what they were trying to achieve... and yet they had the means to accomplish so many things.
"Maybe..." Ebner gave a vague reply after thinking for a moment.
After all, the Twilight Hermit Order was indeed fanning the flames of conflict, trying to trigger a war... but the scale of the war they desired was far greater.
"But why would they do that?" Audrey voiced the question that was on everyone's mind. Such a mysterious and elusive organization couldn't possibly be like the Aurora Order, full of nothing but destructive lunatics, right?
Of course, she didn't expect Mr. Tower to have the answer. After all, he hadn't been sure about the previous questions either, and this one likely exceeded the value of four diary pages...
If he really answered it fully, wouldn't he have to reveal Adam's background?
Ebner grumbled internally. He was just about to bring up a few hints when he suddenly heard a
tap tap tap
knocking sound from nearby.
Everyone immediately straightened up and looked toward the seat of honor—this was a sign that Mr. Fool was about to speak.
Klein raised a finger and spoke in a seemingly casual tone:
"Their core purpose is resurrection—or rather, to awaken the true Creator.
"They interfere with the progress of history, molding it to suit their needs, so that at a certain point, their goal will be achieved.
"If the tide of the times diverges from their expectations, they will do everything they can to correct its course.
"Beyond that, they merely observe silently, indifferently. Perhaps for decades or even centuries, they won't take a single action or issue a single commission..."
This was the information extracted from the spirit of the "Desire Apostle."
All of this... just to ensure the so-called progress of history? And that's why they arranged for Duke Negan to be assassinated?
That sounded absurd... but it was Mr. Fool who had said it, so it had to be true...
Perhaps Duke Negan—or rather, the Conservative Party—was an obstacle to the history they envisioned?
As expected, this organization is too dangerous... I think they're even harder to comprehend than the Aurora Order! At least nobody knows what kind of historical development they want to create...
Audrey, Alger, Xio—even Derrick and the newly joined Sharon—were all deep in thought.
Only Fors looked somewhat confused. "Desire Apostle"? Baron Larry? The "Whatever is spoken shall be known" organization? Historical progression? None of it matched what she had read in the newspapers.
After Mr. Fool finished speaking and said no more, Audrey stood up with some regret and bowed. "Thank you for your answer, Mr. Fool."
Then she turned to Ebner and added, "And thank you as well, Mr. Tower."
After completing the formalities, Audrey handed over the four pages of yellowish-brown diary pages she had materialized to Mr. Fool.
Ebner did the same after returning the gesture.
Klein accepted all six pages and first picked up the one Miss Justice had submitted. On it was written:
"October 16th — After another exchange with Mr. Door, I finally learned something that had puzzled me for a long time.
"That is, why Rhine Kalendia, as a vampire duke, chose to support the Black Emperor and became a noble under Solomon's rule.
"Mr. Door told me that there were many reasons... For example, Rhine was more favored by the progenitor Lilith than other vampires, which greatly displeased the higher-ups in the race—especially Blood Moon Queen Auernia—who subtly ostracized him... After all, Rhine was not a born vampire. He had been rejected by his kind from the start.
"Another reason was that Rhine apparently had a grudge against the Eternal Blazing Sun and was unwilling to serve under the Night Emperor, whom that deity supported.
"But the main reason was that Trunsoest had killed the Orderly Hand of the Tamara family and taken her characteristic... Rhine had only managed to rescue her maddened, corrupted spirit.
"She was his friend."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 632: A Subtle “Report”
chapters.content:
Chapter 632 - A Subtle “Report”
I remember Mr. Tower once said that the "Night Emperor" became Sequence 0 of the Arbiter pathway with the support of the Six Gods...
So, is "Hand of Order" the name of Sequence 1 in that pathway?
Did they hunt down the archangel of the Tamara family in order to become a god, and as a result, incur Liu Bo's hatred?
Heh, Liu Bo really did fly into a rage for a beauty!
Hmm, it seems that every time he transmigrated, he managed to retain his humanity quite well... aside from the "Calamity Seals," of course... Then again, this might just be because the "Hunter" pathway has the nature of a "Conspirator" — it's simply in their blood.
While analyzing in his mind, Klein continued reading the contents below:
"After Mr. Door finished explaining why Rhine Kalendia chose to swear loyalty to Solomon, he stubbornly refused to speak any further about that vampire duke... Hah, his usual trick again, trying to whet my appetite? Not a chance! "If he won't say more, I can still go ask Hermes, or even Zaratul! Although the latter hasn't contacted me in a long time, almost like he's disappeared..."
So, Roselle... your real intention was just to find out who Liu Bo's female friends were? Whether they were really that high-quality, huh? Your Majesty... can you be a little more dignified? Is that really more interesting than everything else?
Do you really want to save face that badly?
After mentally complaining for a bit, Klein focused on the final sentence and mused:
This is the second time I've seen the Emperor mention Zaratul's disappearance in his diary... Where exactly did he go? Did he go straight to the Land of Night after reading the Antigonus family's notes?
After thinking for a few seconds, he returned his gaze to the parchment in his hand and turned to the remaining diary pages provided by Miss Justice.
The second and third pages still recorded conversations between Roselle and Mr. Door, but it was clear they were from a different time than the first — seemingly earlier.
Most of the information about the Fourth Epoch's angelic families was something Klein had already heard from Mr. Tower. Only the part about the ownership of the "Moon" authority gave him pause.
"The 'Moon' has no owner? Then what about Lilith? Judging from the things involving Liu Bo, she likely didn't perish in the Second Epoch... However, considering how she only occasionally responds to the vampires, her current condition might not be very good.
"And what about the Primordial Moon? Even today, people still believe in her and receive responses! The corruption on the Emperor may even be linked to her! Is she not the master of the 'Moon' either?
"As for the Goddess, it does seem as Mr. Door said — she likely only represents the 'Stars'...
"Maybe... Lilith really did fall once during the Second Epoch and lost part of her authority as a result... such as the traits of Sequence 1... or perhaps even her uniqueness?
"It's a strong possibility!"
Klein lowered his gaze and flipped to the fourth page of the diary — also the last one submitted by Miss Justice.
He quickly skimmed over the earlier parts mentioning Bernadette massaging the Emperor's back, and how Florent of the Sauron family seemed like a completely different person after becoming a demigod. These either weren't important or were things he already knew.
It wasn't until the end of the page that he paused again:
"June 5th. I obtained an ancient tome — to my surprise, it actually mentioned the name of the 'Primordial Demoness' — and not in the form of a reverential title!
"She was called 'Cheek', and that's a man's name.
"Is this tome fake?"
Chick?
Could it be that, just like Mr. Tower once said, the "Primordial Demoness" was originally a man?
Klein nearly raised his hand to pinch his chin.
If that's the case, then perhaps pure females might face unique difficulties when walking the "Assassin" pathway... Is that why the Witch Sect only selects males who have transformed into "witches" to cultivate?
That "follower" of mine does fit the conditions quite well... but with his—no, with her personality, just reaching Sequence 7 might already be her limit...
It's hard to imagine her playing the role of a "witch" who brings disaster and pain to others!
As these thoughts flashed through his mind, Klein set aside Justice's diary and flipped through the two pages offered by Mr. Tower.
But he soon flipped them face-down on the desk, separating them from the previous four pages and making them vanish.
After all, those two pages were completely filled with the Emperor's many "praises" of a certain witch... The only useful part was that Klein learned the witch's name — Panatia.
Letting them vanish alongside valuable diary pages made Klein feel like he was
contaminating
the latter.
The diaries from Mr. Tower were as "consistent" in "quality" as always... With a silent jab, he smiled and said to Justice and the others:
"You may begin."
After that, he had the World speak in a hoarse voice to Miss Judgment: "I'm very satisfied with the task I entrusted you with... It even exceeded the payment I originally offered. As agreed, what kind of compensation would you like?"
Xio thought for a moment, then shook her head. "That piece of intel you gave me was already very rewarding. There's no need for extra compensation."
She didn't know that Ebner had requested help from an angel to block the curse from a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact. So she didn't think that either she or Ebner had paid a significant price.
As for the intel about Baron Larry, Her Highness Vera had rewarded her most generously.
Not only did she recommend her for a judge position within MI9's "Court of Extraordinary Affairs," but she also personally gave her a reward of 5,000 pounds.
—The Court of Extraordinary Affairs was a court specifically tasked with handling Beyonder-related cases, making it the ideal role for someone on the "Judge" pathway.
As for the favor she owed Ebner, that was a private matter between the two of them and wouldn't involve outsiders.
The World carefully observed the emotional colors on Miss Judgment and found that she genuinely believed the trade had been fair. Only then did he nod and say, "Very well... But I'll still give you an extra piece of information. You might find it interesting."
"What information?" Xio asked curiously.
Since it didn't involve a transaction, and was free knowledge, there was no reason to refuse it.
"'Desire Apostle' Jason Beria most likely has another accomplice — someone close to Duke Negan, probably with blond hair," the World said in a deep voice.
This came from the Church of Steam's Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, the silver mirror named "Arrodes," which had suddenly appeared in his dream last night and revealed this piece of information...
That blonde individual wasn't just involved with demons, but was also monitoring Miss Justice's bank accounts...
If the members of the Tarot Club hadn't activated the "Fog Logistics" system early on under Mr. Tower's suggestion, many of them might've already fallen into that person's trap!
Such a person must be reported without hesitation!
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 633: The Commission from Tower
chapters.content:
Chapter 633 - The Commission from Tower
After "World" reported to Miss Judgment about the blonde man who had colluded with demons, he then requested a private conversation with Mr. Tower, feeling uneasy as he inquired about what was needed from the angel who had intervened...
Or rather, what Mr. Tower, who had used a favor to summon the angel, might want in return.
As for this, Ebner had already thought it through. He didn't plan to accept any rewards immediately, considering that just a moment ago, Sequence 6 Klein only had a "Blasphemy Card" in hand, nothing that would truly tempt him.
"Should I just keep a note for now?" controlling "World," Klein both sighed in relief and felt a tangible weight on his shoulders.
After all, being in debt was unpleasant, and the favor of an "angel" was even harder to repay! Especially with someone like Mr. Tower, who seemed to know everything, making it difficult to take advantage of the knowledge imbalance.
"I need to advance in sequences faster... Otherwise, if I can't keep up with Mr. Tower, forget about 'World,' even 'Fool' might lose some prestige!"
"Fortunately, I already have the 'Marionettist' trait, and finding a 'Mermaid' shouldn't be too hard... At least, Sequence 5 shouldn't be an issue."
After motivating himself, Klein lifted the sensory barrier on the others and allowed the Tarot Club to proceed.
"The Hanged Man" Alger looked over to "World" once they finished their private conversation:
"Your 'Werewolf' extraordinary trait was sold. A craftsman bought it... But, as you warned, there might be a 'Rose School Curse' within it, so the price was pushed down again, and it was sold for 1,000 pounds..."
"According to our agreement, I will receive 180 pounds as my reward."
This division wasn't bad, but considering that "The Hanged Man" would also bear some risk, Klein thought for a moment before operating "World" to respond:
"No problem..."
Having just received some money from the "Machinery Hivemind," Klein wasn't concerned about these few hundred pounds.
After all, no amount of money could "buy" the favor of an angel's intervention.
Hearing this, "Justice" Audrey raised her hand and repeated her long-standing request:
"One pair of Mirror Dragon eyes, 50 milliliters of its blood, and the fruit of the Elder Tree..."
She didn't have much hope, since she had been trying to acquire these materials ever since she got the recipe from "The Sun." It had almost been two months by now.
But what she didn't expect was that "The Magician" Miss Fors directly responded:
"I asked my teacher about these materials a few days ago. His reply was that the family still has a 'Mirror Dragon's eyes,' but retrieving them will take some time... It may take one to two weeks."
Since Fors became an apprentice in the Abraham family, our "Tarot Club" has gained another new channel!
Add to that my backing from the "Psychological Alchemy Society," Miss Judgment's ties to MI9, Mr. Sun's connections to the "Forsaken Land," and the potential support from the "True God Church" behind Mr. Tower and The Hanged Man...
Calculating all of this, the knowledge and material channels available to our "Tarot Club" could nearly cover half the extraordinary world!
Audrey, feeling a strong sense of ownership in her thoughts, responded on the surface: "I'm not in a hurry, as long as there's definite news... As for the price, that's not a problem."
"The price is not an issue..." Fors's eyes lit up as she thought to herself, slightly guilty.
After attending so many Tarot gatherings, she had learned a valuable lesson: as Emperor Roselle had said, money isn't omnipotent, but without money, nothing can be done...
Hmm... I can just tell the truth about the price increase, and with Miss Audrey's generosity, she'll surely allow it.
Of course, the most important thing is, I'm not sure I can hide this from a "Telepathist."
Seeing that the new "channel" from the Abraham family was already proving useful, Alger became eager and asked: "Do you have any clues about the 'Ocean Songster' potion recipe?"
"The Magician" Fors shook her head and said, "I asked my teacher a few days ago... but I'm afraid he doesn't have it."
Just as Alger was feeling somewhat disappointed, "Justice" Audrey hesitated and spoke up:
"The 'Psychological Alchemy Society' should have it... But I only just joined, so it's impossible to get a recipe of that level in such a short time... You understand, this isn't something money can solve."
At the Sequence 5 level, Beyonders could already be considered "strong," and even in the major True God Churches, they were pillars of the organization. Recipes at this level certainly wouldn't spread easily, and getting one would likely require completing a task assigned by the organization...
As these thoughts turned in her mind, Alger sighed and didn't press further, only asking Miss Justice to look into what it would cost to obtain the recipe.
Ebner, who had been listening to their conversation, thought to himself that the ladies "Greed" and "Sloth" might have a way to acquire the recipe.
However, he opened his mouth, but in the end, nothing came out. After all, it wasn't appropriate to make any promises without their consent. Even if it might be a trivial task for them, it would still be a favor to him, one that would have to be repaid in the future... After all, he wasn't truly the "Countess's lover."
Moreover, if Edwina can bring back the 'Key of the Northern King,' then exploring the 'Grosel's Travels' will definitely be on the agenda within a month or two... At that point, I could also go find that elf girl in the travelogue to exchange for the formula.
While Ebner was lost in thought, the trading session of the Tarot Club had already concluded and smoothly transitioned into the discussion phase.
"The Magician" Fors glanced around, then cautiously asked, "Ladies and gentlemen, besides the method of having children, do you have any solutions for the issue of too many extraordinary traits of the same level accumulating?"
The "having children" method was something Ebner had suggested to Fors on the first day she returned to Beckland last week when she asked for advice. This method not only took a long time but didn't guarantee success the first time... For lower sequences, it was better to put more effort into "playing" to digest them. And that night, Fors had an absurd dream...
She thought it was just the result of overthinking during the day, so she completely abandoned that idea.
"The Hanged Man" Alger turned to "The Magician" Fors and asked in return, "Did you have to drink the second 'Apprentice' potion?"
How did you guess that immediately... It's as if you saw it in person...
Fors cleared her throat uncomfortably and replied, "Yeah, let's just say that's the case...""Do you have any solutions? What would you like in exchange?"
"Justice" Audrey almost laughed out loud, as she also had a similar experience. When she asked about "pets accidentally consuming potions," she was immediately figured out by "The Hanged Man" and "The Fool" as well... Looking back, she realized how naive she had been back then! Now, she could deceive even the Sequence Beyonders in the "Psychological Alchemy Society" without revealing any flaws...
But why does Fors seem a little shy? With her personality, even if her secret was exposed, she wouldn't show such emotions. What's going on in her mind?
As "Justice" Audrey habitually played the role of the "Telepathist," "The Hanged Man" Alger shook his head and replied, "As far as I know... no! At least not for mid-to-low sequence Beyonders... Of course, using rituals to pray to deities for power is an exception. After all, if a deity were to bestow power, it's not impossible to quickly give birth and separate traits..."
As he spoke, he secretly glanced at "The Fool" Klein.
What are you looking at? "The Fool" Klein doesn't have the ability to make people give birth quickly...
Klein wanted to roll his eyes but restrained himself, tapping the edge of the long table with his finger. He casually added, "The 'Primordial Moon' can do it... but people who pray to it are highly likely to mutate into monsters that only know how to reproduce, along with their offspring."
This served as both a display of prestige and an effort to deepen the Tarot Club members' impression of the "Primordial Moon" being extremely dangerous. After all, even Old Yellow could very well fall into its hands.
The members of the Tarot Club felt a chill in their hearts. "The Magician" Fors forced a smile and said, "I understand. The best solution is still to rely on 'playing' to digest."
Ebner interjected, "Below Sequence 7, it's like this. For mid-sequence, you might want to look into extraordinary items from high-sequence 'Sun' pathways to help 'potions' precipitate."
Of course, having children is also an option. After all, ordinary people don't digest potions as quickly as Tarot Club members. It usually takes years, sometimes even two or three years, or even five or six years... In the original work, the side effect of the man-made death god, being able to stay semi-divine for ten years, was considered a divine blessing level treatment.
There was a brief silence, and this was the first time the others had learned that high-sequence "Sun" Beyonders had such an ability.
For Derek, although the Silver City didn't have the "Sun" pathway formula, the powers of the "Creator" and the "Sun God" were recorded in textbooks, so it didn't seem strange to him at all...
He adjusted his posture and said, "I've been assigned another exploration mission."
"Where to explore?" "The Hanged Man" Alger asked, tilting his head.
"It's still that ruined town with the fallen Creator's temple." Derek answered casually.
After that, "The Hanged Man" shared and taught Derek some mind-blowing "loafer" experiences and "slacking off" tutorials. Ebner looked at the dazed "Sun" and, after thinking for a moment, said, "Mr. Sun, I'd like to ask you for a favor..."
"What favor? If I can do it, I'll definitely help!" Derek snapped out of his daze and replied sincerely. He felt he owed Mr. Tower a lot and had been wanting to repay him for some time.
"Hmm, please investigate carefully when you explore that town and see if there are any traces left by people from other city-states..."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 634: Coincidental Encounter
chapters.content:
Chapter 634 - Coincidental Encounter
"Other city-state's traces left behind?" Derrick repeated the request from Mr. "Tower," feeling awkward. After all, that city had been abandoned for a long time. Even if people from other city-states had arrived and left traces, he wouldn't be able to distinguish whether they were naturally part of the city or whether they were left by visitors from other city-states...
Ebner guessed his difficulty and smiled, adding, "What I mean by traces from other city-states is the kind that is vastly different from the civilization of Silver City and that abandoned city, the kind that one can immediately tell apart."
"Ah, I see... I understand now." Derrick, the "Sun," breathed a sigh of relief, then said seriously, "I'll keep an eye out for you."
"Your own safety comes first. Don't forget Mr. 'Hanged Man's' advice for my sake." Ebner reminded him one last time.
For him, it would be great to find what he "predicted," but if not, it was no big deal... After all, it wasn't a necessity.
"Got it." Derrick responded verbally, but in his heart, he had already decided to carefully investigate that ruined city when he explored it.
And this didn't contradict the "trick" Mr. "Hanged Man" shared, as he had said, once entering the temple, "Don't look at what you shouldn't, don't listen to what you shouldn't, don't eat what you shouldn't, and don't touch what you shouldn't..."
The city ruins were not part of the temple.
As for Mr. "Tower's" request for Mr. "Sun," "Justice," "Hanged Man," and the others were curious but didn't speak up, since it was clear from Mr. "Tower's" appearance that he didn't want to talk more about it.
After the topic passed, Arje looked towards the several ladies opposite him, especially "Justice" and "Judgment," and asked:
"I'd like to know about the political changes in Backlund after Duke Negan's death."
"Also, do you think the risk of war will rise because of this?"
When he had just joined the Tarot Society, he had asked Miss "Justice" to investigate whether the kingdom would go to war with Feysac... The result he got was that Ruen wasn't prepared yet and had no war intentions.
—This information had come from Susie's eavesdropping in the Earl's study.
Audrey recalled the recent information she had directly or indirectly heard:
"Duke Negan's death has caused a split in the Upper House. Although his eldest son is about to inherit the title and become a member of the Upper House, his prestige is not enough to quell the disputes."
"Almost ten members of the Upper House jointly proposed that newly ennobled nobles should also have the opportunity to obtain fixed seats."
"Simply put, it means that those who were ennobled through political donations, charitable contributions, and the purchase of corresponding land should become members of the Upper House."
"As for the war... I think the actions of the 'Aurora Order' who took the full blame have already sent out a sufficiently strong signal."
"Judgment" also added, "MI9 failed to capture Bianca, the military attaché at the Intis embassy who was impersonating Mrs. Parnis..."
"But this still doesn't conceal the fact that Baron Larry was funded by Feysac... Although the Envoy Owen repeatedly stated that it was merely the private actions of a defected military officer."
"However, from my judgment, Feysac will probably only send out one more sufficiently 'important' person to 'take the fall,' and this matter will be resolved."
"Given the pressure from Feysac, the kingdom cannot really afford to fall out with Intis."
Upon hearing this, "Hanged Man" Arje sighed with relief, murmuring, "There won't be a war in the short term," before sarcastically commenting on the Upper House's proposal:
"Aren't nobles with a certain history the ones who despise these people who were ennobled through improper means? Their greatest pride and the final glory should be the hereditary and fixed seats in the Upper House, right?"
"Justice" Audrey, however, was not bothered and calmly brought up another topic:
"Fortunately, although the disputes in the parliament have delayed many proposals, including but not limited to raising workers' wages, improving labor hours, and revising the 'Poverty Relief Law,' Mr. 'Fool's' proposal for a unified examination for government employees is still steadily advancing without stopping! Hmm, the investigation into Backlund's air pollution situation is also progressing."
Clearly, the main event of the "Black Emperor" ceremony was what had been delayed! A set of rigorous and complicated rules, yet contradictory to normal circumstances? George III clearly intended to wait until the heavy fog and haze cleared, and when pressured by the church, he would agree in due course... This approach could greatly avoid suspicion from the church... although all the true gods knew perfectly well...
Ebner quietly shook his head
, but he felt that George III's "deification" path might not go as smoothly as in the original text... After all, that person who had transmigrated as the "Disaster Seal" clearly knew the plot, and even if Roselle only heard fragments, he wouldn't have failed to make arrangements.
...
After returning to reality, Xio removed her disguise and left the safe house, heading towards the MI9 headquarters at 9 Belotto Street, West Borough.
She intended to report the blond man, who was reported by Mr. "World," to her superior, Princess Vera.
However, just as she entered the yard, she saw Princess Vera talking to a middle-aged man with a white wig from across the lawn.
Xio recognized him.
He had once been her father's assistant and was currently the head of the palace guards, Viscount Stafford.
Before meeting Ebner, Xio had always believed that this was the only viscount who had been promoted in her father's case and might have framed her father. He was likely her enemy.
But now, Xio didn't think so anymore...
After all, could a mere head of palace guards make Ebner wary? Even if he was somehow connected to her father's death, he would at most be a secondary figure.
Thinking this, Xio casually turned her gaze away and walked toward the princess's office, intending to wait there for her return.
Several minutes later, after hearing Xio's report, Princess Vera took out a portrait and said, "This is a new task assigned to us by the higher-ups, brought by the head of palace guards personally... So, other matters must be put aside for now."
Xio glanced at the portrait, noticing that it was of a man with soft features and a bronze complexion.
Below the portrait was a brief description: ... History department faculty...
"What about the 'blond man' who's in cahoots with demons?" Xio's eyes swept across the portrait but she didn't give up on the matter Mr. "World" reported.
"You have no evidence... and we can't spare manpower to investigate right now..." At this point, Princess Vera changed the subject, then smiled, "However, I can pass this on to the Prime Minister. I'm sure he'd be more than willing to investigate."
Upon hearing this, Xio relaxed slightly and then carefully studied the portrait, asking, "What crime did this man commit? Why did even the head of palace guards come here?"
"I'm not sure of the specifics... but it seems he broke into Soderak Palace!"
...
In the capital of the Rorsted Archipelago, the City of Generosity.
Arje Wilson stepped out of the hotel and headed towards the underground trading market at the "Fragrant Tree Leaf Tavern."
After the Beyonder merchant "Strongman" Ozil died due to divine punishment, and this Beyonder marketplace changed ownership, its reputation had been growing, and the level of Beyonder items had improved significantly.
This was partly due to the presence of "Appraisers" and "Notaries," but also because the "Sea Serpent" Weaver was particularly good at managing.
This time, the behind-the-scenes "Appraiser" and "Notary" released several pages of "Roselle's Notes" for sale...
This was something Arje absolutely couldn't miss! It was a must-have item to please Mr. "Fool"!
Of course, if any materials that Miss "Justice" needed appeared, he wouldn't hesitate to buy them.
After all, buying on behalf of that lady would never be a loss.
...
In Backlund's East Borough, Ebner left his residence on Black Palm Street, carrying the prepared teaching materials, heading towards the free school just a few meters away from the district boundary.
However, as soon as he crossed the school gate, he saw a familiar face walking towards him.
It was a person dressed in a black robe with a hood, wearing blue eyeshadow and blush, exuding an otherworldly beauty.
It was Ms. Daly.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 635: The Spread of Stuart’s Secret Arts
chapters.content:
Chapter 635 - The Spread of Stuart's Secret Arts
Miss Daly? What is she doing at the free school? Did some extraordinary incident occur here?
Though Ebner was puzzled, he outwardly put on a look of surprise, glancing at Miss Daly several times.
After all, the school was close to the East Borough, and women as beautiful and well-dressed as her were rare around here. Sneaking a look was only natural.
Sure enough, Miss Daly suspected nothing, completely ignored Ebner, and stepped into a carriage by the roadside that bore the emblem of the Church of Evernight.
Ebner only turned around and walked into the school after watching the carriage leave, heading to his office.
The four students were already waiting inside.
Very few people were willing to teach at the free school, so a unique teaching model had developed there. The teacher would arrive early, gather a few of the top students, pass on the day's lesson to them, and then those students would teach their respective classes. The teacher would patrol between classrooms to supervise and correct mistakes. This was known as the tutor system.
After Ebner had assumed his current identity and applied to teach at the school funded by the Church of Evernight, he had met with the four top-performing students and memorized their names.
There were three boys and one girl. Their clothes were worn but clean and tidy, and they were all polite.
The only girl was named Daisy. She was the daughter of the laundry worker who had been rescued during the Capim case by the hero bandit Black Emperor.
Of course, with Aetris's help, her family had already moved out of the East Borough, though they still worked in the laundry trade.
Ebner checked over the homework he had assigned earlier, then casually asked, "Did something happen at school?"
Otherwise, why would a Nighthawk show up...
"Yes, sir. A lady just came by. She was a bishop from the Church," a thirteen or fourteen-year-old boy with faint freckles on his face answered respectfully.
His name was Baker—a very common name, especially here in Backlund.
"What was she here for?" Ebner asked.
"I'm not sure... the principal was the one who met with her..." Baker thought for a moment, then pointed to the girl beside him and said, "Oh, right. She seemed to have called Daisy over and asked her something privately."
Ebner turned his gaze to Daisy at those words.
He wasn't worried about appearing nosy—after all, it was perfectly natural to ask about a beautiful woman.
Daisy looked a little confused. "I... I just remember that Miss Daly's perfume smelled really nice, and then... then everything felt hazy. I didn't even notice what she was asking me..."
She lowered her head, embarrassed.
She used spirit mediumship, huh? And only on Daisy—so it's not about something that happened at the school... Is she still investigating the hero bandit Black Emperor?
But judging from what I just saw through the Professor's Sight, Miss Daly seems to have emerged from her grief... there's not even a trace of sorrow in her emotions... instead, there's a bit of longing...
Professor's Sight
was a secret art Ebner had recently begun experimenting with. It combined Spirit Vision, Mind Reading, and the Desire Perception he had learned from the Magic Mirror, allowing him to observe emotional and mental changes more precisely and thoroughly.
And because it incorporated traits of a demon, this secret art was extremely covert, nearly impossible for Beyonders of the same level to detect—even those with sharp spiritual senses.
Given the kind of fierce love Daly had for Dunn in the original work—willing to risk her life for vengeance—I can rule out the possibility that she's fallen out of love...
So... has she confirmed that Dunn is still alive? Did she dig up the grave?I wonder if Dunn came back to see her after parting ways with Closfia...But knowing Dunn's personality, he'd probably be worried that his presence would only cause her trouble, wouldn't he?
With these thoughts swirling in his mind, Ebner pulled out the lesson plan and began teaching the day's material to his four top students.
.....
At 15 Minsk Street, not long after the Tarot Club meeting ended, Miss Sharon—her face pale and her features delicate—knocked on Klein's window.
Seeing the quiet Miss Temperance sitting across from him, Klein smiled before she could say anything.
"This is the payment I owe you for the Deep Sea Naga hair, plus the protection fee for the past two days—500 pounds in total."
After speaking, he took out two stacks of cash from his coat pocket.
Since the 1,000 pounds promised by Machinery Hivemind hadn't come through yet, Klein had owed Sharon money last week. Now that he had received payment from Mr. Hanged Man for selling the Werewolf characteristic, he naturally wanted to pay her back.
Sharon stared quietly at him, then only took 200 pounds from the stack and shook her head.
"I didn't make a move this time, so you don't need to pay me..."
"Bodyguards are paid by the day! I know what you mean—you're saying we're friends now, so you don't want to worry about payment anymore.
"But this is just a token of appreciation from me as a friend." Klein smiled as he offered the rest of the money again.
Sharon glanced at him, then finally reached out and took it.
With a pale hand, she flipped her palm, and the cash vanished without a trace. Then, in a drifting, ethereal voice, she asked:
"You didn't mention the underground ruins with the evil spirit at the Tarot Club, did you?"
"I only described the situation in the main hall, then Mr. Tower told me part of the history from the Dual Chancellor Era of the Fourth Epoch... I told you about that before." Klein didn't ask why Sharon brought this up, and simply thought aloud.
I even found out that Trunsoest became the Arbiter and Tudor became the Red Priest... But that information was sold separately to Miss Justice by Tower, so technically the World wouldn't know. That's why I haven't told you yet,
Klein added to himself with some regret.
He still remembered that when he had first explained this knowledge—what had appeared in the Tarot Club—to Sharon, she had listened intently with her chin propped on one hand. She seemed to enjoy watching plays and hearing all sorts of legends.
Sharon raised her head and gave a short "mm" in response.
"Someone is digging a tunnel to the underground ruins."
Someone is digging a tunnel, trying to get into that underground structure?
Thanks to the context of the earlier question, Klein immediately realized what she was referring to.
He pondered for a few seconds and asked,"That... Baron something? I think his name was Pound?"
He remembered the man was a descendant of the Tudors and lived on Siviras Street, where the Backlund Police Department was located. When he went to interrogate him back then, he'd almost been tricked.
"Mm." Sharon confirmed it.
"What is he trying to find? Doesn't he know there's an evil spirit in there? Doesn't he know their previous Beyonders all died inside?" Klein muttered a few questions to himself.
Sharon sat calmly and answered earnestly.
"I don't know whether he knows or not."
"...How long until he finishes digging?" Klein asked after some thought.
"Two to three months. He's working alone for now," Sharon estimated.
Whew. Klein let out a small sigh of relief.
"Then there's no rush. Once I'm ready, we'll go 'visit' him together."
At this point, he suddenly realized Sharon's earlier question had another meaning.
"You want to inform the Tarot Club about this? Invite Tower or Judgment to go together?"
"Yes. Tower is very likely already a demigod. With him, the danger could be minimized." Because she had identified Judgment as Hugh, Sharon had long suspected that Tower was Ebner.
But after the recent Desire Apostle incident, she wasn't so sure anymore.
After all, just half a year ago, the "Hero Detective" was still just a Sequence 9.
Mr. Tower definitely hasn't become a demigod. Of that, I'm sure... But he probably has demigod-level means!
Although Klein thought this to himself, on the surface he hesitated for a moment before agreeing to Sharon's suggestion and decided to try inviting Mr. Tower to go with them.
I just wonder if sharing a Fourth Epoch ruin could help offset a bit of the favor I owe that angel...
.....
After returning home, Daly pulled all the curtains shut and began setting up a ritual. Finally, she placed a mirror at the center of the altar.
It was a secret art she had learned from Stuart, one that allowed her to pray to the Sealed Artifact "2-111" from the Church of Steam.
"Executioner of Thunder, Notary of Contracts, Magic Mirror that opens the All-Seeing Eye, humble servant of the great master, Arrodes...
"I pray that your power descends upon this mirror;
"I pray that your knowledge brings me the answers I seek..."
After chanting the incantation, she used spirituality to ignite a piece of parchment with her question written on it, letting the ashes scatter across the altar.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 636: Daly and Arrodes
chapters.content:
Chapter 636 - Daly and Arrodes
The question Daly wrote on the paper was: "How was Dunn Smith resurrected?"
She had cleverly avoided asking, "Has Dunn already been resurrected?"—after all, she hadn't found Dunn's body, so she couldn't be completely certain he was really alive again.
But ever since she saw the eyes of "Iron Man," she instinctively felt he was her Dunn, so she was quite confident.
And according to Stuart, as long as the premise was reasonably reliable, "2-111" usually wouldn't be too strict about it.
Very soon, the mirror placed on the altar began to display a series of images, showing a man with a long, narrow face digging up Dunn's corpse, placing it in a burlap sack, taking it to a villa, and then reviving him with the help of a "stone."
"It was Doctor Strange! It really was Doctor Strange!
"And more importantly, Dunn... he really has been resurrected!
"He is Iron Man!"
Daly couldn't contain her excitement. Her face was clearly lit up with a radiant smile, but tears streamed uncontrollably down her cheeks.
But... why didn't he come to find me after he came back?
He should know I would never report him...
Was it the organization that revived him that wouldn't allow it?
Or... was he afraid of dragging down my 'promising future,' and didn't dare to appear before me again?
Heh, maybe I guessed right... that really does sound like something Dunn would do...
Her thoughts spun quickly. Daly turned her gaze to the mirror on the altar again, curious about what kind of question it would ask in return.
When Stuart had taught her this secret ritual, he'd mentioned that although the surface rules of the ritual let one bypass some of "2-111's" restrictions—like not having to answer in front of others, and even though you still had to speak the answer out loud, you could do it somewhere private or soundproof—
In reality, whether this trick would work all depended on "2-111's" mood. If it was in a good mood, it would follow the ritual's rules. But if it was in a bad mood, or just wanted to mess with you, it could even "hypnotize" you into fulfilling its demands.
And those "demands" weren't limited to just saying the answer out loud... According to Stuart, Kuhn, the former captain of the Backlund Mandated Punisher squad, had once publicly shown off his bodybuilder physique in front of the whole team...
That sealed artifact just seems to enjoy watching people make fools of themselves... But I'm not afraid of being embarrassed...
Besides, since I came to investigate that free school anyway, I specifically rented this place in East Borough for the time being. There's no one familiar around here...
Thinking this to herself, Daly calmly looked at the mirror, which had stopped showing images and began revealing words.
But after just one glance, her expression twisted.
"What desires did 'Iron Man' uncontrollably experience while cohabiting with Miss 'Sloth'?
Please say the answer out loud.
