Seeing Ebner's gaze, Fors blushed slightly as memories of the moment before teleporting flashed through her mind. She stammered out a retelling of what had just happened, only omitting the part about receiving a "gift." She claimed the item had been purchased at a previous gathering of Beyonders.
So it was my fault after all... but the 'Flesh Trigger' is usually well-behaved—why would it deliberately scare Fors?
Thinking this, Ebner sat up, changed into his outdoor clothes, and said to Fors, who was still sprawled on the bed:
"We're heading back to the theater now. Your item should be safe in that big cat's paw."
As he spoke, he glanced at Fors's rather indecent posture, cleared his throat, and added, "You should get up too. It feels a bit strange talking like this..."
Fors had already turned her head away when he started changing clothes. Hearing this, she hurriedly stood and headed for the door.
But she was stopped by Ebner, who reached out an arm to block her path.
"What is it?" Fors turned back, puzzled.
Even though my reputation is already bad enough, I should still avoid any unnecessary misunderstandings if I can help it.
Ebner sighed inwardly, then simply explained, "I'll teleport you back myself."
With that, he grabbed Fors and simulated the teleportation ability he had learned from the herded "Recorder."
Although it was only a lower-tier version, the distance from Kingster Street to the Hillston Borough would normally only take about ten minutes by carriage—well within its range.
Very soon, Ebner brought Fors back to the theater's lavatory, and to their surprise, the "Lion" Leon was still waiting there.
After re-establishing the Wall of Spirituality, Ebner asked Leon to return the "Flesh Trigger" to Fors.
However, "Lion" Leon didn't agree immediately. It gave Fors a few curious glances before suddenly speaking, "I heard you're the author of a best-selling novel?"
"Huh? Oh... yes..." Though Ebner had briefly introduced Leon to her earlier, Fors was still surprised to see a talking orange cat.
"Then I want to commission a piece from you. You must write an article that satisfies me, as payment for keeping that extraordinary item safe for you." Leon swayed its head dramatically as it spoke.
"What would you like me to write?" Fors asked cautiously after recovering from her surprise.
"Relax, just a few stories about Roselle..."
...
Aboard the
White Agate
, inside the first-class cabin Danitz had paid for, the 3,000-pound gentleman had just returned to the sitting area after washing his clothes when he suddenly noticed a radiogram operating on its own in the dim, moonlit room. The paper it was printing appeared phantom-like.
—This was something Gehrman had left here earlier? Why is it running on its own? Flames condensed in Danitz's palm as he carefully approached, ready to call out to Gehrman Sparrow in the master bedroom at the first sign of danger.
—Thanks to Miss Sharon's efficiency, Klein had acquired the radio telegraph much earlier than in the original timeline.
As Danitz neared the radio device and saw several Ancient Feysac words spelling out "Hello" on the illusory white paper, he couldn't help but ask, "Who are you?"
"My name is Arrodes.
"In exchange, you must answer a question for me," the white paper printed out two more lines of text.
A question? Why does this strange radiogram have the same weird quirk as that eccentric Doctor who likes to pretend...? Only, the latter preferred others to ask
him
questions. Danitz was now extremely on guard, but he cleared his throat and said aloud:
"You can ask, but I may not answer."
When dealing with things like
you
, the best course is to ignore them altogether.The radiogram fell silent for several seconds before it began clicking again. Another length of ghostly paper was printed, with reddish-colored words:
"Did you know that after Edwina picked up the love letter you wrote, she corrected a few of your grammar mistakes?"
...
When Gehrman Sparrow—aka Klein—entered the sitting room, the first thing he saw was Danitz standing there with a thoroughly
wrecked
expression on his face.
Just then, accompanied by rhythmic clicking, the radio telegraph produced another strip of white paper. This time, it bore two neat and elegant lines in Loenese:
"Your loyal and humble servant, Arrodes, is honored to once again follow in your footsteps, always awaiting the chance to serve."
Arrodes? That mirror that worships the ground I walk on actually found me again?
Klein pondered for a moment, then turned to Danitz and said:
"Go wait outside the door."
"...Understood!" Danitz bolted to the door without hesitation.
He was terrified that the devil named Arrodes might ask
another
question!
Once Danitz stepped out into the corridor and closed the door, Klein stood silently for a moment longer before turning toward the radio telegraph linked to Arrodes. He began to inquire about the whereabouts of the "Mermaid" and finally received the answer:
the ruins of the gods' war
.
Having obtained the result he wanted, Klein originally intended to end the conversation there. But suddenly, something came to mind. After a moment's consideration, he cautiously asked:
"Arrodes, do you know Liu Bo?"
At the mention of that name, Arrodes fell silent for a long time. Finally, it responded ambiguously:
"Honorable Master, may I ask you to change the question?
"'Liu Bo' is a name that in itself is a taboo. Without Their permission, merely knowing it can lead to inexplicable corruption...
"You and Roselle are permitted to know, within accepted bounds...
"But I am not..."
Although the characters "Liu Bo" were blacked out completely on the paper, Klein knew exactly which two characters they were meant to be.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 726: Departure
chapters.content:
Chapter 726 - Departure
"Merely knowing could cause 'corruption'? Sounds like this fellow transmigrator 'Liu Bo' has quite the prestige... This must be power only a true deity could wield."
Klein reflected on his mysticism knowledge. The honorific names and true names of angels—even deities—could leverage certain natural forces. This amounted to borrowing "mystique" and "power" from them... of course, provided they consented... Without consent, it would incur their wrath.
For instance, I once considered using the mystical connection of the "Demoness" card to have a spirit engrave the true name and leverage the power of "The Primordial Demoness" Cheek, the only deity whose true name I know... But after some thought, I deemed it too dangerous and didn't proceed... Because the more likely outcome was that while engraving the honorific and true names, "The Primordial Demoness" would descend her power and drain me dry on the spot... After all, this constitutes an extremely precise supernatural targeting...
Liu Bo's situation was probably similar—those he permitted might know, while others faced "corruption".
Hmm, this so-called "corruption" must be a manifestation of his power, right? His origins are clearly extraordinary!
But when did he permit me to know?
Pondering this, Klein recalled the medium through which he learned of Liu Bo—Roselle's diaries—and suddenly had an epiphany. "Of course. The 'Calamity Seal' stayed by Roselle's side for so long; it must have known about his habit of writing diaries in Chinese... And since the 'Calamity Seal' didn't stop Roselle from writing about 'Liu Bo,' it naturally permitted anyone who could read Chinese to have the right to know!"
Klein initially wanted to ask how Liu Bo's "corruption" manifested, but his spiritual intuition sensed that "Arrodes" was genuinely terrified of questions related to him. Instead, adopting Gehrman Sparrow's tone, he asked, "Then I'll change the question: Where can I obtain the potion formula for 'Bizarro Sorcerer'?"
The name "Bizarro Sorcerer" came from the "Red Angel" evil spirit beneath Williams Street. Now that he possessed the "Marionettist" characteristic and knew how to purge its mental corruption, Klein naturally needed the subsequent formula.
The telegraph machine spat out an unusually long stretch of paper filled with complex symbols, forming a mirror-like surface that displayed a dark hall containing a writhing, indistinct mass. Arrodes appended an explanation:
"This is Zaratul. He lost control during his advancement to Sequence 1 'Attendant of Mysteries'... You cannot obtain the formula from any Secret Order demigod, as Zaratul directly provided high-sequence potions back then."
Such a detailed answer—and it even revealed that Sequence 1 of the "Seer" pathway is "Attendant of Mysteries"... An angel serving the Lord of Mysteries? So the only way is confronting Zaratul directly... and I can't even look at him properly...
Klein was momentarily moved by Arrodes' help. Were he more capable, he might have accepted it as a true servant.
Next, Arrodes showed the Antigonus treasure in Hornacis Mountain and their notebook in Backlund's St. Samuel's Church—both painfully familiar to Klein.
After all this time, everything circles back to the beginning!
When Klein asked about the "Dreamland Labyrinth Tower," Arrodes replied: "Like me, it cannot directly disclose demigod-level formulas... only clues."
Similar to Arrodes indeed—one requires clearing challenges for knowledge, the other demands answering embarrassing questions... Though the Tower has more... punitive measures.
"Hmm," Klein acknowledged before stating, "Your turn to ask."
The machine printed a smiley face. "I've already asked, and you've answered."
This... Being flattered really does feel good!
Though he'd anticipated it, Klein couldn't help but compare this to the miserable experiences of "Machinery Hivemind" senior deacon Ikanser, feeling a wave of satisfaction.
His eyes flicked to the earlier questions on the paper: "Might you ask another question?" and "Are you referring to the 'Dreamland Labyrinth Tower' created by Roselle?"
So that's where the Q&A happened... This thing's rules are quite subjective...
Before Klein could speak again, Arrodes suddenly clattered out another message:
"The aura above the spirit world is fading. I await my next opportunity to serve you, my great master."
With this final transmission, the wireless telegraph machine fell silent, losing its eerie, profound atmosphere.
To contact Arrodes again, I'd need to leave the telegraph on the gray fog for days?
Klein immediately grasped the core issue but also recognized the risks—after all, numerous entities watched for traces of the "gray fog," from the distant "True Creator" to potential nearby threats like the "Primordial Demoness" and the "Visionary Angel" behind the "Twilight Hermit Order," whose plans he'd disrupted.
At least the Earth Mother and Blood Emperor who seem to have "invested" in me hold little influence at sea...
Fortunately, with "Creeping Hunger" and "Burial Blade," I've gained some self-preservation capability.
Turning to the earlier exchange between Arrodes and Danitz, Klein barely suppressed a smirk, taking a quiet deep breath.
"...So it revealed all the little schemes he'd hidden from Edwina?"
"He must realize that new 'Grammar' lectures by Talim on the Golden Dream were added because the 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' found his love letter?"
Maintaining his persona, Klein glanced toward the cabin door where Danitz had returned, likely hoping to "dispose of the evidence" from those questions.
.....
Wednesday Noon, Backlund Steam Train Station
On the platform, Ebner, Fors, the disguised Fanny and Helene, and the orange cat "Leon" waited to board, while Xio, Hazel, Aetris, and the Scards came to see them off.
—Emlyn was absent; his friendship with Ebner wasn't close enough to justify skipping his "funding acquisition" from the vampires.
Fors had joined the trip to Intis last-minute. Having heard of her procrastination habits, Leon insisted she stay nearby to complete their commissioned novel before release. Though reluctant, Fors agreed after an emergency—learning the "Flesh Trigger" required 50kg of meat daily forced her to beg Ebner for a teleport to Pritz to deliver the artifact to her mentor Dorian. Surprisingly, this led to a mission in an Intis border town, making the journey a chance to earn money, complete tasks, and perform "tricks" to digest her potion.
As for Fanny, with the Surry family abandoning their Loen assets, leaving Ebner's protection posed risks. Her enemy Johnson had also returned to Trier, making the Intis trip her safest option.
Choo-choo!
The steam whistle blew as the locomotive's boiler heated up. After farewells, Ebner's group boarded their first-class compartment.
Without electric lighting, passenger trains halted at dusk, forcing an overnight stop at Buekenburg before reaching Linster City by Thursday night. Beyond Linster, two more days of travel would bring them to Toscok—the border city where the "Vice Admiral Iceberg" awaited, and where the Surry family had first settled under Roselle's arrangement.
.....
Meanwhile, Linster City Outskirts
In a Gothic castle, a bloodless hand received a letter from a messenger.
"Ambush detective Ebner Bright's group in West Balam?"
Sulfur-scented flames consumed the paper to ashes.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 727: Storm
chapters.content:
Chapter 727 - Storm
"The Nois family actually wants me to send people after a Mid-Sequence detective? Even if that detective is a favored of the Earth Mother, it still doesn't make sense... What are they really after?"
The owner of the pale hand pondered briefly after burning the letter, then opened his lips and sent out a stream of demonic incantations that traveled to an extremely distant place.
Several minutes later, as if receiving a reply, the corners of the pale hand's owner's lips curled into a mocking smile, and he muttered silently:
"So that's it. A certain item created by Roselle, similar to the sealed artifact Lord Yaldabaoth once bestowed upon Andariel—the same artifact that repelled the Nois family's 'Blood Archduke'—is currently in that detective's hands...
"And inside that item, there's even a remnant of a 'Demon' characteristic...
"Heh, this is worth handling personally!
"However, to be cautious, I'll first send those old fossils of the family to test whether that detective has some hidden backing."
With that thought, the owner of the pale hand opened his lips again and sent his voice to several elders of the Beria family, who were prolonging their lives through deep slumber.
.....
On the outskirts of Trier, capital of Intis, in the castle-style estate of the Delion Family.
A handsome middle-aged man had been savoring his favorite Mist Champagne in his room when, without warning, he collapsed painfully to the floor. He murmured incomprehensible words, his expensive drink spilling across the floor.
It was a while before he finally got up, pale-faced, quietly cleaned up the mess, retrieved an amulet from a drawer and hung it around his neck, then turned and walked calmly out of his room. He headed to the top floor of the castle and knocked on the door of a study.
"Come in," a deep voice called from inside.
The middle-aged man pushed open the door and respectfully saluted the elder sitting on the sofa.
"Father, just as expected, that one from the Beria family extracted information from me using 'Whispers' just now..."
The old man raised his head and scrutinized him for a moment. Noticing nothing abnormal about the amulet he wore, he nodded slightly and asked, "That one didn't suspect that you've broken free from their control?"
The middle-aged man shook his head. "That one never believed me to begin with... But the intel I leaked wasn't falsified—just not the full truth."
"That's reasonable. After all, that one is a 'Whisperer'... Heh. With a 'Demon' characteristic and a fully-unsealed artifact strong enough to rival an angel as bait, even if that one could hold back, the other elders of Beria certainly couldn't," the old man chuckled.
"Indeed. That once-angelic family now has no demigods aside from that patriarch. Even a Sequence 5 can be a family elder... The Beria family has fallen that far," the handsome man sighed. "In contrast, the Andariel family, hidden in Feysac, is far stronger."
"If it hadn't been for the help of Roselle's adopted son—that terrifying duke—Andariel wouldn't even have matched Beria back then..." The old man's voice trailed off, then his expression shifted abruptly. He changed the subject mid-sentence. "But we can't place too much trust in Beria's capability... You'll personally lead a team to Lynn City and ensure the death of Ebner Bryan and his companions.
"Also, someone recently spotted Vice Admiral Iceberg in Tosque, though it's unclear if she's already left... On your return, check the area. If she's still there, kill her or turn her into a marionette."
"Yes, Father." The middle-aged man seemed to sense something and bowed before leaving.
Once he was gone, the old man stood up, opened a hidden door behind the wardrobe, and entered a room prepared with an altar and numerous complex symbols.
He first readied offerings—heart, blood, brain, and other components—then knelt and devoutly chanted:
"Master of blood and desire, symbol of evil and terror, favored of the God of Derangement, controller of the Blood Worship Cult—Earl von Nois...
"I pray for your descent..."
As the ritual progressed, the altar began to glow with crimson light. Then, the brain, heart, and blood converged into a humanoid silhouette atop the altar.
"Welcome to this world, great 'Blood Archduke'," the old man prostrated himself and kissed the ground at the feet of the figure formed from sacrificial parts.
"How is the matter progressing?" The figure ignored the flattery and got straight to the point.
"I've already instructed the Beria family to ambush that detective... Owen also sent word that he's successfully gained control of the 'White Saintess' and is using her to lure in 'Vice Admiral of Ailment' Tracy. There should be no chance of failure.
"Furthermore, he's very confident in turning Princess Vera of Loen into his puppet... As for that other one, the Military Intelligence 9 agent named Xio Derecha, without Vera's protection, she should be easy to eliminate as well," the old man reported.
"Well done... The 'God of Derangement' once decreed that all who have entered the 'Daniel Maze' are sinners and must be severely punished! Unless they surrender their 'hearts' to the God, they are to be executed without exception... If this operation succeeds, the God will not be stingy with rewards!" The figure on the altar paused, then asked another question. "Is the sea monster's sacrifice ready?"
"Please forgive my sin... It's just that Loen has taken a lot of our slave business in recent years, and the latest batch of slaves was intercepted by the ship of 'Admiral of Stars'..." The old man pressed his forehead to the ground, trembling as he spoke.
But before he could finish, the figure on the altar cut him off. "I don't want your excuses. If you can't gather enough offerings by April 10th, then use members of the Delion Family to make up the shortfall!"
"Yes, Your Grace!" The old man breathed a sigh of relief. After all, nearly three months remained—it shouldn't be a problem.
"Good... I must continue my pursuit of Yaldabaoth. I won't be responding again in the short term. I hope next time we meet, you'll bring good news."
With those words, the figure on the altar collapsed instantly into foul-smelling blood sludge.
"Farewell, 'Blood Archduke'!" The old man remained prostrated for a long time before rising. Only after personally restoring the altar to its original state did he head to the bathroom to cleanse himself of the filth.
By the time he had finished bathing and was dressed with the help of his maids, he descended to the first-floor reception room, where his secretary hurried up to him and reported:
"Prime Minister, there's been a large-scale protest in the Lishe District against the government's newly issued speech restrictions and press censorship...
"Lord Soren requests a meeting with you to discuss the matter..."
The old man—none other than Charles Delion, the current Prime Minister of the Republic of Intis—glanced solemnly at his watch and said to his secretary, "At ten o'clock sharp, I will convene an emergency session of Parliament.
"I'll speak with Soren half an hour before the meeting...
"Go notify the party representatives."
"Yes, Prime Minister." The secretary replied seriously, made a note in the schedule, then turned and left.
After he was gone, Charles looked out at the gloomy weather and muttered to himself:
"A storm is coming!"
.....
Night fell over Bayam. The sky was pitch black, the wind howled, and torrential rain poured down as though the apocalypse were upon them.
Klein, who had just arrived in this generous city, pulled out the crystal stone crafted by Ebner and inserted it into the hilt of his blade under the cover of the storm, transforming it into the
Burial Blade
.
Then, as he rose slowly to his feet, thinking of what he was about to do, he couldn't help but feel the sense of playing a new role in another sense. Smiling faintly, he murmured in a low voice:
"Tonight, Gehrman joins the hunt."
As he finished speaking, he swung the
Burial Blade
in a wide arc, making Danitz—who witnessed it all—feel that this lunatic had become even more insane...
He couldn't help but doubt whether this plan to hunt down "Iron" Maveti, the First Mate of the
Blood Admiral
's flagship, would really succeed.
.....
Elsewhere, on Thursday evening, the train carrying Ebner and his companions pressed through the storm and arrived at the steam train station of Lynn City, a small town in the western part of the Siviras County.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 728: Lynn City and the Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 728 - Lynn City and the Demon
In the central region of the Northern Continent, at the origin of the Hornacis Mountain Range, there lay a dry highland. Most of it belonged to the Kingdom of Feynapot, the western edge was under the Republic of Intis, and the eastern side was occupied by the Kingdom of Loen. The indigenous people of the highlands were lean, savage, yet fiercely brave in battle. For a long time, they were one of the biggest headaches for all three nations. But as gunpowder weapons improved and the nature of warfare evolved, the highlanders eventually came to terms with reality and fully submitted.
Lynn City sat right at the junction between the eastern plains and the highlands. It was named after the nearby Lynn Volcano and had developed into a city relying on natural resources and tourism.
The natural resources referred to sulfur ore and the fertile soil formed by volcanic ash. The former was a vital industrial raw material in the age of machinery, while the latter made Lynn's cash crops famous far and wide.
As for tourism, it thrived on the many hot spring pools scattered among the mountains.
In fact, the name "Lynn" itself was taken from the name the highlanders once gave to the goddess of springwater they worshipped...
Of course, with such favorable conditions, the area was now completely under Loen control. At least, after Ebner and the others disembarked from the train, they barely saw any of the true highland natives—those wiry, dark-skinned folk with significantly deeper-set eyes than ordinary Loen citizens.
"Ebner, can we stay at a hot spring inn tonight?" After writing her novel all day on the train, Fors seemed to finally come back to life, asking eagerly.
Ebner, who was holding an umbrella on the surface but actually using it as cover to isolate the ladies from the rain with his "Water Control" ability, had seemed distracted since getting off the train. Upon hearing Fors's question, he narrowed his eyes slightly, then curved his lips into a smile. "Of course."
Helene and Fanny had no objections either. After a long journey, they were also quite eager to soak in a hot spring and unwind.
As for "Lion" Leon, who had transformed into an orange tabby cat, he was currently batting away a stray cat that had tried to approach him, looking completely indifferent to their conversation.
This made the three ladies—who knew his true identity—somewhat speechless:
You're a lion bullying a cat?
Only Ebner gave the stray cat a glance before quickly looking away. Then he hailed a passing horse-drawn cab.
"Sir, ladies, welcome to Lynn. Where would you like to go?" the cab driver greeted them politely, eyeing their attire.
He had typical Loen features, though his thin build and darker complexion suggested he might be of mixed heritage.
"Do you have any recommendations for a quiet hot spring inn?" Ebner asked casually, as if without much thought.
The cab driver's eyes flickered, but he replied with a smile, "I recommend
Whispering Grace
. It's neither too far nor too close to the city center—very peaceful, and it won't delay your return to the train station tomorrow morning. It's a high-end establishment, with excellent spring water. I'm sure it will suit your status and satisfy both you and your ladies."
"Sounds good. Let's go there." Ebner didn't offer any further explanation. He simply handed the man a £1 note. "Keep the change. Consider it a tip."
And also your funeral fee...
That last line, he didn't say aloud.
Once the three ladies and one cat were inside the carriage and it began to roll forward through the rain, the stray cat that had been watching them ran into a dark alley and leapt into a shattered mirror beside a pile of garbage.
Inside the mirror was a cramped space, only two meters across, where a middle-aged man in ragged clothes was gnawing on a human finger.
The moment the stray cat jumped in, it hissed at the man with clear hostility: "Herta, I want that orange cat for myself later! It dared slap me... I'm going to eat all its innards right in front of it!"
"That's an extraordinary creature?" The man named Herta paused his chewing and asked with little expression.
"A normal orange cat couldn't possibly swat me away like that... It probably took some kind of physique-enhancing potion, though its Sequence shouldn't be too high." The stray cat offered its judgment. After all, it had been struck—clearly a sign of hostility—but it hadn't received any warning... which indicated that the orange cat's strength was low. So low, in fact, that it posed no real threat.
It paused for a moment before adding, "They got into Gess's carriage. They're probably heading to
Whispering Grace
."
"
Whispering Grace
... Tchesia's turf... Looks like Shielsmaier and Baru, who were stationed in the city for an ambush, have wasted their efforts." Herta revealed a twisted grin, as if mocking those three rivals.
"Aren't you in the same boat?" the stray cat retorted mockingly.
"I'm a
Mirror Apostle
, a demon of the mirrors. Every mirror in the city is within my domain... naturally, my preparations are everywhere." Herta rebutted the cat out of habit.
As one of the few Sequence 5s in the Belia family, he, unlike the other elders, had not cultivated many subordinates. He only had this demonic cat as an assistant—an approach quite similar to that of the now-deceased "Shadow Apostle," Jason Belia, in Backlund.
Different demons each had their own traits and unique specialties.
"You planning to head to
Whispering Grace
and kill that detective first?" The stray cat pawed over a chunk of bloody meat and licked it as it asked.
"That detective's not that simple. The one who strikes first will likely suffer for it... Better to let Tchesia, Samael, Shiela, and Baru test his limits first," Herta replied, stroking the stray cat's head as he continued, "Besides, I'm not particularly interested in those idiots... My real opponent is the one lurking in the shadows, the one who's skilled in nightmares."
...
Inside the moving carriage, Ebner and "Lion" Leon acted in sync—one cast the mystical art
Shield of Glory
to envelop the space around them, while the other conjured illusions to distract the three ladies with a harmless scene.
Once they confirmed there was no chance of eavesdropping, the man and the lion exchanged a glance and began their conversation.
"You sensed it too, didn't you? The danger hiding within this storm," Leon said first.
Ebner looked at him, surprised that this lion—corrupted by Roselle's influence—was waxing poetic. But after a moment's thought, he immediately saw through it and said, "That last line came from your 'prophecy,' didn't it?"
At his words, the lion's expression froze for a moment in an oddly human fashion, then he quickly changed the subject as if nothing had happened. "Speaking so directly will alert the demons."
Ebner pointed to the
Shield of Glory
that had formed around them and explained, "This is a mystical art I acquired from the trait I obtained when I advanced to
Mystic Instructor
. It can simulate a trace of 'Twilight' power."
"Later, when I was crafting a transformation—crafting an extraordinary item—the materials I used were also tainted by 'Twilight'. That gave me inspiration to improve the
Shield of Glory
, granting it some ability to obscure the danger-sensing abilities of demons."
"I see... So you're the one who killed that 'Apostle of Desire' in Backlund... That poor soul must've been wounded by '1-42' beforehand. The inspiration you got came from the ancient god's blood on that armor, didn't it?" Leon said with deliberate enlightenment.
Ebner asked in surprise, "Roselle once got hold of '1-42'? Otherwise, how would you know all this?"
But Leon shook his head. "When Roselle was still in the 'Artisan' phase, he asked Zaratul to show him a variety of sealed artifacts and mystical items to gain experience... You should know that for angels of the
Seer
pathway, as long as they've seen and understood something, they can reproduce it at will..."
Historical projection, huh... No wonder you're so familiar with it...
Ebner didn't dwell on the topic and instead asked, "Besides that line, did your prophecy reveal anything else?"
"Nothing more. But just now I sensed a demon's gaze. That stray cat was probably just a scout—it didn't know any real plans." Leon shook his head and then looked at Ebner. "What about you? Did you get any prophecy?"
He was well aware that Ebner possessed the ability to "prophesy."
"I didn't perform a prophecy..." Ebner shook his head, then took out the
Magic Mirror
and added, "I relied on the danger sense of the demons shepherded by this thing to directly discern their origins and what they're planning to do."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 729: Roselle’s Legacy
chapters.content:
Chapter 729 - Roselle's Legacy
"Lion" Leon glanced at the magic mirror, and a look of sudden realization appeared on his furry face—he clearly recognized its origin. But he didn't dwell on it. Instead, he asked, "Which demons are planning to cause you trouble? If we're talking about Lienn City... is it the Belia family?"
"It
is
the Belia family, one of the three major demon families..." Ebner nodded. He wasn't surprised that Leon had this intel—after all, tales of demons in Siviras County had circulated since the days of Roselle's reign. It was perfectly normal for the lion to know. So, after pausing to choose his words, he continued:
"I can sense five 'Apostles of Desire' who harbor clear hostility toward me. They are: the 'Apostle of Seduction' Tchesia, the 'Apostle of Slaughter' Sheila, the 'Apostle of Death' Samael, the 'Apostle of Light' Baru, and the 'Apostle of Mirrors' Herta.
"As for the demons I can detect following them, there are thirteen in total. Then there are even more 'serial killers' lurking in the background... In short, I'm facing at least thirty confirmed mid-Sequence enemies.
"The good news is that due to their cold-blooded nature, those Apostles of Desire don't trust each other in the slightest—not even those from the same family. That makes it impossible for them to coordinate effectively... If they did try to work together, they'd have to spend sixty or seventy percent of their energy guarding against each other... so they might as well act alone.
"Moreover, the 'Apostle of Slaughter,' the 'Apostle of Death,' and the 'Apostle of Light' are all over 130 years old. They've only managed to maintain their condition by remaining dormant through special rituals, but they're all on the verge of losing control. Their behavior is more 'insane' than cunning—they've practically lost the scheming nature typical of demons.
"Though the 'Apostle of Seduction' and the 'Apostle of Mirrors' are a bit younger, they're still nearing a hundred, and their situation is only relatively better. They're also facing serious risks of losing control... The Abyss pathway, after all, is the most prone to degeneration and madness.
"And among their subordinates, there are quite a few demons hoping to see us and the apostles destroy each other so they can swoop in and seize our traits. When the fighting breaks out, there'll definitely be plenty of slackers holding back."
"Lion" Leon was a bit stunned as he listened. He asked in surprise, "You picked all that up through your 'malice perception'?" That's way too detailed...
"Of course not... Since you already guessed that I was the one who killed Jason Belia in Backlund, then you should have figured out that I would definitely perform necromancy on him... Most of this intelligence was extracted from Jason's soul." Ebner chuckled before adding, "Also, the 'devil' shepherded by this magic mirror is from the Nors family. His soul was bound by certain safeguards, so he couldn't reveal anything about the Nors—but the Belia family wasn't restricted in the same way."
"I see..." Leon shook his head slightly, then looked at Ebner with a suspicious gaze and said cautiously, "Even so, dealing with dozens of mid-Sequence Beyonders isn't exactly easy... If they're equipped with the right combination of powerful mystical items, they could even force an ordinary demigod into retreat... And you, no matter how strong you are, are still not a demigod!"
The implication behind his words was clear:
Don't expect me to jump in. If you're not confident, you'd better retreat early or go find backup.
I haven't even left Loen yet. Given how much Lilith values me, I'm surely still under Her watch. Since She hasn't descended as the 'Goddess of Beauty' yet, that must mean She believes I can handle this crisis on my own...
That was what Ebner thought inwardly, but on the surface, he spoke with confidence: "Now that I've seen through their plan, resolving the situation becomes much easier... For us on the
Reader
pathway, combat should always be based on an informational advantage—identify the enemy's weaknesses, leverage all available forces, and achieve the greatest results at the smallest cost... Isn't that right?"
"It's
your
battle, not
mine
... At most, I'll help you keep an eye on those three girls over there." "Lion" Leon glanced at the other side of the carriage, where the ladies were entirely ignoring their conversation, then asked, "You only mentioned the good news just now... what's the bad news?"
"The bad news is—according to Jason's intel—among the apostles of the Belia family stationed in Lienn, there's also a 'Nightmare Apostle.' She's the strongest among them and has ties to the current family head, who is also their only demigod. It's said she even holds a Grade-1 Sealed Artifact... but she didn't display any hostility toward me, so I didn't sense her presence...
"Of course, it's more likely she used some special method to block my danger sense."
Although this was "bad news," Ebner wasn't particularly concerned. As long as he had enough time to set up rituals, especially after learning many secret techniques from the latter part of
The Banquet of Blood
, he believed that even if a demigod really did show up, he'd still be able to stall them for a while.
However, "Lion" Leon's expression turned a little strange after hearing that. Then, as if something occurred to him, he let out a sly chuckle and said, "There hasn't been a 'Nightmare Apostle' for a long time... If I'm not mistaken, the so-called 'Nightmare Apostle' of the Belia family is just their only 'Whisperer' in disguise... No—actually, it's likely that the 'Whisperer' had already ascended and
is
the real 'Nightmare Apostle'—just pretending not to be!
"Heh, if it
is
her, then after seeing me and that girl Fanny, she wouldn't dare make a move against us personally."
Ebner frowned, pondering for a moment before asking, "Why pretend? Was there something wrong with the materials she used to ascend? Or is it something about her personally?"
The lion grinned and answered, "Both... Yalubeth was one of the gifts Adabao offered to Roselle back then...
"She gained her promotion largely by pleasing Roselle.
"Also, before becoming a demigod, she swore an oath to the Emperor never to harm any of his descendants. That vow still holds power."
Yalubeth was gifted to Old Huang [Roselle] by Adabao? What kind of wild plot twist is this? Don't tell me even her name was given by Old Huang?
Ebner couldn't help but mentally complain, then suddenly recalled a certain page of Roselle's diary he had handed over to the "Fool." Putting that together with the name, he tentatively asked, "Don't tell me... this Yalubeth is a succubus?"
You know? As I thought—you must be connected to the Catastrophe Seal in some way!
Leon silently muttered in his heart with certainty, then replied, "She
does
have succubus blood, and she can take on a full succubus form through 'Demonic Transformation'..."
So that's the form Old Huang liked, huh?
Still, the head of the Belia family must have been colluding with Adabao long ago—what a double agent...
No wonder, decades ago, the Andrelad family, backed by Adabao, was able to fight the powerful Nors family to a standstill... There was a traitor on the inside!
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 730: The Lion’s Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 730 - The Lion’s Shock
After learning that the so-called "Nightmare Apostle" was most likely just an alternate identity of a "Whisperer," while "Lion" Leon was confident that this mistress of Roselle wouldn't make a move, Ebner still didn't dare to believe it entirely.
After all, that Miss Yalubeth Belia was a Sequence 3 demigod. If she did join the attack, aside from merging with the Bone Dragon to tank for five seconds, he'd probably have no choice but to threaten her with "Lilith's Tear."
So, after thinking it over, Ebner began setting up a ritual in the carriage. As "Lion" Leon watched him with an expression shifting from horror to deep unease, Ebner prayed one by one to the Earth Mother, the Evernight Goddess, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
Soon, he received responses.
The Earth Mother gave him a true name—one that pointed to Cullen's mother, Lady Helen.
The Evernight Goddess directly bestowed upon him a talisman. Engraved on it was a vertical eye formed from a myriad of symbols, radiating a sinister and mysterious aura.
As for the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, He didn't respond directly, but Ebner clearly felt a temporary enhancement in his simulation ability. For a short time, he should be able to use demigod-level powers.
Lilith must believe that, with my proficiency in ritual magic, as long as Lady Helen isn't too far away, constructing a summoning ritual to call her forth shouldn't be difficult.
The talisman from the Evernight Goddess bears symbols that represent Antigonus... So that's what it is—the talisman is essentially a 'Spirit Worm,' and its effect is to summon a 'Historical Projection.' I can pull someone or something from a gap in history to fight for ten seconds...
Don't tell me the Goddess ripped this straight off Antigonus herself?
As for the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, His method isn't hard to guess—it's the power of authority, a true god's influence over the abilities of lower-ranked Beyonders within His pathway... Just like how the ancient Death God, the Phoenix Ancestor Gregali, gave every 'Gatekeeper' the ability to open the Gates of the Underworld...
Another example is from the original work, when the Giant King's Court fought against the Dark Angel Evil Spirit. That time, Amon also used the authority of uniqueness to significantly boost Klein's 'Error' pathway abilities replicated through the 'Staff of the Stars,' reaching the level of Parvis taking action himself.
In short, Lilith's help is region-limited, the Goddess's talisman is single-use, and the favor from the God of Knowledge and Wisdom is time-limited... Each has its own restrictions, but for dealing with a declining demon family, it should be more than enough!
While Ebner was deep in thought, "Lion" Leon beside him was so stunned he almost dropped his eyeballs. He stared blankly at Ebner for a long while before murmuring:
"How the hell have you not been struck down by divine punishment?
"Even back when Roselle was heavily favored by the gods, he only dared to make such requests to the God of Steam and Machinery..."
Compared to how Mr. Fool later went straight into a church to demand a Sequence 2 trait, what I'm doing is practically nothing.
Ebner grumbled inwardly but didn't say much else. Truthfully, he'd even wanted to pray to Mr. Fool for an "Angel's Blessing" to gain immunity to "Desire" or "Whisper" damage, but after considering it, he gave up. After all, the "Pure White Eye" already had similar functions, and Mr. Fool had also said that his name must not be revealed without permission.
"With the blessings of the gods, I'm better prepared than ever. The odds of turning the tables on those demons are now much higher..." As he spoke, Ebner took out a few cards sealed with mystical items and handed them to "Lion" Leon, giving detailed instructions: "If any demons attack Helene, Fors, or Fanny later, give these cards to them. Let them fight for themselves, and you just stay nearby to keep them safe—don't step in personally.
"After all, if your demigod identity is exposed, the other 'Apostles of Desire' might call off tonight's attack. And then we'd be stuck on constant alert, which would be far more troublesome."
Is the important part the divine blessings? The truly terrifying thing is that the gods even responded to you at all! Three gods watching over you... If something actually happened to you, I wouldn't be surprised if an angel descended from the heavens.
Leon complained mentally, but on the surface, he accepted the cards, glanced at them, and nodded affirmatively: "These are a lot like the 'Duel Cards' Roselle used to make."
Of course they are. I'm guessing Roselle's idea came from the Catastrophe Seal, which in turn clearly got this tech from somewhere else—probably from the 'Wanderer' Alvin Abraham.
Thinking that, Ebner didn't pick up Leon's comment but began explaining each card's function in detail:
"This card contains a 'String Puppet.' It can manipulate spiritual threads. While it can't turn people into secret puppets like a 'Marionettist,' it can at least slow down an enemy's movements... Give this to Fors. She's not experienced in real combat, so she'd do better as a control-type in the back line. Oh, and make sure to give her a 'Psychological Invisibility' as well...
"This card holds the 'Hand of Wisdom' gloves—temporarily lend these to Helene. She's been in actual battles before and has a relatively strong will. As a 'Pyromaniac,' her direct combat ability isn't weak, and with the gloves—imbued with most of a 'Briber's' abilities—no ordinary demon should be able to take her down quickly.
"Fanny already has a lot of mystical items, and those mechanical dolls in her backpack are extremely powerful. Her only real weakness is that she hasn't suffered much hardship, so her willpower is lacking and she's vulnerable to spiritual invasion by 'corruption'... That's why this card, which contains the 'Ring of Light,' should go to her. Use the divine light to neutralize the effects of corrupted powers.
"Oh, and don't hand these cards out until a real attack begins. Otherwise, they'll definitely get suspicious. If they don't act convincingly enough, the demons might notice I'm prepared, which would ruin the plan."
"Lion" Leon silently nodded his big head, indicating that he had memorized everything.
If it had been before, he wouldn't have followed orders so obediently. He would've definitely bargained with Ebner first...
But now, with Ebner clearly favored by three gods, his status in Leon's mind had risen dramatically. He was no longer just the emperor's "prophesied one" or someone vaguely connected to the "Catastrophe Seal."
—This had also been one of Ebner's goals in praying right in front of him.
Once the man and lion finalized their preliminary plan, they each dispelled their own occult influences. On the other side of the carriage, the three ladies who had been chatting resumed awareness of Ebner and the orange cat's presence.
They didn't notice anything unusual at all.
.....
The "Gentle Words" hot spring inn was situated on a small hill on the northern outskirts of Linn City. Though a bit removed from the urban center, it had convenient transportation and featured high-end facilities and services. It was also relatively well-known in the surrounding areas...
As soon as Ebner, the three ladies, and the cat stepped out of the carriage, a staff member approached them with umbrellas, smiling warmly as he led them into the hot spring inn.
Because of the storm, there weren't many guests. According to Ebner's senses, aside from their group, the entire inn only had about twenty people total—staff and guests combined.
Heh, are they all demons in disguise? Based on the Mirror of Desires' feedback, there's one "Apostle of Desire," three "Demons," seven "Serial Killers," and the rest are all "Criminals."
That Apostle of Desire is most likely the "Marionettist" Cecia. She's an elder of the Belia family. The others must be elite forces she's trained.
Tch, as expected of a former angelic family. Even in decline, their foundation is still terrifyingly strong!
And this is just the power that a single elder can mobilize!
As he inwardly marveled, Ebner booked two rooms with hot spring pools, which cost him a total of ten pounds.
He didn't mind—after all, he was about to earn much more shortly.
He then smiled and nodded at the three ladies, motioning for them to rest well, before heading straight into the private room he had booked for himself.
Once inside, Ebner shut the door and activated the "Pure White Eye" to inspect the space. He found nothing suspicious—no unusual arrangements, no surveillance.
They know I'm a Beyonder of the "Reader" pathway and figured the traces of a ritual might not escape my notice. So, to avoid alerting me, they gave up on surveillance altogether?
Hmm, but the perception of "desire" is one of the Apostle of Desire's core abilities. That Marionettist is probably monitoring my condition indirectly through that power.
Still, this actually saves me a lot of trouble.
After pondering briefly, Ebner took out the mutated Tudor emblem and began setting up a ritual. In this room, he altered, added to, and manipulated certain rules to construct a special environment.
During the process, he also incorporated part of the principle behind "Ivans' Veil of Secrecy," which ensured that the demons outside wouldn't notice anything abnormal.
Next, he erected a sacrificial altar, inscribed a series of complex symbols, and finally placed the profane card obtained from the Land of Night— the "Door" card—at the center of the altar.
The ritual was based on the principle of a "Teleportation Altar." Combined with the mysterious power imbued in the "Door" card by the "Emperor of Knowledge," it had a certain chance of opening a teleportation channel, allowing Lady Helen to descend in person.
Of course, the distance couldn't be too great, and it also required Helen's cooperation.
With most other Sequence demigods, this method might have little chance of success—but Helen was a "Summoning Grandmaster." She definitely had ways to stabilize the "door," making success much more likely.
After confirming there were no problems with the ritual setup, Ebner began reciting the summoning incantation he had designed:
"O favored of the earth, descendant of the Blood Clan, summoning grandmaster beneath the silver moon, Helen Cullenedia of the Observer family...
"I!
"I call upon you in my name,"And beseech your descent!"
The howling wind surged and swirled, and the flames atop the altar's candles flared violently, tinged with a distinct silver-white hue.
Soon, directly above the "Door" card, a circle of illusory flame abruptly took shape.
Moments later, a beautiful lady stepped gracefully out from within the fiery ring.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 731: Helen
chapters.content:
Chapter 731 - Helen
The lady who appeared before him had silver eyes, a delicate nose, thin lips, and long, smooth silver hair. Her appearance was somewhat similar to Lilith's divine vessel, which had just advanced to a Blessed of the "Beauty Goddess," but she wasn't so "beautiful" that Ebner dared not look directly at her.
She wore a vintage Intis court gown, a wide-brimmed hat decorated with lace ribbons, and carried a silk fan, like a young noblewoman about to attend a ball.
Cullen had said his family originated from Rhine Karenedia, and that Bloodline Duke was Lilith's vessel... so it made sense for Ms. Helen to resemble the newly advanced "Beauty Goddess."
However, Cullen and Lydia both had black hair... Was it from their father? But they were both vampires; they should have inherited Ms. Helen's traits... Hmm, perhaps that Transmigrator Duke's bloodline was special, and only by becoming a demigod would he exhibit those silver hair and silver eye features?
As Ebner speculated wildly, he politely said, "Thank you for answering my summons, madam."
Helen examined Ebner carefully and smiled, "Detective Bryan, it's an honor to meet you... I've heard about you from Cullen and Lydia for a long time. They both found you very amiable and trustworthy..."
"Now I'm sure they weren't lying."
Madam, isn't that a bit hasty a judgment? Although I am indeed favored by Lilith, flattering me won't do much good...
While grumbling internally, Ebner outwardly responded gracefully, "Madam, that's because Cullen and Lydia helped me leave a good impression on you first."
"Spiritual intuition doesn't deceive me easily..." Ms. Helen said meaningfully, then dropped the topic and switched to, "What exactly did you summon me for? Surely not for those low and mid-Sequence demons in this hotel?"
As a demigod of the Moon pathway, the disguise of the Beliar family's Beyonders couldn't fool her at all.
"Madam, it's like this..." Ebner was about to explain when Ms. Helen interrupted him, "You are a Blessed of the Mother. You can just call me Helen. There's no need to be so reserved just because you're friends with Lydia and Cullen."
"Alright... Helen, it's that the Beliar family somehow heard I have a 'Devil' Beyonder characteristic in my possession..." Ebner didn't play coy. He readily changed his address, then completely recounted the intelligence he had gathered to Helen.
"So, you're worried about Yarlbed?" Helen immediately understood Ebner's purpose for summoning her after listening.
"Yes," Ebner nodded. As for the other low and mid-Sequence demons, he was confident he could take them down one by one.
However, judging by Helen's tone when she mentioned Yarlbed, it seemed she knew her?
"I can help you stop Yarlbed, but you'll have to split today's gains with me," Helen proposed her condition after a brief consideration.
She looks like a goddess, but why is she so materialistic when she speaks?
Ebner grumbled silently.
However, he hadn't intended to "freeload" anyway. After all, Helen, this "enforcer," was one of his guarantees during his time in Intis, so he naturally had to "bribe" her well.
Besides, I haven't even gotten the items yet. I'm just being generous with someone else's money.
As his thoughts turned, Ebner nodded, "No problem."
He didn't notarize a contract. After all, they were both Blessed of the Mother; there was still trust between them.
"Also, don't go too far... If all the Beria family's demons die here, Yarlbed will fight to the death... As a former angel family, who knows, she might even produce a very high-level Sealed Artifact!" Helen thought for a moment and added a few more instructions.
Madam, you're really familiar with the Beria family... But from what you're saying, is Adalbaud, that turncoat family head hidden within the Beria family, secretly trying to use me to clean up their internal affairs?
Ebner frowned. He didn't think this was a good thing. After all, demons were cold-blooded creatures, and there was no essential difference whether they believed in the Mother Tree or pledged allegiance to Adalbaud...
After such a cleanup, the emergence of new serial killers and demons would inevitably lead to more killings for the sake of acting...
But this kind of thing was unavoidable... Ebner sighed.
Helen seemed to have read Ebner's mind and smiled, "The Beria family being in Yarlbed's hands is definitely much better than being in the hands of other demons!"
"This isn't because Yarlbed has gained humanity; she's as cold-blooded and ruthless as other demons. However, she's greatly constrained by the power of order, preventing her from certain actions."
So that's how it is... But madam, how do you know such secretive things? Did the Emperor reveal them to curry favor with you?
Though he had questions, Ebner wasn't foolish enough to ask them aloud. He merely scoffed, "Helen, you're overthinking it... How could I possibly keep dozens of mid-Sequence Beyonders here?"
Unless they were foolish enough not to run away.
"Then it's settled! I'll go have a drink with Yarlbed now. At least until the sun rises tomorrow, you won't have to worry about seeing her."
After saying that, Ms. Helen transformed into moonlight and vanished from the hotel room.
Seeing her leave, Ebner packed up the summoning altar and concealed the room's arrangements. Only then did he change into a bathrobe and settle into the luxurious hot spring bath that came with the room.
At the same time, he manipulated the Magic Mirror, using his "Devil" abilities to transmit a false impression of his fluctuating "desires" to the "Charm Apostle."
Soon, a "Seed of Desire" was captured by the "Devil" being herded by the Magic Mirror.
As my "Danger Sense" predicted, that "Charm Apostle" was probably misled by my reputation, thinking I'm a very lustful person. The "Seeds of Desire" she released were all related to female beauty...
Heh, next, she'll send attractive subordinates to tempt me and use the "Seed of Desire" to control me.
But with the "Devil" herded by the "Magic Mirror (Arrodes)," plus my temporarily enhanced "Simulation" ability and the "Manipulator" methods I can use, the possibility of counter-controlling her is very high.
Just as Ebner thought this, two women wearing only transparent sheer gauze pushed open the door and entered, explaining that it was a special service provided by the hotel for esteemed guests.
Two serial killers... This service truly is special!
Ebner sneered. While pretending to be captivated, he manipulated the Magic Mirror to adjust the feedback for the "Seed of Desire." At the same time, he subtly transmitted a certain emotion, magnified by the "rules" within the room, into the mind of the "Charm Apostle" hiding in the dark.
As for the two serial killers, after entering the hot spring water, they intentionally and unintentionally leaned against Ebner, trying to use their seductive methods to further ignite his desires.
Unfortunately, they didn't notice the mechanical, cold gaze in Ebner's eyes.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 732: The Effect of Rewind
chapters.content:
Chapter 732 - The Effect of Rewind
Inside a private room at the "Gentle Words" hotel, at the uppermost section of the hot spring stream, a captivating woman with a voluptuous figure sat quietly in the pool. She allowed the stream to carry a peculiar scent from her fair skin into the current, flowing to the various hot spring pools throughout the hotel.
This unclothed woman was Chesi, the "Charm Apostle" of the Beria family. She closed her eyes, silently sensing something, and only opened them after a while.
Her pretty face was slightly flushed, seemingly in ecstasy. After about a minute, she turned her head, looking downstream, and murmured to herself:
"As expected of the famous great detective who brings three female companions on his travels... Truly valiant, such intense desire... Although I used the 'aura' from 'Charm Words' spread in the stream to heighten it... he truly was too cooperative... Heh, it won't be long until I can completely control his desires, make him obey my every command, and willingly offer up the 'Devil' characteristic!"
"Although this great detective has a formidable reputation and seemingly good strength, his weakness is simply too obvious, and he doesn't know how to restrain himself... Is it because things have always gone too smoothly for him?"
"He really must have a significant background... No wonder the patriarch was so solemn when giving the task..."
"I cannot personally kill such a person. Once he hands over the characteristic, I will devise a plan to lure those fools from 'Slaughter,' 'Death,' and 'Light,' and have them eliminate this detective and his companions."
"The only troubles are those annoying 'Nightmare' and 'Mirror' guys... They aren't like those three idiots; they actually have some brains... They definitely won't be fooled by such a crude scheme."
"But they probably don't know that I already obtained the 'Devil' potion formula a long time ago, and I've already prepared the 'auxiliary materials' and completed the relevant rituals!"
"As long as I'm given a little time, I can advance to demigod! At that time, I will definitely 'take care' of 'Nightmare' and 'Mirror'!"
"One of them looks down on me because of the patriarch's favor, and the other wields a demigod-level item and completely disregards me!"
"Once I become a demigod and implore the favor of that existence, even the patriarch's position isn't something I can't seize!"
As she grew more excited with her thoughts, she was completely unaware that her island of mind was already open, and her own emotions of arrogance, jealousy, greed, and so on were rapidly expanding.
And strands of "black mist," imperceptible even to spiritual vision, continuously entered her island of mind along the pool water and her expanding subconscious—that was precisely the "Heart of the Devil"! At this moment, Chesi's breathing gradually became heavier, and a dazed look appeared in her eyes. She unconsciously said, "It's almost here... The detective's peak is coming, the climax of desire is coming! It's now!"
As she spoke, she stretched out her hand and gripped it suddenly.
Then, she felt her actions completely lose control. She involuntarily called her subordinates and told them that she had succeeded and was about to advance to "Devil"...
At the same time, she gave them orders to guard the perimeter of the hotel, completely ignoring the several moles she had identified long ago.
It wasn't until Chesi felt herself stand up and walk toward the detective's room that her last bit of clear consciousness finally reacted:
What am I doing?
Wasn't I supposed to "ignite" his desire to kill that detective? Why did I suddenly switch to controlling him? And why did I come up with a plan that was even more reasonable than I expected?
I had already prepared the "Devil" ritual? But when did I get that formula?
No... that formula suddenly appeared in my memory... Someone tampered with my mind!
That detective's intense desire was a disguise... He counter-controlled me!
Upon realizing this, Chesi, the "Charm Apostle," made a final effort, attempting to draw symbols with her spirituality to activate a rune inscribed on her body, and then rapidly "demonize" herself, thereby escaping control.
But what Chesi didn't know was that these thoughts were also "arrangements" Ebner had made to coax her into exposing her trump card.
Thus, just as the "symbol" drawn with spirituality was largely complete, and a shining star had just appeared on her smooth back, everything abruptly stopped... Chesi completely lost consciousness! It turned out that she had already entered Ebner's room, stepping into the "ritual" that had been set up using high-level items from the "Black Emperor" pathway as its core.
And with the abilities of "utilization" and "distortion," the "Devil" soul herded by the Magic Mirror completely occupied her mind and body.
"Master..." Chesi, under the Magic Mirror's control, greeted Ebner somewhat awkwardly.
Ebner nodded, then had "Chesi" turn around, revealing her back, which still bore the faint mark of a "star."
This wasn't because he had developed any bad habits, but because this star, and the "symbol" Chesi had drawn at the end, felt familiar to him.
"Demoness of Affliction" Rey had drawn similar symbols and patterns in the carriage after escaping the "Primordial Moon"'s control with the help of three holy artifacts, fleeing to Councilman Macht's manor, where Ms. Daly and I encountered her...
Earlier, in "Daniel's Labyrinth," the patterns and symbols that automatically appeared during the sacrifice of "1-025" were also this...
And if nothing goes wrong... they should be symbols of the "Mother Tree of Desire"!
This rune, which Chesi inscribed on her body as a trump card, had the effect of a demigod-level curse, cursing anyone linked to her aura!
"Although I had guessed that the Beria family's elders wouldn't be simple, if I hadn't chosen to secretly trick her, but instead tried to forcefully control her with 'Manipulator,' I'm afraid I would have already received a curse from the Mother Tree!"
Thinking of this, Ebner couldn't help but feel fortunate that he hadn't become "cocky" even after receiving the "epic" enhancements from the three gods.
"I have to thank the Beria family's name for that... After all, how could someone who became an elder in such a former angel family not have powerful trump cards?"
After a brief lament, Ebner disengaged his "Mechanical Mind" and looked at "Chesi," who was controlled by the Magic Mirror (Arrodes). He asked,
"Are there any other Beyonder items on this 'Charm Apostle'?"
As he spoke, he looked at the red gemstone necklace around the seductive woman's neck and the silver ring with green patterns on her finger...
After all, these were the only two striking items on her otherwise bare body.
"Master... she... most of the items she's obtained over the years were either handed over to the family or given to her subordinates. Plus, as a 'Charm Apostle,' her own abilities are extremely powerful, so ordinary magical items aren't very useful to her..."
"Therefore, the only items she consistently carries are the 'Charm Words' necklace and the 'Wind's Whisper' ring."
"Among them, the 'Charm Words' necklace was crafted from a 'Potions Professor' Beyonder characteristic. It can release various 'auras' that incite desire, and then control charmed people or animals through these 'auras'... It can be said that Chesi owes half of her 'Charm Apostle' title to this item."
"The negative effect of this item is an extreme craving for fresh blood... But for a demon, it's actually nothing, which is why Chesi always carries it."
"The other item, 'Wind's Whisper,' has the ability to control 'wind,' allowing her to use various abilities such as 'Flight,' 'Wind Blade,' and 'Wind Restraint,' compensating for Chesi's lack of mobility..."
"Its negative effect is a fear of the sea... making the wearer afraid of seawater." As the Magic Mirror manipulated "Chesi," its speech gradually became smoother from its initial stiffness.
A Beyonder item with "Wind-blessed" abilities that fears seawater? Was this ring killed by some "Sea King" in its previous life?
After a quick jab, Ebner instructed "Chesi" to temporarily keep both items, then fetched a bathrobe for her to wear. After all, he had ended his "Mechanical Mind" state, and having such a beautiful, naked woman constantly in his sight was somewhat awkward.
Not watching "Chesi" put on the bathrobe, Ebner averted his gaze and asked, "Who do you think will come to probe first?"
The Magic Mirror knew about Ebner's plan to feign capture and then let the demons fight among themselves. So, after integrating Chesi's memories, it replied:
"'Light' and 'Slaughter' are in the worst state, as 'Chesi' just thought. Once the insider spreads the news, their 'half-mad' states will make them the first to lose patience."
"As for their subordinates, those under their control naturally won't question orders, while those not controlled harbor their own intentions. They would likely be very eager to see the 'Apostles' clash. Once one dies, it's their opportunity!"
"'Death' is in a similar state, but his subordinates are all undead puppets, relatively more cohesive... However, he will likely receive the news much later than the other two."
"The most troublesome is 'Mirror.' His mirror abilities are difficult to predict, and his condition is almost the best among all the Apostles... Moreover, he has a troublesome Sealed Artifact in his possession."
The intelligence level of the Magic Mirror with only one seal removed was actually insufficient to analyze so much information. This was borrowed from the wisdom of "Chesi" and the herded "Devil." However, it still could not actively think; it would only use "Chesi"'s brain after Ebner gave a command.
After hearing the Magic Mirror's analysis, Ebner nodded silently, as it largely matched his own judgment.
"'Mirror,' huh? The tricks he can pull are limited..."
Ebner glanced at the hot spring pool in the room, then pretended to be restrained and sat beside "Chesi." The Magic Mirror also "disguised" itself as a "Beyonder characteristic" and landed in the hand of the "Chesi" it controlled.
.....
In another room at "Gentle Words," Fors, Helene, and Fanny were about to take off their clothes and soak in the pool after a short rest.
But then, the "Orange Cat" that had been squatting nearby suddenly spoke, "If I were you, I wouldn't take a bath." After all, the pool water had been "enhanced"...
It was only then that the three ladies suddenly realized there was a cat in the room. However, they didn't pay much attention, and Fors even asked curiously, "Why?"
"Aren't you afraid that detective will peep?" Fearing that he might disrupt Ebner's plan and cause unnecessary variables, Leon felt his response was very appropriate, and the detective would surely be satisfied.
"It's fine if Ebner sees..." Fanny puffed out her chest, stating it as a matter of course.
"Ebner isn't that kind of person," Fors shook her head.
"Boss isn't you..." Helene thought of Detective Bryan's "healthy" daily life over the past few months and said with certainty.
"Tch, you only see the kid's surface..." Speaking of this, "Lion" Leon revealed a smile that humans would also find quite lewd, and continued,
"You should know that 'Detective' has a Beyonder ability called 'Rewind'..."
"But do you know what the specific effect of this ability is?"
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 733: Pure White Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 733 - Pure White Eye
"'Rewind'... isn't that the 'Detective's' ability to reconstruct scenes from clues? Is there a problem?" Fors thought for a moment after hearing "Lion" Leon's words, asking in confusion.
Leon pulled at the corner of his mouth, plucked a mane hair, and caused it to transform into a mirror. Then, while trying to demonstrate the specific effects of 'Rewind', he chuckled, "Heh heh, 'Rewind' isn't that simple... I even think the inspiration for your 'film company's' cameras..."
Before he could finish, the room suddenly shook violently, followed by a strong smell of sulfur permeating the air.
Fors was startled and instinctively tried to "open a door" in the wall to Ebner's room.
However, she didn't succeed because after the "Charm Apostle" was controlled by Ebner and given orders to guard her completion of advancement, Chesi's subordinates—the "demons," "serial killers," and "criminals"—activated the "barrier" of the "Gentle Words" hotel.
Fors, Helene, and Fanny were now clearly isolated by this "barrier."
Seeing this, Helene directly condensed a fire raven and shot it towards the door, but it was easily blocked by a sudden, invisible wall.
Fanny also opened her backpack and released three fully armed mechanical puppets.
At this moment, "Lion" Leon suddenly spoke, "Looks like it's started..."
After speaking, he threw the three cards Ebner had given him to Fors and the other two, and briefly explained the abilities of the magical items sealed within the cards.
Since a full-scale battle had begun and the commotion was so great, there was no need to keep the three in the dark. After all, the demons now had no time to sense their thoughts.
"So we were targeted by demons as soon as we got off the train? Ebner attracted the strongest 'Charm Apostle'..."
"Then we can't be a hindrance! We can't be a burden or his weakness!"
The three ladies quickly discussed and made a decision. Helene, the "Pyromaniac" with practical experience, began to set up specific tactics, awaiting potential enemies.
Though they were somewhat nervous, they weren't overly worried, as a demigod-level lion was squatting in the room, guaranteeing their basic safety.
.....
At this moment, the hotel lobby's roof had been smashed open by a "sulfur fireball" that suddenly descended from the sky, shattering and exploding outwards.
At the epicenter of the explosion, a grotesque monster, three meters tall and wielding a "magma greatsword," slowly rose. With a single strike, it obliterated several "criminals" nearby who hadn't managed to escape!
The first to strike was "Slaughter Apostle" Hila. He enjoyed provoking the "fear" emotion in his opponents after "demonizing," leading to "mad" slaughter, hence his name.
Additionally, because he went mad indiscriminately, he had few subordinates, and they all scattered to various parts of the hotel the moment the "sulfur fireball" exploded, keeping their distance from their master.
Seeing this, two of Chesi's subordinate demons immediately "demonized," transforming into monsters themselves, and held Hila back.
Although their strength was far inferior to his, they possessed rationality and believed they could at least stall him for a while.
However, it wasn't long before they paid a heavy price for their arrogance!
The "Slaughter Apostle" was called "Slaughter" not only because of his numerous killings, but also because he wielded a Sealed Artifact capable of inflicting diseases and plagues!
This was another reason his subordinates kept their distance from him.
Therefore, when the two demons under Chesi's command realized something was wrong, it was already a bit late. They were now so ill that they couldn't even maintain their "demonized" forms!
Although a few more hits would certainly kill the two demons, "Slaughter Apostle" Hila didn't want to waste any more time. So, he bypassed them and swiftly moved towards the room where Chesi's aura was.
But before he could enter the corridor, he was stopped by three demons...
It turned out that "Light Apostle" Baruch had already broken through the hotel's internal barrier while Hila was fighting Chesi's subordinates, and had arranged for his followers to intercept Hila here.
And on the other side, the two "demons" who had just escaped the range of the "disease" took a breath of fresh air, only to find themselves subtly surrounded by over a dozen "serial killers."
Among them were Hila's subordinates, Baruch's followers, and even colleagues who also served Chesi!
Immediately after, a chaotic battle began, all for the sake of seizing Beyonder characteristics...
The selfish, cold-blooded, and ruthless nature of "Demon" pathway Beyonders was utterly exposed at this moment!
.....
Inside the hot spring room, Ebner, feigning capture, observed the entire battle through the pre-arranged ritual. He continuously "guided" the situation using his "Manipulator" abilities, striving for a mutually destructive outcome in each battlefield.
Under such "operation," "Light Apostle" Baruch gradually became separated from his followers and entered the battlefield Ebner had pre-arranged for him.
Baruch was a middle-aged gentleman over 1.8 meters tall, with a well-proportioned physique, golden hair, blue eyes, and a full beard. His features appeared quite benevolent, lacking any demonic aura; instead, he resembled a divine priest.
He wore an Intis-style robe and held a scepter with a white spherical orb embedded at its tip, silently confronting Chesi, who was controlled by the Magic Mirror.
According to the information provided by Chesi's soul, after becoming a "Demon," this "Light Apostle" possessed unique abilities somewhat similar to a "Gatekeeper." He could accommodate "spirits" and even interact with the underworld to some extent, like a true "Gatekeeper"... yet he couldn't truly open the "Door of the Underworld."
However, whether by good or bad luck, shortly after Baruch became a "Charm Apostle," he coincidentally obtained a malevolent spirit, the corrupted form of a high-Sequence "Sun" pathway powerhouse, and allowed it to reside within him...
From then on, he became the only demon unafraid of "Holy Light," and even immune to "Purification," thus earning him the title of "Light Apostle."
But unfortunately, that malevolent spirit continued to revive within him... By now, the malevolent spirit had even taken dominance, causing Baruch to fall into madness from time to time.
Therefore, Baruch was extremely eager for the "Devil" characteristic, even deciding to obtain it at all costs to suppress the malevolent spirit's corrosion.
Seeing that Chesi, controlled by the Magic Mirror, and Baruch were about to make their move, Ebner quietly activated his "Pure White Eye," intending to simultaneously search for Baruch's weakness and use the room's pre-arranged ritual to help the Magic Mirror
quickly kill him.But just as Ebner activated his "Pure White Eye," "Light Apostle" Baruch's benevolent face suddenly became distorted and riddled with patches of light.
Immediately after, an aura extremely similar to the angel malevolent spirit sealed within the Magic Mirror arose from Baruch.
Seeing this, Ebner frowned. Just as he was considering whether to strike first, Baruch's face revealed a fanatical expression. He then threw away his scepter, directly prostrating himself on the ground, facing Ebner's direction, and spoke with extreme piety:
"My Lord, the sinner Orbach finally feels your radiance again!"
Orbach? The second Pope of the Church of the Eternal Sun, who perished before the position of Pope was completely abolished and replaced by a round table conference, seemed to have that name...
And the third, most likely, is the one in the Magic Mirror.
The Magic Mirror has shown a "sycophantic" attitude since first seeing me, and it likes the "Holy Light" I release with "Pure White Eye," even to the point of not devouring people for it.
And now this malevolent spirit, Orbach, who has occupied Baruch, actually called me "My Lord" directly after I activated "Pure White Eye"...
If it's true, as I previously guessed, that the function of "Pure White Eye" was continually perfected by successive transmigrators, then what exactly did they put into it before?
Hmm... "Pure White Eye"... not only does it have the "analysis" and "insight" abilities of a high-Sequence "Reader" pathway, but now it also seems to have a strong connection with the "Sun"...
Could this be pieced together from "Pure White Angel" + "Omniscient Eye"?
Was the name I casually chose not really "casual" at all? Some form of destiny?
But both "White Tower" and "Sun" have True Gods... So where did "Omniscient Eye" and "Pure White Angel" come from?
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 734: Labyrinth
chapters.content:
Chapter 734 - Labyrinth
There was another question... Even if a "Pure White Angel" truly existed in the "Unknown Land," there was no way an evil spirit, fallen from a Pope who had served the "Eternal Blazing Sun," could have made a mistake, could there?
And judging by its devout demeanor, why didn't it directly recite the honorific name of the "Eternal Blazing Sun" and let its Lord save it?
Had it gone so mad after falling into an evil spirit that it even forgot who its Lord was? Or was its mind twisted by someone?
As his thoughts churned, Ebner used his pure white eyes to observe the "Light Apostle," or rather, Orbach, the former Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, who was still prostrated on the ground. He immediately decided to exploit the other party's clearly abnormal state to expand his own advantage!
Simply put, it meant neither admitting nor denying, just playing along for a bit, hoping to trick it... He observed Mr. Fool's performances above the gray fog every week, so he was quite familiar with this "business."
Therefore, after a brief silence of a few seconds, Ebner first used his "Pure White Eye" to simulate "Holy Light" falling upon the "Light Apostle," completely suppressing Baruch, who was struggling for control of the body.
Then, seeing the middle-aged gentleman before him show expressions of profound emotion and intoxication, Ebner secretly muttered, He doesn't look very bright, and then chuckled softly, imitating Mr. Fool's tone, speaking calmly with a low but not deep voice:
"Arise... Without My permission, you shall not reveal My existence to others."
"As Your Lordship commands!" Orbach respectfully responded, then slowly rose. Without waiting for Ebner to ask further, he proactively said, "This demon I inhabit is not only disrespectful to You, My Lord, but has also presumptuously learned of Your existence..."
"Although You have forgiven my sin of degradation for consorting with a demon, I still implore Your permission to personally purify him, to cleanse both our shared sins."
He wants to commit suicide? Although I originally intended to kill "Light Apostle" Baruch, having him die so directly in the current situation would be too much of a waste... It'd be better for him to perish alongside the other "Charm Apostles" outside!
As for whether Orbach would face issues after losing his "host," Ebner wasn't particularly concerned...
Firstly, angelic evil spirits weren't so fragile; without external force, it was difficult for them to truly perish.
Secondly, Ebner was secretly hoping this evil spirit would weaken a bit, ideally becoming as simply intelligent as the Magic Mirror, otherwise his level of disguise would inevitably be exposed sooner or later.
While pondering this, Ebner spoke in a calm and detached tone: "You and his sins shall be washed away with the blood of the sinners outside."
"My Lord, thank you for Your mercy and tolerance." Orbach once again prostrated himself and kissed the ground, then stood up, picked up the scepter, maintained a half-bow, and retreated from the room.
"Phew... I finally managed to fool it!" Ebner re-pocketed the "Historical Projection" rune he had secretly held in his palm, letting out a long breath.
An angelic evil spirit still put a lot of pressure on him!
Although the Red Angel evil spirit was stronger than this "Eternal Blazing Sun" Pope, this wasn't Backlund. There was no Lilith's divine vessel available for immediate support, so Ebner naturally didn't have as much confidence as he did back then.
He composed himself, then once again used the ritual to observe the battle in the hotel.
