At this moment, "Death Apostle" Samael had also arrived, and numerous undead spirits under his control were forcing the various demons to temporarily join forces... Even "mad" Hila, the "Slaughter Apostle," gave up on breaking into the corridor and stopped attacking the demons blocking his path.
—In his view, "Light" and "Charm" would be unlikely to achieve a decisive victory quickly, so it was better to take this opportunity to kill Samael, who had become a public enemy, and thus eliminate a competitor.
Just as both sides entered a chaotic melee, the "Light Apostle" suddenly appeared from behind. He raised the scepter with the white orb at its tip, and then, "Holy Light" personally unleashed by the "Lightseeker" evil spirit indiscriminately illuminated the entire scene.
Although the "Death Apostle's" undead suffered the heaviest losses from this, other demons, including "Light"'s own subordinates, all cried out in agony, unable to even maintain their demonized forms.
They were demons, evil, and thus naturally countered by "Holy Light."
This made Ebner, observing the battle from his room, want to cover his face, thinking: This former Pope Orbach's soul has been in decline for over a thousand years; his mind is clearly not functioning well... using a "Sun" pathway AoE in a demon horde? Isn't that equivalent to a mass taunt? The other two "Charm Apostles" will probably team up to kill you first!
Oh, right, he no longer has a brain...
After a quick jab, Ebner's heart suddenly stirred. He then subtly glanced in the direction of the hot spring water and deliberately, in a commanding tone, told "Chesi," who was controlled by the Magic Mirror , "Go help the 'Light Apostle' deal with 'Slaughter' and 'Death.'"
"Yes, Master." "Chesi" didn't hesitate, opening the door and walking out directly.
Not long after she left, the hot spring water, which had been slightly rippling due to its flow, completely calmed down, then reflected Ebner's image in the room.
"'Mirror Apostle' Herta, huh? He finally couldn't resist making a move!"
Ebner's lips curled slightly. He then found that his position had swapped with his reflection, and he had entered an unknown space, roughly the size of a primary or secondary school classroom.
"No, it should be said that the layout of this space is a classroom... Is this 'Mirror Apostle' Herta's high-level Sealed Artifact? He still chose to act after witnessing me dominate 'Chesi'; he's very confident in himself!"
As Ebner was thinking this, several lines of text suddenly appeared on the blackboard:
"Welcome to 'Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth.' You can only leave by answering ten questions correctly in a row.
"For each correct answer, a reward will be given;
"If you answer incorrectly, your current progress will be reset, and you must start over...
"First question: What will be summoned if you collect seven Dragon Balls?"
Upon seeing this, Ebner's eye twitched a few times. When he first saw the blackboard, podium, tables, and chairs, he didn't suspect anything, as Roselle had already standardized such layouts. Not just in Intis, but many school classrooms in Loen and Feysac were also arranged this way...
But "Alvin Abraham"? Isn't that the senior "Wanderer" who was "slumbering" at the foot of the "Mother of the Sky" statue in the City of Evernight?
And this question... unless you're a Transmigrator or an Ancient One, no one would be able to answer it, right? Even if you guessed one or two correctly, it would be impossible to answer ten questions!
No wonder the information "Chesi" provided said that the "Mirror Apostle's" enemies often mysteriously disappeared...
Being trapped in a quiz labyrinth, with no food or drink to worry about... those questions themselves would be maddening... And such fluctuations in mental state would easily be exploited by "Charm Apostles" hidden in other mirror worlds, allowing them to plant "Seeds of Desire"!
But this place is pretty much a freebie for me... Not to mention I probably know most of those questions, I could easily leave just by using the ritual with the "Door" card, or by praying to Mr. Fool.
However, the reason I let him pull me in... wasn't just to get out easily!
More importantly, this "Quiz Labyrinth" is quite good; I plan to take it and study it...
As he pondered, Ebner answered loudly:
"My answer is, Shenron!"
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 735: The Quiz
chapters.content:
Chapter 735 - The Quiz
"Answer correct.
"Issuing reward..."
Not long after Ebner's words fell, two lines of text suddenly appeared on the blackboard. Then, as a sneer echoed, a bottle of unknown liquid appeared on the podium at the front.
"Hmm... Although it's bottled, this is undoubtedly the hot spring water from the 'Gentle Words' hotel... and it has Chesi's added ingredients." Ebner picked up the bottle and glanced at it, immediately making a guess in his mind.
"It seems the so-called rewards given by the 'Quiz Labyrinth' after a correct answer are provided by the holder of this Sealed Artifact... He probably can't violate this rule, otherwise, he wouldn't have bottled water for me..."
"Of course, it's also possible he's deliberately messing with my head, then seizing the opportunity to plant a 'Seed of Desire'."
When facing a "Charm Apostle," one must never have overly strong emotional fluctuations or display too obvious desires, otherwise, a "seed" will immediately be planted, or one will be remotely controlled, or directly catalyzed and detonated.
In a sense, the "Mechanical Mind" of a "Knowledge Keeper" truly is the bane of a "Charm Apostle."
"Furthermore, during the quiz, that 'Mirror Apostle' probably cannot peek into the 'classroom,' otherwise, he would have made a sound earlier to pressure me."
"Hmm, it's probably because the Transmigrator senior didn't want outsiders to know the questions... So, either they get trapped here and die, or they're one of their own, capable of answering ten questions..."
"This isn't hard to verify. If I answer a few questions correctly in a row, I'll know if he only appears during the breaks in questioning!"
Thinking this, Ebner put down the "hot spring water" and told the "blackboard" that he was ready.
Soon, the second and third questions were easily answered1 by Ebner.
These two questions were not the kind of unspoken questions shared among Transmigrators, but rather two history questions. They weren't simple, but for a "Polymath" like Ebner, who had read extensively, they weren't difficult either.
And that voice belonging to the "Mirror Apostle" indeed only came through with the rewards during the questioning window.
What was more noteworthy was that the reward for the second question was a cup of beverage, while the reward for the third question was a brand new tie.
Hot spring water isn't worth much... that drink is about 5 pence. This tie, judging by the brand, should be between 5 and 10 solidi.
The value of the rewards is progressive, and likely by orders of magnitude... The items given after the fourth question will definitely be measured in gold pounds... At this rate of increase, by the tenth question, can that "Charm Apostle" really afford the price?
And what consequences would there be if he couldn't pay?
As Ebner narrowed his eyes in thought, he heard the gloomy voice of "Mirror Apostle" Herta coming from the broadcast:
"Do you know? Since this Sealed Artifact came into my hands, as long as one's luck isn't so bad as to encounter some incomprehensible questions from the start, it's not uncommon for people to answer 3 questions correctly in a row... But from the fourth question onward, obscure questions become more and more common, and I only know two people who have managed to persist until the sixth question!"
"Also, a free piece of information: once you answer incorrectly, once you restart, even normal questions will become much harder!"
He finished speaking, sneered again, and then fell silent.
Tsk tsk, he's trying to pressure me, but seeing that I don't have the emotional fluctuations he expected, he plans to mess with my mind again after I make a mistake?
Too bad, I think your mind will be the first to break!
While feeling "pleased" internally, Ebner began to tackle the subsequent questions.
The fourth question indeed presented considerable difficulty, requiring the improvement of a ritual. Fortunately, this was a "Reader's" strong suit, so he passed easily.
The fifth and sixth questions were both related to anime from his previous life: one asked the location of the Marineford Arc in One Piece, and the other asked the name of the poison Conan drank at the beginning...
This couldn't help but make Ebner suspect that the senior named Alvin Abraham had a similar range of knowledge to his own, perhaps they were peers.
As for the rewards he received after successfully passing three rounds, they were a shirt, a formal suit, and half a tube of demon blood, respectively.
"Sure enough, the shirt costs around 1 pound, the formal suit is about 10 pounds, and half a tube of demon blood is an excellent spiritual material; it would definitely sell for 100 pounds..."
"This is truly a quantitative leap!"
As Ebner pondered with the half-tube of demon blood, Herta's chilling voice came through again:
"Your luck is truly extraordinary to have answered six questions correctly in a row!
"Unfortunately, starting from the seventh question, it will involve high-sequence knowledge, and the probability of obscure questions will also be higher. There was once a 'Mysticism Magister' holding a Beyonder item with the 'Winner' ability who was trapped here and also stopped at the eighth question!"
His tone hadn't changed, but his words clearly carried a hint of "curse"...
Is this guy panicking a bit? That makes sense. The item value corresponding to the seventh question will likely be 1000 pounds, which is no small sum... And the eighth question will jump directly to 10000 pounds. It's normal for him to panic, especially since my answering speed is beyond his expectations.
Ebner chuckled to himself, then directly initiated the seventh question:
"What is the name of the Sequence 2 potion for the 'Seer' pathway?"
Tsk, an ordinary mid-Sequence Beyonder probably wouldn't know this... But for a Transmigrator, this question is a piece of cake!
"Miracle Invoker!" Ebner gave the answer without hesitation.
This time, after nearly half a minute of waiting, the reward appeared on the podium.
It was a "Knowledge Keeper" potion formula.
Although it's completely useless to me, this space clearly recognizes its value...
Ebner nodded thoughtfully. Then, without waiting for the "Mirror Apostle" to speak, he immediately started the eighth question.
The new question that appeared on the blackboard was indeed quite obscure. Even Transmigrators or Ancient Ones might not be able to answer it...
"Someone came to buy what?"
Ebner pondered for a moment, then cautiously replied, "Melon?"
"Answer correct!
"Issuing reward..."
A moment later, a Beyonder item was "teleported" onto the podium... It was a double-barreled shotgun, with different symbols and patterns drawn on its left and right sides, making it look quite magical.
A Beyonder weapon worth ten thousand pounds? It must have been crafted with a Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic, at least? Of course, it could also have used several Sequence 6s...
Just as Ebner was about to appraise it, a phantom of "Mirror Apostle" Herta actually appeared on the classroom's glass window.
"Ninth question, you cannot answer correctly again! Otherwise, one of your three women will die!"
After he finished speaking, the glass window displayed a scene of a demonized wildcat tearing apart the orange cat and capturing Fors, Helene, and Fanny.
He wasn't genuinely expecting Ebner to give up on the quiz, but rather to disrupt his state of mind and create an opportunity for himself.
However, observing this scene, Ebner's reaction was far from what the other party anticipated; in fact, his lips even curled into a smile.
That wildcat could tear Leon apart? This is either a purely fake image, or Leon, after subduing that demonic wildcat, transmitted a false image to the other party!
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 736: The Last Question
chapters.content:
Chapter 736 - The Last Question
As Ebner had guessed, the image displayed by the "Mirror Apostle"—of the demonic cat killing the "Orange Cat" and capturing Fors, Helene, and Fanny—was a deliberate illusion transmitted to him by "Lion" Leon, who had "intercepted" the connection between the "Mirror Apostle" and the wildcat.
In reality, the demonized wildcat was already at a disadvantage in its battle with the three ladies.
At the beginning, it had fallen into a state of extreme complacency, convinced it had torn the "Orange Cat" to shreds, as if Helene and the other two were already meat on its plate.
"When your enemy loses wisdom due to arrogance, you are wisdom itself." This was the core effect of the "Hand of Wisdom" glove Ebner had given Helene, stemming from one of the "Bribers'" abilities.
Therefore, the demon cat, over two meters long, was merely "provoked" a few times by Helene before it completely abandoned its defenses against Fors and Fanny, and focused all its attacks on Helene. In an instant, "sulfur fireballs" and various "blasphemous words" rained down as if they cost nothing.
As an "Arsonist," Helene possessed good physical qualities and abilities, and the "Bribe" effect weakened those attacks. Coupled with a series of buffs applied by the hidden "Lion" Leon, she miraculously managed to hold her own against the demon, engaging in a back-and-forth struggle with only minor superficial injuries.
This performance naturally enhanced the "provocation" effect, causing the demon cat, fully intent on tearing out Helene's internal organs, to completely miss Fors on the other side holding a head-only puppet towards it...
It was only when its thoughts became sluggish and its movements stuttered that it realized the problem... Unfortunately, it was already a bit late!
The moment the demon cat was initially brought under control, three mechanical puppets, wielding a total of twelve high-pressure steam rifles, unleashed a storm of ammunition. "Demon-hunting bullets" imbued with "Holy Light" effects continuously struck it.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft! Pfft...
As puffs of sulfur-scented blood mist exploded on its body, the demon cat's mouth slowly opened, letting out stuttering, intermittent screams.
Fanny herself extended her right hand, aiming the "Ring of Light" at the monster not far away. Immediately after, golden, illusory flames ignited out of thin air, one after another.
These flames emitted a solar aura, merging into an ocean due to their density, and continuously surged into the demon's body along its wounds.
This was "Flame of Light" from the "Sun" domain!
Speaking of which, each of the three "mechanical puppets" also sealed a "Flame of Light," but their power was far inferior to the Sequence 5 level "Ring of Light." Furthermore, Fanny had learned her lesson from the underground castle of Baron Conval, saving them for unforeseen needs.
Meanwhile, "Lion" Leon, hidden in the shadows, also plucked a mane hair at the opportune moment and solemnly declared, "I announce that the Flame of Light is effective against demons!"
This was a power belonging to the "Notary" of the "Sun" pathway, which could temporarily boost the effectiveness of a "notarized" ability!
On the other side, the demon cat, whose mind was still in a sluggish state, for the first time perceived the malice from the "Orange Cat" that should have been dead...
It... it's actually... that powerful?!
Although it realized this, it was too late. The "Sun Fire," amplified by a demigod's "notarization," raged within its body. Even its powerful physique after "demonization" could no longer resist, and it eventually turned into a pile of dust amidst the golden flames.
Its Beyonder characteristic didn't have time to precipitate; it simply merged into the dust, forming an "ash"-type Sealed Artifact with it.
Seeing their attack succeed, Fanny and Fors quickly rushed to Helene, who was covered in blood, to tend to her wounds.
"It only looks a bit scary. With the potion Leon provided and a 'Hunter's' recovery ability, I'll be fully recovered in a few days," Helene wasn't too concerned about her injuries. Before being captured by "Ailment Maiden" Tracy, she had fought other pirates and even sustained injuries several times more severe than this.
"I didn't expect you to be so strong; you actually managed to contend with such a terrifying monster head-on..." Fors, seeing that Helene was indeed fine, spoke with a mix of envy and admiration.
"That's because of Leon's help," Helene shook her head. She knew her own limits. Without the "buffs" Leon had placed on her, let alone fighting, she probably would have been disemboweled by the demon's initial pounce.
Fanny, who was on alert nearby, interjected, "The sounds of battle outside seem to be getting softer... Should we go help Ebner?"
But before Helene and Fors could answer, "Lion" Leon revealed himself and sneered, "You just make sure you don't get into trouble yourselves! As for that kid... he won't get into trouble!"
If he really got into trouble, wouldn't this place immediately turn into an angelic battlefield? At that point, you wouldn't have to worry, because no one would survive!
Of course, he didn't voice these latter thoughts.
Just then, "Lion" Leon sensed the "Mirror Apostle's" mental communication, and after a malicious chuckle, he transmitted his concocted "image" through the connection.
—From the very start of the battle, "Lion" had "stolen" the connection between the demon cat and its owner.
"Who would have thought that the so-called 'Mirror Apostle's' true, unique mutated ability was actually to communicate with and control Beyonder animals?"
"The 'mirror' abilities he 'promotes' to the public must rely entirely on a certain Sealed Artifact... Tsk tsk, what a treacherous and cunning demon. I wonder how that kid is going to deal with him."
.....
In "Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth," within the classroom located in the mirror world.
Ebner completely ignored "Mirror Apostle" Herta's threat, letting the other party display a scene on the classroom window glass of the demonic cat tearing open "Fanny's" chest and devouring her heart, while still having the blackboard display the ninth question.
"Too fake... The image Leon provided is too perfunctory! How could Fanny's chest be so 'flat'..."
Ebner muttered to himself, then focused on the question:
"In the Type-Moon world, what is the name of the Heroic Spirit Medusa's Mystic Eyes?"
This is both a myth from my previous life and game knowledge... The Old Ones of this world might be able to answer it, but people after the civilization's collapse wouldn't even have a place to guess! No wonder Herta initially completely disbelieved that anyone could actually answer ten questions.
Moreover, this question is very obscure. If I hadn't played that game, I probably would have stopped here too.
"Cybele." Ebner, drawing from the memories of his previous life unearthed by his "Reader" abilities, spoke the answer.
"Answer correct!
"Issuing reward..."
The eighth question's reward was worth around ten thousand pounds. This time, it should be a hundred thousand, right? Tsk tsk, this is a test of wealth, Mr. Herta, put in some effort!
Ebner waited for a few minutes with a "rejoicing in others' misfortune" attitude, then saw a pile of documents land on the podium.
He picked them up and found that they included bank deposits, certificates for land, real estate, mines, and stocks, as well as corresponding property transfer deeds.
Roughly 100,000 acres of Intis countryside land, two wine estates, a luxury villa in Trier, a copper mine in West Balam Colony, shares in Ritter Port Shipping Company and Soussi Bank...
All together, these items were worth over one hundred and fifty thousand pounds! Hmm, stock prices and land values fluctuate greatly, so saying it's a hundred thousand pounds isn't a problem.
Tsk, he's really rich! He's a financial capitalist, a big landowner, and a mine owner... As expected of an old geezer who has lived for nearly a hundred years, far stronger than Jason Beria in Backlund, whose entire fortune was only 50,000 pounds!
After putting away these documents, Ebner heard no more from the "Mirror Apostle." Perhaps his mind broke after signing those transfer deeds?
Of course, it's also possible he realized threats and intimidation were useless against me, and he's plotting some other nasty trick!
Just as Ebner was pondering and asking the blackboard for the 10th question, the voice of the "Mirror Apostle," which shouldn't have appeared at this time, suddenly rang out:
"Hahaha! You're finished!
"It turns out the tenth question requires me, the 'master,' to choose the question! Because of you, I learned this rule for the first time...
"It seems1 my things will ultimately still be mine! And yours will be mine too!
"Hmm, let me think... You seem very good at those obscure questions... Then I'll choose a normal question for you that you absolutely cannot know!
"I need to search! I need to search carefully! Huh?
"Got it... This... to think there would be a question of this level!
"This question perfectly meets my requirements!
"You're truly finished! Hahaha!"
Amidst the "Mirror Apostle's" slightly fearful yet wildly arrogant laughter, Ebner, with furrowed brows, saw the question displayed on the blackboard:
"What is the true name of the Evernight Goddess?"
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 737: The Labyrinth’s Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 737 - The Labyrinth's Secrets
Scanning the question on the blackboard and hearing the hysterical laughter of the "Mirror Apostle," Ebner's lips gradually curled into a smirk.
"It seems that over a hundred thousand pounds in assets is probably Herta's limit... Even if he has some cash or scattered items, it's certainly impossible for him to gather items worth a million pounds."
"In the original work, Count Wolfe, a great noble and landowner, only received 290,000 gold pounds after selling 840,000 acres of land in the countryside."
"Miss 'Justice,' the wealthiest woman in 'Lord of the Mysteries,' had an initial 'dowry' of only 300,000 pounds."
"In the original work, the only people explicitly capable of producing such a large sum of 1,000,000 pounds, besides the Loen Royal Family, were Count Hall, a great banker, Duke Negan, Loen's largest landowner whose annual income from land alone was around 1,000,000 pounds, and Baron Sindras, who spent 1,000,000 pounds to 'buy' a hereditary baronetcy."
"It's impossible for 'Mirror Apostle' Herta to reach their level of wealth before stepping into the demigod realm."
"Furthermore, if he can't pay the full 'reward,' his fate will likely be extremely miserable, which is why his emotions became so agitated after knowing he could choose the question himself, to the point where I even think he was close to losing control..."
"After all, as the most prone to losing control among Beyonder pathways, the inability to control emotions and desires is often a precursor to 'losing control.'"
While these thoughts raced through his mind, Ebner unhesitatingly gave the answer, which was a no-brainer for a Transmigrator: **"Amanises!"**
As for whether reciting the true name would invoke divine power? Ebner thought it unlikely. After all, this wasn't the Forsaken Land of the Gods or the Twilight House in Port Indu, places shrouded in dark divine power. Moreover, he was using English, a language without mystical power.
—Although names are largely similar across different languages, the pronunciation would still differ slightly.
Additionally, in the original work, the elf Shatas from *Grohsel's Travels* directly spoke the name "Goddess of Misfortune" Amanises, and there was no particular reaction.
Of course, most importantly, when Ebner pondered alone, he would sometimes unintentionally murmur "Amanises" or "Lilith" to test the two goddesses' reactions. The conclusion he drew was that They would not "punish" him for such minor matters.
Therefore, he had few qualms about speaking the goddess's true name.
As Ebner gave his answer, "Mirror Apostle" Herta's laughter abruptly ceased. He shrieked in an exasperated tone:
"Impossible!
"Absolutely impossible!
"Why did the 'Labyrinth' deem your answer correct when you clearly didn't give any answer?!"
"You cheated!"
But as soon as he said this, he let out a shriek, followed by frantic pleas for mercy:
"Give me some time... please give me some time!
"I promise to gather items worth 1,000,000 gold pounds within a month... no, a week...
"No! You can't take my spirit..."
The voice abruptly vanished at this point, but a book and a Beyonder characteristic that resembled black mist appeared on the podium in the classroom.
The book recorded the entire life experiences of the "Mirror Apostle" and all the knowledge he possessed. The characteristic was his own Beyonder characteristic... It was unknown what method this labyrinth used to extract it in such a short time.
At this moment, lines of text reappeared on the blackboard:
"Herta's life experience and all knowledge valued at 150,000 pounds, Beyonder characteristic valued at 10,000 pounds, totaling 160,000... Current debt of 840,000, with a daily interest of one millieme."
"It is recommended that the clear-thinking individual use the outstanding debt to exchange for the usage rights of 'Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth,' directly becoming a Level 4 holder of the 'Labyrinth.'"
"If the clear-thinking individual gives up the opportunity to become a holder, the 'Labyrinth' will select a Level 0 permission holder. Should the clear-thinking individual re-enter the 'Labyrinth' in the future, they can directly exchange the 'debt' and accrued 'interest' for quiz answers. Note that a holder can also spend an equivalent amount to offset the clear-thinking individual's 'exchange.'"
Good heavens, this "Labyrinth" has a very familiar pattern! As expected of something built by a Transmigrator senior, this "flavor" is quite pungent!
However, it feels like the "Labyrinth" is hiding a lot of important information... Hmm, this thing is probably "alive"!
After secretly grumbling, Ebner thought for a moment and then asked, "What is the highest level of authority in this labyrinth?"
The blackboard quickly displayed the answer: "Level 5."
"How much value is needed to possess Level 5 authority?" Ebner pressed.
"Level 5 authority requires 1,000,000 gold pounds... but gold pounds are only one condition. The prerequisite you currently lack is 'the Creator's consent.'"
The Creator's consent? Does that mean I have to resurrect that "Wanderer"? No... perhaps it will be enough when I improve the "Manipulation" secret art, allowing me to truly "perfectly fuse" with him, turning him into something akin to a "clone"...
Did the "Wanderer" senior build this "Labyrinth" with the additional purpose of urging me, a latercomer, to improve? What exactly did he gain from it?
As his thoughts spun, Ebner asked again, "What does Level 5 authority include?"
"Sorry, please become a Level 5 holder before inquiring." The text on the blackboard changed instantly.
"Then, what is the minimum 'recharge' for a Level 4 holder... no, what is the minimum requirement in gold pounds?" Ebner thought for a moment, then rephrased his question.
"500,000 pounds..." The blackboard was silent for a while before a new line of text appeared.
Judging by its reaction, this "Labyrinth" was indeed "alive"! Having confirmed his earlier guess, Ebner narrowed his eyes and said, "So, there's no need to use all 840,000 you owe me to 'exchange' for authority right now... I can just pay 500,000, and let the other 300,000-plus debt accrue interest daily?"
"Yes..." The text that reappeared on the blackboard was more loosely written, seeming somewhat weak.
"What can these excess debts be used for?" Ebner asked again.
"They can be used to offset the reward you owe when others answer questions...
"They can be used to adjust the 'Labyrinth's' modes and facilities...
"They can be exchanged for one-time attacks of different values."
Money for attacks? That's interesting...
Thinking this, Ebner tentatively asked, "What type, what pathway of attacks?"
"Money itself is power; no external seeking is needed!" The text on the blackboard read.
"The power of money?"
Ebner was somewhat confused, as to his knowledge, there had been no "money" Beyonder authority or symbol in the world of mysteries.
After a brief thought, Ebner still spent 500,000 pounds to exchange for the so-called Level 4 authority of this "Labyrinth."
Soon, the knowledge corresponding to various authorities was displayed before him.
The other information was nothing much, just related to the item's usage... But the last paragraph, introducing the "Labyrinth's" origin, caught Ebner's attention.
"The 'Labyrinth's' main material is a semi-divine characteristic from an unknown pathway that the 'Wanderer' obtained on an alien planet during his cosmic travels?"
"Is it suspected to be the pathway wielded by the Goddess of Wealth on that planet?"
"The Goddess of Wealth's authority involves 'travel,' 'knowledge,' 'wealth,' 'protection,' and 'trade' in various domains..."

chapters.title: Chapter 738: Aftermath
chapters.content:
Chapter 738 - Aftermath
In a Gothic-style manor on the outskirts of Lynn City, the silver-haired, silver-eyed Lady Helene sat opposite a woman in a pure white gown.
This lady had dazzling golden pupils, a charming, shallow smile playing on her lips, and lustrous, waist-length black hair.
In terms of looks alone, she couldn't compare to Helene opposite her, but the alluring aura she exuded possessed a unique charm.
She was Yarubed Beria, the current patriarch of the Beria family, and also a double-crosser groomed by Adam.
—It's worth noting that the name Yarubed was also a new designation given to her by Roselle after he had tasted the delights of a "succubus."
At this moment, the two ladies were sipping tea, observing a round mirror placed on the table between them.
The mirror displayed the battle at the "Gentle Words" hotel, which was nearing its end.
Seeing "Chesi" transform into a demon and cleave a fleeing "serial killer" with a "lava sword," Yarubed tapped the table with her pale finger and looked across, saying, "'Charm Apostles' are all dead except Herta... Nearly seventy percent of the 'Demons' are dead... Is this what you meant by him knowing his limits?"
"Isn't this what you hoped for?" Helene didn't answer directly, but instead smiled and said, "These Beria family elders usually relied on the Nors family, and even the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' to ignore your commands, didn't they?
"Even this operation targeting Detective Bryan, if it weren't for the 'Devil' characteristic as bait, if the Nors family hadn't also given orders, would they have been so proactive?"
Yarubed was silent for a few seconds before saying, "At least half of the Beyonder characteristics must be left for me... I need them to improve my controlled subordinates."
"I have an agreement with Detective Bryan to split the gains from this evenly. I'll try my best to secure more characteristics for you..." At this point, Helene's goddess-like beautiful face showed a mercenary expression, and her silver pupils were filled with playful amusement as she said, "However, what will you use to redeem them?"
"You traded the cost of stopping me and preventing me from acting for that half of the items, didn't you?"
Is it really appropriate to ask me for money again after that?
Yarubed felt somewhat speechless, only thinking that the other party resembled a demon more than she did.
"Is there a problem with that?" Lady Helene asked with a smile.
"No problem... it's just that you really don't seem like a vampire..." Yarubed shook her head, then after a moment of hesitation, continued, "Aside from the sulfur mines, all the industries the Beria family has operated in Lynn City for over a hundred years can be yours... Anyway, after this attack, the family can no longer hide in Sivellas... If the official forces target us, those industries will be confiscated sooner or later, so it's better to let you have them cheaply."
The Beria family's demons rarely committed crimes near Lynn; even if someone occasionally couldn't resist, they would target Highlanders, so they had always hidden very well, escaping official notice.
—A large portion of Highlanders would leave their ancestral lands upon reaching adulthood, entering Backlund, Trier, Feysac City, and various prosperous cities and ports in the Northern Continent. Some became laborers, while others became fresh blood for local gangs... In short, no one would pay attention to their disappearances.
"Deal." Lady Helene nodded after a brief estimation. Then, she glanced at the circular mirror, which showed "Chesi" beginning to organize items, and smiled, "It's over. I'll go check now."
Before her words faded, huge illusory bat wings appeared on her back, and then her entire being vanished.
After she left, Yarubed snorted, staring at the circular mirror, murmuring to herself:
"Herta died too... Hmph, that detective has good methods. The ritual he set up was something even I couldn't see through or sense..."
"He even invited Helene... If not for her, I would never have allowed so many 'Apostles' to be killed!"
"At least 'Light' and 'Mirror,' who have no connection to the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' didn't have to die!"
"He even controlled Chesi? What a cunning and lecherous fellow, just like Roselle..."
"But this is also good. If the 'Mother Tree of Desire' turns its attention to him because of this, my pressure here will be significantly reduced..."
"Speaking of Roselle, when will those 'rules' he imposed on me, using that 'Labyrinth' he got from who knows where, finally be lifted?"
"The rule about 'not killing innocent civilians' has caused me countless troubles when cultivating subordinates... Fortunately, this world doesn't lack villains who deserve to die."
.....
In the "classroom" of "Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth."
Goddess of Wealth... Beyonder pathway from an alien planet...
Ebner eagerly used his spirituality to "click" on the flashing text for "detailed content" behind this piece of information, only to see a "paid to view" prompt...
That "Wanderer" senior built this item purely to spite society, didn't he?
Ebner couldn't help but inwardly grumble at this, then he closed the Level 4 authority list, preparing to leave this "Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth."
—Although the viewing fee "only" required 10,000 gold pounds, which wasn't much for Ebner, who still held over 300,000 in debt claims, now was clearly not a good time to peruse that information.
Next, as the "classroom" door opened by itself, Ebner took a step and found himself back in his hotel room where he had set up the ritual, beside the hot spring pool.
In his hand, he now held a pair of square-framed glasses with pure gold frames, which was the true form of the "Labyrinth."
According to the brief introduction he had just read, with his current Level 4 authority, this item, in addition to its ability to pull enemies from any mirror into the "Quiz Labyrinth," also allowed the holder to perform "mirror jumps," detect the location of high-value items, and other such abilities...
"But the prerequisite is, you must pay!
"As expected of a pathway wielded by an alien planet's Goddess of Wealth, it really is a money-grubber!"
After grumbling to himself, Ebner activated his "Pure White Eye" again and "analyzed" the glasses for a moment. Only after confirming that its abilities and effects matched the description, did he take off his perpetually worn copper-framed glasses and put on the new ones.
Then, just as Ebner was about to use the "ritual" to check on the battle in the hotel, he saw "Charm Apostle" Chesi enter, holding the Magic Mirror in one hand and "Light Apostle" Baruch's scepter with the white orb at its tip in the other.
Using his "Pure White Eye," Ebner easily discovered that an additional "Charm Apostle" characteristic had been integrated into the scepter, and the aura of Orbach, the former Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, flickered within it, but was highly unstable.
It was likely that after Baruch's death, his characteristic was absorbed by the scepter, and Orbach, who had always relied on Baruch for his existence, transferred his spirit into the scepter.
While contemplating this, Ebner glanced at "Chesi" a few more times, noting that she hadn't suffered any serious injuries, but was once again unclothed due to her earlier "demonization"...
He casually handed her a bathrobe from by the hot spring and then asked:
"What's the situation?"
"Master." "Chesi," controlled by the Magic Mirror , reported while dressing:
"The battle has ended.
"The angelic evil spirit, at the cost of its host's life, heavily wounded 'Death' and 'Slaughter'...
"Their two subordinates betrayed them, killing them, and then massacred each other to seize the characteristics. The final victor was killed by me while trying to escape.
"In short, apart from some 'criminals' and 'serial killers' who saw the unfavorable situation and fled early, only seven or eight 'demons' escaped after paying a significant price...
"I've roughly tidied up the other people's items and characteristics according to your prior instructions and placed them in another room.
"And I've already cleaned up the demon corpses and bloodstains."
Cleaned up? You "ate" them clean, didn't you? Tsk, I didn't expect that while I was delayed in the "Labyrinth" for a bit, the battle here not only ended, but the battlefield was even cleaned up...
Although he thought this, Ebner still praised the Magic Mirror on the surface: "Well done."
"Chesi" immediately bent her eyes upon hearing this, acting somewhat coyly like a little girl...
To make that expression with such a seductive appearance, it really is...
Ebner averted his gaze. After simply putting away the ritual setup, he was about to go to the adjacent room to check on Fors and the other two.
But just then, as a beam of moonlight shone through the window into the room, Lady Helene's figure appeared before him.
.....
First Hunt
Above the house at 15 Incense Tree Avenue in Bayam, a scene of Gehrman's first hunt was unfolding.
After a bitter struggle, "Admiral of Blood" Fatherson's flagship first mate, "Iron" Maivity, who was still at a disadvantage, turned his head and saw two bolts of lightning, like bullets, shoot from Klein's dark brown eyes, piercing into his pupils.
He instinctively threw his head back, gritting his teeth, blood seeping from his nostrils, mouth, and ears, mixed with his previously melted skin.
This was the "Spirit Pierce" from the "Interrogator" herded by "Creeping Hunger"!
For "Zombie" Beyonders, whose bodies are like steel, damage to the spiritual body is more effective!
The spiritual attack caused "Iron" Maivity's body to briefly stiffen while simultaneously loosening the shackles of his sanity. Black, stiff hairs grew on his face, his teeth and nails continuously lengthened, and his skin writhed, trying to re-coagulate, fading from dark to pale, like a true, mad "Zombie" craving fresh blood!
Seizing this opportunity, Klein had already closed in, then leaped high. The dagger hilt he had been holding in his hand instantly transformed into a long-handled scythe. With a mere flick, the "Zombie's" armor-like skin was completely torn open, and then its head was severed!
This was the "Blade of Interment," a 5-minute demigod weapon crafted by Ebner.
"Tonight, Gehrman joins the hunt!"
In the moonlight, the young man spoke softly.
He wore a silk top hat, a black trench coat, holding a large scythe in one hand, and his other hand covered by transparent human skin. Illuminated by the clear light, he looked as if he were bearing the massive red moon on his back.

chapters.title: Chapter 739: Dividing the Spoils
chapters.content:
Chapter 739 - Dividing the Spoils
After herding "Steel" Maveti's soul, Klein avoided Danitz's gaze and then stopped maintaining his persona, quickly removing the crystal from the Burial Blade to restore it to its hilt form.
"Because I had to 'perform' Gehrman's 'madness,' I used it for more than a minute longer than planned..."
Looking at the tiny cracks on the crystal, a heartache, Klein couldn't help but turn his gaze to Maveti's corpse, hoping to make up for his losses from it.
He quickly found 26 pounds, 11 soli, 8 pence in cash, and a pile of seemingly normal but actually strange items, such as candles, clamps, spiked leather whips, and so on.
Considering "Steel" Maveti was a member of the Rose School and belonged to the desire-indulging faction, Klein vaguely understood something, spat, and put away the cash.
To his disappointment, the Admiral of Blood's third mate didn't carry any Beyonder items.
"'Werewolves' have super self-healing abilities, and 'Zombies' have steel-like bodies, so they indeed don't need to carry healing potions or items... This aligns with Sharon's judgment that she told me about above the gray fog: Maveti had no magical items... Also, magical items are rare, and many have obvious flaws and negative effects, so not everyone wants to own them, or can own them..."
"Fortunately, he himself is worth a lot of money!"
While thinking this, Klein took out a folded piece of paper from his pocket.
It was a wanted poster, with Maveti's portrait and the corresponding bounty amount printed on it:
"6000 pounds!"
"According to the agreement with Mr. Hanged Man, he'll give me half once he gets the money!"
Just as Klein was filled with joy at the prospect of 3000 pounds entering his account, in a villa on the outskirts of Bayam City, Miss Abby, the daughter of local gang leader Mr. Bose, suddenly woke up from her sleep.
This lady was also the mistress of the Governor of Bayam, and someone Lion Leon had warned Ebner to be wary of before he left the Rorsted Archipelago.
At this moment, having just tumbled out of bed, she knelt on the floor and devoutly made a gesture belonging to no orthodox deity, murmuring, "As Your will commands, great Mother Tree of Desire.
"I will surely complete Your task when the false god is distracted elsewhere!"
Then, she stood up and took out candles and other ritual items from a room drawer, setting up a small altar.
A moment later, a black rhino horn-shaped necklace, only the size of a finger joint, appeared before Abby.
After devoutly thanking the Mother Tree for the bestowal, Rabbi shook the bell by the bed and called in the gang members who had become vassals of the Celestial Sect, instructing them, "Mobilize manpower to help me inquire about an adventurer named Gehrman Sparrow.
"The operation must be covert; you can use our inside man in the Governor's Mansion to investigate...
"But absolutely do not let the other party become aware!
"Remember, the other party is a very formidable adventurer."
Several confidantes immediately responded, "Yes, Your Excellency, Fertility Envoy."
"You can just call me 'Miss' normally." Abby corrected, then added, "Once the investigation yields initial results, report them to me immediately... I will arrange the subsequent actions!"
...
In Lynn City, Sivella County, Gentle Words Hotel.
After counting the gains from this war with the Beria family, Ebner and Lady Helene began to divide the spoils... no, to distribute the spoils of war.
It was worth mentioning that, unaware if Lady Helene was secretly observing, Ebner did not conceal that he had killed "Mirror Apostle" Herta and plundered over a hundred thousand pounds worth of assets from him. He only omitted the details related to the Quiz Labyrinth. After all, the latter involved the "Wanderer" senior and extraterrestrial characteristics, so it was better left unsaid if possible.
After a brief discussion, the two ultimately decided that the characteristics and items of the three Apostles—Charm, Light, and Mirror—would all belong to Ebner, while those of Death and Slaughter would be Lady Helene's share.
As compensation for missing one "Charm Apostle," all characteristics and items from the other "Demons" and "Serial Killers," except for the "demon cat" killed by Fors, Helene, and Fanny, would belong to Helene.
Ebner had no objection to this, as every Beria family elder was incredibly wealthy, worth at least over a hundred thousand pounds... All the demons and serial killers combined weren't as valuable as a single elder!
For example, the "Light Apostle" who had already merged into the "scepter" was superficially an inherited baron in Segal.
Although Segal was a small country and the value of inherited nobility there couldn't compare to Loen, even without accounting for assets, just obtaining this status itself either required a significant amount of time to accumulate contributions and connections, or cost at least 300,000 pounds to "buy" from the Grand Duke of Segal.
—The "Light Apostle" Baruch clearly took the former route, spending nearly a century to successfully acquire the title.
As for "Charm Apostle" Chesi, she was the behind-the-scenes boss of many high-end brothels in major cities in central and western Loen...
Ebner only needed to pose as Baruch and sell "noble" heir quotas to easily gain over a hundred thousand gold pounds...
Of course, he felt that this noble title might still be useful, so he planned to temporarily retain it.
As a "Charm Apostle," Baruch had openly claimed to be residing abroad for a long time, returning only once a year on the winter billing day. So, at least for this year, there wouldn't be any problems.
Therefore, this distribution method, on the surface, seemed like Helene was losing out... unless she sold them a second time.
After they had gathered their respective items, Helene was about to take her leave when Ebner suddenly called out to her, asking, "Do you know why the Beria family attacked me?"
Although he knew from the "knowledge" left by Chesi, Baruch, and Herta that their main purpose was to seize the "Devil" characteristic, how his possession of this item was leaked was not mentioned.
Despite achieving a "great harvest," being ambushed for no apparent reason, he still needed to understand the cause.
"It was an order conveyed by 'Nors' through the Delien family... but you should know which entity stands behind them." Lady Helene said cautiously after casually setting up a barrier with moonlight.
"The Delien family? They're also colluding with the demon family?" Ebner frowned. His trip to Intis this time was ostensibly to help Lion open a newspaper, establish their shared film and television industry in Trier with Helene, and help Fanny get revenge on the Fryers family... But in essence, his biggest goal was to uncover the true relationship between the sea monster with the "Prophet" characteristic and the Delien family, and to eliminate the sea monster's helpers as much as possible.
So, upon hearing that Delien was also involved with demons, he blurted out:
"The entity behind it... is the Mother Tree of Desire?
"I remember that the current Prime Minister of Intis is from the Delien family... Don't the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun and the Church of Steam care?"
Lady Helene, seeing the question, organized her words and explained:
"Two demigods from the Delien family are Archbishops of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
"Their piety is beyond doubt...
"Any collusion could only be the choice of a portion of the family.
"Moreover, the Prime Minister's power is heavily restricted; he's merely a representative of various interests. Even if he were truly a cultist, the harm wouldn't be too great."

chapters.title: Chapter 740: The Feast of Desire
chapters.content:
Chapter 740 - The Feast of Desire
"What's more, exposed 'demons' are easier to monitor... And even as high-ranking officials of the Intis Kingdom, the Delien family, even if they collude with demons, would not allow them to openly commit egregious acts..."
"In short, as long as there's no clear evidence, the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun won't move against the political forces they've fostered."
"After all, the Delien family also possesses a Grade '0' Sealed Artifact. Pushing them too hard might lead to even more terrifying disasters..."
"This is just like how the three Loen Churches tolerate some minor actions by the Augustus family."
After listening to Helene, Ebner nodded thoughtfully, also noticing a piece of information Helene's words revealed:
"The Delien family possesses a Grade '0' Sealed Artifact?"
The information Xio had received from Vera before didn't mention this.
Lady Helene smiled and explained, "This is information Yarubed deliberately leaked, but she also doesn't know what that Sealed Artifact specifically is... but it's definitely related to the Mother Tree of Desire."
The Mother Tree of Desire... this evil god's reach is truly far! The Delien family's relationship with It is probably closer than I previously imagined... The Churches might have misgivings, but the Eternal Blazing Sun wouldn't truly be unaware, would It?
Why would It allow a family supported by an evil god to become Prime Minister?
Even if, as Lady Helene said, the Prime Minister is just a representative of interest groups and holds power that won't cause too much harm... shouldn't even small harms be taken seriously?
Moreover, if small harms accumulate to a certain extent, they might indeed lead to disaster!
Is the Eternal Blazing Sun plotting something?
Though confused, Ebner knew he wasn't in a position to meddle in a true god's affairs, so he reluctantly put the thought aside for now.
Seeing that he had no further questions, Lady Helene curtsied, smiled, and said, "It was a pleasure cooperating with you, Mr. Bryan... I look forward to future opportunities like this."
"Furthermore, you don't need to worry about the aftermath. With Yarubed and me covering things up, the official squad in this city found no issues... and I will voluntarily report to the three Churches afterwards, not implicating you."
As soon as she finished speaking, she transformed into moonlight and vanished from the hotel.
Of course you're happy. You made so much money from this trip; if I were you, I'd also want to continue cooperating in the future...
After muttering to himself, Ebner removed the room's barrier, and Fors, Helene, Fanny, and Lion Leon entered at that moment.
"Ebner..." Fors had just greeted him, wanting to ask what had happened, when she suddenly saw "Chesi" beside Ebner, clad only in a bathrobe, and blurted out, "This lady is...?"
She doesn't look like an enemy, but when did Ebner get another woman this beautiful and seductive?
The three ladies sized up "Chesi" with various thoughts, especially Fanny, who suddenly felt a sense of crisis, because in front of this lady, her physical advantage completely vanished.
"She's one of the 'Charm Apostles' who attacked me... However, her mind has been controlled by my Magic Mirror; she's just a puppet now." Ebner explained casually, while also observing Fors and the other two. He noticed that, aside from Helene, no one else was injured, which put him at ease.
Then, he used the secret art "Violet's Perfect Restoration," causing five-colored light composed of white, black, blue, green, and red to envelop Helene. In the blink of an eye, she was restored to her original state.
"This secret art is really effective. What's its name? How about this, I'll provide opportunities to help you 'act' it out?" At this moment, Lion Leon, staring at the five-colored light, suddenly spoke.
Although it had witnessed Roselle's process of crafting the "Fallen Morning Star" necklace, it had never personally seen the effects of the secret art within it.
Ebner did not answer immediately, but first glanced at Fors. He had mentioned the name "Violet's Perfect Restoration" at the Tarot Club, so if he answered now, Fors might recognize it... While being recognized wasn't a big deal, it would seem too unskilled to be exposed just for this.
If there's going to be an exposure, Xio's side should be exposed first!
With various thoughts swirling in his mind, Ebner simply nodded, then took out a card sealed with The Cube and handed it to Lion Leon, briefly explaining the usage of the "occult" version of the camcorder.
This was a video backup prepared for the City of Silver, lest the spiritual energy in The Cube be exhausted before they could learn...
Consider it your reward for protecting Fors and the others!
Ebner muttered to himself as he explained.
Come to think of it, he had originally intended to pick a piece of loot as a reward for Leon, but now, of course, he wouldn't.
Just as the man and the lion were conversing, the Magic Mirror also controlled Chesi to greet the three ladies: "Good evening, my hostesses."
Fanny was quite pleased with its address, and her earlier slight worries vanished... After all, it was just a puppet controlled by a Sealed Artifact.
Helene, on the other hand, was a bit embarrassed, her face instantly turning red.
As for Fors, she didn't really care. Months ago, she and Xio were often mistaken as the "Hero Detective's" lovers at various social events, even Miss Audrey had heard about it. Initially, she would try to explain, but after it happened too many times, she became lazy to clarify, as she had already gotten used to it and there was no loss...
Hmm, sometimes there were even benefits... like attracting the envy of some ladies, or feeling more at ease staying at Ebner's place without having to worry about others' gazes...
Having briefly finished explaining the usage of The Cube to Lion, Ebner suddenly noticed that the atmosphere among the ladies was a bit subtle. He performed a slight "Trace" and understood the reason, so he proactively changed the subject, recounting the entire story of the previous battle.
Of course, this was limited to the part about the Charm Apostles' attack; information involving higher-level existences like Helene, the Mother Tree of Desire, and the Goddess of Wealth was omitted.
But even so, the three ladies listened with trepidation.
Five Charm Apostles, dozens of mid-Sequence Demons and Serial Killers, and even more Criminals—such a force, lacking only a demigod, could almost rival a Pirate Admiral's power.
Even the current King of Immortality couldn't assemble such a lineup.
After hearing the full story, Helene, Fors, and Fanny, while suddenly understanding Ebner's previous arrangements, also gained a new perception of his strength.
Helene had always known Ebner was very strong, but only thought he was comparable to Tracy... But now, it seemed she had underestimated him... Even Tracy couldn't have so easily taken down five Charm Apostles.
Fors had some idea of Ebner's background, knowing he was a divine favored one who had rapidly ascended several Sequences to become a Sequence 5.
But this was also the first time she clearly realized just how powerful Ebner truly was.
"Perhaps among those below demigod, only Mr. Tower and Mr. World of our Tarot Club are his match!"
Fanny's eyes sparkled, as she finally saw hope for killing Johnsen Fryers and avenging her grandfather.
Although Ebner had previously spoken of helping her with revenge, Fanny had always felt he was just comforting her... But now, she felt that once Ebner became a true demigod, revenge might not be an issue.
However, Ebner, who "read" their thoughts, felt a bit awkward at this moment. After all, while such a "glorious" battle result was indeed due to his "strategic planning" and individual defeat of enemies... in reality, he didn't participate in any actual combat.
Charm Apostle Chesi was hoist by her own petard, inversely controlled by the Magic Mirror.
Mirror Apostle Herta ran out of money and lost himself.
Light Apostle Baruch was also ridiculous, possessed by an "angel," and surrendered directly.
Slaughter and Death had it even worse, inexplicably self-destructed by the Light Apostle, resulting in their deaths by betrayal from their subordinates while severely wounded.
Speaking of which... there were indeed some "coincidences" in this process!
However, it didn't seem to be orchestrated... Judging from the Quiz Labyrinth, it was more like some kind of aggregation.
Just then, Ebner's heart suddenly stirred. His Pure White Eye activated, receiving a passive "prophetic" revelation:
"The Feast of Desire."
The Feast of Desire? Does it refer to tonight's event?
Feast... Could it be that these Charm Apostles were entrapped by my "gathering disaster" constitution?

chapters.title: Chapter 741: Attempting to Decipher
chapters.content:
Chapter 741 - Attempting to Decipher
After chatting for a while longer, everyone prepared to rest... It was just past midnight, and there was still some time before the 9 AM train departed, so they needed to rest as much as possible.
After all, riding a steam train was quite "energy-consuming," and even a first-class compartment wasn't exactly comfortable...
Only Fors looked at the hot spring water, feeling a bit regretful... Even if the Magic Mirror "ate" the bodies cleanly, quite a bit of blood still flowed into the hot spring... At least, it wasn't suitable for bathing tonight.
Seeing this, Ebner's heart stirred, and he called out to them again.
Under the confused gazes of the three ladies and one lion, he spiritually communicated with the "golden glasses" perched on his nose, then brought everyone into "Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth."
—Although official Beyonders wouldn't detect the abnormality at the Gentle Words Hotel in the short term, some of the "demons" who escaped earlier might return, making the place essentially unsuitable for rest.
This time, Ebner did not appear in the quiz classroom, but inside a luxurious villa.
This villa was not only lavishly decorated with many rooms, but also came with its own hot spring pool, making up for the regrets of Fors and the others.
This was one of the privileges of Ebner's Level 4 authority: he could rent a "mansion" in the "Labyrinth" for 50 gold pounds per day.
Although the price was quite exorbitant, Ebner didn't mind. After all, this "Quiz Labyrinth" still owed him over 600,000 in debt, and the daily interest of one millieme amounted to over 60 pounds. This rent wouldn't even dent the principal of the debt.
On the other side, Fors, Helene, and Fanny, seeing that Ebner had no intention of explaining, wisely didn't ask too many questions. After choosing their respective rooms, they happily headed towards the hot spring pool.
Only Lion Leon surveyed his surroundings, then looked at the clock face, which was distinctly different from the outside world. His lion face showed a peculiar expression as he said, "This environment feels very similar to my 'den' in Lake Daniel..."
They were all transformed from the Mirror World, so of course they're similar...
Ebner glanced at him and casually asked, "Where did you learn the Mirror World transformation technique for constructing your 'den'?"
This "Quiz Labyrinth" was incredibly stingy; it only displayed the "mansion" after it was modified according to his request, giving him no opportunity to "learn."
He had originally wanted to seize the opportunity to secretly learn, so he could develop a "Mansion Spell"...
"Naturally, I learned it from Roselle." Lion Leon said matter-of-factly.
The Great Emperor was truly a polymath... but that's also normal. He had "in-depth" exchanges with many Demonesses, so he wouldn't be unfamiliar with the Mirror World.
With rather unseemly thoughts turning in his mind, Ebner arranged a room for Leon, then "teleported" himself to a massive palace with five tiered platforms.
The columns, steps, and floor of this palace all seemed to be cast from gold, making it somewhat blinding...
Aside from the color scheme, the layout of this palace is very similar to the main hall at the deepest part of Daniel's Labyrinth... especially the "sacrifice" altars in front of each platform, which are identical.
However, I used to sacrifice "1-025" to open the third platform of Daniel's Labyrinth... whereas here, between each level, what needs to be "sacrificed" is money...
Perhaps Daniel also obtained this work from the "Wanderer" senior back then?
Ebner was currently on the fourth level, which corresponded to Level 4 authority, and he could freely travel between the first and fourth platforms. However, when he tried to ascend to the fifth level, he was blocked by an invisible force.
Afterwards, he first returned to the first level and unexpectedly saw a very old and disheveled set of clothes there.
This must be what Herta left behind, right? So he was only a Level 1 authority holder.
I saw in the Book of Knowledge extracted from his spirit that he liked to disguise himself as a beggar when carrying out missions... Despite being worth hundreds of thousands, he liked to pretend to be a beggar. Is there something seriously wrong with him?
And this clothing was so worn out that even the money-grubbing "Quiz Labyrinth" rejected it...
After tutting a few times, Ebner glanced at the Level 1 authority content and realized he might have somewhat misunderstood Herta.
It turned out that Level 1 authority granted very few abilities to the holder; it could only rent a small space less than 5 square meters, and entry and exit both required payment... and the fee was determined by a person's value.
If one dressed too well, their value would be higher, and the fee paid would be more... This might have been Herta's main reason for dressing the way he did.
While contemplating this, Ebner ascended the stairs, exploring each level and focusing on reading the permissions for each level and the list of previous holders who had reached that level.
Just like that, upon reaching the third level, he suddenly discovered an unexpected, yet logical, name: Roselle Gustav.
"The Great Emperor was once a holder of the Quiz Labyrinth?"
"One of the conditions for Level 3 authority is answering 8 questions correctly. It seems the Great Emperor faltered on the last two questions and didn't enter the fourth platform."
"Speaking of which, the mechanism of the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower' is actually somewhat similar to this 'Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth'... Perhaps the Great Emperor got his inspiration here, which is why he created that miraculous item after becoming the 'Emperor of Knowledge'?"
As Ebner pondered, he suddenly saw a flashing "Details" prompt light up under the Great Emperor's name, very similar to the previous extraterrestrial "detailed information" that required "paid viewing"...
This was a "message" function that only became available at Level 3 authority, and the Great Emperor was the only person who "left a message" on this level, because there were no other Level 3 authority holders.
"10 pounds? That's not too expensive..." Ebner looked at the price, then directly "swiped" the debt to "open" the content.
Immediately after, a deep voice rang out: "Although the questions are not the same each time, they all seem to conform to some inherent logic... These questions might contain some deep meaning... Unfortunately, I never knew the answer to the varying ninth question, nor had I ever seen what the tenth question was."
That's it? No wonder it only cost 10 pounds, there's no useful information at all!
As for the possibility that those questions contained some deeper meaning, Ebner had actually suspected it after answering, but hadn't had time to sort it out, as it could have just been his illusion.
But since the Great Emperor also had this feeling, it wouldn't be a misunderstanding...
Ebner recalled the previous questions and mused:
"The first question asked about 'Dragon Ball,' and the answer was 'Shenron'... On the surface, this was about anime, but it might actually be hinting at 'wishing' and 'miracles'... And that 'Wanderer' senior was indeed preparing the 'Miracle Invoker' ritual in the Nation of the Evernight."
"The second and third questions were two history questions, with nothing special about their content or answers, but they referred to historical events after the War of the Four Emperors in the Fourth Epoch and the Pale Disaster, respectively."
"This should correspond to the eras when 'Blood Duke' Rhine Kalendia and 'Death Consul' Vincent Miranda were active."
"Perhaps it's hinting at these two Transmigrator seniors."
"The fourth question asked me to improve a ritual..."
"Combining with the previous ones, is this suggesting that if I want the 'Wanderer' senior to become a 'Miracle Invoker' and leave the 'Nation of the Evernight,' I need to rely on the knowledge left by seniors Rhine and Vincent to modify a secret art that can perfectly integrate with the 'Wanderer's' body?"
"So the second and third questions actually refer to 'Blood Feast' and 'Book of Necromancy'?"
"Next, the fifth and sixth questions were two anime questions, asking about 'Marineford War' from 'One Piece' and 'the name of the drug Conan was given'..."
"'Marineford War'... Is this hinting at a divine war? And what does the shrinking drug in Conan allude to?"
"The seventh question again asked about 'Miracle Invoker'... What does this mean? Does a divine war require the abilities of a 'Miracle Invoker'?"
"The eighth question, 'Hua Qiang Buys Watermelon'... On the surface, it has no meaning, but this TV show is called 'Conquest'... 'Conqueror'? Then could Conan earlier allude to 'Death'?"
"The ninth question, 'Name of Medusa's Mystic Eyes'... 'Cybele'."
"In Type-Moon's setting, Medusa is a degraded ancient Earth Mother Goddess, and 'Cybele' is precisely the name of that ancient Earth Mother Goddess."
"So, this refers to the 'Earth Mother Goddess'?"
"As for the last question, it undoubtedly points to the Evernight Goddess."
"But what do these latter ones mean when connected?"
Looking at the keywords laid out before him, Ebner couldn't help but grumble:
"It can't possibly be trying to tell me that the prerequisite for me to participate in the 'Marineford War' is to 'conquer' the Earth Mother Goddess and the Evernight Goddess by 'drugging' them, can it?"
"Ugh! I'm a 'Detective,' not a 'Cryptologist,' so I'm really not good at analyzing this kind of thing..."

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Blood-Colored Pupils
chapters.content:
Chapter 742 - Blood-Colored Pupils
"However, one thing is certain: the 'Wanderer' senior who left these hints and coded messages probably isn't intentionally being a 'riddler'."
"He can't speak directly, otherwise a certain entity would know?"
"Is this because the coded messages mention a certain entity, or because the answers to these riddles themselves are part of a plot against a certain entity?"
"Hmm, this entity's status should be very high, at least an Angel of God or a True God..."
"Heh, before, Daniel plotted to rescue the Chained God, also leaving no spoken or written words, relying only on the mystical connections and tacit understanding between Transmigrators to complete the layout... Is it my turn to decipher Alvin's plan now?"
"But with so little information, I can only guess blindly... Do I have to wait until I become a demigod to understand further?"
Staring at the keywords he had analyzed, Ebner thought for a moment and took out a monocle from his pocket.
This was one of three items obtained in the Nation of the Evernight from Panatiya, the Despairing Nightingale, who was killed by the historical projection of Death Consul Vincent.
It was crafted from a Dream Weaver characteristic and originally possessed a "living" quality, but under the "pale flame" of a complete mythological creature, this quality had already "died."
This item could grant the wearer "deciphering" abilities comparable to a high-Sequence... Ebner had previously suspected it was essentially Amon's "clone."
Holding the monocle, Ebner hesitated for a long while, but ultimately didn't put it on...
Even after being handled by the Death Consul, it's still too dangerous... To use this item, it's best to reforge it.
"Unfortunately, I used the secret art 'Disintegration' on it whenever I had time before, but I never successfully triggered the effect of restoring Beyonder items to 'Beyonder characteristics'..."
Sighing, Ebner put away the "lens," and then stopped pondering the connections between those questions. After all, with a lack of understanding of many things, the interpretation might very well be wrong from the start...
At this time, Ebner envied Klein more; his "intuition" was always so accurate... while his own "prophecy" needed a certain amount of related knowledge as a foundation to achieve similar effects.
Because the interpretation wasted a lot of time, and Ebner, having just gone through a battle, was also feeling a bit tired, he didn't go to the fourth platform to "purchase" detailed information about the alien planet. Instead, he directly "teleported" back to the "leased" "mansion."
—Of course, this also had something to do with his desire to accumulate a few days of "interest" before exchanging.
By this time, Fors and the other two had already finished bathing and returned to their respective rooms to rest.
Seeing this, Ebner also soaked in the hot spring, served by the Magic Mirror, washing away his fatigue.
During this time, he also organized the Beyonder items he had acquired.
The two items obtained from Chesi, the Charm Whispers Necklace which could release various desire-stirring auras, and the Wind Blessing Ring, a Wind-blessed item afraid of seawater, remained on Chesi, who was controlled by the Magic Mirror.
Fors had seen these two items earlier, and they weren't suitable for sale at the Tarot Club.
Ebner had just taken the time to "appraise" Herta's double-barreled shotgun, which the Quiz Labyrinth had valued at ten thousand pounds, and generally understood its functions:
"It is crafted from the characteristics of a Conspirer and a Wraith; the two barrels can fire 'flame' and 'frost' bullets respectively."
"Any target hit, whether intelligent or non-intelligent, will develop an inexplicable 'hatred' towards the shotgun's wielder."
"When wielding this shotgun, one can transform into a special wraith, possessing most of the abilities of the Wraith Sequence."
"Additionally, while the negative effects are few, they are all fatal..."
"For instance, each use deepens one's faith in a certain hidden existence, until one becomes Its fanatical believer."
"This 'hidden existence' can be specified by oneself, but must at least possess the status of an angel."
"Another example: it will cause a certain desire within oneself to become uncontrollable, leading to constant indulgence..."
.....
Symeem Island
On Symeem Island, which also belongs to the Rorsted Archipelago but is the farthest from the "City of Generosity" Bayam, requiring nearly 5 hours by passenger ship to reach.
Leticia Dolera, a member of the Moses Ascetic Order, along with two companions, searched for the hidden "elf ruins" in the Symeem Island jungle, based on a "prophecy" obtained from the elven "Trial Temple."
Meanwhile, Klein also arrived on the island by ship.
Unlike the original work, since Winter became the butler of Fragrant Manor and Ebner hadn't dismissed him even after leaving Bayam, but instead gave him the Sleepless potion, allowing him to assist "Sea Snake" Weif in managing the Amyris Leaf Bar...
So, Klein wasn't impersonating him to "confess" to his beloved, as he was supposed to be dead...
Klein had heard that the "Black Death" had appeared near this island and decided to investigate the whereabouts of "Vice Admiral of Ailment" Tracy.
—He had herded "Steel" Maveti, liberated the soul of a "Nightguard," and learned from him that a batch of literature about Death might be with Tracy.
However, as soon as Klein disembarked, his spirituality stirred. He slightly turned his head and quickly met a pair of blood-colored pupils.
They belonged to a young silver-haired lady.

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Natural Disaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 743 - Natural Disaster
Silver hair, blood-red pupils, a woman whose features were obscured...
Even though his reflection was already visible in the other party's pupils, it didn't mean Klein truly saw her...
This was just an image that suddenly appeared in his mind!
Who?
Klein's steps didn't falter, his body showed no stiffness. He walked normally down the gangplank onto the dock, just as he had before.
Then, he walked and paused, casually tossing a coin, before winding his way into a restaurant. He requested the innermost private room on the second floor and ordered a few dishes.
After the waiter left the private room, Klein stood up and went to the wall on one side of the room. He pressed his left palm against it—he judged that the blood-red eyes that had been quietly watching him were in the adjacent room.
As his palm touched the wall, a partial scene of the neighboring private room naturally appeared in his mind:
A long table, a few chairs, a coat rack, and wooden crates holding beer... It was the simplest possible layout for a restaurant private room.
And since it was just past two in the afternoon, not dining time, there was no one inside.
Already gone?
Klein had only been probing, so he immediately withdrew his left palm, walked back to the table, and sat down, acting as if nothing had happened.He had performed a divination when he casually tossed the coin earlier, and the result was that the lady bore no ill will... but this wasn't necessarily accurate; it would be better to confirm it above the gray fog.
But I might still be under surveillance right now, so I need to find a safe place to enter the gray fog... Hmm, I looked at a map before coming to Symeem Island and remember there's a Church of the Earth Mother Goddess south of the town.
Since the Earth Mother Goddess invested in me through Mr. Tower, it should be safe there... I'll just change into Detective Bryan's appearance later and go in, which also counts as role-playing for a Faceless.
As he thought this, the waiter had already served a special dish he had just ordered.
This food was called "Teatiwa," which translated to "meat in fruit" in Loenese—the chef used a local giant fruit called "Teana," hollowed out its pulp, leaving only the firm rind, then stuffed it with mashed lamb and fish, seasoned with sea salt and several spices, and repeatedly roasted it over fire. The meat was delicious and exuded a unique aroma, perfectly blending with the sweet and slightly sour taste of the fruit.
Klein really liked the taste of meat mixed with the sweetness of fruit; the Dasi pie he most often ate in Backlund had a similar texture.
After eating his fill, Klein slowly stood up, savoring the delicious taste, paid the bill, and went downstairs to board a carriage, heading towards the church south of town.
While in the carriage, he quietly changed his appearance... The native coachman, who dared not look directly at him, didn't notice.
.....
Just after Klein left the restaurant, a slender figure suddenly appeared in the previously empty adjacent room.
It was a lady whose face seemed obscured by mist, revealing only a pair of blood-red eyes, making her features unclear.
She wore an elegant black robe with a hooded cloak and held a slender wooden stick only about twenty centimeters long.
"He's truly a cautious person..." The lady seemed to nod with satisfaction, then she looked towards the northern jungle and sighed, murmuring to herself, "If only Leticia could be so cautious... As an Astrologer, to be as reckless as a Storm believer... No wonder she has such a 'destiny' with that Book of Calamity..."
"This is truly unlike my descendant... even if her bloodline is very thin."
The word "destiny" was something she had heard from a friend a long, long time ago. Speaking it now, a hint of melancholy appeared, but the lady quickly composed herself.
Just then, her blood-red eyes suddenly narrowed. Immediately after, she used Mystical Reappearance—Nantianmen, stepping into an elven temple constructed of crystal. At the very moment Leticia was about to open the Book of Calamity, she directly summoned that yellowish-brown parchment book to her hand.
At this sudden turn of events, Leticia and her two male companions were startled. They each drew their weapons, aimed them at the blood-eyed lady whose features were obscured, and demanded, "Who are you?"
The hooded, blood-eyed lady stared at them for a while before slowly speaking, "I remember telling you not to open it before you came."
"Told me...?"
Leticia was stunned for a moment, then her greenish-gray eyes widened as she blurted out, "You... You are Ancestor Yarolan?"
Months ago, when she went to Olavi to explore the Elven Trial Temple, she had received a task from her ancestor, and in the end, it was her ancestor who rescued her from the "disappeared" temple.
But she had only ever heard her voice, never seen her person...
Thinking back now, the voice was correct... But why would her ancestor have blood-red eyes?
Just as Leticia showed a suspicious expression, the lady whose features were obscured nodded and said, "I am Yarolan."
With that, she removed the "Peeping" effect from her eyes. The blood-red color immediately receded, turning to gray.
And as the blood-red color receded, so did the layer of "mist" obscuring her face.
It was a face much more delicate and much younger than Leticia's, seemingly imbued with a hint of "beauty," causing Leticia and her companions to stare in a daze.
Of these, part of Leticia's reaction was due to the other's "beauty," but another part was because her Peeping Eye, which she subconsciously activated, saw the shadow of a complete mythical creature...
In other words, the lady before her was an Angel!
If the other party hadn't restrained herself, only letting her see a shadow, her reaction would have been more than just "dazed"!
On the other side, the lady named Yarolan, having revealed her identity, waved her hand and brought the group out of the temple. Then, ignoring her descendant, she placed her hand on the book's cover and began to communicate on an "information" level.
—As a Mystery Pryer Sequence 2 Sage, Her mythical form was already a pure stream of information.
Moments later, Lady Yarolan withdrew her hand, but her pupils once again turned blood-red:
"The Calamity characteristic is still there... but the connection with the Elven Queen is 'broken'!"
"Could Cohinem have completely fallen?"
"No... Although Her fate is very difficult to observe, there are still ripples in the River of Fate..."
"More importantly, the 'thing' hidden in the Book of Calamity is also gone..."
"Did She arrange a contingency plan elsewhere?"
"Or... is it his doing again?"
.....
In the Church of the Earth Mother Goddess on the south side of the port town, the priest, who was wiping tables and chairs, was startled when he saw Klein push the door open and walk in, seeing the face of "Detective Ebner Bryan" disguised by the Faceless ability. He took a few quick steps forward, pulled him into the back room, and urgently asked:
"Detective Bryan, how dare you still show your face in the Rorsted Archipelago?"
"You should know that the commotion caused by your farewell hasn't settled down yet!"
"The Governor of Bayam even privately issued a bounty for you on the black market!"

chapters.title: Chapter 744: "Rats."
chapters.content:
Chapter 744 - "Rats."
Upon hearing this, if not for his Clown abilities, Klein's expression would surely have contorted in uncontrollable surprise.
But even so, the corner of his eye twitched slightly, as if he was doubting whether his portrayal of "Mr. Tower" was correct.
"What on earth did Mr. Tower do in Bayam that was so earth-shattering?!"
