Klein secretly clicked his tongue, deciding to inquire about it as soon as he returned.
After pouring out a torrent of grievances, the priest finally asked Klein, "Did you come here for something?"
"I just need to borrow the restroom..." Klein coughed and replied, thinking to himself that after performing a divination above the gray fog, he would immediately leave the church and switch back to "Gehrman's" face!
Speaking of which, the reason he came to Symeem Island was because he had accidentally heard information in a Bayam hotel that "Vice Admiral of Ailment" Tracy would be visiting here, so he wanted to try his luck and see if he could retrieve those documents about Death from her.
Who would have thought that as soon as he disembarked, he would be targeted by some mysterious strong individual... He wondered if he would miss the time "Vice Admiral of Ailment" appeared.
.....
In Intis, inside the Golden Radiance Manor on the outskirts of Tosk City.
A handsome middle-aged man sat in the sunroom, listening to his subordinates' reports.
A moment later, he stood up and walked to the French window, watching the shimmering lake nearby as he said,
"So, the Beria family's operation completely failed? A demigod from the Church of the Earth Mother Goddess cleared their ambush beforehand?"
His subordinate was an old man with gray hair but a rather rosy complexion.
The old man wore a stiff suit and a monocle, looking meticulous.
At this moment, he replied with a serious expression:
"Yes, Your Excellency Seyrow.
"Among the 'demons' who ambushed Detective Ebner Bryan, one was our informant. He escaped... According to him, they didn't even see the target's face before they started killing each other...
"This is probably something only high-Sequence Beyonders of the Spectator pathway can accomplish... And in the Church of the Earth Mother Goddess, there are indeed Manipulators who have become favored ones."
The middle-aged man, who was the son of the Delien family's Prime Minister, Seyrow Delien, nodded thoughtfully and calmly said, "It seems that detective is much more valued by the Church than we expected... Heh, Yarubed probably didn't make a move, did she?"
"Yes, Your Excellency. The surviving demon said he didn't see the Beria patriarch make a move." The old man confirmed Seyrow's conjecture.
"That's normal. Devils are cunning; with a Church expert guarding, how would she dare to show her face easily?" Seyrow sneered, then asked, "What's the Beria family's loss?"
"That demon informant escaped quite early and didn't notice the subsequent battle, but he speculates that over ten 'demons' were likely killed!"
"As for the 'Apostles,' he thought that, except for 'Light' who was in considerable danger, the other Lords should be fine... After all, each of them has powerful trump cards." The old man replied after a brief thought.
"That's right, those Charm Apostles aren't so easy to kill... Even I can't guarantee leaving any of them behind in a one-on-one fight... Let alone if they teamed up... If they could work together, they might even force back that demigod from the Church of the Earth Mother Goddess... What a pity!" Seyrow Delien sighed.
"However, even if they're not dead, it will be difficult for us to contact them in the short term..." the meticulous old man reminded.
"I understand that... Demons, with their personalities, definitely won't come out and operate again until their injuries are healed and their combat strength is restored to its peak." Seyrow nodded, then casually asked, "When will that Detective Bryan arrive in Tosk City?"
"That detective seems to have switched trains with another identity midway, so I don't know when they will arrive in Tosk," the old man replied carefully, "But I have already sent people to guard the station..."
Before he finished speaking, Seyrow waved his hand, interrupting him, "That detective is reportedly already a Polymath, with diverse methods. If he truly doesn't want to be noticed, the people you sent will be useless...
"But don't worry too much; the young lady from the Sari family is among those accompanying him... They will show themselves openly sooner or later."
Speaking of this, he changed the subject and asked about another matter he had been concerned about: "Has the whereabouts of 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' Edwina Edwards been found?"
"I wounded her; even if she's good at healing, she won't recover that quickly. She must still be in Tosk City!"
"I've received definite news from the Varian family that 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' was rescued by someone..." The old man finally straightened his chest as he answered this time.
"Who were they?" Seyrow frowned and asked.
"A bunch of rats hiding in the sewers!"
.....
Deep within the intricate sewers of Tosk City, a natural underground cave connected to a pool filled with sewage. Edwina lay weakly on a bed in a small room partitioned within the cave.
Outwardly, she had no injuries, but she could deeply feel her spirit being entangled by a "corrupted" power.
This was a wound left after being struck by the "Blade of Flesh and Spirit"...
Who would have thought that Seyrow Delien, considered merely a playboy by the outside world, was actually a Black Knight, a demigod!
After the young girl who was looking after her secretly snuck out to play, Edwina opened her eyes, then used the last bit of strength in her body to struggle into a sitting position and chanted the "honorific name" that Ebner had long discarded, originally belonging to "Doctor Strange":
"The Polymath of the mysterious domain;
The Researcher of dreams and space;
Ebner Bryan from the unknown.
"I pray to share my location with you..."
Then, she transmitted the route she had drawn in her mind, as well as a badge she saw on the bedside table, which seemed to be composed of multiple symbols, together as memory images to the existence pointed to by the "honorific name."
.....
On the other side, Ebner, Helene, Fors, Fanny, plus Chesi, who had "transformed" into a maid, and Lion Leon, five people and one cat, left Lynn City on Friday morning, continuing westward.
Fearing that their itinerary might be tracked again, Ebner first took them with Lion through "mirror travel" to another small city nearby. Then, using fake identities previously prepared by Chesi, they bought train tickets and boarded a steam train again.
At this moment, on Saturday morning, Ebner was sitting on the newly departed train, recording coordinates along the way.
—His simulated "teleportation" ability, or the "teleportation" spell he modified, could only "teleport" to places he had visited before... This was the main reason he needed to travel all the way to Intis by train.
But just then, his Pure White Eye suddenly activated on its own, transmitting the scene of Edwina's prayer.
"Edwina is in trouble?!" Ebner immediately sat up straight, carefully observing the content provided by his Pure White Eye.
Edwina didn't specifically describe what she encountered, only providing her surroundings and a simple map of the sewer.
—After she was rescued earlier, although she appeared to be in a coma, she actually maintained the necessary vigilance, so she recorded the route using a "secret art."
"The sewers of Tosk City...
"I remember that the last frame of the picture of Mr. Cotton Sari's characteristic whereabouts, given by Arrodes, was an 'artisan' who had participated in the 'Hermit Gathering of Fate' finally crawling into the sewers of Tosk City...
"And the design of the badge Edwina saw in her current room...
"Others might not recognize it, but I have a clue...
"Is that actually an English abbreviation?!
"MIB...
"Man In Black?
"Roselle's remnants of the 'Men in Black'?"

chapters.title: Chapter 745: The Rat Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 745 - The Rat Way
As thoughts whirled, Ebner shielded the senses of those around them, then directly asked Lion Leon, "What do you know about Roselle's 'Men in Black'?"
"You mean the organization mainly composed of Beyonders from the Marauder and Assassin pathways?"
"I don't know too much about them... I only know they were led by Edwards... and often engaged in unsavory dealings..."
"Of course, they were much better than the 'Great Tomb' organization led by that fellow Yaldabaoth...
"The latter is much more notorious!"
Lion Leon snorted, clearly having a low opinion of both organizations under Roselle.
Marauder and Assassin... These two pathways are indeed excellent for intelligence and espionage! And since they were led by Edwards, they shouldn't be a threat to Edwina... Ebner nodded thoughtfully, then asked, "Were there high-Sequence Beyonders in the 'Men in Black'?"
"Of course there were before. Roselle even used a captured Amon clone to create an item equivalent to a Grade '0' Sealed Artifact and placed it in the 'Men in Black' headquarters." Leon replied casually.
Amon's clone... Sealed Artifact... Did Amon target Roselle's Marauder organization, only to get caught when he went to steal a bite?
While pondering, Ebner briefly explained the situation to Lion and asked him to look after Fors and the others. Then, he took Chesi, who was controlled by the Magic Mirror, and passed through the train wall, flying at full speed towards Tosk City relying on his Flying Cloak.
.....
Tosk City is located outside a valley at the border of Loen and Intis. It is a well-known trade port city in Intis, thus its economy is quite prosperous.
This city was the birthplace of the Surrey family. Originally, both its economy and politics were controlled by the Surrey family, but in the past decade or so, as the Surrey family's influence entered the high ranks of the Republic and they moved to Trier, the city's "authority" gradually shifted into the hands of the Varian family.
The Varian family was also nobility from the Solomon Dynasty, and even more powerful than the Delien and Fryers families at that time.
Unfortunately, after Roselle came to power, such "former dynasty" nobles naturally became primary targets for suppression, and the higher their noble status, the more thoroughly they were purged.
Thus, the Varian family failed to seize significant benefits from the events leading to the overthrow of the Augustus Dynasty, becoming a third or fourth-rate power, even having to dabble in the "underworld"...
It wasn't until the Surrey family left Tosk that they seized the opportunity to legitimate themselves and rise.
But even so, this family still has intricate ties with the local gangs in the area... such as the "Man In Black" organization hidden in the "Rat Way"... Of course, many people call it the "Thieves' Guild" – because its current function is very similar to the "Thieves' Guilds" depicted in some of Roselle's novels.
—The "Rat Way" is what residents call Tosk's sewer network, and also implicitly refers to the "rats" who hide in the sewers, engaging in illicit activities.
At this moment, in the office of the Varian Winery, a woman in her thirties, dressed luxuriously, was questioning another man.
They were Lister and his wife Denise, the current heads of the Varian family.
Lister, who had just celebrated his thirtieth birthday, looked at his wife, who was constantly pounding the table, and a ruthless glint flickered in his eyes before quickly disappearing. He feigned helplessness and said, "Dear, it's not as serious as you think..."
"What do you mean, 'not as serious as I think'? When you sold out the 'Thieves' Guild' to that playboy from Trier, did you not consider the consequences?"
"Heh, I know he's from the Delien family, the Prime Minister's son... But we're not obligated to help him find a runaway woman! What's more, that woman is connected to the 'Thieves' Guild'!"
"You know, our Varian family managed to control such an important port city, completely bypassing the administrative officials appointed by Trier, all thanks to the support of various local forces..."
"But now that this has happened, how do you expect them to view us?"
"They'll only think that if you could sell out the 'Thieves' Guild,' you'll sell them out sooner or later too!"
"Besides, do you think the 'Thieves' Guild' is easy to provoke? Once they take action, several counties in northeastern Intis will fall into chaos!
"And most importantly, even though you're my husband and have taken the Varian surname, becoming the family's head... why didn't you consult me beforehand on such an important matter?"
Looking at his furious wife, Lister didn't answer directly. Instead, he deflected, "Weren't you busy competing with other wine brands then? I thought it would be bad to disturb you... Besides, it's just a woman. I thought that as long as he made the request, the 'Thieves' Guild' wouldn't refuse him... They might even use this to build a connection with him and perhaps even thank me afterwards..."
"Nonsense! Is your brain full of crap? How could the 'Thieves' Guild' save a stranger for no reason? That woman must have a connection with them... And given their unity, they won't hand her over!" Madam Denise slammed the table again upon hearing this.
What do you know, you foolish woman? That playboy might be a good-for-nothing, but his butler might be a demigod!
That's a half-human, half-god existence. How dare I defy him? Let alone me, even if the Varian family and all the forces in Tosk City combined, they'd be nothing in front of a demigod!
Of course, you don't need to know this... Perhaps when this matter is successfully concluded, with that gentleman's support, I'll no longer have to bow to you and can truly take charge of the Varian family...
Lister mused inwardly, but outwardly, he seemed lost for words, stammering.
After her outburst, Madam Denise glared at her husband, ignoring him. She simply tossed out, "I'm going to the 'Thieves' Guild' to explain this," then put on her hat, donned her coat, and left the room.
As a former great noble, even in decline, the Varian family still had some foundation. Therefore, compared to flattering a playboy, Madam Denise valued their standing more.
This foolish woman cannot be allowed to ruin that lord's plans!
On the other side, Lister watched his wife's retreating figure, unable to hide the malice in his eyes any longer.
After a brief thought, he called over a trusted subordinate and ordered him to send people to intercept Denise, preferably alive... If not, to kill her on sight.
"That way, I can claim credit from that lord afterwards... And you'll get your share of benefits too!" Lister outwardly painted a rosy picture for his subordinate, but inwardly, he had already condemned him to death, waiting only for him to finish the task before silencing him.
But just then, a mocking voice sounded in his ear: "Benefits? I'll show you a treasure right now."
Lister and his subordinate were startled. They instinctively looked towards the source of the voice and saw a mirror with a gaping maw, its sharp teeth snapping at them.
The subordinate was a Sequence 8 Provoker, and Lister himself was just an ordinary person. Facing such a scene, they had no power to resist and were swallowed by the mirror.
The man-eating mirror was naturally Ebner's Magic Mirror. Controlling Chesi, who was holding its main body, it even took out a handkerchief to wipe the "mirror surface."
Ebner was there because he needed a guide to enter the "Rat Way."
Although Edwina had drawn a route map using "secret art," after a personal inspection, Ebner discovered that Tosk's sewer system was not so simple. It seemed to have been specially designed by a high-Sequence Beyonder, and in many places, it used the "distortion" or "magnification" effects of the Black Emperor pathway, making it easy to get lost without a guide, or even never get out...
This was likely the work of Emperor Roselle himself!
If he were to use the Pure White Eye to decipher it, it wouldn't be impossible, though it would take some time... However, Ebner feared that Edwina might not be able to wait that long. So, he found the Varian family's winery, which had the qualifications and methods to summon a "guide" in the "Rat Way," but he unexpectedly encountered this marital quarrel.
—The knowledge about the "Rat Way" and the Varian family came from the book formed by the soul of the Mirror Demon Herta. After all, he had lived for nearly a hundred years and had a property in Tosk, so he was quite familiar with the situation there.
As expected of a Spiritual Book worth hundreds of thousands of pounds, the knowledge it contains is truly valuable!
After the Magic Mirror displayed some scenes from Lister's soul, Ebner collected his thoughts and watched...
Soon, his gaze was drawn to an old man wearing a monocle, who was the butler of the Delien family's playboy.
"Is that Amon?"
"Hmm... Leon said earlier that Roselle turned a captured Amon clone into a Sealed Artifact and gave it to the 'Men in Black'..."
"Aggregation effect?"

chapters.title: Chapter 746: The Person in the Prophecy
chapters.content:
Chapter 746 - The Person in the Prophecy
After a moment of thought, Ebner temporarily put aside the matter of Amon. After all, even if that butler truly was an Amon clone, His primary targets would be the "Men in Black" who are also of the Marauder pathway, and it was unlikely He would specifically target Ebner and Edwina.
Moreover, although Ebner's demigod-level "imitation" experience had ended, he still held a "historical projection" charm bestowed by the Goddess. In crucial moments, he could even use it to invite Lilith's divine descent... Therefore, he wasn't overly afraid of Amon's clones.
As for the thought of Amon stealing the charm and using it? It must be said that the Reader pathway's ability to think in multiple threads and "analyze" after becoming a demigod is very "restraining" to such thought-stealing actions, and Ebner, through his Pure White Eye, had been accustomed to this "multithreading" since Sequence 9.
After dealing with Lister and his confidant, Ebner instructed Chesi, who was possessed by the Devil, to find a place for afternoon tea, while he himself, carrying the Magic Mirror's main body, followed Madam Denise, who had left earlier.
—He suspected that the "Men in Black" stronghold might not actually be in the real world... or perhaps it was in a space that overlapped with reality, so he left Chesi there as a "locator."
As a noblewoman of the Varian family, the actual controllers of Tosk, Madam Denise naturally wouldn't use the sewer "entrance" in the lower-class civilian area that Arrodes had shown in his vision to enter the "Rat Way."
Instead, she first took a carriage to a very secluded villa, then entered its basement and opened a hidden door.
Stepping through the hidden door and walking through a relatively "clean" passage, she entered the truly cold and damp "Rat Way."
However, Madam Denise did not venture deeper. Instead, at a corner of a "crossroads," she placed four torches according to a specific orientation and softly chanted a Hermes word: "Guide."
About five or six minutes later, a figure clad in a black cloak appeared at the intersection. He glanced at Madam Denise, then extended a claw to take a special emblem from her hand before turning around and beginning to lead the way.
During this time, he used a special ability to check, but failed to detect Ebner, who was under "Evans' Secret Barrier."
Ebner, however, saw through his true nature.
"Although called a 'guide,' it's actually just a strange ghost..."
"And Madam Denise clearly knows this, so she didn't try to converse with him."
While thinking, Ebner also followed closely behind Madam Denise, stepping in her footsteps to avoid any unforeseen circumstances.
Initially, they were still traversing normal sewers, only the "paths" went up and down, turning left and right, very misleading... However, this wasn't much of an obstacle for a Reader, who easily memorized the route.
But then, Ebner was completely shocked by the complex structure of the "Rat Way" and was glad he chose to find a "guide" rather than relying on his Pure White Eye to decipher it.
Because this labyrinthine path not only had various "twisted" and "magnified" sections, but also various hidden "doors," and intermittent "nightmares."
Yes, some sections required crossing strange "dreams," and those dreams contained various monsters. If not for the "guide," they would surely have attacked.
And most importantly, this so-called "Rat Way" seemed specifically designed for Beyonders with "analysis" and "deciphering" abilities; the more one "analyzed" it, the more it changed!
To be honest, several times when following Madam Denise through a "door," Ebner felt that he had actually been exposed... But strangely, this large "labyrinth" gave no "warning."
At this point, he couldn't retreat, because even if he wanted to, he couldn't find his way back...
Squeezing the "historical projection" charm in his hand, Ebner felt a renewed sense of confidence. He followed closely behind Madam Denise's footsteps and arrived in a cave roughly twenty square meters in size, containing several storage lockers.
Upon arriving here, the "guide" disappeared on its own, and Madam Denise skillfully took off her clothes and changed into the garments prepared in the lockers.
This made Ebner, who was watching from the side, a little awkward. Just as he was wondering whether to find some clothes here to change into as well, Madam Denise had already walked towards the "door" on the other side of the cave.
Seeing this, Ebner no longer hesitated and immediately followed.
After crossing this last "door," Ebner's vision suddenly cleared, and he found himself in an underground space the size of a football field.
The dome was very high, at least 30 meters or more, and embedded with multiple glowing orbs, preventing the entire space from being dim.
"Denise, you're here..."
At this moment, a man who looked to be in his thirties with dark golden hair came forward, greeted Madam Denise, and then embraced and kissed her.
After a full half-minute, Madam Denise struggled to push him away, chiding him alluringly, "Gute, I'm here for something serious!"
"What is it?" The man named Gute was startled for a moment, then picked up Madam Denise horizontally, "Let's talk about it on the bed..."
Soon, intermittent "conversations" emanated from the private room partitioned off in a corner of the space.
This scene left Ebner dumbfounded. After a comment about "Intis truly being open," he no longer paid attention to them and began to use the secret art Polymath Reconnaissance to locate Edwina.
—This was one of the three "secret arts" he received upon his promotion to Mysticism Instructor, which could improve along with him.
Since there were no other Polymaths in this space, it only took Ebner two minutes to successfully pinpoint Edwina's location—right in the room next to Gute and Madam Denise...
He used his Door ability to walk straight into that room and saw Edwina, looking slightly pale, leaning against the headboard of the bed, holding a book.
However, as the "conversations" from next door grew more intense, her attention was clearly not on the book. Instead, she was closing her light blue eyes, suppressing something.
As "Vice Admiral Iceberg," as a Pirate General, she wasn't entirely unfamiliar with such matters. Although she hadn't practiced them herself, she had witnessed quite a lot... After all, she could also "revert" time.
In the past, even without Mechanical Mind, she could remain calm about this, but after her spirit body was infected by the corrupting power of the Black Knight, she involuntarily began to have chaotic thoughts.
While this wouldn't cause her to immediately fall and lose control, it was still a severe test of her willpower.
After Ebner entered the room, a brief scan revealed Edwina's predicament. He then "simulated" the Judge's ability, blocking the transmission of "sound" between the room and the outside.
The disappearance of the "conversations" made Edwina sigh in relief. She opened her light blue eyes, as clear as spring water, and tentatively asked, "Ebner?"
"It's me," Ebner materialized and replied.
Then, he stepped forward to examine her body and frowned, "Blade of Flesh and Spirit?"
"Yes!" Edwina still had little strength and answered concisely.
"This is quite troublesome... Violet's Perfect Recovery Spell wouldn't work too well on such an injury... This requires a high-level ritual from the Sun domain!"
As Ebner spoke, he recalled the scepter housing the evil spirit of the Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
Using it as a medium should be enough to extract the corrupting power from Edwina's spirit body... but this place is clearly not suitable...
But how to get Edwina out? I just tried, and there's a "space" barrier here, so "teleportation" probably won't work...
As Ebner was pondering, an old voice suddenly sounded in his ear:
"Oh, person of the Great Emperor's prophecy...
"Welcome to 'Kaspersky,' the 'Men in Black's' last base."
Kaspersky? That name itself shows deep malice towards Amon!

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Sacrifice
chapters.content:
Chapter 747 - Sacrifice
The person who suddenly appeared in the room, though his voice sounded old, actually looked to be in his early twenties at most. He wore a white shirt, a brown vest, and a double-breasted black long coat. His appearance was quite ordinary, with no striking features...
This might align with the characteristics of a Thief.
Ebner, holding "Lilith's Tear" in one hand and the "historical projection" charm given by the Goddess in the other, scrutinized the newcomer with his Pure White Eye for a few moments before raising an eyebrow and asking,
"Parasite?"
"Heh, as expected of the person in the Great Emperor's prophecy, you saw through me at once... But you should put away those dangerous things in your hand; my main body isn't here, so they don't pose much of a threat to me," the young man chuckled with an old voice.
That's because you don't know its "Desolation" radius...
Ebner silently grumbled, but only put away "Lilith's Tear."
Then, he composed his words and asked again, "Are you the leader of the 'Men in Black'? I should thank you for saving Edwina... However, do you have something to discuss with me?"
"The leader of the 'Men in Black' will always be the great His Majesty 'Caesar'. I am merely acting as the 'Commander's' proxy." At this point, he glanced at Edwina on the bed, then continued, "I was once Lord Edwards' aide-de-camp, so naturally, I wouldn't stand by and watch Miss Edwina get into trouble... Furthermore, she is also a person from the 'prophecy'."
Another "prophecy"? What arrangements did the Great Emperor make in Tosk? And what's so special about Tosk, why did the Seal of Calamity and Roselle both "make their move" here sequentially...
Hmm, perhaps the latter was following in the footsteps of the former, but this also indicates that what they are planning is no small matter!
"What is this 'prophecy'? How did I become a person from the 'prophecy'?" Ebner thought for a moment and tentatively asked.
The "parasitized" youth smiled without speaking, only taking out a book from his bag that looked normal but felt as if it were composed of many "worms."
It had an ancient and mottled black iron cover, with a strange clockwork-like lock attached to its side.
"This branch of our 'Men in Black' was originally ordered to look after His Majesty's descendants in Tosk... but later, we received the task of waiting for the 'person of prophecy'... And His Majesty ordered me to give this book to the 'person of prophecy,' which is you, Detective Ebner Bryan." The old voice rang out again. The youth didn't hand the book to Ebner but placed it on the table beside him.
Ebner, while examining the book with his Pure White Eye, casually asked, "Do you know me? Oh, and what should I call you?"
"Heh, although our 'Men in Black' no longer have the Empire's support, and our numbers are far fewer than a century ago, we are still one of the world's leading intelligence organizations... And information about you is not scarce." The youth ended the topic here and then chuckled, "As for a name, those of us in this line of work don't really have names. But you can call me 'Heart 1'."
Did the "Aurora Order" register the letter codes first, so the "Men in Black" had to start using "playing cards"?
While grumbling inwardly, Ebner also initially "analyzed" the general nature of the black iron-covered book—what it contained was still unknown, but the book itself was very likely made from "Time Worms"!
"Could this be the book Leon mentioned, made by Roselle using a captured Amon clone? This could truly be a genuine Book of Amon...
"However, that 'lock' is very special; it seals the actual function of the book... Even my Pure White Eye cannot 'analyze' it in a short time...
"But why would the Great Emperor give me this book? This thing attracts Amon, you know... While I'm not too afraid of Amon's clones, I don't want to actively lure him over... Could this old fellow be trying to shift trouble onto someone else?"
As he pondered, Ebner frowned, about to refuse.
But at that moment, Edwina tugged at his sleeve and whispered, "This book is related to that travelogue..."
She didn't elaborate, even deliberately controlling her thoughts to prevent the "parasite" from prying into anything.
Travelogue... Groselle's Travels? Right, the reason Edwina asked to meet me in Tosk was because she found a "safe" way to enter the world within that travelogue...
Regarding that travelogue, I previously speculated it should be an arrangement made by the Seal of Calamity after leaving Roselle...
But here, it's connected to the Book of Amon... Did Roselle later find the arrangements left by the Seal of Calamity and then modify them himself?
However, since the Book of Amon is involved in this matter, I have no choice but to accept it.
"Besides, Amon's main target should still be this 'Kaspersky' stronghold. Even with some aggregation, I can place it in the 'Quiz Labyrinth'... I remember the fourth level of authority has a function to 'weaken' the influence of Beyonder aggregation... although the price is quite steep, 10 pounds per hour."
After weighing it in his mind for a while, Ebner ultimately accepted the black iron-bound book.
As for "sacrificing" it to Mr. Fool, Ebner felt it wouldn't be quite appropriate. This was, after all, Amon's item, and it had arrangements made by the Great Emperor in his later years under the influence of contamination. If Klein were to recklessly "divine" it, there might be danger...
"I have completed the task from the 'prophecy,' and I won't keep you any longer... You are free to leave here now.
"Hmm, I will temporarily open a 'door' in the 'barrier.' I trust you can take advantage of this opportunity." The youth nodded with satisfaction after Ebner put away the book.
"Good." Ebner didn't ask anything further. After all, in front of such a "spy master," he was still too "green" to extract any useful information; anything he learned would inevitably be what the other party deliberately revealed.
With that, he walked to the bed, holding Edwina by her legs and back, and lifted her. At the same time, his Pure White Eye operated at its peak, and he quickly found an invisible "door" open in the underground space's "barrier." From outside this "door," he also connected to Chesi's coordinates.
Knowing the opportunity was brief, and that failure to seize it might truly leave her trapped, Edwina showed no shyness. While complying with Ebner's movements, she grabbed a small bag from the bed, which contained her personal belongings.
"The butler of that young master from the Delien family is very likely Amon!"
As a repayment for the "Men in Black" rescuing Edwina, Ebner warned the parasitized youth.
Immediately after, their figures blurred, entering the mysterious spiritual world where seven pure lights hung high above.
In that strange world, higher than reality, Ebner, holding Edwina, took a step in a certain direction.
A few breaths later, they emerged from their transparent, illusory state, returning to reality, to a guest room in a hotel in Tosk.
Chesi was sitting on the head of the bed, watching them.
.....
"The year when the great fog submerged all living beings, the Hermit Gathering of Fate...
"My bloodline... the foolish generation... after the Knight... those who ignore the 'Rat Way,' taking the 'Book of Pirated Fortune'...
"The sacrifice arrives... I shall return..."
Watching Ebner and Edwina disappear, the youth silently recited the fragmented text. It was part of the "prophecy" left by Emperor Roselle the last time he summoned him.
"Your Majesty, please forgive my incompetence. For all these years, I have been unable to decipher its full meaning..." The parasitized youth sighed.
He returned to his study. After a while, the dark golden-haired man named Gute rushed in and reported, "President, Madam Denise just delivered the latest intelligence. Her husband told that playboy from the Delien family how to summon and command 'guides'."
At this point, he added with a hint of guilt,
"Although there are other arrangements with the 'guides,' and the 'Rat Way' ritual can be activated at any time... I feel this matter is extremely urgent and must be brought to your immediate attention..."
You know it's "urgent"? Then why did you waste nearly half an hour on the bed?
The youth looked at Gute with a half-smile but said nothing more, only deciding that this person could be a potential candidate for deep "parasitism" in the future.
He waved his hand and casually said, "I know, don't worry."
Gute breathed a sigh of relief and then excused himself and left.
"Amon's clone... and that descendant of the Delien family who believes in the True Creator...
"So that's it... These truly are good 'sacrifices'!
"Your Majesty, can you truly return this time?"
Thinking this, the youth had one of his clones lead a portion of the members he hadn't parasitized to evacuate the stronghold.
Firstly, those people could not be fully trusted.
Secondly, it was to leave a spark for the "Men in Black" to continue.
Regardless of success or failure, "Kaspersky" would be destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: Old Huang’s Calculation
chapters.content:
Chapter 748 - Old Huang's Calculation
Inside the rented "mansion" in "Alvin Abraham's Quiz Labyrinth," Ebner had Vice Admiral Iceberg sit to one side, while he placed the staff carrying the "Sun Chaser" evil spirit on the central round table. Then, using the binary ritual method, he lit two candles, completing the preliminary setup.
—After bringing Edwina back to reality, he immediately used his accrued interest to rent the Mirror Mansion for another day from the "Labyrinth." While doing so, he also exercised his authority to request a mystical "isolation" for the book he named The Book of Amon.
Although Edwina was also very interested in the "Mirror World" modification technology, she was too weak to research it. She could only first cooperate with Ebner in performing the ritual to heal her soul injuries.
Even though the evil spirit residing in the staff had fallen into "slumber," upon sensing the Pure White Eye, it cooperated by releasing its power, integrating it with the "Holy Light" that the staff itself could emit. Continuously, like a tide, it surged towards Edwina, cleansing the "corrupting" power from her soul.
Dozens of seconds later, a subtle smile unconsciously appeared on Edwina's usually cold expression. She looked at Ebner and earnestly said, "Thank you for saving me."
"You would have been fine without me; that 'Heart 1' wouldn't have troubled you, even out of respect for your ancestor," Ebner waved his hand.
"No, his primary purpose in saving me was to wait for your arrival; otherwise, he wouldn't have appeared so quickly." Edwina shook her head, clearly understanding this point very well.
"Heh, there's no need to be so serious then. Didn't you save me once too?" Ebner chuckled, referring to Edwina's interception of Mr. D's ship from the Aurora Order back then.
"That was the arrangement of the God of Knowledge..." Edwina first said this, but then, recalling something, she quietly added, "This time might be the same."
Ebner nodded. On the matter of being "arranged," he could proudly say, "I'm a professional," so he had a premonition.
Although the God of Knowledge had hardly revealed His own existence, just considering that Groselle's Travels was originally obtained by Him, and that Edwina's clue to the so-called "safe entrance" of the travelogue came from her teacher Isabella.
—Isabella, as the Princess of Lenburg, must be a believer of the God of Knowledge, and according to Lion, she also had a relationship with Roselle.
As for the later "prophecy" that revealed the information "Loenzell's family is key," it was even more so reliant on the mirror bestowed by the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
There's no way this isn't connected to that particular entity.
"I just don't know if 'Two-Five Dragon' sent me here to fulfill Old Huang's arrangements or to disrupt Old Huang's plans... But one thing is certain: the key to Old Huang's scheme must be me... or rather, the Transmigrator brought by the Pure White Eye."
After silently muttering a few words, Ebner turned to Edwina and asked, "How did you get injured?"
"After you told me that Alanson, the captain of the 'City of Splendor,' was a descendant of Loenzell's family, I intercepted him at Daville once I was fully prepared, and brought him back to his home in Dacy. There, I found something left behind by a mysterious person back then..."
Edwina didn't answer directly. Instead, like a teacher, she earnestly explained the background and took out a book from the bag, as well as a playing card tucked inside.
"According to the records in this book, to safely enter Groselle's Travels, one needs to find the 'ritual place' located in Tosk, and collect Groselle's Travels, The Book of Astrology, and The Book of Fortune Stealing, three mystical books, as well as the three Blasphemy Card: 'Black Emperor,' 'Door,' and 'Error'." Edwina paused here, then added,
"The Book of Astrology was compiled by my great-grandfather by transcribing relatively safe knowledge from the Abraham family's Book of Astrology and Elements...
"I originally thought its original copy would be in Lenburg's Great Library... but after a trip back, I found that the one in Lenburg was a copy, and the original had been taken decades ago by an Intisian who came to Lenburg to study..."
"As for The Book of Fortune Stealing, it should be this one that the 'Parasite' just gave me."
"And this tucked-in playing card should be the 'Error' card, except it doesn't describe a potion formula like the 'Judge' card I saw in Daniel's labyrinth..."
Upon hearing this, Ebner temporarily interrupted Edwina. He then took out a briefcase from his card pouch and extracted a book with The Book of Astrology written on its cover in Ancient Fusak.
"See if this is it?" Ebner asked, handing the book over.
Edwina took it, glanced at it, and affirmed, "It's Great-Grandfather's handwriting!"
Hearing this, Ebner remained silent for a few seconds, then took out a playing card with a bust of Emperor Roselle on it—that was the "Door" card.
"I also know where the 'Black Emperor' card is..." Ebner added.
With this, all the conditions were met! It was just... too coincidental!
Edwina thought for a moment and said earnestly, "I'll go in alone."
After all, this matter originated with her, and she should bear the risks.
Ebner shook his head, having a general understanding, and connecting more dots:
"That Book of Astrology was given to me by Mr. Surrey... He claimed it was a copied version brought back from Lenburg...
"The Book of Astrology is actually a transcription of the transmigrator Alvin's Book of Astrology and Elements, transcribed by Edwards, one of Roselle's 'Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse'...
"Fanny told me before that her 'Lawyer'1 Beyonder characteristic and her grandfather's 'Astronomer' characteristic were both obtained by Mr. Surrey during his studies in Lenburg through fortunate coincidences...
"Mr. Surrey researched that Book of Astrology for decades... After his death, his remaining characteristics were bought by a 'Men in Black' member from the 'Hermit Gathering of Fate' and brought back to Tosk...
"Is this Old Huang's calculation? He who would even calculate his own bloodline descendants... He must have been half-mad when he devised this plan, right?
"What exactly did he arrange within Groselle's Travels?
"Moreover, this arrangement should have originally been the work of the transmigrator senior, the 'Seal of Calamity'... After all, only a transmigrator would think of Loenzell; it's likely that placing the key clues for entering and exiting the travelogue in his home was also a way to compensate for this tragedy... otherwise, it would be entirely unnecessary...
"But Roselle, after finding traces of the 'Seal of Calamity,' clearly replaced those remnants... He likely used the transmigrator's arrangements to make his own...
"And no matter what, since the arrangement was originally set by a transmigrator senior, the key to its completion is most likely with me!
"Additionally, in this matter, the God of Knowledge must have intervened. I wonder if His purpose aligns with Roselle's?
"Hmm, probably not... He must have His own intentions.
"Finally, the 'Door' card was obtained in the Nation of the Evernight... The Book of Astrology originally came from Alvin's notes... and Alvin was in the Nation of the Evernight...
"Plus the previous prayer, the item bestowed by the Goddess is relatively the most valuable...
"Did the Goddess... also have a hand in this? "If so, it seems impossible to back out now."

chapters.title: Chapter 749: Klein’s Confusion
chapters.content:
Chapter 749 - Klein's Confusion
However, Old Huang's (Roselle's) intentions aren't hard to guess... For him, being already "gone," there are only three possibilities:
First, removing his own contamination; second, resurrection; third, currying favor with Transmigrators like me or Mr. Fool to aid his future resurrection.
Even if he were contaminated, these three core desires wouldn't change much; only the process or outcome might have issues.
But even knowing the goal, with the current intelligence, it's still impossible to deduce what exactly he arranged in Groselle's Travels... Hmm, the superficial fantasy world in the travelogue shouldn't be anything special... A reasonable guess is that his arrangement is hidden deep within the travelogue, in the kingdom of the Fantasy Dragon—Leviathan.
As his thoughts raced, Ebner picked up the "Error" playing card again.
The portrait of Roselle on the card didn't wear a monocle as Ebner had conjectured, but it still felt somewhat unsettling—whether it was the smile at the corner of his mouth or his eyes.
Even stranger, looking at the card from different angles, one could see many completely different "Roselles," old and young, male and female... They had different appearances, but each look would make you feel that it was "Roselle."
In the lower-middle part of the bust, this strange Roselle held three translucent small worms with twelve segments each, like the hour, minute, and second hands of a clock.
This card was currently in a "sealed" state, so it didn't reveal the potion formula for the "Error" pathway.
Holding this "Blasphemy Slate," Ebner tried saying words like "Amon," "bug," "Bernadette," "Isabella," etc., in various languages, but received no response...
Suddenly, he looked at Roselle's gloomy expression on the card and the "pose" of him holding the "Time Worms"... A thought struck him, and he said in Chinese, "Panda Burning Incense."
But unfortunately, the card remained unresponsive...
"It seems even Roselle wouldn't be that bored, huh..." Ebner sighed, then decided to temporarily abandon this baseless conjecture.
Just then, Edwina, who had been watching his attempts, thoughtfully said, "The mysterious person who gave Loenzell's family that note left a sentence on the page where this card was tucked in...
"It read: 'My life's greatest error needs your redemption.'"
My life's greatest error needs your redemption? My life's greatest error...
Based on my deductions, the one who first approached the Loenzell family was most likely the "Seal of Calamity." Its purpose should have been to take Groselle's Travels and conduct an unknown transaction with the Fantasy Dragon... Leaving something for Loenzell's family might have been an afterthought, or part of a setup... Of course, it could also have been to make up for some regrets in the original story, there's no telling.
But Roselle later clearly altered his arrangements, making them serve his own ends... So, the subject of this "greatest error" should refer to Roselle himself...
Thinking this, Ebner took a breath and recited in Intisian, "Lunar landing!"
For Roselle, this was his greatest "error," the error that led to the ruin of everything he had. It was perfectly suited as an unsealing incantation for the "Error" card.
As expected, no sooner had his voice fallen than he felt the card in his hand sink slightly. Then, a clear light slowly rose, gradually condensing into a line of text:
"Sequence 0: Error!"
Although Ebner had anticipated this, he still couldn't hide his joy as he looked at the item in his palm, turning page after page and jotting down the formula.
After this, he used his authority in the "Quiz Labyrinth" to "purchase" a mystical "isolation package" for it, only then handing the card back to Edwina.
Seeing this, Edwina's light blue, clear eyes immediately lit up. After also flipping through the names and brief introductions of each Sequence, she put down the card and continued recounting her experience:
"After I obtained the 'Error' card and the note left by the mysterious person in Loenzell's old home in Dacy, I temporarily 'invited' Captain Alanson back to the 'Golden Dream' to prevent him from reporting to the Church...
"Afterwards, while I sent Danitz to deliver a message to you, I myself came to Tosk. Using the descriptions in that note, I searched for the so-called 'ritual place.'
"Finally, I confirmed it was somewhere beneath the Surrey family's ancestral home."
Surrey family ancestral home... I remember Klein told me during the last Tarot Club that Roselle had buried treasure in the Surrey family's home... Could this be referring to that?
Hmm, perhaps the Great Emperor indeed buried treasure at first, but after his return from the moon, his disposition changed significantly, and he extinguished some of his family ties, completely treating the Surrey lineage as tools for his resurrection... Therefore, he changed the treasure into a resurrection arrangement?
As Ebner pondered, he heard Edwina continue:
"Because the Archbishop of the Church of Steam stationed in Tosk was assassinated, the Surrey family's ancestral home was also protected by Machinery Hivemind... I didn't dare get too close, so I could only use the nearby sewers to slowly investigate the exact location of the 'ritual place'...
"And during this time, I was discovered by members of the Delien family and attacked without reason... I fought desperately to escape, and if I hadn't been rescued by the 'Men in Black,' I might have fallen into their hands."
After listening to Edwina's straightforward, unembellished explanation, Ebner subconsciously offered a suggestion: "Keeping your language engaging while teaching helps improve students' learning efficiency."
Edwina blinked her light blue eyes, initially almost failing to keep up with Ebner's leap in logic. After realizing what he meant, she thought carefully for a moment, first nodding, "That makes sense... I'll keep that in mind."
Then, she asked with some hesitation:
"But if I don't lecture in a cold, serious tone, their attention will wander..."
That's because your crew's main purpose in attending class is you, not knowledge...
Ebner muttered inwardly, while outwardly he changed the subject: "Let's not discuss teaching for now... I heard that Seyrow Delien, who came to Tosk, is a playboy. Perhaps he coveted you, which is why he sent people to attack?"
"I don't think so... The 'Blade of Flesh and Spirit' that injured me was wielded by that 'playboy' himself... He's completely different from the rumors." Edwina shook her head.
"Was it a Beyonder item he used, or his own Beyonder ability?" Ebner was somewhat surprised and frowned, pressing for details.
He had previously assumed that the "corrupting" power that injured Edwina was an ability an Amon clone had stolen from elsewhere.
"I can't be certain... but I'm inclined to believe it was his own ability," Edwina replied after thinking for a moment.
In other words, that "Seyrow Delien" is at least a Black Knight?
What is going on with this family? They already have a family head, either an Iron-blooded Knight or a War Bishop, who lived from Roselle's time until now, and then family members who successively believed in the Eternal Blazing Sun became Unshadowed.
That's one thing, but it's astonishing enough that the Prime Minister's direct lineage was involved with the Noth family and the Mother Tree of Desire... And the Prime Minister's biological son, whom people originally thought was a "playboy," even believed in the True Creator?!
Finally, another direct descendant of this family, Owen, joined the "Psychological Alchemists," becoming the "Lust" of the highest council... and is suspected to be a member of the Twilight Hermit Order, serving under Adam...
Is this multi-party hedging... Aren't they afraid of losing control?
They're even more "flashy" than I am! After all, none of the entities they've pledged allegiance to are easy to deal with...
As Ebner clicked his tongue, he wanted to ask for more specific details but suddenly noticed Edwina's breathing gradually becoming even... She had actually fallen asleep leaning against the headboard.
Right, although I used a ritual to help her remove the "corrupting" power from her spirit, that process was very taxing on her mind... She was probably forcing herself to stay awake when she was talking to me earlier.
Her mental weakness will take at least a day or two to fully recover. I can use this time to complete the investigation she hadn't finished... As for the Delien family, since the "Men in Black" were deliberately left in Tosk by Roselle, they will naturally block those who impede Roselle's "plan."
"Heh, I won't have Edwina's concerns when searching for the 'ritual place.' After all, with Fanny's connection, I can completely move into the Surrey family's ancestral home and slowly dig around..."
After murmuring to himself, Ebner pulled the covers over Vice Admiral Iceberg and then left the "Mirror Mansion," returning to the real world hotel.
He then checked the clock and found that it was still early. He decided to grab a meal first, then head to the train station to pick up the others.
.....
Symeem Island.
The "Black Death" was anchored in the leeward side of this outermost island of the Rorsted Archipelago, with towering stone cliffs behind it and restless waves below.
Klein saw Vice Admiral of Ailment Tracy wave at him, then make a reassuring gesture, before leaping from the cliff face back onto the "Black Death."
Watching the entirely black sailing ship, with a large white flag bearing a skull fluttering from its mast, depart, Klein felt a sense of bewilderment beneath his "cold" expression.
Goddess above, he clearly came to hunt Vice Admiral of Ailment Tracy, but how did it turn into him teaming up with her to repel her mother... No, according to her, that was her mom, who used to be her dad...
In short, to protect the ordinary people in that hospital, he had no choice but to rescue Tracy, who had already been captured by her mother, and together with her, they forced back the powerful Demoness of Affliction and her subordinates.
Although, to thank him for saving her, Tracy agreed to help find the documents that had been hijacked by "Vice Admiral Hurricane," which technically achieved his goal... it still felt like something wasn't quite right.
Could it be that after taking Prince Edessak's "Demoness" card, he inherited some of its characteristics?
Aggregation effect?
But I've only used that card once...

chapters.title: Chapter 750: A Notice, a Reminder, an Entrustment
chapters.content:
Chapter 750 - A Notice, a Reminder, an Entrustment
Speaking of which, Klein originally came to Symeem Island after incidentally hearing in Bayam's "Azure Wind" hotel that someone had found "Red-haired" Helene and intended to use her to make a deal with Tracy on Symeem Island, preparing to "hunt" the Vice Admiral of Ailment.
With the "Burial Blade" and the "Creeping Hunger" gloves, he was confident he could defeat that pirate general on land.
But to his surprise, immediately after disembarking, he was inexplicably targeted by a high-Sequence powerhouse, forcing him to borrow a washroom at the Church of the Earth Mother.
When he emerged from the church and hurried to the "deal" location, he found it was actually a trap targeting the Vice Admiral of Ailment, and the person who set this trap was Tracy's mother... a Demoness of Affliction.
If it were merely internal conflict among demonesses, it would be fine, but that Demoness of Affliction clearly had no intention of sparing the ordinary people in the hospital where they were "connecting," intending to transport them all away and sell them as sacrifices... This left Klein unable to stand by!
However, that Demoness of Affliction herself was powerful and had several mid-Sequence subordinates.
No matter how confident Klein was in his own strength, he dared not directly attack... So he summoned his "spirit body" and had it accommodate the "Demoness" card. Using the "invisibility" effect unique to demonesses, he quietly infiltrated the hospital, rescuing Tracy, who had only avoided a terrible fate by "freezing" herself with a Sealed Artifact.
—According to her mother, she would only be offered to that great being after being "educated" into obedience.
Afterward, although their cooperation wasn't seamless, they barely managed to withstand the attacks of the Demoness of Affliction and her subordinates, dragging the fight until the arrival of the "Nighthawks" team—which Klein had, of course, reported beforehand.
The Demoness of Affliction ultimately had no choice but to retreat, no longer caring about the ordinary people, and Tracy was also taken by Klein to his safe house, temporarily evading the "Nighthawks'" search.
In fact, letting the "Demoness" spirit body dissipate directly, without exposing Gehrman, would have been the best choice.
But Klein still needed to inquire about the Death Requiem documents from Tracy. Gehrman was merely an alias, and exposing his use of the "Demoness" spirit body would better reflect his "mad" persona. Therefore, considering both role-playing and practical aspects, Klein still chose to meet with Tracy and presented his demands.
Although Vice Admiral of Ailment Tracy had very low moral integrity, she was indeed someone who remembered kindness. Otherwise, she wouldn't have risked warning Prince Edessak after recovering from her injuries. Thus, she readily agreed to Klein's request.
"But what did she mean by that last remark? That she preferred the appearance of my spirit body? The statue that somewhat resembled the Original Demoness, also bearing some resemblance to Trissy? Tsk, did this 'Vice Admiral of Ailment' maintain her original orientation after becoming a 'Witch'?"
"Fortunately, the transmigrator you met was me, someone with some integrity, the gentlemanly me beneath the mask of the mad Gehrman Sparrow... the real me... Zhou Mingrui!"
"If it had been Huang Tao or Liu Bo, you would probably have been completely consumed by them, using that image."
Above the gray fog, Klein reviewed what had just happened. Finally, amidst his thoughts, he turned his gaze to two Beyonder characteristics.
These were the spoils of his battle, coming from a "Witch" and a Demoness of Pleasure, respectively. Tracy naturally contributed to this, but she voluntarily gave them up.
After "divining" with their not-yet-fully dissipated spirits, Klein habitually tapped the edge of the ancient bronze long table with his fingers, pondering:
"There's no problem; they were merely acting on orders to attack Tracy. The real issue might be her 'mother'..."
"But that's none of my business. As long as she finds those documents, we'll be even."
"However, the Great Emperor's card does have some influence... Although it's not significant enough to overturn my decisions, it will slightly 'amplify' my 'favorability' towards demonesses..."
"Of course, the premise for 'amplification' is that there must be 'favorability'... For example, the two demonesses I just killed are not subject to 'amplification'."
"And towards pirate generals like the Vice Admiral of Ailment, whose sins are lighter compared to other great pirates, there's a bit more 'tolerance'... After all, her greatest misdeed, transporting slaves, was also done under orders, not of her own accord."
After analyzing his own psychology, Klein clarified the extent of the card's influence on him and found it to be within an acceptable range, so he breathed a sigh of relief.
However, he still decided to use this "Blasphemy Card" as little as possible.
After returning to reality from above the gray fog, Klein1 dispelled the "Spirituality Wall" in his hotel room. After resting for a while and recovering his mental strength, he got up and went downstairs, ready to address his dinner.
The entire first floor, apart from the counter, was cluttered with many tables, their surfaces slightly greasy. In a corner, a fireplace blazed, radiating light and heat.
The Rorsted Archipelago is located in the southern part, where the lowest winter temperature is around 10 degrees Celsius, but for the locals, this is still cold weather requiring a fire.
Klein casually found a seat. Since he had already eaten a meal in the afternoon, he only ordered a local specialty roast meat and bay leaf mushroom soup, without a main course.
While waiting, he quietly scanned the diners in the restaurant, his gaze instinctively falling on a lady.
This lady had simply tied-up black hair and a pair of very distinctive grayish-blue eyes. She was quite pleasant to look at, but her spirit seemed a bit wilted, as if she was very frustrated.
She was Leticia Dolera, who had returned empty-handed from the elven ruins, though Klein didn't recognize her.
There are fresh mud stains on this lady's leather boots... Just returned from the jungle? Heh, what an adventurer...
Klein made a preliminary judgment based on some clues.
He had heard before that many adventurers would1 venture deep into the virgin forests on colonial islands, searching for abandoned and forgotten pagan temples or altars. Those places often held ancient offerings of gold and jewels, which were later buried in unknown, forgotten places for various reasons. The bars on every island were full of legends of someone returning from a jungle adventure laden with riches and becoming wealthy overnight.
Those places might have evil spirits lingering... It's better to hunt pirates; at least you can get relevant information beforehand...
Klein withdrew his gaze and focused on waiting for his food.
The Seven Churches categorized various deities from the colonial indigenous faiths as evil spirits, but Klein believed that some of them should be natural spirits.
After a while, the specialty roast meat was served. It was cut into many small pieces, skewered on wooden sticks, coated with a reddish-brown sauce, and emitted a rich, alluring aroma.
It's a bit like kebabs from my previous life... In Loen, they roast large chunks of meat, which the chef then carves after cooking... This method here allows for more flavor infusion...
Klein picked up a skewer, bit off a piece of meat, and felt the juice slightly overflow, tasting savory with a hint of sweetness.
It's my type!
He nodded with satisfaction.
Klein was quite satisfied with this meal, even sampling the local "Gulu Tree Sap," a specialty drink that tasted like lemonade with sugar and milk.
Returning to his room, having been awake all night hunting, he washed up early, extinguished the fireplace, and burrowed into bed.
However, in the middle of the night, Klein's spirituality was suddenly touched by something. His pleasant dream immediately broke, and as he opened his eyes, his hand gripped the hilt of the "Burial Blade."
At that moment, the candles in the room suddenly lit themselves, and a lady with silver hair and blood-red eyes, whose face was indistinct, sat in a chair in the room, smiling at him.
In Symeem Island at midnight, the temperature was around eight or nine degrees Celsius, which felt cold.
But colder than that was Klein's heart. The opponent was so composed; perhaps his spiritual warning was deliberately triggered... That suggested this lady, who had been watching him since the dock, was far more powerful than he imagined.
The only good news was that the other party was likely not here to deal with him; otherwise, he would already be waiting for "resurrection."
"No need to be so guarded, I mean no harm." The lady smiled and said, "You can call me 'Yalolan'."
Yalolan?! Liu Bo's "friend" from his lifetime as a Blood Kin Duke, Rein... Hmm, it seems like the kind of friend with whom he sired children.
Klein's heart stirred, but outwardly, he used his "Clown" ability to control his expression, maintaining his "Gehrman"-esque solemnity.
However, his momentary emotional fluctuation was still caught by Madam Yalolan. She narrowed her eyes and asked, "You seem to have heard of me?"
Upon being asked, Klein considered for a moment, then nodded, "I know something about you and Duke Rhine..."
Like having children.
"You are indeed the one 'He' prophesied... Don't misunderstand, I'm not talking about Rein, but Alvin Abraham... You should know something about 'them,' right?" Yalolan asked pointedly.
Although he understood what she meant, Klein didn't answer. The other party was a "Pillar" of the "Moses Ascetic Order," and due to Old Neil, he had strong opinions about this organization and the "Hidden Sage" behind it. Even if the Yalolan in front of him had had an affair with Liu Bo, he didn't trust her much.
Moreover, after learning from Arrodes that the name "Liu Bo" itself might carry some "contamination," he was even less likely to casually utter his fellow countryman's name.
This was also being responsible for Madam Yalolan.
"What a cautious little fellow!" Madam Yalolan first sighed, then continued, "If you're wary of me because of the 'Hidden Sage,' there's no need. Although I am a high-ranking member of the 'Moses Ascetic Order,' I am also one of only two 'Pillars' who still adhere to the original doctrines... You should also know that before the 'Hidden Sage' revived, the 'Moses Ascetic Order' was not an evil organization."
At this point, she paused, skipped the topic, and then spoke of other things:
"I came to see you because I want to tell you some information, give you a reminder, and then entrust you with a task.
"The information is about 'Sea God' Kalvetua; he is about to fall. If you can find his divine kingdom, you might gain considerable benefits.
"Also, certain characteristics about you are not a secret in the eyes of a few special, high-level spiritual world creatures. Anyone who has had close contact with you can discover this... And Beyonders like me, who have abilities and authority in the domain of fate, can also discover this to varying degrees, of course, the premise is close contact... So, my reminder to you is, when adventuring on the sea, try to control yourself and not let lust dominate your mind... Hmm, but the demoness who left this evening is fine...
"Finally, the entrustment... I hope you will hand this Book of Calamity to him."

chapters.title: Chapter 751: Who Could He Be?
chapters.content:
Chapter 751 - Who Could He Be?
After hearing this information, reminder, and entrustment, Klein maintained the cold and sharp demeanor characteristic of his Gehrman Sparrow identity on the surface, but his mind was highly focused, and his thoughts became exceptionally swift:
"Sea God" Kalvetua? I heard Danitz say that the natives of the Rorsted Archipelago have always worshipped this evil spirit, believing that this being, often appearing as a giant sea serpent, protects all the islands here, preventing them from being swallowed by earthquakes and tsunamis...
It's about to fall? Did something happen? Could it be related to the female adventurer I met downstairs earlier? Hmm, I had a hunch she wasn't simple when I saw her...
Also, Arrodes also mentioned that I have some kind of characteristic; it was through this that it found me...
Admiral Abyssal Sea in Tingen City also went mad as soon as he saw me... Is this because he saw my characteristic?
But what does it mean "don't let lust dominate your mind"? And what does it mean that there's no problem with Tracy, a demoness? I'm not Huang Tao or Liu Bo; I'm not that casual of a person!
As for the entrustment to give that book to "him"... "He" refers to Liu Bo's new identity, right? But why me? I don't even know him!
As Klein's thoughts raced, Yalolan smiled and added, "The Book of Calamity was found by one of my descendants in the elven ruins on this island. The owner of that ruin was the Elf Queen, 'Calamity' Cohinem."
"This book carries strong contamination. Don't open it casually. My descendant merely glanced at it and already began to 'lose control'... It was only when I showed her and her companion my true appearance that the 'contamination' ceased."
"But you can rest assured, I've put some seals on it. At least, as long as you don't try to understand 'its' content, there won't be any problems."
As expected, it's something caused by that pleasant-looking female adventurer... It seems her low spirits are due to glancing at the Book of Calamity?
Klein recalled the appearance of the adventurous lady he had seen in the downstairs restaurant, pondering the whole situation:
"Why would her taking that Book of Calamity from the elven ruins lead to the 'Sea God' Kalvetua's 'fall'? What's the connection between the two?
Elves... 'Sea God'... According to the ancient god legends given by Little Sun, the ancient god Elf King Soniathrym had authority over the powers now held by the Lord of Storms. This means that among the elves, there were undoubtedly Sequence 3 'Sea Kings,' and even higher Sequence 2s...
Could it be that Kalvetua accidentally discovered an elven ruin at the bottom of the sea, directly devoured a Beyonder characteristic left by a high-ranking elf, and miraculously survived instant death and loss of control to successfully gain demigod status and gradually earn the faith of the Rorsted Archipelago natives?
According to the information he had read while serving as a Nighthawk, direct consumption of Beyonder characteristics or corresponding materials for advancement was not unheard of. Before the potion system was fully established, early humans attempted similar feats to gain extraordinary power, but only the extremely lucky few survived, becoming Beyonders without turning into monsters, madmen, or dying instantly with their flesh and blood disintegrating.
Such attempts had an extremely low success rate; after the potion system was developed, no one was willing to take such a huge risk anymore.
"If that's the case, then after the Book of Calamity was taken, the elven ruin collapsed, causing an anomaly in Kalvetua's hiding place, making it impossible for the barely surviving entity to sustain itself any longer? On the verge of losing control and falling?
If that's the case, I really could go reap some benefits...
But there's still that question... Why would Madam Yalolan entrust the Book of Calamity to me? Can't she go find Liu Bo herself?
Also, this so-called Book of Calamity is very dangerous! Just one glance could lead to 'loss of control'... It's almost comparable to some demon book incidents handled by Red Gloves!
The elves of this world are indeed not the forest and sea dwellers, skilled cooks, and nature-lovers depicted in novels of my past life...
That's right, according to Little Sun's description, the eight ancient gods before the Cataclysm were all very tyrannical, cruel, and evil, and this included
Elf King Soniathrym
... Although this might be defamation after the 'Ancient Sun God's' victory, just thinking about the equally 'fallen' and 'mad' 'True Creator' and the 'God of Death' during the War of the Four Emperors, the difference wouldn't be too great...
If gods at the pinnacle of the Sequences are like this, the Beyonders below them would naturally be affected, likely not much better off... Hmm, after those ancient gods fell, they might gradually shed their negative influences and eventually become more normal...
As his thoughts raced, Klein didn't reach for the yellowish-brown parchment book. Instead, he unhooked the pendulum from his cuff and performed a divination:
"There is danger in picking up this book."
Yalolan did not stop him. She watched, seemingly sighing with emotion, and said, "I'll praise you again; truly a cautious young man! If my descendant had half your caution, I wouldn't have had so much to worry about... Unfortunately, perhaps due to her elven bloodline, her actions are always reckless, although that bloodline gives her a 'destiny' with many elven legacies..."
On the other side, Klein, after receiving a "negative" result, still didn't rashly pick up the
Book of Calamity
. Instead, he asked the question that had been on his mind in an uninflected tone:
"Why do you want me to transfer it to 'him'? How are you sure I can meet him? Given your relationship with him, wouldn't it be safer for you to deliver it personally?"
Madam Yalolan didn't answer immediately. Instead, she turned her head, casting her gaze through the window towards the crimson sky, and then said with a touch of melancholy, "Compared to you, the chances of him coming to find me first are very small... And unless he voluntarily appears, it's difficult for me to find him..."
Why do these words sound so much like a classic "love triangle" trope?... But Liu Bo does seem very confident that other fellow transmigrators will appear; otherwise, he wouldn't have 'acquiesced' to people who could read Chinese knowing him later... From this perspective, the chances of him finding me are indeed significant, just like when he was the 'Seal of Calamity,' he went to great lengths to get close to Roselle.
However, Liu Bo not actively seeking out old "friends" probably also stems from him not having fully recovered his memories... After all, the "Seal of Calamity" said that he would only remember everything once he became Sequence 1.
Relieved, Klein no longer stalled. He knew very well that from the very beginning, he had no room to bargain in this matter. No matter how amiable the other party's attitude was, she was a high-Sequence powerhouse whose level he couldn't even discern. Her will was probably beyond refutation.
But he still habitually borrowed the tiger's prestige, asking, "I will temporarily 'sacrifice' the
Book of Calamity
to Mr. Fool to avoid 'contamination'... Once I find him, I will then request Mr. Fool to 'bestow' it... How does that sound to you?"
"The Fool?" Yalolan looked him up and down upon hearing this, then arched her eyebrows and nodded with a smile, "That's acceptable."
I wonder if I bluffed her... The 'mist' on this lady's face prevents me from discerning her true thoughts...
Thinking this, Klein finally reached out and took the
Book of Calamity
.
It felt heavy in his hand, but there were no other anomalies. Klein secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Of course, a full-body "purification" with a "paper angel" for himself later would also be essential.
Seeing him accept the entrustment, Yalolan nodded in satisfaction. Then, she took out a golden leaf from her pocket and, with a slight upturn of her lips, said, "I can't let you help for free either... This leaf is a magical item. Just blow on it, and you can summon my 'messenger'."
"If you encounter any trouble, you can write to me, and I will help you once without charge... Of course, if it's too dangerous, I might not come, but I'll avenge you afterward or try to rescue your spirit."
"Hmm, you can also use some little-known stories to exchange for 'knowledge' from me in your daily life."
If it's too dangerous, you don't need to save my spirit; just come collect my corpse and try to ensure it's intact!
Klein mocked himself. His face remained expressionless, but his heart leaped as he accepted the golden leaf.
A strong support has actively extended itself; I can't let it slip away! This counts as another life assurance for him, besides Mr. Azik.
"Alright, I have nothing else to do. I won't disturb your rest... Good night, Mr. Gehrman Sparrow." With that, her figure transformed into moonlight and vanished.
Klein held the golden leaf and the
Book of Calamity
and waited for a while before carefully getting out of bed in an awkward posture and heading straight to the room's washroom.He had drunk quite a bit of beverages last night and went to bed too early, so he had been feeling uncomfortable from holding it in. He just hadn't dared to ask Madam Yalolan to go to the washroom earlier.
Don't let her constant smiles and gentle demeanor fool you; Klein's intuition told him that her mental state was deeply troubled, giving him the feeling that she could erupt at any moment... The mist on her face was probably set up to seal that very state!
"She's so eager to find Liu Bo; perhaps there's a reason related to this... Hmm, the
Book of Calamity
might just be a tool to find someone? Liu Bo has some connection to this book, so she thinks that as long as I hold this book, I'll definitely encounter him?"
Klein pondered, narrowing his eyes and relieving the pressure on his lower abdomen.
Everything done, he pulled up his trousers, washed his hands, and went back to sleep for a while. He only opened his eyes when it was almost dawn, sealed the room with his spirituality, and then took the golden leaf and the
Book of Calamity
above the gray fog.
Sitting in the "Fool's" position, Klein first held the golden leaf before his eyes and observed it, finding that its main body seemed to be a leaf from the "Brilliant Contract Tree." As a provider of materials for several Sequences of the "Sun" pathway, its leaves indeed possess "contract" power, making them suitable for creating "messenger" summoning items.
He casually put the leaf to his mouth and blew hard. Then, with a "poof," a sound like "passing gas" was heard, and naturally, no "messenger" arrived—after all, this was above the gray fog.
It seems my skill at whistling with leaves from middle school has completely rusted... I'll have to practice again!
Klein casually put down the leaf, picked up the
Book of Calamity
, and began his "dream divination."
A moment later, he frowned because the results of the divination were fragmented, and the figure of the
Elf Queen, Cohinem
, the owner of the
Book of Calamity
, was blurry, almost unformed as a clear image.
This indicates that the connection between the Book of Calamity and Cohinem is almost severed... Could it be that the latter has completely fallen, unable to even maintain her spiritual imprint?
No, that wouldn't make the divination so difficult... This is more like someone has blocked her at the information level! Preventing more of her information from being obtained from the spirit world.
After pondering for a while, Klein had no further leads for the moment, so he set it aside and began to consider how to find Liu Bo's new "reincarnated" body.
Perhaps I don't need to do anything special; just building up Gehrman Sparrow's reputation might attract him... If he truly has "reincarnated" and has played "Bloodborne"...
A moment later, Klein had a preliminary plan in mind. As he was repeatedly deliberating it, a sudden flash of inspiration struck him. He glanced at the other "crystals" of the "Burial Blade" among the miscellaneous items and couldn't help but wonder:
Yalolan judged that Liu Bo is very likely to seek me out first...
So, what if... what if Liu Bo has actually already made contact with me?
Who... could he be?

chapters.title: Chapter 752: Klein’s Guess
chapters.content:
Chapter 752 - Klein's Guess
Without much thought, the figure of Mr. Tower flashed through Klein's mind, and he immediately listed him as the primary "suspect."
Mr. Tower is extremely "erudite," so much so that he far surpasses his current Sequence, explaining all sorts of historical secrets with ease.
Mr. Tower seems to have multiple deities supporting him, which indicates that he, like me, is very special.
Mr. Tower always manages to produce Roselle's diary, and it's often a page of valuable diary entries paired with a page of meaningless "Roselle's social life"... Several times, the diary entries have been perfectly timed... For example, the one before Little Sun encountered Amon happened to contain relevant information...
Mr. Tower likes to use "Marvel" heroes as codenames, even though Roselle wrote relevant novels...
Mr. Tower invented cameras and projectors, and even drew blueprints entrusting Melissa with their creation... I only thought this was the inevitable progress of technology before... Now that I think about it, perhaps it wasn't.
The weapon Mr. Tower forged for me is the "Burial Blade," which perfectly suits Gehrman's identity. Although he didn't name it and the handle has other modes, undoubtedly, the scythe form is the most powerful and my favorite.
Mr. Tower has many female friends, and this is similar to a certain characteristic displayed by Liu Bo...
Finally, Mr. Tower always seems to be able to access items left by Liu Bo... such as Blood Feast and the Book of Astrology and Elements... I didn't know the latter was also his work until Madam Yalolan personally uttered Alvin Abraham's name. It's likely this book was also written by Liu Bo.
Add to that Mr. Tower's personal involvement in the "Daniel Labyrinth" incident. Although I still don't know exactly what happened there, according to the various pieces of information about Danitz, Sharon's teacher's brother, the so-called Daniel, or rather Danitz, could very well be a "Liu Bo" as well.
In summary, if "Liu Bo" has indeed already had contact with me, the prime suspect is Mr. Tower! Although there's no conclusive evidence yet...
Second on the list is Leonard. He also has a face that girls find appealing, seems to have significant secrets, and his identity is much closer to my Klein's identity... He even hinted at something to me.
Recalling the time after the battle with the "Clown" of the "Ascetic Order," Leonard specifically ran over and said, "There are many special people in this world who can always do things others can't, for example, you... and for example, me." Klein couldn't help but interpret it more deeply.
"If it's Leonard, that's fine... But if it's Mr. Tower...
"Would he have known from the beginning that Mr. Fool was a 'fake' transmigrator from back home?"
Recalling his audacious maneuvers in the Tarot Club, such as having "The Fool" use clever rhetoric to create an air of mystery, "Mr. Fool" learning on the spot from "Roselle's Diary," "Mr. Fool" "interpreting" Miss Justice's Chinese explanation of "little girl," and allowing "The World" to fool him with "Ode to the Humble Dwelling," with "Mr. Fool's" tacit approval...
