He had always thought Backlund's humid, gloomy winter cold was the most dreadful, but now he finally understood that absolute low temperatures and razor-sharp winds were a deadly combination. Even though he had preemptively added a sweater and was wearing a thick, long formal coat, he still felt like he couldn't quite withstand it.
He did not put on the Sun Brooch because its warmth was on a spiritual level. While effective for a very short time against intense cold to prevent the body from stiffening, prolonged exposure in an icy environment would be suicidal. Spiritual warmth would cause the body to open its pores, mimic a summer state, remove its last defense against low temperatures, and even actively welcome them.
At this moment, he saw Ebner, who had emerged first, beckon him closer.
Without much hesitation, Klein quickly stepped forward and soon noticed he had passed through a barrier, and the surrounding environment warmed up.
"You came well-prepared." Edwina was the most lightly dressed of the three. After all, she only had a general understanding of the book's environment, and her preparations were more focused on "combat."
"As a 'Mysticism Magister' who frequently uses mystical items for high-speed flight, it's only reasonable to develop a secret art that protects against wind and cold," Ebner self-deprecatingly remarked, then asked, "Which way should we go?"
Edwina took out a brass-framed mirror, seemed to sense something, then pointed towards the south-west, saying, "That way."
Ebner didn't ask further. He directly simulated "Gale," holding their bodies aloft, and flew in the direction Edwina indicated.
When he was Sequence 7, he could use this ability to carry Xio for short flights. Now, even without direct contact, carrying all three was not a big problem.
Traveling in silence, they soon found a mountain peak under Edwina's guidance.
Rounding a huge rock covered with thick ice, they saw a dark, secluded cave.
The three entered cautiously in a triangular formation. Inside the spacious, well-ventilated cave, beside a bonfire radiating light and heat, they saw five figures sleeping in their clothes.
The most striking among them was a four-meter-tall cyclops. His skin was grayish-blue, his chest, abdomen, and waist were wrapped in thick beast hides, while the rest of his body was exposed. Even his feet lacked protection. Even in sleep, he still clutched a greatsword as large as a door.
Beside him, one by one, lay a middle-aged man dressed in an extremely simple white robe, a young Loen soldier sleeping with a rock as a pillow, a nobleman in his thirties wearing mismatched and asymmetrical clothing, and a beautiful female elf lying in the nobleman's arms.
"Giant Groselle... Loen soldier Frunziar... The remaining ascetic, the Fourth Epoch Solomon Empire nobleman, and the elf only have codenames, no specific names," Edwina softly introduced, based on the contents of the travelogue.
"Only Groselle and Frunziar have names? It seems there's really something special about the latter... This is 'protagonist' treatment," Klein remarked, staring at the young soldier in black armor.
It's not strange for Groselle, as the first character to enter this book, to have a name. But judging from the fact that they are all asleep, Frunziar cannot be the last... Therefore, he must have something special... and that special something is likely something Roselle or the Seal of Calamity imposed on him.
Ebner observed for a while with his Pure White Eye, then borrowed the notebook Edwina had obtained from Frunziar's home and placed it on the sleeping Frunziar's chest.
Immediately afterward, dreamlike symbols flashed on the book, merging into Frunziar's body, and then a large door, both illusory and real, opened above him.
"Another door?" Klein glanced at the "door" a few times, uncertain. "This seems to lead to a dream... No, to be precise, the sea of collective unconsciousness..."
"This book contains his family's yearning for him, so it can lead us into his dream... Perhaps what Roselle truly hid is connected to this soldier's dream."
It should be the Divine Kingdom hidden by the Dragon of Imagination, right? Will it still be the same as in the original story?
Ebner analyzed up to this point. Seeing that the door seemed to be getting blurrier, he quickly took out a card and whispered, "Blue-Eyes White Dragon."
Immediately, a massive white dragon appeared in the spacious cave.
Ebner did not let it reveal its true form but added a layer of illusionary "filter" to prevent Edwina from losing control by directly looking at a Demigod-level mythical creature.
As for Klein, he should be able to discern the skeletal dragon's original form using the Sefirah Castle's true sight, but seeing it above the gray fog wouldn't pose much of an issue.
Ebner mounted the dragon's back and said to the other two, "Come on up. It's safer to traverse the dream riding him."
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon?" Klein chewed on the name as he leaped onto the dragon's back.
Although it's Hermetic, that should be the correct meaning...

chapters.title: Chapter 761: Roselle’s Calculation
chapters.content:
Chapter 761 - Roselle's Calculation
Blue-Eyes White Dragon? Is it the Blue-Eyes White Dragon I know? Is 'Tower' really a Transmigrator? Is it Liu Bo? Or is it just a coincidence?
As Klein maintained his expression with his Clown ability, his mind was filled with shock and suspicion. Edwina, who had also jumped onto the dragon's back, asked curiously, "Is this a marionette made from a Demigod-level Mind Dragon? Also, the style of the card containing it seems different from the ones you make."
Hearing the question, Ebner first glanced at the seemingly calm Klein, then, while controlling the Bone Dragon to perform "dream traversal," he smiled and answered Edwina's question:
"Her true form is the previous generation's 'Greed' lady of the Psychological Alchemists, and she was a 'Dream Weaver' in her lifetime... Furthermore, this card was actually made by Emperor Roselle and obtained by me through a stroke of luck."
At the same time, he felt relieved internally,
So Mr. Fool's abnormality at the Tarot Club was because he suspected my origin... Was it that 'Formal Journal' that made him suspicious? After all, a show like 'Taste of Backlund' was indeed a bit too ahead of its time... In fact, at this point, there's no harm in revealing it... it's just not the right time.
Ebner's deliberate mention of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" earlier was also a test for Klein, and the result of the test confirmed his thoughts.
Don't think that just because you have the abilities of 'Clown' and 'Faceless' that prevent 'mind-reading,' I don't know what you're thinking... After all, being completely unfazed in itself indicates that you already had an expectation, otherwise you wouldn't show no reaction at all.
However, upon hearing Ebner and Edwina's conversation, Klein became uncertain again,
Could it be Old Huang's fault?
Compared to the two schemers, Edwina's thoughts were much simpler. She was focused on the Blue-Eyes White Dragon beneath her feet, "learning" about dream-related abilities.
Soon, the three appeared in Frunziar's dream.
This was a prosperous city with many wooden structures, and the pedestrians coming and going were almost all Loenese. In the distance, there was the iconic large clock.
It was Backlund from over a hundred years ago.
Frunziar, with black hair and blue eyes, stood outside a house, not daring to approach it, until a woman in a worn dress emerged. He then excitedly rushed forward, opening his arms, trying to embrace her.
Then, he tightly hugged the woman.
And the woman, recognizing the newcomer, also embraced him back, sobbing uncontrollably.
Frunziar's movements were a bit stiff, as if he couldn't believe he actually touched his mother... One had to know, in countless similar dreams before, he would just pass right through her...
"Mama... Mama..." he called out repeatedly in surprise, and the woman likewise responded, calling back to him.
Riding the bone dragon, hidden in the shadows, Ebner saw this scene and, recalling the unfulfilled embrace in the original novel, thought with some relief,
Whether it was Roselle or that 'Seal of Calamity,' at least they did well in this matter...
That notebook indeed carried Frunziar's family's longing for him!
At the same time, Ebner felt a bit strange. Logically, he had been transmigrated for over half a year, yet he had barely thought about home. Instead, the ties to this world had gradually increased.
Am I naturally emotionally detached? Or is it because in my previous life, I also only returned home once a year, and had already gotten used to it?
But recalling it, I do miss it quite a lot... yet I don't often reminisce...
Thinking of this, he glanced at Klein and found that his face indeed showed a mix of relief and melancholy...
This must be homesickness that even the 'Clown' ability can't hide!
The one most affected is indeed Klein... The "Homesick Group"...
Ebner sighed.
At this moment, Edwina, the Vice Admiral Iceberg, asked thoughtfully, "Do those who were normally drawn into the travelogue still have a chance to leave?"
Before Ebner could answer, Klein replied, "It's probably too late... Too much time has passed. If they leave, they will immediately age, die, or even weather away."
He had just considered this question, but combining it with various novels and films he had seen in his previous life, plus the mystical knowledge he had acquired in this life, he finally reached the pessimistic conclusion above.
"I have the same judgment... Unless there's a 'miracle'!" Ebner interjected, hinting at something.
"'Miracle'?" Klein immediately became thoughtful and recalled the line he saw in Roselle's diary: "To die and be resurrected is a miracle!"
Is there hope to help them if I become a 'Miracle Invoker'?
"'Miracle'?" Edwina was somewhat confused, but the question was too complex to explain, and neither of the two men intended to answer for now.
But just as all three of them uttered the word "miracle," Frunziar in the dream also murmured the word. Immediately, a passage appeared at the edge of his dream island, seemingly leading to a world full of "light."
Seeing this, the three exchanged glances, confirming their mutual decision: continue exploring.
Then, Ebner drove the Bone Dragon and flew into that passage.
The passage was sometimes straight, sometimes winding. After an unknown amount of time, the scenery before the three suddenly opened up.
What appeared before them was a "deep-sea chasm," with an island-sized city in its center.
The city's foundation was grayish-white, with magnificent stone pillars, tens to hundreds of meters tall, standing upon it. They either stood alone or jointly supported ancient and majestic palaces. The overall appearance was both peculiar and grand, unlike anything ordinary creatures could build.
Although Klein and Edwina did not recognize this city, a thought spontaneously arose in their minds:
"City of Miracles, Liveseyd..."
So, "miracle" referred to this?
Klein felt a slight realization, but also vaguely felt something was amiss.
After all, this should be the arrangement of the Dragon of Imagination. What connection does it have with Roselle or the Seal of Calamity? What did they arrange here?
And although Ebner already knew that
Groselle's Travels
concealed the Dragon King's revival plan, he still shared similar doubts with Klein.
Liveseyd was a gigantic city imagined out of thin air by the ancient god, Angwilloud, the Dragon of Imagination. In every aspect, it could be called a miracle, even a divine miracle.
It was grander and more ancient than the "Giant King's Court," possessing otherworldly characteristics. Each stone pillar was nearly a hundred meters tall, like chairs for dragons to rest on, a city that left an unforgettable impression just by hearing about it.
It was dragged into the depths of the sea of collective unconsciousness because the Dragon of Imagination sealed the entrance to the Chaos Sea and a fragment of the Lord's will, which had awakened within it.
Just as he thought of this, Ebner suddenly noticed something amiss because he could now fully recall the meaning of "Chaos Sea."
This means that in this environment near the 'Chaos Sea,' the influence of the Outer Deities has been weakened to a degree where my current 'Pure White Eye' ability can protect me?
If that's the case for Outer Deities, then True Gods would probably also find it difficult to approach... This should be why the Goddess and the God of Knowledge guided Klein and me here, right? Because they find it difficult to interfere?
After all, the higher the Sequence, the more one is affected by the 'Chaos Sea.' Only I, with my cheat, and Klein, who carries the 'Sefirah Castle,' can accomplish this... just like the sleeping place of the Dark Angel in the original Giant King's Court.
However, what is Edwina's role? Is she merely the initiator of the event?
As various thoughts flashed through his mind, Ebner also educated Edwina and Klein on knowledge related to the Dragon King.
Of course, this was primarily for Edwina; Klein had already learned various common facts about "Ancient Gods" from the Sun.
"Exploring an ancient god's divine kingdom, is that really okay?" Edwina, after hearing the "science popularization," thought for a moment and suddenly felt that her preparations were insufficient. She softly asked Ebner.
"The active dangers should have been cleared by the 'Seal of Calamity' or Roselle. What we need to pay attention to, instead, are their arrangements." Under Ebner's Pure White Eye, apart from the majestic palace in the center, which was grayish-white and over two hundred meters tall, the rest of the area was safe.
And even that palace had one spot he couldn't see through.
"I didn't pre-sense any danger," Klein said, retrieving his coin.
Although Edwina felt this was somewhat reckless, her trust in her companions and her thirst for knowledge still outweighed her unease. She allowed Ebner to control the Bone Dragon to land on one of the central palace's pillars.
While the sensation was not as profound in the air, upon "gliding" to the ground, the three suddenly had "the true feeling of a mouse in Backlund," seeing every building as immensely vast.
The entire island, moreover, would not be smaller than Japan's Honshu Island... To fully explore such a city, even with flight, would be a dream without several months.
As they descended from the pillar where the dragon rested, they directly entered the palace's great hall.
On either side of this hall were vibrant murals, extending forward and converging behind a half-broken giant pillar, so vast that it would take countless people to encircle it.
That giant pillar stood in the deepest part of the hall, directly in front. Without external support, its mere presence instilled a strong sense of awe, conveying the vicissitudes of time, like a petrified deity.
Almost instantly, a grayish-white figure was outlined on the giant pillar.
The figure was covered in scales from head to toe, each one like a solid stone slab. Its vaguely presented silhouette alone felt like an epic.
Hall of Honesty...
Ebner, who was prepared, immediately activated the secret art he had developed to restrain his thoughts.
This secret art was created by combining "Mechanical Mind" with "Psychological Suggestion." Ebner named it "Anti-Social Death Art."
"'Dragon of Imagination,' Ankewelt!" At this moment, Klein's inner voice was the first to resonate, and he immediately looked around in astonishment.
Is this the 'King of Dragons'? It looks very powerful... Then what must the Giant King, who opposed Him in the Twin Epochs, have looked like? And what kind of epic scenes were their battles? Ebner seems to know, but he rarely tells me about these, and I don't have much valuable knowledge to exchange with him...
Wait, how did my thoughts get spoken aloud? What's the principle behind this? A high-level ability of the 'Spectator' pathway?
Edwina's inner thoughts echoed at an extremely fast pace within the vast hall, leaving her beautiful light blue eyes somewhat dazed.
Madam, you appear to be an iceberg, but you have so many questions in your mind! This contrast is quite interesting... I wonder what Miss Sharon would be thinking right now. I should have brought her too...
No, this hall is strange. I can't think wildly!
...Suppress thoughts, suppress thoughts, suppress thoughts...
Halfway through his thought, Klein saw the Tower glance at him playfully. He immediately tried to concentrate through meditation, preventing his mind from wandering.
"What does 'contrast cute' mean? Is it cute because of the contrast? And who is Sharon?" Edwina's face flushed slightly, but her own "thirst for knowledge" still betrayed her thoughts.
"Miss Sharon is my friend; as for 'contrast cute,' it's pretty much what you think," Klein said, listening to the thoughts in his mind while new doubts arose in his own mind:
Why doesn't 'Tower' have an inner voice? Based on my previous observations at the gathering, he definitely has a lot of internal monologues, and might even be watching the fun at every gathering.
Indeed... Mr. Fool's abnormality last time was because he guessed this... But with Edwina here, we can't exactly lay out all our cards.
Ebner, while suppressing his thought fluctuations to avoid being caught by the hall, adjusted his "secret art" and let out some of his thoughts: "As a 'Mysticism Magister,' it's perfectly reasonable to have developed a secret art that can restrain thoughts in advance."
Is it reasonable? But I haven't developed one... I don't know much about the mind domain... However, under 'Mechanical Mind,' I can avoid those emotional thoughts, so it's somewhat useful.
Edwina thought to herself, then activated "Mechanical Mind," and her inner voice gradually became "cold."
These two fellows... No, why am I using 'fellows'? Be polite, be polite...
Klein took a deep breath, beginning to shift his attention to the murals around them, but a thought still uncontrollably popped into his mind:
This place is perfect for playing 'truth or dare,' maybe it's even called the 'Hall of Honesty'...
"Truth or dare?" Edwina expressed her confusion.
This time, Ebner interjected before Klein, releasing some of his thoughts: "That's a game, one where people choose to say or do something."
You know? You actually know? Could you really be... No, I need to be careful, I can't think about things I shouldn't... Dacy pie! Sweet iced tea! Bayam roast meat! Witch's Broth Pasta!
Klein didn't dare to continue thinking, lest he utter that name and harm others. He could only distract himself with food.
Is this truly the 'Mad Adventurer' Ebner mentioned when he introduced him?
Edwina thought "coldly" to herself.
Ebner, seeing the "contact" signal had been sent, dared not continue to "tease" Klein's thoughts, lest he get caught up himself. So, he guided the two to look at the surrounding murals.
Klein quickly inferred the "King of Dragons" might not be dead and even planned to use this to resurrect Himself, from the story of Giant Groselle depicted on the murals and the portrayal of the destined encounter between "0-08" and
Groselle's Travels
in reality.
However, Ebner noticed something different... because in his Pure White Eye, the last few paintings felt distinctly different from the earlier ones... almost as if they were added later...
"According to my guess, the King of Dragons has most likely already resurrected through another contingency... This place is probably a disguise made by Him later... or it could involve a transaction with Roselle or the 'Seal of Calamity.'"
While guessing inwardly, Ebner led Klein and Edwina to the back of the giant pillar that served as the "Dragon of Imagination"'s seat, arriving before a downward passage.
This was also the only place Ebner's Pure White Eye could not see through.
At this moment, within that passage, pure and soft light shone, revealing an open ancient bronze gate standing in the deepest part.
It's actually open? Roselle went down there? What about the Chaos Sea below?
Ebner's heart trembled, nearly failing to maintain his "Anti-Social Death Art."
"No feeling of danger..." Klein said deeply, setting down his coin as he looked at the gate.
"Since we've come this far, I doubt we'll be allowed to retreat," Edwina said "coldly."
"Mm, I understand." Ebner nodded, then held the "historical projection" talisman given by the Goddess and "Lilith's Tear" in his hands, and walked in first.
Immediately after, the scene that greeted him left him dumbfounded.
Because he saw a giant, inverted tall tower whose base was almost as large as the island where the "City of Miracles" Liveseyd was located, but its top plunged deeply downward into the black surface of the sea of collective unconsciousness!
Dream Labyrinth Tower...
It was actually built here! Built in the reflection of Liveseyd!
So that's it... How could one seal the contamination of that entity with fragmented souls without a Sefirah?
This was a tower that Ebner knew intimately yet was also unfamiliar with.
Familiar, because he often entered it to earn points and exchange for talismans, though what he had seen before were only parts on the other side of that "black sea."
Unfamiliar, because it was his first time seeing the true appearance of the tower's base.
No wonder I've unconsciously avoided entering the fourth floor... The dream labyrinth beyond the fourth floor crosses those black seas... Could that thing be an offshoot of the 'Chaos Sea'? Similar to the gray fog of the 'Sefirah Castle'?
As he pondered, Ebner connected the previous clues and almost immediately discerned the purpose of part of Roselle's plan:
He wants to use a 'miracle' to resurrect this part of his soul, which he had cut off using 'secret arts'!
The mechanism of the Dream Labyrinth Tower, in essence, is to reward tower climbers with the knowledge they most need through tasks... This is actually indirectly helping others achieve their wishes... Heh, isn't the accumulation of wishes for the final 'miracle'?
As for the one providing the miracle... it's probably the mad Zaratul, right?
The 'Book of Fortune Stealing,' forcefully added into the ritual to enter this travelogue, was prepared for this!
He wants to steal Zaratul's 'resurrection' miracle and use it on himself! A Miracle Invoker's miracle might not be able to resurrect a complete Black Emperor, but a fragmented soul would be no problem!
As for the other book in the ritual, the 'Book of Astrology,' it's probably a lingering effect of his contamination by the 'Mother Goddess'...
Fanny's 'Lawyer' characteristic and Mr. Surry's 'Astronomer' characteristic probably both came from Roselle... Mr. Surry has also always carried that book...
And both Fanny's and Mr. Surry's Beyonder characteristics are currently in Tosk!
They could both serve as vessels for resurrection... I just don't know which one is part of Roselle's plan... or... both?
This resurrection might be very dangerous... So, is the Goddess's purpose for me to prevent it?
But how should I do it?
Just as Ebner thought of this, he saw an entrance suddenly open at the base of the giant tower. Then, an irresistible force pulled him, Klein, and Edwina into it!

chapters.title: Chapter 762: Beginning
chapters.content:
Chapter 762 - Beginning
In the "rat tunnels" pervasive beneath the entire city of Tosk, "Black Knight" Sero Delien, after once again slaying a monster from a "nightmare," turned to look at his attendants, realizing that apart from the old butler wearing a monocle, no one else remained.
Sero stood, leaning on his sword, and asked in a deep voice, "Varys, how long have we been trapped in these so-called 'rat tunnels'?"
"Your Excellency, though in different nightmares, the passage of time is hard to perceive, I know it has been three days," the old man adjusted his monocle, responding elegantly.
Sero nodded, then suddenly raised the black greatsword in his hand, stopping it before the old butler's neck. He asked in a low voice, "Who exactly are you? Varys would not speak to me like this! Are you one of those 'rats' hiding in the sewers? Do you think you've got me cornered, so you've stopped pretending?"
"Your Excellency, I am on your side," the old man replied with a smile, showing no fear. He curled the corners of his mouth.
"Don't want to say? Then I'll herd you and directly question your soul; it's the same." "Black Knight" Delien exerted force with his arm, and the black greatsword, laden with deep darkness, immediately struck down.
Immediately after, a deep gash appeared on the "Black Knight's" own shoulder. The sturdy black armor seemed to be torn apart by something, and the injury rapidly spread, threatening to approach his heart.
This was the "Black Knight's" "Blade of Flesh and Spirit," which not only corroded flesh, annihilated souls, and shattered barriers, but also nullified the defenses of any creature with degenerate intentions. It was one of the "Black Knight's" core Beyonder abilities, stemming from the "Degeneracy" domain.
But at this moment, such a powerful strike had landed upon himself.
"Why go to such lengths? I originally wanted you to explore more of what else is special about this 'Kaspersky' that Roselle specifically designed to deal with me..." The old man looked at Sero with a deliberately feigned "regretful" expression, shaking his head, "I originally thought we were cooperating quite happily... Huh?"
But as he spoke, he suddenly let out a soft "Huh," because he noticed the scene before him rapidly dissipating, and the "Black Knight" whom he had supposedly "killed" also vanished. In its place, the old man's own left hand was silently severed.
—That was precisely the hand he had "stolen" the fate of being slain from, and then returned to the other party.
"So it was a nightmare... Has Sero Delien been captured already? When? I didn't even notice... This is truly interesting." The old man surveyed his surroundings with interest, then used the "Flesh and Blood Magic" he had stolen to restore his left arm.
"Very good, to actually make me unable to contact my other avatars... If I hadn't gathered some of them in Tosk beforehand, I might truly not have been able to crack this so-called 'Kaspersky'!"
After speaking, the old man's appearance began to change, transforming into the figure of a young man.
This figure wore a long, robe-like black trench coat, paired with black trousers and black leather shoes. He had a broad forehead, a thin face, and wore a tall top hat and a very distinctive monocle made of crystal, appearing extremely refined.
He pinched the top and bottom edges of the crystal monocle, and a smile spread across his face, "I've found you, little rats."
.....
At the unknown space at the end of the "rat tunnels," within the "Men in Black" base that Ebner had once visited to rescue "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina.
The young man, who called himself the "Commander," looked at Sero Delien, bound upside down on a cross on the altar, and smiled, "'The Hanged Man' symbolizes degradation and sacrifice. It is most fitting for you, a believer of the 'True Creator' and a 'Black Knight,' to bear the 'contamination' entangled upon His Majesty..."
Unfortunately, Sero, who had fallen into a coma, couldn't hear these words, otherwise he would surely have warmly greeted the young man's family.
"As for the other sacrifice..." The young man paused here, seemingly sensing something, then shook his head, saying:
"The main structure of the arrangements in the 'rat tunnels' is composed of three combined 'Mystical Reappearances' personally left by His Majesty, who is the 'Emperor of Knowledge.'
"Although the 'Nightmare Dragon's Game' and the 'Rhine-Solomon Crow Lasso' have both been cracked by you... the last layer, the 'Cretan Labyrinth,' isn't so easy to unravel.
"His Majesty once said that the 'mystical' prototype of this labyrinth was designed to trap a minotaur... and Amon, a fellow who always occupies others' fates, is also a type of 'minotaur'...
"What a pity... I still haven't been able to decipher the meaning of His Majesty's words... But my personal experience tells me that this 'labyrinth' is indeed very effective against Beyonders of the 'Marauder' pathway... enough to trap you until His Majesty needs your help to transfer the 'contamination' onto the 'Black Knight.'"
Looking at the Beyonder characteristics and monocle placed on the other two altars, the young man laughed unrestrainedly.
He would always remember the scene a hundred years ago when his mother suddenly put on a monocle, "parasitizing" his elder brother, younger sister, and father who had returned from outside, all of them smiling at him with glasses on.
He would also always remember the chestnut-haired monarch who personally rescued him and later designed to capture that Amon avatar, avenging him...
Therefore, even if he could immediately activate the arrangements in the "Kaspersky" stronghold to capture the Amon avatar in the "rat tunnels"... he still endured, waiting for the moment of His Majesty's return.
.....
Since the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" began operating, only five people in total have managed to pass the fourth floor and reach the third.
Of these five, two had even perished within the second-floor scenario, becoming a permanent part of the "Labyrinth Tower."
Just as Ebner, Klein, and Edwina were drawn into the top floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," the three current highest-authority holders on the third floor immediately received news from the "Labyrinth Tower" and were forcibly "teleported" inside.
—Beyond the fourth floor, all challenges must be faced in person!
"A tower climber has entered the first floor. The final authority contest scenario has begun... Confirming total tower climbers: 5 people. (Those sharing authority are counted as 1 person)."
.....
Tylers Renault, a Sequence 4 'Prophet' and a high-ranking deacon of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, was in the library consulting information when he suddenly received a notification from the "Dream Labyrinth Tower." He quickly gave instructions to his subordinates, then retrieved his usual Beyonder items and, before the countdown ended, actively opened the "Door of Dream and Reality" to enter his resting room.
—After all, most of his equipment was actually stored there.
"How could someone suddenly arrive on the first floor? Before, no one had even passed two floors..."
He was puzzled, so before the "scenario" officially began, he prepared a ritual and actively performed a divination.
"Assist the holder of 'Light Seeker' in achieving final victory..."
"The prophecy is so clear, is it the Lord's decree?"
Tylers's face showed astonishment. He wasn't afraid of being punished for not reporting the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" matter, as the Holy Scriptures of the God of Knowledge actually supported secretly hiding and guarding some knowledge and information. Furthermore, as long as one didn't betray the interests of the Church of Knowledge, some other "two-faced" borderline behaviors, such as deep interactions with people from other churches or nations, would not be pursued.
Aside from the official teams handling Beyonder cases, the rest of the Church of Knowledge's organizational structure was quite free and open, more like a confederation of guilds composed of scholars.
In short, after determining that the "prophecy" was indeed the "Lord's" decree, Tylers frowned. He hesitated for a moment, then opened the "exchange list" and spent all his points...
.....
Oravi Island, Rorsted Archipelago.
"Disciple of Silence" Jacks had just heard the prompt from the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," followed immediately by another decree: "Destroy the Labyrinth Tower's final ritual."
Jacks knelt on the ground, his forehead pressed firmly against the floor, trembling as he said, "Your will be done... Great Mother Tree of Desire."
.....
Trier, the "Saint of Shadows" of the Aurora Order swallowed his bitten-off finger, then humbly prostrated himself on the ground, saying, "Following your oracle, I shall surely achieve victory, seize and destroy that blasphemous tower."
.....
Meanwhile, in the scenario on the first floor of the Dream Labyrinth Tower, Ebner rubbed his temples and stood up. Then, he saw words written in "blood" on the ground... It was the task for the first floor:
"Clearance Task: Win the 'Holy Grail' War and make a wish to the 'Holy Grail.'
"Optional Task 1: Heroic Spirit Summoning. Use 'Holy Relics' to summon your own Heroic Spirit.
"Optional Task 2: Kill all 'Masters' except yourself.
"Optional Task 3: Find the person possessed by 'Roselle Gustav's Phantom' and awaken them."
These words only existed for half a minute before transforming into a "magic circle" composed of many magical symbols.
Holy Grail War? Heh, what a fitting scene... No matter what wish the final person makes, it will probably be 'twisted' into resurrecting Roselle, right?
Then what is the evil of this world within the Holy Grail? The 'Chaos Sea,' or the 'Fallen Mother Goddess''s contamination?
Huh... I have another note on me... This is my substituted identity... Kiritsugu Emiya? I didn't expect to be part of the protagonist's team...
Heh, there's indeed a 'Command Seal' on my wrist.
Ebner looked at the patterns on his wrist and mumbled a few complaints, then saw Edwina push open the door and walk in. He peeked behind the door but didn't see Klein's figure.
Edwina also took out a note and said, "I seem to have replaced this person named Irisviel von Einzbern..."
Edwina doesn't have the qualification of a 'tower climber,' so she can't be a 'Master'?
Ebner glanced at her wrist but didn't find any "Command Seal," and other thoughts flashed through his mind:
Kiritsugu is here, his wife is here... So where is Maiya Hisau?
At this moment, the "Magic Mirror" in his sleeve subtly vibrated.

chapters.title: Chapter 763: Klein’s Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 763 - Klein's Identity
"The Holy Grail War, in simple terms, is a battle for the Holy Grail, which can grant its holder's wishes.
"Legend has it that roughly every sixty years, Fuyuki City accumulates enough power to support the Holy Grail's descent. Then, the Holy Grail, possessing the power to immediately grant any wish, will appear here.
"Whenever this happens, seven Beyonders holding Command Seals, leading their summoned Heroic Spirit Servants, engage in a battle for ownership of the Holy Grail. The ultimate survivor will claim ownership of the Holy Grail.
"Finally, so-called Heroic Spirits are likely high-sequence Beyonders who existed in history... perhaps possessing power at the Angel level."
Ebner, combining the games and animated films he had seen in his past life with his guesses about Roselle's method of re-enacting this scene, briefly explained the meaning of the "Holy Grail War" to Edwina.
As for the specific story, he temporarily refrained from mentioning it to Edwina. After all, this was his greatest reliance; once spoken, it would leave a trace, and in the world of mysteries, it was not impossible for opponents to detect it.
—According to the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" notification, he already knew that three "tower climbers" had entered the first floor, and they were likely all Saints at the Demigod level.
"Seven teams... So, we have to defeat or kill the other six teams?" Edwina asked thoughtfully.
"For 'Masters,' killing might not be necessary... but Heroic Spirits, or rather, Servants, are the targets," Ebner replied, then pondered, "By the way, the role you've replaced is also quite special... Do you feel anything unusual about yourself?"
"Anything unusual..." Edwina checked herself, then took out a white oil lamp from her portable bag and said, "This is 'Silent Winter.' You should have seen it; it's a magical item I bought at the Pirate Council... But after entering here, it lost its original abilities and seems to have been imbued with the characteristics of a 'Gatekeeper,' undergoing a fundamental change."
"'Silent Winter'... I remember it was an item sold by 'King of the Five Seas' Nast... " Ebner took the oil lamp, muttering to himself,
Could this thing be the vessel for the 'Lesser Holy Grail'?
A "Gatekeeper" can contain souls... it does seem similar...
This item flowing out of Nast's hands, could it be something Roselle designed long ago?
No, its validity period is only five years, so it shouldn't be Roselle's doing...
Hmm, given that Edwina possesses it, the biggest suspect is the God of Knowledge!
But what is the God of Knowledge's purpose? Simply pushing Edwina into this Irisviel position?
Moreover, considering that the 'Book of Astrology' was previously in Lunburg, and Mr. Surry only accidentally obtained the 'Astronomer' and 'Lawyer' Beyonder characteristics while studying abroad in Lunburg... Roselle likely had a transaction with the God of Knowledge back then... Perhaps, in Roselle's current 'resurrection' plan, He is supportive...
But under the Goddess's hidden push, I entered 'Groselle's Travels,' and She didn't interfere... Does this mean it depends on my choice?
In other words, Roselle's resurrection plan this time might actually succeed... but there are some changes the Goddess doesn't want to see?
Hmm, the specific details of Roselle's resurrection plan are not clear yet, so it's hard to judge... And the minds of deities are even more unpredictable, so it's best not to speculate for now.
However, since the role of the "Lesser Holy Grail" is still to gather souls, I can roughly guess what the so-called Heroic Spirits are... They are probably fragments of Old Huang himself, separated and sealed, temporarily reassembled by the rules of the "Holy Grail War," waiting for the victor to wish for "resurrection"...
It's probable that "Optional Task 3," "Find 'Roselle Gustav's Phantom,'" refers to these "Heroic Spirits."
Combining this with "Optional Task 1," "Use 'Holy Relics' to summon your own Heroic Spirit," if I were to make a bold guess, if the "tower climber" cannot provide the so-called "Holy Relic," what they summon will most likely be various versions of Old Huang...
It seems Old Huang himself is in a bit of a contradiction.
The part of him that yearns to be resurrected issued the clearance task, asking us to win and make a wish.
Meanwhile, optional tasks one and three are both revealing the true nature of this "Holy Grail War," serving as reminders to the "tower climbers"...
Right, if he wasn't self-contradicting, why would he even need to arrange a Holy Grail War? This war itself is actually an attempt to stop me from making a wish!
But this intent to stop isn't even firm...
As thoughts raced through his mind, Ebner returned "Silent Winter" to Edwina and told her his conjectures, leaving out the speculative parts about the God of Knowledge.
Edwina listened quietly. However, due to her limited understanding of the Holy Grail War, she couldn't offer better insights. After a brief contemplation, she changed the subject and asked, "Do you have any clues about 'Holy Relics'?"
Ebner nodded and said, "I have some ideas."
With that, he led Edwina to the magical symbols formed by the earlier bloodstains and continued, "I just studied this 'summoning ritual' and found that the spot for placing Holy Relics actually represents 'the sacrifice of a soul'...
"This means that the so-called Holy Relics are souls of high-level existences... and this ritual's essence is to transform that soul into a Heroic Spirit and then send it back to us...
"If there isn't one, then it randomly sends one... which is what I suspect to be a 'Roselle Gustav Phantom.'"
"Souls of high-level existences..." Edwina frowned. For her, even a Demigod's soul was rare to encounter, let alone an Angel's.
Seeing her frown, Ebner smiled, "Don't worry, I happen to have one here..."
With that, he pulled out a card and took out the Staff of the Sun he obtained from a "Light Apostle." It housed the evil spirit of a former Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
Just as Ebner was about to attempt summoning a Heroic Spirit under Edwina's curious gaze, boundless gray fog suddenly appeared before his eyes. Then, he heard the "World's" request for a "meeting."
After a brief thought, he casually made an excuse to Edwina and headed to the washroom.
.....
Inside the ancient palace above the gray fog, as soon as Ebner's vision returned, he saw not only Klein sitting at the long table, but also Miss Temperance, wearing a Gothic court dress and a small black soft hat.
Seeing him look over in surprise, "World" explained in a hoarse voice, "Miss Temperance and I share authority in the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower,' so she was also pulled into the first floor."
"I see... So, who is your current identity?" Ebner asked, then added, "I'm replacing Kiritsugu."
"Kenneth El-Melloi Archibald... and Miss Temperance is replacing Sola..." "World" answered, staring into Ebner's eyes.
No problem... According to the original story, that Lancer was indeed shared between the two of you.

chapters.title: Chapter 764: The Setup
chapters.content:
Chapter 764 - The Setup
Seeing Mr. Tower look at him and Miss Temperance with a slightly playful gaze, Klein immediately understood that the other party knew who Director Ken and Sola were... or rather, he knew the plot of
Fate/Zero
!
Is he not even pretending anymore? Did he see through my previous probing, so he's just giving up? No... from the current situation, it's more likely that I'm the one giving up...
Now the only hope is that even if he's a transmigrator, he's not Liu Bo... or rather, he's a foreigner who doesn't recognize Chinese characters...
Numerous thoughts raced through his mind, but on the surface, Klein retorted, "Vice Admiral Iceberg replaced Irisviel?"
"Yes." Ebner nodded indifferently.
He had figured it out by now; when it came to reputation, having none was the best. This way, even if someone wanted to deal with the "romantic detective" later, they wouldn't believe that such a promiscuous person would value his female friends around him, which would instead indirectly protect them.
Klein's heart sank slightly, feeling that his "level" was far below the other party's.
Miss Temperance, sitting beside them, turned her head slightly, completely unaware of the veiled conversation they were having, feeling a touch of confusion.
"Ahem, let's exchange information first..." "World" Klein sensed the atmosphere was a bit off. He coughed and continued, "From what I know, Emperor Roselle encountered the completely mad Zaratul and very likely imprisoned Him in a dark palace..."
"Indeed... This information corroborates my previous conjecture... Roselle intends to steal the 'Miracle' of a 'Miracle Invoker' to resurrect the fragmented body, or rather, part of his soul, sealed here." Ebner's expression also became serious upon hearing this. He thought for a moment, then added, "When I last entered the 'City of Night,' I encountered a normal historical projection of Zaratul and... well, 'sealed' it.
"However, if that 'historical projection' were to meet Zaratul's main body, He might use it to resurrect through a 'miracle.'
"And Roselle, what he's waiting for is probably this moment."
After listening, Klein thoughtfully asked, "So, the Evernight Goddess is happy to see Roselle's resurrection, even giving him a push?"
After all, "Tower" could enter the "City of Night" thanks to "0-17," a Sealed Artifact of the Church of Evernight.
Ebner, however, shook his head, "I think quite the opposite. The Goddess does not approve of Roselle's resurrection in this manner."
Goddess... Mr. Tower is definitely not a believer of the Evernight Goddess, so why does he use such a natural address?
Klein's mind flashed with an inexplicable thought, but on the surface, he asked, "Why do you judge that?"
"Because I currently cannot release Zaratul at all... I can only unseal it after becoming a Demigod, at the earliest." Ebner did not directly mention the "Pure White Eye," only referring to it as a "seal." "If the Goddess truly approved of Roselle's plan, She wouldn't have allowed me to come here now..."
If I had come in at the time point in the original novel when you explored 'Groselle's Travels,' I would most likely already be a Demigod... Or if I had arrived at the first floor by normally climbing the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower,' I would definitely be Sequence 4 by then.
"Then does that mean... Roselle's resurrection plan is doomed to fail?" Klein frowned and asked.
"Not necessarily... Zaratul has a high probability of having integrated into the rules of this tower. If we achieve victory and make a wish, then no matter what that wish is, it will probably be 'twisted' by Roselle's authority as the 'Black Emperor' into resurrecting Zaratul, and then 'stealing' his fate...
"But this 'resurrection' would require borrowing the power of the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower' or even Roselle himself, and it wouldn't be as safe as before... it's very likely it still couldn't escape 'contamination'..."
Ebner said, half-reasoning and half-guessing, combining it with the original novel.
After a pause, he added, "Of course, that 'stealing' method of resurrection might have other hidden dangers, which is why the Goddess doesn't approve of Roselle resurrecting in that way."
Klein knew that "Miracles" could bring about "resurrection from death," as he himself had experienced it twice. But he had never heard that "Marauder" could even steal the fate of "resurrection." He couldn't help but secretly sigh,
The "Marauder" pathway truly deserves to be categorized as "
bizarre
" by "Tower"...
After a while, Klein deliberated and then said, "I once heard 'ravings' from Roselle in the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower'... some of those words might be helpful for the current situation..."
"They are:
"'The Seal of Calamity and the two-faced dragon are cooperating; they cannot be trusted,' 'I am not me, and yet I am me,' 'Beware of the Mother card'..."
The Seal of Calamity and the two-faced dragon are cooperating; they cannot be trusted? So that's it... I understand now. No wonder the God of Knowledge seems to be helping Roselle with his resurrection, yet didn't stop me from entering 'Groselle's Travels'...
She's probably not helping Roselle at all, but following Her scheme with the Seal of Calamity!
Heh, that senior transmigrator, the Seal of Calamity, is so 'cunning and sly,' would It not know that Roselle later altered and used Its arrangements?
Roselle's actions were probably within Its plan all along?
Then what would the Seal of Calamity's purpose be? Alas, too little information... I can't grasp Its intentions at all.
Hmm, as for the second phrase, 'I am not me, and yet I am me,' it's easy to understand. The Emperor gained a new personality after ascending to the moon, and this personality was more influenced by the 'Primordial Moon'...
That's it, this must be why the Goddess doesn't want Roselle to resurrect in this way... The part of Roselle's personality sealed in the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower' might be more dominant. Even if he truly escapes the 'Primordial Moon's' contamination, the resurrected Roselle's personality will undergo a significant change... Will that version of him truly still be him?
Even more so, will the resurrected fragmented body, in turn, influence Roselle's main consciousness, making him abandon his resolve and return as the 'Black Emperor' with 'contamination'?
Finally, 'beware of the Mother card' is relatively simple; it should mean beware of the 'Fallen Mother Goddess'...
Thinking this, Ebner habitually pinched his chin.
Klein, seeing this action, asked, "Mr. Tower, do you have any theories?"
Ebner hesitated, then probed back, "You should know about the Seal of Calamity, right?"
He deliberately emphasized "Seal of Calamity," as he felt Roselle wouldn't have failed to write about it in his diaries. Mr. Fool, having read so many, most likely knew it was a transmigrator.
"I know... It's Roselle's closest friend." Klein naturally understood Ebner's meaning, so he also emphasized "closest friend."
This strange conversation once again made Miss Temperance turn her head, looking at "World," expecting him to "translate."
Seeing this, Klein gave a "we'll talk later" look, as he hadn't yet figured out how to selectively "explain."
Ebner didn't notice "World" and "Temperance's" exchange of glances. He pondered and said:
"I think Roselle was probably duped by his 'cunning' 'closest friend'!"
Hearing this, Klein's expression instantly became strange, then he brightened up, suppressing his excitement with his "Clown" ability, and asked curiously:
"How so?"
Why do your emotions seem off?
Ebner muttered to himself, then cast aside the sudden, inexplicable feeling and repeated his earlier conjectures, picking and choosing what to share.
Then, just as both Ebner and Klein fell into contemplation, "Temperance" Sharon suddenly asked, "The seal on Zaratul's historical projection cannot be broken, and only you know that?"
Ebner was startled by this, but still vaguely replied, "A few deities should also know."
Like Lilith, the Goddess, the two-faced dragon... I'm not sure about others...
he added silently in his mind.
"It seems like a 'trap,'" Sharon stated concisely.
Hearing this, Ebner's heart skipped a beat, then he thought of Roselle's phrase "beware of the Mother card," and a name involuntarily flashed in his mind:
"Fallen Mother Goddess!"
"This so-called resurrection, after all the twists and turns, could it be a setup by the deities?"
"The Silver Moon Project?"

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Lying Flat
chapters.content:
Chapter 765 - Lying Flat
Ebner felt he had fallen into a misconception and couldn't help but reflect:
Only I, who know I cannot release Zaratul's historical projection, and a limited few deities who are familiar with past transmigrators, know that the Goddess opposes Roselle's resurrection plan...
But in the eyes of outsiders, or rather, Outer Deities, the Goddess probably sent me to rescue Roselle!
This is absolutely a misdirection!
Roselle established this "Dream Labyrinth Tower" and painstakingly wanted to resurrect a separated part of his soul, which must have been influenced by the "Fallen Mother Goddess"... Or, even if his initial intention was his own decision, there must have been problems during the setup process!
This is just like when his main body wanted to use the "return of the Black Emperor" to cleanse contamination, yet he deliberately placed the last mausoleum on that problematic island.
And since the "Fallen Mother Goddess" invested a considerable "cost" in this matter and believes She successfully "deceived" the Evernight Goddess and the God of Knowledge, She will certainly not give up easily. She will likely gradually increase the cost... and this might be what the deities are plotting...
As for which deity is the mastermind? Ebner believes it must be Lilith, who, from the very beginning, acted as if it had nothing to do with Her, expressed a neutral stance, but was the only one who could act near the "Chaos Sea"!
As for the contradictions and conflicts between the God of Knowledge and the Evernight Goddess in some details, it's probably just to make the act more convincing.
In the eyes of the "Fallen Mother Goddess," She probably accepts any method of Roselle's resurrection, as She can use it to infiltrate more power through the barrier...
But obviously, letting me release Zaratul's historical projection, making the deities inside the barrier believe that Roselle's resurrection is truly "uncontaminated," aligns more with Her intentions.
After all, if Roselle were to return in a potentially "contaminated" state, the deities of Earth would not stand idly by.
Therefore, She will definitely try Her best to ensure I win the "Holy Grail" War and reach the wish-granting stage.
And to force Her to continuously increase Her "cost"... why not just lie flat and see how far the contaminated "Roselle" and the "Fallen Mother Goddess" behind him can favor me.
As thoughts raced, Ebner nodded to "Temperance" Sharon, saying, "Thank you for the reminder, Miss Temperance... I've figured it out."
Recalling the "historical projection" talisman given by the Goddess, Ebner roughly guessed Lilith and Amanises' plan.
"What have you figured out?" Klein asked deeply.
Ebner glanced at him, smiling, "It's better if you two don't know some things... And this trap is probably tacitly approved by Mr. Fool, and even more credible because of your involvement!
"So, when the time is right, Mr. Fool should tell you personally."
Mr. Fool tacitly approved? How would I know that? Don't make decisions for Mr. Fool without permission!
Klein grumbled inwardly, but he couldn't tell if "Tower" genuinely believed that, or if he had already seen through his identity and was deliberately teasing him.
Calm down, calm down. The 'respect' and 'trust' that 'Tower' usually shows me aren't faked. If he had known all along that I, the 'Fool,' was a 'fake,' he wouldn't have had that genuine 'respect.'
After all, respect for a person generally depends on their strength, status, and achievements.
If he had known all along that I was Klein in disguise, it's impossible that he was respecting my 'achievements,' right?
Heh, what credit do I have in this world? Awe of strength is more reasonable.
Having convinced himself, Klein also understood that the matters involved here were probably truly unsuitable for him and Sharon to know, so he nodded and changed the subject, asking, "Have you summoned a Heroic Spirit?"
"Not yet." Ebner shook his head, then expressed some of his conjectures about Heroic Spirit summoning, concluding with, "In short, if no 'Holy Relic' is used to sacrifice a high-level soul, then the resulting Heroic Spirit will most likely be an impersonation of 'Roselle's Phantom.'"
"Is that so?" Klein's tone was slightly off, but he quickly controlled it and then asked, "If every 'tower climber' used a 'Holy Relic,' wouldn't Roselle's act of 'gathering' those 'phantoms' fail?"
"The churches, as supervisors, must possess a large number of 'Command Seals.' Even if everyone uses 'Holy Relics,' they can probably still produce many extraordinary Heroic Spirits, as this is also the norm for Holy Grail Wars.
"And there probably aren't too many 'Roselle Phantoms' anyway..." Ebner replied after thinking for a moment.
You're really familiar with the Holy Grail War...
Klein muttered inwardly, then carefully said, "Actually, I've already summoned a Heroic Spirit..."
"What kind of Heroic Spirit?" Ebner asked curiously, eager to know what kind of "Heroic Spirit" Roselle had designed.
Would it be consistent with the original
Fate/stay night
(FSN) story, or would it directly use historical figures from the "Mysteries" world?
"I didn't know then that the true 'Holy Relics' were the 'souls' of high-sequence Beyonders, so I asked Mr. Fool to bestow a blasphemy card... well, I placed the 'Witch' card there..." Klein explained, organizing his words.
"What was the result?" Ebner was quite "impressed" by Klein's operation and grew even more curious.
"I summoned a Rider-class Medusa..." Klein thought for a moment, then added, "The one from FSN."
Not Lancer? But Rider-class Medusa does fit better with the 'Witch' card...
"Her appearance is extremely similar to the one in FSN, and her self-perception is 'Medusa'...
"Her normal state should have Sequence 3 level strength, but her pathway cannot be discerned from her abilities, nor can she display a 'Semi-Mythical Form.'
"And according to her, after her 'Noble Phantasm' is unleashed, she can unleash strength at the 'Angel' level.
"Also, she told me that Servants almost never disobey Command Seal orders, which is different from how it's described in the story." Klein paused here and couldn't help but ask, "Is she really shaped from a Roselle Phantom?"
Her appearance is probably 'imagined' into existence, her personality perhaps bestowed by a 'Dream Weaver,' and her abilities are closer to being pieced together with 'simulation' and applied to her, so her pathway can't be discerned... As for Noble Phantasm release, it's either temporarily summoning a 'historical projection' or 'mystical reappearance'... Of course, it could also be the effect of a 'simulated' high-rank 'recording' ability.
As for the Command Seals... is it a modified version of the 'Herding' ability?
Hmm, perhaps the 'Holy Grail summoning' system is a 'secret art' composed of all the above abilities combined... It's a shame that this 'secret art' likely utilizes the 'Chaos Sea' and the special environment of 'Groselle's Travels,' so even if one learned it, it couldn't be replicated in the real world.
As Ebner pondered, he also responded to Klein's earlier question: "I think so... You can try to 'awaken' him... If successful, your Heroic Spirit's strength might even increase."
"Awaken..." Klein was thoughtful, and a whole plan instantly formed in his mind.
Then, after the three discussed where to meet up, the conversation shifted to the "battle plan" segment.
But at this moment, Ebner shook his head and said, "This map... no, I mean this scenario is very large, almost the same size as the 'City of Miracles' Liveseyd, encompassing the entire Honshu Island.
"There's no need for us to concentrate in Fuyuki City. We can go travel for a few days first, experience the unique 'civilization' created by Roselle, and only maintain necessary surveillance on Fuyuki... Wouldn't it be better if we only came over to clean up the mess when they're almost done fighting?"
Klein was dumbfounded. He thought for a moment, then tentatively asked, "Wouldn't that be cheating? Won't we be disqualified as 'Masters'?"
"If it were a normal 'Holy Grail War,' of course it would...
"But I have a premonition that the 'Church' in this scenario will go easy on us."
Ebner narrowed his eyes and said.
Lying flat like this would also help test the "Fallen Mother Goddess'" tolerance limit.
And if his prediction was wrong and they really were disqualified as "Masters," then that would be even better; he and Klein wouldn't have to worry about it anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 766: Reinforcements Arrive
chapters.content:
Chapter 766 - Reinforcements Arrive
Back in reality, Ebner unlocked the spiritual seal on the washroom door and returned to the sunroom.
As he pushed the door open, he saw Vice Admiral Iceberg disassembling a radio, studying its internal structure.
Seeing Ebner return, she stopped what she was doing, pointed to the disassembled parts, and sighed with emotion, "This must be the radio mentioned in some of Emperor Roselle's manuscripts... I didn't expect him to have already realized it in this world of imagination."
At this point, Edwina paused, her light blue eyes full of anticipation as she suggested, "Perhaps, we should go to the 'library' in this scenario... if one exists."
"We'll have plenty of time to go later..." Ebner smiled, then briefly recounted what he had discussed with Klein above the gray fog.
Of course, he didn't mention the parts about "traps" and "lying flat"; some things were fine to discuss in the Sefirah Castle, but not safe on the first floor of the Dream Labyrinth Tower.
"So, Gehrman and his companion will be coming to meet up soon?" Edwina thought for a moment, then hesitantly asked, "Is he truly trustworthy?"
"Trustworthy," Ebner answered without hesitation.
"I understand." Edwina nodded, then suggested, "But before they arrive, we'd best summon the Heroic Spirit first."
"That's exactly what I'm going to do." Ebner replied with a smile, then walked to the ritual symbol formed by the bloodstains and placed the Staff of the Sun, which he had already taken out, upon it.
Through his Pure White Eye, Ebner knew that unlike the Holy Grail War in the anime of his previous life, this ritual itself did not require a special activation incantation. It only needed to be started by spiritually activating the Command Seal patterns on the back of the hand.
As faint phosphorescence emerged from the crimson patterns, a current of air suddenly arose in the room. It quickly escalated from a gentle breeze to a violent whirlwind, throwing the entire sunroom into disarray.
Vice Admiral Iceberg, observing this, waved her hand to set up a Spiritual Wall, preventing further damage to the room's furniture.
At this moment, brilliant light gradually rose from the center of the glowing ritual patterns, making it difficult to keep one's eyes open... But Ebner, with his Pure White Eye activated, still noticed a slender yet tall figure slowly ascending from the center of the "magic circle," as if emerging from water.
Soon, the wind imperceptibly ceased, and the crimson patterns that had just emitted light were now dim, appearing scorched and dry.
A young girl clad in black full plate armor appeared before Ebner and Edwina.
She wore no helmet, revealing a delicate face, with beautiful golden hair tied back, holding a thorny spear in her hand.
It's indeed transformed from that Pope's evil spirit; the aura is consistent... However, this appearance...
Is it Lancer-class King Arthur? Or the Alter version... Is it because that Pope degenerated into an evil spirit, which is why she manifests with 'black' armored 'skin'?
As Ebner observed and pondered, the "girl" transformed from that Pope knelt down again, just as she did upon their first meeting at the hot spring inn, addressing Ebner as "My Lord."
She wasn't instilled with the "Heroic Spirit" memory? And she still has self-awareness?
Ebner was surprised internally, asking calmly, "Are you Auerbach, or King Arthur?"
Auerbach was the Angelic evil spirit previously residing in the staff, and also the second Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun who fell before the position of Pope was completely abolished and replaced by a round table conference.
"Auerbach greets My Lord... I have indeed received the persona of a king named 'Artoria Pendragon'... but this cannot extinguish my faith in My Lord.
"In truth, when this sealed artifact—imbued with the powers of 'Profane Presbyter,' 'Wisdom Angel,' 'Discerner,' 'Sun-Chaser,' 'Calamity,' and 'Miracle-Invoker'—forged this 'imagined' shell to stabilize my condition and bestowed upon me personality, abilities, and authority... I would never have accepted it had I not sensed that the master it chose for me was You."
The "girl" replied respectfully and firmly.
Ebner was somewhat embarrassed by her fawning attitude, calling him "My Lord" repeatedly, but he didn't dare to directly deny it. He took a deep breath and began to ponder the information revealed in her words:
It seems the "Dream Labyrinth Tower's" influence isn't as strong on beings of Angelic rank, at least there's a possibility of resistance...
Also, 'Profane Presbyter,' 'Wisdom Angel,' 'Discerner,' 'Sun-Chaser,' 'Calamity,' and 'Miracle-Invoker'... the first five are all Sequence 2 of the "All-Knowing and Omnipotent Pathway"!
This must be leveraging the power of the "Chaos Sea," right? But if it can be leveraged, it means the "raw material" of this tower itself is extraordinary!
Its image is an "inverted tall tower," "Hanged Man," "White Tower"... Could it be that Roselle killed a 'Profane Presbyter' who herded "Wisdom Angels," and combined it with the "Chaos Sea" and Zaratul to create the "Dream Labyrinth Tower"?
Thinking this, Ebner chose his words carefully and asked, "What level of abilities can you use now?"
"Reporting to My Lord... I can now use all abilities from Sequence 9 to Sequence 3 of this pathway. And after unleashing my 'Noble Phantasm,' I can use my original Sequence 2 level powers, and temporarily control several authorities and skills temporarily granted to me by this 'Dream Labyrinth Tower,'" Auerbach answered without concealment.
Hmm, the Rider-class Medusa Klein described earlier, even without unleashing her Noble Phantasm, also had Demigod-level strength, but she could only use a few granted abilities, unlike this one, who is much more comprehensive... As expected of a "Heroic Spirit" summoned with a self-provided soul; this is far more powerful!
Ebner thoughtfully nodded, then pressed, "Can you manifest your mythical form?"
"After unleashing my Noble Phantasm, I can..." Auerbach nodded slightly, then added, "But if I do, this imagined shell will be damaged."
This shell is probably the "soul" that replaces you in the "Lesser Holy Grail," so the "mythical form" should only be a one-time opportunity, but this alone makes her much stronger than other Heroic Spirits without "Holy Relics."
Too bad it's a "Lancer"... But luckily, I'm a believer of the "Yellow-Black King who Wields Good Fortune," so it shouldn't be a problem... right?
Thinking this, Ebner, generally satisfied with his "Heroic Spirit," reined in his thoughts and nodded to the "girl" before him, "Very good, you may rise now... However, in this dream scenario, we temporarily need to hide our identities, so I will call you Lya normally, and 'Lancer' when there are enemies... Do you have any other questions?"
Lya is a diminutive of Artoria.
"Yes, My Lord! I have no questions, and I offer victory to you," Lya said with the fervor of a fanatic in her eyes, standing up and bowing respectfully.
Just as Ebner was about to say something more, his Pure White Eye suddenly detected a subtle disharmony. He immediately grabbed the "Magic Mirror," sidestepped a few paces to shield Edwina behind him, and then looked out the window.
At the same time, the "Lancer girl" also turned around, raising her hand to condense a thorny spear that was pure white and blazing white to the extreme, seemingly composed of pure sunlight. Within her own body, pure and clear light erupted, illuminating every corner of the surroundings.
Under the illumination, outside the French window, a small, masked figure appeared.
Hundred-Faced Hassan? A Heroic Spirit found us so quickly?
Ebner frowned, but recalling Hundred-Faced Hassan's abilities in the original work, his brows relaxed.
After all, a Heroic Spirit who could split himself into dozens of individuals was indeed an excellent scout.
Just as the "Lancer girl" was about to throw the solar spear in her hand, a very magnetic male voice suddenly came in: "Your Excellency the Favored One, please do not act yet. I am not an enemy."
As the words fell, the air outside the French window rippled slightly, and then a man dressed in black priestly attire stepped out from within.
This was a man around thirty years old, with black hair and black eyes, handsome, and with an exceptionally distinguished demeanor.
In short, once seen, he would be hard to forget.
Observing the suddenly appearing man, Ebner was still pondering which deity the other party's "Favored One" corresponded to when Vice Admiral Iceberg Edwina spoke first:
"Is that Professor Tayles?"
She used a question, but her tone was quite certain.
Tayles? That name sounds familiar, I think I heard it somewhere... Right, it was the night I was promoted to "Mysticism Magister," Closfia told me about it! The name of another "Mysticism Magister" she had helped as part of a "ritual"!
So this is what he looks like... No wonder Crossfia praised his charm even years later, and also said that Judy's father, Lord Loreto, really disliked this man back then...
It would be strange if he did like him!

chapters.title: Chapter 767: Tylers’s News
chapters.content:
Chapter 767 - Tylers's News
"So it's Edwina. Years later, I didn't expect the quiet and reserved little girl to become 'Vice Admiral Iceberg,' famous throughout the Five Seas... Fate is always full of such surprises." Tylers said, smiling at Edwina upon hearing her words.
Edwina merely nodded at him, then leaned closer to Ebner and whispered, "Tylers Renault, a lecturer at Lunburg University, a high-ranking deacon of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom... According to Professor Isabella, he fortunately obtained the main ingredient for the 'Prophet' potion three years ago and successfully advanced."
Fortunately obtained the ingredient? He must have gotten a clue from the "Dream Labyrinth Tower's" rewards!
But since he's a lecturer at Lunburg University and a high-ranking deacon of the Church of Knowledge, his previous words must have referred to the God of Knowledge's favored one...
Seeing Ebner still maintaining his guard, and the black-armored Heroic Spirit's "Spear of Unshadowed" ready to be thrown at him at any moment, Tayles, while commending Ebner's caution, further explained, "Before entering the first-floor scenario, I received an oracle instructing me to assist the holder of 'Light Seeker' in achieving final victory..."
Speaking of this, he glanced at the "black-armored girl" and continued, "So, after my Heroic Spirit discovered that you had summoned a Servant from the 'Sun' domain, he immediately rushed over."
The God of Knowledge issued an oracle telling a 'Prophet' to assist me? Heh, this is still part of the 'act' for that other one... If it weren't for Miss Temperance's reminder, which made me realize the problem, I would have certainly believed that the God of Knowledge actually approved of Roselle's resurrection.
As Ebner pondered, his Servant, "Lancer" Lya, stated solemnly, "My Lord, I have notarized his words, and the result is that he did not lie."
Hearing this, Ebner came back to his senses, first nodding slightly to the black-armored girl, then looking at Tayles, "I need to verify that."
"How do you wish to verify?" Tayles asked with interest.
Ebner did not reply. Instead, while having "Lancer" maintain her guard, he himself began to set up a ritual to pray to the "God of Knowledge and Wisdom."
At this moment, Tayles, realizing what Ebner was doing, kindly reminded him, "The 'Dream Labyrinth Tower' does not permit praying to deities or hidden existences."
"I know that, but I'm an exception." Ebner, possessing the Pure White Eye and well aware of the tower's "bullying the weak and fearing the strong" nature, replied indifferently.
Soon, he skillfully drew the holy emblem of the "God of Knowledge and Wisdom," set up the corresponding altar, and placed a parchment with the "oracle" Tayles had just spoken onto the altar.
Then, he lit a candle, picked up the pure dew extracted from lavender and mint, and dripped it onto the quietly burning flame.
Having done all this, he spoke in ancient Hermes:
"I pray for the power of knowledge;
"I pray for the power of reason;
"I pray for the favor of the God of Wisdom;
"I pray for you to discern the truth of the oracle conveyed by Tylers Renault."
.....
Whoosh!
As the incantation reverberated, a phantom of a "brass eye" suddenly appeared on the altar. It scanned the contents of the parchment and then vanished.
And on the parchment, a single word appeared out of thin air: True!
Seeing this, Tayles's eyes filled with surprise. First, he was surprised that the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" truly didn't prevent others from praying to deities. Second, he was surprised that the "God of Knowledge and Wisdom" would actually respond to such a simple ritual from him!
This is no ordinary Favored One... No wonder he could break into the first floor of the Labyrinth Tower even before becoming a Demigod!
As thoughts raced, Tayles composed himself and asked with a smile, "Is that all right now?"
Ebner nodded while gathering the ritual items, and ordered "Lancer" the Servant to retract her "Spear of Unshadowed," maintaining only necessary vigilance.
Speaking of which, Ebner performing this ritual wasn't really because he doubted Tayles's words; in fact, he mostly believed them. The main purpose of asking the "God of Knowledge and Wisdom" for confirmation was to "deter" the other party and gain the upper hand in the conversation.
Otherwise, as a Demigod, even if he received an oracle, he might not necessarily follow the arrangements of a mid-sequence "favored one" like himself.
And if he simply didn't follow the arrangements, it would be fine, but Ebner feared he might try to manipulate him in return... So, Ebner decided to put on a show of authority first.
On the other side, seeing that Ebner was finally no longer hostile, Tayles ordered his Servant to stay on guard outside, then "passed" through the French window's glass and entered the sunroom.
The two sides took their seats, and Edwina had the castle's automaton maid bring red tea. After a brief self-introduction, they got down to business.
"How did you find me so quickly?" Ebner asked the question that had been bothering him.
Although he and Edwina had replaced Kiritsugu and Irisviel, representing the Einzbern family in the war, they were immediately in the Einzbern family's old castle stronghold in Fuyuki City upon entry.
This was no secret to the plot characters, but for "tower climbers," unless they were familiar with the plot like him and Klein, it would be impossible to find them so quickly.
Considering the brief meeting in the Sefirah Castle and the subsequent Heroic Spirit summoning, it had only been a little over an hour at most.
"That depends on the identity I replaced..." Tayles took a sip of red tea before continuing, "The father of this identity is the archbishop supervising this 'Holy Grail War' for the church. He is quite familiar with the potential participating parties and has compiled a lot of information available for perusal.
"Furthermore, this identity's teacher is also a 'Master,' named Tokiomi... it's a bit awkward to pronounce, but he is the manager of the 'Mysticism field' in this city and is naturally no stranger to the Einzberns.
"By the way, I have already met with Mr. Tokiomi and confirmed that he is not a 'tower climber'... Hmm, he has also summoned a Heroic Spirit, an Archer-class Heroic Spirit called 'King of Heroes.'"
So, you replaced Kirei? Hmm, your appearance does somewhat resemble "Mapo Priest," except he has brown hair and eyes, while yours are black hair and eyes.
Ebner muttered inwardly. On the surface, after glancing at the petite Heroic Spirit outside the window, he said, "Your Heroic Spirit should be the 'Assassin'-class 'Hundred-Faced Hassan,' right? Then she probably won't just come to me... Have there been any other gains elsewhere?"
Tayles narrowed his eyes upon hearing this. He hadn't expected the young man before him to see through his Heroic Spirit's true name and abilities at a glance. While becoming increasingly cautious, he couldn't help but sigh:
As expected of Your Excellency the Favored One, you even understand such a lost grand ritual as the 'Holy Grail War'... No wonder Edwina, such a proud young lady, follows him...
—He didn't believe that a complete ritual system like the "Holy Grail War" could be fabricated out of thin air by Roselle. He only thought that Roselle had restored this ritual from lost Third Epoch or even Second Epoch documents and then fabricated a story around it.
While pondering, Tayles organized his words and replied, "Indeed, there have been quite a few gains...
"The Master of another famous Beyonder family in this city, the Matou family, was replaced by the 'Saint of Shadows' from the Aurora Order and summoned a 'Berserker'-class, terrifying Heroic Spirit wearing black armor, just like this Lancer girl. In just an hour, he devoured all members of that family, leaving only a cute little girl...
"You know, people from the Aurora Order are always more lenient towards good-looking people.
"However, to my knowledge, that little girl is not a true member of the Matou family, but Tokiomi's younger daughter.
"The Saint of the Aurora Order might have left her alive with the intention of using her to restrain Tokiomi.
"Although the people of the Aurora Order are insane, they are not ignorant of strategy."
So, the old worm of the Matou family met a "standard" end... got wiped out at the beginning? And the reason might simply be because he was ugly?
Right, so-called "Bug Masters," in front of Beyonders from the "Shepherd" pathway who are skilled at manipulating flesh and blood, are just proper rations, aren't they?
However, who could that terrifying Berserker-class Heroic Spirit summoned by the "Saint of Shadows" be?
Black armor... Could it still be Lancelot?

chapters.title: Chapter 768: Invitation to Hunt
chapters.content:
Chapter 768 - Invitation to Hunt
Considering that the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" can seal parts of the Mother Goddess of Depravity's contamination separated by Roselle, relying on the power of the "Chaos Sea," and that this inverted tall tower itself was very likely crafted by Roselle using a Sequence 2 'Profane Presbyter'...
Ebner felt a faint unease in his heart when he heard that the "Saint of Shadows" from the Aurora Order had summoned a black-armored Heroic Spirit, as if it were something terrifying... This feeling was ethereal, yet it came from the passive premonition provided by his Pure White Eye.
He believed the 'Prophet' Tayles before him felt the same, otherwise he wouldn't have used the modifier "terrifying" for that Heroic Spirit Servant without it even having made a move.
Unfortunately, in this scenario, which is close to a Beyonder characteristic, actively using "prophecy" abilities is almost impossible to succeed. He couldn't know if that Aurora Order Saint also brought something terrifying into the first floor...
However, given the Goddess's far-sightedness, the God of Knowledge's shrewdness, and the Seal of Calamity's cunning, they surely wouldn't have failed to consider the reactions of other deities like the True Creator... Or rather, their reactions should also be within calculation and part of the plan.
Looking at it this way, the Servant summoned by the Aurora Order Saint is very likely a tool to make the Mother Goddess of Depravity increase Her "investment."
Thinking this, Ebner glanced at the young female Servant he had summoned, made from the evil spirit of the former Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, and felt that she should be the same...
Otherwise, it wouldn't have been such a coincidence that she fell into his hands on the way to Tosk.
Speaking of which, the Belial family's attack in Linz also came somewhat inexplicably... Could it be that the Mother Tree of Desire is also secretly acting against the Mother Goddess of Depravity?
Last time, during the "Chained God's" escape incident, the Mother Goddess of Depravity tricked Him, so she wants revenge?
While Ebner pondered, Tayles also briefly shared information about other "tower climbers."
For example, Klein and Sharon, who were staying in a hotel, and Jacks, the "Disciple of Silence" from the Rose School.
However, the latter replaced a person who was not a documented "Beyonder," had no fixed residence, and was difficult to track down after being lost.
Jacks, isn't that the one who attacked Klein outside Bayam City in the original story? He also became a "tower climber"? In that case, the possibility of the Mother Tree of Desire also being involved is even greater.
Ebner thought for a moment, then told the 'Prophet' Tayles that he intended to hide with Edwina and entrusted him with continuing to monitor the movements of the various "tower climbers" and regularly contact his Lancer-class Heroic Spirit, Lya.
—As for his "lying flat" plan of going on vacation, he naturally wouldn't explain it in detail to Tayles.
Tayles highly approved of this divine favored one's plan. After all, he wasn't a Demigod, and recklessly getting involved in battles between powerhouses would be dangerous. It was indeed better to hide.
After briefly settling on communication methods, Tayles left with his Assassin-class Heroic Spirit.
Soon after he left, Klein, Sharon, and a purple-haired, eye-patched "Heroic Spirit" woman arrived at the castle where Ebner was.
