"How was it? Did you awaken Roselle?" Glancing at the eye-patched woman who was awkwardly chatting with the black-armored, blonde Servant not far away, Ebner pulled Klein closer and asked in a low voice.
"Awakened..." Klein exhaled, his expression somewhat indescribable, "But he only has memories from before he was 25... Um, purely Roselle's memories."
The latter part of his sentence was a bit vague, but Ebner immediately understood his meaning:
This so-called Roselle Phantom has no memories from before his transmigration!
Very similar to the one I met on the sixth floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower"... both only remember things after transmigrating, and only remember some things before the scenario was destroyed... That one was probably also a "Roselle Phantom."
But why does Klein have such an expression?
Ebner thought to himself, and then asked aloud.
"I think he's far less reliable than the original Medusa!" Klein grumbled first, then, after glancing at Sharon, who was silently facing Edwina on the other side, he whispered, "Roselle's integrity is really hard to describe... After he 'woke up,' he not only didn't feel anything wrong with having a woman's body, but he was also quite excited to..."
It's clear that Mr. Fool is greatly shaken!
Ebner muttered inwardly, then silently pulled out a card and handed it to Klein. It sealed a "Square of Order" that could both record and broadcast.
Of course, this scene had to be recorded. He'd find an opportunity to play it for Old Huang himself later.
Klein was stunned for a moment, then, understanding implicitly, he took the card and tucked it into his pocket.
.....
Returning to the main topic, after the two parties met, they didn't delay further. Following their plan from above the gray fog, they left the castle, left Fuyuki City, which was gradually turning into a battlefield, and arrived at another small city nearby.
—Although the "map" was large, Ebner didn't dare to run too far.
It's worth mentioning that Ebner handed the "Magic Mirror" to his Heroic Spirit Servant, having her disguise herself as a "Master," and the "Devil" inside the "Magic Mirror" disguise as a Heroic Spirit, to continue operating in Fuyuki City in cooperation with the 'Prophet' Tayles.
He only kept the Roselle-version Rider-class Medusa nearby to protect the four of them.
This arrangement once again made Edwina feel the depth of Ebner's trust in Gehrman.
.....
Two days later, Ebner, who was reading in the library, suddenly noticed several rays of light converging on Edwina beside him.
The latter also sensed it and took out a cold-colored oil lamp, which was the Sealed Artifact "Silent Winter," replacing the Lesser Holy Grail.
"Three 'souls' converged at once... three Heroic Spirits were killed simultaneously!" Edwina said after sensing for a while.
"A major event happened over there..." Ebner nodded, while extending his spirituality to the Command Seals on the back of his hand, communicating with his Lancer-class Heroic Spirit, Lya.
Speaking of which, although he had been on vacation these past two days, he still closely monitored the war in Fuyuki. He knew that, aside from the Saber-class Heroic Spirit King of Conquerors and the Archer-class Heroic Spirit King of Heroes exchanging blows once, they were generally still in their respective probing stages...
How did three suddenly disappear?
Just then, Lya's somewhat disheveled voice came through:
"My Lord, the Heroic Spirit summoned by the 'Aurora Order' Saint is normally at the Angel level! From its abilities, it can be seen that He is a true 'Profane Presbyter'!
"The Saber-class, Archer-class, and Mr. Tayles's Assassin-class Heroic Spirits were all killed by Him in just a few seconds... If I hadn't been able to unleash my 'Angel' level power, this shell might not have been preserved."
"How did you all gather together?" Ebner frowned, conveying his question through the Command Seal.
"The Saber-class Heroic Spirit King of Conquerors held a banquet, and that terrifying Heroic Spirit from the 'Aurora Order' took the opportunity to eliminate them all..." "Lancer" Lya reported.
Banquet? The Banquet of Kings from the anime? This isn't my fault, I didn't go...
Ebner subconsciously defended himself, then gave a self-deprecating smile before asking again:
"And Mr. Tayles? How is he?"
"Mr. Tayles was saved by me and did not suffer serious injuries." At this point, Lya suddenly paused, then continued, "Mr. Tayles asked me to convey to you that he plans to hunt the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's' Demigod 'tower climber' from the Rose School and seize his Heroic Spirit... He asked if you were interested."
Seize a Heroic Spirit? It seems Mr. Tayles isn't entirely without ideas about the omnipotent wish-granting Holy Grail... Or perhaps he thinks the 'Aurora Order' has too great an advantage and they must concentrate their forces?
Ebner pondered for a while, seemed to have thought of something, sighed, "It seems I won't be getting through this easily after all," and then once again transmitted through the Command Seal to Lya, who was far away in Fuyuki:
"Tell him, I accept."
Then, he looked at Edwina, who had turned her head to look at him, pulled up the corners of his mouth, and joked:
"Tonight, the outsiders will also join the 'hunt'!"
"What?" Edwina blinked, her light blue eyes, like clear spring water, filled with confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 769: Obtaining Another Blasphemy Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 769 - Obtaining Another Blasphemy Card
Fuyuki City, a city of hundreds of thousands, had been largely destroyed by the previous Servants' battles. Only the area east of Fuyuki Bridge, where the Church was located, remained intact.
However, because this was not the real world and the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" had absolute control over the scenario, the "Church" still "reasonably" concealed the matter, and people in the undamaged areas lived "normally."
In a puddle in a deserted alley, a slightly transparent figure appeared at some point. His skin was brownish, his face deeply lined with wrinkles, and his sparse white hair resembled autumn leaves, as if he had lived for many, many years.
Appearing with him was a "youth" wearing a wide ritual robe adorned with numerous lavish precious metal ornaments.
These were Jacks and his Magician-class Heroic Spirit.
"What kind of monster did that madman from the Aurora Order summon?!
"That Saber-class King of Conquerors, Archer-class King of Heroes, and the Assassin-class Heroic Spirit, who seemed more like a high-sequence 'Spectator' to me... each of them possessed Angel-level combat power in a short time... yet they were killed so easily?
"No, what's more terrifying than being killed is... they've all been herded by that monster!
"If my Heroic Spirit hadn't had that book with high-sequence 'Apprentice' abilities, I wouldn't have escaped either..."
Thinking this, he glanced at the big-eyed "youth" beside him, feeling a touch of helplessness.
As a Demigod of the Rose School, he had lived long enough and was quite proficient in various rituals, especially in "sacrifice."
Therefore, before performing the Heroic Spirit summoning, he, like Ebner, saw through the essence of the ritual and sacrificed the soul of a "Life School" Demigod he had on hand.
—That was a "Summoning Master" who had lived from the Fourth Epoch to the present, believing in the "Primordial Moon," but unfortunately perished in the previous internal strife of the "Life School," and his soul eventually fell into Jacks' hands.
"But this tower's Heroic Spirit system even implanted a 'hero' persona into him... which conflicted with his original spirit, causing him to be somewhat deranged since his summoning. Not only is he difficult to communicate with, but he also keeps saying inexplicable things.
"If I had known this, I might as well not have used the so-called 'Holy Relic.'"
While pondering, Jacks stared at the passing crowd outside the alley with "malicious" eyes, suppressing his "tyrannical" desires.
Although he had escaped successfully before, he was inevitably injured, and he had also heard the "Profane Presbyter's" incantation, causing his "curses," which could be ignored after becoming a Demigod, to manifest again.
As a member of the indulgent faction of the Rose School, his self-control was limited. If the crowd outside the alley were real living people, he probably would have rushed out to vent his desires long ago.
But unfortunately, this was an "imagined" world. He couldn't truly vent on those people, and might instead attract the Saint of the Aurora Order.
"If praying to a god were allowed, how could I be so pathetic! This damned 'Dream Labyrinth Tower'!"
Just as Jacks was growing increasingly irritable, the corner of his eye suddenly caught sight of a young lady wearing a small black soft hat and a Gothic court dress, sitting in a carriage that quickly passed the alley entrance.
The lady had light golden hair, a delicate face, clear blue eyes, and a pale complexion...
"Sharon..." Jacks subconsciously licked his lips, and the desire he had forcibly suppressed surged again.
Immediately after, his figure continuously flickered between shop windows, shallow puddles, animal eyes, and dewdrops on grass, always maintaining a certain distance from the carriage carrying Sharon.
Soon, Sharon got out of the car and walked towards a hotel by the roadside.
"A decoy?" Jacks stared at Sharon with bloodshot eyes, then pulled a monocle from his inner coat pocket.
It looked normal but shimmered with a pearly white glow in the dark.
This was a Beyonder item from the Life School, which could be used to detect many hidden secrets.
"There are traces of a ritual in the hotel... It might be a trap!
"But Sharon isn't accompanied by a Heroic Spirit, nor any other high-sequence Beyonder... While she could probably use a Command Seal to forcibly summon a Heroic Spirit... I can control her before that!
"This is my chance! Once she enters the hotel, the opportunity will vanish..."
Jacks was already a decisive person, and with his desires influencing him, he quickly decided to capture Sharon and use her to vent his desires.
.....
In front of the hotel, the delicate-faced lady, though pale, gracefully descended from the carriage, carefully lifting her elaborate skirt, and unhurriedly walked toward the hotel steps.
But just then, a figure suddenly appeared on the polished marble ground. The lady didn't even have time to turn her head before her eyes met his.
It was a pair of malevolent brown eyes, belonging to the sparsely white-haired, grotesquely wrinkled Jacks!
"Sharon's pure white eyes are truly captivating..." Just as he was about to succeed, Jacks couldn't help but feel triumphant, but he immediately reacted, and a crucial question flashed through his mind: When did Sharon's eyes turn pure white?!
Along with this thought, a fierce solar fire ignited on his body without warning, causing the "Disciple of Silence" to lose his ability to remain hidden in reflections. As his figure became visible, he began to scream in agony.
Realizing he had been tricked, Jacks endured the soul-searing pain of "purification" and used a Command Seal, trying to summon his Heroic Spirit to his side.
But to his despair, his mentally unstable Heroic Spirit did not immediately lead him to escape. Instead, upon seeing a blonde Heroic Spirit appear from the second floor of the hotel, he began to constantly murmur "Saintess," then pursued her into the hotel, getting trapped within the ritual barrier set up by the Roselle-version Medusa.
The one disguised as Miss Sharon to "lure the enemy" was naturally Ebner. He used the special nature of his Pure White Eye to successfully ambush the Demigod of the Rose School.
"It seems my Pure White Eye is truly the bane of pathways like the 'Chained' pathway, which manipulate others by forming reflections in their pupils.
"However, judging by how Jacks was burned, there must be a high-rank item from the 'Sun' pathway within the space behind the Pure White Eye! Otherwise, it wouldn't have been able to burn a Sequence 3 existence into incapacitation just through a 'channel.'
"Could it be that there really is a 'Pure White Angel' in there?
"Plus, its consistently powerful 'analysis' ability...
"Is the Pure White Eye truly a combination of 'Pure White Angel' + 'All-Knowing Eye,' as I previously speculated?"
Ebner could ponder so calmly because the subsequent hunting work no longer required him.
When the enemy's Heroic Spirit was trapped in the hotel by their two Heroic Spirits, bolts of lightning, as if free for the taking, accurately struck Jacks, instantly disfiguring him beyond recognition.
—This was naturally the work of Mr. Fool's "Scepter of the Sea God."
Meanwhile, the 'Prophet' Tayles had also prepared the pre-arranged "secret art," simultaneously igniting Jacks' increasingly intense desires and emotions, as well as the "plague" that had long been buried deep in his mind.
How ruthless! Burnt and struck by lightning physically, and completely filled with "lightning" spiritually!
Watching this scene unfold, Ebner clicked his tongue a few times. He then waited for a moment, and after confirming that Jacks' Command Seals had disappeared and he was truly dead, he had the "Magic Mirror" release the "Devil" to go and collect the spoils of war.
Soon, the Devil retrieved several items from Jacks' corpse.
Ebner put the other things aside, picking up only one card with Roselle's female image on it.
"The Moon Card?"
Gazing at the crimson background of the card, Ebner narrowed his eyes, and couldn't help but recall the message Roselle had sent him through "Lion" Leon, who had traveled thousands of miles to Fossa:
"The activation incantation for the Moon card is 'Etna'...
"This is part of the 'Silver Moon Project'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 770: Eve of the Decisive Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 770 - Eve of the Decisive Battle
The Moon Card actually appeared here...
And in the message Roselle had "Lion" Leon convey, he told him the activation incantation for this Blasphemy Card, emphasizing that it was part of the "Silver Moon Project."
But if my guess isn't wrong, the "Silver Moon Project" is very likely arranged to target the Mother Goddess of Depravity... If Roselle truly knew about this project, wouldn't that mean the one on the moon also knew? Then what's the point?
So, was what "Lion" conveyed truly instructed by Roselle? Or, did it mistakenly believe it was Roselle's instruction?
Hmm... From my contact with that lion during this period, although he claimed to hate Roselle, he's actually a typical "tsundere," secretly caring deeply about the Emperor... So, would he, out of spite, choose not to immediately convey something Roselle specifically entrusted him with, and only travel thousands of miles to Fossa to find me after the "restriction" took effect?
Perhaps, his memory was tampered with, which is why he suddenly remembered that part... and his so-called "restriction" was added at that time, right?
Who could it be? Lilith, the Goddess, or the God of Knowledge?
Also, how did the Moon Card end up with the Rose School Demigod?
As he pondered, Ebner picked up the Beyonder characteristics precipitated from Jacks, while also having the "Magic Mirror" devour the opponent's lingering soul, or potentially degenerated evil spirit.
This was not "herding," so it did not occupy the spot of the "Devil" in the "Magic Mirror."
Speaking of which, a Demigod of the "Rose School" would certainly have the Mother Tree of Desire's imprint in their soul. If this were outside, in reality, Ebner would definitely not let the "Magic Mirror" devour it so directly.
But he was currently on the first floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," which was not only in the shadow of the ancient god 'Dragon of Imagination's' divine kingdom, the City of Miracles, Liveseyd, but also located at an entrance to the "Chaos Sea"!
In such an environment, the Mother Tree of Desire, which could only indirectly intervene in Earth's affairs through S'ao, would find it very difficult to exert any influence.
Moreover, due to the "Chained God's" escape with the Uniqueness, the Mother Tree of Desire's influence over the "Prisoner" pathway had also significantly decreased.
Soon, the Magic Mirror provided the answer to the question.
"This card came from a 'Summoning Master' of the 'Life School,' who was also a believer of the 'Primordial Moon'...
"And the Heroic Spirit Jacks summoned in this scenario used the soul of this 'Summoning Master' as a 'Holy Relic'...
"The Heroic Spirit summoned this way is 'Bluebeard' from FZ, Marshal Gilles, who pursued Saint Joan of Arc... His Noble Phantasm... is a mystical book with 'Door' pathway abilities?
"Combined with his own 'Summoning Master' background... So that's it, I know the general purpose of the 'Silver Moon Project' now!
"Then, the next step is to continue the 'act'!"
Combining the information at hand with previous clues, Ebner vaguely grasped the plan of Lilith, the Evernight Goddess, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Seal of Calamity.
He wasn't too surprised why the deities didn't tell him directly, but chose to make him guess. After all, they were plotting against a top-tier Old One. Some things, even if spoken, might alert that being, even with the Goddess's "concealment."
"Due to my unique nature, or rather, the unique nature of the Pure White Eye, I can serve as this catalyst and tool...
"And Klein... he's probably both a 'smokescreen' and 'bait,' right?
"When he helped Miss Sharon cleanse her contamination last time, he probably exposed himself to that being's eyes.
"And the power of the Sefirah Castle can certainly enhance the effect of 'miracles.' In that being's view, the Goddess allowing Klein to come here means She fell for its scheme, believing that this could truly allow Roselle to resurrect free of contamination.
"But with the Sefirah Castle right before it, would that being truly have no ideas at all? This also serves as 'bait' to tempt the other party to continue increasing their 'stakes'..."
Ebner didn't delve deeper into his thoughts. After all, even with his Pure White Eye and the concealment provided by the "Chaos Sea" environment, if he thought too meticulously, it would be hard to guarantee that being wouldn't sense him.
The might of an Old One is unimaginable. Outside the influence of the "Chaos Sea," he couldn't even remember its name!
Meanwhile, as Ebner processed the spoils of war and made connections, the 'Prophet' Tayles finally used a Command Seal to forcibly establish a contract with Jacks' Heroic Spirit, "Bluebeard," even though the latter completely gave up resistance upon seeing Lya and continuously followed her.
Klein and the real Sharon also emerged from a nearby washroom.
—Ebner still had Sharon's face at this point. After all, he was still wearing that Gothic long dress, and changing back to his own face would be too incongruous.
After the group reunited, they casually took Jacks' corpse and quickly left the ambush site with the three Heroic Spirits, relocating to a villa two blocks away.
Vice Admiral Iceberg Edwina was waiting in the villa's living room. A large sand table was placed on the floor in front of her, with the terrain arranged to perfectly resemble Fuyuki City.
This was the "Live Sand Table," a miraculous item that the 'Prophet' Tayles had exchanged all his points for before entering the first-floor scenario.
It allowed operations on the sand table to be reflected in "reality" in real-time.
This also applied to people, but one had to have enough understanding of them to include them on the sand table... However, when manipulating living beings, one would not only face resistance but also risk exposing the sand table's location, or even suffering curses.
Its negative effect was that as one operated the sand table, the user would gradually become part of the sand table, living forever within the scenario reflected by the "sand table."
In short, it was a very powerful "strategic" item, unfortunately, it could only be used in the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" and could not be taken to reality.
Edwina stayed behind to guard it, partly to monitor the location of the Aurora Order Saint, and partly as a fallback plan. If Ebner and the others encountered an accident, she could directly manipulate the sand table to "teleport" them back to the villa.
"Where is the Aurora Order Saint now?" Ebner asked with a smile as Edwina rose to greet him.
"Still west of Fuyuki Bridge, in the area that has turned into ruins." Edwina replied, while glancing at Ebner's attire, a hint of a smile appearing on her perpetually "icy" face.
"Cough, I'll go change first." Ebner coughed and turned to enter the bedroom.
The first floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" was already an "imagined" world, not like the more dream-like environments of the ninth to fifth floors. Therefore, he couldn't "change clothes" simply by his own thoughts, like Sharon could in the Tingen scenario.
When Ebner changed into his formal attire, reverted to his own appearance, and returned to the villa's living room, he happened to see the 'Prophet' Tayles put down a brick-like "mobile phone" and said to everyone present:
"The father of the identity I replaced, the bishop of the Church in this scenario, and the supervisor of the Holy Grail War, has just issued a summons.
"It calls upon all Masters and Heroic Spirits to collectively subjugate the Matou family Master—that is, the Aurora Order Saint and his Heroic Spirit—who has been wantonly destroying the city and killing ordinary people."
After hearing his words, Ebner's heart stirred, and he mused:
Is the decisive battle starting so soon? That being, or perhaps Roselle, influenced by that being and currently sealed, is somewhat impatient...
Is the Aurora Order Saint doing something that being cannot tolerate?

chapters.title: Chapter 771: Amon’s Judgment
chapters.content:
Chapter 771 - Amon's Judgment
"The reward for the subjugation is more 'Command Seals,' which might be good for true 'Masters'... but for us, it's useless." At this point, the 'Prophet' Tayles glanced at Klein and Sharon. Seeing no objection from them, he continued, "However, the Church stepping forward shows the necessity of this subjugation... Perhaps that 'Aurora Order' Saint is making even more terrifying arrangements."
His guess aligned with Ebner's, and considering that a more convincing "act" would make that being more confident in "increasing its stake," Ebner nodded directly, "I will heed the Church's call."
Klein, who guessed Ebner might know some inside information, exchanged glances with Sharon and then, in Gehrman's tone, said, "I'll join too."
"Since that's the case, we'll depart immediately after dividing the spoils, lest that 'Saint of Shadows' truly prepares a 'surprise' for us.
"Oh, right, as agreed before, I only want the Heroic Spirit of the 'Rose School' Saint; the rest you can distribute freely."
With that, Tayles pulled out his "mobile phone" again and, as he walked out, began calling his father in this identity.
Seeing him leave, the four, whose relationship had grown familiar after two days of "traveling" together, no longer stood on ceremony and began to examine the items Ebner had taken out.
There weren't many items: only a Beyonder characteristic, a notebook, a monocle, and a somewhat tattered but still relatively intact corpse.
As for the "Moon" card, Ebner did not take it out. This item might be related to the Goddess and Lilith's plan, so it couldn't be distributed.
Klein, Sharon, and Edwina remained silent, all looking at Ebner.
This clearly meant they trusted him to provide a "reasonable" distribution plan.
Ebner thought for a moment and did not refuse. He first looked at Miss Sharon and carefully said, "The key to the success of this operation was my role as 'bait' in tricking Jacks, causing him to suffer severe injuries from the start, even preventing him from turning into a 'Revenant'...
"And for my 'bait' disguise to successfully fool the opponent, Miss Sharon, you also contributed greatly. So, Jacks' corpse will be yours... He's still relatively intact, and although there will inevitably be some residual influence from the Mother Tree of Desire, as long as you pray to that being, you can still create a qualified 'mummy.'"
The "that being" Ebner referred to was naturally Mr. Fool, but due to Edwina and several Heroic Spirits being present, he couldn't speak more explicitly.
Sharon was silent for a few seconds, then said "Thank you" in a phantom-like voice.
She knew Ebner was looking out for her due to their shared membership in the "Tarot Club," as she had done nothing but provide some "parameters."
As for what Sherlock had privately told her about "image usage fees," Sharon merely thought he was joking.
Klein, on the other hand, twitched his eye at hearing this, muttering inwardly, After the "mortuary" service, is Mr. Fool now also taking on the business of "consecrating" corpses?
I didn't realize it before, but now it seems that only a transmigrator could have such an open mind!
And while Mr. Tower respects Mr. Fool, he doesn't show much awe or humility... This also aligns with the characteristics of someone who received modern Chinese education... I was really foolish before, why did I never consider this aspect?
Just as Klein was lost in thought, Ebner had already looked at him and asked with a smile, "You mentioned before that you wanted the 'Puppeteer' characteristic, right?"
Klein's contribution to this battle was not small. Without his suppressing "lightning strikes" from outside, truly killing a Sequence 3 "Disciple of Silence" would not have been so easy, and he might even have unleashed a final burst of power before death...
Sharon turned her head and looked at Klein for a moment, then opened her lips and said in a phantom-like voice, "You don't have to choose this."
Klein, however, smiled, maintaining Gehrman's persona, and said indifferently, "If you successfully advance to Demigod, it will benefit me too. For example, you can help me deal with more powerful enemies."
Hearing this, Sharon didn't decline further, just nodded lightly.
Seeing them reach an agreement, Ebner beckoned to Lya, the Heroic Spirit formed from the former Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, and asked her to progressively separate the "Disciple of Silence" characteristic.
This request was not difficult for an Angel of the "Sun" pathway, it just required a little time. So, after handing the characteristic to her, Ebner proceeded with the next step of distribution.
Although Edwina was only "guarding the base" this time, serving as a backup for the operation, and wasn't ultimately needed, she couldn't be ignored...
After hesitating for a moment, Ebner finally picked up the notebook and handed it to her.
This item was called the "Blood Refinement Notebook." According to the analysis of the Pure White Eye, it was originally a notebook belonging to a high-sequence Beyonder of the "Pharmacist" pathway, used to record their invented potions. Aside from the saint's spiritual imprint, it had no special features.
However, this notebook was later tainted by its owner's blood, and coupled with a Blasphemy Card tucked inside, it mutated.
As long as the user expended spirituality, they could conjure the finished potion recorded on that page, but correspondingly, the content on that page would disappear.
This notebook had a total of twenty-five pages, three of which were currently blank.
Its only side effect was that when using it to obtain potions, the user would be gazed upon by eyes from the starry sky.
The reason Ebner gave such a dangerous item to Edwina was his belief that, after understanding the side effects, she would at most study the recipes in the notebook and not actually use it.
After distributing this notebook, Ebner picked up the monocle himself.
Remembering the very similar lens he had acquired from Panatiya, the "Despairing Nightingale," in the City of Night, Ebner couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth, muttering inwardly:
Amon wouldn't have made a batch of such monocles containing mid-sequence characteristics and then deliberately disseminated them, would he?
.....
Meanwhile, in reality, within the "Kaspersky" base beneath Tosk City.
The young man, calling himself the "Deputy Commander" of the Men in Black, looked at Amon's avatar, bound to a cross by the power of "Knowledge," and shook his head, saying:
"The maze in the 'Mouse Pathway' could have held you for at least another day... But I didn't expect you to actively trigger the 'traps' in the maze and allow me to capture you."
"How else would I know what you want to do?" Amon, wearing his peaked soft hat, showed no sign of being captured. Instead, he looked around with interest, smiling, "Aren't you going to kill this avatar of mine immediately? Although this base's power greatly restrains me, it can only control me for two or three days at most."
"His Majesty is not here. Killing you wouldn't keep the Beyonder characteristics from the 'Worm of Time' from returning to your main body, and it would also transmit the information here." The young man shook his head again, calmly explaining while glancing at Amon several times, then continued, "And you don't need to lie like that. I'm well aware of the base's situation; it can only restrain you for 12 hours at most."
"Then aren't you afraid I'll commit suicide on the spot?" Amon asked back curiously.
"His Majesty said that you wouldn't easily choose that method before figuring out the purpose of the arrangements here... And I also have means to prevent your suicide," the young man replied, taking a sip of coffee.
"Roselle understands me so well? Tsk tsk, I really should have had a good chat with him back then, it would have been very interesting." Amon clicked his tongue a few times, a slightly mischievous smile on his face, "But no matter what resurrection plan he has, it won't succeed!"
"Why?" The young man frowned, knowing Amon was playing tricks, but still asked.
"Because the Gods won't allow it!" Before the other party could ask again, the "God of Mischief" continued,
"Especially Evernight.
"Although I cannot steal what I want to know from the hidden depths, nor can I decipher what other arrangements She has, or where the true key point lies.
"But that doesn't prevent me from knowing that Roselle's entire resurrection plan should just be a trap!"
I accidentally fell asleep earlier and just woke up to write this~ And then I got stuck too~

chapters.title: Chapter 772: Battle Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 772 - Battle Begins
At the villa, after Heroic Spirit Lya progressively separated the characteristics of a "Disciple of Silence," "Puppeteer," "Revenant," and "Zombie," Ebner told her to stop.
After all, materials and Beyonder characteristics from the "Prisoner" pathway had a small audience, and anything below "Zombie" wouldn't fetch a good price anyway.
Handing the "Puppeteer" characteristic to Miss Sharon, and seeing her control Jacks' corpse to take the characteristic back to the bedroom, Klein hesitated for a moment before getting up and following her in.
He guessed that Sharon probably wanted to temporarily store the corpse and characteristic above the gray fog, and "Mr. Tower" would certainly guess the same. At this moment, using the excuse of going to the washroom might expose Mr. Fool's weakness to "Mr. Tower." That's why he endured the playful gazes of others—mainly Ebner—and followed Sharon into the bedroom.
Though Miss Sharon was also very intelligent, her imagination simply wasn't as expansive as "Mr. Tower's."
In fact, Ebner understood their intentions perfectly well, but this didn't stop him from secretly "recording" the scene, intending to show it to Melissa later...
—For simple "recording," Ebner no longer needed auxiliary tools; both the "Magic Mirror" and his developed "Secret Arts" could accomplish it. He created the "Square of Order" purely for his company employees to use.
About ten minutes later, Klein and Sharon returned to the living room. At this point, the 'Prophet' Tayles also returned, bringing each person a black book with three "Command Seal" markings on its cover.
"Is everything ready? If there are no issues, we'll depart now." Tayles asked with a serious expression after Ebner and the others put away their "Book of Command Seals."
Ebner and Klein both nodded slightly, indicating they were ready. Edwina and Sharon naturally had no objections either.
Seeing this, Tayles walked to the "Live Sand Table," covered his right hand with spirituality, then picked up the "mini" villa representing their location on the map and directly placed it on an open space several blocks away from the Aurora Order Saint.
As he completed this action, Ebner felt the floor beneath his feet vibrate.
At the same time, he could feel an invisible hand "gripping" him. The hand's force wasn't strong, yet it effortlessly propelled him through space.
Ebner did not resist, as he could sense that the aura on the invisible hand came directly from Tayles.
No wonder Tayles said this sand table was a "strategic" item before, but ineffective against enemies... Exposing one's aura so completely means only acquaintances would obediently allow themselves to be manipulated... If it were an enemy, there would be many ways to exploit the aura!
While making this judgment about an item from a certain movie, Ebner felt the pushing force on his body suddenly disappear, and the invisible hand vanished abruptly.
Everyone emerged cautiously from the villa and then saw a scene akin to the end of the world.
Aside from their villa, almost none of the surrounding buildings were intact. The hotel where Klein and Sharon had previously stayed was broken in half, its collapsed ruins destroying countless nearby civilian houses.
Above a mountain peak several blocks away, dark clouds currently gathered, and countless bolts of lightning struck down from between the clouds, engulfing the entire mountaintop.
In the center of the numerous lightning bolts, a vast quantity of black, viscous liquid gushed from a hole that was between illusory and real. They twisted and expanded, growing varying numbers of hands and feet, transforming into one monster after another, spreading across the entire mountain.
"Chaos Sea?!" Ebner was startled and quickly looked at Edwina and Sharon beside him.
He and Klein both had "cheats," so seeing the Sefirah from this distance was fine, but those two ladies might be "contaminated."
As for Tayles, he hadn't thought about him for a moment.
But to Ebner's surprise, Edwina and Sharon showed no discomfort other than some dizziness.
"Perhaps, the gushing 'Chaos Sea' is just an illusion? Or, the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower' itself added a 'filter' to it?" Ebner confirmed they truly had no major problems before stroking his chin in thought:
"However, what did that 'Saint of Shadows' from the Aurora Order use to summon a Heroic Spirit that could actually communicate with the 'Chaos Sea,' which is the core of the seal in the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower'... No wonder 'King of Conquerors,' 'King of Heroes,' and 'Hundred-Faced Hassan' lost so quickly!"
Klein, however, found the black viscous liquid increasingly familiar the more he looked at it. After a brief recollection, he remembered the appearance of Miss "Judgment" when she was "contaminated" before...
What exactly is this black mud?
Klein frowned, but chose not to ask at this moment.
"We cannot let the 'Saint of Shadows'' ritual continue, otherwise he really will win the 'Holy Grail War'!" Tayles said gravely upon seeing this.
No matter who won this "game" among those present, they would survive; only the "Saint of Shadows'" victory was unacceptable.
Although throwing out a "Historical Projection" charm would likely solve the problem now, that would certainly disrupt the gods' plans, so Ebner decided to continue the "act."
And he wasn't particularly averse to this. After all, Lilith, the Goddess, and the God of Knowledge had already provided "gifts" in advance.
It's just that the Seal of Calamity hasn't given me anything, and I still have to act according to his wishes, which is a bit annoying... Forget it, I'll give my fellow transmigrator some face.
"Lya, go stop the enemy's scheme and strive for victory with all your might." As Ebner spoke, he expended a Command Seal, buffing his Heroic Spirit.
This enhancement was similar to a "Notary's" notarization ability, but also different; it should be considered a "Secret Art."
"Yes, My Lord, I shall dedicate glory to your banner." The "girl" Heroic Spirit knelt on one knee in response, then raised her spear and flew towards the small mountain.
Behind her, the Roselle-version Rider-class Medusa, and the Magician-class Heroic Spirit "Bluebeard" Marshal Gilles, who had been muttering "Saintess," also followed.
At the same time, Tayles's expression changed continuously, as if he was struggling, but eventually, he clenched his fist and "flew" up.
As a Demigod and a "Prophet" with numerous methods, even if he wasn't a match for the Heroic Spirit, he was a competent support.
On the other side, just as the three Heroic Spirits were about to reach the mountain peak, three black-spotted figures flew out from within the mountain gate.
They were the Heroic Spirits King of Conquerors, King of Heroes, and "Hundred-Faced Hassan," all herded by the "Profane Presbyter" summoned by the Aurora Order Saint.
Three against three. Just as the battle was about to begin, the Roselle-version "Medusa" seemed to suddenly lose her abilities. The Pegasus beneath her abruptly vanished, and she herself was caught off guard by the prepared "Assassin-class" Hassan's sneak attack, nearly suffering a direct fatal blow.
Even so, she sustained extremely severe injuries.
How could this be? What kind of ability is that?
Klein, observing from the rear, couldn't help but frown at this scene.
Ebner, who also witnessed this, felt a stir in his heart and vaguely guessed the reason.
Unless summoned using a "Holy Relic" and providing a high-level soul themselves, the power of the so-called Heroic Spirits in this scenario is actually bestowed by the "Dream Labyrinth Tower"...
And earlier, Lya and "Bluebeard," summoned with "Holy Relics," had no problems. Only Medusa seemed to have lost most of her abilities... She must have been directly stripped of them by the opponent!
No wonder the King of Conquerors, King of Heroes, and Hassan died so quickly before... They probably fell the same way...
Did the "Saint of Darkness" usurp part of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower's" authority? How did he do it?
This tower should be firmly controlled by Roselle, at most his different personalities are warring...
As thoughts raced, Ebner suddenly recalled his earlier speculation about the "Dream Labyrinth Tower's" composition, derived from its appearance:
Roselle killed a "Profane Presbyter" who herded "Wisdom Angels," and combined it with the "Chaos Sea" and Zaratul to create the "Dream Labyrinth Tower"...
"Other Heroic Spirits, even if their souls are of Angelic rank, can only maintain Angel-level combat power for a short time. Only the 'Saint of Shadows'' Heroic Spirit is a complete 'Profane Presbyter'...
"Through a ritual, directly connecting to the 'Chaos Sea' and being able to arbitrarily strip other Heroic Spirits of their abilities...
"Combining these, if I boldly guess...
"What if... that 'Saint of Shadows' brought the True Creator's divinity into the first floor and used it to awaken the spirit of the 'Profane Presbyter' that constitutes this tower... allowing it to join this 'war' as a Heroic Spirit? Then everything makes sense!
"Heh, no wonder the contaminated Roselle is somewhat anxious. As the core seal of the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower,' once this 'Profane Presbyter' gains maximum authority, he will definitely destroy all of Roselle's resurrection arrangements first!
"Of course, the Mother Goddess of Depravity similarly wouldn't want to see that.
"A plan brewing for so many years, if destroyed like this, She certainly wouldn't agree...
"In this environment where the Gods within Earth cannot intervene, by adding some investment, She can preserve the plan, and even obtain the Sefirah Castle...
"Can She resist that temptation?
"And in a situation where She cannot descend in person, the best method would be to throw the 'Goddess of Beauty' characteristic in Her possession into the 'Summoning Gate' of that 'Life School' summoning master, right?
"And this is Lilith's goal!
"This is a crucial part of the 'Silver Moon Project'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 773: Ebner’s Melodramatic Script
chapters.content:
Chapter 773 - Ebner's Melodramatic Script
While Ebner was deep in thought, the battle at the mountain gate changed again.
Although the three enemy Heroic Spirits were quite powerful, their "souls," or what was called "Roselle's phantom," had already entered Edwina's "Silent Winter" oil lamp, entering the "Lesser Holy Grail." Now, they were merely shells.
This state made their actions appear rigid. Ebner's Heroic Spirit, Lya, quickly seized an opening, using her holy spear as a medium to release an Angel-level "Holy Light." With just one strike, she first purified the "King of Heroes."
Then, with the previous Command Seal's blessing from Ebner, she unleashed a second Angel-level attack, successfully inflicting severe injuries on the "King of Conquerors" as well.
On the other side, "Bluebeard" Marshal Gilles, upon seeing Lya bathed in light, became noticeably excited. With the 'Prophet' Tayles's cooperation, he systematically reproduced the powerful spells "recorded" in his magic book, continuously killing the Hassans who had split into different personalities.
—Since Tayles was previously the Master of the Assassin-class Hassan, he was very familiar with his abilities, making the eradication particularly smooth.
But just then, silver electric snakes leaped out from the mountain, rapidly growing, crackling and intertwining, quickly extending forward, evolving into a dazzling ocean of lightning, attempting to engulf the entire mountain gate.
Seeing this, Lya immediately pointed her spear forward and devoutly declared, "God says, invalid."
Before her words even finished, the ocean of lightning before her significantly subsided. Both the flying electric snakes and the dense lightning net diminished or vanished by nearly seventy percent out of thin air.
On the other side, "Bluebeard" and Tayles also quickly abandoned their opponents. The former turned to a page in his magic book, also releasing a lightning net, while the latter internally constructed a barrier with "Secret Arts," barely managing to block this lightning invasion.
But while they could block it, the heavily wounded "King of Conquerors" and the Roselle-version "Medusa" were powerless against this strike. They were instantly engulfed by the lightning and vanished into the air.
The remaining low-strength "Hassans" suffered the same fate. The entity on the mountain evidently didn't hold back just because they were his own kind.
Edwina, observing from the rear, immediately felt more souls appearing within the "Silent Winter" oil lamp in her hand. Immediately after, it broke free from Vice Admiral Iceberg's control, uncontrollably soaring into the air, flying towards the mountain enveloped in lightning and black mud.
As expected, unlike the Holy Grail War in the anime of my previous life, here, as long as all the "fragments" of Old Huang's phantom are gathered, the Holy Grail can be activated...
Thinking this, Ebner pretended to intercept the oil lamp but deliberately failed to keep it.
At the mountain gate, seeing the "Holy Grail" about to fly into the black mud on the mountain, Heroic Spirit Lya initially intended to shoot it down, but then she heard Ebner's command transmitted through the Command Seal and deliberately slowed by half a beat.
It was this slight time difference that allowed the "Silent Winter" oil lamp, which had been modified into the Lesser Holy Grail, to fall into the hands of a giant over five meters tall.
The strongest Heroic Spirit in this Holy Grail War, the "Profane Presbyter," finally appeared.
He casually threw the Lesser Holy Grail into the continuously gushing black mud hole at the top of the mountain. Immediately after, a spacious passage appeared behind the hole, faintly revealing a castle at its end.
The black giant ignored the two Heroic Spirits swiftly ascending the mountain, only having the black mud-contaminated monsters try their best to delay them, while he himself turned and walked towards the passage.
The black giant ignored the two Heroic Spirits swiftly ascending the mountain, only letting the black mud-contaminated monsters try their best to delay them, while he himself turned and walked towards the passage.
Seeing this, Ebner continued with his devised "script." He first had Edwina use the "Live Sand Table" to pull Tayles back to the villa, then continuously expended several Command Seals, ordering his Heroic Spirit Lya to manifest her mythical form.
Upon receiving the command, Lya didn't hesitate, directly transforming into a Sun God Bird with pure white feathers, where everything in her wake turned into an ocean of light.
The divine bird vibrated its wings, and dots of white light purified the monsters formed from contamination on the mountain path one by one. It then locked onto the five-meter-tall figure on the mountaintop and swooped towards him.
But just as Lya was about to pounce on him, the "Profane Presbyter" suddenly turned around and uttered an ancient Hermes word: "Light!"
Immediately after, his figure erupted with endless, pure radiance, seemingly transforming into the sun itself, descending upon reality.
Under the "sun's" illumination, Lya's radiant wings melted, the "ocean of light" subsided, and even her swooping speed slowed increasingly, finally stopping before the opponent, unable to harm him in the slightest.
The "Sun Chaser" was ultimately unable to harm the true "Sun."
This scene, akin to the descent of a true god, shook Klein and the others in the rear. Though they dared not look directly at the battlefield, they understood what was happening on the mountain through the "Live Sand Table."
At this point, Lya, who had manifested as the "Sun God Bird," also rapidly melted in such scorching sunlight. In a short while, she reverted to the appearance of a female knight with tattered armor and fell from the mountain.
Although this mountain wasn't high, Lya's current physical state couldn't withstand the impact of a high-altitude fall.
Fortunately, the Heroic Spirit "Bluebeard," also known as the High Summoner who believed in the Primordial Moon in life, arrived in time to catch her, and while wiping away tears, quickly opened his magic book to heal her.
But Lya's body was on the verge of collapse... Just as she had judged earlier, once she activated her mythical form, this "imagined" body would be damaged no matter what. Now, being directly beaten back to her "original form," it was just more thoroughly damaged.
However, before the outer shell collapses, I must complete the task entrusted by My Lord...
Thinking this, Lya forced herself to take out a card and handed it to "Bluebeard," saying intermittently, "I can only go this far... Stopping him is up to you... Don't disappoint me, Gilles.
"This card might help you. Its activation incantation is... 'Etna'!"
Before she could finish, her body completely shattered, dissipating with the light.
"No! Your Holiness Saintess! Don't leave me again!" The deranged High Summoner was clearly influenced by the Heroic Spirit persona. At this moment, he had completely immersed himself in the role of "Bluebeard." He glared hatefully at the tall figure on the mountain, then resolutely turned to the last page of his magic book and placed that card on it as well.
.....
In the villa in the rear, Ebner, who had just recovered the evil spirit of the former Pope of the "Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun," saw this scene through the "Magic Mirror" and couldn't help but criticize himself:
"Did I make this plot too melodramatic?
"I wonder if the one on the moon will believe it..."

chapters.title: Chapter 774: Desolation
chapters.content:
Chapter 774 - Desolation
Perhaps the gods' plan was far-reaching, perhaps Ebner's "script" was perfectly laid out, or perhaps the Mother Goddess of Depravity simply couldn't resist the temptation...
In any case, when the last Heroic Spirit, utilizing the activated "Moon" card, established a sufficient mystical connection and finally used the High Summoner's ability to open the "Summoning Gate," a blood-red gem shaped like a crescent moon suddenly descended, merging with the High Summoner's evil spirit.
Immediately after, the gem of extreme beauty dissolved, and the High Summoner's evil spirit's body began to swell rapidly, quickly transforming into a mountain-sized mass of flesh!
This fleshy mass was covered with various reproductive organs, emitting dense crimson mist that forcibly copulated with everything near it, whether plants or animals in the ruins, or crumbling walls, and even the monsters contaminated by the gushing black mud were not spared.
For a moment, it was as if they had entered an era of a great explosion of life, with countless "new species" being created.
In the villa, Ebner immediately shielded Vice Admiral Iceberg Edwina's eyes, preventing her from being contaminated simply by seeing it and joining the ranks of "giving birth."
After all, though the "mountain of flesh" appeared disgusting and terrifying in perception, it contained the symbol of "beauty." Ordinary Beyonders would find it impossible not to be attracted to it, impossible not to look at it!
Klein and Miss Sharon, on the other hand, resisted this "temptation," having averted their gaze from the moment the "Summoning Gate" opened.
Ebner guessed that during the ten-plus minutes they were in the bedroom, they must have requested the protection of a "Paper Angel" from Mr. Fool.
Coupled with one being a Temperance faction member and the other "experienced," they were not attracted by this "Goddess of Beauty" who had turned into a monster.
"What... what exactly is that?" the 'Prophet' Tayles asked with a trembling voice.
As a Demigod, possessing divinity, his resistance was much stronger than a group of Sequence 5s. Moreover, he was quite skilled in "psychological" abilities, having developed many related secret arts. Thus, after glancing at the fleshy mountain, he directly severed the connection between his eyeballs and his body and spiritual body, gouging them out and throwing them on the ground, thereby preventing himself from being contaminated.
But even so, those two eyeballs began to "conceive" and then "give birth" a few seconds later, producing two "eyeball monsters."
Watching those two things, somewhat resembling "Black Marbles," being burned to ashes by Tayles's simulated "Light of Dawn," Ebner simply replied:
"It should be the Primordial Moon descending..."
After speaking, he took out a charm from his pocket, a charm inscribed with a vertical eye composed of numerous symbols, appearing eerie and mysterious.
This is... Antigonus's symbol? Mr. Tower actually has an item from that family?
Klein, who had encountered the "Antigonus Notebook" incident in Tingen, recognized the symbol's origin at a glance.
Speaking of which, Mr. Tower joined the "Tarot Club" because he kept muttering "Antigonus" and "half a Fool," which is why I pulled him into the gray fog...
While Klein was making these connections, Ebner noticed his gaze and explained with a smile, "This is a charm bestowed by the Goddess."
Goddess? Which one? If you're really Liu Bo, then there are many possibilities!
Klein muttered inwardly, while maintaining Gehrman's usual indifference on the surface, saying nothing.
At this moment, Tayles, who had regrown his eyeballs using "Flesh Magic," also reacted. As a "Prophet," his logical and analytical abilities were absolutely top-notch. Combining them with the God of Knowledge's previous oracle, he instantly understood something and tentatively asked, "The true target of the Gods, is it Her?"
Since the Primordial Moon had fallen into the trap, Ebner no longer needed to hide anything. He nodded gently while using his spirituality to activate the charm in his hand.
The next second, his arm sank, and he pulled a figure from the void.
This was a beautiful woman with silver hair and silver eyes. She wasn't wearing a coat, only a loose, dark red shirt with unbuttoned collar showing her fair skin. It was precisely the "Goddess of Beauty" Ebner had seen last time in the catacombs of the Harvest Church.
Her eyes initially appeared dull, but soon became lively, giving the impression of having come to life.
Upon seeing this lady, who seemed to symbolize the very word "beauty," everyone present, including Klein, was captivated by her perfect countenance and demeanor, temporarily forgetting to breathe.
Only Ebner, having experienced this "beauty" once before, was the first to recover, bowing and saying, "Welcome your descent, Your Holiness."
He wasn't sure which alias Lilith was using, so he kept his address somewhat vague.
Your Holiness? Is this beautiful lady a Pope from some Church?
Klein and Tayles, having snapped back to reality, instantly began to draw connections from this title.
Lilith naturally understood Ebner's meaning. She first glanced at the nearby "fleshy mountain" through the window, then pulled up the corners of her mouth and said to Ebner in a melodious voice, "You can just call me Lilith."
Lilith? The Ancestor of Vampires? She actually still exists?
Edwina's heart trembled. As a seeker of knowledge, she had heard the name, but never expected to see the true face of this ancient god, as if she had stepped into a myth.
Ebner actually knows an ancient god, and judging by Goddess Lilith's tone, they even have some friendship?
Edwina couldn't help but feel a strong sense of curiosity.Tayles, on the other hand, wasn't too surprised that a favored one of a god would summon an ancient god. The Church of Knowledge itself encouraged such cross-faith "friendships"... But what astonished him was that Ebner, a Sequence 5, could interact with an ancient god as an equal, and was even permitted to call her by her true name...
Chapter 777: Desolation
"Should I say, as expected of Mr. Favored One?" Tayles secretly sighed with emotion.
Klein wasn't particularly surprised by Lilith's appearance, as her continued activity could be inferred from previous "Roselle's Diaries." However, at this moment, his heart was filled with gravity, pondering:
Has the worst-case scenario occurred? Judging by Lilith's casual demeanor with Mr. Tower... the possibility of him being Liu Bo is even greater! If the lady before me is truly Lilith, then this is practically 'ironclad proof'... After all, the possibility of an ancient god favoring two transmigrators at the same time is too small.
Lilith, however, didn't pay attention to what others were thinking. She leaned close to Ebner's ear, whispered a few instructions, and then vanished like moonlight.
After she left, Edwina asked, her eyes moving slightly, "Is this Your Holiness truly the Ancestor of Vampires?"
"Yes," Ebner replied, nodding while observing the battle on the distant mountain peak.
"Is the Primordial Moon's essence the Sequence 1 'Goddess of Beauty' of the 'Moon' pathway, or its Uniqueness?" Klein suddenly interjected at this point.
By now, he finally understood the purpose of this "trap."
"The Primordial Moon is an incarnation of a Great Old One... However, Her essence is indeed the Sequence 1 'Goddess of Beauty' of the 'Moon' pathway." Ebner turned back, and after a moment's consideration, still provided Klein with an explanation.
Indeed... Lilith wants to reclaim godhood, is that why she set up this scheme? Emlyn would surely be delighted if he knew this news.
But I remember the 'Earth Mother Goddess''s 'Planter' pathway should be adjacent to the 'Moon'... If Lilith truly regains godhood, whose side will Mr. Tower stand on? After all, the Earth Mother Goddess seems to value him highly too.
One old lover, one new love... Tsk tsk, it seems Mr. Tower isn't having an easy time either.
Just as Klein was lost in thought, the battle on the distant mountain peak gradually intensified. Although others dared not look, Ebner, with his Pure White Eye activated, saw the five-meter-tall "Profane Presbyter" on the mountain transform into the "sun" again, attempting to "purify" the fleshy mountain that was constantly approaching, eroding, and contaminating his power.
But unlike the previous result of the "Sun God Bird's" pounce, an indescribable aura suddenly manifested on the fleshy mountain, causing the "sun's" rays to seemingly unwillingly harm it, shining instead on other places.
Seeing this, the "Profane Presbyter" surrounded by black mud finally acted. He "laboriously" raised a black greatsword and pointed it forward. Immediately after, his body first transformed into a dense, chilling shadow, then pulled open a "curtain," allowing the black viscous liquid gushing from the hole to block his front, simultaneously blocking the fate of forced copulation.
Silently, the black liquid and the blood-red aura collided. Countless black mud enveloped the fleshy mountain, and the aura emanating from the fleshy mountain silently permeated towards the black mud and the "Profane Presbyter" within the lightning.
But just then, the fleshy mountain and the "Profane Presbyter" simultaneously sensed something and looked upwards.
In the night sky, against the backdrop of crimson and lightning, a beautiful silver-haired, silver-eyed lady appeared in the air. She held a large lace-edged umbrella, looking like a noble lady on her way to a banquet.
In the villa's living room, Ebner, witnessing this scene through the window, secretly thought, "Now's the time." Then, he casually picked up his "mini" figure from the "Live Map" and placed it in front of the black-mud-gushing hole on the mountain peak, at the entrance of the passage opened by the "Lesser Holy Grail."
Achieve victory and destroy the "Holy Grail"...
This was one of the tasks Lilith had whispered to him earlier.
Before being propelled through space by his "invisible hand," Ebner silently chanted Mr. Fool's honorific name.
This made Klein, upon hearing the prayer, feel a stir in his heart. After a brief word with Sharon, he headed to the washroom.
As for the others, since Ebner had already told them what he was going to do, they weren't surprised, though they couldn't help but feel a bit worried.
.....
In front of the mountain-top building named "Ryudō Temple," lightning, crimson, and black mud intertwined, having already destroyed everything around them. Even the monsters formed from the black viscous liquid continuously cycled through birth, conception, reproduction, and destruction... Only a single intact hole leading underground remained.
Suddenly "teleported" here, Ebner felt the three terrifying auras not far away. While clicking his tongue in awe, he dared not look back. He merely simulated his abilities to "purify" himself, then directly leaped into the "hole" leading to the passage.
The passage was long but had few obstacles. The few black mud "monsters" present, aside from "contamination," weren't too strong and were easily dealt with by Ebner.
But just as he was about to reach the deepest palace, a figure blocked his path in the center of the road.
Most of the person's body was in shadow, only a portion revealed due to being stained with "black mud" and "crimson."
His face was indistinct, but the aura emanating from him was terrifying, surpassing that of an ordinary Demigod.
Ebner narrowed his eyes, recalling Tayles's previous reconnaissance results, and quickly recognized the opponent... He was the Master of the "Profane Presbyter" above, the "Saint of Shadows" from the Aurora Order!
He's actually here, and it looks like he's been contaminated...
As this thought crossed his mind, Ebner saw the "Saint of Shadows" turn his head and look at him, an extreme aura of "depravity" simultaneously rushing towards him!
This contaminated "Black Knight's" strength was even more terrifying than normal, and his speed was so fast that Ebner almost couldn't see him clearly.
But even if he could see him, with Ebner's current abilities, he couldn't possibly dodge or block it!
Ebner, who had activated his "Mechanical Mind" since leaping into the passage, faced the black blade about to pierce his heart. His pure white eyes grew colder, and the "blood-red pattern" on his brow abruptly distorted, as if a third eye had opened.
Immediately after, he unhesitatingly crushed the sapphire pendant he had been holding in his hand.
It was "Lilith's Tear"!
In an instant, centered around Ebner, a power that made all things "barren" spread outwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 775: Mr. Fool Photobombs the Group Shot
chapters.content:
Chapter 775 - Mr. Fool Photobombs the Group Shot
With the burst of "Desolation," everything in the passage—plants, monsters, rocks, wood, soil—fell into "withering."
The "Saint of Shadows," closest to the center of "Desolation," bore the brunt of it!
After Ebner's forehead blood rune activated and he transformed into moonlight, his sword strike missed, and he was completely engulfed by the desolate and silent power. The giant sword and armor, condensed from spirituality, began to rapidly decay, then spread to his body and soul. Only the areas contaminated by black mud and crimson barely resisted this trend of withering.
But even so, the tearing of body and soul caused by the decay inflicted irreversible injuries on him in an instant, leading to near-immediate death.
On the other side, Ebner, having unleashed the power of "Desolation," took advantage of Lilith's blessing before it expired, entering "Alvin's Quiz Maze" in his "moonlight" state.
Because of the special circumstances before entry, the "Maze" charged him a "special opening fee" of ten thousand gold pounds, making Ebner lament that this "Maze" was truly a profiteer!
Of course, this also had to do with him only possessing a Tier 4 clearance for the "Maze," rather than being its true owner.
Meanwhile, in the ancient palace above the gray fog, Klein, seated in the "Fool's" position, watched the scene displayed by the star symbolizing "Tower" and couldn't help but marvel at the power of "Desolation."
—Ebner had "purified" himself before entering the passage, which allowed Klein to "live stream" from above the gray fog.
"The level of this power is no less than that of the 'Profane Presbyter' and that fleshy mountain... No wonder the 'Red Angel' evil spirit's tone changed immediately when he saw Mr. Tower holding that pendant!
"But this power seems to be indiscriminate, affecting both friend and foe... I wonder if Mr. Tower is alright.
"Although his 'Crimson Star' is still there, ever since a moment ago, the 'live stream's' 'signal' has become unstable. I can only vaguely see that he seems to have entered a strange space..."
Klein thought for a moment, and was about to click on "Tower's" crimson star to inquire, when his vision suddenly cleared again, and "Tower" himself returned to the now dead silent passage.
And that "Saint of Shadows" had not completely withered under the "Desolation"; a part of his body remained active, but these remaining parts were rapidly losing control and combining with the surrounding "black mud," about to form a new monster.
Since "Tower" believes that Mr. Fool also tacitly approved Lilith's plan, it wouldn't make sense if I didn't display any power at all. It would also make it easier to expose "The Fool's" weakness, and even make "Tower" suspect that "The Fool" and "The World" might be the same person...
And this "Saint of Shadows," having suffered such a terrifying attack, is probably on the verge of death. I might as well deliver the final blow.
Thinking this, Klein, having made up his mind, summoned the "Scepter of the Sea God" and the "Book of Calamities" from his pile of miscellaneous items.
.....
In the passage, Ebner, having just emerged from the "Quiz Maze," immediately noticed the "Saint of Shadows" losing control.
"As expected of a Demigod from the 'Hanged Man' pathway, his vitality is truly tenacious! Theoretically, ordinary Demigods can't withstand the 'Desolation' power from 'Lilith's Tear'; only Sequence 3s with angelic means might be able to endure it...
"Did he escape death because he was contaminated?"
After sighing with emotion, Ebner was about to summon the Bone Dragon and merge with it, intending to completely deal with the 'Saint of Shadows' before he fully transformed into a monster.
But just then, silver lightning bolts struck down without warning, forming a forest of thunder that completely enveloped the monster the 'Saint of Shadows' had become.
Rumble!
Amidst the deafening thunder, the 'Saint of Shadows,' half withered and half monstrous, seemed to lose his wits, showing no intention of dodging. He was quickly annihilated by the forest of thunder, which carried an intense aura of destruction!
Ebner was stunned for a moment, then immediately guessed that Klein was deliberately showing his power. So, he casually made a gesture, pretending to be respectful, and said, "Praise be to you, Mr. Fool."
Klein, above the gray fog, nodded in satisfaction at this scene, thinking:
Finally fooled them, it was worth almost draining my spirituality...
He rubbed his temples and put the "Book of Calamities" back into the pile of miscellaneous items. With this book's blessing, although it could make the "Scepter of the Sea God" more powerful, the consumption was several times greater.
About three minutes later, the thunder in the passage gradually subsided. Ebner had the "Magic Mirror" release the devil, who carefully went forward to search, but found that the 'Saint of Shadows's' remains were completely shattered. Only a pitted metal flask, still carrying residual lightning power, remained.
Observing it with his Pure White Eye, Ebner discovered that the flask itself was merely a container for a special solution. However, at this moment, it had mutated, mixed with the 'Black Knight' characteristic of the 'Saint of Shadows' himself, as well as the "Telepathist," "Solar High Priest," "Briber," "Demoness of Affliction," "Mysticism Magister," "Guardian," "Reaper," and "Classical Alchemist" characteristics he had herded...
Additionally, it had also been contaminated with some "Chaos Sea" and "Primordial Moon" pollution...
It could be said that this thing was currently an extremely terrifying Sealed Artifact. Although its abilities seemed good—just one sip of the liquid produced within would randomly grant seven of the aforementioned sequence abilities, lasting for an hour...
The side effects, however, were something even Ebner, with his Pure White Eye, dared not try.
After all, the side effects of drinking that one sip of "liquid" were also randomly generated!
At best, one would merely praise the sun and suffer mental distortion... In severe cases, one would directly fall into depravity, lose control, or give birth... Who would dare to gamble on that? The only good news was that the 'Black Knight' controlled some of the "Chaos Sea" contamination, and the "Classical Alchemist" integrated the "Primordial Moon" contamination, forming a precarious balance. So, as long as one didn't touch the liquid in the flask, merely possessing it wasn't a big problem...
"I don't even dare to use 'Disintegration' to destroy the structure of this Sealed Artifact... Once the balance inside is broken, only Mr. Fool would likely be able to deal with that contamination...
"Hmm... After returning, I'll try to gradually disintegrate it with a 'Secret Art.' If that really doesn't work, then let Klein 'court death' with it... After all, he was the one who struck down the 'Saint of Shadows,' and half the spoils are his, aren't they?"
Thinking this, Ebner sealed the flask with a card, then continued forward along the now "desolate" passage.
Soon, he arrived before a deep, lightless palace.
Above the gray fog, Klein, through "Tower's" perspective, saw this palace, and his eyes instantly widened.
Because he had seen this palace before; it was identical to the image Arrodes had drawn when demonstrating Zaratul's state!

chapters.title: Chapter 776: You’re Early
chapters.content:
Chapter 776 - You're Early
Standing before the gloomy palace, what Ebner's Pure White Eye reflected was not its exquisite design or lavish decorations, but rather continuously wriggling tentacles bound by the power of "Order"!
This means the palace itself is part of Zaratul? No, more accurately, it's a cage formed by its power being "twisted," trapping itself.
Hmm, while Roselle was likely still the "Knowledge Emperor" when he built the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," he wielded the "Prince of Abolition" characteristic, and there's a good chance he even had the "Black Emperor" Uniqueness... Achieving such a seal wouldn't be difficult for him.
As thoughts stirred, Ebner walked around the palace several times, "analyzing" and "dissecting" every detail.
Soon, he made some new discoveries.
Returning to the palace's main entrance, he couldn't help but ponder:
Based on observation and "retrospection," the original seal should have also utilized the power of the Chaos Sea projected into this illusory world... This means Roselle's split soul might also be trapped within this palace!
But now, because of the Primordial Moon's descent, some of the contaminated power on Roselle should have been temporarily borrowed, so the Chaos Sea also followed...
Additionally, I've noticed some familiar "routines"... Heh, I remember Roselle once crafted a "silver plate" that could communicate with Sefirah Castle, but since he was already a Beyonder of the "Savant" pathway at the time, he couldn't further borrow the power of Sefirah Castle beyond merely seeing an boundless expanse of gray-white mist...
However, if he mystically linked that "silver plate" to Zaratul through a ritual, it might be a different story!
Is this yet another sealing structure designed to balance the powers of the Chaos Sea, Sefirah Castle, and the Mother Goddess?
From Baron Conva's recovery of sanity, to the "Chained God's" escape from the Mother Tree of Desire, and now Roselle's self-seal before my eyes... they all follow this same principle!
And they are all, more or less, connected to the transmigrators brought by the Pure White Eye... Is this part of a long-running experiment?
This experiment also seems to have a significant connection to the continuously perfected "Secret Art" of "controlling the Bone Dragon"...
Perhaps I can talk to "Roselle" about it?
Thinking this, and confirming that the seal was still solid and held no significant danger as long as the "core" wasn't damaged, Ebner finally pushed open the palace gates.
Of course, Ebner's "recklessness" was also due to his trust in Lilith, trusting that she wouldn't send him to his death for nothing.
Finally, something Lilith had quietly told him earlier also gave him considerable confidence.
In the ancient palace above the gray fog, Klein, who was watching the "live stream," frowned. The "signal" was suddenly interfered with the moment Mr. Tower entered the palace, making it difficult for him to see or hear the contents of the "live stream" clearly anymore.
.....
Upon entering the palace, darkness filled his vision. Even Ebner, with his "night vision" ability, couldn't see clearly, only vaguely perceiving a huge, wriggling mass in the deepest part.
In the very center of the palace, there was a single faint blue light, but it only illuminated a range of about four or five paces around it.
Ebner hesitated for a moment, then cautiously approached, quickly discovering that the blue light was actually emanating from the "Silent Winter" oil lamp, which had been absorbed into this place as a "Lesser Holy Grail."
Behind the oil lamp sat a young man with slightly curly chestnut hair and two neatly groomed small mustaches on his lip.
This was Roselle in his youth.
Sensing Ebner's approach, the young Roselle looked over with confused blue eyes, and in a dull tone, said:
"You... came?
"But, you're early!"
This Roselle seems a bit unclear-headed... Is his sealed mind having problems, or is he normally in a "dreaming" state within the "Dream Labyrinth Tower"?
As thoughts raced, Ebner was in no hurry to destroy the "Holy Grail," as he hadn't received Lilith's "signal" yet. So, he tried to extract information: "Do you know me? Do you know who I am?"
Chapter 779: You're Early
"My memory is incomplete... I don't know who you are... But I knew you would come... I said so when we met on the sixth floor..."
The logic is quite clear... But the sixth floor? Is that the Roselle who explored the Solomon ruins? Then it's indeed a part of his soul, but it has now merged with those 'Roselle phantoms.'
Perhaps it's the part of Roselle's personality that wasn't twisted, which is why it was placed in the lower levels... But now that it's merged, it will only make him more chaotic, right?
With several thoughts crossing his mind, Ebner calmly asked again, "Why do you say I'm early?"
"Many reasons..." Roselle, with his blank, dull eyes, seemed to show a slight emotional fluctuation as he spoke to himself:
"Because you came early, I can't release Zaratul's historical projection now, so I can't use the 'Book of Secrets' to steal his 'resurrection' miracle and achieve a relatively perfect resurrection...
"Because you came early, and are still at Tier 5 authority, I couldn't use the arrangements I made on the second floor to make you lower your guard against me...
"Because you came early, my prophesied 'Gatekeeper' female companion was replaced by a 'Mysticism Magister' from the Edwards' descendants, allowing this oil lamp to take her intended place. And I also lost a bargaining chip to force you into 'making a wish.'
"If you don't make a wish, then my second method of resurrection, twisting 'wishes' through my main body to achieve resurrection, cannot be completed...
"Because you came early, my prior arrangement of separating a portion of the 'Queen of Calamity's' soul from the 'Book of Calamities' is useless, because the current you would not agree to my request to trade her whereabouts for your 'wish'...
"Because you came early, my arrangement on one of my descendants also lost its meaning..."
After listening to his words, Ebner couldn't help but frown deeply, because this ruthless Roselle was completely different from what he had read in novels in his previous life and what he had learned after transmigrating!
Threatening a fellow transmigrator, scheming against descendants... No wonder the Goddess doesn't want such a Roselle to resurrect. After all, even if he resurrected, it would be meaningless... He isn't him!
However, regarding the contents revealed in his words, I had already guessed about Zaratul's historical projection...
The so-called "Gatekeeper" female companion must be Jane... If Vice Admiral Iceberg's teacher hadn't suddenly given a "prophecy," Edwina would certainly not have sought out Ronzell's family descendants for a safe way to enter the 'Groselle's Travels.'
And Jane, as a descendant of a transmigrator, who also obtained many items from the late Death Consul Miranda, could easily be manipulated by Roselle into the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," right?
No... If she still held the 'Death' card, she should have already fallen into the trap! Who made these "arrangements"? Someone who can break such mystical connections... I'll ask Jane later, who exactly gave that card to the 'Queen of Mystery.'
The subsequent arrangements on the second floor are also not hard to guess. To make me lower my guard, it was most likely to arrange another scenario with Roselle, deepening our friendship through tasks like fighting common enemies...
But what's with the Queen of Calamity? Why would I be willing to 'make a wish' for his resurrection just for the whereabouts of an ancient god from a god?
And finally, who is he referring to with his "arrangement on a descendant"?
Puzzled, Ebner spoke again, "What is the 'Queen of Calamity's' relationship with my future self?"
"I don't know... I just know it will be useful," the young Roselle said, looking at Ebner with vacant eyes.
"Then I'll rephrase my question. What are your resurrection methods? What are the specifics? Hmm, let's start with the one you arranged through your descendant." Ebner thought for a moment, then posed new questions.
"I had my loyal knight Edwards tamper with the 'Book of Stars,' and before ascending to godhood, I separated a portion of the 'Lawyer' and 'Astronomer' characteristics bearing my imprint.
"According to my arrangements with the 'Men in Black,' at the prophesied time, two of my descendants who had read the 'Book of Stars' would each receive one of these characteristics.
"The one who gets the 'Astronomer' will be an adult male. As long as someone makes a wish, I can distort and steal this wish, allowing my split soul to resurrect in the identity of this male descendant... Then, by seizing an 'Amon' clone, I would steal my contaminated fate, transferring the contamination to a sacrificial offering.
"Because this plan carries great risk... the contamination from that entity might still not leave me... so there's an alternative plan...
"Another descendant of mine who receives my 'Lawyer' characteristic will be a young woman, destined to meet you... and will 'magnify' her good feelings towards you...
"You will enter the first floor when she is pregnant... I will then seize the opportunity to 'resurrect' into her child, who is destined to be a 'Lawyer' from birth.
"And by becoming your child, I will gain your protection, and thus won't have to worry about the lingering 'contamination' issue...
"But you came early..."

chapters.title: Chapter 777: Consecutive Reversals of Scheme
chapters.content:
Chapter 777 - Consecutive Reversals of Scheme
Is he trying to call me "Dad"? Roselle, where's your integrity? Have you no shame left after being contaminated?
And even if Mr. Surrey didn't die from the Delian or Fless family's conspiracies, he'd likely be replaced by his own ancestor... To scheme against his own descendants like this, this person truly isn't Roselle anymore!
The Roselle I know is someone who would challenge a deity because his youngest son lacked humanity!
But this later design of his is truly insidious... Thinking about it carefully, if I later help Fanny get her revenge in Trier, she might indeed reward me in some special way... And I might not be able to resist the temptation... That would be falling into this person's trap.
Fortunately, thanks to the arrangements of multiple deities, I came early...
Ebner looked at the young Roselle before him with an unpleased expression, then heard the other party continue:
"The best way to resurrect is still to have Zaratul and his historical projection meet. This way, I can directly steal his resurrection miracle without needing 'distortion' from my main body, maximizing concealment from that entity.
"At that time, whether as an 'Astronomer,' making a 'sacrifice' bear the 'contamination,' or becoming your child, having you resolve the contamination would be easier and more readily accepted by the gods.
"And once I here resurrect, the one in the 'Black Emperor's' mausoleum will no longer be important... Then the God of Knowledge can disregard your feelings and support His chosen candidate for 'Black Emperor'... This was the basis of my cooperation with Him back then...
