"But it seems now, He failed to uphold His agreement with me... even tampering with many arrangements..."
That's because you lack self-awareness! If I were to approve of your resurrection like this, that would be truly demonic! If the second-fifth dragon really considered my feelings, he definitely wouldn't let you succeed!
However, what he implies is that the God of Knowledge values me so much that He needs to consider my feelings even when supporting a "Black Emperor" candidate?
Of course, this could also be false information released by the God of Knowledge to deceive Roselle.
With thoughts swirling, Ebner stared at Roselle for a while, then glanced at Zaratul deep within the palace, and spoke again:
"Stealing Zaratul's resurrection fate might be possible, but having a so-called 'sacrificer' bear your contamination, even Amon's main body probably couldn't do that, could he?
"How exactly do you plan to solve this problem? If there are truly no hidden dangers, I don't mind 'making a wish' once."
The young Roselle's breathing stopped for a moment after hearing this, then resumed. His eyes remained vacant, and he said slowly:
"This primarily relies on a 'Mystical Reproduction'...
"I heard a legend that the Ancient Sun God made His vice-king, the Dark Angel of the 'Hanged Man' pathway, bear the contamination.
"I relied on this 'mystery' to have the 'Men in Black' similarly search for a Demigod of the 'Hanged Man' pathway as a sacrifice.
"Furthermore, Amon truly cannot 'transfer' this fate, but I can use 'Zaratul' and the 'silver plate' that brought me here as a bridge, utilizing Amon's clone to 'steal' the power of Sefirah Castle to accomplish this step.
"And now is when that entity's power over me is weakest. 'Making a wish' now would have a high success rate of resurrection without contamination."
"What a grand scheme!" Ebner applauded upon hearing this.
The young Roselle, however, seemed to have fallen asleep and did not reply.
Ebner suddenly asked, "Do you know about the 'Calamity Seal'?"
"I know... Although I've lost many memories, I remember that many of my schemes were actually built upon its arrangements," Roselle replied blankly.
"Your knowledge about me, and about Sefirah Castle, also came from it, didn't it? Then do you think there's a possibility that you were also manipulated by it? That all your subsequent actions were within its and the deities' expectations." Ebner said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Roselle's vacant eyes instantly sharpened. He asked in a low voice, "What are you trying to say?"
"No longer pretending? Heh, then let me ask another question. You, who awakened long ago, why are you so diligently answering my questions?" Ebner stared directly into the young Roselle's eyes, pressing him.
Roselle's expression changed abruptly, at times bewildered, at times furious, at times joyful, at times sorrowful. Finally, an anxious voice took over, shouting, "Quick, kill me! Kill the current me! Completely cut off any possibility of my resurrection!
"I don't care at all if I'm contaminated after resurrection. Grabbing Amon's clone isn't to 'steal' contamination, but to trade information I learned from the 'Calamity Seal' with Amon, to assist him in ascending to godhood and seizing Sefirah Castle, ultimately hoping he'll swap my fate with my main body, so I can become the 'Black Emperor'!
"That's a disaster for humanity; you must stop me! Kill me!"
Ebner, however, was unmoved by his desperate shouts. He sneered,
"A new tactic, is it?
"Killing you, wouldn't that just free you from the palace's seal?
"Or perhaps, this is also a different kind of 'wish,' a wish to destroy you, which you can still exploit."
As Ebner's words fell, the urgent voice of the young Roselle gradually faded. He gave Ebner a cold glance and said,
"You are indeed very clever... But do you think the matter of wishing is up to you?"
Ebner clutched the Magic Mirror in his palm, simultaneously glancing at "Silent Winter," and narrowed his eyes, asking, "What do you mean?"
"Heh heh, do you really think the descent of the 'Unique Red Moon' would be without defenses?
"In fact, even though It couldn't be bothered with the laughable schemes of the gods on this planet, It had long anticipated the possibility of an ambush and prepared contingencies sufficient to subdue Lilith! Regardless of whether Lilith secretly advanced to Sequence 1.
"This place is also a trap for Lilith!
"Although only a projection of Lilith came here, as long as It can be subdued, contaminating Lilith's main body through the connection isn't difficult, and it's very subtle, so the gods won't discover it.
"Heh heh, It was Its greed that buried It!
"As for you... once the 'Red Moon' takes down Lilith and seduces the owner of Sefirah Castle, you naturally won't escape either!"
He spoke fiercely, but Ebner showed no worry at all, because Lilith had mentioned this possibility when she whispered in his ear, confidently telling him not to worry.
"What... you don't believe me?" The young "Roselle's" face suddenly twisted, appearing extremely sinister and terrifying.
"I believe you!" Ebner nodded slightly, then smirked and continued,
"But I believe Lilith more!"
.....
In mid-air, Lilith, with illusory wings on her back and silver hair and eyes, pointed her lace parasol downwards. The mountain-like mass of flesh was tightly entangled by the "black mud," binding it ever tighter, making it unable to move.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
The fleshy mountain had no mouth or nose, but it still let out cries of agony.
The parasol was essentially a "Cursed Item," and its true form was the "Chained God," a "projection" of the 'Chained' pathway's Uniqueness.
The root of its curse was the "Chained God's" millennium-long bondage by the Mother Tree of Desire.
If Emlyn were here, he would immediately recognize that the umbrella was a matching accessory for one of his stolen life-sized dolls...
When Lilith ascended in the catacombs of the Harvest Church, she deliberately held this "Cursed Item," so when Ebner pulled out the "historical projection," he pulled it out as well.
Just as Lilith descended, preparing to deliver a fatal blow to the immobilized "fleshy mountain," the fleshy mountain suddenly split open. Immediately after, a red moon rose from the opening, and with an unstoppable momentum, it enveloped the beautiful woman in mid-air.
Facing this sudden situation, Lilith merely smiled, her beauty eclipsing the heavens and earth. Then, unhurriedly, she put away her parasol, and her silver eyes instantly became vacant, as if connected to some unknown existence.
With her movement, the red moon's encroaching light suddenly solidified. It struggled violently for a moment, then became motionless.
Seeing this, Lilith waved her hand, and the opponent, like a bird returning to its nest, flew into her palm.
Playing with the gem condensed from the "red moon" in her hand, Lilith curled her lips, thinking with a hint of triumph:
"You learned a lot about 'Him' from Roselle, didn't you?
"But the more you know without His permission, the more severe the 'contamination' will be! And it's very subtle, hard-to-detect contamination!
"That contamination might have limited effect on your main body, but it's irresistible to this 'Primordial Moon' incarnated as the 'Beauty Goddess'!
"Especially in front of me, who has partial authority over 'unknown' aspects.
"Stopping him from seeing you in Backlund back then was to prevent you from detecting it early, not to save him!
"Heh, you think Roselle really couldn't stop himself from going to the moon back then?
"After all, that was the true beginning of the 'Silver Moon Project.'"
Third update late tonight

chapters.title: Chapter 778: Miracle
chapters.content:
Chapter 778 - Miracle
Just as the "Red Moon" was being withdrawn by Lilith, the crescent moon in the night sky of the real world suddenly rounded, turning blood-red!
Another "Blood Moon" had arrived!
After dealing with Mr. Turon's affairs, Fors, who had returned to Tosk from Rit, was suddenly startled awake from a dream. With a pale face, she glanced at the moon outside the window. Just as she was about to chant Mr. Fool's honorific name, she was swallowed by a sudden crimson light and then entered the ancient palace above the gray fog.
She let out a sigh of relief, stood up, and bowed,
"Respected Mr. Fool, you have saved me again."
"It was an agreed matter," Klein nodded slightly in response.
Since she came to Mr. Fool every full moon, Fors was no longer as nervous as she had been initially. So, she proactively brought up a topic:
"Mr. Fool, I wonder what major event occurred that caused the Blood Moon to suddenly appear?"
She vaguely remembered Mr. Fool mentioning before that the "Blood Moon" involved an evil god.
Klein recalled the scene he had witnessed in the Fuyuki market on the first floor, carefully choosing his words, and said with a half-smile, half-sigh:
"The 'Primordial Moon' has fallen, and the ancient god Lilith has reclaimed more authority, taking another step closer to complete recovery."
The "Primordial Moon" fallen? The ancient god Lilith revived?
I remember the ancient god Lilith should be referring to the Ancestor of Vampires, right? Did She kill that evil god called the "Primordial Moon"?
Hmm, Mr. Moon in the Tarot Club is a vampire... Perhaps Mr. Fool was also involved in this matter? Are He and the ancient god Lilith allies?
After hearing Klein's words, Fors, who was previously a bit confused, instantly sobered up. She hadn't expected a simple Blood Moon to involve such major events as the fall of a god and the revival of an ancient god!
"You know this much is enough; don't spread it carelessly," Klein gently instructed, though he felt that from Goddess Lilith's unreserved demeanor, She didn't care if Her actions were known by others.
It was fine for the Tarot Club members to know, after all, with Mr. Tower's face involved, it wasn't a big problem, but there was no need to further expand the scope of the information.
"As you command," Fors quickly stood up and promised.
She had originally wanted to share it with Ebner and Xio, but now she had to keep it from them.
.....
In the underground of Tosk, within the "Kaspersky" base of the "Men in Black."
When the Blood Moon was in the sky, the young man who called himself the "Acting Commander" and Amon, who was bound to a cross, simultaneously sensed something.
—As high-sequence Cryptologists, they knew a lot of information just from the phenomenon.
The latter even curled his lips and chuckled, "So Their target was the 'Primordial Moon'? Interesting, things have been getting more and more interesting recently!"
Saying that, He looked at the young man, whose expression had turned gloomy, and said playfully, "Do you still think your Majesty can be resurrected?
"I've told you before, the gods won't let such an unstable factor run wild! Even if His plan is meticulously thought out, it won't work!"
The young man remained silent for a moment, then glanced at Amon and said faintly, "His Majesty has more than one contingency. He might not fail."
"Oh? Then this drama gets even more interesting... Let me see what other tricks He has!" Amon said with interest.
"No matter what, your clone will die in the end... I don't know what you're so happy about!" The young man snorted.
"You don't understand..." Amon looked at him and replied with a smile.
.....
In the gloomy palace, the young "Roselle," after hearing Ebner's remark, "But I believe Lilith more," intended to mock him, but before he could speak, his eyes suddenly widened.
He found that the power of the "Red Moon" had vanished!
"It seems Lilith won," Ebner also noticed this through his Pure White Eye and curved his lips.
"Roselle's" expression changed repeatedly again, and finally, he adopted a wry smile, shaking his head and saying:
"You won...
"But you can't kill me, and you won't make a wish, so you'd better leave this place soon...
"Once the power projected from the Chaos Sea returns, it won't be easy for you to leave."
What trick is he up to now?
Ebner now didn't believe a word this contaminated Roselle said. After a brief thought, he also smiled and said, "Thanks for the reminder... But who said I wouldn't 'make a wish'?
"I said earlier that as long as you could provide a suitable explanation for getting rid of the contamination, I would 'make a wish'...
"Although the method you described doesn't align with my desires, that method indeed has a possibility of success...
"Therefore, I've decided to fulfill my promise... After all, one must be true to their word."
"Really?!" "Roselle" seemed to widen his eyes in disbelief. If he hadn't been bound and unable to move, he would have surely rushed to Ebner's side.
Ebner smiled and nodded, "Really!"
With that, without waiting for Roselle to react, he directly made a wish to "Silent Winter," the item that had replaced the "Holy Grail": "My wish is 'resurrection'!"
He didn't add a subject, didn't say "whose" resurrection, only broadly stated the subject of the wish.
But this still sent a jolt through Roselle, because he didn't care what wish the other party made; as long as the act of wishing occurred, he could "twist" the wish and then steal the miracle.
As Ebner's words fell, the "wishes" accumulated by generations of tower climbers over centuries in the Dream Labyrinth Tower surged towards Zaratul deep within the palace, and the miracle was about to manifest.
But just as Roselle communicated with his main body, borrowed the power of "distortion," and connected with the "Book of Concealment" in the Surrey family ritual room, preparing to steal this "miracle," the "miracle" provided by Zaratul, the "Great Holy Grail" in this ritual, vanished!
"Where's the miracle? Where's my miracle? Why is it gone?!" Roselle, who had thought he was about to resurrect, immediately became exasperated.
"So a 'miracle' is worth 300,000 pounds... Then I can buy another one!" At this moment, Ebner muttered to himself, pinching his chin.
Evidently, Zaratul's "miracle" had just been bought by him using the "Quiz Maze."
—This item was crafted from a high-sequence characteristic belonging to the "Goddess of Wealth" from an alien planet. It possesses authority related to "transactions" and can purchase abilities with money and store them.
"Buy... Alvin's Maze? You tricked me?" Roselle immediately understood what had happened upon hearing Ebner's words.
"Yes, I tricked you!" Ebner admitted frankly.
From the moment he learned that this twisted Roselle was scheming against his friends, Ebner decided not to let him "die" too easily.
However, he wasn't intentionally putting himself in danger; instead, he suddenly understood something: why the "Calamity Seal" lured Roselle into building the Dream Labyrinth Tower, and why the Goddess allowed Roselle to take Zaratul.
"The first four questions during the quiz were about the Dragon Balls, historical knowledge from the eras of two senior transmigrators, and the improvement of 'Secret Arts'...
"My previous speculation was that this was a hint that to allow the senior 'Wanderer' to become a 'Miracle Invoker' and escape the 'Night Kingdom,' I would need to rely on the knowledge left by seniors Rhine and Vincent to create a 'Secret Art' that could perfectly integrate with the 'Wanderer's' body...
"But now it seems the first question might not specifically refer to Alvin becoming a 'Miracle Invoker'... but rather that 'miracle' itself is necessary for improving 'Secret Arts'!
"That's why the 'Calamity Seal' deliberately exposed the arrangements of 'Groselle's Travels,' luring Roselle to build the Dream Labyrinth Tower, because 'miracles' require 'wishes,' and 'wishes' require accumulation!
"This should also be why the Goddess allowed Roselle to 'move' Zaratul... Doesn't she want to waste his 'miracle'?
"That 'Mirror Apostle' happened to send 'Alvin's Quiz Maze' and enough money... Who guided that, I wonder?
"Speaking of which, 'Lion' Leon's mandatory questioning talent is very similar to the 'Quiz Maze'...
"It says it's an exclusive ability of the 'Sphinx,' but I haven't seen it recorded in any relevant books...
"Could it also have an 'alien' characteristic? Beyonder convergence... Is that why I, carrying it, naturally encountered the 'Quiz Maze'?
"Hmm, Roselle also entered this maze, and even the initial idea for the Dream Labyrinth Tower might have originated from it...
"So... when he encountered 'Alvin's Quiz Maze' back then, could it also have been because he raised this lion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 779: New Blessing
chapters.content:
Chapter 779 - New Blessing
Speaking of which, that lion never admitted to being a complete "Prophet"... Should I try to give it a full medical check-up when I get back?
Hmm, provided it agrees.
After coming back to his senses, Ebner made another wish, and used his credit in the Quiz Maze to "buy" and "store" it.
—According to the relevant information he had "paid" for in the maze, the Sequence 5 of this pathway, controlled by the "Goddess of Wealth" from an alien planet, is named "Collector," and has a special "space" specifically for storing "purchased" abilities and spells.
There are only four "resurrection" miracles in total. I don't know if Zaratul used any before his death, but even if there are some left, my current credit balance in the Quiz Space is only around 200,000, which isn't enough to buy another one...
*Although I can temporarily "recharge" with items on me, "appraisal" takes some time... It would be bad if something changed here after I entered the Quiz Space. *
Moreover, my intuition tells me I should quit while I'm ahead, otherwise there might be danger...
Thinking this, he glanced at the young "Roselle" not far away, pulling a mysterious smile.
The other party's face was grim. Seeing his strange smile, he immediately said resentfully, "Even if you're wealthy, buying two 'resurrection' 'miracles' must be your limit, right?
"Since you're unwilling to kill me, then leave! I will strip you and your companions of your 'tower climber' status later."
Would a man with such a lack of character be Roselle? Did the Mother Goddess of Depravity perhaps concentrate all the flaws in his personality to create this thing?
Or were these flaws originally scattered, and only became so awful because they converged?
I absolutely refuse to acknowledge such a person as Roselle! Even if his actions are contradictory and he might indeed have a good side.
Thinking this, Ebner pointed at Zaratul deep within the palace: "I bet you have one last arrangement, relying on the 'Holy Grail War' mechanism, to finally make use of Him, right?"
Upon hearing this, "Roselle's" face first contorted into a grimace, then calmed down. He stared at Ebner with cold eyes and said:
"That's right, your 'purchase' of the 'wish' means the 'Holy Grail' ritual couldn't be completed, and there's no victor!
"After you all leave, this oil lamp I'm possessing, which is the 'Lesser Holy Grail,' will merge with the 'Great Holy Grail,' Zaratul... At that point, I'll gamble on directly merging with his uncontrolled spirit...
"Although this is the worst option, with a high probability of being reversely infected by Zaratul's spirit... and even if it succeeds, I'll turn into an uncontrolled monster... there's still a glimmer of hope.
"However, what if you guess correctly?
"You only have two paths before you: either kill me, or leave.
"Don't even think about buying a 'miracle' like before, because 'killing me' will immediately trigger a 'distortion' from my main body, and you won't have time to 'buy' it in advance!
"And a 'miracle' twisted by a deity's status cannot be forcibly bought by that maze."
He's explaining it in such detail... Firstly, he has a rather unpleasant personality and enjoys seeing others frustrated and helpless...
Secondly, it's probably because the small amount of "conscience" he has left is deliberately revealing the plan, trying to get me to stop him.
Analyzing this, Ebner smiled slightly, then extended his right hand. As he conjured a "Lava Sword," he said, "I have no way? Come, let me show you a trick."
With that, he imbued the "Lava Sword" in his hand with his self-created secret art, "Disintegration," and brought it down upon the "Silent Winter" oil lamp.
Crack!
Under "Roselle's" stunned gaze, the lamp's light suddenly converged inwards, forming a "profound" darkness.
The next second, this darkness rapidly spread, connecting with the entire "gloomy" palace.
Immediately after, Zaratul deep within the palace, Roselle before the oil lamp, and the entire palace itself were erased as if by an eraser on a pencil drawing, vanishing quickly within a few seconds, leaving no trace.
Only Ebner remained, his "Lava Sword" dissipated.
The "Silent Winter" originally housed the Goddess's power; no wonder Lilith told me just now that destroying it would resolve the threats of Zaratul and Roselle.
Heh, the Goddess is the Lord of Silence, so it's perfectly normal for Her power to be stored within "Silent Winter."
Yet, such a crucial item was initially bought by Edwina from the "King of the Five Seas" at a pirate gathering...
These arrangements showed no sign beforehand; the "Primordial Moon" and Roselle were truly caught off guard.
Furthermore, that gloomy palace must have been brought back by Roselle when he "moved" Zaratul. It probably contained the Goddess's hidden hand, otherwise Zaratul wouldn't have been so easily "secreted away."
Roselle's actions in his later years were truly contradictory: on one hand, he desperately arranged contingencies for resurrection, and on the other, he blindly used the "Calamity Seal" and the original arrangements of the true gods.
But it makes sense; a drowning man always desperately grasps at anything he can.
Overall, though the "Calamity Seal" schemed against him, it didn't intend to harm him.
It can be seen that all of that cunning fellow's plans targeting Roselle must have been initiated after the latter's journey to the moon.
Just as he thought this, Ebner's spiritual intuition was suddenly triggered. He quickly looked up and saw Lilith, with silver hair and eyes and a beauty that made his heart skip a beat, slowly descending before him.
"Well done," Lilith praised, then walked straight over, cupped Ebner's face, and lightly kissed his forehead.
A mysterious power instantly spread from her lips to Ebner's forehead, forming a pattern even more complex than the previous vertical mark blessing.
Then, Lilith pulled back, smiled at the still-stunned Ebner, and added, "This is your reward... the blessing of the 'Beauty Goddess'!
"Once 'activated,' it can make all attacks and curses actively avoid you, even attacks at the normal Angel level are no exception... unless the opponent uses 'authority.' Hmm, it can only be actively 'activated' three times, after which it becomes useless.
"Additionally, even without activation, it has many other benefits, such as multiplying the effect of the 'Charm Humans' Secret Art you learned from 'Blood Feast' by several times... As for the rest, you can explore them slowly yourself."
Ebner, on the other hand, felt his soul had flown away at this point, not hearing a single word, until Lilith watched him with a smile for over half a minute before he barely came back to his senses.
Oh my god... Lilith, if this keeps up, I'll lose control sooner or later!
Recalling the wonderful sensation on his forehead just now, Ebner took a deep breath and activated his "Mechanical Mind," finally suppressing the throb in his heart.
Then, he "retrospected" the words she had spoken earlier, casually made a moon gesture, and solemnly said, "Thank you for your gift."
Because Lilith appeared as the Ancestor of Vampires, Ebner cautiously avoided drawing the holy emblem of the "Earth Mother Goddess."
"You don't need to be so respectful when we speak alone; just be casual," Lilith first wagged her finger, then she looked around and chuckled, "Evernight 'Concealed' both Roselle and Zaratul?
"That's good. The reason I had Roselle split off parts of his soul was, firstly, to allow him more clearheaded time in his later years to cooperate with some arrangements... Secondly, I was worried that he truly couldn't resist the temptation of resurrection and the erosion from that entity on the moon, leading to the return of the 'Black Emperor' with contamination, which would necessitate his complete fall... The separated souls were also the final insurance, which could be used to some extent to 'awaken' his original consciousness.
"However, when Roselle truly returns in the future, those separated parts must also return to him.
"Now that they're in Evernight's hands, it can also put your mind at ease."
Lilith used the guise of asking questions to briefly explain Roselle's state, reassuring him.
However, the first thing Ebner thought of after hearing this was:
So, once Old Huang truly resurrects, he'll remember all the messed-up things his split souls did, all those unscrupulous arrangements?
At this moment, Ebner suddenly remembered a certain "lion" and decided to increase his investment in its "career"!

chapters.title: Chapter 780: The Gods’ Rewards
chapters.content:
Chapter 780 - The Gods’ Rewards
At the end of the "Ryudou Temple" passage, on the first floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower."
Lilith, confident in her charm, knew Ebner was using "thought" to divert his attention, so she didn't disturb him. Instead, she summoned the shattered "Silent Winter" into her hand.
Immediately after, crimson "Alchemy" runes appeared in the void, and "Silent Winter" gradually restored itself, only tinged with a silver-red hue.
As Ebner emerged from his contemplation, he saw Lilith grasping a fragmented spirit from the void and inserting it into the reassembled oil lamp.
"This lamp has been repaired. I stitched together the shattered soul of the previous 'Profane Presbyter' and numerous remnant souls that died in this tower, and put them all into the lamp.
"Now it not only possesses its original abilities, but when the oil lamp is lit, it can also summon the phantom of a 'Heroic Spirit' that was previously gathered inside to fight... Of course, their strength will at most be that of an ordinary Demigod, and they can only fight for half a minute at most per day."
Saying this, Lilith handed the oil lamp to Ebner, then continued, "Give this to that little girl named 'Edwina.' Consider it your 'mission' reward."
So not only the "Primordial Moon," but also that 'Heroic Spirit' who received the remnant soul of the 'Profane Presbyter' in the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" was also dealt with by Lilith... She's truly powerful!
However, Edwina is a member of the Church of Knowledge; shouldn't her reward come from the God of Knowledge? Although Lilith gained the most, this event was a joint scheme by three... well, at least three deities, right?
As if seeing through Ebner's thoughts, Lilith revealed a smile that made it impossible to look away. She parted her lips and said:
"They are they, and I am I... Knowledge and Evernight might give rewards, or they might not, but neither prevents me from giving you rewards." Saying this, she extended her fair hand and condensed a reddish aura, then gently squeezed it. When she opened her five fingers, a thumb-sized, translucent ruby appeared.
The ruby suddenly transformed into a vampire girl no more than seven or eight centimeters tall. She elegantly curtsied to Lilith and Ebner, then transformed back into a ruby.
"I created this using the 'Creation' authority, combining the aura of the 'Primordial Moon' and that 'High Summoner' who guided its descent, as well as a 'Shaman King' characteristic... Hmm, perhaps it can be called a 'Vampire Fairy' or 'Blood Elf'?
"She can display the 'vampire' demigod form. Although she can't maintain it for too long, it should be helpful for that 'Prophet's' future rituals...
"This is my thank-you gift to him... Tell him to take good care of this little one, and in a year, he must return her freedom."
Did she just create a species on the spot? And even used the 'Moon' authority to adjust the dangers of its "demigod form" specifically?
Also, the 'Prophet's' future rituals... is it the ritual required for advancing to 'Cognizer'?
Just as Ebner was lost in thought after receiving the gem, Lilith handed him the parasol she had been holding:
"This parasol was originally just a 'projection,' but I have used 'alchemical' methods to turn it into a 'physical entity'... Although it is still just an ordinary parasol, it now has some special functions. Hand it over to Miss 'Wraith'; she will know how to use it once she has it."
Ebner examined the parasol with his Pure White Eye and found that it indeed had no abilities, yet it was inextricably linked to a certain existence.
The "Chained God"... No, it should be called "Spirit Angel" Tolzna... The main function of this parasol should be to "invite" this Angel over when "necessary," similar to the puppet finger He gave me before.
It's just that Miss "Temperance" had better not run into Emlyn when she goes out with this parasol...
Having recognized the parasol's origin, Ebner couldn't help but inwardly complain.
"As for 'Mystery'... give him this card. I believe he can make better use of it." Lilith subtly glanced behind Ebner, as if observing someone through him. Then she displayed a playing card; on its face was a crimson moon, and beneath the crimson moon was a beautiful "woman" with slightly curly chestnut hair.
The woman's appearance was somewhat similar to the one on the "Demoness" card, but her temperament was completely different. One was demonically beautiful, the other full of temptation... Undoubtedly, this was another of Roselle's "cross-dressing" paintings.
"I have purified the 'contamination' on this card, but holding it may still cause one to encounter dependents of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' and the 'Mother Tree of Desire.' You'd best remind him," Lilith thought for a moment, then added.
A powerful item, a "miniature" vampire, a parasol that can summon an Angel, a "Blasphemy" card...
Lilith's rewards are generous... This means the Goddess and the God of Knowledge will probably have to spend too, right? They can't let themselves be outdone, can they?
But I can't guess the minds of deities; perhaps They don't care at all... After all, there's probably no other deity with as much humanity as Lilith, right?
Just when Ebner thought Lilith's rewards were finished, he heard her melodious voice say, "Finally, there's a reward just for you."
"For me? Wasn't it already given?" Ebner touched his forehead between his eyebrows, his mind wandering again as he asked in confusion.
"That was just the reward for my previous private commission, not the reward for the successful completion of the first step of the 'Silver Moon Project,'" Lilith said with a smile, shaking her head. She then asked, "Do you still have the soul of the former Pope of the 'Eternal Blazing Sun,' Aurbach, in your possession?"
Former Pope Aurbach had participated in the battle as a "Heroic Spirit." After his "body" was killed by the "Profane Presbyter," Ebner had taken his soul into the Quiz Maze.
Upon being asked, Ebner nodded, then spiritually communicated with the gold-rimmed glasses on his nose. After paying a 200-pound "storage" fee, he brought the slumbering Aurbach into the scene.
"This split soul of Roselle had another arrangement in Tosk for his resurrection... Although he no longer needs it, I can use his arrangement to complete your reward..." As her voice fell, Lilith's pupils suddenly became vacant, then she seemed to communicate with the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," and a water mirror appeared before them.
This water mirror was "split-screened" into two images.
The top screen showed the ritual altar with "Groselle's Travels," the "Book of Stars," and the "Book of Concealment."
The bottom screen showed the "Kaspersky" base that Ebner had visited before... There was also an altar arranged with a handsome middle-aged man bound to a cross, a thin man wearing a monocle, and a Beyonder characteristic placed triangularly at different positions on the altar.
"Chessia," who was guarding the first split screen, seemed completely unaware of the water mirror's gaze, but the monocled man in the second split screen suddenly looked over, a slow smile spreading across his lips.
Amon's clone? I've seen photos of the other handsome man; he's the "Black Knight" of the Delian family who injured Edwina.
I understand now. Roselle's original plan must have been to have this "Black Knight" bear the "contamination" for him, given that the "Hanged Man" pathway's symbolism is "sacrifice."
As for Amon's clone? He's just a tool for transferring "contamination."
However, Roselle's terrible plan also tried to leverage the power of Sefirah Castle; that must be why Amon willingly took the bait and refused to commit suicide to leave, right? He must have glimpsed something.
But unfortunately, I came early... Roselle's plan is destined to fail.
Ebner nodded thoughtfully, then saw Lilith cast the soul of former Pope Aurbach into the "water mirror."
Immediately after, as the "Book of Stars" on the upper screen lit up, Amon in the lower screen gradually "withered," while the "Black Knight" on the other cross suddenly opened his eyes.
But the "water mirror" shattered and disappeared at this moment.
Lilith clapped her hands and chuckled, "Now that the former Pope has taken over the body of a direct descendant of the Delian family, I imagine it will be of considerable help to your trip to Trier."
Ebner instinctively squeezed the Magic Mirror in his hand, thinking:
How come the Popes of the "Eternal Blazing Sun" are so connected to "Black Knights"? My "Magic Mirror" is like that, and now Aurbach is too... Is there some deeper mystical symbolism to this?
.....
Above the gray fog, since the "live stream" resumed when Lilith was distributing rewards, Klein already knew he was about to receive a Blasphemy card, and even rewards bestowed by the other two deities.
He curled his lips, beginning to imagine what items the Evernight Goddess and the God of Knowledge would bestow...
But suddenly, his smile froze.
Because he thought of something... something he had previously overlooked!
"If the Goddess and the God of Knowledge really give rewards... should I, 'The Fool,' who successfully tagged along for the group photo, give something too?!
"If I don't... will 'Tower' be suspicious?!
"After all, they are all resurrected ancient gods, and Lilith gave so much..."
Klein tapped the edge of the ancient bronze long table with his fingers, then after a long while, he muttered helplessly:
"Let's see what the Goddess and the God of Knowledge will bestow first... Then I'll consider what to do...
"Sigh! These days, even deities are starting to engage in internal competition?"

chapters.title: Chapter 781: Return to the City of Miracles
chapters.content:
Chapter 781 - Return to the City of Miracles
"I won't mention myself; Sharon's reward is simpler... she needs to purify the 'contamination' in Jacks' corpse to make a 'mummy,' and all of that requires 'The Fool's' help, so it can perfectly count as a 'reward.'
'Vice Admiral Iceberg' Edwina and 'Prophet' Taylors actually don't know about 'The Fool's' existence. Directly giving them rewards would be no different from a 'Blighted' gift, which is inappropriate both emotionally and logically, and might even terrify them... In short, their rewards can be given later, at an opportune moment...
"The only tricky one is 'Mr. Tower'... What can I give him that's not too expensive yet maintains my 'gravitas'?"
Klein reviewed his miscellaneous items and quickly had an idea, conjuring the "Book of Calamities" and a flattened golden wine cup into his hand.
He first picked up the yellowish-brown parchment book, hesitated for a moment, then put it down. Instead, he toyed with the wine cup, musing:
"The 'Book of Calamities' is an item that Ms. Yalloran of the 'Moses Ascetic Order' asked me to pass on to 'him'... Even if 'Tower' is indeed 'him,' Liu Bo, it's not suitable as a 'reward'...
"This wine cup, however, is quite fitting. It has 'Cohinem's' name engraved on it; it should be a beloved item of that 'Queen of Calamity'..."
With a plan in mind, Klein finally relaxed and refocused his attention on Mr. Tower's crimson star, wanting to continue watching the "live stream."
But at this moment, the sun-like golden light on the star symbolizing Mr. Tower slowly dissipated... The "live stream" was also forcibly cut off.
Cut off again... Mr. Tower, can't you use "Exorcism Holy Light" to "renew" the fees for more time at once?
He complained inwardly, but Klein, unable to spy anymore, could only accept reality.
However, he didn't immediately "return" to the washroom. Instead, he manifested the scene of "Tower" and Goddess Lilith's conversation that he had previously "seen" and reviewed it again.
"Lilith goes without saying... The God of Knowledge had dealings with Liu Bo during his Daniel incarnation, so his involvement isn't surprising...
"But the Goddess clearly intervened this time, perhaps even as the mastermind!
"Is She supporting Lilith's return to godhood? But if so, wouldn't that offend the 'Earth Mother Goddess'?
"Although I don't know why true gods of adjacent pathways fight each other, just by looking at the hostility between the 'Lord of Storms,' the 'God of Knowledge and Wisdom,' and the 'Eternal Blazing Sun,' one can tell that true gods don't want there to be a 'god' in adjacent pathways!
"Will the 'Earth Mother Goddess' have an opinion because of this? Will Mr. Moon's situation become awkward because of this?
"And me... Goddess Lilith and the 'Earth Mother Goddess' have both 'invested' in 'The Fool,' so in the future, when They contend, what stance should I choose?
"But Mr. Tower doesn't seem worried... Logically, he would be the first to face a choice...
"Could it be that he really managed to appease all the goddesses?
"Forget it... I'm just a weak and pitiful Sequence 6 now; no one will force me to take a side immediately... I'll find an opportunity to ask Mr. Tower when we talk in detail privately later."
Thinking this, he recalled the past when he made an oath by pressing his hand on the Goddess's holy artifact in Tingen, and couldn't help but sigh: "Although I'm not entirely clear about my role in this event, from how I was 'reasonably and logically' arranged to be involved, I can tell that the Goddess has probably been observing me for a long time...
"Perhaps I was discovered from the moment I transmigrated... After all, there have been several transmigrators in this world, and there's also Liu Bo who can continuously transmigrate.
"I just don't know if Liu Bo and the Goddess have as close a relationship as he does with Lilith...
"It's really hard to say. When 'Tower' previously took out that summoning charm that brought out Lilith, he explained that it was 'bestowed by the Goddess'...
"This Goddess might be referring to the Evernight Goddess.
"If 'Tower' is indeed Liu Bo, then he could be called 'the goddesses' gigolo'... This is far more sophisticated than Roselle; no wonder the latter's diary is filled with jealousy between the lines..."
After complaining inwardly for a few sentences, Klein then noticed that in the scene he had "manifested," some key words were deliberately blurred, preventing him from discerning what Lilith had said.
And he seemed to have subconsciously overlooked it when he was watching the "live stream"...
Klein frowned, then manifested paper and pen, wrote down a sentence, and leaned back, intending to use "dream divination" to recall what he had just seen and heard.
Soon, he woke up, but his frown deepened because the scene in his dream was consistent with what he had manifested, and several keywords remained unintelligible.
"Such interference... Is it the power of a true god?" Klein thought for a moment, then wisely gave up the idea of continuing to investigate, not wishing to court death by "divining" the source of the interfering power.
"One 'Eternal Blazing Sun' almost destroyed this palace... This time, I might be watched by three deities!"
With lingering doubts, he simulated the feeling of falling and returned to the washroom, waiting for his "reward" to arrive.
.....
Chapter 784: Return to the City of Miracles
Deep in the passage, seeing the "water mirror" vanish, Ebner carefully asked: "Amon should have seen you just now. Even if this clone dies, his main body will definitely receive some information."
"And I am overtly a favored one of the 'Earth Mother Goddess'... Will this attract unnecessary suspicion? Will it disrupt your future plans?"
He hadn't worried about this before, as the first floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" was near the entrance of the "Chaos Sea." Without Roselle, the insider, even the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" couldn't "know" what exactly happened, let alone other deities.
The only flaws existed in Taylors, Edwina, and Sharon, but Ebner assumed that the Goddess and the God of Knowledge would surely clean up after them once they left the "Dream Labyrinth Tower."
But Lilith had so openly let Amon see her... This was somewhat beyond Ebner's expectations.
Upon hearing this, Lilith waved her hand, doing something unknown, then smiled and explained: "Letting other deities know that Lilith is recovering was part of the original plan."
"But it couldn't be too deliberate, otherwise the motive would be suspected... So, using Amon is reasonable. After all, Roselle's 'Men in Black' base was very specifically designed against Amon... Hmm, that's the function of the 'Crow's Lasso.'"
"But he didn't know that Amon had already suffered this loss in the mid-Fourth Epoch and was prepared against that secret art. So, even with a renewed arrangement combining 'Mystical Reproduction,' the fact that he still sent out some information appears perfectly reasonable."
"Crow's Lasso"... That mischievously named item was probably also created by some "transmigrator," right?
However, if Lilith deliberately revealed her recovery, what could her objective be?
After several thoughts crossed his mind, Ebner tentatively asked: "Is it still the 'Silver Moon Project'?"
"Yes." Lilith nodded slightly, then added, "Furthermore, you don't need to worry about being a favored one of the 'Earth Mother Goddess.'"
"This event can be explained as Evernight and Lilith concealing a conspiracy they had with you and the 'Earth Mother Goddess,' and then using you to complete the arrangements."
"Although the 'Earth Mother Goddess' will be angry, She won't blame you and will continue to favor you... It's just that Her attitude towards Evernight will be slightly colder, but there won't be a complete break... After all, Lilith is currently only an Angel King, not yet at the point of conflict with Her."
"As for Lilith seemingly favoring you as well... that's even less strange."
"After all, situations where a follower of 'Knowledge' serves as a favored one for multiple entities have happened before; the high-ranking members of other churches are accustomed to it."
This... Should I say she's truly the "Two-Five Dragon"?
I wonder if this is the influence of Her personality on Her pathway, or if She deliberately allowed this situation to set up the current trap?
Hmm, most likely the former.
Ebner was speechless for a long while. Just as he was about to take out the wine bottle, a mixture of "Black Knight," "Ancient Alchemist," and other characteristics, to ask how to deal with it, Lilith suddenly spoke first:
"The time for the historical projection is almost up. After supporting my combat for so long, it seems even Antigonus can't withstand such consumption."
"Of course, it might also be Evernight interrupting..." At this point, she opened her mouth but no longer made a sound, only managing to change the subject: "This Dream Labyrinth Tower, having lost Roselle and Zaratul, is now ownerless."
"But it's not something you can control yet, nor have you truly completed the main quest of the first floor... So, come back after you reach Sequence 3... Only then will you have some chance of pulling it out of the 'Chaos Sea.'"
"Additionally, to prevent other entities behind 'tower climbers' from seizing this tower, I have just cut off the connection between the fifth and fourth floors."
"To enter the upper four floors again, one must use the entrance in 'Groselle's Travels.'"
"Other 'tower climbers' outside will only be able to reach the fifth floor at most in the future."
"Furthermore, the first five floors deep within the Collective Consciousness Sea will slowly lose their abilities over the next few years until they completely dissipate."
At this point, Lilith already felt her projection was at its limit, so she quickly added another instruction:
"One of the miracles you 'bought' should involve Evernight's plan..."
Before her voice faded, Lilith's beautiful figure completely disappeared.
And at the same time, because the scene ended, Ebner, Klein, Edwina, and even Taylors and Sharon, who were still in the first layer of the world, were sent outside the "Labyrinth Tower."
Because the connection between the fifth and fourth floors was cut off, Taylors and Sharon did not return to their respective entry points. Instead, they were all sent to the City of Miracles, Leviathan.
When Ebner regained his vision, he saw the gate behind the throne. The "Dream Labyrinth Tower" was separated from this city by the gate on the other side.
"Where is this?" Taylors asked in surprise, looking at the huge building not far away.
Sharon didn't speak, but her eyes went directly to Klein, hoping for an answer.
"This is the Kingdom of the Dragon of Imagination, Liveseyd!"
After Klein answered, he and Ebner and Edwina exchanged glances. The three then tacitly began to cast secret arts, activate abilities, and rein in their thoughts...
After all, at the end of the steps was the Hall of Honesty!

chapters.title: Chapter 782: The Hall of Honesty
chapters.content:
Chapter 782 - The Hall of Honesty
With a hint of inexplicable anticipation, Klein led Sharon and the others up the stairs, rounded the enormous throne, and returned to the Hall of Honesty.
The murals also came into the view of Sharon and Taylors, who were seeing them for the first time.
"This mural depicts humans building a city... This one shows scenes of war and migration... Dragons truly have no artistic flair. These paintings are overly crafted; though seemingly realistic, they lack any sense of beauty... Fortunately, the long history imbues them with gravitas...
"Huh? No, this is what I'm thinking, why am I saying it out loud?
"No, it's not me speaking... it's this 'Hall' that's the problem!"
Taylors muttered to himself as he looked at the murals, but he quickly heard his own voice and swiftly identified the problem.
At the same time, Sharon's voice echoed around them, but it lacked her usual ethereal quality and instead sounded a bit playful:
"A story of a warrior defeating an evil dragon? So cliché... I stopped liking it when I was four..."
By this point, Sharon, hearing her own voice, had reacted. She instinctively looked at Klein and Ebner, who were secretly observing her, and immediately understood something. Her inner voice transmitted again:
"They aren't transmitting their inner thoughts... Did they prepare beforehand?
"Ill-intentioned Sherlock... Ebner, who loves to watch a good laugh... Edwina, whose exterior doesn't match her interior..."
Hearing her words, Ebner immediately curled his lips but forcibly suppressed his laughter with a "Secret Art."
Though Klein had reined in his thoughts, he was also amused by Sharon's chattering and couldn't help but let out a low chuckle that resonated through the hall.
And Edwina voiced her first thought: "Is this what Gehrman called 'contrast moe'?"
"'Contrast moe'?" Sharon, who was already trying to "restrain" her inner thoughts, couldn't help but inwardly mumble.
"'Contrast moe'... It's a term Gehrman coined the last time he passed through here. He said then that he wanted to see your 'contrast moe.'" Edwina, with her "Mechanical Mind" active, had an "iceberg" expression on her face, and her inner thoughts were equally devoid of emotion.
Seeing Sharon glance back at him, Klein outwardly put on a Gehrman-esque cold demeanor, but his inner thoughts betrayed his true nature: "Don't talk nonsense... My exact words were definitely not that! Spreading rumors is against the law!"
"The 'Mad Adventurer'..." "Vice Admiral Iceberg" muttered inwardly, recalling Ebner's previous introduction of him.
But to Klein's ears, it sounded somewhat sarcastic.
This made him sigh inwardly: "Why am I still the unlucky one, even after preparing?"
"Sherlock, who wants to pry into my inner thoughts." Sharon concluded inwardly, observing Klein seriously for a moment.
At this moment, names began to sound out nearby; it was Taylors mentally listing his "friends" to distract himself from thinking anything rude.
At first, it was nothing, but as more and more names of various "madames" appeared later, Ebner's and Klein's expressions both grew strange.
Ebner released part of the effect of his "Secret Art," letting his inner voice out: "Your choice of friends seems to be getting more and more... peculiar."
"I once traveled in Intis for a while... They are all very enthusiastic towards friends," Taylors unconsciously replied inwardly.
After hearing his own "words," he couldn't help but stiffen, then "composedly" thought:
Well, men will be men, it's normal. And we 'Readers' also have this kind of charm... This is our true inner self!
He tried to drag Ebner down with him... Unfortunately, what he didn't know was that the latter had already developed an "anti-social death art" for such environments.
"Is that why the 'Eternal Blazing Sun' Church has a 20,000 Firkal bounty on your head?" Edwina's cold voice then rang out.
Firkal is the official currency of Intis; 1 gold pound is roughly equivalent to 1.5 Firkal.
"Haha..." Taylors cleared his mind, only letting out an awkward chuckle.
"What did he do?" Sharon's voice followed, carrying a hint of curiosity.
Is Sharon's inner emotion so rich? Then it must be really hard for her to 'restrain' herself normally...
Klein couldn't help but think.
"It's precisely because I have many thoughts that I need to 'restrain' them... If there were no thoughts, 'restraint' wouldn't exist," Miss Sharon's inner voice spoke halfway before she self-"restrained."
"Among the list of madames he just recited, quite a few surnames belong to bishops and deacons of the 'Eternal Blazing Sun' Church..." At this moment, Edwina's answer also rang out.
But before her inner thoughts were complete, she gathered a "light orb" in her hand, a secret art she had developed for recording others' images. She used it because, after analysis, she believed that by diligently recording others' "inner voices," her own thoughts would be fewer.
"But why was Roselle fine back then?" Klein subconsciously wondered. He had read many diary entries about this; "The Great Emperor worked tirelessly to gain the support of the 'Eternal Blazing Sun Church'!"
"Because I'm a member of the 'Church of Knowledge'..." Taylors seemed to have found the trick to controlling his thoughts, answering the question helplessly in his mind, "In this regard, even 'Tyrant' is more reasonable than 'Eternal Blazing Sun'!"
Seeing that Sharon and Taylors had both passed the "surprise attack" phase and managed to control their thoughts, and Klein was no longer so easily "agitated" after Sharon restrained her thoughts, while Edwina had even found a coping method, Ebner decided not to stay in this city any longer. So, after leading the few of them to view all the murals, he summoned his "Bone Dragon" and flew everyone out of the City of Miracles, Liveseyd.
.....
In the "Kaspersky" base beneath Tosk.
When the former Pope of the "Eternal Blazing Sun Church," Aurbach, was resurrected in the body of the Delian family's "Black Knight," Cero, with the help of Lilith's utilization of Roselle's arrangements, the acting commander of the "Men in Black" immediately knelt down excitedly, proclaiming loudly: "Your Majesty, 'Spade 1' welcomes your return!"
Aurbach looked at the young man kneeling before him, sorted through the extra segment of Roselle's memories, and then suddenly chuckled: "You are 'Heart 1,' aren't you?"
This head of secret agents appeared respectful on the surface, but his words were full of "probing."
"Your Majesty, please forgive my disrespect..." The young man "trembled" as he prostrated himself, his voice fervent, "I knew it! According to the prophecy, when Your Majesty's bloodline... those who deceive the world... descendants of knights... and those who ignore the 'Rat Path' arrive successively, you would truly be resurrected! It truly is so!"
"Caution is necessary, but such probing can be done once or twice, but not thrice." Aurbach chuckled, first giving a warning, then directly pointing out the flaw in his words: "'Foolish one'!"
Upon hearing this, the young man's trust level in the person before him increased to fifty percent, making him feel that this person might indeed be His Majesty returned.
It's just that "resurrection" in the body of the original "sacrifice" is still very strange... His Majesty is not a Beyonder of the "Hanged Man" pathway...
Numerous thoughts swirled in the young man's mind as he secretly attempted to steal the "Black Knight's" thoughts, but failed.
This made him realize that the person before him was at least at the Angel level.
Is it really His Majesty?
Just as the young man's thoughts raced, he saw the supposed "Black Knight" stand up and stretch his limbs, then ordered in a familiar tone:
"You must evacuate this base immediately, otherwise Amon might come knocking at any time. I currently lack the ability to protect you further."
"Additionally, instruct any remaining 'Men in Black' to keep a low profile recently and avoid Amon's retaliation."
"Finally, I will return to Trier using this body's identity... Unless I summon you, try to avoid any further contact with me."
After speaking, he used the partial memories he had gained to walk to an emergency evacuation point in the base, and under the young man's gaze, he initiated a ritual and left the underground space.
The young man watched his disappearing figure, feeling that something was amiss, but he quickly calmed down, pondering:
"His Majesty once said, 'What's real can't be fake, and what's fake can't be real'... Although this may not be entirely accurate in the mystical world, it's suitable for this matter."
"If he is fake, he will expose flaws eventually through contact... I just need to avoid accepting overly dangerous orders from him during this time."
.....
In an old apartment on Riverbank Street, Saint George Borough, Backlund.
Daly leaned into Dunn's ear and chuckled softly: "I'm pregnant... and you still owe me a wedding."
Although it had been less than a month, for a Beyonder, for a "Spirit Guide," she clearly felt the loss of characteristics and the new "life" in her womb.

chapters.title: Chapter 783: The Prophet’s Ritual
chapters.content:
Chapter 783 - The Prophet's Ritual
Hearing Daly's words, Dunn, who had his arm around her shoulders, showed a look of joy, but more than that, he seemed dazed.
Not getting the expected reaction, Daly raised her slender eyebrows, her sparkling green eyes sweeping over Dunn, and asked with a strange tone, "My dear, you don't seem surprised?"
As if sensing "danger," Dunn finally came to his senses. He organized his thoughts and said hesitantly, "I suddenly 'fell asleep' just now... You know, for a 'Soul Assurer,' that's not normal."
"Suddenly fell asleep?" Daly also grew serious upon hearing this. She casually summoned the nearby specters who were on "alert" and asked them if there had been any intruders...
After receiving a negative answer, she thoughtfully asked, "What did you encounter in your dream? Did you learn about my pregnancy?"
Dunn nodded, then, after a moment of hesitation, said in a very complex tone, "I... I heard the Goddess's oracle in my dream."
"The Goddess..." Daly was immediately startled, then became fearful... After all, she, who privately prayed to "The Fool," and Dunn, who had left the Nighthawks after his resurrection, had theoretically both betrayed the Church of Evernight...
Although they still believed in the great "Queen of Calamity and Terror."
After a long while, she gradually came to realize that the Goddess might not have blamed them, otherwise, She wouldn't have given Dunn an oracle.
Daly forced herself to calm down, took a deep breath, and asked, "Can you be sure it was the Goddess's oracle?"
This was very important.
"There's no mistake!" As the former captain of the Nighthawks squad, as a "Soul Assurer" of the "Darkness" pathway, Dunn could still distinguish truth from falsehood.
"Goddess... did She have any commands?" Daly couldn't help but feel nervous, knowing that the message Dunn had just revealed might involve her child.
Could it be that this child shouldn't be born?
Just as Daly's mind raced, Dunn finally recovered from the shock of receiving the oracle. He saw his beloved's fear, and after a moment's thought, understood the reason. He quickly reassured her:
"Don't worry... In fact, the Goddess also provided a solution to our marriage problem..."
Daly, sensing that her beloved wasn't telling a well-intentioned lie, let out a long breath and asked curiously, "What solution?"
"The solution is for you to pray to Mr. Fool... and convey a message to that existence..."
.....
In the "Ritual Chamber" beneath the Surrey family estate in Tosk.
Klein, Edwina, and Ebner, holding the Blasphemy cards of "Black Emperor," "Error," and "Door" respectively, once again opened the door to the world of imagination, leading Sharon and Taylors back to reality.
Upon seeing their "masters" return, "Chessia," who had been waiting there, immediately came forward, and Ebner took the opportunity to have the Magic Mirror release the demon, re-occupying her body.
—Relying solely on "hypnosis" to replace personalities was, after all, not entirely reassuring.
Having reached this point, and thus out of the "dangerous" territory, Ebner distributed the rewards Lilith had entrusted him with to the others.
Without dwelling on Edwina's oil lamp and Sharon's parasol, Klein, after receiving the "Moon" card, merely glanced at it, and his mouth couldn't help but twitch. To maintain Gehrman's persona, he swallowed the question that was on the tip of his tongue: "Does the 'Apothecary' pathway also change a person's gender?"
It was Ebner who, discerning a clue from Klein's prolonged stare at the card, regretted not distributing the rewards before the Hall of Honesty. He briefly explained:
"Sequence 1 of the 'Apothecary' pathway is called the 'Beauty Goddess.'"
Hearing this, Klein jumped, thinking his inner thoughts had accidentally leaked again. When he remembered that they had already left "Groselle's Travels," he relaxed and then mused:
"Beauty Goddess"... I've heard that name before. I didn't expect it to be a gender-changing sequence too... So, Emlyn will become Emeline later?
But this is Sequence 1; it actually has nothing to do with most Beyonders of the 'Apothecary' pathway...
However, with the "Demoness" card first, and now the "Moon" card, is this helping me complete my acting as quickly as possible?
Could it be that acting as a "female" is more conducive to the digestion of a "Faceless"?
Hmm, overcoming psychological barriers and creating a mental state that is both integrated and detached might be one of the "Faceless" acting principles.
Just as Klein was habitually summarizing, the "Prophet" Taylors, on the other side, held the ruby-transformed "Blood Fairy" in his palm, staring at her intently, making the newly born, thumb-sized "little girl" incredibly shy.
"You should restrain yourself... Although she is a reward from a deity, she is also a favored one of that entity," Ebner couldn't help but "threaten" him.
Taylors then noticed his loss of composure and, to avoid misunderstanding, quickly explained: "She can actually display a partial, incomplete mythical form even in her normal state... This is a very attractive research topic for me."
"Although some 'Devils' can also do it, they are clearly not as cooperative."
Hearing this, Ebner's heart stirred. Recalling the information Lilith had revealed when she handed him the "Blood Fairy," he tentatively asked: "Is studying 'incomplete mythical forms' important for a 'Prophet'?"
Upon being asked, Taylors first made the "Blood Fairy" revert to a ruby, then looked at Ebner with a half-smile for a few moments, and finally organized his words:
"If it were anyone else asking, I definitely wouldn't answer easily...
"But since it's Your Excellency, the 'Favored One,' this is not an unspeakable secret. Telling you also counts as fostering our friendship...
"Hmm, as far as I know, the ritual for advancing to a 'Prophet' requires a deep understanding of the essence of at least three 'incomplete mythical creatures.' Only after fully analyzing their models can one consume the potion."
"And the more 'incomplete mythical creatures' one masters, and the broader the scope of knowledge, the higher the probability of successful advancement."
Fully analyze at least three "incomplete mythical creatures"? This sounds simple, but the difficulty is not low at all! After all, no demigod would willingly let others "deeply" study them, right?
So, one either has to possess powerful strength to capture target demigods and forcibly detain them for "analysis," or one must have the charm to make others willingly submit to your research...
No wonder most "Readers" have the persona of "having a wide circle of friends," and no wonder the "Church of Knowledge" even encourages its members to make friends with people from other organizations and churches.
From this perspective, "Readers" and "Seers" are quite similar; they are both pathways that apply "Relationship Studies" and "Interpersonal Communication Studies"!

chapters.title: Chapter 784: The Looming Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 784 - The Looming Shadow
After the rewards from the Vampire Ancestor were distributed, "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina, having put away "Silent Winter," paused for a few seconds. She then picked up "Groselle's Travels" from the altar and handed it to Ebner, stating, "The deities wish for you to keep this book."
Looking at the parchment-bound volume in Edwina's hand, Ebner understood that this was likely the "God of Knowledge and Wisdom" bestowing rewards. This copy of "Groselle's Travels," which concerned the ownership of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," was indeed what he needed most.
So, Ebner accepted it without hesitation.
Next, Edwina took out the "Error" card and, handing it to Klein, simply said, "This is yours."
For her, since the knowledge contained within the "Blasphemy Card" had already been recorded, the card itself held little appeal. Thus, even when the deity instructed her to give the card to Gehrman, she felt little regret.
Klein, having watched the "live stream" earlier, also knew this was a reward from a "deity," so he didn't bother with formalities. He enveloped the card with his spirituality and tucked it into his pocket.
"The 'Error' card... According to Mr. Tower's 'scope' theory, it should belong to the three 'Bizarre' pathways... It should be very compatible with that mysterious space above the gray fog... Hmm, I'll test it out later."
While thinking this, Klein saw Edwina retrieve a circular brass plate engraved with numerous runes and present it to Sharon, briefly introducing it: "This is a charm sealed with a demigod-level 'secret art' that can create 'golden armor' to resist divine attacks."
This charm was given to her by Madam Isabella as a life-saving contingency, but it wasn't used until the first floor's scenario ended.
It now seemed that there was indeed a deity's arrangement behind this; otherwise, a deity wouldn't casually allow a follower's private item to be given away.
Miss Sharon did not immediately take the charm. She first looked at Klein, and only after he gently nodded did she pick up the charm, concisely saying, "Thank you."
With Sharon's acceptance, Edwina's "distribution" task concluded. As for Taylors and herself, their rewards had already been received beforehand.
Since there were no Beyonders of the "Sleepless" pathway among those present, the Goddess's "reward" was unlikely to arrive quickly. So, after "Chessia" retrieved the "Book of Stars" and the "Book of Concealment," Ebner used short-range "teleportation" to bring everyone to the room where he had set up the "Teleportation Altar."
—Although the "Book of Concealment" failed to fulfill its mission of stealing Zaratul's "resurrection" miracle, having been used twice, it was still in a semi-damaged state. According to Ebner's observation, it would completely disintegrate after at most one more use.
Speaking of which, Ebner had originally wanted to arrange a dinner for these friends who had fought side-by-side, but because they had been delayed for several days in the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," aside from Klein, who seemed somewhat interested, both Edwina and Sharon were eager to return home.
Among them, Taylors, upon hearing that they were in Tosk, showed a thoughtful expression, then took his leave first and departed alone.
Meanwhile, Ebner activated the "Teleportation Ritual," first sending Sharon to Backlund, and then returning with Klein and Edwina to the basement of the "Aromatic Manor" in Bayam.
.....
The luxurious suite at the "Azure Wind" hotel.
Danitz, who had returned late at night after carousing at a bar, unknowingly fell asleep. He dreamed that the Captain finally came to find him, but she and "Vice Admiral of Ailment" Tracy were following behind Gehrman Sparrow, like maids, clearly having been subdued by him.
Just as Danitz was seething with indignation and about to go find the equally terrifying Detective Bryan or "Doctor Strange" to rescue the Captain, he suddenly saw the blurry surroundings become clear, settling into the hotel's luxurious suite.
Thump, thump, thump.
Danitz heard a slow, rhythmic knocking at the door.
Am I not dreaming?
Danitz, holding onto this doubt, walked to the door and twisted the handle.As the gap in the door widened, he saw a familiar figure.
It was a beautiful lady with an oval face, a high nose bridge, thin lips, and a pair of light blue eyes like clear spring water.
Her brown hair was parted in the middle, tied simply yet elegantly at the back of her head, then flowed smoothly downwards.
She wore no hat, dressed in a blue mage robe cinched at the waist, with a large, palm-sized flower-shaped decoration woven from white lace extending downwards from the collar. It was none other than Edwina!
And beside her, two gentlemen followed.
They were dressed similarly and both wore gold-rimmed glasses, though one was young and handsome, the other mature and stern. They were Ebner and Klein.
"Captain!" Danitz exclaimed.
He immediately turned around, blocking Gehrman and Ebner, shouting:
"Run, Captain! This lunatic has teamed up with the detective; I can't hold them off for long!"
As his heroic self-sacrifice surged, Danitz heard his Captain frown and ask:
"What exactly did you dream of just now?"
I dreamed you were captured and made into a maid...
Danitz mumbled, then instantly realized that the letter the Captain had left earlier indeed said she would return with her companions...
So, he stopped his obstruction, enduring Ebner's and Klein's strange gazes, and sheepishly said, "I... I was still half asleep..."
"You are still in a dream right now," Edwina calmly stated.
A dream... Right, I'm dreaming, what's there to be afraid of... Danitz thought this, recalling relevant lessons from the "Golden Dream" ship, and suddenly understood:
"Captain, have you simulated a 'Nightmare's' ability?"
"This is a 'Dreamwalker's' ability... But it's close enough," Ebner interjected at this point, asking with slight confusion:
"What did you do? Why are there several people staking you out outside the hotel?"
.....
Inside the three-story building near the Bayam Governor's Mansion, an open and unrestrained dance party hosted by the "Celestial Sect" was underway.
The daughter of a gang boss, the Governor's mistress, and the sect's "Fertility Emissary," Miss Abby, guided a subordinate to climax just as the dance music ended.
Leaning against him, she asked in a husky voice, "Has that adventurer still not returned?"
"Pant... pant... Yes, Miss... We haven't found his ticket purchase record at the ticketing company... He should still be on Blue Mountain Island, possibly exploring the mountains." The subordinate replied, still out of breath.
Abby, hearing this, thought for a moment as her finger traced down his cheek. She then inquired, "Besides that servant, does he have any other relatives or friends?"
"According to information our people obtained from within the 'Demoness Sect,' he should be the adventurer who previously rescued 'Vice Admiral of Ailment' Tracy," the subordinate replied.
"Tracy, you say? Troublesome... but for the Mother Tree's mission, sacrifice is necessary." Abby nodded thoughtfully. As her finger moved, she continued to ask, "I remember the last intelligence report said she was actually being hunted by her mother?"
"Yes, Miss..." Although the subordinate was excited again, he still offered a reminder, "Our people are probably not enough to deal with a Pirate Admiral."
"I know... If necessary, I will act personally."
As her words fell, the subordinate's eyes instantly lost focus. When they regained it, his eyes held nothing but Miss Abby.
If a Beyonder were to use Spirit Vision at that moment, they would discover that his spiritual body was tightly entwined by brown branches.
My condition isn't good today, stomachache, brain's foggy, so this is all for now.

chapters.title: Chapter 785: The Increasingly Unlucky "Vice Admiral of Ailment"
chapters.content:
Chapter 785 - The Increasingly Unlucky "Vice Admiral of Ailment"
Atop the bell tower attached to the Church of Storms, Jahn Kottman, Cardinal of the Church of Storms and High Deacon of the Mandated Punisher, stood at the edge, gazing at the invigorating sea and the mountains stretching along the coastline into the distance.
—The pollution level in Bayam was quite low because mining and smelting industries were located in other cities on the island. Here, the pillars were the spice trade, brothels, and casinos—a hub for goods and transit—with no established industry. Heating coal was used infrequently due to the agreeable climate.
"Sea King" Jahn Kottman had just withdrawn his gaze when he saw a Mandated Punisher run up the winding stairs.
"Your Excellency Kottman, new intelligence," the Mandated Punisher said, striking his left chest with his right fist.
"What is it?" the well-built Jahn Kottman asked, turning around.
The Mandated Punisher handed him a slip of paper:
"According to information from our informant within the Resistance, they received a response from Kalvetua a few days ago and are now shaping a new idol."
"A new idol?" Jahn Kottman unfolded the paper and quickly scanned it.
He then turned his head to look towards the vast jungle of Blue Mountain Island, pondering for a moment:
"Search for anomalous areas in the Rorsted Archipelago waters."
From this intelligence, he confirmed one thing: the mysterious person who took Kalvetua's remaining characteristics had not left the Rorsted Archipelago waters. This could be accurately judged from the fact that the individual was able to impersonate Kalvetua's response to his followers.
At the same time, Jahn Kottman was well aware that the Beyonder characteristics left behind by Kalvetua, who had completely lost control before his death, whether they formed actual items or not, must have severe negative effects and would inevitably cause anomalies in the surrounding area.
And finding the correct sealing method would not be easy.
Even if found, responding to prayers would be uncontrollable, revealing anomalies.
This was the clue!
"Yes, Your Excellency Kottman, the Storm be with you!" The Mandated Punisher saluted and was about to leave when Kottman called him back:
"Have any members of the 'Demoness Sect' visited the Rorsted Archipelago waters recently?"
The "Sea King" still remembered the image of the woman he had replayed in the "water screen" within Kalvetua's hidden ruin. From his intuition, she must have been a Demoness.
"'Vice Admiral of Ailment' Tracy encountered a squad from the 'Demoness Sect' chasing her on Symeem Island last week." As this case was ultimately handled by the squad led by this very Mandated Punisher, he remembered it clearly and answered directly.
"Symeem? I recall the previous intelligence report mentioned someone found an elven ruin on that island, didn't it?"
"Yes, Your Excellency... The timing was just before Kalvetua lost control... So we suspect there might be a connection between them." The Mandated Punisher realized something at this point as well. "You mean... 'Vice Admiral of Ailment' Tracy and the 'Demoness Sect' squad pursuing her might be involved?"
"Kalvetua's hidden ruin is of elven temple style... The ruin discovered on Symeem Island was also built by ancient elves... A Demoness took Kalvetua's remnant... And a Demoness appeared on Symeem Island just before Kalvetua lost control..."
"Hmph! Once is a coincidence, how can it be a coincidence every time?!" "Sea King" Kottman snorted.
The Mandated Punisher nodded in realization, then hesitated before revealing new intelligence, "One of the 'privateer captains' we support, well, a bishop named Alger, previously reported that the 'Celestial Sect' is deliberately approaching His Excellency the Governor and promoting their sect's ideology through him."
"And just recently, we received news that they also issued a mission to find members of the 'Demoness Sect' and the 'Vice Admiral of Ailment.'"
"Alger? Is that the Captain who reported the anomaly at Bansy Harbor?" His Excellency Kottman asked with interest.
"Yes, that's him." This Mandated Punisher member clearly had a good relationship with Alger; this was indirectly giving him credit.
Kottman was well aware of this but saw no issue, as all this intelligence was valuable.
"In that case, keep an eye on this 'sect.' Although they haven't shown much harm yet... I have a premonition that behind them might be one of our 'old friends,'" Kottman had also heard of the "Celestial Sect's" doctrines and already disliked them.
However, there were too many such rogue organizations, and this sect hadn't done anything too outrageous beyond messing with male-female relationships, so he hadn't bothered with them.
"As you command, Your Excellency."
.....
Aboard the "Black Death," Tracy, lightly wounded, allowed her blonde maid, Hilia, to help bandage her wounds.
She had just escaped another dangerous battle, once again fleeing from her father... no, her mother.
"The letter to Mother received no response... and because of it, Mother chased me again... What's going on? Is it possible that not just Mother, but even Mother is being controlled by some mastermind?"
"But she's an old immortal who's lived since the Fourth Epoch; she shouldn't be so easily manipulated... Or rather, even if she were, she wouldn't lack means of self-preservation."
"And my contact person in the organization also has problems; it'll probably be hard to find an opportunity to report this bizarre incident within a month or two..."
"But can I even hide for a month or two? If Mother is truly controlled and she personally intervenes..."
At this thought, Tracy even felt a pang of despair.
But she quickly cast aside such weak thoughts and began to consider countermeasures.
"Enter the 'Raging Sea'! Only by entering the 'Raging Sea' can I temporarily block Mother and Mother's perception of me through our bloodline!"
"Once I disappear, the organization will inevitably investigate the entire affair, and there's a good chance they'll uncover the problem."
"And even if they don't, I can arrange for someone to find the 'Saintess of Darkness' before entering the 'Raging Sea.'"
She had just thought of this when commotion and shouts suddenly erupted outside the cabin. Tracy frowned. Just as she put on a piece of clothing, a sailor burst in, frantically reporting: "Captain! It's bad! The second mate and third mate have gone mad; they've killed the first mate!"
"What?" Tracy shot up. She rushed out of the cabin in a few strides, only to find that there was no battle on the deck as she had imagined. The "killed" first mate, along with the second and third mates, stood together, eyeing her greedily.
A bad premonition immediately arose in Tracy's heart. Just as she was about to use her accumulated prestige to question them, a sharp pain shot through the wound on her back, and she herself felt light-headed.
At this point, she noticed a faint, peculiar odor in the deck's air.
This odor, mixed among a group of pirates, was very subtle and had no adverse reactions... But when it came into contact with Tracy's wound, it transformed into a potent "sleeping" potion.
"Specifically targeting wounds? No... The medicine Hilia applied to me is problematic!"
Tracy struggled to turn her dizzy head, and then saw her blonde maid's face full of guilt.
"I'm sorry, Captain... But it was Madam's order... You actually don't have to resist; Madam won't truly harm you!" Hilia stammered, not daring to meet the Captain's eyes.
Madam? Ah, Mother... So Hilia was her person all along... I never knew...
Tracy saw her former subordinates closing in. In her current state, she couldn't use her Beyonder abilities, so she ignited her last bit of spirituality, activating the diamond-encrusted bracelet on her wrist.
Instantly, countless diamond-like crystals "grew" from her body, encasing her entirely.
Tracy mustered her last ounce of strength, using her control over the "Black Death" to make it lurch, tossing the crystal-encased self into the sea.
The pirates, caught off guard, failed to stop Tracy's actions. When they reacted, they all attacked the crystal, but were repelled by it, which only propelled it faster into the sea.
Seeing this, the few officers' faces turned ashen. They immediately ordered the "Sailor" pathway crew members to dive into the sea to retrieve it.
Unfortunately, the crystal seemed to have merged with the seawater, having already vanished.
.....
Bayam, in Danitz's dream.
After listening to the "Great Pirate," whose worth had increased to 4500 pounds, recount his experiences of the past few days, Ebner, Edwina, and Klein found nothing out of the ordinary.
Could it be that a bounty hunter saw through Danitz's disguise and intended to use him to find "Vice Admiral Iceberg"?
Ebner speculated.
Meanwhile, Klein noticed a detail in Danitz's words:
The Governor's Mansion invited me to a banquet? I have no relation to the Governor... Why invite me?
The reason given was that I am a recently famous hunter...
Hmm, could it be that they want to invite me to eliminate Detective Ebner Bryan?
Thinking of the bounty issued by the Governor on the black market, Klein couldn't help but look at "Tower" beside him...

chapters.title: Chapter 786: Goddess’s Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 786 - Goddess's Reward
Because of Klein's excellent "Clown" abilities, Ebner didn't detect his inner thoughts.
He pondered for a moment, signaled to Edwina with his eyes, and then left Danitz's dream.
