Their shared experiences in the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" had fostered considerabletacit understanding, so Edwina naturally understood Ebner's meaning.
But this scene struck Danitz as somewhat amiss... When did the Captain ever exchange glances like that with anyone? What exactly happened between that pretty-boy detective and the Captain?
Nothing much happened, just acted as a couple for a few days... Klein, easily seeing through Danitz's thoughts, answered his question inwardly.
If I weren't Gehrman, I could comfort you... But unfortunately, my current persona is the "Mad Adventurer."
In Klein's view, a woman like "Vice Admiral Iceberg," hailing from the Church of Knowledge, would surely prefer someone learned, someone with whom she could discuss problems and progress together.
Roselle likely used a similar approach when pursuing Princess Isabella of Lenburg.
So, Danitz's hopes are truly slim... Conversely, Mr. Tower has great potential, even if he doesn't actively pursue it...
Just as Klein's mind wandered, Ebner returned to the dream and shook his head at Klein and Edwina, saying, "The people tailing him are employed by the Governor's Mansion; they know nothing."
He now possessed numerous means, making it easy to subtly extract information from low-Sequence individuals or even ordinary people.
But Danitz didn't even notice such low-level surveillance? Edwina, are your teachings too biased? Although he has mastered various languages containing power, in many respects, he's utterly failing!
Because Ebner didn't conceal it, Edwina roughly "read" the meaning in his eyes and decided that upon their return, she absolutely had to catch him up on his lessons.
"Should we investigate the Governor's Mansion?" Klein, maintaining Gehrman's demeanor, asked coolly.
"No need... The Governor of Bayam is a member of the Lari family. Due to the actions of that family's Baron previously, he cannot remain in this position and will be dismissed within half a month at most."
"Once he's gone, the problem will resolve itself. Until then, just don't actively show yourselves."
After speaking, Ebner glanced at Klein.
He vaguely guessed who the mastermind was, but being in Bayam, far from Lilith's, the Evernight Goddess's, and the God of Knowledge's sphere of influence, how could he actively provoke that entity? Naturally, he spoke evasively.
Moreover, this was Klein's problem, and a large number of "investors" were naturally concerned about it.
Klein was startled by his gaze, then recalled Yalolan's warning to him, and considering the divination results he received above the gray fog before going to Tosk, he suddenly understood.
The divination then showed that if I didn't go to Tosk, I would encounter great danger... Could this danger refer to the Governor's banquet?
Has someone detected the special aura on me, and is using the Governor's influence to deal with me?
With thoughts rapidly swirling, Klein made a decision and resolved to temporarily leave Bayam.
Next, as it was already very late, and Edwina was reluctant to expose that the "Golden Dream" had a "Teleportation Altar" connected to the "Fragrant Manor," following Ebner's suggestion, the four quietly left the monitored hotel and temporarily checked into a suite provided by the "Amyris Leaf Bar."
Klein, assigned a single room, immediately sealed it with his spirituality upon entering, then walked four steps counter-clockwise and ascended above the gray fog.
—He had heard someone praying to "The Fool" back at the hotel.
This crimson star is... Madam Daly? Did something happen to the Captain?
Klein frowned, extending his spirituality.
Soon, he received the good news of Madam Daly's "pregnancy."
What is this? A "red invitation" that's unavoidable even in another world?
After complaining, Klein's attention shifted to another matter Madam Daly reported:
The Evernight Goddess actually gave the Captain an oracle, asking "The Fool's" favored one to find a way to enter behind the Chanis Gate of St. Samuel Cathedral?
What does this mean?
Hmm... According to the images seen from Arrodes, the Antigonus family's notebook should be behind the Chanis Gate of St. Samuel Cathedral...
So, is this the Goddess's reward for the "Dream Labyrinth Tower" incident? Or a test?
Tapping the edge of the ancient long table with his finger, Klein pondered for a while, then remembered another important question:
Who exactly is that favored one? Is it "The World," or "Tower"?
After hesitating for another moment, Klein vaguely had a plan...
"However, I still need to confirm some things with Mr. Tower!"
Klein thought this, casting his gaze upon "Tower's" crimson star. He looked for a long time, and finally sighed, seemingly having made some decision, and extended his spirituality.
As early as in the Hall of Honesty, Klein had intended to have a good talk with Mr. Tower, but after entering the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," he never found the time, and the environment there was not suitable for discussing "transmigrators," so he had endured until now.
.....
In the adjacent room, Ebner, who had long fallen into a deep sleep, was currently dreaming a very fantastical dream.
In the dream, he was in a tranquil world filled with plants like moonflowers and night-scented herbs, surrounded by boundless darkness, and faintly permeated with the scent of "Daniel Pure Dew."
Somewhat muddled, he continued to walk through the darkness until his cheek touched something soft.
Then, his glasses were removed, and then put back on.
Just as Ebner, who seemed to have lost the ability to think, was about to ask a question, he suddenly felt his body plummet rapidly, and then he sat up in bed.
Although the dream was fantastical, it felt very real... Ebner pondered for a moment, extending his spirituality to the gold-rimmed glasses on his nose, which was the entrance to the "Alvin's Quiz Labyrinth." To his surprise, he found that the 600,000 pounds he spent on two "miracles" had returned!
"Meaning, the reward given by the Goddess is 'reimbursement'? This is truly down-to-earth!"
Thinking about it carefully, in the original work, the Goddess had also reimbursed expenses for Her followers, just not in such a huge amount, so he felt relieved.
"At least I didn't make a request like solving 'constipation'..."
"However, since the Goddess can 'transfer money' in the 'Quiz Labyrinth,' it means She is most likely an authority holder! And I didn't see Her name in the previous four levels of authority, so She can only be the highest, Level Five authority holder!"
"That's right, to obtain the highest authority, answering questions is secondary; the key is to get 'Alvin Abraham's' permission..."
"And Alvin is currently in the Land of Night, and from the previous image I received, he most likely has a good relationship with the Goddess..."
"So, it's perfectly normal for the Goddess to have Level Five authority."
Just as he finished analyzing this, boundless gray fog appeared before Ebner's eyes, and he saw the image of "The World" requesting to meet him.
Ebner glanced at the next room with a strange expression, thinking:
If you want to meet, why not just come knock on the door? Do you need such "high-tech" stuff as "The Fool's" communication?
So... is this the showdown?

chapters.title: Chapter 787: Mutual Probing
chapters.content:
Chapter 787 - Mutual Probing
Ebner was actually well-prepared for the "showdown."
One could say that if Klein hadn't been so weak and inexperienced in the early days, making it difficult to keep secrets, Ebner might not have chosen to conceal things from him when he first entered the "Sefirah Castle."
After all, at that time, Ebner didn't know the attitude of the deities, especially the Evernight Goddess, towards true transmigrators like himself.
However, once he later discovered that there were many transmigrators like himself brought by the "Eye of Pure White," and that the Evernight Goddess, Lilith, and the God of Knowledge had long been aware of them and maintained a certain degree of goodwill, concealing things from Klein lost much of its meaning.
The reason he hadn't actively "showed his cards" to Klein was simply that he couldn't bear to give up the "fun" of the Tarot Club...
But Ebner's subsequent "concealment" wasn't very diligent, even perfunctory at times, which is why Klein probably noticed something amiss.
The "showdown" wasn't the problem; the only problem now was to what extent to "show."
"Hmm, Klein will most likely use 'The World,' meaning the identities of Klein, Sherlock, and Gehrman, to acknowledge me as a 'fellow countryman'... While 'The Fool's' disguise will most likely still be kept hidden..."
"I don't need to expose this... After all, if I expose it, knowing that 'The Fool' is actually a weakling, it would be harder for me to casually 'command' 'The Fool's' functions."
"Also, the truth about his 'transmigration' must be suppressed for now; it wouldn't be good if Mr. Fool developed psychological problems now... As for my true origin, that absolutely cannot be revealed..."
"Beyond these things, I can reveal a bit more, but I can't appear too 'mystical.'"
As he had deliberated many times before, Ebner quickly had a plan in mind. Only then did he pray to "The Fool," accepting "The World's" request for a meeting.
After waiting a few seconds, surging crimson light erupted before his eyes, engulfing everything.
Immediately, Ebner arrived above the gray fog, within the magnificent and ancient palace.
He looked around but didn't find "The World," yet he noticed a small room had appeared to the side, with its mahogany door slightly ajar.
Ebner curiously pushed the door open and saw a beautifully decorated living room. "The World" was sitting on a sofa in the room, watching the "television" hanging on the opposite wall.
This style is quite similar to the hotel room he and Sharon rented on the first floor of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower"... Was he inspired?
Glancing at the content on the "television," he saw it was "A Bite of Backlund," a show produced by "Bryan Film Company" starring Emlyn.
Is he trying to pressure me? However, to put on this act, your spirituality consumption must be considerable. Can you really sustain it?
A slight curve played on Ebner's lips as he sat on the sofa opposite Klein, watching with him.
As expected, in less than half a minute, Klein turned off the "television" and then looked at Ebner across from him, waiting for the other to initiate the conversation.
Next came over a minute of staring, and the room suddenly fell silent.
Finally, Klein, whose "spirituality" was limited, couldn't help but speak first: "Don't you have anything to say?"
Ebner thought for a moment and, obligingly, replied in Chinese: "The mountain is not high?"
"Its fame comes from the presence of immortals..." Klein subconsciously responded, and his face instantly darkened. After all, this poem, "Ode to the Humble Dwelling," was his "dark history." He had written it to deceive "Tower," thinking the latter wouldn't understand.
Now, he realized that when "Tower" taught Hazel to write this piece at Harvest Cathedral, it was absolutely intentional...
I actually thought it was all my "fault" back then... No, in a sense, it really was my "fault."
After grumbling a few words inwardly, Klein took a deep breath and took the opportunity to ask the question he most wanted to know: "When did you know I was a transmigrator?"
As soon as he spoke, he oddly found that the atmosphere wasn't as tense as before. He couldn't help but mock himself again: Does self-deprecating humor help alleviate awkwardness? But why does it have to be me?
Ebner had already prepared his response and answered with a smile: "From the very beginning."
The very beginning...
Klein stiffened again, instantly feeling that "self-deprecating humor" couldn't save him now.
Just as he was about to ask at what point "the very beginning" was, he heard Mr. Tower sigh and ask in return: "You wouldn't think that something as major as 'The Fool's' revival and the release of His 'container' from 'Sefirah Castle' would go unnoticed by deities, would you?
"At least the Evernight Goddess has always been paying attention, and the Mother Goddess of Earth happened to be in Tingen at that time."
Huh? He didn't guess that I am "The Fool"... But what is "Sefirah Castle"? Is it this space above the gray fog? He really knows a lot about this place; no wonder when I first pulled him up, he was deeply convinced of "The Fool's" divine identity. This might not only be because he knows "The Fool" is the name of Sequence 0 of the "Seer" pathway, but also related to his understanding of this space...
However, he still misunderstood my relationship with "The Fool," which is good news for me; my disguise wasn't completely stripped... But, what is a "container"? Why would he think I'm "The Fool's" container?
Finally, so I was being watched by two deities from the very beginning? Does that mean the Captain's "resurrection" by the Mother Goddess of Earth was indeed a favor to me?
With thoughts rapidly swirling, Klein stared at Ebner and asked, "So you deliberately joined the Tarot Club?"
"Is that your question, or Mr. Fool's question?" Ebner replied meaningfully.
He's confirming that my relationship with "The Fool" is very close... "Container," does that refer to a relationship like a deity's half-self? Like Danitz and the "Feared God"?
Thinking this, Klein cautiously replied indirectly on the surface: "You should know that Mr. Fool doesn't care about your motives or origins."
Good rhetorical skill...
Ebner praised inwardly, nodding: "I did deliberately join the Tarot Club, but later I genuinely came to like this organization... Otherwise, I wouldn't have pulled in 'Justice' and 'Magician.'"
"Although saying this here might sound like flattery, I must say, Mr. Fool is much more humane than I understood Him to be; He truly is a benevolent and kind deity."
Klein felt somewhat awkward being praised. He hadn't expected such a high evaluation from Mr. Tower, especially since he hadn't really done much and had even lost his Sealed Artifact.
No sooner had he thought this than Ebner "sincerely" lamented again: "You lost my 'Fallen Morning Star' during the battle with Ince Zangwill, but Mr. Fool chose to shoulder the 'debt' for you, fulfilling many of my rather excessive 'requests'... This undoubtedly shows Mr. Fool's magnanimity and His favoritism towards you!
"Praise Mr. Fool!"
Stop talking!
At this moment, Klein wished he could dig a hole in the floor with his toes, but he managed to control his expression using his "Clown" ability. He also stood up and piously said in the tone of a fervent believer: "Praise be to You, Mr. Fool."
And Ebner, witnessing this scene, struggled immensely not to burst out laughing...

chapters.title: Chapter 788: Klein’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 788 - Klein's Plan
"Of course, I'm equally grateful for Mr. Fool's leniency. After all, I deliberately used some 'garbled' diary entries to test Him before, yet He merely reprimanded me by providing a new interpretation of 'little girl' and teaching me how to write dates...
"This is truly a 'God of Justice' who genuinely believes in 'equivalent exchange.'
"Praise 'The Fool'!" Ebner praised again.
Those garbled pages were intentional? I hadn't thought about it that way before... So, those scandalous stories of Roselle were also intentional, right? At least, they weren't carefully filtered...
Fortunately, the persona I established is that of a deity who adheres to the principle of 'equivalent exchange.' Naturally, when receiving such diaries from others, I wouldn't refuse Mr. Tower's...
Otherwise, this alone would have made him suspicious... No, he must have been suspicious, otherwise, he wouldn't have tested me... It must have been the few 'miracles' I performed afterward that dispelled his doubts, right?
However, the Evernight Goddess, the Mother Goddess of Earth, and the Vampire Ancestor might know my true background, but they don't seem to have told 'Tower'...
Moreover, even though they are closely related to Liu Bo, they clearly haven't told Mr. Tower that things like the 'Seal of Calamity,' Duke Rhine, and 'Lord of the Undead' Vicente Miranda are also 'Liu Bo.'"
Perhaps this is for Mr. Tower's protection? He shouldn't know this information yet?
Klein forced himself to shift his focus and analyze and speculate, to avoid revealing any unusual expressions due to "shame."
This didn't last long. Once Ebner stopped his "praise," Klein said seriously: "Mr. Fool, though lenient, His leniency is not limitless."
"I understand," Ebner responded solemnly, then extended his hand with a smile. "Let's formally introduce ourselves. My name is Liu Bo. What do I call you?"
It really is you, Liu Bo!
Hearing Ebner introduce himself, Klein had no more excuses this time. While sighing inwardly, he also extended his hand and shook the other's, saying, "Zhou Mingrui... I transmigrated in 2018. What about you?"
"2021," Ebner replied without hiding.
2021... Why did he transmigrate so late, yet appear in this world during the early Fourth Epoch? Are the timelines of the two worlds perhaps misaligned?
Klein's heart trembled slightly; he dared not think too deeply, but he hesitated and still asked, "Do you know the reason for our transmigration?"
Upon hearing this, Ebner shook his head: "I'm not quite clear how I transmigrated, but it should be similar to the methods of other transmigrators like the 'Seal of Calamity,' Daniel, and Duke Rhine... It should be different from you and Roselle, and also different from the Creator in Silver City."
This is similar to what Old Huang said and what was recorded in Roselle's diary about the 'Seal of Calamity'... However, the Creator of Silver City? Was that Ancient Sun God really a transmigrator? No wonder he named his sons Adam and Amon, and influenced by him, the religions of this world are similar to the Western churches of my previous life...
But... our transmigration methods are different? In what way?
Klein thought this and asked.
Ebner thought for a moment, then pretended to ask Mr. Fool for permission to speak.
Klein was speechless, but he cooperated, having the "hidden" "Fool's" marionette emit a voice: "You may."
Only then did Ebner organize his words: "To my knowledge, you, Roselle, and the Evernight Goddess transmigrated by relying on 'Sefirah Castle'... while that Ancient Sun God emerged from the 'Sea of Chaos'..."
"The Evernight Goddess is also a transmigrator?" Klein was instantly dumbfounded, even his "Clown" ability couldn't mask his astonishment. Then, he suddenly understood, musing:
No wonder the Evernight Goddess paid attention to me as soon as I transmigrated... So, She also has the same origin... But She has already become a deity, yet hasn't returned to Her homeland... Is it impossible even for deities?
Since the Evernight Goddess is a transmigrator, what about Lilith, whose name is even more "suspicious"? Is the Vampire Ancestor also one?
Also, I heard the name 'Sefirah Castle' again... What does it refer to? This gray fog space, or that luminous door I can't enter?
With thoughts rapidly swirling, Klein first asked if Lilith was a transmigrator.
But Ebner wasn't sure either, and could only sigh: "I can't be certain... She seems very good to me, but the feeling I get from her is somewhat ethereal; I don't know where that goodness comes from... So I haven't found an opportunity to ask."
Is there a possibility that you had interactions with her in your previous life or lives? Hmm, from this, it seems Mr. Tower truly doesn't have memories of his past lives yet.
Klein also had no intention of telling him that Rhine, Miranda, "Seal of Calamity," etc., were all Liu Bo. After all, even the Vampire Ancestor, the Mother Goddess of Earth, and the Evernight Goddess, who were closely related to him, hadn't told him. This indicates that Mr. Tower shouldn't know this now, and if I blab, there might be adverse changes...
Of course, taking the opportunity to collect some "dirt" on Mr. Tower is just a side benefit and not worth mentioning.
"What is 'Sefirah Castle'?" Klein asked again, having processed a series of bombshell revelations.
"This place is 'Sefirah Castle'... or rather, within the scope of 'Sefirah Castle'! As for what it is..." Ebner paused, then meaningfully said: "The answer to that question isn't cheap, but since we're fellow countrymen recognizing each other today, I'll give you a discount..."
"What do you want?" Klein asked in a deep voice.
At the same time, he prayed to the Evernight Goddess, hoping "Tower" wouldn't demand too high a price.
"It's not troublesome. You should know that the 'Book of Concealment' is with me. Its essence is actually a 'Time Worm,' well, a dead 'Time Worm'...
"Currently, there's one left in the book, but utilizing it requires a ritual like the one in the 'Ritual Chamber,' which is very troublesome... So, I'd like you, as 'The Fool's' favored one, to ask Mr. Fool to help me turn it into a 'Concealment Charm.'"
"The specific method is recorded in the 'Book of Concealment.'" Ebner stated his request.
"Concealment Charm"? Klein remained outwardly calm, but was quite interested inwardly. However, he remembered his identity, so he only replied faintly: "I will consult Mr. Fool about it."
This Attendant of Mysteries act... Tsk!
Ebner praised him inwardly, then nodded and said, "Your word is enough."
With that, he organized his thoughts and said:
"Unlike the creation myths of various Churches, to my knowledge, the original Creator left behind nine different entities. Some are kingdoms, some are cities, some are rivers, some are oceans, some are keys. 'Sea of Chaos' and 'Sefirah Castle' are among them.
"These nine entities might be related to the 'Original Sefirot' recorded on the second 'Blasphemy Slate.'
"The black viscous liquid we saw on the first floor of the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower,' and the contamination Xio experienced earlier, were actually just phantoms of the 'Sea of Chaos.'
"If you want to know more, you can ask Arrodes...
"I happen to have a secret art for 'summoning' it."
Klein was originally pondering the "Original Sefirot," but hearing the last sentence, he couldn't help but inwardly complain:
Are all you Mysticism Magisters so enthusiastic about promoting these socially embarrassing spells? Stuart of the Church of Storms is like this, and so are you...
But unfortunately, Arrodes is very "obedient" in front of me; I don't need a secret art to find it... You should teach your "Vice Admiral Iceberg" that spell instead!
"Is all transmigration related to 'Original Sefirot'? Could it be that your reason for transmigration is also some kind of 'Original Sefirot'?" Klein speculated after a period of contemplation.
"Perhaps..." Ebner didn't actually know what was behind the "Eye of Pure White."
But his reason for transmigration definitely wasn't an "Original Sefirot."
After this topic, the two fell silent for a while before Klein brought up the conversation again, briefly mentioning the contents of Daly's report to Ebner and asking about the Evernight Goddess's attitude.
Earlier, Klein was somewhat wary, but after hearing that She was also a transmigrator like himself, his guard was somewhat lowered.
And "Tower" had even extracted the fact that the Evernight Goddess was a transmigrator, clearly indicating an unusual relationship with Her, and he must know something.
The Evernight Goddess took "Tower" away after the Great Smog; I even worried for a while... Now that I think about it, I was probably overthinking it...
Thinking this, Klein felt a bit regretful, believing he had underestimated Liu Bo's "ability."
Ebner, however, was unaware that Klein was inwardly "slandering" him. He was first surprised by Daly's pregnancy, but then relieved, as with Daly and Dunn constantly together, not getting pregnant would be strange.
Then he thought about the task the Evernight Goddess assigned regarding entering the Chanis Gate, as well as the state of the Land of Evernight after he had "cleansed" it with his "Pale Flame," and confidently told Klein: "Without a doubt, this is the Evernight Goddess's reward for you.
"It just comes with some trials."
Although he wasn't sure why the Evernight Goddess bothered with this extra step, Ebner believed She certainly had Her reasons.
"I see..." Klein nodded. He didn't know that entering the Chanis Gate would send him to the Land of Evernight; he only thought the reward was the Antigonus family's notebook.
As for the trials, he thought it might be "obstacles" deliberately set up because he had informed the Earth Mother.
"Oh, by the way, did you receive the Evernight Goddess's reward?" Klein asked casually, then felt he had asked a superfluous question, as surely if the Evernight Goddess gave a reward, it would be to him first.
"Yes, the Evernight Goddess reimbursed me for a 600,000-pound bill..."
Ebner answered with a smile, and as expected, saw Klein's mouth slowly fall open.
A 600,000-pound bill?
What did you buy that cost so much? And the Evernight Goddess actually "reimbursed" it?!
Should I say, as expected of "the Evernight Goddess's kept man"?
But why am I so envious... I even somewhat understand Roselle's feelings now!
Klein took a few deep breaths, skipped this "sad" topic, and instead started talking about his arrangements for Dunn and Daly: "I want to prepare a rich man's identity for Dunn, so he can marry Madam Daly under that identity and interact normally with the priests of St. Samuel Cathedral.
"When I return to Backlund in the future, I can take over this identity and naturally inquire about how to enter the Chanis Gate...
"If this identity isn't exposed even after that, I can use it to enter the upper echelons of Loen and uncover the truth behind the Great Smog!"
This plan previously had a flaw: Dunn and Daly would be implicated if exposed...
But now, since the Evernight Goddess is "one of us," there are no worries. The Evernight Goddess will surely make arrangements then.
"I've given this identity a name...
"It's called Dwayne Dantès."

chapters.title: Chapter 789: Friday
chapters.content:
Chapter 789 - Friday
Dwayne Dantès... I remember that in the original work, this character was developed by Klein based on Captain Dunn's image... I didn't expect Dunn to actually play the role this time.
However, this plan isn't bad. Entering the Church circles several months in advance and marrying a Beyonder who is a Bishop in the Church—this starting point is much higher than Klein's in the original work.
Moreover, it makes things more natural... After all, the appearance of Dwayne Dantès in the original work was somewhat abrupt, with insufficient groundwork.
I just wonder what the Evernight Goddess's purpose is in assigning such a task to Klein...
Is it a test for Klein? Or is She setting up some kind of scheme involving Dunn?
While pondering this, Ebner also understood that Klein told him the plan to figure out if it aligned with the Evernight Goddess's intentions...
But for something like this, why don't you, the "Evernight Goddess's Cat," pray and ask yourself, instead of going through me?
After all, you're the Evernight Goddess's favored one!
Of course, complaints aside, Ebner still gave Klein an "I understand" look, while nodding: "A good plan."
After this, Klein initially wanted to directly hand over the "Book of Calamity" to "Tower," but after some thought, he felt it wasn't appropriate for him to bring it up. It would be better to wait until the Tarot Club and let Mr. Fool personally mention it.
After all, during the last Tarot Club, the book was already by "The Fool's" hand, so it would be illogical for him, as the favored one, to control it.
As for other matters, Klein didn't plan to discuss them today. After all, there was plenty of time ahead, no need to rush, and if he asked about everything, it would make him, as the favored one, seem too ignorant.
So, after discussing what had happened in his previous life after his transmigration, Klein ended this "showdown."
He only said at the end, "There will be a reward from Mr. Fool shortly, pay attention to receive it."
After returning to his room, before Ebner could even fully grasp what Klein meant, his spiritual intuition was triggered. He held onto the "Magic Mirror" while looking up, only to see a majestic figure covered in black armor, wearing a pitch-black crown, appear on the ceiling. It threw a golden goblet with intricate and elegant patterns, its stem already bent, and then vanished.
"A reward? Is this because he saw that the three deities all gave rewards in the previous events, so Mr. Fool also has to save face?"
Ebner guessed Klein's thoughts after a brief consideration. He chuckled, then picked up the goblet and played with it for a while, pondering:
"This should be the 'Calamity Queen's' goblet. In the original work, part of Groselle's soul resided within it...
"But now, I'm certain there's nothing inside.
"Earlier in the 'Dream Labyrinth Tower,' Roselle mentioned that he specifically separated a portion of the ' Queen of Calamity's soul from the 'Book of Calamity' and hid her, intending to use her to threaten me...
"I was a bit puzzled at the time... Now it seems that I only formed a connection with that Elf Queen after receiving this goblet, to the point where it became inseparable?
"So, Roselle said I 'came too early'...
"When did I become such a 'Cao Thief'?"
"Hmm, after Groselle felt that something was wrong with her in the 'Book of Calamity,' she definitely wouldn't continue to stay in this goblet... But she might still have a connection with it..."
Just as he thought this, a knock suddenly came from the door. Ebner used "mysticism" to sense it briefly and found Edwina standing outside, so he immediately opened the door.
Upon entering the room, Edwina took out an ancient book bound with thick parchment from her pocket. The book's hard cover was deep black, with two lines of Hermes language written on it in crimson hues:
"The Book of Secrets."
"Klarmann."
Edwina placed the book on the table, then said unhurriedly:
"A special spiritual entity just entered my room and left this 'Book of Secrets.'"
Even Edwina got a share? But for "Vice Admiral Iceberg," this reward should be quite to her liking...
Ebner muttered inwardly, about to feign ignorance and ask if the entity was "black armored," but before he could speak, he heard Edwina add:
"It was a female, her face wasn't clear, but she exuded an extreme sense of beauty... very similar to the projection of the Vampire Ancestor."
...Klein, you're playing quite elaborately! After leaving me, you went back and changed your "skin"?
Ebner swallowed the words he hadn't managed to utter, and curiously asked: "What... what did she look like?"
Edwina thought for a moment, then cast the secret art "Scholar's Communication," transmitting the image she saw into Ebner's "Learning Space."
Still quite a bit inferior to Lilith...
Ebner commented after scrutinizing Klein's "new skin," deciding to record it and give it to Benson and Melissa as a gift when he returned to Backlund.
With thoughts swirling, Ebner smiled at Edwina and said: "No need to worry; that should be an apostle of another deity."
"So, in addition to the God of Knowledge, the Evernight Goddess, and the Vampire Ancestor, other deities also interfered in that previous incident?" Edwina immediately understood the meaning implied by Ebner's words, and said thoughtfully.
"Yes," Ebner nodded, not elaborating much, only vaguely saying, "The reward He gave, you can accept it without worry."
"I understand." Edwina didn't ask further, changing the subject: "I sent a telegram earlier; the 'Golden Dream' should arrive in the Rorsted Archipelago waters tomorrow morning...
"During this time, I happen to have some questions about 'mystical' constructions I'd like to discuss with you... Also, you haven't taught me the secret art to summon 'Arrodes' yet..."
Earlier, the few of them had already discussed their arrangements for after dawn:
Ebner, having many matters to attend to in Intis, would leave after safely escorting Edwina back to the "Golden Dream."
Klein, wanting to discuss hunting the "Admiral of Blood" together, accepted Edwina's invitation and prepared to be a guest on the "Golden Dream" for a few days.
As for Danitz... naturally, wherever his Captain went, he would go.
Hearing Edwina's words, Ebner inwardly complained: She's such a good girl, why does she insist on rushing to learn a "social death spell"?
But he also genuinely wanted to know if "Vice Admiral Iceberg" had any unknown little secrets, so he still smiled and explained:
"This secret art isn't complicated... The difficulty actually lies in attracting Arrodes's attention... Hmm, this 'Book of Secrets' is a very good 'offering'..."
.....
Friday morning. Danitz, who had deliberately woken up early and brought breakfast from the bar restaurant, had just gone upstairs when he saw the Captain run out of that annoying detective's room, her face flushed, her steps even somewhat flustered...
This... The Captain has never had such an expression, such a demeanor! It's rather cute... No! What on earth happened between them?
Danitz's expression suddenly became blank; he nearly dropped the tray in his hands.
Klein, who had witnessed this scene, walked over to him, took the tray, and "comforted" him in Gehrman's tone:
"They probably just discussed mysticism all night." This was what that sycophantic mirror had specifically reported to him next door after completing its "Q&A."
What do you, a mad adventurer, know? The Captain's state is definitely problematic! Wait... this mad fellow seems to have won the heart of "Vice Admiral of Ailment," so he's not simple either...
At this thought, Danitz asked with a hint of hope: "Really?"
"Really..." Klein maintained Gehrman Sparrow's indifferent expression, twitching the corner of his mouth.
Danitz was about to sigh in relief when Gehrman continued in a flat tone:
"They summoned Arrodes, and it told your Captain about its previous Q&A with you."
Upon hearing this, Danitz's mouth slowly dropped open. He felt as if flames were rising within his body, and illusory black smoke billowed from his head.
At that moment, his mental state exploded.

chapters.title: Chapter 790: Miss Messenger
chapters.content:
Chapter 790 - Miss Messenger
Outside a private port on Graggs Island, south of the Rorsted Archipelago, Ebner watched the clean, neat "Golden Dream," dozens of meters long and reflecting golden light under the sun, gradually recede. Only then did he simulate a short-range "teleportation," traveling along various islands back to Bayam.
He wasn't in a hurry to return to Tosk. Instead, he planned to first use the underground workshop of the "Fragrant Manor" to craft an item.
—He had long wanted to use the "Resentful Soul" characteristic he possessed to create a magical item that could transform him into a special spiritual entity. Combined with the effect of the "Door" card, this would bypass the restrictions of "teleportation altars" and allow him to freely perform long-distance "Spirit World Traveling."
Now, the prototype of the secret art had already been researched, but the item for transforming into a special spiritual entity had not yet been made.
Without disturbing any servants, Ebner quietly entered the workshop and casually set up a spiritual barrier.
Although Irene, his "fire-stoking maid," was no longer there, Chessia, controlled by the "Magic Mirror," could barely handle the job—she had also followed Ebner to Bayam but had remained in the workshop guarding the house.
Several hours later, as the steam engine ceased operation, a bronze ring, stamped into shape, appeared in Ebner's hand.
"Name: Azure Shadow
Appearance: A rusty bronze ring.
Abilities: Allows the wearer to transform into a powerful, special 'Wrathful Spirit,' possessing most of the 'Resentful Soul' abilities, lasting for one minute.
Negative Effects: After wearing for more than one minute, the body will suffer severe curses, undergoing irreversible changes, gradually transforming into a pure Spirit World creature.
Sealing Method: When not worn, place it in a dark, warm environment.
Remarks: One minute is the usage time for a normal Beyonder... If the wearer is a demigod or possesses other means of resisting curses, the safe wearing time can exceed one minute.
After each transformation into a spiritual entity, there needs to be a half-hour interval before it can be used again."
After appraising the ring's effects, Ebner was generally satisfied.
Although one minute was short and wouldn't be of much use in combat, it was sufficient for "Spirit World Traveling."
After tidying up the workshop, he put the bronze ring on his right index finger.
Instantly, a series of roars seemed to echo in his ears, roars that sounded like curses from the source of the Sequence.
But Ebner, who had already activated his "Eye of Pure White," quickly suppressed the roars with a trace of oppressive aura emanating from his eyes.
"An eternal roarer, huh?" Ebner muttered softly to himself. Then, his body and clothes turned from solid to ethereal, forming a special spiritual entity similar to a "Wrathful Spirit."
He briefly examined himself and found that the strength of his spiritual body was no less than that of Miss Sharon, who was a genuine "Wrathful Spirit."
As the "transformation" time was limited, Ebner no longer delayed. He took out the "Door" card he had prepared earlier, merged it into his spiritual body, then used his spirituality to outline complex magical symbols, opening a "Teleportation Gate" in the void.
Ebner unskillfully controlled his spiritual body and entered the gate.
One minute later, on Damir Island, a figure quickly materialized in a classroom at Mr. Gaston's school.
"Unlike a 'teleportation altar,' this new secret art I developed is more akin to the 'Spirit World Traveling' of 'undead' or Spirit World creatures. It must rely on self-positioning to provide coordinates to ensure one doesn't get lost...
"In other words, unless one is familiar with the symbols of the Spirit World, or has means like divination or prophecy for 'navigation,' one can only go to places they've already visited.
"Moreover, this process also takes time...
"Overall, this secret art is a success, but unfortunately, it not only requires a magical item crafted from a 'Resentful Soul' but also precious items like a Blasphemy Card... I'm afraid it has no possibility of widespread use."
Summarizing the pros and cons of the new secret art, Ebner sighed, then left the school, planning to "entertain" himself at a bar in the port for half an hour before continuing his "travel."
"The secret art will be called 'Ebner's Spirit Walk.'"
.....
Aboard the "Golden Dream," Klein followed Edwina on a tour of her collection and saw the recently much-talked-about so-called "Key of Death."
However, from its form and size, it looked more like a giant's key, and Edwina clearly agreed with this view.
Klein subconsciously asked about the price, and after receiving a quote of 5,000 gold pounds, he decisively abandoned the idea of buying it, thinking to himself:
If the subsequent exploration of Silver City really needs this key, I can just have Mr. Tower borrow it...
Considering the questions Edwina was asked last night, as reported by Arrodes, she certainly wouldn't refuse, as long as he told her the result.
Afterward, Klein and Edwina discussed their plan to jointly hunt "Admiral of Blood," and proposed a scheme to intercept radio transmissions.
Due to "Admiral of Blood's" subordinate's previous attack on Danitz, Edwina agreed without much thought.
Unlike the original work, Edwina now possessed a magical item that could summon "Heroic Spirits" to fight, naturally giving her more confidence.
Since the radio needed constant monitoring, Edwina assigned Danitz, who absolutely dared not appear before her, to Gehrman as an assistant and liaison.
Having finalized the cooperation plan, it was already approaching noon. After Klein enjoyed lunch on board, he returned to the room "Vice Admiral Iceberg" had arranged for him to take a nap.
He didn't rush to rest. Instead, he sealed the room with his spirituality, then, following the guidance in Mr. Azik's letter and the ritual sealed on Madam Yalolan's golden leaf, he attempted to summon his own messenger.
Next, after several failures, having successively summoned Spirit World creatures that were too fast to stop, too slow to notice their movement, and so imperceptible that he couldn't even detect them himself, Klein somewhat helplessly "randomly" modified the summoning incantation.
He gazed at the quietly burning candlelight, stepped back, and said:
"I!
"In my name, summon:
"Spirits wandering in falsehood, friendly beings available for command, unique existences willing to become my messenger."
Whoosh!
Within the spirituality wall, the wind suddenly intensified, and a translucent head slowly emerged as if breaking through a membrane. Its hair was pale golden and smooth, its eyes crimson like blood, and its appearance was bright and grand.
Immediately after, a tall woman with only an incision at her neck, holding four identical heads in her hands, appeared before Klein.
"Is..." "It..." "You summoning..." "Me?" The headless woman, dressed in a somber and intricate black dress, stood quietly. Her four hanging heads spoke one after another, in ancient Feysac.
Although surprised that this Spirit World creature could communicate, Klein calmed himself, "interviewed" her, and finally, after settling on a "price" of one gold coin per delivery, the two parties signed a contract.
Watching one of the golden-haired, red-eyed heads held by the headless woman bite the rounded steel pen and write down the name "Reinette Tinekerr," Klein suddenly found it somewhat familiar.
He recalled briefly and remembered that this name had been mentioned by Sharon in the information she provided to Mr. Tower during the "Daniel Labyrinth" incident.
She is Liu Bo's sister from his Danitz lifetime, and also Sharon's teacher...
Or should I use "Her"?
What a coincidence!
Klein showed no change in expression, but inwardly decided to go to the gray fog later and confirm with Sharon.
On the other side, the four heads held by the headless woman Reinette blinked simultaneously, as if sensing some change, but she said nothing more. After the contract took effect, her figure quickly became illusory and returned to the Spirit World.
After confirming her departure, Klein did not retract the spiritual barrier. Instead, he walked four steps counter-clockwise and entered above the gray fog.
He didn't immediately pull Miss Temperance onto the gray fog. Instead, he first summoned the "Scepter of the Sea God" and browsed through the messages from the Sea God's believers—this was his original plan.
Initially, there was no special news, just prayers for favorable winds and rains, giving Klein the illusion that he was the "Dragon King of the East Sea."
But soon, a report from a fisherman believer caught his attention.
"Great deity, today I salvaged a large crystal, and within the crystal, a beautiful woman was sealed.
"After our collective deliberation, we have determined this to be a treasure that can adorn your collection...
"Although this violates your newly established 'Ten Commandments,' your devout followers still wish to offer it to you.
"After all, apart from you, mortals are not worthy of holding this 'Crystal Beauty.'"
A woman in a crystal?
Klein became interested. With the power of the gray fog, he quickly merged into the perspective of that believer and saw what the so-called treasure truly was.
"This is... Tracy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 791: Klein, Whose Words Become Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 791 - Klein, Whose Words Become Law
Tracy wasn't already back on the "Black Death" previously, was she? How did she end up like this again... Did she encounter her mother again, or an even more terrifying enemy?
According to the information "Tower" revealed at the last Tarot Club, her birth mother and foster mother were likely both controlled by the Intis special envoy... Did they act again?
Is that special envoy determined to capture the entire "White Saintess" family in one fell swoop?
However, Tracy was previously ordered to transport native slaves, and now she herself has been picked up by island natives and "sold" to me...
In a way, this could be considered karmic retribution, right?
With thoughts swirling, Klein temporarily set this matter aside and continued to browse other prayers from Sea God believers. Soon, he saw several similar "sacrifice" requests, clearly from the same group of fishermen.
Tracy still had some luck; these fishermen were currently on a relatively remote, uninhabited island, and no one had discovered this matter yet...
While thinking this, Klein also saw another "message" that caught his attention.
It came from Karat, Edmonton, and other former high-ranking members of the Sea God Church. They reported that the Governor's Mansion had hired them to find the whereabouts of "Vice Admiral of Ailment."
The Governor's Mansion... The Governor's Mansion again? They invited me to a banquet before... and now they're looking for Tracy's whereabouts... Is there a connection here?
Thinking this, Klein picked up the "Scepter of the Sea God" and poured his spirituality into a light spot.
He did not issue a broadcast-style oracle, as this might be an unbearable burden for him and not easy to keep secret.
He selected the leader among the fishermen who requested "sacrifice" and said in a deep voice against a backdrop of surging waves:
"Hide her, protect her well.
"Do not let others discover her."
After saying this, Klein did not explain, nor did he accept the sacrifice. He only noted down the location of the island where those fishermen were.
He hadn't initially intended to specifically save Tracy; letting her atone for her actions this way would also be a good choice... But now, he had to first figure out what happened to her.
Moreover, he vaguely felt that saving this "Vice Admiral of Ailment" would be more beneficial to him.
Temporarily putting this matter aside, Klein threw the "Scepter of the Sea God" back into the clutter, then materialized "The World's" dummy. Only then did he touch Miss Temperance's crimson star with his spirituality, sending her the image of "The World" requesting a meeting.
A moment later, Sharon's figure appeared in the ancient palace above the gray fog. She wore a small black soft cap and a matching Gothic court dress. As soon as she was seated, she turned to "The World" at the lowest seat, parting her lips to ask: "What happened?"
They've only been apart for a day, he couldn't have caused another major incident, could he?
Upon being asked, Klein didn't keep her in suspense, directly stating: "I just tried to contract a messenger... and ended up summoning a lady with four heads..."
Four heads...
Sharon's eyes moved, but she didn't speak, only quietly watched him, waiting for him to continue.
"When signing the contract, she left the name 'Reinette Tinekerr.'"
Saying this, Klein materialized the image of the messenger lady before Sharon's eyes.
Looking at the figure holding four golden-haired, red-eyed heads, Sharon's gaze froze, and her doll-like face suddenly showed intense emotional change.
She blurted out:
"Teacher!
"She truly still exists!"
She had vaguely sensed this possibility in some of her teacher's biographies rewarded on the earlier floors of the "Dream Labyrinth Tower," so her joy at this moment outweighed her shock.
This was the first time Klein had seen Miss Sharon so agitated. Unfortunately, with the gray fog obstructing, he couldn't see her exact expression...
"Is it really your teacher, Master Daniel's sister from over 700 years ago?" After thinking for a moment, Klein asked again for confirmation.
"Her state isn't right, but it's Teacher," Sharon confirmed, then shifted her gaze from the image and asked Klein: "What was your messenger's summoning incantation?"
"The spirit that wanders about the unfounded,
The friendly creature that can be subordinated,
The messenger that belongs to Gehrman Sparrow" Klein knew she had deep feelings for her teacher, so he naturally wouldn't intentionally play coy here.
"Thank you," Sharon said sincerely after writing down the incantation.
Klein knew she was thanking him for facilitating her meeting with her teacher, so he genuinely felt happy for her, humbly saying: "It was just a coincidence."
Sharon pursed her lips and said nothing more.
Guessing that she must want to see her teacher sooner, Klein didn't keep her long. After briefly mentioning the messenger lady's "fees," he pretended to request Mr. Fool to send her back to reality.
After this, Klein took the opportunity to divine the purpose of the Bayam Governor, but due to insufficient prerequisite conditions, he didn't obtain any useful information.
Just as he was tapping the edge of the long table, deep in thought, and preparing to return to the real world.
Suddenly, among the crimson stars quietly suspended in the boundless gray fog, one abruptly lit up, spreading out light like water!
It expanded and contracted, contracted and expanded, unusually conspicuous.
And this was a crimson "star" that did not belong to any current member of the Tarot Club.
Today is really busy... Who could it be? Someone like Miss Justice, Mr. Hanged Man, Mr. Tower, Little Sun, who has a connection with the gray fog through certain items?
Klein thoughtfully extended his spirituality, not responding, but merely observing.
As Klein's spirituality touched it, the constantly expanding and contracting crimson "star" revealed the images and sounds it contained:
A black-haired lady in classical robes lay on the floor, writhing painfully and contortedly.
She held what seemed like an ordinary astrolabe in one hand and a short scepter less than an forearm's length in the other. Her strong will to survive almost broke through the crimson "star's" confines, directly reaching Klein's ears.
Klein could even clearly see the muscles on her cheeks tearing open, with flesh and blood condensing inside, as if turning into eyeballs; her ears stretched outwards, like trumpets; her fingers clawed vivid bloodstains onto the floor.
What bothered Klein even more was the pair of cold, ruthless, nearly transparent eyes with no eyelashes hovering above the lady.
Old Neil also had such a pair of eyes behind him! "Hidden Sage"?!
Klein leaned back against his chair, preparing to save this lady.
With his "hatred" for the "Hidden Sage," he subconsciously didn't want the latter to succeed.
He thought for a moment, then once again summoned the "Scepter of the Sea God," pointing it remotely at the corresponding "star."
His spirituality surged forth, pouring into the crimson light that flowed like water.
This time, he established a mysterious and stable connection with relative ease.
The black-haired lady's figure instantly appeared beside the long bronze table, sitting on a chair that did not belong to any of the current Tarot Club members.
The lady clearly hadn't grasped the situation yet. After tentatively conversing with Klein for a few sentences and learning that the great existence before her was revered as "The Fool," she recalled what had just happened to her and fell silent again.
After a few seconds, she spoke with a somewhat deep voice:
"My name is Cattelya, and I have the nickname 'Admiral of Stars.'
"Mr. Fool, did you save me?"
"Admiral of Stars"?
I'm currently on "Vice Admiral Iceberg's" ship, my believers coincidentally found "Vice Admiral of Ailment," and now I've pulled "Admiral of Stars" onto the gray fog...
If I go out later and encounter "Admiral of Pale"'s "Pale Saintess," would this mean I've established contact with all the female pirate admirals in one day?
After complaining inwardly, Klein maintained "The Fool's" posture and asked Cattelya some questions about the Moses Ascetic Order, the "Hermit of Concealment," and Madam Yalolan. Then, after she actively expressed her willingness to join the Tarot gathering, he allowed her to choose a Tarot card.
Cattelya glanced around and said directly:
"The Hermit."
.....
On the "Golden Dream," inside the captain's cabin, "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina was holding a book, lost in thought, wondering about something.
But then, her first mate, "Gourmet" Brew Walls, suddenly entered and reported: "Captain, ten nautical miles ahead, the 'Pale Saintess' is attacking a Loen merchant ship!"
.....
Backlund, South Bridge District, Harvest Church.
Ebner's figure materialized directly before a silver-haired, silver-eyed woman who seemed to embody the very concept of "beauty."

chapters.title: Chapter 792: Two Missions
chapters.content:
Chapter 792 - Two Missions
"It actually came straight in..." Ebner looked at the "beautiful" woman with silver eyes that lacked spiritual essence, standing before him, recalling the scene he had just encountered while Spirit World Traveling.
Ebner had originally intended to "travel" to his villa at 28 Ginster Street, but upon entering the area symbolizing Backlund, he suddenly noticed an extremely conspicuous "coordinate" appear before him.
Through simple "analysis," Ebner realized this "coordinate" likely belonged to the original Duke Rhine Kaldredia, now Rhine, the Beauty Goddess.
Ebner guessed it was probably because She was once the master of the Eye of Pure White that She became his "coordinate" in the Spirit World.
However, Rhine's body had always been kept in the underground of Harvest Church, sealed there as Lilith's vessel for divine descent.
And a true god's church generally couldn't be "teleported into," much less the underground area containing sealed artifacts...
This was why Ebner was greatly surprised after directly entering; such treatment was probably not even available to the Archbishops of the Earth Mother Church.
Am I receiving a little too much favor? I'm a bit scared...
Just as he thought this, Ebner saw the Beauty Goddess's silver eyes become lively, and then her entire being "came alive."
"Do you have any more questions? Speaking of which, the previous 'projection' time was limited, and some things truly couldn't be said..." Lilith, having descended upon the Beauty Goddess's body, looked Ebner over and said with a smile.
She merely emphasized the word "limited."
I want to ask about those transmigrators, but you won't tell me...
Ebner complained inwardly, then first habitually made the Earth Mother's holy emblem gesture, praised her, and only then organized his words:
"I actually came to you for help...
"In the Dream Labyrinth Tower, I used the 'Desolation' power you bestowed to kill the Aurora Order's Saint of Shadow. However, his own characteristic mixed with those of the Telepathist, Solar High Priest, Briber, Demoness of Affliction, Mysticism Magister, Guardian, Reaper, and Classical Alchemist characteristics he had herded. This caused a mutation, forming a highly debilitating and 'polluted' flask."
"I wish to ask for your assistance in separating the characteristics."
After speaking, he took out a card, removed its seal, and revealed the metal flask with a noticeable dent on its surface.
Ebner had originally planned to have The Fool cooperate with his "Disintegration" spell to complete the separation after the "showdown"... But since the previous "showdown" was only half-done, it wasn't appropriate to ask The Fool for help, so he had to ask Lilith.
Lilith, the Beauty Goddess, took the flask, studied it carefully for a few minutes, and finally shook her head: "Although I can separate these characteristics by forcefully crushing the flask and then allowing them to recombine...
"But in that case, the pollution within the flask will inevitably spread, creating a considerable commotion that will attract the attention of many beings..."
Ebner heard this and said with some disappointment: "Is there no other way?"
"Naturally, there is... Just 'sacrifice' it to the Divine Kingdom, and the Earth Mother can handle it." Lilith brushed a strand of silver hair from her temple with her hand, smiling as she continued, "However, in that case, some payment will be required...
"Hmm, I wonder if you're willing to part with that Classical Alchemist characteristic?"
Classical Alchemist... This must be for the Earth Mother Church to reclaim Beyonder characteristics of its own pathway, right? This price isn't too high; anyway, I don't need that characteristic.
While calculating inwardly, Ebner answered without hesitation: "I believe it would also be very happy to return to the glory of the Mother."
—The Classical Alchemist characteristic herded by the Saint of Shadow most likely came from the Earth Mother Church.
"Very good... I imagine Chloe will thank you." After Lilith finished speaking, she casually pulled open a Summoning Gate and threw the flask inside.
As a true god's avatar, and as the higher-level Beauty Goddess of the Summoner pathway, Lilith did not require a ritual to "sacrifice" to the Earth Mother.
It wasn't until the Beauty Goddess before him completed her action, and Ebner, whose gaze had been drawn by the "beauty" emanating from her every move, finally came back to his senses, that he curiously asked: "What does this have to do with Chloe? Does she want to prepare demigod materials for Judy in advance?"
But Judy only recently advanced to Druid, and she's still very far from fully digesting it. Even if she knows the acting method, it will be at least a year before she can try.
"Preparing demigod materials for her daughter is just one aspect... More importantly, Chloe's mother was actually herded by the Saint of Shadow," Lilith explained briefly.
—Chloe came from the Castiya family, the royal family of the Feysac Kingdom. Her father was a duke with real power, and her mother was an archbishop of the Earth Mother Church. Their marriage was considered a political alliance.
Lilith, as Lamia, knew Chloe's mother when she joined the Church's special team, so she was quite familiar with these past events.
So there were these internal reasons...
Ebner nodded slightly, no longer feeling so pained about giving up a demigod characteristic, as it would ultimately go to someone he knew.
While waiting for the deity to act, Lilith's silver eyes shifted slightly, and she raised a new topic, saying with a smile: "Actually, even if you hadn't come today, I would have sent someone to summon you..."
"Well, to be precise, I have two missions for you."
Missions...
Ebner, who owed Lilith too many favors, suddenly felt a little relieved and promptly stated: "Please command.""These two missions, one is short-term, and one is long-term.
"The short-term one requires you to investigate the hidden secrets of the Deline family in Intis.
"I previously replaced the personality of the Deline family's Black Knight with that of the former Pope of the Eternal Blazing Sun, and I also arranged for him to assist you in the investigation." Lilith's smile faded as she spoke.
The Deline family? Could this family, which has been hedging its bets and flip-flopping between Adam, the True Creator, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the Mother Tree of Desire, still be hiding deeper secrets?
As Ebner pondered, Lilith continued: "As for the long-term mission... you need to find the portion of the Queen of Calamity's soul from the 'Book of Calamity' that Roselle hid.
"Of course, the key point isn't her soul, but the item she took from the 'Book of Calamity.'"
Having said that, Lilith suddenly opened a Summoning Gate again and pulled out a spectral demon wolf ghost, ethereal in form, with eight legs and covered in dark, short fur.
This demon wolf ghost appeared quite normal in size, only slightly larger than a husky. As soon as it appeared, it ran to Lilith's feet, frolicking.
Lilith stroked its head, and after it revealed an expression of enjoyment, she added: "I always give rewards before assigning tasks.
"You don't have a messenger yet, do you? You can contract with this deceased demon wolf, which I control.
"It is the third child of 'King of Demonic Wolves' Flegrea...
"You should know that in the Second Epoch, Flegrea, the Mutated King, and I perished together.
"This demon wolf, during its life, was a demigod of the mixed pathways of Corpse Collector and Seer. After losing the 'King of Demonic Wolves' protection, it was quickly killed, and its soul was turned into a spirit by Salinger, who later became the Death deity, becoming His dependents.
"After the Pale Disaster, when Death perished, it naturally came to me.
"Although it doesn't have much sentience now, it's qualified as a messenger."
Though she says that, if I use a demon wolf spirit as a messenger, will the Evernight Goddess consider me disrespectful...?
Ebner thought this after listening to Lilith's introduction and reaching out to stroke the demon wolf's head.
But what exactly is that "thing" taken from the 'Book of Calamity'? Why is Lilith so concerned about it?

chapters.title: Chapter 793: "Luck"
chapters.content:
Chapter 793 - "Luck"
"Hmm... I once speculated about the item the Elf King gave to the Queen of Calamity for her to take to the Western Continent."
"If it's truly as I suspect, that the Elf King was actually a 'fallback plan' prepared by a certain Sefirah, then that 'thing' is most likely related to a 'Sefirah'...
"No wonder Lilith attaches such importance to it!"
"Where would Roselle hide Groselle? There's absolutely no clue...
"However, Groselle's soul is currently split into two parts: one part was originally hidden in the 'Book of Calamity' and was taken by Roselle along with the 'thing';
"The other part, Groselle in the golden goblet, most likely sensed that something was wrong and actively severed the connection to hide herself...
"And now I not only possess the 'Golden Goblet' but can also borrow the 'Book of Calamity' at any time. The chances of encountering either part are not low... As long as I find one, the other shouldn't be difficult...
"Finally... Roselle must have learned about the 'Book of Calamity' because the 'Calamity Seal' actively revealed it to him... I wonder what that cunning 'Conspirator' is plotting now!
"Thinking about it carefully, all the incidents I've encountered in the past six months are inextricably linked to that guy who transmigrated into a 'Sealed Artifact'!"
Thinking this, Ebner quietly "cursed" the "Calamity Seal" for a few moments, then pondered the first mission Lilith had assigned:
"To uncover the hidden secrets within the Deline family, there are roughly two directions...
"First, use the Black Knight Serlo Deline, whose body and fate were stolen by the former Pope of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, to gather information from within.
"Second, continuously suppress this family from the outside, forcing them to reveal things they haven't shown before...
"Hmm, internally, Serlo Deline can only represent the faction aligned with the Intis Prime Minister, and may not be able to uncover the deepest secrets... After all, the Deline family also has a most mysterious lineage, that of the patriarch following the Hunter pathway.
"And simply suppressing them from the outside makes it difficult to control the degree...
"Therefore, a combined approach, both internal and external, would be more stable."
With a preliminary plan in mind, Ebner looked back at Lilith, who was smiling at him, and nodded, accepting her missions.
However, although Ebner appeared to have given it deep thought before agreeing, he had actually never considered refusing from the very beginning.
No matter how gentle Lilith's attitude was towards him, she was still a deity, and Ebner certainly didn't have the courage to refuse a deity's command.
What's more, given the blessings Lilith had already bestowed upon him, he wouldn't want to refuse.
"Very good... However, in Intis, you're not without support... Helen is currently in Trier. If anything comes up, you can contact her anytime.
"Additionally, if needed, I can send some personnel to you later."
After Lilith finished speaking, she extended a finger and touched the demon wolf's forehead, drawing out some spirituality from it and infusing it into a golden piece of paper she had pulled out from somewhere—this was a contract.
Then, she handed the "contract" to Ebner.
The process of contracting this ghost demon wolf needs no further elaboration; it went smoothly.
As Lilith said, after being converted into an undead, it had lost most of its memories and its intelligence had regressed significantly, making it only slightly smarter than a wild beast. It was now completely under Lilith's control and would not question her commands at all.
Ebner suspected this might be a habit it developed during its time under Salinger's command.
Watching this eight-legged ghost, resembling a husky, run to his feet with its tongue hanging out and even lower its head to sniff... Ebner's feelings were somewhat subtle, but he quickly suppressed certain thoughts that could be considered "blasphemous," completed the final step of the "contract," and temporarily sent the demon wolf back to the Spirit World.
"Abigail..." Ebner learned its name after the contract was completed.
At this point, Lilith once again extended her fair hand and swiped forward, and the Summoning Gate, condensed from crimson light patterns, reappeared.
Next, accompanied by swirling fierce winds and the vibration of natural forces, the illusory gate covered with mysterious blood-red patterns opened wide, and Beyonder characteristics flew out one by one.
Telepathist, Solar High Priest, Briber, Demoness of Affliction, Mysticism Magister, Guardian, Reaper, and Black Knight...
Following these characteristics, the metal flask with a noticeable dent also flew out together.
Lilith caught the characteristics one by one, patiently divided them into different containers, sealed them, and then placed them in a briefcase, handing it to Ebner.
Next, she picked up the metal flask again and said with a smile: "This item still retains most of its previous abilities, but each ability's liquor only has a single effect, and it's gone after use."
"Once the effects of all the Beyonder abilities within it are exhausted, it will become an ordinary flask."
"What's better than before is that the effects and side effects of the liquor generated each time can be 'appraised.' If it's not to your liking, you can pour it out."
This is much more practical; after all, it's not a complete 'blind box,' so the risks are controllable...
Ebner took the flask, deeply feeling that the liquor inside could be used as both an "enhancement fluid" and a "poison."
After all, if the side effect is 'giving birth,' tricking an enemy into drinking it might directly cause them to 'lose a Sequence.'
.....
East Chester County, at the Hall Family manor.
Audrey sat before her dressing table and lit a candle.
Then, she looked at herself in the mirror through the flickering candlelight and performed a simple "psychological suggestion."
She intended to explore her dream, to see if she could, by doing so, enter the subconscious ocean and spiritual sky of all living beings.
This was an attempt no other Psychiatrist had ever thought of; at least, the reference experiences provided by the Psychological Alchemists did not include anything similar—self-suggesting, self-exploring one's own dreams.
However, fortunately, Audrey succeeded in just one attempt. She entered her lucid dream, saw the spiritual sky, and even discovered psychological issues she hadn't noticed before.
Just as she entered the collective subconscious ocean and walked through one dream after another, a cave made of various crystals suddenly appeared before her.
Whose dream is this? So fantastical?
Audrey curiously observed it for a while, then bravely stepped inside.
Soon, a lady dressed in an exquisite and intricate long gown appeared before her eyes.
The lady seemed slightly dazed, just staring blankly in the direction of the cave entrance, seemingly unaware of any outsider intruding.
Audrey carefully observed her and found that her face seemed to be veiled by a layer of mist, appearing extremely blurry. She could only deduce from her shiny black hair and the soft contours of her cheeks that her appearance should be good.
Blurred face... indicating she has issues with her self-perception... Is she suffering from amnesia? Or symptoms of old age?
As Audrey observed and pondered, the woman seemed to finally notice her and suddenly looked over.
The woman's height was similar to Audrey's, but the latter still felt the pressure from a superior being.
However, this pressure quickly dissipated, and the woman fell back into a state of confusion and helplessness.
"I apologize for disturbing you... However, perhaps I can help you with something," Audrey thought for a moment and said cautiously.
"Who am I? Where am I? What am I doing?" The woman looked over again, directly asking her confusion.
Oh dear... I'm not entirely sure either...
Audrey smiled awkwardly, but connecting it to the current scene, she had some guesses and tentatively said: "Perhaps you are waiting for someone?"
The black-haired woman was silent for a moment, then uttered a word in ancient Elvish:
"Luck!"

chapters.title: Chapter 794: Hazel’s Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 794 - Hazel's Battle
In the workshop of the Surry family mansion in West Borough, Backlund, Ebner was meticulously carving runes onto a bell, solidifying the ritual to summon the "Demon Wolf Ghost."
Beside his hand, there were conspicuously four other bells, identical to the one he was working on.
—After obtaining the separated Beyonder characteristics, Ebner left Harvest Church, but he didn't "teleport" directly to Tosk. Instead, he first came to the Surry family's workshop, intending to craft several items that could summon "messengers."
At the workbench, Ebner simulated the "Artisan's" ability, utilizing his "spirituality," relying on his own knowledge and established designs, and assisted by steam-powered mechanical arms, to engrave various symbolic patterns, corresponding spiritual numbers, magical symbols, and ancient incantations on both sides of the bell.
When the final stroke was laid, Ebner, whose mind felt somewhat drained, disengaged the mechanical arm's power source, then began to infuse spirituality into the bell.
The bell was bell-shaped, with no metal clapper suspended inside, yet under the effect of spirituality, it emitted a series of clear sounds whose source was impossible to pinpoint.
"Dong! Dong! Dong..."
Accompanied by this sound, an eight-legged demon wolf ghost emerged from the void. It looked at its "master" who had summoned it with a rather human-like, helpless gaze.
After all, this scene had already occurred four times before, and even a "Husky's" disposition would grow tired of it.
"You've worked hard!" Ebner rubbed its head—which, despite being a spirit body, felt surprisingly furry—then ended the summoning, sending it back to the Spirit World.
"Five bells... that should be enough," Ebner thought to himself while tidying up the workshop. "There's no way Xio would ask me to pray directly to Mr. Fool; she doesn't need this... Similarly, the same applies to Klein."
"So, leaving one bell for Hazel should suffice before my teacher returns to Backlund.
"Her Beyonder circle isn't large, but almost all of them are my friends... With this bell, Aetris, Bishop Utravsky, or even Emlyn, if they want to find me, can do so through her.
"Edwina needs one for convenience of contact... Klein should still be on the 'Golden Dream,' so he can hand it over.
"Cullen and Judy have Silly Red there, so they don't need my messenger;
"Miss Gwen, young Trann, and Lydia... I don't know where they've sailed to, and I can't contact them currently...
"The Evernight Goddess... I'll pass on that... And this demon wolf ghost seems very afraid of the Goddess."
As he thought this, Ebner had already restored the workshop to its original state, then put away the bells, "simulated" a "short-range teleportation," and directly arrived at "Elk Manor" in the northwest suburbs.
This manor originally belonged to a viscount and has a history of over a hundred years. Councillor Macht bought it after getting married and spends a sum of money each year on major renovations so he can invite friends for holidays on weekend in autumn and winter.
—Ebner had casually exchanged pleasantries with Bishop Utravsky before leaving Harvest Church and learned that Hazel was currently at this manor.
However, as soon as his figure materialized in the manor's garden, he sensed something was amiss. After all, it was already close to dinner time, yet there wasn't a single light in the main building of the manor nearby!
Moreover, Ebner smelled a faint scent of blood in the air.
"Something's happened..."
Ebner activated his Eye of Pure White and carefully observed the main manor building nearby.
"The entire building has been swallowed by a powerful spirit, no wonder there's no light visible from outside...
"No... that's not right! Rather than a spirit, it's more like an out-of-control Beyonder...
"So that's it! It's an out-of-control Gatekeeper! The 'Door' within him is connecting the Underworld with the main manor building!
"This manor was once dragged into an independent space by Demoness of Affliction Rey using the Church of Storms' Sealed Artifact '2-001'... Could it be that lingering influence from that incident made it a target for this out-of-control Gatekeeper?"
"But no matter what, Hazel's current situation is probably not good..."
As thoughts whirled, Ebner Bryan did not rashly attack the invisible barrier shrouding the main building. After all, the Eye of Pure White was quite slow at "analyzing" Spirit World-related phenomena, and the Underworld is part of the Spirit World, so currently, he could only get a general idea.
It would be terrible if breaking the barrier caused Hazel's family to fall into the Underworld...
Several thoughts ran through his mind, and Ebner Bryan finally put on the bronze ring crafted from a Wraith on his finger, then accommodated the Door card, flying directly towards the main manor building and quickly merging into the barrier.
A Wraith is a type of spirit, and with the Door card, one can naturally pass through the "door" within a Gatekeeper.
.....
In the living room on the second floor of the main building, Hazel, with long dark green wavy hair and bright dark brown eyes, was biting her lip, continuously drawing the string of a short bow, shooting out streaks of bright fire to eliminate the ghosts and spirits invading from the doorway.
Behind her lay a dozen men and women in disarray, including her parents, Councillor Macht and Madam Liana, her personal maid, the manor's servants and butler, and even bodyguards hired by her father.
For this sixteen-year-old girl, her current predicament was even more dangerous than what she faced at the
Daily Observer
headquarters or the Aurora Order's stronghold.
After all, there was no powerful Detective Ebner Bryan to help her sever the pollution, nor was there a reliable Bishop Utravsky "guarding" her...
This was her first time facing the horrors of the Beyonder world alone!
Fortunately, she still had a metal arm fighting alongside her—Green Lion.
Thanks to Green Lion, when she first discovered an enemy attacking the manor, she decisively used the "guard" ability provided by the metal arm to create a barrier in the living room and called in her family, who had not yet been completely drawn into the Underworld and lost consciousness.
However, the barrier provided by the metal arm was, after all, not comparable to a true Guardian; it had many flaws, forcing her to personally shoot down the ones that slipped through.
But as time passed, the barrier's flaws would only grow larger, and even if she was only using a "magical item," Hazel's spirituality, at Sequence 8, was ultimately limited...
Although she hadn't reached her limit yet, Hazel estimated that she could only hold out for ten more minutes at most!
But in that short time, the Church's Beyonder team couldn't possibly arrive, unless a Nighthawk, Mandated Punisher, or Machinery Hivemind member happened to be passing by.
But "Elk Manor" was unfortunately in the suburbs...
What would Ebner or the Bishop do if they were in my position?
Thinking of how Ebner , upon discovering the pollution, could have escaped alone but chose not to leave the ball, instead warning the Mandated Punishers... thinking of Bishop Utravsky bravely resisting the terrifying attacks of the Aurora Order's divine envoy without retreating a step...
Hazel made her decision:
Even if I die, I will hold out until the last moment!
Even if she ran away alone, relying on the metal arm created by the Alchemist, her success rate of escaping danger wouldn't be low... but her family was right behind her!
However, her unwavering will could not bridge the huge gap between herself and an out-of-control Gatekeeper. As the barrier's flaws grew larger, the spirits invading the living room increased in both quantity and quality.
Finally, Hazel made a mistake. After strenuously shooting down a Sequence 7 spirit, she couldn't account for several evil spirits pouncing on her parents and family!
Just as Hazel bit her lip, despairingly watching the evil spirits' claws reach for her mother's body, unable to even unleash any attack, a bronze whistle was suddenly thrown into the living room, landing on the floor on the other side.
And those evil spirits that were initially pouncing on the Macht couple all paused, their "gazes" fixed on the trajectory of the falling whistle. Immediately after, they swarmed it, completely ignoring the "delicacy" that was almost within their grasp.
Immediately following, a clump of golden, dense flames appeared out of nowhere at the whistle's location, and a sacred aura permeated the air.
"Flame of Light"!
The evil spirits that pounced on the whistle simultaneously let out shrill screams, turning into nothingness in the golden firelight.
At this moment, the figure of a handsome man with brown curly hair also materialized from illusion, appearing in the living room.
"Ebner ?!" Hazel's despairing emotions vanished instantly after seeing the appearance of the suddenly arrived reinforcement.
It was as if with this person's arrival, all crises and difficulties could be perfectly resolved.
Ebner didn't yet know that the young lady before him held him in such high regard. He picked up the ancient brass whistle Jane had given him, and inwardly sighed with emotion:
"The tactics developed by Mr. Fool are truly effective!"

chapters.title: Chapter 795: Tudor
chapters.content:
Chapter 795 - Tudor
This Gatekeeper's "Self-Underworld" showed signs of peculiar expansion, seeming to encompass every part of his physical body, making them part of his "Self-Underworld."
And he was already close to losing control and dying, currently allowing his "small underworld" to return to the true Underworld. That's why "Elk Manor" was in this special independent space.
Fortunately, I didn't attack from the outside just now, otherwise, I might have accelerated his death, causing Hazel and her parents to be dragged into the true Underworld along with this "Self-Underworld."
Some things couldn't be seen from the outside, but being inside the Gatekeeper's "Self-Underworld," even without the Eye of Pure White, Ebner's own knowledge alone was enough to "reconstruct" a certain truth.
However, this "Self-Underworld's" anomaly certainly wasn't formed "naturally"...
