He directly blamed himself, saying he hadn’t kept up with my pace... licking so hard it’s making me feel a bit guilty... But even so, I still need to be on guard...
Klein suddenly recalled Mr. Tower’s nickname for it — "bootlicker mirror" — and felt it was very apt.
Arrodes didn’t wait, and using the wireless telegraph machine, tap tap tap, it created a little emoticon of a cautious head peeking out on the illusory white paper:
"Great Master, Dominator Above the Spirit World, your servant feels that you are troubled by something?"
This guy can now skillfully use emoticons, even starting to create full expression packs? Is he asking me this so that he can answer my question according to the ’rules’?
Being licked like this really does feel nice... But calling me ’Dominator Above the Spirit World’... That means in its mind, I’m some ancient god in the process of awakening? The ’Celestial Worthy’ that Mr. Tower spoke of?
After figuring out why Arrodes deliberately asked, Klein calmly nodded and said:
"Yes."
"You have answered my question. As an exchange, as a rule I must follow, you may ask me one question." Arrodes typed back quickly, even adding a little smiley face at the end.
As expected!
Without hesitation, Klein asked, "Arrodes, do you know about the ’God’s Coffer’?"
Arrodes was silent for two seconds, then the wireless telegraph machine tapped again, spitting out more illusory white paper:
"Great Master, your question is too considerate of me — I could answer it simply with the word ’yes’. I’ve slightly revised it to ’Tell me what you know about the God’s Coffer.’
"It is a box similar in origin to me. It once contained several special souls, but now it is empty, and even the lid of the coffer is lost.
"I cannot see the details of those souls or know where they went, but what I can confirm is that the coffer was fully unsealed by one of the personalities of the Queen of Calamity, and the lid was taken away by Roselle Gustav, who hid it somewhere unknown.
"At present, because it has lost its lid, the God’s Coffer has lost all functions and become an ordinary box.
"Only by reuniting the two can the God’s Coffer regain its power."
A long strip of illusory white paper emerged, bearing this entire explanation.
One of the Queen of Calamity’s personalities fully unsealed the God’s Coffer? Roselle took the lid? This information should be useful to Mr. Tower...
Hmm, that lid must have some special property, otherwise Roselle wouldn’t have gone out of his way to take it... Perhaps the experiment eleven years ago was related to this...
Thoughts flashing quickly, Klein asked the now darkened and deepened telegraph machine:
"Second question — your origin."
The tapping paused for two seconds before resuming.
White paper was fed out in strips, revealing a new scene:
From a hole in the ground surged large amounts of thick black liquid. They twisted outward, growing varying numbers of arms and legs, then transforming into strange monsters that rushed forward.
In this process, a point of light was ejected along with the black liquid, landing on a rock. It quickly merged with the rock, transforming into an ancient-patterned silver mirror decorated with black gemstones on both sides.
What a bizarre scene... So Arrodes was born this way? And that light — what was it, where did it come from? Looks like Beyonder characteristics... The more I look, the more familiar that black liquid seems...
Klein suddenly remembered the "black sludge" he had seen flowing from the so-called Holy Grail on the first floor of the Dream Labyrinth Tower.
I recall Mr. Tower saying those black viscous fluids are a projection of the Sea of Chaos... So Arrodes comes from the Sea of Chaos? A kind of so-called ’primal essence’?
But why would it seek me out specifically? I’m obviously tied to the Sefirah Castle — another primal essence mentioned by Mr. Tower... If it really wanted to find someone, shouldn’t it seek out that Creator of Silver City who crossed over from the Sea of Chaos?
And it said the God’s Coffer has a similar origin... so is that coffer also from the Sea of Chaos?
Perhaps... that transmigrator predecessor, the Creator of Silver City, was one of the special souls that came out of the God’s Coffer?
While his mind spun with speculation, Klein stopped examining the scene and nodded. "Very well, your turn to ask a question."
He waited with interest for Arrodes’s question, curious to see if it could surprise him again.
The tapping slowed, hesitating, and the illusory white paper was fed out bit by bit:
"Great Master, may I... may I say something to you?"
"You may." Klein, slightly surprised, answered and waited to hear what Arrodes would say.
The tapping suddenly sped up, filled with enthusiasm.
On the illusory paper, lines of words appeared:
"Great Master, happy birthday!
"Today is March 4th, 1350, and the body you now possess was born on March 4th, 1327. I had wanted to be the very first to wish you at midnight, but I couldn’t keep up with your footsteps."
...Definitely a topic I didn’t see coming... I even forgot about my birthday...
Klein’s mouth twitched slightly, unsure what to say.
He had inherited fragments of the original body’s memories and some of its emotions, so he knew the date. But drifting alone for so long, he had no reason to keep track of such things.
So Arrodes is actually the first to wish me a happy birthday... Wait, could its earlier refusal to respond to Mr. Tower’s summons mean it calculated that I would ’summon’ it today, deliberately leaving the question for me to ask now?
Hmm, at least that’s part of the reason...
Klein felt a wave of emotion, his gaze toward the telegraph machine softening.
At the same time, he thought of Benson and Melissa. On this day, they were probably more sad than happy... The interviews had ended back in February — had Benson managed to become a government employee? After Melissa became a Savant, had she faced any danger? Unfortunately, Sharon was still in the middle of a ritual, so he couldn’t check on Melissa’s situation.
While he sighed, the tapping didn’t stop, producing another line:
"Great Master, do you have any other questions?"
After a moment’s thought, Klein nodded.
"I want to know about the fifth survivor from the God’s Coffer experiment eleven years ago, apart from Abby, Bianca, Maria, and Lofia."
The telegraph machine tapped and spat out illusory paper:
"I’m sorry, Great Master. Because of an inexplicable concealment, all I can see is that she is a woman in her twenties, currently in Backlund...
"The information is scarce... Can you accept my apology?"
It can be like this?
Klein shook his head with a small smile and replied in a low voice, "I accept."
"Glory to you, merciful Master!" The tapping grew lively again. "The aura is about to fade... Great Dominator Above the Spirit World, your loyal and humble servant awaits the next time I may serve you, and looks forward to always following in your footsteps. Farewell~" The final image on the illusory paper was a waving hand.
The quiet hotel room returned to normal as the darkened telegraph machine regained its usual state, and the gloomy air dissipated.
Klein busied himself preparing a ritual, sacrificed it to the gray fog, then sat in the Fool’s seat to respond.
At that moment, Mr. Tower’s crimson star pulsed and contracted.
Extending his spirituality to touch it, Klein read the message, hesitated for a moment, then moved to the World’s seat and pulled Mr. Tower into the gray fog.
On the other side, as the crimson glow faded before Ebner’s eyes, he glanced toward the World’s position and smiled.
"Klein, happy birthday."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 867: Vera
chapters.content:
Chapter 867: Vera
After returning from the gray fog to the safe house in reality, Ebner touched his chin and murmured silently to himself, "Mr. Fool was a little moved just now... He even chatted with me about some past events from his previous life..."
Recalling the emotions Klein had just tried so hard to suppress, Ebner smiled knowingly, then began pondering the answers Arrodes had given him.
"The ’God’s Box’ actually has a lid? Since Arrodes mentioned it deliberately, it’s clearly very important... Why did Roselle take it away? Was it for the plan he mentioned earlier—to release Mr. Door, break through the seal of the Western Continent, and have the ’Sefirot’ help him get rid of his contamination?
"I can’t be certain for now, but there’s a high probability that the lid is in the hands of someone connected to Roselle... Hmm, Bernadette is excluded... Even in his madness in old age, Roselle deliberately avoided dragging his little princess into these disputes.
"So who could it be? His adopted son, Yaldabaoth? Edwina’s teacher, the former Lenburg princess Isabella? The former Bayam Empire princess Bruna? Some succubus lover? Or one of his Men in Black subordinates?
"This possibility list is a bit long...
"Next, I’m a little concerned about a term Arrodes mentioned... ’One personality of the Queen of Calamity’...
"I used to think the Queen of Calamity had split her soul... Now it seems she’s been divided into two personalities? And the ability to make an angel split into different personalities... there are only a few possibilities...
"Is Cohinem polluted by the Moon like Roselle was, or influenced by the ’Celestial Worthy’ or the ’True Creator’?"
At this thought, Ebner couldn’t help but picture the Golden Goblet saying to the
Book of Calamity
,
’Adam gave me humanity.’
"Lastly, the fifth survivor’s characteristic is a woman in her twenties... This clue is almost as good as useless, since the other four are all women in their twenties, all beautiful, and it’s easy to guess the fifth is probably similar...
"The only useful information is that the lady is currently in Backlund.
"And the contamination on her is most likely dominated by the ’Knowledge Moor,’ so the abnormal abilities she displays are probably also related to knowledge...
"Is there such a lady in Backlund? Hmm... I should not have met her before. Looks like this fifth survivor is hiding very well."
After thinking for a while without any leads, Ebner decided to have Xio pay attention to the libraries or the laboratories of various universities in the future to see if there was a lady who matched the criteria...
After all, being contaminated by the ’Sefirot’ was sometimes involuntary, and that survivor would surely crave all kinds of ’knowledge.’
Temporarily setting aside the matter of the ’God’s Box,’ Ebner glanced at the clock and felt that there was still some time before Xio and Madam Helene returned. So he put on his coat, his top hat, picked up his cane, and went out to call a carriage, heading straight for the Harvest Church.
Some of his plans still needed Lilith’s consent and cooperation...
.....
West Borough, No. 9 Bellotto Street, MI9 headquarters building.
Xio came to the door of Her Highness Vera’s office, hesitated for more than ten seconds, and finally knocked.
"Come in!" Her Highness Vera’s voice quickly came from inside.
Xio took a deep breath, pushed the door open, and walked in, approaching the desk.
Vera put down the document in her hand and asked, "Is there something you need?"
Xio was silent for a few seconds, then said hesitantly, "Actually... I have a personal request to make of you..."
"Let’s hear it." Her Highness Vera looked at Xio with a faint smile, as if she had already guessed something.
"It’s just... I have a friend... uh, Detective Ebner Bryan... He wants to meet you tonight at a safe house. He said it’s something very important he needs to discuss with you... I don’t know if..." Xio reported haltingly.
She knew her explanation sounded suspicious, but she didn’t want to lie to trick Her Highness into going, so she could only try to show her "sincerity" as much as possible.
But before she could finish, she heard Her Highness Vera agree cheerfully, "Alright!"
The normally dignified voice even carried a faint trace of excitement.
"I know this is impolite... but I suggest you... uh, what did you say?" Xio stopped halfway, suddenly realizing what she’d just heard, looking at Vera in disbelief.
Goddess above, I haven’t even used the prepared speech yet!
"I said I agree to this meeting." Vera, seeing Xio’s expression, couldn’t help but smile, her heroic features softening considerably.
"Then... tonight at ten... at Safe House No. 5, the one I’ve reported." Although surprised, Xio calmed herself and gave the time and location for the meeting.
As for why she reported the safe house to MI9? Naturally, it was to get reimbursed for the rent. And she inflated the reported amount to also rent those unreported, truly private houses.
"That works." Vera stood, walked to the window, and pushed open the glass panes.
Only then did Xio notice that at some point, the room had filled with some transparent mist, which was now quickly dissipating as the indoor and outdoor air mixed.
She didn’t think much of it, since there was always a water-boiling device in the room—a standalone steam mechanism—so a little water vapor was perfectly normal.
Xio originally wanted to explain Ebner’s purpose, but Vera waved her hand and said they would talk after meeting.
With nothing else to say, Xio took her leave.
After she left, Vera looked through the window toward the towering Gothic clock tower in the distance.
It was Backlund’s most famous landmark—the "Clock of Order."
Her gaze then passed the clock tower, toward the layered, ornate palace further away—the king’s residence, Sodorak Palace.
Vera’s lips curved slowly as she thought,
So you’re really selling me out? The frequency of surveillance is much higher than before! Unfortunately, I am not the real Vera... That naive girl who firmly opposed you died long ago in the mission you arranged.
Hmph, but my opinion of you hasn’t changed. Someone so lacking in resolve, who doesn’t even dare eliminate me for fear of the royal family’s opinion, and instead schemes to borrow an outsider’s hand... How could someone like that ever ascend to the ’Black Emperor’s’ throne?
An emperor must carry out their will, enforce the order they set, and never compromise!
Rules built on compromise, in violation of the natural state of things...
Vera gave a cold smile, then packed up and left her office, heading in good spirits toward her villa.
She was going back to change into something more appropriate.
.....
St. George’s Borough, in a cluttered room of a factory.
A cracked mirror suddenly gleamed, its surface turning dark and deep, as if connecting to another world.
Suddenly, a pale hand reached up from beneath the mirror’s surface, as though passing through rippling water.
A figure emerged from the mirror—it was Vice Admiral of Ailment Tracy, wearing a white shirt and beige trousers.
She glanced around, finding nothing, and frowned in puzzlement.
At that moment, moonlight suddenly shone into the room, and a beautiful silver-haired lady appeared before her.
The lady’s beauty was so exquisite that Tracy lost herself for a moment, feeling a sensation similar to when Ebner had "charmed" her.
Shame and annoyance welled up inside her, but the lady was undoubtedly a demigod—and a stranger at that—so she dared not reveal her feelings. Instead, she greeted politely and cautiously asked, "Madam, where is Ebner Bryan?"
Although Ebner had let her go previously, to prevent her from committing further crimes, he had taken some of her blood and hair to track her location.
If he ever heard news of her doing evil again, he could remove her at any time.
This time, Ebner had used her blood and hair to perform a ritual, summoning her here for a meeting.
The silver-haired lady was, of course, Madam Helene, who had come to Backlund with Ebner. She glanced at Tracy a few times, her severe expression softening slightly, for Tracy’s soul wasn’t as filthy and degenerate as she had imagined.
It was still not clean, but remained within the bounds of an ordinary human.
"Ebner asked me here to resolve the matter of your mother being controlled..."
(End of this Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 868: Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 868: Meeting
"You can tell me about her current situation." Madam Helene spoke as she showed Tracy the blood and hair that Ebner had taken from her, both to gain the other party’s trust and to warn the "Vice Admiral of Ailment" in front of her not to try anything again—such as escaping through a mirror.
Seeing her important belongings in the hands of the beautiful woman dressed in strange clothes before her, Tracy silently cursed Ebner a few times, then stopped trying to activate a certain item and "honestly" replied, "I haven’t met with my mother. That would allow the one controlling her to discover me... But she must have sensed me through our bloodline connection, and even deliberately left behind a mystical item that can traverse the Mirror World for me to find...
"Because that action of hers did not carry any malice toward the one pulling the strings, it hasn’t been discovered yet."
As she spoke, she seemed to recall something and asked, "Right, I haven’t asked how I should address you?"
Madam Helene’s expression didn’t change as she flatly replied, "That’s not something you need to know." Then she shifted the topic back. "To what extent is she being controlled?"
"Based on my observations over this period, I can roughly deduce that she cannot disobey any orders from that person, nor can she form any thoughts that would harm them...
"Other than that, she’s no different from before... So the upper ranks of the Demoness Sect haven’t noticed anything unusual about her." Tracy detailed the results of her weeks-long investigation to Madam Helene and finally concluded, "The most important thing is that she seems to be clearly aware that she’s under control, but she can’t resist, can’t even ask for help—such thoughts simply can’t arise in her mind."
"How do you know that?" Helene pressed.
"Because I know her too well... Those seemingly normal actions and reactions are all abnormal to me!" Tracy said, biting her lip.
Her dangerous investigation was not only an attempt to save her mother but also to save herself... Without her mother’s protection, she was in a very precarious position... And that shadowy manipulator might have been too busy with other matters recently to bother capturing her...
Once they were free to act and ordered her mother to seize her, there would be no way for her to escape!
When that time came, she feared she would be just like her mother, losing herself and becoming that person’s plaything in bed.
That image alone was terrifying to imagine.
Meanwhile, after hearing Tracy’s deductions, Helene closed her eyes and thought quietly for a while. Then, in her hands, countless crimson moonbeams condensed into a round gem.
"Find a way to let her pick up this gem... As for when to use it, I think she’ll know." With that, Helene tossed the gem to Tracy and said no more. Her form dissolved into moonlight and disappeared.
The moment she left, Tracy unhesitatingly used a mystical item to dive into the mirror. She didn’t relax until she had reached a hidden safe house and confirmed that the strangely dressed woman had not followed.
Even so, the lingering fear drained all color from her face, and her forehead was covered in beads of sweat.
With a sharp crack, she shattered the mirror she had used to enter the room into powder, then muttered blankly, "Ebner could actually call someone that terrifying...
"Her aura seemed even stronger than my mother’s!
"At least a Sequence 3 existence!
"And she clearly dislikes demonesses...
"Although, that strange outfit of hers was hardly proper—she looked more like a witch than I do...
"Hmm, come to think of it, that outfit resembled the ’Crimson Witch’ illustrations in Roselle’s novels.
"I even had someone make a similar outfit for Helene to wear once..."
As her thoughts wandered, Tracy felt a chill run down her back, as if a cold wind had blown past.
She had never imagined that merely meeting with Ebner could be so dangerous. Fortunately, that lady hadn’t acted against her... and had even given her a glimmer of hope to rescue her mother...
But can she really be trusted?
It seems I have no better choice than to believe her...
Forget it, I’ll let Mother decide for herself!
With that decision, Tracy gripped the gem tightly and entered another mirror.
.....
Elsewhere, Madam Helene actually didn’t care whether Tracy could successfully deliver the gem to the Saintess of White Katarina. She wasn’t even sure if that strange gem she had summoned from another world would work.
But according to Ebner, her role here was optional—it would be nice if it worked, and no problem if it didn’t... Even if the Saintess of White remained an enemy in the battle that weekend, their side would still have the absolute advantage.
"That gem is usually quite effective at removing similar forms of ’mind control.’ That Owen Delien’s ability to manipulate others is indeed bizarre, but the gem should still have some effect..."
As her thoughts shifted, Madam Helene suddenly sensed something. Countless beams of moonlight gathered like swarming bats, coalescing into her silver-haired, beautiful form.
She looked to her left, where a villa stood behind the Bravehearts Bar in the Bridge District.
At that moment, on the villa’s rooftop, a figure in a somber, elaborate black gown, holding four identical beautiful heads, emerged from the void. Eight eyes stared at Helene.
Seeing this, Madam Helene smiled and greeted her. "Long time no see, Renette."
Renette Tinkerr’s scarlet eyes gazed at her for a moment.
Then, each mouth on each head spoke in turn, in perfect sequence:
"Thank you..." "For giving..." "Sharron..." "That..." "Thing..."
.....
In a detached house on Rose Street in the Southbridge District—also the safe house Xio had arranged—Ebner was sitting in the study, waiting for the princess of the Loen royal family to arrive.
He had previously visited the Harvest Church. Although he hadn’t seen Lilith’s divine descent vessel, he had received a "go ahead" oracle from Bishop Utravsky.
Since this safe house was near the Harvest Church, Ebner had no qualms about meeting a Loen royal family demigod in private. He wasn’t at all worried she might harm him.
The blessing of the Goddess of Beauty on his forehead could at least block two attacks from a demigod, even an angel, which would be enough for him to flee into the church for sanctuary.
Besides, when it came to an ordinary demigod, he was confident he could exchange a few moves.
However, when he saw the spirited woman in full evening dress—as if attending a ball—appear before him, Ebner realized he had been overthinking...
She clearly hadn’t come to fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 869: The Proactive Princess
chapters.content:
Chapter 869: The Proactive Princess
Vera wore a finely crafted black gown, its skirt slightly flared, carrying an air of mystery and the unknown.
This rather retro court-style dress was neither in the conservative Loen fashion nor the open Ince style, but more akin to the Austrian court dress worn by Empress Sissi in a movie from a past life... The neckline was slightly low, revealing a patch of fair, delicate skin, but unless she bent over, nothing that shouldn’t be revealed would be shown.
The gown’s tailoring was equally clever, displaying Vera’s elegant, smooth neck, full and firm chest, and slender yet powerful waist in the most captivating way, radiating feminine charm.
Did this princess just come straight from a ball?
Ebner muttered inwardly before politely standing to greet her and guiding her to a seat.
Since this was a secret meeting, no servants had prepared drinks or desserts, but under Xio’s advice, Ebner had already made ready her preferred Duke’s Black Tea.
This tea, as famous as the Queen’s Black Tea—said to originate from the "Blood Moon Queen"—was among the most prized varieties, its legendary origins tracing back to a noble family of the Fourth Epoch’s Solomon Empire.
It was worth noting that Xio, as the "middleman," had originally wanted to participate in this meeting, but had received an urgent mission at the last minute and couldn’t get away.
"Detective Bryan, this is our second time meeting." Vera took a small sip of the tea, then, with her smile still in place, spoke meaningfully.
Second time?
Ah yes—months ago, when I went to see my teacher off at the airship, I had encountered this princess... Only, at the time, I had disguised myself as Xio... Later, Xio had mentioned that due to the height mismatch, she had indeed noticed something off.
As the thought passed, Ebner smiled in reply. "Your Highness, your insight is as impressive as your beauty."
"You really do know how to talk." Vera’s smile didn’t fade. After exchanging a few words about his disguise and becoming a bit more familiar, she said, "We’re partners now, so just call me Vera."
She was obviously referring to the film company.
Though slightly surprised, Ebner, who didn’t care much about such formalities, replied, "You can call me Ebner."
At that, he paused, put away his smile, and asked in a somewhat heavy tone, "Vera, are you aware someone is plotting against you?"
"I know." Vera nodded "sincerely."
Uh... you know? Normally, shouldn’t you ask, ’Who?’
Ebner complained silently, feeling this princess wasn’t playing by the usual script, making his prepared words useless right from the start.
Vera continued on her own, "That ’Lust’ of the Psychological Alchemy Union—Owen Delien—has long coveted me, or something I possess. A few weeks ago, he even proposed marriage to my brother...
"And though His Majesty the King hasn’t responded yet, he’s clearly inclined to agree... He’s long wanted to get rid of me, a dissenter and destabilizing factor! He just hasn’t acted because of other members of the Augustus family.
"This time, ’Lust’ intends to seize me by force and put me under his control, something my brother would be glad to see... After all, that way I couldn’t threaten his plans anymore... And he could use my controlled self to indirectly seize another portion of MI9 not directly under him...
"What’s more, Owen has promised numerous benefits, selling Ince quite a few interests, enough to offset the loss of marrying off a royal demigod.
"This has silenced the few royal demigods who had opposed the idea."
Why do I feel like you know even more than I do?
But if she knew all this and still came to meet me... she must see the royal family as unreliable and be looking for outside help.
After a brief thought, Ebner decided he should also offer some "real goods" to avoid losing control of the conversation.
He organized his words and told Vera about "Lust’s" plan. In the end, he said:
"In short, that envoy ’Lust’ has brought together ’Pride,’ ’Sloth,’ and ’Greed’—three members of the Psychological Alchemy Union’s Council—plus the Saintess of White and the Black Knight, making six demigods to besiege you!
"The time should be Sunday night, after the ball at Count Cross’s mansion..."
"My brother really can’t wait... Count Cross’s mansion has a newly built underground screening hall, and the weekend ball is essentially for the promotion of your film...
"I didn’t expect them to set the stage there... Looks like when that screening hall was built, someone arranged some sort of formidable ritual or array." Princess Vera narrowed her eyes slightly, her smile fading. After a brief thought, she looked straight at Ebner and said decisively, "It seems you already have a plan!"
"You might not believe this, but I can get ’Greed’ and ’Sloth’ to temporarily switch sides to yours, and also bring in one or two more demigods..."
Ebner was laying his cards on the table, but before he could finish, Vera spoke firmly:
"No, I believe you."
Uh... you believe me just like that? This princess’s trust feels a little too much... This is only the second time we’ve spoken.
Ebner couldn’t help feeling suspicious. He considered for a moment before adding, "’Saintess of White’—I’m not completely sure there, but I can try, and the odds aren’t low.
"So, when the time comes, it might be eight against two..."
Vera shook her head and corrected with a smile, "Nine against one!" Then, with a meaningful tone, she added, "’Pride’ is no longer the ’Pride’ you know!"
’Pride’ isn’t ’Pride’? So that royal advisor, Herwin, may have been replaced by someone else? No wonder Vera knows the Psychological Alchemy Union’s and George III’s schemes so clearly!
As his thoughts raced, Ebner heard Vera say again, "What kind of reward do you want to help me? I’ll do my best to meet it!"
Hearing this, Ebner was moved—this was a good chance to test the princess’s true attitude. He deliberately named a few difficult conditions:
"After killing ’Lust,’ I need all of his items and his body, because I need him for verifying a newly developed secret technique and for using his identity to infiltrate the Delien family.
"So afterward, Your Highness, you’ll need to actively cooperate with me for a time, pretending to be under my control, and even agreeing to a marriage... until that identity loses its value...
"Can you do that?"
As he spoke, Ebner even prepared for her to turn hostile, his hand already gripping the "Magic Mirror." After all, what he’d just asked was indeed excessive.
But to Ebner’s surprise, Vera didn’t even think before nodding. "No problem! I’ll cooperate fully. Even if you want to act as ’Lust,’ I’ll go along..."
Hey hey, I never said I’d actually do ’Lust’s’ thing—princess, your imagination’s running too far!
Still... she actually agreed to even this? She’s even more eager than I am...
Once again—it must be said, this princess is a bit off.

chapters.title: Chapter 870: The Secret of the Delien Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 870: The Secret of the Delien Family
Although without his intervention, Mr. Owen, the "Lust," would likely have invited two other members of the Psychological Alchemy Council to join his side, while his own "Black Knight," Selo, would not have betrayed him, and the "Saintess of White" Katarina would have obeyed his orders completely...
In that case, Owen’s side would have had at least five demigod-level combatants!
But since "Pride" was standing on Princess Vera’s side, this ambush would actually be hard to pull off. Even if George III had been bought off, Vera could simply seek the church’s help.
Logically speaking, she had no need to sacrifice so much to secure my assistance... especially since this was help I offered on my own, not something she asked for.
Could it be that she had another plan in mind, one that avoided relying on the church to solve the problem?
Was she intending to turn the situation to her advantage, pretending to become an obedient puppet so that George III would grant her greater authority?
But even if everything succeeded, she would still be controlled by "Lust"... Did George III trust "Lust" that much?
Was there some special relationship between them?
As his thoughts spun, Ebner asked Vera this question directly, instinctively feeling that she should know.
At the same time, this was also a way to continue testing her sincerity and intentions.
Vera smiled faintly and answered without the slightest concealment:
"They have two connections... First, my brother and Owen are both members of an organization even more secretive than the Psychological Alchemy Council... Yes, ’Pride’ is also one of them. They should have signed a ’contract’ under the gaze of a certain existence, which is why there’s a foundation of trust between them.
"Second, in the Delien family, any descendant of their demigod ancestor must unconditionally obey the first three orders issued by His Highness the ’Protector.’ This is one of the ’rules’ He set, a manifestation of authority, imprinted in the bloodline—similar to how an evil god’s will binds His followers. Even gods can only temporarily suppress it; they cannot completely remove it.
"Because of this, my brother actually trusts Owen, an ’outsider,’ more than his own subjects, or even his children."
She actually answered—and with such a deep secret of the Augustus family. If it weren’t for the fact that she still didn’t have the slightest malice, I would’ve thought she was about to kill me after giving a "villain’s reveal" like in some drama from my previous life...
As for "Lust," "Pride," and George III being members of the Twilight Hermit Order—that wasn’t surprising at all. After all, the original work had "hinted" at it, and even that foreign-pathway Grade 1 Sealed Artifact in "Pride’s" hands was sealed with Adam’s help...
The "Protector" she mentioned should be the founder and protector of Loen, its first king—William Augustus I, the man whose face was printed on the ten-pound note.
He was also the Augustus family’s archangel, the Sequence 1 "Hand of Order."
Even so, the fact that he could set a rule directly into the "bloodline" meant that the Delien family’s ancestor must be one of his blood descendants...
If my previous speculation was correct, then the Delien family’s current demigod "ancestor" should be Lady Julia, the one who married from Loen into Intis...
And Roselle had suspected she was a member of MI9! Was she a collateral branch of the Augustus family?
Clearly, her marriage into the Delien family was part of a mission. And to maintain control over her, the "Protector" William personally used a method on her.
However, Lady Julia’s later choice to seek Roselle’s help and become a Beyonder of the Hunter pathway was puzzling...
Just as Ebner reached this thought, Vera seemed to guess what was on his mind and added with a smile, "However, that Delien ancestor clearly didn’t want herself and her descendants to be restricted by the ’Protector’s’ ’Order’ forever. So, she chose to drink the Hunter pathway potion. After becoming an ’Iron-Blooded Knight,’ she used the pathway’s unique properties to alter her own ’bloodline,’ making it so that the power of ’Order’ could no longer appear in herself or her descendants.
"Now, the so-called ’Patriarch’ faction in the Delien family is actually descended from that ancestor and her husband’s younger sister. This branch has truly broken free from the ’Order’s’ power."
So that’s how it is... In that case, after the fall of the Gustav Dynasty, the Delien family’s rapid rise was not only thanks to the support of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun—Loen likely had a hand in it as well!
And the reason the Delien family was so internally divided—its factions as numerous as a cultist convention—was probably that the members unwilling to be "chained" by Loen were seeking a way out, trying to counteract the "Order" in their bloodline through the worship of gods and hidden existences.
That’s why some devoutly worshiped the righteous god, the Eternal Sun, while others joined organizations created by evil gods or hidden existences such as the Mother Tree of Desire, the True Creator, and Adam...
But obviously, this couldn’t remove the "Order" from their blood. After all, they were merely joining these groups, not becoming true followers. Even followers couldn’t expect the kind of on-demand aid that Tarot Club members could receive from Mr. Fool.
Of course, the fact that these organizations were willing to take them in was probably related to the Delien family secret that Lilith wanted me to investigate...
And what exactly was that secret?
Ebner tentatively asked Vera this question, but she shook her head. "I’ve never heard of any hidden secret in the Delien family... But their ancestor is indeed very mysterious. She’s always hidden away in the family’s ancestral home, guarding the family’s sealed artifact treasury.
"If there really is a secret, it must be inside that treasury."
In other words, to learn that secret, one would either have to find a way to get it out of the ancestor directly, or lure her away and infiltrate the treasury...
Hmm, breaking in by force would be an option too... but a treasury guarded by a demigod wielding a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact... even an angel might find it difficult to enter. If possible, Lilith wouldn’t have sent me to do this task.
He sighed. Though he felt he had gotten closer to the truth, Ebner also realized that Lilith’s task was truly difficult...
The price of the eight-legged demon wolf messenger was no joke!
After that, Ebner and Vera discussed the details of the weekend’s operation. At last, they turned to the most troublesome and unavoidable factor in killing "Lust"—the angel Owen had invited!
Although Ebner didn’t think an angel would really fight for "Lust," at most concealing fluctuations in his abilities or rescuing him in a crisis...
Even so, that would be a huge threat to their plan. After all, with the angel present, Ebner’s scheme to make it seem like "Lust" had won would be impossible.
For this, Ebner had planned to shamelessly pray at both the Church of the Earth Mother and the Church of the Evernight over the next few days... If that didn’t work, he was even prepared to risk meeting the "Pillar" of the Monastic Order of Moses that Klein had mentioned—Lady Yaloran. After all, she was also an angel.
And when it came to "hidden stories" to pay her price, Ebner had plenty to spare.
However, upon hearing Ebner’s concern, Vera dismissed it casually. "Don’t worry about that angel... On Sunday, He will indeed descend, but His real purpose will be to keep my brother from seeing what’s happening on our side."
Ebner was momentarily stunned. It took him a while to process this before he asked in surprise:
"So... the angel that ’Lust’ spent so much to invite is actually on your side?"
Thinking about it that way... that poor guy. All the helpers he painstakingly invited were actually "actors" and double agents!
"They’re on our side," Vera corrected with a smile, pointing first at Ebner, then at herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 871: Opening
chapters.content:
Chapter 871: Opening
But... the angel who was supposedly invited by "Lust" but was actually leaning toward "Pride" or Vera—was their primary goal to watch over George III?
Not "Hand of Order" William I, not "Balancer" Duke Nerville... but specifically George III, who outwardly wasn’t even a demigod!
That meant Princess Vera knew George III’s background very well... which wasn’t surprising, but she had actually said it outright without the slightest hesitation!
What exactly was she trying to do?
Before meeting her today, Ebner’s impression of Vera had been that she was a marginal figure in the secretive Augustus family—someone who, although she had become a demigod through her own efforts, was still a pitiable soul who could be casually sold out...
But after the conversation they had just had, Ebner completely overturned his earlier assumptions. This princess clearly hid far greater secrets than he had imagined. Her stance was unclear, her mind unpredictable, and she wasn’t even a character who had appeared in the original story. That made it even harder for him to figure out her background and intentions.
At most, he could roughly judge that although she was George III’s younger sister, their relationship was very poor—otherwise she would never have brought Xio, who bore a grudge against the king, into MI9, nor would she so casually reveal the royal family’s deepest secret.
Was she doing this deliberately, using him to leak news to the orthodox churches backing him? Or was she certain he already knew, and thus unconcerned?
He was starting to doubt whether seeking her cooperation had been the right choice... but Lilith’s oracle had been for him to "go ahead without hesitation"... which meant it probably wasn’t a big problem? Or that even if there was, she would handle the fallout?
Thinking this, Ebner spoke half in testing, half in sincerity, "Your Highness... no, Vera, to be honest, this was really beyond my expectations... It seems that even without my help, you wouldn’t be in any danger."
"No, without your help, I might have exposed some issues to my brother. That’s why I’m willing to help you cover certain things... because it’s beneficial to me as well." Vera replied with a smile.
Although it made sense, he still felt she was plotting something deeper... Ebner muttered to himself but didn’t probe further. After all, this was only their second meeting; it wasn’t the right time to dig too deep... everyone had their own secrets.
As for whether she would turn on him afterward, Ebner wasn’t too worried. Not only did he have plenty of cards up his sleeve, but based on past experience, Lilith or the Evernight Goddess would never allow his life to be at risk in Backlund... if necessary, perhaps even vessels for their descent would come flying to him...
And as long as he stayed alive, Xio wouldn’t be in danger either.
With that thought, Ebner said solemnly, "Since the plan is already set, let’s sign a ’contract.’"
But Vera shook her head, pricked her finger to draw some of her own blood, and said with a smile, "No need for something so troublesome. I’ll give you my blood... if I truly break our agreement, you can use it against me anytime... I’m guessing you have many ways to track me or even curse me using it.
"This is also my sincerity."
Willing to give her blood, yet unwilling to request a god to notarize the contract? And given that he was openly known as a Blessed of a deity—if she really broke their agreement, and he handed the blood to that deity, the punishment she would suffer would be far worse than from a "contract"!
It seemed the secrets she carried were not small at all.
After thinking for a moment, Ebner accepted the blood, sealed it with spirituality, and then looked into Vera’s eyes. "Sorry, but I won’t be giving you my blood in return."
"That’s fine, I told you... I trust you!" Vera’s eyes curved as she replied casually.
This... really didn’t seem like a lie... but where did her trust in him come from?
Your Highness, we barely even know each other!
Ebner was puzzled, even rifling through the original body’s memories, but confirmed he had never had any contact with her before.
Even until the sun was nearly rising, when Vera stood, lifted her skirt slightly in a curtsey, and departed, Ebner still hadn’t figured out the answer.
Her trust in me... is very similar to Lilith’s indulgence toward me, and the Goddess’s favor toward me... But those two are likely because I’m a transmigrator bearing the "Pure White Eye"...
Could she be one too?
Hmm... boldly guessing, maybe she’s not truly Vera at all... which is why she feels no attachment to the Augustus family and can casually betray their secrets...
A certain long-lived demigod or angel who once had dealings with previous transmigrators?
I recall Xio once telling me that this princess not only possesses a sealed artifact from the Tamara family, but also knows quite a bit about their history...
And when Xio was in East Chester County, she once met members of the Tamara family, even served as a tool for a certain psychic dragon, delivering a letter for a lady of that family...
So, could this Princess Vera actually be a member of the Tamara family? And Xio’s encounter in East Chester was arranged because she carried traces of the "Pure White Eye"’s aura?
While such speculations crowded Ebner’s mind, Xio, who had been busy all night, pushed the door open and entered, carrying breakfast.
After greeting him, she sat on the sofa Vera had occupied earlier, pushed a plate of bread and bacon toward him, and asked casually, "How did your talk with Her Highness go? She’s a serious and conservative person, so don’t take offense."
Serious and conservative
... Ebner recalled her attire and the ever-present smile on her lips, and suddenly felt as if he’d met the wrong person last night.
"Very smoothly. We’ll act tomorrow night." Ebner didn’t elaborate, just nodded, then sandwiched the bacon into the bread and took a bite.
...
In an unremarkable villa in St. George Borough, "Lust" Owen Delien had just settled the visiting ladies "Greed" and "Sloth" into their respective rooms before politely taking his leave and returning by carriage to the embassy in West Borough.
Upon arrival, he went straight to his office, spent some time indulging himself with the waiting "Saintess of White" Katarina, then exhaled in relief and muttered as if venting, "The aftereffects are getting worse... I almost couldn’t suppress my urges just now, nearly making a move on ’Greed’ and ’Sloth’...
"The side effects of that item, combined with the ’Lust’ mask, are truly terrifying!
"Fortunately, I’ll soon have Vera under my control. Once I get the complete brain of the ’Mist Monster’ from her, I can advance to Sequence 3 ’Cognizer’ of the Reader pathway!
"And as a ’Cognizer,’ I should have enough means to counter these desires... after all, the ’White Tower’ is absolute madness within absolute calm... the desire for knowledge will suppress all other desires."
The "trampled" Katarina silently dressed herself, her eyes shifting as she asked with a smile, "So, those two ladies ’Sloth’ and ’Greed’ are both very beautiful?"
"I didn’t see their faces, but their figures, bearing, and status already stirred my urges!" Owen finished, then looked at Katarina with a meaningful smile. "I know what you’re trying to do. I even know that your pirate admiral daughter has already arrived in Backlund, but I don’t care, because she and they will all be mine sooner or later.
"Your little scheme to provoke me against those two ladies, and the little moves you and your daughter make, are just small episodes in my future conquest of them. Sooner or later—I’m in no rush.
"We’ll talk after I become a ’Cognizer.’"
With that, he gave Katarina a squeeze, then left the office to her pained cry and headed toward the study.
He had already sensed the arrival of his brother, the "Black Knight" Seyrow.
Only after watching Owen’s back disappear did Katarina slowly take out a red gem from the mirror she carried and murmur, "He really didn’t notice... this gem works!"
A strange gleam shone in her eyes.
...
March 6th, Sunday night, 8 p.m.
The ball at the Cross Earl’s mansion was in full swing. At this moment, Princess Vera, led by the Earl’s eldest son, Wilson, entered the underground projection hall.
The moment she stepped in, she sharply sensed that the space was completely sealed off, as if cut off from the real world.
On the small stage before the curtain, Owen was leering at Vera with a wide grin.
"Welcome, Your Highness.
"This is a play I’ve prepared just for you.
"Thanks to the machine invented by Detective Bryan, I’ll be recording your process of submitting to me in full shortly."
With that, he clapped his hands, and the five demigods—"Greed," "Pride," "Sloth," "Black Knight," and "Unaging"—appeared together on the stage.
"Six against one, Your Highness... I hope you won’t resist." Owen offered "politely."
(End of this Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 872: The “Lust” Dream
chapters.content:
Chapter 872: The “Lust” Dream
Facing such a "desperate situation," Princess Vera showed no trace of fear or surprise. Instead, she waved her hand, sending out countless tendrils of black fog that spread and enveloped this independent space that seemed detached from reality.
At the same time, the appearance of Wilson, the earl’s eldest son beside her, suddenly changed, revealing the form of Ebner.
Dressed in a black trench coat and a half-top hat, he slightly bowed toward Mr. Owen and smiled. "Thank you for appreciating my ’camera,’ but I don’t want you using it for such filthy things."
As he spoke, a massive red moon rose above his head, faintly revealing the figure of a beautiful woman dressed in strange clothing.
Immediately after, the phantom of a "Devil" appeared, standing in front of Ebner.
Seeing this, "Lust" Owen instead felt truly relieved. He smiled. "A herded ’Devil,’ a demigod of the ’Moon’ pathway, and a detective who’s not even a demigod... This is your preparation, Your Highness?
"How disappointing."
Shaking his head in disdain, he then smiled at "Greed," "Sloth," and the "Black Knight" Seyrow. "Please, the three of you, block the helpers that the detective brought!
"Once we take down Princess Vera, we’ll help you get rid of them as well..."
After personally "seeing" the three demigods clash with Vera’s "reinforcements," he didn’t hesitate any longer. He directly used his "Mind Deprivation" ability, attempting to invade Princess Vera’s subconscious island. At the same time, he ordered the "Saintess of White" to release a plague to weaken her body.
As for "Pride," he seemed to have completely forgotten about him...
Very quickly, in Owen’s perception, thanks to the "Saintess of White’s" assistance, Vera’s condition worsened. Her stamina gradually ran out, and he successfully invaded her mind island, temporarily "hypnotizing" her, then began "controlling" her actions.
Meanwhile, "Greed," "Sloth," and the "Black Knight" Seyrow had already gained absolute advantage over the "Devil" and the blood clan demigod, severely injuring them.
Seeing this, "Lust" Owen’s mind turned dark. He secretly contacted his elder brother, the "Black Knight" Seyrow, planning for him to betray at the key moment. Then, under the guise of bringing reinforcements, Owen approached "Greed" and "Sloth" with the "Saintess of White" and the temporarily controlled Vera—only to suddenly attack and capture the two women who had originally been his allies.
...
Meanwhile, in the projection hall, all the demigods except "Lust," "Pride," and the "Saintess of White" had gathered, watching the "dream" of "Lust" play out on the big screen.
"That ’Pride’ gentleman can hypnotize a demigod without them realizing it, trapping them in the ’Dream Labyrinth’ without their knowledge... Perhaps we should call him ’He’? Though He only displayed power at Sequence 3 level..." Ebner glanced at Princess Vera in her evening dress beside him and thought to himself,
Her outfit now is far more conservative than the one she wore when she came to see me that day...
"You should be able to guess who He is." Vera smiled faintly, not answering directly but confirming Ebner’s suspicion.
There weren’t many "Spectator" angels, and the one replacing "Pride" was most likely the revived "Dragon of Imagination," wasn’t it?
Had He truly allied with the Tamara family? If Vera was indeed from the Tamara family...
Also, the fog enveloping the theater was unusual... Could it be the "Fog of Uncertainty"? In the original work, the Tamara family had a mysterious connection with that...
While Ebner pondered, "Sloth" Miss Closfia, though astonished at "Pride’s" strength, still asked puzzled, "We have absolute advantage. Killing him wouldn’t be hard. Is there really a need to go through all this trouble?"
The "Greed" lady—the countess—also looked over. She didn’t speak, but her gaze showed agreement with "Sloth’s" words.
As for "Black Knight" Seyrow, he said nothing, simply waiting for Ebner’s command.
The ’Greed’ lady really is starting to take the ’shape’ of Miss Sloth... This subtle mental suggestion, in my view, is far more dangerous than ’Lust’s’ overbearing domination!
After some inner complaints, Ebner considered and replied, "There are three reasons...
"First, to create traces of Owen’s actions, so the Loen royal family won’t notice anything unusual... Oh, and later I’ll need to edit his dream experiences... selecting certain parts to intentionally leak, so that certain people will ’happen’ to get them.
"Second, you and ’Greed’ must have signed a contract with him preventing mutual attacks. While I’m sure you both have ways to bypass that, now that he has attacked you first in the Dream Labyrinth, breaking that agreement will be easier."
At this, both "Greed" and "Sloth" nodded, confirming his point, so he continued,
"Third, you should know that the high-level item ’Lust’ possesses is strange and powerful. So it’s better to let him reveal its full details in the dream before acting."
This reverse-hunt plan was personally designed by Ebner, so naturally, he would not underestimate a demigod. He had made many preparations to capture "Lust" at the smallest possible cost.
At this point, Owen’s dream on the screen reached its "climax." After severely injuring "Sloth" and "Greed," he pulled open his collar, revealing a necklace with seven stones.
Only one stone was glowing, clearly showing the image of the "Saintess of White" Katarina.
Owen pulled "Greed" and "Sloth" to his side, impatiently removing their masks—only to be met by a haze of mist. Since he had never seen their real faces in reality, the dream could not "display" them.
His consciousness wavered, sensing something wrong, and he began to wake up.
"Pride" immediately acted according to subconscious reflex, sending the strangely dressed Helen to his side.
Seeing the beauty appear before him, Owen in the dream immediately forgot the earlier suspicion and turned the necklace toward Helen.
Outside the screen, Closfia chuckled to Helen. "That outfit really is seductive—no wonder ’Lust’ can’t control himself and completely forgets the flaw."
Helen replied irritably, "I only dressed like this because you told me to."
Hearing their exchange, "Greed" silently felt relieved—her "master" had never asked her to wear strange outfits.
As for Ebner, his focus was on the necklace:
It was clear that the previously cold "Greed" and "Sloth," as well as Helen, all became more enthusiastic after seeing it... Obviously, in Owen’s subconscious, this was the necklace’s effect.
On the screen, just as Owen’s breathing grew heavier and he prepared to "enjoy" his spoils—just as "Pride" was about to change the script to make him reveal more secrets—his body suddenly convulsed, followed by a violent cough!
This was clearly the work of the "Saintess of White" Katarina, who was holding a red gem and had chosen this moment to betray him in the dream!
The sudden pain in his body instantly tore him out of the near-real dream, allowing him to clearly realize that he had fallen into a trap and had already been influenced to some extent before.
Without hesitation, his back bent slightly as his body began to swell.
His pupils became vertical, shifting from light blue to golden. On his face, his hands, and every inch of exposed skin, gray-white scales like stone began to grow.
With a tearing sound, his white shirt, black vest, suit jacket, and trousers all ripped apart, revealing the dragon scales underneath.
In an instant, Owen Delien became an abnormally massive monster. Aside from his head, which remained human, the rest of his body had completely transformed into that of a gray-white giant dragon whose evolution was incomplete.
The dragon’s back sprouted two gray, leathery wings. Its thick limbs were covered in scales carved with countless intricate, three-dimensional mystical symbols that stretched inward into its flesh and outward into the surrounding void, forming something not of the real world. Just looking at them would drive the mind to madness, twist one’s thoughts, and taint one’s spirit with an irresistible urge to tear or destroy oneself.
This was the "Spectator" pathway’s incomplete mythical creature form!
For demigods of other pathways below the angel level, using a mythical form in battle required an extremely strong will and unwavering faith—otherwise, they would lose control and become a true monster. But the "Spectator" pathway was different: they had "Soothing" and mental healing abilities, allowing them to manage madness and loss of control. As long as the battle didn’t last too long, they could shift into or out of mythical form at will.
Owen’s subconscious boiled. All thoughts surged, identifying and expelling the implanted, modified fragments one by one, dissolving them into nothingness.
The roaring wind around the gray-white dragon seemed to come from both reality and illusion.
Just as his enormous head was about to burst from the screen into the view of the four women and "Black Knight" Seyrow surrounding Ebner, Princess Vera stood, tore open a scroll, and tossed it forward while chanting in ancient Hermes:
"Mystical Reappearance—Dragon-Slaying in a Dream."
This was clearly a spell scroll from Madam Yaroran, containing her magic.
The "dragon-slaying in a dream" allusion came from the story of Wei Zheng beheading the River Jing Dragon King in his sleep. Converted into "Mystical Reappearance," it became a spell specifically for dealing with "psychic dragons"!
In an instant, Owen’s "psychic dragon" form let out a wail, shattered, and returned to human form.
Almost at the same time, he was once again dragged by "Pride" back into the "Dream Labyrinth" to dream yet another "beautiful dream."
(End of this Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 873: The Fall of the Former “Lust”
chapters.content:
Chapter 873: The Fall of the Former “Lust”
Empress Borough, Sodela Palace.
Wearing a crown, with a firm face and a small mustache, George III stood by the window, overlooking the Earl of Cross’s mansion from above.
At this moment, the distance between the palace and the mansion seemed to shrink suddenly, allowing George III to easily see every detail of the ball’s venue.
Baron James was chatting happily with the earl’s youngest daughter; his eldest son was watching this scene, his fists gradually clenching; the earl’s sister-in-law was gazing at James’s eldest son...
George III had no interest in probing into the nobles’ secrets. He focused his gaze and further closed the distance, finding the door that led to the underground screening hall.
But just then, before his eyes appeared a city shrouded in night, suspended between reality and illusion, blocking his view.
Faintly, he saw an elderly gentleman whose face was indistinct smile at him.
The Psychology Alchemists’ angel? Does he think I’m going to rescue Vera, so he’s blocking me?
George III narrowed his eyes, then withdrew his gaze.
It wasn’t that he feared this angel, but now was not the time to "expose" his true strength.
Besides, that angel was, in the end, one of "his own."
At least until I ascend to godhood, he’s still one of my own...
George III muttered silently, thinking:
Vera, I’m sorry... Your existence and your stance are a great threat to me! Because of you, even Governor of Oravi, Auston Levitt, and many noble vassals have secretly formed a society to oppose some of my overseas plans...
Although, after I had members of that organization warn Emilius, the situation was kept within certain bounds and didn’t trigger major conflict, to avoid any big mishaps in these final moments, I have no choice but to sacrifice you!
Besides, the terms offered by Owen and the Derien family are truly tempting... Hard to imagine, just for beauty, that he’d agree to such a price... Heh, worthy of "Lust"!
But when I truly become the Black Emperor, I’ll rescue you from his hands.
Thinking this, George III sat back on his throne, quietly waiting for the outcome.
...
Before the large screen of the underground theater, Ebner and Vera, along with other demigods, watched with interest as Mr. "Pride" wove a new "dream labyrinth," making "Lust" Owen and "Saintess of White" Katarina unknowingly "relive" the day when the latter was under the former’s control.
Just as Owen was about to repeat his previous success—pretending to be seduced by the demoness, only to pull out that necklace at the critical moment to control the "Saintess of White"—
She suddenly "awoke" and placed a red gemstone on her chest.
Immediately, the two demigods, who had been in dangerously close proximity, broke into a fierce battle... a real battle!
Unexpectedly, under the influence of "Mysterious Reenactment" and temporarily unable to transform into a dragon, Owen still managed to suppress the "Demoness of Unaging" with the necklace-like sealed artifact. If not for her being bizarrely hard to kill, and her mastery of various stand-ins and resurrection spells, she would have already fallen to him.
It was worth noting that this dream labyrinth "script" had actually been provided by Ebner, intended to make "Lust" Owen reveal all his trump cards and prevent any surprises.
"This ’Lust’ fellow is truly formidable. In a head-on fight, I might not win against him," Closfia remarked.
That was high praise, considering she was already a Sequence 3 "Dreamweaver," armed with powerful extraordinary items. The fact that she had so easily subdued "Greed" before spoke to her combat prowess.
Helen watched for a while, then shook her head. "His sealed artifact is extremely effective against demonesses. Even with my gemstone’s protection, the ’Saintess of White’ struggles against him..."
At this point, Lady "Greed" stood up and suggested, "We’ve been watching the show long enough. Time to help him out—free ’Lust’ from his misery."
Her words were mainly directed at Closfia and Ebner, since the others present lacked the ability to enter dreams.
Closfia had no objection. After all, "Lust" had already shown all his cards, leaving little risk.
Ebner immediately summoned the "Bone Dragon" and gave the "Black Knight" Sero a look, signaling him to stand by outside.
Though he didn’t think Vera would turn on him, it was best to be prepared.
Vera said nothing more, only nodding slightly at Ebner in agreement.
Next, three giant dragons suddenly appeared in "Lust’s" dream, tearing at his spirit with "Mind Breath," "Mind Stripping," and "Mental Plague." This also rapidly worsened the plague in his body, leaving him near death.
But the dual assault on body and mind freed Owen from the dream labyrinth. Coughing blood, he looked up to see the two women—supposedly his allies—revert from dragons to human form, now standing beside that detestable detective.
His mood sank into despair, unable to feel any joy, filled with self-loathing, wishing he could just die to stop burdening others.
The next moment, he became feverishly excited, vision turning blood-red, filled with desire for the women opposite him—if not for his grave illness, he would have lunged at them to vent his primal urges.
As a Manipulator, he knew his mind had been invaded, his mental body disturbed.
He tried to "soothe" himself, to resist the abnormal state, but thoughts from seemingly different people flashed through his mind:
Run! You’re no match!
So that’s what ’Greed’ and ’Sloth’ look like—so beautiful! They just transformed into dragons; their current clothes must be illusions. Why not rush over now and conquer them?
Who is this detective? Why do ’Sloth’ and ’Greed’ obey him... and Vera seems close to him too!
No, I should cure my mental illness first before escaping.
I haven’t lost yet... My brother Sero is outside; he must still be fighting. If I meet up with him, I can still escape.
Right, I still have the ’Token of Lost Mind’ necklace! If my own mind is about to collapse, then give up—let the necklace take over me!
With that, Owen put on the "Lust" mask one last time, surrendering completely to the necklace’s negative effects, allowing it to swiftly erode and control him.
However, Ebner and the others, already aware of the item’s powers through the dream, would never give him that chance. In the next instant, the "Token of Lost Mind"—a necklace strung with seven stones—appeared in Ebner’s hand.
Underwear Theft Technique
... Since all of Owen Delien’s clothes had been shredded when he transformed into a dragon, the necklace could count as his only covering.
"Didn’t think that would actually work..." Ebner murmured, looking at the necklace in his hand.
He had only been testing it—if it failed, he had other secret arts ready, and "Pride" was also prepared to pull Owen back into the dream labyrinth at any moment.
Seeing his last resort stolen, Owen’s mind unraveled further. He fled desperately, quickly escaping from dream and illusion, climbing out of the "screen" and returning to the underground screening hall.
Throughout this, Ebner and the others followed quietly without striking—since they still needed Owen’s body, they didn’t want to damage it too much. His mind was already beyond saving; collapse was inevitable.
Clambering out of the screen, Owen immediately spotted his brother Sero. His spirits lifted somewhat, and he cried out repeatedly, "Help me! Help me!"
But after a few shouts, he sensed something was wrong—his brother had remained motionless, staring coldly at him, seemingly ready to attack at any moment.
And not far from Sero stood the detective’s "devil," along with a vampire demigod and Vera...
They didn’t appear to be enemies... they were on the same side!
It took a while for Owen’s scattered thoughts to piece that together. Turning back, he caught sight of "Greed," "Pride," "Sloth," and Detective Bryan stepping out of the dream into reality.
Realizing what had happened, he let out a bitter laugh. "You... why did you betray me?"
"You were the one who first had designs on me and ’Greed’," Closfia replied, then smiled slyly, her tone meaningful. "Besides, I’ve always followed Detective Bryan’s orders."
It was the truth—she had taken on the Mother Goddess’s task, and before Ebner, now a demigod, she had to obey his arrangements.
"So do I." Lady "Greed," the countess, also walked over to Ebner, smiling.
She was already under "Sloth’s" control, and since "Sloth" listened to Ebner, how could she not?
Helen and Vera seemed to catch Closfia’s meaning as well, stepping forward to stand at Ebner’s side.
Seeing the beauties he had coveted obeying that detective, "Lust’s" expression twisted completely. The mental fortress he had been defending split open, and "Pride" seized the chance to crush it entirely.
The "Black Knight" Sero unleashed a beam of black light, tainting Owen’s mindless soul. Overcome by jealousy, hatred, and pain, he quickly fell into an evil spirit.
Unfortunately for him, the moment the spirit formed, Ebner—prepared in advance—had the "magic mirror" swallow it whole.
The Psychology Alchemists’ Council member, "Lust" Owen, had fallen completely.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 874: The Birth of the New “Lust”
chapters.content:
Chapter 874: The Birth of the New “Lust”
After dealing with the evil spirit that Owen had degenerated into as "Lust," Ebner held the strange Sealed Artifact, Proof of Lost Mind, glanced at the corpse on the ground, and felt slightly embarrassed.
After all, in this incident, the greatest contributors were "Pride," who had kept Owen trapped in the dream, and Vera, who had used a precious scroll...
On his side, he had basically just taken the final blow, yet he claimed almost all the spoils. To be honest, such a distribution was rather unreasonable.
But if he wanted to act under Owen’s identity in the future, the Sealed Artifact Proof of Lost Mind was absolutely necessary. Without it, it would be easy to arouse suspicion.
Seeing Ebner hesitate, Vera immediately guessed what he was thinking and said with a smile, "We agreed beforehand — both the spoils and ’Lust’ himself are yours."
"But when we made that plan, we didn’t expect you to be so well-prepared... It’s fair to say that without me, you wouldn’t have been in any danger at all..." Ebner shook his head, reluctant to take advantage of this.
When he had made such excessive conditions earlier, one reason was to test Vera’s attitude and background, and the other was that he thought his intervention could save her from a tragic fate...
But the facts proved that his contribution wasn’t that significant, and his actions were more like stealing the credit.
Still, he didn’t want to give up Owen’s identity. Ebner began thinking about how to compensate Vera in another way.
At that moment, Vera pointed at "Greed," "Sloth," and "Black Knight" beside Ebner, and said sincerely, "Without you, they would all be my enemies... By then, I certainly wouldn’t have been so composed!
"So everything I agreed to before is what you deserve."
It can be explained like that? This princess really is generous!
After weighing her words, Ebner no longer dwelled on it.He simply made a silent decision that if Vera ever needed something in the future, he would help her if he could.
I remember she once asked Xio to look for the Wishing Lamp... I know where it is, but that thing is not only dangerous, it’s also entangled in many matters... I can’t tell her for now... Besides, it’s not mine yet...
While thinking, Ebner walked over to Owen’s corpse and began arranging a ritual around it, experimenting with a mystical art that was still a "half-finished" product.
This mystical art had no name yet, but it was extremely important, because it might involve the continuous relay of "experiments" carried out by Transmigrators throughout history!
Ebner had discovered clues about this when he was controlling the body of that "Wanderer" senior in the Nation of the Evernight, and combined with the metaphors revealed by the first four questions in the Quiz Labyrinth, he roughly guessed what kind of mystical art his predecessors had been trying to develop.
It was an art that would allow him to control — or even turn the bodies of his predecessors into Avatars — or perhaps a method to resurrect them... The exact outcome would depend on what their essence truly was!
"The first four questions in the Quiz Labyrinth metaphorized ’Miracle,’ the technology developed during the time of Vampire Duke Rhine and Death Consul Vicente, and finally integrating it into a mystical art...
"At first, I thought ’Miracle’ meant controlling the body of Senior Wanderer Arvin to advance to Miracle Invoker...
"But later, after I bought a resurrection ’Miracle’ on the first floor of the Dream Labyrinth Tower, that idea was overturned.
"The first question’s real metaphor should be that this newly developed mystical art requires a resurrection ’Miracle’!
"Furthermore, the mystical art hypothesized during Senior Arvin’s time was clearly incomplete, missing an important step... ’Contamination’... contamination from the Eye of Pure White!
"Later, Master Dannett apparently used the contamination of Sefirot to fill that gap in the experiment, and even created Baron Conva.
"Hmm... only with contamination can I turn their bodies into Avatars... or perhaps allow the Transmigrator seniors to resurrect through it?
"I’m not sure about the specifics. I’ll only be certain after becoming a Demigod and gaining a preliminary understanding of the Unknown Land...
"But that doesn’t stop me from experimenting with someone else’s body first!"
While pondering, Ebner followed the "rehearsal" he had done in his Learning Space, drawing a series of complex symbols and magical patterns. He had Closfia channel the power of the Dream Weaver into one altar;
On the other altar, he infused the Black Knight’s "Herding" ability through the Magic Mirror.
Next, Ebner summoned the Bone Dragon and used another mystical art to merge it with Owen’s corpse.
Owen was not a Transmigrator senior, and his spiritual characteristics were entirely different from Ebner’s, so the Bone Dragon was needed to make them "compatible."
The Bone Dragon itself was the remains of a Dream Weaver, so it could merge with a Manipulator of the same sequence without obstruction.
Although this meant losing the Bone Dragon as a trump card, the value of a Demigod Avatar was clearly much greater if it succeeded.
In truth, the best way would be to use the spells recorded in the Book of the Dead to attune Owen’s body’s spirit, but that would take at least several months, and Ebner couldn’t wait — hence the "sacrifice" of the Bone Dragon.
Once the fusion mystical art was completed, Ebner had the Magic Mirror release Owen’s spirit and place it on the other altar.
At this point, preparations were complete. Ebner took a deep breath, solemnly prayed to the Unknown Land for power, and connected to the Quiz Labyrinth, releasing one of the two resurrection Miracles he had purchased from Zaratul.
Of course, Ebner only recited the prayer to the Unknown Land silently. Given his close connection to it, communication was easy and required no elaborate ritual.
Very soon, as the mystical art combining "Miracle," "Manipulation," "Herding," and high-level contamination from the Eye of Pure White was activated, the "Owen" in the center of the ritual opened his eyes in the next second.
He... had been resurrected! But he was both himself and no longer himself!
Or rather, in his current perception, he was Ebner’s Avatar, with no barrier between him and the original body.
Ebner stayed silent for a few minutes, receiving all of Owen’s memories. Yet, instead of feeling joy at his success, his heart was heavy.
Because he had felt this before... back when he first transmigrated and became Ebner Bryan!
The effect of this mystical art was almost identical to his transmigration, only cruder... For instance, Owen was truly just an Avatar now, unable to advance further in the Sequence; and Owen’s Avatar couldn’t activate the Eye of Pure White...
Even so, it made Ebner reflect deeply:
"It needs a multi-pathway ability fusion mystical art, requires mental multithreading operation... To perfect it, a ’Reader’ will be essential...
"So they, and the deities related to them, had prepared Reader advancement materials long ago, waiting for me to fulfill the ’conditions’ step by step?
"The transmigration brought by the Unknown Land is, in essence, contamination...
"Was my transmigration... also part of the so-called experiment?"
With a bitter smile, Ebner shook his head, discarding some baseless conjectures. He then took a set of clothes from the Labyrinth and had Owen — who was essentially himself — put them on.
He was now Owen, and under dual-thread operation, there was no conflict with his original self.
However, since Ebner was not yet a Reader Demigod, his current mental multithreading was entirely dependent on the Eye of Pure White. If he closed it, Owen would have to be managed by a virtual personality.
Fortunately, Ebner could now keep the Eye of Pure White open for up to eight hours a day, allowing him to maintain dual-thread operation most of the time.
At this moment, Vera sensed the change in the resurrected Owen. After he finished dressing, she asked first, "Did the mystical art succeed?"
Ebner returned to his senses and had both of himself speak in unison: "Very successful!"
Seeing this, Closfia clicked her tongue in amazement, trying hard to recall the steps of the mystical art, but feeling something was missing, making it impossible to replicate.
"We need to lift the blockade and leave here quickly... We’ve already wasted some time, and if we delay further, my brother will grow suspicious." Vera paused, glanced at Ebner, and added, "If there’s anything, we can discuss it in detail after we get to the embassy."
"The embassy?" Ebner didn’t react immediately.
"With ’Lust’s’ personality, since he’s ’successfully’ taken control of me, tonight I’ll certainly have to stay at the embassy... Otherwise, it would arouse suspicion." Vera looked into Ebner’s eyes and said with a smile.
"..." Ebner was at a loss for words, because having inherited Owen’s memories, he — though like the original Ebner, with only the memories and no emotions — knew Vera was right...
Although Owen had ulterior motives toward Vera, he had indeed lusted after her body.
(The End of This Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 875: Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 875: Harvest
At 10 p.m., after the ball at the Earl of Cross’s mansion ended,
Ebner hid his main body in the Quiz Labyrinth, while his "Lust" avatar, following the original owner’s habit, instructed the embassy’s coachman to stop the carriage at a secluded alley nearby.
The coachman wasn’t surprised. For the special envoy to take a certain young lady home after a banquet was nothing unusual.
Before long, Vera, dressed in an evening gown, appeared at the other end of the alley. In a few steps, she reached the carriage, opened the door, and boarded.
As for "Sloth," "Greed," "Pride," and "Black Knight" Seyrow, they had each already used their own methods to leave.
— Since they were foreign demigods who had already been exposed to the Loen royal family’s attention, it was better for them to leave as soon as possible.
After all, they were just helpers invited by Owen, and the Loen authorities neither trusted nor welcomed them.
Inside the carriage was a small bar stocked with prepared distilled spirits such as Gold Lanqi and Winter Blackland, as well as various Intis red and white wines. Unsure if someone was still monitoring, Ebner imitated Owen’s manner and poured a glass of red wine for Vera, who had taken the initiative to sit beside him.
Princess Vera took it, sipped, and whispered, "There really was someone watching just now... but they’re gone now."
Ebner relaxed slightly, but still maintained Owen’s demeanor. The two drank and chatted, the atmosphere gradually growing ambiguous—naturally, this was intentional on Ebner’s part and fully reciprocated by Vera.
As a "Detective" capable of "Backtracking," Ebner would never let down his guard just because no one was observing.
And when Owen wasn’t under the influence of a Sealed Artifact or dominated by the "Lust" mask, he was, on the surface, still a gentleman, at least refraining from inappropriate behavior in a carriage.
Thus, drinking and chatting was perfectly normal.
...
In the previous alley, an MI9 agent, after watching Princess Vera board Owen’s carriage, passed the information directly to his superior, who in turn quickly reported it to Viscount Stratford, the Captain of the Royal Guards.
The Viscount entered the palace that night to meet King George III.
After dismissing his attendants, George III flipped through the compiled intelligence and sneered:
"For Vera, ’Lust’ actually gathered five demigods and an angel... quite the extravagance!
"From the looks of it, even if Vera is prepared, this time she won’t escape being controlled.
"From now on, we can gradually ease the monitoring and restrictions on her...
"Also, have Owen investigate why I always feel uneasy whenever I see her.
"Heh, I’d love to just grant Owen’s request and marry Vera off to Intis... Unfortunately, most within the royal family disagree..."
...
At the Intis Embassy in West Borough, the wine-scented Ebner half-embraced Vera as they stepped through the door.
Come to think of it, the last time Ebner came here was to assassinate Bekland, yet now he had somehow become the master of the embassy.
Shaking his head to clear away stray thoughts, Ebner and Vera made their way to the living room.
After dismissing the servants, Ebner had Vera enter a bedroom on one side, while he went to the other side of the living room. Using his memory, he skillfully activated a mechanism and entered a chamber protected by multiple warding rituals.
Using his blood to temporarily disable the ritual, Ebner took from the central "altar" a metal box sealed with spirituality.
Casually lifting the seal and opening the box, a pair of eyes pieced together from various colors came into view.
This was the "Eyes of Asmo," one of the main ingredients for the
Reader
pathway’s Sequence 3 "Cognizer"!
Asmo were astral creatures that appeared as golden-haired, unusually beautiful humanoid women. They were calm, kind, and known for "perceiving" all kinds of laws, often serving as attendants or apostles to angels and subordinate gods in true deities’ divine kingdoms.
According to legend, if a traveler lost in the astral world won an Asmo’s favor and completed its trial, the Asmo would gift its eyes to the traveler, helping them return to the real world.
"Owen had Katarina kill the archbishop of the Surrey family mainly to obtain the Eyes of Asmo...
"And his elaborate scheming toward Vera was for the possible ’Mist Monster’ she possessed—its complete brain is another main ingredient for a Cognizer.
