At this time, the four demigods had closed in once more, sealing his fate.
Inside the seabed cave, Ebner observed the scene. Amused, he also became thoughtful:
Perhaps this was one of the effects the gods desired?
With most of the Mother Tree of Desire’s attention entangled with the Tenebrous World, aside from a few favored followers such as Siah, she neither wished to, nor could spare, the effort to save the rest of her subordinates?
As Ebner thought this, he suddenly saw an exquisitely beautiful doll fly out of his pocket, expanding from palm-size to life-size in an instant...
The doll resembled a little girl in a luxurious gown, adorned with gleaming jewelry, just like a noble young lady attending a ball.
Ebner recognized her immediately—after all, this was one of Emlyn’s favorite collectibles. While not the most expensive, it was absolutely the "Moon" gentleman’s "treasure."
And the one fond of taking Emlyn’s dolls... The "Spiritual Angel" Tolzna? But judging from how much she liked female dolls, perhaps she should be called Tolzna instead.
When did she slip into my pocket?
Hmm, after escaping with the uniqueness of the "Chained God," she had always been under Lilith’s protection...
So, she was actually sent by Lilith to protect me?
Just as Ebner realized this, he saw the doll first glance at the distant battlefield where Azik, Reinette, and the "Life-Producer" monster fought.
Seeing that the monster had retreated, her gaze grew empty, as if staring into the void...
Moments later, regret appeared clearly on her doll-like face as she shifted her sight to the last battlefield on the island, shrouded in black mist.
"What happened?" Ebner cautiously asked.
"I just cursed Barranca, but he still managed to escape... though he’s gravely injured and won’t be able to return to his peak within a year." The doll vibrated the air, answering naturally.
Remembering how clumsy she was in speech last time when dealing with Talim’s curse, and now comparing it with her fluency—could it be because this doll was more expensive?
While Ebner’s thoughts drifted, he also recalled who Barranca was—that angel of the Rose School, the one Lady Yalolan had earlier forced back into the spirit world.
Angels were indeed not so easy to kill!
As he sighed, the doll Tolzna seemed to sense his thoughts. Her emerald glass eyes turned to him, seriously explaining:
"It was because I hadn’t spoken for over a thousand years, so I was rusty.
"Remember, even in a story, someone who lived in solitude for only sixteen years still needed time to adapt before speaking fluently again—let alone a thousand years. So it wasn’t strange."
Uh... I didn’t expect her to be so particular about such a trivial matter... But, sixteen years... she couldn’t be referring to the "Little Dragon Girl" from The Return of the Condor Heroes, right?
Startled, Ebner cautiously asked, "Who told you the story of those sixteen years?"
The doll stared at him for a moment, then turned her head away, replying, "You guess."
I... Ebner was choked for words, almost raising a hand to his forehead. But just then, the black mist over the island gradually dispersed, revealing two figures.
One was a woman in her twenties with a high-bridged nose and full lips. Wearing skirted armor, she exuded heroic spirit.
Although Ebner didn’t recognize her, he saw Princess Vera’s shadow in her features. He guessed she was either Vera’s elder, or perhaps Vera herself in disguise.
As for the skirted armor—it was all too familiar. Wasn’t that the classic Knight King armor? Which transmigrator senior’s doing was this?
The other figure was a grotesque demon, nearly four meters tall. Unlike the dignified lady opposite him, his entire body was riddled with wounds, at least seven or eight sword cuts visible. Even one of his demon horns had been broken.
Now, seeing the black mist disperse, he rejoiced, thinking Leticia Tamara’s control over that "Grade 0" Sealed Artifact had finally reached its limit, and he was about to counterattack.
But just then, he received information that had been blocked by the black mist: the Mother Tree had merely used him as bait, and her objective had already been achieved...
In that case, his situation was perilous!
Although it was an honor to sacrifice for the Mother Tree, if he could live, he would still fight for survival!
Thinking this, Grand Duke of Blood El von Nois could no longer spare any thought for the woman before him. He immediately changed tactics, unhesitatingly transforming his body into "blood," seeking to merge with the surroundings.
Once the "Deep Sea Festival" ritual activated, this island temporarily intersected with the projection of the first layer of the Tenebrous World. Thus, before May 1st, one could enter but not leave.
Even though the Sea Monster had died, the prerequisite of the ritual was complete, and this trait would not change.
But as a Moon pathway angel, El clearly knew the ritual better... He knew he couldn’t return to reality without the corresponding authority or status. But by altering his form and becoming part of the "filth," he could briefly enter the first layer of the Tenebrous World’s projection.
And that projection of the first layer of the Tenebrous World was linked to the "Abyss"! He could completely take a detour through the Abyss to escape... Though it was still dangerous there, at least it wouldn’t be as deadly as being surrounded by several angels.
Not far away, Leticia Tamara merely watched quietly without moving, because she had already noticed that a doll outside the island had broken one of its fingers.
The Grand Duke of Blood El, who had just merged into the "Shadow," was immediately struck by the curse. He transformed into a blood-marked toad on the spot. Yet he still managed, in the brief moment before the curse fully descended, to pass through the first layer of the Tenebrous World and reach the Abyss’s entrance.
Just as he breathed a sigh of relief, preparing to hide and deal with the curse, a slightly playful voice suddenly rang in his ear:
"To meet you here truly is a gift of destiny... don’t you agree, Mr. El von Nois?"
"Yaldabaoth?!
"How are you here?"
The pitiful Grand Duke of Blood El tried to cry out in shock—but only croaked "gua."
(The End of the Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 892: Thanks and Farewell
chapters.content:
Chapter 892: Thanks and Farewell
In the "Happy" town on the island, "Admiral of the Deep Seas" Howl Constantine gazed toward the harbor, his heart surging like a storm-tossed sea.
Although he could not see clearly how many terrifying existences were clashing, just the dreadful auras emanating from the waters beyond the island were enough to suffocate him.
The black fog rising near the harbor nearly drove him into loss of control just by observing it...
In his heart he kept praying that the one known as "the Unknown" would be the victor. After all, if the "Rose School" and the Nors family won, then as a traitor, he would not even have the luxury of a swift death!
Fortunately, things unfolded just as he wished. That distinct-looking demon fled in a panic into the shadows, so the victor could not possibly be the enemy’s side.
As the black fog dissipated, he finally saw the neatly dismembered corpse of the sea monster "Segust."
At that moment, he could no longer suppress his excitement and swung his arm fiercely.
Since the sea monster was dead, he no longer needed to fear being dominated again!
I’m truly free now!
Praise the Unknown!
In that instant, "Admiral of the Deep Seas" even developed a trace of genuine devotion toward Ebner... though it lasted only for a fleeting moment.
...
In the undersea cavern outside the small island, Ebner suddenly closed his eyes, for he sensed that his "Knowledge Keeper" potion had been fully digested.
Feedback from "Admiral of the Deep Seas"? When the mystic arts I developed allowed him to fulfill the wish he had harbored for years, even inspiring a faint sense of reverence for me...
Learning mystic arts, developing mystic arts, teaching mystic arts, letting mystic arts be no longer hidden... in the end, they must be put to use, solving problems!
This is indeed in line with the sequence from "Knowledge Keeper" to "Polymath."
I suppose the next stage, "Prophet," will be similar—helping others solve their problems and change their fates.
From "Knowledge Keeper" to "Prophet," the difference may only lie in details and emphasis, but the general direction should be the same... just like climbing a tower, where each floor shows you different things, yet the goal remains to keep ascending upward...
After letting his thoughts wander, Ebner felt greatly uplifted. Ignoring the inexplicable, probing gaze of the angelic doll beside him, he turned his attention back to his Owen avatar.
The sea monster’s characteristics were already precipitating.
Looking at the lump of things tangled together like fishing floats, Ebner sighed inwardly:
As expected, it’s a mixture of many characteristics...
Without the "Pure White Eye," he could not identify them precisely, but roughly speaking, aside from the "Prophet," the rest were all mid- to low-sequence characteristics.
Hmm, fortunately the mix wasn’t too large—only three or four kinds. The others must have been expelled by granting them to its thralls.
I might as well take advantage of that "Angel of Spirit" being here and ask Him to crush and separate them.
Acting on the thought, though Owen’s avatar couldn’t leave the island before May 1st, Mr. Fool could provide "cross-domain" service. Thus Ebner immediately held a sacrificial ritual, offering the characteristics and other valuable materials from the sea monster onto the gray fog.
Then, through the undersea cavern, his true body performed the "receiving" ritual and took back the mixed characteristics.
As for the sea monster’s spiritual materials, he offered them to Mr. Fool as thanks...
Mr. Fool did not refuse, only saying mildly: "It will be passed on to one of my Blessed... that Blessed happens to be lacking in similar materials recently, so he is willing to assume the contribution that Mr. Tower has advanced in this ’support.’"
Faced with such a situation, what else could Ebner say? Of course, he praised Mr. Fool and His Blessed!
After this operation, Ebner handed the clumped characteristics to the exquisite doll.
As they had communicated beforehand, Tolznar did not say much and immediately activated angelic-level power to shatter the characteristics.
Soon, five pure Beyonder characteristics appeared before Ebner’s eyes: "Prophet," "Wind-blessed," "Sun Priest," "Listener," and "Audience."
They corresponded exactly to the "All-Knowing, All-Powerful Five Pathways"... that sea monster really had ambitions...
Too bad you didn’t make it!
Ebner had just finished the thought when he saw Tolznar stuffing the remnants of spirit and pollution from the shattering process into the doll’s eyeball, turning its once-emerald green into pitch black.
Turning his head toward Ebner, he said earnestly:
"This doll, even with my modifications, has reached the limit of what it can bear. It is about to shatter...
"I must also return to be ’born’ again... You won’t make it in time, but it doesn’t matter. When I reach my full month, you must come with a birthday gift!
"You can use this doll’s eyeball... It holds the spiritual pollution of the sea monster and countless sacrifices, as well as the aura of the ’Tenebrous World.’ Now it already counts as a sealed artifact with extremely dreadful side effects..."
Before he finished speaking, the life-sized exquisite doll collapsed into countless grains of sand, scattering across the ground.
Only that pitch-black eyeball remained intact, which Ebner drew into his hand.
After a brief examination, Ebner felt a stabbing headache. The thing was the purest kind of sealed artifact, impossible to use directly—at best, its negative effects could be used to trap others...
Not daring to hold it for long, Ebner thought for a moment, then again set up a sacrificial altar and offered it onto the gray fog.
This contains remnants of the sea monster and many human spirits... Klein may enjoy studying it...
Besides, no matter what, it’s safer than the Sun God’s divine blood or the Real Creator’s polluted ear...
So this is what it means to be an angel? To demand such a "hardcore" full-month gift!
But the Northern Continent doesn’t have the custom of "baby’s full month"... could it be a tradition created in the Southern Continent by Senior Danyet?
After leaving the Angel of Spirit’s full-month gift with Mr. Fool, Ebner stored away the Beyonder characteristics and left the cavern, surfacing above the sea.
By then, aside from Yaloran and the Lady of Black Fog on the island, the other angels and demigods had already gathered there. Seeing Ebner appear, they all flew over.
Renette Tinicole’s four heads each swept a glance, and she was the first to speak:
"Already..." "Safe..." "Afterwards..." "Remember..." "Payment..."
Ebner smiled and replied: "Do you have an account? I can have someone transfer the money right now... you can withdraw the gold coins at any Suhit Bank branch."
Renette was visibly startled at these words, then her four heads nodded in succession:
"Transfer to..." "Gehrman’s..." "Account..." "Will do..."
Having said that, she vanished as though she still had urgent matters.
After she left, Lady Helen said with a strange expression: "She has actually become Gehrman Sparrow’s messenger... how odd."
Recently, Gehrman’s name had been resounding across the seas, hailed as the "Craziest Adventurer." Even Helen, in Intis, had heard of him.
"Lady Helen, are you well acquainted with this messenger?" Ebner asked casually.
"Not only do I know her... before she was besieged by the Rose School’s Liberators, I had quite a good relationship with her. When Sharon and Maric were hunted, I even lent them aid," Lady Helen answered briefly without going into detail.
At this, Karen suddenly realized: "No wonder Miss Sharon has that item of yours..."
Hearing this reminder, Ebner also recalled that time. When he and Judy met with Sharon and Maric, Karen, who should have been lurking in the shadows, had suddenly appeared and questioned Sharon... so this was the reason.
"I saw Sharon suffer at the hands of that ’Scarlet Moon Crown,’ so I lent it to her temporarily..."
At this, Lady Helen smirked mischievously and teased:
"Speaking of which, I found Sharon suited my taste and wanted to trick her into becoming my daughter-in-law... After all, you hadn’t become the ’Witch King’ back then, and you were already over five hundred years old—it was high time you thought of descendants!"
No sooner had she finished than Karen felt Mr. Azik’s sharp gaze from the side. His head throbbed instantly, and he changed the subject: "How are those Lydia and the others wanted to save?"
Some matters, even if one’s conscience was clear, only grew worse the more explained, so the best choice was not to pursue it. Everyone could see that Lady Helen had been joking anyway.
"They must wait until May 1st, when this island returns to reality, before they can leave... Fortunately, the island has abundant supplies, so basic needs aren’t an issue.
"And with the Admiral of the Deep Seas here, no chaos will arise.
"Next month, I’ll organize a fleet to fetch them and resettle them."
Ebner thought a moment and gave his reply.
As for his Owen avatar, once the true body left the island, it would be left in the care of a "virtual personality."
Currently, the virtual personality he could arrange did not have high intelligence. It could manage daily life and combat, but not problem-solving.
So Ebner planned to have it simply hide for a month, avoiding contact with the others on the island—that was a task a virtual personality could handle.
"I see... I’ve been assigned to a mission in the Southern Continent. If I have time this month, I’ll come take a look, to prevent any mishaps," Karen said with a nod.
After that, Ebner expressed his gratitude once more to his friends.
Although Krosfia and Helen had come at the Earth Mother’s command, Karen was helping Lydia’s group avenge and rescue Gwen’s uncle, Mr. Azik had accepted Death God manuscripts as payment, and Madam Greed belonged to Sloth...
They had all risked their lives to fight on his behalf, and this favor Ebner acknowledged.
As for Sero? He could not appear before everyone, and the "Black Knight" identity was unwelcome. So as soon as the battle ended, Ebner sent him back to Trier directly.
Once the demigods and angels accepted Ebner’s thanks, Mr. Azik asked: "Where are you heading? I still have some time and can take you there."
Recalling the message brought to him by the "Strongest Hunter" Anderson when he first became a "Knowledge Keeper," Ebner pulled from his pocket an invitation long kept sealed. Pointing at the address written there, he smiled: "Please take me to this place in West Balam!"
...
After everyone had left the island, Leticia Tamara transformed the black mist into white, wrapped herself in it, and turned into Vera Augustus.
From several kilometers away, she glanced at Owen hiding within the manor, smiled slightly, and in a shroud of mist took one step beyond the island’s boundary.
The projection of the "Tenebrous World" could not hinder her in the slightest.
Reaching the sea’s surface, she spoke into the empty void: "Since you’re watching, why not speak? Don’t you still need him to resolve your issue?"
After a long silence, a woman’s voice echoed from the void: "It isn’t time yet... wait a little longer... To go to him now would only burden him..."
...
In West Balam, Berensport, in an ordinary-looking house.
An old man in a plain white robe embroidered with brass-colored thread looked at Ebner, who had just entered, and smiled:
"Your arrival is far earlier than the time I foresaw..."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 893: Sequence 4 Prophet
chapters.content:
Chapter 893: Sequence 4 Prophet
"My name is Luca Brewster. I am a clergyman serving the ’God of Knowledge and Wisdom,’ currently responsible for the church’s affairs in West Bairan.
"I originally expected that you would at least take a year after receiving the invitation letter to arrive, but I didn’t expect that in less than ten months, you would have already become a ’Mysticism Magister.’"
The old gentleman Luca, with silver hair neatly combed and wearing a plain white robe embroidered with brass threads, gave a brief self-introduction, then smiled warmly at Ebner Bryan and said:
"There are many copies of ’mysticism’ prepared in this house. In the coming period, you may freely study and research here. I have also selected several very gifted children in advance. You may teach them the ’mysticism’ you learn, to help you digest the potion more quickly.
"Also, I have already arranged—"
"Wait!" Luca’s words were interrupted before he could finish. Ebner Bryan raised his hand helplessly and said with a hint of disappointment, "But I don’t need those... I have already finished digesting the ’Mysticism Magister’ potion."
Hearing this, Luca froze for a few seconds, then gave a bitter smile. "So it’s not that you came early, but that you came late...
"This is quite different from my ’prophecy’... Indeed, fate is always difficult to grasp."
Sighing, he took two sheets of parchment from a drawer and handed them to Ebner Bryan with a sigh.
"In that case, I have little left that I can provide... only these may still be of some use to you."
Ebner Bryan curiously took the parchments and read the top one carefully:
"Sequence 4: Prophet.
"Main ingredients: The primary eye of an Absolu, the true spirit body of a Mothman.
"Supplementary ingredients: 200ml of Absolu’s blood, 20g of powdered Mothman wings, 10g of bark fragments from a Treant Mentor, 10g of freshly squeezed juice from golden grapes, 10 stalks of blue serrated grass, and a notebook imbued with your own breath and spirit.
"Advancement ritual: Independently complete an invention or discovery, and present it publicly, revealing unknown aspects of it, and causing as many people as possible to feel shock and admiration. Then, before those emotions fade, consume the potion."
The content on the parchment was none other than the potion formula for "Prophet"!
The ritual’s requirements are not as high as that lion, Leon, claimed, about ’an invention or discovery that shocks the world.’ Clearly, his words were exaggerated... Of course, perhaps in his eyes, any invention or discovery should shock the world, since after all, he was raised by Roselle...
Although demigod potion formulas were extremely precious, for Ebner Bryan, who already had the extraordinary characteristics of "Prophet" and could analyze the related information using the "Pure White Eye," this was only a time-saver, not particularly crucial.
So he only grumbled internally for a few moments before setting it down, showing none of the delight Luca had expected, leaving the old man—who had wanted to show off—feeling frustrated again.
Unaware of the elder’s childlike feelings, Ebner Bryan picked up the second sheet of parchment and discovered it was a list recording many scientific achievements.
"Electromagnetic Waves," "Principles of the Photoelectric Effect," "Prevention and Treatment of Anthrax"...
Looking at these titles, which seemed quite different in style from his own, Ebner Bryan faintly guessed their origin but still politely asked, "What are these for?"
Luca’s spirits lifted at the question. He first introduced the significance of each work, then proudly said, "These are papers I have not yet published. You may freely choose one, and the church will find people to promote it, help you build momentum, and finally hold an academic conference to present it, creating a sensation in certain circles...
"In this way, you will be able to complete the ritual relatively smoothly."
Hearing this, Ebner Bryan’s mouth twitched, and he subconsciously asked, "Isn’t that cheating? Can such a ritual count?"
"As long as no one else has published it first, bringing it to public knowledge, it counts! In fact, perhaps others already discovered similar results long ago, but they were buried by history... so naturally, it belongs to whoever first presents it. It cannot be called false." Luca responded unconcernedly.
You’re not wrong there. These things were all studied back in the Old Era before the First Epoch... But plagiarizing others’ work like this feels wrong, and it doesn’t fit my character. If I suddenly present it, people would question me rather than be shocked... It would take a long time—at least half a year to a year of preparation—to succeed...
But Mister Fool will become a demigod in two months, and the world will grow increasingly dangerous... I, too, stand at the center of many conspiracies and whirlpools... Perhaps I cannot wait that long...
As these thoughts turned, Ebner rubbed his chin and asked Luca, "What was your own demigod advancement ritual like?"
"Mine..." Luca did not hide anything. While recalling, he organized his words and replied, "From the ’Mysticism Magister’ stage, I had been teaching knowledge to generals and soldiers of tribal warlords in the Southern Continent. When I was nearing advancement, I had the general summon tens of thousands of soldiers along with their families to witness me, using my knowledge, discover and excavate the remains of a feathered serpent.
"Then, amid their shock and fear, I drank the potion and advanced to demigod.
"But looking back now, the ritual was rather risky. The number of witnesses was still too few. If I had not been respected by them as a ’Mentor,’ trusted and even revered... and if the feathered serpent had not been seen by them as a god... I might have been lost in the ’River of Fate.’"
"So... discovering something that everyone knows exists, but has never been revealed, is also acceptable?" Ebner asked thoughtfully.
"It is, but unlike inventing or discovering a principle with tangible evidence and derivations, you must then rely on sufficiently demonstrating your knowledge reserves, logical reasoning, and a bit of luck..." Luca replied at a steady pace.
"I see... Then it won’t be too much of a problem... As for a large enough audience, I can manage that myself." Ebner Bryan stood up with confidence, bowed to Luca, and said sincerely, "Thank you for your explanation."
"You don’t want any of my research results?" Luca asked in surprise, as if he had "foreseen" something.
"Brewing scientific discoveries takes too long... I’ve thought of a better way." Ebner replied with a smile, then picked up the parchment with the formula again and asked, "Do you have any of these supplementary ingredients on hand?"
Luca thought for a moment and calmly answered, "I still have some of ’Absolu’s blood’... I can sell it to you directly.
"As for the others, the monster ’Mothman’ appears occasionally in the Feysac Empire; you may find it there.
"’Golden grapes’ are native to Intis, but monopolized by the ’Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun’ and several major families; they only grow in their estates.
"’Bark of a Treant Mentor’ is not considered valuable and can be easily bought in Lenburg.
"’Blue serrated grass’ is uncommon. I happened to buy some at a Beyonder gathering back then.
"As for the notebook imbued with your own breath and spirit, I don’t need to provide that, do I?"
After saying this, he asked Ebner to wait and went into the inner room.
While waiting, Ebner calculated inwardly:
The ’powdered wings of a Mothman’ can be handled by Miss Greed; her family has been rooted in Feysac for a thousand years, and they may well have some.
For the ’golden grapes,’ even if Helene’s family doesn’t, the Delaine and Sauron families surely cultivate them. Acquiring some fresh juice shouldn’t be difficult.
As for ’bark fragments of a Treant Mentor,’ I should ask Edwina and Telles first. If neither has them, I can pray to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom... If that fails, I’ll go to Lenburg myself.
’Blue serrated grass’ is rare, but members of the Church of the Earth Mother should cultivate it.
As for the notebook... I should start keeping a diary today. It should still be in time...
After sorting out his plans, Luca came back carrying a metal box sealed with spirituality and placed it on the table.
Ebner Bryan inspected the goods, paid, and once more expressed his gratitude. He promised to return later to study mysticism, then turned and left the house that looked so ordinary.
After he left, Luca’s jaw moved slightly as he murmured to himself:
"What a terrifying young man. Merely meeting him once has altered my fate... The crisis I originally needed someone’s help to survive has suddenly vanished...
"Has the crisis already dissipated, or has it changed into something I cannot ’foresee’?"
Meanwhile, outside, Ebner Bryan boarded the carriage, looked at the waiting mirror spirit Closfia, and smiled.
"It seems we are about to embark on a splendid adventure."
As he spoke, he took out a parchment scroll from his pocket—the gift from Lady Dragonmight, Miss Gwen: Roselle’s map of the Sunk Laureate.
"But with exploration and the advancement ritual keeping me busy, I probably won’t have the energy to join the Tarot Club... Hmm, I’ll just take a two-week leave first."
...
[April 12, Feysac, Intis, Lenburg, Backlund, film premieres, gathering of ingredients, Greed, Helene, Edwina, Closfia, Judy, etc. — events unfold as in the original text, with characters delivering materials, the film Finding the Laureate premiering worldwide, and Ebner Bryan preparing for the ritual.]
...
On April 17th, Sunday.
In Loen, Feysac, Intis, Fenerport, Lenburg... even in Bayam overseas and some major cities in the Southern Continent, theaters opened at the same time, and countless people poured in.
Among them were Xio, Fors, Helene, Edwina, and other friends of Ebner Bryan, as well as Telles, Mr. Azik, and even Klein, who stepped out of the washroom, bought a ticket, and entered the only theater on Sunia Island.
Under the gaze of so many people, Ebner Bryan’s adventure to discover the Laureate began!
As the plot progressed, Ebner Bryan in the film again and again relied on knowledge and wisdom to escape danger, ultimately deducing the location of the Laureate and boldly diving into the great whirlpool... When he finally uncovered the treasure after countless hardships, the audience’s shock, envy, and awe reached their peak.
At that very moment, Ebner Bryan drank the prepared potion in one gulp.
The icy potion slid down his throat, and he felt himself entering a world devoid of color, mechanical and cold, filled with endless streams of information.
It was the "World of Absolute Rationality," the very domain of the "River of Fate"!
The Pure White Eye opened automatically, the "Wheel of Fate" within it reflecting and intertwining with the "River of Fate"...
About three to four minutes later, Ebner Bryan finally raised his hand to rub his throbbing forehead. His face bore both astonishment and joy.
He was astonished at the smoothness of the advancement, and joyful because—
He had finally attained the initial spark of divinity, becoming a demigod existence of the Reader Pathway!
He had become—
Sequence 4, "Prophet"!

chapters.title: Chapter 894: New Abilities and the Pure White Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 894: New Abilities and the Pure White Eye
After a burst of excitement, Ebner recalled the experience he had just gone through after consuming the potion, and he couldn’t help but furrow his brow.
The state of immersing himself in the "world of absolute rationality," wandering through the different tributaries of the "River of Fate," was simply too dangerous!
Of course, this didn’t mean that Ebner had encountered a great peril during his advancement. On the contrary, his promotion had been relatively smooth.
But unlike ordinary "Mysticism Magisters," he had long since grown accustomed to a "multi-threaded" mental state thanks to the ability provided by the "Pure White Eye" back at Sequence 9. What’s more, the "ritual" he held for his advancement to Sequence 4 was of an absolutely unparalleled scale, and its effect of anchoring him in reality was exceptionally strong.
Even with all those advantages combined, Ebner still felt lingering fear toward the terror of the "River of Fate." With one careless mistake, he might have been trapped there forever, becoming part of that world! If even he felt this way, how much more luck would other Mysticism Magisters need to succeed in advancing?
Or is it that I’m special? That’s why I was able to plunge into the River of Fate... while others only observe from afar during their advancement?
Is this the influence of the "Wheel of Destiny" I obtained after the Pure White Eye?
Hmm, I recall Lilith once said that after becoming a demigod, I would qualify to begin learning the secrets of the Pure White Eye... but that it would be best not to enter it myself...
Though tempted to explore the "space" behind the Pure White Eye immediately, Ebner had just completed his promotion and his spirit was exhausted. To prevent any accidents, he decided to rest with his eyes closed first and act only once he had fully recovered.
While waiting, he also organized the knowledge he had gained during the promotion and obtained a preliminary grasp of the abilities of the "Seer":
First of all, by becoming a Seer, he could glimpse the River of Fate and naturally acquired the core ability of this Sequence—"Prophecy."
This ability had roughly three directions of application:
The first was the combination of his previous "Breath Extraction" and "Scene Retrospection" abilities, elevating the former into "Information Extraction." This truly realized the saying, "Everything leaves a trace." As long as no Authority-level powers interfered, he could extract "information" from within a scene out of thin air, then "retrospect" its past "fate trajectory." Compared to before, this was far more advanced, resembling the method by which the "god" in a domestic animation he once watched read hidden data.
The second was the sublimation of his "Mechanical Mind" into an "Absolute Rationality State," allowing him to observe the River of Fate within this mode. With the help of "keywords," he could "search" for related information, then use his further-advanced "Analysis" ability to deduce the direction of fate.
Most of the time, fate branched into multiple paths depending on choices. Typically, a newly advanced Seer could only observe and analyze the most probable "fate tributary," with limited accuracy and success rate... just like when Ebner had once used the Pure White Eye to attempt "active prophecy" before he had obtained the Wheel of Destiny.
However, his prophetic ability had mutated because of his deep immersion into the World of Absolute Rationality and the River of Fate during advancement. He could observe far more developments of fate than ordinary Seers, and his results were clearer and more accurate.
That said, the Seer pathway was inherently dangerous. After glimpsing the future, a Seer could not casually reveal the results or act deliberately upon them—for most people and things, their fate was already set.
Changing fate would force the Seer to pay a heavy price.
Thus, most Seers only guided others discreetly, nudging them toward fate tributaries with better outcomes. This way, they avoided being backlashed by fate and paid negligible costs.
But if one insisted on changing someone’s predetermined fate, fate’s resistance was inevitable. Even if the attempt succeeded, the Seer would pay a steep price.
The cost might be reduced lifespan, weakened fortune, harm to family ties, or the attraction of disaster... reminiscent of the "Five Losses and Three Lacks" that fortune-tellers in his previous life spoke of.
Of course, this wasn’t absolute. Some Seers actually gained benefits after altering others’ fates...
Ebner guessed that this was because the foundational rules of the mysterious world were chaotic. The honorific of the Old One who symbolized "Fate," the Key of Light, even contained the description: "Endless Chaos." Thus, problems in the application of fate-related abilities were normal.
The third direction was "Passive Prophecy" related to one’s own fate. This only applied to oneself. Upon encountering a key person, object, phrase, or even sound, the Seer would passively receive a prophecy that told them how to avoid disaster or seize fortune.
Because such prophecies lacked "information," they were often vague, but every Seer valued them greatly. For example, that Knowledge Church leader in West Balam, Mr. Luca, in the original novel had actively sought out Klein because he passively foresaw that Klein could turn a crisis into an opportunity.
For prophecies about oneself, there was no need to worry about fate’s backlash—perhaps because Beyonders in the domain of Fate had inherently unstable destinies.
After researching his new ability of Prophecy, Ebner sensed his other powers and found that the "Omniscient Heart" had fused with the "Learning Space" into his incomplete demigod mythic form—the bookshelf of the Crippled Room, surrounded by countless eyes made of black shadow.
In essence, this mythic form was just a "room" within the White Tower that stored knowledge.
The Learning Space formed its framework, the Omniscient Heart provided its material foundation, and "Analysis" became the eyes within the shadows.
With the Omniscient Heart’s sublimation, the mystic techniques that once required rituals or special items could now be instantly cast as if they were extraordinary abilities.
Take "Disintegration," for example. In the past, Ebner needed the longsword of the "Hell Lieutenant General," which could destroy anything, as a medium.
But now, he could directly "create" the trait of that sword within himself, then complete the mystic technique.
Even the extraordinary items or talismans he had crafted in the past, since they too were stored within the Learning Space, could now be "created" within his mythic form.
Unfortunately, such creations couldn’t last long in reality. Once removed from his Crippled White Tower, their power would dissipate within seconds, and their material basis would instantly collapse.
Talismans could still unleash their effects if used quickly, but extraordinary items were difficult to employ, and using them risked harming himself when they collapsed.
Since they were already included in his White Tower, meaning he could simulate their abilities directly, there was little point in using such "created" items in battle. This application was somewhat tasteless.
Still, it reminded him of the Dream Labyrinth Tower’s exchange function. The "Ninth Law Talisman" he once exchanged for had a similar application, unable to exist long in reality...
Lilith once said the Dream Labyrinth Tower was built using an Archangel’s extraordinary characteristics... Heh, so the entire tower was actually created by Roselle relying on another’s mythic form? The bookshelves in the ’Reward Space’ must be the knowledge reserves of that deceased Archangel.
Well, no rush. Once I advance to Sequence 3, the Cognizer, I’ll take complete control of the Dream Labyrinth Tower.
Speaking of which, my Seer potion has already been mostly digested right after I drank it, with less than a fifth remaining. At this rate, I may fully digest it within a month or two.
For now, the Seer’s acting requirements seem to revolve around three aspects: "Glimpsing Fate," "Diverting Fate," and "Changing Fate."
The hardest of these is Changing Fate, since it requires heavy costs and often brings resistance and danger... But I may already have fulfilled this part. My arrival alone has altered the fates of countless people... Not to mention the big shots—just Talim, Cherie, Dunn, Daly, Freya, even Buddy and Winter... all of them avoided death because of me. That definitely counts as changing fate.
Not to mention Zaratul and the Chained God, along with other angels and demigods who should not have died, yet did...
The strange thing is, I haven’t paid too steep a price for this... Is it because I don’t belong to this world? Or did the Pure White Eye shield me?
And as for glimpsing fate... is there anything more like peering at fate than reading the plot of a novel? In a sense, the Secret novel itself is a reflection of the River of Fate.
What I currently lack is the simplest—Diverting Fate. That is, guiding others so their fate flows into tributaries with better or worse outcomes.
As he calculated in his heart, Ebner felt his spirit had almost fully recovered. He took a deep breath and activated the Pure White Eye.
Now, as a demigod, he immediately sensed the differences in the Pure White Eye.
First, due to his divinity, he hardly felt any burden from this "golden finger." Even if he kept it active for days on end, it would likely be no problem.
Second, unlike before, with his mythic form, Ebner could clearly perceive the existence of the passage behind the Eye.
That passage didn’t lead to reality, nor to the spirit world or astral world... A voice whispered within him that it connected to an "unknown" world!
Ebner had a hunch that as long as he transformed into his mythic form, he could pass through the passage and enter the world beyond.
But Lilith had warned him not to enter rashly before reaching angelhood... So, after a moment’s hesitation, Ebner split off a fragment of shadow containing an "eye." This was his mental and rational avatar, a thread of his multi-threaded thoughts, a mythic state born of his sublimated "Analysis" fused with his divinity.
He named it "Insight Eye."
The shadow with the eye was soon sent by Ebner into the passage behind the Pure White Eye.
Immediately, through the Insight Eye, a gigantic illusory sun embedded with a pair of illusory brass eyes manifested in Ebner’s mind.
It sat at the other end of the entrance, completely blocking the passage!
"Pure White Eye"... "Pure White Angel"... "Omniscient Eye"...
So the names I casually gave... actually held real meaning?!
(End of this Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 895: The Curtain Gradually Rises
chapters.content:
Chapter 895: The Curtain Gradually Rises
"Pure White Angel"... "Omniscient Eye"...
So this was the true nature of the "golden finger" ability? That was why he could always experience the powers of the "Reader" pathway in advance, why his abilities of "Analysis" and "Retrospection" far surpassed those of ordinary demigods?
So that was also why the "Divine Light" he simulated through the Pure White Eye exceeded the genuine version, and could even draw the attention of that third Pope of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, sealed inside the "Mirror of Calamity," and the second Pope who had seized Selo’s fate—making both recognize him as their master?
But these two things clearly weren’t part of the space behind the Pure White Eye originally... and they even blocked the entrance.
Who had placed them here, making them his "golden finger"?
Ebner faintly guessed the answer, but he had no evidence. He wasn’t in a hurry, though, for if his guess was right, the proof lay within this very space.
At this thought, the Insight Eye in the shadow, under Ebner’s control, carefully observed the illusory "sun." Soon, he saw a golden wheel of light at its top—the very "Wheel of Destiny" that had intruded earlier.
On the left side of the golden wheel was a crimson mass. The aura it emitted felt vaguely familiar. After some recognition, Ebner realized it was Zaratul’s historical projection.
But most of that red mass had already been dyed black. The little that remained grew ever dimmer, as though it struggled desperately against some kind of corruption.
Beneath the sun, many black spots were scattered. Some were near—close enough that the Insight Eye could almost touch them—while others lay far away, some even behind the illusory sun.
Amid those dark marks, very close to the pair of illusory "brass eyes," floated an ancient-looking seal, glowing fiery red.
Just by seeing it, Ebner felt a strange sense of familiarity, and he blurted out:
"The Calamity Seal?!
"So it’s here! That means... my vague guesses might actually be correct?
"Hm, if the Calamity Seal is listed alongside those black spots... then their essence must be..."
He immediately directed the Insight Eye toward the nearest black spot and extended his spirituality to make contact.
In an instant, a foreign memory unfolded before his eyes.
It was from more than a year ago, when a foreign soul named Liu Bo descended upon a gentleman who had just died in a shipwreck.
But tragically, even after taking over, Liu Bo couldn’t escape death. He watched helplessly as the original body’s wife and children were devoured by a Segust sea monster, and soon after, he too perished in the ocean.
After witnessing this brief five-minute life, Ebner fell silent. Only after a long while did he sigh softly:
"So, the anonymous check of 500 pounds that the Dream Labyrinth Tower once gave me... actually belonged to the former ’me’!"
Yes, even though that life lasted only five minutes, Ebner discovered within Liu Bo’s inherited memories a familiar anonymous check. Its withdrawal code was identical to the reward he had received from the Dream Labyrinth Tower.
This matches some of the things I once suspected in the Land of Evernight but was prevented from thinking deeper about...
So, I really wasn’t crossing for the first time!
Then, those so-called ’other transmigrators’... were all me?
But those guys were all so crafty... no, shrewd and calculating... Can someone as simple as me really be them?
One case proves nothing. I need to look further.
With that, Ebner guided the Insight Eye deeper into the space, contacting several more black spots.
Sure enough, each one corresponded to Liu Bo’s "transmigrations" over the past decade or so. But not a single one lasted long.
One had crossed into a "sorcerer" who invented unique sorcery to borrow power from higher-tier extraordinary items, hoping to probe his golden finger. But he died on the spot from mysterious backlash.
One, similar to Ebner’s own first crossing, sold formulas at a foreign Beyonder gathering, only to be tracked and murdered for profit.
Another had transmigrated into a fallen Nighthawk. Upon awakening, he found enemies guarding the corpse to harvest its trait, and unsurprisingly was killed again.
Ebner’s expression grew darker with each one he examined. Finally, when he touched a black spot near the surface of the "sun," he saw a somewhat "familiar" figure and a life much longer than the rest combined.
That black spot bore the imprint of Giuseppe Castilla.
Giuseppe Castilla, heir to Count Senepot Sevia, member of an angelic family, died after trespassing into the ruins of a Red Angel in Backlund.
Afterward, Liu Bo transmigrated into him, escaped the underground ruins successfully, and took the new name "Felipe."
Instead of returning to his family, Felipe, while traveling, "accidentally" encountered Lamia, who had fled from the Earth Mother Church. The two fell in love and lived a carefree life as "husband and wife" in a hidden valley of Blue Mountain Island.
Because of Lamia’s special body, they could not conceive children, so they adopted a baby boy.
Becoming a father seemed to give Felipe the resolve to face the coming apocalypse. He went out seeking advancement opportunities but eventually died within the Ghost Empire.
A stream of vivid memories swept through Ebner’s mind. Even as he mocked the melodrama of this "plot," his scalp tingled with dread.
After all, the Earth Mother Goddess—Lilith herself—had once personally admitted that Lamia was one of her more unusual avatars. Much of the "liveliness" she now showed in her human nature came from her time as Lamia.
Giuseppe was Liu Bo—was himself...
No wonder Lilith treated him with such leniency. With the relationship Lamia once had with Giuseppe, their bond was still rather distant now.
Hmm... if all previous transmigrators were him as well, then he must have known Lilith long ago. Even his body as "Rhine Karenardia" had been in her hands, serving as her vessel for descent...
Wait, Kalun and Helene are heirs of the Feast of Blood, carrying Rhine’s bloodline... Could they be my and Lilith’s descendants?
And come to think of it, Rhine, Vicente, Arvin, Ivans, Felipe... all those names appeared in Arcana! Even Daniel seemed to show up in that novel...
The naming style was so consistent. If Felipe was Liu Bo, then the others very likely were too!
That’s right—why had I forgotten Arcana before? I had to recall it from Felipe’s memories...
If I had remembered, I would surely have connected the dots and realized that all the so-called transmigrators outside the original story were the same person...
And I would have very likely concluded that they were all me!
Yes, that must be why I had forgotten Arcana!
Lilith had clearly told him not to investigate these things before reaching demigodhood. She must have been referring to this truth—that all transmigrators were Liu Bo.
But what danger did uncovering this pose?
Just then, Ebner noticed the Insight Eye he had sent into the "unknown land" becoming sluggish.
Sensing carefully, he was shocked to find it was being "corrupted" by a strange power, much like Zaratul’s historical projection. The corruption spread faster and faster, and soon he lost control. It even tried to spread back along their link to overwhelm his true body.
At once, Ebner severed the connection.
Frowning, he "retrospected" the entire process of the Insight Eye entering the unknown land, then muttered thoughtfully:
"The moment it entered, it was already being corrupted by that power. But its resistance seemed stronger than Zaratul’s historical projection. At the entry point, the corruption progressed so slowly it was negligible.
"But the deeper it went, the stronger the force became. By the time it reached Felipe’s black spot, it quickly lost resistance. And that’s just at the entrance of the passage. Beyond the ’sun,’ the corruption will surely be far worse!
"Hm, what resisted the corruption was the ’divinity’ I attached to the Insight Eye. In other words, if I want to see further, to glimpse the earlier lives that belong to me, I must keep enhancing and strengthening my divinity.
"Heh, who knows how vast that space is... Beyond the sun might lie boundless regions. It probably takes an angel to truly pass through the sun at the entrance and delve into the unknown.
"That must be why Lilith forbade me from investigating before reaching demigodhood... Perhaps even knowing the truth—that all transmigrators were Liu Bo—would allow corruption to seep out from the unknown land. Without demigod divinity, I probably wouldn’t even have been able to cut off the connection.
"But what exactly is the essence of that corruption? The secret technique I once created to control ’Owen,’ based on the hints from those earlier transmigrations—or rather, earlier versions of myself—likely also used this corruption.
"Unfortunately, though Felipe lived a happy life, he contributed nothing to this secret art. He knew even less about the unknown land than I do... Truly a...
"Cough, he was me too... I can’t just curse myself."
After mulling it over, Ebner suddenly remembered something: ever since he revealed the truth to Klein, Klein had never once called him "Liu Bo." Yet he himself sometimes called Klein "Old Zhou" in the Sefirah Castle.
"For my past self, Liu Bo, perhaps Klein knew something?
"And he still hides Roselle’s crucial diary pages?
"Yes... I recall that whenever I badmouthed those so-called ’senior transmigrators,’ even though his expression control was perfect, there would occasionally be a slight incongruity...
"I didn’t think much of it then, but now it seems he must have already known that those transmigrators were me. He was watching me make a fool of myself!
"Heh, Old Zhou, you really are something!
"Tomorrow is the Tarot Meeting. During the small gathering, I’ll settle accounts with him... and make sure to get those key diary pages."
Having made up his mind, Ebner steadied his thoughts and once again studied the Pure White Eye. But this time, he didn’t send the Insight Eye in, and of course he wouldn’t enter himself. In terms of resisting corruption, he was no stronger than the Insight Eye, since both consumed his divinity.
Instead, as after each promotion, he examined how the Pure White Eye, his golden finger, would enhance his abilities.
"Come to think of it, whichever past me put this thing here, it was clearly prepared to help later versions of me better utilize the unknown land.
"With it, opening the passage becomes much easier. Even mere spirituality suffices, though at first only for a few seconds...
"Heh, perhaps until the Pure White Eye itself enters and stabilizes the entrance, I will need to be at least a demigod—or maybe even an angel—before I can truly connect to the unknown land!"
(End of this Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 896: Ebner’s Intuition
chapters.content:
Chapter 896: Ebner’s Intuition
After activating the "Pure White Eye" and studying it carefully for a while, Ebner basically figured out what new "experiences" he had gained after advancing to "Prophet."
Enhancement to existing skills isn’t worth mentioning, since that’s the inherent ability of the Pure White Eye—every Sequence has it...
What benefits me most is the sublimation of the ’Simulation’ ability!
The upgraded Simulation lets me briefly transform into the ’Incomplete Mythical Form’ of other pathways to fight!
This is also one of the signature abilities of the ’Cognizer.’
Of course, the prerequisite is that the model of the Incomplete Mythical Form must be fully analyzed and mastered by me...
Heh, I recall that Teles, after receiving the ’Blood Fairy’ reward from Lilith, once said that the ritual to advance to ’Cognizer’ requires an in-depth understanding of at least three Incomplete Mythical Forms. Only by fully parsing their models can one consume the potion...
Moreover, the more Incomplete Mythical Essences one masters, and the wider the fields covered, the higher the chance of a successful promotion.
Now that I think about it, this ability of the ’Cognizer’... perhaps it should be called ’Mimicry’... it ought to have been acquired from the ritual itself.
This ritual seems simple, but it’s not easy at all... after all, what demigod would willingly expose themselves entirely for someone else’s study? Either you must be trusted deeply, or you must have enough power to forcibly parse them...
But for me... in a certain sense, this ritual is already complete!
Thinking of this, Ebner recalled the information he had just obtained from the Pure White Eye. Inside it—or rather, inside that illusory brass eye set upon the "Sun"—there were preserved the complete models of the Mythical Forms of nine pathways: "Monster," "Apothecary," "Corpse Collector," "Apprentice," "Prisoner," "Savant," "Hunter," "Arbiter," and "Bard."
The ’Monster’ information should have come from the ’God of Luck.’ He really was me? What concerns me is, what exactly is His relationship with the ’Queen of Calamity’?
As for ’Apothecary,’ that must be the ’Observer with Silver Eyes,’ Rhine Karenardia... Tsk, can’t believe that back then I was so shameless, actually pretending with a title from Arcanism...
I remember Lilith said that he... no, ’I’ once told the other party stories from Arcanism... Ha, did I even use the line ’whenever you see the moon, think of me’ to curry favor? That really does sound like something I would do.
The ’Corpse Collector’ knowledge corresponds to the ’Lord of Spirits,’ Vicente Miranda... yet another... forget it, better not complain about myself again...
But this ’me’ was very likely Jane’s ancestor... No wonder the first time I met Jane after transmigrating, I felt such familiarity... But how should I get along with her in the future?
Forget it, best to pretend nothing happened, to avoid awkwardness when we meet.
The ’Apprentice’ is also clear: the ’Wanderer’ Alwen Abraham, who died in the Land of Evernight.
Heh, Alwen? No wonder the mysticism book he left behind was called "Book of Astrology and Elements"...
If my Arcanism-related memories hadn’t been blocked, I probably would’ve clarified some things long ago! Hm, it feels like the former me left many methods behind, but they weren’t systematic... From Alwen onwards, however, ’my’ scheming ability seems to have grown by leaps and bounds.
The puzzles in the Quiz Labyrinth, the arrangements in the Land of Evernight, the connection with the Goddess... everything is so mysterious!
Was it because upon entering the Fifth Epoch, ’I’ finally felt a sense of crisis? Couldn’t afford to be as reckless as before?
’Prisoner’ is the one I currently know best besides Giuseppe—Danitz Tinekerr... who schemed against the Mother Tree of Desire, freed the Chained God, who is now the Spiritual Angel Tolzna.
I’ve more or less figured out his other arrangements. The only unclear part is what kind of experiment he conducted with the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and what transaction they had... Hm, perhaps I can reverse-engineer this by studying Baron Conva, who was sealed away by Mr. Azik.
Also, although I lack proof, the brass-colored eye within the Pure White Eye—that illusory ’All-Knowing Eye’—was most likely the product of Danitz and the God of Knowledge’s experiment.
The model of the ’Savant’ Mythical Form should belong to the unlucky ’me’ who transmigrated to the Forsaken Land of the Gods and even built a floating city!
Though I don’t know his name, judging from the secret techniques of the floating city—’Ivans’s Hidden Barrier’ and ’Vaolit’s Perfect Restoration’—they must’ve been named after figures from Arcanism.
This ’me’s black spot wasn’t too far from the entrance, just slightly farther than the Calamity Seal. Once I become stronger, I should be able to read his memories.
’Hunter’ is undoubtedly the Calamity Seal. This ’me’ is the most unusual, even feeling unfamiliar to me... It was because of him that for the longest time I didn’t consider the possibility of having transmigrated multiple times.
He’s the ultimate schemer. In countless events I’ve encountered, his shadow has loomed! He even tied together all the prior arrangements of ’me’... The millennium plan against the Mother Tree, the ’Silver Moon Project’ to seize the Goddess of Beauty’s power—most likely these were perfected in tacit agreement with the gods.
He feels the least like me of all the ’me’s!
The ’Arbiter’ representative is Giuseppe Castiya, no need to say more. Among the demigod versions of me, he was likely the lowest Sequence—just a Sequence 4 ’Imperative Mage.’
The last, the ’Sun,’ should not be ’me,’ but rather the model provided by that illusory sun within the Pure White Eye...
I still don’t know what it truly is... After all, the Eternal Blazing Sun and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom still exist, so where did the ’Pure White Angel’ and the ’All-Knowing Eye’ at Sequence 1 come from?
After wandering in thought for a while, Ebner suddenly realized something and mocked himself:
All my past selves—except Giuseppe—were really amazing! They’ve ’arranged’ everything for the current me so thoroughly...
Take advancing to Sequence 3 ’Cognizer,’ for example. Right now I’m just Sequence 4, but my potion digestion is already four-fifths complete. The next potion formula and one of its main ingredients, the ’Eye of Asmo,’ I’ve already obtained from ’Lust’ Owen. The other main ingredient, the ’complete brain of a Mist Monster,’ also has a lead from Princess Vera...
Couple that with this ritual already being completed, barring accidents, I just need to gather the auxiliary materials, and within one or two months I can smoothly advance to Cognizer!
As for the next step, ’Wisdom Angel,’ its characteristic has already been arranged within the Dream Labyrinth Tower...
If I really were a rebellious youth, I’d surely resist this kind of ’arrangement’! Too bad I’m not... so I choose to say, ’It smells sweet.’
But one must have ambition. I should set a small goal for myself first... Hm, within the next one or two months, I’ll try to collect as many more Incomplete Mythical Form models as possible.
After sorting through the "All-Knowing Eye" portion of the Pure White Eye’s abilities, since he could already observe the scenes within the channels and distinguish between them, Ebner then experimented with stirring the power of the "Pure White Angel" alone. He discovered that, without even using Simulation, he could already wield most of the Sequence 4 "Unshadowed" abilities.
Moreover, the effects seemed even stronger than those of a genuine Unshadowed.
"It’s equivalent to having another Grade 1 Sealed Artifact with hardly any side effects..."
Ebner gave this evaluation, nodded in satisfaction, then packed away the beakers and flasks, dismissed the Spirituality Wall, and pushed open the door of his home at 28 Kinster Street. He was heading toward the main theater of the "Bryan Film Company" in Hillston District to attend the "banquet" after the premiere of their new movie.
Because he had donated all the 3 million pounds’ worth of valuables salvaged from the "Laurel" as offering, Ebner was about to be conferred the title of "Viscount of Belden." Thus, he had been staying in Backlund recently, awaiting an audience with the King.
Speaking of which, Ebner’s original plan after advancing to demigod was to visit the "Harvest Church" to meet Lilith’s descent vessel, then seek out Lady Yalolan, who wished to meet him, and finally consult Princess Vera regarding the lead to another main potion ingredient...
But plans couldn’t keep up with changes. Ever since learning that all the past transmigrators had been himself, Ebner had resolved that until he got Roselle’s crucial diary from Klein and figured out his actual relationship with those "ladies," he would avoid them for now.
This wasn’t because he had "prophesied" anything, but because Ebner’s intuition told him this was the more "prudent" choice.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 897: Prophecy and Another Seal
chapters.content:
Chapter 897: Prophecy and Another Seal
Belden City was located in Jianhai County, a city that had once risen on coal mines and later declined because of them.
Since the coal resources began to run dry, the young people in the city gradually left Belden for larger metropolises like Constant and Backlund to make a living. This city, which had once been fairly prosperous, quickly lost its vitality, and the atmosphere became more and more oppressive.
After all, even though it sat along a railway line, Belden, which had lost its own resources and had yet to find a new identity, offered no visible hope.
For such a half-dead city, with a bit of reputation but no practical benefit, situated in Jianhai County—a border region facing Feysac—granting it as a fiefdom to a "newly minted viscount" who had contributed three million pounds of wealth was nothing more than a costless reward for the Loen royal family.
A few days ago, when Ebner heard that George III was planning to grant him this city, he couldn’t help but sigh at just how calculating the king really was.
If he remembered correctly, according to the trajectory of the original story, this very Belden City would fall in the coming war. And just as it had yet to recover from the devastation, it would suffer another calamity when the archbishop of the Church of the God of Combat fled into the city with the sealed artifact "0-02," nearly destroying it altogether...
Truly unfortunate timing... but since I, a ’Prophet’ who can defy fate itself, am now this city’s lord, perhaps fortune has turned in its favor!
After a few moments of self-praise, Ebner did not feel that revitalizing the economy of a declining city was particularly difficult. In fact, with just a bit of casual thought he already had several plans—such as directly investing in the construction of a "film city" and outdoor sets there, turning it into a filming site for various genres of movies to push the city into a new identity...
When that time came, wouldn’t there be flocks of people coming here like "northern drifters"? How could there be no vitality then!
In short, as long as there was investment and resources were directed there, was there any reason development wouldn’t follow?
Especially since Ebner could at any time "observe" the city’s "course of destiny" and choose the most "reliable" stream of fate to guide it along.
While turning these plans over in his mind, Ebner was about to board his carriage to head to the theater in Hillston District.
But just then, he suddenly felt a strange "premonition." He stopped in his tracks and told the coachman to wait a moment.
It was his "passive prophecy" ability, suddenly giving him a sign: he absolutely must buy the newspaper in the newsboy’s hands in a few minutes, and afterward, "fate" would unfold in a way favorable to him.
This feeling wasn’t unfamiliar to Ebner. Even back when he was still an ordinary man, the Pure White Eye had subtly influenced him with "passive prophecy."
For example, on the very first day of his transmigration, he suddenly joined in Xio’s mission and generously told her about the "acting method." Beyond the fact that he himself already had a favorable impression of Xio, who in the original story was Miss "Judgment" of the Tarot Club, and that the "Reader" pathway carried a tendency to show off, subconsciously following prophecy to seek fortune and avoid harm had been another important reason.
It was just that back then, he had not realized this was the Pure White Eye’s influence, believing it to be his own decision.
Only after becoming "Knowledge Keeper" and deepening his use of the Pure White Eye did he faintly notice the truth.
"But what was the benefit of approaching Xio back then?
"Was it that she and Fors became my close friends?
"Or was it that I shook off the sense of unreality at the start of my transmigration, and gained a ’bond’?"
As Ebner let his thoughts wander, a newsboy came around the street corner. The boy’s business seemed to have gone well today—by the early afternoon his satchel was already empty, with only one last newspaper still in his hands.
Seeing this, Ebner knew that this was the figure from his prophecy. He beckoned the boy over.
The clear voice of the newsboy rang out, with a slightly uneasy tone: "Sir, there’s only one copy of the Tarsok Miscellany left..."
The Tarsok Miscellany was a small tabloid that only published bits of street gossip. Because it never relied on exaggerated headlines for sensationalism, its sales were always mediocre.
It was rumored that the only reason it hadn’t gone bankrupt as a weekly was because its backer had been continually subsidizing it...
But Ebner knew the truth: the real owner of this little paper was actually a high-ranking deacon of the Church of Storms, Stuart. Most of the stories printed were events from the families of more open-minded Storm believers. He seemed to be trying to express certain views through this, but unfortunately its influence was far too limited.
Come to think of it, the reason Ebner even knew this at all was because Xio had told him.
Just over a month ago, on the night he had met with Princess Vera in secret, Xio had received an urgent mission to recover a stolen seal.
That seal was said to be the signet of the Intis Gustav Dynasty, but it had been stolen during an exhibition. The Mandated Punishers responsible for security lost face, and so Stuart was added to the case as well, forming a joint investigative group with the military.
At that time, it was only by relying on his own "Retrospection" ability and the help of his newspaper’s reporters that Stuart discovered the thief’s rented lodgings and recovered the stolen seal overnight.
Unfortunately, the thief still managed to escape in the end. No one had ever truly seen his face, and it remained completely unknown who he was or why, after stealing the seal, he chose to abandon it.
Since Stuart had used his reporters in that case, it was natural that Xio learned of the Tarsok Miscellany, and later she told Ebner.
While turning these things over in his mind, Ebner pulled out a coin and paid the newsboy, buying the paper.
Then, he boarded the carriage and began reading it on his way to the theater.
Ebner skimmed quickly over the family drama stories and soon locked his gaze onto a single advertisement:
"This Wednesday at 10 a.m., the private museum at 16 Pinster Street, North District, will open its doors..."
If my premonition was right, it should be this... Could it be that this private museum will exhibit something useful to me?
And moreover, the entire paper only has this one advertisement... Is the circulation so poor that no one wants to pay for ads, or is this museum actually connected to the newspaper?
Perhaps I should send someone to investigate first...
Lost in thought, Ebner soon arrived at the theater. After alighting from the carriage, he entered through the back door, and before long he saw Xio, who was busy arranging for people to handle reporters and film critics.
Speaking of which, since the "film industry" had only just begun, most of the film critics at present were not very professional—in fact, a large portion of them were "plants" that Ebner had trained beforehand to guide public opinion...
After all, the battlefield of public discourse had to be seized early. As long as he nurtured some authoritative critics and established a reputable film journal, it would become much harder for competitors to surpass his company.
On the other side, when Xio saw Ebner arrive, she finally breathed a sigh of relief. To her, hosting such an event was more exhausting than a fight with a Beyonder.
Still, she pulled Ebner aside first, stood on tiptoe, and studied him for quite some time with a very complex expression, before speaking with both excitement and genuine happiness for him: "The ritual was successful?
"Ebner, you’ve become a demigod?"
His state wasn’t good—his brain was a muddle—so he only wrote this much.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 898: Curiosity Killed…
chapters.content:
Chapter 898: Curiosity Killed...
Seeing the complicated emotions on Xio’s face, Ebner remembered the "Loen-style" subtlety from the original story. Without answering directly, he just chuckled and said:
"No need to envy me. You’ll soon catch up with my footsteps too."
Just a few days earlier, Xio’s ritual application report had finally been approved by the military high command. They opened a Berot Mountain ape nest under their control to her, and she successfully used the chaotic and lawless rules within to resist the "self-punishment" impulse after consuming her potion, becoming a Sequence 5 "Disciplinary Paladin."
Ebner really has become a demigod...
In a daze, Xio recalled the promise they had made during their travels about "demigods." Back then, she had felt that such lofty beings were impossibly distant, forever out of reach...
But how long had it really been? Barely ten months, and Ebner had already pushed open the doors of a Saint, obtained divinity... and I myself am already a Sequence 5 Beyonder...
Maybe within a few years, I’ll truly be able to uncover the truth behind Father’s unjust case!
Regarding her father’s misfortune, although Xio had used her convenience as a formal member of MI9 to secretly investigate and uncover some scraps of information and vague suspicions, her intuition told her the truth was still far away. After all, if even Ebner and Princess Vera had chosen silence, it was clearly not a simple matter.
"I’m not confident I can keep up with your pace... After all, even Her Highness had to personally collect a demigod characteristic. It’s nearly impossible for me to obtain materials from MI9, no matter how great the merit I render..." Xio first mocked herself, then adjusted her mood and teased with a smile: "Congratulations, Ebner... And since you’ve succeeded, shouldn’t you be treating us to a celebration?"
"Of course I’ll treat everyone—I’ve already made preparations. After all, quite a few people helped with my ritual..."
But it’ll have to be split into groups. If I invite everyone at once, I have a premonition something bad will happen.
After grumbling in his heart, Ebner shifted the subject with meaning: "Actually, the materials for your demigod promotion aren’t entirely without a source."
Xio froze at first, then realized something and asked in return: "You mean the ’Ghost Empire’?"
"That’s right. Less than two months remain before the ’Ghost Empire’ makes its next ’port call.’ If you digest your Disciplinary Paladin in time, you might have the chance to ascend to demigod then." Ebner nodded with a smile.
"No one knows what lies hidden within the ’Ghost Empire’..." Xio shook her head, unwilling to fantasize about uncertain matters. "Besides, the ritual for ’Imperative Mage’ is not so easily completed."
Though I don’t know what treasures lie deep within the Ghost Empire, ’Giuseppe Castilla’ did die there. His... well, my... ’Imperative Mage’ characteristic must still remain...
Ebner silently added in his heart, but outwardly he recalled the "Judgment" card he had once seen, and said thoughtfully: "The promotion ritual for Imperative Mage requires one to establish laws and decrees in a town of at least ten thousand people, and for every person there to sincerely recognize and obey them, right?"
"Yes... Without official cooperation, this ritual is nearly impossible to complete," Xio sighed.
"It’s not that difficult... You know, I’m about to be ennobled as Viscount Belden. That city has plenty of subordinate towns. With a bit of planning, it shouldn’t be hard." Several schemes instantly flashed through Ebner’s mind. He continued: "And if you don’t want to attract the authorities’ notice, I also hold a hereditary barony in Segar with its own territory... though its population might not reach ten thousand."
That Segar barony came from "Apostle of Light" Balu, whose greatest legacy to Ebner had been that title he had bought with money.
Of course, if necessary, Ebner could also use Giuseppe Castilla’s identity to return to Feynapotter and inherit the title of Count Sevia... though that would be troublesome. Even with Giuseppe’s full memories, he would need to maneuver carefully, since according to Closfia, the title had long been passed to Giuseppe’s younger brother.
"Let’s wait until I actually obtain the demigod characteristic before talking about it," Xio said, waving her hand. Outwardly she looked unconcerned, but Ebner’s earnestness on the matter made the corners of her lips curl upward uncontrollably.
The two chatted for a while longer, until a staff member knocked to announce the banquet’s beginning.
Speaking of which, the film
Finding the Laurel
had a tremendous impact on audiences. Unlike
Roselle Gustav,
which, though finely produced, was only on par with stage plays and operas of the same genre—just more realistic—this one was completely different.
It was the very first adventure film of this era!
For those who had never glimpsed the vastness of the world or the ferocity of the sea, the visual impact was incomparable!
And at the film’s climax, when Ebner used "Knowledge" to calculate the escape velocity and angle, and successfully guided the
Laurel
out of the "Maelstrom," the scene became an eternal classic, unforgettable to all who saw it.
After all, the news of Ebner Bryan being granted nobility thanks to the treasure made everyone believe the story told in the film was entirely true.
Of course, only Ebner and Closfia, who had filmed the footage, knew that while the formulas in the calculation were sound, the
Laurel
had actually been lightened by the mutated Tudor Emblem Ebner wielded, and then hauled out by Miss "Sloth" in her dragon form...And the Maelstrom’s depths weren’t simple either—there lay a castle beneath the sea!
Legends of an undersea city had circulated for over a thousand years, but Ebner, who had actually found it, knew it wasn’t sealing some so-called "terrifying monster" as the stories claimed... What it truly sealed was an entrance to the "Sea of Chaos!" Just like the castle at the heart of Delaire Forest that sealed another Chaos Sea entrance.
This was also why, for over a century, many Beyonders had attempted divinations to locate the
Laurel
but never succeeded. No one knew how Roselle had found it.
In short, judging by the excitement and frenzy of the audience after the premiere,
Finding the Laurel
was an unprecedented success.
Thus, the banquet was naturally filled with praise and congratulations. The entrepreneurs and socialites who attended all tried to cozy up to Ebner, hoping for cooperation with Loen’s new noble.
As glasses clinked, Ebner continued using his ability to "observe" the future fate-streams of those present. Even though such quick, unprepared readings weren’t very precise, they still allowed him to distinguish who was worth continued cooperation and who should be gradually distanced.
For example, a wealthy merchant chatting with him now, due to his adventurous nature, was fated to soon encounter a financial crisis. No matter which branch of fate he followed, the outcome was still a loss—only a question of more or less.
Having decided to reduce contact, Ebner discreetly hinted at the risks in some projects, nudging the man toward a fate-stream of lighter losses, and said nothing more.
He did this not merely out of role-playing, nor simple kindness...
But to make a small compensation for the merchant’s housekeeper.
This woman, Tanya, had risen from the lowest maid to head maid, then followed the current merchant’s wife into her new household, eventually becoming the housekeeper.
According to the original trajectory, after the merchant’s bankruptcy and her dismissal, she would have been introduced by Walter to Klein, becoming Dwayne’s housekeeper.
But because of Ebner’s transmigration, events had already shifted. In the futures he saw, her most likely fate-stream was quite tragic. Thus, by guiding the merchant, he was trying to make up for it.
Even after becoming a Cognizer, Ebner still abided by his principle: if he hadn’t encountered it, so be it. But since he had, and had the ability to change it, he would extend a helping hand.
...
Port Jacob, the second-largest city on Sonia Island.
Klein walked out of the theater, feeling both exhilarated and pained.
Exhilarated, naturally, because even as a modern man who had seen countless films, he found this one thrilling. Many of its action scenes looked far too real to be special effects...
Of course, in a world with Beyonder powers, he suspected they really weren’t special effects.
What pained him, though, was that 3 million pounds of wealth had been "donated" by Mr. Tower just to exchange for a viscount title that held little practical benefit.
Though he also understood—it was a ritual. One couldn’t hoard such fortune silently. Offering it up as a "sacrifice" was actually the wisest choice.
After all, a sum that large would attract endless eyes and schemes. Even if Mr. Tower wasn’t afraid, it would be nothing but trouble.
Not to mention, the question of ownership wasn’t simple either. The
Laurel
’s original owner, the Loen Oceanic Trading Company, still existed!
There was no international law to declare that salvage on the high seas belonged to the finder—it was only an unspoken rule. If pressed, it could lead to lawsuits.
By donating the fortune in exchange for a title, Mr. Tower had taken the most efficient path. Even the Augustus family, major shareholders of the trading company, wouldn’t stoop to suing a newly minted noble.
"But still, it feels like Mr. Tower lost out badly... I risked my life killing so many pirates, and the money I earned isn’t even a fraction of that."
Mourning the "squandering" of his fellow transmigrator, Klein turned into a seafood shop to buy a crate of wolffish cans.
His original plan was to sail from the Rossland Islands directly to "White City" Nas, capital of the Gargas Archipelago, and there wait for the
Future
to take him to the "Divine War Ruins" sea region to search for mermaids, as Ebner had mentioned.
The only reason he had stopped at Sonia Island was because the Gargas Archipelago was too far from the continent to have theaters yet. Wanting to contribute to Mr. Tower’s ritual, he had detoured here to watch the film.
Now, having seen it, he needed to hurry to Nas.
It so happened that the "alchemist" recommended by Roy King—Darkwill, the "Fat Apothecary’s" teacher—who could upgrade the "Creeping Hunger," also lived in Nas.
According to Roy King, this so-called "Idiot of Nas" loved nothing more than wolffish cans. That was why Klein decided to buy some here.
But when he carried the crate aboard the ship bound for Nas, a sailor doing a routine safety check spotted the label. Instantly, everyone nearby pulled away, keeping at least three meters from him...
Only then did Klein’s mouth twitch as he remembered the notorious reputation of this canned food.
"But Miss Temperance once sent some wolffish cans to the Sun... and the people of Silver City didn’t seem to mind?"
Puzzled yet curious, that very night Klein secretly opened a can in his first-class cabin...
Then, with immense willpower, the mad adventurer Gehrman Sparrow forced the Creeping Hunger to swallow the entire thing. As for himself, he flung open the window, clamped a hand over his mouth, rushed onto the deck, grabbed the railing, and crouched, dry-heaving silently...
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 899: The Tarot Gathering After Becoming a Demigod
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: The Tarot Gathering After Becoming a Demigod
