Outside the "Loreto Cinema" in Feynapotter City, which had only been built a month earlier.
Miss Judy held onto Miss "Plant," who looked exactly the same as her, and licked the cinema’s complimentary "exit ice cream" while excitedly saying to her mother, Closfia, who was walking on the other side:
"Mom... Ebner is amazing. How exactly did he calculate the precise data of the whirlpool and then work out the minimum escape speed and the most suitable angle?"
Closfia was a little speechless when she heard this. Ebner had indeed thought of making such a calculation at the time, but he quickly gave up, feeling that it was unnecessary...
But since this might have been related to the success or failure of the ritual, Closfia didn’t expose the lie. She simply gave a vague answer:
"Ebner relied on some tools..." (Such as me.)
"Used some methods..." (For example, twisting the weight of the ship.)
"And that’s how the ’Laurel’ was pulled out of the whirlpool. It’s just that, in the movie, in order to emphasize his ’wisdom,’ that part wasn’t shown."
Judy suddenly understood, but she still admired him greatly. "Even so, he’s still incredible. If it had been me, I probably would have asked you to turn into a dragon and drag the ship out."
Good, it seems you and Ebner should have a lot in common...
Closfia muttered inwardly. She was about to say something when her expression suddenly shifted, and she drew a letter from the void.
Seeing this, Judy immediately opened her "spiritual vision," but only saw an eight-legged demonic wolf enter the spirit world and disappear.
Judy recognized this wolf phantom. She knew it was Ebner’s messenger, the same one her mother had used to deliver the "Blue Serrated Grass" to him earlier.
"What did Ebner say in the letter?" Judy asked curiously as her mother put it down.
"He said he has successfully advanced to demigod... so to thank us for our help, he has invited us to a banquet at his home in Backlund on Thursday evening." Closfia answered with a smile.
"He’s really a demigod now..." Although she had already expected it, Judy was still astonished. After all, it hadn’t been that long since their parting on Blue Mountain Island... back then, he had still been at Sequence 6.
But she then asked in puzzlement, "Why Thursday?"
Such a thank-you banquet should have been held the next day. And if it was for a more grand and formal atmosphere, it should have been on the weekend.
"Based on my understanding of him, and of some Beyonders on the ’Cognizer’ pathway... it’s probably because he needed to stagger the invitations. We were simply arranged for Thursday." Closfia thought for a moment before replying with certainty.
Judy blinked, not quite understanding what her mother meant, but she didn’t press further. Instead, she asked, "Then should we head to Backlund now?"
"No need. When Thursday comes, he will come fetch us."
...
Meanwhile, in Trier, Intis, Fanny, who had just left the cinema as well, received a letter from the "demonic wolf."
"A banquet on Wednesday evening? Wonderful. It’s been so long since I went back to Backlund. I miss my friends there... I wonder how Emma is doing now... and the ’Eye of Wisdom’ grandpa...
"And I’ll get to see Ebner again..."
As she was daydreaming, the voices of a few citizens who had just watched the film drifted into her ears.
"What a stunning movie... and so enviable. It makes me want to go treasure hunting at sea and find a great fortune." One man spoke with longing.
"Stop dreaming... Without Ebner Bryan’s experience and wisdom, you’d only die trapped in that giant whirlpool!" his friend mocked.
"I’d naturally prepare thoroughly before going..." the first man snorted in dissatisfaction before sighing regretfully. "But why would Ebner Bryan, when he’s settled in our Intis, donate such a fortune to Loen?"
"He was aiming for a noble title... we don’t even have that here!" his friend said helplessly.
"Exactly... Why did our country abolish the monarchy? Even Emperor Roselle explored and realized that the path without a king doesn’t work, which is why he crowned himself! Looking back at the era of Emperor Roselle Gustav, our nation was the strongest. Loen, Feysac, Feynapotter... they all had to beg us for peace. And look at us now... sigh!" the man grumbled.
His words immediately resonated with those around him, who chimed in:
"They always say our system now is the best, but how are those great families any different from the nobles of old? And without the king’s restraint, they’re even more unscrupulous."
"Exactly. Especially the current prime minister, who even wants to restrict press freedom. That’s worse than when we had kings!"
"Right. Maybe we should restore Emperor Roselle’s system. Whether it’s the Sauron family, the Gustav family, or some other family qualified to be king, let them compete fairly... In short, maybe we could elect a king."
Surprisingly, this whimsical suggestion received much praise. Soon, the crowd, still heated from watching the film, gathered into a marching procession, dragging many passersby with them as they surged toward the Parliament building.
At first, Fanny, who was caught in the crowd, was worried. But then, a thought struck her. She revealed her identity as a Member of Parliament and, using the persuasion and charm of the "Lawyer" pathway, managed to gain the leadership of the march.
...
In Lenburg, "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina unfolded the letter delivered by the demonic wolf, her eyes lighting up instantly. Ebner had invited her to explore the ruins beneath Bayam’s "Aromatic Manor" on Saturday.
This was something they had agreed upon months ago. Ebner knew Edwina loved fine food but didn’t enjoy formal banquets, so he used the ruin exploration as his way of showing gratitude.
And Edwina was indeed more interested in that. She immediately returned to her home in Lenburg to pack, then used secret techniques to inform her first mate to sail the "Golden Dream" to the designated location.
...
On Monday, at 2:30 in the afternoon.
Ebner sealed his room with spirituality and kept adjusting the shadowy eyes in his "Incomplete Mythical Form"—the divine spirit bodies he had named "Eyes of Wisdom."
Moments later, using his previous experience exploring the "Unknown Land," he successfully separated one "Eye of Wisdom" and changed its appearance to look like himself.
"With this, the ’Eye of Wisdom’ is like a divine spirit body clone of mine, though carrying very little power. If it attends the Tarot Gathering in my place, not only will it let me share what it sees and hears in real time, it’ll also spare Klein from too much burden...
"Of course, this requires the cooperation of Mr. Fool. If the ’Sefirah Castle’ isolates it, this technique won’t work.
"Sigh, I said I’d settle accounts with him, but in matters like this I still have to be considerate... After all, Mr. Fool doesn’t have it easy either..."
After sighing for a while, Ebner casually made up an excuse, then recited the honorific name to request letting the "Eye of Wisdom" attend the Tarot Gathering on his behalf.
As expected, Mr. Fool readily agreed.
...
At exactly three o’clock, in the ancient hall above the gray fog.
On both sides of the mottled, ancient bronze long table, nine blurry figures—"Justice," "Magician," "Judgment," "Hermit," "Hanged Man," "Tower," "Sun," "Moon," and "World"—stretched and solidified in the embrace of the crimson light. The surroundings were as quiet and vast as ever, solemn and sacred like a temple.
No, this was a temple! A temple of the gods!
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool~" "Justice" Audrey led the others to stand up, her bright and cheerful voice quickly echoing through the grand hall upheld by rows of stone pillars.
Klein nodded in response, watching as the members, with Miss "Justice’s" liveliness, exchanged simple greetings with one another.
Among them, "Temperance" Sharon’s seat remained empty. This young lady had been absent from the Tarot Gathering for nearly three months.
This worried the kind Audrey, who suspected that her promotion ritual might have encountered some trouble.
When the voices subsided and everyone was seated, "Fool" Klein once again glanced at Miss "Justice."
Having had similar experiences before, Audrey immediately understood and did not raise her hand to ask a question.
"Fool" Klein then looked toward "Tower" Ebner and chuckled lightly, as if in passing:
"Congratulations on taking another step forward on the extraordinary path."
(The End of This Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 900: A New Diary
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: A New Diary
"Mr. Tower has taken another step forward on the extraordinary path? He has become a true demigod?"
As soon as the Fool’s voice fell, the "elder" members who knew Ebner’s original Sequence—"Justice," "Magician," "Hanged Man," and "Sun"—all looked over. Though their thoughts differed, all of them sincerely felt happy for "Tower." Even the most calculating "Hanged Man" was no exception.
After all, in Alger’s eyes, who had become increasingly invested in the Tarot Club, "Tower’s" breakthrough in strength was greatly beneficial to him as well.
If nothing else, once he advanced to Sequence 5 "Singer of the Sea," the step beyond that, across the boundary between human and divine, would surely require powerful assistance.
And this assistance was not something the Church of Storms was likely to provide. The only place Alger could count on was the Tarot Club.
On the other side, "Justice" and "Sun" had already offered their blessings. The former, knowing that "Tower" was actually Ebner, immediately linked the movie that had premiered yesterday with the demigod ritual. Her heart was full of curiosity, and she thought she would ask him privately during free exchange later.
"Magician" Fors simply felt that it was quite a coincidence. Ebner had advanced to demigod just last week as well. But aside from that, she didn’t think too much of it. After all, it was already unbelievable enough that there was someone she knew, Miss "Justice," in the Tarot Club. How could there be another?
As for the two "new" members, "Moon" Emlyn and "Hermit" Cattleya, both had always assumed "Tower" was already a demigod. So when they heard he had taken a step forward, they thought it meant he had advanced to Sequence 3 or Sequence 2!
Cattleya even directly examined Ebner with her deep violet-black eyes, only to find that he did indeed feel stronger than before, but he was still far from the level of the "Queen."
Has "Tower" always had some way of hiding his true strength above the gray fog?
Now that he has just advanced and his spirituality is unstable, he has accidentally leaked part of his real power?
But what’s the point of that? None of us know him well, and he surely can’t hide it from Mr. Fool anyway...
As Cattleya was filled with confusion, she suddenly noticed "Tower" looking back at her, his gaze meeting her "Secret-Peeping Eye."
In an instant, a feeling of being completely seen through flooded her body. She even had the illusion that her "fate" rested entirely in his hands, at his mercy.
Fortunately, Mr. Tower quickly withdrew his gaze, and that feeling vanished.
Phew... "Hermit" Cattleya let out a soft breath. She dared not look again, and deep inside she even felt a faint unease and fear:
Even a demigod can sense my observation... Every time I secretly watch Mr. Fool, that existence close to a god, how could He not notice?
Perhaps He simply can’t be bothered to mind...
But I can’t control myself... Every time I tell myself not to pry again, but the next time I still can’t help it...
"Moon" Emlyn was a little envious of "Tower’s" promotion, but as the self-proclaimed savior of the Blood Clan, he believed he too would eventually reach that height. It was only a matter of time.
And as a vampire, a race of longevity, time was not what he lacked.
As for Ebner, after giving Cattleya a slight "warning," he stood up and expressed his gratitude to Mr. Fool for His assistance in his advancement.
Klein knew Ebner was thanking him for his efforts in the battle to seize the sea monster’s characteristic, so he smiled and said, "No need to thank me. It was just an equivalent exchange."
No wonder he took the initiative to bring up my promotion... He was borrowing the chance to act cool again? He was so sure I’d play along? Hah, looks like that kid actually has some guesses in his heart already, but he’s just pretending not to know.
Or perhaps, he doesn’t dare to admit it?
Seems that when I created the ’Eye of Wisdom’ clone to reduce his burden, it only made him think more...
Ebner felt a flash of realization. Outwardly, he saluted Mr. Fool once more before sitting back down.
At the head of the table, Klein, the Fool, who had been observing "Tower," secretly shook his head, muttering inwardly with helplessness:
Since becoming a demigod, he’s become even harder to read emotionally...
After this small interlude, Klein quickly adjusted his state. He glanced at Miss "Justice," signaling for the Tarot Club to return to its usual proceedings.
"Justice" Audrey immediately understood, and respectfully spoke:
"Honorable Mr. Fool, I’ve collected two pages of Emperor Roselle’s diary."
These two pages were ones she had seen in the collection of a professor in the Department of History at Ston University when she had gone to visit.
The professor, seeing her interest, generously allowed her to make a copy.
A new diary?
Klein was inwardly delighted. While quietly drawing the parchment that Miss "Justice" had manifested into his hands, he asked, "What do you want in exchange?"
Audrey thought for a moment. Finding she had no immediate need, she requested to accumulate contribution instead, to be used later.
"Good," Klein replied succinctly from the main seat. After glancing around to confirm no one else had a diary to hand in, he picked up the first page and began to read.
At a glance, the corner of Klein’s mouth nearly twitched. It was yet another entry from Roselle’s infamous escapades. Ever since his confrontation with "Tower," Roselle’s diary excerpts had become more restrained, and Klein hadn’t seen such passages in a while.
Fortunately, the last part of the page contained something worth reading:
"June 3rd. From some traces left behind, it can be seen that although Captain Isaca disappeared in the divine battle ruins, he still managed to send out a key message...
"That is, the entrance to the Forsaken Land is very likely hidden in the night of the Divine Battle Ruins Sea!
"I just don’t know what this ’night’ refers to?
"The Goddess of the Night? Or perhaps something special within the night of the ruins?
"Ah, if he were still alive, maybe he could give me the answer. Unfortunately...
"In any case, to honor Captain Isaca’s contribution, I have decided to name a newly discovered island after his surname!"
The entrance to the Forsaken Land is in the night of the Divine Battle Ruins Sea?
Hmm... Regarding this so-called ’night,’ my view is similar to Roselle’s. Either it refers to the Goddess’s domain, or it’s a special phenomenon in the Divine Battle Ruins...
Moreover, the environment of Silver City is also ’darkness.’ Could there be some connection?
The Divine Battle... Such an environment is very likely caused by lingering divine power of the Goddess or other deities.
On the verge of setting out for the Divine Battle Ruins Sea himself, Klein couldn’t help but ponder quickly as he read. After a long moment, he set down the first parchment page and picked up the second.
Immediately, his spirit sharpened. This diary was very different from the usual ones.
It had no date, the handwriting was scrawled, and since it wasn’t an original, many characters were distorted, barely recognizable after careful inspection.
Yet even so, Klein could feel the agitation and frustration embedded in the words.
"Impossible! Impossible! How could this be!
"What exactly did I do after landing on the moon?!
"If my ’prophecy’ wasn’t wrong... then about a hundred years later, around 1325 to 1327, five women will become pregnant after seeing the blood moon!
"And then, within a few days, each will give birth to a baby girl!
"How could such an absurd thing happen?!
"Could those stories of women conceiving after sensing the sun and moon, or falling asleep in a giant footprint, actually be true? Is this the same cause?
"No... I must do something... I must do something...
"I can’t let the orthodox Churches know, otherwise those five baby girls will die!
"In comparison, perhaps the ’Mother Tree of Desire’ is more trustworthy...
"But even She cannot be fully trusted!
"Let me think, let me think... What should I do! What should I do!
"I understand! Only pollution can fight pollution!
"I must design a ritual to help them!
"What should I use as a medium?
"The entrance to the Sea of Chaos is too hard to find, and no one would be willing to perform a ritual pointing toward it...
"Other than that... what kind of item could achieve this...
"Only the ’God’s Coffer’ he mentioned!"
(The End of This Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 901: Klein’s Analysis
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Klein’s Analysis
After repeatedly reading the content on this page of the diary, Klein couldn’t help but frown, thinking to himself:
Even the copies carry a certain power to stir emotions. When the Emperor wrote this diary, he had very likely already become the "Knowledge Emperor" that the "Tower" told me about, unconsciously imbuing his words with power. Even the copies still retained the influence.
Fortunately, Miss Justice and the other handlers couldn’t understand Chinese, otherwise there would most likely have been problems...
But even so, the place where this original page of the diary was kept for a long time would probably show certain issues... for example, it might make people more impulsive, more prone to doing things they would later regret.
After considering it, Klein decided to ask Miss Justice later about the origin of this page of the diary, and then let Ebner handle it, so as to avoid real trouble.
His attention then quickly shifted back to the diary itself, with both relief and confusion in his heart:
Why was the Emperor’s mood so agitated, nearly hysterical, when he prophesied that women would conceive under the influence of the moon?
And the intense turbulence and impulsiveness between the lines felt abnormal. It did not match the image of a man who had long been in a high position, nor the bearing of an angel. What exactly happened on the moon that made him lose composure like this, become so emotional?
And what did this have to do with the five who conceived under the moon?
Wait... if I boldly assume... could it be that those five infant girls were mystically linked to him, or perhaps were even children he had with some existence on the moon after he landed there?
But such a method of birth is horrifying...
Then, who was that existence on the moon? Was it the "Primordial Moon" that Lilith destroyed?
If this assumption holds... then the following events can be reasonably "deduced."
Such "spawn of an evil god" would naturally be destroyed if discovered by the orthodox Churches. And Roselle clearly thought of this. Whether it was due to the influence of some being, or genuine "familial affection," he chose to protect the five girls who were born more than twenty years ago, that is, between 1325 and 1327.
Later, Roselle most likely took the "God’s Coffer" from the Book of Calamity, and even hid the soul of the Queen of Calamity, Coshinam, for another arrangement.
Or rather, to protect her?
Of course, given how contradictory Roselle’s actions were in his later years, his arrangements were often exploited by other existences... and knowing this, he most likely left additional clues, so that those with insight might discover them and patch the flaws in his plan...
Perhaps the act of leaving the empty "God’s Coffer" to Miss Magician was precisely the result of such circumstances.
As for those five infant girls... nine out of ten, they were the five survivors of that experiment eleven years ago.
The faction—or factions—that organized that experiment must have gathered many suitable young girls who were born under a blood moon, with incomplete records of their births, and used them in the experiment... or rather, in the ritual Roselle designed for those five girls.
The goal was actually to use other "Source Qualities" to balance the influence of that lunar existence, preventing it from descending or carrying out other schemes, right?
No wonder only those five survived...
Among them, "Pale Admiral" Maria was the most special... Roselle must have foreseen something about her, and thus prepared the weapon "Pale Justice" in advance, to let her control the "contamination"...
As for the "Devil" characteristic sealed within her... I don’t know what special significance it has... Was it simply to make "Pale Justice" balance the "contamination" better? Or was there another calculation?
What is certain is that behind the "Pale Admiral" are the shadows of the Secret Order and that adopted son of Roselle, Yaldabaoth... They were most likely among the organizers of that experiment.
Besides them, the faction under the "Mother Tree of Desire" must also have participated... It seemed Roselle was exploiting the grudge between Her and that lunar existence.
Finally... what exactly did "Source Quality" mean? Was it equivalent to a true god? Why did Roselle have to use "Source Quality" to balance the pollution of these evil gods?
Didn’t he trust the orthodox deities? But then why not rely on, or design, something using the "Primordial Witch," the "True Creator," or other evil gods?
Hmm... after the Tarot Gathering ends, I’ll show this page of the diary to Ebner. He knows more about the five survivors, and maybe he can infer more useful information.
Sigh, Roselle really was capable of making a mess in his later years...
But I can’t shake the feeling that this matter is also tied to Liu Bo!
One thought after another flashed by. Klein wasted no time, made the two pages of the diary vanish, and smilingly looked at Miss Justice, while tapping the edge of the ancient long table with his fingers to shield the senses of the others.
About half a minute later, "The Fool" Klein, having memorized a professor’s name and address, lifted the shielding. He then leaned back in his chair, swept his gaze around, and said:
"You may begin."
After a brief silence, "Magician" Fors spoke before "Justice" Audrey, straightening her back and glancing around as she said:
"Everyone, I’d like to purchase two mystical items: one for offense, one for defense. Do you have any recommendations?"
Because the film
Roselle Gustav
was selling explosively, Fors, as its main screenwriter, had just received a huge dividend.
Just yesterday, she had as much as 1,500 pounds transferred into her account. This instantly gave her confidence, and the urge to buy mystical items.
—This had always been Fors’s desire, but each time before, poverty had curbed her ambitions.
Currently, although she had the "Marionette" and the Ring of Light—two items borrowed from Ebner for self-defense—she would eventually have to return them.
Especially the Ring of Light; Fors didn’t even dare to wear it often, or she would become a devout believer of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
As for the other one, the "Marionette," she liked it very much as a control-type mystical item, and planned to discuss purchasing it from Ebner after returning to Backlund.
At this moment, Fors’s gaze mainly settled on the "Tower," the "World," and the "Hermit," since their connections were much broader.
Ebner looked at Fors on the opposite side, his face expressionless, but his thoughts turning strange:
According to the original development, Fors will get the Abraham family’s "Lemano’s Travel Notes" in just a few days!
With that notebook capable of recording extraordinary abilities, Fors could be both offensive and defensive... so why spend this extra money now?
Wouldn’t she regret it so much she’d want to bang her head against the wall then?
Mm, I really want to see that expression on her face!
At that thought, Ebner’s lips curved slightly, his mood inexplicably lightened. After obtaining permission from Mr. Fool, he projected a series of images of mystical items.
Tired, that’s enough for now.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 902: Ebner Clearing Stock
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Ebner Clearing Stock
A ring inlaid with a blue gemstone, a plain formal suit, an ancient-style badge, a dazzling golden revolver, a heavy ,sharp spear, and a pair of toy-like wheels appeared before everyone in an instant.
"Justice" Audrey’s gaze locked onto the blue gemstone ring. She suddenly felt that Mr. "Tower" actually had quite good taste; he always managed to bring out extraordinary items that she liked at first sight.
"Hermit" Cattleya was a little surprised that "Tower" produced so many items at once, guessing that he might have a "Craftsman" behind him, or that he himself was a "Craftsman."
"Magician" Fors was dazzled for a moment. After thinking for a bit, she looked at "Tower" across from her with great interest and said, "Mr. ’Tower,’ aren’t you going to introduce them?"
As soon as she finished speaking, the other members turned their gazes toward Ebner. After all, no one ever thought they had too many mystical items in hand. As long as they were suitable, "Justice," "Hermit," "Hanged Man," and even "Moon" and "World" wouldn’t mind buying one or two.
Only the honest "Sun" and Miss "Judgment," who knew Ebner was once again "teasing" Fors, didn’t have that thought for now.
Seeing everyone look over, Ebner first enlarged the blue gemstone ring to display its lines and details, then smiled and said: "The ’Blink Ring.’ When the wearer faces a fatal attack, it allows them to ’blink’ to a random spot three meters away... It has no negative effects, but it only lasts for half a year, and once used it will be destroyed.
"Its price is 100 pounds... Trust me, if not for the short duration, it would definitely cost more than this."
Everyone nodded slightly at that. After all, 100 pounds for a life-saving item was actually a bargain. The only problem was if nothing happened within that half year, then the item would be wasted. This felt very much like the complicated mood of buying "accident insurance" beforehand, so no one spoke for the moment.
Meanwhile, after introducing the ring, Ebner presented the "plain formal suit" and continued: "This is the ’Magician’s Attire.’ It can condense a green ’barrier’ in front of the wearer. But the function of the ’barrier’ is not to block the enemy’s attack, rather, it transfers the damage taken onto the attire.
"Though the attire can self-repair, its endurance is limited. Once its threshold is exceeded, it will be completely destroyed.
"Moreover, each time it takes an attack, its threshold decreases... At present, it can withstand three or four close-range volleys from large-caliber muskets.
"In addition, this attire can change its appearance once per month, with the look set by the wearer.
"This attire has no definite time limit. If it doesn’t continue to block attacks, it can be used for a long time, at least ten years with no problem.
"But if it is attacked frequently, or pierced through in one strike, then it will break down the next second.
"The ’Magician’s Attire’ is valued at 600 pounds... I think this is quite a reasonable price."
It’s indeed a good item, but for me it isn’t very useful...
"Hermit," "World," "Moon," and "Hanged Man" all had similar thoughts at the same time.
After all, the "Hanged Man" had "Illusionary Scales," the "Moon" could transform into a phantom bat, the "Hermit" could condense "Starlight" into a shield, so their defenses weren’t bad. As for "World," that went without saying—his ability to transfer damage was far stronger than this "Magician’s Attire."
However, "Magician" Fors was quite tempted. After all, her body as a "Trickmaster" was still very fragile. She wanted to buy it right away, but after glancing at the items that followed, she restrained herself, simply nodding with some composure and saying, "Not bad... What about the ones after this?"
At those words, Ebner picked up the ancient-styled badge and introduced it: "This is the ’Return Badge.’ To use it, rub its surface ten times, and it will open a ’portal’ that allows the user to instantly return to a preset location.
"Of course, the distance cannot exceed ten kilometers, otherwise the ’teleport’ won’t work.
"This item can only be used once. And after use, there’s a certain chance of being detected by a high-Sequence existence. You’ll need Mr. Fool’s protection.
"Overall, I’ve priced it at 500 pounds."
This is basically the same effect as my old Spirit World Traversal stones! Though a little more troublesome to use...
Fors’s heart stirred and she immediately decided to buy it.
As for the possibility of a high-Sequence existence noticing, she didn’t care at all. After all, if she had to use such a thing to escape, it would already be a life-and-death situation. Who would still worry about whether a high-Sequence Beyonder was watching? Besides, since Ebner himself had become a high-Sequence Beyonder, even without Mr. Fool’s protection, she wouldn’t be afraid.
Thinking this, Fors immediately said: "I’ll take this one. Together with the earlier ’Magician’s Attire,’ make it 1,000 pounds. How about that?"
The "Hermit" and the "Hanged Man," who also coveted this item, felt some disappointment, but they didn’t compete.
Cattleya, the "Hermit," was still observing the Tarot Club. She didn’t think it was worth offending other members over a mid-Sequence mystical item.
Moreover, she had the feeling that even if she bid, "Tower" wouldn’t sell it to her.
As for Alger, the "Hanged Man," his considerations were simpler. He didn’t want to lose his channel of information and materials from the Abraham family.
"Deal." Ebner, who didn’t particularly care about such small sums, directly agreed to Fors’s counteroffer.
Seeing how readily he agreed, Fors couldn’t help but wonder if she had been tricked... but with Mr. Fool watching, Mr. "Tower" wouldn’t dare falsify anything.
While she was still a bit suspicious, Ebner began introducing the next three items.
The ring, suit, and badge from earlier were all life-saving items that Ebner had taken from "Johann Fules" while helping Fani take revenge. They were really just to make up the numbers. The next three were the powerful mystical items he had personally crafted recently, in between preparing rituals.
It was worth mentioning that Johann Fules’s protective amulet had been secretly placed into the treasury of the Delien family estate by Ebner’s "Owen" clone. Afterwards, the Fules family had tested that place several times but had failed each time.
This made Ebner, who wanted to use their hands to uncover the Delien family’s secrets, feel some regret.
However, since the Fules family was already certain that "Johann" had been captured and imprisoned by the Deliens, their relations had dropped to an all-time low. Recently, the family even expressed opposition to the Prime Minister’s decisions in many council matters.
"The ’Phoenix Revolver,’ forged using the ’Gatekeeper’ Beyonder characteristic. Anyone struck will have their soul forced out of their body and thrown into an opened ’Gate of the Underworld.’
"Without corresponding methods, it is very difficult to escape.
"Its negative effect is that it gradually transforms all nearby living beings into spirits, drawing them into the ’Underworld.’
"The sealing method is to provide it with sufficient spirits beforehand. That way, its desire to transform nearby creatures won’t be as strong... As for how many spirits, since it possesses living traits, that can be negotiated.
"Price: ten thousand pounds. No bargaining."
The "Gatekeeper" characteristic was also obtained from Johann. The revolver found on him had originally been forged from that characteristic.
But that revolver was likely a natural fusion with the characteristic, resulting in overwhelming side effects and making it nearly impossible to use. This was why Johann had relied only on life-saving items to escape, and never considered using the revolver to fight back. Once used, he too would have died.
Ebner had studied that revolver for some days but found no way to improve it, so he destroyed it using "Disintegration" and forged a new one with comparatively lighter side effects.
He had originally been quite satisfied with this work, planning to use it himself. But after advancing to "Prophet" and acquiring the "models" of those nine "Incomplete Mythical Creature Forms," along with related knowledge, he immediately dismissed it and decided to sell it.
After finishing his introduction of the revolver, Ebner didn’t wait for the eager "Hermit ," "Justice," and "World" to start bidding. He directly pointed to the final two items manifested on the long table: a spear and a pair of toy-like wheels.
"They’re actually a set...
"I call them the ’Flame-Tipped Spear’ and the ’Wind-Fire Wheels’..."
Flame-Tipped Spear and Wind-Fire Wheels?
Mr. "Tower," are you trying to create a ’Nezha’ in the Tarot Club? This style doesn’t fit at all!
"The Fool" Klein’s lips twitched, and he almost blurted out the complaint on the spot.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 903: Klein Let Out a Sigh of Relief
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: Klein Let Out a Sigh of Relief
Although Ebner could not see through the gray fog covering Klein’s face, he could still guess what the other was thinking at this moment. However, he had never intended to make anyone play "Nezha." After all, a Nezha with a Westerner’s face was just far too strange. This wasn’t a world where two flowers bloomed.
The only reason he gave the extraordinary items he had crafted such names was to satisfy his own mischievous tastes.
It had to be said, ever since advancing to "Prophet" and realizing he had so many "past selves" laying out plans, Ebner’s cautious, repressed nature had gradually begun to surface more openly.
But he didn’t see this as a bad thing. In his opinion, the deeper and more profound parts of one’s personality were the hardest to erase.
"’Wind-Fire Wheels’ are forged from the extraordinary characteristics of a ’Favored by the Wind’ and an ’Arsonist.’ They can be ridden for flight and also commanded to strike enemies with violent gusts and blazing flames.
"As for this ’Fire-Tipped Spear,’ it is a paired item to the ’Wind-Fire Wheels.’ Without them, it is merely an unusually sharp, exceptionally tough spear...
"But once empowered by the ’Wind-Fire Wheels,’ the spear’s tip can condense a special ’flame.’ The effect of this flame is similar to my developed secret art, ’Disintegration.’ It can bring absolute destruction to whatever it pierces. Even items formed from extraordinary characteristics can have their structure broken and their functions disabled temporarily.
"Its negative effect, however, is that it throws both the wielder and nearby enemies into extreme rage and fury, making them prone to losing their reason altogether. Without some ability like ’Mechanical Mind’ to neutralize it, the wielder and those nearby will fall into meaningless slaughter until one side collapses."
At this point, Ebner swept his eyes around and said with a smile, "The set is priced at 10,000 pounds. No bargaining."
The "Favored by the Wind" characteristic had come from the sea monster "Sagust," while the "Arsonist" had been separated out step by step from the "Conspirer" trait Ebner obtained from "Mirror Apostle" Hertha.
As for the materials of the "Fire-Tipped Spear" and "Wind-Fire Wheels," they were derived from the "Hell Admiral’s" "Harris Rapier," which Ebner later turned into a wand for spellcasting. After advancing to Prophet, he no longer needed the corresponding item to cast secret arts, so this was a matter of recycling wasted resources.
In truth, the negative effect of this set was already considered heavy, but Ebner had done his best. After all, stacking the "Hunter’s" provocation with the "Sailor’s" fury, the outcome of "both friend and foe falling into rage" was only natural.
"10,000 pounds. I’ll take that ’Phoenix’ revolver. Can you accept payment with extraordinary characteristics?" At that moment, under Klein’s control, "The World" was the first to rasp out in a hoarse voice.
Although he felt some strange familiarity with the "Wind-Fire Wheels" and "Fire-Tipped Spear" combination, if it meant he had to actually go into battle with that appearance... unless forced, Klein refused.
What’s more, the negative effect of the set clashed badly with his combat style.
By contrast, after having exhausted the crystal of the "Funeral Blade" and unable to replenish it for the time being, Klein was in desperate need of a powerful offensive weapon. The "Phoenix" revolver was exactly the kind of weapon he needed.
Hearing "The World" speak, the "Hermit" Cattleya, who had been about to bid, suddenly fell silent. From all the clues so far, "The World" and Mr. Fool were closely connected—very likely even one of His chosen.
And I’ve already revealed parts of the Tarot Club’s information behind Mr. Fool’s back... if I now compete with The World, won’t that only invite greater displeasure from Him?
Hesitant for a long while, Cattleya finally chose to give up.
Besides, the style of the "Fire-Tipped Spear" and "Wind-Fire Wheels" didn’t match her at all, so she had no reason to ask further.
What about the other members of the Tarot Club? "The Sun" felt he couldn’t use such things yet. "The Hanged Man" and "The Magician" once again realized their own poverty. "The Judgment" lady had just spent a huge sum recently to buy a "Disciplinary Paladin" characteristic from Jane, and so she wasn’t wealthy either.
The only one who could afford it, "Justice," said frankly that she had no need for such a weapon. Moreover, as a future "Dragon," she faintly felt repelled by the "Wind-Fire Wheels" and "Fire-Tipped Spear."
So her eyes fell instead upon the ring that was both beautiful and could "blink" her away in danger. After some deliberation, she said, "I’ll take that ’Blink’ Ring..."
After speaking, she turned to "The Magician" and smiled. "Miss Magician, you don’t mind, do you?"
"Ah? Oh... it’s fine, I don’t mind, Miss Justice." Fors came back to her senses at Audrey’s words.
In truth, she had liked the "Blink" Ring as well. She hadn’t bought it earlier because she wanted to save money for an extraordinary weapon. Who would have thought the weapon prices would skyrocket straight into five digits? That instantly killed her desire and deflated her earlier inflated mood. At this point, how could she dare compete with Miss Justice?
—In fact, the reason Ebner brought out such expensive weapons afterward was precisely so Forsi could keep a bit of pocket money. Watching her fluster was one thing, but he couldn’t really bleed her dry.
After closing a few deals, Ebner saw that no one had asked about his little joke creation. Without caring, he dismissed the manifestation.
While he was unconcerned about whether it sold or not, he quietly thought,
Maybe I should sell the set to Miss "Plant." As an incarnation of vegetation, she would probably be more compatible with them...
After that, since no further trades came up, the Tarot Club automatically shifted into free discussion.
Miss Justice first applied to Mr. Fool for a private talk with Ebner. After reporting on her progress investigating the "Queen of Calamities," she asked with some anticipation, "Mr. Tower, that newly released film ’Searching for the Laurel,’ was it your promotion ritual?"
"Yes." Ebner didn’t conceal it. He briefly explained the requirements of the Prophet ritual to Audrey before asking, "The clue you mentioned just now, in the northern town of East Chester County—how reliable is it?"
Audrey, who had been marveling at the difficulty of demigod rituals, immediately grew serious and shook her head. "I’m not sure... but I’ve already used this information to pique the ’Psychological Alchemy Society’s’ interest. That not only earned me contributions but will also let them scout the place first."
Ebner nodded thoughtfully. He didn’t think a bunch of mid-to-low Sequence "Spectators" could achieve much, but at least they could probe the truth.
Thinking this, he said solemnly, "Notify me before they set out."
"Alright." Audrey didn’t ask why and agreed directly.
After that private exchange, the Tarot Club members shared some of their experiences, and then the gathering reached its end.
The members stood, saluted the head of the bronze table, and took their leave.
As the crimson light faded, the figure of the Fool vanished under the respectful gazes of "The Tower" and "The World."
Only then did Ebner turn his gaze to Klein, who had secretly swapped his body with the "All-Black Eye." With a faint smile, he looked him up and down.
Klein felt uncomfortable under his gaze, frowned, and asked in Chinese, "What’s wrong with you? Why are you looking at me like that?"
"I just think you really can act!" After a long pause, Ebner finally retracted his gaze and sighed.
Act? Does he actually know I am the Fool?
Klein’s heart gave a violent jolt, and his nerves went taut, thinking his identity as the Fool was about to be exposed. He was about to say something, but then Ebner’s voice, tinged with some grievance, reached his ears:
"You knew early on, didn’t you? About the Calamity Seal, Alvin, Dennett, Rhine, Vicente—all of them being ’Liu Bo’?"
So that’s what it is? Scared me to death! I thought my identity was about to be socially ruined!
Klein instantly let out a long breath of relief.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 904: Shocking to the Eyes
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Shocking to the Eyes
Facing Ebner’s question, Klein calmed himself from his earlier worry. He weighed his tone carefully and asked cautiously in return, "You remembered the events from your previous lives?"
This undoubtedly confirmed that he had long known that the many transmigrators in the past were all "Liu Bo"...
However, Klein didn’t intend to keep hiding it. After all, the other party was already a demigod. Even if he learned part of the truth, it should not be a problem... Otherwise, those goddesses would have intervened, just as They had warned and reminded Mr. Tower before.
"I only remembered a small part, but even with those fragments I could infer quite a lot!" Ebner nodded slightly, then looked at the "World" below him, and said with deep meaning, "So you really did know some of the inside story... But why bother disguising yourself? Is watching me make a fool of myself really that amusing?"
"That is indeed very amusing!" Unexpectedly, the "World" Klein nodded in all seriousness, and then pretended to request permission before projecting many of Ebner’s own self-mocking remarks.
Soon, scenes where Ebner mentioned "Calamity Seal," Alvin, and Dannit, accompanied by labels such as "lyb" and "cunning old fox," played out one after another before his eyes.
Looking at these obviously "edited" scenes, Ebner froze for a while before regaining his senses. He helplessly complained, "Maybe my film company should hire you as a director. The movies you shoot would definitely be blockbusters!"
"That’s only natural. As the future ’Marionettist,’ when it comes to directing plays, I’m at Spielberg’s level!" Klein said with a beaming smile. He had been waiting for this moment for a long time. In the earlier "showdown," he had been completely on the back foot, but now he had managed to win a round back.
"You think I was complimenting you?" Ebner replied irritably, then wisely chose not to dwell on this topic. After all, Klein’s biggest "handle" was still in his hands. The "victory or defeat" didn’t need to be decided immediately.
He instead asked, "You didn’t hide things from me just because of these silly matters, did you?"
Hearing this, Klein had wanted to say it was Mr. Fool’s warning, but after thinking about it, he felt it wasn’t very safe. So before the words left his mouth, he changed it to: "’Arrodes’ told me that if anyone knows about the existence of ’Liu Bo’ without your permission, they would be polluted. Even it didn’t dare to investigate further... And you told me before that Lilith asked you not to explore your ’cheat’ before becoming a demigod... I thought these two might be related, so I wanted to wait until you became a demigod before telling you in detail..."
Without my permission, just knowing about ’Liu Bo’ would cause pollution? Am I really that powerful? This is something at the level of an Old One...
That means the source of pollution in the "Unknown Land" might really come from the name Liu Bo, from that concept itself?
But I am Liu Bo. Why would even my "Clairvoyant" avatar be polluted?
Also, Lilith doesn’t want me to explore the secrets of "Liu Bo" before becoming a demigod, and she also warned me not to enter the "Unknown Land" before angels...
This all shows she doesn’t want me to come into contact with the concept of "Liu Bo" too early... Or rather, not to be polluted by it too early?
Would I be polluted by myself... what kind of situation is this?
And this "pollution" shouldn’t refer to being impacted by memories of my previous lives... After all, based on my experience absorbing Giuseppe Castilla’s memories, after fusion, emotionally I was still mainly this life’s Ebner. Although those memories all felt very real and natural to me, in my perception they were indeed my own experiences.
Of course, maybe Giuseppe’s life wasn’t long enough... But even a short one lasted nearly ten years, which was still more than my less-than-one-year-long current life as Ebner...
But in reality, I am still primarily the "me" of now, which shows that the pollution isn’t a "mental" issue like this. My self-identity hasn’t been affected at all. I’m not some stitched-together monster.
Giuseppe is Ebner, Ebner is Giuseppe, and also Dannit, Alvin, Vicente, Rhine...
"Looks like if I want to figure out the essence of this ’pollution,’ I’ll still have to improve my Sequence and go deeper into the Unknown Land!"
After thinking for a while, Ebner temporarily set the matter aside, looked again at "World" Klein, and sighed, "Take them out!"
"What?" Klein didn’t understand.
"All the Roselle Diaries involving ’Liu Bo’... I bet you have quite a few. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have bothered asking Arrodes." Ebner said with great certainty.
"As expected of the ’Hero Detective,’ your reasoning ability really is impressive!" Klein first praised him, then tapped his finger on the edge of the long table and smiled. "Mr. Fool did grant me some of those diaries... but I can’t just show them to you for free."
Old Zhou feels less and less like Gehrman here. Wasn’t he supposed to strictly act in character?
Hmm... His current demeanor is closer to Klein back in Tingen... I can’t tell if this is his real personality, or if he’s just switched to another acting template... His acting is too good, I really can’t distinguish it... But the ease he’s showing should be genuine...
Ah, hopefully he hasn’t specifically created a "persona" just for interacting with me. That would be too exhausting... I really don’t want him to carry heavy masks just because of the changes I brought!
Unfortunately, even with the help of the "Pure White Eye," the Seer’s ability can’t see the "tributaries" of the Destiny Anchor.
While Ebner sighed inwardly, on the surface he asked, "What do you want from me in return?"
His tone was relaxed, since he was sure the other party wouldn’t really make things difficult for him.
"I just want to ask you a few questions..." Klein said in a deep voice.
"What questions?" Ebner asked curiously.
"I want to know, who is the ’Turncoat Dragon’? And who is Lamia?" These were doubts Klein had accumulated over time, but Ebner had never answered them before.
Ebner hesitated for a moment, but felt that telling Klein now wasn’t a problem. After all, with
Grossel’s Travel Notes
in his own possession, the other party might lose many opportunities to uncover secrets.
"The ’Turncoat Dragon’ refers to the ’God of Knowledge and Wisdom.’ He was also one of the Eight Archangels serving the Ancient Sun God, the ’Angel of Wisdom’!
"As for Lamia, she was actually an avatar of the ’Earth Mother’..."
After listening to Ebner’s brief introduction, Klein was surprised but also showed an expression of "as expected."
The surprise lay in the fact that the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was actually a dragon, and had once served the Ancient Sun God... Based on that, it wasn’t hard to imagine why he carried the nickname "Turncoat."
And the "as expected" part was that his earlier suspicion had been correct—Liu Bo really was the "toyboy" of the Earth Mother!
The progenitor of the Vampires, the Earth Mother, and the still-to-be-confirmed Evernight Goddess... not to mention several angels like Lady Yalolan...
Liu Bo, aren’t you afraid of getting chopped to pieces?
Klein gave Ebner a strange look, then manifested those diaries containing "Liu Bo," and casually asked, "Why was the God of Knowledge called the ’Turncoat Dragon’? Also, since the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was one of the Eight Archangels, then the ’Eternal Blazing Sun’ and the ’Lord of Storms,’ who were alongside him in creation myths, were they as well?"
Ebner accepted the diaries but didn’t immediately read them. Instead, after thinking for a moment, he also manifested a projector and passed it to Klein, saying, "Watch this and you’ll understand."
After that, he lowered his head and began to read.
Seeing this, Klein felt a stir in his heart. He quickly created a projection screen, opened the machine, and moments later saw a penitent monk speaking with devout sincerity:
"Only the Holy Spirits can truly serve the Lord...
"The Lord stands above billions of lights, His mercy spreading across heaven and earth, with eight ’Kings’ standing beside Him.
"The ’Angel of Darkness’ was the first angel created by the Lord. He is His left hand, His executor, the Vice Sovereign of Heaven;
"The ’Angel of Fantasy’ is the Lord’s eldest son. The Lord said: In the distant future, you will become the savior of life;
"The ’Angel of Time’ is the Lord’s second son. The Lord said: You are the God of Trickery, the God of Mischief, the light at the end of days;
"The ’Pure White Angel,’ the ’Angel of Wind,’ and the ’Angel of Destiny’ are the Lord’s loyal followers—resolute, brave, devout, never changing from weak to strong;
"The ’Angel of Wisdom’ was saved by repentance, sanctified by redemption, the exact opposite of those who ate the fruit of sin and fell to earth;
"The ’Angel of War’ is the Lord’s wrath, His punishment. He descends upon the earth to bring the sword..."
Klein recognized this penitent monk. He was one of the "main character" party members whom he, Ebner, and Edwina had encountered asleep inside
Grossel’s Travel Notes.
"Did Mr. Tower later meet people from other eras while exploring the Notes?
"Maybe when Miss Justice completes Mr. Tower’s commission and earns the reward of entering the City of Miracles, I can take the chance to go again... After all, with the Black Emperor card in my possession, she’ll need my support to enter safely..."
As Klein’s thoughts spun and ideas popped into his head, Ebner, who was reading the diary, felt as if waves were crashing violently inside his heart!
The one in Roselle’s diary was really me?
Lilith... Aurore... Tamara...
And these were just Rhine Karendaria’s "friends"...
And I even boasted about it to Roselle...
Were my past lives really this "wild"?
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 905: Return to the Harvest Church
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Return to the Harvest Church
"The diary says that Rhine joined the ’Black Emperor’ faction partly because the Tamara family’s ’Hand of Order’ was ambushed and killed by the Night Emperor...
"And that ’Hand of Order’ was Liu Bo, my friend... When Old Huang quoted it, he even used the third-person pronoun ’she’...
"Although the evidence isn’t solid, judging from Princess Vera’s inexplicable closeness to me, she’s very likely the evil spirit of the Tamara family’s ’Hand of Order’ that I rescued!
"She’s able to recover now, probably because of the ’Mist of Uncertainty’... But the ’Mist of Uncertainty’ is an Outer God. Even if it somehow slipped through Earth’s barrier, it must have its own will... How could it let Vera control it so freely?
"Hmm... this is most likely Rhine’s doing... Perhaps the consciousness within the ’Mist of Uncertainty’ has been sealed away in some artifact, just like the ’Lamp Genie’?
"To pull off something like that, he must have tricked It into the ’Primordial Substance’ or the ’Unknown Land’..."
At this thought, Ebner suddenly remembered the research recorded in the latter half of
Banquet of Blood
, as well as the experiments conducted with Solomon and the Death God...
"Maybe the ’Mist of Uncertainty’ was summoned from outside back then by Rhine, using the special nature of the ’Unknown Land’!"
As he pondered, Ebner also decided that, when he had the chance, he would search for the small island where that "laboratory" was located. His past self had very likely left something behind for him there.
Or rather, the "Seal of Calamity" had used those ruins to scheme against Roselle and left something for his current self...
Yes, ever since reading those crucial diary entries, Ebner had been almost certain that Roselle’s series of strange, uncharacteristic actions in his later years were seven or eight parts guided by the "Seal of Calamity"!
It had been using Roselle’s actions to conceal its true purpose.
For example, the "Dream Labyrinth Tower." That "wondrous building" not only accumulated "wishes" for the "Miracle" pathway, but also helped Lilith trap the "Primordial Moon," achieving the first step of the "Silver Moon Plan." And in the end, it would most likely become a material for Ebner’s ascension to "Angel"...
But Old Huang’s original intent in building it—resurrection—had never had any chance of success from the very beginning!
That was completely unlike something he would do... As expected, the "Seal of Calamity" was the version of him that least resembled himself!
With a sigh, Ebner set the diary aside, then noticed that Klein had already finished watching the "film" and was deep in thought.
Sensing Ebner’s gaze, Klein snapped out of it, a mischievous smile appearing on his face as he asked, "After reading those diaries, what do you feel?"
Ebner knew exactly what Klein was thinking. He glanced at him and replied coolly, "It’s fine. After all, in my awakened memories, I did live together with Lamia for several years."
Klein’s expression stiffened. He stared deeply at "Mr. Tower." Now he somewhat understood Roselle’s feelings. This man’s way of "Versailles-ing" things was really infuriating.
"You’re not afraid the Goddess Lilith might be angered and punish you for it?" Klein pressed, unwilling to give up.
At this, Ebner only chuckled and answered meaningfully, "My relationship with Lamia... Lilith wouldn’t care."
After all, Lamia = Mother Earth Goddess = Lilith.
Seeing how unbothered he was, Klein was left speechless. He could only grumble inwardly,
So the goddesses’ pretty boy really does have some tricks,
before changing the subject.
"In the earlier image, the ’Pure White Angel’ should be the current ’Eternal Blazing Sun,’ right?
"And the ’Angel of Wind’ is the ’Lord of Storms’?"
He was rather certain about the first. After all, when he once divined using the "god-blood" stored in Sealed Artifact 3-0782, he had gotten the term "Pure White Angel," which matched perfectly.
"That’s right. The three current deities were once the three Angel Kings serving the ’Ancient Sun God,’" Ebner nodded slightly.
"All three gods fall under what you summarized as ’omniscience and omnipotence’... That’s also the authority of the one worshiped in Silver City as the ’Omniscient and Omnipotent Lord’... In other words, the three gods betrayed Him, causing His fall, and split His authority among themselves, which created the ’Forsaken Land of the Gods’?
"And the ’God of Knowledge,’ because he first defected from the dragons to the Ancient Sun God, and later stole His authority to become a god, is why he’s mockingly called the ’Turncoat Dragon’?"
Klein reasoned based on his knowledge, feeling regret at the Ancient Sun God’s fall.
After all, Ebner had mentioned before that the "Ancient Sun God" had also been a Transmigrator. Though his method of transmigration was different from Klein’s, the Goddess’s, Roselle’s, and Liu Bo’s, it still made Klein empathize deeply.
"More or less, but not entirely correct... In fact, the one who killed that Russian was the ’Rose of Redemption,’ and the ’Rose of Redemption’ was essentially created by his alt account, the Dark Angel Saslier," Ebner explained briefly, not delving further. After all, Klein was facing a situation similar to the Russian’s. If he learned too much before reaching demigod level, it might bring about unwanted consequences.
Although the "Fate Compass" couldn’t show him clear fate tributaries, Ebner could still faintly sense certain hazy "premonitions."
Russian? So the Ancient Sun God was Russian? But why would he have his alt account lead people to kill him? Did the alt account develop its own consciousness and betray him?
While pondering, Klein asked again, "Why did the Ancient Sun God do that?"
To this, Ebner only smiled without answering, raising the diary in his hand instead.
Klein immediately understood: This was Ebner’s way of saying
my diary can only trade for previous answers.
Sighing, Klein didn’t press further. He had already gained plenty today. He gathered his thoughts, then pulled out the diary page he had just received from Miss "Justice" and handed it to Ebner.
Since this page wasn’t something Ebner urgently needed, and because Klein was also interested in the experiment from eleven years ago and wanted Ebner’s opinion, he shared it freely.
Ebner read it carefully, noting the hysteria revealed in Roselle’s writing. He frowned and thought to himself:
"From this diary page, it’s very likely that the experiment eleven years ago was a ritual Roselle designed for the five girls who could potentially become ’guides’ for Outer Gods. Its purpose was probably to use other kinds of primordial substances to seal away the influence of the Mother Goddess of Depravity!
"In that case, my earlier guess about their innate attribute—that they must engage in reproduction to trigger their special abilities—finally makes sense...
"But there’s a problem. Roselle in his later years didn’t even hesitate to use his eldest son Charles’s illegitimate descendants, the Surreys. How could he truly care about a few inexplicable ’daughters’ from the moon?
"Hmm, assuming those five girls really were his ’children’ from the moon...
"Then it must have been because some existence influenced him... The most likely one being the Mother Goddess of Depravity!
"What was Her purpose?
"To use that ritual as a means to contact the ’Brood’?
"So when the Brood didn’t respond, he thought the ritual failed and abandoned them?
"The ’Seal of Calamity’ must have interfered as well. At the very least, the location of the ’God’s Coffer’ was something it ’accidentally’ leaked to Old Huang.
"So what exactly was its plan there?
"Hmm... Maybe to figure out what the Seal of Calamity did, I need to find all five survivors and study the secrets hidden in their bodies, reconstructing the ritual imprinted deep within them..."
As his thoughts raced, Ebner shared part of his deductions with Klein, who agreed. But the fifth survivor hidden in Backlund still had no clues, so the matter had to be set aside for now.
Next, Klein entrusted Ebner with a task: to go to the capital of East Chester County and retrieve the original page of the diary that Miss "Justice" had submitted, to prevent the "power" it radiated from causing real harm.
Ebner felt it wasn’t difficult and agreed casually.
After that, the two discussed the sea of divine war ruins for a while... And before the small meeting ended, when Klein asked if Ebner had any final additions, the latter thought for a moment and offered two pieces of advice:
"First, write a letter to that ’little snake’ in Backlund. He will help you.
"Second, if you encounter mortal danger, try praying to the Goddess..."
...
Monday afternoon, four o’clock. At the Harvest Church on Rose Street in the Southbridge District, Backlund.
Ebner looked complicated as he gazed at the holy emblem of the "Earth Mother Goddess" engraved on the outer wall—an infant surrounded by symbols of wheat, flowers, and spring water. He then took a deep breath, gathered his courage, and pushed open the church doors.
After all, this visit was different. Having recalled all of Giuseppe’s memories, his mindset was no longer the same as before.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 906: Conversation with Lilith
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Conversation with Lilith
Because it was not yet time for Holy Communion, the Harvest Church had no believers inside. Only Father Utravsky, who looked half-giant, was sitting at the front, praying devoutly.
Because of the Tarot Club this afternoon, Emlyn should be at his own home, so he is not here. And Haylor is most likely busy preparing for the banquet invitation tonight, so she has not come to the church either...
With these thoughts flashing through his mind, Ebner slowly walked up to the half-giant bishop and raised his head.
Bishop Utravsky put down his hands, opened his eyes, and said kindly, "Go down by yourself. The Earth Mother already knows of your arrival."
Ebner had originally wanted to exchange a few words with the bishop, but hearing this, he could only nod and reply, "Alright."
After all, he could not let a deity wait idly in the basement... even if that deity had a somewhat complicated relationship with him.
Passing through the stone door engraved with the "Holy Emblem of Life" and numerous mysterious symbols forming a complete seal, Ebner once again saw the beautiful figure with silver hair.
However, this time, knowing that the "shell" of the Goddess of Beauty before him was actually the product of his own "remains" ascending, Ebner’s gaze toward her was inevitably a little strange... though it did not stop him from admiring her beauty.
"It seems you have already explored that place." Lilith, who had once more descended into the body of the Goddess of Beauty, was the first to speak with a smile.
Ebner carefully studied his body, now completely transformed into female form, and noticed that she was still wearing the same red shirt he had once worn as a Vampire Duke. Although it was actually quite a fine mystical item, he still found it a little "shabby."
Next time I come, I need to prepare a few good-looking outfits for myself... no, for Lilith. In my memory, Lamia actually loved wearing pretty clothes, and even changed into quite a few "anime" styles just to please me.
After muttering inwardly, Ebner nodded slightly on the surface and said, "Yes... I recalled what happened when I was Felipe."
Felipe was the alias Ebner had given himself when he was Giuseppe Castiya.
At this point, he could not help but ask, "Do you know how Lamia is now?"
"Lamia may have been my avatar, but at the time, she—or rather I—did not know my true nature... Later, while searching for you, she encountered danger and perished," Lilith replied casually.
"How did she die?" Ebner frowned and asked.
"I ran into Sia... You know, Lamia’s strength was only at the level of an Ancient Alchemist. She could not possibly have been the opponent of a Spawn of God." Lilith smiled as she responded, as though speaking of someone other than herself.
Sia? Why would It attack Lamia? Wait... I remember Lilith once said that the ’material’ used for Lamia’s avatar was the same as Miss Plant, taken from some ’unknown’ plant. That plant was attractive to the Mother Tree of Desire? But if she used that material to create an avatar, Lilith could not have been unaware of this...
"So, Lamia being killed by Sia was also part of your plan?" Ebner thought this and asked aloud.
Lilith only curved her lips into a smile and remained silent.
Ebner immediately realized that there were things Lilith could not say, otherwise the Mother Tree of Desire would inevitably sense them. After pondering for a while, he tentatively asked, "Does it have something to do with the event where the Mother Tree of Desire tried to infect the Tenebrous World through the sea monster’s mind?"
After ascending to demigod and deepening his connection with the All-Knowing Eye and the Pure White Angel in the Land of Evernight, Ebner had discovered that the memory seal was lifted. He could now freely think about matters related to the Old Ones without being polluted.
Lilith raised a finger to his lips and said meaningfully, "Some things you should understand in your heart, but don’t always say them out loud... Otherwise, even you cannot fully block that one’s perception."
As she spoke, she suddenly stepped forward, leaned to Ebner’s ear, her gaze half-hidden, lips almost touching as she whispered, "I can only tell you this—the imprint of the Tenebrous World, after being stripped away by the God of Fortune, once entered that ’unknown’ space."
Feeling her breath at his ear and catching her fragrance at his nose, Ebner cursed inwardly. The goddess before him was truly adept at using her body and words to create an ambiguous atmosphere...
And she’s using my own body, too...
Ebner felt an uncomfortable reaction in a sensitive place and had to divert his attention, thinking instead about the meaning behind Lilith’s words.
Since the pollution in the Land of Evernight most likely comes from the concept of "Liu Bo"... That means the imprint of the Tenebrous World had already taken the form of Liu Bo? Then my earlier guess was broadly correct—indeed, the Tenebrous World was a trap prepared for the Mother Tree of Desire... But Lamia... her essence was a special plant... Could it be that she was a suitable vessel of spirit and power for the Mother Tree? Wait... that ’Proof of Lost Mind’ necklace... could it have once been Lamia? If that is true, then the Mother Tree of Desire was probably ensnared from the very beginning. Hah, ’Unknown’ plants... always unknown! If my speculation is correct, then the reason Lamia was arranged to stay by my side for those years might also have been to continue nurturing her essence in the Land of Evernight...
Although Ebner was very certain that the feelings he had shared with Lamia were genuine—after all, Lilith herself admitted that much of her current humanity stemmed from that period—he still held a degree of wariness toward deities. He could not fully believe her motives were so simple... even if she behaved as though she were his wife, his lover.
But I can’t just ask her directly why she treats me with such indulgence... the consequences would be unpredictable... and I don’t have the strength to survive a bad end right now!
Taking a deep breath, Ebner shifted the topic and asked something else: "Do you know about the ritual Roselle designed, the one held eleven years ago? That was likely the plan of the Fallen Mother Goddess."
Seeing that Ebner remained unmoved by her teasing, Lilith deliberately stepped back a few paces and shook her head with a smile. "I am not all-knowing and almighty... If I had known in advance, that experiment would never have been carried out. Hmm, this should have been planned by the you of the Calamity Seal together with ’Knowledge’ or Adam. I do not know the details... That version of you was rather special. Neither I nor the Evernight Goddess had much interaction with you, only watching from afar."
You and the Evernight Goddess... Could it be that the Goddess really is...?
Remembering how terrifying she was in the original story, the pressure in Ebner’s heart surged, though outwardly he pressed, "What was special about the Calamity Seal?"
"That is something you must uncover yourself. I cannot tell you directly. But, I can give you a hint... Why do you think that whether it was the God of Fortune, or Rhein, or Vicente... in so many of your lives, you always stopped at Sequence 2?"

chapters.title: Chapter 907: Attempt at a Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Attempt at a Breakthrough
Other than the Calamity Seal, had all the rest of "me" stopped at Sequence 2?
It really did seem to be the case...
This should not have been an issue of lacking materials.
Judging from the earlier incident when the Wheel of Fortune actively entered the Pure White Eye and stepped into the Unknown, back then, as the God of Fortune, I must have already wielded it...
And at that time, Will most likely had not yet become the Sequence 1 Serpent of Mercury. With my "luck" and the external aid at my disposal, finding that Sequence 1 and advancing with it should not have been difficult.
But for some reason, I had chosen not to do so...
That lifetime as Rhine Karenardia, the Observer of the Silver Eye, was also similar. Aside from the Blood Moon Queen and Lilith, who each held one characteristic of the Goddess of Beauty, there should have been another one lost outside, yet Rhine seemed to have shown no signs of deliberately seeking it.
As for Vicente Miranda, the Lord of the Dead, there was no need to even mention him. From the historical projection I had drawn out in the Land of Evernight, it was clear he had always possessed the "0"-level sealed artifact, the Pallid Death, formed from the Sequence 1 Pale Emperor’s characteristic!
It was worth noting that the sealed artifact had originally slumbered together with Vicente in a tomb deep in the city of Calderón. But later, in his twilight years, Roselle entered that tomb and took away the Pallid Death.
In summary, in the three lifetimes of mine with the greatest achievements, there had been opportunities to advance to Sequence 1, yet in the end I had never succeeded, or I had simply given up...
Was it because I could not, or because I dared not?
Hmm, in one of Roselle’s key diary entries, he recorded words revealed by the Calamity Seal. He said only by becoming a Sequence 1 could one search within the Unknown and retrieve all of one’s past memories...
Could this "all memories" have carried some hidden issue?
Was that why the Calamity Seal was so peculiar... why it felt completely unlike me?
Given what I knew about myself, even faced with tremendous threats, I would never have been content to remain at Sequence 2. I would have tried every possible way to overcome it.
Maybe... the matter of traversing into a "0"-level sealed artifact was itself one of my attempts?
I remembered that the latter half of The Feast of Blood recorded a ritual spell called the "Sealed Artifact Vitalization Ritual." By praying to an Unknown existence and offering a sacrifice, one could grant a chosen sealed artifact the property of being "alive."
At the time, I had thought the ritual carried too many variables, with uncertain outcomes. So although not very difficult, it had seemed impractical... But thinking back now, perhaps in that lifetime as Rhine, "I" had already thought of trying something similar. That magic was merely a prototype, or a preliminary step toward some ritual.
But the direct attempt to become the Sequence 1 sealed artifact, the Calamity Seal, must have run into problems, and ultimately failed...
That was why I was now myself as the Reader... Yet I still did not know what sort of path the former me had left for the current me.
Heh, I must criticize that self of mine as Giuseppe Castiya. All he did was indulge in "pleasures." In the memories, aside from "enjoyment," there was nothing else... Truly disgraceful.
As a Prophet, Ebner was skilled in both logical deduction and mystical reasoning. Very quickly, he organized his thoughts and roughly guessed part of his former intentions.
"It seems the most critical lifetimes were Alwyn the Wanderer, Dannet the Silent Disciple, the Arcane Demon, and the Calamity Seal.
"Alwyn should have set the overall direction. Dannet, together with that Dragon of Twenty-Five, ran numerous experiments, eliminated certain plans, and even produced many by-products and branch schemes.
"That lifetime as the Arcane Demon, though still unclear what exactly was done, just so happened to be on the Artisan pathway, so it must have laid the groundwork for the later transition into the Calamity Seal.
"And the Calamity Seal was in some ways similar to Roselle in his later years. On the one hand, it prepared all kinds of conveniences for me now. On the other, it refused to let me obtain them easily, even setting up numerous obstacles...
"This might be the surface symptom of its own problems!
"The series of times it sabotaged Roselle afterwards, though meant to conceal its own small moves within Roselle’s actions, still revealed certain contradictions!
"It is worth noting that Lilith and the Goddess likely did not support this attempt of the Calamity Seal. So they only observed, set up a few casual arrangements, but offered no assistance, forcing it to cooperate with the God of Knowledge or with Adam...
"The attempt they favored was most likely me now, as the Reader!"
As his thoughts spun, Ebner could not be sure that his guesses were absolutely correct, but he felt they fit well with his own way of acting, and they did have some basis.
Of course, that "basis" lay in his understanding of himself and... his intuition!
Afterwards, Ebner tried to probe Lilith using part of his guesses, but all he received was her enchanting smile.
Realizing Lilith would not reveal anything further, Ebner felt a bit disappointed, yet quickly adjusted his mood.
Glancing at his pocket watch, he saw that it was already late and the banquet at his home would soon begin. He hurriedly bid farewell to Lilith, then almost fled from the underground chamber.
Only when he once more saw Bishop Utravsky’s towering figure did he finally breathe a sigh of relief and calm his restless emotions.
Recalling some of Lilith’s parting hints, Ebner felt overwhelmed in his heart.
But after all, that was my own body. If it really came to that... it would be far too strange!
If it had been Lamia here instead, perhaps I truly would not have left so quickly.
Unfortunately... all thanks to Sia!
With a few sighs of regret, Ebner returned by teleportation to the villa at 28 Kinst Street, carrying feelings that were a mix of relief and remorse.
.....
Night over the Sonia Sea.
Staring at the undulating sea surface outside the cabin, Klein relied on his "night vision" ability and finally spotted the port city, its houses built mainly of white stone.
The easternmost colony of the Feysac Empire, capital of the Gargas Archipelago—Nass!
"At last we’re here... To avoid the hurricane, this ship went off course, forcing us to risk sailing into harbor at night..." Watching the vessel he had boarded, a passenger ship of typical Feysac style, its rough and solid presence almost tangible, Klein let out a sigh.
At the same time, he noticed many ships flying pirate flags moored at the port, without the least concern.
As expected, this sea region has already become a paradise for pirates...
Klein set his hat in place, picked up his luggage, carefully packed away the wolf-fish cans, and only after the steamer had come to a halt did he leave the cabin, descend the gangplank, and step onto the dock, heading toward the street beyond.
His first impression of this city called Nass was that most houses were white, with stone widely used as material. Secondly, though not located too far north, the climate was bitterly cold. Even though it was already April, the temperature was only a few degrees Celsius. Thirdly, there were many whaling houses, where massive white whales were butchered into hide, meat, fat, bones, and "ambergris."
The last two were particularly valuable: the bones could be used as skirt supports for evening gowns, while ambergris was a top-grade spice. Whether as incense or perfume ingredient, it was a luxury only nobles and the wealthy could afford.
As for the whale hide, meat, and fat, they each had their uses—clothing, food, oil refining. In Nass and across the Gargas Archipelago, the cooking of whale had already developed into a unique culture, with various methods and famous restaurants.
"Quite distinctive! Perhaps I can buy some fresh ingredients here and let Shoko work with them, so my Food Attendant can develop a few more signature dishes."
As these pleasant thoughts drifted in his mind, Klein walked into a bar named "Rodar"—which in the local language meant "Dawn." It was a gathering place for adventurers of the archipelago and also a hub for information.
Since he had arrived two days earlier than expected, Klein was in no rush to visit Admiral of Stars Cattleya’s contact point. Instead, he planned to first find the "Alchemy Master" recommended by Roy King, and use the Black Knight characteristic to upgrade the Creeping Hunger.
After ordering a glass of strong Nippos, burning hot like flame, the bartender pointed to a lady drinking glass beer alone in a corner. "If you’re looking for ’Nass’s Idiot,’ you can ask her to lead you. She’s the agent of that old man right now."
Right now? Does that mean the master’s agent often changes?
Pondering this, Klein looked toward the solitary woman. After a few glances, he suddenly found her familiar, as if he had seen her somewhere before...
He was about to use divination to recall, but the woman seemed to sense his gaze and suddenly turned her head to look back at him.
As their eyes met, Klein immediately remembered who she was:
"Mr. Tower’s friend... descendant of Liu Bo...
"Miss Jane Grant Miranda?"

chapters.title: Chapter 908: Floating City?
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: Floating City?
Although the girl across from him had painted her face with all kinds of makeup, making her originally youthful features appear much more mature, Klein, who still remembered vividly that "live broadcast" sea battle, instantly recognized her true identity—the Lady Scythe, Jane Grant Miranda, with a bounty of 7,000 gold pounds.
At the same time, Jane, who had locked eyes with Klein, was even more shocked than he was. Her hands clenched involuntarily, her body tensed, and while her eyes fixed on him, she also used her peripheral vision to quickly scan the surroundings, looking for an escape route.
For more than a month now, she had been in Nauth, and whether by choice or not, she had grown far more aware of the various rumors at sea than when she was aboard the Future.
And the name Gehrman Sparrow had recently become the most famous one on the seas!
Even without deliberately prying, Jane had seen his photographs and heard stories about this adventurer from different channels—from the killing of "Steel" Mavit, to helping Vice Admiral of Ailment Tracy resist the pursuit of the Demoness Sect, to successfully hunting several pirates with bounties over 7,000 pounds. All of it revealed the madness lurking in his character.
He left the Rorsted Archipelago and came to the Gargas Islands? Why is he looking at me like that... As if he recognized who I am... Could it be that he wants to hunt me?!
But most of my weapons and extraordinary items aren’t with me. To summon my undead to fetch them and undo their seals would take some time...
Calm down, Jane... He doesn’t seem to have malicious intent... Or at least, he doesn’t look like he’s about to act immediately.
Suppressing the instinctive fear and unease rising in her heart, Jane watched Klein, who was about to walk past her seat, and said in a deep voice:
"Mr. Gehrman... don’t come any closer!
